The authors suggest this regimen may have potential for intracavitary treatment of human ovarian cancer when combined with systemic calcium leucovorin rescue.

title: Impaired susceptibility of human trophoblast to MHC nonrestricted killer cells: implication in the maternal-fetal relationship.
title_ja: ヒト栄養膜細胞のMHC非拘束性キラー細胞に対する感受性低下：母児関係への示唆
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来を含む培養細胞株21種に対し、NK細胞とLAK細胞の細胞傷害性を比較した研究です。絨毛癌由来の5株でLAK細胞による溶解が低下し、共通の標的分子の減少が示唆されました。この感受性低下は半同種の胎児の生存に寄与する可能性があり、母児の免疫関係への示唆があります。
summary_en: This study tested whether human trophoblastic tumor cells resist MHC-nonrestricted killer cells, comparing NK and LAK cytotoxicity across 21 cultured cell lines. Five choriocarcinoma-derived lines showed decreased LAK lysis. Cold-target inhibition and TNP modification experiments indicated a reduced common target molecule recognized by LAK effectors. The authors propose that this impaired susceptibility of trophoblast to killer cells may be functional for survival of the semiallogeneic fetus, linking the finding to maternal-fetal immune relations.

title: Long-term effects of testicular cancer on sexual functioning in married couples.
title_ja: 精巣がんが夫婦の性機能に与える長期的影響
summary_ja: 精巣がん治療終了の約4年後、34組の夫婦の双方に個別面接を行った研究です。性機能と妊孕性に関する患者と配偶者の回答を比較しました。患者の23.5%が治療後に魅力が低下したと感じており、性的満足度の低下も多く報告されました。配偶者との回答の一致度は全体的に高いものでした。
summary_en: This study interviewed both members of 34 married couples about four years after testicular cancer treatment ended, comparing their responses on psychosexual functioning and fertility. Patients were more likely than spouses to feel less attractive and reported decreased sexual satisfaction. Both groups more often reported decreased intercourse frequency. Concordance between spouses was generally high. Few couples saw infertility as a problem, yet 53% were parents, and men who banked sperm were less likely to already have children.

title: Testicular seminoma. Results of the Yale University experience, 1964-1984.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対するイェール大学での経験（1964〜1984年）
summary_ja: 1964〜1984年にイェール大学で放射線療法を受けた精巣セミノーマ83例の解析。病期Iおよび病期IIの大半で15年生存率は95%、再発は病期Iの1例のみ（照射野辺縁）であった。進行例では化学療法併用で生存した1例が唯一の無病生存者であった。術後放射線療法は病期Iおよび病期IIのセミノーマに有効な治療選択肢と結論づけられている。
summary_en: This Yale University series reviewed 83 testicular seminoma patients treated with radiation therapy between 1964 and 1984. Most had early disease: 61 stage I, 15 stage IIA, and 3 stage IIB. The 15-year survival rate was 95%. Only one stage I patient relapsed, at the field margin, and no stage II patients recurred. Among four patients with advanced disease, the only disease-free survivor received cisplatin-based chemotherapy plus radiation. Minor radiation complications occurred, and the 15-year risk of a second malignancy was 3.3%. The authors conclude that postoperative radiation is a successful option for stage I and II seminoma.

title: Are germ cell tumors part of the Li-Fraumeni cancer family syndrome?
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍はLi-Fraumeni癌家系症候群の一部か？
summary_ja: 骨または軟部組織の肉腫を有する小児の親族に発生した胚細胞腫瘍6例（精巣5例、卵巣1例）の報告。著者らは、胚細胞腫瘍がLi-Fraumeni癌家系症候群にみられる癌の遺伝的素因のまれな表現型である可能性を提唱している。症例数が少ないため関連は示唆にとどまり、確認には追加の検証が必要である。
summary_en: This report describes six germ cell tumors (five testicular and one ovarian) occurring in relatives of children with bone or soft tissue sarcomas. The authors propose that germ cell tumors may be an uncommon manifestation of the genetic predisposition to cancer seen in Li-Fraumeni cancer family syndrome. Because this is a small set of clinical observations, the link is suggested rather than proven. Further study would be needed to confirm whether germ cell tumors belong to this familial cancer spectrum.

title: Isochromosome 12p in mediastinal germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍における等染色体12p（i(12p)）
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 縦隔に発生した性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な等染色体12p（i(12p)）が検出された1例の細胞遺伝学的報告。i(12p)は性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍にも生じうることを示す。核型は精巣腫瘍に典型的な近三倍体・近四倍体と異なり近二倍体であり、発生部位による生物学的差異が示唆される。
summary_en: This report describes an extragonadal mediastinal germ cell tumor carrying an isochromosome 12p, a chromosomal abnormality characteristic of testicular germ cell tumors. The finding shows that i(12p) can also arise in germ cell tumors outside the gonads. The patient's karyotype was near-diploid, unlike the near-triploid or near-tetraploid karyotypes typical of testicular tumors. This difference suggests possible biological variation by tumor site. It is a single-patient cytogenetic observation.

title: Choriocarcinoma presenting as an intussusception--a case report.
title_ja: 腸重積として発症した絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 16歳女児が回腸・回腸型腸重積で発症し、原因は絨毛癌であった。文献検索により、この特異な発症形式の絨毛癌は2例目の報告とされる。絨毛癌が腸閉塞として初発しうることを示し、若年者の腸重積の鑑別において留意すべき稀な病態であることを強調している。
summary_en: The report describes a 16-year-old girl who presented with ileo-ileal intussusception caused by choriocarcinoma. Based on a literature review, the authors state that this is only the second reported case of choriocarcinoma presenting in this unusual way. The case shows that choriocarcinoma, usually considered a gestational or germ cell malignancy, can first manifest as bowel obstruction. It is a brief case report from Central Africa that emphasizes the rarity of this presentation in young patients with intussusception.

title: Compaction-defective embryonal carcinoma cell variants.
title_ja: コンパクション欠損胎児性癌細胞変異株
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 化学変異誘発により、H6胎児性癌細胞株からコンパクション（細胞凝集）欠損変異株を2株単離した。自然発生変異体は得られず、F9胎児性癌株やES-D3胚性幹細胞株からも取得できなかった。雑種解析で一方は優性、他方は劣性を示した。胎児性癌細胞を初期胚発生のモデルとして用いた体外培養の細胞生物学研究である。
summary_en: The authors isolated two compaction-defective variants of the H6 embryonal carcinoma cell line after chemical mutagenesis. Compaction is required for morula differentiation, and a similar process occurs in embryonal carcinoma cell aggregates. No spontaneous variants arose, and such variants could not be obtained from F9 embryonal carcinoma or ES-D3 embryonic stem cells. In hybridization tests, one variant behaved as dominant and the other as recessive. The work is an in vitro cell-biology study that uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a model of early embryogenesis.

title: [Clinical study of testicular tumor: tumor tissue content of hCG in seminoma].
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の臨床的研究：セミノーマにおける腫瘍組織中hCG
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の純粋セミノーマ19例、非セミノーマ14例、正常精巣11例において、腫瘍組織と血清のhCGおよびhCG-βを測定。絨毛癌成分を含む非セミノーマで組織内hCGは極めて高値だった。純粋セミノーマの組織hCG-βは正常精巣より有意に高いが、血清hCGは陽性率・値とも低く、腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性は限定的と結論づけている。
summary_en: This Japanese study measured hCG and hCG-beta in tumor tissue and serum of 19 pure seminomas, 14 non-seminomas, and 11 normal testes. Tissue hCG was far higher in non-seminomas containing choriocarcinoma than in pure seminomas. Tissue hCG-beta in pure seminomas was significantly higher than in normal testes but lower than in choriocarcinoma-containing non-seminomas. Positivity and levels of serum hCG were lower in pure seminomas than in non-seminomas. The authors conclude that serum hCG has limited value as a tumor marker for pure seminoma.

title: Synergistic effect of combined intraperitoneal cisplatin and cytosine arabinoside in a murine ovarian cancer model.
title_ja: マウス卵巣奇形癌モデルにおけるシスプラチンとシトシンアラビノシドの腹腔内併用の相乗効果
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス卵巣奇形癌モデルで、腹腔内投与のシスプラチンとシトシンアラビノシドの相乗効果を検討した。両薬剤の同時投与により生存期間の相乗効果が認められ、3日間の連日投与では120日後も全例生存した。著者らは、この3日間スケジュールによる臨床試験を提案している。
summary_en: In a murine ovarian teratocarcinoma model, the authors tested intraperitoneal cisplatin combined with cytosine arabinoside for synergy. Cisplatin alone prolonged survival, and simultaneous combination dosing produced synergy. Daily dosing for three days yielded 100% survival at 120 days. Both agents have favorable pharmacokinetics when given intraperitoneally. The authors conclude that a clinical trial of this three-day schedule is warranted.

title: [The results of radiation therapy of patients with pure seminoma of the testis].
title_ja: 精巣の純粋型セミノーマ患者に対する放射線療法の成績
summary_ja: 精巣の純粋型セミノーマ75例を後方視的に検討し、精巣摘除後に大動脈周囲および同側の腸骨領域へ放射線療法を行った。N0症例は28～30 Gyで全例制御され、N1・N2症例では35 Gy以上が推奨された。合併症や不妊は認められなかった。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 75 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy to periaortic and ipsilateral iliac fields after orchiectomy. All patients with N0 disease receiving 28-30 Gy were controlled and alive. Higher doses of 35 Gy or more were recommended for N1 and N2 disease. No treatment complications and no induced sterility were observed, supporting 30 Gy for N0 disease.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ developing in dermoid cyst of the ovary. Report of a case with laminin immunohistochemical staining demonstrating basement membrane integrity.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫内に発生した扁平上皮癌in situ：基底膜の保持をラミニン免疫染色で示した症例報告
summary_ja: 30歳女性の右卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた扁平上皮癌in situの症例である。ラミニン免疫染色で基底膜が保たれ、in situ病変であることを確認した。予後は腫瘍の浸潤度に依存するため温存手術が可能となり、4年後も良好な経過であった。
summary_en: A 30-year-old woman had squamous cell carcinoma in situ arising in a dermoid cyst of the right ovary. Laminin immunostaining demonstrated intact basement membranes, confirming the in situ nature of the lesion. Because prognosis depends on the degree of tumor penetration, conservative surgery could be performed. Four years later the patient remained well, supporting the diagnosis and the value of laminin labelling in excluding invasive carcinoma.

title: Surgical excision of pulmonary metastases from primary testicular cancer--case reports.
title_ja: 原発性精巣がんの肺転移に対する外科的切除：症例報告
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性の原発精巣がんに伴う肺転移を外科的切除した3症例を報告する。化学療法後に残存病変が部分奏効または無効の場合に手術が検討された。組織所見は壊死や良性変化から生存腫瘍まで多様で、以後の治療方針の決定に役立った。
summary_en: This case series describes three patients who underwent surgical excision of pulmonary metastases from nonseminomatous primary testicular cancer. Surgery was considered after chemotherapy when residual lesions persisted with partial or no response. Histology ranged from necrotic lesions and benign transformation to viable tumor. These findings guided whether to continue or change further chemotherapy.

title: The effect of interleukin-1 alpha and tumor necrosis factor alpha on the secretion of human chorionic gonadotropin by JAR human choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: JAR絨毛癌細胞によるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン分泌に対するインターロイキン1αおよび腫瘍壊死因子αの作用
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARを用い、組換えインターロイキン1αと腫瘍壊死因子αがhCG分泌に及ぼす影響を検討した。IL-1αは用量依存的にhCG産生を増加させ、加熱処理で効果が消失した。TNFαはhCG産生と細胞生存に影響しなかった。IL-1が栄養膜細胞のhCG産生を制御する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Using JAR human choriocarcinoma cells, the authors examined whether recombinant interleukin-1 alpha and tumor necrosis factor alpha regulate hCG secretion. IL-1 alpha increased hCG production in a dose-dependent manner, and heat inactivation abolished this effect. TNF-alpha had no effect on hCG output or cell viability. The results suggest IL-1 may regulate trophoblastic hCG production and that the two cytokines diverge in reproductive regulation.

title: Benign cystic teratoma of the ovary rupturing into the rectum: a rare problem.
title_ja: 卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫の直腸破裂：稀な病態
summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫が直腸へ破裂し、排便習慣の変化として発症した症例を報告する。嚢腫内に便が充満して直腸を圧迫していた。卵巣奇形腫の腸管への破裂は稀であり、一般的な良性腫瘍の非典型的な発症形式として注目される。
summary_en: This case report describes a benign cystic ovarian teratoma that ruptured into the rectum and presented as a change in bowel habit. Faeces filled the cyst and compressed the rectum. Rupture of an ovarian cystic teratoma into the bowel is rare. The authors highlight it as an unusual presentation of a common benign neoplasm.

title: Ovarian and cervical thyroid struma. A case report.
title_ja: 卵巣および子宮頸部甲状腺腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 24歳女性の症例で、右甲状腺の濾胞性腺腫に加え、偶然見つかった左骨盤内嚢胞性腫瘤を認めました。開腹で卵巣由来の良性甲状腺組織からなる嚢胞性腫瘍が確認され、卵巣甲状腺腫と診断されました。患者は無症状で甲状腺機能亢進症はありませんでした。卵巣甲状腺腫は稀で、甲状腺機能亢進を伴うのは約1/4とされています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with a right thyroid follicular adenoma and an incidentally found left pelvic cystic mass. At laparotomy the mass was a cystic tumor composed of benign thyroid tissue arising from the left ovary, consistent with struma ovarii. The patient was clinically asymptomatic with no hyperthyroidism. The authors review that struma ovarii is rare and is seen with hyperthyroidism in only about one quarter of cases, and classify patients into hyperthyroid, ascitic, and asymptomatic groups.

title: Malignant and normally developing trophoblastic cells of human placenta display different characteristics defined by histochemical and biochemical mapping of endogenous lectins.
title_ja: ヒト胎盤の悪性栄養膜細胞と正常発育栄養膜細胞は、内在性レクチンの組織化学的および生化学的マッピングにより異なる特徴を示す
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛上皮腫(絨毛癌)組織と妊娠初期の正常栄養膜細胞について、標識ネオ糖タンパク質を用いて糖鎖受容体(レクチン)の発現を比較しました。両者の間には明らかな違いがあり、正常細胞では成熟に伴い結合が減少しました。この違いは、栄養膜細胞の浸潤・接着性に関係している可能性があると考察されています。
summary_en: This study compares lectin and sugar-receptor expression in malignant chorionepithelioma (choriocarcinoma) tissue and normal early-gestation placental trophoblast using labelled neoglycoproteins and glycohistochemistry. Controls excluded glycosidase or glycosyltransferase artifacts. Pronounced differences were found in receptors for glucosides, N-acetylgalactosamine, N-acetylglucosamine and other carbohydrates, and normal trophoblast binding decreased with maturation. The authors suggest that transient early-pregnancy lectins may relate to the invasive and adhesive behavior of trophoblast and chorionepithelioma.

title: [A case of mediastinal immature teratoma with elevated levels of CA19-9].
title_ja: CA19-9高値を伴った縦隔未熟奇形腫の症例報告
summary_ja: 15歳女性の縦隔前部の大きな腫瘤の症例です。術前に血清CA19-9が高値を示し、切除標本の病理検査で未熟奇形腫と診断されました。腫瘍内液のCA19-9も高値で、腫瘍内には膵・気管支・腸管様上皮に陽性所見がみられました。術後にCA19-9は正常化し、経過は良好でした。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍でCA19-9が検出された報告は従来なく、症例の蓄積が必要とされています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old woman with a large anterior mediastinal mass and elevated preoperative serum CA19-9. Pathology after resection confirmed an immature teratoma. CA19-9 was also elevated in tumor fluid, and immunostaining showed positivity in pancreatic, bronchial, and intestinal-type epithelium within the tumor. CA19-9 normalized after surgery and the postoperative course was satisfactory. The authors note that no prior mediastinal germ cell tumor has been reported with CA19-9 elevation, calling for more cases.

title: [Treatment of a patient with mediastinal germinoma and with rare anomaly of congenital subclavian steal phenomenon].
title_ja: 先天性鎖骨下動脈盗血現象を伴う縦隔ジャーミノーマ患者の治療
summary_ja: 40歳男性の前縦隔ジャーミノーマの症例で、心タンポナーデを合併していました。シスプラチン、ビンデシン、ペプロマイシンによる化学療法2コースで腫瘍が著明に縮小したのち、完全な外科的切除を実施しました。術後は化学療法1コースと40Gyの放射線療法を行い、術後7か月の時点で再発はありません。右大動脈弓と先天性鎖骨下動脈盗血現象も合併していました。
summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old man with anterior mediastinal germinoma complicated by cardiac tamponade. Two courses of cisplatin, vindesine and peplomycin chemotherapy shrank the tumor markedly before complete surgical resection. After surgery he received one more chemotherapy course and 40 Gy of radiotherapy and remained recurrence-free at 7 months. The patient also had a right aortic arch and congenital subclavian steal phenomenon, rare anomalies that the authors note were not previously reported together with a mediastinal tumor.

title: Hereditary sacrococcygeal teratomas.
title_ja: 遺伝性仙尾部奇形腫
summary_ja: 奇形腫の家族性発症を示した家族の報告です。父親は髄膜瘤が疑われ、その2人の子どもは仙尾部奇形腫を有し、そのうち1人には前方髄膜瘤を伴っていました。遺伝性仙骨前奇形腫とその関連奇形は過去6家系で報告されており、本報告はその文献に加わるものです。
summary_en: This report describes a family with hereditary sacrococcygeal teratomas. The father presented with a presumed meningocele, while his two children both had sacrococcygeal teratomas, one with an associated anterior meningocele. The authors note that hereditary presacral teratoma with associated anomalies has been described in six previous kindreds, and add this family to that literature. The case highlights the familial occurrence of these tumors and their association with spinal malformations.

title: Neonatal diagnosis of a presacral mass in the presence of congenital anal stenosis and partial sacral agenesis.
title_ja: 先天性肛門狭窄および部分的仙骨無形成を伴う仙骨前腫瘤の新生児診断
summary_ja: 生後1日の男児で、肛門狭窄、三日月状仙骨、前後の髄膜瘤に加え、仙骨前奇形腫を認めた症例です。メトリザミド脊髄造影と三次元CT再構成を組み合わせた画像法で診断しました。後方到達法で髄膜瘤と脊髄係留を修復し、人工肛門造設後に閉鎖しました。術後2年の時点で良好な経過です。仙骨前腫瘤、仙骨形成異常、直腸肛門奇形の3徴候がある場合は、仙骨前奇形の精査が必要と提唱されています。
summary_en: This report describes a 1-day-old boy with anal stenosis, a scimitar-shaped sacrum, large anterior and posterior meningoceles, and a presacral teratoma. A new radiographic approach combining metrizamide myelography and three-dimensional CT reconstruction allowed diagnosis. The meningoceles and tethered cord were corrected through a posterior approach, and a colostomy was performed and later reversed. At two years the child was doing well. The authors propose that this triad of presacral mass, sacral dysgenesis and anorectal malformation should prompt investigation for presacral malformation.

title: Ambiguous genitalia, gonadoblastoma, aniridia and mental retardation with deletion of chromosome 11.
title_ja: 曖昧性器、性腺芽腫、無虹彩症、知的障害および染色体11番の欠失
summary_ja: 曖昧性器、性腺芽腫、無虹彩症、知的障害を有し、染色体11番(11p13)の欠失を伴う46,XY症例です。性腺芽腫は性腺形成異常に伴う胚細胞腫瘍の一型で、性分化疾患との関連が知られています。この組み合わせは過去2例の報告しかなく、稀な遺伝型と表現型の関係を示すものです。
summary_en: This report describes a patient with ambiguous genitalia, gonadoblastoma, aniridia, and intellectual disability with a 46,XY karyotype carrying a deletion of chromosome 11 at 11p13. Gonadoblastoma is a germ cell neoplasm associated with dysgenetic gonads and disorders of sex development. The authors note that this combination of features has been observed in only two previous patients, making it a rare genotype-phenotype association relevant to gonadoblastoma development.

title: Supernumerary chromosome 1 in interphase nuclei of atypical germ cells in paraffin-embedded human seminiferous tubules.
title_ja: ヒト精細管の異型胚細胞の間期核にみられる1番染色体の過剰
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: パラフィン包埋したヒト精細管内の異型胚細胞、すなわちセミノーマ様細胞の前駆病変を調べた研究です。1q12領域のDNAプローブを用いた解析で、異型胚細胞を含む管内核の3分の1に3つのシグナルがみられ、正常な腸管や精原細胞は2つでした。これは、前がん細胞の染色体解析を発生源の組織上で直接行えることを示しています。
summary_en: This study examined atypical germ cells, the precursor of testicular germ cell tumors resembling seminoma cells, in paraffin-embedded human seminiferous tubules. Using a chromosome 1q12 DNA probe in situ, one-third of intratubular nuclei containing atypical germ cells showed three hybridization signals, whereas normal intestine and spermatogonia showed two. This demonstrates that cytogenetic analysis of precancerous cells can be performed directly on the originating tissue, and reveals a chromosome 1 gain in a precursor of seminoma.

title: Early stage pure seminoma testis.
title_ja: 早期病期の純粋精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 早期病期の純粋精巣セミノーマ患者43例を対象とした後方視的研究である。精巣摘除術と放射線療法で治療し、経過観察期間は4.3～17.4年、全生存率は97.7%であった。病期Iセミノーマに対するこの治療アプローチの長期成績を示している。
summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 43 patients with early-stage pure testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy and radiation therapy. Follow-up ranged from 4.3 to 17.4 years, and overall survival was 97.7%. The report documents long-term outcomes of this treatment approach for stage I seminoma, offering historical benchmark survival data for this germ cell tumor subtype.

title: An immunohistochemical study of neuropeptides and neuronal cytoskeletal proteins in the neuroepithelial component of a spontaneous murine ovarian teratoma. Primitive neuroepithelium displays immunoreactivity for neuropeptides and neuron-associated beta-tubulin isotype.
title_ja: 自然発生マウス卵巣奇形腫の神経上皮成分における神経ペプチドおよび神経細胞骨格タンパク質の免疫組織化学的研究：原始神経上皮は神経ペプチドおよび神経関連βチューブリンアイソタイプに免疫反応性を示す
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: LTXBO系統マウスに自然発生する卵巣奇形腫の神経上皮成分を免疫組織化学的に解析した研究である。原始神経上皮は神経ペプチドやクラスIIIβチューブリンを発現し、神経細胞への初期分化を示唆した。未分化幹細胞やアストログリアは一般的なβチューブリンのみを発現した。ヒト胎児性腫瘍の神経上皮分化の研究にも応用可能な知見である。
summary_en: This study characterizes spontaneous ovarian teratomas in LTXBO mice, which contain a large neuroepithelial component. Immunohistochemistry showed that primitive neuroepithelial rosettes express neuropeptides such as somatostatin and neuropeptide Y, along with neuron-associated class III β-tubulin, while stem cells and astroglia express only general β-tubulin. The findings indicate early neuronal commitment in neoplastic primitive neuroepithelium and provide a framework for analyzing neuroepithelial differentiation in embryonal tumors.

title: Primary choriocarcinoma of the lung in a man.
title_ja: 男性にみられた原発性肺絨毛癌
summary_ja: 中年男性に発生した非妊娠性・性腺外の絨毛癌の症例です。剖検により腫瘍が肺由来であることが確認されました。免疫組織化学染色でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が陽性を示し、絨毛性の起源が裏付けられました。妊娠歴のない原発性肺絨毛癌という稀な病態を示しています。
summary_en: This report describes a middle-aged man with nongestational, extragonadal choriocarcinoma that originated in the lung, confirmed at autopsy. The trophoblastic origin was demonstrated by immunoperoxidase staining for human chorionic gonadotropin, supporting the diagnosis of a primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma. The case highlights that choriocarcinoma can arise outside the gonads without a gestational precedent, a rare presentation relevant to the germ cell tumor spectrum.

title: Cytogenetic analysis of ten human seminomas.
title_ja: ヒトセミノーマ10例の細胞遺伝学的解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒトのセミノーマ10例について、腫瘍細胞を直接採取して細胞遺伝学的解析を行いました。modal染色体数は63から112の範囲で、フローサイトメトリーによるDNA量測定と一致しました。8例で少なくとも1コピーのi(12p)が認められ、2例では認められませんでした。
summary_en: This study performed cytogenetic analysis on ten human seminomas harvested directly from tumor cells. Modal chromosome numbers ranged from 63 to 112, consistent with flow cytometric DNA content. Eight tumors carried at least one i(12p) abnormality, while two lacked it. The findings describe the chromosomal characteristics of seminoma, with i(12p) being a frequent marker in these germ cell tumors.

title: Chromosomal changes in mature residual teratomas following polychemotherapy.
title_ja: 多剤化学療法後の成熟残存奇形腫における染色体変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 多剤化学療法後に残存した成熟奇形腫13例の細胞遺伝学的解析を行いました。modal染色体数は52から85の範囲でした。12例で少なくとも1コピーのi(12p)が認められました。原発性精巣非セミノーマとの比較から、残存奇形腫は核型異常の少ないクローンが選択されて生じたと考察しています。
summary_en: This study cytogenetically analyzed 13 mature residual teratomas after polychemotherapy, with modal chromosome numbers of 52 to 85. At least one i(12p) was present in 12 tumors. The authors compared these karyotypes with primary testicular nonseminomas and suggested that residual teratomas arise from selection of clones with less abnormal karyotypes from the primary tumor.

title: Neuron-specific enolase as a serum marker for immature teratoma and dysgerminoma.
title_ja: 未熟奇形腫およびディスジャーミノーマの血清マーカーとしての神経特異エノラーゼ
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍54例および胚細胞腫瘍細胞株9株で血清神経特異エノラーゼ(NSE)を測定しました。未熟奇形腫8例中4例、ディスジャーミノーマ6例中5例で血清NSEが上昇していました。ディスジャーミノーマでは広範な陽性染色が見られ、未熟奇形腫では神経成分に限局していました。NSEは両腫瘍の診断マーカーとして有用と考察されています。
summary_en: This study measured serum neuron-specific enolase in 54 patients with ovarian germ cell tumors and in nine germ cell tumor cell lines. Serum NSE was raised in 4 of 8 immature teratomas and 5 of 6 dysgerminomas. Immunohistochemistry showed widespread NSE staining in dysgerminomas but neural-restricted staining in immature teratomas. The authors conclude NSE may be a diagnostic marker for both tumor types.

title: Malignant struma ovarii.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は histologic な悪性基準に議論がある極めて稀な腫瘍です。転移例では予後が不良となりえます。本症例では、腹腔内転移に対して腹腔内リン酸クロム投与と甲状腺ホルモン抑制療法を用いました。長期フォローアップによる治療効果の評価が必要とされています。
summary_en: This case report describes malignant struma ovarii, a very rare tumor with debated histologic criteria for malignancy. Patients often respond well to surgery, but metastatic disease carries a poorer prognosis. The authors report using intraperitoneal chromic phosphate for metastatic intraperitoneal disease with thyroid suppression, and suggest prophylactic thyroid hormone in such cases. Long-term follow-up is needed to evaluate this therapy.

title: Familial 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis and gonadoblastoma/dysgerminoma: case report.
title_ja: 家族性46,XY純粋性腺形成不全に伴う性索腫およびディスジャーミノーマ
summary_ja: 無月経を主訴とした姉妹2例で、家族性46,XY純粋性腺形成不全を認めました。両側の性腺に性索腫とディスジャーミノーマが認められました。手術と放射線療法を行い、5年後も再発は認められていません。Y染色体物質を有する性腺形成不全では悪性化のリスクが高く、予防的性腺摘出が必要と述べています。
summary_en: This case report describes two sisters with familial 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis who had gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma in dysgenetic gonads. Both underwent bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and hysterectomy, with irradiation. Five years after treatment, both remained free of recurrence. The report emphasizes the malignancy risk in gonadal dysgenesis with Y chromosome material and the need for prophylactic gonadectomy.

title: Prognostic factors for relapse after complete response in patients with metastatic germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の完全奏効後における再発の予後因子
summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍216例のうち、シスプラチン併用化学療法で完全奏効に至った患者を解析しました。38例が再発しました。化学療法後に残存腫瘍の外科的切除を要した患者は、完全切除されていても再発リスクが高いと示されました。初回化学療法時のLDHおよびhCG高値も再発因子でした。
summary_en: This study analyzed 216 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors who achieved complete response to cisplatin-based chemotherapy, of whom 38 relapsed. Patients requiring surgical resection of residual tumor after chemotherapy had markedly higher relapse risk, even when fully resected. Elevated LDH and hCG at initial chemotherapy were also associated with relapse. The authors note that these patients remain at high risk despite additional chemotherapy.

title: Primary and secondary orbital teratomas.
title_ja: 原発性および二次性の眼窩奇形腫
summary_ja: 1989年の報告で、眼窩原発奇形腫2例と、上顎洞から眼窩へ浸潤した奇形腫1例を提示した。眼球が強く突出し、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で充実性と嚢胞性が混在する腫瘤が確認された。組織学的に2〜3胚葉由来の組織を認め、外科的切除が行われたが視力予後は不良であった。中枢神経系外の胚細胞腫瘍として位置づけられる。
summary_en: This 1989 report describes three patients with orbital teratomas: two primary orbital tumors and one teratoma invading the orbit from the maxillary sinus. Presentations were dramatic, with the globe displaced by extreme proptosis. Computed tomography was nearly diagnostic, showing a mixed solid and cystic mass. Histology revealed tissues from two or three germ layers. Surgical removal was performed, but visual outcomes were poor. The authors attribute these tumors to proliferation of germ cells deposited in cephalic structures during embryogenesis. This is an extragonadal germ cell tumor not arising in the central nervous system.

title: Paratesticular metastases from congenital retroperitoneal tumor.
title_ja: 先天性後腹膜腫瘍による精巣傍組織への転移
summary_ja: 1989年の報告で、生後15日の乳児の後腹膜奇形腫を提示した。3か月後に再発と腹膜転移を来し、12か月後には左精巣の鞘膜や精索へ転移した。転移巣では成熟した神経細胞とグリア細胞が認められた。腔内進展と、中皮細胞が胚細胞の分化に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This 1989 Urology report describes a retroperitoneal teratoma removed from a 15-day-old infant, consisting mainly of immature nervous tissue. Three months later, the tumor recurred with numerous peritoneal metastases. Twelve months later, teratoma metastases infiltrated the tunica vaginalis, epididymis, and spermatic cord of the left testis, showing mature neurons and glial cells. The authors note early dissemination suggesting intracavitary spread. They propose that tumor maturation in paratesticular structures implies mesothelial involvement in germ cell differentiation.

title: Studies with choriocarcinoma and normal pregnancy serum chorionic gonadotrophin.
title_ja: 絨毛癌および正常妊娠血清の絨毛性ゴナドトロピンに関する研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1989年の研究で、正常妊娠と絨毛癌患者の血清からヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を精製し比較した。絨毛癌由来のものは生物活性と免疫活性の比が低く(0.69対0.90)、個々の血清でも差が確認された。この比は絨毛癌の治療評価に有用と考えられた。
summary_en: This 1989 East African Medical Journal study purified human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) from pooled serum of normal pregnant women and patients with choriocarcinoma. Both preparations were heterogeneous on ion exchange chromatography and focusing, with similar Stokes radii. Choriocarcinoma hCG had a lower biological-to-immunological activity ratio (0.69) than normal pregnancy hCG (0.90), a difference confirmed in individual serum samples. The authors suggest this ratio could help evaluate treatment of choriocarcinoma patients, particularly in resource-limited settings.

title: Post-chemotherapy lymph node histology in radiologically normal patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer.
title_ja: 画像上正常な転移性非セミノーマ精巣がん患者における化学療法後のリンパ節組織像
summary_ja: 1989年の研究で、進行非セミノーマ精巣がん37例がシスプラチン併用化学療法後にCT陰性でも後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。25例で完全壊死・線維化、11例で成熟奇形腫、残存悪性腫瘍は1例のみだった。CT陰性でも化学療法後の手術を日常的に行うべきと提案された。
summary_en: This 1989 Journal of Urology study reviewed 37 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular cancer who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after cisplatin-based chemotherapy despite normal CT findings. Complete necrosis or fibrosis was found in 25 patients, and 11 had mature teratoma. Residual viable malignancy occurred in only one patient. Neither initial mass size nor primary tumor histology predicted pathology. Given the high rate of mature teratoma, the authors recommend routine post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal surgery even when CT is negative.

title: Massive hemoperitoneum following rupture of hepatic metastases from unsuspected choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 未発見の絨毛癌による肝転移の破裂に続発した大量血腹症
summary_ja: 1989年の症例報告で、出産後4週の29歳女性が、未診断の絨毛癌の肝転移破裂による大量血腹症を呈した。腹腔内大量出血は通常、子宮外妊娠が原因となるため、まれな病態である。絨毛癌の転移巣からの出血の可能性と、予後分類および治療法を論じている。
summary_en: This 1989 case report describes massive hemoperitoneum in a 29-year-old woman four weeks postpartum, caused by spontaneous rupture of hepatic metastases from previously unsuspected choriocarcinoma. Massive intraperitoneal hemorrhage is usually associated with ectopic pregnancy, making this presentation unusual. The authors note that choriocarcinoma can bleed from secondary sites, although rupture of hepatic metastases is rare. The report reviews presentation, prognostic grouping, and treatment modalities.

title: Clinical and radiological correlation of retroperitoneal metastasis from nonseminomatous testicular cancer treated with chemotherapy.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの後腹膜転移に対する化学療法後の臨床的および放射線学的相関
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの後腹膜転移40例を後方視的に検討し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤の予測因子を評価した研究です。初診時CTで腫瘤が2cm未満の症例では残存腫瘤が少なく、1cm以上の残存腫瘤には後腹膜リンパ節郭清が必要と結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 40 patients treated for retroperitoneal metastases from nonseminomatous testicular cancer examined whether CT-measured mass size predicts residual masses after chemotherapy. Patients with initial masses under 2 cm had markedly fewer residual masses than those with larger lesions. Residual masses were found in seven of 22 patients with embryonal carcinoma, and three of those seven had mature teratoma. Residual masses of 1 cm or more warranted retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy regardless of histology. The role of surgery for residual masses under 1 cm remained undetermined.

title: Radiotherapy for testicular seminoma stage I: treatment results and long-term post-irradiation morbidity in 365 patients.
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法：365例における治療成績と照射後の長期的な合併症
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1970〜1982年に治療された病期Iの精巣セミノーマ365例を対象としたノルウェーの研究。10年がん関連生存率は99%で、13例が再発し、9例は救済療法で治癒した。長期的には16例に消化不良、9例に消化性潰瘍が生じ、肺がんリスクは境界域の増加であった。著者らは、横隔膜下放射線療法が病期Iセミノーマの標準治療として最適であると結論づけた。
summary_en: This Norwegian Radium Hospital study reviewed 365 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated with infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy between 1970 and 1982. The 10-year cancer-related survival was 99%, and 13 patients relapsed, most within three years, with nine cured by salvage therapy. Long-term effects included dyspepsia in 16 patients and peptic ulcers in nine, with a borderline increased risk of pulmonary cancer. The authors concluded that infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy remains the optimal routine treatment for stage I seminoma and that inguinal and scrotal fields are unnecessary.

title: [A case of spermatocytic seminoma].
title_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマの症例
summary_ja: 33歳男性の右陰嚢内容の無痛性腫大に対し精巣摘除術を施行した精母細胞性セミノーマの症例報告です。病理組織学的検査で3種類の腫瘍細胞と特徴的な巨細胞が確認され、術後10か月の時点で転移や病勢の再燃はありませんでした。稀なセミノーマ亜型の形態と経過を示した報告です。
summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 33-year-old man with a painless right scrotal swelling of six months' duration. Surgical orchiectomy revealed a 130 g testis with an edematous, homogeneous tumor. Histopathology showed a typical spermatocytic seminoma with three distinct cell types, including giant cells containing spireme-like chromatin of primary spermatocytes. Chest radiography, CT and lymphography showed no metastases, and the patient remained disease-free 10 months after orchiectomy. The report illustrates the characteristic morphology and favorable early outcome of this rare seminoma variant.

title: Testicular tumors occurring in non-twin brothers: a case report.
title_ja: 非双生児の兄弟に発生した精巣腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 非双生児の兄弟2例に精巣セミノーマが同時に発生した症例を報告した論文です。両者はHLAのハプロタイプが同一で、遺伝的素因の関与が議論されています。過去に64組の同胞例が報告されており、本報告は症例数が少ないため結論は暫定的です。
summary_en: This short Japanese case report describes two brothers, not twins, who developed testicular seminoma simultaneously. Both siblings showed identical HLA-A, -B, -C and -DR haplotypes, and HLA-DR antigens were examined in the brothers with testicular tumors. The authors note that 64 earlier sibling sets had been reported and discuss a possible hereditary role in etiology. Because the report includes only two cases, its conclusions about genetic susceptibility remain tentative.

title: A histiocytoid (epithelioid) vascular tumor of the ovary: occurrence within a benign cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した卵巣の類組織球性（類上皮性）血管腫瘍
summary_ja: 22歳女性の両側卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫の一方に、類組織球性（類上皮性）血管腫瘍が見つかった症例の病理学的報告です。核分裂像は10高倍率視野で4〜6個でしたが血管内発育はなく、術後30か月の時点で良好な経過でした。卵巣の血管腫瘍に関する文献的レビューも含みます。
summary_en: This pathology report describes a 22-year-old woman with benign cystic teratomas of both ovaries, one of which contained a histiocytoid (epithelioid) vascular tumor. The lesion showed closely arranged, canalized nests of vacuolated endothelial cells, with four to six mitoses per ten high-power fields but no intravascular growth. The patient remained well 30 months after surgery. The authors review the literature on ovarian vascular tumors and histiocytoid vascular lesions in general, presenting this as an unusual finding within a teratoma.

title: Computed tomography and angiographic findings in metastatic choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 転移性妊娠性絨毛癌のCTおよび血管造影所見
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の転移による脳内出血を繰り返した女性の症例報告です。運動性失語や片麻痺などの症状を呈し、脳内血腫は計5回生じました。多発性頭蓋内出血の鑑別診断の重要性と、中枢神経系絨毛癌の特徴を文献的にまとめています。
summary_en: This report describes a woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma who presented with headache, speech difficulty, motor aphasia, facial weakness and hemiparesis, and had a large intraparenchymal hematoma. She subsequently developed five intraparenchymal hemorrhages in total. The authors emphasize the diagnostic dilemma posed by multiple intracranial hemorrhages and the importance of a complete differential diagnosis. They also review the imaging and clinical features of CNS choriocarcinoma, showing that brain metastases from gestational tumors can present primarily as hemorrhage.

title: Adenocarcinoma in a mature cystic teratoma. A case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した腺癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した粘液産生性腺癌の症例報告です。全腹式子宮摘出術、左卵管卵巣摘除術、大網切除、傍大動脈リンパ節生検が行われました。腫瘍が嚢胞壁を越えて腹腔内構造に及ぶと予後が不良であることが示されています。奇形腫由来の悪性転化の稀な症例として、手術時に嚢胞壁外への進展を評価する重要性が強調されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a mucin-producing adenocarcinoma that arose within a well-differentiated mature cystic teratoma. The patient underwent total abdominal hysterectomy, left salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy and paraaortic lymph node biopsy. The authors note that prognosis is unfavorable when the tumor extends through the cyst wall to involve intraperitoneal structures. The case illustrates malignant transformation within a mature cystic teratoma, a recognized but uncommon complication, and highlights the importance of assessing extension beyond the cyst wall at surgery.

title: Time-effect relationship of chromosome aberrations in peripheral lymphocytes after radiation therapy for seminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマに対する放射線療法後の末梢リンパ球染色体異常の経時的変化
summary_ja: セミノーマ患者23例の放射線療法後の末梢リンパ球について、二動原体染色体と不安定型染色体異常を有する細胞の経時的変化を解析した研究です。損傷細胞の消失速度を示す差分半減期を数理モデルで算出し、治療終了時0.4年、1720日後で3.6年でした。
summary_en: This study analyzed dicentric chromosomes and cells with unstable chromosome aberrations (Cu cells) in peripheral lymphocytes from 23 seminoma patients sampled over 0 to 1720 days after radiotherapy. Nine patients were also studied before treatment. The authors propose a model that separates the mean lymphocyte lifetime, estimated at about 10 years, from a differential half-time for the decline of damaged cells immediately after exposure. Differential half-times for dicentrics were 0.4 years at the end of therapy and 3.6 years at 1720 days.

title: Rare solitary metastasis to subcutaneous tissue from choriocarcinoma of testis.
title_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の皮下組織への稀な単発転移例
summary_ja: 精巣原発の絨毛癌(主体はセミノーマ)が皮下組織に単発転移した稀な症例を報告している。血管経路による転移が特徴で、術前β-hCGは4,200単位と高値だったが術後2週間で正常化した。転移経路から微小転移の可能性を考慮し、完全切除後も化学療法が行われた。近年の化学療法により精巣腫瘍の予後は大きく改善したと総括している。
summary_en: A rare case of a solitary subcutaneous metastasis from a testicular choriocarcinoma with a predominant seminoma component is described. The tumor spread via the vascular route, and preoperative beta-hCG of 4,200 units normalized within two weeks of surgery, suggesting complete extirpation of a solitary site. Because of the metastatic pattern, chemotherapy was given despite apparent complete removal. The authors review the markedly improved prognosis of testicular germ cell tumors with modern chemotherapy.

title: Immature (malignant) teratoma of the fallopian tube.
title_ja: 卵管原発未熟(悪性)奇形腫
summary_ja: 卵管に原発した未熟(悪性)奇形腫の症例を報告している。奇形腫は胚細胞腫瘍の一型だが、生殖器以外の卵管に生じることは極めて稀で、本報告は文献上3例目と考えられている。症例の希少性を示す報告である。抄録には患者の臨床経過、治療内容、転帰の詳細は記載されていない。
summary_en: The authors report a case of primary immature (malignant) teratoma arising in the fallopian tube, an extremely rare site for this tumor. They note that it appears to be only the third such case reported in the literature. The report highlights the rarity of this presentation. The abstract provides limited clinical detail regarding the patient's presentation, treatment, or outcome.

title: [Treatment of primary mediastinal germ cell tumors].
title_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の治療
summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の治療に関する総説。成熟奇形腫は診断後に速やかに切除すべきで、完全切除後の予後は良好である。悪性胚細胞腫瘍はセミノーマと非セミノーマ性に分類され、非セミノーマ性では シスプラチン を含む積極的化学療法が行われる。AFPやβ-hCGなどの腫瘍マーカーが治療後に正常化すれば長期予後は良く、高値が持続する場合は予後不良とされる。
summary_en: This Japanese review addresses treatment of primary mediastinal germ cell tumors. Mature teratomas should be resected promptly, with good prognosis after complete excision. Malignant germ cell tumors are divided into seminomatous and nonseminomatous types, and seminomas respond well to radiotherapy or chemotherapy. Nonseminomatous tumors receive aggressive cisplatin-based chemotherapy and are guided by AFP and beta-hCG levels. Normalized tumor markers after treatment predict better long-term prognosis, while persistently elevated markers indicate poor outcome.

title: [Current status of surgery for mediastinal tumors].
title_ja: 縦隔腫瘍の外科治療の現状
summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘍の外科治療の現状をまとめた総説。奇形腫などの良性腫瘍は完全切除で良好な予後が得られる。浸潤性胸腺腫では完全切除後の放射線療法が推奨される。純粋セミノーマは切除と放射線療法、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍はAFPとβ-hCGが陰性化するまで積極的な化学療法と放射線療法を行い、その後に手術を行う方針が示されている。
summary_en: This review summarizes the role of surgery across mediastinal tumors. Benign lesions such as teratoma, congenital cyst, intrathoracic goiter, and neurogenic tumors have good outcomes with complete resection. Invasive thymoma benefits from complete excision followed by radiation therapy. Pure seminoma is treated with resection and radiation therapy, while non-seminomatous germ cell tumors receive aggressive chemotherapy and radiation therapy until AFP and HCG normalize, followed by surgery. The authors also discuss neuroblastoma screening and stress accurate diagnosis.

title: Cytology of yolk-sac tumor of the ovary in ascitic fluid. Report of a case.
title_ja: 腹水中の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の細胞診：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の一例で、腹水検体の細胞診により診断が示唆された症例です。塗抹標本に加え細胞ブロックの検討が追加の診断所見をもたらしました。血清学的、免疫細胞化学的、組織学的所見も報告され、細胞形態に基づく予備診断が後続の検査計画に有用であることが強調されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a yolk sac tumor of the ovary first suggested by cytologic examination of ascitic fluid. Conventional smears and, importantly, a cell block prepared from the effusion provided additional diagnostic clues. The authors also report serologic, immunocytochemical, and histologic findings. They emphasize that a preliminary cytomorphologic diagnosis of this highly malignant tumor guides subsequent immunocytochemical and serologic studies, highlighting the value of cell block preparation for effusion specimens.

title: Differential production of human chorionic gonadotropin and free subunits in gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびその遊離サブユニットの差次的産生
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患を対象に、血清hCGと遊離サブユニットを高感度免疫放射定量法で測定した研究です。絨毛癌ではβ-hCGとhCGの比が著明に高値を示し、胞状奇胎は中間的な値でした。この比により正常妊娠、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌を高い確率で鑑別でき、絨毛癌の極早期の再発予測にも有用でした。
summary_en: This study measured serum hCG and its free alpha and beta subunits using highly sensitive immunoradiometric assays in gestational trophoblastic disease. Normal pregnancy showed a stable beta-hCG to hCG ratio, whereas gestational choriocarcinoma had markedly elevated beta-hCG levels and ratios. Complete hydatidiform mole showed intermediate values. These ratios discriminated normal pregnancy, mole, and choriocarcinoma with high probability. The assay also predicted very early tumor recurrence in choriocarcinoma patients, suggesting clinical utility for monitoring.

title: Effects of products of activated leukocytes (lymphokines and monokines) on the growth of malignant trophoblast cells in vitro.
title_ja: 活性化白血球の産物（リンフォカインおよびモノカイン）が悪性栄養膜細胞の増殖に及ぼす影響（in vitro）
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来JEG-3細胞を用い、活性化白血球の培養上清およびリンフォカイン・モノカインの増殖への影響を検討したin vitro研究です。γ-インターフェロン、腫瘍壊死因子、コロニー刺激因子は増殖を抑制し、高用量のインターロイキン1および2は増殖を促進しました。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における免疫学的機序の理解に示唆を与えるとされています。
summary_en: This in vitro study examined how supernatants from activated leukocytes and individual lymphokines and monokines affect proliferation of JEG-3 human gestational choriocarcinoma cells. Gamma-interferon, tumor necrosis factor, and colony-stimulating factor inhibited growth, while high-dose interleukin-1 and interleukin-2 stimulated it. B cell growth factor showed dose-dependent effects. The authors suggest these findings may inform understanding of immunologic mechanisms in early pregnancy and tumor-host interactions in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

title: Ataxia-telangiectasia and endodermal sinus tumor of the ovary: report of a case.
title_ja: 毛細血管拡張性運動失調症と卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 毛細血管拡張性運動失調症の患者に卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍が生じた症例報告です。両疾患ともαフェトプロテイン産生異常と関連し、同一の血清マーカーを示すことから診断・管理上の課題が論じられています。この合併は文献上初の報告とされています。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with ataxia-telangiectasia who developed an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor of the ovary. Both conditions are associated with abnormal alpha-fetoprotein production, and ataxia-telangiectasia carries an increased risk of malignancy. The authors note that primary ovarian tumors in these patients are extremely rare and that this association had not previously been reported. They focus on the diagnostic and management challenges of two diseases sharing the same serum marker.

title: Sarcoidosis and testicular tumors.
title_ja: サルコイドーシスと精巣腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌とセミノーマ)に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清と化学療法後、肺門リンパ節腫大とαフェトプロテイン上昇を呈した35歳男性の症例報告です。縦隔鏡下生検によりサルコイドーシスと診断されました。精巣腫瘍治療後の腫瘍マーカー上昇や所見の解釈における鑑別の重要性が示されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man who presented with hilar lymphadenopathy and elevated alpha-fetoprotein after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and chemotherapy for a mixed embryonal and seminomatous testicular tumor. Mediastinoscopy-guided biopsy established the diagnosis of sarcoidosis. The case highlights a diagnostic pitfall in which findings and elevated tumor markers after testicular germ cell tumor treatment may be confused with malignant relapse.

title: [The current management of testicular cancer].
title_ja: 精巣がんの現在の治療
summary_ja: 精巣がんの治療の進歩を、シスプラチンを中心とした化学療法の導入を軸にまとめた総説です。播種性病変の約70%はPVBまたはVAB-6療法で無病状態となる一方、約30%は難治性で、その20〜40%はシスプラチンとVP-16またはVM-26の併用救援化学療法で救済可能とされています。化学療法、手術、放射線療法の適切な組み合わせが治癒に不可欠と述べられています。
summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes current management of testicular cancer. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy has dramatically improved outcomes, with about 70% of disseminated patients achieving disease-free status after PVB or VAB-6 therapy. Roughly 30% have unresectable or refractory disease, and 20-40% of these can be salvaged with cisplatin plus VP-16 or VM-26 combination salvage chemotherapy. Selected patients with negative serum markers may undergo salvage surgery. The authors stress that combining chemotherapy, surgery, and radiation therapy is essential for cure.

title: Short-course etoposide, bleomycin and cisplatin in the treatment of metastatic germ cell tumours. Appraisal of its potential as adjuvant chemotherapy for stage 1 testis tumours.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対する短期間エトポシド・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチン療法と、Stage I精巣腫瘍における補助化学療法としての可能性
summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍およびStage I精巣腫瘍の補助化学療法を想定し、EBCi(3)レジメン（エトポシド・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン3日間持続投与）を評価した研究です。44例中40例が中央値21か月の観察で無病であり、2年無病生存率は91%でした。ブレオマイシン肺毒性は認めず、低毒性・高い有効性が示唆されています。
summary_en: This study evaluated a short-course regimen of etoposide, bleomycin, and cisplatin with prolonged daily bleomycin infusion over 3 days for metastatic germ cell tumors and as potential adjuvant treatment for stage 1 testicular tumors. Among 44 patients, 40 remained disease free at a median follow-up of 21 months, with 2-year disease-free survival of 91%. No bleomycin-related lung toxicity was observed, compared with four cases among 91 previously treated patients. The authors conclude the regimen may be suitable as adjuvant treatment.

title: High frequency of incomplete human chorionic gonadotropin in patients with testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者における不完全型ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の高頻度出現
summary_ja: 男性がん患者でラジオイムノアッセイにより高値を示した血清hCGを、無傷分子を認識する免疫測定法と比較した研究です。免疫測定法で確認されたのは72%で、28%は乖離していました。そのうち22例は精巣セミノーマ患者（検討例の42%）であり、不完全型hCGの存在が示唆され、セミノーマにおける腫瘍マーカーの解釈に影響を与えます。
summary_en: This study compared immunometric assays requiring intact hCG with a competitive radioimmunoassay measuring intact hCG and its free beta chain in male cancer patients with elevated levels. Immunometric methods confirmed elevation in 72% of samples, but 28% were discordant, reading normal by immunometric assays. Of these discrepancies, 22 patients had seminomatous tumors, representing 42% of seminoma patients tested. The authors attribute this to incomplete hCG forms detected by the radioimmunoassay, which affects tumor marker interpretation in seminoma.

title: Profiles of epitope-defined markers in sera from patients with testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者血清におけるエピトープ定義腫瘍マーカーのプロファイル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の血清を用い、モノクローナル抗体でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、PLAP、CEAのエピトープ別マーカーを測定した1988年の研究。セミノーマでは特徴的なPLAPパターンがみられ、1例では臨床的再発の10か月前から上昇した。AFP単独高値は卵黄嚢腫瘍、hCGとAFPの併存は奇形腫または胎児性癌成分を示唆した。マーカープロファイルが組織型の推定や病態把握に有用であることを示した。
summary_en: This 1988 study measured epitope-defined tumor markers, AFP, hCG, PLAP and CEA, in sera of patients with testicular germ cell tumors using monoclonal antibodies. Localized and metastatic seminoma showed characteristic PLAP profiles, and PLAP rose ten months before clinical recurrence in one case. Persistent PLAP elevation suggested metastatic seminoma, while high AFP alone indicated yolk sac tumors and combined hCG and AFP suggested teratoma or embryonal carcinoma components. The authors conclude that marker profiles may help characterize histology and detect disease.

title: Advanced seminoma: the role of chemotherapy and adjunctive surgery.
title_ja: 進行セミノーマに対する化学療法と補助的外科療法の役割
summary_ja: 進行性性腺外・病期IIC・病期III期セミノーマ患者62例を対象とした非ランダム化前向き試験の報告。シスプラチン併用化学療法で88%が完全寛解を得て、85%が無病生存を維持した。エトポシドとシスプラチンの併用は多剤併用と同等の効果を示した。治療開始時のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値は予後不良と関連していた。
summary_en: This 1988 nonrandomized prospective trial treated 62 patients with advanced extragonadal, stage IIC, or stage III seminoma, mostly with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Complete remission was achieved in 88% of evaluable patients, and 85% of all patients remained alive and disease-free. The etoposide plus cisplatin regimen performed as well as multidrug regimens. Elevated hCG at treatment start predicted worse outcome. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based chemotherapy is effective and should be considered as initial therapy for these patients.

title: The treatment of advanced seminoma with chemotherapy and radiotherapy.
title_ja: 進行セミノーマに対する化学療法と放射線療法の併用
summary_ja: 1979〜1984年に転移性セミノーマの37例に化学療法と放射線療法を施行した研究。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は49%で、バルキー病変は不良因子だった。完全寛解は24%、良好な部分奏効は56%だった。シクロホスファミドとエトポシドの併用は、シスプラチン併用療法より好中球減少や敗血症が少なかった。
summary_en: This 1988 British Journal of Cancer study reviews 37 patients treated for metastatic seminoma between 1979 and 1984. Twenty-seven had relapsed after initial radiotherapy for stage I or IIA disease, and ten received chemotherapy first followed by radiotherapy to bulky sites. Regimens included cisplatin-containing combinations or cyclophosphamide with etoposide. Five-year overall survival was 49%, with bulky disease an adverse factor. Complete response occurred in 24% and good partial response in 56% of assessable patients. Cyclophosphamide-etoposide caused less neutropenia and sepsis.

title: Differences between subcutaneous and intraperitoneal forms of three human testicular teratocarcinomas in nude mice.
title_ja: ヒト精巣奇形癌3株の皮下移植と腹腔内移植における差異(ヌードマウス)
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌3株をヌードマウスに皮下継代し、その後腹腔内に移植して性状の違いを比較した研究。皮下移植では胎児性癌1例と卵黄嚢腫瘍2例の成分が維持され、卵黄嚢腫瘍はAFPを産生した。腹腔内では臓器浸潤型の腫瘍と遊離スフェロイドが生じ、AFP産生は付着型の病変に限られた。
summary_en: This 1988 study serially passaged three human testicular teratocarcinomas in nude mice by subcutaneous transplantation, then injected tumor cell suspensions intraperitoneally. Subcutaneous transplants preserved one primary tumor component each: embryonal carcinoma in one case and yolk sac tumor in two, the latter producing AFP. Intraperitoneal injection yielded attached tumors invading abdominal organs and free-floating spheroids. AFP localized only in attached growths, suggesting that a critical tumor volume or vascularization is needed for AFP production.

title: Histological origins of discordant chorionic gonadotropin secretion in malignancy.
title_ja: 悪性疾患におけるhCG分泌の不一致の組織学的起源
summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患138例と胚細胞腫瘍123例の血清hCG、α-hCG、β-hCGをモノクローナル抗体で測定した1988年の研究。β-hCG/hCG比の上昇は多剤併用化学療法を要する高リスク例の同定に有用だった。非妊娠性悪性腫瘍ではサブユニットの上昇がより少なかった。組織学的特徴とhCGの分泌パターンの関連が検討された。
summary_en: This 1988 study measured serum hCG, alpha-hCG and beta-hCG using monoclonal antibodies in 138 women with trophoblastic disease and 123 with germ cell neoplasia. Elevated beta-hCG was common initially in trophoblastic disease, and a rising beta-hCG to hCG ratio identified high-risk patients needing multiagent chemotherapy. Subunit elevation was less frequent in nongestational malignancy. The authors propose that imbalanced differentiation of cytotrophoblasts disrupts subunit secretion, linking histology to hCG patterns.

title: Primary choriocarcinoma of the urinary bladder.
title_ja: 膀胱原発絨毛癌
summary_ja: 57歳男性で、移行上皮癌に対する膀胱摘除術後の標本から膀胱原発の絨毛癌が見出された症例報告です。術後に両肺転移が出現し、化学療法にもかかわらず急速に進行して、入院後5か月で死亡しました。免疫染色では、ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲンが強陽性、hCGのαおよびβサブユニットが弱陽性でした。
summary_en: A case report of primary choriocarcinoma arising in the urinary bladder of a 57-year-old man who had undergone cystectomy for transitional cell carcinoma. Metastases to both lungs developed after surgery and progressed rapidly despite chemotherapy, and the patient died five months after admission. Immunohistochemistry showed strong human placental lactogen staining and weak staining for both alpha and beta subunits of hCG in the primary tumor and metastases.

title: Analysis of 309 cases after hydatidiform mole: different follow-up program according to biologic behavior.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎後の309例の解析:生物学的挙動に応じた異なるフォローアップ方式
summary_ja: 1976年から1985年にミラノ大学で、胞状奇胎患者309例(完全223例、部分86例)を連続的なβ-hCG測定で追跡した後方視的解析。92.9%で自然寛解が生じた。奇胎の種類に応じて異なるフォローアップ期間を設定すべきと提案されている。
summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 309 patients with hydatidiform mole (223 complete, 86 partial) followed with serial beta-hCG monitoring at Milan University from 1976 to 1985. Spontaneous remission occurred in 92.9%. Marker levels were undetectable within 60 days in 80.4% of cases and between 61 and 140 days in 19.6%. Twenty-two patients (7.1%) developed gestational trophoblastic tumors requiring chemotherapy, mostly after complete moles. The authors propose different follow-up durations for partial and complete moles.

title: [An autopsy case revealing bilateral successive testicular germ cell tumors of different cell types].
title_ja: 両側精巣に順次発生し組織型の異なる精巣胚細胞腫瘍を呈した剖検例
summary_ja: 28歳男性の剖検例で、左右の精巣に異なる組織型の胚細胞腫瘍が順次発生しました。右精巣はセミノーマで、11か月後の左精巣は非セミノーマ性腫瘍(AFP 3319 ng/ml)、組織学的には胎児性癌でした。鎖骨上窩リンパ節転移に補助化学療法を行いましたが、進行により死亡しました。剖検では後腹膜および大動脈傍リンパ節に成熟奇形腫と胎児性癌の転移が確認されました。
summary_en: An autopsy report of a 28-year-old man with bilateral successive testicular germ cell tumors of different histology. The right testicular tumor was a seminoma treated by orchiectomy. Eleven months later, the left testis showed a non-seminomatous tumor with AFP of 3319 ng/ml, and histology after orchiectomy revealed embryonal carcinoma. Supraclavicular metastasis led to adjuvant chemotherapy, but he died of progression. Autopsy showed retroperitoneal and para-aortic metastases with mature teratoma and embryonal carcinoma.

title: Total parenteral nutrition as an adjuvant to patients undergoing chemotherapy for testicular carcinoma: protection of body composition--a randomized, prospective study.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する化学療法患者への補助療法としての完全静脈栄養：体組成の保護に関する無作為化前向き研究
summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌に対するCVB化学療法を受けた栄養状態の良好な23例を、入院中の完全静脈栄養群と経口摂取群に無作為化した前向き研究です。静脈栄養群は入院中に窒素出納を維持しましたが、10週間の体重と体内窒素の減少は大きくなりました。主因は化学療法後の長期の食欲不振で、院内栄養の効果は限定的でした。
summary_en: A randomized prospective study of 23 well-nourished patients receiving CVB chemotherapy for testicular teratocarcinoma, comparing total parenteral nutrition with oral intake alone during hospitalization. The TPN group maintained nitrogen balance during in-hospital chemotherapy but lost more body weight and nitrogen over 10 weeks than the oral group. Weight loss was mainly caused by prolonged anorexia after each chemotherapy cycle. Intermittent in-hospital nutrition had only marginal benefit.

title: Combination chemotherapy including VP-16 for poor prognosis germ cell neoplasms.
title_ja: 予後不良な胚細胞腫瘍に対するVP-16併用化学療法
summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍15例(精巣原発9例、性腺外4例、成人奇形腫症候群2例)に、VP-16を含む併用化学療法の後に手術を行った報告です。精巣原発の9例は全例生存しましたが、2例で再発がみられました。性腺外の4例中2例は無病生存し、成人奇形腫症候群の2例はいずれも死亡しました。
summary_en: Fifteen patients with poor-prognosis germ cell neoplasms (9 testicular, 4 extragonadal, 2 adult teratoma syndrome) were treated with combination chemotherapy including VP-16, followed by surgery. All 9 testicular-primary patients remained alive at median follow-up of 36 months, though 2 relapsed. Two of 4 extragonadal patients were alive without disease, and both adult teratoma syndrome patients died. The authors conclude that chemotherapy followed by surgery can be employed successfully in this subset.

title: Lactic dehydrogenase, alkaline phosphatase and human chorionic gonadotropin in a pure ovarian dysgerminoma.
title_ja: 純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫における乳酸脱水素酵素、アルカリホスファターゼおよびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)
summary_ja: 21歳女性の片側性純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫例で、血清LDH、hCG、ALPが著明に上昇し、腫瘍摘出後に正常化した。腫瘍組織では正常卵巣より数倍高いこれらの物質が検出され、組織化学的にも腫瘍細胞内に酵素の存在が確認された。著者らは、これらが本腫瘍の診断とフォローアップに有用な腫瘍マーカーになりうると提唱している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with unilateral pure ovarian dysgerminoma whose serum lactate dehydrogenase, hCG and alkaline phosphatase were markedly elevated. Levels normalized after tumor removal. Homogenized tumor tissue contained several-fold higher amounts of these substances than normal ovary, and histochemistry confirmed enzyme presence within tumor cells. The authors propose that these enzymes and hormone may serve as tumor markers for diagnosis and follow-up of this germ cell tumor type.

title: Normal pregnancy after successful treatment of choriocarcinoma with cerebral metastases. A case report.
title_ja: 脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の治療後の正常妊娠：症例報告
summary_ja: 脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の女性患者に対し、従来法より毒性の低い化学療法と全脳照射を併用して治療に成功した症例報告である。その後、患者は2回の正常分娩を経験した。絨毛癌治療後の妊孕性や妊娠転帰に関する知見を示す点で、臨床的に意義がある。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman treated for choriocarcinoma with cerebral metastases. She received less toxic chemotherapy than conventional regimens, combined with whole-brain irradiation, and the treatment succeeded. She later had two uneventful pregnancies. The report highlights that fertility and normal pregnancy outcomes may be preserved after this treatment, and it is relevant to choriocarcinoma management and to the brain metastasis of a germ cell tumor.

title: Cisplatin-induced changes of selenium levels and glutathione peroxidase activities in blood of testis tumor patients.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫患者の血液におけるシスプラチン誘発性のセレン濃度およびグルタチオンペルオキシダーゼ活性の変化
summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた15例で、ヘマトクリット、血中グルタチオンペルオキシダーゼ活性、セレン濃度を測定した。輸血なしでは、ヘマトクリットは平均約40%低下した。血漿セレンは各コース内で低下し、次コースまでにほぼ回復したが、コースを重ねるごとに低下が進行した。シスプラチンの組織内貯留がセレン代謝に影響すると著者らは考察している。
summary_en: This study measured hematocrit, blood glutathione peroxidase activity, and selenium levels in 15 patients receiving cisplatin combination chemotherapy for testicular teratoma. Hematocrit fell by about 40% without transfusion, and GPx decline matched the loss of erythrocytes. Plasma selenium dropped within each course and recovered between cycles, with progressive decline across courses. The authors suggest that cisplatin retention in tissues alters selenium metabolism, a finding relevant to supportive care during germ cell tumor chemotherapy.

title: Mediastinal germ cell tumors and histiocytosis.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と組織球症
summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と原発性の血液増殖性疾患を合併した2例を報告している。1例は卵黄嚢分化を伴う縦隔未熟奇形腫と難治性血小板減少症を、他の1例は死後に判明した未熟奇形腫と劇症型悪性組織球症を有していた。既報19例の検討から、卵黄嚢分化がこの症候群の発症に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This report describes two men with mediastinal germ cell tumors associated with primary hemoproliferative disorders. One had a mediastinal immature teratoma with yolk sac differentiation alongside refractory thrombocytopenia and benign histiocytic proliferation; the other, found postmortem, had immature teratoma with yolk sac and hepatic differentiation and fulminant malignant histiocytosis. A review of 19 published cases suggests that yolk sac differentiation may contribute to the pathogenesis of this syndrome, which may represent different manifestations of one process.

title: A randomized trial of standard chemotherapy v a high-dose chemotherapy regimen in the treatment of poor prognosis nonseminomatous germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における標準化学療法と大量化学療法レジメンのランダム化比較試験
summary_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者52例を対象とした前向きランダム化試験である。2倍量シスプラチンとエトポシドを含む大量化学療法レジメン(PVeBV)が、標準のPVeBと比較された。完全寛解率と再発率は改善傾向を示し、5年生存率は78%対48%であった。骨髄抑制と重度の難聴はPVeBVで多かった。
summary_en: This prospective randomized trial compared a high-dose regimen (double-dose cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin and etoposide, PVeBV) with standard PVeB in 52 patients with poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The high-dose regimen achieved higher complete remission (88% vs 67%) and lower relapse rates, with 5-year survival of 78% versus 48%, a trend not reaching significance. Myelosuppression and severe hearing loss were more frequent with PVeBV. The authors attribute the benefit to double-dose cisplatin, etoposide, or their synergy.

title: [Hypomagnesemia following chemotherapy of disseminated testicular tumors].
title_ja: 播種性精巣腫瘍の化学療法後の低マグネシウム血症
summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍16例にシスプラチン併用化学療法を行ったところ、81%が低マグネシウム血症を発症し、累積投与量に応じてマグネシウム値が低下した。神経筋症状や不整脈などの症状もみられ、クレアチニンクリアランスの低下も併せて報告されている。なお、一部の患者では腎機能が不可逆的に低下した。
summary_en: This 1988 Japanese study followed 16 patients with metastatic testicular cancer treated with cisplatin-containing combination chemotherapy. Hypomagnesemia developed in 81% of patients, and the magnesium nadir fell with cumulative cisplatin dose. Four patients had clinical symptoms, including neuromuscular disturbance and arrhythmia. Creatinine clearance declined progressively, and in three patients it fell irreversibly below 50 ml/min. Transient changes in potassium and calcium were also noted but did not correlate with magnesium levels.

title: [Treatment of nonseminomatous testicular tumor with liver metastases].
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の肝転移例の治療
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍で肝転移を生じた2例を報告する。両例とも胎児性癌と絨毛癌などの混合型で、PVB療法などにより完全奏効を得た後に肝転移が出現した。1例はシスプラチンを含む4剤併用療法で部分奏効にとどまり死亡した。もう1例はVAB-6療法で完全奏効を得た。肝転移例の予後は不良であり、従来の化学療法以外の治療法の検討が必要とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes two patients with nonseminomatous testicular tumors and liver metastases. Both had mixed histology including embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma, and both achieved complete response to PVB-based chemotherapy before liver metastases appeared. One patient received four-drug cisplatin-based therapy, achieved partial response, and died. The other responded completely to VAB-6. The authors conclude that prognosis is poor and that treatments beyond conventional chemotherapy should be considered.

title: Fragmentation of the beta-subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin produced by choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 絨毛癌が産生するヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニットの断片化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者の尿中hCGを解析し、還元条件下でβサブユニットが25kDaのCTP'と18kDaのFMCに解離することを示した。CTP'は正常妊娠のhCGより絨毛癌由来のもので顕著であった。レクチン結合性から、CTP'はO結合型、FMCはN結合型の糖鎖を持つと考えられる。絨毛癌のhCGβサブユニットには特異的な解離部位が存在する。
summary_en: This study examines hCG from the urine of a choriocarcinoma patient. Under reducing conditions, the beta-subunit dissociates into a 25 kDa C-terminal-containing fragment (CTP') and an 18 kDa faster-moving component (FMC). CTP' is much more prominent in choriocarcinoma hCG than in normal pregnancy hCG. Lectin binding indicates that CTP' carries O-linked sugars and FMC carries N-linked sugars. The findings suggest an unusual dissociation site in the beta-subunit of choriocarcinoma hCG.

title: Correlation between the alpha 1-fetoprotein (AFP) concentrations determined in the sera and in the tumour tissues in patients with testicular tumours.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者の血清と腫瘍組織におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)濃度の相関
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍10例の血清と腫瘍組織におけるAFPを同時に測定した。セミノーマ2例はいずれも陰性であった。非セミノーマ8例中7例で血清AFPが上昇し、6例で腫瘍組織にAFPが検出され、両者は相関した。AFPの免疫染色は、原発不明転移および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で臨床的意義があるとされた。
summary_en: This study simultaneously measured AFP in the serum and tumor tissue of 10 patients with testicular tumors. Both seminomas were negative. Seven of eight nonseminomas had elevated serum AFP, and six had detectable AFP in tumor tissue. AFP immunoperoxidase staining proved clinically useful mainly in unknown-primary metastases and extragonadal germ cell tumors. The findings suggest that tissue AFP staining adds value only in selected situations.

title: The serum pregnancy-specific beta 1-glycoprotein to beta-human chorionic gonadotrophin ratio as an index of prognosis in patients with choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 絨毛癌の予後指標としての妊娠特異的β1グリコプロテインとβ-hCGの血清比
summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の女性12例を対象に、妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク(SP1)とβ-hCGの血清比を検討しました。化学療法後に比が1.0を超えた7例は完全寛解に至り、低値のままだった5例は薬剤耐性で死亡しました。治療初期のSP1/β-hCG比は絨毛癌の予後予測に有用である可能性が示されています。
summary_en: This study examined the serum ratio of pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP1) to beta-hCG in 12 women with metastatic choriocarcinoma. Before chemotherapy, the ratio was low, averaging 0.34. In seven patients who achieved complete remission, the ratio rose above 1.0 after one or two chemotherapy courses. In the five patients who died from drug-resistant disease, the ratio stayed low and tended to decline. The authors conclude that the SP1/beta-hCG ratio after early chemotherapy may help predict prognosis in choriocarcinoma.

title: Encephalopathy following cisplatin, bleomycin and vinblastine therapy for non-seminomatous germ cell tumour of testis.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン療法後の脳症
summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の22歳男性が、シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法後に重度の脳症、全身痙攣、視覚障害を発症した症例です。治療可能な原因を除外した後は対症療法のみで、症状は数か月で回復しました。シスプラチン併用療法に特有のまれな毒性として、腫瘍内科医が認識すべき症候群であると提言しています。
summary_en: A 22-year-old man with metastatic testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor developed severe encephalopathy, generalized seizures and visual disturbance after cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin chemotherapy. After treatable causes were excluded, supportive care alone was given, and symptoms resolved over several months. The authors describe this as a distinct clinical syndrome and suggest it is a rare toxicity of cisplatin-based therapy. Given the widespread use of cisplatin, they urge medical oncologists to recognize this complication.

title: Acute vascular toxicity after combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin for testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対する化学療法（シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン）後の急性血管毒性
summary_ja: 精巣がんに対してPVB療法（ブレオマイシン、ビンブラスチン、シスプラチン）を受けた連続21例で、急性の血管虚血性イベントを評価しました。狭心症は38%に現れ、治療開始から中央値5.6週で2～7日間持続しました。レイノー現象やつま先の一過性虚血も報告されています。動脈閉塞性イベントはPVB療法で頻度の高い毒性であると結論づけています。
summary_en: This study evaluated acute vascular ischemic events in 21 consecutive patients with testicular cancer treated with bleomycin, vinblastine and cisplatin (PVB). Angina pectoris occurred in 38 percent of patients, typically about 5.6 weeks after treatment began and lasting 2 to 7 days. Raynaud's phenomenon affected 33 percent and transient toe ischemia 29 percent. No major cerebrovascular events were seen. Ischemia occurred at varying times, and drug dose did not correlate with onset. The authors conclude that arterial occlusive events are a frequent toxicity of PVB chemotherapy.

title: Postoperative reduction of serum beta-HCG in testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおける術後の血清β-hCG低下
summary_ja: 純粋精巣セミノーマ17例を対象に、精巣摘除術後10～74か月のフォローアップ中の血清β-hCGと尿中hCGを測定しました。術前が正常範囲の症例でも、術後に血清β-hCGは有意に低下しました。セミノーマの術前マーカー値は非セミノーマ性腫瘍より著しく低値ですが、少量のhCG産生はありえると結論づけています。
summary_en: This study measured serum beta-hCG and urinary hCG in 17 patients with pure testicular seminoma who were followed for 10 to 74 months after orchiectomy. Preoperative urinary hCG was abnormal in 53 percent of patients, and serum beta-hCG was slightly elevated in six of twelve evaluated. After orchiectomy, serum beta-hCG fell significantly, even in patients with normal preoperative levels. Preoperative marker levels in seminoma were far lower than in non-seminomatous tumors, though small amounts of hCG may still be produced by seminoma cells. No patient had residual disease or recurrence.

title: A case of mediastinal germ cell tumor radically operated on after neoadjuvant chemotherapy-combined resection of the superior vena cava and reconstruction with expanded-PTFE graft.
title_ja: 術前化学療法後に上大静脈の切除と拡張型PTFE人工血管による再建を併用して根治切除した縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 上大静脈症候群を呈し、当初切除不能と判断された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告です。シスプラチン、ビンデシン、ブレオマイシンによる術前化学療法で腫瘍が65%縮小し、血清hCGも正常化しました。その後、拡張型PTFE人工血管を用いた上大静脈再建を伴う完全切除が行われ、術後15か月で再発はありません。
summary_en: This case report describes a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor presenting with superior vena cava syndrome and initially deemed unresectable. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy with cisplatin, vindesine and bleomycin produced a 65 percent tumor reduction and normalized serum hCG. The tumor was then completely resected with superior vena cava reconstruction using an expanded PTFE graft. At 15 months after surgery the patient had returned to work with a patent graft and no recurrence. The authors conclude that neoadjuvant chemotherapy is vital for anterior mediastinal germ cell tumors.

title: The management of advanced testicular teratoma.
title_ja: 進行精巣奇形腫の管理
summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者320例に対する化学療法の成績を報告しています。中央値39か月の追跡で266例（83%）が生存・健在でした。治療関連死は9例で、化学療法の強度と関連していました。腫瘍量が大きく血清腫瘍マーカーが高い患者以外では再発はまれであり、予後に応じた治療強度の選択を提唱しています。
summary_en: This series reviews 320 patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis treated with chemotherapy. At a median follow-up of 39 months, 266 patients (83 percent) were alive and well. Nine deaths were attributed to treatment-related causes, and mortality correlated with chemotherapy intensity. Relapse was uncommon except in patients with large tumour volume and high serum marker levels. The authors developed a risk-adapted approach that selects chemotherapy by prognostic group, aiming to reduce toxicity in patients with a good prognosis.

title: Immunohistochemistry of germ cell and trophoblastic neoplasms.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍および絨毛性腫瘍の免疫組織化学
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍・絨毛性腫瘍121例を15種の抗体で免疫組織化学的に解析した研究。性腺・性腺外、原発・転移病変で類似した免疫プロファイルが得られた。PLAPは胚細胞分化の鋭敏なマーカーで、LCAとS100はリンパ腫・黒色腫との鑑別に有用だった。サイトケラチンはセミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別に役立つ一方、NSEは特異性に疑問が残った。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study profiled 121 germ cell and trophoblastic neoplasms using a panel of 15 antibodies, including PLAP, AFP, BHCG, cytokeratin, EMA, LCA, S-100 and NSE. Gonadal and extragonadal tumors, gestational and nongestational choriocarcinomas, and primary and metastatic lesions showed similar patterns. PLAP was a sensitive marker of germ cell differentiation, while LCA and S-100 helped exclude lymphoma and melanoma. Cytokeratin distinguished seminomas from nonseminomatous tumors, although some seminomas were positive. NSE was expressed in 75% of cases, limiting its specificity.

title: Metastatic spermatocytic seminoma. A case report with light microscopic, ultrastructural, and immunohistochemical findings.
title_ja: 転移性精母細胞性セミノーマの症例報告：光顕、超微細構造および免疫組織化学的所見
summary_ja: 50歳男性の転移性精母細胞性セミノーマの症例報告。精巣摘除術後18か月で同側後腹膜傍大動脈リンパ節転移が見つかった。生検・減量的郭清、放射線療法、併用化学療法を受けたが、精巣摘除後25か月で化学療法の合併症により死亡した。転移性精母細胞性セミノーマとして完全に記録された初の症例とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old man with metastatic spermatocytic seminoma involving homolateral retroperitoneal paraaortic lymph nodes, detected 18 months after orchiectomy. He underwent retroperitoneal biopsy with cytoreductive lymphadenectomy, followed by radiotherapy and combination chemotherapy. He died 25 months after orchiectomy from complications of a second chemotherapy course, with no autopsy and no signs of further spread. Light microscopy and electron microscopy showing intercellular bridges, together with absent placental alkaline phosphatase, supported the diagnosis. The authors describe this as the first fully documented metastasizing spermatocytic seminoma.

title: A randomized trial of etoposide + cisplatin versus vinblastine + bleomycin + cisplatin + cyclophosphamide + dactinomycin in patients with good-prognosis germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 予後良好な胚細胞腫瘍患者におけるエトポシド＋シスプラチン対ビンブラスチン＋ブレオマイシン＋シスプラチン＋シクロホスファミド＋ダクチノマイシンのランダム化試験
summary_ja: 予後良好な胚細胞腫瘍164例を対象に、EP療法とVAB-6療法をランダム化比較した試験。完全寛解率はVAB-6が96%、EPが93%で、生存成績は同等だった。EPは嘔吐、マグネシウム喪失、粘膜炎、肺毒性が少なかった。有効で毒性の少ない化学療法として、予後良好な播種性胚細胞腫瘍に推奨された。
summary_en: This randomized trial compared etoposide plus cisplatin (EP) with the VAB-6 regimen in 164 patients with good-prognosis germ cell tumors. Complete remission rates were 96% with VAB-6 and 93% with EP, and survival outcomes were similar. EP caused less emesis, less magnesium wasting, less mucositis and no pulmonary toxicity, with higher nadir counts. No treatment-related deaths occurred. The authors recommend EP as an efficacious, less toxic regimen for good-prognosis disseminated GCT.

title: Results of adjuvant surgery in patients with stage III and IV nonseminomatous testicular tumors after cisplatin-vinblastine-bleomycin chemotherapy.
title_ja: シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン化学療法後の進行期非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍（ステージIII・IV）に対する補助手術の成績
summary_ja: 1978〜1983年に進行非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍53例へシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法を行い、化学療法後の残存腫瘍切除を検討した。中央値65か月の追跡で生存率は72%。奇形腫成分を有し腫瘍マーカー陰性の症例では、画像所見にかかわらず開腹探索術を行うことを推奨している。
summary_en: This study reviewed 53 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular tumors treated with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin between 1978 and 1983. Among 41 marker-negative patients, 35 underwent residual tumor resection, with viable tumor found in four and residual mature teratoma in many. Salvage chemotherapy achieved remission in these cases. Survival was 72% at a median follow-up of 65 months, varying by tumor volume. The authors recommend laparotomy for all marker-negative patients with a teratomatous component in the primary tumor, regardless of imaging findings.

title: Immunohistochemical study of hepatic and enteric structures in testicular endodermal sinus tumors.
title_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍における肝および腸管様構造の免疫組織化学的研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍6例を連続切片で免疫組織化学的に検討し、2例で肝組織と腸管組織の特徴を確認した。肝巣はPASおよびAFP、サイトケラチンに陽性で、腸管様管腔はCEAを頂部に示した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は胚体内外の内胚葉への分化能を持ち、単一起源の奇形腫と解釈される可能性が示された。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined serial sections of six testicular endodermal sinus tumors and embryonal carcinomas. Two cases showed hepatic structures and enteric tubules. Hepatic nests were PAS-positive and immunoreactive for AFP and cytokeratin, while enteric tubules showed CEA at the apical surface without atypia. The authors suggest that endodermal sinus tumors show both intra- and extraembryonic endodermal differentiation and may represent a monophyletic teratoma.

title: Primary chemotherapy and the role of second-look laparotomy in non-dysgerminomatous germ cell malignancies of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣の非ディスジャーミノーマ性悪性胚細胞腫瘍における初回化学療法と第2回開腹術の役割
summary_ja: 1976〜1983年にMSKCCで卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用VAB化学療法を受けた16例の後方視的検討である。治療後に第2回開腹術を受けた11例は全例で無病であった。組織型は未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍が中心であった。第2回開腹術は治療の修正や治癒の予測、化学療法の安全な中止に役立つと論じている。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 16 patients treated at Memorial Sloan-Kettering from 1976 to 1983 evaluates primary cisplatin-based VAB chemotherapy for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Eleven patients underwent second-look laparotomy after therapy, and all were free of disease. Histologies were mainly immature teratoma, endodermal sinus tumor, and mixed germ cell tumor. The authors argue that second-look laparotomy can guide treatment, predict cure, and support safely stopping chemotherapy.

title: Disease relapse in patients with stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis on active surveillance.
title_ja: 精巣の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における積極的監視中の再発
summary_ja: 精巣の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者36例を、精巣摘除術と集中的な監視のみで管理した研究である。33.3%が中央値7か月で再発した。腫瘍マーカーは再発の検出に限られた価値しかなく、リンパ管侵襲のみが再発率の上昇と関連した。精巣摘除後の最適な管理は依然として確立されていない。
summary_en: This study followed 36 patients with apparent stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis managed by orchidectomy and intensive surveillance without adjuvant therapy. Relapse occurred in 33.3% at a median of seven months. Tumor markers were of limited value for detecting relapse, while lymphatic invasion was the only primary tumor factor linked to higher relapse. All relapsed patients received cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and optimal management after orchidectomy remains undefined.

title: [A case report of extragonadal germ cell tumor with special reference to VAB-6 therapy].
title_ja: VAB-6療法を施行した性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣に病変がない24歳男性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。腹部巨大腫瘤と左頸部リンパ節腫脹を認め、リンパ節は絨毛癌と胎児性癌の混合型であった。VAB-6併用化学療法によりほぼ完全寛解に近い部分奏効が得られ、腫瘍マーカーとCT所見も正常化した。
summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with a large abdominal mass and left cervical lymphadenopathy, with no testicular lesion on examination or biopsy. Lymph node biopsy showed mixed choriocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma, and tumor markers were markedly elevated. VAB-6 combination chemotherapy produced a near-complete partial response, with markers and CT findings normalizing. The case illustrates extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting without a primary testicular lesion.

title: The diagnostic value of alpha-fetoprotein in an infant with sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の乳児におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の診断的意義
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた乳児1例の報告である。術前後の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を連続測定した。AFP値は非常に高かったものの提唱された正常範囲内にとどまり、良性を示唆した。病理では成熟組織と少量の未熟神経外胚葉組織を認め、腫瘍内の胎児肝にAFP染色陽性を認めた。
summary_en: This case report describes an infant treated surgically for sacrococcygeal teratoma, with serial AFP measurements before and after operation. Although very high, the AFP levels remained within a proposed normal range, suggesting a benign process. Pathology showed mature tissue with a small immature neuroectodermal component, and fetal liver within the tumor stained positive for AFP. The case highlights the diagnostic interpretation of AFP in teratoma.

title: Pulmonary nodules simulating metastasis of germ cell tumor after aggressive chemotherapy.
title_ja: 化学療法後に転移性胚細胞腫瘍の転移と見誤られた肺結節
summary_ja: 転移性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に対し、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、エトポシドによる併用化学療法を受けた患者の症例報告である。感染症状を伴わずに出現した肺結節は、開胸術で線維化のみであった。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の偽陽性上昇とCT所見から、当初は新たな転移と判断された。
summary_en: This case report describes pulmonary nodules that appeared during combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, cisplatin, vinblastine and etoposide for metastatic extragonadal germ cell tumor, without infectious symptoms. Thoracotomy revealed only fibrosis. False-positive elevation of alpha-fetoprotein and CT appearance led clinicians to initially interpret the nodules as new metastases, illustrating pitfalls in marker and imaging interpretation during treatment.

title: Treatment of testicular tumors: analysis of treatment results of chemotherapy.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の治療：化学療法の治療成績の解析
summary_ja: 1968年から1982年にトゥルク大学病院で治療された精巣腫瘍72例を後方視的に検討した研究です。化学療法を受けた25例のうち、初期の三剤併用療法の患者は2年以内に死亡しました。一方、CBV併用療法では8例中6例が完全寛解を得ました。化学療法による罹患は認められたものの、不可逆的な毒性は長期には認められませんでした。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviews 72 patients with malignant testicular tumors treated at Turku University Central Hospital from 1968 to 1982, including 49 seminomas and 21 non-seminomas. Twenty-five patients received chemotherapy. Early triple-drug regimens failed, with patients dying within two years, whereas CBV combination therapy produced six complete remissions among eight treated patients. Chemotherapy caused significant but not irreversible morbidity.

title: Evidence of interepithelial seminoma spread into the rete testis by immunostaining of paraffin sections with antibodies against cytokeratin and vimentin.
title_ja: 免疫染色による精巣網へのセミノーマの上皮内進展の証拠
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 典型的なセミノーマ47例のパラフィン切片を、サイトケラチンおよびビメンチンに対する抗体で免疫染色した研究です。精巣網がほぼ破壊された症例でも残存する微小な精巣網を検出でき、精巣網細管内への上皮内進展も同定できました。この方法はセミノーマの病期分類に有用とされています。
summary_en: This study applies immunostaining with antibodies against cytokeratin and vimentin to paraffin sections of 47 typical seminomas. The method detects small rete testis residuals in cases of subtotal rete destruction. It also identifies discrete interepithelial spread of seminoma within the rete ductules. The authors conclude that this approach facilitates staging of seminoma, since such spread may otherwise be difficult to recognize.

title: Chemotherapy for poor risk germ cell tumours. An independent evaluation of the POMB/ACE regime.
title_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法：POMB/ACE療法の独立評価
summary_ja: 進行した悪性奇形腫55例と大きな転移を有するセミノーマ5例に対するPOMB/ACE療法を独立に評価した研究です。肝転移や脳転移を含む予後不良例にも有効でした。マーカー正常化後の長期治療は不要と考えられました。毒性が強いため、予後良好例には推奨されていません。
summary_en: This independent evaluation assesses the seven-drug alternating high-dose cisplatin regimen POMB/ACE in 55 patients with advanced malignant teratomas and 5 with bulky metastatic seminomas. Many patients had relapsed after prior treatment. The regimen was effective even in patients with hepatic and cerebral metastases, and prolonged treatment after marker normalization seemed unnecessary. However, the regimen is complex and toxic, so the authors do not recommend it for patients with a good prognosis.

title: Early and long-term toxicity in the management of advanced germ cell testicular tumors.
title_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法の早期および長期毒性
summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者47例を、PVB化学療法の治療終了後平均2.5年に再診した研究です。約3分の1に肺、腎臓、末梢神経の軽度の持続的毒性がみられました。セミノーマで放射線療法を受けた32例では、客観的な長期毒性はまれでした。染色体や精子形成への影響の可能性にも注意が必要とされています。
summary_en: This study reexamined 47 patients with advanced germ cell testicular tumors about 2.5 years after treatment with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB). About one third had persistent mild long-term toxicity affecting the lungs, kidneys, and peripheral nerves. Among 32 seminoma patients who received radiation therapy, objective long-term toxicity was rare. The authors caution that possible damage to chromosomes and spermatogenesis should be kept in mind.

title: The capacity for differentiation and production of human chorionic gonadotropin and alpha-fetoprotein in human embryonal carcinoma cell lines.
