The paper is a concise clinical imaging report focused on benign ovarian germ cell tumors.

title: The variable sonographic appearances of ovarian teratomas: correlation with CT.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の多様な超音波所見：コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)との対比
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫23例の超音波所見とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を比較し、腫瘍内部の組成が超音波像にどう影響するかを検討した研究である。ダーモイドプラグの大きさ、石灰化の有無、脂肪成分の組織像が超音波所見を大きく左右すると結論づけている。
summary_en: This imaging study compares the sonographic and CT appearances of 23 ovarian teratomas to explain how internal composition shapes ultrasound features. Most lesions had mixed echotexture, and fat intermixed with hair appeared echogenic with acoustic shadowing. Dermoid plugs were a key finding, and their size, calcifications, and fatty histology determined the overall sonographic appearance. The authors conclude that dermoid plug size, calcified elements and fat composition are the main determinants of how teratomas look on ultrasound.

title: Human teratocarcinomas.
title_ja: ヒト奇形癌
summary_ja: 若年男性に多い奇形癌と、そこから樹立された胎児性癌(EC)幹細胞株についての総説である。TERA-2株の性質やレチノイン酸とHMBAによる分化誘導を紹介し、ヒト初期胚のモデルとしての有用性を論じている。
summary_en: This review describes human teratocarcinomas, a common cancer in young men, and the embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cell lines derived from them. The authors describe properties of human EC cells, including the TERA-2 line that can differentiate into neural and glandular elements in nude mice. They also outline differentiation induced by retinoic acid and HMBA, and discuss the value of these cells as models of early human embryogenesis and of teratogenic agents such as cytomegalovirus.

title: Spermatocytic seminoma with associated sarcoma of the testis.
title_ja: 肉腫を伴う精巣の精母細胞性セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣に生じた精母細胞性セミノーマに肉腫成分を伴った2例の報告である。ラブドミオサルコーマと原始間葉系紡錘形細胞肉腫が認められ、転移は肉腫成分のみに生じた。手術と多剤化学療法を行ったが、いずれも発症後14か月以内に死亡しており、予後不良な稀な組み合わせであることを示している。
summary_en: This report describes two patients with testicular spermatocytic seminoma that contained a sarcomatous component, one with rhabdomyosarcoma and one with primitive mesenchymal spindle cell sarcoma. Only the sarcoma component metastasized, to lung, lymph nodes or liver. Both patients received combined surgery and multiagent chemotherapy, yet one died within a year and the other at 14 months. The paper highlights the rare combination and its poor prognosis.

title: Comparative study of the mucin-type sugar chains of human chorionic gonadotropin present in the urine of patients with trophoblastic diseases and healthy pregnant women.
title_ja: 絨毛性疾患患者と正常妊婦の尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖の比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の患者尿から精製したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖構造を正常妊娠と比較した生化学研究である。絨毛癌由来のhCGでは四糖コア含有糖鎖の割合が約60%と著明に増加し、侵入奇胎でも中等度の増加がみられた。
summary_en: This biochemistry study compares mucin-type sugar chains of hCG purified from urine of patients with trophoblastic disease and of healthy pregnant women. Normal and hydatidiform mole hCG showed about 10% of oligosaccharides with the tetrasaccharide core, while choriocarcinoma hCG had about 60%. Invasive mole hCG showed an intermediate increase. The findings suggest that hCG glycosylation patterns differ across gestational trophoblastic disease and may serve as diagnostic markers.

title: Paratesticular dermoid cyst in 6-month-old infant.
title_ja: 生後6か月乳児にみられた精巣傍類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 生後6か月の男児に発生した左精巣傍部の類皮嚢腫の症例報告。稀な良性奇形腫としては報告された中で最年少の症例であり、組織学的基準に基づき核出術による治療が推奨されている。精巣傍奇形腫が乳児期に発症しうること、核出術が妥当な治療法となりうることを示した。
summary_en: This report describes a 6-month-old boy with a dermoid cyst arising in the left paratesticular region. The authors note that it is the youngest patient reported with this rare benign teratoma. They recommend enucleation as the treatment for this type of lesion, based on histopathological criteria from the literature. The case shows that paratesticular teratomas can present in infancy and that enucleation is a reasonable surgical approach.

title: The changing patterns of occurrence and management in primary mediastinal tumors and cysts in the People's Republic of China.
title_ja: 中国における原発性縦隔腫瘍・嚢胞の発生と治療の変遷
summary_ja: 1963年から1985年に中国で診断された原発性縦隔腫瘍・嚢胞4,357例を解析した。北部では奇形腫様腫瘍が最も多く、南部では胸腺腫と神経原性腫瘍が多かった。病歴と胸部X線写真から組織診断を80%予測でき、針生検の併用で91.4%に向上した。最適な治療は完全な外科的切除とされ、局在分類と手術手技が示された。
summary_en: This large Chinese review analyzes 4,357 primary mediastinal tumors and cysts diagnosed from 1963 to 1985, including 307 from the authors' institution. Teratoid tumors predominated in northern China, whereas thymomas and neurogenic tumors were more common in the south. Preoperative histologic prediction was 80% accurate using history and chest radiographs, rising to 91.4% with needle biopsy added. The authors present a localization scheme and operative approach, concluding that complete surgical resection is the optimal therapy.

title: Synchronous bilateral primary germ cell tumors in patient receiving estrogen therapy.
title_ja: エストロゲン療法中に生じた両側同時性原発胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 68歳男性がエストロゲン療法を11か月間受けた後に、両側性の同時性原発胚細胞腫瘍を発症した症例を報告。マウスやヒトでエストロゲン投与によりライディッヒ細胞腫瘍が生じるとの報告はあるが、胚細胞腫瘍との関連を示した文献は見当たらなかった。単一症例のため因果関係は証明されていないが、関連の可能性を示唆する。
summary_en: This report describes a 68-year-old man who developed bilateral synchronous primary germ cell tumors after eleven months of estrogen therapy. The authors note prior reports of Leydig cell tumors in mice and men receiving estrogens. However, they found no previously published connection between germ cell tumors and estrogen medication. Because this is a single case, causality is not established, but the report raises the possibility of an association between estrogen exposure and germ cell tumor development.

title: Testicular germ cell tumor in patient with Klinefelter syndrome.
title_ja: Klinefelter症候群に合併した精巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: Klinefelter症候群の患者に発生した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。Klinefelter症候群では縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍が多いことが知られているが、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の報告は稀である。本症例から、両者の関連は従来の報告より多い可能性があると著者らは示唆している。
summary_en: This report describes a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis in a patient with Klinefelter syndrome. The authors note that mediastinal germ cell tumors are known to occur more frequently in Klinefelter patients, whereas testicular tumors in this population are rarely reported. Based on this case, they suggest that the association between Klinefelter syndrome and testicular germ cell tumors may be more frequent than previously reported.

title: Case-control study of gestational choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の症例対照研究
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の女性75例と、年齢・妊娠時期・居住地を一致させた対照群を用いた多施設症例対照研究。BMIの上昇と定期的な運動は低リスク、月経量の少なさ、初経12歳以降、性交頻度の低さは高リスクと関連した。著者らは、低エストロゲン状態が排卵を乱し、絨毛癌の素因となる可能性を提唱している。
summary_en: A multicenter case-control study of 75 women with gestational choriocarcinoma and matched controls examined reproductive, fertility, and lifestyle risk factors. Higher body mass index and regular exercise were associated with lower risk, whereas light menstrual flow, menarche after age 12, and infrequent intercourse were linked to elevated risk. Cases had more dizygotic twins in their families and were more likely to have married more than once. The authors propose that low estrogen levels may disrupt ovulation and predispose women to choriocarcinoma.

title: Normal pregnancy and delivery two years after adjuvant chemotherapy for grade III immature ovarian teratoma.
title_ja: グレードIII未熟卵巣奇形腫に対する補助化学療法の2年後に正常妊娠・分娩に至った1例
summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫（Grade 3）の27歳女性に対し、片側卵管卵巣摘出術とVAC併用化学療法による補助化学療法を施行した症例報告。重度の骨髄毒性のため予定の12コースではなく6コースで中止となった。18か月後に妊娠し、正常児を出産した。VAC療法後の妊娠成功例としては2例目であり、治療後の妊孕性の可能性を示す。
summary_en: This report describes a 27-year-old woman with grade 3 immature ovarian teratoma treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and VAC combination chemotherapy. Six postoperative courses were given instead of the twelve originally planned, because of severe bone marrow toxicity. Eighteen months later she conceived and delivered a healthy child. The authors note this is only the second reported successful pregnancy after VAC chemotherapy for immature teratoma, supporting the possibility of fertility after treatment.

title: Ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of low malignant potential associated with a mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴った低悪性度粘液性嚢胞腺癌の卵巣例
summary_ja: 54歳女性の右卵巣に発生した29ポンド（約13kg）の多嚢胞性腫瘍の症例報告。組織学的に、低悪性度の粘液性嚢胞腺癌と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の2成分が認められた。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴う卵巣上皮性の低悪性度腺癌としては初の報告とされる。単一の卵巣腫瘍内で上皮性成分と胚細胞成分が共存する稀な例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old woman with a 29-pound multicystic tumor arising from the right ovary. Histology revealed two components: a mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of low malignant potential and a mature cystic teratoma. The authors describe this as the first reported case of an ovarian epithelial adenocarcinoma of low malignant potential associated with a mature cystic teratoma. The report documents a rare coexistence of epithelial and germ cell components within a single ovarian mass.

title: Term pregnancy after three trophoblastic disease events.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎2回および絨毛癌の治療後に成功した妊娠
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎2回と絨毛癌を経験し、EMA-CO療法を受けた女性が、その後妊娠に成功した症例報告。エトポシド投与後の妊娠成功例としては初めての報告とされる。多剤化学療法を要した後も妊孕性が保たれうることを示している。
summary_en: This report describes a successful pregnancy in a woman who had two hydatidiform moles and a choriocarcinoma, treated with EMA-CO chemotherapy. The authors describe it as the first reported successful pregnancy after administration of etoposide. The case suggests that fertility may be preserved and a pregnancy achieved despite prior molar pregnancies and a choriocarcinoma requiring multiagent chemotherapy that included etoposide.

title: Gliomatosis peritonei with endometriosis externa.
title_ja: 外性子宮内膜症を伴う腹膜神経膠腫症
summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の切除から9年後に発症した腹膜神経膠腫症の症例報告です。典型的な症状のない外性子宮内膜症を併発していた稀な組み合わせを示しています。予後は原発腫瘍の組織学的悪性度や、播種病変における臓器転移や未熟成分の有無に依存すると述べ、両病変の病態を簡潔に考察しています。
summary_en: This case report describes gliomatosis peritonei arising nine years after removal of an immature ovarian teratoma, with an unusual coexistence of endometriosis externa that lacked the usual endometriosis symptoms. The authors note that prognosis depends on the histological grade of the primary tumor and on organ metastasis or immature elements within the implants. They briefly discuss the pathogenesis of both lesions. The report highlights the rare association of these two peritoneal lesions and the need for long-term surveillance after immature teratoma.

title: Management of seminoma with bulky abdominal disease.
title_ja: 腹部に大きな病変を伴うセミノーマの治療
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1948〜1983年に治療された腹部病変を触知するセミノーマ33例の治療成績を検討した研究です。全体の5年・10年疾患特異的生存率は87%・81%でした。病期IIBでは腹部への放射線療法のみの群で再発が多かったものの、生存率に差はありませんでした。横隔膜上への進展や血行性転移がある場合は放射線療法単独では不十分と結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 33 seminoma patients with palpable abdominal disease, treated between 1948 and 1983, reports 5- and 10-year disease-specific survival of 87% and 81%. Stage IIB patients treated with abdominal radiation alone had more relapses than those who also received prophylactic mediastinal and supraclavicular radiation, though survival was unchanged. The authors conclude that radiation alone is inadequate when supradiaphragmatic lymphatic spread or hematogenous metastases are present.

title: Testicular seminoma: the M. D. Anderson experience. An analysis of pathological and patient characteristics, and treatment recommendations.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ：M. D. Andersonでの経験。病理学的・患者特性の解析と治療推奨
summary_ja: 1960〜1982年に治療された精巣セミノーマ240例の後方視的解析です。全体の無病5年生存率は93.6%、病期I例では95.5%でした。腫瘍容積に関連する因子を中心に14の病理・臨床因子を検討しています。病期IまたはIIAには放射線療法、病期IIB以上には化学療法を推奨し、残存腫瘤には追加の放射線療法を行う方針を示しています。病期分類やフォローアップの指針も紹介しています。
summary_en: This M. D. Anderson series of 240 testicular seminoma patients treated from 1960 to 1982 reports a 5-year disease-free survival of 93.6% overall and 95.5% for stage I disease. Fourteen pathological and clinical factors were analyzed, most of which related to tumor volume. Based on this retrospective review, the authors recommend radiation therapy alone for stage I or IIA disease and chemotherapy for stage IIB or higher disease, with adjunctive radiotherapy for persistent masses. They also discuss staging evaluation and follow-up guidelines.

title: Retroperitoneal seminoma with simultaneous occurrence in the prostate.
title_ja: 前立腺に同時発生した後腹膜セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣に異常のない後腹膜セミノーマに、前立腺病変が同時に認められた症例報告です。前立腺病変は後腹膜からの転移ではなく多中心性発生と判断されました。ビンクリスチン、ペプロマイシン、シスプラチンによる全身化学療法が後腹膜と前立腺の両病変に有効でした。精巣外に発生したセミノーマの稀な提示例です。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with retroperitoneal seminoma and a simultaneous prostatic lesion, with normal testes on physical and ultrasound examination. The authors favor multicentric occurrence over metastasis from the retroperitoneum to the prostate. Systemic chemotherapy with vincristine, peplomycin and cisplatin was effective against both the prostatic and retroperitoneal lesions. The report illustrates an unusual extragonadal presentation of seminoma and the reasoning used to distinguish it from metastasis.

title: Spermatocytic seminoma of testis with sarcomatous transformation. A report of five cases.
title_ja: 肉腫性転化を伴う精巣精母細胞性セミノーマ5例の報告
summary_ja: 肉腫様成分を伴う精巣の精母細胞性セミノーマ5例を報告しています。うち1例は横紋筋肉腫型でした。通常は予後良好な腫瘍が、肉腫様成分により高度悪性の腫瘍へ変化し、少なくとも2例が死亡しました。奇形腫様構造は認められませんでした。肉腫様成分は非セミノーマ性胚細胞成分ではなく未分化転化と解釈されています。
summary_en: This series reports five testicular spermatocytic seminomas with sarcomatous components, one of which was rhabdomyosarcomatous. The authors describe a rare aggressive transformation of a typically indolent tumor, and no teratomatous structures were identified. At least two patients died of disease. The authors favor interpreting the sarcomatous elements as anaplastic transformation rather than as a nonseminomatous germ cell component.

title: Radiotherapy in the treatment of ovarian dysgerminomas.
title_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の放射線療法
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1969〜1983年にPrince of Wales Hospitalで治療された卵巣未分化胚細胞腫14例を後方視的に検討しています。3例は初回手術後の再発または残存腫瘍を有して紹介されました。14例中10例（72%）が生存し、死亡例はすべて腹腔内腫瘍の再発が原因でした。奇形腫との混合型は除外されています。治療における放射線療法の役割を考察しています。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 14 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated at the Prince of Wales Hospital, Sydney, from 1969 to 1983 examines presenting symptoms, treatment and survival. Three patients had recurrent or residual tumor after primary surgery. Ten of 14 patients (72%) remained alive, and all four deaths resulted from recurrent intra-abdominal tumor, with or without distant metastases. Mixed ovarian germ cell tumors were excluded. The authors discuss the role of radiotherapy in treatment.

title: The ovarian teratomas. A histopathological review of 77 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫：77例の病理組織学的レビュー
summary_ja: 本研究は卵巣奇形腫77例の病理組織学的レビューである。手術検体の検査方法、組織学的パターン、各種組織成分の頻度を解析し、腫瘍の組織発生に関する主要な考察も論じている。臨床転帰や治療ではなく形態学的特徴の記載が中心であり、卵巣奇形腫の組織構成と組織発生を整理した記述研究である。
summary_en: This histopathological review examined 77 ovarian teratomas, analyzing surgical specimens by examination method, histologic patterns, and the frequency of different tissue components. The authors also discussed the main histogenetic hypotheses for these tumors. The study is a descriptive series from the late 1980s, focused on morphologic characterization rather than clinical outcomes or treatment. Its value lies in documenting the tissue composition and histogenesis of ovarian teratomas.

title: Metastatic cerebral choriocarcinoma with primary neurological presentation.
title_ja: 原発神経症状を呈した転移性脳絨毛癌
summary_ja: 脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の2例を報告する。1例は胞状奇胎の除去後、もう1例は妊娠初期の自然流産後に神経症状で発症した。孤立性脳転移に対して開頭切除と化学療法を行い、術後5年および9年の生存を確認している。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の脳転移の治療を概説し、孤立性病変では手術と化学療法の併用により治癒もえられうると述べている。
summary_en: This report describes two women who presented with neurological symptoms due to metastatic cerebral choriocarcinoma, one after a molar pregnancy and one after a spontaneous abortion. Both underwent craniotomy with excision of solitary brain metastases followed by chemotherapy, and both remained alive and well 5 and 9 years later. The authors briefly review management of cerebral metastases in gestational trophoblastic disease. They note a generally poor prognosis but possible cure for solitary lesions treated with combined surgery and chemotherapy.

title: Mitosis counting in seminoma: an exercise of questionable significance.
title_ja: セミノーマにおける核分裂数の計数：疑問の残る取り組み
summary_ja: 2名の病理医が精巣セミノーマ45例を分類し、各症例30視野の核分裂数を評価した。核分裂率には観察者間で有意差があり、3例で分類が一致しなかった。高核分裂率と判定された4例はいずれも病期Iで発症し、追跡中に無病であった。著者らは「高核分裂率セミノーマ」という分類の意義に疑問を呈し、ポアソン分布モデルで誤分類確率と診断閾値を推定している。
summary_en: Two pathologists classified 45 testicular seminomas and evaluated mitotic counts across 30 high-power fields per case. Interobserver differences in mitotic rate led to disagreement in three tumors. All four high-mitotic-rate cases presented at stage I and remained disease-free during follow-up. The authors question the value of the 'high-mitotic-rate seminoma' designation. Using a Poisson model, they estimate the probability of misclassification and diagnostic mitotic-rate thresholds.

title: Absence of expression of a human endogenous retrovirus is correlated with choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: ヒト内在性レトロウイルスの発現欠如は絨毛癌と相関する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は170の組織・細胞検体におけるヒト内在性レトロウイルスERV3のRNA発現を調べた。ERV3は正常胎盤絨毛で最も高発現したが、絨毛癌細胞株と侵入奇胎の生検組織ではほぼ消失していた。この消失はゲノムの欠失や再配列によるものではなく、DNAメチル化による説明もつかず、5-アザシチジンでも誘導されなかった。著者らは、ERV3発現の喪失が絨毛癌の発生しやすさと関連すると提唱している。
summary_en: This study examined ERV3 endogenous retrovirus RNA expression across 170 human tissues and cell specimens. ERV3 was highest in normal placental chorionic villi but nearly absent in choriocarcinoma cell lines and an invasive hydatidiform mole biopsy. The loss was not due to genomic deletion or rearrangement, and it was not explained by methylation or reversed by 5-azacytidine. The authors propose that loss of ERV3 expression is associated with susceptibility to choriocarcinoma.

title: Occult primary seminoma: eighteen-year delay in presentation.
title_ja: 潜在性原発セミノーマ：発症までに18年の遅れ
summary_ja: 後腹膜セミノーマを切除してから18年後に精巣セミノーマで発症した症例を報告する。精巣の組織所見は当初の後腹膜腫瘍の病理と一致し、潜在していた精巣原発セミノーマの再発と考えられた。後腹膜原発と思われた症例でも、潜在性の精巣原発が長期間を経て出現しうることを示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient who presented with testicular seminoma 18 years after resection of a retroperitoneal seminoma. Histology of the testis matched the original retroperitoneal pathology, suggesting that the testicular tumor represented recurrence of an occult primary testicular seminoma. The report highlights that an occult testicular primary can present years after an apparently retroperitoneal primary.

title: Pregnancy outcomes after successful chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma and invasive mole: long-term follow-up.
title_ja: 絨毛癌および侵入奇胎に対する化学療法後の妊娠転帰：長期フォローアップ
summary_ja: 1959年から1980年に絨毛癌または侵入奇胎で化学療法のみを受け、子宮摘出を行わなかった265例の長期フォローアップ研究である。その後妊娠した205例で355回の妊娠があり、303名が生児を得た。子どもの発育・発達は正常で、胎児損失、奇形、多胎、乳児死亡の頻度は増加しなかった。94名の染色体検査でも異常の増加はなかった。再発率は子宮摘出例と同程度であり、化学療法のみでの妊孕性温存を支持する。
summary_en: This long-term follow-up study reports pregnancy outcomes in 265 women with choriocarcinoma or invasive mole treated with chemotherapy alone, without hysterectomy, between 1959 and 1980. Of 205 women who later conceived, 355 pregnancies yielded 303 livebirths. Children showed normal growth and development, and fetal wastage, malformations, twinning, and infant mortality were not increased. Chromosomal analysis of 94 children showed no increase in aberrations. Recurrence rates were comparable to those after hysterectomy, supporting fertility preservation with chemotherapy alone.

title: Correlation between differentiation and lung colonization by retinoic acid-treated F9 cells as revealed by the expression pattern of extracellular matrix and cell surface antigens.
title_ja: レチノイン酸処理F9細胞の分化と肺定着の相関：細胞外基質および細胞表面抗原の発現パターンから
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸で分化誘導し、実験的転移アッセイで臓器への定着パターンを比較した。未処理細胞は肝臓に、処理細胞は肺に定着した。両群の腫瘍は組織学的に分化の所見を欠く胎児性癌であった。ラミニンやIV型コラーゲンの発現は分化を示す一方、未分化マーカーSSEA-1は処理細胞由来の肺結節でのみ消失しており、in vitroで分化誘導に反応した細胞がin vivoで脱分化したと著者らは考察している。
summary_en: This study used F9 embryonal carcinoma cells to test whether retinoic acid-induced differentiation alters organ colonization. Untreated cells colonized the liver, whereas retinoic acid-treated cells colonized the lungs, a pattern seen with both spontaneous death and micrometastasis assessment. Tumors from both groups remained histologically undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma. Laminin and collagen IV expression was consistent with this, but SSEA-1 was absent only in lung-colonizing tumors, suggesting that cells responded to induction in vitro and dedifferentiated in vivo.

title: Use of anti-seminoma monoclonal antibody to confirm the diagnosis of mediastinal seminoma. A case report.
title_ja: 抗セミノーマ単クローン抗体を用いて縦隔セミノーマの診断を確認した症例報告
summary_ja: 20歳男性の前縦隔腫瘤は当初非ホジキンリンパ腫と診断され、CHOP療法は無効であった。免疫染色ではαフェトプロテイン(AFP)や絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は陰性であったが、精巣セミノーマを認識する単クローン抗体に強陽性を示し、縦隔セミノーマと確定された。若年男性の縦隔腫瘤の鑑別における本抗体の有用性を示す症例である。
summary_en: A 20-year-old man presented with a large anterior mediastinal mass initially suspected as non-Hodgkin lymphoma; CHOP chemotherapy was ineffective. Immunohistochemistry was negative for AFP, hCG and other markers, but the tumor strongly reacted with a monoclonal antibody that recognizes testicular seminomas. The authors conclude that this antibody is valuable for confirming mediastinal seminoma when conventional markers fail. This case highlights the diagnostic pitfalls of mediastinal masses in young men.

title: Metastatic choriocarcinoma simulating an arteriovenous malformation on chest radiography and dynamic CT.
title_ja: 胸部X線写真および動的コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で動静脈奇形様所見を呈した転移(性)絨毛癌
summary_ja: 右下葉の転移(性)絨毛癌が、胸部X線写真および動的コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で動静脈奇形と誤認された。画像上、転移(性)絨毛癌が血管性病変に酷似しうることを示す症例である。血管様所見を示す肺病変の鑑別には、転移(性)絨毛癌も考慮すべきであると述べている。
summary_en: A metastatic choriocarcinoma in the right lower lobe of the lung was misinterpreted as an arteriovenous malformation on both chest radiography and dynamic CT. The case shows that metastatic choriocarcinoma can closely mimic vascular lesions on imaging. Clinicians and radiologists should therefore include metastatic choriocarcinoma in the differential diagnosis of pulmonary lesions with vascular-appearing features.

title: Familial double testicular tumors: identical chromosome changes in seminoma and embryonal carcinoma of the same testis.
title_ja: 同一精巣内のセミノーマと胎児性癌に認められた同一染色体異常を示す家族性の重複精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 患者とその弟に精巣腫瘍が発生した家系を報告している。ある患者の同一精巣にセミノーマと胎児性癌が併存し、両者に同一の異常染色体i(12p)と由来不明のマーカー染色体が認められた。弟も2年前にセミノーマで精巣摘除術を受けていた。精巣腫瘍の細胞起源と遺伝学的特徴の観点から考察している。
summary_en: The authors describe a family in which a patient and his younger brother both developed testicular germ cell tumors. In one patient, a single testis contained both a seminoma and an embryonal carcinoma, and both tumors shared an identical abnormal chromosome, i(12p), plus a marker chromosome of unknown origin. The younger brother had also undergone orchiectomy for seminomas in the left testis two years earlier. The findings are discussed in terms of the cellular origin of testicular tumors and their genetic characteristics.

title: Benign cystic teratoma of the lung.
title_ja: 肺の良性嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 若年男性が反復する咳嗽と喀血で受診し、開胸術で肺実質内の良性嚢胞性奇形腫が判明した。奇形腫は縦隔では一般的だが、肺内発生は極めてまれで報告例は30例未満とされる。外科的切除後、患者は速やかに回復した。奇形腫の珍しい発生部位を示す症例報告である。
summary_en: A young man presented with recurrent cough and hemoptysis and was found at thoracotomy to have a benign cystic teratoma within the lung parenchyma. Although benign cystic teratomas are common in the mediastinum, they rarely arise intrapulmonary, with fewer than 30 cases reported. Some patients present with bronchiectasis, abscess, or pneumonia. The patient recovered rapidly after surgical excision. The report is a brief clinical description of an unusual site for teratoma.

title: ERV3 human endogenous provirus mRNAs are expressed in normal and malignant tissues and cells, but not in choriocarcinoma tumor cells.
title_ja: 正常およびがん組織・細胞におけるヒト内在性プロウイルスERV3のmRNA発現：絨毛癌細胞株での非発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常組織と悪性腫瘍の計170検体で、ヒト内在性プロウイルスERV3のmRNA発現を検討した。胎盤絨毛では高発現で、他の多くの組織も胎盤の2～30%程度の発現を示した。一方、絨毛癌細胞株では発現が認められず、ERV3の発現消失が絨毛癌の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study measured mRNA expression of the human endogenous provirus ERV3 across 170 normal and malignant human tissue and cell samples. ERV3 was highly expressed in first-trimester and term placental chorionic villi and at lower levels in most other tissues, but was absent in choriocarcinoma cell lines. The authors suggest ERV3 may have been co-opted for a biological function in the placenta, and that loss of its expression may contribute to choriocarcinoma development.

title: Gonadoblastoma in infancy: indications for early gonadectomy in 46XY gonadal dysgenesis.
title_ja: 乳児期の性腺芽腫：46XY性腺異形成症における早期性腺摘出の適応
summary_ja: ターナー様の特徴を示した生後15か月の表現型女児が、核型解析で46XY性腺異形成症と診断された。膀胱尿管逆流症に対する両側尿管再移植術の際に行った性腺摘出で性腺芽腫が見つかった。乳児期にすでに悪性化していたことから、診断時点での早期性腺摘出が必要であると結論づけられている。
summary_en: A 15-month-old phenotypic female with Turner-like features was diagnosed with 46XY gonadal dysgenesis by karyotyping. Gonadectomy performed during bilateral ureteral reimplantation for vesicoureteral reflux revealed gonadoblastoma. Malignancy was already present at 15 months of age, leading the authors to recommend early gonadectomy at the time of diagnosis in 46XY gonadal dysgenesis. The report highlights that gonadoblastoma can develop in infancy and supports timely surgical management of dysgenetic gonads.

title: Testicular seminoma. A study of 103 cases treated at UCLA.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ103症例の検討（UCLA、1956～1983年）
summary_ja: 1956～1983年にUCLAで治療された精巣セミノーマ103例を後方視的に検討した。病期Iの10年疾患特異的生存率は93％、病期IIは70％であった。病期IIIの多くは放射線療法と化学療法の併用で長期無病生存を得た。骨盤手術歴のある患者では骨盤照射による制御改善はなく、hCG上昇を伴わない女性化乳房は性腺機能不全に起因すると考えられた。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 103 patients with stage I to III testicular seminoma treated at UCLA between 1956 and 1983 examined histology, treatment protocols, survival, and subsequent primary malignancies. Ten-year cause-specific survival was 93% for stage I and 70% for stage II. Most stage III patients achieved long-term disease-free survival with combined irradiation and chemotherapy. Pelvic irradiation did not improve control in patients with prior pelvic surgery, and gynecomastia without elevated hCG was attributed to gonadal failure.

title: Hydatidiform moles. Application of flow cytometry in diagnosis.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎の診断におけるフローサイトメトリーの応用
summary_ja: 水腫様胎盤31例にフローサイトメトリーによるDNA倍数性解析を行い、胞状奇胎の診断補助として検討した。完全胞状奇胎はすべて二倍体、組織学的部分胞状奇胎の多くは三倍体で、対照胎盤はすべて二倍体であった。核型解析とも一致し、組織学的評価を補完する迅速・正確で費用対効果の高い方法と結論された。
summary_en: Flow cytometric DNA ploidy analysis was applied to 31 placentas, 19 of which appeared hydropic on ultrasonography or gross examination, to aid the diagnosis of hydatidiform moles. Complete moles were uniformly diploid, most histologically classified partial moles were triploid, and all control placentas were diploid. Ploidy results matched karyotyping where it was performed. The authors conclude that flow cytometry is a rapid, accurate, and cost-effective supplement to histologic evaluation of hydropic placentas.

title: Results of treatment of non seminomatous germ cell tumours; 122 consecutive cases in the West of Scotland, 1981-1985.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療成績：スコットランド西部122例（1981～1985年）
summary_ja: 1981～1985年にスコットランド西部で治療された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍122例を検討した。精巣原発の2年生存率は91％、性腺外原発は25％であった。精巣腫瘍では非常に大容量の転移で生存率が著しく低かった。病期I患者でフォローアップのみとした症例の23％が再発したが、全例が化学療法で治療された。
summary_en: This study reviewed 122 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours treated at a West of Scotland referral centre from 1981 to 1985, 98 of whom received cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic disease. Two-year survival was 91% for testicular and 25% for extragonadal tumours. Among testicular patients, very large volume metastases were associated with markedly worse survival. Of 31 stage I patients, seven managed by surveillance relapsed, all of whom were successfully treated with chemotherapy.

title: Carcinoid tumor in a presacral teratoma associated with an anterior sacral meningocele: case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 仙骨前奇形腫内のカルチノイド腫瘍と前仙骨髄膜瘤の併存：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 35歳女性の仙骨前奇形腫に悪性カルチノイド成分が含まれ、前仙骨髄膜瘤を併存していた症例である。臨床・画像・病理所見を報告し、仙骨前髄膜瘤および遺伝性仙骨前奇形腫症候群について文献的に考察している。稀な併存例として、仙骨前腫瘍の診断と治療上の留意点を示している。
summary_en: A 35-year-old woman presented with a presacral teratoma containing a malignant carcinoid component, associated with an anterior sacral meningocele. The authors describe the clinical, radiographic, and pathological features of this rare combination. They also review presacral meningoceles and the hereditary presacral teratoma syndrome. The case highlights diagnostic and therapeutic considerations for presacral tumors coexisting with meningocele.

title: Primary choriocarcinoma of the urinary bladder.
title_ja: 膀胱原発絨毛癌
summary_ja: 膀胱原発の絨毛癌の症例報告である。初回生検では絨毛癌と移行上皮癌が共存していたが、膀胱摘除標本と転移巣は絨毛癌のみであった。形態所見と、腫瘍組織および血清中のhCG検出により診断された。性腺外の絨毛癌が膀胱に生じうることを示す症例である。
summary_en: This case report describes primary choriocarcinoma of the urinary bladder in a patient whose initial biopsy showed coexisting choriocarcinoma and transitional cell carcinoma. The cystectomy specimen and metastatic lesions contained only choriocarcinoma. Diagnosis was confirmed morphologically and by demonstration of hCG in both tumor tissue and serum. The case shows that extragonadal choriocarcinoma can arise in the bladder and may be initially under-recognized on limited biopsy sampling.

title: Metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma: two cases.
title_ja: 転移性妊娠性絨毛癌：2症例
summary_ja: 出産後の女性に生じる稀で侵襲性の高い妊娠性絨毛癌の2症例を報告する。消化管、呼吸器、泌尿生殖器、中枢神経系など通常とは異なる部位への転移が初発症状となった点が特徴である。原発巣が自然消退したように見える症例も示され、婦人科疾患が明らかでない場合でも本疾患を念頭に置く必要性が強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes two women with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma, a rare and aggressive cancer arising after pregnancy. The authors highlight unusual initial presentations involving the gastrointestinal, respiratory, genitourinary, or central nervous systems. In some patients, metastatic lesions were evident while the primary site appeared to resolve spontaneously. The report emphasizes that clinicians should consider gestational choriocarcinoma in women presenting with multisystem metastatic symptoms, even when a gynecological problem is not obvious.

title: Embryonal carcinoma of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣胎児性癌
summary_ja: 米国の集中がん患者データを用い、精巣の胎児性癌479例と卵黄嚢腫瘍33例の予後を検討した。胎児性癌の多くは15〜34歳で、約4分の3が診断時に転移性疾患を有していた。5年生存率は全体で88%で、限局例98%、領域例96%、遠隔転移例74%と進展度に相関した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は主に若年層に生じ、生存率はやや不良であった。早期発見と新規化学療法の進歩が成績向上に寄与したと結論づけられている。
summary_en: This large retrospective analysis from the Centralized Cancer Patient Data System examined 479 patients with testicular embryonal carcinoma and 33 with endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor. Most embryonal carcinoma patients were aged 15 to 34 years, and about three-quarters presented with metastatic disease. The overall 5-year survival was 88%, and survival correlated with disease extent: 98% for localized, 96% for regional, and 74% for distant disease. Endodermal sinus tumor occurred mainly in young patients and had slightly poorer survival. Improved detection and newer chemotherapy were credited for better outcomes.

title: Involvement of the gastrointestinal tract by metastases from germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍からの消化管転移
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の消化管転移を6例（セミノーマ3例、非セミノーマ3例）で報告する。いずれも上部消化管に生じ、初診時または再発時に見つかった。無病期間は3か月から10年であった。転移経路は血行性または傍大動脈リンパ節からの直接進展と推定された。強い腹痛、腸閉塞、潰瘍、貧血などの症状がみられ、化学療法後に多くの患者が無病の状態となった。
summary_en: This report describes six cases of testicular germ cell tumor metastasizing to the gastrointestinal tract, three seminomas and three nonseminomatous tumors. All involved the upper gastrointestinal tract, either at presentation or at relapse, with disease-free intervals ranging from 3 months to 10 years. Spread occurred hematogenously or by direct extension from paraaortic nodes. Symptoms included severe abdominal pain, obstruction, ulceration, and anemia. Most patients treated with chemotherapy became disease-free, highlighting that GI involvement should be considered in relapsing testicular cancer.

title: Choriocarcinoma arising in transitional cell carcinoma of bladder: a case report.
title_ja: 膀胱移行上皮癌に生じた絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 膀胱の移行上皮癌内に生じた絨毛性の化生から発生した絨毛癌の症例を報告する。このような栄養膜様成分は膀胱の尿路上皮腫瘍で時に生じることが示されている。生じた絨毛癌は典型的な上皮性膀胱癌とは異なる振る舞いを示す可能性があり、予後や治療方針に影響しうると指摘されている。抄録は簡潔で、患者背景や経過、治療に関する記載は限られており、稀な組織学的現象を記録したものである。
summary_en: This case report describes choriocarcinoma arising from trophoblastic metaplasia within a transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder. The authors note that such trophoblastic components occasionally develop in bladder urothelial tumors. They suggest that the resulting choriocarcinoma may behave differently from typical epithelial bladder cancers, which has implications for prognosis and treatment planning. The abstract is brief, offering limited details about patient demographics, clinical course, or therapy, so the report primarily documents a rare histologic phenomenon.

title: Intraperitoneal rupture of benign cystic teratoma after midtrimester pregnancy termination. A case report.
title_ja: 中期妊娠中絶後に生じた良性嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔内破裂：症例報告
summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫が自然に腹腔内破裂した症例を報告する。破裂は、拡張・排出法による妊娠中期の人工妊娠中絶後に生じた。このような破裂は稀であり、著者らは中期中絶に関連した初めての報告と述べている。産科的処置中に骨盤内腫瘤が存在する場合には、稀ではあるが起こりうる合併症として認識すべきであることが示された。抄録には治療経過や転帰の記載はない。
summary_en: This case report describes spontaneous intraperitoneal rupture of a benign cystic teratoma. The rupture occurred after a midtrimester pregnancy termination performed by dilatation and evacuation. Such rupture is considered unusual, and the authors state this is the first reported case associated with midtrimester abortion. The report highlights a potential, though rare, complication of benign teratomas that clinicians should recognize, especially when a pelvic mass is present during obstetric procedures. Management and outcome details are not included in the abstract.

title: Occurrence of ovarian malignancy in childhood and adolescence: a community-wide evaluation.
title_ja: 小児期および思春期における卵巣悪性腫瘍の発生：地域全体での評価
summary_ja: ナッシュビルの5施設で、21歳以下の女性の卵巣腫大と卵巣腫瘍を後方視的に検討した。卵巣腫大137例中5.8%、卵巣腫瘍82例中9.8%が境界悪性または悪性であった。悪性腫瘍6例はすべて胚細胞由来で、境界悪性腫瘍は上皮性で10代後半に多かった。三次医療機関からの報告より悪性率は低いと結論づけられている。それでも若年女性の腹部骨盤内腫瘤は速やかな評価が必要である。
summary_en: This retrospective community-based review at five Nashville hospitals assessed ovarian enlargement and neoplasms in females aged 21 and younger. Borderline or malignant ovarian neoplasms were found in 5.8% of 137 patients with ovarian enlargement and 9.8% of 82 with ovarian neoplasms. All six malignant tumors were of germ-cell origin, while borderline tumors were epithelial and occurred in late teens. The authors conclude that malignancy rates are lower than suggested by tertiary-center series. Nevertheless, an abdominal-pelvic mass in young females warrants prompt, thorough evaluation.

title: Abdominal rescue after incomplete delivery secondary to large fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 大型胎児仙尾部奇形腫による不完全経膣分娩後の腹部救済
summary_ja: 胎児の大型仙尾部奇形腫による不完全経膣分娩の2例を報告した。膣内と腹部からの併用操作により、骨盤位を通常と逆方向に娩出させたところ、良好な転帰が得られた。この手技は、閉塞分娩を防ぐには遅すぎた場合に限られる。早期の超音波診断と、陣痛進行前の帝王切開が閉塞分娩の予防に重要とされる。
summary_en: Two cases of incomplete vaginal delivery caused by large fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas are described. Recognition of the obstructed delivery led to combined vaginal and abdominal manipulation, with the breech extracted abdominally in a direction opposite to the usual one. Both mother and infant had favorable outcomes with minimal morbidity. The authors note the maneuver applies only when the fetal tumor is diagnosed too late to prevent obstruction. They emphasize that early ultrasonographic diagnosis and cesarean delivery before advanced labor can prevent obstructed delivery.

title: Primary endodermal sinus tumor of the prostate: report of a case.
title_ja: 原発性前立腺卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 前立腺癌と診断された29歳男性の根治的前立腺全摘術で、原発性の前立腺卵黄嚢腫瘍が判明した。シラー・デュバル様小体とAFP陽性の硝子様小体が認められた。尿道周囲導管、尿道、精嚢へ浸潤し、リンパ節転移を1個認めた。精巣超音波は陰性であった。積極的手術と化学療法にもかかわらず、診断後10か月で死亡した。
summary_en: A 29-year-old man with suspected prostatic adenocarcinoma underwent radical prostatectomy, revealing a primary endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor of the prostate. Histology showed tubular, papillary and solid patterns with Schiller-Duval-like bodies and alpha-fetoprotein-positive hyaline bodies. The tumor infiltrated periurethral ducts, urethra and seminal vesicles, with one lymph node metastasis. Testicular ultrasound was negative. Despite aggressive surgery and chemotherapy, the patient died 10 months after diagnosis. The authors note this is the third such case in the literature.

title: Familial ovarian dermoid cysts.
title_ja: 家族性卵巣類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 母親と娘2人の卵巣類皮嚢腫の家系を対象に、染色体の検査を行った。家系内で異数性と染色体切断の頻度増加が認められ、染色体不安定性が示唆された。症例数は極めて少なく、因果関係は確立されていない。卵巣類皮嚢腫の遺伝的素因の可能性を示す短報である。
summary_en: A mother and two daughters with ovarian dermoid cysts were studied for chromosomal abnormalities. The family showed an increased frequency of aneuploidy and chromosomal breakage, indicating chromosomal instability. The report is a brief communication without detailed clinical description, cytogenetic methods or statistical analysis. The findings suggest a possible genetic predisposition to ovarian dermoid cysts within this family, although the sample is very small and no causal link is established.

title: Seminoma testis and concomitant ipsilateral renal cell carcinoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマと同側腎細胞がんの併存
summary_ja: 同側の精巣セミノーマと腎細胞がんが同時性に発生した1例を報告した。文献検索で類似症例は6例であった。2つの腫瘍の併存が偶然によるものかどうかを考察している。治療経過や転帰の詳細は抄録には記載されていない。症例報告と短い文献的考察からなる論文である。
summary_en: A case of synchronously arising seminoma of the testis and ipsilateral renal cell carcinoma is reported. The authors reviewed the literature and found six similar cases. They discuss whether the coexistence of these two tumors could be due to chance. The report is a brief case description with a short literature review, and the abstract gives no detail on treatment or outcome.

title: Effects of dietary retinoids upon growth and differentiation of tumors derived from several murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines.
title_ja: 食事性レチノイドがマウス胎児性癌細胞株由来腫瘍の増殖と分化に及ぼす影響
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 7種類のマウス胎児性癌細胞株由来腫瘍に対する食事性レチノイドの効果を検討した。全トランスレチノイン酸を含む餌は多くの腫瘍の増殖を抑制し、分化を促進した。分化欠陥株の腫瘍はレチノイン酸に抵抗性を示した。レチノイン酸投与はマウスの体重増加を抑制する有害作用があった。分化促進以外の機序も関与すると結論づけられている。
summary_en: The effects of dietary retinoids on growth and differentiation of tumors derived from seven murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines were examined. Diets containing all-trans-retinoic acid suppressed growth of many tumors and increased differentiation, mostly quantitatively. Tumors from two differentiation-defective lines were resistant to retinoic acid. Changes in dietary retinyl palmitate had modest effects. Retinoic acid diets impaired weight gain in mice. The authors conclude retinoic acid reduces teratocarcinoma growth partly by promoting differentiation, but other mechanisms also contribute.

title: Metastatic testicular teratoma invading the inferior vena cava.
title_ja: 下大静脈に浸潤した転移性精巣奇形腫
summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌に対する化学療法後に、下大静脈内に奇形腫血栓が生じた1例を報告した。巨大な後腹膜病変の患者の約1%に下大静脈内転移が起こるとされる。奇形腫は局所進展のみでも致命的になりうる。手術時には下大静脈の確認と、化学療法後の残存腫瘤の完全切除が推奨されている。
summary_en: A case is reported of a teratoma thrombus within the inferior vena cava after chemotherapy for testicular embryonal carcinoma. The authors review literature showing intracaval metastases in about 1 percent of patients with bulky retroperitoneal disease. Seminoma and embryonal carcinoma have previously been found in the vena cava, and teratoma is now added. The case highlights the lethal potential of teratoma through local growth alone. They recommend inspecting the inferior vena cava at surgery for bulky disease and complete resection of residual masses after chemotherapy for testis cancer.

title: Experimental rat model for human yolk sac tumor.
title_ja: ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍の実験的ラットモデル
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 実験的に誘発したラット卵黄嚢癌を、ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍と形態学的・生物学的に比較した。多くの特徴が共通する一方、細胞起源は異なると考えられた。ヒトの卵黄嚢腫瘍は胚細胞由来とされるが、ラットの臓側卵黄嚢由来腫瘍は胚細胞由来ではないと筆者らは仮説を立てている。
summary_en: Experimentally induced rat yolk sac carcinomas were compared with human yolk sac tumors morphologically and biologically. The rat tumors share many features with their human counterparts, but the authors propose that their cellular origin differs. Human yolk sac tumors are considered germ cell derived, whereas rat visceral yolk sac-derived tumors are not. They hypothesize that rat tumors arise from multipotential cells displaced into the extra-embryonic membrane. The model's relevance rests on its morphological and biological similarity to the human disease.

title: Growth and chemotherapy of a human germ-cell tumour line (GCT 27).
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍株GCT 27の増殖と化学療法
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヌードマウスの皮下異種移植片として増殖させたヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株GCT 27で、化学療法への反応を検討した。シスプラチンとカルボプラチンは用量依存的に腫瘍増殖を遅延させた。ブレオマイシンは高用量で体重減少を招いた。エトポシドを低用量のシスプラチンと併用すると、単独では無効でも高用量シスプラチンに匹敵する増殖遅延が得られた。
summary_en: The human germ cell tumour line GCT 27, grown as subcutaneous xenografts in nude mice, was used to test chemotherapeutic responses. Cisplatin and carboplatin produced clear dose-dependent growth delay, while bleomycin caused weight loss at high doses. Vinblastine and etoposide alone had no effect at nontoxic doses. Combining etoposide with cisplatin, which were each ineffective alone, produced growth delay comparable to higher cisplatin doses, possibly by interfering with cisplatin-induced DNA crosslink repair via topoisomerase II inhibition.

title: [Basic and clinical study of anticancer effect of etoposide on choriocarcinoma].
title_ja: 絨毛癌に対するエトポシドの抗腫瘍効果に関する基礎的・臨床的研究
summary_ja: 絨毛癌に対するエトポシドの有効性を検討した基礎・臨床研究。5種の絨毛癌細胞株で強い抗腫瘍効果を示し、栄養膜性疾患29例では有効率93.3%と、アクチノマイシンD(50.0%)やMTX(21.0%)より高かった。副作用も軽度で、高リスク群ではMECA療法が全例で寛解を得た。
summary_en: This study evaluated etoposide against choriocarcinoma. In vitro, etoposide showed strong cytotoxicity across five human choriocarcinoma cell lines, comparable to actinomycin D and cyclophosphamide. Clinically, in 29 patients with trophoblastic disease (15 choriocarcinoma, 14 invasive mole), etoposide achieved a 93.3% effective rate, versus 50.0% with actinomycin D and 21.0% with methotrexate. Side effects were milder. In high-risk choriocarcinoma, the MECA protocol achieved complete or partial remission in all five patients, compared with 50% under the MAC protocol.

title: Neonatal tonsillar teratoma.
title_ja: 新生児の扁桃奇形腫
summary_ja: 新生児の巨大扁桃奇形腫(epignathus)の男児症例の報告と治療経過の記載。極めて稀な病変で、生存例の報告は少ない。性腺外に生じた奇形腫の症例で、中枢神経系ではない。新生児期に発症した性腺外奇形腫の希少例として位置づけられる。
summary_en: A case report of a newborn boy with a giant tonsillar teratoma, also called epignathus, describing his clinical management. Such lesions are rare, and the authors note that few survivors have been reported. The paper is a single-patient report of an extragonadal teratoma arising in the oropharynx, outside the central nervous system. It is relevant as an example of a teratoma at an unusual extragonadal site presenting in the neonatal period.

title: Hormonal factors and risk of ovarian germ cell cancer in young women.
title_ja: 若年女性における卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクとホルモン因子
summary_ja: 若年女性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍73例と対照138例を比較した症例対照研究。母親の外因性ホルモン曝露(OR 3.60)、妊娠前の高BMI、妊娠時の母親年齢20歳未満などがリスク上昇と関連した。精巣がんと同様にホルモン要因が関与し、エストロゲンの作用機序が示唆された。
summary_en: A case-control study of 73 women under 35 with ovarian germ cell tumors and 138 matched controls from Los Angeles and Seattle. Maternal exogenous hormone exposure during pregnancy, including hormonal pregnancy tests, DES, and inadvertent oral contraceptive use, was associated with increased risk (OR 3.60). High pre-pregnancy body mass, rapid menstrual onset, and maternal age under 20 at pregnancy were also linked to elevated risk. The findings parallel testicular cancer studies, supporting a hormonal etiology for germ cell tumors, with estrogen proposed as a mechanism.

title: Immature teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣の未熟奇形腫
summary_ja: クアラルンプールの病院で治療された卵巣の純粋未熟奇形腫9例の報告。6例が病期I、3例が病期IIIで、ほとんどの腫瘍はグレード2または3であった。病期I患者は症例に応じて保存的手術または根治的手術を受け、補助化学療法にはパルス投与シクロホスファミド、VAC、PVBのレジメンが用いられた。患者7例が疾患の証拠なく最長9年間生存した。
summary_en: A report of nine pure immature teratomas of the ovary treated at a hospital in Kuala Lumpur. Six patients had stage I disease and three stage III, with most tumors grade 2 or 3. Stage I patients underwent conservative or radical surgery depending on the case, and adjuvant chemotherapy used pulsed cyclophosphamide, VAC, or PVB regimens. Seven patients survived up to nine years without evidence of disease, showing favorable outcomes for this rare ovarian germ cell tumor.

title: Complications from large field intermediate dose infradiaphragmatic radiation: an analysis of the patterns of care outcome studies for Hodgkin's disease and seminoma.
title_ja: ホジキン病およびセミノーマに対する大範囲横隔膜下放射線療法後の合併症
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: ホジキン病およびセミノーマに対する中等量の横隔膜下放射線照射後の合併症を、1,026例で解析した研究。3年合併症率は任意で14%、重篤で4%。消化管障害が最多で、線量の増加とともに合併症が増えた。治療効果と毒性のバランスから、線量の最適化が必要とされる。
summary_en: Analysis of 1,026 patients from the Patterns of Care Outcome Studies who received intermediate-dose infradiaphragmatic radiation for Hodgkin's disease or seminoma. Overall, 3-year complication rates were 14% for any complication and 4% for major ones, with gastrointestinal injury most common. Complications rose significantly with total dose, and prior GI disease increased bowel complication risk. The authors conclude that dose should be optimized to balance tumor control with toxicity, ideally keeping doses at or below 3,500 cGy where possible.

title: [The surgical treatment for the site of metastases of choriocarcinoma].
title_ja: 絨毛癌転移巣に対する外科的治療
summary_ja: 1978〜1987年に治療された妊娠性絨毛癌16例の後方視的検討で、肺および脳転移に対する外科的治療に焦点を当てた。寛解率は87.5%。肺転移では肺葉切除で完全寛解、脳転移では腫瘍摘出と放射線療法で完全寛解が得られた。化学療法との併用による選択的な積極的手術が有効と結論づけられた。
summary_en: A review of 16 women with gestational choriocarcinoma treated from 1978 to 1987, focusing on surgical management of lung and brain metastases. Of the 16 patients, 14 had pulmonary metastases, and 10 of these underwent lobectomy with complete remission. Three had brain metastases; tumorectomy with irradiation was performed in two, both achieving complete remission. Overall remission was 87.5%. The authors conclude that aggressive, selective surgery combined with systemic chemotherapy is effective for metastatic sites.

title: HLA association of testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおけるHLA関連性
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者52例を対象とした後方視的研究で、HLA抗原頻度を検討した。多重比較補正後に有意に増加したのはBW41のみで、セミノーマの発症に遺伝因子が関与する根拠は弱いと結論づけた。転移性セミノーマではA29、BW41、DR7の増加傾向がみられ、MHCクラスII抗原の関与を含め今後の検討が必要とされている。
summary_en: This retrospective study examined HLA class I and II antigen frequencies in 52 patients with histologically pure testicular seminoma to assess genetic susceptibility. After correction for the number of antigens tested, only BW41 was significantly increased (P = 0.0005). HLA-DR1 was decreased but not significantly. In metastatic seminoma, trends toward increased A29, BW41, and DR7 were observed. The authors conclude that evidence for a genetic role in seminoma pathogenesis is weak, and that the metastatic trend and possible MHC class II involvement merit further study.

title: Metastatic teratoma associated with an intra-abdominal abscess.
title_ja: 腹腔内膿瘍を伴った転移性精巣奇形腫
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後12年で組織学的に確認された転移性精巣奇形腫の症例報告である。2年前にも再発を疑う所見で受診していたが、大きな腹腔内膿瘍のため診断が遅れた。経過中、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGは一度も上昇しなかった。腫瘍マーカーが晩期再発を示さない場合があり、炎症所見で画像診断が不明瞭な際には組織診断が必要であることを示す。
summary_en: This case report describes metastatic testicular teratoma confirmed histologically 12 years after orchidectomy. The patient had presented with a possible recurrence two years earlier, but a large intra-abdominal abscess delayed the diagnosis. Serum alpha-fetoprotein and beta-hCG were never elevated during the course. The case illustrates that tumor markers may fail to signal late relapse in testicular germ cell tumors, and that histological confirmation may be needed when inflammatory findings confound imaging.

title: Immature teratomas in children.
title_ja: 小児の未熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 出生から18歳までの小児胚細胞腫瘍216例を後方視的に検討し、27例の未熟奇形腫を確認した。17例は1回の手術で根治的に治療され、腫瘍死は2例のみであった。再発や転移は治療可能なことが多く、卵巣腫瘍では組織学的悪性度が予後に重要であった。「悪性奇形腫」という用語は混乱を招くため避けるべきだとしている。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 216 germ cell tumors in children from birth to age 18 and identified 27 immature teratomas arising at various sites. Seventeen were treated curatively with a single operation, and only two patients died directly from tumor growth. Recurrences and metastases were often treatable. In ovarian tumors, histological grading carried important prognostic value. The authors recommend avoiding the term malignant teratoma, which they consider confusing.

title: Choriocarcinoma of the esophagus producing chorionic gonadotropin.
title_ja: hCG産生食道絨毛癌
summary_ja: 42歳日本人男性の食道原発絨毛癌の剖検例である。食道中部の腫瘍は出血・壊死を伴う純粋な絨毛癌で、肝・肺・リンパ節に転移していた。免疫染色ではヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が主に検出された。食道発生の性腺外絨毛癌は既報が少なく、発生機序と病理学的特徴を考察している。
summary_en: This autopsy report describes primary esophageal choriocarcinoma in a 42-year-old Japanese man. The mid-esophageal tumor was pure choriocarcinoma with hemorrhagic and necrotic features and had metastasized to liver, lung, and lymph nodes. Immunohistochemistry showed predominantly human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), with human placental lactogen in a few syncytiotrophoblastic cells. The authors note only three prior esophageal extragonadal choriocarcinomas and discuss possible pathogenesis.

title: Tubal pregnancy associated with a benign cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube. A case report.
title_ja: 卵管妊娠に合併した卵管良性嚢胞性奇形腫（症例報告）
summary_ja: 卵管妊娠に合併した卵管の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。極めて稀な所見であり、卵管内に2つの腫瘤を認めた場合には本併存の可能性を考慮すべきと報告している。妊娠初期に付属器腫瘤を評価する際には、本病態を鑑別に含めて術式や病理診断を計画することの重要性を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a benign cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube coexisting with a tubal pregnancy. The finding is rare, and the authors note that two masses within one fallopian tube should prompt consideration of this combination. Because the tubal pregnancy and the teratoma appeared together, clinicians evaluating an adnexal mass in early pregnancy should keep this rare possibility in mind when planning surgical management and pathological review.

title: Serum lactic dehydrogenase: a tumor marker for dysgerminoma.
title_ja: ディスジャーミノーマにおける腫瘍マーカーとしての血清乳酸脱水素酵素
summary_ja: ディスジャーミノーマにおける血清LDHの腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した。4例で術前にLDHの上昇を認め、軽度の肝酵素上昇を伴った。このパターンの認識により2例で適切な術中病期分類と化学療法の早期開始が可能となり、見落とした1例では不十分な病期分類と再手術を要した。LDHはLDH-1とLDH-2のアイソザイム選択的上昇が本腫瘍を示唆し得る。
summary_en: This study examined whether serum lactic dehydrogenase (LDH) can serve as a tumor marker for dysgerminoma. Four patients with stage IA to IIIC disease had preoperative LDH elevations up to 51.5 times normal, with mild liver enzyme elevations. Recognizing this profile led to proper intraoperative staging and earlier chemotherapy in two patients, whereas missing it caused inadequate staging and reoperation in another. LDH levels correlated with tumor size and stage, and selective elevation of LDH-1 and LDH-2 isoenzymes may suggest dysgerminoma.

title: Seminal analysis after orchiectomy in stage I teratoma.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iの奇形腫における精巣摘除術後の精液分析
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの悪性精巣奇形腫97例について、精巣摘除術後2か月以内に精液検査を行い再発との関連を検討した。精子数10×10⁶/mL未満で再発は28%、以上で32%と差はなかった。未分化型では再発率が高く、無精子症例では再発や対側精巣の胚細胞腫瘍を認めた。精子数分析は病期Iの再発リスク推定に有用でないと結論された。
summary_en: This study analyzed semen parameters within two months of orchiectomy in 97 patients with clinical stage I malignant testicular teratoma managed by surveillance. Relapse occurred in 28% with sperm counts below 10 million per milliliter and 32% above that threshold, showing no meaningful difference. Relapse rates were higher in undifferentiated teratoma, and azoospermic patients had relapses or contralateral germ cell tumors. The authors concluded that sperm count analysis does not usefully estimate relapse risk in clinical stage I teratoma.

title: Low sperm counts as a prognostic factor of progression in stage I non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumours.
title_ja: 病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における病勢進行の予後因子としての低精子数
summary_ja: 病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象とした前向き研究で、低精子数が病勢進行の予測因子かを検討した。精巣摘除術後は進行が確認されるまで治療を行わなかった。精子数10×10⁶/mL未満の20例中9例で進行を認めたが、それ以上の例では進行はなかった。精子数は病勢進行と良好に相関し、サーベイランスの判断に有用な予後マーカーとなり得る。
summary_en: This prospective study examined whether low sperm count predicts disease progression in patients with stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. Patients received no treatment after orchiectomy until progression was confirmed. Progression occurred in 9 of 20 patients with sperm counts below 10 million per milliliter and in none of those above that threshold. The authors found a good correlation between semen sperm counts around orchiectomy and progression, suggesting sperm count may be a useful prognostic marker for surveillance decisions.

title: Methotrexate-induced resistance to dactinomycin in choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 絨毛癌におけるメトトレキサートによるダクチノマイシンへの耐性誘導
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株NaUCC-2が標準的な併用化学療法に不応だった背景を、in vitroで検討した。他の3株と比べメトトレキサートの取り込みは高かったが、メトトレキサートとダクチノマイシンの併用は単独使用より殺細胞効果が弱かった。DHFR活性に差はなく、取り込みやDHFR以外の耐性機序の関与が示唆された。標準的なダクチノマイシン・メトトレキサート併用の最適性にも疑問を投げかけている。
summary_en: This in vitro study investigated why the choriocarcinoma cell line NaUCC-2 responds poorly to standard combination chemotherapy. Compared with three other choriocarcinoma lines, NaUCC-2 showed higher methotrexate uptake, and methotrexate combined with dactinomycin was less lethal than dactinomycin alone. Dihydrofolate reductase activity was similar. The authors conclude that mechanisms beyond drug uptake and DHFR activity contribute to resistance, and suggest the standard dactinomycin-methotrexate combination may not always be optimal.

title: Late recurrences in long-term survivors of germ cell neoplasms.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者における晩期再発
summary_ja: 1970〜1985年に進行精巣がんを治療した81例のうち、5例が初回治療後58〜195か月で異時性の再発を来した。全例が救援化学療法に反応したが、完全奏効は2例のみであった。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化などを晩期再発の機序として挙げている。治癒した患者には2年以降も少なくとも年1回の評価を含むフォローアップが必要と提唱している。
summary_en: This Vanderbilt series reviewed late recurrences in germ cell neoplasm patients who were in remission at two years. Of 81 patients with advanced testicular cancer treated between 1970 and 1985, five developed a recurrence 58 to 195 months after initial treatment, and all responded to salvage chemotherapy, though only two achieved complete responses. The authors propose mechanisms for late relapse, including malignant transformation of mature teratoma. They recommend that cured patients receive careful follow-up beyond two years, at least annually, with more frequent evaluations after teratoma is found post-chemotherapy.

title: Primary retroperitoneal pure choriocarcinoma. Two long-term complete responders from a rare fatal disease.
title_ja: 原発性後腹膜純粋絨毛癌における長期完全奏効の2例
summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜純粋絨毛癌の2例の症例報告で、稀少かつ従来最も予後不良とされる性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の亜型である。両例とも積極的な初回多剤併用化学療法を受け、24か月および81か月の時点で無病生存している。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は、腫瘍量や進展度が同等でも性腺由来より予後が悪い可能性があると述べている。積極的な多剤療法により良好な長期予後が期待できるとしている。
summary_en: This case report describes two patients with primary retroperitoneal pure choriocarcinoma, one of the rarest and historically most lethal extragonadal germ cell tumor subgroups. Both received aggressive primary multiagent chemotherapy and remain disease-free at 24 and 81 months. The authors note that extragonadal germ cell tumors may have a worse prognosis than gonadal tumors even at equal tumor burden. They conclude that aggressive multiagent therapy may yield favorable long-term outcomes.

title: Treatment of the residual retroperitoneal mass after chemotherapy for advanced seminoma.
title_ja: 進行セミノーマに対する化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘤の治療
summary_ja: 進行セミノーマに対する化学療法後に残存する後腹膜腫瘤の管理を論じた1988年の論文。文献レビューにより、こうした腫瘤の15～25%に残存がんが含まれると示唆された。そのため、これらの患者には後腹膜リンパ節郭清が適切と結論づけている。非セミノーマ性精巣がんで残存腫瘤切除が標準とされる点との比較も含まれる。
summary_en: This 1988 J Urol review addresses how to manage residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy for advanced seminoma. The literature suggests that 15 to 25 percent of such masses contain residual cancer. The authors conclude that retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is appropriate for these patients. Management of residual masses after nonseminomatous testicular cancer, where resection is standard, is used as the point of comparison.

title: Rapidly growing mature teratoma of the mediastinum: do sex hormones affect growth of the tumor?
title_ja: 急速に増大した縦隔成熟奇形腫:性ホルモンは腫瘍の増殖に影響するか
summary_ja: 12歳女児の前縦隔に生じた成熟奇形腫の症例報告。初経後に急速に増大し、切除組織にエストロゲン受容体およびプロゲステロン受容体が検出された。性ホルモンが腫瘍の増殖に影響した可能性が示唆されている。思春期のホルモン変化が急速な増大に関与したと考えられる。
summary_en: A case report of a 12-year-old girl with a rapidly growing anterior mediastinal mature teratoma that expanded after menarche. The resected tumor tissue contained both estrogen and progesterone receptors. The authors propose that sex hormones may have influenced the growth of this extragonadal teratoma. Hormonal change at puberty may have contributed to the rapid enlargement.

title: Radioimmunoassay of the serum free beta-subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin in trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 血清遊離β-hCGのラジオイムノアッセイ：栄養膜疾患における
summary_ja: 遊離β-hCGに特異的なRIAを開発し、正常妊娠と栄養膜疾患患者で測定した研究です。正常妊娠では検出されず、多くの患者では検出されました。遊離β-hCG/hCG比は胞状奇胎で最も低く絨毛癌で最も高く、栄養膜細胞の分化度を反映すると考えられました。
summary_en: The authors developed a specific RIA for free beta-hCG using monoclonal antibody 1D12 and applied it to 38 normal pregnant women and 72 untreated trophoblastic disease patients. Free beta-hCG was undetectable in normal pregnancy but measurable in most patients. The free beta-hCG to hCG ratio was lowest in hydatidiform mole and highest in choriocarcinoma, suggesting the ratio reflects trophoblastic differentiation. Serial measurements in seven patients showed stable ratios over time.

title: Radioimmunoscintigraphic detection of occult gestational choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 潜在性妊娠性絨毛癌の放射免疫シンチグラフィーによる検出
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の広範な治療後にβ-hCGが上昇した患者の肺再発病変を、131I標識抗体(5F9.3)シンチグラフィーで局在化した症例報告です。病変の抗体集積は正常肺の約10倍で、外科的切除に役立ちました。潜在性病変の検出法として提案されています。
summary_en: A patient with rising serum beta-hCG after extensive therapy for gestational choriocarcinoma had a pulmonary recurrence that was not clearly seen on conventional imaging. Iodine-131-labeled monoclonal antibody (5F9.3) scintigraphy localized the lesion, which showed roughly tenfold higher antibody uptake than normal lung. The scan guided surgical resection of the tumor focus. The authors propose this approach for detecting occult gestational choriocarcinoma lesions in patients with rising beta-hCG.

title: Yolk sac tumors of the ovary and the human yolk sac.
title_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍とヒト卵黄嚢
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠4〜11週のヒト卵黄嚢と卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を比較した形態学的研究です。両者は小管構造やSchiller-Duval小体様の乳頭状内胚葉を示し、超微細構造も類似していました。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性で、卵黄嚢腫瘍は妊娠4〜7週の内胚葉に相当すると結論されました。
summary_en: The authors compared human yolk sacs from 4- to 11-week pregnancies with yolk sac tumors of the ovary. Both showed tubular structures, papillary endoderm resembling Schiller-Duval bodies, and similar ultrastructure. Both were AFP-positive, although fetal yolk sac AFP expression ceased around week seven. The authors conclude that yolk sac tumor resembles the endoderm of 4- to 7-week embryos. The study is morphologic and ultrastructural.

title: Physiological studies of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), alpha hCG, and beta hCG as measured by specific monoclonal immunoradiometric assays.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、αhCG、β-hCGの生理学的研究：モノクローナル免疫放射定量法による測定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: モノクローナル免疫放射定量法で妊娠経過と絨毛癌のhCG、αhCG、βhCGを測定した研究です。絨毛癌では血清β-hCGが妊娠時最大値の3〜100倍で、β-hCG/hCG比も極めて高値でした。非栄養膜性腫瘍178例では異所性産生は稀で、マーカーとしての有用性は低いと結論されました。
summary_en: The authors developed monoclonal immunoradiometric assays for hCG, alpha-hCG, and beta-hCG and used them to study early pregnancy, normal gestation, and choriocarcinoma. Choriocarcinoma showed serum beta-hCG 3 to 100 times higher than pregnancy maxima and exceptionally high beta-hCG to hCG ratios. In 178 patients with nontrophoblastic tumors, ectopic subunit production was rare and hCG was not detected. The authors conclude these markers are not useful for nontrophoblastic tumors.

title: Primary choriocarcinoma of mediastinum with immunohistochemical study and review of the literature.
title_ja: 縦隔原発絨毛癌の免疫組織化学的検討と文献的考察
summary_ja: 縦隔原発の絨毛癌の症例を報告した論文です。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍の多くは精巣からの転移であり、原発例は極めて稀です。腫瘍は絨毛癌の組織像を示し、免疫組織化学でβ-hCG陽性でした。患者は手術と化学療法の後、2年経過時点で無症状で生存しています。文献的考察も含まれます。
summary_en: This case report describes primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare entity, since most mediastinal germ cell tumors represent testicular metastases. The tumor showed choriocarcinoma histology and stained positively for beta-hCG by immunoperoxidase. The patient received surgery and chemotherapy and was alive and asymptomatic two years after treatment. The paper also includes a review of the literature.

title: Intermediate filaments and desmosomal plaque proteins in testicular seminomas and non-seminomatous germ cell tumours as revealed by immunohistochemistry.
title_ja: 免疫組織化学により明らかにされた精巣セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における中間径フィラメントとデスモソーム板タンパク質
journal: Virchows Arch A Pathol Anat Histopathol
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 免疫組織化学と電子顕微鏡により、精巣セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍におけるサイトケラチン、ビメンチン、デスモソームを検討した。大部分のセミノーマ細胞はサイトケラチンフィラメントを欠くがデスモソームを有し、主にビメンチンフィラメントと関連していた。対照的に、悪性奇形腫の癌細胞ではサイトケラチン束とデスモソームが認められ、そのパターンは組織の成熟度により異なった。一部のセミノーマにはサイトケラチン陽性細胞が含まれ、多分化能起源と胎児性癌との移行型の可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical and electron microscopic study examined cytokeratin, vimentin, and desmosomes in testicular seminomas and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Most seminoma cells lacked cytokeratin filaments but contained desmosomes, mainly associated with vimentin filaments. In contrast, carcinoma cells in malignant teratomas showed cytokeratin bundles and desmosomes, with patterns varying by tissue maturation. Some seminomas contained cytokeratin-positive cells, suggesting a multipotential origin and possible transitional forms with embryonal carcinoma.

title: Elevated beta-human chorionic gonadotropin and a search for cancer.
title_ja: 上昇したβ-hCGと悪性腫瘍の検索
summary_ja: 女性化乳房、乳汁漏出、β-hCG高値で受診した24歳男性の症例報告です。広範な検索でも原発巣を特定できませんでした。右精巣摘除術では精巣は正常でしたが、リンパ節に胎児性癌と絨毛癌の成分が認められました。化学療法によりβ-hCGは正常化し、患者は治癒したとみられています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with gynecomastia, galactorrhea, and elevated beta-hCG. Extensive workup, including CT and selective testicular vein catheterization, did not identify the source. Right orchiectomy showed a normal testis, but a lymph node biopsy contained embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma elements. Chemotherapy normalized beta-hCG levels, and the patient appeared cured. The authors emphasize the need for an extensive malignancy search and consideration of orchiectomy in such cases.

title: Alternating cycles of etoposide plus cisplatin and VAB-6 in the treatment of poor-risk patients with germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 予後不良胚細胞腫瘍に対するエトポシド+シスプラチン(EP)とVAB-6の交互療法
summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍患者41例を対象に、EP療法とVAB-6療法を交互に6か月行った第II相試験です。縦隔・後腹膜腫瘍の完全寛解率は57%、予後不良の精巣がんは52%でした。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の成績はVAB-6単独と同等でしたが、毒性は強く出ました。著者らはこの交互療法を推奨せず、臨床試験実施施設への紹介を勧めています。
summary_en: This phase II trial tested six months of alternating etoposide plus cisplatin (EP) and VAB-6 in 41 evaluable patients with poor-risk germ cell tumors. Complete remission rates were 57% for mediastinal and retroperitoneal tumors and 52% for poor-risk testicular cancer. Outcomes for nonseminomatous tumors matched those of VAB-6 alone, but toxicity was greater. The authors did not recommend this schedule and advised referral of such patients to centers conducting prospective trials.

title: The role of aggregation in embryonal carcinoma cell differentiation.
title_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の分化における凝集の役割
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞の凝集体をDMSOで処理し、分化を観察した基礎研究。小型凝集体は原始内胚葉様の上皮へ、大型凝集体では壊死領域近傍に心筋様の筋細胞が出現した。筋分化には上皮被覆に加え、壊死への近接などの別の因子が必要と考察している。凝集体サイズと微小環境が胎児性癌の分化に影響することを示す。
summary_en: P19 embryonal carcinoma cells were aggregated and exposed to DMSO to examine their differentiation. Small aggregates mainly formed a primitive extraembryonic endoderm-like epithelium, identified by ultrastructure and cytokeratin expression. Cardiac-like muscle cells appeared only in large aggregates, typically near necrotic regions, after 5 to 6 days. The authors propose that muscle differentiation requires both a DMSO-induced epithelial coat and a second factor, possibly proximity to necrosis. The findings show how aggregate size and microenvironment shape embryonal carcinoma differentiation.

title: Yolk sac carcinoma of the testis in children.
title_ja: 小児精巣卵黄嚢癌
summary_ja: 1971〜1983年に小児病院で治療された、2歳未満の病期I精巣卵黄嚢癌11例の後方視的検討。全例に根治的鼠径精巣摘除術を施行した。術後AFPが正常で局所限局の症例は、追加治療の利益が乏しかった。リンパ節浸潤、広範な転移、再発例は化学療法や放射線療法で治療された。
summary_en: This report reviews 11 children under two years old with stage I yolk sac carcinoma of the testis, treated at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia from 1971 to 1983. All underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy, and four also had retroperitoneal node dissection, with no tumor found in the nodes. Patients with normal postoperative AFP levels and localized disease did not benefit from additional surgery, irradiation, or chemotherapy. Patients with nodal involvement, widespread metastasis, or recurrence responded to chemotherapy, sometimes with radiation therapy.

title: Chemotherapy for germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法
summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法と治療方針をまとめた総説。シスプラチン併用化学療法と補助的な外科的処置で約70〜80%が治癒する。血清腫瘍マーカーは診断、予後判定、治療モニタリングに用いられる。治療前マーカー、病変範囲、組織型、原発部位で予後良好群と不良群に分類し、それぞれに応じた治療開発の必要性を論じる。
summary_en: This review summarizes management of germ cell tumors. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy combined with adjunctive surgery cures roughly 70 to 80 percent of patients with advanced disease. Serum tumor markers guide diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment monitoring. Patients are classified as good risk or poor risk using pretreatment markers, disease extent, histology, and primary site. Good-risk patients are being studied in trials of less toxic regimens, while poor-risk patients need innovative therapy. Progress will depend on randomized trials and new drug discovery.

title: [Treatment of advanced testicular cancer].
title_ja: 進行精巣がんの治療
summary_ja: 進行精巣がん14例(病期II 2例、病期III 12例)にシスプラチン(CDDP)・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法を実施した報告。完全奏効4例、部分奏効6例で、奏効率は71.4%。完全奏効例の50%が再発した。腫瘤の大きい転移では予後不良で、高負荷転移にはエトポシドによる早期導入療法が必要とされる。
summary_en: This report describes 14 patients with advanced testicular cancer, 2 with stage II and 12 with stage III, treated with CDDP, vinblastine, and bleomycin. Complete response occurred in 4 (28.6%) and partial response in 6 (42.9%), for an overall response rate of 71.4%. Two of the complete responders relapsed. The authors conclude the regimen has some efficacy, but prognosis is poor with bulky metastasis. Early induction with etoposide is needed in cases of high-volume metastatic disease.

title: Treatment of patients with poor prognosis anaplastic germ cell tumours (AGCT) of the testis and other sites.
title_ja: 予後不良な未分化胚細胞腫瘍(精巣およびその他の部位)の治療
summary_ja: 1977〜1986年にPOMB/ACE化学療法を完了した未分化胚細胞腫瘍の男性170例の報告。1979年以降はPOMBを3コース以上投与し、初診時のhCGやAFPの高値が予後不良因子でなくなった。治療完了139例の全生存期間(全生存率)は89%、放射線療法歴のない例では92%だった。
summary_en: This report describes 170 male patients with anaplastic germ cell tumors of the testis or other sites who were treated with POMB/ACE chemotherapy from 1977 to 1986. After 1979, patients received at least three POMB courses, which removed the adverse prognostic effect of high initial hCG and AFP. Among 139 who completed therapy, overall survival was 89%, and 92% in patients without prior radiotherapy. Stage at presentation and metastatic volume were not major adverse factors with this regimen.

title: Incidence of developmental handicaps among the offspring of men treated for testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ治療を受けた男性の子における発達障害の発生率
summary_ja: 1969〜1984年に精巣セミノーマの放射線療法を受けた男性を対象とした、子の発達に関する調査。回答33例で、放射線照射の前後に生まれた子を比較した。放射線療法後に生まれた子に、情緒、身体、発達上の有害な影響は認められなかった。精巣セミノーマ長期生存者の生殖転帰への懸念に答える研究である。
summary_en: Researchers at NYU Medical Center surveyed men treated with radiotherapy for testicular seminoma between 1969 and 1984 about the development of their children. Of 33 respondents, the survey covered offspring conceived before and after radiation treatment. The authors found no detrimental emotional, physical, or developmental effects in offspring fathered after radiation therapy for seminoma. The study addresses concerns about reproductive outcomes in long-term survivors of testicular seminoma.

title: Human embryonal carcinoma cells and their differentiation in culture.
title_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞とその培養下での分化
summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍由来のクローン株2102Ep・TERA-2を用い、ヒト胎児性癌細胞の共通特性を総説した。SSEA-3/4、TRA-1-60/81などの表面抗原とサイトケラチンの発現が特徴。SSEA-3/4陰性の変異株もあり、糖脂質のコア構造の変化が分化の指標と考えられる。インターフェロンはクラスI MHC抗原の発現を誘導するが、増殖や分化には影響しなかった。
summary_en: This paper reviews properties of human embryonal carcinoma cells, using the clonal lines 2102Ep and TERA-2 derived from human germ cell tumours. Common features include expression of surface antigens SSEA-3, SSEA-4, TRA-1-60, and TRA-1-81, and cytokeratin. Some variants lack SSEA-3 and -4 yet still produce the relevant glycolipids, suggesting that a switch in core structure synthesis marks differentiation. Interferon induces class I MHC antigen expression without altering growth, differentiation, or viral resistance.

title: Primary chemotherapy for clinical stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis: a follow-up of 50 patients.
title_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(病期II)に対する初回化学療法：50例の追跡調査
summary_ja: 1987年の報告。病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍50例に初回化学療法を施行し、96%が完全奏効を得た。化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)は22%で必要で、胎児性癌では8%、奇形腫成分を有する例では36%だった。組織型と残存腫瘍の大きさに基づく個別化治療を提案している。
summary_en: This 1987 study reports 50 patients with clinical stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis treated with primary chemotherapy, with postchemotherapy RPLND in selected cases. Complete response was achieved in 96%, with mean disease-free survival of 132 weeks. Postchemotherapy RPLND was needed in 22%, less often for embryonal carcinoma (8%) than for teratomatous primaries (36%). The authors propose individualized therapy by histology and residual tumor volume: chemotherapy alone for embryonal carcinoma, RPLND for teratomatous elements, and chemotherapy plus surgery for larger volumes.

title: Residual mass after chemotherapy for seminoma: changing concepts of management.
title_ja: セミノーマの化学療法後の残存腫瘤：治療方針の考え方の変化
summary_ja: 1987年の泌尿器科報告。進行セミノーマの導入化学療法後に残る腫瘤を扱う。後腹膜線維化は切除不能で病理学的に陰性であることが多い一方、限局性腫瘤は切除可能だが生存セミノーマを含むことが多く、追加治療の適応となる。化学療法後の残存病変に対する治療方針の考え方の変化を示す。
summary_en: This short 1987 urology paper addresses residual masses after induction chemotherapy for advanced seminoma. Radiographic and clinical findings can reflect either retroperitoneal fibrosis or a discrete mass. Fibrotic residue is unresectable and usually pathologically negative, while discrete masses are resectable but often contain viable seminoma, indicating further therapy. The authors update management concepts for post-chemotherapy residual disease.

title: [A case of primary retroperitoneal tumor with combined histologic features of embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor].
title_ja: 胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織像を併せ持つ原発性後腹膜腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 31歳男性の原発性後腹膜腫瘍の1例。胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織像を併せ持っていた。当初は汎腹膜炎と診断され、開腹術で腹部大動脈に付着する大きな腫瘍が見つかった。網状構造の腫瘍細胞はαフェトプロテイン陽性であった。精巣は触診と超音波検査で異常がなく、精巣外の原発と判断された。
summary_en: A case report of a 31-year-old man with a primary retroperitoneal tumor showing combined embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor histology. He presented with severe abdominal pain, initially diagnosed as panperitonitis, and a large tumor adherent to the abdominal aorta with hemorrhage and necrosis was found at laparotomy. Histology showed solid immature large cells with reticular, tubular and glomeruloid patterns, and immunohistochemistry showed alpha-fetoprotein positivity in the reticular component. Testes were normal on examination and ultrasound.

title: [Salvage surgery following chemotherapy of advanced testicular cancer].
title_ja: 進行精巣がんの化学療法後のサルベージ手術
summary_ja: 精巣がんの進行例52例にPVB療法(シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン)を施行した1987年の報告。完全寛解が得られなかった24例中18例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清などのサルベージ手術を行った。残存組織は線維化40%、奇形腫28%、活動性癌32%であった。線維化と奇形腫の症例の多くは無病生存を続けたが、活動性癌では8例中3例のみであった。全体の67.3%が無病生存した。
summary_en: A Japanese series of 52 patients with advanced testicular cancer treated with PVB chemotherapy (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin). Of 24 without complete remission, 18 underwent salvage resection, including retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, lung, cervical and brain lesions. Residual histology was fibrosis in 40%, teratoma in 28%, and active cancer in 32%. Patients with fibrous tissue or teratoma remained disease-free, whereas only three of eight with active cancer were alive without disease. Overall, 67.3% were alive without evidence of disease.

title: Tissue alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotrophin in non-seminomatous testicular tumours. A comparative study with serum levels.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍における組織αフェトプロテインとヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン：血清値との比較
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍18例の組織標本で、AFPとhCGの局在を血清値と比較した1987年の報告。組織染色の陽性所見は血清腫瘍マーカーの上昇と密接に相関した。AFPとhCGは異なる細胞に局在し、同一細胞での共染色はなかった。血清値が正常でも組織で陽性を示す例があり、免疫細胞化学は血清測定より感度が高いと結論された。
summary_en: This 1987 study compares tissue localization of AFP and hCG with serum levels in 20 specimens from 18 patients with nonseminomatous testicular tumors. Immunoperoxidase staining correlated closely with elevated serum markers. AFP and hCG were localized to different cells, with no cell staining for both. Some patients with normal serum markers still showed tumor marker positivity in tissue, leading the authors to conclude that immunocytochemistry is more sensitive than serum measurement.

title: Sensitivity of human germ-cell-tumor cell lines to human interferons.
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株のヒトインターフェロンに対する感受性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 分化段階の異なるヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株4種を用い、インターフェロン(IFN)への感受性を検討した1987年の基礎研究。胎児性癌株はIFNによる抗ウイルス作用や2-5Aシンテターゼ誘導が認められなかった。一方、絨毛癌株と卵黄嚢腫瘍株は抗ウイルス作用に感受性を示した。絨毛癌株のみが抗増殖効果も示した。IFNの産生と感受性は細胞の分化度に依存すると結論づけられた。
summary_en: Four human germ cell tumor cell lines representing different differentiation stages (two embryonal carcinomas, one choriocarcinoma, one yolk sac tumor) were tested for responses to human interferons in vitro. Poly I:C induced IFN production in choriocarcinoma and yolk sac lines but not in embryonal carcinoma lines. Embryonal carcinoma lines were resistant to antiviral effects and 2-5A synthetase induction, while the choriocarcinoma and yolk sac lines responded. Only the choriocarcinoma line showed antiproliferative response, suggesting IFN sensitivity tracks differentiation.

title: The treatment of advanced metastatic seminoma: experience in 55 cases.
title_ja: 進行転移性セミノーマの治療：55例の経験
summary_ja: 進行転移性セミノーマ55例の治療成績を報告した1987年の論文。未治療39例中36例が完全奏効を得た。初回放射線療法後に再発した15例にもシスプラチン併用化学療法が施行され、13例が完全奏効した。重篤な合併症で4例が死亡した。病期の軽い症例では、毒性の少ない化学療法レジメンの検討を提唱している。
summary_en: A 1987 series of 55 patients with advanced metastatic seminoma treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy with or without surgery or radiotherapy. Of 39 untreated patients, 36 achieved complete response and 33 were alive without evidence of disease at median 36 months. Fifteen patients with relapse after radiotherapy also responded. Efficacy was high, but severe toxicities including septicemia and marrow aplasia caused four deaths. The authors suggest that less toxic regimens be explored for less advanced disease.

title: [Malignant germ cell tumors in the mediastinum].
title_ja: 縦隔の悪性胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 1987年の本報告は、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍12例の臨床経験と文献レビューに基づき、診断と治療をまとめたものである。セミノーマは手術と放射線療法で治療でき、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍にはシスプラチンを含む化学療法が第一選択とされる。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は診断と効果判定に有用である。縦隔病変の生存期間中央値は14カ月で、精巣例より短かった。
summary_en: This 1987 Japanese report reviews 12 patients with mediastinal germ cell tumors and the literature. Seminomas are radiosensitive and can be treated with surgery and radiation, while non-seminomatous germ cell tumors require cisplatin-based chemotherapy. AFP and hCG are recommended for diagnosis and for monitoring response, with tissue diagnosis obtained by mediastinoscopy or anterior mediastinotomy. Median survival with mediastinal involvement was 14 months, lower than in testicular disease.

title: Differentiation patterns of testicular germ-cell tumours as revealed by a panel of monoclonal antibodies.
title_ja: モノクローナル抗体パネルによる精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分化パターン
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1987年の本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍30例を対象に、ケラチン、上皮糖蛋白、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼなどに対する単クローン抗体パネルで免疫染色を行った。奇形腫や混合型腫瘍のケラチン発現は正常上皮に類似していた。ケラチン19抗体などは胎児性癌とセミノーマの鑑別に有用であった。胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼは大多数の症例で陽性であり、胚細胞腫瘍のマーカーとして有用である。
summary_en: This 1987 study used a panel of monoclonal antibodies to keratins, epithelial glycoproteins, placental alkaline phosphatase, and collagen IV to examine 30 human testicular germ cell tumors. Keratin expression resembled normal epithelium in teratomas and mixed tumors. Keratin 19 antibodies and the RICEO-MFG-06.3 antibody helped distinguish embryonal carcinoma from seminoma. Placental alkaline phosphatase was positive in nearly all tumors, supporting its use as a germ cell tumor marker.

title: Therapy of a locally advanced testicular seminoma without metastases. A case report.
title_ja: 転移のない局所進行精巣セミノーマの治療：症例報告
summary_ja: 1987年の南アフリカからの症例報告で、鼠径部精巣に生じた転移のない局所進行セミノーマの33歳男性を対象とする。シスプラチンを含む多剤併用化学療法の後、残存腫瘤を切除したが生存腫瘍は認められなかった。31カ月経過時点で再発の所見はない。局所進行精巣セミノーマに対する化学療法の有効性を示す。
summary_en: This 1987 South African case report describes a 33-year-old man with a locally advanced seminoma arising in an inguinal testis without metastases. He received cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy, followed by resection of the residual mass, which contained no viable tumor. At 31 months of follow-up there was no evidence of disease. The report illustrates that chemotherapy can be effective for locally advanced testicular seminoma.

title: Human chorionic gonadotropin and alpha-fetoprotein in sera and tumor cells of a patient with pure dysgerminoma of the ovary. A case report with radio-immunoassay and immunoperoxidase.
title_ja: 卵巣の純粋ディスジャーミノーマにおけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンとαフェトプロテイン：症例報告
summary_ja: 1987年の本症例報告は、純粋卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ7例のうち1例で術前に血清hCGとAFPが軽度上昇していた事例を検討した。摘出後にいずれも正常範囲に戻った。免疫染色により、hCGは多核巨細胞と紡錘形細胞、AFPは円形細胞に局在した。腫瘍細胞自体が腫瘍マーカーを産生することが示唆された。
summary_en: This 1987 case report examined one of seven patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma who had mildly elevated serum hCG and AFP before surgery. Both markers normalized after tumor removal. Immunohistochemistry localized hCG to multinucleated giant cells and spindle-shaped cells, and AFP to round cells. The findings suggest that the tumor cells themselves produce these markers. The study provides insight into the marker-producing components of dysgerminoma.

title: Serum neuron-specific enolase. A marker for responses to therapy in seminoma.
title_ja: 血清神経特異的エノラーゼ：セミノーマの治療反応マーカー
summary_ja: 1987年の研究は、精巣がん105例で血清神経特異的エノラーゼ(NSE)を評価し、AFPやhCGと比較した。転移性セミノーマの73%でNSEが上昇し、化学療法後に正常化した。非セミノーマでは上昇例は15%にすぎなかった。セミノーマの治療モニタリングにNSEが有用と考えられる。
summary_en: This 1987 study evaluated serum neuron-specific enolase (NSE) in 105 patients with testicular cancer, compared with AFP and hCG. NSE was elevated in 73% of patients with metastatic seminoma and normalized after chemotherapy. Only 15% of patients with metastatic nonseminomatous tumors had elevated NSE, so AFP and hCG remained more informative for them. NSE was normal in 53 of 54 patients after orchiectomy without metastatic disease. The authors propose NSE as a marker for monitoring metastatic seminoma.

title: Sarcoid-like hilar and mediastinal lymphadenopathy in a patient with metastatic testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん転移症例にみられたサルコイドーシス様の肺門・縦隔リンパ節腫大
summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の根治的切除後に、進行性の肺門・縦隔リンパ節腫大と多発肺結節を呈した症例報告である。縦隔リンパ節生検で肉芽腫が見られ結節性サルコイドーシスが疑われたが、肺結節の穿刺吸引で精巣がんの転移と判明した。類肉腫反応は精巣がん切除後にも起こるが、併存する肺結節は転移除外のため生検すべきだと著者らは述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with progressive hilar and mediastinal lymphadenopathy and multiple pulmonary nodules after apparently curative resection of testicular embryonal cell cancer. Mediastinal node biopsy showed granulomas, suggesting nodular sarcoidosis. However, needle aspiration of the lung nodules revealed metastatic testicular cancer.
