The authors emphasise that sarcoid-like reactions can follow resection, but coexisting pulmonary nodules should be biopsied to exclude metastases.

title: Intrapericardial yolk sac tumor in an infant girl.
title_ja: 乳児女児に発生した心膜内卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 14か月の女児に発生した心膜内卵黄嚢腫瘍の初めての報告例である。収縮期雑音、心拡大、心不全症状で発症し、手術で心膜内に巨大で脆い腫瘤を認めた。初回切除、化学療法、13か月後の再切除を行ったが、診断から24か月後に死亡した。腫瘍の増大は血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇と関連していた。
summary_en: This report describes the first known case of an intrapericardial yolk sac tumour, in a 14-month-old girl who presented with a systolic murmur, cardiomegaly and cardiac failure. Surgery revealed a large, friable intrapericardial mass without extrapericardial spread, confirmed as yolk sac tumour histologically and immunohistochemically. After resection, chemotherapy and a second resection 13 months later, the patient died 24 months after diagnosis. Tumour enlargement was associated with elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein.

title: Cultured stem-cells from human testicular teratomas: the nature of human embryonal carcinoma, and its comparison with two types of yolk-sac carcinoma.
title_ja: ヒト精巣奇形腫由来の培養幹細胞：ヒト胎児性癌の性質と2種の卵黄嚢癌との比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト精巣奇形腫から6株の細胞株を樹立し、3種類の細胞型に分類した。GCT27、35、48は胎児性癌で、サイトケラチンや表面抗原SSEA3/4を発現した。GCT27、35はヌードマウスでαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性腫瘍を形成した。GCT72は臓側内胚葉様の性質を示し卵黄嚢腫瘍を形成した。GCT44、46は壁側内胚葉様で、卵黄嚢癌を形成した。
summary_en: The authors established six cell lines from human testicular teratomas, representing three cell types. GCT27, GCT35 and GCT48 were embryonal carcinoma lines expressing cytokeratin and stage-specific embryonic antigens; GCT27 and GCT35 formed AFP- and hCG-positive tumours in nude mice. GCT72 showed visceral endoderm-like properties and produced solid yolk sac tumours with high AFP secretion. GCT44 and GCT46 resembled parietal endoderm and formed yolk sac carcinomas. The findings suggest testicular teratoma epithelial cells may be nullipotent, pluripotent or committed to extraembryonic endoderm.

title: Chemotherapy of metastatic seminoma: the Southeastern Cancer Study Group experience.
title_ja: 転移性セミノーマの化学療法：南東部がん研究グループの経験
summary_ja: 1978〜1984年に南東部がん研究グループの2つの連続したプロトコルで治療された、精巣・性腺外の進行性セミノーマ62例の解析である。全例が進行性疾患の患者で、全体の68%が完全寛解に達し、37例が無病生存していた。病変の広がりと既往の放射線療法が有意な予後因子であった。
summary_en: This cooperative-group analysis reviewed 62 patients with advanced seminoma of testicular or extragonadal origin treated on two consecutive SECSG protocols between 1978 and 1984, all with progressive disease. Regimens were PVB with or without doxorubicin, or PVB versus cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin. Overall, 68% achieved complete remission and 37 patients were alive and disease-free. Extent of disease and prior radiotherapy were significant prognostic factors. The study confirms chemosensitivity of metastatic seminoma in a cooperative-group setting.

title: Cavitary lung nodules associated with combination chemotherapy containing bleomycin.
title_ja: ブレオマイシン含有化学療法後にみられた空洞性肺結節
summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対しブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチンの併用化学療法を受けた患者で、感染症状を伴わず多発性の空洞性肺結節が出現した。開胸肺生検で悪性腫瘍や感染のない広範な肉芽腫が認められた。著者らは、この所見をブレオマイシンによる肺毒性の範囲に加えるべきだと報告している。
summary_en: A patient with metastatic testicular cancer developed multiple cavitary lung nodules without infectious symptoms after combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, cisplatin and vinblastine. Open lung biopsy showed extensive granulomas without malignancy or infection. The authors propose that cavitary nodules with granuloma formation should be added to the spectrum of bleomycin pulmonary toxicity.

title: False positive beta-human chorionic gonadotropin in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおける偽陽性β-hCG
summary_ja: 絨毛癌成分を伴う進行セミノーマの患者で、化学療法後もβ-hCGが高値で、CTで残存腫瘤を認めた。肝楔状切除と後腹膜リンパ節郭清では壊死組織のみが得られ、それにβ-hCGが検出された。術後に血清β-hCGは検出限界以下となり、3年間再発なく経過した。壊死腫瘍の貪食によって閉じ込められていたβ-hCGが放出され、偽陽性の腫瘍マーカーとなったと考察されている。
summary_en: A patient with advanced seminoma containing choriocarcinoma had persistently elevated serum beta-hCG and residual masses on CT after chemotherapy. Wedge liver resection and retroperitoneal node dissection yielded only necrotic tissue, which was positive for beta-hCG on assay and immunostaining. Serum beta-hCG fell to undetectable levels after surgery, and the patient remained disease-free for three years. The authors suggest that phagocytosis of necrotic tumour released entrapped beta-hCG, producing a false positive tumour marker.

title: The differential diagnosis of yolk sac tumor and seminoma. Usefulness of cytokeratin, alpha-fetoprotein, and alpha-1-antitrypsin immunoperoxidase reactions.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍とセミノーマの鑑別診断：サイトケラチン、αフェトプロテイン、α1-アンチトリプシン免疫染色の有用性
summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍20例とセミノーマ21例で、鑑別に有用な免疫組織化学マーカーを比較した。サイトケラチンは全卵黄嚢腫瘍で陽性だったが、セミノーマの43%でも陽性であった。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は卵黄嚢腫瘍の55%で陽性、セミノーマでは全例陰性であり特異性が高かった。α1-アンチトリプシンは感度・特異度ともに不十分であった。鑑別には光学顕微鏡所見の評価が依然として最も重要である。
summary_en: The authors compared immunohistochemical markers for distinguishing yolk sac tumour from seminoma in 20 yolk sac tumours and 21 seminomas. Cytokeratin was positive in all yolk sac tumours but also in 43% of seminomas, although staining was typically more diffuse and intense in yolk sac tumour. AFP stained 55% of yolk sac tumours but no seminomas, making it specific. Alpha-1-antitrypsin showed poor sensitivity and specificity. Light microscopic pattern interpretation remains paramount in the differential diagnosis.

title: The frequency and histology of hepatic tissue in germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における肝組織の頻度と組織学的特徴
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍516例の検討で、肝組織は9.3%に認められた。頻度は後腹膜および仙尾部の腫瘍、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍で高く、多くは乳児期に見られた。成熟奇形腫や未熟奇形腫(Grade 1)の肝組織は成人肝に類似し、混合型腫瘍の肝組織は胎児肝に類似していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分に接する肝組織は肝細胞癌様の所見を示した。
summary_en: This study of 516 germ cell tumours found hepatic tissue in 9.3%, most often in retroperitoneal and sacrococcygeal tumours and in yolk sac and mixed germ cell tumours, mainly in infancy. Hepatic tissue in mature or immature grade 1 teratomas resembled adult liver, whereas tissue in mixed tumours resembled fetal liver. Immunohistochemistry showed alpha-1-antitrypsin, albumin and complement positivity, with AFP in some fetal-type cases. Tissue adjacent to yolk sac elements showed hepatocellular carcinoma-like features.

title: Expression of the 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme A-reductase and LDL-receptor genes in human embryonic tumours and in normal foetal tissues.
title_ja: ヒト胎児性腫瘍および正常胎児組織におけるHMG-CoA還元酵素とLDL受容体遺伝子の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1987年の研究で、ヒト胎児性腫瘍と妊娠初期の正常胎児組織におけるHMG-CoA還元酵素およびLDL受容体遺伝子の発現を比較した。すべての発生期腫瘍でHMG-CoA還元酵素RNAが高値を示したが、3種の小型転写産物の増加は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のみで認められた。LDL受容体転写産物の増加は、胎児性癌の1例にのみ見られた。
summary_en: This 1987 study compared expression of the HMG-CoA reductase and LDL-receptor genes in primary human embryonic tumours and normal first-trimester foetal tissues. All developmental tumours showed high HMG-CoA reductase RNA, but only non-seminomatous germ cell tumours contained increased levels of three smaller transcripts. Among these tumours, only one embryonal carcinoma showed elevated LDL-receptor transcript, of the expected 5.3 kB size. The findings suggest qualitative differences in cholesterol-regulatory gene transcripts between embryonal tumour types.

title: Failure of adjuvant chemotherapy in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおける補助化学療法の失敗
summary_ja: 精巣の病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に補助化学療法を行ったが失敗した2例を報告した。両例とも初回外科的切除は完全であった。1例は救援化学療法後も無病を維持したが、もう1例は集中治療にもかかわらず進行性疾患で死亡した。著者らは補助療法を研究的な場に限定し、厳密なフォローアップが必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This 1987 report describes two patients who failed adjuvant chemotherapy after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis. Both had complete initial surgical resection and received two cycles of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin at appropriate doses. One patient remained disease-free after salvage chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, while the other died of progressive disease despite intensive cisplatin and etoposide treatment. The authors conclude adjuvant therapy should be restricted to investigative settings with close follow-up.

title: The epitope of mouse embryonic antigen(s) recognized by monoclonal antibody TEC-02 is a carbohydrate carried by high-molecular-weight glycoconjugates.
title_ja: マウス胚性抗原モノクローナル抗体TEC-02が認識するエピトープは高分子量糖複合体に担われる糖鎖である
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来細胞株を用い、モノクローナル抗体TEC-02が認識するエピトープを解析した。TEC-2抗原は壁側内胚葉細胞PYS-2と胎児性癌細胞F9の一部に検出され、レチノイン酸による分化誘導中に一過性に増加した。TEC-2は高分子量の多分散性糖複合体で、糖鎖がエピトープ本体であることが示された。胎児性癌細胞において発生依存的に制御される糖鎖エピトープである。
summary_en: This study characterised the TEC-02 monoclonal antibody epitope in mouse teratocarcinoma-derived cells. TEC-2 antigens were detected in parietal endoderm PYS-2 cells and a fraction of embryonal carcinoma F9 cells, and their expression transiently rose during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Biochemically, TEC-2 is a polydisperse high-molecular-weight glycoconjugate, and immunostaining indicated a GalNAc beta1-4Gal beta1-4R sequence. The authors conclude TEC-2 is a developmentally regulated carbohydrate epitope carried mainly on large glycoprotein-bound carbohydrates in embryonal carcinoma cells.

title: Chemotherapy of germ-cell ovarian tumours: first-line treatment with etoposide, bleomycin and cisplatin or carboplatin.
title_ja: 胚細胞卵巣腫瘍の化学療法：エトポシド、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンまたはカルボプラチンによる一次治療
summary_ja: 1980年から1985年に、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者9例に対し、エトポシドおよびブレオマイシンに、シスプラチンまたはカルボプラチンを併用した一次化学療法を行った。8例が6〜62か月で無病生存した。病期IIIのディスジャーミノーマ2例は、化学療法後に放射線療法を受けて無病であった。早期ディスジャーミノーマにはサーベイランスを、非ディスジャーミノーマ性腫瘍には全病期で併用化学療法を提案している。
summary_en: This study reported nine patients with malignant ovarian germ-cell tumours treated with first-line etoposide and bleomycin plus cisplatin or carboplatin between 1980 and 1985. Eight were alive and disease-free at 6 to 62 months. Two stage III dysgerminomas were disease-free after chemotherapy followed by radiotherapy. Among seven non-dysgerminomatous tumours, six remained disease-free. The authors propose surveillance for early-stage dysgerminoma and recommend combination chemotherapy for all stages of non-dysgerminomatous tumours.

title: Precocious puberty associated with malignant thoracic teratoma and malignant histiocytosis in a child with Klinefelter's syndrome.
title_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の小児にみられた、思春期早発症を伴う悪性胸部奇形腫および悪性組織球症
summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群を有する10歳男児が、思春期早発症と、β-hCGおよびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇を伴う悪性胸部奇形腫を呈した。縦隔腫瘍は完全切除され補助化学療法が開始されたが、3週間以内に血液異常が生じ悪性組織球症と診断された。著者らは、XXY核型が縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の発生と造血器悪性腫瘍の併発に影響する可能性を指摘している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old boy with Klinefelter syndrome, precocious puberty and a malignant thoracic teratoma with elevated beta-hCG and alpha-fetoprotein. The mediastinal tumour was completely excised and adjuvant chemotherapy began, but within three weeks he developed haematological abnormalities and was diagnosed with malignant histiocytosis. He died a few days after starting therapy for that condition. The authors suggest the XXY karyotype may influence mediastinal germ cell tumour development and its association with haematological malignancy.

title: Cis-platin combination chemotherapy for non-seminomatous germ-cell tumours of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法
summary_ja: 1979年から1985年に、転移(性)非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣がん患者18例をシスプラチン併用化学療法で治療した。病期分類のためのリンパ節郭清後に化学療法を受けた病期II 3例は無病であった。病期IIの不良因子例および病期IIIの15例中11例は、中央値52か月で無病であった。全体の5年生存率は81%で、シスプラチン導入前の9例は全員死亡していた。
summary_en: This South African report describes 18 patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy between 1979 and 1985. Three stage 2 patients were disease-free after chemotherapy following staging lymphadenectomy. Of 15 patients with stage II disease with adverse factors or stage III disease, 11 were disease-free at a median 52 months. The overall five-year survival was 81%, compared with no survivors among nine patients treated before cisplatin.

title: Clinical evaluation of basic fetoprotein in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおけるbasic fetoprotein の臨床的評価
summary_ja: 1987年の本研究では、精巣がん58例(セミノーマ31例、非セミノーマ27例)の血清マーカーとしてbasic fetoprotein(BFP)を評価した。BFPはセミノーマの71%、非セミノーマの56%で上昇し、AFP・β-hCG・LDHが正常の症例も検出できた。再発患者4例中3例で再上昇が見られた。BFPは精巣がんの有用な血清マーカーと結論づけられた。
summary_en: This 1987 study evaluated basic fetoprotein (BFP) as a serum marker in 58 men with testicular cancer (31 seminoma, 27 nonseminoma). BFP was elevated in 71% of seminoma and 56% of nonseminoma patients, detecting cases where AFP, beta-hCG, and LDH were normal. Levels tracked clinical course and rose again in 3 of 4 patients with recurrence. Tissue BFP exceeded normal testis, confirmed immunohistochemically. The authors concluded BFP is a useful serum marker for testicular cancer.

title: Quantification of alpha-fetoprotein and beta-HCG in testis tumor patients.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGの定量
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1987年の本研究では、精巣腫瘍患者の血清および組織中のAFPとβ-hCGを、免疫組織学的定量法で評価した。非セミノーマの66%では主に多核巨細胞がβ-hCGを産生し、絨毛上皮細胞がない場合は非特異的であった。AFPは真のセミノーマを陰性として識別し、AFP陽性の純粋セミノーマは硬化性奇形腫成分を示唆した。転移巣では原発巣に比べマーカー合成が有意に低下していた。
summary_en: This 1987 study measured serum and tissue levels of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and beta-hCG in patients with testis tumors, using immunohistochemistry with computer-assisted quantitation. Beta-hCG was produced mainly by polynuclear giant cells in 66% of nonseminomas, making it relatively nonspecific without chorioepithelial cells. AFP reliably distinguished true seminoma, which was consistently negative, while AFP-positive pure seminoma suggested sclerotic teratoma. Metastases showed markedly reduced marker synthesis compared with primary tumors.

title: Testicular cancer: B5, a new tumour marker.
title_ja: 精巣がん:新しい腫瘍マーカーB5
summary_ja: 1987年の本報告は、普遍的な腫瘍マーカーとして提案された赤血球抗原B5を、精巣がん患者63例で評価したものである。赤血球凝集試験によりB5の状態を定量化した。奇形腫とセミノーマの両方でB5の上昇が認められ、セミノーマ患者28例中20例(71%)がB5陽性であった(病期I の13例を含む)。一方、hCGが上昇していたのは2例のみであった。有効な治療後、B5は有意に低下したが、対照群では安定していた。
summary_en: This 1987 report evaluated B5, an erythrocyte antigen proposed as a universal tumour marker, in 63 patients with testicular cancer. A haemagglutination test quantified B5 status. Both teratoma and seminoma were marked by B5; 20 of 28 seminoma patients (71%) were B5-positive, including 13 of 20 with stage I disease, while only 2 had raised beta-hCG. Successful treatment produced a significant downward shift in B5, whereas controls remained stable.

title: Production of alpha-fetoprotein by human germ cell tumors in vivo and in vitro.
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍によるαフェトプロテインの生体内および生体外での産生
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、手術標本、培養細胞、ヌードマウスに移植した腫瘍を用い、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍のAFP産生を検討した。AFPは卵黄嚢腫瘍で最も高頻度に検出され、胎児性癌や奇形腫でも時に検出された。奇形腫のAFP陽性細胞は腺様または肝様の形態を示した。胎児性癌のAFP産生は、形態的発現に先行する卵黄嚢分化の機能的発現によると考えられた。移植腫瘍では産生が維持されたが、培養細胞では維持されなかった。
summary_en: This Japanese study examined alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) production by human germ cell tumors using surgical specimens, cultured cells, and transplanted tumors in nude mice. AFP was detected most often in yolk sac tumors, and occasionally in embryonal carcinomas and teratomas, where positive cells showed glandular or hepatoid features. The authors propose that AFP in embryonal carcinoma reflects yolk sac differentiation that precedes its morphologic expression. Transplanted tumors maintained AFP production, while cultured cells did not.

title: [Significance of tumor markers in the treatment of patients with ovarian malignancies].
title_ja: 卵巣悪性腫瘍患者の治療における腫瘍マーカーの意義
summary_ja: 1987年の本研究では、卵巣癌24例で7種類の腫瘍マーカーを評価し、経時的モニタリングにはCA125が最も有用であった。手術後にVAC化学療法を受けた卵巣胎児性癌27例では、血清AFPは半減期約7日で低下し、全例で10週以内に正常範囲に戻った。その後死亡した症例では、初回治療後10〜30週でAFPが再上昇した。
summary_en: This 1987 Japanese study assessed seven tumor markers in 24 patients with ovarian cancer; CA125 was the most useful for serial monitoring of disease. In 27 patients with ovarian embryonal carcinoma treated with VAC chemotherapy after surgery, serum AFP fell with a half-life of about 7 days and normalized within 10 weeks in all cases. In patients who later died, AFP rose again 10 to 30 weeks after initial treatment, indicating its value for tracking outcome.

title: [Significance of tumor markers in the treatment of urological malignancies].
title_ja: 泌尿器悪性腫瘍の治療における腫瘍マーカーの意義
summary_ja: 1987年の日本の総説で、泌尿器悪性腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーを概観している。精巣腫瘍では、血清AFPが卵黄嚢腫瘍の75%、胎児性癌の70%、奇形腫の62%で陽性となり、絨毛癌では全例でhCGが上昇する。前立腺癌のPAPやPSA、骨病変のマーカーも論じられている。腎癌と膀胱癌には特異的マーカーがない。
summary_en: This 1987 Japanese review summarizes tumor markers in urological malignancies. For testicular tumors, serum AFP is positive in 75% of yolk sac tumors, 70% of embryonal carcinomas, and 62% of teratomas, and all choriocarcinomas show elevated hCG. Prostate cancer markers such as PAP and PSA are discussed, along with bone-related markers. Renal and bladder cancers lack specific markers, with several nonspecific candidates noted. The authors anticipate future clinical use of immunohistochemical and flow cytometric findings.

title: Current concepts in clinical therapeutics: testicular cancer.
title_ja: 臨床治療の最新概念:精巣がん
summary_ja: 1987年の臨床薬学の総説で、精巣がんの疫学、病態生理、診断、病期分類、治療をまとめている。精巣腫瘍の90%以上は胚細胞由来で、セミノーマが約40%、純粋な胎児性癌が15〜20%を占める。セミノーマは放射線感受性が高く、播種病変にはシスプラチン併用療法が用いられる。転移のない症例は精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、約10%が再発する。
summary_en: This 1987 clinical pharmacy review covers epidemiology, pathophysiology, diagnosis, staging, and treatment of testicular cancer. More than 90% of testicular neoplasms are germ-cell derived, with seminoma about 40% and pure embryonal carcinoma 15-20%. Seminoma is highly radiosensitive, and cisplatin combinations treat disseminated disease. Patients without metastases undergo orchiectomy with retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection, with about 10% relapsing. The review notes that toxicity reduction and identifying patients who can be spared intensive treatment are research priorities.

title: Long-term survival after vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin treatment in patients with germ cell tumors of the ovary: an update.
title_ja: 卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対するビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチン療法の長期生存:最新報告
summary_ja: 1987年の追跡報告では、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者13例にVBP療法を行った。12例が完全寛解に達し、うち10例が寛解を維持した。2例で6か月と27か月に再発した。全体で11例が治療後14〜84か月の長期寛解にある。大きな残存腫瘍を有する症例にも有効と結論づけられた。
summary_en: This 1987 update reports 13 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin (VBP). Twelve achieved complete remission, and 10 of these remained in remission. Recurrence occurred in two patients at 6 and 27 months. Overall, 11 patients are in long-term remission 14 to 84 months after treatment. The authors conclude that VBP is effective for ovarian malignant germ cell tumors, including patients with large residual disease.

title: Patterns of seminoma tissue markers and deletions.
title_ja: セミノーマの組織マーカーと欠失のパターン
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1987年の本研究では、セミノーマ18例と対照組織の腫瘍マーカーを解析した。全セミノーマでPLAP様酵素が高値で、正常組織の約100倍、胎盤の約10分の1であった。純粋セミノーマ17例中13例でhCGが上昇し、正常精巣では認められなかった。純粋セミノーマではAFPは検出されなかった。CA-50は低下していた。
summary_en: This 1987 study analyzed tissue markers in 18 seminomas and control tissues. All seminomas showed very high placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP)-like enzyme, about 100 times normal tissue but 10 times lower than placenta. HCG was elevated in 13 of 17 pure seminomas, unlike normal testes. Liver and intestinal alkaline phosphatase were markedly increased, and AFP was not detected in pure seminomas. CA-50 decreased compared with normal testis. The authors suggest enzyme defects explain the PLAP rise and CA-50 decrease.

title: Reassessment of the role of adjunctive surgical therapy in the treatment of advanced germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍における補助的外科療法の役割の再評価
summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍30例で、高用量白金系化学療法後の残存病変切除の意義を検討した。残存悪性成分は非セミノーマ患者の35%、後腹膜外残存病変の40%で認められ、追加の白金・エトポシド化学療法で約75〜80%が持続寛解に至った。初診時の広範な肺病変と切除病変での残存悪性成分が治療失敗の予測因子であった。
summary_en: This 1987 J Urol study of 30 patients with stage B3 or B3C advanced germ cell tumors evaluated adjunctive surgical resection after high-dose platinum-based chemotherapy. Residual malignant elements were found in 35% of nonseminomatous patients with retroperitoneal residuals and 40% with residual disease beyond the retroperitoneum. Additional platinum-etoposide chemotherapy yielded sustained complete remission in roughly 75 to 80% of stage B3 and B3C patients. Extensive pulmonary disease at presentation and residual malignancy in resected lesions predicted treatment failure. The authors support resecting residual lesions after initial chemotherapy in advanced metastatic germ cell tumors.

title: [General concepts of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP)-secreting tumors, with special reference to the histogenesis].
title_ja: AFP産生腫瘍の総論:組織発生に関する考察
summary_ja: AFP産生腫瘍を総論的に検討し、卵黄嚢腫瘍のほか肝細胞癌、成人型胎児性癌、胃癌、卵巣腺癌などを取り上げた。卵黄嚢腫瘍はヒト卵黄嚢内胚葉細胞を模倣することが示された。AFP産生腫瘍の組織発生は内胚葉起源、または卵黄嚢内胚葉細胞への逆分化に帰すると考察している。
summary_en: This general review examines alpha-fetoprotein (AFP)-secreting tumors beyond classic yolk sac tumors, including hepatocellular carcinoma, adult-type embryonal carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and ovarian adenocarcinoma. Morphological comparison of yolk sac tumors with the human yolk sac suggests tumor cells mimic human yolk sac endodermal cells. Some non-yolk sac carcinomas may show selective differentiation toward these endodermal cells, producing increased serum AFP. The authors propose that AFP-secreting tumors share an endodermal origin, or retrodifferentiation to yolk sac endodermal cells, and suggest the term endodermal cell tumors.

title: Immediate adjuvant chemotherapy versus observation with treatment at relapse in pathological stage II testicular cancer.
title_ja: 病理病期II期精巣がんにおける直後の補助化学療法と再発時治療を伴う経過観察の比較
summary_ja: 完全切除された病理病期II期精巣がん195例を対象とした無作為化試験である。補助シスプラチン併用化学療法群の再発率は6%、経過観察群は49%であった。経過観察群の再発例はほぼ全例が救済可能であった。
summary_en: This international randomized trial of 195 patients with completely resected pathological stage II testicular cancer compared immediate adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy (two cycles) with observation and treatment only at relapse. Relapse occurred in 6% of the adjuvant group versus 49% of the observation group. Nearly all relapses in the observation group were successfully salvaged, with 93 of 98 patients alive and disease-free. The authors conclude that adjuvant chemotherapy almost always prevents relapse, but optimal surgery, follow-up, and chemotherapy at relapse yield equivalent cure rates.

title: Gonadal endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor with pure intestinal differentiation: a new histologic type.
title_ja: 純粋な腸管分化を示す性腺卵黄嚢腫瘍:新しい組織型
summary_ja: 卵巣2例と精巣1例の卵黄嚢腫瘍を検討した。いずれも血清AFPが高値で、円柱上皮に囲まれた腺房状構造を示した。免疫組織化学と電子顕微鏡で腸管分化のみを示すことが確認され、純粋な腸管分化型卵黄嚢腫瘍という新しい組織型と提唱された。
summary_en: Three endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors, two arising in the ovary and one in the testis, were studied in patients with markedly elevated serum AFP. All showed a distinctive histology of acinar structures lined by columnar epithelium with large immature nuclei. Immunohistochemistry and electron microscopy, including freeze-fracture studies, confirmed exclusive intestinal differentiation. The authors propose this as a new histologic variant, a pure yolk sac tumor with exclusive intestinal differentiation.

title: Alpha-fetoprotein localization in pure ovarian teratoma. An immunohistochemical study of 12 cases.
title_ja: 純粋卵巣奇形腫におけるαフェトプロテインの局在:12例の免疫組織化学的研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 純粋卵巣奇形腫12例を免疫組織化学的にAFP産生を検討した。3例で卵黄嚢様小胞などにAFP陽性巣が認められた。術前AFP高値の2例は卵巣摘出後に正常化した。術前のAFP上昇は成熟奇形腫ではない可能性を示唆すると結論づけている。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study of 12 pure ovarian teratomas (six mature, six immature) assessed alpha-fetoprotein production and localization. AFP-positive foci were found in three tumors, within yolk-sac-like vesicles, intestinal epithelium, or liver-like tissue, while nine were negative. Preoperative serum AFP was elevated in two of the three positive cases and normalized after oophorectomy. The authors conclude that AFP expression in pure ovarian teratomas recapitulates ontogenic patterns, and a raised preoperative AFP suggests the tumor is not mature.

title: In vitro and in vivo studies of the production of placental proteins (HCG, SP1, PPs) in human choriocarcinoma cell lines.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株における胎盤蛋白(hCG、SP1、PPs)産生のin vitroおよびin vivo研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株8株を用い、hCGやSP1などの胎盤蛋白産生を検討した。hCG産生は細胞株間で大きく異なり、in vitroと異種移植腫瘍で一致した。SP1はhCG産生と逆相関を示した。胎盤蛋白は絨毛癌細胞内で不均一に発現しており、腫瘍全体で一様には産生されないことが示された。
summary_en: This study characterized placental protein production (hCG, SP1, and several placental tissue proteins) in human choriocarcinoma cell lines, including gestational and nongestational lines, using radioimmunoassay and immunoperoxidase staining. hCG production varied substantially among cell lines and was consistent between in vitro culture and xenograft tumors. SP1 was inversely correlated with hCG output in three lines. Placental proteins were heterogeneously expressed within choriocarcinoma cells, indicating they are not produced uniformly across the tumor.

title: Quantitative assessment of lung damage due to bleomycin using computed tomography.
title_ja: コンピュータ断層撮影を用いたブレオマイシンによる肺障害の定量的評価
summary_ja: 精巣悪性奇形腫でブレオマイシンを投与された18例を対象に、CTで肺障害を評価した。視覚的評価はブレオマイシン障害の特徴づけと確定診断に有用だった。CTによる定量的濃度測定はKCOと逆相関し、治療中の生理学的モニタリングに使える。
summary_en: Eighteen patients receiving bleomycin for testicular malignant teratoma were assessed with computed tomography to quantify lung damage. Visual CT assessment characterized bleomycin-induced injury and allowed confident diagnosis, though it did not correlate with changes in gas transfer (KCO). Quantitative CT lung density, however, inversely correlated with KCO and could serve as a physiological monitoring tool. The authors conclude that CT can characterize and monitor bleomycin lung damage during treatment.

title: Prognosis following chemotherapy for metastatic malignant teratoma.
title_ja: 転移性悪性奇形腫に対する化学療法後の予後
summary_ja: 転移性悪性奇形腫93例の予後因子を多変量解析で検討した。血清AFP 500μg/L超と、臨床病期分類で示される腫瘍量の多い病変が、初回化学療法後の再発の独立した不良因子だった。血清hCG高値による悪影響は認められなかった。腫瘍マーカーは転移性疾患の体積と相関した。
summary_en: Multiple regression analysis of 93 patients with metastatic malignant teratoma treated at the Royal Marsden Hospital between 1979 and 1981. In 53 patients with CT-calculated tumor volume, tumor marker levels correlated with metastatic burden. Serum AFP above 500 μg/L and bulky disease on clinical staging were independent adverse factors for relapse after initial chemotherapy. High hCG levels showed no adverse effect, possibly reflecting the small number of such patients.

title: [A case report of ovarian squamous cell carcinoma developing into a dermoid cyst with malignant transformation--immunohistochemical study].
title_ja: 悪性転化を伴う類皮嚢腫へ進展した卵巣扁平上皮癌の症例報告:免疫組織化学的研究
summary_ja: 64歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫内に発生した高分化型扁平上皮癌の症例報告である。奇形腫からの悪性転化の一例にあたる。免疫組織化学ではTPAが多くの癌細胞で陽性、CEAとAFPは陰性だった。臨床病期はIa(i)と判定された。
summary_en: A case report of a 64-year-old woman with a 1550 g ovarian tumor in which a well-differentiated keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma developed within a dermoid cyst, representing malignant transformation of a teratoma. Clinically staged as Ia(i). Immunohistochemistry showed TPA positivity in many cancer cells, while CEA and AFP were negative. The study documents this rare teratoma-derived squamous malignancy and its immunophenotype.

title: [Clinical observation of twelve cases of testicular cancer].
title_ja: 精巣がん12例の臨床的観察
summary_ja: 1984〜1985年に当科で治療した精巣がん12例の臨床報告。セミノーマ8例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍4例。病期に応じて放射線療法、PVB療法、CDDP含有化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った。原発巣が大きい症例でLDHが上昇し、セミノーマの多くでβ-hCGが軽度上昇していた。再発は認められず、精巣がんはほぼ治癒可能な疾患と考察している。
summary_en: This clinical report describes twelve testicular cancer patients treated at a Japanese urology department in 1984-1985. Eight had pure seminoma and four had non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Treatments, chosen by stage, included radiotherapy, PVB and cisplatin-containing chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node resection. Lactate dehydrogenase was elevated in large primary tumors, and most seminomas had mildly raised beta-hCG. No recurrences occurred, supporting a largely curable prognosis.

title: [Subacute cerebellar degeneration with HCG-beta positive seminoma of the testis].
title_ja: β-hCG陽性の精巣セミノーマを伴う亜急性小脳変性症
summary_ja: 29歳男性の精巣セミノーマ症例。血清β-hCG高値を伴い、小脳失調、複視、構音障害を呈した亜急性小脳変性症と考えられた。脳CTは正常。高位精巣摘除術後、後腹膜転移はVAB VI療法で消退し完全寛解に至ったが、寛解後14か月も小脳症状が残存した。精巣腫瘍に伴う本症の報告は本例で2例目とされる。
summary_en: Case report of a 29-year-old man with a left testicular seminoma and high serum beta-hCG (200 ng/ml) who developed subacute cerebellar degeneration with ataxia, diplopia, and dysarthria. Brain CT was normal. High orchiectomy showed typical seminoma. Retroperitoneal metastases shrank after VAB VI chemotherapy, and beta-hCG normalized with complete remission. Cerebellar symptoms persisted 14 months later. The authors attribute this to a paraneoplastic process associated with seminoma and note it is only the second such testicular case reported.

title: The human chorionic gonadotrophin alpha subunit gene in gestational trophoblastic disease. 1. Restriction fragment length polymorphisms in hydatidiform moles.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)α鎖遺伝子. 1. 胞状奇胎における制限断片長多型
summary_ja: 欧州系の胞状奇胎65例、対照71例、家系6組を対象に、hCGα鎖遺伝子のRFLPを解析した。奇胎では対照と遺伝子型分布が異なったが、対立遺伝子頻度に有意差はなかった。絨毛癌との関連が示唆されるR-R-,H+H+遺伝子型は、自然寛解例と栄養膜細胞性腫瘍への進展例で同程度に認められた。遺伝子型と臨床経過に関連はなく、予後マーカーとしては不適切と結論づけている。
summary_en: This study examined EcoR1 and HindIII restriction fragment length polymorphisms in the hCG alpha subunit gene, comparing 65 hydatidiform moles with 71 controls and six families, all of European origin. Genotype distributions differed between moles and controls, though allele frequencies did not. The rare homozygous R-R-,H+H+ genotype occurred at similar rates in moles that resolved spontaneously and in those that progressed to trophoblastic tumours. Genotype showed no association with clinical outcome, so this marker is unsuitable for predicting prognosis.

title: AIDS and germ cell tumors of testis.
title_ja: AIDSと精巣の胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 1施設で7年間に治療した精巣腫瘍115例の後方視的解析。うち25例はAIDS、AIDS関連症候群、またはAIDS発症リスクありと判定された。AIDS群では非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍がより多く認められた。抄録は短く、臨床転帰の詳細は示されていない。免疫不全状態と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の組織型との関連を示唆する報告である。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of all testicular tumors treated at one institution over seven years. Of 115 patients, 25 had AIDS, AIDS-related complex, or were judged to be at risk of developing AIDS. Non-seminomatous germ cell tumors were more common in the AIDS group. The abstract is brief and does not report detailed clinical outcomes. The finding raises the possibility that HIV-related immune status is linked to the histology of testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Intermediate trophoblast in germ cell neoplasms.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における中間栄養膜
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍124例と妊娠性絨毛癌11例を、胎盤マーカーおよびサイトケラチンで免疫染色した。栄養膜様細胞は40例に認められ、全例の絨毛癌や混合型胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分、一部の胎児性癌とセミノーマに存在した。大型単核細胞は各組織型でマーカー陽性を示した。正常胎盤の中間栄養膜細胞と同等とみなす考えを提唱している。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of 124 germ cell tumors and 11 gestational choriocarcinomas for placental markers hCG, hPL, PSG1, and cytokeratin. Trophoblastic-type cells were found in 40 cases, including all choriocarcinomas and choriocarcinomatous foci in mixed tumors, as well as some embryonal carcinomas and seminomas. Large mononuclear cells reactive for these markers appeared across histologies. The authors propose that these cells are equivalent to the intermediate trophoblast of normal placenta and of gestational trophoblastic neoplasms.

title: [Chemotherapy of high-risk trophoblastic neoplasia].
title_ja: 高リスク栄養膜細胞性腫瘍の化学療法
summary_ja: 1974〜1980年に治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患の全国77施設の登録データを報告。5年生存率は侵入奇胎でほぼ100%、絨毛癌で約80%であり、転移の有無に左右される。高リスク例にはBagshaweの予後スコアを用い、MECA療法を推奨。hCG陰性化後も少なくとも4コース追加し、寛解後3年以上は毎月のフォローアップが勧められている。
summary_en: Report of Japanese hospital registry data from 77 institutions on trophoblastic neoplasia treated from 1974 to 1980. Five-year survival approaches 100% for invasive mole and about 80% for choriocarcinoma, with choriocarcinoma survival depending on the presence of metastases. High-risk patients are stratified by Bagshawe's prognostic score. The MECA regimen is recommended for high-risk disease, with at least four additional courses after hCG negativity. Monthly follow-up for at least three years after remission is advised.

title: Computed tomography of anterior mediastinal tumors. Differentiation between thymoma and germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 前縦隔腫瘍のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)：胸腺腫と胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別
summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘍に対するコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を、縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍10例と胸腺腫15例で比較した1987年の研究。腫瘍内部の構造が鑑別の決め手となり、胚細胞腫瘍は円形で石灰化を伴い、良性は均一な低濃度、悪性は不均一な濃度を示した。胸腺腫は分葉状の充実性腫瘤で卵殻様石灰化を示すことがあり、CTは前縦隔腫瘤の鑑別に有用と結論された。
summary_en: This 1987 study compared computed tomography (CT) findings in 10 patients with mediastinal germ cell tumors and 15 with thymoma, correlating imaging with surgical specimens. Internal structure proved most diagnostically informative. Germ cell tumors appeared as round masses with globular or arched calcification. Benign lesions showed homogeneous near-water density with thick walls, while malignant ones were heterogeneous. Thymomas typically showed lobulated solid masses, sometimes with eggshell calcification. The authors concluded that CT is valuable for differentiating anterior mediastinal masses.

title: Neuron-like derivatives of cultured F9 embryonal carcinoma cells express characteristics of parietal endoderm cells.
title_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞由来の神経様誘導細胞は壁側内胚葉細胞の特徴を発現する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウスF9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPで処理して得られた神経様細胞を解析した1987年の研究。誘導細胞はラミニンやIV型コラーゲン、サイトケラチンを発現したが、神経フィラメントには反応せず、神経成長因子にも応答しなかった。結論として、真の神経細胞ではなく改変された壁側内胚葉様細胞の特徴を示すとされ、胎児性癌の分化能の理解に寄与する。
summary_en: This 1987 study examined neuron-like derivatives of murine F9 embryonal carcinoma cells induced by retinoic acid and dibutyryl cyclic AMP. The induced cells expressed laminin, type IV collagen, and often cytokeratin filaments, but did not react with neurofilament antibodies or respond to nerve growth factor. Intermediate filaments were partially lost in long-term culture. The authors concluded that these cells resemble modified parietal endoderm-like cells rather than true neural cells, providing insight into the differentiation capacity of embryonal carcinoma cells.

title: Detection of testicular neoplasms by cytological examination of seminal fluid.
title_ja: 精液細胞診による精巣腫瘍の検出
summary_ja: 1987年の予備的研究で、精液の細胞診を精巣腫瘍のスクリーニング法として検討した。精巣腫瘍患者7例と対照50例を対象に、精液中の腫瘍細胞を検出する手技を提示した。症例数が少ないため予備的な結果であるが、精子の細胞診が精巣腫瘍のスクリーニングに有用である可能性が示された。
summary_en: This preliminary 1987 study evaluated cytological examination of seminal fluid as a screening method for testicular tumors. The study included seven patients with testicular tumors and 50 controls, and described a technique for detecting neoplastic cells in seminal fluid. The authors suggested that sperm cytology could potentially serve as a screening tool for testicular tumors. Given the small sample size, the findings are preliminary and would require validation in larger cohorts before clinical use.

title: Isolation of complementary DNA clones for genes exhibiting reduced expression after treatment of mouse teratocarcinoma stem cells with a tumor-promoting phorbol ester.
title_ja: マウス奇形癌幹細胞をTPA処理した際に発現が減少する遺伝子のcDNAクローンの単離
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1987年の研究で、未分化マウスF9奇形癌幹細胞をTPAで処理すると発現が低下するmRNAに対応する3種のcDNAクローンを単離した。発現は1〜10時間で4倍から50倍以上低下した。pFT27は転写レベルで、pFT43とpFT60は転写後レベルで制御されていた。レチノイン酸やジブチリルcAMPでも同様の減少がみられ、TPAが早期の細胞分化に関して共通の効果を持つことが示された。
summary_en: This 1987 study isolated three cDNA clones (pFT27, pFT43, pFT60) corresponding to transcripts that decreased sharply in undifferentiated murine F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells after TPA treatment. Decreases were fourfold to more than fiftyfold within 1 to 10 hours. pFT27 was regulated transcriptionally, whereas pFT43 and pFT60 were regulated post-transcriptionally. Similar reductions followed retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP treatment, suggesting that TPA shares common early differentiation effects with these agents.

title: Response of human chorionic gonadotrophin to luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone stimulation in the culture media of normal human placenta, choriocarcinoma cell lines, and in the serum of patients with gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: LHRH刺激に対する正常胎盤、絨毛癌細胞株、および妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者血清のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)反応
summary_ja: 1987年の研究で、LHRH刺激に対する正常胎盤、絨毛癌組織、BeWo細胞のβ-hCG産生を培養系で検討し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者では生体内でも検討した。正常と悪性の栄養膜細胞はいずれもLHRHに反応してβ-hCGを産生した。寛解期の残存絨毛癌細胞の検出にLHRH刺激が有用である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This 1987 study measured immunoreactive beta-hCG responses to LHRH stimulation in cultured normal placenta, choriocarcinoma tissue, and BeWo cells, and in vivo in women with gestational trophoblastic disease. Normal and malignant trophoblastic cells both released beta-hCG after LHRH exposure. In patients, 100 micrograms of LHRH was given intravenously to control women, women in possible remission, and women with minimal resistance, with serial sampling over 120 minutes. The authors suggested that LHRH stimulation could help detect residual choriocarcinoma cells during periremission periods.

title: The propensity to malignancy of dispermic heterozygous moles.
title_ja: 二精子受精性ヘテロ接合性胞状奇胎の悪性化傾向
summary_ja: 1987年の研究で、ホモ接合性とヘテロ接合性の完全胞状奇胎における続発症の頻度を比較した。ヘテロ接合性胞状奇胎10例中5例で胞状奇胎後栄養膜疾患が生じ、ホモ接合性では51例中2例であった。また、検討した絨毛癌細胞株2種はいずれもXY染色体構成であり、ヘテロ接合性胞状奇胎の悪性化傾向が示唆された。
summary_en: This 1987 study compared postmolar sequelae in patients with homozygous and heterozygous complete hydatidiform moles, establishing androgenetic origin in 84 of 91 cases using genetic polymorphisms. Five of ten patients with heterozygous moles developed postmolar trophoblastic disease, compared with two of 51 with homozygous moles. The authors also noted that both in vitro choriocarcinoma cell lines examined had XY sex chromosomes, supporting a higher malignant propensity of heterozygous moles.

title: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: diagnosis with Doppler US.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍のドプラ超音波検査による診断
summary_ja: 1987年の研究で、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍が疑われた6例に対しドプラ超音波検査を実施し、子宮動脈の信号を比較した。腫瘍例では収縮期・拡張期のドプラ偏位が他の群より高く、臨床的に有用である可能性が示された。超音波検査所見は非特異的であることも指摘された。
summary_en: This 1987 study assessed Doppler ultrasound for diagnosing gestational trophoblastic neoplasia in six suspected patients, comparing uterine artery signals with those of nongravid volunteers and first-trimester pregnancies. Three patients instead had incomplete abortion or molar degeneration. Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia showed higher systolic and diastolic Doppler shifts than postabortal, gravid, or nongravid signals. The authors noted that sonographic appearance is nonspecific and that serum hCG above 100,000 IU/L is strongly suggestive, and concluded that Doppler ultrasound may be clinically useful.

title: Problems and pitfalls in the histopathologic diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic lesions.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性病変の組織学的診断における問題点と落とし穴
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性病変の組織診断における問題点と鑑別の落とし穴を論じたレビューです。胞状奇胎は絨毛の腫大を伴う栄養膜過形成で診断され、絨毛癌と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は細胞構成の二形性と単形性で区別されます。水腫性流産や着床部など紛らわしい病変にも触れ、十分な組織採取と判断困難例の相談を勧めています。
summary_en: This 1987 review addresses pitfalls in the histopathologic diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic lesions. It notes that healthy trophoblast shares cytologic features with malignancy, complicating diagnosis. Hydatidiform mole is identified by trophoblastic hyperplasia with villous swelling, while choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumor are distinguished by dimorphic versus monomorphic trophoblast patterns. Mimics such as hydropic abortus and implantation sites are highlighted. The authors recommend thorough sampling, familiarity with benign variants, and consultation for ambiguous lesions.

title: Role of surgical therapy and radiotherapy in gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における外科療法と放射線療法の役割
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療における外科療法と放射線療法の役割をまとめた1987年のレビューです。胞状奇胎には吸引掻爬術や子宮摘出術が推奨されます。子宮摘出術は化学療法の減量や救援治療に有用であり、脳・肝転移の出血予防には全脳および肝臓への照射が用いられます。
summary_en: This 1987 review examines the role of surgery and radiotherapy in gestational trophoblastic disease despite advances in chemotherapy. Suction curettage and hysterectomy are preferred for evacuating hydatidiform mole. Hysterectomy can reduce chemotherapy needs or serve as salvage therapy after failed primary chemotherapy. In poor-prognosis metastatic disease, thoracotomy and craniotomy may help. Whole brain and liver irradiation reduces hemorrhagic complications of brain and liver metastases.

title: Causes of treatment failure in gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における治療失敗の原因
summary_ja: 1962年から1986年にノースウェスタン大学で治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍539例のうち、死亡53例を解析した報告です。全例が絨毛癌で、治療開始の遅れと治療前のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値が死亡と関連していました。主な死因は転移巣からの出血と肺不全でした。
summary_en: This 1987 analysis reviews 53 deaths among 539 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors treated at Northwestern University from 1962 to 1986. All fatal cases had choriocarcinoma. Delayed treatment and higher pretreatment hCG were associated with death. Half had brain, liver, or peritoneal metastases at diagnosis, and most had high-risk Bagshawe scores. Causes of death were hemorrhage and pulmonary insufficiency. The authors conclude that extensive disease at diagnosis, inadequate initial aggressive therapy, and limited protocol efficacy drove failure.

title: Differentiation antigens defined by mouse monoclonal antibodies against human germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍に対するマウスモノクローナル抗体によって定義された分化抗原
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト乳児胎児性癌細胞株MTEの表面抗原に対する2種類のモノクローナル抗体を作製し、胚細胞腫瘍の卵黄嚢成分などを染色することを示した研究です。他の小児腫瘍は染色されず、抗原は糖鎖抗原と考えられました。原始内胚葉および卵黄嚢の分化研究の基盤となります。
summary_en: This 1987 study generated two mouse monoclonal antibodies, M912-2A2 and M912-2G10, against surface antigens of the human infantile embryonal carcinoma line MTE. Both antigens marked yolk sac components and some endodermal structures in human germ cell tumors, but not other childhood tumors. In normal tissues, they showed distinct patterns in kidney, blood cells, and testis. Biochemical analysis indicated carbohydrate antigens, with 2G10 recognizing a type 2 carbohydrate chain structure. These findings support studies of primitive endodermal and yolk sac differentiation.

title: Medical options in the management of stages 1 and 2 (N0-N3, M0) testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 病期I・II（N0-N3, M0）精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する内科的治療の選択肢
summary_ja: 病期I・IIの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、内科的治療の選択肢を検討したレビューです。病期Iでは監視療法と救援化学療法により4年生存率が約98%と報告されました。再発予測因子として、静脈・リンパ管侵襲や卵黄嚢分化の欠如などが挙げられています。
summary_en: This 1987 review compares treatment options for stage I and II nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, showing that retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and radiotherapy give equivalent survival. Surveillance with salvage chemotherapy for stage I tumors achieved about 98 percent survival at four years, with relapses continuing at about 4 percent annually. Venous and lymphatic invasion, absence of yolk sac differentiation, and undifferentiated cells predicted relapse. Carboplatin may match radiotherapy for stage I seminoma, offering an adjuvant alternative.

title: Detection of early pregnancy factor-like activity in women with gestational trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者における早期妊娠因子様活性の検出
summary_ja: 本研究は、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の女性患者の血清における早期妊娠因子(EPF)様の免疫抑制活性を測定したものである。絨毛癌患者の血清では活性が検出され、胞状奇胎患者では検出されなかったことから、両者の鑑別マーカーとしての有用性が示唆された。さらに、絨毛癌患者血清中のEPF成分は妊娠中のものとは分子的に異なる可能性が提案されている。
summary_en: This 1987 study measured early pregnancy factor (EPF)-like immunosuppressive activity in the serum of women with gestational trophoblastic tumors. EPF activity was detected in choriocarcinoma patients but not in those with hydatidiform mole, suggesting its potential use to distinguish these two conditions. The authors also propose that the EPF moiety in choriocarcinoma serum may differ molecularly from that found during normal pregnancy.

title: Clinical problems of invasive hydatidiform mole in patients aged 40 or more.
title_ja: 40歳以上の浸潤胞状奇胎患者における臨床上の問題
summary_ja: 76例の浸潤胞状奇胎患者を年齢別に再検討した研究である。40歳以上では転移例の割合が約2倍であり、治癒までに必要な化学療法のコース数も多かった。また、40歳以上の19例中4例(21.1%)が絨毛癌を発症したのに対し、若年例では発症が認められなかった。高齢が、より進行した病態と治療抵抗性のリスク因子となることが示唆された。
summary_en: This review of 76 patients with invasive hydatidiform mole examined clinical course and outcomes by age. Patients over 40 had roughly twice the proportion of metastatic disease, required more chemotherapy courses to achieve cure, and were more likely to develop choriocarcinoma (4 of 19, versus none of the younger patients). The findings suggest that older age is a risk factor for more aggressive disease and poorer treatment response.

title: Difficulties of a surveillance study omitting retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における後腹膜リンパ節郭清を省略した経過観察研究の難しさ
summary_ja: 1987年の本サーベイランス研究では、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の85例を精巣摘除術のみで経過観察した。27%に再発を認め、多くは後腹膜再発で、肺転移はより早期に出現した。αフェトプロテインおよびhCGの上昇が画像所見に先行したのは35%のみであった。胎児性癌などの因子が再発を予測したが、補助治療の選択基準は明確にならず、後腹膜の経過観察は困難であった。
summary_en: This 1987 surveillance study followed 85 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors after orchiectomy alone, without retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Relapse occurred in 27%, mostly retroperitoneal, and lung metastases appeared earlier. AFP and hCG elevations preceded imaging findings in only 35% of relapses. Embryonal carcinoma and other features predicted relapse, but no clear criteria emerged for selecting adjuvant treatment, and retroperitoneal follow-up was difficult.

title: An unusual case of primary hormone-secreting germ cell tumor of the retroperitoneum.
title_ja: 後腹膜原発ホルモン分泌性胚細胞腫瘍の稀な一例
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、ホルモンを分泌し、当初低分化癌が疑われた後腹膜原発の稀な胚細胞腫瘍を報告したものである。著者らは、低分化癌と思われる患者で胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべき診断基準について考察している。また、本例で認められたホルモン異常を説明する仮説を提示し、性腺外腫瘍の診断の難しさを指摘している。
summary_en: This case report presents an unusual primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumor that secreted hormones and was initially suspected to be a poorly differentiated carcinoma. The authors discuss the clinical and pathological criteria that should prompt consideration of a germ cell tumor in patients with apparently poorly differentiated carcinomas. They also present a hypothesis to explain the hormonal abnormalities seen in this patient, highlighting the diagnostic challenge of extragonadal tumors.

title: Lack of therapeutic activity of the lipoidal amine CP-46,665 in rodent tumors and human non-seminomatous germ cell tumors growing in nude mice.
title_ja: ヌードマウスで増殖させたげっ歯類腫瘍およびヒト非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する脂質アミンCP-46,665の治療活性の欠如
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、脂質アミンCP-46,665の抗腫瘍効果を、げっ歯類腫瘍2種およびヌードマウスで増殖させたヒト非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍株2種で検討した。非毒性用量およびLD10を超える用量のいずれにおいても治療効果は認められなかった。胚細胞腫瘍に対する候補薬剤の前臨床スクリーニングにおける陰性結果である。
summary_en: This study tested the lipoidal amine CP-46,665 for antitumor activity in two rodent tumor models and two human non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (NSGCT) lines grown in nude mice. The compound was given at non-toxic doses and at doses exceeding the LD10. It showed no therapeutic effect in any model, including the NSGCT cell lines H 12.1 and H 12.7. The negative findings are relevant to preclinical screening of new agents for germ cell tumors.

title: Surgery in the management of gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における外科治療
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の外科治療を総説した論文である。正確な診断、患者の蘇生、個別化治療の重要性を述べる。出血性腫瘍に対する選択的塞栓術や、胞状奇胎に対する吸引搔爬の有用性を示す。化学療法中の脳病変は予後不良であり、続発症の予防も論じられている。本論文は臨床管理の指針を提供することを目的とする。
summary_en: This review covers the surgical management of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), including accurate diagnosis, patient resuscitation, and individualized treatment selection. Reported prognosis reaches 70-100% success depending on risk factors. Surgical adjuncts such as selective arterial embolization for bleeding tumors are highlighted, along with suction curettage as the preferred evacuation method for hydatidiform mole. Cerebral lesions during chemotherapy remain a poor prognostic factor, and sequelae and their prevention are discussed.

title: Some qualitative differences of hCG in serum from early and late pregnancies and trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠初期・後期の血清および絨毛性疾患におけるhCGの質的差異
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠初期・後期、妊娠性絨毛癌、精巣腫瘍のhCGを、生物学的活性と免疫活性の比(B/I比)および電気泳動の移動度により比較した。妊娠後期のhCGは負電荷が少なく、B/I比も低かった。精巣腫瘍のhCGは最も負電荷の強い型を示した。これら指標により4群を鑑別しうる可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study compared hCG in serum from early and late pregnancy, gestational choriocarcinoma, and testicular hCG-producing tumors. Using a bioassay and immunoassays, the bioactivity-to-immunoreactivity (B/I) ratio and electrophoretic median charge were measured. Late pregnancy hCG was less negatively charged and had a lower B/I ratio. Testicular tumors showed the most negatively charged forms. These features may help differentiate these four groups.

title: [A study on the role of DNA methylation within hCG and hPL genes in trophoblastic disease].
title_ja: 絨毛性疾患におけるhCGおよびhPL遺伝子内のDNAメチル化の役割に関する研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎盤、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌組織におけるhCGα、hCGβ、hPL遺伝子のDNAメチル化を解析した。妊娠中にメチル化シトシン量は増加した。高いhCGを発現する奇胎組織ではhCGα遺伝子が低メチル化していた。メチル化と遺伝子発現は逆相関し、栄養膜の悪性転化との関連も示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined DNA methylation of hCG alpha, hCG beta, and hPL genes in placenta, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma tissue. Total methylated cytosine increased across pregnancy. Hypomethylation of the hCG alpha gene was seen in molar tissue expressing high hCG, showing an inverse relationship between methylation and gene expression. Restriction polymorphisms in hCG alpha and hPL genes were also noted and linked to possible malignant transformation of trophoblast.

title: Immunocytochemical and ultrastructural findings in a mature retroperitoneal teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟型後腹膜奇形腫における免疫細胞化学的および超微細構造的所見
summary_ja: 32歳男性の成熟型後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告。ACTHやセロトニンなど多数の内分泌マーカーに陽性の細胞が腫瘍の嚢胞上皮に認められ、電子顕微鏡では神経分泌顆粒が確認された。しかし患者に内分泌症状は見られず、内分泌様細胞は臨床的に無症状であった。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a mature retroperitoneal teratoma. Immunohistochemistry revealed cells positive for ACTH, Met-enkephalin, beta-LPH, serotonin, FSH, BPP, S100, and neuron-specific enolase, mainly within the glandular epithelium lining the tumor cysts. Electron microscopy showed neurosecretory granules in the endocrine-like cells. Despite this widespread endocrine marker expression, the patient never developed endocrine symptoms, suggesting these cells are a clinically silent component of the benign teratoma.

title: Recent developments in the pathology of germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の病理学における最近の進展
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理学的進歩をまとめた総説。胎児性癌からの多分化、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍、精母細胞性セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍の認識などを扱う。奇形腫成分から非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍への形質転換や、化学療法後の変化にも言及している。全体の予後は良好とされる。
summary_en: This review summarizes recent pathological advances in testicular germ cell tumors. Topics include the differentiation of tumors from embryonal carcinoma, the origin of intratubular germ cell neoplasia, and the questionable value of 'anaplastic seminoma' as a diagnostic term. It also covers spermatocytic seminoma, recognition of yolk sac tumor and its mimicry of seminoma, and transformation of teratomatous elements into non-germ cell malignancies, including sarcomas and carcinomas after chemotherapy. Overall prognosis is noted as excellent.

title: Placental-site trophoblastic tumor of the uterus. Clinicopathological and immunohistochemical observations of a case.
title_ja: 子宮の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：1症例の臨床病理学的および免疫組織化学的観察
summary_ja: 28歳女性の子宮胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例報告。重度のタンパク尿と嚢胞性子宮腫瘍で発症し、血清β-hCGの上昇は軽度であった。絨毛癌に特徴的な二層構造は欠如していた。免疫染色で多くの腫瘍細胞がhPL陽性を示し、鑑別と予後評価に有用と考察している。
summary_en: A case report of a 28-year-old woman with uterine placental-site trophoblastic tumor presenting with severe proteinuria and a cystic uterine mass. Serum beta-hCG was only slightly elevated. The tumor extended to the serosa, was resected, and lacked the bilaminar structure of choriocarcinoma. Immunohistochemistry showed abundant human placental lactogen in most tumor cells but hCG in few, a pattern proposed as useful for distinguishing PSTT from other trophoblastic and non-trophoblastic uterine tumors and for prognostic assessment.

title: Induction of differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma cells by ouabain.
title_ja: オアバインによるマウス胎児性癌細胞の分化誘導
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞をオアバインで分化誘導できることを示した研究。Na+,K+-ATPase阻害、イオン濃度変化、増殖抑制のいずれも一貫して分化を説明しなかった。レチノイン酸やDMAとの共通機序も否定され、オアバインは誘導剤特異的な経路で作用すると考えられた。
summary_en: Murine embryonal carcinoma cells were induced to differentiate by ouabain at concentrations that inhibit Na+,K+-ATPase. The authors tested whether ion flux changes, growth inhibition, or Na+,K+-ATPase inhibition explain differentiation induced by retinoic acid or DMA. None of these mechanisms consistently accounted for differentiation, suggesting that ouabain acts through an inducer-specific pathway rather than a mechanism shared by other embryonal carcinoma differentiation inducers.

title: Canine ovarian neoplasms: a clinicopathologic study of 71 cases, including histology of 12 granulosa cell tumors.
title_ja: 犬の卵巣腫瘍71例の臨床病理学的研究（顆粒膜細胞腫瘍12例の組織学を含む）
summary_ja: 犬の原発性卵巣腫瘍71例を後方視的に解析した研究です。胚細胞腫瘍は全体の20%で、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）と奇形腫が同数でした。奇形腫の大半は悪性で、悪性奇形腫は転移率が最も高く、遠隔転移も多く認められました。顆粒膜細胞腫瘍の組織像や子宮内膜増殖症との関連も報告されています。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 71 primary canine ovarian tumors classifies neoplasms into epithelial, sex cord-stromal, and germ cell tumors. Among 14 germ cell tumors, dysgerminomas and teratomas were equally represented, and most teratomas were malignant. Malignant teratomas showed the highest metastasis rate along with adenocarcinomas, and distant spread was more common in teratomas. The paper also characterizes granulosa cell tumors histologically and describes endometrial hyperplasia and contralateral ovarian cysts associated with sex cord-stromal tumors.

title: Testicular cancer and antecedent diseases.
title_ja: 精巣がんと先行疾患
summary_ja: 精巣がん259例と対照群を比較した症例対照研究です。停留精巣（RR 6.3）と流行性耳下腺炎による精巣炎（RR 12.7）の既往が強く関連していました。15歳以前の鼠径ヘルニア手術はセミノーマに特に関連していました。先天的な精巣下降異常と免疫異常がリスクに関与する可能性が示唆されています。
summary_en: This case-control study examined prior medical history as risk factors for testicular cancer, comparing 259 cases with two control groups. Cryptorchidism showed the strongest association (RR 6.3), followed by mumps orchitis (RR 12.7), with smaller associations for atopy and other conditions. Inguinal herniorrhaphy before age 15 was particularly linked to seminoma, while other risk factors had similar relative risks for seminoma and teratoma. The authors suggest congenital testicular descent abnormalities and immunological abnormalities may contribute to risk.

title: Organ colonization pattern of retinoic acid-treated and -untreated mouse embryonal carcinoma F9 cells.
title_ja: レチノイン酸処理・未処理マウス胎児性癌細胞F9の臓器定着パターン
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1987年の研究で、マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9の臓器定着性を実験的転移アッセイで検討した。未処理細胞は肝臓に、レチノイン酸処理細胞は肺に優先的に定着した。レチノイン酸による臓器指向性の変化は、誘導剤を除去しても元に戻らなかった。
summary_en: This 1987 study examined how mouse embryonal carcinoma F9 cells colonize distant organs in experimental metastasis assays. Untreated F9 cells preferentially colonized the liver, whereas cells treated with retinoic acid, which induces differentiation into parietal endoderm, colonized the lungs. Lung-derived cells reverted to liver colonization only when retinoic acid was present, and removing the inducer did not reverse the lung-colonizing phenotype. The authors conclude that retinoic acid alters organ tropism of F9 cells, and that this is unlikely to result from cell aggregation.

title: Radioimmunolocation of a heterotransplanted human choriocarcinoma (BeWo) using monoclonal anti-SSEA-1: pharmacokinetics.
title_ja: 抗SSEA-1モノクローナル抗体によるヒト絨毛癌(BeWo)異種移植腫瘍の放射免疫局在:薬物動態
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: SSEA-1を発現する絨毛癌細胞株BeWoの担癌ヌードマウスに、放射標識抗SSEA-1抗体を投与して腫瘍の局在を検討した。非特異的ミエローマ蛋白に比べ、抗体は腫瘍へ速やかかつ特異的に集積した。ガンマカメラで腫瘍を描出でき、F(ab')2断片でも画像化が可能であった。
summary_en: This study used a monoclonal antibody against stage-specific embryonic antigen-1 (SSEA-1), which is expressed on some non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, to image human choriocarcinoma BeWo xenografts in nude mice. Radiolabeled anti-SSEA-1 accumulated rapidly and specifically in tumors compared with an unselected myeloma control, reaching high tumor-to-blood and tumor-to-muscle ratios by five days. Gamma-camera imaging detected the tumors, and F(ab')2 fragments also allowed visualization. The work demonstrates the potential of SSEA-1-directed radioimmunolocalization for choriocarcinoma.

title: A rat monoclonal antibody 4D7 produced by a hybridoma established from a yolk-sac tumor-bearing rat binds selectively to the stage-specific embryonic antigen SSEA-1.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍保有ラットから作製したラットモノクローナル抗体4D7はSSEA-1に選択的に結合する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍のアイソグラフトを保有するラットから作製したモノクローナル抗体4D7を解析した。本抗体は卵黄嚢腫瘍に強く選択的に結合し、他の腫瘍細胞や正常組織への結合は少なかった。精製SSEA-1に結合しLewis A糖脂質には結合しなかったことから、Gal β1-4(Fuc α1-3)GlcNAc決定基を認識すると結論づけられた。
summary_en: The authors generated a rat IgM monoclonal antibody, 4D7, from a hybridoma derived from a rat bearing a yolk sac tumor isograft. 4D7 strongly and selectively bound all tested yolk sac tumors, with little binding to other tumor cell lines or normal tissues, although immunohistochemistry showed some reactivity with certain normal rat tissues. Biochemical testing showed it binds purified SSEA-1 but not Lewis A glycolipid, indicating recognition of a Gal beta1-4(Fuc alpha1-3)GlcNAc determinant. Some tumor-bearing rats also developed antibodies to this determinant.

title: Amplification and enhanced expression of the c-Ki-ras2 protooncogene in human embryonal carcinomas.
title_ja: ヒト胎児性癌におけるプロトオンコジーンc-Ki-ras2の増幅と発現亢進
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera-1、Tera-2および転移性胎児性癌検体でc-Ki-ras2遺伝子を解析した。両細胞株で4〜6倍の増幅とmRNAの著明な増加が認められた。転移腫瘍の半数以上でも増幅または発現亢進がみられ、培養前から生じている可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined the c-Ki-ras2 protooncogene in human embryonal carcinoma cell lines Tera-1 and Tera-2 and in metastatic embryonal carcinoma tumor samples. Both cell lines showed 4- to 6-fold gene amplification with marked enhancement of mRNA expression. More than half of the metastatic tumors also showed amplification or enhanced expression, although these were not always linked. The authors suggest that amplification may arise before in vitro culture, possibly through genomic instability during early development, contributing to oncogenic processes.

title: Appearance of high affinity receptors for type beta transforming growth factor during differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞の分化に伴うI型トランスフォーミング増殖因子β高親和性受容体の出現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9およびPC-13を用い、レチノイン酸による分化に伴うTGF-β受容体の発現を検討した。未分化細胞はTGF-βをほとんど結合せず反応もしなかったが、分化細胞は48時間以内に受容体を発現し、約6000個の高親和性受容体を示した。分化細胞の増殖はTGF-βに影響されたが、軟寒天でのコロニー形成は誘導されなかった。
summary_en: The authors examined transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-β) receptors in murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines F9 and PC-13 before and after retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Undifferentiated cells bound little TGF-β and did not respond to it. After retinoic acid treatment, differentiated cells began expressing TGF-β receptors within 48 hours, reaching approximately 6000 high-affinity receptors. TGF-β then affected growth of differentiated cells in both serum-free and serum-containing media, but did not induce colony formation in soft agar, suggesting roles in early mammalian development.

title: Histopathology in the prediction of relapse of patients with stage I testicular teratoma treated by orchidectomy alone.
title_ja: 精巣摘除単独治療を受けた病期I精巣奇形腫における再発予測と病理組織学
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術単独で治療された病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍259例を追跡した。病理組織学的所見から、精巣静脈浸潤、リンパ管浸潤、卵黄嚢成分の欠如、未分化腫瘍の存在の4因子が再発を独立して予測した。これらに基づく高リスク群55例の2年無再発率は42%であった。
summary_en: This Lancet study followed 259 UK patients with stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated by orchidectomy alone, with a median follow-up of 30 months. Central review of 233 orchidectomy specimens identified four histological features independently predicting relapse: invasion of testicular veins, invasion of lymphatics, absence of yolk sac elements, and presence of undifferentiated tumor. A score based on these features defined a high-risk group of 55 patients with a 42% two-year relapse-free rate, compared with 74% overall.

title: Carcinoma-in-situ testis in patients with assumed extragonadal germ-cell tumours.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が疑われた患者における精巣上皮内癌(CIS)
summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が疑われた連続15例で精巣生検を行った。臨床的に精巣病変はなかったが、8例(53%)に精巣上皮内癌(CIS)を認め、うち3例では小さな浸潤性腫瘍も見られた。精巣生検が正常な場合にのみ性腺外起源と判断できると結論された。
summary_en: This report describes testicular biopsies performed in 15 consecutive patients who were presumed to have extragonadal germ cell tumors without clinical signs of testicular involvement. Carcinoma in situ (CIS) was found in the gonads of 8 patients (53%), and three of these also showed small foci of invasive tumor growth. The authors conclude that a germ cell tumor can be classified as extragonadal only when testicular biopsy shows normal histology. The findings emphasize the importance of testicular biopsy in evaluating suspected extragonadal disease.

title: Torsion of an undescended intraabdominal benign testicular teratoma.
title_ja: 停留精巣内の良性精巣奇形腫の捻転
summary_ja: 停留精巣の4歳男児が骨盤痛と跛行で受診し、CTで後腹膜の石灰化腫瘤が見つかった。開腹で梗塞した腫瘤が認められ、腹腔内停留精巣の捻転と良性精巣奇形腫と診断された。腫瘍を摘出し、経過は良好であった。停留精巣に発生する胚細胞腫瘍の症例として示唆に富む。
summary_en: A 4-year-old boy with an undescended left testis presented with pelvic pain and limping. CT showed a calcified retroperitoneal pelvic mass. At laparotomy, an infarcted mass was found, representing torsion of an intra-abdominal undescended testis containing a benign testicular teratoma. The tumor was excised and the child recovered uneventfully. The case highlights that undescended testes can harbor germ cell tumors and may present with torsion.

title: Testicular cancer risk in boys with maldescended testis: a cohort study.
title_ja: 精巣下降不全の男児における精巣がんリスク：コホート研究
summary_ja: 1949年から1960年に停留精巣で入院した男児506例を追跡したコホート研究である。6例に精巣がんが発生し、デンマークの罹患率と比べた相対リスクは4.7と有意に高かった。停留精巣が精巣がんのリスク因子であることは確認されたが、従来報告された40～50倍ほどではなかった。
summary_en: This cohort study followed 506 boys hospitalized for maldescended testis between 1949 and 1960. Six developed testis cancer, giving a standardized relative risk of 4.7 compared with the Danish population, which was statistically significant. The authors confirm that maldescent raises testicular cancer risk, though the magnitude is smaller than earlier estimates of a 40 to 50-fold increase.

title: Management of unexpected ovarian dermoid cyst during laparoscopy for oocyte pickup.
title_ja: 卵母細胞採取時の腹腔鏡検査で偶発的に発見された卵巣類皮嚢腫の管理
summary_ja: 1987年の報告で、体外受精のための卵子採取時の腹腔鏡検査で偶発的に発見された卵巣類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）の管理を検討している。完全切除、腹腔洗浄、卵巣機能の温存、対側卵巣の評価を治療目標とし、腹腔鏡下ドレナージや嚢胞壁の焼灼により再発を抑え、開腹や卵巣摘出を避けうると提案している。病理学的確認も不可欠とする。
summary_en: This 1987 report describes management of an unexpected ovarian dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) found during laparoscopic oocyte pickup for in vitro fertilization. The authors propose therapeutic goals: complete tumor eradication to avoid malignancy and recurrence, thorough peritoneal lavage to prevent chemical peritonitis, preservation of functional ovarian tissue, and evaluation of the contralateral ovary. They suggest that laparoscopic drainage, marsupialization, and fulguration of the cyst wall may lower recurrence and avoid oophorectomy or laparotomy. Histologic examination of the contents is essential.

title: Structural differences found in the asparagine-linked sugar chains of human chorionic gonadotropins purified from the urine of patients with invasive mole and with choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 侵入奇胎および絨毛癌患者尿由来ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの糖鎖構造の相違
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 侵入奇胎および絨毛癌患者の尿から精製したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖構造を比較した1987年の研究。侵入奇胎由来hCGは正常や胞状奇胎とは異なる分画パターンを示し、絨毛癌特異的な三本鎖型糖鎖が検出された。一方、腫瘍特異的な二本鎖型糖鎖は認められなかった。絨毛癌の発生にはN-アセチルグルコサミニルトランスフェラーゼIVの異所性発現と基質特異性の変化が関与すると結論している。
summary_en: This 1987 study compares the asparagine-linked sugar chains of hCG purified from the urine of patients with invasive mole and choriocarcinoma. Oligosaccharide fractionation of invasive mole hCG differed from normal and hydatidiform mole hCG. Triantennary complex-type sugar chains, typical of choriocarcinoma hCG, were detected in invasive mole samples, whereas the unusual biantennary complex-type chains characteristic of tumor hCG were absent. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma development involves ectopic expression of N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase IV and a change in its substrate specificity.

title: The significance of atypia within teratomatous metastases after chemotherapy for malignant germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 化学療法後の悪性胚細胞腫瘍における奇形腫転移巣の異型性の意義
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチンを含む多剤併用化学療法を受けた55例の奇形腫転移巣を検討した1987年の研究。上皮・間葉成分の異型度を評価し、異型が強い群で再発奇形腫が多い傾向を認めたが有意差はなかった。浸潤性の悪性像は再発リスクを有意に高めた。浸潤を伴わない異型のみでは治療方針を変更する根拠として不十分と結論している。
summary_en: This study reviews completely resected teratomatous metastases from 55 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Cytologic atypia of epithelial and mesenchymal elements was graded, and atypical elements showed a trend toward more recurrent teratoma, but the difference was not significant. An invasive malignant pattern significantly predicted recurrent teratoma-derived tumor. Atypia without invasion was not considered sufficient to change standard therapeutic strategy for teratomatous metastases.

title: Differential modulation of human chorionic gonadotropin production by methotrexate in normal and malignant placental cultures and its increase by dibutyryl cyclic adenosine monophosphate and/or actinomycin D in normal cultures.
title_ja: 正常および悪性胎盤培養におけるメトトレキサートによるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン産生の差異的調節
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常初期胎盤器官培養および絨毛癌由来JAr細胞で、メトトレキサート(MTX)などがヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生に与える影響を比較した1987年の研究。MTXは正常胎盤では影響しなかったが、JAr細胞では約8倍に増加させた。DNA合成経路の利用様式の違いが反応性の差を説明すると考察している。
summary_en: This 1987 study compares how methotrexate, dibutyryl cyclic AMP, and actinomycin D affect hCG production in normal first-trimester placental organ cultures and in JAr choriocarcinoma cells. Methotrexate did not change hCG output in normal placenta but increased it about eightfold in JAr cells. Analysis of DNA precursor incorporation showed different use of de novo and salvage synthesis pathways. The authors suggest these differences explain why normal and malignant trophoblastic cultures respond differently to methotrexate.

title: Immunosuppressive acidic protein in patients with testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者における免疫抑制酸性タンパク質
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者54例、良性泌尿器疾患62例、健常者203例の血清で、免疫抑制酸性タンパク質(IAP)を乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)と比較した1987年の研究。IAPは精巣がん患者で有意に高値で、病期とよく相関した。病期1では陽性率がLDHの44%に対しIAPは12%と低かったが、病期分類、治療効果のモニタリング、再発予測への有用性が示唆されている。
summary_en: This 1987 study evaluates serum immunosuppressive acidic protein (IAP) as a marker for testicular cancer, comparing it with lactic dehydrogenase (LDH) in 54 patients, 62 patients with benign urologic disease, and 203 healthy controls. IAP levels were significantly higher in testicular cancer patients and correlated with tumor stage. Elevation was seen in only 12% of stage 1 patients, versus 44% for LDH, but IAP correlated better with stage. The authors suggest IAP may help in staging, monitoring treatment, and predicting recurrence.

title: Unique variants of hCG in sera of choriocarcinoma patients.
title_ja: 絨毛癌患者血清中に存在する特異的なhCG変異体
summary_ja: 絨毛癌の進行例5例の血清では、等電点電気泳動で酸性側に特異的なヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)変異体（pI 3.2〜3.7）が検出され、正常妊娠や胞状奇胎・侵入奇胎よりも高値であった。ノイラミニダーゼ処理でアルカリ側へ移動したことから、シアル酸含量の増加が示唆された。この変異体を持つ患者は予後不良であり、予後マーカーや治療効果判定への応用が期待される。
summary_en: This study used isoelectric focusing to separate hCG in patients with choriocarcinoma. Sera from all five patients with advanced choriocarcinoma contained unique acidic hCG variants (pI 3.2-3.7), at significantly higher levels than in normal pregnancy or hydatidiform/invasive mole. Neuraminidase treatment shifted these variants to alkaline pI, implicating increased sialic acid content. Patients with these acidic variants had poorer survival, suggesting the variants may serve as prognostic markers and tools for monitoring therapy response.

title: Induction of class I major histocompatibility complex antigens in human teratocarcinoma cells by interferon without induction of differentiation, growth inhibition, or resistance to viral infection.
title_ja: インターフェロンによるヒト胎児性癌細胞のMHCクラスI抗原誘導：増殖抑制・分化・抗ウイルス作用を伴わない応答
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒトおよびマウスの奇形癌細胞に対するインターフェロンの作用を検討した。IFN-γはヒト胎児性癌および卵黄嚢腫瘍の細胞株でMHCクラスI抗原の発現を誘導したが、増殖抑制、分化誘導、クラスII誘導、抗ウイルス抵抗性は認められなかった。応答性は発生段階により調節され、レチノイン酸で分化させた細胞で高かった。マウスの細胞でも部分的な誘導が見られた。
summary_en: This study examined how interferons affect human and murine teratocarcinoma/embryonal carcinoma cells. IFN-gamma induced MHC class I (HLA-A, B, C) and beta2-microglobulin expression in human embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor lines, but did not cause growth inhibition, differentiation, MHC class II induction, or antiviral resistance. Responsiveness depended on developmental state and was greater in retinoic acid-differentiated cells. Murine EC and yolk sac tumor lines showed similar partial class I induction, indicating limited, developmentally regulated interferon responses.

title: Adenocarcinoma of the endometrium with trophoblastic differentiation and metastases as choriocarcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 絨毛癌様転移を伴い、絨毛性分化を示す子宮内膜腺癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 70歳女性の子宮内膜腺癌で、一部に絨毛癌への分化が見られた。肝、腎、脳、肺への転移は純粋な絨毛癌であった。原発巣と転移巣のトロホブラスト成分はhCG免疫染色陽性であった。非妊娠性絨毛癌は通常、精巣や奇形腫に生じるため、子宮内膜発生は初めての報告である。消化管癌や肺癌との類似性と組織発生を考察している。
summary_en: A 70-year-old woman had endometrial adenocarcinoma focally differentiating into choriocarcinoma. Metastases to liver, kidney, brain, and lung were pure choriocarcinoma. hCG immunocytochemistry was positive in trophoblastic foci in both primary and metastatic lesions. The authors note that nongestational choriocarcinoma usually arises in gonads or teratomas, so endometrial origin is unprecedented. Similarity to gastrointestinal and lung carcinomas with trophoblastic change is discussed, along with possible histogenesis.

title: Poorly differentiated (small cell) carcinoma of the ovary in young women: evidence supporting a germ cell origin.
title_ja: 若年女性の卵巣低分化(小細胞)癌：胚細胞由来を支持する所見
summary_ja: 若年女性の卵巣低分化小細胞癌6例を報告する。全例が片側性で、急速に進行し致死的経過をたどった。免疫組織化学でサイトケラチンとビメンチンが陽性、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は陰性であった。セミノーマと奇形腫が混在する精巣腫瘍と類似することから胚細胞由来が示唆され、卵黄嚢腫瘍と関連するが古典的なものとは異なると考察している。
summary_en: Six young patients with poorly differentiated small cell carcinoma of the ovary are described. All tumors were unilateral, some caused hypercalcemia, and all proved rapidly fatal. Immunohistochemistry showed cytokeratin and vimentin positivity, while alpha-fetoprotein was negative. Ultrastructure revealed dense globules and basement membrane-like material. A histologically similar testicular tumor mixed with seminoma and teratoma suggested germ cell origin, possibly related to yolk sac tumor but distinct from it.

title: Computerized tomography demonstration of an intrarenal teratoma.
title_ja: 腎内奇形腫のコンピュータ断層撮影所見
summary_ja: 腎内に発生した奇形腫のCT所見を報告する。画像所見を詳細に示し、特にWilms腫瘍との鑑別を中心に考察している。奇形腫が生殖腺外の腎臓に生じうることを示し、腎腫瘤の評価で考慮すべき点を提示している。
summary_en: This report describes computed tomography findings of an intrarenal teratoma. The CT appearance is presented in detail. The differential diagnosis, especially distinguishing it from Wilms tumor, is discussed as the main clinical challenge. The case highlights that teratoma can arise within the kidney, an extragonadal site, and should be considered in the evaluation of renal masses. It is a brief imaging-focused case description.

title: Chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の化学療法
summary_ja: 妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍に対する化学療法を概説する。非転移性および低リスク転移性の症例は、メトトレキサートやアクチノマイシンDなどの従来薬でほぼ治癒する。一方、高リスク転移例の約30%は従来療法に抵抗性で、いずれも転移性絨毛癌であった。そのため、シスプラチンやVP16-213を含む多剤併用療法が検討されている。
summary_en: This review covers chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic tumors. Nonmetastatic and low-risk metastatic disease is almost always curable with conventional agents such as methotrexate and actinomycin D, alone or combined. About 30 percent of high-risk patients, all with metastatic choriocarcinoma, are resistant to conventional therapy. The authors therefore examine multidrug and combination regimens including cisplatin or VP16-213.

title: Complete and incomplete Drash syndrome: a clinicopathologic study of five cases of a dysontogenetic-neoplastic complex.
title_ja: 完全型および不完全型Drash症候群：異常発生-腫瘍性複合体5例の臨床病理学的研究
summary_ja: 完全型または不完全型Drash症候群の5例を報告。本症候群は腎不全、性分化異常を伴う性腺腫瘍、腎芽腫からなる。全例に異形成性性腺がみられ、4例は性腺芽腫を有していた。1例は両側Wilms腫瘍、もう1例は後腎性過誤腫を有していた。発症機序を解析し、不完全型症例の慎重な経過観察を強調している。
summary_en: Five patients with complete or incomplete Drash syndrome are described, a complex combining renal failure, abnormal sexual differentiation with gonadal neoplasia, and nephroblastoma. Dysgenetic gonads were present in all; four had gonadoblastomas, one with a juvenile granulosa cell tumor. One patient had bilateral Wilms tumor and another a metanephric hamartoma. The authors analyze pathogenesis of each component, review complete forms, and emphasize careful follow-up of incomplete cases.

title: Endocrine and exocrine profiles of men with testicular tumors before orchiectomy.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者の精巣摘除術前における内分泌および外分泌プロフィール
summary_ja: 1987年の臨床研究で、胚細胞性精巣腫瘍の男性15例を精巣摘除術前に評価しました。約3分の2に精子形成障害がみられ、hCGやエストラジオールの上昇などの内分泌異常も多くみられました。術後に精子所見が改善した例もあり、異常は手術前から存在すると結論づけています。
summary_en: This 1987 clinical study evaluated serum hormone profiles and semen analyses in 15 men with germ cell testicular tumors before orchiectomy. Defective spermatogenesis was found in two-thirds of patients, and endocrine abnormalities, including elevated serum hCG and estradiol, were common. Three patients with subfertile semen analyses who underwent orchiectomy alone showed improved spermatogenesis later. The authors conclude that these abnormalities precede surgery and suggest a primary germ cell defect in these patients.

title: Thymic enlargement following treatment for a metastatic germ cell tumor: a case report.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の治療後にみられた胸腺肥大：症例報告
summary_ja: 1987年の症例報告で、転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に縦隔腫瘤が出現した男性を報告しています。切除標本では腫瘍ではなく良性の胸腺過形成でした。化学療法後の縦隔腫礀が必ずしも再発を意味しないため、不適切な治療を避けるには良性の原因も考慮すべきだと述べています。
summary_en: This 1987 case report describes a man with metastatic testicular germ cell tumor who developed an anterior mediastinal mass eight months after complete remission following chemotherapy and surgery. Pathological examination of the excised mass showed benign thymic hyperplasia rather than residual or recurrent tumor. The authors emphasize that a mediastinal mass after successful chemotherapy does not always indicate relapse. They caution that a benign cause should be considered to avoid inappropriate treatment.

title: Inter- and intra-pathologist variability in the diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の診断における病理医間および病理医内変動
summary_ja: 1987年の研究で、1975～1982年にボルチモアで診断された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍190例を対象に、病理診断の一致度を評価しました。奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の基準を統一し、kappa統計量で病理医間・病理医内のばらつきを算出しました。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の診断のばらつきは小さく、部分胞状奇胎では大きいことを示しました。
summary_en: This 1987 study assessed diagnostic agreement among pathologists for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia in 190 Baltimore cases from 1975 to 1982. Two pathologists independently reviewed slides using uniform criteria for hydatidiform mole, invasive mole and choriocarcinoma, and a sample was re-reviewed for intra-observer agreement. Variability was measured with the kappa statistic. Diagnostic variability was low for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia but high for incomplete mole. The findings bear on the reliability of histologic diagnosis in this disease spectrum.

title: 12-O-tetradecanoyl phorbol-13-acetate potentiates adenosine 3',5'-monophosphate-mediated chorionic gonadotropin secretion by cultured human choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: 培養ヒト絨毛癌細胞におけるアデノシン3',5'-一リン酸介在性ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌をTPAが増強する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1987年の内分泌学研究で、培養BeWo絨毛癌細胞のhCG分泌を調節するシグナル経路を検討しています。コレラ毒素とTPAがそれぞれhCG分泌を促進し、併用するとさらに増強されました。細胞増殖は原因ではなく、両経路が相乗的に作用することを示しました。
summary_en: This 1987 endocrinology study examines how protein kinase C and adenylate cyclase signaling regulate human chorionic gonadotropin secretion by cultured BeWo choriocarcinoma cells. Cholera toxin and the phorbol ester TPA each stimulate hCG secretion, and TPA potentiates the cholera toxin effect on both cAMP accumulation and hCG output. The combination produced a 16- to 27-fold increase in hCG, with cell proliferation excluded as the cause. The results show that the two pathways act synergistically in choriocarcinoma cells.

title: Structure and expression of mos sequences in spontaneous and Moloney murine sarcoma virus-induced yolk sac carcinomas in rats.
title_ja: ラットの自然発生およびMoloney肉腫ウイルス誘発卵黄嚢癌におけるmos配列の構造と発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1987年の研究で、胎仔摘出ラットに生じた自然発生および Moloney 肉腫ウイルス誘発の卵黄嚢癌におけるmos配列を解析しました。ウイルス誘発腫瘍では、ウイルスのプロウイルスが挿入されていました。自然発生例では細胞性c-mosの再配列は認められず、ウイルス由来のmosが発癌に関与することを示唆しています。
summary_en: This 1987 study examines mos gene sequences in yolk-sac carcinomas that arose in fetectomized rats, both spontaneously and after Moloney murine sarcoma virus infection. Virus-induced tumors carried at least one randomly integrated Mo-MSV provirus, while spontaneous tumors showed no c-mos rearrangement or amplification. No mos-related RNA was detected in the cell lines, and v-mos DNA was heavily methylated. The findings suggest that viral mos integration, rather than activation of cellular c-mos, drives virus-associated yolk-sac carcinogenesis.

title: Targeting of neoglycoprotein-drug conjugates to cultured human embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: 胎児性癌細胞へのネオグリコタンパク質－薬物複合体の標的化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株2種の表面レクチンを蛍光ネオグリコタンパク質で調べ、エトポシド・シスプラチン・メトトレキサートを結合させた薬物複合体の効果を検討した。糖鎖を介した取り込みにより細胞傷害性は糖鎖なし担体より大幅に増強された。2種の標的を組み合わせると併用化学療法のモデルでも有用であった。糖修飾担体による薬剤の標的化の可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This 1987 study used fluorescent neoglycoproteins to identify surface lectins on two human embryonal carcinoma cell lines and tested drug-neoglycoprotein conjugates carrying etoposide, cisplatin, or methotrexate. Sugar-mediated lectin uptake, followed by lysosomal release of the drug, markedly increased cytotoxicity compared with a nonglycosylated carrier. Two neoglycoproteins targeting independent lectins were combined in a model of combination chemotherapy. The authors suggest glycosylated carriers could target therapeutic agents to embryonal carcinoma cells.

title: Testicular cancer: prognostic implications of vascular invasion.
title_ja: 精巣がん：血管侵襲の予後的意義
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ33例と非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍53例の原発巣を再評価し、血管侵襲の意義を検討した後方視的研究。血管侵襲は非セミノーマ性で多く（53%）、内臓転移と関連した。補助化学療法を行わない場合、血管侵襲を有する非セミノーマ患者は全例に転移が生じた。初期の非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍では、病期分類と治療選択に血管侵襲の評価が重要であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study re-evaluated primary tumors from 33 seminoma and 53 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients for vascular invasion. Vascular invasion was more frequent in nonseminomatous tumors (53%) than seminomas (27%) and was associated with visceral metastases. Without adjuvant chemotherapy, all nonseminomatous patients with vascular invasion developed metastases, whereas adjuvant chemotherapy markedly reduced this risk. In seminoma, vascular invasion showed no significant association with progression. The authors conclude that vascular invasion is important for staging and treatment decisions in early nonseminomatous testicular tumors.

title: Neoplastic potential in patients with disorders of sexual differentiation.
title_ja: 性分化疾患患者における腫瘍発生の潜在的リスク
summary_ja: 1960～1980年に小児病院で性分化疾患と診断された157例を対象に、腫瘍発生を検討した。未切除の混合性性腺異形成患者4例中2例に性腺芽腫が発生しており、早期の性腺摘除の必要性が示された。Turner症候群の1例では性腺の胎児性癌、男性仮性半陰陽を含む4例にWilms腫瘍が認められた。男性仮性半陰陽とWilms腫瘍の関連の機序は未解明である。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 157 patients with disorders of sexual differentiation at a major pediatric hospital (1960-1980) assessed tumor development. Gonadoblastoma arose in two of four patients with mixed gonadal dysgenesis who had not undergone gonadectomy, supporting early gonadectomy. Gonadal embryonal carcinoma occurred in one Turner syndrome patient, and four nephroblastomas (Wilms tumors) were identified, including three in male pseudohermaphrodites. The authors note that the link between male pseudohermaphroditism and Wilms tumor remains to be established.
