summary_en: This 1983 report describes a case of testicular seminoma complicated by an extensive granulomatous reaction. The granulomatous response was so florid that a benign process was initially suspected. The correct diagnosis of seminoma was made only after additional tissue was examined histologically. The case highlights how an inflammatory reaction within a germ cell tumor can mimic a benign condition and delay diagnosis, underscoring the importance of thorough histological sampling.

title: Ovarian masses in the child and adolescent.
title_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘤の治療成績
summary_ja: 16例の小児卵巣腫瘤の5年間の治療経験を報告。腹痛や腹部腫瘤が主な症状で、超音波検査は10例中9例で病変を正しく同定した。奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマなどが認められ、悪性腫瘍には多剤化学療法が行われ、生存率は94%であった。将来の内分泌・生殖機能を考慮した手術の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This 1983 five-year series describes 16 children aged 8 weeks to 16 years treated for ovarian masses. Abdominal pain or mass was the most common presentation, and ultrasonography correctly localized the lesion in nine of ten cases. Surgery revealed teratomas, endodermal sinus tumors, and dysgerminomas, among other lesions. Malignant tumors received multiagent chemotherapy, and overall survival was 94%. The authors emphasize conservative resection and attention to future endocrine and reproductive function.

title: Invasive dysgerminoma in a girl with 45,X/46,X; mar mosaicism.
title_ja: 45,X/46,X;marモザイク症例にみられた侵襲性ディスジャーミノーマ
summary_ja: ターナー症候群様の特徴を示す16歳女児の侵襲性ディスジャーミノーマ症例報告である。核型は45,X/46,X;marのモザイクで、切除後12か月間細胞毒性薬による治療を受けた。複数の組織で核型モザイクが確認された。文献的に、形成異常性生殖腺における細胞遺伝学的所見と悪性増殖・分化の予後を論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with Turner syndrome features and 45,X/46,X;mar mosaicism who underwent removal of an invasive dysgerminoma. She received cytotoxic drugs for 12 months afterward. Karyotype mosaicism was identified in various tissues. The authors review the literature on cytogenetic findings and on the prognosis of malignant growth and differentiation in dysgenetic gonads, highlighting the link between gonadal dysgenesis and dysgerminoma.

title: Occult germ-cell testicular tumours.
title_ja: 触知不能な精巣原発を有する転移性胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣に触知可能な原発腫瘍がなく転移を伴う胚細胞悪性腫瘍の男性18例の報告である。全例で腹部リンパ節転移があり、組織型は栄養膜性悪性奇形腫が最多であった(9/18例)。腹痛や全身症状が多く、精巣萎縮や一過性の精巣痛の既往も見られた。精巣組織の検討で、自然退縮、分化、微小原発巣が確認された症例があった。
summary_en: This 1983 series describes 18 men with metastatic germ-cell malignancy in whom no primary testicular tumor could be palpated. All had abdominal nodal involvement, and the most common histologic subtype was trophoblastic malignant teratoma (9 of 18). Abdominal pain and systemic symptoms were common presentations, and testicular atrophy or transient pain often preceded diagnosis. Histologic examination of testes in several patients revealed occult primaries, including spontaneous regression, differentiation, or micro-primary tumors.

title: Ruptured benign cystic teratomas mimicking gynecologic malignancy.
title_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍と紛らわしい破裂した良性嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 卵巣の破裂した良性嚢胞性奇形腫を2例報告し、術前に卵巣癌と誤診された経過を示す。手術で奇形腫の穿孔によるびまん性肉芽腫性腹膜炎が判明した。腹腔内癒着や腫瘤が後遺症として多くみられた。根治的手術の前に悪性腫瘍の有無を確定する必要があると指摘している。文献的考察も含まれる。
summary_en: This 1983 report describes two cases of ruptured benign cystic teratomas of the ovary that were initially suspected to be ovarian carcinoma. Surgery revealed diffuse granulomatous peritonitis caused by perforation of the teratomas, rather than malignancy. Intra-abdominal adhesions and masses were frequent sequelae. The authors emphasize that malignancy must be confirmed before radical surgery is performed, and they include a literature review.

title: Carcinoma in situ of germ cells and subsequent development of an invasive seminoma in a hyperprolactinaemic man.
title_ja: 高プロラクチン血症の男性にみられた胚細胞上皮内癌と浸潤性セミノーマの発生
summary_ja: 高プロラクチン血症と下垂体腫瘍を有する25歳男性で、初回の右精巣生検では精子形成障害と精細管壁の肥厚がみられた。5年後に精巣腫大を来し、切除により浸潤性セミノーマと判明した。初回生検標本を再検討すると上皮内癌が認められ、胚細胞の上皮内癌から浸潤性腫瘍への進展を示す症例である。
summary_en: A 25-year-old man with hyperprolactinaemia and a pituitary tumour had small, atrophic testes. A right testicular biopsy showed impaired spermatogenesis. Five years later he presented with testicular enlargement, and resection revealed an invasive seminoma alongside a pituitary adenoma. Review of the earlier biopsy identified carcinoma in situ, documenting progression from germ cell carcinoma in situ to invasive seminoma.

title: Yolk-sac carcinoma of extra-embryonic origin in the 129 Sv/Sl mouse.
title_ja: 129 Sv/Sl マウスにみられた胚外起源の卵黄嚢癌
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 129 Sv/Sl マウスにおいて、8か月の長い潜伏期間を経て卵黄嚢癌が発生したことを報告する。原発巣と転移巣は臓側型と壁側型の像を示した。腫瘍は正常、ヘテロ接合型、不妊型の胚の胚外組織に由来しており、これらの卵黄嚢癌は胚細胞由来ではないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study reports yolk-sac carcinoma arising in 129 Sv/Sl mice after a long latent period of eight months. This tumour had not previously been observed in this species after displacement of the visceral yolk sac. The primary tumour and its metastases showed visceral and parietal patterns. Because the tumours developed from extra-embryonic tissue of normal, heterozygous and sterile embryos, the authors conclude that these yolk-sac carcinomas do not derive from germ cells.

title: Mediastinal teratoma presenting as a rapidly enlarging paracardial mass.
title_ja: 急速に拡大する心膜傍腫瘤として発症した縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 若年男性が、心臓に隣接する急速に増大する腫瘤を主訴に受診した。腫瘤は良性の前縦隔奇形腫と診断された。縦隔奇形腫は通常、胸部X線検査で偶発的に発見されることが多いが、本症例は心膜傍部の急速に拡大する腫瘤として発症した点で異例である。
summary_en: The report describes an uncommon presentation in a young man, in which a benign anterior mediastinal teratoma appeared as a rapidly expanding paracardial mass rather than being discovered incidentally. Mediastinal teratomas are usually found on chest radiography. This case is notable for its rapid growth and its location adjacent to the heart.

title: Computed tomography of cystic ovarian teratomas with gravity-dependent layering.
title_ja: 重力依存性の層形成を示す嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見
summary_ja: X線検査や超音波検査で診断が困難な嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫について、CT所見を報告する。病変は石灰化・骨成分、軟部組織成分、水成分、脂肪成分を含む。脂肪成分における重力依存性の層形成や脂肪-液体レベルは類皮嚢腫に特異的であり、画像診断の補助としてCTが有用であると述べている。
summary_en: This report describes computed tomography findings in cystic ovarian teratomas that were difficult to diagnose on radiography and ultrasonography. The heterogeneous lesions contain calcification or bone, soft-tissue solid components, water-density fluid and fatty material. A gravity-dependent layering within a fatty mass or a fat-fluid level is described as a specific finding of dermoid cysts. CT may therefore be a valuable adjunct when conventional imaging is inconclusive.

title: Developmental potential of teratocarcinoma stem cells in utero following aggregation with cleavage-stage mouse embryos.
title_ja: 卵割期マウス胚との凝集後の子宮内における奇形癌幹細胞の発生能
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞を卵割期マウス胚と凝集させ、偽妊娠の子宮へ移植した。胎児への寄与が大きいほど形態異常が多く、胎児期の正常発生には十分な宿主胚細胞が必要であると示唆された。出生個体のキメラ形成は散発的かつ限定的であった。
summary_en: Embryonal carcinoma cells were aggregated with cleavage-stage mouse embryos and transferred to pseudopregnant uteri. Midgestation foetuses with large contributions from the carcinoma cells were frequently morphologically abnormal, and the abnormality correlated with the extent of contribution. Live-born animals showed sporadic, limited chimaerism. The authors suggest that large numbers of embryonal carcinoma cells are incompatible with normal development.

title: Histogenetic and neoplastic potential of different regions of the mouse embryonic egg cylinder.
title_ja: 8日齢マウス胚卵筒の各領域の組織形成能と腫瘍形成能
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 8日齢マウス胚の卵筒の各領域を精巣被膜下へ異所性移植し、組織形成能と腫瘍形成能を検討した。前部・遠位部の外胚葉断片は胚内での運命を超える組織形成を示し、後部断片は増殖しなかった。前部由来の胎児性癌の発生頻度は後部より高く、腫瘍形成能に領域差があることが示された。
summary_en: The histogenetic and neoplastic potential of regions of the 8th-day mouse embryonic egg cylinder was examined after ectopic transfer beneath the testis capsule. Anterior and distal fragments of embryonic ectoderm produced histogenetic profiles exceeding their assigned embryonic fates, while posterior fragments failed to grow. Anterior slices gave a higher incidence of embryonal carcinoma cells than posterior slices, indicating regional differences in neoplastic potential.

title: Malignant struma ovarii. A case report and literature review.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 骨盤内腫瘤に対する開腹術で、良性の卵巣甲状腺腫に生じた乳頭状腺癌が発見された。既往に両側嚢胞性奇形腫がある。サイログロブリン免疫染色は良性部と悪性部の双方で陽性であった。コロラド州の15年間の検討では、嚢胞性奇形腫における悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の頻度は0.3%であった。
summary_en: A woman developed papillary adenocarcinoma arising within a benign struma ovarii, found at laparotomy for a pelvic mass. She had a prior history of bilateral cystic teratomas. Immunoperoxidase staining for thyroglobulin was positive in both benign and malignant areas. A 15-year review of cystic teratomas in Colorado showed a 0.3% frequency of malignant struma ovarii. The report combines a case description with a literature review.

title: Testicular seminoma--analysis of radiation therapy for stage II disease.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ―病期IIに対する放射線療法の解析
summary_ja: 本研究は単施設の後方視的解析で、病期IIA精巣セミノーマに横隔膜上照射が必要かを検討した。横隔膜下のみ照射したIIA例6例は全例無再発で、病期Iの50例でも縦隔・鎖骨上窩の再発はなかった。横隔膜上照射は病期IIAでは不要な可能性があると結論づけているが、症例数が少ない点が限界である。
summary_en: This 1983 retrospective analysis from a single radiation center examined whether supradiaphragmatic radiation is necessary in stage IIA testicular seminoma. Six stage IIA patients received infradiaphragmatic-only treatment and none relapsed, while 50 stage I patients treated below the diaphragm had no mediastinal or supraclavicular failures. The authors conclude that above-diaphragm irradiation may be unnecessary in stage IIA seminoma, a finding limited by the small sample size and the absence of lymphangiography in several patients.

title: Testicular cancer in cryptorchids.
title_ja: 停留精巣患者における精巣がん
summary_ja: 1934〜1976年に治療された停留精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者137例を検討した報告。矯正の有無で5年生存率に差はなく、セミノーマは胚細胞癌より予後が良好だった。矯正後に発生した腫瘍の多くは胚細胞癌であったため、片側の停留精巣には精巣摘除術を推奨し、長期的な経過観察を提唱している。
summary_en: This 1982 Cancer study reviewed 137 patients with cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumors treated from 1934 to 1976. Five-year survival was similar in corrected and uncorrected cryptorchid patients (61% versus 63%), and higher in pure seminoma (79%) than in germinal carcinomas (50%). Most five-year survivors received radiotherapy or chemotherapy. Because tumors arising after orchiopexy were mostly germinal carcinomas, the authors recommend orchiectomy for unilateral cryptorchidism and long-term periodic observation.

title: Isolation and characterization of peanut agglutinin-resistant embryonal carcinoma cell-surface variants.
title_ja: PNA耐性胎児性癌細胞の細胞表面変異株の単離と特性解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 変異誘発によりPNA耐性のマウス胎児性癌細胞株を単離した研究。耐性は安定で劣性形質であり、PNA受容体の欠損が示唆された。全クローンが同系マウスで奇形癌を形成し、細胞表面構造が変化しても分化能は保たれていた。胚細胞腫瘍の基礎研究モデルとしての意義がある。
summary_en: This 1982 J Cell Physiol study isolated peanut agglutinin (PNA)-resistant variants of mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells after mutagenesis. The resistant phenotype was stable and recessive, consistent with deficient PNA receptors, and showed reduced SSEA-1 antibody binding. All eight clones formed well-differentiated teratocarcinomas in syngeneic mice. Despite altered surface markers, the variants still differentiated and sorted with endodermal cells into embryoid bodies, supporting their use as models of germ cell tumor biology.

title: Orchidectomy alone in testicular stage I non-seminomatous germ-cell tumours.
title_ja: 精巣病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する単独精巣摘除術
summary_ja: 1982年のLancet誌に掲載された研究で、臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性53例を対象に、転移が明らかになるまで精巣摘除術のみで経過観察した。17%が再発し、多くは6か月以内であり、全例が化学療法で救済された。再発率は胎児性癌(42.8%)で畸形癌(3.4%)より著しく高かった。放射線療法を併用した精巣摘除術の歴史的コホート(再発25.8%)と比較し、著者らはルーチンの郭清や所属リンパ節照射は正当化されない可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: A 1982 Lancet study followed 53 men with clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors who received orchidectomy alone, with surveillance until metastases were evident. Seventeen percent relapsed, mostly within six months, and all were salvaged with chemotherapy. Relapse was far higher in embryonal carcinoma (42.8%) than in teratocarcinoma (3.4%). Compared with a historical orchidectomy-plus-radiotherapy cohort (25.8% relapse), the authors suggest routine lymphadenectomy or nodal irradiation may be unjustifiable.

title: The spectrum of genitourinary abnormalities in patients with cryptorchidism, with emphasis on testicular carcinoma.
title_ja: 停留精巣における泌尿生殖器異常のスペクトラム：精巣がんを中心として
summary_ja: 停留精巣に伴う泌尿生殖器異常の広がりを概説し、精巣がんの高いリスクとの関連を検討した総説。精巣異形成が停留精巣の発がんに関与する可能性を提唱している。精巣がんの特徴と、早期の精巣固定術を支持する根拠も整理されている。
summary_en: This 1982 Cancer review describes the spectrum of genitourinary abnormalities in cryptorchidism, with emphasis on testicular carcinoma, the most important complication. The authors propose that testicular dysgenesis may underlie carcinogenesis in the cryptorchid testis. They summarize the characteristics of testis cancer arising in cryptorchid testes and the evidence supporting early orchiopexy. The review frames cryptorchidism as a risk condition that warrants early intervention.

title: Sports activities and risk of testicular cancer.
title_ja: スポーツ活動と精巣がんのリスク
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの症例対照研究で、出生後の危険因子を検討した報告。停留精巣と乳児期鼠径ヘルニアとの既知の関連が確認された。さらに自転車競技と乗馬との関連が見出され、出生後の明確な危険因子と精巣がんとの初の関連とされる。
summary_en: A 1982 British Journal of Cancer case-control study examined postnatal risk factors for testicular seminoma. Previously recognized associations with cryptorchidism and infantile inguinal hernia were confirmed. New associations were found with cycling and horse-riding, which the authors describe as the first relationships between testicular cancer and well-defined postnatal risk factors. The study highlights exposures occurring after birth rather than only congenital factors.

title: Screening for carcinoma in situ of the contralateral testis in patients with germinal testicular cancer.
title_ja: 胚細胞性精巣がん患者の対側精巣における上皮内癌のスクリーニング
summary_ja: 片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者250例の対側精巣生検を検討し、上皮内癌を5.2%に認めた。萎縮精巣や停留精巣の既往を有する群で発見率が高く、ハイリスク群の選択的スクリーニングの意義が示された。経過観察中に2例が第二の癌を発症した。
summary_en: A 1982 BMJ study analyzed 250 contralateral testis biopsies from men with unilateral germ cell testicular cancer for carcinoma in situ. Changes were found in 13 patients (5.2%). Patients with an atrophic contralateral testis or a history of cryptorchidism were at higher risk, and screening these groups would have detected 85% of cases. Because the natural course of carcinoma in situ is unknown, patients are being reevaluated frequently, and two developed a second cancer.

title: Serum lactate dehydrogenase and its isoenzymes in men with maldescended testes.
title_ja: 停留精巣の男性における血清乳酸脱水素酵素とそのアイソザイム
summary_ja: 1982年のJ Urol誌に掲載された研究で、停留精巣の男性130例を対象に、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のスクリーニングとして血清乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)とそのアイソザイムを測定した。臨床的に明らかな腫瘍は1例のみで、無症状の病変は生検により3例で確認された。これらの4例ではLDHとアイソザイムは正常値であったが、腫瘍のない3例では上昇がみられた。著者らは、LDHとそのアイソザイムは無症状の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の検出に感度が低いと結論づけている。
summary_en: A 1982 J Urol study measured serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) and its isoenzymes in 130 men with maldescended testes to screen for testicular germ cell neoplasia. Only one clinically evident tumor was found, and subclinical lesions were identified by biopsy in three men. These four patients had normal LDH and isoenzyme values, while three men without neoplasia had elevated levels. The authors conclude that LDH and its isoenzymes are not sensitive for detecting subclinical testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Immunohistochemical localization of murine stage-specific embryonic antigens in human testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるマウス病期特異的胎児抗原の免疫組織化学的局在
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1982年のAmerican Journal of Pathologyの研究で、マウスの段階特異的胚抗原に対するモノクローナル抗体を用いて、ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍における局在を検討した。SSEA-1は卵黄嚢癌成分に検出されたが胚性癌細胞には検出されず、SSEA-3はヒト胚性癌細胞に検出された。両抗原は胎児精巣の胚細胞に存在し、成人の精細管には存在しなかった。ヒト胚性癌細胞はマウス細胞より未熟な胚細胞に対応するとの知見が示され、腫瘍の組織発生の理解に寄与するとしている。
summary_en: A 1982 American Journal of Pathology study used monoclonal antibodies against murine stage-specific embryonic antigens to localize them in human testicular germ cell tumors. SSEA-1 was detected on yolk sac carcinoma components but not on embryonal carcinoma cells, whereas SSEA-3 was detected on human embryonal carcinoma cells. Both antigens were present on fetal testicular germ cells but absent from adult seminiferous tubules. The findings suggest human embryonal carcinoma cells correspond to a less mature embryonic cell than murine cells, informing the possible histogenesis of these tumors.

title: The role of abdominal surgery in the treatment of advanced testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療における腹部手術の役割
summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍21例に対し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤を腹部手術で切除したところ、66%が完全寛解に至った。術前のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の高値は予後不良を示し、CTは3例で偽陰性だった。残存腫瘤の切除は組織型の確認と寛解達成に有用で、予後不良と考えられた患者6例も長期寛解を得たと結論している。
summary_en: This 1982 Br J Surg study reviews 21 patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumours (20 teratoma, 1 seminoma) who underwent abdominal surgery to remove residual masses after sequential chemotherapy. Complete remission was achieved in 66 percent, and histological maturation or necrosis occurred in 57 percent. Patients with raised preoperative hCG or AFP had a poor prognosis, and CT gave false-negative results in three patients. The authors advocate resecting residual masses to determine histology and achieve remission, which benefited six patients with poor prognosis.

title: In vitro synthesis of alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotropin in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のin vitro合成
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者5例の新鮮な腫瘍組織を用い、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のin vitro合成を放射性同位元素の取り込みと免疫沈降により検証した。合成の所見は免疫細胞化学染色と相関した。腫瘍自体がこれらの血清腫瘍マーカーを産生することを示した基礎的研究である。
summary_en: This 1982 Cancer study examined in vitro synthesis of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in fresh testicular cancer tissue from five patients. Using 14C-leucine and 14C-lysine incorporation, radioimmunoassay, and immunoprecipitation, the authors showed that the tumour tissue actively synthesised AFP and hCG. The synthesis correlated with immunocytochemical staining of the cancer cells, suggesting that these tumours directly produce the serum markers measured clinically.

title: Ultrastructural studies of xenografted human germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植片の超微細構造研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 免疫不全マウスに移植した胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植片を超微細構造で解析し、原発のヒト腫瘍と比較した。同じ組織型の腫瘍間や同一腫瘍内でも分化の程度に幅があった。セミノーマと卵黄嚢癌の中間、胎児性癌と卵黄嚢癌の中間の特徴を示す細胞が認められ、その組織発生への示唆が論じられている。
summary_en: This 1982 Cancer study describes the ultrastructure of xenografts established in immunosuppressed mice from three embryonal cell carcinomas, two yolk sac carcinomas, and one alphafetoprotein-producing seminoma-like tumour. The xenografts were compared with the original human germ cell tumours. Ultrastructural differentiation varied between tumours of the same histological type and within individual tumours. Cells with features intermediate between seminoma and yolk sac carcinoma, and between embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac carcinoma, were identified, and their implications for histogenesis are discussed.

title: Markers of minimal residual disease.
title_ja: 微小残存病変のマーカー
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍、大腸癌、乳癌を対象に、微小残存病変の検出に用いる腫瘍マーカーの方法を概説した総説である。体液中の腫瘍マーカー測定は臨床的価値が限られると結論し、放射免疫検出法や免疫細胞化学などの代替法を批判的に検討している。
summary_en: This 1982 review in Recent Results in Cancer Research surveys tumour marker methods for detecting minimal residual disease in human germ cell, colorectal, and breast neoplasms. The authors conclude that measuring tumour markers in body fluids has limited clinical value. They critically appraise alternative approaches, including radioimmunodetection and immunocytochemistry, for identifying small amounts of residual tumour.

title: Prognostic factors in clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ-cell tumours of the testis.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の予後因子
summary_ja: 精巣の臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍59例を対象とした予後因子の検討である。放射線療法後の再発は、原発腫瘍の局所進展と、精巣摘除後のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の低下速度に関連した。紹介時の血清マーカー高値そのものは予後因子ではなかった。胎児性癌は奇形癌より局所浸潤しやすかった。
summary_en: This 1982 Br J Cancer study examined prognostic factors in 59 men with clinical Stage I non-seminomatous germ-cell tumours of the testis treated at the Royal Marsden Hospital. Fourteen relapsed after radiotherapy, and 45 remained disease-free. The local extent of the primary tumour and the rate of decline of serum AFP and beta-hCG after orchidectomy were significantly associated with relapse. Initial serum marker levels and tissue-associated hCG were not prognostic. Embryonal carcinoma was more often locally invasive than teratocarcinoma.

title: Circulating immune complexes as markers of response to chemotherapy in malignant teratomas and gestational trophoblastic tumours.
title_ja: 悪性奇形腫および妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の化学療法反応マーカーとしての循環免疫複合体
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍22例と悪性奇形腫11例の化学療法中に、循環免疫複合体(CIC)を連続測定した研究である。CICは一部の症例で病勢と相関したが、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)より感度・特異度が低かった。寛解中にもCIC上昇がみられ、現行の測定法は腫瘍マーカーとして臨床的価値に乏しいと結論している。
summary_en: This 1982 Br J Cancer study measured circulating immune complexes (CIC) serially during chemotherapy in 22 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumours and 11 with malignant teratoma. CIC levels correlated with disease status early in treatment in some patients, but CIC assays were less sensitive and less specific than hCG and AFP. Several patients in sustained complete remission had raised CIC levels. The authors conclude that current CIC measurements lack clinical value as tumour markers in these diseases.

title: [Studies on marker substances in cell lines derived from various human gynecologic tumors (author's transl)].
title_ja: 各種ヒト婦人科腫瘍由来培養細胞株におけるマーカー物質の研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣悪性奇形腫由来のHOTC 3細胞と絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞を含む婦人科腫瘍由来の培養細胞5種で、各種マーカー物質を比較した研究である。hCG-βはBeWo細胞から培地へ漏出したが、HOTC 3細胞からは漏出しなかった。AFPは5種すべてで検出されなかった。細胞の生物学的機能を反映し、腫瘍マーカーとしての臨床応用を示唆している。
summary_en: This 1982 Japanese study compares intracellular and secreted marker substances in five human cultured cell lines from gynaecologic tumours, including an ovarian malignant teratoma line (HOTC 3) and a choriocarcinoma line (BeWo). LDH activity was highest in BeWo, HOC-21 and HOTC 3 cells. hCG-beta was detected in BeWo and HOTC 3 cells but leaked into the medium only from BeWo cells. AFP was undetectable in all five lines, and plasminogen activator was absent from the teratoma and choriocarcinoma lines.

title: The development of hyponatremia following combination chemotherapy for metastatic germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対する併用化学療法後の低ナトリウム血症の発症
summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対しビンブラスチン・シスプラチン・ブレオマイシン併用化学療法を受けた12例全例で血清ナトリウムが低下し、4例は重篤な症状を呈した。水分処理能の障害も確認され、主に高用量ビンブラスチンが原因と考えられた。本レジメンでは低ナトリウム血症の監視と、症状がある場合の水分制限や高張食塩水投与が推奨される。
summary_en: Twelve patients receiving high-dose vinblastine, cisplatin, and bleomycin for metastatic germ cell tumors all developed falling serum sodium after chemotherapy, and four had severe symptoms. Eight showed hypoosmolality and five had abnormal water load tests, indicating impaired water handling. The authors attribute the hyponatremia mainly to high-dose vinblastine and recommend monitoring for hyponatremia in patients on this regimen, with water restriction or hypertonic saline when symptomatic.

title: The detection and measurement of oncodevelopmental proteins in gynecological malignant disease.
title_ja: 婦人科悪性疾患におけるオンコフェタル蛋白の検出と測定
summary_ja: 婦人科悪性疾患におけるオンコフェタル蛋白を文献と自験データから検討した研究である。臨床的モニタリングに有用なのは、内胚葉性腫瘍のAFPと胚細胞腫瘍のhCGのみと結論づけている。CEAや胎盤性蛋白などその他のマーカーは、この目的には有用性が示されなかった。
summary_en: This review and measurement study examines several oncodevelopmental proteins, including AFP, CEA, hCG, and placental proteins, in gynecological malignancies and relates them to clinical data. The authors conclude that only AFP in endodermal tumors and hCG in germ cell tumors are useful for clinical monitoring. Other markers were not found to be clinically useful for this purpose. Germ cell tumors are a key focus of the conclusion, with tumor marker monitoring as the central theme.

title: Polyembryoma of ovary producing alpha-fetoprotein and HCG: immunoperoxidase and electron microscopic study.
title_ja: AFPおよびhCGを産生した卵巣多胚芽腫：免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法と電子顕微鏡による検討
summary_ja: AFPとhCGを産生した卵巣多胚芽腫の1例である。hCG上昇により思春期早発症様の症状を呈した。手術とVAC療法後、5か月時点で再発やAFPの再上昇はなかった。免疫染色ではAFPは卵黄嚢細胞、hCGは合胞体栄養膜細胞に局在し、電子顕微鏡では胚様体の細胞接合と表面被覆の特徴が明らかになった。
summary_en: A woman with ovarian polyembryoma producing AFP and hCG presented with pseudoprecocious puberty due to elevated hCG. After surgery and VAC chemotherapy, she had no recurrence and no re-elevation of serum AFP at five months. Immunoperoxidase staining localized AFP to yolk sac cells and hCG to syncytiotrophoblastic cells within embryoid bodies. Electron microscopy characterized cell junctions and surface coats, suggesting the thick deposit is related to AFP.

title: Effects of retinoic acid on differentiation of choriocarcinoma cells in vitro.
title_ja: レチノイン酸が絨毛癌細胞の分化に及ぼす影響（in vitro）
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞の培養系におけるホルモン産生をレチノイン酸などで調節した研究である。レチノイン酸は通常分泌されないPSβGを誘導し、hCGとhCGα産生を増加させた。cAMP調節物質との併用で相乗効果を示した。レチノイド処理により、PSβGとhCGの産生が持続的に増加する安定した表現型変化が生じた。
summary_en: Choriocarcinoma cells in culture were studied for hormone production. Retinoic acid induced the normally absent pregnancy-specific beta1-glycoprotein and increased hCG and hCG alpha, and it acted synergistically with cAMP modulators. Passage in retinoic acid produced a stable altered phenotype with elevated PSβG and hCG. The cells remained responsive to cAMP agents, while BrdUrd strongly suppressed hCG and hCG alpha production. The findings show that retinoids can reprogram choriocarcinoma hormone secretion in vitro.

title: Treatment of recurrent and persistent germ cell tumors with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin.
title_ja: 再発性・持続性胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法
summary_ja: 再発・持続性の胚細胞腫瘍4例にビンブラスチン・シスプラチン・ブレオマイシンを投与した。全例で奏効し、2例は完全奏効でセカンドルック開腹術後も無病であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例は一過性の奏効のみで、6か月以内に再発し死亡した。
summary_en: Four patients with recurrent or persistent germ cell tumors received vinblastine, cisplatin, and bleomycin. All achieved clinical response, and two attained complete response, remaining disease-free after second-look laparotomy. One had a mixed germ cell tumor that persisted as dysgerminoma after primary chemotherapy, and one had pure dysgerminoma. Patients with endodermal sinus tumor had only transient responses, with recurrence and death within six months.

title: Gynecomastia after cytotoxic therapy for metastatic testicular cancer.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する細胞傷害性化学療法後の女性化乳房
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対し化学療法を受けた男性4例で、一過性の女性化乳房を認めた。血清ホルモン測定でライディッヒ細胞と胚上皮への毒性とエストラジオール上昇が示された。良性の所見であり、不要な検査や治療を避けるため、その認識が重要と結論づけている。
summary_en: Four men with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer developed transient gynecomastia during combination chemotherapy. Serum hormone measurements showed toxic effects on Leydig cells and germinal epithelium, with elevated estradiol even without tumor. The authors suggest Leydig cell dysfunction or refeeding after weight loss as causes. They emphasize recognizing this benign condition to avoid unnecessary investigation and treatment.

title: Lymphadenectomy for testicular carcinoma.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対するリンパ節郭清術
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者の約半数は後腹膜転移を有するため、精巣摘除術後の追加治療が重要である。病期AおよびBの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、後腹膜リンパ節郭清術は治療効果と正確な病期分類の両面で有用である。化学療法の進歩によりその役割は再検討されているが、72例のレビューから依然重要と結論づけている。
summary_en: Half of testicular tumor patients present with retroperitoneal metastases, supporting retroperitoneal treatment after orchiectomy. Lymphadenectomy remains valuable in stage A and B nonseminomatous germ cell tumors for therapeutic benefit and accurate staging, since clinical staging is imprecise. Effective modern chemotherapy has prompted reassessment of its role. A review of 72 cases over ten years at McGill University hospitals supports its continued importance, and indications for retroperitoneal dissection are discussed.

title: Reversal of recurrent laryngeal nerve palsy following VP16-213 combination therapy in a patient with metastatic teratoma of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の転移性奇形腫に対するVP16-213併用療法後に反回神経麻痺が回復した1例
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある32歳男性が、喀血・嗄声と肺門部腫瘤を呈した。ビンブラスチン系療法では嗄声が残存したが、VP16-213・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチンへの変更でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が正常化し、麻痺も回復した。7か月間完全寛解が続き、このレジメンの有用性が示唆された。
summary_en: A 32-year-old man treated for a non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor developed hemoptysis, hoarseness, and a left hilar mass with elevated AFP and beta-hCG. Despite vinblastine-based therapy plus cisplatin and mediastinal radiotherapy, hoarseness persisted. After AFP rose again, VP16-213 with bleomycin and cisplatin normalized AFP and resolved hoarseness, with complete remission for seven months. The authors suggest this regimen has useful activity against testicular NSGCT.

title: Radiation therapy of testicular non-seminomas.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の放射線療法
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍121例の予後を評価した。臨床的リンパ節転移と原発巣のT分類が予後因子で、肺再発が転帰を規定した。T1・T2かつリンパ管造影陰性の低リスク群は肺再発9%で、いずれも治癒可能であった。悪性奇形腫中間型は未分化型より好ましい症例が多く、腫瘍マーカーの活用が待機的化学療法の対象選別に役立つ可能性がある。
summary_en: This study of 121 patients with malignant teratoma intermediate or undifferentiated testicular non-seminoma assessed prognosis after radiation-based management. Clinical nodal involvement and primary T category were key prognostic factors, with pulmonary relapse determining outcome. Low-risk patients with T1 or T2 primaries and negative lymphangiography had 9% pulmonary relapse, all curable. Intermediate histology had more favorable patients. Tumor markers and vascular invasion might identify unfavorable patients who could benefit from elective chemotherapy.

title: Cytoreductive surgery for advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of testis.
title_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する減量手術
summary_ja: 進行性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の減量手術の役割を概説した論文です。残存悪性組織の完全切除が長期無病生存の改善に必要とされ、化学療法中の病勢進行は手術の禁忌とされます。切除不完全例や術後の腫瘍マーカー高値は予後不良因子であり、術前の高値例には追加の化学療法が推奨されています。
summary_en: This review examines the role of cytoreductive surgery in advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis treated with chemotherapy. The authors state that complete resection of residual malignancy is needed to improve long-term disease-free survival. Surgery is generally recommended after three to four cycles of an optimal chemotherapy regimen. Progressive disease during chemotherapy is a contraindication to surgery. Residual malignant tissue is found in up to one third of patients with residual disease. Incomplete resection and elevated tumor markers after surgery indicate poor prognosis.

title: Significant factors in the optimal management of advanced stage germ cell carcinoma.
title_ja: 進行期胚細胞癌の最適な治療における重要な因子
summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞がん22例に、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、アクチノマイシンDの併用化学療法を行った報告である。73%が完全寛解に達し、1例は残存病変を完全切除した。病変の範囲と不良な全身状態が有意な不良因子であった。無病状態に達した患者は生存利益があり、大半が無病で生存していた。著者らは、多くの患者が治癒しうると述べ、大病変例の最適治療と維持療法の役割にはさらなる検討が必要としている。
summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 22 patients with advanced germ cell carcinoma treated with a combination of cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin, and actinomycin D. Complete remission was achieved in 73 percent of patients, and one patient had complete resection of residual disease. Extent of disease and poor performance status were the only significant adverse pretreatment factors. Prior therapy did not affect the chance of complete remission but increased hematologic toxicity. Patients who became disease-free had a significant survival advantage, and most were alive and disease-free at follow-up.

title: Acute leukemia following a malignant teratoma in a child with Klinefelter's syndrome: case report and review of secondary leukemias in children following treatment of a primary neoplasm.
title_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の小児における悪性奇形腫後の急性白血病：症例報告と原発性腫瘍治療後の小児二次性白血病の検討
summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の男児に発生した縦隔奇形癌の症例を報告し、その後の急性白血病による死亡を記述した論文です。あわせて、小児の原発性悪性腫瘍治療後に生じる二次性白血病の文献的検討を行っています。二次性白血病の治療反応は不良で、生存期間中央値は約4か月でした。
summary_en: The authors report a child with Klinefelter syndrome who developed a mediastinal teratocarcinoma that produced gonadotropin. The child seemed to survive the tumor but died of acute leukemia two years later. This prompted a review of secondary leukemias in children after chemotherapy or radiotherapy for another primary malignancy. These leukemias responded poorly to treatment, with a median survival of about four months. The authors note that secondary leukemias may become more common as children survive longer after potentially leukemogenic therapy, and recommend close monitoring.

title: Role of pulmonary function tests in the prevention of bleomycin pulmonary toxicity during chemotherapy for metastatic testicular teratoma.
title_ja: 転移性精巣奇形腫の化学療法中におけるブレオマイシン肺毒性の予防に関する肺機能検査の役割
summary_ja: 転移性精巣奇形腫の男性38例を対象に、ブレオマイシン化学療法中の肺機能検査の有用性を検討した論文です。ブレオマイシン90mg投与後にDLcoのみ有意に低下し、晩期の検査値に有意な変化はみられませんでした。総投与量が360mg以下であれば、特別な危険因子がない限り定期検査は不要と結論づけています。
summary_en: This study evaluated whether routine pulmonary function tests can detect bleomycin lung toxicity in 38 men treated for metastatic testicular teratoma with up to four courses of chemotherapy. Tests were performed before each course and repeated 2 to 5 years later in 10 disease-free survivors. Only the carbon monoxide diffusing capacity fell after the first 90 mg of bleomycin. Late values did not change significantly. The authors conclude that routine tests are unnecessary when the total bleomycin dose is 360 mg or less, unless particular risk factors are present.

title: alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP), human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG), and carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) demonstrated in the immature glands of mediastinal teratocarcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 縦隔奇形癌の未熟腺組織におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびCEAの検出：症例報告
summary_ja: 縦隔奇形癌の21歳男性の症例報告で、血清中のAFP、hCG、CEAの変動と組織内局在を検討しています。改変VAC療法後にAFPとhCGは有意に低下し、CEAは徐々に上昇しました。未熟な腺組織にこれら3種の抗原が同一腺内に存在することが示されています。
summary_en: The authors report a 21-year-old man with mediastinal teratocarcinoma and high serum levels of AFP, hCG, and CEA. After modified VAC chemotherapy, AFP and hCG fell significantly, while CEA rose gradually. Histology showed embryonal carcinoma combined with teratoma. Immunoperoxidase staining detected AFP, hCG, and CEA in the immature glandular tissue of the teratoma, and the markers were found within the same glands on serial sections. Tumor tissue contained high levels of AFP, beta-hCG, and CEA.

title: Lack of expression of HLA-ABC antigens in choriocarcinoma and other human tumor cell lines.
title_ja: 絨毛癌およびその他のヒト腫瘍細胞株におけるHLA-ABC抗原の発現欠損
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト腫瘍細胞株21種におけるHLA-ABC抗原の発現を検討した論文です。絨毛癌2株は抗体に全く反応せず、HLA-ABC重鎖の合成欠損がその原因とされました。この欠損は、妊娠時の栄養膜と同様に腫瘍をT細胞による攻撃から守る可能性があると考察されています。
summary_en: The authors tested 21 human tumor and other cell lines for HLA-ABC antigen expression. Two choriocarcinoma lines showed no detectable reaction with monoclonal antibodies, and several other lines showed reduced expression. In choriocarcinoma and one breast tumor line, beta-2 microglobulin was expressed but little or no HLA-A, B, or C polypeptide was synthesized. Other negative lines lacked surface HLA-ABC because beta-2 microglobulin was not made. The authors suggest this loss may protect tumors from T-cell attack, similar to the protection of trophoblast during pregnancy.

title: Renal vascular lesions after chemotherapy with vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin.
title_ja: ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチン化学療法後の腎血管病変
summary_ja: 転移性胎児性癌の30歳男性が、ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチン併用化学療法中に高血圧を発症した。治療終了3か月後に加速性高血圧が生じ、カプトプリルで血圧は正常化した。腎生検では細動脈の狭窄と血栓が認められ、薬剤性腎血管性高血圧が示唆される。
summary_en: A 30-year-old man with metastatic embryonal carcinoma developed hypertension during vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin chemotherapy. Three months after treatment ended, accelerated hypertension occurred. Nitroprusside failed, but captopril normalized his blood pressure. Renal biopsy showed onion-skin narrowing of interlobular arteries and fibrin thrombosis of afferent arterioles, suggesting drug-induced renovascular hypertension. The case highlights a possible late toxicity of standard germ cell tumor chemotherapy.

title: Acute changes of alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotropin during induction chemotherapy of germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の導入化学療法中におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の急性変化
summary_ja: 精巣および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍37例に導入化学療法を施行し、36例でAFP/hCGが正常化した。治療初期にマーカー値の一過性上昇が多くみられ、大量転移病変と相関した。AFPおよびhCGの半減期算出は胚細胞腫瘍の管理に有用とされる。
summary_en: Thirty-seven patients with germ cell cancers and elevated AFP and/or hCG received induction chemotherapy with vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin. Markers normalized in 36 patients. Most patients showed a transient rise in AFP or hCG early in therapy, which correlated with large-volume metastatic disease. Patients with relapsed or refractory disease showed prolonged AFP half-life later in treatment. The authors recommend AFP and hCG half-life calculations for managing germ cell cancer patients.

title: In vitro differentiation of mouse teratocarcinoma cells monitored by intermediate filament expression.
title_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞の中間径フィラメント発現によるin vitro分化の解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 抗血清を用いてマウス奇形癌およびEC細胞の中間径フィラメント発現を解析した。胚様体の内部細胞は発現を欠き、外側細胞はサイトケラチンを発現した。レチノイン酸による分化誘導後の発現パターンは細胞株ごとに異なり、EC細胞株は胚発生の分化研究に有用と示された。
summary_en: This study used intermediate filament class-specific antisera to characterize differentiation of mouse teratocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma cells. Inner cells of embryoid bodies lacked all intermediate filament types, while outer cells expressed cytokeratin, resembling the blastocyst. Twelve EC lines expressed vimentin. Retinoic acid-induced differentiation produced line-dependent patterns of cytokeratin, vimentin, GFAP, and neurofilament expression, supporting EC lines as models of embryonic differentiation.

title: Morphological characteristics of different types of cystic teratoma of the ovary. A study of surface ultrastructure in relation to tumor classification and development.
title_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の形態学的特徴: 表面超微細構造と腫瘍分類・発生との関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫28例の表面超微細構造を検討し、形態と分類・生物学的挙動との関連を評価した。扁平上皮は異常な角化を示し、呼吸上皮には微絨毛細胞と線毛細胞が認められた。超微細構造は嚢胞腺腫との鑑別に有用で、判定困難な病変の同定にも役立った。
summary_en: The surface ultrastructure of 28 cystic ovarian teratomas was examined to relate morphology to tumor classification and biological behavior. Squamous epithelium showed abnormal maturation and keratinization, while respiratory epithelium contained microvillous and ciliated cells. Heaped squamous cells in onion-like arrangements appeared even in histologically regular lesions. Ultrastructural features distinguished teratomas from cystadenomas and helped identify indeterminate lesions and areas of malignant potential.

title: Alphafetoprotein messenger RNA in human embryonal carcinoma grown in nude mice, and cloning of its complementary DNA.
title_ja: ヌードマウスで増殖させたヒト胎児性癌におけるαフェトプロテインmRNAおよびそのcDNAのクローニング
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヌードマウスで増殖させたヒト精巣胎児性癌からAFP mRNAを部分精製し、cDNAをクローニングした。5つの陽性クローンのうち最大のpHAF2は、AFP mRNAの3'末端に対応していた。
summary_en: Messenger RNA for human alpha-fetoprotein was partially purified from a human testicular embryonal carcinoma propagated in nude mice. Complementary DNA was synthesized, inserted into pBR322, and screened in E. coli, yielding five positive clones. The largest clone, pHAF2 (900 nucleotides), corresponded to the 3' end of AFP mRNA and had a restriction map distinct from previously reported mouse AFP cDNA clones.

title: Hyaline globules in yolk sac tumor. Histochemical, immunohistochemical and electron microscopic studies.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍における硝子様小体: 組織化学、免疫組織化学および電子顕微鏡による検討
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣および卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍4例で硝子様小体を検討した。小体は糖蛋白性で、多くが細胞質内でAFP陽性であった。電子顕微鏡では、内臓型細胞のAFP陽性高電子密度小体と、壁側型細胞由来のAFP陰性線維状小体の2型が認められた。
summary_en: Four yolk sac tumors of the testis and ovary were examined by histochemistry, immunohistochemistry, and electron microscopy to characterize hyaline globules. The globules were glycoprotein-positive, and most intracytoplasmic globules were AFP-positive. Electron microscopy revealed two types: electron-dense AFP-positive globules in visceral-type cells, and filamentous, basement-membrane-like AFP-negative globules in parietal-type cells.

title: The management of metastatic seminoma testis.
title_ja: 転移性精巣セミノーマの管理
summary_ja: 未治療の転移性精巣セミノーマ85例を報告した。病期IIの再発率は転移巣の大きさに伴い上昇し、IIAで9.4%、IICで39.1%であった。横隔膜下放射線療法を受けた13例では横隔膜上の初回再発はなかった。病期IIA・IIBには放射線療法、病期IICには化学療法を先行させる方針が提案された。
summary_en: Clinical details of 85 men with previously untreated metastatic seminoma are reviewed. In stage II disease, relapse rates rose with metastasis size, from 9.4% in IIA to 39.1% in IIC. None of 13 stage II patients treated with infradiaphragmatic irradiation had a supradiaphragmatic first relapse. The authors propose irradiation for IIA and IIB, initial chemotherapy for IIC, and initial chemotherapy with individualized radiotherapy for stage III and IV disease.

title: Current concepts in the management of testicular germ cell tumours in adults. A review.
title_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理における現在の考え方: 総説
summary_ja: 成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理を総説した。最も有効な化学療法はシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン併用療法である。生存率は病期Iで約100%、病期IIで90%、病期IIIで60%とされる。低病期セミノーマは依然として放射線療法が行われる。
summary_en: This review summarizes management of adult testicular germ cell tumors. Cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin is the most active regimen, with etoposide as an alternative. Surgery provides definitive cure in low-stage disease and debulking after chemotherapy in advanced stages. Survival is about 100% in stage I, 90% in stage II, and 60% in stage III. Low-stage seminoma is still treated with radiotherapy, and chemotherapy appears to improve survival in advanced seminoma.

title: Chemotherapy of endodermal sinus tumour (yolk sac tumour) of the ovary: preliminary communication.
title_ja: 卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍の化学療法：予備報告
summary_ja: 1982年の予備報告。卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍の女性8例に、シスプラチン・ブレオマイシン・ビンブラスチン(PVB)併用化学療法を実施した。8例中7例で完全寛解が得られ、全例が3〜33か月後も生存し健康であった。PVBは女性の胚細胞腫瘍に対し、精巣奇形腫と同程度に有効と考えられると結論づけている。
summary_en: This 1982 preliminary report describes eight women with ovarian yolk sac (endodermal sinus) tumour treated with combination chemotherapy of cisplatin, bleomycin and vinblastine (PVB). Seven of eight achieved complete remission, and all seven were alive and well 3 to 33 months later. The authors compare these results with their earlier experience and published reports. They conclude that the PVB regimen is likely as effective for female germ cell tumours as for testicular teratoma.

title: Adjuvant chemotherapy with vinblastine and bleomycin in stage B nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(病期B)に対するビンブラスチンとブレオマイシンによる補助化学療法
summary_ja: 1982年の泌尿器科研究。非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病期B患者25例に、高用量ビンブラスチンと持続静注ブレオマイシンによる補助化学療法を行った。再発は2例(8%)で、いずれもシスプラチンを含む追加化学療法で無病となった。25例中24例(96%)が15か月から7年以上無病で経過した。
summary_en: This 1982 urology study reports adjuvant chemotherapy with high-dose vinblastine and continuous-infusion bleomycin in 25 men with stage B nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. Two patients (8%) relapsed after adjuvant therapy, and both became disease-free after further chemotherapy including cisplatin. Twenty-four of 25 (96%) remained disease-free for 15 months to over 7 years. One patient died after a second primary embryonal carcinoma developed in the remaining testis.

title: Infantile embryonal carcinoma of testis.
title_ja: 乳児期の精巣胎児性癌
summary_ja: 1968〜1979年に治療された乳児期の精巣胎児性癌19例の報告。精巣摘除術と化学療法(メトトレキサート等)を受けた10例は全例無病で、手術のみやリンパ節郭清を受けた例では死亡例がみられた。卵黄嚢成分を持つ腫瘍は血行性転移をきたしやすい。病期Aでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清は不要とし、AFPの測定が治療モニタリングに有用とする。
summary_en: This 1982 report reviews 19 infants with embryonal carcinoma of the testis treated between 1968 and 1979. Patients given orchiectomy plus methotrexate, actinomycin D and cyclophosphamide all remained disease-free, whereas several patients managed with surgery alone or with lymphadenectomy died. Infantile tumours with yolk sac elements showed haematogenous spread even when nodes were negative. The authors argue that infantile embryonal carcinoma differs from the adult type, that retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy is unnecessary in clinical stage A, and that AFP levels help monitor treatment.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma: prenatal diagnosis with elevated alphafetoprotein and acetylcholinesterase in amniotic fluid.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断：羊水および母体血清αフェトプロテインとアセチルコリンエステラーゼの上昇
summary_ja: 妊娠24週の超音波検査で仙尾部奇形腫が疑われた症例の報告。羊水および母体血清のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に上昇し、羊水のゲル電気泳動でアセチルコリンエステラーゼのバンドが認められた。25週で分娩が始まり、染色体正常の男児で胎児体重の約4分の3に相当する腫瘍が確認された。
summary_en: This 1982 case report describes a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma suspected by ultrasound at 24 weeks' gestation. Amniotic fluid and maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein were markedly elevated, and amniotic fluid gel electrophoresis showed an acetylcholinesterase band. Labour began at 25 weeks, and the chromosomally normal male fetus was found to have a tumour equal to three-quarters of its weight.

title: Synthesis of retrovirus-like particles in testicular teratocarcinomas.
title_ja: 精巣奇形癌腫におけるレトロウイルス様粒子の合成
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌腫由来のヒト細胞株5種で、電子顕微鏡によりレトロウイルス様粒子が確認された。誘導処理により粒子産生と培養上清中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)量が増加し、合胞体栄養膜様細胞が粒子産生に関与する可能性が示された。粒子の起源や発症への関与、患者血清抗体反応の診断マーカーとしての可能性が論じられている。
summary_en: This 1982 study examines human testicular teratocarcinoma cell lines for retrovirus-like particles. Electron microscopy detected such particles in all five cell lines studied. Virus induction increased particle production and chorionic gonadotropin levels in the culture medium, suggesting that syncytial trophoblast-like cells within the tumours produce the particles. The authors discuss whether the particles are endogenous or exogenous, their role in pathogenesis, and the potential of serum antibody reactivity as a diagnostic marker.

title: Vinblastine, actinomycin D, bleomycin, cyclophosphamide and cis-platinum combination chemotherapy in metastatic testis cancer--a 1-year program.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する5剤併用化学療法：1年間プログラムの成績
summary_ja: 進行精巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍(病期III等)の男性31例(評価可能25例)に、5剤併用の1年間化学療法を実施した。完全寛解率は92%で、中央値27か月超の追跡で80%が無病であった。微小転移例や奇形腫成分のない例は化学療法単独で良好で、進行例や奇形腫成分例は併用療法で利益を得た。主な重篤な毒性は骨髄抑制であった。
summary_en: This 1982 report describes a one-year regimen of vinblastine, actinomycin D, bleomycin, cyclophosphamide and cisplatin in 31 men with stage III or bulky stage II malignant testicular germ cell tumours, 25 of them evaluable. Complete remission occurred in 92%, and 80% remained disease-free at a median follow-up of over 27 months. Patients with minimal metastases or no teratoma in the primary tumour responded well to chemotherapy alone, while those with advanced disease and teratoma benefited from combined treatment. Myelosuppression was the main serious toxicity.

title: Reduced platelet survival following chemotherapy with vinblastine, bleomycin and cis-platinum for testicular teratoma.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対する化学療法後の血小板生存期間の低下
summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対しビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチンを併用した化学療法では、早期に一過性の血小板減少症がしばしば生じた。著者らは、この作用が血小板生存期間の短縮によることを示した。関連文献のレビューから、薬剤の相乗作用が原因である可能性を提唱している。本報告は化学療法に伴う血液毒性の理解に寄与するものである。
summary_en: This 1982 study examines thrombocytopenia after vinblastine, bleomycin and cisplatin chemotherapy for testicular teratoma. Patients often developed early, transient low platelet counts. The authors show that this effect is due to reduced platelet survival. The relevant literature is reviewed, and they propose that the phenomenon may be attributable to drug synergism.

title: Surgical resection of residual tumor after chemotherapy in non-seminomatous testicular cancer.
title_ja: 化学療法後の残存腫瘍に対する外科的切除:非セミノーマ性精巣がん
summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣がん15例が、導入化学療法後の残存腫瘍に対して外科的切除を受けた。縦隔・肺転移では9例中7例、後腹膜転移では6例中2例が完全寛解に至った。AFP高値例は寛解が得られず、成熟・未熟奇形腫や壊死の切除例で寛解が得られた一方、胎児性癌や卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を含む例では寛解が少なかった。
summary_en: Fifteen patients with disseminated nonseminomatous testicular cancer underwent surgical resection of residual tumor after induction chemotherapy. Complete remission was achieved in 7 of 9 with mediastinal or pulmonary metastases and 2 of 6 with retroperitoneal metastases. Patients with high AFP failed to achieve remission. Resection of mature or immature teratoma or necrosis yielded remission, whereas embryonal carcinoma or yolk sac tumor components did not. Most patients in remission stayed disease-free during follow-up.

title: [Chemotherapy of testicular cancer, with special reference to cisplatin therapy].
title_ja: [精巣がんの化学療法:シスプラチン療法を中心として]
summary_ja: 1950〜1977年の日本における精巣腫瘍死亡率の推移と、シスプラチン(CDDP)を用いた化学療法の副作用を報告している。消化器症状、骨髄抑制、腎毒性が多くみられた。病期IIおよびIIIの精巣がんでは、50%生存期間が1965〜1974年の6か月から1975年以降は18か月へと改善し、VAB療法やPVB療法の導入が一因とされた。
summary_en: This Japanese study reviews testicular neoplasm mortality from 1950 to 1977 and reports toxicity of cisplatin-based chemotherapy in 47 urogenital cancer patients. Gastrointestinal symptoms, marrow suppression and nephrotoxicity were common. In patients with stage II or III testicular cancer, the 50% survival time improved from 6 months (1965-1974) to 18 months after 1975, which was attributed to VAB or PVB regimens.

title: [Study on the rationale for chemotherapy of refractory choriocarcinoma].
title_ja: [難治性絨毛癌の化学療法の根拠に関する研究]
summary_ja: 高リスク絨毛癌でメトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、アルキル化剤の併用療法を行い、寛解率は約70%であった。低リスク例では100%であった。難治例に対しては、四剤併用、CHAMOMA法、シスプラチン・ブレオマイシン・ビンブラスチン療法、超大量メトトレキサート療法、MTXを含まない併用療法などを検討した。最後の療法はヌードマウスを用いた化学療法の実験データに基づき設計された。
summary_en: Combination chemotherapy with methotrexate, actinomycin D and an alkylating agent achieved about 70% remission in high-risk choriocarcinoma patients refractory to prior regimens, versus 100% in low-risk patients. For refractory cases, the authors tested quadritherapy, the CHAMOMA protocol, cisplatin-bleomycin-vinblastine, ultra-high-dose methotrexate, and an MTX-free combination. The last regimen was designed from chemotherapy experiments in nude mice.

title: Control by the extracellular environment of differentiation pathways in 1003 embryonal carcinoma cells: study at the level of specific intermediate filaments.
title_ja: 胎児性癌1003細胞における分化経路の細胞外環境による制御:特異的中間径フィラメントの観点から
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎児性癌クローン細胞株1003は、培地組成を変えることで異なる発生経路へ誘導される。血清含有培地では大部分の細胞が未分化を保ち、無血清培地では神経上皮細胞からニューロンへ分化する。血清再添加では間葉系細胞になる。ビメンチンやニューロフィラメント蛋白質の発現変化を指標に、各分化段階の特徴を解析した。
summary_en: The 1003 embryonal carcinoma clonal cell line was driven along different developmental pathways by changing the culture medium. In serum-containing medium most cells stayed undifferentiated, whereas serum-free medium induced neuroepithelial cells, then neurons, and re-adding serum induced mesenchymal cells. Changes in vimentin, neurofilament proteins and the ECMA 7 embryonic antigen were used to characterize each differentiation stage.

title: Multivariate analysis of risk factors in patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors treated with vinblastine and bleomycin.
title_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法における危険因子の多変量解析
summary_ja: 転移を有する精巣胚細胞腫瘍39例にビンブラスチンとブレオマイシンを投与し、8例が完全寛解に至った。完全寛解の予測因子は腫瘍容積とパフォーマンス・ステータスであった。Cox比例ハザードモデルでは、原発巣のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、血清乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)、パフォーマンス・ステータス、完全寛解が生存に有意な影響を与え、層別化治療への応用が期待される。
summary_en: Thirty-nine patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors received vinblastine and bleomycin, and 8 achieved complete remission. Stepwise discriminant analysis found that tumor volume and performance status predicted complete remission. Cox multivariate analysis showed that primary tumor hCG, serum LDH, performance status and complete remission significantly affected survival, suggesting these factors may help guide differentiated treatment.

title: Natural history of dysgerminoma.
title_ja: ディスジャーミノーマの自然経過
summary_ja: 純粋型ディスジャーミノーマ56例の自然経過を報告している。リンパ管造影、腹腔鏡検査、腹腔細胞診で病期分類を行った。5年無再発生存率は病期IA〜ICで91%、後腹膜病変を伴う病期IIIで74%、腹膜病変を伴う病期IIIでは24%であった。
summary_en: This report describes 56 patients with pure dysgerminoma, staged by lymphography, peritoneoscopy and peritoneal cytology. Most patients had Stage IA disease. Five-year relapse-free survival was 91% for Stage IA to IC, 74% for Stage III retroperitoneal disease, and 24% for peritoneal involvement. Diaphragmatic inspection was always negative, and lymphography changed the stage in about a third of patients.

title: The management of brain metastases in germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における脳転移の管理
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移12例に対し全脳照射と全身化学療法を施行した。単発病変例の平均生存期間は29.9か月、多発例は13.7か月であった。単発例の一部で髄膜癌腫症を来し、脳脊髄液中に悪性細胞が認められた。
summary_en: Twelve patients with brain metastases from germ cell tumors were treated with whole brain irradiation and systemic chemotherapy. Patients with a single brain lesion had a mean survival of 29.9 months, versus 13.7 months for those with multiple lesions, suggesting that chemosensitive tumors improve outcomes. Meningeal carcinomatosis developed in two patients initially treated for a single metastasis, and cerebrospinal fluid cytology showed malignant cells.

title: Roentgenologic manifestations of pulmonary metastases in choriocarcinoma and invasive mole.
title_ja: 絨毛癌および侵入奇胎における肺転移の胸部X線所見
summary_ja: 絨毛癌429例と侵入奇胎441例の胸部X線写真を解析し、肺転移の頻度はそれぞれ85.1%、65.0%であった。連続撮影や肺動脈造影を病理所見と対比した。各種の転移陰影は同一病変の経時的変化を示すと結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed chest radiographs from 429 choriocarcinoma and 441 invasive mole cases, finding pulmonary metastases in 85.1% and 65.0% of patients, respectively. Serial films in 27 cases, along with postmortem and surgical pulmonary arteriography, were used to correlate radiographic patterns with pathology. The authors conclude that the various forms of metastatic shadows represent different evolutionary stages of the same lesion.

title: Criteria toward the definition of nonmetastatic gestational trophoblastic disease after hydatidiform mole.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎後の非転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の定義に向けた基準
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後にhCG値が持続的に高値を示す非転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の診断基準を検討した。4施設のデータでは26%に診断され、化学療法前の時代の絨毛癌頻度16%と比較された。綿密なフォローアップ下では3〜4週間のプラトー確認が妥当と提案している。
summary_en: The authors address when to diagnose nonmetastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia after hydatidiform mole, since chemotherapy is typically started after a three-value hCG plateau over two weeks. Data from four US centers show NMGTN diagnosed in 26% of cases, compared with a 16% choriocarcinoma frequency in the prechemotherapy era. They argue that a 3- to 4-week plateau may be justified before treatment in closely followed patients.

title: Circulating placental proteins (hCG, SP1 and PP5) in trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における循環血中胎盤蛋白(hCG、SP1、PP5)
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎31例、侵入奇胎1例、絨毛癌10例の血清を対象に、hCG、SP1、PP5を放射免疫測定した。SP1とhCGは病勢モニタリングに有用であった。PP5は胞状奇胎で検出され絨毛癌では検出されず、悪性栄養膜細胞の浸潤活性との関連が示唆された。
summary_en: Serum hCG, pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP1), and placental protein 5 (PP5) were measured by radioimmunoassay in samples from 31 patients with hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, or choriocarcinoma (228 samples in total). Both SP1 and hCG were useful for monitoring disease. PP5 was present in hydatidiform mole but absent in choriocarcinoma, supporting its association with the invasive activity of malignant trophoblast.

title: Specificity of the control of tumor formation by the blastocyst.
title_ja: 胚盤胞による腫瘍形成制御の特異性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 蛍光マイクロスフェアで標識した胎児性癌細胞を胚盤胞に注入し、腫瘍形成の制御機構を検討した。非分化性胎児性癌株の一部は50%水準で制御され、多分化能を持つ未分化株はほぼ完全に制御された。壁側卵黄嚢癌細胞は制御されなかった。各腫瘍に対応する胚発生の場が制御を担うという仮説が提唱された。
summary_en: Using fluorescent microsphere-labeled cells injected into blastocysts, the authors examined how the blastocyst regulates tumor formation by different cell lines. Some nullipotent embryonal carcinoma lines were controlled at about 50%, others were not controlled, and a multipotent undifferentiated line was almost completely controlled. Parietal yolk sac carcinoma cells were not controlled, leading to a hypothesis that each carcinoma may be regulated by a corresponding embryonic field.

title: Primary anterior mediastinal seminoma.
title_ja: 原発性前縦隔セミノーマ
summary_ja: メイヨークリニックにおける原発性前縦隔セミノーマ21例（純粋型17例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍4例）の後方視的検討。純粋型では9例が無病生存、8例が転移性疾患で死亡した。35歳超、発熱、上大静脈症候群、鎖骨上・頸部リンパ節腫大、肺門病変などが進行の危険因子と考えられ、予後との関連が示唆された。
summary_en: This Mayo Clinic review of primary anterior mediastinal germ cell tumors includes 17 patients with pure seminoma and four with mixed germ cell tumors containing seminoma. Among pure seminoma patients, nine remained disease-free and eight died of metastatic disease. Of the mixed tumor patients, two died. Poor prognosis was associated with age over 35, fever, superior vena cava syndrome, supraclavicular or cervical adenopathy, and hilar disease on radiographs, suggesting these features indicate more aggressive progression.

title: Conversion of malignant murine embryonal carcinomas to benign teratomas by chemical induction of differentiation in vivo.
title_ja: 化学的分化誘導によるマウス胎児性癌の良性奇形腫への転換（in vivo）
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC4azalを用い、レチノイン酸とジメチルアセトアミドによる分化誘導を生体内で検討した。腫瘍内または全身投与により神経上皮様・腺様への分化が誘導され、増殖抑制と生存期間の延長が得られた。18例中4例では良性奇形腫へ完全に転換し長期生存が得られた。胚細胞腫瘍の前臨床モデルとして分化療法の可能性を示す。
summary_en: Murine PCC4azal embryonal carcinoma tumors grown subcutaneously in mice were treated with retinoic acid dissolved in dimethylacetamide, given intratumorally or systemically. Treatment induced substantial differentiation into neuroepithelial and glandular structures, slowing growth, reducing mitoses and necrosis, and prolonging host survival. In four of 18 treated animals, tumors fully converted into benign teratomas, yielding long-term survival. The study shows that chemical induction of differentiation can reverse malignant germ cell phenotypes in vivo, offering a preclinical model relevant to germ cell tumor therapy.

title: HLA antigens in patients with germ cell cancers of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者におけるHLA抗原
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者145例のHLA-A、-B、-C、-DR抗原発現を解析した研究。純粋型セミノーマ群ではAw33、B5、DR5、DRw6が、胎児性癌を含む群ではA3、B7が増加していた一方、DR3は全群で減少した。多重比較補正後は有意差はなかった。罹患兄弟3組はHLAハプロタイプを少なくとも1つ共有していた。
summary_en: This study analyzed HLA-A, -B, -C, and -DR antigen expression in 145 Caucasian patients with testicular germ cell tumors, including 18 with pure seminoma and others with nonseminomatous tumors containing embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma, choriocarcinoma, or yolk sac components. Frequencies of several HLA antigens increased in specific histologic subgroups, including Aw33, B5, DR5, and DRw6 in pure seminoma and A3 and B7 in embryonal carcinoma, while DR3 decreased across groups. Differences were not statistically significant after correction. Three affected brothers shared at least one HLA haplotype, the significance of which remains unclear.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumour (trophoblastic pseudotumour): a study of four cases requiring hysterectomy including one fatal case.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（トロホブラスト偽腫瘍）：致死例1例を含む子宮摘出を要した4例の検討
summary_ja: 子宮摘出術を施行された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍4例の臨床病理学的検討。1例はネフローゼ症候群と播種性血管内凝固を呈し、術後に改善した。2例は子宮外へ進展し、うち1例は化学療法にもかかわらず転移性疾患で死亡した。絨毛癌に有効なレジメンに抵抗性を示し、血清β-hCG値は比較的低かった。全摘出とβ-hCGモニタリングの重要性を強調している。
summary_en: Four patients with placental-site trophoblastic tumour, also called trophoblastic pseudotumour, were treated with hysterectomy. One patient had nephrotic syndrome with disseminated intravascular coagulation that resolved after surgery. Two tumors extended beyond the uterus, and one patient died with widespread metastases despite intensive chemotherapy. Tumors showed infiltrative behavior resistant to choriocarcinoma regimens and relatively low serum hCG. Histology lacked bilaminar structure. The authors emphasize serum hCG monitoring and complete surgical excision and argue that the name pseudotumour is inappropriate.

title: Immunohistochemical demonstration of placental protein 5 in trophoblastic tumours.
title_ja: 栄養膜腫瘍における胎盤タンパク質5の免疫組織化学的検出
summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍組織におけるPP5（胎盤タンパク質5）の免疫組織化学的検出を検討した報告。胞状奇胎15例全例、破壊性奇胎6例中2例、絨毛癌7例中1例で陽性だった。生物学的役割は不明だが、プラスミン不活性化との関連から、胎盤の浸潤性制御に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Immunoperoxidase staining was used to detect placental protein 5 (PP5) in tissue from trophoblastic tumours. PP5 was present in all 15 hydatidiform moles, in two of six destructive moles, and in one of seven choriocarcinomas. Although its biological role remains unclear, its association with plasmin inactivation suggests PP5 may help control placental invasiveness. This brief report describes PP5 expression across the gestational trophoblastic disease spectrum.

title: VP16-213, cisplatinum, and adriamycin salvage therapy of refractory and/or recurrent nonseminomatous germ cell neoplasms.
title_ja: VP16-213、シスプラチン、アドリアマイシンによる難治性・再発性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のサルベージ療法
summary_ja: 従来の化学療法に抵抗性または再発した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍11例に、VP16-213、シスプラチン、アドリアマイシンによるサルベージ療法を施行した。完全奏効1例、部分奏効10例（うち4例は手術で良性奇形腫）が得られ、4例は18か月以上生存した。難治例への真のサルベージ療法となる可能性が示され、初回治療への組み入れも支持されている。
summary_en: Eleven patients with recurrent or refractory nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, unresponsive to conventional chemotherapy, received salvage therapy with VP16-213, cisplatin, and adriamycin. One complete response and ten partial responses were observed, four of which were benign teratomas at surgery. Four patients survived beyond 18 months. The authors suggest the regimen may offer true salvage for refractory patients and recommend incorporating VP16-213 into initial treatment regimens for germ cell neoplasms.

title: Trophoblastic cells of the hydatidiform mole contain a beta 1-subtype adrenergic receptor.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎の栄養膜細胞はβ1アドレナリン受容体を有する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎組織の膜標本を用いてβアドレナリン受容体を解析した研究。栄養膜細胞はβ1受容体のみを発現し、アデニル酸シクラーゼと共役していた。β2受容体は非栄養膜成分に存在すると考えられた。受容体量は倍数性や絨毛癌への進展とは関連しなかった。胎盤代謝におけるカテコラミン調節を示唆する。
summary_en: Human hydatidiform mole tissue was examined for beta-adrenergic receptors using membrane binding assays. Trophoblastic cells expressed only beta1-adrenergic receptors coupled to adenylate cyclase, with binding characteristics matching the beta1 subtype and metoprolol selectivity. Beta2 receptors likely reside on nontrophoblastic stromal or endothelial cells. Receptor levels did not vary by ploidy, fetal presence, or progression toward choriocarcinoma. Choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo and JEG-3 lacked specific binding. The findings support catecholamine regulation of placental metabolism.

title: Single drug therapy in non-seminomatous germinal cell tumours of the testicle.
title_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する単剤化学療法
summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍84例に対するミトラマイシン単剤療法の成績を検討。進行例では強力な化学療法より生存率が低く、進行期には推奨されない。一方、低病期例の生存率は、補助化学療法なしで両側リンパ節郭清を受けた既報より良好だった。低病期例の補助療法としてのみ使用すべきとされる。
summary_en: This study evaluated single-agent mithramycin in 84 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis across stages. Survival with advanced disease was lower than with more intensive chemotherapy, so mithramycin is not recommended for advanced stages. In contrast, patients with low-stage disease had better survival than historical series treated with bilateral lymphadenectomy without adjuvant chemotherapy. Most patients underwent unilateral gland dissection preserving sexual function. The authors suggest single-drug therapy be used only as adjuvant treatment in low-stage disease.

title: Autopsy findings in 154 patients with germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍154例の剖検所見
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者154例の剖検例を検討した研究である。明らかな純粋セミノーマの44%に非セミノーマ成分の転移が認められた。主な遠隔転移部位は肺、肝、脳、骨で、死因は肺転移による呼吸不全が最多であった。白金製剤導入の前後で転移パターンに明確な差はみられなかった。
summary_en: This autopsy review of 154 patients with testicular germ cell tumors found that 44% of those with apparently pure seminoma had evidence of nonseminomatous metastases. Lung, liver, brain, and bone were the most common distant metastatic sites, with brain metastases frequent in choriocarcinoma and bone metastases in seminoma. Brain, liver, and bone involvement typically appeared late and accompanied other sites. Respiratory failure from lung metastases was the leading cause of death. Retroperitoneal recurrence after lymph node dissection mainly occurred in patients with prior retroperitoneal nodal disease. Outcomes did not clearly differ before and after platinum-based regimens.

title: Treatment of nonmetastatic gestational trophoblastic disease: results of methotrexate alone versus methotrexate--folinic acid.
title_ja: 非転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対するメトトレキサート単独療法とメトトレキサート–ホリナート療法の比較
summary_ja: 非転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対し、メトトレキサート単独とメトトレキサート–ホリナート交互投与を後方視的に比較した研究である。メトトレキサート抵抗性は単独群7.7%、ホリナート併用群27.5%で、併用群の寛解導入効果が劣った。最終的には全例が寛解した。単独療法は毒性が強く、ホリナート併用は毒性を減らすものの、寛解導入の有効性は低下すると結論づけられた。
summary_en: This retrospective comparison of methotrexate alone versus methotrexate alternated with folinic acid in nonmetastatic gestational trophoblastic disease included 39 and 29 patients, respectively. Methotrexate-resistant disease occurred in 7.7% of the single-agent group and 27.5% of the folinic acid group. All patients ultimately achieved remission. Methotrexate alone was more toxic, while the folinic acid regimen was less toxic but less effective at inducing remission.

title: The growing teratoma syndrome.
title_ja: growing teratoma syndrome
summary_ja: 化学療法で奏効した転移性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の患者6例に、増大する孤立性腫瘤が出現した。切除標本はいずれも悪性組織を含まない成熟奇形腫であり、growing teratoma syndrome と呼ばれる病態が示された。全例が追加治療なしで5〜108か月無病生存していた。化学療法後の良性腫瘤の増大を認識すれば、外科的救済が可能となる。
summary_en: Six patients with metastatic mixed germ cell tumors who responded to chemotherapy developed enlarging solitary masses. Each mass was resected and proved to be mature teratoma without malignant histology, a phenomenon described as growing teratoma syndrome. Two masses enlarged from expansile cysts and four were solid. All remained disease-free without further therapy at follow-up of 5 to 108 months. Recognizing this benign enlargement after chemotherapy allows surgical salvage rather than unnecessary further treatment.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease. The effect of duration of disease and hCG titer on response to therapy.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における罹病期間およびhCG値の治療反応への影響
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患352例を対象に、治療前のhCG値と先行妊娠終了から治療開始までの期間が治療反応を予測するかを検討した。転移性と非転移性を合わせた解析では、両因子ともハイリスク患者を同定できた。転移性絨毛癌では両因子とも予後への有意な影響はなく、転移部位や先行妊娠の種類がより重要と考えられた。
summary_en: This 1982 study of 352 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease assessed whether pretreatment hCG titer and the interval from antecedent pregnancy to treatment predict response to therapy. Across metastatic and nonmetastatic disease combined, both factors reliably identified high-risk patients. In metastatic disease alone, predictive strength differed. In metastatic choriocarcinoma, neither factor significantly affected outcome, suggesting that metastatic site and antecedent pregnancy matter more for prognosis.

title: Lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (LDH-1) in athymic mice with xenografts of a human testicular germ cell tumor.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植を担うヌードマウスにおける乳酸脱水素酵素アイソザイム1(LDH-1)
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植モデルで、LDHアイソザイムを検討した研究である。腫瘍組織と嚢胞液でLDH-1活性が高く、血清LDH-1は腫瘍体積と強く相関した。血清LDH-1が腫瘍由来であることを示し、腫瘍量を反映するマーカーとしての有用性を支持する。
summary_en: This study examined lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) isoenzymes in athymic mice bearing xenografts of a human testicular germ cell tumor. LDH-1 activity was high in tumor tissue and cystic fluid, and histochemistry showed LDH in all tumor cells. Serum LDH-1 correlated closely with tumor volume, indicating that circulating LDH-1 originated from the xenografted tumor. The findings support LDH-1 as a serum marker reflecting germ cell tumor burden in an experimental model.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease: treatment results at the Brewer Trophoblastic Disease Center.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療成績：Brewer 絨毛性疾患センターにおける経験
summary_ja: 1962~1978年に同センターで治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患359例の治療成績を報告している。全体の寛解率は92%で、転移のない症例は100%、転移性疾患では83%であった。転移性疾患の治療反応を規定する5因子を同定し、化学療法が主体であった。
summary_en: This report summarizes treatment outcomes for 359 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease, including choriocarcinoma and invasive mole, treated at the Brewer Trophoblastic Disease Center from 1962 to 1978. Overall remission was 92%, with 100% for nonmetastatic and 83% for metastatic disease. Five factors, including histology, pretreatment hCG level, metastatic sites, antecedent pregnancy type, and prior chemotherapy, predicted response in metastatic disease. Chemotherapy was the mainstay, with adjuvant surgery and radiation used selectively. Relapse from remission was also analyzed.

title: Fatal gestational trophoblastic disease: an analysis of treatment failures.
title_ja: 致死的な妊娠性絨毛性疾患：治療失敗例の解析
summary_ja: 1962~1979年に同センターを受診した妊娠性絨毛性疾患399例のうち死亡した48例を解析した。全例が転移性絨毛癌であった。死因は出血と肺不全が主で、治療失敗は進行病変、初期治療の不足、無効な化学療法に起因した。二次化学療法や補助手術は生存率を改善しなかった。
summary_en: This analysis examined 48 deaths among 399 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease referred to the Brewer Center from 1962 to 1979. All fatal cases had metastatic choriocarcinoma. Most patients had elevated pretreatment hCG or delayed treatment, and many had metastases to liver, brain, or peritoneum at presentation. The main causes of death were hemorrhage and pulmonary insufficiency. Treatment failure was attributed to extensive disease, inadequate initial treatment, and ineffective chemotherapy. Secondary chemotherapy, non-brain radiation, and adjuvant surgery did not improve survival.

title: Placental protein 5 in gestational trophoblastic disease: localization and circulating levels.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における胎盤蛋白5(PP5)：局在と循環レベル
summary_ja: 免疫組織化学でPP5を妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に局在させ、血清PP5をラジオイムノアッセイで測定した。PP5は高分化型を含む多くの腫瘍で検出された。持続性疾患では血清PP5の検出頻度と濃度はhCGより低かった。高PP5値の1例で血管内凝固を伴った。
summary_en: This study localized placental protein 5 (PP5) by immunoperoxidase staining in gestational trophoblastic tumors and measured serum PP5 by radioimmunoassay. PP5 was present in a high proportion of tumors, especially well-differentiated ones. In patients with persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, serum PP5 was detected less often and at lower levels than hCG. One case with high PP5 showed concurrent intravascular coagulation, the only clinically significant finding.

title: Radioimmunoassay of placental protein 12: levels in amniotic fluid, cord blood, and serum of healthy adults, pregnant women, and patients with trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 胎盤蛋白12のラジオイムノアッセイ：羊水、臍帯血、血清における値と妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎盤蛋白12(PP12)のラジオイムノアッセイを確立し、羊水、臍帯血、正常妊娠・非妊娠者および妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者の血清で測定した。胞状奇胎や絨毛癌で高値を示したが、hCGとの相関はなかった。このため、PP12は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の適切なマーカーではないと結論づけた。
summary_en: This study developed a radioimmunoassay for placental protein 12 (PP12) and measured its levels in amniotic fluid, cord blood, serum of pregnant and nonpregnant individuals, and patients with trophoblastic disease. Serum PP12 peaked at 22-23 weeks of pregnancy. Elevated levels in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma did not correlate with hCG. The authors concluded that PP12 is not a suitable marker for trophoblastic disease, though normal pregnancy values provide a reference.

title: Primary embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma of the mediastinum. A case report.
title_ja: 縦隔原発の胎児性癌および絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 67歳男性の縦隔原発胎児性癌と絨毛癌の症例を報告している。既報で最高齢の症例とされる。縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の診断には精巣原発の除外が必要であることを強調し、予後不良である点を指摘した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 67-year-old man with primary embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma of the mediastinum, believed to be the oldest reported patient with this lesion. The authors stress that a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor should be diagnosed only after excluding a testicular primary through thorough clinical evaluation. They note that prognosis is very poor for teratocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma despite aggressive therapy.

title: Kaposi's sarcoma following chemotherapy for testicular cancer in a homosexual man: demonstration of cytomegalovirus RNA in sarcoma cells.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対する化学療法後に発症したカポジ肉腫：同性愛男性例におけるサイトメガロウイルスRNAの検出
summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の手術と化学療法後に、カポジ肉腫を発症した男性の症例を報告している。in situハイブリダイゼーションでカポジ肉腫細胞にサイトメガロウイルスmRNAが検出された。ウイルス所見の意義について考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a homosexual man who developed Kaposi's sarcoma after surgery and chemotherapy for testicular embryonal carcinoma. Cytomegalovirus messenger RNA was detected in the Kaposi sarcoma cells by in situ hybridization. The authors discuss the possible significance of this viral finding. Because the sarcoma followed treatment for germ cell tumor, the report links prior testicular cancer therapy with a subsequent second malignancy.

title: Absence of sperm-specific lactate dehydrogenase-x in patients with testis cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者における精子特異的乳酸脱水素酵素X(LDH-X)の欠如
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者53例の血清で精子特異的LDH-Xを検索したが、検出された例はなかった。総LDH高値の31例では、すべてアイソザイム1および/または2が上昇の原因であった。LDHは有用なマーカーであるが、原因となるアイソザイムはLDH-Xではないと結論した。
summary_en: This study screened 53 patients with germ cell tumors for serum sperm-specific lactate dehydrogenase-X (LDH-X). None had detectable LDH-X. Among 31 patients with elevated total LDH, isozymes 1 and/or 2 accounted for the elevation in all cases. The authors conclude that LDH is a useful marker in germ cell tumors, but LDH-X is not the responsible isozyme.

title: Monitoring therapy in trophoblastic diseases by radioimmunoassay of pregnancy-specific beta 1-glycoprotein and the beta subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患治療のモニタリングにおける妊娠特異的β1グリコプロテインとヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニットの放射免疫測定
summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍患者43例の血清473検体で、hCGβとSP1を測定した。治療に伴い両者は低下したがhCGの低下はより顕著であった。臨床的な再発に先行して残存腫瘍を検出でき、両方のマーカーを同時測定する意義を示した。
summary_en: This study measured hCG beta-subunit and pregnancy-specific beta1-glycoprotein (SP1) in 473 serum samples from 43 patients with trophoblastic tumors. Both markers were elevated in untreated patients, and both declined with treatment, with hCG falling more markedly. SP1 remained detectable for 60-150 days, while hCG persisted even longer. Both were sensitive for residual disease months before clinical recurrence, and measuring both was important because some cases had only one marker detectable.

title: Endometriosis of the colon with mixed "germ cell" tumor.
title_ja: 大腸の子宮内膜症に合併した混合性胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 42歳女性の卵管・卵巣の子宮内膜症が、後に大腸の子宮内膜症と悪性変化を来した症例報告。組織学的に良性の異所性子宮内膜腺から異形成・腫瘍組織への直接移行が認められ、卵黄嚢腫瘍・絨毛癌・奇形腫の成分を含んでいた。子宮内膜症由来の悪性腫瘍と混合性胚細胞腫瘍成分の稀な組み合わせとその意義について考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with oviductal and ovarian endometriosis who later developed endometriosis of the colon with malignant transformation. Histology showed direct transition from benign ectopic endometrial glands to dysplastic and neoplastic tissue. Areas contained yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma components. The authors discuss this unusual combination of endometriosis-derived malignancy with mixed germ cell tumor elements and its implications.

title: Non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. Immunohistochemical localization and serum levels of human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) and pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP-1); value of SP-1 as a tumor marker.
title_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)と妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク(SP-1)の免疫組織化学的局在および血清レベル:腫瘍マーカーとしてのSP-1の価値
summary_ja: 精巣の進行期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍41例を対象に、血清および原発巣組織中のhCGとSP-1の局在を比較した研究。SP-1陽性例は常にhCG陽性を伴い、SP-1は絨毛癌成分に対してより高い特異性を示した。進行期疾患における腫瘍マーカーとしての予後的意義が示唆されるが、hCG以上の情報は少ない。
summary_en: This study examined 41 patients with advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. Serum and tissue levels of hCG and SP-1 were compared with their immunohistochemical localization in primary tumors. SP-1 positivity was always accompanied by hCG positivity, but SP-1 showed higher specificity for choriocarcinoma components. The authors suggest serum SP-1 may have prognostic value as a tumor marker in advanced disease, although it adds little information beyond hCG.

title: Disease of the trophoblast.
title_ja: 栄養膜疾患
summary_ja: 奇胎を中心に栄養膜疾患を概説した総説。非典型的な妊娠では奇胎を考慮すること、施設によっては超音波検査によるスクリーニング、奇胎除去後のhCG測定による密なフォローアップが重要と述べる。薬物療法、補助的手術、場合により放射線療法を組み合わせた個別化治療を勧めている。
summary_en: This review addresses trophoblastic disease, focusing on molar pregnancy. It emphasizes considering molar pregnancy in atypical pregnancies, the value of ultrasound screening where facilities allow, and close follow-up with serial hCG radioimmunoassay after mole evacuation. Treatment is individualized, combining drugs, adjuvant surgery, and occasionally radiotherapy. The authors advise continuing treatment even after hCG becomes negative to eradicate residual tumor.

title: [Studies on the recurrent trophoblastic disease].
title_ja: 再発性栄養膜疾患に関する研究
summary_ja: 1973～1980年に治療した栄養膜疾患168例の寛解と再発を検討した日本の臨床研究。全体の寛解率は91.1%、再発率は5.2%で、高リスク例と絨毛癌で再発が多かった。高リスク例では、尿中hCGがLH値を下回った状態が3か月持続することを寛解の基準として提案し、hCGβ値が1.0 ng/mlを超える場合には追加の化学療法が必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This Japanese clinical study reviews 168 patients with trophoblastic disease treated from 1973 to 1980. Remission was achieved in 91.1%, with recurrence in 5.2% overall, highest in high-risk cases and choriocarcinoma. Recurrence intervals and outcomes of recurrent cases are reported. In high-risk patients, the authors propose that urinary hCG remaining below LH levels for three months defines remission, and recommend additional chemotherapy when hCG-beta exceeds 1.0 ng/ml.

title: Human embryonal carcinoma cells in culture do not synthesize fibronectin until they differentiate.
title_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞は分化するまでフィブロネクチンを合成しない
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来のヒト細胞株2102Epにおけるフィブロネクチン合成を解析した研究。高密度培養では胎児性癌の表現型を保ちフィブロネクチンを合成しないが、低密度では分化してSSEA-1陽性細胞が出現し、その細胞のみがフィブロネクチンを産生する。産生されるフィブロネクチンは胎生型の可能性がある。
summary_en: This study examined fibronectin synthesis in 2102Ep, a human cell line derived from a testicular germ cell tumor. In dense cultures, cells retain an embryonal carcinoma phenotype and do not make fibronectin. In sparse cultures, cells partly differentiate, express SSEA-1, and synthesize fibronectin. Fluorescence-activated sorting showed fibronectin production is confined to SSEA-1-positive cells. The product has a slightly higher molecular weight than fibroblast fibronectin, possibly representing an embryonic form, and is not deposited as extracellular matrix.

title: Modulation of dexamethasone receptor expression in embryonal carcinoma cells and their differentiated derivatives.
title_ja: 胎児性癌細胞および分化誘導細胞におけるデキサメタゾン受容体発現の修飾
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞とその分化誘導細胞におけるデキサメタゾン結合能を検討した1982年の基礎研究。未分化な胎児性癌細胞では糖質コルチコイド受容体の発現が培養条件により不安定で可逆的であったが、分化誘導後は安定して発現した。分化状態が受容体発現を制御することを示した初期の知見である。
summary_en: This 1982 Biochemical Journal study examines dexamethasone binding in embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells and their differentiated derivatives. The authors found that glucocorticoid receptor expression was unstable and reversible in undifferentiated EC cells under varying culture conditions, but became stable once the cells were induced to differentiate. Epidermal growth factor binding was assessed in parallel under identical conditions. The work provides early insight into how differentiation status regulates hormone receptor expression in germ-cell-derived malignant stem-like cells, rather than clinical management of tumors.

title: Rates of synthesis of basement membrane proteins by differentiating teratocarcinoma stem cells and their modulation by hormones.
title_ja: 分化する奇形癌幹細胞の基底膜タンパク質合成速度およびホルモンによるその修飾
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株F-9を用い、基底膜タンパク質であるラミニンとIV型コラーゲンの合成を定量した1982年の基礎研究。レチノイン酸による内胚葉様細胞への分化誘導で産生が5～10倍に増加し、ジブチリル環状AMPが特にIV型コラーゲンで増強作用を示した。インスリンなどのホルモンの効果は限定的であった。
summary_en: This 1982 Connective Tissue Research paper uses the murine embryonal carcinoma line F-9 to quantify synthesis of basement membrane proteins laminin and type IV collagen. Retinoic acid-induced differentiation toward endoderm-like cells increased their production 5-10 fold, with dibutyryl cyclic AMP enhancing the effect, especially for type IV collagen. Insulin, EGF and NGF had only modest, variable effects. Most of the protein was secreted into the medium. The study is a basic model of EC differentiation rather than clinical management.

title: A monoclonal antibody marker of human primitive endoderm.
title_ja: 原始内胚葉のマーカーとなるモノクローナル抗体
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株LICR LON HT39/7に対するモノクローナル抗体を作製した1982年の報告。抗体FC 10.2は未分化な奇形腫由来細胞や胚細胞腫瘍内の内胚葉領域に限局する200kDa膜糖タンパク質を認識し、原始内胚葉のマーカーとして有用であった。
summary_en: This 1982 International Journal of Cancer report describes monoclonal antibodies raised against the human embryonal carcinoma line LICR LON HT39/7, using formol-saline fixed cells to yield antibodies that recognize histologically processed antigens.
