summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術後の臨床病期I精巣セミノーマ24例および非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍20例を、腫瘍マーカーと画像検査で監視した。再発はセミノーマで8.3%、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で50%に認められ、大半は2年以内に生じた。監視療法のみでも信頼できるが、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では肺転移評価の改善が必要とされる。
summary_en: This study assessed surveillance without adjuvant therapy in 24 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma and 20 with stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors after radical orchiectomy, followed with tumor markers and imaging. Recurrence occurred in 8.3% of seminoma and 50% of NSGCT patients, most within two years. Recurrences were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and most patients remained disease-free. The authors conclude surveillance is reliable, though NSGCT patients need better assessment of lung metastasis.

title: Synchronous testicular seminoma and adrenocortical carcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 同時性精巣セミノーマと副腎皮質癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 57歳男性で、肺および傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴う精巣セミノーマ（臨床病期IIIB）と同時性に副腎皮質癌を併発した症例。カルボプラチンで完全奏効が得られたが、12か月後に出現した副腎腫瘍は化学療法に抵抗性で、腹腔鏡下副腎摘除術により副腎皮質癌と診断された。術後42か月間再発はない。
summary_en: This case report describes a 57-year-old man with synchronous testicular seminoma (clinical stage IIIB, with lung and para-aortic metastases) and adrenocortical carcinoma. Carboplatin achieved a complete response, but a left adrenal tumor appeared 12 months later and progressed despite bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin. Laparoscopic adrenalectomy revealed adrenocortical carcinoma, and the patient remained recurrence-free for 42 months. The case highlights the need to consider a second primary tumor when a new lesion appears during germ cell tumor follow-up.

title: cAMP stimulates the bystander effect in suicide gene therapy of human choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: cAMPは絨毛癌の自殺遺伝子治療におけるバイスタンダー効果を増強する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoにHSV-tkを導入し、ガンシクロビルによる自殺遺伝子治療でのバイスタンダー効果を検討した。HSV-tk陽性細胞が10%を超えると陰性細胞も殺傷された。8-ブロモ-cAMPはバイスタンダー効果を増強し、connexin40発現とギャップ結合を増加させた。絨毛癌に対する遺伝子治療の効果向上に寄与する可能性が示された。
summary_en: The BeWo human choriocarcinoma cell line, transfected with HSV-tk, was tested for ganciclovir sensitivity and the bystander effect in suicide gene therapy. Bystander killing of HSV-tk-negative cells occurred when HSV-tk-positive cells made up more than 10% of the population. 8-bromo-cAMP enhanced the bystander effect and increased connexin40 expression and gap junctional communication, suggesting cAMP could improve the efficacy of this approach for choriocarcinoma.

title: Thoracic metastasectomy for germ cell tumours: long term survival and prognostic factors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する胸部転移巣切除術：長期生存と予後因子
summary_ja: ロイヤル・ブロンプトン病院で胸部転移を切除された胚細胞腫瘍141例を後方視的に解析し、長期生存と予後因子を検討した。5年全生存率は77%、15年は65%であった。悪性奇形腫成分と不完全切除は予後不良因子であり、前者は再発リスクも高めた。胸部転移巣切除は病理学的反応の評価に有用で、化学療法抵抗性疾患の根治にも寄与するとされた。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 141 patients who underwent thoracic metastasectomy for germ cell tumours at Royal Brompton Hospital evaluated long-term survival and prognostic factors. Complete resection was achieved in 87%. Overall survival was 77% at five years and 65% at fifteen years. Malignant teratomatous elements and incomplete resection were independently associated with poorer survival, and malignant teratomatous elements also increased relapse risk. The authors conclude that thoracic metastasectomy helps assess pathological response and can achieve permanent cure in chemoresistant disease.

title: A parallel association between differentiation and induction of galectin-1, and inhibition of galectin-3 by retinoic acid in mouse embryonal carcinoma F9 cells.
title_ja: レチノイン酸によるマウス胎児性癌細胞F9の分化とガレクチン-1の誘導およびガレクチン-3の抑制の並行的関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9とレチノイン酸抵抗性変異株RA-3-10を用い、レチノイン酸による分化とガレクチンの発現調節を検討した基礎研究である。野生型ではレチノイン酸により内胚葉分化とガレクチン-1の誘導、ガレクチン-3の抑制が並行して生じた。変異株ではこれらの応答は見られなかった。ガレクチン-1は少なくとも部分的に転写レベルで制御される。
summary_en: This basic study examined how all-trans retinoic acid regulates galectin expression during differentiation of the murine embryonal carcinoma line F9 and its retinoic acid-resistant mutant RA-3-10. In wild-type cells, retinoic acid induced endodermal differentiation with concurrent galectin-1 and laminin/LAMP induction, while inhibiting galectin-3. The mutant showed none of these responses. Galectin-1 is regulated at least partly at the transcriptional level. The findings suggest that galectin expression is linked to retinoic acid-induced differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells.

title: Systemic mast cell disease associated with primary ovarian mixed malignant germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 原発性卵巣混合性悪性胚細胞腫瘍に伴う全身性肥満細胞症
summary_ja: 卵巣原発の混合性悪性胚細胞腫瘍を有する12歳女児が、手術と化学療法を受けた。化学療法の約3か月後に全身性肥満細胞症を発症した。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に血液悪性腫瘍が伴うことは報告されていたが、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と全身性肥満細胞症の関連は初の報告である。稀な組み合わせを記載した単一症例報告である。
summary_en: A 12-year-old girl with a primary ovarian mixed malignant germ cell tumor was treated with surgery and chemotherapy. About three months after chemotherapy she developed systemic mast cell disease. The authors note that hematologic malignancies have previously been reported with mediastinal germ cell tumors, but this is the first report linking a primary ovarian germ cell neoplasm with systemic mast cell disease. This single case report describes a rare association.

title: Teratoma of the liver--a case report.
title_ja: 肝臓の奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 生後10か月の男児に発生した原発性肝奇形腫の症例報告である。肝臓は性腺外の稀な発生部位であり、報告の価値はその希少性にある。インドの文献で初めての症例とされる。組織学的所見、治療、転帰は抄録に記載がない。
summary_en: This case report describes a 10-month-old male infant with a primary teratoma of the liver, a rare extragonadal site. The authors present it as the first case reported in Indian literature. The abstract gives no details on histology, treatment, or outcome. The report is presented mainly because of the rarity of the lesion.

title: [A case of thoracic extradural spinal cord teratoma with neurological sequelae more than 10 years after surgery].
title_ja: 術後10年以上で神経症状を呈した胸部硬膜外脊髄奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 縦隔後部奇形腫の手術から10年以上経過して、左ブラウン・セカール症候群を呈した42歳男性の症例である。MRIで胸髄Th9レベルの硬膜外腫瘍を認め、手術で椎間孔を通って進展した被包性のダンベル型腫瘍が切除された。組織像は縦隔腫瘍とほぼ一致し、残存した縦隔病変から10年以上かけて発生したと考えられた。縦隔奇形腫の長期的な局所進展を示す症例である。
summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with left Brown-Séquard syndrome more than ten years after surgery for a posterior mediastinal teratoma that contained adenocarcinoma. MRI revealed an extradural spinal tumor at Th9 that compressed the cord, and surgery found a well-encapsulated dumbbell tumor extending through the intervertebral foramen. Histology closely matched the original mediastinal tumor, indicating development from residual mediastinal disease over more than a decade. The case highlights long-term local progression of a mediastinal teratoma.

title: Germ-cell tumors of the mediastinum.
title_ja: 縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の多数症例の経験をまとめ、最近の知見を概説した論文である。従来は症例報告や小規模症例が中心で、命名法や病期分類が確立していなかった。奇形腫性病変に悪性成分が伴う頻度や、性腺腫瘍との分布・組織像・挙動の比較を検討している。
summary_en: This article summarizes the authors' experience with a large series of primary mediastinal germ cell tumors and reviews recent concepts. It notes that earlier reports were mostly case reports and small series, and that mediastinal tumors lacked standardized nomenclature and a clinical staging scheme. The authors examine how often teratomatous lesions carry malignant components in the mediastinum, and compare mediastinal tumors with gonadal counterparts in distribution, histology, and behavior.

title: Experience with vascular control before excision of giant, highly vascular sacrococcygeal teratomas in neonates.
title_ja: 新生児における巨大な高血管性仙尾部奇形腫の切除前の血管コントロール
summary_ja: 巨大で高血管性の仙尾部奇形腫を有する新生児3例に対し、切除前に開腹して大動脈と腫瘍動脈血流を事前に制御した。全例で血行動態は安定し、腫瘍は完全切除された。術後8.5〜18か月で再発なく生存している。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は切除後に正常化し、経過中も正常範囲を保った。
summary_en: Three neonates with giant, highly vascular sacrococcygeal teratomas underwent laparotomy with preliminary control of the aorta and tumor arterial supply before resection. Hemodynamic stability was maintained and all tumors were resected. All three were alive without recurrence 8.5 to 18 months after surgery. AFP normalized after resection and stayed normal during follow-up. The authors conclude that preoperative vascular control is safe, reduces intraoperative blood loss, and lowers postoperative morbidity in these infants.

title: Transforming growth factor-beta expression in human testicular neoplasms.
title_ja: ヒト精巣腫瘍におけるトランスフォーミング増殖因子β（TGF-β）の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍26例を対象に、TGF-βアイソフォームとその受容体の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。発現は腫瘍部で隣接する非腫瘍性精巣より高かった。組織型により分布が異なり、セミノーマではびまん性、未熟奇形腫では限局性に染色された。奇形腫内では分化した構造に多くのTGF-βが認められた。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examines expression of TGF-β1, -β2, -β3 and their receptors TGF-βRI and RII in 26 human testicular tumors, including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, immature teratomas, and mixed forms, plus two Leydig cell tumors. Expression was generally higher in tumor tissue than in adjacent nonneoplastic testis. The pattern varied by histologic type: seminomas showed diffuse TGF-β immunoreactivity, whereas immature teratomas showed focal, patchy staining. Within teratomas, differentiated structures contained more TGF-β than undifferentiated ones.

title: Successful treatment of a bulky seminoma in an abdominal undescended testis: a case report.
title_ja: 腹腔内停留精巣に生じた巨大セミノーマの治療成功例：症例報告
summary_ja: 未矯正の腹腔内停留精巣に生じた40歳男性の巨大セミノーマの症例報告である。超音波ガイド下生検と腫瘍マーカーにより診断され、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる化学療法の後、残存腫瘍を外科的切除した。停留精巣は精巣悪性腫瘍の主要な危険因子であり、希少な病態の診断と治療を考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old man with a bulky seminoma arising in an uncorrected abdominal undescended testis. Diagnosis was established by sonoguided biopsy and tumor marker studies. He received initial cisplatin and etoposide combination chemotherapy, followed by surgical resection of the residual tumor. The authors discuss the optimal diagnosis and management of this rare presentation. Undescended testis is a recognized major risk factor for testicular malignancy, making this case relevant to testicular germ cell tumor management.

title: Development of primary leiomyosarcoma of the sternum postirradiation: report of a case.
title_ja: 縦隔セミノーマに対する放射線療法後に生じた胸骨原発平滑筋肉腫の1例：症例報告
summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマに対する正中切開術と50Gyの放射線療法の11年後に、胸骨原発の平滑筋肉腫を発症した30歳男性の症例報告である。化学療法2コースで腫瘍は約90%縮小し、胸壁構造とともに切除された。術後に追加の化学療法を行い、45か月間再発は認められていない。胚細胞腫瘍治療後の晩期の治療関連二次癌として関連性がある。
summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man who developed a primary leiomyosarcoma of the sternum 11 years after median sternotomy and 50 Gy radiotherapy for mediastinal seminoma. Two courses of chemotherapy produced about 90% tumor regression, after which the tumor was resected with adjacent chest wall structures. Reconstruction used a methylmethacrylate prosthesis prepared preoperatively. Two further chemotherapy courses followed, and the patient had no recurrence for 45 months. The report is relevant as a late, treatment-related second malignancy after germ cell tumor therapy.

title: Testicular teratoma with a unique mode of spread and spontaneous maturation.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫の特異な進展様式と自然成熟
summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫が通常とは異なる経路で進展し、乳糜腹水を伴った症例の報告である。乳糜腹水は後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の稀な合併症として知られており、精巣がんの進展経路として報告されたのは本論文が初めてとされる。転移部位で奇形腫が自然に成熟した可能性も示唆されている。抄録は短く、治療経過の詳細は限られる。
summary_en: This report describes a testicular teratoma with an unusual pattern of spread, in which chylous ascites appeared. Chylous ascites is a rare complication after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, and the authors state that it has not previously been reported as a means of spread of testicular cancer. The tumor also appears to spontaneously mature at the metastatic site. The abstract is brief, so details of treatment and follow-up are limited.

title: Pulmonary metastasectomy for testicular germ cell tumors: a 28-year experience.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する肺転移切除術：28年間の経験
summary_ja: 1967年から1995年の間に精巣胚細胞腫瘍で肺転移を疑われ切除を受けた157例の28年間の経験をまとめた研究である。完全切除は99%で達成され、44%で生存癌が認められた。5年生存率は全体で68%、1985年以降の診断例では82%であった。肺以外の内臓転移と切除標本内の生存癌が予後不良因子であった。
summary_en: This 28-year single-institution review examines pulmonary metastasectomy in 157 men with testicular germ cell tumors who underwent resection of suspected lung metastases between 1967 and 1995. Complete resection was achieved in 99%, and viable carcinoma was found in 44%. Five-year survival after resection was 68% overall and 82% for patients diagnosed after 1985. Adverse prognostic factors were nonpulmonary visceral metastases and viable carcinoma in the resected specimen. With current chemotherapy regimens, about 85% of patients undergoing complete resection may achieve long-term survival.

title: Natural interferon enhances expression of placental alkaline phosphatase in human seminoma xenograft.
title_ja: 天然インターフェロンはヒトセミノーマ異種移植片におけるPLAP発現を増強する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 重症複合免疫不全（SCID）マウスに移植したヒトセミノーマ異種移植片において、天然インターフェロン（IFN）がPLAP発現を増加させるかを検討した研究です。IFN投与により、異種移植片のPLAP量は有意に増加しました。さらに、放射標識抗PLAPモノクローナル抗体の保持も増強され、セミノーマの検出効率を高める可能性が示唆されました。
summary_en: This study examined whether natural interferon (IFN) increases placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) expression in human seminoma xenografts grown in severe combined immunodeficient mice. IFN administration significantly raised PLAP levels in the xenografts. Retention of a radiolabeled anti-PLAP monoclonal antibody was also enhanced after IFN treatment, suggesting that IFN may improve antibody-based detection of seminoma. The authors conclude that IFN has some effect on the efficacy of this antibody for seminoma detection.

title: Different concentrations of two small stress proteins, alphaB crystallin and HSP27 in human urological tumor tissues.
title_ja: ヒト泌尿生殖器系の正常組織および腫瘍におけるαBクリスタリンとHSP27の濃度
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常の泌尿生殖器組織および各種泌尿器腫瘍における小型ストレスタンパク質αBクリスタリンとHSP27の濃度を定量した研究です。精巣腫瘍（セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ）では、αBクリスタリン濃度が正常精巣より有意に低値でした。腎細胞癌ではHSP27が正常腎より高値を示しました。複数の腫瘍を比較した研究であり、胚細胞腫瘍はその一部を占めます。
summary_en: This study quantified the small stress proteins alphaB crystallin and HSP27 in normal genitourinary tissues and their tumors. HSP27 was significantly higher in renal cell carcinoma than in normal kidney, and alphaB crystallin was higher in prostatic carcinoma than in benign hyperplasia. Notably, alphaB crystallin levels in testicular tumors, including seminomas and non-seminomas, were significantly lower than in normal testis. Both proteins were localized immunohistochemically in normal kidney and renal cell carcinoma.

title: Laparoscopy for ovarian pathology in infancy and childhood.
title_ja: 小児の卵巣病変に対する腹腔鏡手術
summary_ja: 生後4か月から11歳の女児8例に対し、卵巣病変の腹腔鏡手術を行った経験を報告しています。緊急手術では捻転した付属器病変（良性嚢胞性奇形腫を含む）、待機手術では卵巣嚢腫や成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の切除が行われました。合併症はなく、平均手術時間は76分、平均在院日数は2.25日でした。小児の卵巣病変に対する腹腔鏡手術は、安全で有効な方法とされています。
summary_en: This study reports laparoscopic management of ovarian pathology in eight girls aged 4 months to 11 years. Four children underwent emergency surgery for twisted adnexal lesions, including a benign cystic teratoma, and four had elective excision of ovarian cysts or mature cystic teratomas. No operative complications occurred, with a mean operative time of 76 minutes and a mean hospital stay of 2.25 days. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is an effective and safe method for diagnosis and definitive treatment of ovarian lesions in infancy and childhood.

title: Teratoma of the tongue in neonates: report of a case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 新生児の舌奇形腫：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 経口的に突出する巨大な腫瘤を有した女児新生児の症例です。腫瘤は舌から発生し、出生日に完全摘出されました。病理学的に成熟奇形腫と診断されました。その後、上咽頭壁に付着した1cm大の成熟奇形腫も生後20日に摘出されました。2年間のフォローアップで再発はなく、文献的考察も加えられています。
summary_en: This report describes a female newborn with a large mass protruding from the mouth, arising from the tongue and completely excised on the day of birth. Histology showed mature teratoma. A second 1 cm mass attached to the upper pharyngeal wall was also mature teratoma and was removed 20 days after birth. The infant had a complete cleft palate but no other malformations, and there was no recurrence at two-year follow-up. The paper also reviews the literature on this condition.

title: Mediastinal teratoma in a neonate.
title_ja: 新生児の縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 重度の呼吸窮迫を呈した新生児の良性縦隔奇形腫の症例です。腫瘍は早期に容易に切除されましたが、心機能不全のため児は死亡しました。新生児の縦隔奇形腫は文献上10例のみと報告されています。胎内での肺の発育障害は知られていましたが、心臓の発育不良による出生後の心筋機能障害が記録されたのは初めてと述べています。
summary_en: The authors report a neonate with severe respiratory distress caused by a benign mediastinal teratoma. Although the tumor was excised early and easily, the infant died from poor cardiac function. The authors note that only ten neonatal mediastinal teratomas had been reported in the literature. While the tumor is known to interfere with lung development in utero, this report is the first to document postnatal myocardial dysfunction attributed to poor heart development.

title: Neonatal benign sacrococcygeal teratoma with N-type rectobulbar fistula.
title_ja: 新生児の良性仙尾部奇形腫に合併したN型直腸球部瘻
summary_ja: 新生児に発生した良性仙尾部奇形腫と、N型直腸球部瘻の合併を示した症例報告である。仙尾部奇形腫は新生児に最も多い卵巣外の胚細胞腫瘍であり、本症例のような瘻孔の合併は稀である。抄録では手術方法や転帰の詳細は示されていないが、先天性仙尾部腫瘤の管理を行う小児外科医にとって参考となる症例である。
summary_en: This report describes a neonate with a benign sacrococcygeal teratoma associated with an N-type rectobulbar fistula, a rare combination. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is the most common extragonadal germ cell tumor in neonates, and its coexistence with a rectobulbar fistula is unusual. The authors present this unique case to document the clinical features of this association. The abstract is brief and does not detail the surgical approach, imaging, or outcome. Given its rarity, the case is of interest to pediatric surgeons and clinicians managing congenital sacrococcygeal masses in newborns.

title: Hypothyroldism in a neonate following excision of a cervical teratoma.
title_ja: 頸部奇形腫切除後に新生児で発症した甲状腺機能低下症
summary_ja: 大きな頸部奇形腫の切除後に、新生児が甲状腺機能低下症を発症した症例を報告している。頸部奇形腫は甲状腺組織に由来することが多く、切除時に残存甲状腺が確認できない場合は甲状腺機能検査を全例で行うことを推奨している。治療経過や低下症の持続期間は抄録に記載がない。頸部奇形腫の切除後管理に関わる医療者にとって実践的な知見である。
summary_en: This report describes a neonate who developed hypothyroidism after surgical excision of a large cervical teratoma. The authors note that cervical teratomas commonly originate from thyroid tissue, which may explain the endocrine complication. They recommend routine thyroid function testing in all patients when no identifiable residual thyroid tissue is seen at the end of surgery, as postoperative hypothyroidism may otherwise go unrecognized. The abstract does not provide the patient's detailed course, treatment, or duration of hypothyroidism. The message is clinically practical for surgeons and neonatologists caring for children after neck teratoma resection.

title: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone-induced elevation of serum hCG in choriocarcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 絨毛癌におけるGnRH投与による血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の上昇：症例報告
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の計5例で、GnRH 投与による血清 hCG の反応性を検討した。陽性を示した絨毛癌の1例では、8コースの化学療法後も hCG は正常範囲でも GnRH 試験が陽性で、残存する生細胞の存在が示唆された。試験が陰性化した後に完全寛解に至った。治療前の GnRH 試験は、寛解判定と化学療法中止時期の判断に有用となりうると提案している。症例数が少ない点に留意が必要である。
summary_en: This study examined whether gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) stimulation can elevate serum hCG in gestational trophoblastic disease, using five patients with hydatidiform mole or choriocarcinoma. Only one choriocarcinoma patient showed a positive GnRH test, and her hCG normalized after eight cycles of chemotherapy while the test remained positive, suggesting persistent viable cells. After the test became negative, complete remission was achieved. The authors suggest a pretreatment GnRH test may identify patients in whom repeated testing can help determine remission and the timing to stop chemotherapy. The small sample limits generalizability.

title: In utero diagnosis of intrapericardial teratoma: a case for in utero open fetal surgery.
title_ja: 心膜内奇形腫の子宮内診断：子宮内開腹胎児手術の適応を示す症例
summary_ja: 妊娠26週に超音波検査で診断された心膜内奇形腫の症例である。腫瘍は急速に進行して胎児水腫を来し、予定していた子宮内開腹胎児手術の前日に胎内で死亡した。著者らは、このような腫瘍では子宮内手術が介入の選択肢となりうると主張している。組織学的所見や手術計画の詳細は抄録に記載されていない。出生前に診断された奇形腫の管理の難しさを示す症例である。
summary_en: This case report describes an intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed in utero by ultrasound at 26 weeks of gestation. The tumor presented as a large mass and rapidly led to hydrops fetalis. The fetus died in utero one day before scheduled open fetal surgery. The authors use this case to argue for in utero open fetal surgery as a potential intervention when such a tumor is detected early. The abstract emphasizes the rapid progression and the timing relative to planned surgery, but does not report histology or details of the surgical plan. The case highlights the challenges of managing prenatally identified teratomas.

title: Unexpected death due to gestational choriocarcinoma: a report of two cases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌による予期せぬ死亡：2例の症例報告
summary_ja: 転移性の妊娠性絨毛癌が原因で予期せず死亡した2症例を報告し、文献的考察を加えている。異所性妊娠や人工妊娠中絶後の医学的フォローアップの重要性を強調している。法医病理学の立場から、臨床医や病理医への注意喚起を目的とした報告である。患者の年齢や治療歴、転移部位の詳細は抄録には記載がない。
summary_en: This report describes two unexpected deaths caused by metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma, along with a review of the literature on these neoplasms. Both patients died suddenly, which highlights the danger of unrecognized disease. The authors emphasize that medical follow-up after an ectopic pregnancy or therapeutic abortion is extremely important, since gestational choriocarcinoma can progress to fatal metastases without warning. The case series is written from a forensic pathology perspective and aims to alert clinicians and pathologists. The abstract does not give patient ages, treatment histories, or metastatic sites in detail.

title: Elevated serum inhibin and tumor-associated trypsin inhibitor concentrations in a young woman with dysgerminoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の若年女性で血清インヒビンおよびTATIが上昇した症例
summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の若年女性で、病勢の進行に伴い血清インヒビン、腫瘍関連トリプシンインヒビン(TATI)、CA 125 が上昇した症例である。インヒビンの値は病勢と密接に相関した。一方、TATI と CA 125 は潜在性の病変を検出できなかった。ディスジャーミノーマのフォローアップでは、インヒビンが有用な腫瘍マーカーとなりうることを示唆している。症例は1例のみであり、一般化には限界がある。
summary_en: This report describes a young woman with ovarian dysgerminoma whose serum inhibin, tumor-associated trypsin inhibitor (TATI), and CA 125 rose progressively as the disease advanced. Inhibin levels closely tracked disease behavior, making it a useful marker during follow-up. In contrast, TATI and CA 125 did not detect silent disease, meaning they failed to reveal occult tumor activity. The findings suggest inhibin may be more reliable than TATI and CA 125 for monitoring dysgerminoma. The abstract is limited to a single patient, so generalizability is restricted. The paper is relevant to clinicians managing ovarian germ cell tumors and their marker follow-up.

title: [Treatment outcome on 52 patients with 53 testicular germ cell tumors].
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍52例53腫瘍の治療成績
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍52例53腫瘍の治療成績を解析した臨床研究。セミノーマ34例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍19例を含む。胎児性癌と脈管侵襲を有する臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では再発が多く、病期II・IIIにはVAB-6化学療法が行われた。平均61カ月の観察で、全セミノーマ患者と19例中18例が無病生存した。
summary_en: This clinical series covers 53 testicular germ cell tumors in 52 patients treated at Toranomon Hospital, including 34 seminomas and 19 non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. All underwent high ligation orchiectomy. Most stage I seminomas were managed with surveillance, while half of stage I NSGCTs containing embryonal carcinoma with vascular invasion relapsed. Stage II and III patients received VAB-6 chemotherapy, with salvage therapy rescuing partial responders. At a mean follow-up of 61 months, all seminoma patients and 18 of 19 NSGCT patients were alive without disease.

title: Unilateral laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対する単側腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の6例に対し、単側腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った報告。出血はわずかで輸血は不要だった。病理学的に2例に胎児性癌の微小転移がみられ、補助化学療法を受けた。平均27.1カ月の観察で再発はなく、実施可能で有効と評価された。
summary_en: This report describes unilateral laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (LRPLND) in six patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who had undergone radical orchiectomy. Mean operative time was 325 minutes, with minimal blood loss and no transfusions. Mean hospital stay was 4.8 days in five patients, while one patient stayed 18 days due to subcutaneous emphysema. Pathology showed microscopic embryonal carcinoma metastases in two patients, who received adjuvant chemotherapy. With a mean follow-up of 27.1 months, no relapses occurred. The authors judge LRPLND feasible and effective but call for larger studies with long-term follow-up.

title: Intrapulmonary teratoma: a report of three cases.
title_ja: 肺内奇形腫の3症例報告
summary_ja: 肺内奇形腫の3例の報告。2例は喀毛、1例は反復性喀血で発症し、全例で患側肺葉切除が行われた。病理では気管支と連続する嚢胞部と、三胚葉由来の組織を含む充実部が認められた。性腺外に生じた胚細胞腫瘍の症例である。
summary_en: This report describes three patients with intrapulmonary teratoma, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. Two presented with trichoptysis, the expectoration of hair, and one with recurrent hemoptysis. All were treated with lobectomy of the affected lung. Pathology showed a cystic portion connected to the bronchial system, containing sebaceous material and hair, and a solid portion with tissues from all three germ cell layers. The pathologic findings correlated well with the clinical symptoms and radiologic findings.

title: Malignant ovarian germ cell tumours: experience in the National University Hospital of Singapore.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍13例の経験：シンガポール国立大学病院
summary_ja: シンガポール国立大学病院における悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍13例の検討。未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ、混合型胚細胞腫瘍を含む。病期I・IIの全例が無病生存し、病期IIICのうち最適な腫瘍減量術を受けた2例は長期無病であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の低下が予後因子として重要であった。
summary_en: This series reports 13 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors at the National University Hospital of Singapore: 5 immature teratomas, 3 endodermal sinus tumors, 1 dysgerminoma and 4 mixed germ cell tumors. Most had stage I disease (61%). Ten patients received adjuvant chemotherapy, mainly bleomycin/etoposide/cisplatin. All patients with stage I and II disease were alive and disease-free. Of four with stage IIIC, two undergoing optimal debulking remained disease-free, while two with bulky residual disease had poor outcomes. Regression of alpha-fetoprotein was of prognostic significance in endodermal sinus tumors.

title: Optimal treatment in gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における最適な治療
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の最適な治療を論じた総説。良性の胞状奇胎は子宮内容除去術や子宮摘出術で治療し、悪性例では化学療法が中心となる。低リスク群の治癒率はほぼ100%、高リスク群は80〜85%とされる。正確な診断、予後スコアによるリスク評価、専門施設での治療が重要である。
summary_en: This review addresses optimal management of gestational trophoblastic disease, which ranges from benign hydatidiform mole to malignant choriocarcinoma. It emphasizes accurate diagnosis, risk assessment with prognostic scoring systems, and treatment at specialized centers given the disease's rarity. Benign moles are managed by evacuation or hysterectomy. For malignant disease, chemotherapy is the treatment of choice: single agents for non-metastatic and low-risk metastatic disease, and combination chemotherapy for high-risk metastatic disease. Judicious use of surgery and radiotherapy may improve survival, with cure rates near 100% in the low-risk group and 80 to 85% in the high-risk group.

title: Struma ovarii: appearance on MR images.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫のMR画像所見
summary_ja: 多施設後方視的研究で、組織学的に確定した卵巣甲状腺腫12例のMR画像を検討した。全例で嚢胞成分と充実成分があり、多房性で表面は多葉状、隔壁は肥厚していた。T2強調像では主に高信号、T1強調像の信号は多様であった。粘稠なゼラチン様物質がT1で低信号、T2で無信号〜低信号を示した。
summary_en: This multi-institutional retrospective study reviewed MR images of 12 patients with histologically proven struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma composed mainly of thyroid tissue. All lesions had both cystic and solid components, with multilobulated surfaces and thickened septa. T2-weighted images were mostly high signal, and T1 signals varied. Contrast enhancement of solid components was marked or moderate. Viscid gelatinous material produced low T1 and low or void T2 signal. The authors propose that a multicystic tumor with a solid component, multilobulated surface, and these signal features is characteristic of struma ovarii.

title: Sacrococcygeal germ-cell tumours--the Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital experience, 1980-1996.
title_ja: 仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍：Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospitalにおける1980～1996年の経験
summary_ja: 南アフリカのRed Cross War Memorial Children's Hospitalで1980～1996年に治療された仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍27例の後方視的検討。新生児期発症が多く、奇形腫は完全切除のみで治癒した。1歳以降の診断例は悪性が多く、再発例も再手術と化学療法で救済された。完全切除の重要性が示された。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 27 children treated at the Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital in South Africa from 1980 to 1996 examines sacrococcygeal germ cell tumours. Most patients presented in the neonatal period, and all mature or immature teratomas were cured with complete surgical resection alone. Malignant tumours were more frequent in children diagnosed after age one. Relapses, including yolk sac tumour recurrence after resection of a mature teratoma, were salvaged with repeat surgery and chemotherapy. The authors stress the value of complete resection.

title: Chylopericardium of neoplastic aetiology.
title_ja: 腫瘍性病因による乳び心膜
summary_ja: 縦隔浸潤を伴うディスジャーミノーマの30歳男性が、治療中に孤立性乳び心膜を発症した症例報告。乳び心膜の病因・診断・新たな治療法を文献的に概観している。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に伴う稀な合併症として認識すべきことを示している。
summary_en: A 30-year-old man with dysgerminoma involving the mediastinum developed an isolated chylopericardium during treatment. The report combines a case presentation with a review of the etiology, diagnosis, and emerging treatment approaches for chylopericardium. Neoplastic causes, such as mediastinal germ cell tumours, should be considered when chylopericardium occurs. The paper is brief and focuses on recognizing this rare complication rather than reporting outcome data. It is relevant to clinicians managing mediastinal germ cell tumours.

title: Mediastinal germ cell tumor complicated by visceral hemangiomatosis.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に合併した内臓血管腫症
summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の17歳男児で、化学療法後に脾臓の多発結節が転移と疑われたが、切除標本では海綿状血管腫だった。患者は19か月後に胚細胞腫瘍の再発で死亡し、剖検で肺と肝臓にも同様の血管腫が認められた。極めて稀な合併例であり、転移の画像診断で注意すべき点を示している。
summary_en: A 17-year-old boy with mediastinal germ cell tumour developed multiple splenic nodules three weeks after chemotherapy, initially suspected to be metastases. Resection showed cavernous hemangiomas instead. He died of germ cell tumour recurrence 19 months after initial treatment, and autopsy revealed similar hemangiomas in the lung and liver. This extremely rare coexistence can complicate imaging interpretation of metastatic disease in germ cell tumour patients.

title: Maternal health and pre- and perinatal characteristics in the etiology of testicular cancer: a prospective population- and register-based study on Norwegian males born between 1967 and 1995.
title_ja: 精巣がんの病因における母体の健康状態と出生前・周産期要因：ノルウェーで1967～1995年に出生した男性を対象とした前向き住民・登録ベース研究
summary_ja: ノルウェーで1967～1995年に出生した約87万人の男性を対象に、精巣がんの出生前・周産期の危険因子を検討した。新生児黄疸は非セミノーマのリスク上昇と関連し、妊娠前の母体疾患は特に5歳未満で関連が強かった。胎盤遺残はセミノーマと非セミノーマの両方と関連した。胎児期の免疫反応などの関与が示唆されている。
summary_en: This prospective register-based study of 868,068 Norwegian males born 1967 to 1995 examined pre- and perinatal risk factors for testicular cancer. Neonatal jaundice was linked to non-seminoma risk, and maternal disease before pregnancy was associated with testicular cancer, especially in children under 5. Retained placenta was associated with both seminoma and non-seminoma. Lower parity showed an inverse trend. The authors suggest fetal immune reactions and estrogen exposure may contribute to development.

title: Treatment of stage I seminoma: should beta-HCG positive seminoma be treated aggressively?
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの治療：β-hCG陽性のセミノーマは積極的に治療すべきか？
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍122例の後方視的検討で、病期Iセミノーマの精巣摘除前β-hCG上昇の予後的意義を評価した。β-hCG陽性は局所進行との有意な関連がなかった。再発は1例のみで、その患者のβ-hCGは正常だった。少数例の検討だが、β-hCG陽性例には横隔膜下放射線療法が有用かもしれないと示唆された。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 122 patients with testicular germ cell tumour assessed whether preorchiectomy β-hCG elevation in stage I seminoma affects prognosis. Among 55 stage I seminoma patients, 29 of 54 tested had elevated β-hCG, with no significant association with locally progressive cancer. Treatment was radiotherapy for β-hCG-negative cases and chemotherapy or radiotherapy for positive cases. One recurrence occurred in a patient with normal β-hCG. The authors suggest infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy may suit β-hCG-positive cases, though the series is small.

title: [Perinatal and perianesthetic management of the sacrococcygeal teratoma in a neonate].
title_ja: 新生児仙尾部奇形腫の周産期および麻酔管理
summary_ja: 新生児仙尾部奇形腫の女児に対する周産期および麻酔管理の症例報告。妊娠34週に尿路閉塞解除のため胎児膀胱穿刺を行ったが、出生後に尿の腹腔内漏出による腹水が生じた。生後2日目の腫瘍摘出は合併症なく完遂された。大量出血、凝固障害、動静脈瘻による高拍出性心不全などの術前リスク評価の重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: This case report from Japan describes perinatal and anesthetic management of a female neonate with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Fetal bladder puncture was performed at 34 weeks to relieve urinary obstruction, but urine leakage caused postnatal ascites. After cesarean delivery, tumour resection was done on day 2 without complications. The authors emphasize preoperative assessment of risks, including exsanguinating hemorrhage, coagulopathy, and high-output heart failure from arteriovenous fistulae.

title: [Successful management for chemorefractory testicular cancer with brain and lung metastases. A case report].
title_ja: 脳転移および肺転移を伴う化学療法抵抗性精巣がんの救済的治療：症例報告
summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性の精巣がんで、脳と肺に転移した29歳男性の症例報告。肺転移の楔状切除では胎児性癌が確認された。全脳照射とVIP化学療法で腫瘍は縮小しhCG値も正常化し、脳病変の救済手術では壊死が確認された。治療終了後24か月間再発はなく、難治例に対する救済療法の有効性を示した。
summary_en: A 29-year-old man with chemorefractory testicular cancer and a solitary brain metastasis plus lung metastases achieved long-term remission after multimodal therapy. Wedge resection of lung metastases showed embryonal carcinoma. Whole brain irradiation with VIP chemotherapy produced tumour regression and normalized hCG. Salvage surgery of the brain lesion showed necrosis. The patient remained free of recurrence 24 months after completing treatment, illustrating a salvage strategy for advanced refractory disease.

title: Establishing germ cell origin of undifferentiated tumors by identifying gain of 12p material using comparative genomic hybridization analysis of paraffin-embedded samples.
title_ja: パラフィン包埋標本の比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション解析により12p領域の増加を同定し、未分化腫瘍の胚細胞起源を確立する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 未分化腫瘍の胚細胞起源を判定するため、パラフィン包埋検体で12p増加を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法により検出した予備的研究。既知の精巣GCT 3例と、組織発生不明の7例を解析した。3例で12p増加がみられ、臨床経過とおおむね一致した。12p増加がないことは胚細胞腫瘍を否定しないが、診断への有用性が示された。
summary_en: This preliminary study used comparative genomic hybridization on paraffin-embedded samples to detect 12p gain, a marker of testicular germ cell tumour origin. Frozen and paraffin specimens from three known testicular GCTs were compared, and seven undifferentiated tumours of uncertain histogenesis were then analyzed. Three showed 12p gain, suggesting germ cell origin, and their clinical course broadly matched. Absence of 12p gain does not exclude GCT. The approach may aid diagnosis in patients with undifferentiated carcinoma.

title: Over 20 Years of Progress in Radiation Oncology: Seminoma.
title_ja: 過去20年間の放射線腫瘍学の進歩:セミノーマ
summary_ja: セミノーマの放射線治療に関する過去20年の進歩をまとめた総説です。治癒率は約97%に達し、照射線量と照射範囲が縮小されました。病期Iでは監視療法が選択肢となり、進行例ではブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法が標準となりました。
summary_en: This review traces 20 years of advances in seminoma radiation oncology. Cure rates reached about 97%, with reduced radiation doses and volumes, adoption of serum tumor markers and CT or MRI staging, and surveillance as an option for stage I disease. Chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin became standard for advanced disease, while prophylactic mediastinal irradiation was abandoned. Remaining controversies include stage IIC management and inguinal-scrotal irradiation.

title: Multiple dermoid cysts of omentum.
title_ja: 網嚢ではなく大網の多発性類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 50歳女性にみられた大網の多発性類皮嚢腫の症例報告です。きわめてまれな腹腔内病変で、病因、臨床像、関連文献を簡潔に概説しています。成熟奇形腫の一型として扱われ、胚細胞腫瘍の範囲に含まれます。症例報告の形式で、詳細は限られています。
summary_en: The authors describe a 50-year-old woman with multiple dermoid cysts of the omentum, an extremely rare extragonadal lesion. They briefly review its aetiopathogenesis, clinical presentation, and relevant literature. Omental dermoid cysts are generally regarded as mature teratomas, so the report falls within extragonadal germ cell tumor scope. The article is a short case report with limited detail.

title: Immature gastric teratoma.
title_ja: 未熟性胃奇形腫
summary_ja: 乳児に発生した稀な未熟性胃奇形腫の症例報告。胃奇形腫は乳児期にみられる極めて稀な腫瘍で、通常は良性とされる。既報66例中、未熟な胚様成分を認めたのは3例のみであり、本症例はその少ない報告に加わる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の組織学的特徴を検討する上で意義がある。
summary_en: This report describes a rare immature gastric teratoma in an infant. Gastric teratoma is an extremely uncommon tumor of infancy that is usually benign. Immature embryonic elements have been reported in only three of 66 previously described cases. The authors present one such immature gastric teratoma, adding to the limited literature on this extragonadal germ cell tumor and its histological features.

title: Hypertension and nephritic urine sediment following retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の高血圧と腎炎性尿沈渣
summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療から11年後に、高血圧と腎炎性尿沈渣を発症した30歳男性の症例。後腹膜リンパ節郭清の際に左腎静脈が損傷され修復された。左単純腎摘除術後に症状は改善し、遅発性の腎血管合併症と考察されている。
summary_en: A 30-year-old man developed hypertension and nephritic urine sediment eleven years after treatment of a left testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy had required cisplatin-based chemotherapy, followed by surgical resection of a residual mass. During perihilar dissection, the left renal vein was injured and repaired. Hypertension and sediment resolved after left simple nephrectomy. The authors attribute this late complication to renal artery injury.

title: Choriocarcinoma coexistent with intrauterine pregnancy: two additional cases and a review of the literature.
title_ja: 正常子宮内妊娠に合併した絨毛癌：2症例の追加報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 正常な子宮内妊娠に合併した絨毛癌の2症例を報告し、文献をレビューした論文。起源として既往妊娠の絨毛組織の遺残からの発生と、正常妊娠中の絨毛の悪性転換の2説を検討している。診断・治療は進歩したものの生存率は依然不良と述べられている。
summary_en: This article reports two additional cases of choriocarcinoma coexisting with a normal intrauterine pregnancy and reviews the literature. The authors discuss two proposed origins: development from trophoblastic remnants of a prior pregnancy, and malignant transformation of normal trophoblast during an otherwise normal pregnancy. Incidental choriocarcinoma foci in apparently normal placentas support the second hypothesis. Diagnosis, management, and persistently unsatisfactory survival rates are summarized.

title: Peripartum ovarian masses.
title_ja: 妊娠期の卵巣腫瘤
summary_ja: 妊娠に合併した卵巣腫瘤84例を後方視的に検討した研究。最多は良性の嚢胞性奇形腫であった。無症状例の多くは帝王切開時に偶然発見され、日常的な超音波検査でも見逃されていた。帝王切開時の卵巣検査の励行と、多くの病変に対する保存的治療を提案している。
summary_en: A retrospective review of 84 pregnancies complicated by ovarian masses examined presentation, management, pathology, and outcome. Benign cystic teratoma was the most common tumor. Forty-seven cases were asymptomatic, and 29 of these were found incidentally at cesarean section despite routine ultrasound. Aspiration cytology was helpful in only 53%, while histology gave a definitive diagnosis in all. The authors recommend routine ovarian examination at cesarean section and conservative management of most lesions.

title: Tetraploid arrest with overexpressed non-mutated p53 in germ cell cancers.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における非変異型p53の過剰発現を伴う四倍体停止
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍40例を膀胱癌や頭頸部扁平上皮癌と比較し、p53・Bcl-2・HSP70を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。胚細胞腫瘍の89%でp53が陽性だった。セミノーマは非セミノーマより p53 陽性率が高かった。非変異型p53の四倍体近傍での過剰発現が、化学感受性に関与する可能性が示唆されている。
summary_en: This immunocytochemical study of 40 germ cell cancers compared p53, Bcl-2 and HSP70 expression with bladder and head and neck cancers. Most germ cell cancers were p53-positive (89%), while Bcl-2 positivity was lower than in the comparison cancers. Seminomas showed higher p53 positivity than non-seminomas. The authors propose that near-tetraploid overexpression of non-mutated p53 contributes to the chemosensitivity of germ cell cancers, and suggest meiotic checkpoints as targets for other cancers.

title: Expression of epidermal growth factor and its receptor in gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるEGFおよびその受容体の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: インド・ケララ州の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を対象に、EGFとEGF受容体の発現を免疫組織化学と放射性リガンドアッセイで検討した研究。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌では、EGFとEGFRの双方で非常に強い結合が認められた。持続性栄養膜疾患では変異したEGF受容体が存在する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Immunohistochemistry and radioligand assays were used to evaluate epidermal growth factor (EGF) and EGF receptor (EGFR) expression in gestational trophoblastic disease from Kerala, India. Samples included 50 normal placentas, 122 molar pregnancies, and 52 cases of persistent disease. Invasive moles and choriocarcinomas showed very strong binding of both EGF and EGFR. The authors suggest that persistent trophoblastic disease may harbor mutated EGF receptors, which could be relevant to its behavior. The study is descriptive and quantitative, focusing on expression patterns across the gestational trophoblastic disease spectrum.

title: Macrophage colony-stimulating factor as a marker of ovarian carcinoma.
title_ja: 卵巣癌のマーカーとしてのマクロファージコロニー刺激因子
summary_ja: 卵巣悪性腫瘍における血清マクロファージコロニー刺激因子（M-CSF）の腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した研究。M-CSFは上皮・間質性腫瘍と胚細胞腫瘍の双方のマーカーとなり、特異的マーカーのないディスジャーミノーマで有用であった。複数の卵巣腫瘍細胞株でM-CSF産生が確認されたが、オートクラインの機序は確認されなかった。
summary_en: The authors evaluated macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) as a serum tumor marker for malignant ovarian tumors and examined its production by tumor cells and whether an autocrine loop operates. Serum M-CSF was useful for malignant ovarian tumors, including epithelial stromal tumors and germ cell tumors. It was notably a marker for dysgerminoma, for which no specific tumor marker is currently available. Combined assays with M-CSF were valuable. M-CSF was produced by several ovarian tumor cell lines, although an autocrine mechanism was not confirmed.

title: Telomeric length variation in human testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるテロメア長の多様性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍5例を対象に、末端制限断片（TRF）長を測定したテロメア解析の研究。古典的セミノーマと胎児性癌/セミノーマ混合型は平均約9kbpであった一方、奇形腫/胎児性癌混合型は平均20kbpと長かった。精母細胞性セミノーマは最大100kbpに達した。症例数は少ない。
summary_en: Telomere length was measured by terminal restriction fragment analysis in five human testicular germ cell tumours, including classical seminomas, a mixed embryonal carcinoma/atypical seminoma, a mixed teratoma/embryonal carcinoma, and a spermatocytic seminoma. Placental DNA served as the reference. Classical seminomas and the mixed embryonal carcinoma/seminoma showed mean lengths of about 9 kbp, while the teratoma/embryonal carcinoma had longer telomeres (mean 20 kbp). The single spermatocytic seminoma had extremely long telomeres, up to 100 kbp. The study is small, with only five cases, so conclusions are preliminary.

title: Ovarian tumor complicated by a colo-ovarian fistula.
title_ja: 結腸卵巣瘻を合併した卵巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍に結腸卵巣瘻を合併した4例を3年間で経験したという報告。1例目は注腸造影での造影剤漏出とCTでのガス含有病変で診断された。病理は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が2例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍と低悪性度漿液性嚢胞腺腫がそれぞれ1例であった。結腸卵巣瘻の成因と鑑別診断を概説している。
summary_en: This report describes four patients with colo-ovarian fistula associated with ovarian tumors, encountered over three years. The first case was demonstrated by barium extravasation on enema and a gas-containing lesion within the tumor on computed tomography. Pathology showed mature cystic teratoma in two patients, while the other two had a mixed germ cell tumor and a serous cystadenoma of low malignant potential. The authors review the etiology and differential diagnosis of colo-ovarian fistula. The fistula is a rare complication of ovarian tumors.

title: The role of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in mature teratoma of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の原発性純粋成熟奇形腫における後腹膜リンパ節郭清の役割
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍772例のうち原発性純粋精巣奇形腫44例を後方視的に検討した研究。臨床病期Iでは19.2%、病期IIA/Bでは66%にリンパ節転移を認めた。摘除標本の連続切片では、瘢痕や石灰化を伴う燃え尽き腫瘍が多く、微小病巣の胎児性癌も見られた。後腹膜リンパ節郭清と監視療法の選択に、連続切片の検索が有用と結論付けている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 44 patients with primary pure testicular mature teratoma, identified among 772 testicular germ cell tumor cases, evaluates the role of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Lymph node metastases occurred in 19.2% of clinical stage I and 66% of stage IIA/B disease. Serial sectioning revealed burned-out tumors with scarring or calcification in 80% of the 20 patients examined, and microfocal embryonal carcinoma in 20%. No stage I patients relapsed, whereas 33% of stage IIA/B patients did. Overall, 43% presented with metastatic disease. The authors recommend serial sectioning of orchiectomy specimens to guide the choice between lymphadenectomy and surveillance.

title: Combination effect of anti-Fas antibody and chemotherapeutic drugs in ovarian cancer cells in vitro.
title_ja: 卵巣癌細胞における抗Fas抗体と化学療法薬の併用効果(in vitro)
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 婦人科癌細胞株でFas抗原の発現を調べ、卵巣癌株では発現を認めたが絨毛癌株では認めなかった。抗Fas抗体は多くのFas陽性株でアポトーシスを誘導した。卵巣癌株と耐性変異株で化学療法薬との相乗効果が見られ、薬剤耐性克服の可能性が示された。
summary_en: The authors examined Fas antigen expression in gynecologic cancer cell lines, finding it in ovarian cancer lines but not choriocarcinoma lines. Anti-Fas antibody induced apoptosis in most Fas-positive lines. A synergistic effect was observed when combined with chemotherapeutic drugs in an ovarian cancer line and its resistant variants, suggesting a strategy to overcome drug resistance.

title: Long-term survival of patients with recurrent or refractory germ cell tumors after high dose chemotherapy.
title_ja: 大量化学療法後の再発または難治性胚細胞腫瘍患者の長期生存
summary_ja: 再発または難治性の胚細胞腫瘍74例に対し、自家造血幹細胞救援を併用した大量化学療法(カルボプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミド)を施行した。5年時点の全生存期間(全生存率)は38%、無増悪生存率は31%であった。従来量のシスプラチン投与中に進行した患者では長期生存者はいなかった。
summary_en: This phase I/II trial treated 74 patients with recurrent or refractory germ cell tumors using high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell rescue, combining carboplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide. Two patients died from treatment toxicity, and 47 relapsed or progressed after a median of 3 months. At five years, overall survival was 38% and failure-free survival 31%. No long-term survivors were seen among patients whose disease progressed during conventional-dose cisplatin. The authors conclude that high-dose chemotherapy can be curative for patients who respond to conventional-dose treatment but do not become disease free.

title: Goblet cell carcinoid arising in a mature teratoma of the mediastinum.
title_ja: 縦隔成熟奇形腫内に発生したゴブレット細胞カルチノイド
summary_ja: 縦隔の成熟奇形腫内に発生したゴブレット細胞カルチノイドの症例報告です。英語文献では初めての発生部位とされます。腫瘍は均一な腺房状の胞巣を形成し、細胞異型は軽度でした。免疫組織化学では神経内分泌および上皮性の特徴を示し、病変は奇形腫内に完全に限局していました。縦隔奇形腫の悪性転化に関する文献もレビューされています。
summary_en: This case report describes a goblet cell carcinoid arising within a mature teratoma of the mediastinum, a location not previously described in the English literature. The tumor showed uniform glandular nests of goblet, endocrine and Paneth cells with minimal atypia and rare mitoses, and immunohistochemistry confirmed neuroendocrine and epithelial features. The carcinoid component was entirely contained within the teratoma. The authors also review published mediastinal teratomas with malignant transformation.

title: The management of gestational trophoblastic tumors with etoposide, methotrexate, and actinomycin D.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対するEMA療法(エトポシド・メトトレキサート・アクチノマイシンD)の治療成績
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対するエトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD(EMA)療法の有効性と安全性を後方視的研究で検討した報告です。一次治療では7例中5例、単剤抵抗性例の二次治療では22例中21例が寛解に至りました。急性血液毒性は主にグレード1~2でした。二次性腫瘍のリスクから、エトポシドが寛解に必要な症例に限定すべきと結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated etoposide, methotrexate and actinomycin D (EMA) for gestational trophoblastic tumor as primary and secondary therapy. Primary EMA induced remission in 5 of 7 patients, and secondary EMA achieved remission in 21 of 22 patients resistant to single-agent regimens. Acute hematologic toxicity was mostly grade 1 or 2, with only 2 of 90 cycles causing grade 4 toxicity. The authors recommend restricting EMA to patients who require etoposide for remission because of secondary malignancy risk.

title: Cisplatin-based chemotherapy in the management of germ cell tumors of the ovary: The Institut Gustave Roussy Experience.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法:Institut Gustave Roussyでの経験
summary_ja: 卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍54例に対し、シスプラチン併用化学療法を後方視的研究で検討した報告です。中央値6年の追跡期間で全生存期間(全生存率)は74%でした。術後補助療法群では96%が無病生存しており、最も良好でした。長期毒性は軽度でした。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の予後改善に有用と結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 54 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluated cisplatin-based chemotherapy given as first-line or salvage therapy at the Institut Gustave Roussy. With a median follow-up of 6 years, overall survival was 74%, and adjuvant-setting patients fared best, with 96% alive without disease. Long-term toxicity was minimal, and many patients who had conservative surgery later resumed menstruation or had children. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based chemotherapy improves prognosis, especially in the adjuvant setting.

title: Fertility after chemotherapy for testicular germ cell cancers.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の精子形成の回復
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し精巣摘除術とシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた178例を対象に、治療後の精子形成の回復を解析した。治療前に正常精子数であった患者では、2年で48%、5年で80%に回復した。カルボプラチン併用群は回復確率が高く、4サイクル超では低下した。予後予測モデルで回復確率を3群に層別化できた。
summary_en: This study of 178 men treated for testicular germ cell cancer between 1979 and 1991 examined recovery of spermatogenesis after orchidectomy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Sperm counts before and after chemotherapy were classified as normospermic, oligospermic, or azoospermic. In men with normal pre-treatment counts, spermatogenesis recovered to 48% at two years and 80% at five years. Carboplatin-based therapy was associated with higher recovery probability, while more than four cycles reduced it. A prognostic model divided patients into three groups with 25%, 45%, and 82% probabilities of recovery by two years.

title: FDG-PET evaluation of retroperitoneal metastases of testicular cancer before and after chemotherapy.
title_ja: 精巣がんの後腹膜転移に対する化学療法前後のFDG-PET評価
summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌（胎児性癌が主体）の患者で、後腹膜転移に対し化学療法前後にFDG-PETを行った症例報告である。治療前は転移巣のブドウ糖代謝が不均一に亢進していた。化学療法後は腫瘍容積が増大したにもかかわらずFDG集積は正常範囲に低下し、組織学的には純粋な成熟奇形腫であった。ブドウ糖代謝による腫瘍分化の評価には、さらなる検討が必要とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a primary testicular teratocarcinoma composed predominantly of embryonal carcinoma. FDG-PET was performed before and after chemotherapy for retroperitoneal metastases. Before treatment, the metastases showed heterogeneous, increased glucose metabolism. After chemotherapy, FDG uptake normalized despite increased tumor volume. Histology showed a pure mature teratoma. The authors suggest that measuring glucose metabolism may help assess tumor differentiation in testicular teratocarcinoma metastases, and that further studies are needed to confirm this.

title: Intraperitoneal fat sign.
title_ja: 腹腔内脂肪徴候
summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の患者で、腹腔内が皮脂様物質で満たされていた症例を報告している。腹部X線写真で、壁側腹膜と上行結腸外側壁の間に広い脂肪の線状陰影がみられた。著者らはこの所見を、大量の腹腔内脂肪性物質を示す「腹腔内脂肪徴候」と命名した。単一症例の画像所見報告である。
summary_en: This short report describes a patient with an ovarian cystic teratoma whose peritoneal cavity was filled with sebaceous material. On an abdominal radiograph, a wide fat stripe was seen between the parietal peritoneum and the lateral wall of the ascending colon. The authors named this finding the intraperitoneal fat sign, which indicates large amounts of intraperitoneal fatty material. The paper is a brief imaging observation from a single case rather than a systematic series.

title: Struma ovarii: MR appearances.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫のMR所見
summary_ja: 組織学的に確定した卵巣甲状腺腫5例のMR画像を後方視的に検討した。全例で多房性嚢胞と充実成分からなる複雑な嚢胞性腫瘤を示し、大小の甲状腺濾胞を反映していた。嚢胞液は多くでT1強調像低信号、T2強調像高信号であったが、出血を伴う1例では逆のパターンであった。多房性嚢胞と充実成分を持つ腫瘤が本疾患の特徴的なMR所見と結論づけられた。
summary_en: This retrospective imaging study analyzed unenhanced and gadolinium-enhanced MR images from five histologically proven struma ovarii, a rare benign ovarian neoplasm. All lesions were complex cystic masses with multiple cysts and a solid component, reflecting large and small thyroid follicles. Cyst fluid was usually hypointense on T1-weighted and hyperintense on T2-weighted images, while one hemorrhagic lesion showed the reverse. The authors conclude that a multicystic mass with a solid component is a characteristic MR appearance of struma ovarii.

title: Nasopharyngeal teratoma: CT and MR findings.
title_ja: 上咽頭奇形腫のCTおよびMR所見
summary_ja: 成人で発見された上咽頭奇形腫の症例報告である。上咽頭の奇形腫は通常新生児に発生するため、成人例は稀である。本症例は初回発生から34年後に再発した。従来のX線写真、CT、MR、組織学的所見を提示し、長期間をおいて再発した稀な節外性奇形腫の画像所見を記録している。
summary_en: This case report describes a teratoma of the nasopharynx discovered in an adult, a site where such tumors usually present in neonates. The tumor recurred 34 years after its initial occurrence. The authors present conventional radiographs, CT, MR, and histologic findings. The report documents the imaging appearances of a rare extragonadal teratoma that recurred after a very long interval.

title: Residual pulmonary masses after chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Prediction of histology. ReHiT Study Group.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の残存肺腫瘤：組織型の予測
summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法後に開胸術を受けた215例の残存肺腫瘤を解析した。組織型は壊死54%、成熟奇形腫33%、がん13%であった。開胸前の予測因子、特に後腹膜リンパ節郭清の組織所見を用いたモデルは壊死を高精度に識別し（AUC 0.86）、壊死が疑われる症例では綿密なフォローアップが考慮されると結論づけている。
summary_en: This ReHiT Study Group analysis of 215 patients who underwent thoracotomy after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors examined residual pulmonary masses. Histology was necrosis in 54%, mature teratoma in 33% and cancer in 13%. Logistic models using pre-thoracotomy predictors, especially RPLND histology, discriminated necrosis well (AUC 0.86). The authors suggest close follow-up for patients likely to have necrosis, and recommend RPLND before thoracotomy.

title: Unique expression patterns of H19 in human testicular cancers of different etiology.
title_ja: 病因の異なるヒト精巣がんにおけるH19遺伝子の発現様式
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成人精巣の各種腫瘍におけるインプリンティング遺伝子H19の発現を解析した。浸潤性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の多くで両アレルの発現がみられ、これは成人精巣において本腫瘍に特異的な所見であった。発現量は分化系譜と成熟段階に相関し、原始胚細胞起源という考えと整合する。H19は腫瘍抑制遺伝子としては働かないと著者らは結論づけている。
summary_en: This study examined imprinted H19 expression in testicular cancers of differing etiology, including spermatocytic seminomas, lymphomas, and Sertoli and Leydig cell tumors, alongside normal and germ cell-free testicular tissue. Most invasive testicular germ cell tumors showed biallelic H19 expression, a pattern specific to these tumors in the adult testis. Expression levels correlated with differentiation lineage and maturation stage, consistent with a primordial germ cell origin. The authors conclude that H19 does not act as a tumor suppressor gene.

title: Malignant struma ovarii. A case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 32歳の無症状女性に生じた悪性乳頭状卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。著者らは悪性乳頭状卵巣甲状腺腫の診断基準を提案している。完全な病期分類を行えば、腫瘍の経過は通常良性で転移は少ないため、保存的治療が可能であると述べている。希少疾患における診断・治療の混乱を整理する一助となる報告である。
summary_en: This report describes a 32-year-old asymptomatic woman with malignant papillary struma ovarii, a rare ovarian carcinoma arising from a teratoma. The authors propose diagnostic criteria for malignant papillary struma ovarii. They note that complete staging allows conservative treatment, since this tumor usually has a benign course and a low rate of metastasis. The report helps clarify diagnosis and management of this rare entity.

title: Highly differentiated teratoma and fetus-in-fetu: a single pathology?
title_ja: 高分化型奇形腫と胎児内胎児：同一の病態か？
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の乳児症例で、胎児内胎児様の特徴を示した。偽胎児は単心室様の未発達な心臓を有し、宿主児とは異なる拍動数で拍動していた。X線検査で脊柱は認められなかった。胎児内胎児は高度に分化・組織化された奇形腫であり、両者は同一の病態である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma in an infant that displayed features of fetus-in-fetu. The pseudo-fetus contained a rudimentary single-cavity heart that beat at a rate different from the host infant's, and radiography showed an absent spinal column. The authors conclude that fetus-in-fetu can represent a remarkably complex, well-differentiated, and highly organized teratoma, suggesting that the two entities may share a single pathological basis.

title: Prenatal diagnosis, pathology, and genetic study of fetus in fetu.
title_ja: 胎児内胎児の出生前診断、病理学的および遺伝学的検討
summary_ja: 後腹膜の胎児内胎児を報告した。妊娠後期の超音波検査で、腹腔内嚢胞性病変内に四肢や脊椎を備えた無脳症・無心臓性の塊が確認された。切除標本は四肢、椎体、歯を有する胎児様構造で、宿主と同一の46,XY核型を示し、分子解析でも遺伝学的差異はなかった。十分に発達した四肢と脊椎があれば出生前診断が可能であると強調された。
summary_en: The authors report prenatal diagnosis, pathology, karyotyping, and molecular analysis of a retroperitoneal fetus-in-fetu. Third-trimester ultrasound of the host fetus showed an anencephalic, acardiac mass containing identifiable limbs and spine within an intra-abdominal cystic lesion. The resected fetiform mass had four extremities, vertebral bodies, teeth, and an umbilical cord. Both host and mass had a 46,XY karyotype with no genetic difference on molecular analysis. The authors emphasize that such lesions can be diagnosed prenatally when well-developed limbs and spine are present.

title: Maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein and epithelial tumour marker concentrations are not increased by fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫では母体血清αフェトプロテインおよび上皮性腫瘍マーカー濃度は上昇しない
summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫を合併した妊娠10例で、妊娠15週の母体血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を測定した。妊娠後期のCA12-5、TATI、PIIINPも検討した。いずれの値も正常妊娠と同等で、成熟型と未熟型・悪性型の奇形腫の間にも差はなかった。本異常は第2三半期の母体血清トリソミースクリーニングでは検出できないと結論された。
summary_en: This study measured maternal serum AFP and total hCG at 15 weeks' gestation in ten pregnancies complicated by fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma, along with late-pregnancy CA 12-5, TATI, and PIIINP. Values were comparable to normal pregnancies and did not differ between histologically mature and immature or malignant teratomas. The authors conclude that this anomaly is not detectable by maternal serum trisomy screening in the second trimester.

title: Quantification of immunocompetent cells in testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における免疫担当細胞の定量
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍43例を対象に、T細胞、マクロファージ、B細胞、形質細胞を無作為抽出法で定量した。T細胞とマクロファージはセミノーマで非セミノーマ性腫瘍より多かった。胎児性癌は未熟奇形腫よりT細胞が多く、成熟奇形腫はB細胞が多かった。無作為抽出は腫瘍全体の免疫応答をより正確に評価できると結論された。
summary_en: This study quantified immunocompetent cells, including T lymphocytes, macrophages, B lymphocytes, and plasma cells, in 43 testicular germ cell tumors using randomized field selection. T lymphocytes and macrophages were more abundant in seminomas than in non-seminomatous tumors, and embryonal carcinomas had more T lymphocytes than immature teratomas. Mature teratomas showed high B lymphocyte counts, while plasma cells were sparse. The authors conclude that randomized sampling yields a more representative immune assessment and allows comparison with other malignancies.

title: Direct invasion of the renal vein by metastatic testicular cancer.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんによる腎静脈への直接浸潤
summary_ja: 精巣原発の転移性セミノーマが左腎静脈へ直接浸潤し、腫瘍栓が下大静脈まで進展した症例報告である。血栓性の増大により初回化学療法を完遂できず、外科的介入を要した。手術標本に生存腫瘍は認めなかったが、補助化学療法2コース後に腎静脈浸潤部位で再発した。
summary_en: This case report describes metastatic seminoma with direct invasion of the left renal vein. A tumor thrombus extended into the renal vein, and the associated vena cava thrombosis proved to be a noncancerous clot that grew as an extension of it. Thrombotic growth prevented completion of primary chemotherapy and required surgery. Surgical specimens showed no viable tumor, and two cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy were given, yet the tumor relapsed at the site of renal vein invasion. The report highlights the diagnostic and management challenges of tumor thrombus extension in testicular cancer.

title: Relative expression of epidermal growth factor receptor in placental cytotrophoblasts and choriocarcinoma cell lines.
title_ja: 胎盤栄養膜細胞および絨毛癌細胞株における上皮成長因子受容体の相対的発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株(BeWo、JAr)では、良性の栄養膜細胞と比べてEGFRが10倍以上高発現し、TGF-αを自己分泌していた。EGFRやTGF-αを阻害するとJArの増殖が抑制された。EGFR過剰発現と自己分泌ループが絨毛癌の無制御な増殖に関与すると考えられる。
summary_en: This study examines epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) expression and the transforming growth factor-alpha (TGF-α) autocrine loop in benign placental cytotrophoblasts and in choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo and JAr. Choriocarcinoma cells showed EGFR levels at least tenfold higher than benign cytotrophoblasts, did not respond to exogenous TGF-α, and secreted TGF-α in an autocrine fashion. Blocking EGFR or TGF-α inhibited JAr proliferation. The authors propose that EGFR overexpression and the autocrine loop contribute to the uncontrolled growth of choriocarcinoma cells.

title: Management of seminoma of the testis: recommendations based on treatment results.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの治療：治療成績に基づく推奨
summary_ja: シドニーの単施設で1979〜1993年に治療された精巣セミノーマの成績を後方視的に評価し、文献も踏まえた治療方針を提示した。病期Iおよび病期IIAでは精巣摘除術後の放射線療法で治癒率がほぼ100%に達した。病期IIB(10cm超)では初回化学療法の後に放射線療法を追加する方針が妥当とされた。
summary_en: This retrospective review evaluates treatment outcomes for testicular seminoma at a single Sydney institution from 1979 to 1993 and reviews the literature to propose management protocols. Post-orchidectomy radiotherapy for stage I and IIA disease achieved near 100% long-term cure, and routine or surveillance chemotherapy is unlikely to improve outcomes. For stage IIB disease up to 10 cm, radiotherapy with chemotherapy reserved for relapse was considered appropriate. Bulkier stage IIB disease (over 10 cm) warranted initial chemotherapy followed by consolidation radiotherapy.

title: Is it feasible to diagnose germ-cell tumors by fine-needle aspiration biopsy?
title_ja: 穿刺吸引生検により胚細胞腫瘍の診断は可能か
summary_ja: 穿刺吸引細胞診(FNAB)による胚細胞腫瘍の診断可能性を検討した論文である。多くの組織型は細胞診で容易に識別可能とされる。混合型胚細胞腫瘍では一成分が優位な場合に診断が難しく、免疫組織化学が確定診断に有用とされる。
summary_en: This paper assesses whether fine-needle aspiration biopsy (FNAB) can reliably diagnose germ cell tumors. The authors state that most subtypes are readily recognized and distinguished from one another on FNAB, and that clinicopathologic correlation helps in difficult cases. Mixed germ cell tumors can be problematic when one component predominates. Immunohistochemistry is noted as an important adjunct for a definitive diagnosis. The report is a brief review of cytologic diagnosis of germ cell tumors.

title: A pure brain metastasis of choriocarcinoma from a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍由来の絨毛癌の脳単独転移
summary_ja: 卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍に由来する絨毛癌の脳単独転移の症例報告である。化学療法中に出現し、開頭による切除、放射線療法、追加の化学療法を行った。その後、肺転移は消失し長期生存が得られた。極めてまれな病態である。
summary_en: This report describes a pure brain metastasis of choriocarcinoma arising from a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary in a 19-year-old patient. The metastasis appeared during combination chemotherapy, after pulmonary metastases had proven resistant to treatment. Craniotomy with tumor resection, brain radiation, and further chemotherapy were administered. Afterward, the pulmonary metastasis disappeared and the patient survived long term. The authors emphasize that this isolated brain involvement is extremely rare.

title: Primary choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix: clinical, MRI, and color Doppler ultrasonographic study.
title_ja: 子宮頸部原発絨毛癌：臨床像、MRI、カラードプラ超音波検査による検討
summary_ja: 分娩4か月後に不正性器出血で発症した子宮頸部原発絨毛癌の症例である。MRIとカラードプラ超音波検査で、中心壊死を伴う血流豊富な腫瘤を描出した。化学療法2コース後の子宮全摘で残存病変はなく、無病経過を維持している。
summary_en: A 38-year-old woman developed primary choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix four months after a term vaginal delivery, presenting with irregular genital bleeding. MRI and color Doppler ultrasonography revealed a hypervascular 6 cm cervical tumor with central necrosis, and urinary hCG was markedly elevated. After two courses of chemotherapy, total hysterectomy showed no residual choriocarcinoma, and the patient remained disease-free. The authors conclude that MRI and Doppler ultrasound are useful for diagnosis by demonstrating abundant blood flow and central necrosis.

title: Bax upregulation is an early event in cisplatin-induced apoptosis in human testicular germ-cell tumor cell line NT2, as quantitated by flow cytometry.
title_ja: フローサイトメトリーによる定量から見た、ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株NT2のシスプラチン誘導性アポトーシス初期におけるBax上昇
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株NT2においてシスプラチンが誘導するアポトーシスとBcl-2・Baxの発現変化を検討した。72時間後には約90%の細胞がアポトーシスを示した。フローサイトメトリーでは、早期アポトーシス細胞の一部でBax発現の上昇が認められ、ウェスタンブロットでは検出されなかった。NT2の化学感受性は低いアポトーシス閾値とBax過剰発現によると考察されている。
summary_en: This study examined apoptosis induced by cisplatin in the human testicular germ cell tumor line NT2. Annexin V staining showed apoptosis increasing over 72 hours, reaching about 90% of cells. Bcl-2 and Bax levels were measured by flow cytometry and Western blotting. Western blotting showed no change in Bax, but flow cytometry revealed Bax upregulation in a subpopulation of early apoptotic cells, which was confirmed after sorting. The authors suggest NT2 chemosensitivity reflects a low apoptotic threshold with Bax overexpression, and that flow cytometry better detects heterogeneous Bax expression.

title: Primary mediastinal germ cell tumor with intratubular germ cell neoplasia of the testis--further support for germ cell origin of these tumors: a case report.
title_ja: 精巣の上皮内胚細胞腫瘍を伴う原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍：縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の胚細胞起源をさらに支持する所見――症例報告
summary_ja: 局所浸潤性の原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する成人男性の症例報告である。一方の精巣に浸潤性腫瘍や瘢痕を伴わず、管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)が認められた。臨床的にも剖検でも転移は認められず、患者は診断後まもなく死亡した。著者らは、縦隔腫瘍は精巣の in situ 病変を併存する原発性腫瘍であり、性腺外腫瘍が胚細胞起源であることを支持すると提案している。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の組織発生に関する文献レビューも示されている。
summary_en: This case report describes an adult male with a locally invasive primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Examination of the testes revealed intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) in one testis, without invasive tumor or scar. No metastases were found clinically or at autopsy, and the patient died shortly after diagnosis. The authors propose that the mediastinal tumor is a primary neoplasm with a concomitant in situ lesion in the testis, supporting a germ cell origin for extragonadal tumors. A literature review on the histogenesis of extragonadal germ cell tumors is also presented.

title: Full-term pregnancies and incidence of ovarian cancer of stromal and germ cell origin: a Norwegian prospective study.
title_ja: 全期妊娠と卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍および間質性腫瘍の発生：ノルウェー前向き研究
summary_ja: ノルウェーの前向きコホート研究で、約110万人の20〜56歳女性を追跡し、出産歴と卵巣癌の組織型との関連を検討した。間質性腫瘍41例では明確な関連は認められなかった。一方、胚細胞腫瘍71例は高齢出産および最終出産からの期間の短さと関連していた。生殖因子が胚細胞腫瘍と間質性腫瘍のリスクに異なる影響を与える可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This Norwegian prospective cohort study followed about 1.1 million women aged 20 to 56 years to examine associations between full-term pregnancies and ovarian cancer subtypes. Among 41 stromal tumors, no clear associations were found. Among 71 germ cell tumors, incidence was related to high-age childbirth and short time since last birth. The findings suggest that reproductive factors may differentially influence the risk of germ cell versus stromal ovarian tumors.

title: Genetic dissection of susceptibility to murine ovarian teratomas that originate from parthenogenetic oocytes.
title_ja: 単為生殖卵子に由来するマウス卵巣奇形腫に対する遺伝的感受性の解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: C57BL/6J×LT/SvのF2マウスを用いた連鎖解析により、自然発生卵巣奇形腫の感受性遺伝子を検討した。LT/Svマウスは単為生殖卵子に由来する卵巣奇形腫の発生率が高い。6番染色体上に、半優性様式で奇形腫頻度を高める主要遺伝子座Ots1が同定された。この特異的表現型の遺伝学的基盤を示す研究である。
summary_en: This study used genetic linkage analysis in (C57BL/6J x LT/Sv)F2 mice to investigate susceptibility to spontaneous ovarian teratomas. LT/Sv mice have a high incidence of ovarian teratomas that arise from spontaneously parthenogenetic oocytes, a phenomenon rare in other strains such as C57BL/6J. The authors identified a single major locus on chromosome 6, designated Ots1 (ovarian teratoma susceptibility), which increases teratoma frequency in a semidominant manner. The work provides a genetic basis for this unusual phenotype and a model for ovarian teratoma development.

title: k-FGF protoncogene expression is associated with murine testicular teratogenesis, but is not involved during mouse testicular development.
title_ja: マウス精巣奇形形成に関連するk-FGF発現：精巣発生との比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウスの精巣発生、自然発生精巣奇形腫（STT）およびOTT6050奇形癌におけるk-FGF発現を検討した。発生中の胚細胞ではk-FGFは検出されず、Oct-4はこの細胞でk-FGFを活性化しないと考えられた。実験的なOTT6050では高発現、分化したSTTでは低発現であった。k-FGFの活性化は腫瘍発生に関与し、悪性腫瘍のマーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined k-FGF (Fgf4) expression during normal mouse testicular development and in spontaneous testicular teratoma (STT) and the OTT6050 teratocarcinoma. k-FGF was not detectable in developing mouse testicular germ cells, despite Oct-4 expression, indicating Oct-4 does not activate k-FGF in these cells. High k-FGF expression was found in the experimental OTT6050 teratocarcinoma, but only low levels in differentiated STT. The authors suggest k-FGF activation may contribute to tumor genesis and serve as a malignancy marker.

title: Chromosomal abnormalities in sperm from testicular cancer patients before and after chemotherapy.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者におけるBEP化学療法前後の精子染色体異常
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者を対象に、BEP化学療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)の前後で精子の染色体異常を評価した研究である。多色蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーション(FISH)法により16万個以上の精子を解析した。治療後に有意差が認められたのは第1染色体のdisomyの減少のみで、性比や倍数体の頻度に変化はなかった。対照健常者との比較でも差はなく、BEP療法が精子の数的染色体異常を増加させないと結論づけられた。
summary_en: This study assessed sperm chromosome abnormalities in men with testicular cancer before and after BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin). Using multicolour FISH on over 160,000 sperm, the authors measured disomy for chromosomes 1, 12, X, Y and XY, along with diploid frequency and sex ratio. Most frequencies did not differ significantly after treatment; only chromosome 1 disomy decreased. Values in patients matched those of 10 healthy control donors. The authors concluded that BEP chemotherapy does not increase numerical chromosomal abnormalities in sperm.

title: Oncoproteins and tumor suppressor proteins in congenital sacrococcygeal teratomas.
title_ja: 先天性仙尾部奇形腫におけるがん遺伝子および腫瘍抑制遺伝子タンパク質の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 先天性仙尾部奇形腫8例を対象に、ras、fos、junなどのがん遺伝子およびp53、nm23-H-1などの腫瘍抑制遺伝子の発現を検討した研究である。発現の強さは腫瘍径、患者の年齢、生存期間と関連せず、未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫の間にも差はなかった。これらの遺伝子はSCTに存在し、発生や発達に関与している可能性が示唆されたが、その正確な役割は未解明である。
summary_en: This study examined oncoproteins and tumor suppressor proteins in eight cases of congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), the most common germ cell tumor of infancy. The authors tested ras family oncogenes, fos and jun early genes, and p53 and nm23-H-I tumor suppressors. Expression did not correlate with tumor size, patient age, or survival. Expression also did not differ between immature and mature teratomas. The findings suggest these genes are present in SCT and may play a role in tumor development, though their exact function remains unclear.

title: Testis-preserving surgery in bilateral testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍における精巣温存手術
summary_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者13例を対象に、標準的な両側精巣摘除術の代わりに精巣温存的な腫瘍核出術を評価した。腫瘍は6〜30 mmで、腫瘍床と周辺実質の生検が行われた。上皮内癌を有する患者は精巣照射を受け、一部は補助的局所療法を受けた。観察期間中央値62か月で、1例の局所再発を除き全例が無病であった。ホルモン値は補充なしで正常範囲内に保たれた。著者らは、選択された患者に対して臓器温存手術は有効な選択肢であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study evaluated testis-sparing tumour enucleation in 13 patients with bilateral testicular germ cell tumours, rather than standard bilateral orchidectomy. Tumours of 6 to 30 mm were enucleated, with biopsies of the tumour bed and surrounding parenchyma. Patients with carcinoma in situ received testicular radiation, and some received adjuvant local therapy. With a median follow-up of 62 months, all were disease-free except one local recurrence, which was treated by orchidectomy. Hormone levels stayed normal without androgen replacement. The authors conclude that organ-sparing surgery is a viable option for selected patients.

title: Evaluation of primary standard cisplatin-based chemotherapy for clinical stage II non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis.
title_ja: 臨床病期II非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する標準的シスプラチン併用化学療法の初回治療としての評価
summary_ja: 本研究は、1984年から1992年の間に治療された臨床病期II非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者55例を対象に、RPLNDの前に行う初回のシスプラチン併用化学療法を評価した。化学療法のみで16例(29%)が持続的完全寛解を得た一方、30例(55%)は残存腫瘍のためRPLNDが必要であった。当初反応を示した6例はその後再発した。全体では95%が33～111か月にわたり無病であった。著者らは、初回のシスプラチン併用化学療法が、病期IIのすべてのサブグループにおいて治癒をもたらしうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study evaluated primary cisplatin-based chemotherapy before retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 55 patients with clinical stage II non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours treated between 1984 and 1992. After chemotherapy, 16 patients (29%) achieved sustained complete remission without surgery, while 30 (55%) required RPLND for residual masses. Six patients who had initially responded later relapsed. Overall, 95% remained disease-free at 33 to 111 months. The authors concluded that primary cisplatin-based chemotherapy can cure stage II disease across all subgroups.

title: Complications of the post-chemotherapy resection of retroperitoneal residual tumour mass in patients with non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤切除の合併症
summary_ja: 1979〜1995年に化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘍を切除された播種性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍112例を対象とした。組織学的には生存腫瘍が9%、成熟奇形腫が44%、壊死・線維化が44%であった。合併症は18%に発生し、大半は尿路感染症であった。年齢や残存腫瘍径などは合併症と関連しなかった。残存腫瘤の切除は安全性の高い手技であり、化学療法効果の最終評価には手術による評価が依然として標準であると結論づけられた。
summary_en: This study reviewed 112 patients with disseminated non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours who underwent resection of retroperitoneal residual masses after chemotherapy from 1979 to 1995. Viable tumour was found in 9%, mature teratoma in 44%, and necrosis or fibrosis in 44%. Complications occurred in 18% of patients, mostly urinary tract infection. Age, residual tumour size, operative duration, prior laparotomy and pathology were not associated with complications. The authors concluded that residual mass resection is a safe procedure, although surgical evaluation remains the gold standard for assessing treatment response.

title: DNA repair capacity and cisplatin sensitivity of human testis tumour cells.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍細胞のDNA修復能とシスプラチン感受性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍細胞株3株と膀胱癌細胞株3株について、シスプラチン曝露後のDNA白金化とその除去能を比較した研究である。精巣腫瘍細胞株では白金の除去が乏しく、N-rasやCD3δ遺伝子でも修復が認められなかった。この修復能の低下が、精巣腫瘍細胞のDNA障害剤に対する過敏性に関与すると結論づけている。
summary_en: This 1997 study compared DNA repair capacity and cisplatin sensitivity in three human testicular tumour cell lines and three bladder cancer cell lines. After a 1-hour exposure to 50 µM cisplatin, testicular lines showed lower DNA platinum levels. Over 72 hours, bladder lines removed platinum from the genome, whereas two testicular lines showed little removal. Quantitative PCR of the N-ras and CD3δ genes confirmed repair deficiency in these testicular lines. The authors suggest reduced repair of cisplatin-damaged DNA underlies the hypersensitivity of testicular tumour cells.

title: International Germ Cell Consensus Classification: a prognostic factor-based staging system for metastatic germ cell cancers. International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group.
title_ja: 国際胚細胞腫瘍コンセンサス分類：予後因子に基づく転移性胚細胞腫瘍の病期分類システム
summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の大規模国際共同解析により、予後不良因子(縦隔原発、AFP・hCG・LDHの高値、非肺内臓転移)を同定した。これらを統合し、予後良好・中間・不良の3群に分類した。5年生存率はそれぞれ91%、79%、48%であり、臨床試験や治療判断に用いる国際的な分類として提案された。
summary_en: This 1997 collaborative analysis of 5,202 non-seminomatous and 660 seminoma patients with metastatic germ cell tumours identified independent adverse factors, including mediastinal primary site, elevated AFP, hCG and LDH, and non-pulmonary visceral metastases. Integrating these yielded good, intermediate and poor prognosis groups, with 5-year survival of 91%, 79% and 48%, respectively. The International Germ Cell Consensus Classification provides a simple, clinically applicable framework for risk-based treatment decisions and for designing and reporting clinical trials.

title: Surveillance policy for stage I ovarian germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 病期I卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するサーベイランス方針
summary_ja: 病期Iaの悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍24例を対象に、外科的切除後にサーベイランスを行った研究である。中央追跡6.8年で、5年全生存期間(全生存率)は95%であった。再発や二次原発で化学療法を要した8例の多くは救済された。補助化学療法を省くことの妥当性が示された。
summary_en: This study evaluated surveillance rather than adjuvant chemotherapy for 24 women with stage Ia malignant ovarian germ cell tumours treated by surgical resection alone. Histologies included dysgerminoma, pure immature teratoma, and endodermal sinus tumour. With a median follow-up of 6.8 years, 5-year overall survival was 95% and disease-free survival 68%. Eight patients needed chemotherapy for recurrence or second primary tumours, and most were salvaged. The authors conclude that careful clinical, radiologic and serologic surveillance avoids unnecessary adjuvant therapy and its complications.

title: Aberrant expression of cyclin D2 is an early event in human male germ cell tumorigenesis.
title_ja: サイクリンD2の異常発現はヒト男性胚細胞腫瘍発生の初期事象である
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 12p上の増幅遺伝子であるサイクリンD2(CCND2)の発現を、ヒト男性胚細胞腫瘍で解析した。異常な胚細胞を含む上皮内病変では全例で発現し、正常胚細胞では発現がなかった。分化度が低い腫瘍ほど発現が高い傾向が見られ、サイクリンD2の異常発現は胚細胞腫瘍発生の初期事象と考えられた。
summary_en: This study examined cyclin D2 (CCND2), a gene on the 12p amplicon, in human male germ cell tumours. CCND2 was expressed in all carcinoma in situ/intratubular germ cell neoplasia lesions studied, but not in normal germ cells. Expression was high in tumours lacking differentiation (seminoma) or with primitive differentiation (embryonal carcinoma), and was lower in more differentiated lines, which showed increased p21. The authors propose that aberrant cyclin D2 expression is an early event in germ cell tumorigenesis.

title: CA19-9: a possible serum marker for embryonal carcinoma.
title_ja: CA19-9：胎児性癌の血清マーカーの可能性
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍18例で血清CA19-9を測定し、胎児性癌の腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した。胎児性癌の5例で上昇し、治療反応とともに正常化した。組織免疫染色でも胎児性癌と成熟奇形腫で陽性であり、血清CA19-9は胎児性癌の有用なマーカーになりうると示された。
summary_en: This study investigated serum CA19-9 as a marker for embryonal carcinoma in 18 male patients with germ cell tumours. Serum CA19-9 was elevated in five of eight embryonal carcinoma patients and normalized with treatment response, while seminoma patients had normal levels. Immunohistochemistry showed CA19-9 positivity in embryonal carcinomas and mature teratomas, faint positivity in seminomas, and negativity in choriocarcinomas, yolk sac tumours and immature teratomas. The authors suggest serum CA19-9 may be a useful marker for embryonal carcinoma.

title: A modified BEP protocol: reduction of hospitalization without reducing the efficacy.
title_ja: 改変BEPプロトコル：有効性を保ったままの入院期間の短縮
summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍64例に対し、短縮型BEP療法の有効性と入院期間を検討した。化学療法単独で54%が完全奏効し、手術と追加化学療法を加えると計89%が腫瘍消失に至った。1コースあたりの入院は平均約65時間に短縮され、従来法と同等の有効性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study assessed a condensed BEP regimen (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) for metastatic testicular germ cell tumours in 64 consecutive patients. Cisplatin and bleomycin were given as single daily doses, with etoposide over three consecutive days, and mean hospitalization per course was about 65 hours. Of the patients, 54% achieved complete response with chemotherapy alone, and 35% more became tumour-free after surgery and additional chemotherapy. Creatinine clearance was unchanged. The authors suggest this cost-effective, shorter regimen may match conventional efficacy, pending randomized trials.

title: Metastasizing placental site trophoblastic tumor: immunohistochemical and DNA analysis. 2 case reports and a review of the literature.
title_ja: 転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：免疫組織化学的およびDNA解析－2症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 35歳と29歳の患者に肺転移を伴う胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の2例を報告。核分裂像は10視野あたり9および13個。免疫染色では1例でhPL陽性細胞が優位、もう1例では逆のパターンを示した。DNA解析では1例に四倍体ピークを伴う異数性を認めた。PSTTの臨床経過は予測困難で、信頼できる予後指標は存在しないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes two cases of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) with pulmonary metastasis in patients aged 35 and 29. Mitotic counts were 9 and 13 per 10 high-power fields. Immunohistochemistry showed hPL-positive cells predominating over hCG-reactive cells in one case and the reverse pattern in the other. DNA analysis of one tumor revealed an aneuploid tetraploid pattern. The authors conclude that PSTT clinical behavior is unpredictable and that no reliable prognostic markers currently exist.

title: Hysteroscopy provides proof of trophoblastic tumors in three cases with negative color Doppler images.
title_ja: カラードプラ画像で陰性であった栄養膜腫瘍3例の子宮鏡による証明
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の評価にカラードプラ超音波検査が用いられるが、hCG値が上昇していても約25%の症例では異常血管が描出されない。本報告では、カラードプラが陰性であった3例に子宮鏡下で筋層生検を行い、栄養膜腫瘍を確認した。小さな腫瘍巣はドプラで検出されない可能性があり、遺残性胞状奇胎の管理に影響しうると述べている。
summary_en: Color Doppler ultrasonography is widely used to evaluate gestational trophoblastic disease, yet about 25% of patients with suggestive hCG levels show no abnormal uterine vessels.
