Malignant GTD (choriocarcinoma) expressed HERV-K, while benign molar pregnancy did not. The authors propose a shared molecular pathogenesis for GCT and malignant GTD, with implications for classification and support for carcinoma in situ as a common precursor.

title: Alterations of the p53 tumor suppressor gene in carcinoma in situ of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣上皮内癌におけるp53癌抑制遺伝子の変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍18例に隣接する正常精巣内の上皮内癌（CIS）細胞を解析し、p53遺伝子の変化を検討した研究である。18例中12例でSSCP解析により変異が示され、7例では塩基配列で確認された。1例ではCISと腫瘍に同一の変異が認められ、CISからの単クローン性発生が示唆された。CISの悪性potentialとp53の関与を支持する結果である。
summary_en: This study examined p53 gene alterations in carcinoma in situ (CIS) cells found in normal testicular tissue adjacent to 18 germ cell tumors. CIS cells were isolated by microdissection using placental-like alkaline phosphatase staining. Mutational band shifts were found in 12 of 18 cases (66%), and sequencing confirmed point mutations in seven cases. One case showed an identical mutation in both CIS and the associated tumor, suggesting monoclonal development from CIS. The findings support malignant potential in testicular CIS and a role for p53 in germ cell cancer precursors.

title: Diagnosis and management of malignant germ cell ovarian tumors in young females.
title_ja: 若年女性における悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断と治療
summary_ja: 若年女性の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断と治療をまとめた総説である。ディスジャーミノーマが最多で、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫が続く。腫瘍マーカーはAFPとhCGが主に用いられ、治療効果判定と再発の早期発見に有用とされる。BEP療法などの現行治療と妊孕性への影響を論じ、新たな治療法への期待を述べている。
summary_en: This review addresses malignant ovarian germ cell tumors in young women, which account for most malignant ovarian tumors in preadolescents. Dysgerminoma is most common, followed by endodermal sinus tumor and immature teratoma. Among tumor markers, only AFP and hCG are routinely monitored, mainly to assess treatment response and detect recurrence early. The authors outline current regimens such as BEP, including their effect on fertility, and suggest that new surgical and chemotherapeutic approaches may further improve prognosis.

title: Ovarian tumors associated with pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠に伴う卵巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 妊娠中に手術で切除された卵巣腫瘍106例を検討した研究である。大半は良性で、類皮嚢腫（奇形腫）が最多であった。悪性は5例で、胎児性癌とディスジャーミノーマを含んでいた。術後の自然流産率は10%にとどまった。持続・増大する腫瘤には妊娠初期の手術による組織診断と悪性の除外を推奨している。
summary_en: This study reviews 106 ovarian tumors surgically resected during pregnancy. Most were benign, with dermoid cysts the most common lesion, and five were malignant, including one embryonal carcinoma and one dysgerminoma. Most benign tumors were larger than 8 cm and were diagnosed before 10 weeks of gestation. Spontaneous abortion after surgery was 10%, and 76% of patients delivered at term. The authors recommend first-trimester surgery for persistent or enlarging masses to obtain a histologic diagnosis and exclude malignancy.

title: Placental-site trophoblastic tumor following metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の後に生じた胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍
summary_ja: 化学療法で治療された転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の後に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が発生した症例報告である。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は通常、正期産や非胞状流産の後に生じ、胞状奇胎に先行した例は過去10例のみである。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍からの移行の可能性を示し、治療後の経過観察への示唆を与えている。
summary_en: This case report describes placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) that developed after metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated with chemotherapy. PSTT typically follows term pregnancy or nonmolar abortion, and only ten prior cases were preceded by hydatidiform mole. This is the first reported case in which PSTT followed chemotherapy-treated metastatic GTN. The report highlights a potential sequence between gestational trophoblastic tumors and PSTT, which may be relevant to surveillance after treatment.

title: Diffuse testicular microlithiasis associated with intratubular germ cell neoplasia and seminoma.
title_ja: びまん性精巣微小石灰化に併発した精細管内胚細胞腫瘍およびセミノーマ
summary_ja: 腫瘤を伴わない孤立性のびまん性精巣微小石灰化の患者に、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍とセミノーマの微小病巣が認められた症例報告である。精巣微小石灰化は前悪性・悪性の変化と関連しうるため、超音波所見を認識し、腫瘍形成への進行を見逃さないための厳重な経過観察が推奨されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with isolated diffuse testicular microlithiasis and no focal mass, in whom intratubular germ cell neoplasia and a microscopic seminoma focus were found. Testicular microlithiasis, which shows diffuse hyperechoic specks on sonography, has been associated with premalignant and malignant change. The authors urge clinicians to recognize this condition and maintain heightened surveillance to detect progression to tumor formation.

title: Testicular microlithiasis as a predictor of intratubular germ cell neoplasia.
title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化は精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の予測因子か
summary_ja: 31歳男性の左精巣がんと右精巣の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告する。左根治的精巣摘除術の際に行った右精巣生検で診断された。術前超音波検査で右精巣に精巣微小石灰化を認め、これが生検の契機となった。超音波所見は精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を示唆する指標になり、非侵襲的に生検対象を選ぶ手段として有用である可能性があると著者らは提案している。
summary_en: This study reports a 31-year-old man with left testicular carcinoma and right intratubular germ cell neoplasia, detected by biopsy at the time of left radical orchiectomy. Preoperative ultrasound had revealed microlithiasis in the contralateral right testis, which prompted the biopsy. The authors propose that ultrasonographically detected testicular microlithiasis may signal intratubular germ cell neoplasia and that ultrasound could serve as a noninvasive tool to select patients for testicular biopsy.

title: Extragonadal germ cell tumor followed by metachronous testicular tumor. A case report.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の後に異時性に発生した精巣腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 性腺外に生じた混合型胚細胞腫瘍(奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分)の切除後、7年後に異時性に精巣腫瘍が発生した症例を報告する。精巣腫瘍は純粋なセミノーマで、初回腫瘍とは組織型が異なっていた。長い期間と組織学的相違から、両腫瘍は独立して発生したと考えられる。性腺外腫瘍の切除後に異時性に精巣腫瘍が生じた報告は、本症例が初めてである可能性があると著者らは述べている。
summary_en: A patient with an extragonadal germ cell tumor of mixed type (teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor) later developed a metachronous testicular tumor 7 years afterward. The testicular tumor was a pure seminoma, histologically distinct from the earlier lesion. The long interval and histological differences suggest that the two tumors arose independently rather than as a single tumor spreading. The authors note this may be the first reported case of a testicular tumor occurring metachronously after extragonadal tumor extirpation.

title: Management preferences in stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis: an investigation among patients, controls and oncologists.
title_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における治療選好：患者、対照者、腫瘍専門医への調査
summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者、対照者、腫瘍専門医を対象に、直ちに補助化学療法を受けるか経過観察とするかの選好を質問紙で調査した。再発リスク10〜90%の各水準で選択が変わり、群内でも大きなばらつきがみられた。経験のある選択肢を好む傾向があり、がん患者は対照者より医師に判断を委ねる割合が高かった。医師間のばらつきも患者と同程度であった。
summary_en: This survey study examined how patients, non-cancer controls, and testicular tumour oncologists choose between immediate adjuvant chemotherapy and surveillance for stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. Questionnaires from 207 participants varied recurrence-risk thresholds from 10% to 90%. Preferences varied widely within groups, and subjects favoured options they had experienced. Cancer patients more often preferred the doctor to decide than controls, and oncologists varied as much as patients.

title: Resection of residual retroperitoneal masses in testicular cancer: evaluation and improvement of selection criteria. The ReHiT study group. Re-analysis of histology in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおける残存後腹膜腫瘤の切除：選択基準の評価と改善（ReHiT研究グループ：精巣がんの組織学の再解析）
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんの化学療法後に残存した後腹膜腫瘤に対して郭清を受けた544例のデータを用いた。既存の切除基準の多くは腫瘤径に依存し、偽陽性率が37〜87%と高かった。原発腫瘍の組織型、化学療法前の腫瘍マーカー、腫瘤縮小の程度を加えたロジスティック回帰モデルで判別能が向上した。単純な統計モデルが患者選択の指針としてより優れると結論している。
summary_en: Using data from 544 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for residual masses after chemotherapy for metastatic non-seminomatous testicular cancer, the authors evaluated existing resection criteria. Most rely on mass size, giving high true-positive but 37-87% false-positive rates. A logistic model adding primary histology, pre-chemotherapy AFP, hCG, LDH, and mass shrinkage improved discrimination. The authors conclude a simple statistical model gives better patient selection guidance.

title: CD30 expression in seminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマにおけるCD30発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: Ber-H2抗体を用いて、精巣セミノーマ38例のCD30発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。純粋な古典型セミノーマ21例中4例、混合型腫瘍のセミノーマ成分14例中7例で、セミノーマ細胞に限局したCD30陽性がみられた。精母細胞性セミノーマと精細管内胚細胞腫瘍は陰性であった。CD30発現はセミノーマから胎児性癌への移行を示唆する可能性があると著者らは述べている。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined CD30 expression, using the Ber-H2 antibody, in 38 testicular seminomas, including pure, mixed, and spermatocytic types. CD30 was focally detected in seminoma cells in 4 of 21 pure classic seminomas and in 7 of 14 seminomatous components of mixed tumors. Spermatocytic seminomas and intratubular germ cell neoplasia were negative. The findings support a close relationship between seminoma and embryonal carcinoma, suggesting CD30 expression may indicate seminoma transformation.

title: Extent of apoptosis in relation to p53 and bcl-2 expression in germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるアポトーシスとp53・bcl-2発現との関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣と卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍53例について、in situ 3'末端DNA標識法によるアポトーシスと、p53およびbcl-2の免疫染色を検討した。アポトーシスは胎児性癌で最も多く、次いでセミノーマ、絨毛癌、未熟奇形腫の順であった。成熟奇形腫ではアポトーシス細胞はほとんどみられなかった。p53は腫瘍の62%で発現し、胎児性癌で最も強かった。bcl-2は奇形腫の一部の成分にのみ認められた。
summary_en: This study measured apoptosis by in situ 3'-end DNA labeling in 53 testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors, alongside p53 and bcl-2 immunostaining. Apoptosis was highest in embryonal carcinoma, followed by seminoma, choriocarcinoma, and immature teratoma, while mature teratomas rarely showed apoptotic cells. p53 was expressed in 62% of tumors, strongest in embryonal carcinoma. Bcl-2 appeared only in some teratomatous components. Apoptosis level tracked histologic type, consistent with p53 contributing to apoptosis.

title: [A case of embryonal carcinoma successfully treated by neoadjuvant chemotherapy: report of a case].
title_ja: 術前化学療法により治療に成功した縦隔胎児性癌の1例：症例報告
summary_ja: 咳と呼吸困難を主訴に受診した20歳男性で、前縦隔に巨大腫瘍を認め、下大静脈や左心房への浸潤と血清AFP高値を伴っていた。針生検で原発性縦隔胎児性癌と診断された。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる3コースの化学療法後、腫瘍は縮小しAFPは正常化した。外科的切除に成功し、3年間無病生存している。
summary_en: A 20-year-old man presented with cough and dyspnea and was found to have a large anterior mediastinal tumor invading the inferior vena cava, right pulmonary artery, and left atrium, with elevated serum AFP. Needle biopsy diagnosed primary mediastinal embryonal carcinoma. After three cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, the tumor shrank and AFP normalized. Complete surgical resection was successful, and the patient has remained disease-free for 3 years.

title: Antitumor activity of paclitaxel after failure of high-dose chemotherapy in a patient with late relapse of a non-seminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発で大量化学療法後に不応となった患者に対するパクリタキセルの抗腫瘍効果：症例報告
summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法11コース後に晩期再発した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告する。自家幹細胞救援を伴う大量化学療法は奏効しなかった。肝・肺転移による症状に対しパクリタキセル単剤を投与し、部分奏効を得た。血液毒性は許容範囲内であった。併用療法としての有用性を検討する臨床試験の必要性を指摘している。
summary_en: The authors describe a patient with late relapse of non-seminomatous germ cell tumor who failed high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue after 11 cycles of cisplatin-based treatment. Symptomatic hepatic and pulmonary metastases responded to single-agent paclitaxel with partial remission, and hematologic toxicity was tolerable. The report notes responses to paclitaxel in pretreated germ cell tumor patients and argues for further trials of paclitaxel-containing combination regimens.

title: Detection of chromosomal DNA gains and losses in testicular germ cell tumors by comparative genomic hybridization.
title_ja: 比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションによる精巣胚細胞腫瘍における染色体DNAの増加と減少の検出
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 分裂中の細胞を必要としない比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション(CGH)法で精巣胚細胞腫瘍の一連の症例の染色体異常を解析した。全例で12pの増加がみられ、一部では12p11.2-p12.1の限局的な増幅が認められた。FISHで複数コピーを確認し、癌原遺伝子の候補領域を示した。ほかに2p、4q、6p、19pの増加や13番染色体の欠失も繰り返しみられた。
summary_en: The authors applied comparative genomic hybridization to a series of testicular germ cell tumors to detect chromosomal gains and losses without requiring dividing cells. All tumors showed gain of 12p, and some had restricted 12p11.2-p12.1 amplification confirmed by FISH with a YAC probe showing multiple copies. Recurrent gains at 2p, 4q, 6p, and 19p, gains of chromosomes 8, 14, 21, and X, and loss of chromosome 13 were also found. The study identifies candidate regions for protooncogenes in these tumors.

title: Choriocarcinoma in situ at a first trimester. Report of two cases indicating an origin of trophoblast of a stem villus.
title_ja: 妊娠第1三半期における絨毛癌上皮内病変：幹絨毛由来を示唆する2例の報告
summary_ja: 妊娠初期胎盤に生じた絨毛癌の上皮内病変2例の報告。いずれも胎児を認めず、組織学的に幹絨毛由来の微小な腫瘍性栄養膜細胞結節が確認された。転移はなく、治療を行わずに無病経過をたどった。絨毛癌は幹絨毛の栄養膜細胞に由来しうることを示し、妊娠産物の詳細な顕微鏡検査の重要性を指摘している。
summary_en: Two cases of choriocarcinoma in situ arising in first-trimester placentas are described, in women with no fetus present after dilation and curettage. Histology showed small neoplastic trophoblastic nodules arising from stem villi, composed of cytotrophoblast and syncytiotrophoblast, with no metastases and normal hCG levels. Both patients remained disease-free without therapy during follow-up, one after a subsequent full-term delivery. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma can originate from stem villus trophoblast and recommend thorough microscopic examination of conception products.

title: Adjuvant radiation versus observation: a cost analysis of alternate management schemes in early-stage testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 早期精巣セミノーマに対する補助的放射線療法と観察：費用分析
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの早期病期に対し、精巣摘除術後の観察療法と補助的放射線療法の費用を比較した解析。5年間の医療費は観察療法の方が約39%多く、費用同等点は2.5年であった。治療成績の差は報告されていないとされ、補助的放射線療法の費用面での有用性が示唆されている。
summary_en: This cost analysis compared observation with adjuvant pelvic and para-aortic radiotherapy for early-stage testicular seminoma after inguinal orchiectomy. Charges were reviewed for patients treated with radiation or salvage chemotherapy, and costs were projected over five years with assumed failure rates of 5% and 15%. Observation generated about 39% higher medical costs over five years, and cost equivalence occurred at 2.5 years. The authors note no reported outcome difference between strategies, suggesting that adjuvant radiation may be more cost-effective.

title: [Effective administration of recombinant granulocyte colony-stimulating factor to prevent granulocytopenia due to combination chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors].
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する併用化学療法における顆粒球減少予防のための組換え顆粒球コロニー刺激因子の効果的投与法
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するBEP化学療法の顆粒球減少予防として、組換えG-CSFの投与法を比較したランダム化試験。定期投与は、必要時投与に比べて白血球減少症と口内炎を有意に減少させた。血小板減少症は定期投与群で目立ったが、有意差はなかった。費用や血小板減少が問題となる状況では必要時投与が適しているとされる。
summary_en: This prospective randomized study tested two schedules of recombinant G-CSF in 15 patients receiving BEP chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors. Group A received G-CSF routinely on day 6, while group B received it only after granulocytes fell to 1,500/mm3. Routine administration significantly reduced leukocytopenia and stomatitis compared with the on-demand approach, without notable side effects. Thrombocytopenia was more prominent in group A, though not significantly. The authors suggest the on-demand schedule may suit settings where thrombocytopenia and cost are concerns.

title: HLA class I antigens are expressed by Sertoli cells of intratubular germ cell neoplasia.
title_ja: 精細管内胚細胞腫瘍におけるHLAクラスI抗原はセルトリ細胞に発現する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ5例と、セミノーマ/胎児性癌の混合例1例の凍結検体を、免疫組織化学的にHLAクラスI抗原の発現を検討した。陽性は精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を伴う精細管のみで、PLAP陽性のセルトリ細胞と判定された。浸潤腫瘍細胞や正常精細管は陰性であり、セミノーマへのリンパ球浸潤と免疫監視との関連が考察されている。
summary_en: This study examined HLA class I antigen expression in frozen samples from five seminomas and one combined seminoma/embryonal carcinoma. HLA class I staining was seen only in tubules with intratubular germ cell neoplasia, where it co-localized with PLAP-positive cells identified as Sertoli cells. Invasive tumor cells and normal seminiferous tubules were negative. Staining with anti-beta2-microglobulin paralleled the anti-HLA class I results. The authors interpret these findings in relation to lymphocytic infiltration and immune surveillance of seminomas.

title: Acute abdomen following dermoid cyst rupture during transvaginal ultrasonographically guided retrieval of oocytes.
title_ja: 経膣超音波ガイド下卵子採取中の類皮嚢腫破裂による急性腹症
summary_ja: 体外受精の卵子採取時に経膣超音波ガイド下で類皮嚢腫を穿刺し、急性腹症を発症した女性の症例報告である。発症後の超音波で骨盤内に類皮嚢腫様の腫瘤が確認された。診断的開腹術で破裂した類皮嚢腫と腹膜炎が認められ、手術を要した。卵子採取に伴う稀な合併症として報告されている。
summary_en: The authors report a woman who developed acute abdomen after a dermoid cyst was punctured during transvaginal ultrasound-guided oocyte retrieval for IVF. Ultrasound performed after onset showed a pelvic mass with dermoid features. Diagnostic laparotomy confirmed a ruptured dermoid cyst with subsequent peritonitis, requiring surgery. The case highlights a rare complication of oocyte retrieval involving an ovarian dermoid cyst.

title: Infantile choriocarcinoma: a case report with MRI, angiography and bone scintigraphy.
title_ja: 乳児絨毛癌：磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)、血管造影、骨シンチグラフィーを用いた症例報告
summary_ja: 乳児の絨毛癌症例で、貧血、出血性肝腫瘍、急速な進行による死亡を呈した。母体の絨毛癌も合併していた。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)、血管造影、骨シンチグラフィーを施行し、肝腫瘍への集積増加を認めた。原発巣は今回の妊娠の胎盤と2年前の胞状奇胎の2通りが考えられた。
summary_en: The authors report an infant with choriocarcinoma showing anemia, hemorrhagic liver tumors, rapid progression to death, and maternal choriocarcinoma. Imaging included MRI, angiography and bone scintigraphy, which showed increased uptake by the liver tumors. Two possible primary sites were considered: the placenta of the current pregnancy and a hydatidiform mole present two years earlier. The case illustrates the rarity of infantile choriocarcinoma and the difficulty of identifying its primary site.

title: Testes tumors in a Sub-Saharan African city (Yaounde). Incident cases and histopathology.
title_ja: ヤウンデ（サハラ以南アフリカの都市）における精巣腫瘍：発症例と病理組織学
summary_ja: カメルーンのヤウンデで発生した14例の精巣腫瘍について、組織型と危険因子を検討した研究である。悪性腫瘍は11例で、最多はバーキットリンパ腫であった。セミノーマは3例にとどまった。欧米の報告とは疫学・組織像が大きく異なり、人種と地理的要因の重要性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined histologic types and risk factors in 14 testicular tumors from Yaounde, Cameroon. Eleven were malignant, but Burkitt's lymphoma was the most common lesion rather than germ cell tumor. Only three seminomas were found, and none occurred in black Africans. The authors conclude that the epidemiology and histology differ markedly from other series, with race and geography appearing important, which changes how testicular masses should be approached in this setting.

title: Changing incidence and delay of testicular cancer in southern Norway (1981-1992).
title_ja: 1981～1992年の南ノルウェーにおける精巣がんの発生率の変化と診断遅延
summary_ja: 1981～1992年に南ノルウェーで新規診断された精巣がん352例の診療記録を検討した研究である。発生率は増加したが、診断・治療までの遅延や入院期間は短縮した。術前に約半数で腫瘍マーカーが上昇し、5年生存率は99%であった。患者側の遅延が3か月を超えると生存率が低下し、啓発と資源確保の重要性が示された。
summary_en: This Norwegian population study reviewed medical records of 352 patients with newly diagnosed unilateral testicular cancer across three two-year periods from 1981 to 1992. Incidence rose markedly, while diagnostic and treatment delays and hospitalization time declined. Serum tumour markers were elevated in about half of patients before orchiectomy. Five-year cancer-related survival was 99%, and longer patient delay was associated with reduced survival. The authors call for resource planning, awareness campaigns, and better tumour marker use to shorten delays.

title: Neuroectodermal cyst may be a rare differential diagnosis of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma: first case report of a prenatally observed neuroectodermal cyst.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の稀な鑑別診断となりうる神経外胚葉性嚢胞：出生前に観察された神経外胚葉性嚢胞の初の症例報告
summary_ja: 出生前超音波検査で指摘された胎児の無エコー性腫瘤を、当初は仙尾部奇形腫と考えた症例報告である。帝王切開後の切除標本の病理組織学的所見から、後神経孔由来の神経外胚葉性嚢胞と診断された。仙尾部奇形腫の稀な鑑別診断として重要であり、術後には膀胱神経障害による尿路感染症や肛門括約筋機能障害が生じた。
summary_en: This prenatal case report describes an anechoic fetal intra- and extra-abdominal mass initially suspected to be a sacrococcygeal teratoma. After elective cesarean delivery and excision, histology showed a neuroectodermal cyst arising from the posterior neuropore. The authors highlight this extremely rare entity as a differential diagnosis of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma. Postoperative complications included recurrent urinary tract infections from bladder neurological damage and impaired anal sphincter function.

title: Remission of recurrent mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary after treatment with vincristine, carboplatin, fluorouracil, and ifosfamide: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣の再発性混合型胚細胞腫瘍のビンクリスチン・カルボプラチン・フルオロウラシル・イホスファミドによる寛解：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 卵巣の再発性悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の女性患者に対し、ビンクリスチン、カルボプラチン、フルオロウラシル、イホスファミドによる救済療法を行い、寛解を得た症例報告である。卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍の再発時救済療法の報告は少ない。標準的な救済療法は精巣腫瘍の経験に基づくものであり、患者は6年間寛解を維持している。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman with recurrent malignant mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary who achieved remission after salvage therapy with vincristine, carboplatin, fluorouracil and ifosfamide. The authors note that mixed germ cell tumors make up about 8 percent of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors and that salvage data are limited. The standard salvage regimen, derived from testicular cancer studies, is etoposide, vinblastine, ifosfamide and cisplatin. This combination had not previously been reported for this setting, and the patient remained in remission for six years.

title: Cytological distinction between clear cell carcinoma and yolk sac tumor of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣の明細胞癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の細胞学的鑑別
summary_ja: 卵巣の明細胞癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍は組織学的に類似するが、生物学的挙動は異なる。本研究は両者の細胞学的特徴を比較し、鑑別指標を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は細胞の結合性が低く、多形性や多核巨細胞が目立つ。詳細な細胞診は、臨床情報を補完する鑑別診断の手段になると結論づけている。
summary_en: This cytology study compared clear cell carcinoma and yolk sac tumor of the ovary, two histologically similar but biologically distinct tumors. Imprint smears and ascites or metastatic-site samples from 20 clear cell carcinomas and 3 yolk sac tumors were examined. Clear cell carcinoma cells were more cohesive, less pleomorphic and had well-preserved borders, while yolk sac tumor cells were dyscohesive, markedly pleomorphic and often showed nucleoli and multinucleated giant cells. The authors propose detailed cytology as a useful aid for differential diagnosis.

title: Spermatocytic seminoma: a clinicopathological review of ten patients.
title_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ：10症例の臨床病理学的レビュー
summary_ja: 病理学的に確定された精母細胞性セミノーマの10例を後方視的に検討した研究である。全例が病期Iで、5例は放射線療法、5例はサーベイランスを受けた。追跡期間中央値8年で再発例はなかった。予後は良好であり、この亜群では放射線療法を省略できる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This review describes ten patients with pathologically confirmed spermatocytic seminoma of the testis, all presenting at stage I. Five received radiotherapy and five were managed with surveillance. Median age was 56.5 years and median follow-up was eight years, with no relapses and two deaths from intercurrent disease. The authors conclude that spermatocytic seminoma has a good prognosis and low metastatic potential, and that radiotherapy may be safely omitted in this subgroup since only one relapse has been reported in the literature.

title: Alpha-foetoprotein heterogeneity: what is its value in managing patients with germ cell tumours?
title_ja: αフェトプロテインの不均一性：胚細胞腫瘍の管理における臨床的意義は何か
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍で上昇したAFPを、コンカナバリンAへの結合性によって奇形腫由来と肝由来に区別できるかを論じた報告である。精巣腫瘍の再発例では、この検査の高い特異度を過信したため再発診断が遅れ、患者は死亡した。レクチン結合検査の臨床的有用性は未確立であり、さらなる検証が必要である。
summary_en: This clinical discussion examines whether AFP heterogeneity, assessed by concanavalin A lectin binding, can distinguish teratoma-derived from liver-derived AFP elevation in germ cell tumor patients. The authors present a patient with relapsed testicular germ cell tumor whose management decisions relied on ConA binding results. Overreliance on the presumed high specificity of the test delayed diagnosis of recurrence, and the patient died. They conclude that the clinical utility of lectin binding assays remains uncertain and needs further evaluation.

title: Tumor implantation along abdominal trocar site after pelviscopic removal of malignant ovarian tumor--a case report.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣腫瘍の腹腔鏡下摘出後に腹部トロカール部位に生じた腫瘍播種：症例報告
summary_ja: 腹腔鏡下に摘出された卵巣腫瘤の後、腹部トロカール部位に局所的な腫瘍播種が生じた症例報告である。病理学的には成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌であった。悪性卵巣腫瘍の腹腔鏡下切除では、ポート部位への播種の危険性に留意すべきことを指摘し、文献的な検討も併せて行っている。
summary_en: This case report describes a localized tumor implant at an abdominal trocar site after laparoscopic removal of an ovarian mass. Histology showed squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. The authors highlight the risk of tumor seeding at port sites when malignant ovarian tumors are excised laparoscopically, and briefly review the literature on this complication. Surgeons should consider this possibility when managing malignant ovarian masses with pelviscopic techniques.

title: Intradermal dermoid cyst associated with occult spinal dysraphism.
title_ja: 潜在性脊髄披裂を伴う皮内類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 2歳男児に、腰仙部の先天性皮膚病変として脂肪腫、毛細血管拡張、多毛、皮内の類皮嚢腫が併存した症例を報告。潜在性二分脊椎と椎体の裂隙を伴い、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で脂肪腫は硬膜と連続せず、外科的治療を要する脊髄病変は認めなかった。類皮嚢腫の皮内局在は異例であり、脊髄係留症候群との関連を考察している。
summary_en: Describes a 2-year-old boy with congenital lumbosacral skin lesions combining lipoma, telangiectasia, hypertrichosis and an intradermal dermoid cyst, with occult spina bifida and a vertebral cleft. MRI showed the lipoma extending into the spina bifida region without dural connection and no other spinal lesion requiring surgery. The authors note the unusual intradermal location of the dermoid and discuss lumbosacral dermoid cysts associated with spinal dysraphism.

title: Successful treatment on an out-patient basis of a patient with Down's syndrome and disseminated testicular seminoma.
title_ja: Down症候群に合併した播種性精巣セミノーマの外来治療
summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併し播種性精巣セミノーマを発症した患者を報告。先天性停留精巣により精巣がんのリスクが高い。シスプラチンを含むレジメンは毒性があり入院を要することが多いが、本症例は併用化学療法を外来で完遂し成功した。外来治療の実現可能性を示した点に意義がある。
summary_en: Reports a patient with Down syndrome and disseminated testicular seminoma successfully treated with combination chemotherapy on an outpatient basis. The authors note that undescended testes raise the risk of testicular cancer in Down syndrome. Cisplatin-containing regimens are effective but toxic and usually require hospitalization, so outpatient delivery of this treatment is a notable finding.

title: [Surgical treatment of primary mediastinal tumors in children].
title_ja: 小児原発性縦隔腫瘍の外科的治療
summary_ja: 小児の原発性縦隔腫瘍20例の外科治療成績を報告。悪性10例中3例が胚細胞腫瘍で、未熟奇形腫の1例を除き術後化学療法と放射線療法の後に生存。良性腫瘍は全例完全切除された。気管支原性嚢胞の乳児2例も呼吸窮迫に対する緊急手術で救命された。
summary_en: Reports surgical outcomes in 20 children with primary mediastinal tumors, half benign and half malignant. Among malignant cases, seven were neurogenic and three were germ cell tumors. Benign tumors were completely resected, and most malignant patients survived after postoperative chemotherapy and radiotherapy, except one with immature teratoma. Two infants with bronchogenic cysts underwent emergency surgery for respiratory distress and survived.

title: Isochromosome 12p and maternal loss of 1p36 in a pediatric testicular germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍における12p等染色体と母性由来の1p36欠失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍（胎児性癌）の染色体解析。従来法と蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションを用い、2本の12p等染色体（i(12)(p10)）と母性由来の1p36欠失を一貫して確認した。小児精巣胎児性癌におけるi(12)(p10)の初報告であり、小児胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝学的異常の理解に寄与する。
summary_en: This cytogenetic study of a pediatric testicular germ cell tumor with embryonal carcinoma histology combined conventional karyotyping and fluorescence in situ hybridization. It consistently identified two isochromosomes 12p, i(12)(p10), along with loss of the maternal 1p36 band and other numerical and structural changes, mostly from paracentromeric breaks. The authors report the first description of i(12)(p10) in a pediatric testicular embryonal carcinoma, which may aid understanding of genetic alterations in pediatric germ cell tumors.

title: Bilateral metastatic spread of testicular teratoma to mandibular condyles.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫の両側下顎骨頭への転移
journal: Eur J Cancer B Oral Oncol
summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫が両側の下顎骨頭に転移した症例の報告。全身性悪性腫瘍の既往がある患者に原因不明の顎関節部痛がみられた場合は、局所転移を鑑別に挙げるべきだと提言している。臨床所見と画像所見の特徴を示し、まれな転移様式を報告する。
summary_en: A patient with a known systemic malignancy presented with unexplained pain in both temporomandibular joints. Imaging revealed bilateral metastatic spread of a testicular teratoma to the mandibular condyles. The authors suggest that local metastatic deposits should be considered as a cause of unexplained temporomandibular pain in patients with prior systemic malignancy, and they describe the clinical and radiological features of this rare presentation.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease: a spectrum of radiologic diagnosis.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患：画像診断のスペクトラム
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌）の画像診断をまとめた総説。初期診断には超音波検査が適し、胞状奇胎は嚢胞性と充実性組織の混在として描出される。CTとMRIは筋層浸潤や転移の検出に有用であり、病態の理解が精査・治療方針の判断に役立つと述べている。
summary_en: This review describes the radiologic spectrum of gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma. Ultrasonography is the preferred initial examination, showing molar gestations as alternating cystic and solid tissue filling the uterus. CT and MR imaging are useful for detecting myometrial invasion, parametrial extension, and metastases. The authors emphasize that understanding the pathophysiology and natural history of each modality helps radiologists guide workup and management decisions.

title: Dysgerminoma: the role of conservative surgery.
title_ja: ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）：保存的手術の役割
summary_ja: 1958〜1992年にUCLAで治療された純粋卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ25例の後方視的解析。保存的手術と非保存的手術の間で再発率に有意差はなく、再発は補助療法を受けなかった例に多かった。全生存期間や病期との関係も検討され、妊孕性を希望する患者には保存的手術を推奨している。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 25 pure ovarian dysgerminomas treated at UCLA from 1958 to 1992 examined recurrence and overall survival by type of primary surgery, adjuvant therapy, and stage. Fourteen patients underwent conservative surgery preserving the contralateral ovary. Recurrence rates did not differ significantly between conservative and nonconservative surgery, and most recurrences occurred in patients who received no adjuvant chemotherapy or radiotherapy. The authors recommend conservative surgery for patients desiring fertility.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌26例の治療成績。病期Iは手術のみで管理され、進行例は減量手術後にシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた。最適な減量と低い病期が無病生存の良好な予後因子であった。SCC抗原の連続測定は再発の早期発見に有用とされる。
summary_en: This series analyzed 26 patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Stage I patients were managed with surgery alone, while advanced cases underwent cytoreductive surgery followed by cisplatin-based chemotherapy with or without radiotherapy. Optimal cytoreduction and lower stage were associated with better disease-free survival. Serum SCC antigen rose in recurrences, suggesting that serial monitoring may aid early detection.

title: A case of intrapulmonary teratoma presenting with hair expectoration.
title_ja: 毛髪の喀出を呈した肺内奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 28歳女性が毛髪の喀出を主訴に受診し、肺原発の良性嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された症例報告。病理組織学的所見、臨床所見、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を示す。肺の良性嚢胞性奇形腫は極めてまれで、文献上の報告は約30例に限られる。
summary_en: A 28-year-old woman presented with expectoration of hair and was found to have a benign cystic teratoma of the lung. The authors describe the histopathological, clinical, and CT features of this case. Benign cystic teratomas of the lung are extremely rare, with only about 30 cases previously reported in the literature. The report adds one more example to this limited body of evidence.

title: Middle ear teratoma in a newborn.
title_ja: 新生児の中耳奇形腫
summary_ja: 新生児に生じた先天性中耳奇形腫の症例報告。頸部まで進展し、末梢性の先天性顔面神経麻痺で発見された。小児の奇形腫はまれで、頭頸部発生はさらに珍しい。過去20年で英語文献に報告された2例目とされ、胚細胞腫瘍の頭頸部発生例として位置づけられる。
summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a congenital middle ear teratoma extending into the cervical region. The tumor presented as a peripheral congenital facial palsy. The authors note that teratomas are rare in children and that head and neck location is unusual. They report only the second such case in the English literature in the past 20 years.

title: Amifostine does not alter the antitumor activity of cisplatin in a pre-clinical model of testicular cancer.
title_ja: アミフォスチンは精巣がんの前臨床モデルにおいてシスプラチンの抗腫瘍効果を変化させない
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣がんの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍モデル（ヌードマウス異種移植）を用い、細胞保護薬アミフォスチンがシスプラチンの抗腫瘍効果を妨げるかを検討した。アミフォスチン単独では腫瘍抑制効果はなく、併用群と単独シスプラチン群の腫瘍体積に有意差は認められなかった。腫瘍保護作用はなく、抗腫瘍効果を損なわずに併用できる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This preclinical study tested whether amifostine, a cytoprotective agent, protects against cisplatin antitumor activity in nude mouse xenografts derived from an alkaline phosphatase-positive embryonal carcinoma cell line (H12.1), modeling non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Mice received amifostine alone, amifostine plus cisplatin, or cisplatin alone at maximally tolerated doses. Amifostine alone had no antitumor effect, and tumor volumes with the combination did not differ significantly from cisplatin alone at days 14 or 30. The authors conclude amifostine provides no tumor protection, supporting its use alongside cisplatin in testicular cancer without compromising efficacy.

title: [A case of testicular tumor in a patient with Down's syndrome: a case report].
title_ja: ダウン症候群に合併した精巣腫瘍の1例：症例報告
summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併した20歳男性が、左陰嚢の無痛性腫瘤を主訴に来院した。高位鼠径精巣摘除術が施行され、病理診断は混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。本症例を含め、ダウン症候群に精巣腫瘍を合併した報告17例を文献的に検討した症例報告である。
summary_en: A 20-year-old man with Down syndrome presented with a painless, swollen left scrotal mass and underwent high inguinal orchiectomy. Pathology revealed a mixed germ cell tumor. The authors reviewed 17 previously reported cases of testicular tumor in patients with Down syndrome, including this one, in this case report from a Japanese urology journal. The review highlights the association between Down syndrome and germ cell neoplasia.

title: The expression of the human chorionic gonadotropin beta subunit gene depends on negative control.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニット遺伝子の発現は負の制御に依存する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARおよびJEG-3を用い、hCG βサブユニット遺伝子の発現調節を細胞融合とRT-PCRで解析した。HeLa細胞との融合クローンではhCG-β発現がほとんど消失し、JAR×JEG-3融合クローンでは高発現が維持された。転写産物の多くはβ5遺伝子に由来した。著者らは、非胎盤組織への分化に伴って現れる抑制因子による負の制御を想定している。
summary_en: This cell biology study examined regulation of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) beta subunit genes using choriocarcinoma cell lines JAR and JEG-3, which express high hCG-beta levels, compared with HeLa cells that express little. Cell fusion experiments and RT-PCR showed that hybrids of HeLa with choriocarcinoma cells largely lost hCG-beta expression, whereas JAR x JEG-3 hybrids retained it. Most transcripts came from the beta-5 gene. The authors propose that hCG-beta expression depends on negative control by specific inhibitors that appear as embryonic cells differentiate into nonplacental tissues.

title: Prevalence of contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia in patients with testicular germ cell neoplasms.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における対側精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）の有病率
summary_ja: 片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者1,954例で対側精巣を生検し、精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）は4.9％に認められた。TINは精巣萎縮と強く関連し（リスク4.3倍）、停留精巣の既往も関連したが、多変量解析で独立した因子は萎縮のみであった。TINの多くは萎縮のない精巣に存在し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変とする仮説を支持する結果である。
summary_en: This study screened the contralateral testis by biopsy in 1,954 consecutive patients with unilateral testicular germ cell tumors, finding testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) in 4.9%. TIN was associated with testicular atrophy (4.3-fold risk) and a history of undescended testis, though only atrophy remained independent on multivariate analysis. Most TIN cases occurred without atrophy and in normal-appearing testes, and patients with TIN were younger. The results support TIN as a precursor of testicular germ cell neoplasms.

title: [Two cases of primary mediastinal germ cell tumor].
title_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の2例
summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の2例を報告。1例目は血清AFP高値の26歳男性で、左上葉の一括切除後に術後化学療法を行い、10年間無病生存。2例目は腫瘍マーカー正常の25歳男性で、術前化学療法2コース後の切除標本に生存腫瘍細胞を認めず、術後3か月時点で無病。いずれも良好な経過をたどった。
summary_en: This report describes two patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors. The first, a 26-year-old man with elevated AFP, underwent en-bloc resection of the left upper lobe followed by postoperative combination chemotherapy and has remained disease-free for ten years. The second, a 25-year-old man with normal AFP and hCG, received two cycles of combination chemotherapy before residual tumor resection, and the resected tumor contained no viable tumor cells. Both patients had favorable outcomes.

title: [Combined treatment with resection, intraoperative hypotonic and post-operative systemic chemotherapy using cis-platinum for a mediastinal yolk sac tumor: a case report].
title_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍に対する切除、術中低張化学療法および術後全身化学療法による併用治療：症例報告
summary_ja: 33歳男性の縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。右上葉や心膜に浸潤する大型腫瘍で、組織学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍の特徴を認め、血清AFPも高値であった。部分心膜切除と右上葉楔状切除に加え、術中低張シスプラチン投与、術後のシスプラチン・エトポシド併用化学療法を行い、8か月後に合併症なく退院した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with a large mediastinal tumor invading the right upper lobe, pericardium, and diaphragm. Histology showed endodermal sinus structures, Schiller-Duval bodies, and eosinophilic hyaline globules consistent with yolk sac tumor, and serum AFP was elevated. Treatment combined partial pericardiectomy and right upper lobe wedge resection with intraoperative hypotonic cisplatin, followed by postoperative cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy. The patient was discharged uneventfully eight months later.

title: Nuclear deoxyribonucleic acid ploidy of testicular tumors: peculiar features and clinical significance.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の核DNA倍数性：特徴と臨床的意義
summary_ja: パラフィン包埋の精巣腫瘍と非腫瘍性精巣を用い、フローサイトメトリーで核DNA倍数性を測定した。腫瘍32例のうち59.4%が異数体で、セミノーマは非セミノーマより異数体のDNA指数が高かった。根治的精巣摘除術後、異数体腫瘍の21.1%に転移を認めたが、二倍体・四倍体腫瘍では転移はなかった。
summary_en: This study measured nuclear DNA ploidy by flow cytometry in paraffin-embedded testicular tumors and nontumorous testes. Of 32 tumors, 25% were diploid, 15.6% tetraploid, and 59.4% aneuploid. Among aneuploid tumors, seminomas had a higher DNA index than nonseminomas. After curative orchiectomy, metastases occurred in 21.1% of aneuploid tumors but in none of the diploid or tetraploid tumors. Clinicopathological findings were less predictive than ploidy, and the authors conclude that flow cytometry is useful for characterizing testicular tumors.

title: Results of postchemotherapy adjunctive retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in non-seminomatous germ cell cancer patients.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における化学療法後補助的後腹膜リンパ節郭清の成績
summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍123例を対象に、化学療法後の後腹膜手術の成績を比較した。平均72か月の追跡で、交互療法群の生存率は50%、PEB療法群は79%であった。後腹膜壊死や成人型奇形腫では生存率が高く、残存活性癌では47%にとどまった。残存腫瘍の組織型が予後を予測し、PEB療法が優れると結論された。
summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 123 patients with advanced non-seminomatous germ cell cancer who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal surgery after either a sequential alternating cisplatin-based regimen (1979-1985) or the PEB regimen (1985-1991). After a mean follow-up of 72 months, survival was 50% with the alternating regimen and 79% with PEB. Patients with necrosis or adult teratoma had high survival, while residual active carcinoma had only 47% survival. PEB chemotherapy was judged superior, and residual tumor histology predicted outcome.

title: Testicular microlithiasis associated with seminoma: Gray-scale and color Doppler ultrasound findings.
title_ja: セミノーマを伴う精巣微小石灰化：グレースケールおよびカラードプラ超音波所見
summary_ja: 32歳の不妊男性において、セミノーマに精巣微小石灰化を伴う症例を報告した。グレースケールおよびカラードプラ超音波所見を示し、文献を簡単に考察した。精巣微小石灰化は精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク因子として知られており、超音波検査による評価の重要性が示された。
summary_en: The study reports a 32-year-old infertile man in whom testicular microlithiasis was found together with a seminoma. The authors present the gray-scale and color Doppler ultrasound findings of this case and discuss them in relation to the existing literature, which they briefly review. Because microlithiasis is an established risk marker for testicular germ cell tumors, the report underscores the value of ultrasonography in identifying patients who may need closer follow-up.

title: A case of intraperitoneal testicular cancer with ascites.
title_ja: 腹水を伴う腹腔内精巣がんの1例
summary_ja: 精巣がんが腹腔内に播種し腹水を生じた症例の報告です。腹水細胞診では腫瘍細胞を認めませんでしたが、β-hCGとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は高値でした。病理学的診断がないままシスプラチンを含む併用化学療法を2コース行い、マーカーは正常化し、腹水もCTで消失しました。腹水は播種した精巣がん細胞に由来すると考察されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with intraperitoneal testicular cancer presenting with ascites. Cytology of the ascites showed no tumor cells, but serum beta-hCG and AFP were elevated. Without a pathological diagnosis, the patient received two cycles of cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy, after which both markers normalized and ascites resolved on CT. The authors concluded that the ascites likely originated from disseminated testicular cancer cells in the peritoneum, suggesting that marker-guided treatment can be considered when histology is unavailable.

title: Human trophoblast and choriocarcinoma expression of the growth factor pleiotrophin attributable to germ-line insertion of an endogenous retrovirus.
title_ja: ヒト栄養膜および絨毛癌で発現する内在性レトロウイルス挿入由来の増殖因子プレイオトロフィン
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞では、内在性レトロウイルスの挿入により生じたPTN転写産物HERV-PTNが発現していました。奇形癌細胞株など他系統の細胞では認めません。リボザイムでHERV-PTN mRNAを抑制すると、マウスで絨毛癌の増殖、浸潤、血管新生が抑制されました。HERV-PTNが絨毛癌の攻撃的な増殖を支え、治療標的となりうることが示唆されています。
summary_en: This study shows that human trophoblast and choriocarcinoma cells express HERV-PTN, a pleiotrophin transcript generated by an endogenous retrovirus insertion that creates a trophoblast-specific promoter. HERV-PTN was detected in normal trophoblast and term placenta and in choriocarcinoma cell lines, but not in teratocarcinoma or other lineages. Ribozyme depletion of HERV-PTN mRNA blocked choriocarcinoma growth, invasion, and angiogenesis in mice, suggesting that this transcript supports the aggressive behavior of choriocarcinoma and may be a therapeutic target.

title: HLA antigen sharing in Italian couples in which women were affected by gestational trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: イタリア人夫婦における妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者のHLA抗原共有
summary_ja: 侵入奇胎または絨毛癌の女性とそのパートナー16組と、対照の健康な夫婦30組でHLA型を比較しました。HLA-AおよびBでは差はなく、HLA-DR6の頻度が上昇し、DR座の抗原共有も対照より有意に多くみられました。Bw35-DR5の組み合わせもパートナーで高頻度でした。MHC連鎖遺伝子が妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発症に関与する可能性が示唆されましたが、症例数は少数です。
summary_en: This study compared HLA class I and II antigen typing between 16 couples in which the woman had an invasive mole or choriocarcinoma and 30 fertile control couples. No differences were found for HLA-A and HLA-B antigens, but HLA-DR6 frequency was increased, and HLA-DR antigen sharing between partners was significantly higher in gestational trophoblastic tumor couples. A higher frequency of the Bw35-DR5 combination was also found in partners. The authors concluded that an MHC-linked gene likely influences gestational trophoblastic tumor development, although the sample size was small.

title: A fetus with Down syndrome and intratubular germ cell neoplasia.
title_ja: ダウン症候群の胎児に認められた精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)
summary_ja: 染色体21トリソミーの22週胎児の精巣に精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を認めた症例報告で、この所見は2例目です。ダウン症で精巣胚細胞腫瘍が多いとされる機序が、胎児期早期からすでに働いている可能性が示唆されました。ダウン症の新生児では精巣胚細胞腫瘍の報告がないことから、この上皮内病変は妊娠中に退縮する可能性があると考察されています。
summary_en: This report describes a 22-week-old fetus with trisomy 21 showing intratubular germ cell neoplasia in the testis, the second such fetal case reported. The findings support the idea that the mechanism behind the excess of testicular germ cell tumors in Down syndrome is already active in early fetal life. No neonatal testicular germ cell tumor in trisomy 21 has been reported, so the authors suggest the in situ lesion may regress during gestation, possibly through a controlled mechanism similar to that of transient myeloproliferative syndrome.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma in mature cystic teratoma in a young woman: a diagnostic and management dilemma.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌：若年女性における診断と管理上のジレンマ
summary_ja: 25歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に扁平上皮癌が生じた症例を報告し、診断と治療上の課題を考察しています。悪性転化は通常50～60歳代に多く、扁平上皮癌がこの奇形腫で最も多い悪性腫瘍です。若年の妊孕性のある女性では、この稀な合併症の管理が難しいことが示されています。
summary_en: This report describes a 25-year-old woman with squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, a rare complication usually seen in the fifth and sixth decades. The authors review the epidemiology of malignant transformation, noting that squamous cell carcinoma is the most common malignancy in these teratomas, and discuss the diagnostic and management challenges in a young patient. The paper highlights the difficulty of managing this rare event in reproductive-age women.

title: Abdominal mass in a young woman. Pitfalls and delayed diagnosis. Case report.
title_ja: 若年女性の腹部腫瘤：診断の落とし穴と診断の遅れ（症例報告）
summary_ja: 18歳女性の巨大な卵巣腫瘍の症例報告で、基本的な検査を省いたため診断が遅れた経過が示されています。付属器の胚細胞腫瘍は若年女性に比較的多く、まず身体診察、次いで超音波検査で評価すべきと強調されています。大きな付属器腫瘤の診療における診断の落とし穴を示す報告です。
summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with a massive ovarian tumor whose diagnosis was delayed because basic diagnostic steps were skipped. The authors emphasize that germ cell tumors of the adnexa are relatively common in young women and that evaluation should start with physical examination and proceed to ultrasonography. The report highlights diagnostic pitfalls in managing a large adnexal mass and the importance of using simple, reliable tools before more advanced investigations.

title: Choriocarcinoma in the term placenta: a difficult diagnosis.
title_ja: 正期胎盤における絨毛癌：診断の難しい症例
summary_ja: 死産後の正期胎盤に生じた絨毛癌の症例です。初回の病理組織検査では診断に至らず、11週後の持続する性器出血で行われた搔爬で絨毛癌と確定しました。保存されていた胎盤標本を再検討して診断を確認しています。分娩から治療開始までの期間が予後に大きく影響するため、早期の認識が重要と強調されています。
summary_en: This report describes choriocarcinoma arising in a term placenta after a stillborn delivery, where the initial histological examination failed to make the diagnosis. Eleven weeks later, persistent vaginal bleeding led to curettage that established choriocarcinoma. Reviewing the original placental material confirmed the diagnosis. The authors stress that the interval between delivery and treatment strongly influences prognosis and that mature placentas can be diagnostically difficult to interpret.

title: Gynecomastia as a complication of chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法に伴う女性化乳房の合併症
summary_ja: プラチナ系併用化学療法で完全寛解に至った転移性精巣がん190例中4例に、治療終了後2〜5か月で女性化乳房が生じた。血中hCGβとテストステロンは正常範囲であったが、FSH、LH、エストラジオールは上昇していた。ゴナドトロピン上昇による精巣性エストロゲン分泌の増加が原因と考えられ、再発を意味しないことを認識する重要性が示された。
summary_en: This clinical report examines gynecomastia in 4 of 190 patients with metastatic testicular cancer who achieved complete remission after platinum-based combination chemotherapy. Affected patients had normal beta-hCG and testosterone but elevated FSH, LH, and estradiol, suggesting gonadotropin-driven testicular estrogen secretion. The authors conclude that this treatment-related gynecomastia, appearing months after chemotherapy, does not necessarily indicate relapse, and recognizing it can prevent unnecessary investigations that distress young patients.

title: Attempted preservation of one gonad in patients with bilateral germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 両側胚細胞腫瘍に対する片側生殖腺の温存の試み
summary_ja: 両側性の卵巣ディスジャーミノーマと精巣セミノーマの各1例を報告。病変の軽い側の生殖腺を臓器温存手術で残し、化学療法を併用した。両者とも妊孕性を回復したが、男性例では残存精巣に新たな胚細胞腫瘍が発生した。若年者の両側性腫瘍における本治療戦略の利点と注意点が考察されている。
summary_en: This report describes two patients with bilateral germ cell tumors: a woman with bilateral dysgerminoma and a man with bilateral testicular seminoma. In both, the less affected gonad was preserved by organ-sparing surgery, followed by chemotherapy. Both regained fertility, but the man later developed a new germ tumor in the remaining testicle. The authors discuss the benefits and potential pitfalls of this gonad-preserving approach in young adults, where fertility and hormone production are important.

title: [A clinical study on 109 cases with testicular tumor].
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍109例の臨床的検討
summary_ja: 1970〜1994年に治療された精巣腫瘍109例を検討。胚細胞腫瘍106例のうち純粋セミノーマは61例、非セミノーマ性成分を含むものは45例であった。5年生存率は全体で79.6%であり、1981年以降はCTとシスプラチンを含む化学療法の導入により有意に改善した。
summary_en: This Japanese clinical study reviewed 109 patients with testicular tumors treated between 1970 and 1994. Of 106 germ cell tumors, 61 were pure seminomas and 45 contained non-seminomatous elements, with three non-germinal tumors. Clinical stage I accounted for 80 cases. The 5-year survival was 79.6% overall, and survival improved significantly after 1981, when CT and cisplatin-containing chemotherapy were introduced, compared with before 1980.

title: Investigation of carcinoma in situ cells of testis by quantification of argyrophilic nucleolar organizer region associated proteins (AgNORs).
title_ja: 精巣上皮内癌細胞におけるAgNOR関連タンパク質の定量的検討
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌(CIS)を含む24検体で、AgNOR面積を画像解析により定量した。CISはセルトリ細胞や精原細胞より有意に高値を示し、セルトリ細胞指数1.0が両者の鑑別に有用であった。非セミノーマに伴うCISはセミノーマ由来のものより高値で、形質転換能に亜クローン性の差がある可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This pathology study applied AgNOR silver staining to 24 testicular specimens containing carcinoma in situ (CIS). AgNOR area per nucleus was significantly higher in CIS cells than in Sertoli cells and spermatogonia. A Sertoli cell index above 1.0 helped distinguish CIS from spermatogonia. CIS associated with non-seminoma showed higher AgNOR levels than CIS associated with pure seminoma, suggesting subclonal variation in transformation potential.

title: [Methotrexate in gynecologic oncology].
title_ja: 婦人科腫瘍におけるメトトレキサート
summary_ja: 絨毛癌の初の治癒例から妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の第一選択治療に至るまで、婦人科腫瘍におけるメトトレキサートの役割を総説。作用機序と耐性機構を解説し、非転移例や低リスク転移例の治癒率、高リスク転移性GTDでの多剤併用療法の有用性を示す。子宮頸がんへの併用化学療法にも触れる。
summary_en: This review traces methotrexate's use in gynecologic oncology, from its early role in curing choriocarcinoma to its use in gestational trophoblastic disease. It describes mechanisms of action and resistance, reports cure rates for nonmetastatic and low-risk metastatic disease, and notes the benefit of early multiagent therapy in high-risk metastatic GTD. It also briefly discusses combination chemotherapy in cervical carcinoma.

title: [Etoposide (VP-16) in gynecologic malignancy].
title_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍におけるエトポシド(VP-16)
summary_ja: 卵巣・子宮内膜・子宮頸部のがんに加え、妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるエトポシド(VP-16)の臨床応用を総説。妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対する最も有効な薬剤の一つとされ、単剤または多剤併用で用いられる。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍ではブレオマイシンおよびシスプラチンとの併用で有効性を示し、現在の化学療法で重要な役割を果たしている。
summary_en: This review summarizes the clinical use of etoposide (VP-16) in gynecologic malignancies, including trophoblastic disease and ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancer. Etoposide is described as one of the most effective agents for trophoblastic disease, used alone or in multidrug regimens. It is also active in combination with bleomycin and cisplatin for ovarian germ cell tumors, where it plays an important role in current chemotherapy.

title: [Three cases of resected primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor following six courses of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin (BEP) combination chemotherapy].
title_ja: BEP併用化学療法6コース後に切除した原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の3症例
summary_ja: 原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の3例を報告。全例でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値で、G-CSF支持下にBEP化学療法6コース後、残存腫瘍を肺と心膜を含めて一塊に切除した。切除標本に生存腫瘍細胞はなく、術後5か月から3年9か月の時点で3例とも無病生存している。AFPは著明に低下したものの正常化はしなかった。
summary_en: Three patients with primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor, all with markedly elevated AFP, received six courses of BEP chemotherapy with G-CSF support before resection. CT showed anterior mediastinal masses infiltrating adjacent tissue, and one patient had multiple pulmonary nodules. AFP fell substantially but did not normalize. Residual masses were removed with en-bloc resection of lung and pericardium, and no viable tumor cells were found in the specimens. All three remained disease-free 5 to 45 months after surgery.

title: [Two cases of relapse or refractory germ cell tumor who had been treated with combination chemotherapy of cisplatin and carboplatin].
title_ja: シスプラチンとカルボプラチンの併用化学療法を行った再発または難治性胚細胞腫瘍の2症例
summary_ja: 再発または難治性の胚細胞腫瘍2例に対し、シスプラチンとカルボプラチンによる救済化学療法を施行した。1例は精巣原発の胎児性癌とセミノーマの2回目再発例、もう1例は縦隔原発の難治性胎児性癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍例である。2例中1例で完全奏効が得られ、非血液毒性は許容範囲であった。本療法は胚細胞腫瘍の再発に有用である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Two young men with recurrent or refractory germ cell tumors were treated with salvage combination chemotherapy of cisplatin, carboplatin, and vinblastine. One patient had a testicular tumor with embryonal carcinoma and seminoma after a second relapse. The other had primary refractory mediastinal embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor. One of two patients achieved complete response. Non-hematologic toxicity was tolerable. The authors suggest this regimen may be useful for germ cell tumor recurrence.

title: Testosterone-producing benign cystic teratoma with virilism. A case report.
title_ja: 男性化を伴うテストステロン産生性の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告
summary_ja: 25歳女性が巨大腹部腫瘤と男性化徴候で受診し、テストステロンの上昇を認めた。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では脂液面形成と石灰化を伴う腫瘤が確認された。30cmの左卵巣腫瘤を摘出したところ、卵巣静脈血中のテストステロン値は著明に高値で、病理学的には成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。術後にテストステロン値は正常化した。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が男性化を来す例はまれである。
summary_en: A 25-year-old woman with virilism and a large abdominal mass had elevated testosterone and creatinine, along with anemia and right kidney obstruction. CT showed a mass with fat-fluid levels and calcifications. Surgery removed a 30-cm left ovarian mass, and left ovarian vein testosterone was markedly elevated. Pathology showed a mature cystic teratoma, and testosterone normalized after surgery. The authors note that androgen production and virilization are rare but possible with mature cystic teratoma.

title: Choriocarcinoma of the ovary in a post-menopausal woman.
title_ja: 閉経後女性に生じた卵巣絨毛癌
summary_ja: 閉経後の50歳女性に生じた卵巣絨毛癌の1例。開腹時に大きな壊死性卵巣腫瘤として認められた。妊娠関連と非妊娠関連の卵巣絨毛癌の鑑別の難しさを論じ、両者の予後の違いを説明するため細胞遺伝学的検討の必要性を指摘している。本稿は症例報告である。
summary_en: A 50-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with choriocarcinoma of the ovary, which appeared at laparotomy as a large necrotic ovarian mass. The report focuses on the difficulty of distinguishing gestational from non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma. The authors note that these two entities may differ in prognosis and call for cytogenetic studies to clarify the reasons for this difference.

title: Silibinin protects against cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity without compromising cisplatin or ifosfamide anti-tumour activity.
title_ja: シリビニンは、シスプラチンまたはイホスファミドの抗腫瘍活性を損なうことなく、シスプラチン誘発性腎毒性から保護する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: シリビニンをシスプラチン投与前に与えたラットでは、糸球体および尿細管の腎毒性が有意に軽減された。ヒト由来の胚細胞腫瘍細胞株3種では、シリビニンはシスプラチンと4-ヒドロペルオキシイホスファミドの抗腫瘍活性を阻害しなかった。著者らは、精巣がん患者を対象とした無作為化臨床試験の基礎になると結論している。
summary_en: This study tested whether the flavonoid silibinin protects against cisplatin-induced kidney injury in rats without reducing anti-tumour activity. When given before cisplatin, silibinin reduced glomerular and tubular toxicity markers, and it had no effect alone. In three human testicular cancer cell lines, silibinin did not blunt the cytotoxicity of cisplatin or 4-hydroperoxy-ifosfamide. The authors conclude that these findings support a randomised clinical trial of silibinin in patients with testicular cancer receiving cisplatin.

title: Sertoli cells, but not tumor cells, of seminoma in situ express ICAM-1.
title_ja: 上皮内セミノーマにおけるセルトリ細胞のICAM-1発現:腫瘍細胞は発現しない
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: セミノーマ6例と混合型腫瘍1例について、接着分子ICAM-1、VCAM-1、ELAM-1の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。ICAM-1は精細管内胚細胞腫瘍のセルトリ細胞に発現し、腫瘍性胚細胞には発現しなかった。VCAM-1とELAM-1は主に内皮細胞に限局していた。これらの所見を、リンパ球浸潤、免疫監視、精細管上皮に対するT細胞寛容の観点から論じている。
summary_en: Immunohistochemistry was used to examine ICAM-1, VCAM-1 and ELAM-1 in six seminomas and one mixed seminoma/embryonal carcinoma, along with surrounding testicular tissue. ICAM-1 was expressed by Sertoli cells in intratubular germ cell neoplasia but not by neoplastic germ cells, while inflammatory cells and endothelium also expressed it. VCAM-1 and occasionally ELAM-1 were confined to endothelial cells. The authors relate these patterns to lymphocytic infiltration, immune surveillance, and T-cell tolerance in the immunoprivileged seminiferous epithelium.

title: Primary treatment in stage II non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis: a matter of scalpel or drug infusion?
title_ja: 精巣の病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における初期治療:手術か薬物療法か
summary_ja: 低腫瘍量(5cm以下)の後腹膜転移を有する病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の初期治療を論じている。北米では後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)が、欧州では化学療法が主流である。精巣摘除術後に腫瘍マーカーが正常の場合は初回RPLNDが適切と考えられる。治療選択は毒性や患者の希望を含めた費用対効果とリスク対効果に基づくと述べている。
summary_en: This paper discusses primary treatment for low-volume (5 cm or less) retroperitoneal metastases in stage II non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. North American practice favors primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, while Europe favors chemotherapy. After orchiectomy with normal tumor markers, primary RPLND seems most appropriate for staging. Roughly one-third of patients in each approach need the other, so decisions weigh cost, risk, toxicity and patient preference.

title: Case report: malignant teratoma in the thyroid gland.
title_ja: 甲状腺の悪性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 35歳女性の甲状腺悪性奇形腫の症例報告である。全甲状腺摘出術の直後に局所再発を来し、化学療法と局所放射線療法で局所制御は得られたものの、その後遠隔再発に至った。稀な疾患であり、術後の局所再発と転移の頻度が高い点が強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with malignant teratoma of the thyroid gland, a rare and highly aggressive tumour. Local recurrence occurred immediately after total thyroidectomy. Local control was achieved with chemotherapy and local radiotherapy, but distant relapse developed later. The authors emphasise the high frequency of local recurrence and metastasis after surgery in this rare entity, illustrating its aggressive clinical course.

title: The role of paclitaxel in chemosensitive urological malignancies: current strategies in bladder cancer and testicular germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 化学感受性を有する泌尿器悪性腫瘍におけるパクリタキセルの役割：膀胱がんと精巣胚細胞腫瘍における現在の戦略
summary_ja: パクリタキセルの泌尿器悪性腫瘍における役割を総説したもの。膀胱がんでは一次治療として高い奏効率が示され、シスプラチン抵抗性の精巣がんでは単剤の奏効率は約26%であった。TIP療法の後に末梢血幹細胞救援を伴う大量化学療法を行う救済療法として用いられている。
summary_en: This review examines paclitaxel in chemosensitive urological malignancies, focusing on bladder cancer and testicular germ cell tumours. In bladder cancer, paclitaxel combinations achieve high response rates as first-line therapy for metastatic disease. In cisplatin-refractory testicular cancer, single-agent response rates were about 26 percent. Paclitaxel combined with cisplatin and ifosfamide (TIP) is used for salvage therapy, followed by high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue.

title: Lectin binding as a prognostic indicator in gestational trophoblastic diseases (GTD).
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の予後指標としてのレクチン結合性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の掻爬直後の悪性度評価法として、ジャックフルーツレクチン結合性を検討した研究。GTDでは正常胎盤より強い結合を示し、遺残病変では細胞異型を伴って強く拡散性に結合した。血清β-hCGの下降パターンと相関し、ハイリスク病変の同定や治療計画への応用が期待される。
summary_en: This study evaluated jackfruit lectin binding as a rapid, inexpensive marker of aggressiveness in gestational trophoblastic disease immediately after evacuation. Lectin binding was higher in GTD than in normal placentae, and persisting lesions showed intense, diffuse binding with cytological atypia. The lectin score correlated with the regression pattern of serum beta-hCG rather than initial levels, suggesting it may identify high-risk lesions and guide early treatment planning.

title: Uterine cervical clear-cell adenocarcinoma with a choriocarcinomatous component: a case report.
title_ja: 絨毛癌成分を伴う子宮頸部明細胞腺癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 膣出血で受診した55歳女性の子宮頸部腫瘍で、明細胞腺癌と絨毛癌の2成分からなる症例報告。組織学的所見から、絨毛癌成分は既存の明細胞腺癌から化生過程を経て生じたと考えられた。胚細胞腫瘍以外の癌の中に絨毛癌成分が生じる稀な混合型腫瘍である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old woman who presented with vaginal bleeding and a cervical tumour composed of two components: clear-cell adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma. Histology suggested that the choriocarcinomatous component arose from the pre-existing clear-cell adenocarcinoma through a metaplastic process. The case illustrates a rare mixed tumour in which a choriocarcinoma element develops within a non-germ cell carcinoma.

title: Mucinous cystadenocarcinoma with sarcoma-like mural nodules arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた肉腫様壁在結節を伴う粘液性嚢胞腺癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた、肉腫様の壁在結節を伴う粘液性嚢胞腺癌の極めて稀な症例報告。奇形腫の悪性転化の多くは扁平上皮癌であり、本例の組織型は非典型的である。卵巣奇形腫の悪性転化の多様性と非典型例の認識の重要性が示されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a very rare mucinous cystadenocarcinoma with sarcoma-like mural nodules arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Most reported malignant transformations of ovarian teratomas are squamous cell carcinomas, so this histological type is unusual. The authors highlight the diversity of malignant transformation patterns in ovarian teratoma and the importance of recognising atypical variants.

title: Metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma of the skin. Report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の皮膚転移：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 精巣の純粋型絨毛癌を有する22歳日本人男性で、多発する紅色皮膚結節が転移と確認された症例。皮疹出現から3か月後に死亡した。文献的検討では絨毛癌の皮膚転移は既報が7例のみで、結節型を呈し予後不良とされている。
summary_en: This report describes a 22-year-old Japanese man with pure testicular choriocarcinoma who developed multiple reddish cutaneous nodules, confirmed as metastases with the typical histology of the primary tumour. He died three months after the onset of skin metastasis. A literature review identified only seven previous cases of cutaneous choriocarcinoma metastasis, which usually present as nodular lesions and carry a poor prognosis.

title: Mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: a clinicopathologic study of 283 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の臨床病理学的研究：283例
summary_ja: 1988〜1993年に国立台湾大学病院で手術を受けた卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫283例の後方視的研究です。原発性卵巣腫瘍の32.6%を占め、平均年齢は35.4歳でした。主訴は疼痛が最多で、16.6%は無症状で発見されました。合併症では捻転が9.2%と最も多く、悪性転化は0.7%（扁平上皮癌）でした。悪性転化は閉経後女性に多く、予後は不良とされています。
summary_en: This retrospective single-institution series reviewed 283 consecutive mature cystic teratomas of the ovary treated at National Taiwan University Hospital from 1988 to 1993. Mature cystic teratoma accounted for 32.6% of primary ovarian neoplasms, with a mean age of 35.4 years. Pain was the most common complaint, and 16.6% of cysts were found incidentally. Torsion (9.2%) was the most frequent complication. Malignant transformation, usually to squamous cell carcinoma, occurred in 0.7% of cases, and the authors note it is more common in postmenopausal women with a poorer prognosis.

title: Beware the undescended testis and abdominal mass.
title_ja: 停留精巣と腹部腫瘤に注意せよ
summary_ja: 停留精巣に発生したセミノーマの5例を、文献レビューとともに報告しています。思春期後の停留精巣患者では、年齢にかかわらず精巣摘除術を推奨すると述べています。フォローアップが困難であること、また腫瘍治療が奏効しない可能性があることが理由です。腹部腫瘤を呈する患者では、停留精巣を念頭に置くよう注意を喚起しています。
summary_en: Five patients presenting with seminoma arising in an undescended testis are described, alongside a literature review. The authors advocate orchidectomy for post-pubertal patients with cryptorchidism regardless of age. Their rationale is that follow-up can be difficult and that treatment of the tumour may be unsuccessful. The report warns clinicians to consider an undescended testis in patients who present with an abdominal mass.

title: Phase I/II trial of carboplatin dose escalation in combination chemotherapy with etoposide, bleomycin and GM-CSF support for poor prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors patients.
title_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対するカルボプラチン増量併用化学療法（エトポシド、ブレオマイシン、GM-CSF支持）の第I/II相試験
summary_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍24例を対象に、カルボプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン（CEB）の併用療法でカルボプラチンを増量する第I/II相試験を行いました。骨髄抑制のため推奨用量は500 mg/m²で、完全奏効率は71%でした。治療成績は標準的なシスプラチン併用化学療法を上回らず、今後は糸球体濾過量に基づく用量設定が必要とされています。
summary_en: This phase I/II trial tested dose escalation of carboplatin combined with etoposide and bleomycin, with GM-CSF support, as initial therapy for poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors in 24 patients. Myelosuppression limited the dose to 500 mg/m2, and the complete response rate was 71%. Response was higher at carboplatin doses above 400 mg/m2 (92% vs 50%). However, the authors concluded that outcomes were no better than standard cisplatin-based chemotherapy. They recommend that future carboplatin dosing be calculated from glomerular filtration rate.

title: Down syndrome associated with a retroperitoneal teratoma and Morgagni hernia.
title_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫およびモルガーニヘルニアを伴うダウン症候群
summary_ja: ダウン症候群の患者に後腹膜奇形腫とモルガーニヘルニアが合併した症例を報告した短報です。ダウン症候群に関連する悪性腫瘍としては白血病が最も多いと述べています。詳しい治療経過やフォローアップの記載はありません。性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍と先天性横隔膜欠損が併存した稀な例として参考になります。
summary_en: This brief case report describes a patient with Down syndrome who had both a retroperitoneal teratoma and a Morgagni hernia. The authors note that leukaemia is the most common malignancy associated with Down syndrome. The report gives no detailed treatment course or follow-up data. It is relevant because it documents an extragonadal germ cell tumour coexisting with a congenital diaphragmatic defect in a patient with Down syndrome.

title: The management of dermoid cysts--a comparative study of laparoscopy and laparotomy.
title_ja: 類皮嚢腫の管理――腹腔鏡手術と開腹手術の比較研究
summary_ja: 良性卵巣類皮嚢腫の女性38例を、腹腔鏡手術群18例と開腹手術群20例に分けて比較した。腹腔鏡手術は手術時間が長かったが、入院期間は有意に短かった。両群とも合併症はみられず、腹腔鏡手術は安全で有効な方法と結論づけられている。
summary_en: This study compared laparoscopy with laparotomy for removing benign ovarian dermoid cysts in 38 women, allocated 18 to laparoscopy and 20 to laparotomy. Operating time was longer with laparoscopy (93.6 ± 23.8 min), while hospitalization was significantly shorter (22.4 ± 6.6 h). No complications occurred in either group. The authors conclude that operative laparoscopy is a safe and effective alternative to laparotomy for removing ovarian dermoid cysts.

title: [Clinical study of testicular cancer].
title_ja: 精巣がんの臨床的検討
summary_ja: 1986年から1995年にかけて登録された精巣胚細胞腫瘍148例を前向きに検討した。内訳はセミノーマ99例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍49例であった。病期I・IIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍などでは5年生存率が高かったが、病期IIIのセミノーマでは5年生存率が0%であり、進行例では新たな治療法の導入が必要と結論づけられた。
summary_en: This prospective study from the Nara Uro-Oncology Research Group enrolled 148 patients with germ cell tumor of the testis between 1986 and 1995, including 99 seminomas and 49 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Five-year survival was 100% for stage I seminoma and for stage I and II NSGCT, 75% for stage II seminoma, 0% for stage III seminoma, and 66.7% for stage III NSGCT. The authors conclude that new treatment modalities should be introduced for advanced disease.

title: Mitotic frequency in different early stages of testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの初期病期における有糸分裂頻度
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの早期段階ごとに有糸分裂頻度を比較した研究である。上皮内癌の0.65%から充実性セミノーマの3.59%へと、腫瘍の発育とともに増加した。組織の区画により増殖挙動が異なり、微小環境への適応と解釈されている。早期セミノーマの増殖動態に関する知見を補うものである。
summary_en: This study examines mitotic frequency across defined early stages of testicular seminoma: carcinoma in situ, intratubular seminoma, intratubular seminoma with interstitial cells, and solid seminoma. Mitotic frequency rose progressively with tumor development, from 0.65% in carcinoma in situ to 3.59% in solid seminoma. Tumor cells in different tissue compartments showed different proliferation behavior. The authors interpret these differences as adaptation to changing tissue microenvironments, adding to limited data on early seminoma kinetics.

title: Pregnancy achieved by intracytoplasmic sperm injection using cryopreserved semen from a man with testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者の凍結保存精液を用いた卵細胞質内精子注入法(ICSI)による妊娠成立
summary_ja: 右精巣セミノーマに対する摘除術と放射線療法後に無精子症となった男性の凍結保存精液を用い、ICSIによる妊娠・出産に至った症例報告である。放射線療法前の精液による人工授精は3回失敗していた。融解後の運動性が極めて低かったためICSIを選択し、12個中8個の卵子で正常受精が得られた。治療前の精子凍結保存の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This report describes a successful pregnancy after intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) using cryopreserved semen from a man treated for right testicular seminoma with orchidectomy and radiotherapy. He was azoospermic after treatment. Earlier intrauterine insemination failed three times with pre-radiotherapy semen, and IVF with ICSI was then performed because post-thaw motility was poor. A healthy male infant was delivered at 39 weeks. The authors advise cryopreserving sperm before cancer treatment regardless of quality.

title: Metastatic seminoma simulating malignant lymphoma in an HIV infected hemophiliac.
title_ja: 悪性リンパ腫に類似したHIV感染血友病患者の転移性セミノーマ
summary_ja: HIV感染血友病患者に生じた転移性セミノーマの、知られている限り初の症例報告である。頸部・腋窩リンパ節腫脹が悪性リンパ腫に類似していた。頸部リンパ節の穿刺吸引生検と切除生検により確定診断された。HIV関連リンパ節腫脹の鑑別診断では転移性胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきと強調している。
summary_en: This report describes the first known case of metastatic seminoma in an HIV-infected hemophiliac. Cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy simulated malignant lymphoma. Fine needle aspiration of a cervical node showed a mixture of lymphocyte-like cells and loosely cohesive large tumor cells in a tigroid background. Immunocytochemistry and excisional biopsy confirmed the diagnosis. The authors emphasize that metastatic germ cell tumors should be included in the differential diagnosis of HIV-related lymphadenopathy.

title: [Matured mediastinal teratoma with high levels of tumor markers in cystic fluid].
title_ja: 嚢胞液中に腫瘍マーカーの高値を認めた成熟縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 胸部X線で縦隔陰影を指摘された42歳女性の、縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例報告である。嚢胞液では癌胎児性抗原が550 ng/mlと著明に高値で、8種類の腫瘍マーカーが上昇していた。免疫組織化学で腫瘍マーカーの局在を確認した。術後2週間で血清の癌胎児性抗原は正常化し、奇形腫の多様な細胞成分との関連が示唆された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with a mediastinal abnormality on chest X-ray. Resection revealed an 11 cm mature teratoma containing pancreatic tissue, collagen, squamous epithelium and hair follicles. Cystic fluid showed markedly elevated carcinoembryonic antigen (550 ng/mL) and high levels of eight tumor markers, including CA125, CA19-9 and NSE, which were localized by immunohistochemistry. Serum carcinoembryonic antigen normalized within two weeks after surgery, suggesting the markers reflected the tumor's various cellular components.

title: Clonal analysis of sacrococcygeal "teratomas".
title_ja: 仙尾部「奇形腫」のクローン解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 以前に奇形腫と診断された先天性仙尾部腫瘤3例について、X染色体不活化を用いたPCRでクローン性を解析した。充実性未熟奇形腫1例は単クローン性であった。主に嚢胞性で組織学的に成熟した腫瘤は多クローン性であった。仙尾部の未熟奇形腫は単クローン性の腫瘍であり、一部の成熟奇形腫は過誤腫とみなすのが適切と結論している。
summary_en: This study uses a PCR-based assay for nonrandom X chromosome inactivation to determine the clonality of three congenital sacrococcygeal masses previously diagnosed as teratomas. One solid immature teratoma was monoclonal. A predominantly cystic, histologically mature mass was polyclonal, and a third immature teratoma was noninformative. The authors confirm that sacrococcygeal immature teratomas appear to be monoclonal neoplasms and suggest that some mature teratomas may be better classified as hamartomas.

title: Autocrine mechanism of epidermal growth factor in choriocarcinoma cell proliferation.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞増殖における上皮増殖因子(EGF)の自己分泌機構
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株4種でEGFとEGF受容体の発現を調べ、NaUCC-4で自己分泌性の増殖経路が働くことを示した。抗EGF・抗EGFR抗体は増殖を抑制したが、hCG産生には影響せず、EGFは分化よりも増殖を促すことが示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined EGF and EGFR expression in four choriocarcinoma cell lines, including NaUCC-4, which showed the highest EGF binding and immunoreactive EGF. Exogenous EGF stimulated DNA synthesis, and anti-EGF or anti-EGFR antibodies inhibited it, indicating an autocrine loop promoting proliferation. The antibodies did not affect hCG production, suggesting EGF drives proliferation rather than differentiation. The findings point to EGF/EGFR signaling as a potential therapeutic target in choriocarcinoma.

title: High-dose chemotherapy in germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における大量化学療法
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する幹細胞支持下の大量化学療法を総説し、再発例の救援療法と予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍への初回地固め療法を検討した。予後因子として病勢、原発部位、前治療効果、治療前血清hCGを挙げ、難治例では効果が乏しいと述べる。
summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell support in germ cell tumors, covering salvage use in relapsed disease and first-line consolidation in poor-risk non-seminomatous tumors. Prognostic factors include disease status, primary site, prior response, and pretreatment serum hCG. Patients without adverse factors had over 50% cure rates, while refractory disease did not benefit. Ongoing randomized trials and new strategies such as repeated cycles and paclitaxel are discussed.

title: A randomized trial of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (PEB) versus carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (CEB) for patients with 'good-risk' metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 「良好リスク」転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者に対するシスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン(PEB)療法とカルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン(CEB)療法のランダム化比較試験
summary_ja: 予後良好な転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍54例を対象に、PEB療法とCEB療法をランダム化比較した。完全寛解率に差はなかったが、再発率はCEBで高く、早期中止となった。カルボプラチンはシスプラチンの代替にならず、PEBが標準であると結論づけた。
summary_en: This randomized German trial compared cisplatin-etoposide-bleomycin (PEB) with carboplatin-etoposide-bleomycin (CEB) in 54 patients with good-risk metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Complete response rates were similar (81% vs 76%), but relapse was more frequent after CEB (32% vs 13%), and CEB-treated patients had more deaths from progression. The trial was stopped early for excess negative events. The authors conclude carboplatin cannot replace cisplatin, and PEB remains the standard.

title: Choriocarcinoma in infant and mother: a case report.
title_ja: 母体と乳児における絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠中の母体に生じた妊娠性絨毛癌が新生児に転移した症例を報告した。新生児は貧血と肝腫大で発症し、38日齢で死亡し剖検で診断された。母体は産後に肺と肝臓への広範な転移を来した。新生児の貧血や肝腫大では母児のhCG測定が有用と指摘する。
summary_en: This case report describes gestational choriocarcinoma in a pregnant woman with metastases to her infant. The neonate presented with severe anemia and hepatomegaly, progressed rapidly despite treatment, and died at 38 days; autopsy established the diagnosis. The mother later developed widespread lung and liver metastases. The authors advise checking maternal and infant hCG levels when a neonate has anemia or hepatomegaly, to detect an occult maternal tumor.

title: Surveillance versus adjuvant chemotherapy in stage I non-seminomatous testicular cancer: a decision analysis.
title_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんにおけるサーベイランス対補助化学療法：意思決定分析
summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんで、経過観察と補助化学療法のどちらが適切かを意思決定分析で比較した。患者では再発率50%超、医師では73%超で補助化学療法が優先された。患者の選好を考慮すると補助化学療法をより多く検討すべきと結論づけた。
summary_en: This decision analysis compared surveillance with adjuvant chemotherapy for stage I non-seminomatous testicular cancer, using probabilities from the literature and expert input. Utilities were obtained from 68 patients and 50 clinicians. Adjuvant chemotherapy was preferred at relapse rates above 50% using patient utilities and above 73% using clinician utilities. Stated preference questions yielded lower thresholds, suggesting patient preferences should be considered when choosing adjuvant treatment.

title: Multidrug resistance of testis cancers: the study of clinical relevance of P-glycoprotein expression.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の多剤耐性：P-糖タンパク質発現の臨床的意義の検討
summary_ja: 未治療の精巣胚細胞腫瘍48例でP-糖タンパク質の発現を免疫染色で評価した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の53%が陽性で、セミノーマの14%より多かった。発現は進行病期と化学療法抵抗性に相関し、治療前の評価が予後不良例の同定に有用と考えられた。
summary_en: This study measured P-glycoprotein expression by immunostaining in 48 untreated primary germ cell testicular tumors. P-gp was found in 53% of non-seminomatous tumors but only 14% of seminomas. Expression correlated with advanced stage and with chemotherapy resistance. The authors propose that pretreatment P-gp assessment could identify patients with worse prognosis and less chemosensitivity.

title: Analysis of risk factors for postmolar trophoblastic disease: categorization of risk factors and effect of prophylactic chemotherapy.
title_ja: 奇胎後絨毛性疾患のリスク因子の解析：リスク因子の分類と予防的化学療法の効果
summary_ja: 完全奇胎妊娠140例を後方視的に解析し、奇胎後絨毛性疾患(PMTD)の危険因子を低・中等度・高リスク群に分類した。高リスク群では予防的化学療法により寛解までの期間が短縮し、PMTD発症も有意に減少した。低・中等度リスク群では効果は認められず、高リスク患者への予防的化学療法の有用性が示唆された。
summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 140 complete molar pregnancies treated at Yonsei University College of Medicine. Risk factors for postmolar trophoblastic disease (PMTD) were ranked by frequency and patients were stratified into low-, medium-, and high-risk groups. In high-risk patients, prophylactic chemotherapy significantly shortened time to remission and reduced PMTD occurrence. No benefit was seen in low- or medium-risk groups, supporting prophylactic chemotherapy for patients meeting high-risk criteria.

title: Laparoscopic techniques for extracting ovarian teratomas.
title_ja: 良性卵巣奇形腫の腹腔鏡下摘出術
summary_ja: 良性卵巣奇形腫の腹腔鏡下摘出を、5cm以下にはポーチ法、5cm超には温水による吸引洗浄を併用する方法で行った。内容物の漏出は腹腔の洗浄と歯などの固形物の除去で対処した。両手技とも合併症は報告されておらず、手技の詳細を示す臨床報告である。
summary_en: This study describes two laparoscopic techniques for extracting benign ovarian teratomas. For cysts up to 5 cm, a pouch technique with partial extraction and stab incisions to empty contents was used; for larger cysts, endoscopic aspiration with hot water irrigation preceded partial extraction. Spillage was managed by extensive peritoneal lavage and removal of debris, including teeth. No complications were reported with either method.

title: Laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy for a benign teratoma in a 10-year-old girl.
title_ja: 10歳女児の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢胞摘出術
summary_ja: 8cmの成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有する10歳女児に対し、卵巣温存を目的とした外来での腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術を施行した症例報告である。患者は24時間で完全に回復した。小児の適切に選択された症例において、腹腔鏡手術が保存的治療として有効である可能性が示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old girl diagnosed with an 8-cm mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. She underwent an outpatient ovary-conserving laparoscopic cystectomy and recovered fully within 24 hours. The authors suggest that laparoscopy can be an effective conservative approach for selected gynecologic disorders in children. The report highlights the feasibility of ovary-sparing surgery in pediatric patients with benign ovarian teratoma.

title: Laparoscopic conservative removal of ovarian dermoid cysts.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡下保存的摘出術
summary_ja: 妊孕性温存を希望する41例の卵巣類皮嚢腫に対し、腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出の剥離法を比較した。アクアディセクションは鈍的剥離とハサミより手術時間が短く、術中の内容物漏出も有意に少なかった。両法とも合併症はなく、腹腔鏡手術は安全で有効な管理法と結論された。
summary_en: This study compared two dissection methods for laparoscopic cystectomy of ovarian dermoid cysts in 41 women aged 17 to 38 who wished to preserve fertility. Aquadissection shortened operative time (59.3 vs 78.4 minutes) and significantly reduced intraoperative spillage compared with blunt dissection and scissors. Neither method caused complications, and hospital stay was similar. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is a safe and effective approach for managing ovarian dermoid cysts.

title: Detection and enrichment of carcinoma-in-situ cells in semen by an immunomagnetic method using monoclonal antibody M2A.
title_ja: モノクローナル抗体M2Aを用いた免疫磁気法による精液中の上皮内がん細胞の検出と濃縮
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: セミノーマと上皮内がんに特異的なモノクローナル抗体M2Aを用いた免疫磁気法で、精液からCIS細胞を濃縮する方法を開発した。CIS患者では対照者より大型円形細胞が有意に多く回収された。精巣CISの非侵襲的スクリーニングへの応用が期待される。
summary_en: The authors developed an immunomagnetic method using monoclonal antibody M2A, specific for seminoma and carcinoma-in-situ (CIS), to enrich CIS cells from semen. Spiked HEY cells were recovered selectively in preliminary experiments. Applied to ejaculates from five CIS patients and 22 controls, large round cells were recovered in significantly higher numbers from CIS patients, with no overlap between groups (p < 0.001). The approach could support future non-invasive screening for testicular CIS.

title: Laparoscopic management of benign cystic teratomas during pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠中の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡下外科的管理
summary_ja: 妊娠9〜17週で腹腔鏡下に良性嚢胞性奇形腫を摘出した12例を後方視的に検討した。嚢胞破裂は93%で生じたが、慎重な操作と骨盤内の十分な洗浄で化学性腹膜炎を回避できた。母体・胎児の合併症はなく、妊娠中の腹腔鏡下摘出の安全性が示された。
summary_en: This retrospective review examined 12 pregnant women who underwent laparoscopic removal of benign cystic teratomas at 9 to 17 weeks of gestation. Cysts measured 5 to 13 cm, and rupture occurred intraoperatively in 93% of patients. Careful technique and copious pelvic irrigation prevented chemical peritonitis. Mean operating time was 87 minutes, and no maternal or fetal complications occurred, supporting the safety of laparoscopic removal of ovarian cystic teratoma during pregnancy.

title: Phase II study of paclitaxel in patients with relapsed or cisplatin-refractory testicular cancer.
title_ja: 再発またはシスプラチン抵抗性の精巣がんに対するパクリタキセルの第II相試験
summary_ja: 再発またはシスプラチン抵抗性の転移性精巣がん患者24例にパクリタキセルを投与した第II相試験である。25%で奏効が得られ、完全奏効は2例であった。主な毒性は顆粒球減少症と末梢神経障害であった。パクリタキセルは有意な抗腫瘍活性を示し、併用療法の検討に値すると結論された。
summary_en: This phase II trial evaluated paclitaxel in 24 men with relapsed or cisplatin-refractory metastatic testicular cancer, most of whom had prior platinum-based chemotherapy. Six patients (25%) responded, including two complete responses, and five had stable disease. Median response duration was 8 months. Main toxicities were granulocytopenia and grade II or higher peripheral neuropathy. The authors conclude that paclitaxel has meaningful activity and that combination regimens may be worth exploring.

title: Testicular microlithiasis: case report and discussion of management under special consideration of testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化：症例報告と精巣胚細胞腫瘍を考慮した管理に関する考察
