summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 48 patients with stage II testicular seminoma (28 IIA, 20 IIB) evaluated post-orchiectomy management. Three-year survival was 82% for IIA and 75% for IIB. Relapse occurred in 28% and 35%, respectively. Radiotherapy was the mainstay, and salvage chemotherapy succeeded in 70% of nodal relapses. The authors recommend abdominal radiotherapy alone for IIA, induction chemotherapy for IIB, and do not advocate routine mediastinal irradiation.

title: Vascular toxicity associated with chemotherapy for testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん化学療法に伴う血管毒性
summary_ja: 精巣がんの化学療法に伴う血管毒性について概説した総説。シスプラチン併用化学療法は転移性胚細胞腫瘍の予後を改善したが、レイノー現象が頻発する。心筋梗塞、脳卒中、肺塞栓などの重大な血管イベントは稀だが、晩期の血管毒性も考慮が必要とされる。治療判断は発生率の低さだけで行うべきではないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This review summarizes vascular toxicity associated with chemotherapy for testicular cancer. Cisplatin-based regimens improved outcomes in metastatic germ cell tumors, but Raynaud's phenomenon is common. Major vascular events such as myocardial infarction, stroke and pulmonary embolism are infrequent, though late vascular toxicity should be considered. Causality is probable for some events, while others may be coincidental or disease-related. The low incidence should not drive therapeutic decisions.

title: Testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん
summary_ja: 精巣がんの国際的な罹患率と死亡率の推移を解析した総説。1970〜1985年に13の集団で15〜54歳男性の罹患率が上昇し、奇形腫とセミノーマの両方が増加していた。一方、9か国では化学療法の普及により死亡率が低下した。環境要因は特定されておらず、早期診断と治療の改善が重要とされる。
summary_en: This review analyzes international testicular cancer incidence and mortality trends. Incidence rose in men aged 15 to 54 across 13 populations between 1970 and 1985, affecting both teratomas and seminomas, while mortality declined in nine national populations. Delayed declines in some countries reflect slow uptake of chemotherapy. Environmental risk factors are suspected but unidentified, so early diagnosis and improved treatment remain central to control.

title: Clinical experience with yolk sac tumors and teratoma in children.
title_ja: 小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍および奇形腫の臨床経験
summary_ja: 1971〜1993年に京都大学で治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍の小児12例を報告した。内訳は卵黄嚢腫瘍7例と成熟奇形腫5例。卵黄嚢腫瘍のうち病期I 6例中2例に肺転移が生じ、1例は死亡した。卵黄嚢腫瘍の7例中6例と成熟奇形腫の全例が生存しており、フォローアップ期間は4か月から22年。
summary_en: This report describes 12 children with testicular germ cell tumors treated at Kyoto University between 1971 and 1993: seven yolk sac tumors and five mature teratomas. Of the yolk sac tumor patients, six had stage I disease, and two of these developed lung metastases, one of whom died. Six of seven yolk sac tumor patients and all five mature teratoma patients are alive, with follow-up from 4 months to 22 years.

title: An unusual late relapse in pathologic stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumor: case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 病理学的病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における非典型的な遅発再発:症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 精巣の病理学的病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例で、精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清後40か月で再発した。唯一の所見は血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇であり、併用化学療法により完全寛解が得られた。腫瘍マーカーの上昇のみで発見された病期I精巣NSGCTの遅発再発は初報告であり、長期の腫瘍マーカー経過観察の重要性を示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with pathologic stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who relapsed 40 months after inguinal orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The only sign of recurrence was an elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein level. Combination chemotherapy led to complete remission. The authors reviewed the literature and note this as the first reported late relapse in pathologic stage I testicular NSGCT presenting solely with a tumor marker elevation, highlighting the need for long-term marker surveillance.

title: The aggressive treatment of choriocarcinoma of the testis associated with lung bone, and brain metastases.
title_ja: 脳・肺・骨に転移した精巣絨毛癌の積極的治療
summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌が後腹膜、肺、骨、脳に転移した症例を報告する。手術、化学療法、放射線療法を組み合わせた積極的な集学的治療により、良好に治療されたとされる。多臓器転移を伴う稀で悪性度の高い病態に対する治療経験を示した短報である。
summary_en: A patient with metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma involving the retroperitoneum, lung, bone, and brain was successfully treated with surgery, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy. The report documents aggressive multimodal management of this rare, highly malignant variant with multi-organ metastases. It is a brief clinical report in the International Journal of Urology and is of interest to clinicians managing advanced testicular germ cell tumors with central nervous system involvement.

title: Survival and prognostic factors associated with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular and extragonadal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の生存率と予後因子
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍50例と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍10例を対象に、予後因子を検討した。3年生存率は精巣が71.9%、性腺外が60.0%であった。絨毛癌成分、LDHの高値、肝・脳・縦隔転移、10cmを超える後腹膜腫瘍が予後不良因子であり、これに基づく予後分類で良好群と不良群の生存率を明確に区別できた。
summary_en: This study of 50 patients with testicular and 10 with extragonadal germ cell tumors (all retroperitoneal) with metastatic nonseminomatous disease assessed prognostic factors. Three-year survival was 71.9% for testicular and 60.0% for extragonadal tumors. Choriocarcinoma histology, LDH above twice the upper limit, liver, brain, or mediastinal metastases, and retroperitoneal tumors over 10 cm predicted worse survival. The authors proposed a poor-risk classification that separated patients with 3-year survival of 88.7% and 49.7%.

title: A case of testicular teratoma located in the opposite side of the upper abdominal wall.
title_ja: 上腹部壁の反対側に位置した精巣奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 右停留精巣の2歳男児の症例である。鼠径部探索術で腹腔内精巣に腫瘍が見つかり、正中線を越えて反対側の上腹部壁に及んでいた。病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。精巣奇形腫がこのような部位に位置した例はこれまで報告がないとしている。
summary_en: A 2-year-old boy with right cryptorchidism underwent inguinal exploration, and a tumor was found in the intra-abdominal testis extending across the midline into the opposite upper abdominal wall. Histology showed a mature teratoma. The authors report that this unusual location of a testicular teratoma has not been previously described and note the rarity of such a presentation.

title: Cisplatin or carboplatin for ovarian and testicular cancer?
title_ja: 卵巣がんおよび精巣がんに対するシスプラチンかカルボプラチンか
summary_ja: 卵巣がんと精巣がんの治療におけるシスプラチンとカルボプラチンを比較した解説記事である。カルボプラチンは1986年に、シスプラチンより毒性の低い代替薬として導入された。シスプラチンを置き換えられるかについては議論が続いている。両薬剤を比較し、臨床医の選択を支援する内容である。
summary_en: This Drug Therapeutics Bulletin article compares cisplatin and carboplatin in treating ovarian and testicular cancer. Carboplatin was introduced in 1986 as a less toxic alternative to cisplatin, and the debate about whether it can replace cisplatin has continued. The article reviews the two agents for these cancers to help clinicians decide between them.

title: Transvaginal color Doppler in early pregnancy: rational and clinical potential.
title_ja: 妊娠初期における経膣カラードプラ法:その根拠と臨床的可能性
summary_ja: 妊娠初期における経膣カラードプラ超音波検査の有用性を検討した。ドプラ所見により妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病型を鑑別でき、全胞状奇胎と侵入奇胎や絨毛癌を区別できると報告している。筋層浸潤の程度評価にも有用とされる。非侵襲的で簡便な手法であるが、さらなる検討と安全性の評価が必要と述べている。
summary_en: This paper describes the use of transvaginal color and pulsed Doppler ultrasonography in early pregnancy. The authors propose that Doppler findings may distinguish forms of gestational trophoblastic disease, allowing complete mole to be differentiated from invasive mole or choriocarcinoma, and that myometrial invasion may be assessed. They suggest the technique is noninvasive, simple, and clinically valuable, while noting that further studies and safety considerations are needed.

title: Combined microcystic adnexal carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma arising in the ovarian cystic teratoma--a brief case report.
title_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた微小嚢胞性付属器癌と扁平上皮癌の合併:簡単な症例報告
summary_ja: 72歳女性の右卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫で、破裂し周囲組織と癒着していた。組織学的に、エクリン・毛包分化を示す微小嚢胞性付属器癌と扁平上皮癌が良性奇形腫内に同時に認められた。PASおよびCEA陽性がエクリン分化を示唆した。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化の稀な一例として報告している。
summary_en: A 72-year-old Korean woman had a right ovarian cystic teratoma that ruptured and adhered to adjacent structures. Microscopy revealed a combined tumor of microcystic adnexal carcinoma, showing eccrine and hair follicular differentiation, and squamous cell carcinoma arising within the benign teratoma. PAS and CEA positivity supported eccrine differentiation. The authors describe this rare combination as an example of malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma.

title: Primary mediastinal seminoma.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣型に類似する稀な原発性縦隔セミノーマの3症例を報告する。治療は放射線療法と化学療法の併用、または手術と放射線療法であった。1例は化学療法中の血栓性合併症により死亡した。生存した2例は26か月および5年の時点で無症状であった。診断、腫瘍マーカー、治療プロトコルについても考察する。
summary_en: This report describes three cases of primary mediastinal seminoma, a rare neoplasm histologically similar to testicular seminoma and mainly affecting men aged 30 to 60. Treatments included combined radiotherapy and chemotherapy, surgical resection with radiotherapy, and thoracotomy with radiotherapy. One patient died after chemotherapy was interrupted by thrombotic complications. The two surviving patients remained asymptomatic at follow-up of 26 months and 5 years. The discussion covers embryogenesis, clinical and radiological features, tumor markers, diagnostic procedures, and treatment protocols.

title: Mediastinal tumor and Klinefelter's syndrome.
title_ja: 縦隔腫瘍とクラインフェルター症候群
summary_ja: 47,XXY核型のクラインフェルター症候群に、縦隔原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を合併した症例を報告する。内分泌変化によりβ-hCG値が上昇していた。肺転移を伴っていたが、化学療法と胸部外科手術により完全寛解が得られた。両疾患の稀な合併とhCGマーカーの有用性を示す。
summary_en: This report describes a patient with Klinefelter syndrome (karyotype 47,XXY) who had a primary extragonadal germ cell tumor of the mediastinum. Elevated beta-hCG levels were present, reflecting altered endocrinology in Klinefelter syndrome. The patient had lung metastases. Chemotherapy combined with thoracic surgery achieved complete remission. The case highlights the rare association between Klinefelter syndrome and extragonadal germ cell tumors and the value of hCG as a marker in such patients.

title: Effect of low-dose testicular irradiation on sperm count and fertility in patients with testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者における低線量精巣照射が精子数および妊孕性に及ぼす影響
summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を受けた病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者8例を前向きに追跡した。照射後3か月で多くの患者の精子数が大きく低下した。運動率は維持された。3例のパートナーが妊娠し、正常児を出産した。放射線療法による一過性の不妊は多くが可逆的と考えられる。
summary_en: This prospective study followed eight patients with stage I testicular seminoma who underwent radical orchiectomy and then megavoltage radiotherapy to the retroperitoneum. Radiation reduced sperm counts to below 10 million/ml in most patients by three months. Motility remained unchanged. One patient's count recovered to normal by 12 months but stayed below 20% of baseline. Three partners conceived between 9 and 14 months and delivered healthy infants. The authors conclude that radiotherapy causes transient infertility that is often reversible.

title: A review of testicular intratubular germ cell neoplasia in infertile men.
title_ja: 不妊男性における精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（ITGCN）の検討
summary_ja: 1955年から1992年の不妊男性2,739例の精巣生検を後方視的に検討した。16例に片側性の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（ITGCN）を認め、常に精巣萎縮を伴っていた。未治療例の50%が6年以内に胚細胞腫瘍を発症した。ITGCNの発生率と管理、フォローアップの重要性を論じる。
summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed testicular biopsies from 2,739 infertile men collected between 1955 and 1992. Unilateral intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) was found in 16 men and was always associated with testicular atrophy. Half of the untreated patients with ITGCN developed germ cell tumors within six years. Among 1,639 men biopsied before 1982, three without ITGCN later developed germ cell tumors. The study discusses the incidence and management of ITGCN in infertile men, emphasizing the importance of follow-up.

title: Intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) with p53 and PCNA expression and adjacent mature teratoma in an infant testis. An immunohistochemical and morphologic study with a review of the literature.
title_ja: 乳児精巣における p53 および PCNA 発現を伴う精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（ITGCN）と隣接する成熟奇形腫：免疫組織化学的・形態学的検討と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 3歳男児の精巣に精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（ITGCN）と成熟奇形腫が併存した稀な症例を報告する。非定型胚細胞の約5%でp53とPCNAの核発現を認めた。PAS染色で細胞質内グリコーゲンが確認された。PCNA、p53、PAS染色は悪性の精細管内胚細胞の検出に有用と考えられる。
summary_en: This report describes a 3-year-old boy with both intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) and mature teratoma of the testis, a rare combination in children. Immunohistochemistry showed p53 and PCNA nuclear expression in about 5% of atypical germ cells, while PLAP and 43-9F were negative. Periodic acid-Schiff staining revealed intracytoplasmic glycogen in these cells. The authors suggest that PCNA, p53, and PAS staining may be useful markers for detecting malignant intratubular germ cells. A literature review is included.

title: Gestational trophoblastic tumors: refining histologic diagnoses by using DNA flow and image cytometry.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の組織学的診断の精緻化におけるDNAフローサイトメトリーおよび画像細胞計測の利用
summary_ja: DNA含量の測定により、部分胞状奇胎は大多数が三倍体、完全胞状奇胎は二倍体または四倍体であることが示された。DNA含量の把握で診断の一致率が向上し、双胎妊娠合併例では診断遅れと持続・転移性疾患の増加が認められた。残存中間型トロホブラスト結節は化学療法に抵抗性であった。免疫組織化学は胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と絨毛癌の鑑別に有用だが、重なる例もある。
summary_en: This review covers recent DNA content studies of gestational trophoblastic tumors. Flow cytometry and image analysis showed that partial hydatidiform moles are mostly triploid and complete moles mostly diploid or diploid/tetraploid. Measuring DNA content improved diagnostic agreement for hydropic abortuses and moles. Interphase cytogenetic probes and microsatellite analysis allowed ploidy and parental-origin assignment. Twin pregnancy with a mole was linked to delayed diagnosis and more persistent or metastatic disease. Residual intermediate trophoblast nodules resisted chemotherapy. Immunohistochemistry helps separate placental site trophoblastic tumor from choriocarcinoma, though profiles sometimes overlap.

title: Peritoneal strumosis.
title_ja: 腹膜ストルーマ症
summary_ja: 49歳女性の子宮平滑筋腫手術中に左卵巣腫瘤と大網播種が見つかった。組織学的に良性の卵巣ストルーマ(甲状腺腫)の大網進展と診断された。3コースの化学療法後、32か月間無病であった。病変の本態は不明確で、卵巣ストルーマ由来の高分化濾胞癌の成熟化の可能性も否定できないとされる。
summary_en: This report describes a rare case of peritoneal strumosis. A 49-year-old woman undergoing surgery for a uterine leiomyoma was found to have a left ovarian mass and omental implants. Histology showed benign ovarian struma with omental spread and no thyroid neoplasm. After three courses of chemotherapy, she remained disease-free at 32 months. The authors note the lesion's nature is unclear and that maturation of a well-differentiated follicular carcinoma arising in the ovarian struma cannot be excluded.

title: Overexpression of the p53 oncoprotein in carcinoma in situ of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣上皮内癌におけるp53癌蛋白の過剰発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫に隣接する精巣組織の上皮内癌(CIS)を検討した。成人患者8例中4例でPLAP免疫染色によりCISを同定し、そのうち3例でCIS細胞がp53陽性であった。p53の変異による不活化が示唆された。成熟奇形腫の潜在的悪性度とCISの関連、および精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初期発生へのp53関与が考察されている。
summary_en: This study examined carcinoma in situ (CIS) in testes adjacent to mature teratomas. CIS was identified by placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) immunostaining in four of eight adult patients with mature teratomas. In three of these four, CIS cells were positive for p53 protein, suggesting p53 tumor suppressor inactivation. The authors propose that CIS in histologically normal testicular tissue near mature teratomas may relate to their malignant potential. They also suggest p53 inactivation may act early in testicular germ cell tumor development.

title: Malignant squamous cell elements in the ovarian cancer: report of 5 cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣癌における悪性扁平上皮成分:5例の報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 悪性扁平上皮成分を伴う卵巣癌5例を報告する。2例は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した扁平上皮癌で、うち1例は上皮内癌であった。他3例は腺扁平上皮癌で、奇形腫を合併した例もあった。組織発生と形態は多様であり、文献的考察も加えられている。
summary_en: This report describes five ovarian cancers containing malignant squamous cell elements. Three were adenosquamous carcinomas, associated with mature cystic teratoma or mixed mesodermal tumor in some cases. Two were squamous cell carcinomas arising in mature cystic teratoma, one with in situ carcinoma. One adenosquamous case showed transitional forms between squamous and endometrioid components. The authors conclude that malignant squamous elements in ovarian cancer show diverse histogenesis and morphology, with a review of the literature.

title: Preliminary results of a phase I/II trial of paclitaxel in patients with relapsed or cisplatin-refractory testicular cancer.
title_ja: 再発かつシスプラチン抵抗性の精巣がんに対するパクリタキセルの第I/II相試験予備結果
summary_ja: 再発かつシスプラチン抵抗性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍10例にパクリタキセルを投与した。3例が奏効し、1例は5か月以上部分奏効を維持した。135〜225 mg/m²で毒性は許容可能であった。その後のシスプラチン併用化学療法で4例が奏効した。ドイツのグループによる第II相試験が進行中である。
summary_en: This phase I/II trial tested paclitaxel in ten patients with relapsed, cisplatin-refractory testicular germ cell tumors. Three patients responded, though two relapsed after two and four cycles, and one remained in partial response beyond five months. Doses of 135 to 225 mg/m2 were tolerable, with reversible granulocytopenia in all patients. Six patients were retreated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy after paclitaxel, and four achieved responses. A phase II study by the German Testicular Cancer Study Group is ongoing.

title: Emergence of mature teratoma following treatment of sacrococcygeal endodermal sinus tumor: CT and MR imaging with pathological correlation.
title_ja: 仙尾部卵黄嚢腫瘍の治療後に成熟奇形腫が出現した例：CTおよびMRIの病理学的対比
summary_ja: 8か月齢女児の仙尾部腫瘍は生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、化学療法を受けた。残存腫瘍は画像と病理で成熟奇形腫と確認された。卵黄嚢腫瘍が成熟奇形腫へ逆転したように見える偽性逆転として報告されている。CTおよびMRI所見が病理所見と対比して示されている。
summary_en: This report describes an 8-month-old girl with a sacrococcygeal tumor diagnosed by biopsy as yolk sac tumor. After chemotherapy, the residual tumor was confirmed as mature teratoma by imaging and pathology. The authors describe this as pseudoretroconversion, in which the yolk sac tumor appeared to convert to mature teratoma. CT and MRI findings are presented alongside pathological correlation.

title: The role of granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor in the treatment of germ cell tumors. German Testicular Cancer Study Group.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の治療における顆粒球マクロファージコロニー刺激因子の役割
summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループによる報告で、進行した悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対しPEI化学療法後にGM-CSFを投与し、用量強度を1.4倍に高めた。評価可能な75例の全生存期間(全生存率)は、中央値27か月のフォローアップで79%であった。用量制限毒性は重度の粘膜炎・腸炎と遷延する血小板減少であった。今後は末梢血幹細胞を用いた支持療法と併せ、標準用量との無作為化比較試験が必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This study from the German Testicular Cancer Study Group evaluated granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF) in patients with far-advanced malignant germ cell tumors. Following PEI chemotherapy, GM-CSF allowed a 1.4-fold increase in dose intensity. Among 75 evaluable patients, overall survival was 79% at a median follow-up of 27 months. Dose-limiting toxicities were severe mucositis/enteritis and prolonged thrombocytopenia. The authors propose using peripheral blood stem cells and growth factors to support multiple cycles of dose-intensified chemotherapy, which future trials must compare against standard dosing.

title: Placental teratoma with three-germ layer differentiation.
title_ja: 三胚葉分化を伴う胎盤奇形腫
summary_ja: 胎盤の胎児面から有茎性腫瘤として突出した稀な胎盤奇形腫の症例を報告する。組織学的に皮膚・付属器、神経組織、腸管構造、軟骨・骨、平滑筋および横紋筋など三胚葉すべての由来組織を含んでいた。分節的な構成は認められなかった。奇形腫の成分が胎盤内にも生じうることを示す症例であり、性腺や典型的な性腺外部位以外での奇形腫の範囲を示している。
summary_en: This report describes a rare placental teratoma presenting as a pedunculated mass on the fetal surface of the placenta. Histology showed tissues derived from all three germ layers, including skin with appendages, neural structures, gut, cartilage, bone, and smooth and striated muscle. The lesion lacked segmental organization. The case highlights that teratomatous elements can arise within placental tissue, extending the spectrum of teratoma beyond gonadal and typical extragonadal sites.

title: Acute myeloid leukaemia with +i(12p) shortly after treatment of mediastinal germ cell tumour.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の治療直後に発症したi(12p)を伴う急性骨髄性白血病
summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の治療が奏効した直後に急性骨髄性白血病（M2）を発症した症例を報告する。白血病に先行して骨髄異形成期が記録されていた。骨髄および末梢血には胚細胞性悪性腫瘍に典型的なi(12p)を含む複雑な染色体異常が認められた。FISHでは骨髄芽球、赤芽球、好中球にi(12p)が検出されたがリンパ球には検出されなかった。両疾患は共通のクローン起源を持つ可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: A patient developed acute myeloid leukemia (M2) shortly after successful treatment of a mediastinal germ cell tumor, preceded by a documented myelodysplastic phase. Bone marrow and peripheral blood cells showed complex cytogenetic abnormalities, including i(12p), typical of germ cell malignancy. Fluorescence in situ hybridization detected i(12p) in myeloblasts, erythroblasts and neutrophils but not in lymphocytes. The authors suggest a common clonal origin for the hematologic malignancy and the mediastinal tumor.

title: The malignant potential of postchemotherapy residual mature teratoma for disseminated nonseminomatous testicular tumors.
title_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍における化学療法後残存成熟奇形腫の悪性の可能性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の播種例で化学療法後に残存した成熟奇形腫3例の、パラフィン包埋標本7検体を用いてフローサイトメトリーによる核DNA倍数性解析を行った。組織学的に良性の所見であるにもかかわらず、全検体でDNA異数体が認められた。化学療法後の成熟奇形腫は悪性の挙動を再開しうるため、完全な外科的切除が推奨される。
summary_en: Flow cytometric nuclear DNA ploidy analysis was performed on paraffin-embedded blocks from three patients with residual mature teratoma after chemotherapy for disseminated nonseminomatous testicular tumors. All seven specimens were DNA aneuploid despite benign histologic appearance. The authors conclude that postchemotherapy mature teratomas can resume malignant behavior and recommend complete surgical removal. The findings support cautious management of apparently benign residual lesions in patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

title: Combination of granulosa cell tumour and carcinoid in an imitation of appendix vermicularis within a mature teratoma--a unique case.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の虫垂様構造内に顆粒膜細胞腫とカルチノイドが合併した稀な症例
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟奇形腫内に虫垂様構造があり、そこから原発性卵巣カルチノイドが発生した稀な症例を報告する。対側卵巣には形態が類似する顆粒膜細胞腫が認められた。術後に追加治療は行わず、診断から13年後も無症状で良好に経過している。成熟奇形腫内にカルチノイドが生じる例は極めて稀であると述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a primary ovarian carcinoid arising in an imitation of the appendix within a mature teratoma, with 13 years of follow-up. The contralateral ovary contained a granulosa cell tumor with similar morphology. The patient received no additional therapy after surgery and remained well at 13 years. The authors describe this combination as unique and emphasize the rarity of carcinoid components within ovarian mature teratomas.

title: Neoplastic hormone-producing cells of the placenta produce and secrete parathyroid hormone-related protein. Studies by immunohistology, immunoassay, and polymerase chain reaction.
title_ja: 胎盤の腫瘍性ホルモン産生細胞によるパラソルモン関連蛋白（PTHrP）の産生
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 腫瘍性の胎盤細胞がパラソルモン関連蛋白（PTHrP）を産生することを検討した。免疫組織化学と免疫測定法により、絨毛血管腫、絨毛癌、胞状奇胎でPTHrPが検出された。正常胎盤の合胞体栄養膜細胞や細胞性栄養膜細胞なども産生し、栄養膜および羊膜上皮由来の細胞株は培養液中へ分泌した。PTHrPは胎盤腫瘍性病変のマーカーとなりうると考察している。
summary_en: This study shows that neoplastic placental cells produce parathyroid hormone-related protein (PTHrP). Immunohistology and immunoassay detected PTHrP in chorioangioma, choriocarcinoma, and hydatidiform mole. PCR confirmed transcripts in placental cells and in trophoblast and amniotic epithelial cell lines, which secreted PTHrP into culture medium. PTHrP was also produced by normal syncytiotrophoblast, intermediate and cytotrophoblasts, and amniotic epithelium. The authors propose PTHrP as a potential marker of placental neoplasia.

title: Clonality of combined testicular germ cell tumors of adults.
title_ja: 成人の混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍のクローン性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成人の混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍9例を対象に、染色体15番の動原体領域のコピー数を指標としてクローン性を検討した。セミノーマ成分と非セミノーマ成分、それぞれに隣接する上皮内癌は、多くの症例で同一の起源を持つことが示唆された。一方、2例では成分間でコピー数パターンが異なった。大半の腫瘍は単クローン性起源であり、上皮内癌と浸潤癌の核型進化は類似していると結論づけられた。
summary_en: This study examined the clonal origin of combined testicular germ cell tumors in nine adult cases by counting chromosome 15 centromeric copy numbers in carcinoma in situ, seminoma, and nonseminomatous components. In most tumors, the seminoma and nonseminomatous components and their adjacent carcinoma in situ shared the same copy-number pattern, although two cases showed discordant patterns. The findings suggest that these components generally arise from a monoclonal origin, with karyotype evolution in carcinoma in situ closely resembling that of the invasive tumor.

title: Retinoids in bladder, testis and prostate cancer: epidemiologic, pre-clinical and clinical observations.
title_ja: レチノイドと膀胱がん、精巣がん、前立腺がん：疫学的、前臨床的、臨床的観察
summary_ja: 本総説は、膀胱・精巣・前立腺がんにおけるレチノイドを検討したものである。疫学では血清レチノイド低値が膀胱がんと前立腺がんのリスク上昇と関連し、前臨床研究では増殖抑制と分化誘導が示された。胚細胞腫瘍に対する13-シス レチノイン酸の第II相試験は陰性であった。臨床試験も期待外れであった。著者らは、臨床的利益はまだ示されておらず、有効な患者群を特定するさらなる研究が必要だと結論している。
summary_en: This review examines retinoids in bladder, testicular, and prostate cancers. Epidemiologic data link low retinoid levels to higher bladder and prostate cancer risk, and preclinical studies show growth suppression and differentiation induction. In germ cell tumors, a phase 2 trial of 13-cis retinoic acid was negative. Clinical trials in superficial bladder cancer and advanced prostate cancer have also been disappointing. The authors conclude that retinoids have not yet shown clinical benefit and that further work is needed to identify responsive patient subsets.

title: Adenosquamous carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた腺扁平上皮癌：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 本症例報告では、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた病期Iaの腺扁平上皮癌を持つ57歳女性を紹介している。手術後に化学療法を受け、3年間無病生存を維持した。文献上の7例を併せて検討し、早期例は予後良好であったが進行例は予後不良であった。
summary_en: A 57-year-old woman with stage Ia adenosquamous carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary is reported. She underwent total hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and omentectomy, followed by chemotherapy, and remained disease-free for three years. The authors reviewed seven reported cases of this rare malignant transformation. Early-stage tumors had favorable outcomes, whereas advanced-stage cases had poor survival, suggesting a worse prognosis than conventional squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma.

title: A case report on radiotherapy in choriocarcinoma: a life saving procedure.
title_ja: 絨毛癌に対する放射線療法：救命に至った症例報告
summary_ja: 外科手術が困難な絨毛癌の症例に対し、子宮からの致死的な出血を抑える目的で放射線療法を行い、救命に成功したことを報告している。全身状態が重篤で手術が困難な症例において、放射線療法が有効な選択肢となりうることを示した症例報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with choriocarcinoma whose surgery was not feasible because a large nodule extended into the anterior vaginal wall and she was in critical condition. Radiation therapy was given to control life-threatening uterine hemorrhage. The treatment was successful and life-saving, and it is presented as a palliative option when surgery is not possible.

title: Extra gonadal germ cell tumours: report of two cases.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の2症例
summary_ja: 縦隔と頭皮に生じた性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の若年女性2例を報告している。両例とも腫瘍マーカーが上昇し、組織学的に胎児性癌と診断された。シスプラチン併用化学療法により完全奏効が得られ、卵巣機能は回復して出産にも至った。フォローアップ期間中、両例とも無病生存が維持されている。
summary_en: Two young women with extragonadal germ cell tumors are described. Both presented with midline lesions, one in the mediastinum and one on the scalp, with elevated tumor markers and normal ovaries on CT. Histology showed embryonal carcinoma in both. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy achieved complete response, and both later regained normal ovarian function and delivered healthy babies. Both remained disease-free at 30 and 55 months of follow-up.

title: The influence of grade on the outcome of stage I ovarian immature (malignant) teratomas and the reproducibility of grading.
title_ja: 卵巣の病期I未熟（悪性）奇形腫の転帰に対する悪性度の影響と悪性度評価の再現性
summary_ja: 本研究では卵巣未熟奇形腫244例を解析し、組織学的悪性度が転帰を予測するか、また分類が再現性を持つかを検討した。病期Iの143例では、高悪性度腫瘍の死亡率が悪性度1の腫瘍より著しく高かった。他の胚細胞成分の小さな病巣は予後を悪化させなかった。病理医間の一致度は、三段階分類では中等度にとどまったが、二段階分類では改善した。著者らは、トレーニングと簡略化された基準の必要性を示唆している。
summary_en: This study analyzed 244 immature ovarian teratomas, including 143 stage I cases with long follow-up, to test whether histologic grade predicts outcome and whether grading is reproducible. High-grade tumors had a markedly higher death rate than grade 1 tumors. Small foci of other germ cell elements did not worsen prognosis. Interobserver agreement for the traditional three-tiered grading was only moderate and improved with a two-tiered system, suggesting that training and simplified criteria are needed.

title: Stage I nonseminomatous germ-cell testicular cancer--management options and risk-benefit considerations.
title_ja: 病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍：治療選択肢とリスク・ベネフィットの検討
summary_ja: 本研究は1965～1989年に臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍464例に初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った結果を検討した。病理病期Aの再発率は11%、死亡率は0.7%であった。病理病期Bで補助化学療法を受けなかった群の再発率は32%で、補助化学療法を受けた46例では再発はなかった。神経温存術式により射精不能を回避できると結論している。
summary_en: This review analyzes 464 patients with clinical stage A nonseminomatous testicular germ-cell cancer who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection (RPLND) between 1965 and 1989. Relapse rates were 15% in the early era and 11% in pathological stage A patients in the later era, with 0.7% mortality. Pathological stage B patients who did not receive adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed in 32% of cases, whereas none of 46 patients who received adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed. The authors conclude that RPLND remains a sound approach and that nerve-sparing techniques can avoid anejaculation.

title: Genetic factors in malignant germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝的要因
summary_ja: 本総説は悪性胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝的要因に関する現時点の知見をまとめたものである。停留精巣が主要な既知のリスク因子であり、人種や地域による発生率の差も大きい。家族例や両側例、泌尿生殖器奇形の合併から遺伝的関与が示唆される。多くの胚細胞腫瘍でみられるアイソクロモソーム i(12p) は診断や予後に有用とされ、発症に関わる遺伝子の研究も紹介されている。
summary_en: This review summarizes current knowledge of genetic factors in malignant germ-cell tumors. Undescended testis is the major known risk factor, and environmental exposures early in life are thought to contribute, with marked variation in incidence across populations and races. Familial cases, bilateral tumors, and urogenital malformations suggest a genetic component. The isochromosome i(12p), found in most germ-cell tumors, can aid diagnosis and may have prognostic significance. Ongoing research on genes involved in germ-cell tumor development is also discussed.

title: Vascular considerations in postchemotherapy. Retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection: Part I--Vena cava.
title_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清における血管的考察 第I部：下大静脈
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の巨大転移に対し化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った際、下大静脈切除または腔内腫瘍栓摘出を受けた42例を報告している。適応は腫瘍の遺残除去、静脈の瘢痕閉塞、腫瘍栓であった。腫瘍栓の病理所見は多くの症例でリンパ節所見と一致した。合併症は一過性が多く、生存率は71%であった。
summary_en: This report describes 42 patients who underwent inferior vena cava resection or intraluminal tumor thrombectomy during postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection for bulky nonseminomatous germ-cell cancer. Indications included tumor clearance, caval scar occlusion, and caval tumor thrombus, and thrombus pathology mirrored nodal findings in most cases. Complications were generally transient. The 71% survival rate was considered to justify this intensive surgery in patients who had exhausted chemotherapeutic options.

title: Vascular considerations in postchemotherapy. Retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection: Part II.
title_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清における血管的考察 第II部
summary_ja: 1965～1992年に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた710例を検討している。巨大病変の10例で大動脈置換が必要であった。大動脈破裂の主な危険因子は腫瘍固着による広範な外膜下剥離であり、十二指腸損傷や腸漿膜の広範な損傷は大動脈腸管瘻のリスクを高めた。高リスク例では予防的な大動脈移植を検討し、大網間置は瘻孔形成の予防に有効とされる。
summary_en: This report reviews 710 patients who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection between 1965 and 1992. Ten patients with bulky disease required aortic replacement, either postoperatively or during surgery. The main risk factor for aortic rupture was extended subadventitial dissection needed because of tumor fixation. Duodenal injury or extensive bowel serosal violation increased the risk of aortoenteric fistula. The authors suggest prospective aortic grafting in high-risk cases and note that omental interposition helps prevent fistula formation.

title: Persistent cancer in postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection: outcome analysis.
title_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清における残存癌：転帰解析
summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する初回または救援化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清で見つかる残存癌を転帰とともに解析している。救援化学療法後の患者の約55%に残存癌があった。完全切除された53例では、術後の再度救援化学療法の有無で無病生存に差はなく、転帰は切除の完全性に左右されると結論している。
summary_en: This outcome analysis evaluates persistent cancer found in postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection after primary or salvage chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer. About 55% of patients after salvage chemotherapy had residual cancer, whereas after primary chemotherapy most specimens showed teratoma or necrosis. Among 91 patients who underwent surgery after salvage chemotherapy, 53 had complete resection. Repeat postoperative salvage chemotherapy did not improve disease-free outcomes, so the completeness of resection appeared to determine outcome.

title: Size and status of metastases after inductive chemotherapy of germ-cell tumors. Indication for salvage operation.
title_ja: 導入化学療法後の胚細胞腫瘍における転移巣の大きさと状態：救援手術の適応
summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の導入化学療法後に残存した腫瘍について、153例（評価可能127例）の後方視的研究で検討している。原発腫瘍の組織型別に残存腫瘍の組織を評価した。悪性成分は各群の一部の残存腫瘍にみられ、非セミノーマでは最小の悪性残存腫瘍が4～5cmであった。残存腫瘤が5cm未満のセミノーマ、3cm未満の奇形腫を含まない非セミノーマでは二次手術を省略しうると提案している。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 153 patients with advanced germ-cell tumors examines residual masses after inductive chemotherapy to identify when secondary resection can be omitted. Residual histology was assessed by primary tumor type: pure seminoma, nonseminoma without teratoma, and nonseminoma with teratoma. Malignant elements were found in some residual masses across all groups, with the smallest malignant residues measuring 4 to 5 cm in nonseminomatous tumors. The authors suggest that secondary surgery may be omitted for residual seminoma under 5 cm or nonseminoma without teratoma under 3 cm.

title: Unusual neoplasms detected in testicular cancer patients undergoing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy.
title_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清で検出された非典型的腫瘍
summary_ja: 化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた557例のうち45例（8.1%）で、古典的な胚細胞腫瘍以外の腫瘍成分を認めた。内訳は肉腫14例、その他の非肉腫性・非胚細胞性癌18例、嚢胞性非定型絨毛癌8例である。原発腫瘍の臨床的・組織学的特徴から予測できなかった。外科的切除で根治の可能性があり、無病生存率は肉腫68%、絨毛癌88%であった。
summary_en: This study of 557 patients undergoing postchemotherapy RPLND identified 45 cases (8.1%) with neoplastic elements beyond the classic germ-cell tumor types. These included sarcomas in 14 patients, other nonsarcomatous non-germ-cell cancers in 18, and cystic atypical choriocarcinoma in 8. No clinical or histologic feature of the primary tumor predicted these findings, although orchiectomy sampling error was considered. Surgical resection was potentially curative, with disease-free survival of 68% for sarcoma, 56% for other cancers, and 88% for choriocarcinoma.

title: Treatment intensification in disseminated germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍における治療強化
summary_ja: 予後不良の播種性胚細胞腫瘍で、治療反応が不十分な例や再発例に対する治療強化を検討する総説である。非交差耐性薬剤の交互投与や用量強化レジメンは従来法より優れていなかった。造血成長因子や造血幹細胞再輸注を用いた早期治療強化はさらなる検討に値する。第I/II相試験では、治癒困難とされた患者が大量化学療法と自家幹細胞再輸注で救済されており、第III相試験が計画・進行中である。
summary_en: This review examines treatment intensification for poor-risk disseminated germ-cell tumors with inadequate response or relapse. Alternating non-cross-resistant drugs and dose-intensified regimens have not proven superior to conventional chemotherapy. Early intensification with hematopoietic growth factors or stem cell reinfusion warrants further study. Phase I/II trials showed that patients considered incurable were salvaged with high-dose chemotherapy and autologous stem cell reinfusion, and several phase III trials are planned or ongoing.

title: Characterization of 17 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 in choriocarcinoma cells: regulation by basic fibroblast growth factor.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞における17β-ヒドロキシステロイド脱水素酵素1型の特性解析：塩基性線維芽細胞増殖因子による調節
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JAR、JEG-3、BeWoにおける17β-HSD1型の特性を検討した研究である。全細胞株が正常ヒト細胞と同一の遺伝子を保持していたが、発現量はJAR細胞で最も低く、BeWo細胞で最も高かった。還元活性は酸化活性の4～7倍で、エストラジオール生成に有利であることが示された。
summary_en: This study characterizes 17 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 (17-HSD1) in three choriocarcinoma cell lines: JAR, JEG-3, and BeWo. All lines carried and expressed the same gene as normal human cells, but expression levels differed markedly, being lowest in JAR and highest in BeWo cells. Promoter sequence differences did not explain these variations. Reductive activity, converting estrone to estradiol, was 4 to 7 times higher than oxidative activity, indicating that these lines favor estradiol formation.

title: H5D12 monoclonal antibody identifies a 24-kD immunosuppressor factor produced by human chorio carcinoma cells.
title_ja: H5D12モノクローナル抗体によるヒト絨毛癌細胞が産生する24kDa免疫抑制因子の同定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: EASF（胚関連免疫抑制因子）に対するモノクローナル抗体H5D12を作製し、絨毛癌細胞が分泌する因子を解析した。免疫組織化学でBeWo絨毛癌細胞に強い染色を認め、分子量24kDの免疫抑制活性を持つ因子を同定した。対照細胞株には同様の活性は認められず、生殖機能の制御因子となりうることが示唆された。
summary_en: The authors generated monoclonal antibody H5D12 against an embryo-associated immunosuppressor factor (EASF) and used it to characterize a factor secreted by choriocarcinoma cells. Immunohistochemistry showed intense staining of BeWo choriocarcinoma cells, and biosynthetic labeling identified a 24-kD molecule with immunosuppressive activity in a lymphocyte proliferation assay, absent in control cell lines. The findings suggest a unique secreted factor that may regulate reproductive functions.

title: Rupture of the thoracic duct following treatment of mediastinal seminoma.
title_ja: 縦隔セミノーマの治療後に生じた胸管破裂
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの転移により縦隔病変を有した患者が、化学療法への良好な反応に伴い乳糜胸を発症した症例を報告している。悪性腫瘍に伴う乳糜胸は稀な合併症であり、転移性精巣セミノーマでの報告は既報の1例のみで、本報告が2例目となる。
summary_en: A patient with metastatic testicular seminoma involving the mediastinum developed chylothorax after chemotherapy. Chylothorax is a rare complication of malignancy, and only one prior report describes it in metastatic testicular seminoma. The authors report this second case, which developed as a result of a favourable response to chemotherapy.

title: Malignant change in a mediastinal dermoid cyst.
title_ja: 縦隔類皮嚢腫における悪性転化
summary_ja: 縦隔に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）が、初診から19年後に悪性転化した症例を報告している。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は通常卵巣に生じるが、縦隔にも発生しうる。悪性転化は1〜2%に認められる稀な合併症であり、長期のフォローアップの重要性が示唆される。
summary_en: The authors describe malignant transformation within a mediastinal dermoid cyst, a mature cystic teratoma, occurring 19 years after initial presentation. Mature cystic teratomas usually arise in the ovary but can occur in the mediastinum, and malignant change is a rare complication reported in 1-2% of cases. The report highlights the importance of long-term follow-up for patients with mediastinal teratomas.

title: Amplification of chromosome subregion 12p11.2-p12.1 in a metastasis of an i(12p)-negative seminoma: relationship to tumor progression?
title_ja: i(12p)陰性セミノーマの転移巣における12p11.2-p12.1領域の増幅と腫瘍進行との関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの転移巣を細胞遺伝学的に解析し、複数の数的・構造的異常を確認した。染色体12番短腕の異常な分染領域は12p11.2-p12.1領域の増幅に由来し、FISHおよび比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションで同定された。この領域は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進行に関わる遺伝子を含む可能性があると推測されている。
summary_en: This study analyzed a metastasis of an i(12p)-negative testicular seminoma using cytogenetics, FISH and comparative genomic hybridization. Multiple numerical and structural anomalies were found, including an abnormally banding region on chromosome 12 that resulted from amplification of 12p11.2-p12.1 sequences. The authors speculate that this region may harbor genes relevant to testicular germ cell tumor progression.

title: Robb-Smith type malignant histiocytosis associated with a mediastinal germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に伴ったRobb-Smith型悪性組織球症
summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍（混合奇形腫、肝様αフェトプロテイン陽性、腺管状の卵黄嚢腫瘍成分）を有する22歳男性が、肺・肝臓・骨髄などに広がる悪性組織球症を併発した。化学療法には初期に感受性を示したが、初診から4か月以内に播種性血管内凝固症候群により死亡した。
summary_en: A 22-year-old man with a mediastinal germ cell tumor containing mixed teratoma, hepatoid alpha-fetoprotein-positive, and glandular yolk sac components also had widespread malignant histiocytosis involving multiple organs. The disease was initially sensitive to chemotherapy, but the patient died of disseminated intravascular coagulation within four months of presentation.

title: Mediastinal lymph node metastasis 38 months after surveillance for stage I seminoma: a case report.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマのフォローアップ後38か月目に生じた縦隔リンパ節転移：症例報告
summary_ja: 病期Iの典型的セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術を施行された63歳男性が、38か月後に縦隔リンパ節のみの再発を来した。CTで縦隔腫瘍を指摘され、細針吸引細胞診でセミノーマ細胞が確認された。COMPE療法3コースにより完全寛解が得られ、治療後8か月時点で無病生存が続いている。
summary_en: A 63-year-old man developed isolated mediastinal lymph node relapse 38 months after orchiectomy for stage I typical seminoma, detected by CT and confirmed by fine-needle aspiration cytology. Complete remission was achieved after three courses of COMPE chemotherapy (cisplatin, vincristine, methotrexate, peplomycin, etoposide), and he remained disease-free for 8 months. The authors note that most relapses occur within 3 years and mostly involve retroperitoneal nodes, making this late mediastinal-only relapse rare.

title: [Two cases of testicular tumor with brain metastasis].
title_ja: 脳転移を伴った精巣腫瘍の2症例
summary_ja: 70例の精巣腫瘍のうち脳転移を来した2例を報告している。1例は胎児性癌・奇形腫・STGCの病理像を示し、化学療法中に脳ヘルニアで死亡した。もう1例は胎児性癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍・奇形腫で、脳転移に対し切除と大量化学療法が行われ13か月間の完全寛解が得られた。国内文献21例の検討から予後は極めて不良とされる。
summary_en: The authors report two patients with testicular germ cell tumors who developed brain metastases among 70 treated cases over eight years. One patient had embryonal carcinoma, teratoma and STGC with lung and retroperitoneal metastases and died of brain herniation three months after orchiectomy. The other had embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor and teratoma, achieved remission with chemotherapy, and had a later brain relapse treated with resection and high-dose chemotherapy. A review of 21 Japanese cases highlights the very poor prognosis.

title: Choriocarcinoma in a term placenta with pulmonary metastasis.
title_ja: 肺転移を伴った正期産胎盤の絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠26週に喀血と肺腫瘤を認めた女性が、38週で正期産となった症例である。胎盤の3か所で絨毛癌が確認され、分娩後に尿中hCGは急速に低下した。化学療法2コース後の部分肺葉切除では生存腫瘍は認められず、母児ともに良好な経過をたどった。胞状奇胎後の妊娠では胎盤の詳細な検索が必要とされる。
summary_en: The authors report choriocarcinoma within the placenta of a woman who delivered at term after a pregnancy complicated by hemoptysis and a lung mass at 26 weeks. Choriocarcinoma was found at three placental sites, and urine hCG fell rapidly after delivery. After two courses of chemotherapy, a partial lobectomy showed no viable tumor, and mother and infant remained well. The authors recommend detailed placental examination in post-molar pregnancies.

title: Choriocarcinoma metastasis in the thyroid gland.
title_ja: 甲状腺への絨毛癌転移
summary_ja: 34歳女性で、甲状腺の単発結節として発症し、肺および脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の甲状腺内転移例を報告している。針生検では未分化な悪性細胞がみられ、甲状腺摘除後の病理検査で甲状腺内の絨毛癌と確定した。化学療法と放射線療法の併用により良好な反応が得られた。甲状腺への転移性絨毛癌の報告はこれで3例目とされ、きわめてまれな病態である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with intrathyroid metastasis of choriocarcinoma, accompanied by pulmonary and brain metastases. She presented with a solitary thyroid nodule, and needle biopsy showed anaplastic malignant cells. Pathology after thyroidectomy confirmed choriocarcinoma in the thyroid gland. She responded satisfactorily to combined chemotherapy and radiotherapy. The authors note that this is only the third reported case of metastatic choriocarcinoma in the thyroid, underscoring this rare presentation.

title: Dysgerminoma in a pure 45,X Turner syndrome: report of a case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 純粋45,X型ターナー症候群に生じたディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 純粋な45,X型Turner症候群の患者で、異形成性の性腺から生じたディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例を報告している。血液と腫瘍の分子生物学的解析でY染色体由来の材料は認められなかった。従来、Turner症候群での性腺腫瘍のリスクはY染色体材料の存在が前提とされてきたが、本例はこれに当てはまらない。過去の純粋45,X症例5例の文献レビューも併せて行われている。
summary_en: This case report describes a dysgerminoma arising from a dysgenetic gonad in a patient with pure 45,X Turner syndrome. Cytogenetic and molecular analyses of blood and tumor found no Y chromosome material, which is classically required for gonadal tumor risk in Turner syndrome. The authors review five previously reported gonadal tumors with a pure 45,X karyotype, all supported only by cytogenetic analysis. They present this as the first ovarian tumor in 45,X Turner syndrome in which Y material was excluded by extensive molecular testing.

title: [A case of mediastinal mature teratoma presenting increased serum CA19-9 level].
title_ja: 血清CA19-9高値を呈した縦隔成熟奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 50歳女性の縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例で、咳嗽と胸痛で受診し、右肺への浸潤と右胸水を伴っていた。血清CA19-9が204.4 U/mlと著明に上昇したが、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、CEA、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は正常であった。肺の一部を含めて腫瘍を全摘し、術後にCA19-9は正常化した。組織学的に皮膚、膵組織、軟骨、気管支上皮を含んでいた。
summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old woman with a mediastinal mature teratoma that invaded the right lung and presented with cough, chest pain and right pleural effusion. Serum CA19-9 was markedly elevated at 204.4 U/ml, while AFP, CEA and hCG were normal. Complete resection with the adherent lung was performed, and CA19-9 normalized after surgery. Histology showed skin, pancreatic tissue, cartilage and bronchial epithelium. CA19-9 immunostaining was positive in bronchial epithelium but negative in the pancreatic tissue.

title: Orchiectomy alone for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis (NSGCTT): a minimum follow-up period of 5 years.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する精巣摘除術単独治療：最低5年間の追跡
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者80例を、精巣摘除術単独後5年以上追跡した。サーベイランスとして腫瘍マーカー、胸部X線、後腹膜CTを行い、36.3%で再発した。再発リスクは血管侵襲、胎児性癌の主体成分、奇形腫の副成分、精巣摘除前の低精子数であった。血管侵襲と組織成分に応じて、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、補助化学療法、サーベイランスを使い分けるよう推奨している。
summary_en: This study followed 80 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors for at least five years after orchiectomy alone, using surveillance with tumor markers, chest X-ray and retroperitoneal CT. Relapse occurred in 36.3% of patients. Risk factors included vascular invasion, a major embryonal carcinoma component, a minor teratoma component and low sperm count before orchiectomy. The authors recommend risk-adapted management: retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, adjuvant chemotherapy, or surveillance, depending on vascular invasion and histologic components. Overall survival was 95%.

title: A review of teratomas in Ibadan.
title_ja: イバダンにおける奇形腫のレビュー
summary_ja: 1960～1985年にナイジェリアのイバダン大学病院（UCH）病理部で診断された奇形腫をレビューした。外科的生検1,000件あたり3.4例で、卵巣が83.2%と最多、次いで仙尾部が6.3%であった。女性対男性比は18対1、平均年齢は25.8歳であった。組織学的に再検討された症例の88%が成熟奇形腫、8%が未熟奇形腫、4%が悪性であった。
summary_en: This review of teratomas diagnosed at the Pathology Department of UCH Ibadan between 1960 and 1985 found 3.4 cases per 1,000 surgical biopsies. The ovary was the most common site (83.2%), followed by the sacrococcygeal region (6.3%). Other sites included the neck, testes and mediastinum, while extracranial, intracranial, uterine cervix and intraocular sites were rare. The female-to-male ratio was 18:1, with a mean age of 25.8 years. Of histologically reviewed cases, 88% were mature, 8% immature and 4% malignant.

title: Radiological appearances of dermoid tumours (with emphasis on fat fluid levels).
title_ja: 類皮腫瘍の画像所見(脂肪-液体レベルを中心として)
summary_ja: 胸部1例、腹部8例の計9例の類皮腫瘍について、単純X線、超音波検査、CTの所見を報告した研究です。脂肪-液体レベルや「氷山」「ターゲット」徴候がCTで特異性高く描出されることを示し、これらの所見があれば類皮嚢腫に特徴的と結論しています。
summary_en: This 1994 case series from Africa describes nine dermoid tumours, one in the chest and eight in the abdomen, with radiological features on plain films, ultrasound, and computed tomography. The authors emphasize fat-fluid levels and the 'iceberg' or 'target' signs seen on CT and ultrasound. They note that ultrasound appearances of fat are variable, making CT more specific for demonstrating fat-fluid levels. The paper concludes that fat-fluid levels with a positive iceberg or target sign are diagnostic of dermoid cysts. The study provides imaging criteria for these mature teratomas.

title: The significance of the nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of metallothionein in human liver and tumor cells.
title_ja: ヒト肝臓および腫瘍細胞におけるメタロチオネインの核および細胞質局在の意義
summary_ja: ヒト肝臓や各種腫瘍におけるメタロチオネインの局在を免疫組織化学で調べた研究です。精巣胚細胞癌を含む腫瘍で検討し、分化度の高いセミノーマでは発現が乏しく、分化度の低い胎児性癌では高い発現が見られました。発現は腫瘍の種類や分化度に依存すると考察しています。
summary_en: This 1994 immunohistochemical study examined metallothionein localization in human liver and several tumour types, including testicular germ cell carcinoma, thyroid, bladder, and salivary gland tumours. Metallothionein was often high in both nucleus and cytoplasm of malignant tumours, with the strongest staining at the proliferating edge. Within germ cell tumours, well-differentiated seminomas showed little metallothionein regardless of stage, whereas less differentiated embryonal carcinomas expressed more. The authors suggest expression depends on tumour type, cellular origin, heterogeneity, and growth stage. The abstract is truncated in the source.

title: In utero development of a mediastinal teratoma: a second-trimester event.
title_ja: 胎児期の縦隔奇形腫の子宮内発育:妊娠中期の出来事
summary_ja: 妊娠27週で胎児水腫と子宮内死亡をきたした、前縦隔の急速に増大する奇形腫の症例報告です。超音波検査所見と病理所見を示しています。出生前診断は稀ですが、本例は妊娠中期に急速進行し致死的経過をとりうることを示しました。出生前の超音波検査の重要性を強調しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a rapidly growing anterior mediastinal teratoma detected prenatally during the second trimester. The tumour caused hydrops fetalis and in utero fetal demise at 27 weeks' gestation. The authors present the sonographic and pathological findings. Mediastinal teratomas are rarely diagnosed before birth, and when found in the neonatal period they usually cause respiratory distress or hydrops. The report highlights the importance of prenatal ultrasound in recognising such rapidly progressive germ cell tumours and their potentially lethal course in utero.

title: Bilateral testicular cancer.
title_ja: 両側精巣がん
summary_ja: 両側精巣がんの症例を報告し、精巣がんの発生率上昇を論じた家庭医学の論文です。家族歴、停留精巣の既往、不妊症、対側精巣容積12mL未満などの高リスク群を挙げています。毎月の自己検査や、対側の上皮内癌を除外するための精巣生検の検討を勧めています。
summary_en: This family medicine case report describes bilateral testicular cancer and reviews its rising incidence. The authors highlight high-risk groups, including men with a family history, prior cryptorchidism, infertility, or contralateral testicular volume below 12 mL. They recommend monthly testicular self-examination and suggest considering testicular biopsy to exclude carcinoma in situ in the contralateral testis. Treatment and follow-up options are discussed to reduce long-term morbidity. The article is aimed at primary care physicians, emphasizing early recognition and risk-based evaluation of germ cell tumour patients.

title: Polymorphism of spermatocytic seminoma. A morphometric study.
title_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマの多形性：形態計測による検討
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣の胚細胞腫瘍である精母細胞性セミノーマ（SS）について、組織切片上の核面積を画像解析で定量した形態計測研究である。浸潤型SS12例を、他型のセミノーマや正常精子形成と比較した。SSの核面積は32.5〜56.5μm²と他型より小さく、一部のSSは既知の確率分布に当てはまらなかった。
summary_en: This morphometric study analyzes nuclear profile areas in spermatocytic seminoma (SS), a testicular germ cell neoplasm, using image analysis on histological slides. Twelve infiltrating SS cases were compared with intracanalicular SS, typical and anaplastic seminomas, and normal spermatogenesis. SS nuclear populations showed mean areas of 32.5 to 56.5 square microns, much smaller than other seminomas. Statistical tests distinguished most populations, and some SS distributions fit no standard model. The authors argue this finding argues against haploid nuclei in SS cells.

title: Intracardiac teratoma in a child simulating an atrioventricular nodal tumor.
title_ja: 房室結節腫瘍を模倣した小児の心臓内奇形腫
summary_ja: 6歳女児の心臓内奇形腫の症例報告である。当初は房室結節腫瘍と誤診された。3年後に再発した腫瘍には三胚葉由来の成熟成分がみられ、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。免疫染色では奇形腫内に膵島組織の過形成が確認された。心臓内奇形腫は極めて稀で、診断が困難になり得る。
summary_en: This report describes a 6-year-old girl with an intracardiac teratoma initially mistaken for an atrioventricular nodal tumor. The first biopsy showed clusters of epithelial cells in fibrotic stroma. Three years later the tumor recurred with mature elements from all three germ layers, establishing a diagnosis of mature cystic teratoma. Immunostaining showed overgrown pancreatic islet components within the teratoma. The case highlights the rarity of intracardiac teratoma and the diagnostic pitfalls it presents.

title: A dosing scheme for carboplatin in adult cancer patients based upon pre-infusion renal function and platelet count.
title_ja: 投与前の腎機能と血小板数に基づく成人がん患者へのカルボプラチン投与スキーム
summary_ja: 本研究は、カルボプラチンの投与前の腎機能と血小板数に基づき、卵巣がんおよび精巣がんの成人患者向けの投与量設定法を検討した。23例の薬物動態・毒性データと4施設の既報値を統合し、モンテカルロ・シミュレーションにより5段階の投与スキームを導いた。
summary_en: This study derives a carboplatin dosing scheme for adults with ovarian or testicular cancer based on pre-infusion renal function and platelet count. Pharmacokinetic and toxicity data from 23 patients were combined with published values from four centers. Relationships were established between platinum clearance and glomerular filtration rate, and between platelet reduction and platinum exposure. A Monte Carlo simulation aimed for 5% grade IV thrombocytopenia and produced a five-level scheme. Most patients with ovarian or testicular cancer would receive an initial dose of 900 mg.

title: Burned-out tumour of the testis presenting as retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 後腹膜絨毛癌として発症した焼け跡型精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 20歳男性の、精巣腫瘍が焼け跡型（burned-out）として後腹膜転移で発症した症例報告である。精巣摘除術では精巣網近傍に線維性瘢痕のみが認められた。切除不能な後腹膜腫瘍の生検で絨毛癌と診断され、化学療法を速やかに開始したが、発症7か月後に死亡した。
summary_en: This report describes a 20-year-old man whose testicular tumor presented as widespread retroperitoneal metastases, a burned-out tumor pattern. Orchiectomy revealed a subalbuginal fibrous scar near the rete testis, with no obvious primary mass. Biopsy of the unresectable retroperitoneal disease showed choriocarcinoma. Chemotherapy was started promptly, but the patient died seven months after initial symptoms. The case illustrates how a regressed testicular primary can present with aggressive retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma.

title: Radiology of retroperitoneal cystic teratoma in adult: a case report.
title_ja: 成人における後腹膜嚢胞性奇形腫の画像所見：症例報告
summary_ja: 成人の後腹膜嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。画像所見から術前に嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され、外科的切除により患者は利益を得た。しかし、腫瘍の大きさや石灰化、嚢胞性・充実性成分の有無は良性挙動を予測しないとされ、確定診断には病理学的評価が必要であった。
summary_en: A case report describing an adult with a retroperitoneal cystic teratoma. The radiologic pattern allowed a preoperative diagnosis, leading to surgical removal that benefited the patient. The authors note that tumor size, calcification, and cystic or solid components do not reliably predict benign behavior. Definitive diagnosis required histopathology. Retroperitoneal teratoma is rare in adults, and the report highlights the limits of imaging-based diagnosis.

title: Case report: choriocarcinoma presenting with brain metastases.
title_ja: 症例報告：脳転移を呈した絨毛癌
summary_ja: 正期産妊娠の9か月後に発症し、肺と脳に転移した絨毛癌の症例報告である。絨毛癌は婦人科以外の症状で発症しうるため、脳転移を呈する女性では妊娠検査により絨毛癌の可能性を確認または否定すべきと著者らは述べている。妊娠歴の聴取が診断上重要であることを示す。
summary_en: A case report of choriocarcinoma presenting with lung and brain metastases. The malignancy arose after a full-term pregnancy that ended nine months before admission. Although choriocarcinoma is a gynecologic malignancy, it can present with nongynecologic symptoms. The authors recommend a pregnancy test for women presenting with cerebral metastases, as it can confirm or exclude choriocarcinoma. The report emphasizes the diagnostic value of considering prior pregnancy in such presentations.

title: Quantitative DNA measurement by flow cytometry and image analysis of human nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍のフローサイトメトリーおよび画像解析による定量的DNA測定
summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍62例を対象に、フローサイトメトリーと画像解析による定量的DNA測定を比較した研究である。両法は76.5%で一致し、フローサイトメトリーのS期分画や画像解析の5c超過率が潜在性リンパ節転移の予測に有用であった。早期患者で後腹膜リンパ節郭清かフォローアップのみかを選択する一助となりうる。
summary_en: Flow cytometry and image analysis were compared in 62 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Both techniques agreed in 76.5% of samples. Aneuploid S-phase and G2M+S fractions by flow cytometry, and the 5c exceeding rate by image analysis, best predicted occult lymph node involvement. The authors suggest these measures may help select early-stage patients for lymph node dissection versus follow-up.

title: Difference in DNA index of seminomas and non-seminomas.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍におけるセミノーマと非セミノーマのDNA指数の差
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍90例の新鮮腫瘍組織をフローサイトメトリーで解析した研究である。中央値DNA指数はセミノーマ1.82に対し非セミノーマ1.53と有意に低かった。進行例はS期分画の増加や5c超過指数陽性と関連し、リンパ節転移は異数性により92.8%で検出された。セミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別に寄与しうると結論づけられた。
summary_en: Flow cytometry was performed on fresh tumor tissue from 90 patients with testicular germ cell tumors. The median DNA index was lower in nonseminomas (1.53) than in seminomas (1.82), P<0.01. Four of 42 nonseminoma patients had progressive disease, and these patients more often showed increased S-phase fraction or a positive 5c-exceeding index. Lymph node metastases were detected by aneuploidy in 92.8% of available nodes. The authors conclude that flow cytometry supports rapid diagnosis of malignancy and may help distinguish seminomas from nonseminomas.

title: Fertility in patients treated with radiotherapy following orchidectomy for testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣摘除後に放射線療法を受けた精巣セミノーマ患者の妊孕性
summary_ja: 精巣摘除後に放射線療法を受けた病期I・IIの精巣セミノーマ患者50例の妊孕性を検討した研究である。残存精巣への線量を2Gy未満に抑えると妊孕性が温存され、出生児に遺伝的異常は認められなかった。治療前の不妊例や治療後に子をもうけなかった例も多く報告されている。
summary_en: Studied 50 patients with stage I and II testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy to paraaortic and ipsilateral pelvic nodes after orchidectomy. Eleven were infertile before treatment, and 23 were unable or unwilling to father children after radiotherapy. Of the remaining 16 men, 11 pregnancies resulted. Fertility was preserved when the dose to the remaining testis was kept below 2 Gy. No genetic abnormalities were found in the offspring.

title: Fatal primary mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumour initially diagnosed as malignant mesothelioma.
title_ja: 悪性中皮腫と誤診された原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の致死的症例
summary_ja: 悪性中皮腫と誤診された原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。臨床経過と合わない初期診断の後、上大静脈閉塞に対する緩和的放射線療法を経てようやく正しい診断に至った。化学療法の開始前に大量喀血で死亡しており、診断の遅れの危険性を示している。
summary_en: A case report of a patient with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumour initially misdiagnosed as malignant mesothelioma. The initial diagnosis did not fit the clinical course. The correct diagnosis was reached only after palliative irradiation for superior vena cava obstruction. The patient died of massive haemoptysis before chemotherapy could begin. The case highlights the risk of diagnostic delay in mediastinal germ cell tumors and the importance of re-evaluating diagnoses that conflict with clinical progression.

title: Carcinoma in situ of the testis detected by DNA flow cytometry of testicular fine-needle aspirates.
title_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌を精巣穿刺吸引細胞診のDNAフローサイトメトリーで検出する
summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍18例の精巣穿刺吸引検体をDNAフローサイトメトリーで解析し、上皮内癌(CIS)の検出を検討したものである。全核解析では16例中11例しか検出できなかったが、過二倍体領域の解析により感度は93.8%に向上した。組織学的生検に代わる低侵襲な検出法としての臨床応用可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study evaluated DNA flow cytometry (FCM) of testicular fine-needle aspirates as an alternative to histological biopsy for detecting testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS) in patients with testicular germ cell tumors. Among 18 cases, CIS was histologically present in 16. Analysis of all nuclei detected aneuploid peaks in only 11 cases, but restricting analysis to the hyperdiploid compartment identified four additional cases, raising sensitivity to 93.8%. DNA indices of CIS and invasive tumors were nearly identical. The authors conclude that FCM of FNA samples may be clinically applicable for CIS detection.

title: Primary germ cell tumours of the mediastinum.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: タタ記念病院で1974〜1989年に診療された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍29例の後方視的検討である。良性例は術後良好であった。悪性例は男性のみで、セミノーマは放射線療法により75%が無病生存した一方、非セミノーマ性腫瘍は予後不良で、シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けても長期完全奏効は20%にとどまった。
summary_en: This 16-year single-institution series from Tata Memorial Hospital reviewed 29 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors. Benign tumors, mostly in females, had excellent outcomes after surgery. Malignant tumors occurred only in males, and prognosis differed by histology: seminomas treated mainly with radiotherapy achieved 75% disease-free survival, whereas non-seminomatous tumors had poor survival (mean 14 months with cisplatin-based chemotherapy versus 5.3 months without). Only 20% of cisplatin-treated non-seminomatous patients achieved long-term complete response, reflecting advanced disease at presentation.

title: Parapharyngeal teratoma in the newborn.
title_ja: 新生児の咽頭傍奇形腫
summary_ja: 新生児に生じた咽頭傍腔の奇形腫の症例報告である。急性呼吸窮迫に対して気管切開が行われ、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腫瘍の局在と範囲が確認された。経頸部的アプローチで完全切除され、組織学的には成熟脳組織が主体であった。術後6年間再発はなく、新生児の咽頭傍腔に生じた奇形腫の初の包括的報告とされる。
summary_en: This report describes a newborn with a parapharyngeal teratoma causing acute respiratory distress that was relieved by tracheostomy. Imaging including computed tomography defined the tumor's location and extent. The tumor was completely excised via a transcervical approach without mandibulotomy. Histology showed predominantly mature brain tissue with smaller amounts of fibrous and smooth muscle elements and minimal cartilage and epithelium. No recurrence was seen six years after surgery. The authors describe it as the first comprehensive report of a parapharyngeal teratoma in a newborn.

title: Combined single course carboplatin with radiotherapy in treatment of stage IIA,B seminoma--a preliminary report.
title_ja: 病期IIA・IIBのセミノーマに対するカルボプラチンと放射線療法の併用：予備的報告
summary_ja: 精巣摘除後の病期IIA・IIBのセミノーマ21例に対し、カルボプラチン単回投与後に放射線療法を行った予備的検討である。全例が完全寛解を達成し、無病の状態が続いていた。毒性は悪心・嘔吐が主で、血液毒性は軽度であった。横隔膜下放射線療法単独との比較には、より大規模で長期の検討が必要とされている。
summary_en: This preliminary report describes 21 patients with stage IIA or IIB seminoma treated after orchidectomy with a single course of carboplatin followed by conventional radiotherapy. Median follow-up was 34 months. All patients achieved complete remission and remained disease free. Main toxicities were nausea and vomiting, with only slight hematologic toxicity and no neuropathy, ototoxicity, or renal decline. The authors consider this combined approach feasible and effective but note that larger, longer-term studies are needed for comparison with infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy alone.

title: Targeting of tumours with murine and reshaped human monoclonal antibodies against placental alkaline phosphatase: immunolocalisation, pharmacokinetics and immune response.
title_ja: マウスおよびヒト化モノクローナル抗体による腫瘍標的化：胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼに対する免疫局在、薬物動態および免疫応答
summary_ja: 本初期臨床研究では、胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)を標的とする放射性標識モノクローナル抗体、マウス抗体H17E2およびヒト化抗体Hu2PLAPを、主に精巣および卵巣腫瘍のイメージングについて評価した。活動性精巣がん患者33例では、抗体スキャンにより腫瘍が確認され、従来の画像検査で陰性であった2例で病変が検出された。完全寛解の患者のスキャンは陰性であった。Hu2PLAPは、PLAP陽性の卵巣および胃の腫瘍のイメージングに成功し、H17E2より長い半減期を示したが、免疫応答により一部のスキャンは制限された。
summary_en: This early clinical study evaluated radiolabeled monoclonal antibodies against placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP), murine H17E2 and humanized Hu2PLAP, for imaging mainly testicular and ovarian tumors. In 33 patients with active testicular cancer, antibody scans confirmed tumors and detected disease in two patients with negative conventional imaging. Scans of patients in complete remission were negative. Hu2PLAP successfully imaged PLAP-positive ovarian and gastric tumors and had a longer half-life than H17E2, though immune responses limited some scans.

title: A study on the serum pregnancy zone protein levels in pregnant women and patients with gynecological tumors.
title_ja: 妊婦および婦人科腫瘍患者における血清妊娠帯蛋白(PZP)濃度の検討
summary_ja: 正常妊娠708例、異常妊娠207例、婦人科腫瘍188例で血清妊娠帯蛋白(PZP)を測定した検討である。侵入奇胎の51.6%、絨毛癌の80.0%で値が低下していた。卵巣癌では他の卵巣腫瘍より高値であった。切迫流産の評価や栄養膜疾患・婦人科腫瘍の鑑別に有用な指標になりうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study measured serum pregnancy zone protein (PZP) in 708 normal pregnancies, 207 abnormal pregnancies, and 188 patients with gynecological tumors. PZP rose with gestational age in normal pregnancy. Levels were lower than normal in about half of patients with invasive moles and 80% with choriocarcinoma. Among gynecological tumors, levels were higher in ovarian carcinoma than other ovarian tumors and in endometrial or cervical carcinoma than uterine myomas. The authors propose PZP as a reference index for threatened abortion and trophoblastic disease.

title: DNA ploidy analysis of pediatric germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍のDNA倍数性解析
summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍32例のパラフィン包埋組織を用いてDNA倍数性解析を行った研究である。未熟卵巣奇形腫では高グレードほど異数体を示し、卵黄嚢腫瘍は異数体や四倍体が多かった。仙尾部奇形腫が卵黄嚢腫瘍へ転化した例では異数体の出現が認められた。小児胚細胞腫瘍は成人例と発生機序が異なる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study applies static image cytometry to paraffin-embedded tissues from 32 patients under 18 to assess DNA ploidy in pediatric germ cell tumors. Teratomas were mostly diploid, with aneuploidy found in higher-grade immature ovarian teratomas, while endodermal sinus tumors were frequently aneuploid or tetraploid. Infantile testicular and extragonadal endodermal sinus tumors were often diploid or tetraploid. Sacrococcygeal teratomas that transformed into endodermal sinus tumors acquired aneuploidy. The authors suggest pediatric GCTs may be pathogenetically distinct from adult tumors.

title: Video-assisted thoracoscopic resection of a mediastinal cyst: report of a case.
title_ja: 縦隔嚢胞性病変に対するビデオ補助下胸腔鏡切除：症例報告
summary_ja: 23歳女性の縦隔嚢胞性病変に対し、胸腔鏡下切除を施行した症例報告。術後経過は良好で疼痛は少なく、速やかに回復した。病理学的に良性の嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。縦隔嚢胞性病変に対する低侵襲手術の有用性を示している。
summary_en: A 23-year-old woman underwent successful video-assisted thoracoscopic resection of a mediastinal cystic lesion. Her postoperative course was uneventful, with minimal pain and rapid recovery. Histology confirmed a benign cystic teratoma. The authors suggest that video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery will become the standard approach for most mediastinal cystic lesions. The case report highlights the expanding role of minimally invasive endoscopic surgery in mediastinal tumors.

title: Attempted protection of spermatogenesis from irradiation in patients with seminoma by D-Tryptophan-6 luteinizing hormone releasing hormone.
title_ja: 放射線療法を受けるセミノーマ患者における精子形成保護の試み：D-Trp-6-LH-RHの効果
summary_ja: 精巣摘除後のセミノーマ患者を対象に、放射線療法前からGnRHアゴニストを投与し、精子形成の保護効果を検討した。治療群12名と対照群8名を比較した結果、用いた投与法では放射線による精巣障害に対する保護効果は認められず、18か月後には全例で精子や性ホルモン値が回復した。
summary_en: Twelve men with seminoma who underwent unilateral orchiectomy received the long-acting GnRH agonist D-Trp-6-LH-RH, combined with cyproterone acetate, before and during radiotherapy, and were compared with eight controls. Pituitary-gonadal axis suppression was achieved, but at 18 months after therapy all patients, regardless of treatment, recovered gonadotropin, testosterone, and motile sperm levels. The GnRH agonist showed no protective effect against radiation-induced testicular damage at the dose and schedule studied.

title: Oxyphilic follicular tumor arising in struma ovarii.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に生じた好酸性濾胞性腫瘍
summary_ja: 26歳女性の両側性の無症候性成熟奇形腫に伴う卵巣甲状腺腫で、増殖性病変が認められた。免疫組織化学と超微形態により好酸性濾胞性甲状腺腫瘍と同定された。悪性を疑わせる所見はあったが、核分裂像の増加や脈管侵襲はなく、両側卵巣部分切除後1年で良好な経過が確認された。
summary_en: A 26-year-old woman had bilateral asymptomatic mature ovarian teratomas, and a proliferative lesion within a struma ovarii was found. Immunohistochemistry and ultrastructure identified it as an oxyphilic follicular thyroid tumor. Although solid trabecular growth and nuclear pleomorphism raised suspicion of malignancy, high mitotic activity and vascular invasion were absent. The patient remained well one year after bilateral subtotal ovariectomy.

title: Examination for intratubular germ cell neoplasia at operation for undescended testis in boys.
title_ja: 停留精巣に対する手術時の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の検索
summary_ja: 停留精巣の手術時に精巣生検を受けた男児843例を成人まで追跡し、胚細胞腫瘍の有無を検討した。非セミノーマ、セミノーマ、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を含む5例が確認された。染色体異常や外性器異常を伴う症例での生検実施を推奨し、セルトリ細胞のみの所見では将来の精巣がんを否定できないと結論している。
summary_en: 843 boys who underwent testicular biopsy during orchiopexy for undescended testis were followed into adulthood to screen for germ cell neoplasia. Five cases were identified, including nonseminoma, seminoma, and intratubular germ cell neoplasms. Three of these had abnormal karyotype or external genitalia. The authors recommend biopsy in boys with 45,X/46,XY karyotype or abnormal genitalia, noting that Sertoli-cell-only biopsies do not exclude later testicular cancer.

title: Modulation of cytostatic drugs by nifedipine in two heterotransplanted human testicular-cancer cell lines differing in their sensitivity to standard agents.
title_ja: ヒト精巣がん細胞株2種におけるニフェジピンによる抗がん薬の修飾作用
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 感受性の異なる2種のヒト精巣がん細胞株を移植したヌードマウスを用い、ニフェジピンと各種抗がん薬の併用効果を検討した。ニフェジピンはシスプラチンの抗腫瘍効果を高めたが、毒性も増加した。他の薬剤との併用では効果の増強は認められなかった。臨床応用には毒性軽減が必要とされる。
summary_en: Nude mice bearing two human testicular cancer xenografts with different chemosensitivity were treated with nifedipine combined with cisplatin, epirubicin, vinblastine, or etoposide. Nifedipine significantly enhanced cisplatin antitumor activity in vivo and in vitro, apparently independent of P-glycoprotein-mediated resistance, but also increased toxicity. Combinations with the other agents showed no benefit. The authors conclude that further work is needed to reduce toxicity before clinical application.

title: Differential expression of protooncogenes in human germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるがん原遺伝子の発現差
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究では、ノーザンブロット解析を用いて、原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ16例、胎児性癌6例、未熟奇形腫を含む)および正常精巣における15種のがん原遺伝子の発現を調べた。セミノーマと胎児性癌ではN-mycの発現が高く、c-erbB-1およびc-erbB-2は発現していなかった。一方、未熟奇形腫ではc-erbB-1が発現し、進行例の1例ではc-erbB-2も発現していた。著者らは、N-mycは未分化腫瘍に重要であり、erbB受容体は分化した腫瘍に寄与する可能性があり、腫瘍の分化に伴ってがん原遺伝子の発現が切り替わると提案している。
summary_en: This study used Northern blot analysis to examine the expression of 15 protooncogenes in primary testicular germ cell tumors, including 16 seminomas, 6 embryonal carcinomas, and immature teratomas, alongside normal testes. Seminomas and embryonal carcinomas showed high N-myc expression and lacked c-erbB-1 and c-erbB-2, whereas immature teratomas expressed c-erbB-1, and one advanced case showed c-erbB-2. The authors propose that N-myc may be important for undifferentiated tumors, while erbB receptors may contribute to differentiated tumors, suggesting that protooncogene expression switches during tumor differentiation.

title: Multiple mechanisms of resistance in a series of human testicular teratoma cell lines selected for increasing resistance to etoposide.
title_ja: エトポシド耐性を段階的に獲得させたヒト精巣奇形腫細胞株系列における複数の耐性機構
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト精巣奇形腫細胞株SuSaから、放射線照射やエトポシド(VP-16)の曝露によりエトポシド耐性亜株を樹立し、耐性機序を解析した。低度耐性にはトポイソメラーゼIIの変化が、高度耐性にはP糖蛋白(Pgp)の過剰発現が関与していた。
summary_en: Resistant sublines were derived from the human testicular teratoma cell line SuSa by X-irradiation or by etoposide (VP-16) exposure, either pulsed for 24 hours or continuous. Resistance ranged from 3- to 33-fold and was accompanied by cross-resistance to vincristine, with some sublines also resistant to doxorubicin. Resistance was not linked to altered drug accumulation. Instead, decreased etoposide-induced single-strand breaks and reduced Topo II beta mRNA were observed. Pgp overexpression appeared only in the most resistant sublines, suggesting that Topo II modifications precede Pgp overexpression in low-level resistance.

title: The correlation of P53 protein expression with proliferative activity and occult metastases in clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(精巣)におけるp53蛋白発現と増殖活性・潜在性転移との相関
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍69例で、p53蛋白の免疫染色をS期解析およびPCNA陽性率と比較した。49%がp53陽性で、p53陽性例は増殖活性が有意に高かった。p53の発現は腫瘍の増殖活性と関連することが示された。
summary_en: Sixty-nine clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis were immunostained for p53 using a microwave antigen retrieval method and compared with S-phase fraction by flow cytometry and PCNA labeling on the same tissue blocks. Forty-nine percent were p53-positive. p53-positive tumors had significantly higher S-phase fractions and PCNA-positive percentages than p53-negative tumors, and high PCNA levels correlated with p53 positivity. The authors interpret this as consistent with p53 mutations marking aggressiveness in other neoplasms. The title also links p53 to occult metastases, which the truncated abstract does not detail.

title: Origin of adult male mediastinal germ-cell tumours.
title_ja: 成人男性の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の起源
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 著者らは、成人男性の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と性腺の胚細胞腫瘍の非ランダムな染色体異常を比較し、前駆細胞が異なる発生段階に由来するかを検証した。組織学的亜型の構成は群間で異なったものの、非ランダムな染色体変化は本質的に同一であった。これらの知見は、すべての男性の胚細胞腫瘍が性腺に由来し、初期発生において前駆細胞が縦隔などの性腺外部位へ稀に移動することを支持する。著者らは、上皮内癌、原始生殖細胞の移動、精母細胞の減数分裂挙動を統合した起源モデルを提案している。
summary_en: The authors compared non-random chromosomal abnormalities in adult male mediastinal germ cell tumors with those in gonadal germ cell tumors to test whether they arise from precursors at different developmental stages. Although histological subtype composition differed between groups, their non-random chromosomal changes were essentially the same. These findings support a gonadal origin for all male germ cell tumors, with occasional early migration of precursors to extragonadal sites such as the mediastinum. The authors propose a model of male germ cell tumor origin that integrates carcinoma in situ, embryonal migration of primordial germ cells, and spermatocyte meiotic behavior.

title: Carcinoma in situ in boys with cryptorchidism: when can it be detected?
title_ja: 停留精巣の男児における上皮内癌:いつ検出可能か
summary_ja: 停留精巣の男児57例(1～16歳)から採取した精巣生検70検体を対象とした。悪性胚細胞腫瘍は3精巣に発生したが、上皮内癌は16歳の1検体のみで確認された。小児期の生検では成人期の腫瘍発生を確実に除外できない可能性があり、思春期前に前がん病変は認められなかった。
summary_en: Researchers reviewed 70 testicular biopsies taken during orchidopexy from 57 boys aged 1 to 16 years, with follow-up through 1989. Malignant germ cell tumors developed in three testes, but carcinoma in situ was found in only one biopsy, taken at age 16 and four years before a teratoma appeared. Earlier biopsies from the same and contralateral testes showed no carcinoma in situ, including one taken 22 years before tumor diagnosis. The authors conclude that childhood biopsies may not reliably exclude later adult tumors, and that no histological premalignant changes were detected before puberty.

title: High-dose treatment with carboplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide followed by autologous stem-cell transplantation in relapsed or refractory germ cell cancer: a phase I/II study. The German Testicular Cancer Cooperative Study Group.
title_ja: 再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍に対するカルボプラチン・エトポシド・イホスファミドによる大量化学療法と自家幹細胞移植:第I/II相試験
summary_ja: 再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍74例を対象に、カルボプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミドによる大量化学療法と自家幹細胞移植を評価した。カルボプラチン1,500mg/m2で安全性が確認され、奏効率は63%、2年時点の全生存期間(全生存率)は44%であった。化学感受性のある症例で予後が良く、救済療法として有効と結論された。
summary_en: This German Testicular Cancer Cooperative Study Group phase I/II trial evaluated high-dose carboplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide followed by autologous stem-cell transplantation in 74 patients with refractory or relapsed germ cell cancer. Unacceptable nephrotoxicity and neurotoxicity occurred at carboplatin 1,750 to 2,000 mg/m2, whereas the 1,500 mg/m2 dose with etoposide 2,400 mg/m2 and ifosfamide 10 g/m2 was considered safe. The objective response rate was 63%, and the 2-year overall survival was 44%. Patients with chemosensitive disease fared better than those with refractory disease, supporting this regimen as an effective salvage therapy.

title: Expression of c-erb B-2 oncogene product in persistent gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるc-erbB-2癌遺伝子産物の発現
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎除去後の持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を予測するため、56例の絨毛組織でc-erbB-2発現を後方視的に免疫組織化学染色で検討した。陽性は持続例の1例のみで、c-erbB-2発現と持続性疾患の関連は有意ではなかった。今後は他の癌遺伝子産物の検討が必要とされた。
summary_en: This retrospective immunohistochemical study examined c-erbB-2 oncoprotein expression in 56 trophoblastic tissue specimens. The cohort included complete moles that progressed to persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, choriocarcinomas after term pregnancy or abortion, spontaneously regressing moles, and first-trimester and term placenta controls. Only one case of persistent disease stained positive, and all other groups were negative. The authors concluded that c-erbB-2 expression did not significantly correlate with persistent disease after molar evacuation, and suggested that future work should investigate other oncoproteins.

title: Familial testicular carcinoma: in search of genetic triggers.
title_ja: 家族性精巣がん：遺伝的誘因の探索
summary_ja: がん好発家系の非双生児兄弟に発生した精巣腫瘍2例を報告した。細胞遺伝学的検査と家系のHLA型判定では遺伝的欠損は同定されなかった。著者らは連鎖解析を提案したが、実施には追加の家系が必要とされた。
summary_en: This short report describes two cases of testicular tumours in non-twin brothers from a family with a history of cancer predisposition. Cytogenetic analysis of both patients and HLA typing of the family did not identify any genetic defect. The authors propose linkage analysis as the next step for genetic study of familial testicular carcinoma. However, they note that this approach would require additional families with multiple affected members before it could be performed.

title: Aetiology of testicular cancer: association with congenital abnormalities, age at puberty, infertility, and exercise. United Kingdom Testicular Cancer Study Group.
title_ja: 精巣がんの病因：停留精巣、思春期年齢、不妊、運動との関連
summary_ja: 英国の症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性794例を検討した。停留精巣と鼠径ヘルニアは危険因子であり、10歳前の精巣固定術でその過剰リスクは消失した。思春期の早さや不妊、運動不足は関連し、運動は保護的であった。
summary_en: This population-based case-control study from England and Wales included 794 men aged 15 to 49 years with testicular germ cell tumours diagnosed from 1984 to 1987, each matched with a general practice control. Questionnaires and general practitioner records were used to assess risk factors. Undescended testis and inguinal hernia were associated with increased risk, and this excess was eliminated by orchidopexy before age 10. Early puberty markers, infertility, and sedentary lifestyle were positively associated, while exercise showed a protective effect. Vasectomy showed no association.

title: Proliferating cell nuclear antigen expression to predict occult disease in clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における潜在病変の予測因子としてのPCNA発現
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍89例で、PCNA発現と組織学的特徴から潜在転移（病理病期II）や再発を予測できるかを検討した。血管侵襲と胎児性癌の割合が最も有用で、両者の組み合わせで正診率85.9%を示した。
summary_en: This study analysed primary tumour tissue from 89 men with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. The authors evaluated PCNA expression and histological features to distinguish pathological stage I from stage II disease or later relapse. Vascular invasion and a higher percentage of embryonal carcinoma were highly predictive of occult disease. The combination of these two factors provided the best predictive model, with 85.9% accuracy. Adding PCNA expression did not improve the clinical model.

title: Deficient repair of cisplatin-DNA adducts identified in human testicular teratoma cell lines established from tumours from untreated patients.
title_ja: 未治療患者由来の精巣奇形腫細胞株におけるシスプラチン-DNA付加体の修復欠損
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 未治療患者由来の精巣奇形腫細胞株4株で、シスプラチン感受性とPt-DNA付加体の除去能を検討した。主要な付加体の多くは18時間後も残存し、修復能の低下が示された。この修復欠損が、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のシスプラチン高感受性の基盤と考えられた。
summary_en: This study examined cisplatin sensitivity and platinum-DNA adduct repair in four testicular teratoma cell lines derived from untreated patients. All lines were highly sensitive to cisplatin, with IC50 values of 0.09 to 0.42 micrograms per mL. Most major platinum-DNA adducts persisted 18 hours after exposure, indicating reduced repair. Expression of DNA polymerase beta, ERCC-1 and XPBC/ERCC-3 was analysed as well. The authors propose that defective repair of platinum-DNA crosslinks explains the hypersensitivity of testicular germ cell tumours to cisplatin.

title: Cancers not associated with immunodeficiency in HIV infected persons.
title_ja: 免疫不全との関連がないHIV感染者の悪性腫瘍
summary_ja: HIV感染者で免疫不全と明確に関連しない悪性腫瘍として、肺癌と胚細胞悪性腫瘍を概説した。胚細胞悪性腫瘍は感染者と非感染者で臨床像や組織像に違いがなく、標準的な治療も適切に忍容されると結論づけた。
summary_en: This review examines cancers in HIV-infected persons that are not clearly linked to immunodeficiency, focusing on lung cancer and germ-cell malignancies. Lung cancer in HIV patients presents younger, at a more advanced stage, and more often as adenocarcinoma, with no clear link between immunodeficiency and stage or survival. Germ-cell malignancies in HIV-infected patients resemble those in uninfected patients in presentation and histology. The authors conclude that treatment for germ-cell malignancies is well tolerated and appropriate for HIV-infected patients.

title: Differential formation and enhanced removal of specific cisplatin-DNA adducts in two cisplatin-selected resistant human testicular teratoma sublines.
title_ja: 2種のシスプラチン耐性ヒト精巣奇形腫サブラインにおける、特異的なシスプラチン-DNA付加体の形成差と除去の促進
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 未治療の精巣奇形腫から樹立した、シスプラチン耐性（約3倍）を示す2つの細胞サブラインを検討した。薬剤取り込みやグルタチオン量に差はなく、耐性は特定の白金-DNA付加体を親株より効率よく修復する能力によると示された。付加体の種類ごとに修復パターンが異なっていた。
