summary_en: This study examined cisplatin resistance in two independently selected sublines derived from a primary human testicular teratoma, each showing about threefold resistance. Drug uptake, total glutathione, and related enzyme activities were not altered. Instead, the resistant sublines removed specific platinum-DNA adducts more efficiently than their parental lines, which generally repair poorly. Each subline showed a distinct repair pattern: one efficiently cleared intrastrand Pt-AG and Pt-(GMP)2 lesions and interstrand cross-links, while the other removed Pt-GG adducts well. These findings suggest that enhanced, adduct-specific DNA repair underlies cisplatin resistance in testicular teratoma cells.

title: Management of yolk sac tumor of the testis in children.
title_ja: 小児精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の管理
summary_ja: 1978〜1990年に精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された小児30例を後方視的に検討した。病期Iは精巣摘除術のみで無病生存率89%と良好で、後腹膜リンパ節郭清や定期的化学療法の上乗せ効果は認められなかった。病期II・IIIには化学療法または放射線療法が必要とされた。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 30 children treated for testicular yolk sac tumor at Chang Gung Children's Hospital from 1978 to 1990 assessed outcomes by disease stage. All underwent orchidectomy first. Stage I patients treated with orchidectomy alone achieved an 89% disease-free survival rate when followed with strict alpha-fetoprotein monitoring. Retroperitoneal node dissection and routine chemotherapy gave no survival benefit at this stage. Patients with stage II or III disease required chemotherapy or irradiation for better outcomes, supporting stage-based management in pediatric yolk sac tumor.

title: Treatment of malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍の治療
summary_ja: 1982〜1992年に卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍35例を治療した。死亡例は主に卵黄嚢腫瘍と混合型で、悪性度の高い組織型にはVAC療法よりプラチナ製剤が推奨された。未熟奇形腫は手術単独または補助化学療法で良好な成績であった。早期例では妊孕性温存も可能であった。
summary_en: This study reviewed 35 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 1982 and 1992, including immature teratoma, endodermal sinus tumor, dysgerminoma, and mixed germ cell tumor. Most received postoperative multiagent chemotherapy. Five patients died, mainly those with yolk sac or mixed histology. Stage I immature teratoma was cured by surgery alone or with adjuvant chemotherapy. For aggressive histologies, platinum-based regimens were preferred over VAC, and fertility preservation was feasible in early or selected advanced disease.

title: Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and its free subunits in hydrocele fluids and neoplastic tissue of testicular cancer patients: insights into the in vivo hCG-secretion pattern.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者の水瘤液および腫瘍組織中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびその遊離サブユニット：生体内でのhCG分泌パターンに関する知見
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者13例の水瘤液でhCGおよび遊離サブユニットを測定し、血清と比較した。水瘤液では検出率が血清より高く、血中マーカー陰性の純粋セミノーマ5例でも遊離hCGβが全例で上昇していた。RT-PCRでも産生が確認された。マーカー陰性の分類は再検討が必要とされた。
summary_en: This study measured hCG and its free alpha and beta subunits in hydrocele fluid from 13 testicular cancer patients and compared them with peripheral and testicular vein serum, using 11 nonmalignant hydroceles as controls. Hydrocele fluid showed higher detection rates than peripheral serum, and free hCGβ was elevated in all five pure seminomas that were marker-negative in blood. RT-PCR confirmed hCGβ and hCGα transcription in these tumors. The authors conclude that marker-negative classification of testicular cancer should be reconsidered.

title: Ifosfamide and carboplatin combined with 41.8 degrees C whole-body hyperthermia in patients with refractory sarcoma and malignant teratoma.
title_ja: 難治性肉腫および悪性奇形腫患者に対するイホスファミドとカルボプラチンと41.8℃全身温熱療法の併用
summary_ja: 難治性肉腫または悪性奇形腫19例に、イホスファミド・カルボプラチンと41.8℃全身温熱療法を併用した。白血球・血小板の最低値に有意差はなく、部分寛解7例を認めた。温熱の有無でイホスファミド代謝物の血中濃度が変化した。用量制限毒性は腎症であった。
summary_en: Nineteen patients with refractory sarcoma or malignant teratoma received ifosfamide and carboplatin combined with 41.8°C whole-body hyperthermia in a pilot study. Hyperthermia did not significantly change leukocyte or platelet nadirs, though ifosfamide metabolite levels shifted. Of 19 evaluable patients, 7 had partial remission and 8 had stabilization. Nephropathy was the dose-limiting toxicity, and no hyperthermia-related deaths occurred. The authors conclude the combination is feasible with acceptable toxicity, warranting further evaluation.

title: Gene expression in X-irradiated human tumour cell lines expressing cisplatin resistance and altered DNA repair capacity.
title_ja: X線照射したシスプラチン耐性およびDNA修復能が変化したヒト腫瘍細胞株における遺伝子発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 分割X線照射により得られたシスプラチン耐性細胞株で遺伝子発現を検討した。精巣奇形腫由来のSuSaサブラインでのみERCC1 mRNAが増加した。卵巣癌由来のSKOV-3サブラインの耐性は2倍であった。耐性機序は薬剤選択された卵巣癌細胞のものとは異なると考えられた。
summary_en: This study examined whether altered gene expression explains cisplatin resistance in two human tumour sublines made resistant by fractionated X-irradiation rather than drug exposure. One subline derived from a testicular teratoma line (SuSa) and one from ovarian carcinoma (SKOV-3) showed about 3-fold and 2-fold resistance. Most genes were expressed similarly to parental cells, but only the teratoma subline increased ERCC1 mRNA. ERCC3/XPB expression was unchanged. Resistance appears to arise through mechanisms different from those in drug-selected ovarian cells.

title: A modified technique for nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors using intraoperative measurement of bladder neck pressure alterations following sympathetic nerve fiber electrostimulation.
title_ja: 病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する、膀胱頸部圧測定を用いた神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清の改良法
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの病期I（4例）と病期II（6例）に対し、射精を温存する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の改良法を報告。術中電気刺激で交感神経線維を同定し、膀胱頸部圧を監視した。全例で射精が保たれ、精液所見の多くも維持された。化学療法後に術前無精子症を呈した例では一部回復を認めた。
summary_en: This report describes a modified nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous testicular cancer. Sympathetic fibers involved in antegrade ejaculation were identified by intraoperative electrostimulation, with bladder neck closure pressure monitored by a two-channel microtip catheter. Ten patients with stage I (4) or stage II (6) disease were treated, and ejaculation was preserved in all. Sperm parameters were largely maintained, although some patients who had received chemotherapy were azoospermic before surgery, and one showed partial recovery.

title: Testicular tumor and the acquired immunodeficiency syndrome.
title_ja: AIDS患者における精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: HIV陽性男性のEBウイルス関連精巣リンパ腫を報告し、文献上のHIV陽性者の精巣腫瘍19例を整理した。内訳は胚細胞腫瘍15例とリンパ腫4例。初期は精巣炎と誤診されやすい。免疫不全では進展が強く、胚細胞腫瘍では早期の後腹膜リンパ節郭清が再発予防に推奨されている。
summary_en: This review presents a case of EBV-associated testicular lymphoma in an HIV-positive man and surveys 19 published cases of testicular tumors in HIV-positive patients. Fifteen were germ cell tumors and four were lymphomas. Early presentations were often misdiagnosed as orchitis. Management is complicated by extensive tumor spread in immunodeficiency. The authors summarize treatment approaches: chemotherapy for lymphoma, and early aggressive retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for germ cell tumors to reduce the risk of relapse.

title: Partial orchidectomy for second testicular tumour.
title_ja: 2つ目の精巣腫瘍に対する部分精巣摘除術
summary_ja: 対側精巣に根治的精巣摘除術を受けた精巣がん患者が、残存精巣の2つ目の腫瘍に部分精巣摘除術を受けた症例報告。術後に2人の子をもうけた。家族計画が未完了の単独精巣に生じた早期胚細胞腫瘍では、部分切除による精巣温存が選択肢になり得ると述べる。単一症例であり一般化は難しい。
summary_en: This case report describes a man who had a radical orchidectomy for testicular cancer on one side and later underwent partial orchidectomy for a second testicular tumor in the remaining testis. He subsequently fathered two children. The authors suggest that testis-sparing partial orchidectomy may be considered for men with early germ cell tumor in a solitary testis who have not completed their families. Because this is a single case, evidence for routine use is limited.

title: Spermatocytic seminoma.
title_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣に発生する稀な成人型腫瘍である精母細胞性セミノーマを、病理組織学的、DNA解析、レクチン結合性の観点から検討した論文。ほぼ全例が精巣摘除術で根治し、転移例は200例超のうち1例のみと報告されている。通常のセミノーマとは多くの点で異なり、セミノーマの亜型ではないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This paper describes spermatocytic seminoma, a rare neoplasm found only in adults and in descended testes, with no ovarian counterpart. Orchiectomy is curative in nearly all cases, and only one of more than 200 reported cases has metastasized. Grossly, the tumor is edematous or gelatinous, and microscopically it consists of small, medium, and large cells with spherical nuclei and no glycogen. Unlike classical seminoma, it lacks haploid DNA populations and spermatocyte-type lectin maturation, and the authors conclude it is not a seminoma variant. Sarcomas arising in association with it have often caused death from metastatic disease.

title: Unique combination of an ovarian gonadoblastoma, dysgerminoma, and mucinous cystadenoma in a patient with Turner's syndrome: a cytogenetic and molecular analysis.
title_ja: ターナー症候群患者にみられた卵巣性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、粘液性嚢胞腺腫の複合腫瘍：細胞遺伝学的および分子学的解析
summary_ja: ターナー症候群でXO/XYモザイクを示す患者に生じた卵巣複合腫瘍（性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、粘液性嚢胞腺腫）の症例。in situハイブリダイゼーションと分子解析によりY染色体長腕の欠失を同定した。モザイクをクローナルマーカーとして用い、ディスジャーミノーマと嚢胞腺腫が独立した起源をもつことを示した。複合腫瘍が必ずしも同一起源ではないため、クローン解析の必要性を強調している。
summary_en: This paper describes a patient with Turner syndrome who had a composite ovarian neoplasm comprising a gonadoblastoma, a dysgerminoma, and a mucinous cystadenoma. In situ hybridization revealed an XO/XY genotype with partial Yq deletion, and molecular analysis mapped the breakpoint to deletion interval 6. Using the mosaicism as a clonal marker, the authors showed that the dysgerminoma and cystadenoma arose independently. This supports an ovarian surface epithelial origin for mucinous cysts with gastrointestinal epithelium. The study also shows that composite tumors do not necessarily share a common origin, so clonal analysis is needed to establish their relationship.

title: Immature ovarian teratoma with mature peritoneal metastatic deposits showing glial, epithelial, and endometrioid differentiation: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の腹膜転移巣に神経膠、上皮、子宮内膜様分化を認めた症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: グレード1の未熟卵巣奇形腫切除の20年後に発生した腹膜転移の症例報告。転移巣は成熟した神経膠、上皮、子宮内膜症様の分化を示し、腹膜神経膠腫症や子宮内膜症の併存と関連する。精巣奇形腫にも類似した高分化型転移が生じることを指摘し、この組み合わせは文献上ユニークとしている。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman with multiple peritoneal metastases showing mature glial, epithelial, and endometriotic differentiation. The metastases appeared 20 years after resection of a grade 1 immature ovarian teratoma. The findings resemble gliomatosis peritonei and endometriosis, which have been reported together before. The authors also note that similar well-differentiated metastases occur in testicular teratomas. They consider this combination of differentiation patterns unique in the literature, and they review previous cases of epithelial differentiation in metastases from immature ovarian teratomas.

title: Gallium-67-citrate imaging in extragonadal and gonadal seminomas: relationship to radiologic findings.
title_ja: 性腺外および性腺のセミノーマにおけるガリウム67クエン酸イメージング：放射線学的所見との関係
summary_ja: 性腺外セミノーマ3例と性腺セミノーマ9例で、ガリウム67シンチグラフィーの感度と化学療法後の反応を検討。治療前の感度は92%で、1.5cmの病変も検出された。化学療法後はCTで残存陰影が多くみられたが、ガリウムスキャンの11部位中10部位は正常で、フォローアップでも活動性腫瘍は否定された。残存病変の活動性と線維化の鑑別に有用と結論づけた。
summary_en: This study compares baseline and follow-up gallium-67 citrate scintigraphy in three patients with extragonadal seminoma and nine with gonadal seminoma. Pretherapy scan sensitivity was 92% overall, the smallest detectable mass was 1.5 cm, and there was no significant difference between sites. After chemotherapy, CT showed residual masses in all extragonadal and most gonadal sites, but gallium scans were normal in 10 of 11 sites. Clinical follow-up for 6 to 72 months supported the absence of active tumor. The authors conclude that gallium imaging can distinguish active disease from fibrosis in residual masses after treatment.

title: Thymic hyperplasia in newly diagnosed testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 新規診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍における胸腺過形成
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍362例の後方視的検討で、化学療法前の病期分類CTにおいて4例（1.8%）に胸腺過形成を認めた。全例が低病期で、2例は胸腺摘除術により組織学的に反跳性過形成と確認された。前縦隔の腫瘤を認めた際は転移と即断せず、胸腺過形成を鑑別に挙げるべきと結論づけた。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 362 testicular germ cell tumor patients identified thymic hyperplasia on staging chest CT in four patients (1.8%) before any systemic therapy. Three had seminoma and one had nonseminoma, all with low-stage disease and diagnostic delays of 5 to 24 weeks. Thymic hyperplasia was found 18 to 37 days after orchiectomy. Two patients underwent thymectomy, which showed rebound hyperplasia histologically. None had recurrence after 1 to 54 months. The authors conclude that an anterior mediastinal mass in newly diagnosed low-stage testicular cancer may be thymic hyperplasia rather than metastatic disease.

title: [Torsion of a seminoma in an intrascrotal testis. A case report].
title_ja: 陰嚢内精巣に生じたセミノーマの捻転：症例報告
summary_ja: 54歳男性の左陰嚢腫脹・疼痛例。精巣シンチグラフィで血流欠損を認め急性精巣捻転が疑われたが、術中に720度の捻転を伴う陰嚢内精巣のセミノーマと判明し、根治的精巣摘除術を施行した。術後4年時点で無病生存している。陰嚢内精巣腫瘍の捻転は極めて稀で、本邦初の報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old man with acute left scrotal pain whose presentation mimicked testicular torsion. Technetium-99m RBC scintigraphy showed absent uptake, and inguinal exploration revealed a 720-degree torsion of an intrascrotal testis. Histology confirmed seminoma, and radical orchiectomy was performed. The patient remained disease-free at 4 years. The authors note that torsion of an intrascrotal testicular tumor is very rare, with only five prior cases reported worldwide and this being the first in Japan.

title: Frequent allelic deletions and loss of expression characterize the DCC gene in male germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍におけるDCC遺伝子の高頻度な対立遺伝子欠失と発現消失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍61例の対になる正常・腫瘍DNAを用い、DCC遺伝子のLOH解析とRT-PCRによる発現解析を行った。45%に18q21の対立遺伝子欠失、2例にホモ接合欠失を認め、細胞株の45%と腫瘍組織1例で発現消失、3例で発現低下がみられた。セミノーマと非セミノーマの全組織型で高頻度にLOHを認め、DCC抑制が胚細胞腫瘍発生の初期事象である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined the DCC tumor suppressor gene in 61 paired normal-tumor DNA samples from male germ cell tumors, along with cell lines and tumor tissues, using LOH analysis and RT-PCR. Allelic deletions at 18q21 occurred in 45% of tumors, and two homozygous deletions were identified. DCC expression was absent in 45% of cell lines and one tumor, and reduced in three tissue samples. Loss of heterozygosity was seen across seminomas and all non-seminoma subtypes, in both primary and metastatic tumors. The authors conclude that DCC suppression is likely an early event in GCT development.

title: Retroperitoneal imaging with third and fourth generation computed axial tomography in clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における第3・第4世代コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による後腹膜画像診断
summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床病期Iの精巣非セミノーマ患者57例を対象に、第3・第4世代CTによる後腹膜病期分類の正確性を検討したものです。術前のCTと腫瘍マーカーが正常であった症例の33%が手術で病期が上がり、CTの正確度はわずか66%でした。CT単独での病期分類への依存に警鐘を鳴らしています。
summary_en: This 1994 Urology study assessed the accuracy of third- and fourth-generation CT for retroperitoneal staging in 57 patients with clinical stage I testicular nonseminoma. Despite normal preoperative CT and tumor markers, 33% were upstaged at surgery, including 11% with volume disease. CT accuracy was only 66%, and 6 of 7 pathologic stage II cases showed nonpathologic nodes by size criteria. The authors caution against relying solely on CT and advise suspicion for occult nodal disease when any nodes are present in the landing zone.

title: Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in a four month old boy complicated with precocious puberty.
title_ja: 生後4か月男児に発生した原発性肺絨毛癌（思春期早発を合併）
summary_ja: 生後4か月の男児に発生した原発性肺絨毛癌の症例です。同性性早発思春期と血清hCG高値を呈し、右肺の孤立性腫瘍を摘出して絨毛癌と診断されました。頭蓋照射と化学療法は一時的な効果にとどまり、より有効な治療法の確立が必要であると結論づけています。
summary_en: This report describes a four-month-old boy with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma who presented with isosexual precocious puberty and markedly elevated serum hCG. A solitary right lung nodule was identified on chest X-ray, MRI and gallium scintigraphy and resected about six weeks after symptom onset, with histology and hCG staining confirming choriocarcinoma. Skull irradiation and cisplatin-vinblastine-bleomycin chemotherapy produced only transient tumor shrinkage and hCG normalization, and the authors call for more effective regimens.

title: Intraoperative molar pregnancy crisis.
title_ja: 奇胎妊娠の術中クライシス
summary_ja: 奇胎妊娠（胞状奇胎）の手術中に生じる危機的状況を扱った周術期看護の総説です。診断、吸引搔爬、子宮摘出などの治療に加え、肺機能不全、絨毛癌、播種性血管内凝固などの合併症を挙げ、看護師が果たす役割を解説しています。
summary_en: This perioperative nursing review examines the intraoperative crisis of molar pregnancy, a gestational trophoblastic disease feared among gynecologic tumors. It describes first-trimester bleeding, hyperemesis and toxemia, and ultrasound diagnosis. Suction curettage is the usual treatment when fertility is desired, while hysterectomy may be needed, and abdominal hysterectomy lowers the risk of malignant sequelae. The authors describe complications such as pulmonary insufficiency, choriocarcinoma and DIC, and the nurse's role in managing them.

title: Post-orchidectomy radiation therapy for patients with stage I seminoma of the testis.
title_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマに対する精巣摘除後放射線療法
summary_ja: 1960年から1989年に病期Iの精巣セミノーマで精巣摘除後に放射線療法を受けた270例の成績です。5年全生存率は97%、無再発生存率は95%でした。再発8例のうち3例は救済療法で治癒し、副作用は軽微でした。放射線療法は良好な治癒率をもたらすと結論づけています。
summary_en: This Australasian Radiology study reviewed 270 patients treated between 1960 and 1989 with radiotherapy after orchidectomy for stage I testicular seminoma. Most received 30 Gy to para-aortic and ipsilateral hemipelvic fields. Five-year overall and recurrence-free survival were 97% and 95%. Eight patients relapsed, and three were cured with salvage therapy. Patients treated before 1979 had significantly worse disease-free survival. Side effects were negligible, and the authors conclude that radiotherapy gives excellent cure rates while noting surveillance challenges.

title: Current management of mediastinal tumors.
title_ja: 縦隔腫瘍の現在の治療
summary_ja: 本総説は、北米で増加している縦隔腫瘍の現在の治療を概説する。良性病変は通常外科的に治療されるが、悪性腫瘍は治療が難しく、多職種による管理を要することが多い。悪性縦隔腫瘍の大部分は胸腺腫、胚細胞腫瘍、リンパ腫で占められる。治療は内科的治療のみで行われる場合もあれば、初回に切除される場合もあり、多くは多モダリティ療法を必要とする。
summary_en: This review covers the current management of mediastinal tumors, which are increasingly common in North America. Benign mediastinal lesions are usually treated surgically, whereas malignant tumors are challenging and often require multidisciplinary care. Thymomas, germ-cell tumors and lymphomas make up most malignant mediastinal neoplasms. Some are treated medically alone, while others are resected initially; many need multimodality therapy, given per protocol or off protocol.

title: Predictive parameters in biologic assessment of low-stage retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection.
title_ja: 低病期後腹膜リンパ節郭清の生物学的評価における予測因子
summary_ja: 臨床病期A非セミノーマ性精巣がん102例の精巣摘除標本を解析し、潜在的な後腹膜転移を予測する因子を検討した。100%胎児性癌の場合は高リスクとされ、フローサイトメトリーでS期の異数体細胞が29%を超える場合も高リスクと分類された。このモデルは病理学的病期Aの77%、病期Bの91%を正しく分類し、検査効率は82%であった。著者らは前向きに検証する必要があると述べている。
summary_en: This pilot study of 102 patients with clinical stage A nonseminomatous testicular cancer, all staged by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, sought to identify orchiectomy features that predict occult retroperitoneal metastasis. Pure embryonal carcinoma (100%) indicated high risk, and an S-phase aneuploid fraction above 29% by flow cytometry also indicated high risk. The model correctly classified 77% of pathologic stage A and 91% of stage B patients, with 82% test efficiency. The authors recommend prospective validation.

title: Management of contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia in patients with testicular germ-cell tumor.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における対側精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)の管理
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者1810例の対側精巣を生検し、免疫組織学的に対側精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)の頻度を調べた。TINは4.9%に認められ、精巣萎縮や停留精巣の既往と関連した。18-20 Gyの局所放射線療法を受けた患者ではTINが消失し、化学療法後も2例でTINが残存した。著者らは全患者に対側生検を行い、対側TINには局所放射線療法を第一選択とすべきと結論している。
summary_en: This study analyzed contralateral testicular biopsies from 1810 patients with testicular germ-cell tumor, using placental alkaline phosphatase staining. Contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia was found in 4.9%, and was associated with testicular atrophy and a history of cryptorchidism. Local radiotherapy of 18-20 Gy eliminated TIN in all treated patients tested, whereas persistent TIN was seen in 2 of 9 patients after chemotherapy. The authors recommend contralateral biopsy for all patients and local radiotherapy as the preferred treatment for contralateral TIN.

title: Initial chemotherapy for stage II testicular non-seminoma.
title_ja: 病期II精巣非セミノーマに対する初回化学療法
summary_ja: 1982年から1986年に英国の複数施設とノルウェーの1施設で、精巣摘除後に化学療法を受けた病期II精巣非セミノーマ287例を後方視的に解析した。3年全生存率は病期IIAで98%、IIBで96%、IICで84%であった。残存腫瘤に対してリンパ節郭清を受けた80例の多くは分化型奇形腫であった。病期IIAとIIBでは、初回化学療法の生存成績は初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清に匹敵すると結論されている。
summary_en: This retrospective survival analysis included 287 patients treated with chemotherapy after orchidectomy for stage II testicular non-seminoma at UK centres and one Norwegian centre between 1982 and 1986. Three-year overall survival was 98% for stage IIA, 96% for IIB and 84% for IIC disease. Among 80 patients who underwent residual mass lymphadenectomy, most histologies were differentiated teratoma. The authors conclude that for stages IIA and IIB, initial chemotherapy yields survival comparable to initial retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

title: Second cancer after treatment of malignant germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍治療後の二次がん
summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍を治癒した患者では、新たな悪性腫瘍の相対リスクが1.3〜2.1と上昇しており、最も多いのは別の胚細胞腫瘍である。現代の胚細胞腫瘍治療が二次がんの原因となるかは、まだ明確ではないと著者らは指摘する。特に集中的な細胞毒性治療後には、非胚細胞性がんのリスクが高いと考えられる。
summary_en: This review examines the risk of second cancers among patients cured of malignant germ-cell tumors. Such patients have a relative risk of 1.3 to 2.1 for developing a new malignancy, most commonly another germ-cell cancer. The authors note that the role of modern germ-cell tumor treatment in causing subsequent cancers is not yet defined. The relative risk of non-germ-cell cancers appears particularly elevated after intensive cytotoxic treatment.

title: Refractory anemia with excess of blasts and isochromosome 12p in a patient with primary mediastinal germ-cell tumor.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍患者にみられた芽球増加を伴う不応性貧血と12p等染色体
summary_ja: 縦隔奇形癌の既往がある患者に生じた芽球増加を伴う不応性貧血の症例報告。骨髄の全30中期分裂像で47,X,-Y,+8,+i(12)(p10)の核型を認め、i(12p)は胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な異常である。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と悪性血液疾患の関連について既報と比較している。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor, previously treated for mediastinal teratocarcinoma, who was diagnosed with refractory anemia with excess blasts. Cytogenetic analysis of bone marrow showed the karyotype 47,X,-Y,+8,+i(12)(p10) in all 30 metaphases. Isochromosome 12p is characteristic of germ cell tumors and is rarely seen in hematologic disorders. The authors compare their findings with previously published reports on the association between mediastinal germ cell tumors and malignant hematologic disorders.

title: Loss of heterozygosity identifies multiple sites of allelic deletions on chromosome 1 in human male germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト男性胚細胞腫瘍における染色体1の欠失の多発部位をヘテロ接合性の消失により同定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍48例を対象に、第1染色体上22か所の多型マーカーでLOH解析を行った。1p22領域（38.5%）などに頻発する欠失部位を同定し、胚細胞腫瘍に関連する新規の腫瘍抑制遺伝子候補の存在を示唆した。奇形腫は胚細胞腫瘍の他の組織型より欠失頻度が高かった。
summary_en: The authors performed loss of heterozygosity analysis of 48 male germ cell tumors at 22 polymorphic loci on chromosome 1. Allelic losses occurred in 46% of cases on 1p and 23% on 1q. Teratomas showed higher loss frequencies than embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, and seminomas. Four frequent deletion sites were identified, including 1p22 at 38.5%, which suggests a novel candidate tumor suppressor gene associated with germ cell tumors. Some deletion sites overlap with those reported in breast carcinomas, suggesting shared tumor suppressors. Subregional mapping of selected probes used fluorescence in situ hybridization.

title: Infrequent mutation in tumor suppressor gene p53 in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍におけるp53遺伝子変異はまれである
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎24例と絨毛癌細胞株2株で、p53遺伝子の全コード領域（エクソン2〜11）を解析した。胞状奇胎1例のみにコドン295のミスセンス変異を認めた。p53変異は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発症にまれにしか関与しないことを示した分子生物学的研究である。
summary_en: The authors examined p53 mutations in 24 molar pregnancies and two choriocarcinoma cell lines, JAR and JEG-3. Using PCR amplification of exons 2 to 11, single-strand conformation polymorphism analysis, and sequencing, they identified only one missense mutation, a proline-to-leucine change at codon 295, in a single hydatidiform mole. The results indicate that p53 mutation is rarely involved in the pathogenesis of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. The study provides molecular evidence on tumor suppressor involvement in this trophoblastic disease.

title: Calcitonin-secreting ovarian strumal carcinoid.
title_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に生じたカルシトニン分泌性卵巣甲状腺腫様カルチノイド
summary_ja: 38歳女性の成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に偶然見つかった3mmの甲状腺腫様カルチノイドの症例報告。甲状腺成分はサイログロブリン陰性であったが、腫瘍細胞はカルシトニンを発現していた。機能不全の甲状腺組織と神経内分泌腫瘍の密接な関連は、多方向分化能を持つ多能性幹細胞の存在説を支持すると考察されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 3-mm strumal carcinoid discovered incidentally within a mature ovarian cystic teratoma in a 38-year-old woman, who was followed for more than nine years. The thyroid component appeared histologically normal and lacked thyroglobulin and thyroxine on immunohistochemistry, yet tumor cells showed immunoreactive calcitonin, indicating neuroendocrine marker secretion. The authors suggest this close association between imperfectly functioning thyroid tissue and a calcitonin-secreting tumor supports the concept of a pluripotential stem cell capable of multidirectional differentiation.

title: Treatment of testicular seminoma in patients with HIV infection. Report of two cases.
title_ja: HIV感染症患者における精巣セミノーマの治療：2症例の報告
summary_ja: 本報告は、病期IIaおよびIIcの純粋な精巣セミノーマを有するHIV陽性の男性2例を報告するものである。両者とも半側精巣摘除術の後、病期に応じた治療を受けた。一方は後腹膜への放射線療法、他方はカルボプラチン4サイクルを受けた。35か月および14か月の経過観察で再発はなく、HIV病期の進行もみられなかった。著者らは、病期に応じた胚細胞腫瘍の治療はHIV感染患者にも安全に適用でき、カルボプラチン単剤は転移性セミノーマに対する有効かつ低毒性の選択肢であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes two HIV-positive men with pure testicular seminoma, at stages IIa and IIc, managed with stage-oriented therapy after semicastration. One received retroperitoneal radiotherapy and the other four cycles of carboplatin. Neither patient relapsed over follow-up of 35 and 14 months, and HIV disease stage did not progress. The authors conclude that stage-adapted germ cell tumor treatment can be safely applied in HIV-infected patients, and that carboplatin monotherapy is an effective, low-toxicity option for metastatic seminoma.

title: Hepatocytic transcription factor expression in human embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac carcinoma cell lines: expression of HNF-3 alpha in models of early endodermal cell differentiation.
title_ja: 胎児性癌および卵黄嚢癌細胞株における肝細胞型転写因子の発現：初期内胚葉分化におけるHNF-3αの役割
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株GCT 27 X-1と卵黄嚢癌細胞株を用い、肝細胞型転写因子(HNF)の発現を解析した。レチノイン酸処理によりGCT 27 X-1はマウス内臓内胚葉に類似した上皮細胞へ分化し、HNF-3αの発現が増加した。HNF-3αはヒトの初期内胚葉分化に重要な役割を果たす可能性がある。
summary_en: This study examines hepatocytic transcription factor expression during differentiation of the embryonal carcinoma line GCT 27 X-1 and in yolk sac carcinoma lines. Retinoic acid induced GCT 27 X-1 cells to form an epithelial type resembling rodent visceral endoderm, with increased HNF-3 alpha expression. Yolk sac carcinoma lines showed distinct HNF transcription factor profiles depending on whether they resembled visceral or parietal endoderm. The authors propose that HNF-3 alpha may play an important role in early endodermal differentiation in humans.

title: The role of cell shape for differentiation of choriocarcinoma cells on extracellular matrix.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞の分化における細胞形態と細胞外マトリックスの役割
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞を用い、細胞外マトリックスの物理的性質が分化に与える影響を検討した。ゲル基質上では硬い基質より強くhCG分泌が誘導され、接着性を下げると細胞は球状になりhCG分泌も増加した。化学的シグナルだけでなく、細胞形態と基質の物理的性質が分化を規定すると結論している。
summary_en: This study investigates how physical properties of the extracellular matrix influence differentiation of BeWo choriocarcinoma cells, using hCG secretion as the readout. Cells on artificial gel substrates secreted more hCG than on rigid substrates of the same chemistry, and gradually reduced adhesiveness on poly-HEMA-coated plastic correlated with rounder cell morphology and higher hCG output. Cells kept in suspension showed only marginal increases. The authors conclude that cell shape and matrix mechanics, not just chemical signals, are decisive for differentiation.

title: Emergency surgery in gestational trophoblastic tumours.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における緊急手術
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍92例のうち10例(11%)に侵襲的手術が行われ、多くは生命を脅かす出血に対するものであった。化学療法で大半は治癒し妊孕性も温存されるが、手術は緊急対応として依然重要であると論じている。
summary_en: This study discusses emergency surgical procedures in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Among 92 patients treated at one institution, 10 (11%) required invasive surgery, mostly for life-threatening hemorrhage. The authors note that chemotherapy achieves cure in most cases with preserved fertility, and that surgery plays a minor but definitive role, particularly as an emergency measure. The paper focuses on the indications and characteristics of these emergency operations within the gestational trophoblastic disease spectrum.

title: Struma ovarii with pseudo-Meigs' syndrome: report of a case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に伴う偽Meigs症候群：症例報告と文献的考察
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に腹水と胸水を伴った症例報告。古典的なMeigs症候群（卵巣線維腫）と区別するため偽Meigs症候群と命名されている。診断上の問題点を考察し、既報例の文献レビューを行っている。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with struma ovarii presenting with ascites and hydrothorax, a combination termed pseudo-Meigs syndrome to distinguish it from classic Meigs syndrome, which is associated with ovarian fibroma. The authors discuss the diagnostic difficulties of this rare condition and review previously reported cases in the literature. The review highlights how ovarian thyroid tumors can mimic conventional Meigs syndrome and complicate diagnosis.

title: Salvage surgery for chemorefractory ovarian germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 化学療法抵抗性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する救援手術
summary_ja: 化学療法に抵抗性の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍20例を後方視的に解析し、二次的な腫瘍減量術の意義を検討しました。未熟奇形腫では救済手術を受けた患者の生存が有意に良好でした。全体的な有用性は未確定ですが、特に未熟奇形腫など特定の患者群で有益な可能性が示唆されています。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 20 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluated whether secondary surgical debulking benefits patients with chemorefractory disease. Patients had immature teratoma, mixed tumors, endodermal sinus tumors, or dysgerminoma. Salvage surgery was performed in 18 patients, and 16 received subsequent salvage chemotherapy. Survival was significantly better in patients with immature teratoma who underwent salvage surgery. The authors conclude that secondary debulking may benefit a select subgroup, particularly those with immature teratoma, although its overall role remains undetermined.

title: Bilateral spontaneous pneumothoraces in osteogenic sarcoma and extragonadal germ cell tumour.
title_ja: 骨肉腫および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍における両側性自然気胸
journal: Indian J Chest Dis Allied Sci
summary_ja: 骨肉腫と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の患者に生じた両側性自然気胸について報告しています。肺転移性疾患に伴う合併症で、転移が明らかになる前や化学療法中に起こることがあります。自然に軽快する場合もあれば、胸腔ドレナージが必要になる場合もあります。
summary_en: This report describes bilateral spontaneous pneumothoraces in patients with osteogenic sarcoma and extragonadal germ cell tumor. Such bilateral pneumothoraces are uncommon complications of metastatic pulmonary disease, typically occurring before overt metastases or during chemotherapy. They are seen more often in osteogenic sarcoma and are uncommon in extragonadal germ cell tumor. The condition may resolve spontaneously or require tube drainage. The abstract is brief and focuses on the clinical presentation and management of this complication.

title: Intracardiac mass as the initial manifestation of metastatic germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の初発症状としての心臓内腫瘤
summary_ja: 33歳の胎児性癌患者が、心房内腫瘤を初発症状として発見された症例です。播種性胚細胞腫瘍の心臓転移が初発症状となることは稀です。血行性転移の典型的部位は肺、中枢神経系、肝臓とされています。若年者の心臓内腫瘤では、転移性疾患も鑑別に入れる必要性が示されています。
summary_en: This report describes a 33-year-old patient with embryonal cell carcinoma whose initial manifestation of metastatic germ cell tumor was an intra-atrial cardiac mass. Cardiac metastases as the presenting feature of disseminated germ cell tumors are rare. Germ cell tumors typically spread hematogenously to the lung, central nervous system, and liver. The case highlights that cardiac involvement can be the first sign of metastatic disease and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of an intracardiac mass in young patients.

title: Radionuclide diagnosis of regional metastases in patients with testicular tumours.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍における放射性核種による後腹膜リンパ節転移の診断
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍181例を対象に、放射性核種リンパシンチグラフィーによる後腹膜リンパ節転移の診断能を検討しました。郭清術後の病理所見との比較で、感度83%、特異度90.9%でした。転移の部位や広がりを把握し、照射野の決定や病期分類の精度向上に有用とされています。
summary_en: This study evaluated radionuclide lymphoscintigraphy for detecting regional retroperitoneal lymph node metastases in 181 patients with testicular germ cell tumors. Among these patients, lymphoscintigraphy results were compared with histology after transperitoneal lymphadenectomy in 80 patients. The method showed sensitivity of 83% and specificity of 90.9%. The authors conclude that lymphoscintigraphy helps define the site, size, and spread of metastases, guiding irradiation fields and lymphadenectomy extent, and enables more accurate staging.

title: Expression of aminopeptidase N on human choriocarcinoma cells and cell growth suppression by the inhibition of aminopeptidase N activity.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞におけるアミノペプチダーゼNの発現と、その阻害による細胞増殖抑制
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株におけるアミノペプチダーゼN(AP-N/CD13)の発現と、その阻害による増殖への影響を検討しました。NaUCC-4とBeWoは酵素活性が高く、ベスタチンに高い感受性を示しました。AP-N阻害剤や酵素活性を阻害する抗体により細胞増殖が抑制され、絨毛癌などの腫瘍に対する治療標的となる可能性が示唆されています。
summary_en: This study examined aminopeptidase N (AP-N/CD13) expression in human choriocarcinoma cell lines and its role in cell growth. Choriocarcinoma lines NaUCC-4 and BeWo had high AP-N activity and were highly sensitive to the inhibitor bestatin. AP-N localized to the cell membrane as a 165-kDa protein. Growth of NaUCC-4 cells was suppressed by the AP-N inhibitor actinonin and by the anti-CD13 antibody WM15, which inhibits enzyme activity. The results suggest AP-N inhibition may suppress growth of choriocarcinoma and certain other tumors.

title: Testicular seminoma in a patient with pineal germinoma.
title_ja: 松果体ジャーミノーマの患者に生じた精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 30歳男性。16年前に松果体ジャーミノーマを発症し、2年後に頭蓋内転移を認めた。その後、精巣セミノーマが生じた。胚細胞系列における重複病変という稀な経過を示した症例報告である。中枢神経と精巣という異なる部位の胚細胞腫瘍が同一患者に生じた点が特徴で、長期にわたる経過の重要性を示す。
summary_en: A 30-year-old man developed a testicular seminoma 16 years after presenting with a pineal germinoma, which was followed two years later by intracranial metastases. The authors describe this as an unusual double pathology within the germ cell lineage. The report documents a long interval between a central nervous system germ cell tumor and a subsequent testicular germ cell tumor in the same patient, and it is relevant because the testicular lesion is part of its subject.

title: Testicular germ cell tumours of childhood in Denmark, 1943-1989: incidence and evaluation of histology using immunohistochemical techniques.
title_ja: デンマークにおける小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍（1943～1989年）：発生率と免疫組織化学を用いた組織学的評価
summary_ja: 1943～1989年のデンマークにおける小児精巣腫瘍72例のうち、病理標本が得られた34例を再評価した。29例が胚細胞腫瘍で、乳児型は卵黄嚢腫瘍または奇形腫、思春期型は成人型と同様であった。乳児型の予後は良好で、両群は異なる前駆細胞に由来すると考えられている。
summary_en: This Danish registry-based study identified 72 testicular tumours in boys under 15 years from 1943 to 1989, and histology was reviewed in 34 retrievable cases. Of these, 29 were germ cell tumours. Tumours of infancy, typically presenting before age 3, were pure yolk sac tumours or teratomas, while pubertal tumours resembled adult germ cell tumours. Infantile patients had better survival. The authors suggest the two groups arise from different precursor cells, both likely prenatally, and that immunohistochemistry confirmed morphology but was not needed for diagnosis.

title: [A surgical case of giant mediastinal teratoma].
title_ja: 巨大縦隔奇形腫の外科治療症例
summary_ja: 35歳女性。胸部X線で左肺野に大きな陰影を認め、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)、気管支鏡により評価された。中心部に石灰化を伴う腫瘤で、左主気管支の狭窄を伴っていた。前縦隔由来の成熟奇形腫と診断し、正中胸骨切開で摘出した。術後16か月まで良好に経過した。
summary_en: A 35-year-old woman with a large left lung field shadow underwent chest CT, MRI, and bronchoscopy, which showed a large mass with central calcification and left main bronchial stenosis. A mature teratoma arising from the anterior mediastinum was diagnosed and resected through a median sternotomy. The 14 × 12 × 10 cm specimen, weighing 1,045 g, contained sebaceous material, hair, and teeth. Histopathological examination confirmed a mediastinal mature teratoma, and the patient was well 16 months after surgery.

title: Seminomas of the canine testis. Counterpart of spermatocytic seminoma of men?
title_ja: イヌ精巣のセミノーマ:ヒトの精母細胞性セミノーマの相当物か?
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、1985年から1991年に収集された自然発生のイヌ精巣腫瘍を、形態およびDNA含量の点からヒトの精巣胚細胞腫瘍および精母細胞性セミノーマと比較した。イヌの腫瘍の大半は高齢のイヌに生じる純粋型セミノーマで、大半が二倍体であり、ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍に典型的な準三倍体パターンとは異なっていた。イヌのセミノーマはヒトの精母細胞性セミノーマに相当すると著者らは提唱している。間質細胞成分は二方向性分化ではなく反応性変化と考えられた。
summary_en: This study analyzed spontaneous canine testicular tumours collected from 1985 to 1991 and compared them morphologically and by DNA content with human testicular germ cell tumours and spermatocytic seminomas. Most canine tumours were pure seminomas occurring in older dogs, and most were diploid, unlike the peritriploid pattern typical of human testicular germ cell tumours. Because canine seminomas resembled human spermatocytic seminomas, the authors propose that they are counterparts of that human entity. Leydig elements were considered reactive rather than biphasic differentiation.

title: Cytogenetic analysis of childhood endodermal sinus tumors: a Pediatric Oncology Group study.
title_ja: 小児卵黄嚢腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的解析：Pediatric Oncology Group研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 3歳未満の小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍9例(性腺外4例、精巣5例)の細胞遺伝学的解析と倍数性解析を報告した研究です。7例に構造異常が認められ、成人の胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的なi(12p)は認められませんでした。小児と成人の胚細胞腫瘍の生物学的な違いを示唆しています。
summary_en: This Pediatric Oncology Group study reports cytogenetic and ploidy analysis of nine endodermal sinus tumors from children under 3 years old, four extragonadal and five testicular. Structural abnormalities were found in seven tumors, most commonly 1p deletion and 6q deletion, and none showed the i(12p) typical of adult germ cell tumors. Interphase FISH confirmed the absence of i(12p). The authors conclude that pediatric EST differs biologically from adult counterparts and that 1p, 6q and 3q loci merit further study.

title: Mesenteric desmoid tumor 19 years after radiation therapy for testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法後19年に発症した腸間膜デスモイド腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法から19年後に発生した腸間膜デスモイド腫瘍の症例報告です。精巣がん治療後の腹腔内腫瘍の鑑別診断にデスモイド腫瘍を含める必要性と、放射線療法による誘発の可能性が強調されています。長期経過観察の重要性も示唆されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a mesenteric desmoid tumor arising 19 years after radiotherapy for testicular seminoma in a patient treated at age 40. The authors emphasize that desmoid tumor should be included in the differential diagnosis of intra-abdominal tumors after testicular cancer treatment and that radiation may induce desmoid tumor. The report highlights the need for long-term surveillance after treatment for germ cell tumors.

title: Management of retroperitoneal recurrences. Seminoma and nonseminoma.
title_ja: 後腹膜再発の管理：セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ
summary_ja: セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ由来の胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜再発に対する外科的管理を概説した論文です。正確な画像・臨床的再評価と前治療医との相談、切開部位の計画が重要とされています。血管切除を含む事態への備えが必要で、適切に行えば患者の約75%で無病状態を得られると述べられています。
summary_en: This review discusses management of retroperitoneal recurrence after treatment of seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. It emphasizes accurate radiographic and clinical restaging, consultation with prior treating physicians, and careful planning of surgical incision and exposure. Surgeons should be prepared for vascular resection and other intra-abdominal or thoracic contingencies. The authors note that nearly 75% of patients can be rendered free of disease when these principles are applied.

title: The management of patients with advanced germ cell tumors. Seminoma and nonseminoma.
title_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍の管理：セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ
summary_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍の治療を概説した論文です。組織型、原発部位、LDHおよびhCG値、転移部位数などの予後因子により治療が層別化されます。予後良好例にはシスプラチン併用化学療法を3～4サイクル行い、予後不良例には大量化学療法と自家骨髄移植が検討されます。初回治療不応例には有効なサルベージ療法があります。
summary_en: This review summarizes management of advanced germ cell tumors, emphasizing that treatment is guided by histology, primary site, serum LDH and hCG levels, and number of metastatic sites. Good-risk patients receive three or four cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy, while poor-risk patients may be considered for innovative strategies such as early high-dose chemotherapy with autologous bone marrow transplantation. Effective salvage regimens exist for patients who fail first-line therapy.

title: Teratomas of the head and neck.
title_ja: 頭頸部の奇形腫
summary_ja: 舌根部に発生した頭頸部奇形腫の稀な症例報告。新生児期に多く、気道閉塞や高い死亡率を伴う。成人では悪性腫瘍化の頻度が高いとされる。三胚葉の遺残が遊走中に取り残されて発生するという発生学的機序を考察し、治療は外科的切除で、呼吸困難例では気道確保を優先すると述べている。本論文は、奇形腫の発生機序と治療方針を臨床的に整理した報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare teratoma arising from the base of the tongue, a head and neck site where such tumors most often present in neonates and cause airway obstruction. The authors note that head and neck teratomas are usually benign in infancy but carry a high malignancy risk when found in adults. They explain the proposed embryologic origin from remnants of the three germ layers pinched off during migration. Surgical excision is the recommended treatment, with airway establishment prioritized in patients with respiratory difficulty.

title: Endoscopic treatment of dermoid cyst.
title_ja: 腹腔鏡下治療を行った類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）7例に対する腹腔鏡下治療の報告。嚢腫摘出6例、付属器切除1例で、内容物の漏出を避ける手技を用いた。全例で良好な転帰が得られ、合併症は認められなかった。症例数は少ないが、漏出を防ぐ手技を用いれば腹腔鏡下治療が実施可能であることを示唆している。
summary_en: This report describes seven cases of benign cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) managed laparoscopically. Six patients underwent cyst excision and one underwent adnexectomy. A surgical technique was used to avoid spillage of cyst contents. All patients had good outcomes without complications. The small case series suggests that laparoscopic management with a spillage-avoiding technique is feasible for these lesions.

title: Gonadal mixed germ cell tumor combined with a large hemangiomatous lesion in a patient with Turner's syndrome and 45,X/46,X, +mar karyotype.
title_ja: 混合型胚細胞腫瘍と血管腫様病変を合併したターナー症候群の性腺腫瘍
summary_ja: ターナー症候群（45,X/46,X,+mar モザイク）の患者に生じた両側性性腺腫瘍の報告。左側に性腺芽腫、右側に混合型胚細胞腫瘍と海綿状血管腫様病変の合併を認めた。病変は腫瘍容積の約半分を占め、両者の境界は不明瞭であった。ターナー症候群の性腺でこの組み合わせが報告された初めての症例であり、組織学的特徴を詳述している。
summary_en: A patient with Turner syndrome and 45,X/46,X,+mar mosaicism had bilateral gonadal tumors. The left gonad contained a gonadoblastoma with a streak gonad remnant. The right gonad was replaced by a large solid and cystic mass combining a mixed germ cell tumor with a cavernous hemangiomatous lesion, which occupied about half of the tumor volume. The authors describe this as the first reported Turner syndrome case with this combination in the gonad and detail the histopathological findings.

title: Carcinoma in situ of the testis followed by an overt malignant teratoma of the testis within 12 months.
title_ja: 精巣上皮内癌に続き1年以内に発症した悪性奇形腫
summary_ja: 両側性の異時性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。初回精巣摘除時に上皮内癌が診断され、積極的監視とされた。約1年後に対側精巣に悪性奇形腫が発生し、2度目の精巣摘除とテストステロン補充を行った。精巣上皮内癌の臨床経過と管理、顕性腫瘍への進展について考察している。
summary_en: This report presents a patient with bilateral metachronous testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumour. Carcinoma in situ was diagnosed at the first orchidectomy, and the patient was placed under active surveillance. About a year later a malignant teratoma developed in the second testis, requiring a second orchidectomy and starting testosterone replacement. The authors discuss the clinical course and management of testicular carcinoma in situ and its progression to an overt tumor.

title: Unusual contents of a dermoid cyst of the ovary removed by laparoscopy.
title_ja: 腹腔鏡下に摘出した卵巣類皮嚢腫の異常な内容物
journal: Aust N Z J Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）を腹腔鏡下に摘出した症例報告。通常は三胚葉由来の組織を含み、皮脂物質、毛髪、軟骨、歯などが認められる。本症例では、十分に形成された顎と舌という稀な内容物が見られた。一般的な良性病変である卵巣嚢腫のまれな内容物の一例であり、腹腔鏡下に摘出が成功したことを報告している。
summary_en: This case report describes a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary, commonly known as a dermoid cyst, removed laparoscopically. Such cysts usually contain tissues from the three embryonic germ layers, including sebaceous material, hair, and cartilage. In this case the cyst unusually contained a well-formed jaw and tongue. The tumour was successfully excised through the laparoscope, illustrating an unusual content of an otherwise common benign ovarian lesion.

title: Testicular seminoma presenting with features of androgen excess.
title_ja: 男性ホルモン過剰の症状を呈した精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 32歳男性が痤瘡と筋肉量増加で受診し、右精巣に硬い結節を認めた。根治的精巣摘除術で典型的なセミノーマと著明なライディッヒ細胞過形成が確認された。右腸骨リンパ節転移のみがhCG産生性の合胞体栄養膜細胞を含み、これが高テストステロン血症の原因と考えられた。男性ホルモン過剰症状で発症した精巣セミノーマの初報告である。
summary_en: A 32-year-old man presented with worsening acne and increased muscle bulk and was found to have a firm, granular right testicular mass. Radical orchiectomy showed typical seminoma with marked Leydig cell hyperplasia. A solitary right iliac lymph node metastasis, but not the primary tumor, contained hCG-producing syncytiotrophoblast cells, which were considered the hormonal stimulus for the Leydig cell hyperplasia and elevated serum testosterone. The authors report this as the first description of testicular seminoma presenting with androgen excess symptoms.

title: Chemotherapy for germ cell tumours: prophylactic ciprofloxacin reduces the incidence of neutropenic fever.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法：予防的シプロフロキサシンは好中球減少性発熱の発症を減少させる
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する集中化学療法を受けた88例を後方視的に検討し、予防的シプロフロキサシンの効果を評価した。コースごとの発熱率は15%から5%へと有意に低下した。入院率も低下傾向を示した。本研究は非ランダム化の後方視的研究である。費用対効果の観点から、好中球減少例のみへの投与が提案された。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 88 men treated with intensive chemotherapy for germ cell tumours assessed whether prophylactic ciprofloxacin reduces neutropenic fever. Ciprofloxacin was given from day 7 to day 21 once neutrophils fell below 1 x 10^9/l and in subsequent courses. Fever per course fell significantly, from 15% to 5%, and admissions showed a non-significant trend from 8% to 4%. Two patients died of chest infection. The authors conclude that prophylactic ciprofloxacin is effective and suggest restricting it to neutropenic patients for cost effectiveness.

title: Hemangiomas, cystic hygromas, and teratomas of the head and neck.
title_ja: 頭頸部の血管腫、嚢胞性リンパ管腫、奇形腫
summary_ja: 乳児の頭頸部に生じる血管腫、嚢胞性リンパ管腫、奇形腫を扱った本論文。奇形腫はまれだが、乳児期の大きな腫瘤として重要である。出生前エコーにより胎児異常との関連が示され、計画的な周産期管理により予後が改善した。血管腫は従来の経過観察から治療へ移行しつつある。
summary_en: This paper covers the head and neck masses most common in infants: hemangiomas, cystic hygromas, and teratomas. Cystic hygromas and teratomas are rare, while most hemangiomas are initially small. Hemangiomas were historically observed on the assumption that they all involute, but this is often not the case, and newer treatments are emerging. Prenatal ultrasonography showed that most cystic hygromas are associated with fetal anomalies and fetal demise. Careful prenatal planning has improved outcomes for infants with isolated cystic hygromas and teratomas.

title: Transscrotal approach to testicular tumors: an anatomical approach.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する経陰嚢的アプローチ：解剖学的アプローチ
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍が疑われる症例に対し、従来の鼠径部からの根治的精巣摘除術に代わる経陰嚢的アプローチを提案した論文。鼠径部切開では良性病変を誤って摘除する恐れ、副次的な腫瘍播種経路の未処理、外鼠径輪での圧迫による腫瘍拡散という3つの問題がある。経陰嚢的アプローチはこれらを解決する。臨床評価のための提案である。
summary_en: This paper proposes a transscrotal approach to suspected testicular tumors as an alternative to conventional radical inguinal orchiectomy. The authors identify three problems with inguinal removal: benign lesions may be removed unknowingly, alternate venous dissemination routes are not clamped before the testis is delivered, and squeezing the testis through the inguinal ring may spread tumor. The transscrotal approach addresses all three. The paper is presented for critical clinical evaluation rather than as a validated outcome study.

title: Salvage chemotherapy for recurrent germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 再発胚細胞腫瘍に対する救援化学療法
summary_ja: 再発胚細胞腫瘍に対する救援化学療法の現状をまとめた総説。一次化学療法後の再発例の生存率は20〜30%にとどまる。標準治療はイホスファミドとシスプラチンの併用で、エトポシドまたはビンブラスチンを加える。大量化学療法は一部の患者を治癒させるが、早期導入の有用性は未確定である。
summary_en: This review examines salvage chemotherapy for recurrent germ cell cancer. Only about 20% to 30% of patients survive recurrence after primary chemotherapy. Standard therapy is combination ifosfamide and cisplatin, given with etoposide or vinblastine. High-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support can cure a small subset of patients with multiple recurrences. Whether earlier high-dose therapy, as initial salvage or primary treatment, improves outcomes remains uncertain, because trials have not shown a clear advantage over conventional-dose regimens.

title: Etoposide plus carboplatin or cisplatin in good-risk patients with germ cell tumors: a randomized comparison.
title_ja: 予後良好な胚細胞腫瘍に対するエトポシド+カルボプラチンとシスプラチンのランダム化比較
summary_ja: 予後良好群の胚細胞腫瘍265例を対象に、カルボプラチン+エトポシドとシスプラチン+エトポシドをランダム化比較した試験。完全寛解率は同等だったが、カルボプラチン群は再発が多く（12%対3%）、不良事象も多かった。好中球減少性発熱による入院や血小板の低下も多く、一般診療での使用は推奨されないとされた。
summary_en: This randomized trial compared carboplatin plus etoposide with cisplatin plus etoposide in 265 evaluable good-risk patients with germ cell tumors. Complete remission rates were similar, at 88% and 90%. However, carboplatin patients had more relapses (12% versus 3%) and more unfavorable events overall (24% versus 13%, P=.02). Carboplatin patients also had more hospitalizations for neutropenic fever and lower platelet nadirs. The authors concluded that carboplatin gave inferior event-free survival and worse toxicity, and it is not recommended for general practice.

title: Treatment of ovarian dermoid cysts. Place and modalities of operative laparoscopy.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の治療：腹腔鏡手術の位置づけと術式
summary_ja: 1986〜1990年に卵巣類皮嚢腫の65例を後方視的に検討した研究。86.2%が腹腔鏡手術のみで治療され、78.6%は腹腔内嚢腫摘出術だった。不透過性の袋を用いた無傷摘出により腹膜汚染を防ぎ、化学性腹膜炎は起きなかった。再発は4%で、腹腔鏡手術は安全かつ有効とされた。
summary_en: This retrospective, noncomparative study reviews 65 patients with ovarian dermoid cysts treated at one institution between 1986 and 1990. Most (86.2%) were managed purely laparoscopically, mainly by intraperitoneal cystectomy (78.6%). Intact cyst extraction in an impermeable sack avoided peritoneal contamination, and no chemical peritonitis occurred. Recurrence after conservative treatment was 4%. Second-look laparoscopy showed adhesions in only 2 of 10 patients examined. The authors conclude that laparoscopic treatment is feasible, safe, and effective, and can be conservative in over 80% of cases.

title: [The role of salvage surgery following chemotherapy in advanced testicular cancer].
title_ja: 進行精巣がんにおける化学療法後の救援手術の役割
summary_ja: 進行精巣がん27例にシスプラチン併用化学療法後の救援手術を行った検討。摘出標本では壊死・線維化が44%、成熟奇形腫が19%、残存癌が37%だった。残存癌の症例では無病生存は60%にとどまった。残存癌が見つかれば救援化学療法が必要で、腫瘍マーカー高値例での手術は避けるべきとされた。
summary_en: This Japanese study reviews salvage surgery after cisplatin-based chemotherapy in 27 patients with advanced testicular cancer. Resected specimens showed complete necrosis or fibrosis in 44%, mature teratoma in 19%, and residual cancer in 37%. Ten of 12 patients with necrosis and all five with mature teratoma remained disease-free, whereas only 60% of those with residual cancer did. The authors conclude that residual carcinoma requires further salvage chemotherapy, and that salvage surgery should be avoided when serum tumor markers are elevated.

title: [Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for patients with advanced testicular tumor].
title_ja: 進行精巣腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の適応
summary_ja: 進行精巣腫瘍30例で後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）の適応を検討した研究。病期IIAの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では手術と化学療法の順序による差はないが、化学療法先行が望ましいとした。病期IIB以降では残存病変に生存腫瘍が残りやすく郭清が必要。セミノーマでは残存腫瘍が3cm未満か80%以上縮小していれば不要とされた。
summary_en: This study examines when retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) is indicated in 30 patients with advanced testicular tumors. For stage IIA nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, the sequence of RPLND and primary chemotherapy made no difference in outcome, but the authors favor chemotherapy first to prevent tumor dissemination. Viable tumor often persists in retroperitoneal residue after chemotherapy in NSGCT beyond stage IIB, so RPLND is needed for residual masses. In seminoma, RPLND may be unnecessary if the residual tumor is under 3 cm or has shrunk by more than 80%.

title: Primary mediastinal germ cell tumour and acute monocytic leukaemia occurring concurrently in a 15-year-old boy.
title_ja: 15歳男児に同時発症した原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と急性単球性白血病
summary_ja: 縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の治療中に急性単球性白血病を発症した15歳男児の症例報告。両疾患の同時発症は極めて稀で、共通の病因の可能性が論じられている。染色体マーカーi(12p)の胚細胞腫瘍診断における役割も検討された。縦隔腫瘍の診療における細胞遺伝学的所見の意義も示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old boy who presented with a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor and developed acute monocytic leukemia while receiving chemotherapy. The authors note that such simultaneous conditions are extremely rare and discuss a possible shared etiology. The report also examines the role of the chromosome marker i(12p) in diagnosing germ cell tumors, which is relevant to pathologists managing mediastinal masses.

title: Predictors of residual mass histology following chemotherapy for metastatic non-seminomatous testicular cancer: a quantitative overview of 996 resections.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんにおける化学療法後残存腫瘤の組織学的予測因子：996件の切除の定量的検討
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんの化学療法後に残存する腫瘤について、壊死と生存がんや成熟奇形腫を鑑別する因子を996例の切除データから解析しています。奇形腫陰性の原発巣、化学療法前の腫瘍マーカーが正常であること、腫瘤が小さいことなどが壊死の予測因子でした。20 mm以下の後腹膜残存腫瘤でがんが見つかったのは4%のみでした。外科的切除の要否判断への応用が示唆されています。
summary_en: This pooled analysis of 19 studies, comprising 996 resections, identifies predictors of benign necrosis versus viable cancer or mature teratoma in residual masses after chemotherapy for metastatic non-seminomatous testicular cancer. Predictors of necrosis include a teratoma-negative primary tumor, normal pre-chemotherapy AFP and hCG levels, smaller postchemotherapy masses, large shrinkage, and lung rather than abdominal sites. Cancer was found in only 4% of retroperitoneal residual masses of 20 mm or less. The authors suggest combining histology, marker levels, and mass size to guide decisions on surgical resection and avoid unnecessary surgery.

title: A case of primary gastric choriocarcinoma and a review of the Japanese literature.
title_ja: 原発性胃絨毛癌の1例と日本文献の検討
summary_ja: 63歳の女性が胃腺癌と診断されて胃全摘術を受けましたが、切除標本で原発性胃絨毛癌と判明しました。術後化学療法を受けたものの、入院後3か月で死亡し、剖検で診断が確定しました。出血と壊死を伴う腫瘍で、腺癌と絨毛癌が混在することが特徴です。予後は極めて不良であり、出血性・壊死性の胃腫瘍では本疾患も鑑別診断に含めるべきと論じています。
summary_en: This report describes a 63-year-old woman initially diagnosed with gastric adenocarcinoma who underwent total gastrectomy. Pathology revealed primary gastric choriocarcinoma, which was confirmed at autopsy after she died three months after admission despite postoperative chemotherapy. The tumor typically forms a necrotic, hemorrhagic mass with a mixture of adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma components. The authors review the Japanese literature and emphasize the extremely poor prognosis. They recommend considering primary gastric choriocarcinoma when a hemorrhagic, necrotic gastric tumor is encountered in the differential diagnosis.

title: The placental site nodule: an immunohistochemical study.
title_ja: 胎盤部結節：免疫組織化学的研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠後に子宮内膜や子宮頸管に生じる良性の中間型栄養膜細胞増殖病変、胎盤部結節・プラーク(PSN-P)の11例を免疫組織化学的に検討しています。サイトケラチン、EMA、ビメンチンがほぼ陽性で、SP1は全例で陽性でした。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は弱陽性または限局性でした。鑑別診断にはサイトケラチン、ビメンチン、SP1が有用と結論づけています。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study analyzes 11 cases of placental site nodule and plaque (PSN-P), a benign proliferation of intermediate trophoblast in the endometrium or endocervix following intrauterine pregnancy. Cytokeratins, EMA, and vimentin were broadly positive. Pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP1) was present in all cases, and placental alkaline phosphatase in most. Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and placental lactogen were weak or focal. The authors conclude that cytokeratin, vimentin, and SP1 are the most useful antibodies for the differential diagnosis of PSN-P.

title: Testicular seminoma: 20-year experience at the Northern Israel Oncology Center (1968-1988).
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ:北イスラエル腫瘍センターにおける20年の経験(1968~1988年)
summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、北イスラエル腫瘍センターで1968年から1988年の間に治療された精巣セミノーマ患者84例を対象としている。大半は病期Iで、85%が術後照射を受けた。平均97か月の追跡で、20年の生命表による生存率は90%であった。8例が再発し、3例は化学療法で救済された。重篤な晩期障害には、ブレオマイシンによる致死的肺線維症があり、8例が二次がんを発症し、そのうち3例は以前の照射野内に生じた。
summary_en: This retrospective series from the Northern Israel Oncology Center reviewed 84 patients with testicular seminoma treated between 1968 and 1988. Most patients had Stage I disease, and 85% received postoperative irradiation. With a mean follow-up of 97 months, the 20-year actuarial survival was 90%. Eight patients relapsed, and three were salvaged with chemotherapy. Serious late effects included fatal bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis, and eight patients developed second cancers, three within the prior radiation field.

title: The association of ovarian dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma in a phenotypic female with 46 XY karyotype.
title_ja: 46XY核型の表現型女性にみられた卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と性腺芽腫の合併
summary_ja: 46,XY核型をもつ非男性化の表現型女性（18歳）の症例。左卵巣にディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、右卵巣に性腺芽腫を認めた。両側卵管卵巣摘出術と子宮全摘術、リンパ節郭清を受け、病期III と判定された。術後に骨盤と傍大動脈リンパ節、縦隔、鎖骨上窩へ放射線療法が行われた。術後46か月で無病生存中である。
summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype who had a dysgerminoma of the left ovary and a gonadoblastoma replacing the right ovary. She underwent bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, hysterectomy, and lymphadenectomy, and the surgical-pathological stage was retroperitoneal stage III. Postoperative radiotherapy was given to the pelvis, para-aortic nodes, mediastinum and supraclavicular nodes. At 46 months after surgery she remained alive without evidence of disease.

title: Mixed ovarian neoplasm composed of struma ovarii and Brenner tumour. Report of a case.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫とブレナー腫瘍が混在した卵巣腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫とブレナー腫瘍が混在した極めてまれな卵巣腫瘍の症例報告。英語文献では、この組み合わせの十分に記載された症例は2例のみとされる。卵巣甲状腺腫は主に甲状腺組織からなる特殊型の奇形腫である。抄録は詳細な組織所見をほとんど含まず、本症例は単一症例の記述である。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare mixed ovarian neoplasm composed of struma ovarii and Brenner tumour. The authors note that only two well-documented cases of this combination had been reported in the English literature. Struma ovarii is a specialized teratoma composed predominantly of thyroid tissue. The short abstract offers limited histopathological detail and no clinical follow-up information beyond the diagnosis.

title: Cyto-histological aspects of chorionepithelioma in fluorescence.
title_ja: 絨毛上皮腫の蛍光顕微鏡による細胞組織学的所見
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛上皮腫（絨毛癌）の細胞組織学的所見を蛍光顕微鏡で示した報告。オレンジアクリジンによる染色（Bertalanffy法）でDNAとRNAが明瞭に染色された。強い染色性は栄養膜細胞の活発な機能活性と高い栄養性を示すと解釈された。臨床情報や転帰は抄録に記載されていない。
summary_en: This short report describes cytochemical and histochemical features of chorion-epithelioma (choriocarcinoma) visualized by fluorescence microscopy. Orange acridine staining, following Bertalanffy's method, clearly highlighted both DNA and RNA. The intense staining was interpreted as evidence of lively functional activity and elevated trophism of the trophoblastic cells. The abstract provides no clinical details, patient numbers or outcomes, so the study appears to be a morphological description.

title: Ovarian metastasis from thyroid carcinoma 12 years after partial thyroidectomy mimicking struma ovarii: report of a case.
title_ja: 部分甲状腺切除術の12年後に発生し、卵巣甲状腺腫に類似した甲状腺癌の卵巣転移：症例報告
summary_ja: 甲状腺濾胞癌の部分切除から12年後に、右卵巣腫瘍と副腎腫瘍を生じた29歳女性の症例。組織学的には奇形腫成分を伴わない悪性濾胞型腫瘍であった。当初は悪性卵巣甲状腺腫が疑われたが、甲状腺癌の卵巣転移と判断された。患者は転移性疾患が拡がり死亡した。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の診断には既往の甲状腺腫瘍の除外が必要である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with a large solid-cystic right ovarian tumour and an adrenal mass, twelve years after partial thyroidectomy for follicular thyroid carcinoma. Histology showed a malignant follicular-type tumour without other teratomatous elements, initially raising concern for malignant struma ovarii. Because of the prior thyroid cancer, the lesion was considered a metastasis rather than a primary struma ovarii. The patient developed widespread metastatic disease and died, emphasizing the need to exclude prior thyroid neoplasm before diagnosing malignant struma ovarii.

title: Mature cystic teratoma: a clinicopathologic evaluation of 517 cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫：517例の臨床病理学的評価と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 1975年から1989年に摘出された成熟嚢胞性奇形腫573個（517例）を対象とした腫瘍登録ベースの研究。悪性転化は0.17%と低率であった。卵巣温存を重視する方向へ治療が変化し、嚢胞摘出術が増え、対側卵巣生検は激減した。症状、捻転、悪性変性の頻度は既報より低いと報告している。
summary_en: This registry-based study reviewed 517 patients with 573 mature cystic teratomas removed between 1975 and 1989. Median patient age was 30 years, and 60% were asymptomatic. Torsion occurred in 3.5%, bilateral disease in 10.8%, and malignant transformation in only 0.17%. Over the study period, management shifted toward ovarian preservation, with more cystectomies and far fewer contralateral ovarian biopsies. The authors report that rates of symptoms, torsion and malignant degeneration were lower than previously published.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma: a case of mistaken identity.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の誤認例
summary_ja: 出生前超音波で仙骨部の大きな嚢胞性病変を認め、母体のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)も高値であったため脊髄髄膜瘤と診断され、妊娠17週で妊娠中絶が行われた症例。剖検で実際は嚢胞性仙尾部奇形腫であったと判明した。画像や母体血清マーカーは誤解を招きうるため、出生前診断の確認には胎児の全剖検が有用であると示している。
summary_en: This pediatric radiology report describes a fetus diagnosed prenatally with myelomeningocele after ultrasound showed a large sacral cystic lesion and maternal alpha-fetoprotein was elevated. The pregnancy was terminated at 17 weeks. Autopsy revealed that the lesion was actually a cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma rather than a neural tube defect. The case underscores the value of full fetal autopsy for confirming prenatal diagnoses, since imaging and maternal serum markers can be misleading.

title: Thyroid/cervical teratomas in children: immunohistochemical studies for specific thyroid epithelial cell markers.
title_ja: 小児の甲状腺・頸部奇形腫における甲状腺上皮細胞マーカーの免疫組織化学的研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 小児の甲状腺内および頸部奇形腫4例を対象に、病理組織学的所見と甲状腺上皮細胞マーカーの免疫組織化学的所見を検討した。全例で三胚葉由来の成分が認められた。甲状腺内奇形腫3例ではサイログロブリン陽性の腫瘍性濾胞がみられ、頸部奇形腫1例では甲状腺由来の証拠は得られなかった。カルシトニンは陰性で、後鰓体起源説を支持する所見はなかった。
summary_en: This study examines four pediatric thyroid and cervical teratomas, pathologically and by immunohistochemistry for thyroid epithelial markers. All tumors contained elements from the three germ layers. Thyroglobulin-positive neoplastic follicles were seen in three intrathyroid teratomas, while a cervical teratoma lacked evidence of thyroid origin. Calcitonin was not expressed, so the authors found no support for an ultimobranchial origin. Thyroid tissue is a not-infrequent component of cervical teratomas.

title: Glycolipids of germ cell tumors: extended globo-series glycolipids are a hallmark of human embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の糖脂質:拡張型グロボ系糖脂質はヒト胎児性癌細胞の特徴である
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍株の糖脂質を薄層クロマトグラフィーと抗体染色で解析した。胎児性癌株ではGb5やGL7などのグロボ系糖脂質が高発現していた。レチノイン酸による分化でこの発現は低下した。絨毛癌株はGb3を含むが、拡張型グロボ系糖脂質を欠いていた。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢癌、絨毛癌はそれぞれ異なる糖脂質発現パターンを示すと結論された。
summary_en: The authors analyzed glycolipids from human germ cell tumor cell lines by thin-layer chromatography and antibody immunostaining. Embryonal carcinoma lines contained high levels of globo-series glycolipids, including Gb5 and GL7, which decreased upon retinoic acid differentiation. Choriocarcinoma lines contained Gb3 but lacked extended globo-series glycolipids, and yolk sac carcinoma lines varied. The authors conclude that EC, YC and CC have distinct glycolipid profiles, and that Gb5 and GL7 are hallmarks of EC cells.

title: Immunohistochemical expression of P53 tumor suppressor gene protein in adult germ cell testis tumors: clinical correlation in stage I disease.
title_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるp53タンパク質の免疫組織化学的発現:臨床病期I疾患との相関
summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍の精巣摘除術標本152例でp53の免疫組織化学的発現を評価した。p53はセミノーマの90%、非セミノーマ成分の94%で発現していた。臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、潜在性病期II疾患の予測因子を検討した。脈管侵襲と胎児性癌の割合が有用であり、p53は予測能を向上させなかった。
summary_en: This study assessed p53 immunostaining in 152 orchiectomy specimens of adult testicular germ cell tumors. P53 was expressed in 90% of seminomas and 94% of nonseminomatous components, with embryonal carcinoma expression rising with stage. The authors also tested whether p53, vascular invasion, and the percentage of embryonal carcinoma predict occult stage II disease in clinical stage I nonseminomatous tumors. Vascular invasion and embryonal carcinoma percentage were the most useful predictors, and p53 added no benefit.

title: Stage I seminoma of the testis: long term results and toxicity with adjuvant radiotherapy.
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対する補助放射線療法の長期成績と毒性
summary_ja: 1953年から1987年に治療された純粋な病期I精巣セミノーマ102例への術後放射線療法の長期成績と毒性を報告した。30年の原病特異的生存率は99%で、早期毒性は軽度、晩期有害事象は8例に認められた。再発は少なく、救援治療で治癒した例と転移で死亡した例が1例ずつであった。術後の放射線療法は有効で、治療選択肢として推奨されるとしている。
summary_en: This study reports long-term outcomes and toxicity of adjuvant radiotherapy in 102 patients with pure stage I testicular seminoma treated between 1953 and 1987. Median follow-up was 13 years. The 30-year cause-specific actuarial survival was 99%, with mild early toxicity and late side effects in 8 patients. Relapse was rare: one out-field inguinal relapse was cured with radiotherapy and chemotherapy, and one patient died of widespread metastases. The authors conclude that post-orchidectomy para-aortic and ipsilateral pelvic irradiation is safe, effective, and remains the treatment of choice for stage I testicular seminoma.

title: Correlations of choriocarcinoma mortality with alcohol drinking and reproductive factors in China.
title_ja: 中国における絨毛癌死亡率と飲酒および生殖要因との相関
summary_ja: 中国の農村49郡を対象とした生態学的相関研究で、絨毛癌死亡率と生殖要因・生活習慣との関連を検討した。死亡率は飲酒量、妊娠回数、閉経年齢と正の相関、初産年齢と負の相関を示した。喫煙、BMI、食事などとは明確な関連はみられなかった。生態学的データのため因果関係は推定できないとしている。
summary_en: This ecological correlation study across 49 rural Chinese counties examined associations between choriocarcinoma mortality and reproductive and lifestyle factors. Choriocarcinoma mortality correlated significantly with alcohol consumption, number of pregnancies, and age at menopause, and inversely with age at first birth. No clear association was found with smoking, body mass index, diet, serum nutrients, sex hormones, or herpes simplex antibodies. The authors note that ecological data preclude causal inference but add evidence on reproductive risk factors for this rare cancer.

title: Metachronous occurrence of seminoma and Hodgkin's lymphoma in the same patient with late-onset colon cancer.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマとホジキンリンパ腫の異時性発生、および晩発性大腸癌を伴った1例
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマとホジキンリンパ腫が異時性に発生し、約20年後に大腸癌を発症した症例を報告した。精巣がんとホジキン病は疫学的特徴を共有するが、両者の合併は極めて稀である。文献上、異時性は14例、同時性は3例のみと記載されている。胚細胞腫瘍を含む重複がんの稀少性を示す報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with testicular seminoma and Hodgkin's lymphoma, in whom colon carcinoma developed nearly 20 years later. The authors note that testicular cancer and Hodgkin's disease share epidemiological features, but their co-occurrence is exceptional, with only 14 metachronous and 3 synchronous cases previously reported. In this patient, the seminoma and lymphoma occurred metachronously, and colon cancer appeared as a further malignancy later in life. The report highlights how rare multiple malignancies involving germ cell tumors are.

title: Salvage chemotherapy in patients with extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors: the Indiana University experience.
title_ja: 性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における救援化学療法：インディアナ大学の経験
summary_ja: インディアナ大学で1976～1993年に治療した再発性性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍73例を後方視的に検討した。救援化学療法後に長期無病生存を得たのは5例（7%）のみであった。大量化学療法と自家骨髄移植を受けた28例は、いずれも持続的な無病状態を維持できなかった。性腺外腫瘍には新たな治療アプローチが必要であると結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 73 patients with relapsed extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, treated at Indiana University from 1976 to 1993, evaluated the effect of salvage chemotherapy on long-term survival. All had received cisplatin-based primary chemotherapy. Only 5 patients (7%) were long-term disease-free survivors after salvage therapy. Of 28 patients who received high-dose chemotherapy with autologous bone marrow transplant, none remained continuously disease-free. The authors conclude that salvage strategies that cure about 30% of testicular cancer relapses are inadequate for extragonadal tumors, and new approaches are needed.

title: Biallelic expression of the H19 and IGF2 genes in human testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるH19およびIGF2遺伝子の両アレル発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍20例（セミノーマ10例、非セミノーマ10例）で、刷り込み遺伝子H19とIGF2の対立遺伝子発現を検討した。H19は判定可能な14例中12例、IGF2は11例中10例で両アレルが発現していた。正常発生の単アレル発現とは異なっていた。発生前駆細胞でインプリンティングが消失または緩和された可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: This study examined allelic expression of the imprinted H19 and IGF2 genes in 20 adult testicular germ cell tumors, 10 seminomas and 10 nonseminomatous tumors. Informative cases showed biallelic expression of H19 in 12 of 14 informative tumors and of IGF2 in 10 of 11, unlike the monoallelic expression seen in normal development. Three tumors had lost the nonexpressed allele. The authors conclude that testicular germ cell tumors consistently express both parental alleles, suggesting imprinting was erased or relaxed in their precursor cells.

title: Antenatal diagnosis of sacrococcygeal teratoma with hydrops fetalis; a case report.
title_ja: 水腫を伴う仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断:症例報告
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、胎児期に水腫を伴う仙尾部奇形腫と診断された症例を紹介する。妊娠30週で帝王切開により出産し、腫瘍摘出を行った。術後1年時点で再発はなく生存しているが、周産期の循環血液量低下による低酸素が原因と考えられる重度の脳障害を認めた。妊娠30週でも生存は可能であり、周産期の循環管理の重要性が示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma complicated by hydrops fetalis, diagnosed antenatally at 30 weeks of gestation. Cesarean delivery was followed by surgical tumor removal, and the infant was alive one year later without recurrence, although with profound brain damage likely due to perinatal hypovolemia. The authors conclude that survival is possible at 30 weeks in such cases and emphasize the importance of perinatal circulatory management.

title: Solid mature teratoma of the ovary: appearances at MR imaging.
title_ja: 卵巣の充実性成熟奇形腫:磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、稀な充実性成熟奇形腫の卵巣病変について磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見を示したものである。病変はほぼ充実性で、嚢胞成分は小さかった。気管支軟骨、平滑筋、腺組織、上皮からなる充実部は、T1強調像で低信号、T2強調像で高信号を示し、造影後は網状の増強を呈した。充実性変異を認識する上で有用な所見として報告されている。
summary_en: This case report presents magnetic resonance imaging findings of a rare solid mature teratoma of the ovary. The lesion was almost entirely solid with only a small cystic component. The solid tissue, composed of bronchial cartilage, smooth muscle, glands and epithelium, showed low T1 and high T2 signal with reticular enhancement after contrast. Fat mixed with hair, lacking typical fat signal, was identified through chemical shift artifact within the cystic component. The authors highlight these features for recognizing solid variants.

title: Prognosis of testicular teratoma differentiated.
title_ja: 分化型精巣奇形腫の予後
summary_ja: 本単施設後方視的研究は、ロイヤル・マーズデン病院で、分化型精巣奇形腫(TD)の成人患者を他の組織学的亜型と比較し、フォローアップを変えるべきかを検討した。10年間に診察された精巣奇形腫592例のうち、TDは16例であった。臨床像は似ていたが、TDは右精巣に多く発生した。無増悪生存期間に差はなかったが、TD患者では全生存率が不良であった。著者らは、TDの管理は他の精巣奇形腫の亜型に確立された一般原則に従うべきだと結論づけている。
summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study from the Royal Marsden Hospital compares adult patients with differentiated testicular teratoma (TD) with other histological subtypes to test whether follow-up should differ. Among 592 testicular teratoma patients seen over a decade, 16 had TD. Clinical presentation was similar, except that TD more often involved the right testis. Although progression-free survival did not differ, TD patients had worse overall survival, possibly due to few events. The authors conclude that management of TD should follow the general principles used for other testicular teratoma subtypes.

title: Metachronous gonadal and extragonadal primary germ cell tumors: two case reports.
title_ja: 性腺および性腺外に生じた異時性胚細胞腫瘍：2症例報告
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、初発の胚細胞腫瘍の後に別の原発性胚細胞腫瘍を発症した2例を提示したものです。1例目は後腹膜の胎児性癌の治療後、14年後に精巣にセミノーマが生じました。2例目は精巣の奇形癌で、4年後に縦隔の卵黄嚢腫瘍を発症し致死的経過をたどりました。残存精巣と性腺外のいずれにも再発リスクがあり、監視では全ての部位を考慮すべきと結論づけています。
summary_en: This two-case report describes patients who developed a second primary germ cell tumor after an initial one. In the first patient, a retroperitoneal embryonal carcinoma treated with chemotherapy and surgery was followed 14 years later by a testicular seminoma. The second patient had a testicular teratocarcinoma treated with surgery alone, and four years later developed a mediastinal endodermal sinus tumor that proved fatal. The authors conclude that the remaining testis and extragonadal sites both carry risk for second primary germ cell tumors, so surveillance should consider all potential sites.

title: Replication error-type genetic instability at 1q42-43 in human male germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍における1q42-43領域の複製エラー型ゲノム不安定性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は男性胚細胞腫瘍69例で、腫瘍と正常組織のDNAを対比し、1q42-43領域の体細胞性の遺伝子不安定性を解析しました。全体の38.2%で変化が認められ、マイクロサテライト不安定性と異型接合性の消失は別々の現象である可能性が示されました。マイクロサテライト変化は奇形腫以外の組織型に多く、異型接合性の消失は奇形腫に多く認められました。
summary_en: This study analyzed paired tumor and normal DNA from 69 male germ cell tumors to assess somatic genetic instability at chromosome 1q42-43. Using one tandem repeat marker and three microsatellite loci, the authors detected alterations in 38.2% of tumors, including rearrangements, replication error-type changes, and loss of heterozygosity. Microsatellite alterations were more frequent in non-teratoma histologies, whereas loss of heterozygosity was more common in teratomas. The findings suggest that microsatellite instability and loss of heterozygosity at this locus may be separate genetic events contributing to germ cell tumor development.

title: Advances in the epidemiology of gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の疫学の進歩
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患のうち、胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の発生頻度に関する近年の報告をレビューしています。胞状奇胎は世界の多くの地域で約1,000妊娠に1例とされ、日本ではその約2倍です。母体年齢と胞状奇胎の既往が両疾患の確立したリスク因子です。絨毛癌は頻度が低く、推定値のばらつきも大きいことが示されています。
summary_en: This review summarizes recent reports on the incidence of hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma, two gestational trophoblastic disease entities. It discusses methodological difficulties in obtaining accurate rates. Hydatidiform mole occurs in about 1 per 1,000 pregnancies in most parts of the world and is roughly twice as common in Japan. Choriocarcinoma is far rarer, with highly variable estimates. Maternal age and prior hydatidiform mole are established strong risk factors for both, while diet, ethnicity, estrogen levels, ABO blood group and environmental toxins have weaker supporting evidence.

title: Effects of cytokines on epidermal growth factor receptor expression by malignant trophoblast cells in vitro.
title_ja: サイトカインがヒト絨毛癌細胞の上皮成長因子受容体発現に及ぼす影響
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒトの絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3の増殖と上皮成長因子受容体（EGFR）発現に対するサイトカインの作用を検討したものです。IL-1α、IL-1β、TNF-αは増殖を抑制し、EGFR発現を増加させました。絨毛癌細胞株ではEGF mRNAが低レベルで検出され、オートクリン性の増殖経路が示唆されています。
summary_en: This in vitro study examined how lymphocyte and macrophage cytokines affect the growth and EGF receptor expression of JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma cells. IL-1 alpha, IL-1 beta and TNF suppressed cell growth and increased EGF receptor expression, while other cytokines had no significant effect. The authors also detected low EGF mRNA in JEG-3, Jar and BeWo choriocarcinoma lines, suggesting an autocrine growth pathway. They propose that cytokines may act as paracrine mediators regulating choriocarcinoma growth through growth factor receptor modulation.

title: Cystic struma ovarii: a frequently unrecognized tumor. A report of 20 cases.
title_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫：見過ごされやすい腫瘍 20症例の報告
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫20例を検討した。片側性・卵巣限局性で多房性のことが多く、甲状腺濾胞が乏しい部位では見逃されやすい。隔壁内の甲状腺濾胞や類皮嚢腫の合併が手がかりとなる。診断困難例ではサイログロブリン免疫染色が有用であり、嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍では甲状腺濾胞の注意深い探索が推奨される。
summary_en: This series of 20 cystic struma ovarii cases, a monodermal teratoma composed mainly of thyroid tissue, was reviewed. Tumors were unilateral, confined to the ovary, and usually multilocular. Thyroid follicles were sparse in many areas, so the lesion was often overlooked when the cyst lining looked nonspecific. Thyroid follicles in the septa, larger typical struma areas, and association with dermoid cysts were helpful clues. Thyroglobulin immunostaining confirmed the diagnosis in problematic cases. The authors urge pathologists to search carefully for thyroid follicles in cystic ovarian neoplasms.

title: Adhesive properties of choriocarcinoma cells toward lymphocytes activated or not by interleukin-2.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞の、IL-2で活性化されたまたは活性化されていないリンパ球への接着特性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWo、JEG-3、JARと末梢血リンパ球との接着能を検討した。IL-2で活性化してもリンパ球接着はきわめて低く増加しなかった。絨毛癌細胞はICAM-1を発現し、CD56は絨毛癌細胞のみで発現していた。TNF-αやIFN-γはICAM-1発現を増強したが接着は改善せず、細胞傷害性エフェクターに対する絨毛癌の抵抗性の一因が示唆された。
summary_en: Choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo, JEG-3 and JAR were tested for adhesion to peripheral blood lymphocytes with or without IL-2 activation. Lymphocyte adhesion was very low and did not increase after IL-2 stimulation. Choriocarcinoma cells and term cytotrophoblasts expressed ICAM-1, whereas only choriocarcinoma cells expressed CD56. TNF-alpha or interferon-gamma increased ICAM-1 without improving adhesion. The authors suggest poor lymphocyte adhesion partly explains the resistance of choriocarcinoma cells to cytotoxic effectors.

title: Pagetoid spread into the rete testis by testicular tumours.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍による網精巣へのパジェット様進展
summary_ja: 未治療の胚細胞腫瘍47例を含む71例の精巣摘除標本で、精細管内胚細胞性新生物の網精巣へのパジェット様進展を検討した。未治療例の14例に進展を認め、網精巣過形成を伴うことが多かった。化学療法後の標本では病変は乏しかった。網精巣への進展は一般的で、過形成の原因となりうると考えられた。
summary_en: Pagetoid spread of intratubular germ cell neoplasia into the rete testis was examined in 71 orchidectomy specimens, including 47 untreated germ cell tumors. Pagetoid involvement occurred in 14 of the 47 untreated tumors. Rete testis hyperplasia was frequently associated, and neoplastic cells were seen within hyperplastic rete epithelium. Post-chemotherapy specimens showed only focal hyperplasia. The authors suggest pagetoid rete involvement is common and may contribute to rete testis hyperplasia.

title: Efficacy of radiographic chest imaging in patients with testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんの初期病期分類における胸部画像検査の有用性
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍201例の初期病期分類で、胸部単純X線撮影と胸部CTの有用性を後方視的に比較した研究。非セミノーマの胸部転移の大半はX線で検出された。多くの症例では単純X線撮影のみで十分であり、CTは進行例や疑わしい所見の評価に限定すれば費用削減につながると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 201 patients with testicular germ cell tumors compared chest radiography (CXR) and chest CT (CTC) during initial staging. Chest metastases occurred in 17.9% of nonseminoma and 2.4% of seminoma patients, and CXR detected most nonseminomatous chest metastases. The authors conclude that CXR alone suffices for most patients, reserving CTC for clinical stage II or greater disease or suspicious CXR findings, which offers important cost savings.

title: Loss of heterozygosity and decreased expression of NME genes correlate with teratomatous differentiation in human male germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト男性胚細胞腫瘍における、ヘテロ接合性の消失およびNME遺伝子発現低下と奇形腫様分化の相関
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト男性胚細胞腫瘍37例を用い、胎児性癌と奇形腫の違いを検討した基礎研究。奇形腫ではヘテロ接合性の消失が86%と、胎児性癌の17%より高頻度だった。NME遺伝子の発現も奇形腫で4〜5倍低く、異常な体細胞分化の抑制にはヌクレオシド二リン酸キナーゼの一定以上のレベルが必要と考えられている。
summary_en: This study examined 37 human male germ cell tumors, comparing embryonal carcinomas with teratomas. Loss of heterozygosity was far more frequent in teratomas (86%) than in embryonal carcinomas (17%). NME1 and NME2 expression was four- to five-fold lower in teratomas, suggesting that a critical level of nucleoside diphosphate kinase is needed to suppress aberrant somatic differentiation during teratomatous differentiation.

title: Multiple primary neoplasms in patients with testicular germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における多重原発悪性腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍584例を後方視的に解析し、3.9%に精巣外の悪性腫瘍の重複がみられた。膀胱がんと気管支原性癌が多く、9例は放射線照射野内に発生し、潜伏期間の中央値は12年だった。化学療法後の発生はなかった。遺伝的素因と放射線が主要因と結論している。
