summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 584 patients with testicular germ cell tumors identified 23 (3.9%) who developed a nontesticular malignancy. Bladder carcinoma and bronchogenic cancer were most frequent. Nine second cancers arose within radiation fields, with a median latency of 12 years, and none followed chemotherapy. The authors conclude that genetic predisposition and radiation are the main contributors to multiple primary neoplasms in germ cell cancer.

title: Malignant germ cell tumor of the mediastinum: a multimodality therapeutic approach.
title_ja: 縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍：集学的治療アプローチ
summary_ja: 東京の国立がんセンター病院で治療された縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍25例の治療成績を報告した研究。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は33.5%だった。集学的治療を受けた群の中央生存期間は83週で、単独治療群より明らかに長く、集学的アプローチの有用性を示している。
summary_en: Twenty-five patients with malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors were treated at a Tokyo cancer center with surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, or combinations. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy was given to nine patients, and one underwent high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell rescue. Five-year overall survival was 33.5%. Patients receiving combined modality treatment had a markedly longer median survival (83 weeks) than those given surgery alone or chemotherapy alone, supporting multimodality therapy.

title: A mutation in the Ter gene causing increased susceptibility to testicular teratomas maps to mouse chromosome 18.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫への感受性を高めるTer遺伝子変異はマウス染色体18にマップされる
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 自然発生する精巣奇形腫への感受性を高めるTer変異の遺伝子座を解析したマウス遺伝学研究。PCRを用いたDNAプール法により、マウス18番染色体のD18Mit62付近との連鎖を見出した。ヒトでは5番染色体長腕(5q)に相同遺伝子が存在する可能性が示され、遺伝的素因の研究モデルとなる。
summary_en: This mouse genetics study mapped the Ter mutation, which increases susceptibility to spontaneous testicular teratomas in strain 129 mice while reducing germ cell numbers. Using PCR-based DNA pooling of mice with extreme testis phenotypes, the authors linked Ter to a region near D18Mit62 on mouse chromosome 18. They suggest a possible human homologue on chromosome 5q, offering a model for inherited germ cell tumor susceptibility.

title: Resection of postchemotherapy residual masses and limited retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in patients with metastatic testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後残存腫瘤切除と限定的後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者40例を対象とした後方視的研究で、術中迅速凍結切片診断に基づき化学療法後の残存腫瘤切除と限定的後腹膜リンパ節郭清の範囲を決定した。壊死のみの場合は限定的郭清、それ以外は両側郭清を試みた。再発は主に胸部に生じ、後腹膜再発は認めなかった。壊死のみの凍結切片では限定的郭清が両側郭清の安全な代替法であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 40 patients with metastatic testicular NSGCT evaluated resection of postchemotherapy residual masses with limited retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy guided by intraoperative frozen section. When frozen section showed only necrosis, a limited RPLND was performed; otherwise a bilateral dissection was attempted. Recurrences were mostly in the chest, with no retroperitoneal recurrence. The authors conclude that limited RPLND for necrosis-only frozen sections is a safe alternative to bilateral dissection.

title: Predictive parameters of biologic behavior of early stage nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 早期非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生物学的挙動に関する予測因子
summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍102例の精巣摘除標本を、組織学、フローサイトメトリー、細胞DNA解析で後方視的に検討した。胎児性癌100%は後腹膜転移の高リスクと判定され、それ以外では異数性S期細胞割合が病理学的病期を予測した。82%の検査精度を示し、今後前向き検証を予定している。
summary_en: This retrospective pilot study analyzed orchiectomy specimens from 102 patients with clinical stage A nonseminomatous testicular GCT using histopathology, flow cytometry, and cytophotometry. A model was built in which 100% embryonal carcinoma indicated high risk for retroperitoneal metastasis, and otherwise the percentage of aneuploid S-phase cells predicted pathologic stage. The model correctly classified 82% of patients. The authors plan prospective validation to determine clinical usefulness.

title: Chromosome analysis of parallel short-term cultures from four testicular germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍4例の並行短期培養における染色体解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣悪性奇形腫（中間分化型）4例、うち2例はセミノーマ成分を伴う腫瘍から並行短期培養17株を用いて染色体解析を行った。3腫瘍でクローン進化が認められ、主に染色体1の再構成が関与していた。卵黄嚢成分を有する腫瘍ではi(12p)が認められ、4、5、13、18番染色体の過少表現から腫瘍抑制遺伝子の関与が示唆された。
summary_en: This study performed cytogenetic analysis on 17 parallel short-term cultures from four malignant testicular teratomas of intermediate differentiation, two with seminoma components. Clonal evolution was seen in three tumors, mainly involving chromosome 1 rearrangements. Characteristic i(12p) was present in tumors with yolk sac elements, and chromosomes 4, 5, 13 and 18 were underrepresented in all tumors, suggesting tumor suppressor genes on these chromosomes may contribute to progression.

title: Mediastinal teratoma: two case reports.
title_ja: 縦隔奇形腫の2症例報告
summary_ja: 縦隔良性奇形腫の2症例を報告し、開胸術により良好な結果が得られたことを示す。三胚葉由来の奇形腫の発生機序を概説し、緩徐発育で境界明瞭な良性例と、急速増大で浸潤性の悪性例を対比する。悪性縦隔奇形腫は精巣セミノーマより予後が不良であるとしている。
summary_en: This case report presents two patients with benign mediastinal teratomas treated by thoracotomy with good results. The paper reviews the histogenesis of teratomas from three germ layers and contrasts the slow-growing, well-circumscribed benign forms with fast-growing, diffuse malignant teratomas. It notes that malignant mediastinal teratomas have a poorer prognosis than testicular seminoma.

title: Intracranial extension of a nasal dermoid sinus cyst in a 56-year-old man.
title_ja: 56歳男性にみられた鼻類皮嚢腫の頭蓋内進展
summary_ja: 56歳男性が右内眼角部の排膿性瘻孔と鼻窩を主訴に受診した。画像検査で頭蓋内に進展する鼻類皮嚢腫が疑われた。本病変は稀で、従来は主に小児例が報告されてきた。患者は顔面頭蓋からの摘出術を受け、術後経過は良好であった。鼻類皮嚢腫は成人まで無症状で潜在しうるため、頭蓋内進展例の頻度は従来の報告より高い可能性がある。著者らは、頭蓋外と頭蓋内にまたがる病変には、耳鼻咽喉科と脳神経外科による一期的な合同手術を推奨している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old man with a nasal dermoid sinus cyst extending intracranially, treated with a one-stage combined otolaryngologic and neurosurgical craniofacial removal. The authors note that such lesions may remain dormant into adulthood and be more common than reported. The lesion is a congenital dermoid rather than a germ cell tumor.

title: Benign hematologic neoplasm associated with mediastinal mature teratoma in a patient with Klinefelter's syndrome: a case report.
title_ja: Klinefelter症候群の男性における縦隔成熟奇形腫に関連した良性血液腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の18歳男性に生じた縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例報告である。10年後に対麻痺で発症した孤立性硬膜外腫瘤は組織球様細胞からなり、胚細胞腫瘍の再発は認められなかった。局所放射線療法を実施し、4年後も良好である。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に関連する播種性組織球性悪性疾患の限局型と考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old man with Klinefelter syndrome who had a mediastinal mature teratoma, treated with debulking surgery and brief cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Ten years later he presented with paraplegia due to an isolated epidural mass composed of mature histiocytoid cells resembling malignant histiocytosis. There was no medullary dissemination and no recurrence of the germ cell tumor. Local radiation therapy and a leukemic induction course were given, and he remained well four years later. The authors propose this as a localized variant of diffuse histiocytic malignancies associated with mediastinal germ cell tumors.

title: Enhanced translation: a novel mechanism of mdm2 oncogene overexpression identified in human tumor cells.
title_ja: 翻訳増強：ヒト腫瘍細胞で同定されたmdm2がん遺伝子過剰発現の新たな機序
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株において、MDM2が翻訳増強によって過剰発現する新たな機序を同定した基礎研究である。野生型p53を発現する細胞株で、MDM2タンパク質は100倍以上増加していた。遺伝子増幅やmRNA発現上昇ではなく翻訳亢進が原因と考察している。
summary_en: This study identifies a novel mechanism of MDM2 overexpression in human choriocarcinoma cell lines. Although these lines express wild-type p53 with a prolonged half-life, MDM2 protein levels are more than 100-fold higher. The authors exclude gene amplification, elevated RNA expression and altered protein stability as causes, and attribute the overexpression to enhanced translation. Because MDM2 inhibits p53 and has potential transforming activity, this mechanism may represent a new way in which MDM2's oncogenic activity is activated in tumors. The work is laboratory-based and focuses on molecular regulation within choriocarcinoma cells.

title: [Effective chemoembolization for liver metastasis in a case of testicular cancer].
title_ja: 精巣がんの肝転移に対して有効であった化学塞栓療法の一例
summary_ja: 21歳男性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌とセミノーマ)の症例で、後腹膜腫瘤と肝転移を伴っていた。精巣摘除後にPEB療法4コースを施行し、肝腫瘍に化学塞栓療法を行った結果、生検で生存腫瘍細胞は消失した。1994年時点で無病生存を続けている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man with embryonal carcinoma and seminoma of the right testis, with a retroperitoneal mass and liver metastases. After orchiectomy he received four courses of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin (PEB), which shrank the retroperitoneal and liver tumors without eradicating them. Chemoembolization of the liver tumor was performed in 1988, and biopsy later showed no viable tumor cells. He remained free of disease through follow-up until 1994.

title: Selective expression of the high-affinity isoform of the folate receptor (FR-alpha) in the human placental syncytiotrophoblast and choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: ヒト胎盤合胞体栄養膜および絨毛癌細胞における葉酸受容体アイソフォーム(FR-α)の選択的発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎盤合胞体栄養膜および絨毛癌細胞株JARにおける葉酸受容体の同定を行った基礎研究である。正常栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞では、FR-αのみが検出されFR-βは認められなかった。胎盤全体で見られるFR-βは母体の脱落膜由来と考察している。
summary_en: This study establishes that the folate receptor expressed in the placental syncytiotrophoblast is FR-alpha rather than FR-beta, using RT-PCR and Northern analysis in placenta, cultured trophoblast cells and JAR choriocarcinoma cells. Only FR-alpha was detected in normal trophoblast and choriocarcinoma cells, and sequencing confirmed identity with FR-alpha cDNA. FR-beta in whole placenta likely derives from maternal decidua. The work challenges the prevailing isoform nomenclature for fetal and adult tissues and is a laboratory study that uses choriocarcinoma cells as a principal model.

title: Germ cell tumors of the sacrococcygeal region: radiologic-pathologic correlation.
title_ja: 仙尾部の胚細胞腫瘍:放射線-病理学的相関
summary_ja: 仙尾部の胚細胞腫瘍(成熟・未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍)の画像所見と病理所見の対応を解説した総説。奇形腫は新生児期に発見されることが多く、50%以上で石灰化または骨化を認める。治療は尾骨切除を含む外科的切除で、悪性例では化学療法を併用し、多剤併用化学療法により予後が改善している。
summary_en: This radiologic-pathologic review describes germ cell tumors of the sacrococcygeal region, including mature and immature teratomas and endodermal sinus tumors. Teratomas are usually found in newborns as obvious masses, sometimes prenatally, while endodermal sinus tumors appear in early childhood. Imaging shows cystic, solid, or mixed patterns, with calcification or ossification in over half of cases. Malignant teratomas show substantial solid components. Treatment combines surgical excision, including coccygectomy, with chemotherapy for malignant tumors. Teratoma prognosis is excellent, though local recurrence can occur.

title: Orbital germ cell tumors revisited: a clinicopathological approach to classification.
title_ja: 眼窩の胚細胞腫瘍の再検討:分類に対する臨床病理学的アプローチ
summary_ja: 眼窩の胚細胞腫瘍を臨床病理学的に分類した総説。原発性眼窩奇形腫は通常骨欠損を伴わず、早期切除後の再発は稀である。一方、頭蓋内へ進展する複合型は再発リスクが高い。眼窩卵黄嚢腫瘍は小児の悪性腫瘍で、化学療法や放射線療法が有効な場合がある。
summary_en: This review classifies orbital germ cell tumors clinicopathologically. Primary orbital teratomas cause axial or vertical proptosis, usually without bone defects, and rarely recur after early excision. Combined orbital teratomas extend into periorbital and intracranial spaces, typically with bony defects and a substantial recurrence risk even after craniotomy and reconstruction. Intracranial teratomas with orbital spread often cause stillbirth. Orbital yolk sac tumors are malignant pediatric neoplasms that may respond to chemotherapy and irradiation. Rare intraocular teratomas and malignant change are also discussed.

title: Benign mediastinal teratoma masquerading as a large multiloculated effusion.
title_ja: 大きな多房性胸水として誤認された良性縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 前縦隔から発生した大きな良性奇形腫が、多房性胸水と誤認された症例報告。縦隔奇形腫は無症状で発見されることが多く、症状は隣接構造の圧迫によるものがほとんどである。外科的切除により良好な経過が得られ、長期の再発はみられなかった。縦隔腫瘤が胸水様の画像所見を呈しうることを示す教訓的な症例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a large benign teratoma arising from the anterior mediastinum that mimicked a multiloculated pleural effusion. Benign mediastinal teratomas are uncommon germ cell tumors that are often asymptomatic and typically arise in the anterosuperior compartment, with symptoms usually caused by compression of adjacent structures. The patient was treated successfully with surgical excision, and no long-term recurrence was observed. The case highlights that mediastinal masses can present with misleading pleural findings.

title: Establishment of a leukemia cell line with i(12p) from a patient with a mediastinal germ cell tumor and acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と急性リンパ芽球性白血病の患者から樹立されたi(12p)を伴う白血病細胞株
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断後に急性リンパ芽球性白血病を発症した患者から、白血病細胞株UoC-B10を樹立した報告。腫瘍と白血病の双方にi(12p)異常が認められた。24か月以上増殖を続け、顆粒球コロニー刺激因子(G-CSF)の受容体を発現しており、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の造血分化の研究に有用と考えられる。
summary_en: The authors established a leukemia cell line, UoC-B10, from a patient who developed acute lymphoblastic leukemia months after diagnosis of a mediastinal yolk sac tumor. The yolk sac tumor responded to chemotherapy, and a mature teratoma was later resected. The leukemia and cell line shared an i(12p) abnormality, also identified retrospectively in the mediastinal tumor. The line has grown for over 24 months, is EBV-negative, and expresses G-CSF receptors. It may be useful for studying i(12p) and hematologic differentiation of mediastinal germ cell tumors.

title: Ovarian teratomas. An analysis of 134 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫：134例の解析
summary_ja: パドヴァ大学病理学研究所で1979年から1989年に診断された卵巣奇形腫134例をすべて再検討した。成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫は予後が著しく異なるため、別々に解析された。単一施設の後方視的病理学的検討として、卵巣奇形腫の患者を評価する際にこれらの組織学的亜型を区別することの臨床的重要性を示している。
summary_en: This study re-reviewed all ovarian teratomas diagnosed at the Institute of Pathology, University of Padua, between 1979 and 1989, totaling 134 cases. Mature and immature teratomas were analyzed separately because of their markedly different prognoses. As a single-institution retrospective pathology series, it highlights the clinical importance of distinguishing these histologic subtypes when assessing ovarian teratoma patients.

title: Unusual neoplasms detected in testis cancer patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者で化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清時に検出された稀な腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者557例の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を検討した。45例(8.1%)で古典的な胚細胞腫瘍以外の腫瘍成分が見つかり、肉腫や非胚細胞性癌、嚢胞性非定型絨毛癌が含まれた。原発巣の組織像からは予測できず、外科的切除により治癒の可能性があった。
summary_en: This series reviewed 557 patients who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer. In 45 patients (8.1%), tumor elements other than classical germ cell tumor types were found, including sarcomas, other nongerm cell cancers and cystic atypical choriocarcinoma. Histologic features of the primary tumor did not predict these findings. Surgical resection was potentially curative, with favorable disease-free survival in each subgroup.

title: Allele loss on chromosome 17 in ovarian cystic teratomas.
title_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫における第17染色体のアレル欠失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍12例を対象に第17染色体の12遺伝子座でアレル欠失を解析した分子遺伝学的研究である。良性胚細胞腫瘍を中心にヘテロ接合性の消失が認められた。症例数は少なく、嚢胞性奇形腫における第17染色体の変化を示唆する予備的所見である。
summary_en: This molecular genetic study analyzed chromosome 17 allele loss in 12 ovarian tumors, including four benign and one malignant germ cell tumor, using 12 hypervariable-locus probes. Loss of heterozygosity was detected at the THH59 and KKA35 loci in several benign germ cell tumors and in some epithelial carcinomas. Because the sample size is small, the results are preliminary and suggest possible chromosome 17 alterations in ovarian cystic teratomas.

title: Sieve-like areas in mature cystic teratomas of the ovary. A histochemical and immunohistochemical study of 7 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における篩状領域:7例の組織化学的および免疫組織化学的検討
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 1985年から1991年の卵巣奇形腫31例のうち7例に見られた多嚢胞性の篩状領域を検討した病理学的研究である。嚢胞の内張りは組織球・内皮系の性質を示した。脂質の血管外漏出による肉芽腫性反応やリンパ管拡張が成因として考察されている。
summary_en: Seven cases of ovarian mature cystic teratomas were examined for multicystic sieve-like areas, found in 7 of 31 ovarian teratomas diagnosed from 1985 to 1991. Histochemical and immunohistochemical analysis showed the cyst linings had macrophagic and endothelial features and were surrounded by fibrous tissue. The authors propose these spaces arise from a granulomatous lipophagic reaction to extravasated lipid material and/or lymphatic dilatation.

title: CA19-9 in mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫におけるCA19-9
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫250例を対象に、血清CA19-9高値の由来を検討した研究です。術前平均79.4 U/mlは術後27.4 U/mlに低下しました。高値例では奇形腫内の気管支腺・気管支粘膜にCA19-9の発現が確認されました。嚢胞液中濃度は血清より高く、奇形腫組織からの直接分泌と嚢胞から間質を経た漏出の2経路で血中に移行すると示唆されています。
summary_en: This 1994 study examined 250 women with ovarian mature cystic teratoma to clarify the source of elevated serum CA19-9 levels. Mean preoperative CA19-9 was 79.4 U/ml, falling to 27.4 U/ml after surgery. Immunohistochemistry showed CA19-9 expression in bronchial glands and mucosa within the teratomas of patients with markedly elevated levels. Cyst fluid CA19-9 exceeded serum levels, suggesting two mechanisms for release into circulation: direct secretion from bronchial tissue and leakage from cysts through the interstitium into capillaries.

title: Automated image analysis DNA cytometry in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおける自動画像解析DNA細胞計測法
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣がんの組織型鑑別における自動DNA画像細胞計測の有用性を検討した研究です。セミノーマ54例、hCG陽性セミノーマ13例、胎児性癌48例のパラフィン切片を解析しました。過3倍体と低3倍体の比率や複数のDNA指標が腫瘍型と相関し、補助的な診断手段となる可能性が示されています。
summary_en: This study assessed automated DNA image cytometry for distinguishing testicular cancer histologies. Paraffin sections of 54 seminomas, 13 hCG-positive seminomas, and 48 embryonal carcinomas were Feulgen-stained and analyzed with a Modular Image Analysis Computer. The ratio of hypertriploid to hypotriploid cells increased from hCG-positive seminoma through embryonal carcinoma to seminoma. Several DNA indices, including mean ploidy, the 2c deviation index, the 5c exceeding rate, and nuclear diameter correlation, correlated with tumor type, supporting cytometry as an adjunct diagnostic tool.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular tumor.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下の診断的後腹膜リンパ節郭清の手技を報告した研究です。腹側と外側の2段階アプローチにより、大動脈後方・下大静脈後方のリンパ節も切除可能としました。15例中2例は開腹に移行し、2例で顕微鏡的転移が確認されました。出血以外の重大な合併症はなく、低侵襲で実施可能と結論づけています。
summary_en: This report describes a laparoscopic technique for diagnostic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular tumors. A two-step approach combined a ventral dissection with a lateral approach, allowing removal of retroaortic and retrocaval nodes by transecting the lumbar vessels. Fifteen patients underwent the procedure between 1992 and 1994. Conversion to open surgery was required in two patients, and microscopic metastases were found in two others. Apart from bleeding, no major complications occurred, and the authors concluded the technique is feasible and reduces morbidity.

title: Predictive factors for the histologic nature of residual tumor mass after chemotherapy in patients with advanced testicular cancer.
title_ja: 進行精巣がんにおける化学療法後の残存腫瘤の組織学的性状の予測因子
summary_ja: 進行精巣がん23例で、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の残存腫瘤の組織像を予測する因子を検討しました。4因子の組み合わせによる全体的な予測値は94.1%で、腫瘤縮小率とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の半減期が最も重要でした。この基準により、化学療法後の残存腫瘤摘出を約30%の患者で回避できる可能性が示されています。
summary_en: This study identified predictors of the histology of residual masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy in 23 patients with advanced testicular cancer. Viable malignancy was found in 11 of 20 resected specimens, teratoma in 3, and fibrosis or necrosis in 6. A four-factor model, including absence of a teratomatous primary element, over 85 percent tumor reduction, normal postchemotherapy AFP and hCG beta-subunit levels, and AFP half-life under 7 days, predicted histology with a 94.1 percent overall predictive value. Tumor reduction rate and AFP half-life were the strongest predictors, potentially sparing about 30 percent of patients from surgery.

title: [Single agent carboplatin therapy for advanced seminoma].
title_ja: 進行セミノーマに対する単剤カルボプラチン療法
summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ5例にカルボプラチン単剤療法を行い、平均23か月追跡した報告です。全体のCR率は60%、全生存期間(全生存率)は100%でした。残存腫瘤を有した患者の2例が再発し、手術とEP療法で救済されました。毒性は悪心・嘔吐のみで、VAB6療法と比べ低いとされています。
summary_en: This report describes five patients with advanced seminoma treated with single-agent carboplatin at 400 mg/m2 every three to four weeks, with mean follow-up of 23 months. One achieved complete response, and residual masses disappeared in two of four patients observed. Two of the four patients with residual masses relapsed and were salvaged with surgery and EP chemotherapy. The overall complete response rate was 60 percent with 100 percent overall survival. Nausea and vomiting were the only toxicities, compared with more frequent leukopenia, alopecia, and thrombocytopenia with VAB6.

title: Dose-dependent impairment of testicular function in patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者におけるシスプラチン併用化学療法後の精巣機能障害の用量依存性
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対するPEB療法後の精巣機能を、シスプラチン高用量群と通常用量群で比較した研究です。高用量群では精子濃度が著明に低く、無精子症は47%でした。累積シスプラチン量が600 mg/m2を超えると全例で高度乏精子症または無精子症となりました。FSH値も高用量群で高く、精子形成障害は用量依存的と結論づけられています。
summary_en: This study compared testicular function in men with germ cell cancer treated with conventional-dose or high-dose PEB chemotherapy, including 33 and 21 patients respectively. Median sperm density was 5.83 million per ml in the conventional group versus 0.005 million per ml with high dose. Azoospermia occurred in 19 percent versus 47 percent. All patients with cumulative cisplatin above 600 mg/m2 had severe oligospermia or azoospermia. Basal and stimulated FSH were higher in the high-dose group, supporting a dose-dependent impairment of spermatogenesis.

title: The superior mediastinal approach to hepatic malignancy.
title_ja: 肝悪性腫瘍に対する上縦隔アプローチ
summary_ja: 上大静脈閉塞を呈した26歳男性で、悪性奇形腫を上縦隔アプローチにより切除した症例報告です。3年後に再発し再切除されました。再発病変の奇形腫内の肝成分から肝細胞癌が発生していたことが組織学的に示されています。稀な経過と手術法の要点を示した報告です。
summary_en: This 1994 case report describes a 26-year-old man with superior vena caval obstruction who underwent excision of a malignant teratoma containing benign hepatic tissue, approached through the superior mediastinum. Three years later he developed a recurrence and underwent a second resection. Histology revealed hepatocellular carcinoma arising within the hepatic component of the recurrent intermediate-grade malignant teratoma. The report highlights this rare evolution and the surgical approach used.

title: Mature cystic teratomas of the ovary without fat in the cystic cavity: MR features in 12 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で嚢胞内に脂肪を含まない症例のMR所見：12例の検討
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫78例のうち、嚢胞内に脂肪を含まない12例のMR所見を後方視的に検討した。全例がT1低信号・T2高信号で、7例では壁の脂肪がグラジエントエコー法で確認された。典型的な所見が欠ける症例では、グラジエントエコー画像による壁内脂肪の検出が診断に有用である。
summary_en: This study reviewed 12 mature cystic teratomas of the ovary that lacked fat in the cyst lumen and evaluated their MR features. All lesions were hypointense on T1-weighted and hyperintense on T2-weighted images. Fat in the cyst wall was detected in seven tumors using opposed-phase gradient-echo imaging. Classic signs such as reversed chemical-shift artifact and dermoid plug were absent. Gradient-echo imaging helps detect small amounts of wall fat and supports diagnosis in atypical cases.

title: Teratoma of the umbilical cord. Case report with review of the literature.
title_ja: 臍帯奇形腫の1例：文献的考察を含む症例報告
summary_ja: 正期産児の臍帯にみられた奇形腫の1例を報告した。臍帯ヘルニアの端に位置する10cm大の腫瘤で、3胚葉すべての組織を含んでいたが骨格構造はなかった。過去の報告例をレビューし、無心体との関係を考察した。臍帯の奇形腫は極めてまれであり、貴重な症例報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a full-term infant with a 10 cm teratoma of the umbilical cord, located at the end of an omphalocele. The mass contained tissues from all three germ layers but no skeletal structures. The authors review the five previously reported cases and discuss its relationship with holoacardius amorphus. Teratomas of the umbilical cord are extremely rare, and this case adds to the limited literature.

title: Testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん
summary_ja: 精巣がんの研究と治療に関する近年の進歩をまとめた総説である。12pアイソクロモソームなどの分子マーカー、部分精巣摘除術後の妊孕性、エトポシドや放射線療法の晩期合併症を扱う。さらに、予後指標としての乳酸脱水素酵素（LDH）や、不良リスク患者への大量化学療法についても論じている。
summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in testicular cancer research and management. Topics include molecular markers such as 12p isochromosome and LOH studies, fertility after partial orchiectomy, and late effects of etoposide and radiotherapy. It also covers trials substituting cisplatin or eliminating bleomycin, LDH as a prognostic marker, and high-dose chemotherapy for poor-risk patients.

title: Resistance of malignant trophoblast cells to both the anti-proliferative and anti-invasive effects of transforming growth factor-beta.
title_ja: 悪性栄養膜細胞はTGF-βの抗増殖・抗浸潤作用に抵抗性を示す
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: TGF-βが妊娠初期の正常栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞株JAR・JEG-3の増殖および浸潤に及ぼす影響を比較した。TGF-βは正常栄養膜の増殖と浸潤を抑制したが、絨毛癌細胞では抑制されなかった。絨毛癌細胞は正常な増殖制御機構に抵抗性を持ち、腫瘍の進行に関与すると考えられる。
summary_en: This study compared the effects of TGF-beta on proliferation and invasion of normal first-trimester trophoblast cells with those of choriocarcinoma cell lines JAR and JEG-3. TGF-beta inhibited normal trophoblast but not choriocarcinoma cells. Gelatinase A and TIMP-1 regulation differed between the two cell types, and plasminogen activator secretion was unaffected in malignant cells. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma cells resist normal growth-control mechanisms, which may contribute to tumor progression.

title: [A case of recurrent yolk sac tumor of testis in a 3-year-old child successfully treated by VAC (vincristine, actinomycin-D, cyclophosphamide) therapy].
title_ja: 3歳児の再発精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対しVAC療法が奏効した1例
summary_ja: 2年前に左高位精巣摘除術を受けた3歳5か月の小児が、血清αフェトプロテインの上昇により精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の再発と診断された。左傍大動脈領域に再発腫瘤を認めた。VAC療法を2コース施行して完全奏効が得られ、後腹膜リンパ節郭清術で確認された。乳児期の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対して有効かつ安全と考えられる。
summary_en: This case report describes a child with recurrent yolk sac tumor of the testis, detected by rising serum alpha-fetoprotein two years after left high orchiectomy. A recurrent mass was found in the left para-aortic region. VAC chemotherapy with vincristine, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide achieved complete response after two courses, confirmed by retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. The authors conclude that this regimen is effective and safe for infantile testicular yolk sac tumor.

title: [Simultaneous bilateral testicular tumors: a case report].
title_ja: 両側同時性精巣腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 43歳男性の両側同時性精巣腫瘍の症例を報告する。両側高位精巣摘除術により、両側ともに典型的なセミノーマと診断された。病期IIIOと判定され、PVBによる併用化学療法を施行した。化学療法後、無病の状態が確認されている。本症例は同時性の両側精巣セミノーマとして比較的まれであり、標準的な化学療法で管理された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with simultaneous bilateral testicular tumors. Bilateral high orchiectomy revealed typical seminoma in both testes, and the patient was staged as IIIO. Combination chemotherapy with PVB was given, and no evidence of disease was observed afterward. The report highlights that synchronous bilateral testicular seminoma is rare and can be managed with standard chemotherapy.

title: Endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor of the urachus.
title_ja: 尿膜管の内胚葉洞（卵黄嚢）腫瘍
summary_ja: 2歳児の尿膜管遺残から発生した、稀な内胚葉洞（卵黄嚢）腫瘍の症例報告です。腫瘍は膀胱上部に位置し、完全切除されました。3年8か月のフォローアップで無腫瘍生存が確認されています。小児の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に関する限られた文献を補う症例です。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor arising from urachal remnants in a two-year-old infant. The tumor was located in the upper bladder and was completely removed surgically. At follow-up of three years and eight months, the patient remained free of disease. The report highlights the rarity of urachal yolk sac tumors and the favorable outcome achieved with complete resection in a pediatric patient. Because such lesions are infrequent, documenting individual cases contributes to the limited literature on extragonadal germ cell tumors in children.

title: Super-high-risk germ-cell tumors: a clinical entity. Report of eleven cases.
title_ja: 超高リスク胚細胞腫瘍：臨床的一実体、11例の報告
summary_ja: 1982〜1989年に治療された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍56例のうち、11例が化学療法開始後5週間以内に死亡しました。多くは広範な肺転移を有し、急性呼吸窮迫や敗血症を伴っていました。著者らはこれを超高リスク胚細胞腫瘍という臨床単位として提唱しています。直ちにフル用量の標準化学療法と集中的な支持療法を行うことを推奨しています。
summary_en: This report describes eleven patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who died within five weeks of starting chemotherapy, out of 56 treated between 1982 and 1989. Most had extensive pulmonary metastases, and two had bulky mediastinal masses with pleural effusion. All developed acute respiratory distress requiring mechanical ventilation, and septicemia was common. The authors propose a clinical entity called super-high-risk germ cell tumors and attribute early death to multifactorial pulmonary distress. They recommend immediate full-dose standard chemotherapy with intensive supportive care.

title: Neural cyst of the ovary with central nervous system microvasculature.
title_ja: 中枢神経系の微小血管を有する卵巣の神経嚢胞
summary_ja: 卵巣に生じた、成熟神経膠組織のみからなる稀な単一胚葉性奇形腫の症例報告です。神経細胞体は認められず、上衣細胞と白質で構成されていました。神経外胚葉由来の血管は血液脳関門様の特徴を示しました。病理組織学的所見と免疫組織化学的所見を詳しく記載しています。
summary_en: This histopathology case report describes a rare monodermal teratoma of the ovary composed entirely of mature neuroglial tissue, without neuronal cell bodies. The cyst lining consisted of ependymal cells surrounded by white matter, resting on mesothelium. Immunohistochemistry showed glial fibrillary acidic protein positivity in ependymal and white matter regions and S-100 restricted to white matter. Vessels within neuroectodermal tissue expressed glucose transporter protein, suggesting blood-brain barrier characteristics. The authors conclude this is a rare ovarian teratoma containing purely mature brain tissue with a barrier-type microvasculature.

title: Histopathology of ovarian cancer.
title_ja: 卵巣癌の病理組織学
summary_ja: 卵巣の多様な組織に由来する卵巣腫瘍の病理組織学を概説した総説です。WHO分類に準拠し、わずかな変更が加えられています。主要な上皮性卵巣癌とともに、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理組織学を詳しく論じています。分類の全体像を把握するための参考になります。
summary_en: This review summarizes the histopathology of ovarian tumors, which form a complex group because of the variety of tissues in the ovary. It follows World Health Organization classification criteria with minor variations. The authors discuss in detail the histopathology of the most common ovarian carcinomas, the common epithelial tumors, and germ cell tumors. The article serves as a reference for pathologists and clinicians seeking an overview of ovarian tumor classification. Germ cell tumors are one of the principal categories covered.

title: Chemotherapy of ovarian germ cell tumors and sex cord stromal tumors.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍および性索間質性腫瘍の化学療法
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と性索間質性腫瘍に対する化学療法を概説した総説です。VAC療法が長く標準でしたが、現在はBEP療法が主流で、転移例でも75%超の持続寛解が報告されています。転移性純粋ディスジャーミノーマでは、妊孕性を温存できる化学療法が放射線療法に代わりました。性索間質性腫瘍には標準療法がありません。
summary_en: This review summarizes chemotherapy for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors and sex cord stromal tumors, both uncommon compared with epithelial ovarian cancer. VAC was the standard in the 1970s and achieved high remission in stage I disease but poor results in metastatic disease. After cisplatin was introduced, platinum-based regimens replaced VAC by the mid-1980s, with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (BEP) now preferred and showing over 75 percent sustained remission in metastatic disease. For metastatic pure dysgerminoma, chemotherapy has largely replaced radiotherapy, preserving fertility. Sex cord stromal tumors lack a standard therapy.

title: Salvage therapy for germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対するサルベージ療法
summary_ja: 初回のシスプラチン併用化学療法後に再発・進行した胚細胞腫瘍に対するサルベージ療法の総説。ビンブラスチン/イホスファミド/シスプラチンは二次治療で約25%を治癒させ、大量化学療法と自家骨髄移植は15〜20%を治癒させる。性腺外発生例の治癒率は極めて低い。さらに初期サルベージ療法としての自家骨髄移植の評価も行われている。
summary_en: This review examines salvage therapy for germ cell tumors that progress or relapse after first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Cisplatin-based combinations such as vinblastine, ifosfamide and cisplatin cure about 25% of patients as second-line treatment, while carboplatin and etoposide high-dose chemotherapy with autologous bone marrow transplantation cures 15-20% of patients who progress after cisplatin or receive later-line therapy. Cure rates are very low for extragonadal disease. The authors also report evaluating autologous transplantation as initial salvage therapy.

title: Extragonadal choriocarcinoma in a patient with Down syndrome.
title_ja: ダウン症候群患者にみられた性腺外絨毛癌
summary_ja: ダウン症候群の患者に発生した性腺外絨毛癌の症例報告で、同病態の初めての報告とされる。シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン療法により完全寛解に至り、32か月のフォローアップで無病を維持した。ダウン症候群に進行精巣がんを合併した場合は、根治を目指した化学療法が推奨される。
summary_en: This report describes a patient with Down syndrome who developed extragonadal choriocarcinoma, described as the first such case in the literature. Prior reports of Down syndrome with testicular cancer are reviewed, with a median age at diagnosis of 18 years. The patient achieved complete remission after cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy and remained disease-free at 32 months of follow-up. The authors recommend potentially curative chemotherapy for Down syndrome patients with advanced testicular cancer.

title: Response and resistance to retinoic acid are mediated through the retinoic acid nuclear receptor gamma in human teratocarcinomas.
title_ja: ヒト奇形癌におけるレチノイン酸応答と抵抗性はレチノイン酸受容体γを介する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株NT2/D1のレチノイン酸(RA)抵抗性の機序を検討した基礎研究。抵抗性株ではレチノイン酸受容体γ(RARγ)の発現が低下しており、RARγの再導入により応答が部分的に回復した。胚性癌様細胞においてRARγの発現量がRA応答を規定することが示唆された。
summary_en: This study examines why human teratocarcinoma cells, including the NT2/D1 line, become resistant to retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Resistant subclones and a de novo resistant line showed reduced retinoic acid receptor gamma (RARγ) expression. Restoring RARγ by transfection partially reversed resistance, and reporter assays showed that RARγ repressed transcription in undifferentiated cells in the presence of retinoic acid. The authors conclude that RARγ levels are closely coupled to retinoic acid response in these embryonal carcinoma-type cells.

title: A second case of "chorangiocarcinoma" presenting in a term asymptomatic twin pregnancy: choriocarcinoma in situ with associated villous vascular proliferation.
title_ja: 満期の無症候性双胎妊娠に発生した絨毛血管癌(絨毛血管増殖を伴う上皮内絨毛癌)の第2例
summary_ja: 満期の無症候性双胎妊娠で、一方の胎盤に絨毛血管増殖を伴う上皮内絨毛癌(絨毛血管癌)が見つかった症例報告。病変は梗塞様の肉眼像を呈した。母体と新生児には出産後3か月時点で転移性疾患の所見はみられなかった。双胎妊娠における絨毛癌の初めての報告とされる。
summary_en: This report describes an asymptomatic term twin pregnancy in which one dichorionic placenta showed choriocarcinoma in situ with villous vascular proliferation, termed chorangiocarcinoma. The lesion resembled a placental infarct and contained malignant trophoblast in eight microscopic fields. The co-twin placenta was normal, and neither mother nor infants had evidence of metastatic disease at 3 months postpartum. The authors note this is only the second chorangiocarcinoma reported and the first choriocarcinoma in situ in a twin pregnancy.

title: Cisplatin-based chemotherapy for ovarian germ cell malignancies: the Australian experience.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法：オーストラリアの経験
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法を、オーストラリアの58例で後方視的に検討した研究。5年の全生存期間(全生存率)は87%で、重篤な合併症は少なかった。治療関連死は1例(ブレオマイシンによる呼吸不全)のみである。進行例の成績は男性胚細胞腫瘍に匹敵すると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective Australian review analyzed 58 patients treated for ovarian germ cell tumors with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, using a standardized questionnaire sent to gynecologic oncology centers. Five-year overall survival was 87%, with one death among 14 dysgerminoma patients and four among 44 nondysgerminomatous patients. Serious complications were uncommon, and there was one treatment-related death from bleomycin-induced respiratory failure. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based chemotherapy is highly effective and that outcomes approach those of male germ cell tumors.

title: Clinical significance of nuclear DNA ploidy pattern in nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞性精巣腫瘍における核DNA倍数性パターンの臨床的意義
summary_ja: 白金製剤化学療法を受けなかった非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍を対象に、フローサイトメトリーで核DNA倍数性を解析した後方視的研究。大多数はDNA異数体で、異数体は局所進展と病勢進行に関連した。10年生存率はDNA二倍体で86%、異数体で53%であった。核DNA含量は腫瘍の自然史と生物学的特性に関する有用な情報をもたらすとされる。
summary_en: This retrospective study examined nuclear DNA ploidy by flow cytometry in paraffin-embedded tissue from patients with nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors who did not receive platinum-based chemotherapy. Most tumors were DNA aneuploid, and aneuploidy was associated with local extension and disease progression. The 10-year survival rate was 86% for diploid tumors versus 53% for aneuploid tumors. The authors conclude that DNA content provides important information on tumor natural history and biology.

title: The association of sacrococcygeal teratoma with high anorectal and genital malformations.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫と高位鎖肛・性器奇形の合併
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫に高位鎖肛、近位部陰茎尿道下裂、陰嚢-陰茎転位が合併した稀な症例の報告。英文文献に類例はないとされる。既存の知見に基づき発生病因を考察している。奇形腫と肛門直腸・性器奇形の併存に注目した報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare sacrococcygeal teratoma occurring together with high anorectal malformation, proximal penile hypospadias and penoscrotal transposition. The authors state that no similar association had been reported in the English literature. They explain the embryopathogenesis using existing knowledge. The report highlights the coexistence of teratoma with genital and anorectal malformations.

title: Highly vascularized sacrococcygeal teratoma: description of this atypical variant and its operative management.
title_ja: 高度血管新生を伴う仙尾部奇形腫：非定型亜型とその手術管理
summary_ja: 高度に血管の豊富な非定型の仙尾部奇形腫を経験した乳児3例の報告です。全例で周術期に重大な合併症が生じ、3例とも心停止、うち1例が死亡しました。著者は、この希少な亜型の診断の手がかりや術前・術中管理の要点を提示しています。
summary_en: This report describes three infants with an atypical, highly vascularized variant of sacrococcygeal teratoma. All three patients had major perioperative problems leading to cardiac arrest, and one infant died. The authors suggest diagnostic clues, along with preoperative and intraoperative management strategies, for this rare variant. The paper is a clinical case series emphasizing the surgical and anesthetic risks of vascular sacrococcygeal teratomas in neonates and infants, where careful planning is essential to avoid catastrophic hemodynamic events.

title: [Results of treatment for advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis based on Indiana University classification].
title_ja: 精巣の進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する治療成績（Indiana University分類に基づく）
summary_ja: 1980〜1990年に病期II以上の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍45例を治療した後方視的研究です。Indiana University分類で予後良好群と不良群に分けました。シスプラチンの用量強度が80%を超えると予後良好群のNED率が向上し、不良群でも残存腫瘍を切除しなかった例は成績が不良でした。
summary_en: This Japanese retrospective study reviews 45 patients treated from 1980 to 1990 for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of stage II or higher. Patients were classified as good or poor risk using the Indiana University classification. Higher cisplatin dose intensity above 80% was associated with better NED rates in good-risk patients, and poor-risk patients whose residual tumors were not resected had only 25% NED. Tumor marker half-lives were similar between prognostic groups.

title: [A case of immature teratoma and yolk sac tumor of the testis associated with pulmonary metastases of 2 distinct histological types].
title_ja: 肺転移が2種類の組織型を示した精巣の未熟奇形腫および卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 24歳男性の精巣腫瘍例で、未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され精巣摘除術を受けました。8か月後に肺に2つの転移が出現し、エトポシドとシスプラチンによる併用化学療法の後に手術で切除されました。転移巣の組織型は未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍と異なっており、全ての転移巣を検索する重要性を示す症例です。
summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with a testicular tumor diagnosed as immature teratoma and yolk sac tumor after high inguinal orchiectomy. Eight months later, two separate pulmonary metastases appeared. After combination chemotherapy with etoposide and cisplatin, both lung lesions were resected surgically. Histology showed that one metastasis was immature teratoma and the other yolk sac tumor, so the metastases differed in histologic type from each other. The case illustrates the importance of examining all metastatic lesions in mixed germ cell tumors.

title: Current management of ovarian germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の現在の治療
summary_ja: 若年女性に生じるまれな卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療の現状をまとめた総説です。治療が不十分だと急速に悪化するため、適切な初期治療が重要とされます。非ディスジャーミノーマ性腫瘍にはエトポシド含有レジメンが用いられ、近年はディスジャーミノーマにも化学療法を第一選択とする報告が増えています。
summary_en: This review summarizes current management of ovarian germ cell tumors, which are rare but affect young women and can be fulminant if undertreated. Tumors are divided into dysgerminomas and nondysgerminomatous types, though many show mixed histology. The authors emphasize that surgical staging by inexperienced surgeons is often inadequate. Except for localized pure dysgerminoma, prompt chemotherapy is preferred over repeat exploration for staging. Etoposide-containing regimens are the usual choice for nondysgerminomatous tumors, and recent data support primary chemotherapy for dysgerminoma as well.

title: Metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma and secondary hyperthyroidism: case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 転移性精巣絨毛癌と二次性甲状腺機能亢進症：症例報告および文献的考察
summary_ja: 精巣原発の絨毛癌が転移した16歳男児で、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の上昇に伴い甲状腺機能亢進症が甲状腺クリーゼ寸前まで進行した。hCGによる甲状腺刺激作用が原因と考えられた。化学療法で原発巣とhCGが制御されるまで、対症的な抑制療法を行った。本症候群は泌尿器科領域で認識されにくい傍腫瘍症候群である。
summary_en: A 16-year-old boy with metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma presented with elevated human chorionic gonadotropin and severe hyperthyroidism approaching thyroid storm. The thyrotoxicosis was attributed to hCG stimulating the thyroid through a thyroid-stimulating hormone-like effect. Symptomatic suppressive therapy was given until chemotherapy controlled the primary tumor and hCG levels. The authors also reviewed the urological literature and found that this paraneoplastic syndrome is rarely recognized and may be serious.

title: Extragonadal germ cell tumor of retroperitoneal origin: report of two cases.
title_ja: 後腹膜起源の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍：2症例の報告
summary_ja: 後腹膜原発の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の2症例を報告した。1例目は悪性リンパ腫として治療された26歳男性で、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に転移は消失したが再発し、治療抵抗性で死亡した。2例目は36歳男性で、シスプラチン併用化学療法と切除により完全寛解を得て、2年間寛解を維持した。
summary_en: Two cases of primary retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor are described. The first, a 26-year-old man initially treated for lymphoma, had lung, liver, and supraclavicular metastases. After cisplatin-based chemotherapy the metastases disappeared, but disease relapsed and proved resistant, and he died within a year. The second, a 36-year-old man with pulmonary metastases, achieved complete remission with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and resection, and remained in remission for two years with G-CSF support.

title: Case report: metastatic malignant testicular teratoma of the thymus.
title_ja: 転移性悪性精巣奇形腫の胸腺転移：症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣原発の悪性奇形腫が胸腺に転移した症例を報告した。精巣奇形腫患者では、化学療法後の胸腺腫大が一般に胸腺過形成によるとされてきた。本症例は、胸腺腫大が転移によるものでありうることを示し、治療後の縦隔腫瘤評価で考慮すべきと述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes metastasis of malignant testicular teratoma to the thymus, a site not previously reported. Thymic enlargement after chemotherapy in patients with testicular teratoma is commonly attributed to thymic hypertrophy. The authors show that thymic enlargement may instead reflect metastatic tumour, a possibility to consider when assessing mediastinal masses in such patients after treatment.

title: Germ cell tumors of the ovary arising after dermoid cyst resection: a long-term follow-up study.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫切除後に発生した胚細胞腫瘍：長期フォローアップ研究
summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の切除後の経過を、99例を対象に平均約5年追跡した研究である。悪性胚細胞腫瘍が2例、同じ卵巣に再発した類皮嚢腫が3例認められた。両側または多発性の類皮嚢腫を有する女性は、将来の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高い亜群である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This long-term follow-up study of 99 women operated for ovarian dermoid cysts, with a mean follow-up of about 5 years, found two malignant germ cell tumors and three recurrent dermoid cysts in the same ovary. Women with bilateral or multiple dermoid cysts appeared to form a subgroup at greater risk of later ovarian germ cell neoplasms. Four of the five women with a germ cell neoplasm had bilateral or multiple cysts at initial surgery, suggesting they may merit closer follow-up after cyst resection.

title: Postchemotherapeutic surgery for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors: results of extended primary chemotherapy and limited surgery.
title_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後手術：延長化学療法と限定的手術の成績
summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性32例を対象に、延長化学療法後に残存腫瘤のみを切除する方法を検討した。残存組織は奇形腫55%、線維化・壊死26.5%、活動性腫瘍23.5%であった。平均28.5か月の経過で4例が再発し、1例が死亡した。逆行性射精は1例のみで、化学療法後の神経温存手術に代わる選択肢となりうる。
summary_en: This study of 32 men with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors evaluated extended cisplatin-based chemotherapy followed by excision of residual masses only, rather than standard retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Residual tissue showed teratoma in 55%, fibrosis or necrosis in 26.5%, and active tumor in 23.5%. Over a mean follow-up of 28.5 months, four patients relapsed and one died, with no relapses among patients with residual teratoma. Only one patient had retrograde ejaculation, supporting this approach as an alternative to nerve-sparing surgery.

title: Characterisation of the unusual expression of cross resistance to cisplatin in a series of etoposide-selected resistant sublines of the SuSa testicular teratoma cell line.
title_ja: SuSa精巣奇形腫細胞株のエトポシド選択耐性サブラインにみられる異常なシスプラチン交差耐性の特性解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のモデルであるSuSa奇形腫細胞株の、エトポシド耐性サブラインにおけるシスプラチン交差耐性を解析した研究である。耐性はグルタチオンや白金取り込み量の変化では説明されず、DNA鎖間架橋の除去能の亢進や特定の鎖内損傷の修復が関与すると考えられた。
summary_en: This study characterizes cisplatin cross-resistance in etoposide-selected resistant sublines of the SuSa testicular teratoma cell line, a germ cell tumor model. Cisplatin resistance was not explained by glutathione changes or total platinum levels. The most resistant subline showed enhanced removal of interstrand crosslinks and proficient repair of specific pApG intrastrand adducts. The authors suggest that this unusual cross-resistance arises from enhanced DNA repair of specific crosslinks, with similar mechanisms seen in other cisplatin-resistant SuSa sublines.

title: Extragonadal germ cell tumors. A 14-year Toronto experience.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍：トロント14年間の経験
summary_ja: トロントの4施設で1978～1993年に治療された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍40例の成績を報告した。縦隔セミノーマは9例中8例が無病生存で、縦隔非セミノーマは完全寛解が53%にとどまった。中枢神経系のジャーミノーマも放射線療法で良好な反応を示した。性腺外セミノーマの5年無病生存率は80%超であった。
summary_en: This 14-year Toronto series of 40 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors reports outcomes by site, including mediastinal, retroperitoneal, CNS and widespread disease. Mediastinal seminomas had excellent survival, with 8 of 9 alive without disease, whereas only 53% of mediastinal nonseminomas achieved complete remission after combined therapy. Retroperitoneal seminomas and CNS germinomas also responded well. The authors conclude that extragonadal seminomas have over 80% five-year disease-free survival, while mediastinal nonseminomas carry a poorer prognosis.

title: Familial clustering of malignant germ cell tumors and Langerhans' histiocytosis.
title_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍とランゲルハンス細胞組織球症の家族内集積
summary_ja: 祖母に卵巣胎児性癌があった家系の3姉妹の症例報告である。2名は小児期に卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍を、1名はランゲルハンス細胞組織球症を発症した。胚細胞腫瘍の2名はHLAを完全に共有しており、組織球症の1名も1つのハプロタイプを共有していた。3名とも化学療法で良好に治療されている。
summary_en: This report describes three sisters from a family in which the grandmother had an ovarian embryonal carcinoma. Two sisters developed malignant ovarian germ cell tumors and the third developed Langerhans cell histiocytosis in childhood. The two with germ cell tumors shared an identical HLA type, and the histiocytosis patient shared one haplotype with them. All three were successfully treated with chemotherapy and remain well off treatment. The authors describe a familial clustering of these conditions, suggesting a shared familial predisposition.

title: Unusual endovaginal ultrasonography and magnetic resonance imaging of placental site trophoblastic tumor.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍における非典型的な経膣超音波検査およびMRI所見
summary_ja: 本報告は稀な妊娠絨毛性疾患である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の1症例で、経膣超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で評価された。従来の報告では嚢胞性像が特徴とされてきたが、本例では両検査で壁内の充実性腫瘤が描出された初めての報告である。画像所見の多様性を示し、術前評価や鑑別診断に有用な知見を提供する。
summary_en: This case report describes a placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare gestational trophoblastic disease, evaluated with endovaginal ultrasonography and magnetic resonance imaging. Earlier imaging reports described PSTT as cystic, but these authors documented the first case showing a solid intramural mass on both modalities. The finding broadens the recognized imaging spectrum of this rare tumor and may inform preoperative assessment and differentiation from other uterine masses.

title: Cryptic presentations of germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的な初発症状
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍636例の後方視的検討で、9.6%にあたる61例が精巣外症状で初診していた。疼痛、女性化乳房、肺症状などが多く、誤診により不要な手術を受けた例も多かった。精巣の診察と腫瘍マーカーの測定を行えば早期診断が可能になり、不要な開腹探索術を避けられると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 636 patients with testicular carcinoma identified 61 (9.6%) who presented with extratesticular symptoms such as pain, gynecomastia, pulmonary complaints, or neurologic changes. Many were initially misdiagnosed and underwent unnecessary surgery. Most had abnormal testicular examination, elevated tumor markers, or a history of cryptorchidism. The authors conclude that careful testicular examination and tumor marker testing, combined with a high index of suspicion, allow prompt diagnosis and can avoid unnecessary exploratory surgery.

title: Frequent overexpression of p53 in dysgerminoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマにおけるp53の高頻度な過剰発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣のディスジャーミノーマ7例について、2種類の抗p53抗体を用いて免疫組織化学染色を行った研究である。全例でp53の過剰発現が認められ、2例では腫瘍細胞核の50%以上が陽性であった。病期との関連はみられなかった。上皮性卵巣癌と同様に、ディスジャーミノーマでもp53過剰発現は一般的であることが示唆された。症例数が少ないため予備的な知見である。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined p53 protein expression in seven ovarian dysgerminomas using two monoclonal antibodies. All tumors showed p53 overexpression, with more than half of tumor nuclei positive in two cases. No association was found between tumor stage and the degree of p53 staining. The authors note that p53 overexpression is common in dysgerminoma, similar to epithelial ovarian cancer. The small sample size means these findings are preliminary.

title: [A study on the distribution of metastases at autopsy in 70 patients with ovarian cancer].
title_ja: 卵巣癌70例の剖検例における転移分布の検討
summary_ja: 卵巣癌で死亡した女性70例の剖検記録から転移の分布を検討した研究である。胚細胞腫瘍は2割を占め、上皮性腫瘍より若年で発症していた。死因は腹膜播種が最も多く、腹膜が最も高頻度の転移部位であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた群は、他の治療群より生存期間が長かった。
summary_en: This autopsy review of 70 women who died of ovarian cancer examined metastatic patterns. Twenty percent had germ cell tumors, which occurred at younger ages and had shorter disease duration than epithelial tumors. Carcinomatosis was the most common cause of death, and the peritoneum was the most frequent metastatic site. Patients receiving cisplatin-containing regimens had longer survival than those treated with other regimens. The paper compares outcomes across histologic subtypes, including germ cell tumors.

title: Gonadal tumors in disorders of sexual differentiation.
title_ja: 性分化疾患における性腺腫瘍
summary_ja: 性分化疾患の患者21例を後方視的に検討し、性腺腫瘍の頻度を調べた研究である。44%にあたる9例で性腺腫瘍が認められ、混合型と純粋型の性腺異形成症で多かった。組織型は性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、セミノーマなどであった。診断が確定したら早期の両側予防的性腺摘除を考慮すべきと結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 21 patients with disorders of sexual differentiation examined the prevalence of gonadal tumors. Nine of 21 (44%) had a gonadal tumor, most often in mixed and pure gonadal dysgenesis. Tumor types included gonadoblastoma, dysgerminoma, teratocarcinoma, and seminoma. The authors conclude that early, bilateral, prophylactic gonadectomy should be considered once the diagnosis is confirmed in children with gonadal dysgenesis.

title: Primary skeletal metastasis of a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における孤立性骨転移の1例
summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、孤立性の骨転移を初発とした症例を報告している。外科的切除時に後腹膜リンパ節は正常であった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の骨転移は一般的だが、通常は進行期にリンパ節や内臓病変を伴って出現する。本例は後腹膜への進展を伴わずに骨病変が生じた点で稀である。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who presented with isolated bony metastasis. Retroperitoneal lymph nodes were normal on assessment at surgical resection. The authors note that bone metastasis from testicular germ cell tumor is common but usually occurs late, with lymph node or visceral involvement. This case is unusual because skeletal disease appeared without retroperitoneal nodal spread.

title: Second-look laparotomy in ovarian germ cell tumors: the gynecologic oncology group experience.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるセカンドルック開腹術：婦人科腫瘍学グループの経験
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍にシスプラチン併用化学療法を行った症例で、セカンドルック開腹術の意義を検討した研究である。初回手術で完全切除された例では不要と判断された。奇形腫成分を含む不完全切除例では、残存成熟奇形腫の切除で予後が良好な例があった。一方、卵黄嚢腫瘍や胎児性癌が残存した例は死亡した。
summary_en: This Gynecologic Oncology Group review analyzed second-look laparotomy in patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with brief cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Completely resected patients rarely had residual tumor, so routine second-look surgery was deemed unnecessary for them. In advanced, incompletely resected tumors without teratoma elements, residual endodermal sinus tumor or embryonal carcinoma was fatal. Second-look surgery benefited enough patients with incompletely resected teratoma-containing tumors to support its general use.

title: Experience with the management of ovarian germ cell tumors in Chinese patients.
title_ja: 中国人患者における卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療経験
summary_ja: 治療された中国人の原発性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者37例を、手術、放射線療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法で解析した。4年生存率は全体で94.1%、初回手術直後に紹介された患者では100%であった。シスプラチンをカルボプラチンに置き換えても結果に影響はなかった。再発時に紹介され、最適でないレジメンで治療された患者2例が死亡した。著者らは初回から最適な化学療法を行えばほぼ完治が可能とし、予後良好例では化学療法の強度低減を検討すべきとしている。
summary_en: This series reviews 37 Chinese women with primary ovarian germ cell tumors treated with surgery, radiotherapy, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The four-year actuarial survival was 94.1%, and 100% among patients referred immediately after initial surgery. Substituting carboplatin for cisplatin did not affect outcomes. Two deaths occurred among patients referred at relapse and treated with suboptimal regimens. The authors conclude that optimal chemotherapy from the start can achieve near-complete cure and suggest studying reduced intensity in patients with good prognosis.

title: Management of testicular masses incidentally discovered by ultrasound.
title_ja: 超音波検査で偶発的に発見された精巣腫瘤の管理
summary_ja: 他の目的で行った陰嚢超音波検査約1,600件中に偶発的に見つかった触知しない精巣腫瘤9例を検討した研究である。良性7例に対し、悪性は奇形癌とセミノーマの各1例であった。鼠径部からの探索と術中迅速診断を推奨し、良性であれば精巣温存が可能とする。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の患者では、触知しない腫瘤も悪性として扱うべきだと提言している。
summary_en: This 1994 J Urol study reviewed nine nonpalpable testicular masses incidentally found on about 1,600 scrotal ultrasound examinations performed for other reasons. Seven were benign, while one teratocarcinoma and one seminoma were malignant. The authors recommend inguinal exploration with frozen section diagnosis, allowing testis-sparing surgery when a lesion is benign. They advise that nonpalpable masses in patients with metastatic germ cell tumor be treated as malignant. Ultrasound follow-up is reserved for suspected nonneoplastic lesions such as recent trauma or infection.

title: Conservative management of an ovarian polyembryoma.
title_ja: 卵巣ポリエンブリオーマの保存的管理
summary_ja: 43歳女性のIA期卵巣ポリエンブリオーマの症例報告である。全腹式子宮摘出と両側卵巣卵管摘出による手術での病期分類の後、AFPとhCGの連続測定およびCTで経過観察した。腫瘍マーカーは正常域へ低下し、画像上も再発を認めなかったため、化学療法は行わなかった。片側卵巣に限局する症例では、侵襲的な化学療法を避け、腫瘍マーカーと画像による経過観察が有用としている。
summary_en: This 1994 Obstet Gynecol case report describes a 43-year-old woman with stage IA ovarian polyembryoma, an immature germ cell malignancy. After surgical staging with total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, she was monitored with serial AFP and hCG assays and abdominal and pelvic CT scans. Because her tumor markers declined steadily into the normal range and imaging showed no recurrence, chemotherapy was withheld. The authors conclude that polyembryomas confined to one ovary may be managed with surveillance rather than aggressive cytotoxic chemotherapy.

title: Sebaceous carcinoma arising in a benign dermoid cyst of the ovary.
title_ja: 良性卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた皮脂腺癌
summary_ja: 卵巣の良性類皮嚢腫内に生じた皮脂腺癌の稀な症例報告である。全腹式子宮摘出、両側卵巣卵管摘出、およびシスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンによる補助化学療法を受けた。術後54か月間生存し、再発の所見は認められていない。卵巣類皮嚢腫の悪性転化は稀であるが、併用補助化学療法により良好な経過が得られたことを報告している。
summary_en: This 1994 Acta Obstet Gynecol Scand case report describes sebaceous carcinoma arising within a benign ovarian dermoid cyst, a rare entity. The patient underwent total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and adjuvant chemotherapy with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin. She survived 54 months without evidence of recurrence. The authors highlight the rarity of malignant transformation within ovarian dermoid cysts and the favorable outcome achieved with combination adjuvant chemotherapy.

title: Well-differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma of the mediastinum (teratoma with malignant transformation). Report of a surgical case.
title_ja: 縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した高分化型腺癌（悪性転化を伴う奇形腫）：外科的症例の報告
summary_ja: 66歳男性の縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に、高分化型腺癌の悪性転化を認めた外科的症例の報告である。胸部X線で7年前から指摘されていた腫瘤を摘出した。術前の化学療法や放射線療法は受けていなかった。文献的考察から、悪性転化を治療誘発型と自然発生型の2型に分類し、それぞれの発生機序を論じている。
summary_en: This 1994 Am J Clin Pathol report describes a 66-year-old man with a mediastinal mature cystic teratoma harboring well-differentiated adenocarcinoma, termed teratoma with malignant transformation. The mass had been noted on chest radiography seven years earlier and was surgically resected without prior chemotherapy or radiation therapy. The authors review the literature and classify malignant transformation into two types: chemotherapy- or radiotherapy-induced and naturally occurring. They discuss the pathogenesis of both types.

title: Association of systemic lupus erythematosus and choriocarcinoma: a role of hormonal immunomodulation?
title_ja: 全身性エリテマトーデスと絨毛癌の合併：ホルモンによる免疫調節の役割？
summary_ja: 全身性エリテマトーデス(SLE)の経過中に発生した絨毛癌の初めての症例報告である。肺転移による腫瘍性血栓と肺塞栓から肺高血圧症を呈し、SLEの増悪と同時期に発見された。SLEにおけるホルモンの役割を考察し、ホルモンによる免疫調節が両疾患の関連に寄与した可能性を論じている。自己免疫疾患と絨毛癌の稀な合併例である。
summary_en: This 1994 Clin Exp Rheumatol case report describes the first documented choriocarcinoma arising during systemic lupus erythematosus. The tumor presented as pulmonary metastases with pulmonary hypertension due to neoplastic thrombi and pulmonary embolism, coinciding with an SLE flare-up. The authors discuss a possible role of hormones in SLE and suggest that hormonal immunomodulation may have contributed to the association. The report highlights an unusual overlap between an autoimmune disease and a germ cell malignancy with significant cardiopulmonary complications at presentation.

title: Evaluation of testicular germ cell tumor proliferation using DNA flow cytometry and nucleolar organizer silver staining.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の増殖評価におけるDNAフローサイトメトリーと銀染色核小体形成体(Ag-NOR)の検討
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍41例を対象に、DNAフローサイトメトリーと銀染色によるAg-NOR計数で増殖活性を評価した研究である。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、DNA異数性腫瘍がDNA二倍体腫瘍よりS+G2M期細胞割合とAg-NOR数が高かった。両指標は相関したが、生存率や臨床病期とは相関しなかった。Ag-NOR計数は、DNAフローサイトメトリーより安価な増殖評価法として有用と結論づけられた。
summary_en: This study evaluated proliferative activity in 41 testicular germ cell tumors using DNA flow cytometry and silver-stained nucleolar organizer region (Ag-NOR) counting. In nonseminomatous tumors, aneuploid tumors showed higher S+G2M fractions and Ag-NOR counts than diploid tumors, and these measures correlated linearly with each other. However, neither DNA ploidy nor proliferation markers correlated with survival or clinical stage. The authors concluded that Ag-NOR enumeration is an effective and less expensive alternative to DNA flow cytometry for assessing proliferation.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for high-risk stage 1 nonseminomatous germ cell tumor: report of four cases.
title_ja: 高リスク臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清：4症例の報告
summary_ja: 高リスク臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の4例に対し腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を前向きに施行し、開腹手術の8例と比較した。4例中3例で十分な郭清が可能で、1例は下大静脈損傷のため開腹に移行した。術後合併症は開腹手術より明らかに少なかった。監視療法や開腹手術の代替となり得るが、さらなる症例の蓄積が必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This prospective study tested laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (RPL) in four patients with high-risk stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors and compared the results with eight historical open-surgery controls. Laparoscopic dissection was feasible in three of four cases, and one required conversion to laparotomy after a caval laceration. Postoperative morbidity was considerably lower than with open surgery. The authors suggest laparoscopic RPL may be an alternative to surveillance or open RPL, but more experience is needed.

title: Evaluation and management of congenital cervical teratoma. Case report and review.
title_ja: 先天性頸部奇形腫の評価と管理：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 出生前MRIで診断された巨大な先天性頸部奇形腫の新生児例である。帝王切開後も胎盤循環を維持したまま気道確保を行い、無事に挿管できた。出生後に腫瘍は急速に増大し出血を伴ったが、生検で良性の未熟奇形腫と判明した。CTでは椎体前方の解剖構造が不明瞭だったものの、手術では容易に切除できた。新生児の頸部奇形腫では、切除可能性の標準基準の修正が必要かもしれないと論じている。
summary_en: The authors describe a neonate with massive congenital cervical teratoma diagnosed by antenatal MRI. After cesarean section, the infant was kept on the maternal circulation until intubation was achieved, with a second team ready for emergency bronchoscopy or tracheotomy. After birth the tumor grew rapidly and bled, and biopsy showed a benign immature teratoma. CT showed the tumor obliterating anatomy ventral to the vertebrae, yet it was easily resected. The paper reviews malignancy risk in neonatal cervical teratomas and suggests that standard resectability criteria may need modification.

title: Human papillomavirus and Epstein-Barr virus in the etiology of testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病因におけるヒトパピローマウイルスとEpstein-Barrウイルス
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の上皮内癌を含む20検体について、PCRによりHPVとEBVのDNAを検出した。増幅できた19検体からHPV16型とHPV18型は検出されなかった。EBVは6例で微弱なシグナルを示したが、免疫組織化学と in situ ハイブリダイゼーションでは陰性であった。ウイルスが発癌に直接関与する可能性は低いが、間質のEBV感染リンパ球による増殖促進作用は否定できないと結論している。
summary_en: The authors tested 20 testicular germ cell tumor specimens, including preinvasive carcinoma in situ, for HPV and EBV DNA using PCR. None of the 19 successfully amplified samples contained HPV-16 or HPV-18 DNA. Faint EBV DNA signals appeared in six cases on one of two runs, but immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization were negative. The findings argue against a significant direct role for these viruses in testicular germ cell carcinogenesis, although a growth-stimulating effect of EBV-transformed lymphocytes in the stroma cannot be excluded.

title: [A case of testicular tumor with a small tumor focus in the testis].
title_ja: 精巣内に微小病変を伴った精巣腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 41歳男性が頸部リンパ節腫脹で受診し、精巣は正常大であった。CTで後腹膜腫瘍が見つかり、血清hCGとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に上昇していた。頸部リンパ節生検で胎児性癌と診断された。圧痛のある左精巣を摘除したところ、精巣上体直下に約7mmの微小腫瘍が見つかり、病期IIIaとされた。VAB-6療法3コースで部分寛解が得られた。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が疑われる場合は超音波検査で精巣を慎重に検査すべきと述べている。
summary_en: A 41-year-old man presented with a cervical lymph node swelling and a normal-sized testis. CT revealed a retroperitoneal tumor, and serum hCG and AFP were markedly elevated. Cervical node biopsy showed embryonal carcinoma. Excision of the tender left testis revealed an occult 7 mm tumor beneath the epididymis, leading to a stage IIIa diagnosis. Three courses of VAB-6 chemotherapy produced partial relief. The authors suggest that the testis should be carefully examined by ultrasonography whenever an extragonadal germ cell tumor is suspected.

title: Molecular characterization of a recurring complex chromosomal translocation in two human extragonadal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 2例の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に認められた反復性複雑染色体転座の分子学的解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍2例で共通して見られた、6p21・6p22・6q23・11q13を含む反復性の複雑な染色体転座を解析した。FISHとパルスフィールドゲル電気泳動により、11q13の切断点をD11S457とD11S546のマーカー間に位置づけた。両腫瘍で異常な制限酵素断片が認められ、切断点はD11S546から約200kbp以内にあると推定された。切断点領域を絞り込んだ分子学的報告である。
summary_en: The authors characterized a recurring complex chromosomal translocation involving 6p21, 6p22, 6q23, and 11q13 in two independent extragonadal germ cell tumors. Using FISH and pulsed-field gel electrophoresis, they mapped the 11q13 breakpoint between markers D11S457 and D11S546. Aberrant restriction fragments in both tumors indicated that the breakpoint lies within about 200 kilobase pairs of D11S546. The study narrows the breakpoint region within a long-range restriction map of this chromosomal band.

title: Competitive in situ hybridization in a mediastinal germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍における競合的in situハイブリダイゼーション
summary_ja: 縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍に認められる染色体12の異常を、競合的in situハイブリダイゼーション法で検討した研究である。i(12p)を含むマウス-ヒト体細胞雑種細胞株由来のプローブを用い、この異常が染色体12短腕の真のアイソクロモソームであることを確認した。胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な染色体異常の分子遺伝学的な裏付けを示している。
summary_en: This study applied competitive in situ hybridization to a mediastinal germ cell tumor to examine a chromosome 12 aberration previously identified cytogenetically as isochromosome 12p. Using a mouse-human somatic hybrid cell line containing i(12p) as a probe, the authors confirmed that the marker is a true isochromosome of the short arm of chromosome 12. The work is a molecular cytogenetic characterization of a single mediastinal germ cell tumor case and supports the chromosomal abnormality as a genuine, recurrent feature of germ cell neoplasia.

title: Genetic origin of malignant trophoblastic neoplasms.
title_ja: 悪性トロホブラスト性腫瘍の遺伝的起源
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 3例の悪性トロホブラスト性腫瘍（絨毛癌2例、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)1例）の遺伝的起源を制限酵素断片長多型解析で検討した。完全奇胎由来の可能性がある絨毛癌1例は父親由来と母親由来の両方の対立遺伝子を有しており、正常受精を示唆した。もう1例の絨毛癌は減数第一分裂後の胚細胞に由来する単為生殖性のパターンを示した。PSTTは両親由来の対立遺伝子を含み、以前の異常妊娠が示唆された。組織量が少ないためPCR増幅が必要であった。
summary_en: The authors determined the genetic origin of three malignant trophoblastic neoplasms, two choriocarcinomas and one placental site trophoblastic tumor, by restriction fragment length polymorphism analysis. One choriocarcinoma, possibly arising from a complete mole, carried both paternal and maternal alleles, suggesting normal fertilization. The other choriocarcinoma showed a parthenogenetic pattern consistent with origin from a germ cell after meiosis I. The PSTT contained alleles from both parents, indicating a prior abnormal pregnancy, and required PCR amplification because little tumor material was available.

title: Pilot studies of 2 and 1 course carboplatin as adjuvant for stage I seminoma: should it be tested in a randomized trial against radiotherapy?
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する2コースおよび1コースのカルボプラチン補助化学療法の予備的検討：放射線療法との比較を試験すべきか
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの3つの治療戦略を、6施設の後方視的解析で比較した。再発率は監視療法で27%と最も高く、放射線療法6%、カルボプラチン2コース1%、1コースで0%であった。カルボプラチン補助療法は忍容性が良好で有効と結論され、ランダム化試験が必要とされた。
summary_en: This study compared three management strategies for Stage I seminoma: surveillance, prophylactic radiotherapy, and adjuvant single-agent carboplatin, at six centers in the Anglian Germ Cell Tumor Group. Recurrence was most frequent under surveillance (27%), followed by radiotherapy (6%) and one course of platinum (1%), with none after one course of carboplatin. Toxicity was similar across groups, although single-course carboplatin appeared to cause less sickness. The authors conclude that carboplatin is well tolerated and effective, and recommend a randomized trial.

title: Lack of self-regulation of human chorionic gonadotropin biosynthesis in human choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)生合成の自己調節の欠如
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARを用い、hCG生合成が正常絨毛と同様に自己調節されるかを検討した。外因性hCGはJAR細胞のhCG遺伝子発現と分泌を抑制しなかった。受容体の発現様式も正常と異なっていた。この自己調節の欠如が、妊娠性絨毛性疾患で高いhCG値を示す理由と考えられた。
summary_en: The authors examined whether JAR human choriocarcinoma cells regulate hCG biosynthesis by feedback, as normal trophoblasts do. Exogenous hCG failed to suppress hCG alpha and beta transcripts or secretion in JAR cells, and receptor antibodies had no effect. Unlike normal trophoblasts, JAR cells express multiple hCG/LH receptor transcripts and only a 50-kilodalton receptor isoform. cAMP still induced hCG alpha expression. The authors conclude that the loss of self-regulation may explain the very high hCG levels seen in gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Pure dysgerminoma of the ovary in childhood: treatment results and sequelae.
title_ja: 小児の卵巣純粋型ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）：治療成績と晩期障害
summary_ja: 1956年から1985年にIGRで治療された小児の卵巣純粋型ディスジャーミノーマ35例を後方視的に検討した。5年全生存率は94.1%であった。病期Iは無症状で生存したが、病期II・IIIでは放射線療法による重篤な晩期障害がみられた。播種例にはシスプラチン含有化学療法を先行し、残存腫瘍のみ放射線療法とすることが提案された。
summary_en: This Institut Gustave Roussy study reviewed 35 children with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated from 1956 to 1985. The five-year overall survival was 94.1%, and disease-free survival was 81.8%. Stage I patients treated with salpingo-oophorectomy and prophylactic radiotherapy all survived without sequelae. Stage II and III patients receiving radiotherapy developed severe late sequelae. The authors propose initial chemotherapy with cisplatin-containing regimens for widespread disease, reserving radiotherapy for residual tumor.

title: [Detection of mycobacterial DNA by in vitro enzymatic amplification in lung nodular lesions in a patient with ovarian immature teratoma].
title_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫患者の肺結節性病変におけるin vitro酵素増幅法によるマイコバクテリアDNAの検出
summary_ja: 13歳の女児で卵巣未熟奇形腫の既往があり、多発肺結節が出現した。転移との鑑別のため開胸術が行われ、組織学的に結核が疑われた。抗酸菌染色と培養では確定できなかったが、PCRにより結核菌DNAを検出し、抗結核療法により病変は縮小した。腫瘍性病変との鑑別におけるPCRの有用性が示された。
summary_en: A 13-year-old girl with ovarian immature teratoma developed multiple pulmonary nodules that raised concern for metastasis. Thoracotomy and histopathology suggested tuberculosis, but acid-fast staining and culture were nondiagnostic. PCR and hybridization detected Mycobacterium tuberculosis DNA in the resected specimens, and anti-mycobacterial therapy led to regression of the lesions. The authors recommend PCR-based mycobacterial DNA detection to distinguish tuberculosis from neoplastic lung lesions in patients who may have germ cell tumors, where surgery may otherwise be indicated.

title: The tumor microenvironment: possible role of integrins and the extracellular matrix in tumor biological behavior of intratubular germ cell neoplasia and testicular seminomas.
title_ja: 腫瘍微小環境：精巣セミノーマおよび精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の生物学的挙動におけるインテグリンと細胞外マトリックスの役割の可能性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常精巣、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)、原発性および転移性精巣セミノーマにおけるインテグリンサブユニットと細胞外マトリックスの分布を検討した。ITGCNではセルトリ細胞と悪性化した胚細胞でα3、α6、β1の発現が増加していた。浸潤性セミノーマへの進展に伴いα3の発現は消失し、ITGCNの非浸潤性の性質との関連が示唆された。細胞外マトリックスの分布はセミノーマ間で異なり、腫瘍と間質の相互作用が生物学的挙動に関与する可能性が示された。
summary_en: This 1994 study examined integrin subunits and extracellular matrix proteins in normal testis, intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN), and primary and metastatic testicular seminomas. ITGCN showed increased alpha3, alpha6, and beta1 integrin expression in Sertoli cells and malignant germ cells. Loss of alpha3 accompanied progression to invasive seminoma, suggesting a role in the noninvasive character of ITGCN. Alpha6 and beta1 were strongly expressed in all tumors, while alpha5 was weak in primary seminomas. The extracellular matrix distribution varied between seminomas, implying that tumor-stroma interactions shape biological behavior.

title: Current approaches to diagnosis and treatment of ovarian germ cell malignancies.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍の診断と治療に関する現在のアプローチ
summary_ja: 若年女性に多い卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍の診断と治療をレビューした論文である。併用化学療法の導入により予後は大きく改善し、BEPはPVBと同等の有効性と低い毒性を示した。組織型に応じた化学療法の選択、腫瘍マーカーやFIGO病期分類に基づく治療期間の決定が提案されている。初期病期の患者では妊孕性温存が適切とされている。
summary_en: This 1994 review covers the diagnosis and treatment of ovarian germ cell malignancies, which are aggressive tumors typically affecting young women. Modern combination chemotherapy transformed their prognosis from poor to highly curable. VAC was an early regimen, while PVB and BEP became standard, with BEP offering equal efficacy and less toxicity. The authors describe tailoring chemotherapy by histology and determining treatment duration using serial tumor markers or FIGO staging. Fertility preservation is appropriate for early-stage disease and selected advanced cases.

title: Value of phase-shift gradient-echo MR imaging in the differentiation of pelvic lesions with high signal intensity at T1-weighted imaging.
title_ja: T1強調画像で高信号を示す骨盤内病変の鑑別における位相シフト勾配エコーMR画像法の有用性
summary_ja: 骨盤内のT1高信号病変について、出血性腫瘍と奇形腫の鑑別における位相シフト勾配エコーMR法の有用性を60例で検討した。従来のスピンエコー法では両者の信号強度が類似していたが、FLASH法は病変をより明瞭に描出した。位相シフト勾配エコー法は、T1高信号骨盤内病変の鑑別診断に利用しやすい有用な手法である。
summary_en: Sixty patients underwent T1- and T2-weighted spin-echo and phase-shift FLASH gradient-echo MRI to evaluate high-signal-intensity pelvic lesions, mainly hemorrhagic tumors and teratomas. Lesion signal intensities were compared with intraperitoneal fat and surgical findings, and diagnostic performance was analyzed using ROC curves. Hemorrhagic lesions and teratomas showed similar signal intensities on conventional sequences, but FLASH imaging detected lesions more decisively. The authors conclude that phase-shift gradient-echo imaging is a readily available tool for differential diagnosis of T1-hyperintense pelvic lesions.

title: Long-term evaluation of postorchiectomy irradiation for stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する精巣摘除術後照射の長期評価
summary_ja: 1966〜1991年に治療された病期Iセミノーマ104例について、精巣摘除術後の横隔膜下照射(30Gy)の長期成績を検討した。重篤な急性毒性や晩期合併症は認められなかった。全体の制御率は97.1%で、再発3例は救援化学療法と放射線療法で救済された。二次悪性腫瘍は6例に発生したが、放射線誘発とは考えられなかった。
summary_en: This study followed 104 patients with stage I seminoma treated from 1966 to 1991 and evaluated the late effects of postorchiectomy megavoltage infradiaphragmatic irradiation (30 Gy). No serious acute toxicity or late complications occurred. Three patients recurred and were salvaged with chemotherapy and radiation therapy, and two of them remained disease-free long-term. Six patients developed second malignancies, none considered radiation induced. Overall control rate was 97.1%, indicating that first-course postorchiectomy irradiation controls most stage I seminomas.

title: Relaxation of imprinting in trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 絨毛性疾患におけるインプリンティングの弛緩
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常胎盤および絨毛性疾患におけるインプリンティング遺伝子H19の発現を、in situハイブリダイゼーションで検討した。完全胞状奇胎では間質に発現がみられず、一部の増殖細胞のみが陽性であった。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と妊娠性絨毛癌では顕著な発現が認められた。インプリンティングの弛緩と解釈され、完全奇胎の悪性の可能性との関連が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined expression of the imprinted gene H19 by in situ hybridization in normal placenta and trophoblastic disease. H19 was abundantly expressed in normal trophoblast and partial mole, but was absent from the stroma of complete hydatidiform mole, except for some proliferating mononuclear cells. Prominent expression was found in placental site trophoblastic tumor and gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors interpret this emergence of expression as relaxation of imprinting, which may be associated with the malignant potential of complete mole.

title: Macrophage colony-stimulating factor induces the growth and differentiation of normal pregnancy human cytotrophoblast cells and hydatidiform moles but does not induce the growth and differentiation of choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: マクロファージコロニー刺激因子は正常妊娠絨毛細胞および胞状奇胎細胞の増殖と分化を誘導するが、絨毛癌細胞には誘導しない
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マクロファージコロニー刺激因子(M-CSF)の、絨毛細胞、胞状奇胎細胞、絨毛癌細胞株に対する作用を検討した。M-CSFは初期妊娠絨毛細胞と奇胎細胞の増殖およびhCG・hPL分泌を促進したが、絨毛癌細胞株には影響がなかった。免疫染色でもM-CSFは絨毛細胞と奇胎細胞に存在し、絨毛癌細胞では陰性であった。正常および奇胎の絨毛細胞はM-CSF依存性である一方、絨毛癌は非依存性と考えられた。
summary_en: The authors examined whether macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) regulates growth and hormone secretion of human chorionic cells, hydatidiform mole cells, and choriocarcinoma cell lines. M-CSF promoted growth and hCG and hPL secretion in early gestation chorionic cells and mole cells, but had no effect on choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo, Jar, Jeg-3, and NUC-1. Immunohistochemistry detected M-CSF in chorionic and mole cells but not in choriocarcinoma cells. Growth and differentiation of normal and molar trophoblast appear M-CSF dependent, whereas those of choriocarcinoma are not.

title: Ovarian dysgerminoma: MR and CT appearance.
title_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫：MRおよびCT所見
summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫3例のCTおよびMR所見を病理所見と対比して後方視的に検討した。腫瘍は、T2強調像で低〜等信号を示し造影で著明に増強される隔壁によって小葉状に分けられていた。隔壁は病理学的に線維血管束に相当した。充実性卵巣腫瘤でこの所見を認めた場合、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫を疑うべきである。
summary_en: Three patients with ovarian dysgerminoma were retrospectively reviewed, comparing CT and MR findings with pathology. Tumors were divided into lobules by septa that were hypointense or isointense on T2-weighted imaging and showed marked enhancement on contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MR and contrast-enhanced CT. Histologically, these septa corresponded to fibrovascular bundles. The authors conclude that such septal enhancement within a solid ovarian mass should raise the possibility of dysgerminoma.

title: [Clinical study of the advanced testicular tumor non-achieved complete response by primary chemotherapy and relapse cases. The East Japan Testicular Tumor Study Group].
title_ja: 初回化学療法で完全奏効に至らなかった進行精巣腫瘍例および再発例の臨床的検討 ── 東日本精巣腫瘍研究グループ
summary_ja: 東日本精巣腫瘍研究グループによる進行精巣腫瘍の検討。初回化学療法で完全奏効に至らなかった症例では、残存腫瘍の切除などにより多くが無病生存を得た。残存腫瘍の組織は壊死・線維化が主で、奇形腫成分を認める例もあった。完全奏効後の再発例も分析され、病期IIIB・IIICで再発が多く、部分奏効後に残存腫瘍切除を受けた例で再発が多かった。
summary_en: This report from the East Japan Testicular Tumor Study Group examines advanced testicular tumor patients who did not achieve complete response to primary chemotherapy. Residual-tumor resection or radiation therapy in seminoma stage II patients led to no evidence of disease in several cases, and most non-seminoma stage II and about half of stage III patients with resectable residuals also achieved it. Residual masses were mainly necrosis or fibrosis, with teratoma in six cases. Eight patients who relapsed after complete response were also analyzed. Relapse was more frequent in stage IIIB and IIIC disease and after partial response.

title: Case report: intraperitoneal metastases from testicular germ cell tumour.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍からの腹腔内転移：症例報告
summary_ja: セミノーマの治療後に腹腔内転移を生じた患者の症例報告である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍としては稀な転移部位であり、転移病変で腫瘍形態が変化していたことが記載されている。単一症例のため頻度や機序についての結論は限られるが、治療後の非典型的な転移形式を理解する上で参考になる。
summary_en: A patient treated for seminoma developed intraperitoneal metastases, an unusual site of spread for testicular germ cell tumour. The case report notes that tumour morphology changed in the metastatic lesions. Because this is a single case, conclusions about frequency or mechanism are limited. The report adds to documentation of atypical metastatic patterns in testicular GCT after treatment, which can inform surveillance and clinical awareness.

title: Cytogenetics and origins of pediatric germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学と起源
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍17例について細胞遺伝学とDNAフィンガープリント解析を行った。全例が正常二倍体核型であった。宿主と腫瘍のヘテロ多型の比較から、性腺外および精巣の胚細胞腫瘍は減数分裂の誤りや内部倍加によらず、体細胞または胚細胞からの有糸分裂によって生じると結論している。
summary_en: Cytogenetic and DNA fingerprint analyses were performed on 13 new pediatric germ cell tumors, plus four previously reported cases, arising in the ovary, sacrococcygeal region, testis, mediastinum and craniofacial region. All new cases had a normal diploid karyotype. Comparing host and tumor centromeric heteromorphisms, the authors conclude that extragonadal and testicular GCTs do not arise through meiotic errors or endoreduplication. They propose that these tumors arise mitotically from somatic or germ cells, unlike ovarian GCTs, which have several meiotic mechanisms.

title: Central nervous system as sanctuary site of relapse in patients treated with chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんの化学療法後に再発の聖域となる中枢神経系
summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんにシスプラチン併用化学療法を行った417例のうち、6例が完全寛解中に単発の脳再発を生じた。多くは手術と放射線療法を受け、3例は19〜86か月後も再発なく生存している。脳が化学療法後の聖域部位となり得ることを示し、この稀な再発は比較的予後が良好であると述べている。
summary_en: Among 417 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer, six developed isolated cerebral relapse while in complete remission, a median of four months after chemotherapy ended. Five of the six had advanced pulmonary dissemination, and no viable tumour was found at post-chemotherapy surgery. Most patients underwent surgery and radiotherapy, and three were alive and relapse-free 19 to 86 months later. The authors describe the brain as a sanctuary site and note a relatively favourable prognosis for this rare complication.

title: Neonatal teratoma presenting as hygroma colli.
title_ja: 頸部リンパ管腫として発症した新生児奇形腫
summary_ja: 新生児に頭蓋、頸部、上縦隔にわたる大きな腫瘍が見られ、頸部リンパ管腫様に見えた。画像・病理検査で囊胞成分を伴う成熟奇形腫と診断された。囊胞形成の機序として、リンパ嚢の閉塞、奇形腫の一部としての異常なリンパ管増殖、脈絡叢組織由来の3説を挙げ、本例では脈絡叢由来が最も可能性が高いとしている。
summary_en: A neonate presented with a large tumour involving the cranial, cervical and upper mediastinal regions, initially resembling a hygroma colli.
