Radiological and pathological examination revealed a mature teratoma with prominent cystic components. The authors discuss three explanations for the cystic formation: obstruction of primary lymphatic sacs by the teratoma, abnormal lymphatic proliferation as part of the teratoma, or origin of the cystic part from choroid plexus tissue containing CSF. They consider the last explanation most probable in this patient.

title: Flow-cytometric and quantitative histologic parameters as prognostic indicators for occult retroperitoneal disease in clinical-stage-I non-seminomatous testicular germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における潜在性後腹膜病変の予後指標としてのフローサイトメトリーおよび定量的組織学的パラメータ
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍67例の保存原発腫瘍を用い、潜在性後腹膜転移を予測した後方視的研究。胎児性癌の割合と異数性細胞のS期分画が独立した予測因子で、併用モデルは91.0%を正しく分類した。組織学的基準のみでは56.7%だった。
summary_en: This study examined whether combining DNA flow cytometry with quantitative histopathology improves prediction of occult retroperitoneal metastasis in clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Archival primary tumors from 67 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection were reanalyzed. The percentage of embryonal carcinoma and the S-phase fraction of aneuploid cells were independent predictors. The combined model correctly classified 91.0% of cases, with 95.3% sensitivity and 83.3% specificity, compared with only 56.7% using histopathology alone.

title: Persistent gestational trophoblastic tumour with partial hydatidiform mole as the antecedent pregnancy.
title_ja: 部分胞状奇胎を先行妊娠とする持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍
summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎を先行妊娠とする持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍6例を16年間にわたり後方視的に検討。2例で肺転移を生じ、5例は化学療法で寛解した。部分胞状奇胎も悪性化しうるため、β-hCGのフォローアップと早期の胸部X線検査が必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This 16-year retrospective review examined persistent gestational trophoblastic tumor after partial hydatidiform mole in 207 women, of whom six had partial mole as the antecedent pregnancy. Two developed pulmonary metastases, and none developed choriocarcinoma. Five of six achieved remission with chemotherapy, and one with hysterectomy. DNA ploidy was triploid in three and diploid in two. The authors conclude that partial mole can be malignant, that follow-up of serum beta-hCG and early chest X-ray are needed.

title: Epidermoid cyst of the testis: a review of clinical and histogenetic considerations.
title_ja: 精巣の類表皮嚢胞：臨床および組織発生学的考察のレビュー
summary_ja: 精巣類表皮嚢胞10例と精巣胚細胞腫瘍481例を22年間で後方視的に解析した研究。周囲に精巣上皮内腫瘍は認められず、単純型は良性で精巣温存手術が妥当と結論づけた。奇形腫や胚細胞腫瘍を伴う複合型とは区別される。
summary_en: This review analyzed 10 patients with simple epidermoid cysts of the testis and 481 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated over 22 years. Immunostaining for placental alkaline phosphatase showed no testicular intraepithelial neoplasia around the cysts. The authors propose separating complex epidermoid cysts, which occur with teratoma or germ cell tumor, from simple cysts, which are benign and not teratomas. Testis-sparing surgery is justified for simple cysts. Six of the ten patients were managed with conservative surgery and none relapsed.

title: Testicular tumor after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for germ cell malignancy.
title_ja: 胚細胞悪性腫瘍に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法後の精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた胚細胞悪性腫瘍417例を中央値7年追跡した研究。6例が二次性の精巣腫瘍を発症した。化学療法でリスクは下がるが消失はしないため、後腹膜原発例では慎重な長期フォローアップが必要とされた。
summary_en: This study followed 417 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for germ cell malignancy for a median of seven years. Six developed a second testicular tumor. In three cases, the initial tumor was testicular, while in the others it was retroperitoneal. The authors conclude that cisplatin may reduce but does not eliminate the risk of a contralateral testicular tumor. Patients with primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumors therefore need close, careful long-term follow-up.

title: Antitumor effect of recombinant human tumor necrosis factor on human testicular tumors heterotransplanted in nude mice.
title_ja: ヌードマウスに異種移植したヒト精巣腫瘍に対する組換えヒト腫瘍壊死因子の抗腫瘍効果
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植したヒト精巣腫瘍の胎児性癌と奇形癌に対し、組換えヒトTNFの効果を検討した前臨床研究。腫瘍内投与で両者とも完全退縮が得られ、静脈内投与より有効かつ安全であった。
summary_en: This preclinical study tested recombinant human tumor necrosis factor against two human testicular tumor xenografts in nude mice, an embryonal carcinoma line and a teratocarcinoma line. Intratumoral injection produced clear antitumor effects and complete regression in both models, with the embryonal carcinoma line more responsive. Intravenous administration at the same dose had little effect. Histological findings matched tumor volume reduction. The authors conclude that intratumoral delivery is more effective and safer than intravenous delivery for testicular tumors.

title: Ber-H2 expression in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるBer-H2発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍52例を対象に、モノクローナル抗体Ber-H2によるCD30抗原発現を検討した。セミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍成分では陰性、胎児性癌成分の大半では陽性であった。奇形腫成分や精細管内胚細胞腫瘍は陰性で、胎児性癌をセミノーマ・卵黄嚢腫瘍と鑑別する指標となり、セミノーマと精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の関連を示唆する。
summary_en: This study examined CD30 antigen expression, detected by the monoclonal antibody Ber-H2, in 52 testicular tumors including pure seminoma, pure embryonal carcinoma, and mixed germ cell tumors. Ber-H2 was absent in seminomas and yolk sac tumor components, present in most embryonal carcinoma components, and absent in teratomatous elements and intratubular germ cell neoplasia. The authors conclude that Ber-H2 helps distinguish embryonal carcinoma from seminoma and yolk sac tumor, and that the negative staining in intratubular germ cell neoplasia supports its close relationship with seminoma.

title: Anterior mediastinal mass in a young man.
title_ja: 若年男性にみられた前縦隔腫瘤
summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘤を呈した若年男性を報告する。縦隔奇形腫が発見された後にクラインフェルター症候群と診断された。縦隔腫瘤を最初に評価することの多い胸部専門医は、この関連を認識しておく必要があると著者らは強調する。本症例は、縦隔奇形腫と性染色体異常の併存を示す症例報告である。
summary_en: A young man presented with an anterior mediastinal mass, and a mediastinal teratoma was identified as the cause. Klinefelter syndrome was diagnosed only after this discovery. The authors highlight that this association matters for chest physicians, who are often the first to evaluate patients with mediastinal masses, so the condition should be considered when such a tumor is found.

title: Lack of heritability in ovarian germ cell malignancies.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍における遺伝性の欠如
summary_ja: 新生児から20歳までの46,XX核型の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者78例について、3世代にわたる家系を調査した。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）および性腺芽腫は除外されている。第1度・第2度近親者456名に卵巣の悪性腫瘍は認められず、同種腫瘍の発症リスクは上昇していなかった。遺伝性腫瘍で見られる若年発症の傾向とは異なる結果であった。
summary_en: This study reviewed three-generation pedigrees of 78 presumptive 46,XX patients aged newborn to 20 years with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, excluding dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma. Among 456 surveyed first- and second-degree relatives, none had a malignant ovarian neoplasm. The authors conclude that relatives of these patients do not have an increased risk of similar tumors, which was unexpected given the usual pattern of hereditary tumors with early onset.

title: Occurrence of seminoma and dysgerminoma in father and daughter.
title_ja: 父と娘におけるセミノーマとディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の発生
summary_ja: 父親のセミノーマと娘のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例を報告する。両腫瘍は組織学的に類似していた。同一家系で胚細胞腫瘍が発生したことは、これらの腫瘍に共通の遺伝的基盤がある可能性を支持する。男女の近親に胚細胞腫瘍が認められた事例として、家族内集積に関する限られた知見を補うものである。
summary_en: The authors report seminoma in a father and dysgerminoma in his daughter, with similar histological appearances in both tumors. The occurrence of germ cell tumors of these types in one family supports the idea that they may share a common genetic basis. The brief report adds to limited evidence on familial occurrence of germ cell tumors in male and female relatives.

title: Primary lung choriocarcinoma masquerading as a metastatic gestational neoplasm.
title_ja: 転移性妊娠性腫瘍と誤認された原発性肺絨毛癌
summary_ja: 当初は転移性妊娠性腫瘍と診断された若年女性が、標準的な化学療法に反応しなかった。子宮摘出および両側卵管卵巣摘出術でβ-hCG産生源は同定されず、開胸肺葉切除により原発性肺絨毛癌と判明した。その後化学療法は行わず、3年以上無病で経過している。肺絨毛癌で成功裏に治療された初の報告例とされる。
summary_en: A young woman was initially diagnosed with a metastatic gestational neoplasm but did not respond to standard chemotherapy. Hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy failed to identify a source of beta-hCG production, and thoracotomy with lobectomy revealed primary lung choriocarcinoma. She received no further chemotherapy and remained disease free for more than three years. The authors describe this as the first recorded case of lung choriocarcinoma successfully treated with more than one year disease-free survival.

title: Mortality and cancer incidence following radiotherapy for seminoma of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法後の死亡率と発がんリスク
summary_ja: 1961年から1985年に精巣セミノーマに対して放射線療法を受けた859例を対象に、死亡率と二次がんの発生を検討したコホート研究である。二次がん死亡は全体として有意な増加を示さなかったが、白血病は相対危険度6.2と顕著に増加した。放射線療法による死亡リスク増加の明確な根拠は示されず、白血病の増加は治療関連の可能性があるとされた。
summary_en: This registry-based cohort study followed 859 patients treated with radiotherapy for testicular seminoma between 1961 and 1985 to assess mortality and second cancers. Fifty-one patients died of testicular cancer, and second cancer deaths were not significantly elevated overall. Leukaemia was notably increased, with a relative risk of 6.2. Non-cancer mortality was not elevated, though mortality risk appeared to rise over time. The authors conclude there is no definite evidence of increased mortality from radiotherapy, although the leukaemia excess may be treatment-related.

title: Lower urinary tract dysfunction in children with benign sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 良性仙尾部奇形腫の小児における下部尿路機能障害
summary_ja: 良性仙尾部奇形腫の小児11例を対象に、排尿機能を超音波検査、排尿時膀胱尿道造影、尿流動態検査で評価した研究である。11例中9例に異常所見がみられ、神経因性膀胱・括約筋機能障害が最も多かった。主な原因は骨盤神経叢や仙骨神経の手術による外傷と考えられ、2例では脊髄係留が一次的原因であった。
summary_en: This study evaluated lower urinary tract function in 11 children with benign sacrococcygeal teratoma using ultrasonography, voiding cystourethrography, and urodynamic testing. Nine of the 11 had abnormal findings, most often neurogenic bladder-sphincter dysfunction. The authors attribute the neurogenic dysfunction mainly to surgical trauma of the pelvic plexus and sacral nerves, and note that tethered spinal cord was a primary cause in two patients. Voiding dysfunction is common in these children and is usually neurogenic in origin.

title: Deoxyribonucleic acid ploidy in seminomas with and without syncytiotrophoblastic cells.
title_ja: 合胞体栄養膜細胞を有するセミノーマと有さないセミノーマにおけるDNA倍数性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: セミノーマ50例のDNA倍数性をフローサイトメトリーと画像細胞計測で比較した研究である。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生性の合胞体栄養膜細胞を有する例と有さない例で、DNA指数に差はみられなかった。倍数性は病期や臨床経過と相関せず、合胞体栄養膜細胞の存在は腫瘍内の分化の多様性を示すもので、独立した予後サブグループとは考えられないと結論された。
summary_en: This flow and image cytometry study compared DNA ploidy in 50 seminomas, 30 containing syncytiotrophoblastic cells that produce hCG and 20 without. Nearly all tumors (98%) were DNA aneuploid, with no difference in DNA index between the groups. Multiploidy and hypertetraploidy appeared more often in negative cases. Neither ploidy nor stemline pattern correlated with stage or clinical course. The authors conclude that syncytiotrophoblastic cells reflect intratumoral differentiation variability rather than a distinct prognostic subgroup.

title: Primary chemotherapy for stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する初回化学療法
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後に白金製剤を含む初回化学療法を受けた病期II非セミノーマ122例の治療成績を報告した研究である。中央値5.5年の追跡で97%が無病生存し、5年生存率は95%であった。腫瘍の病期は再発を予測しなかったが、化学療法後のリンパ節郭清の必要性には影響した。初回化学療法は初回リンパ節郭清と同等に有効で、68%で大手術を回避できたと結論された。
summary_en: This series of 122 patients with clinical stage II testicular nonseminoma treated with primary platinum-based chemotherapy after orchiectomy reports a median follow-up of 5.5 years. Ninety-seven percent remained disease-free, and 5-year survival was 95%. Tumor substage did not predict relapse but affected the likelihood of post-chemotherapy lymphadenectomy. Resected residual masses showed mature teratoma, necrosis, or embryonal carcinoma. The authors conclude that primary chemotherapy was as effective as primary lymph node dissection and avoided major surgery in 68% of cases.

title: Long-term disease-free survival in a child with refractory metastatic malignant germ cell tumor treated by high-dose chemotherapy with autologous bone marrow rescues.
title_ja: 自家骨髄救済を伴う大量化学療法により治療した難治性転移性悪性胚細胞腫瘍の小児における長期無病生存
summary_ja: 8か月の女児の難治性転移性悪性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。救援白金系化学療法、手術、転移巣切除に抵抗性を示した。初回コース後にαフェトプロテインが正常化したため、自家骨髄救済を伴う大量化学療法を2コース施行した。移植後3年以上完全寛解を維持し、治療関連の後遺症は認めていない。小児の難治性悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、用量強化化学療法が根治的となり得ることを示唆している。
summary_en: This case report describes an 8-month-old girl with refractory metastatic malignant germ cell tumor who did not respond to salvage platinum-based chemotherapy, surgery, and metastatectomy. After serum alpha-fetoprotein normalized following the first course, she received two courses of high-dose carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide with autologous bone marrow rescue. She has remained in complete remission for over three years after transplant, without detectable treatment-related sequelae. The authors suggest that dose-intensive chemotherapy with autologous bone marrow rescue may have curative potential in children with refractory malignant germ cell tumors.

title: Percentage of embryonal carcinoma and of vascular invasion predicts pathological stage in clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ精巣がんにおいて胎児性癌の割合と血管侵襲は病理学的病期を予測する
summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍92例を解析し、真の病理学的病期Iと潜在性病変を有する病期IIを区別する原発腫瘍の特徴を検討した。多変量解析では血管侵襲と胎児性癌の割合が有意で、この2因子による予測モデルは85.9%の確率で病期を正しく判定した。両因子を全例で評価し、治療方針の決定に役立てることを提案している。
summary_en: This study analyzed 92 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors to identify primary tumor features that distinguish true pathological stage I disease from occult advanced disease. In multivariate analysis, vascular invasion and the percentage of embryonal carcinoma remained significant. A model using these two variables predicted pathological stage correctly in 85.9% of cases. The authors suggest that these factors should be assessed in all clinical stage I nonseminomatous patients to guide therapeutic decisions.

title: Radiation therapy for stage I and IIA testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 病期I及びIIAの精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1964〜1988年に精巣摘除術と腸骨・傍大動脈への放射線療法を受けた精巣セミノーマ128例の後方視的解析。5年無病生存率は病期Iで97%、病期IIAで93%であった。再発は4例（3%）で、いずれも照射野外であり、多くは化学療法で救済された。予防的縦隔照射の有無にかかわらず縦隔再発は認めず、根治的精巣摘除術と放射線療法が第一選択と結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 128 patients with histologically confirmed testicular seminoma, including 95 with stage I and 33 with stage IIA disease, treated with orchiectomy and radiation therapy to the iliac and paraaortic lymphatics at a single institution from 1964 to 1988. Five-year disease-free survival was 97% for stage I and 93% for stage IIA. Four patients (3%) relapsed, all outside the radiation field, and most were salvaged with chemotherapy. No mediastinal recurrences occurred with or without prophylactic mediastinal irradiation. The authors conclude that radical orchiectomy with iliac and paraaortic irradiation is the treatment of choice.

title: Hematuria, renal mass and amenorrhea: indicators of a rare diagnosis.
title_ja: 血尿、腎腫瘤、無月経：稀な診断の指標
summary_ja: 腎転移性絨毛癌は稀な病態であり、その初発症状として血尿と腎腫瘤を呈する例はさらに稀である。本論文は2症例を報告し、文献レビューを行っている。無月経も診断の手がかりとなり得ることを示唆している。これらの所見を認めた際には、腎腫瘤の鑑別診断として転移性絨毛癌を考慮する必要性を示している。
summary_en: This report presents two cases of metastatic choriocarcinoma of the kidney, a rare entity whose primary presentation was hematuria and a renal mass. The authors review the literature on this uncommon presentation. The title also highlights amenorrhea as a clue to the diagnosis. Recognizing these features may help clinicians consider this rare diagnosis when evaluating a renal mass. The report is aimed at improving awareness of an unusual clinical presentation.

title: Retroperitoneal tumor eleven years after initial treatment of testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん初回治療から11年後に生じた後腹膜腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する精巣摘除術の11年後に後腹膜腫瘍を生じた症例報告。原発の精巣腫瘍は純粋な絨毛癌で、後腹膜腫瘍は絨毛癌を伴わない胎児性癌と推定された。化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清により完全寛解が得られた。精巣がんの晩期再発か、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の原発かの鑑別は困難であると論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient who developed a retroperitoneal tumor eleven years after orchiectomy for testicular cancer. The primary testicular tumor was pure choriocarcinoma, while the retroperitoneal lesion was likely embryonal carcinoma without choriocarcinoma foci. Complete remission was achieved with combination chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The authors note that it is difficult to determine whether the retroperitoneal tumor is a late recurrence of testicular cancer or a primary extragonadal germ cell tumor.

title: Integrated approach to the management of patients with advanced germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の進行性胚細胞腫瘍の患者に対する統合的管理アプローチ
summary_ja: 1985年から1991年に播種性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の63例を後方視的に検討した。初回シスプラチン併用化学療法で完全奏効は38%だった。41%に外科的切除を行い、平均30か月の観察で75%が無病状態であった。進行例の救援化学療法は5例に行われ、手術を加えて救済できたのは1例のみだった。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 63 patients with disseminated testicular germ cell tumors treated with initial cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy between 1985 and 1991. Complete response was seen in 38%, and 41% underwent adjunctive surgical resection, including intraoperative radiation in two seminoma patients. Salvage chemotherapy was given to five patients with progression, and only one was salvaged by surgery. Disease-free status was achieved in 75% at a mean follow-up of 30 months.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome.
title_ja: growing teratoma syndrome
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法中に、血清腫瘍マーカーが正常なまま後腹膜の転移巣が増大した4例を報告した。growing teratoma syndromeの典型的な臨床像を示す。全例で外科的切除が行われ、術後6〜24か月の無病生存が得られた。
summary_en: This short case series describes four patients with growing teratoma syndrome, in which enlarging metastatic masses containing mature teratoma appeared during chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. All masses were retroperitoneal and grew despite normal serum tumor markers. Surgical excision was performed in all four patients, with disease-free survival from 6 to 24 months afterward.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma in children: a diagnostic challenge.
title_ja: 小児の仙尾部奇形腫：診断の難しさ
summary_ja: 小児の仙尾部奇形腫4例を報告した。典型的な腫脹を示す例は診断が容易である一方、血管腫を伴う例や尾状付属物を示す例、肛門皮膚瘻を示す例では診断が難しかった。直腸診と適切な画像検査、特にコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)が診断に有用であり、臨床的疑いを高く持つことが重要と結論づけた。
summary_en: This report describes four children with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Two neonates had obvious or subtle sacral swelling, one had a tail-like appendage at the natal cleft, and one had an anocutaneous fistula with partial sacral agenesis. The authors emphasize that a careful rectal examination combined with imaging, such as computed tomography, is needed to diagnose less obvious cases, which require a high index of clinical suspicion.

title: Testicular cancer in blacks. A multicenter experience.
title_ja: 黒人における精巣がん：多施設での経験
summary_ja: 軍の医療センター7施設で精巣腫瘍の黒人患者66例を後方視的に検討した。予後、左右差、非セミノーマの発症年齢は一般集団と同様であった。一方、間質性腫瘍がやや多く、セミノーマの発症年齢は若く、白人と比べて診断が遅れていた。シスプラチン併用化学療法により生存率が改善した。
summary_en: This multicenter retrospective review of 66 Black patients with testicular tumors from military medical centers compared their features with the general population. Prognosis, side distribution, and age of onset for nonseminoma were similar, but interstitial tumors were slightly more common, seminoma presented at a younger age, and diagnosis was delayed compared with White patients. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy improved survival in this population.

title: Production of placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and PLAP-like material by epithelial germ cell and non-germ cell tumours in vitro.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍および非胚細胞腫瘍の培養細胞におけるPLAPおよびPLAP様物質の産生
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 培養細胞87株の培養上清中のPLAPおよびPLAP様物質を測定し、胚細胞腫瘍を含む腫瘍細胞での発現を評価した。新たな免疫放射定量法(IRMA)は従来の酵素免疫測定法より高い検出率と再現性を示した。PLAP様物質の異所性発現は過小評価されており、腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性は抗原量で再評価すべきだと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study measures placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and PLAP-like material in culture media from 87 neoplastic and normal cell lines, including germ cell and non-germ cell tumours. A new immunoradiometric assay (IRMA) detected PLAP in 46% of epithelial and germ cell cultures, versus 33% with the conventional enzymatic assay (IAEA). The IRMA was more robust, with lower coefficients of variation. The authors conclude that ectopic expression of non-enzymatic PLAP-like genes is more common than previously recognized, and that PLAP's utility as a tumour marker should be re-evaluated using antigen-mass assays rather than enzyme activity.

title: Maturation arrest of stem cell differentiation is a common pathway for the cellular origin of teratocarcinomas and epithelial cancers.
title_ja: 幹細胞分化の成熟停止は奇形癌と上皮性癌に共通する起源の経路である
summary_ja: 多くの臓器の癌と奇形癌は、分化が成熟段階で停止した組織特異的幹細胞に由来するという仮説を提示したレビュー。腫瘍の分化度は未分化幹細胞の割合と成熟停止の段階で決まる。奇形癌で得られた知見は他臓器の癌にも適用でき、細胞傷害性治療に代わる分化誘導療法の可能性を示唆する。
summary_en: This review proposes that carcinomas of many organs, and teratocarcinomas, arise from tissue-determined stem cells whose differentiation is arrested at a maturation stage. The degree of tumour differentiation depends on the proportion of undifferentiated stem cells, the stage of arrest, and the ability of some cells to escape it. The authors argue that teratocarcinomas, long studied as a model, are unique only in the potential of their stem cells, and that insights from embryonic regulation could support therapies that redirect malignant stem cells toward normal differentiation as an alternative to cytotoxic treatment. The abstract provided is truncated.

title: Negative testicular biopsy and asynchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumour.
title_ja: 生検陰性であった異時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 一側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対して精巣摘除術を受けた患者が、3年後に反対側に第二の原発性精巣がんを発症した症例報告です。初回手術時の対側精巣生検は陰性でした。生検陰性でも後から胚細胞腫瘍が生じ得ることを示しています。
summary_en: This brief case report describes a patient who was found to have a second primary testicular cancer three years after orchiectomy for the first tumor. The contralateral testis had a negative biopsy at the time of the first surgery. The title points to the limitation of a negative contralateral biopsy, which does not exclude later development of a testicular germ cell tumor. The abstract reports only this single patient.

title: Dysgerminoma of the ovary associated with hypercalcemia.
title_ja: 高カルシウム血症を伴う卵巣のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）
summary_ja: 19歳女性の右卵巣腫瘍で、高カルシウム血症を呈した症例です。切除された腫瘍は典型的なディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)で、術後にカルシウム値は正常化しました。若年女性で高カルシウム血症を伴う卵巣腫瘍として、本腫瘍が2番目に多いことを指摘しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with a right ovarian tumor, abdominal swelling, polydipsia and polyuria, and serum calcium of 12.2 mg/dl. After salpingo-oophorectomy, the tumor was a typical dysgerminoma and calcium normalized postoperatively. The authors note that dysgerminoma is the second most common ovarian neoplasm associated with hypercalcemia in young women, after small cell carcinoma of the hypercalcemic type. They emphasize that pathologists should be aware of this to avoid diagnostic confusion on microscopy. The paper also briefly reviews the literature.

title: Clinical relevance of the i(12p) marker chromosome in germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるi(12p)マーカー染色体の臨床的意義
summary_ja: 男性の胚細胞腫瘍171検体で染色体マーカーi(12p)を解析した研究です。異常核型の約8割で認められ、非セミノーマで多く見られました。正中線腫瘍の7例は胚細胞腫瘍と再分類されました。i(12p)は診断的、また予後的な意義を持つ可能性があると結論づけています。
summary_en: This study evaluated the i(12p) isochromosome as a marker of male germ cell tumors in 171 evaluable tumor samples from 150 men, and tested whether it could diagnose germ cell origin in 28 midline tumors of uncertain histogenesis. i(12p) was found in about 79% of abnormal karyotypes, more often in nonseminomas than seminomas. Cytogenetic failure was associated with complete chemotherapy response. Copy number of i(12p) did not affect outcome. FISH detected i(12p) in tumors where karyotype failed, and seven midline tumors were reclassified as germ cell tumors.

title: Neonatal testis tumors: a review of the Prepubertal Testis Tumor Registry.
title_ja: 新生児の精巣腫瘍：前思春期精巣腫瘍登録の検討
summary_ja: 米国小児科学会の前思春期精巣腫瘍登録から、新生児の精巣腫瘍22例を検討しました。卵黄嚢腫瘍が最多で、ほとんどの患者は無病でした。化学療法導入前に卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された1例は転移性疾患で死亡しています。陰嚢内腫瘤の鑑別診断として本疾患を考慮すべきと述べています。
summary_en: This registry review analyzed 338 prepubertal testis tumors collected by the American Academy of Pediatrics since 1980, focusing on 22 tumors in neonates under one month old. Yolk sac tumors were most common, followed by gonadal stromal tumors and juvenile granulosa cell tumors, with gonadoblastoma and teratoma less frequent. Preoperative AFP levels ranged widely. Most of the 18 children with follow-up had no evidence of disease, while one child with yolk sac tumor treated before chemotherapy died of metastatic disease. The authors recommend considering neonatal testis tumors in the differential diagnosis of a scrotal mass.

title: Immunohistochemical characterization of teratomatous and fetal neuroendocrine pancreas.
title_ja: 奇形腫性および胎児性の神経内分泌膵組織の免疫組織化学的特徴
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 性腺外奇形腫6例に含まれる膵組織を免疫染色で解析し、胎児および成人の膵と比較しました。奇形腫内の膵組織には成熟した膵島が見られる一方、胎児・新生児膵に似た広範な膵島過形成(nesidioblastosis)も認められました。異常な分化がホルモン産生不全につながる可能性を示唆しています。
summary_en: This study analyzed six extragonadal teratomas containing pancreatic tissue and compared their neuroendocrine cells with fetal and adult pancreas. Immunohistochemistry for insulin, glucagon, somatostatin, pancreatic polypeptide and other markers was performed. All six teratomas had mature-appearing islets with beta, alpha, delta, and PP cells, along with widespread nesidioblastosis resembling late fetal and neonatal pancreas. Alpha and delta cell proportions were increased in several cases, indicating immaturity. Abnormal differentiation may cause deficient hormone production, which the authors suggest.

title: Increased expression of the matrix metalloproteinase 2 in differentiating Tera 2 human embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: Tera 2ヒト胎児性癌細胞の分化に伴うマトリックスメタロプロテアーゼ2の発現増加
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera 2を用い、MMP-2の発現調節を検討した研究です。未分化で腫瘍形成能を持つ細胞はMMP-2活性が低く、レチノイン酸による分化誘導でMMP-2発現が著明に増加しました。悪性形質との関連を示す他モデルとは対照的な結果で、臨床ではなく細胞生物学的な知見です。
summary_en: This study examined matrix metalloproteinase-2 (MMP-2) regulation in Tera 2 human embryonal carcinoma cells. Undifferentiated, tumorigenic cells produced low MMP-2 activity, which was not altered by bFGF or TPA. Retinoic acid-induced differentiation markedly increased MMP-2 expression and type IV collagenase activity, while TIMP-1 and TIMP-2 expression was largely unchanged. Unlike many models where collagenase activity tracks malignancy, this pattern suggests MMP-2 upregulation reflects differentiation. The work is cell-biological rather than clinical.

title: Cisplatin containing combination chemotherapy of advanced germ cell line testicular tumours.
title_ja: 進行性胚細胞系精巣腫瘍に対するシスプラチン含有併用化学療法
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍190例に対する修正Einhorn法による化学療法の成績を報告した研究です。胎児性癌組織型とマーカー陰性例で成績が良好でした。一次治療抵抗性または再発の112例では奏効率53.6%で、完全奏効例の平均寛解期間は37か月でした。第三選択療法の寛解率は24.5%でした。
summary_en: This Hungarian report describes 190 patients with germ cell testicular tumours treated with a modified Einhorn chemotherapy scheme, with the best responses in embryonal histology and marker-negative patients. A second cohort of 112 patients with primary resistance or relapse received salvage combination chemotherapy including cisplatin, with a 53.6% response rate. Complete responders had a mean remission of 37 months versus 6.1 months for partial responders. Third-line therapy achieved remission in 24.5%, and the authors conclude that salvage regimens and metastasectomy offer long-term survival to a minority.

title: A 18 years study of testicular tumours in Jodhpur, western Rajasthan.
title_ja: ラジャスタン州西部ジョードプルにおける18年間の精巣腫瘍の検討
summary_ja: 1969〜1987年にジョードプルで記録された精巣腫瘍100例をWHO分類で後方視的に検討した研究です。単一組織型の胚細胞腫瘍が76%を占め、セミノーマと胎児性癌が多くみられました。停留精巣に生じた例が5例あり、混合型では奇形癌が優勢でした。地域的な疫学・病理像の報告です。
summary_en: This review of 100 testicular tumours recorded at Jodhpur from 1969 to 1987 classified cases by WHO histologic typing. Tumours accounted for 2.57% of male genital malignancies, peaking in the third and fourth decades with right-sided predominance. Five cases arose in undescended testes. Germ cell tumours of a single histologic type made up 76%, with seminoma (34%) and embryonal carcinoma (28%) most common, while teratocarcinoma predominated in mixed-type tumours. The study provides a regional epidemiologic and pathologic description.

title: Management of benign ovarian cystic teratomas: laparoscopy compared with laparotomy.
title_ja: 良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡手術と開腹手術の比較
summary_ja: 良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫38例を、腹腔鏡手術19例と開腹手術19例で後方視的に比較した研究です。腹腔鏡群では術中破裂が多かったものの、入院期間は有意に短くなりました。平均11か月のフォローアップで重篤な合併症はありませんでした。腹腔鏡下の治療は安全で費用対効果も高いと結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective comparison included 38 women with benign ovarian cystic teratomas (dermoids), 19 treated laparoscopically and 19 by laparotomy, matched for age, gravidity, parity, and lesion size. Laparoscopy produced more intraoperative ruptures but a significantly shorter hospital stay. Cystectomy with ovarian preservation was usual. After a mean follow-up of 11 months, no severe chemical peritonitis or persistent pelvic pain occurred in the laparoscopy group. The authors conclude that laparoscopic management is safe, cost effective, and speeds recovery.

title: New laparoscopic instrument for removing hair from ovarian dermoid cysts.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫から毛髪を除去するための新しい腹腔鏡器具
summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫内の毛髪を腹腔鏡下に除去するための新しい器具を紹介した報告です。テフロン製で、先端6cmが溝付きのテーパー形状になっています。毛髪の塊の中で回転させると、毛髪が先端に絡みつき容易に引き出せます。腹腔鏡手術中の奇形腫内容物の扱いの課題に対応するものです。
summary_en: This short report describes a new laparoscopic instrument for removing hair from ovarian dermoid cysts. The Teflon device is 35 cm long and 9 mm in diameter, with a distal 6 cm tapered segment bearing longitudinal and transverse grooves. When rotated in the hair mass, the hair adheres to the tapered portion and can be withdrawn easily. The instrument addresses a practical problem of intraoperative handling of mature teratomas during laparoscopic surgery.

title: Laparoscopic removal of gonads containing on occult seminoma in a woman with complete androgen resistance.
title_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症の女性における、潜在性セミノーマを含む性腺の腹腔鏡下摘出
summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症(46,XY)の20歳女性に対し、性腺悪性腫瘍のリスクから予防的に腹腔鏡下性腺摘出を行った症例報告です。左性腺に8mmの潜在性セミノーマが見つかりました。術後の腫瘍マーカーは正常で、転移は認められませんでした。摘出時は回収バッグの使用を推奨しています。
summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with complete androgen resistance (46,XY) underwent prophylactic laparoscopic gonadectomy because of the increased risk of gonadal malignancy. Pathology revealed an occult 8-mm seminoma in the left gonad, along with Sertoli cell hamartomas and Müllerian remnants. Postoperative tumor markers were normal, and CT and chest radiographs showed no metastatic disease. The authors recommend using retrieval bags during removal to avoid dissemination of potentially malignant cells from occult tumors.

title: A new laparoscopic aspiration technique for ovarian dermoid cysts.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する新しい腹腔鏡下吸引法
summary_ja: 良性卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する新しい腹腔鏡下吸引法を紹介した報告です。切開を延長せず、ダグラス窩を開放せずに虚脱した嚢壁を除去できます。10例で良好な結果が得られ、嚢内容物の腹腔内への漏出はほとんどないか皆無でした。
summary_en: This brief report describes a new laparoscopic aspiration technique for benign ovarian dermoid cysts. The method allows removal of the collapsed cyst wall without extending laparoscopic incisions or opening the pouch of Douglas. One author used the technique in 10 patients with good effect and minimal or no spillage of cyst contents into the peritoneal cavity. It is presented as a practical approach for dermoid management that avoids enlarged incisions.

title: Laparoscopic Surgery During Pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠中の腹腔鏡手術
summary_ja: 急性骨盤痛と付属器腫瘤を有する妊娠中の2例に対し腹腔鏡手術を行った報告である。1例は大型の良性嚢胞性奇形腫、もう1例は傍卵管嚢胞に伴う卵管捻転であった。両例で嚢腫摘出術を行い、後者では卵管を温存した。適切な手技と悪性腫瘍の除外を前提に、妊娠中期における付属器腫瘤の腹腔鏡下摘出は実施可能と考察されている。
summary_en: This report describes two pregnant women with adnexal masses and acute pelvic pain who underwent operative laparoscopy during pregnancy. One had a large benign cystic teratoma and the other had fallopian tube torsion secondary to a paratubal cyst. Cystectomy was performed in both, and the tube was conserved in the second case. The authors conclude that, with proper technique and careful exclusion of malignancy, laparoscopy can be a feasible option for removing adnexal masses during the second trimester of pregnancy.

title: Laparoscopic Conservative Cystectomy of Ovarian Benign Cystic Teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡下保存的嚢腫摘出術
summary_ja: 生殖年齢の女性37例を対象に、4〜8cmの良性嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔内からの摘出法を2群で比較した前向き非ランダム化試験である。袋に入れて摘出した群は牽引法より摘出時間が有意に短く、内容物の漏出や創部合併症も少なかった。腹腔鏡手術は安全かつ有効で、袋を用いた摘出法が有利と結論づけている。
summary_en: This prospective non-randomized trial compared two methods of removing enucleated benign cystic teratomas (4 to 8 cm) laparoscopically in 37 reproductive-age women. Group A extracted cysts by traction through an extended incision, while group B placed cysts in a plastic bag for extraction through a trocar site. Bag extraction was markedly faster, with fewer spillage events and wound complications, and similar operating time and hospital stay. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is safe and effective and that bag extraction is preferable.

title: Laparoscopic Treatment of Benign Ovarian Dermoid Cysts.
title_ja: 良性卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡治療
summary_ja: 1992〜1993年に良性卵巣類皮嚢腫49個に腹腔鏡手術を行った44例を検討した。術前診断の多くは内診と経膣超音波検査で正しく得られた。大半の症例で卵巣が温存され、閉経後女性では付属器切除が行われた。検査した20例中11例でCA 19-9の上昇がみられたが、重篤な合併症はなかった。良性類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡治療は安全かつ有効と結論している。
summary_en: This study reviews 44 women who underwent laparoscopic surgery for 49 benign ovarian dermoid cysts in 1992 and 1993. The diagnosis was correct preoperatively in most cases by pelvic examination and vaginal ultrasound. Ovarian preservation was achieved in most patients, while postmenopausal women underwent adnexectomy. CA 19-9 was elevated in 11 of 20 patients tested. Complications were minor. The authors conclude that laparoscopic management of benign dermoid cysts is safe and effective.

title: Operative Laparoscopy for the Treatment of Ovarian Dermoids.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の治療における手術的腹腔鏡手術
summary_ja: 1991〜1993年にローマの9施設で、組織学的に良性嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された67例に手術的腹腔鏡手術を行った。92.5%は腹腔鏡下に完遂され、5例は開腹術へ移行した。大半は卵巣温存療法で、7例では卵巣摘出術が行われた。少なくとも3か月のフォローアップで再発例はなかった。類皮嚢腫に対し、手術的腹腔鏡手術は開腹術の有効な代替法と結論づけている。
summary_en: Sixty-seven patients with histologically confirmed benign cystic teratoma treated by operative laparoscopy at nine centers in Rome from 1991 to 1993 are reported. Laparoscopy was completed in 92.5% of cases, with five converted to laparotomy. Conservative surgery was performed in most patients, while ovariectomy was required in seven. No recurrences were observed in patients followed for at least 3 months. The authors conclude that operative laparoscopy is a valid alternative to laparotomy for dermoid cysts.

title: Mixed germ cell malignancy of the ovary concurrent with pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠中に併発した卵巣の混合型胚細胞悪性腫瘍
summary_ja: 18歳の妊婦が出生前スクリーニングで母体血清AFPの著明な上昇を指摘された。妊娠20.5週の病期分類目的の開腹術で、卵黄嚢腫瘍とGrade 3の未熟奇形腫からなる卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンの3コースを受け、第2コースまでにAFPは正常化した。健康な児が満期で出生した。著者らは、AFPの上昇が悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の徴候となりうると述べ、重大な胎児毒性はみられなかったとしている。
summary_en: An 18-year-old pregnant woman had markedly elevated maternal serum AFP detected during antenatal screening. Staging laparotomy at 20.5 weeks' gestation revealed a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary, comprising endodermal sinus tumor and grade 3 immature teratoma. She received three courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, with AFP normalizing by the second course. A healthy infant was delivered at term. The authors suggest that elevated AFP may signal malignant ovarian germ cell neoplasms, and no major fetal toxicity was seen.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome after chemotherapy for germ cell tumors of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後のgrowing teratoma syndrome
summary_ja: 化学療法後も残存または増大した卵巣腫瘤を有する20〜22歳の女性3例を報告する。治療前は全例が未熟奇形腫であった。腫瘍マーカーは終始正常で、切除された腫瘤には悪性成分のない成熟奇形腫が認められた。全例が診断後6〜31か月の時点で無病であった。化学療法後の増大は必ずしも悪性の進行を示さないが、閉塞などの合併症予防のため切除すべきと結論している。
summary_en: This report describes three women aged 20 to 22 years with persistent or growing masses after chemotherapy for ovarian germ cell malignancies, all of whom had immature teratomas before treatment. Tumor markers remained normal throughout, and resected masses contained mature teratoma without malignant elements. All patients were disease-free 6 to 31 months after diagnosis. The authors conclude that growth after chemotherapy does not necessarily indicate progression, especially with normal markers, but masses should be resected.

title: Differentiation-dependent expression of the BCL-2 proto-oncogene in the human trophoblast lineage.
title_ja: ヒト栄養膜細胞系譜におけるBCL-2原癌遺伝子の分化依存的発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常胎盤の各妊娠週数、胞状奇胎、原発性絨毛癌、JEG-3絨毛癌細胞におけるBCL-2発現を比較した研究である。BCL-2は正常胎盤の合胞体栄養膜細胞で最も強く、絨毛癌では弱かった。JEG-3細胞をcAMPで処理するとBCL-2は約2倍に上昇し、p53とは逆相関を示した。絨毛癌でのBCL-2発現の低さがアポトーシスへの感受性を高める可能性が考察されている。
summary_en: This study examines BCL-2 expression during trophoblast differentiation, comparing normal placenta at various gestational ages with hydatidiform moles, primary choriocarcinoma, and JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. BCL-2 was most prominent in the syncytiotrophoblast of normal placenta and was weak in choriocarcinoma. Cyclic AMP treatment of JEG-3 cells raised BCL-2 about twofold, and an inverse relation with p53 was observed. The authors propose that low BCL-2 in choriocarcinoma may make these cells more susceptible to apoptosis.

title: Mismanagement of choriocarcinoma due to a false low HCG measurement.
title_ja: hCGの偽低値測定により誤った管理となった絨毛癌の1例
summary_ja: 肺転移を伴う43歳女性の絨毛癌症例で、市販のhCG測定キットが高用量フック効果により偽低値を示し、診断が遅れた。不要な子宮摘出と肺生検が行われた経緯が報告されている。この分析上の問題の詳細と回避法が記述され、正確なhCG測定の重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old woman with extensive lung metastases from choriocarcinoma who underwent an unnecessary hysterectomy and lung biopsy. The diagnosis was delayed because a commercial hCG assay gave a falsely low result due to the high-dose hook effect. The authors describe this analytical phenomenon in detail and outline methods to avoid it. Accurate hCG measurement is essential for diagnosing and managing this potentially rapidly fatal but curable tumor.

title: Retrospective review of 41 patients with endodermal sinus tumor of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍41例の後方視的検討
summary_ja: 混合型を含む卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍41例を後方視的に検討した。全例が減量手術を受け、VACまたはPVBによる補助化学療法の有無は問わなかった。病期I・IIは5年・10年生存率が約80%と良好であったが、病期III・IVはほとんどが2年以内に死亡した。若年者には温存手術に続く化学療法が推奨されている。
summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 41 patients with ovarian endodermal sinus tumor, including pure tumors and those combined with dysgerminoma or immature teratoma. All were treated with cytoreductive surgery, with or without adjuvant VAC or PVB chemotherapy. Outcomes were favorable in stage I or II disease, with 5- and 10-year survival around 80%, whereas most stage III or IV patients died within two years. Aggressive surgery did not improve stage I outcomes, and postoperative chemotherapy was essential. Conservative surgery followed by chemotherapy is recommended for young patients.

title: Echo patterns of benign cystic teratomas by transvaginal ultrasound.
title_ja: 嚢胞性奇形腫の経腟超音波エコーパターン
summary_ja: 手術で確認された嚢胞性奇形腫39例の経腟超音波像を後方視的に検討した。純粋な嚢胞性から高エコー性まで6種類のエコーパターンが認められた。82%の腫瘍で高度の高エコー域がみられた。術前予測に有用な場合がある一方、悪性腫瘍との鑑別は困難とされている。
summary_en: This study retrospectively reviewed transvaginal ultrasound findings in 39 surgically confirmed cystic teratomas. Six distinct echo patterns were identified, ranging from purely cystic to densely echogenic. Dense echogenic areas were present in 82% of tumors. Although the sonographic appearance may allow accurate preoperative prediction, the variable patterns make it difficult to distinguish cystic teratomas from malignant tumors.

title: Gestational choriocarcinoma in norway, 1953-92 - an epidemiologic report.
title_ja: ノルウェーにおける妊娠性絨毛癌の疫学報告（1953〜1992年）
summary_ja: 1953〜1992年にノルウェーで報告された妊娠性絨毛癌115例を後方視的に検討した。発生率に時間的傾向はみられなかったが、病期分布と生存率は後期に改善した。5年生存率は57.9%から94.8%へ上昇した。病期が進むほど生存率は低下し、多変量解析で病期は有意な予後因子であった。
summary_en: This population-based retrospective study of 115 Norwegian patients with gestational choriocarcinoma spanned 1953 to 1992. Incidence showed no temporal trend, but stage distribution and survival improved in the later period. Five-year survival rose from 57.9% to 94.8% between the two periods. Survival declined with advancing FIGO stage, with 5-year rates of 93.5%, 80.0%, 64.1%, and 26.7% for stages I through IV. Stage was a significant prognostic factor on multivariate analysis, whereas age was not.

title: A comparative-analysis of the activity of retinoic Acid and cyclic-amp in the induction of differentiation of embryonal carcinoma-cells.
title_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の分化誘導におけるレチノイン酸とcAMPの比較解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、複数の胎児性癌(EC)細胞株に対し、レチノイン酸とcAMP上昇薬の分化誘導能を比較した。分化の程度はEndo A、コラーゲンIV、組織プラスミノゲン活性化因子などの段階特異的マーカーのmRNA量で評価された。cAMP上昇薬単独では完全な分化は得られなかった。細胞株ごとに反応は異なり、分化の程度はcAMP上昇薬の種類と評価したマーカーによって変化した。EC細胞の分化誘導剤への反応の不均一性が示された。
summary_en: This study compared retinoic acid (RA) and cAMP-elevating agents for inducing differentiation of several embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines. Differentiation was assessed by mRNA levels of stage-specific markers, including Endo A, collagen IV, and tissue plasminogen activator. cAMP-elevating agents alone could not achieve complete differentiation. The response differed among cell lines, and the degree of differentiation depended on both the type of cAMP-elevating agent and the marker examined. The results highlight heterogeneity in EC cell responses to differentiation-inducing agents.

title: Quantitation of human choriocarcinoma spheroid attachment to uterine epithelial cell monolayers.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛癌スフェロイドの子宮内膜上皮単層への接着の定量
journal: In Vitro Cell Dev Biol Anim
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: JAR絨毛癌多細胞スフェロイドのヒト子宮内膜上皮細胞単層への接着を定量するin vitroモデルを構築した。JAR細胞はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とプロゲステロンを分泌していた。遠心力による接着アッセイで、RL95-2への接着が最も強く、AN3-CAには接着しなかった。RL95-2では上皮細胞間への浸潤が24時間後も続いた。絨毛癌細胞の接着特性は子宮内膜細胞株ごとに異なり、着床の分子機構解析の基盤となる。
summary_en: This study established an in vitro model to quantify attachment of JAR human choriocarcinoma multicellular spheroids to human endometrial epithelial cell monolayers. JAR spheroids secreted hCG and progesterone. Attachment, measured with a centrifugal adhesion assay, was greatest for RL95-2 cells and intermediate for HEC-1A and KLE cells, and JAR spheroids did not attach to AN3-CA cells. At 5 hours, choriocarcinoma cells began to intrude between RL95-2 epithelial cells, and this penetration persisted at 24 hours only with RL95-2. The model reveals differences in adhesive properties among endometrial lines and may help study molecular interactions in implantation.

title: Adenohypophyseal tissue in an immature teratoma of the human ovary.
title_ja: ヒト卵巣未熟奇形腫内の腺下垂体組織
summary_ja: 31歳無症状女性の卵巣未熟奇形腫の症例報告で、改変Thurlbeck-Scully法によりgrade 2と判定された。腫瘍内の成熟神経組織の中に、中心動脈を伴う腺下垂体組織が認められた。免疫細胞化学では成長ホルモン、プロラクチン、ACTH、hCGのαサブユニットが陽性、TSH、FSH、LHは陰性だった。周囲組織では視床下部由来ペプチド等が陰性で、腺下垂体の発生はこれらのペプチドに依存しないと考察された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old asymptomatic woman with an ovarian immature teratoma, graded as grade 2 by the modified Thurlbeck-Scully system. The tumor contained adenohypophyseal tissue with a central arteriole, situated within mature neural tissue. Immunocytochemistry showed positive staining for growth hormone, prolactin, adrenocorticotropin, and alpha-subunit hCG, but not for TSH, FSH, or LH. Adjacent tissue lacked staining for several hypothalamic and posterior pituitary peptides, which the authors interpret as evidence that adenohypophyseal development is independent of these peptides.

title: The Activin A-Dependent Proliferation of PCC3/A/1 Embryonal Carcinoma Cells in Serum-Free Medium: (Activin/EC/ES cell/Follistatin/Serum-free medium/LIF).
title_ja: 無血清培地におけるPCC3/A/1胎児性癌細胞のアクチビンA依存性増殖
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞と胚性幹細胞の無血清培地での増殖要件を検討した。PCC3細胞はアクチビンAが無いと3日以内に崩壊し、増殖・生存に必要だった。P19、AT805、F9細胞は無血清でも増殖し、アクチビンAの影響は細胞株により異なった。白血病抑制因子を加えるとES細胞株とPSA-1細胞も増殖した。PCC3細胞はEC/ES細胞の増殖制御研究に有用な栄養要求変異体と考えられた。
summary_en: This study examined growth requirements of murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) and embryonic stem cells in serum-free medium. PCC3 EC cells required activin A to grow or survive; without it, they disintegrated within 3 days. P19 and AT805 cells grew without activin A, with slight facilitation by its addition, while F9 growth was somewhat inhibited by activin A. ES cell lines and PSA-1 EC cells grew in serum-free medium when leukemia inhibitory factor was added. The authors propose PCC3 cells as a nutritional mutant useful for studying growth regulation of EC and ES cells.

title: Activin Receptor Type II Gene Expression is Induced During Embryonic Development and Differentiation of Murine F9 Embryonal Carcinoma Cells: (activin receptor/development/endoderm/embryonal carcinoma cell/retinoic acid).
title_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞F9の胚発生および分化過程で誘導されるアクチビン受容体II型遺伝子発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス初期胚と胎児性癌細胞株F9におけるアクチビン受容体II型(ActR-II)遺伝子発現を解析した。ActR-IIは成熟卵子で発現し、2細胞期に低下後、外胚葉と内胚葉が形成される胚6日目で強く活性化された。F9細胞では、レチノイン酸が内胚葉分化の過程でActR-II mRNAを誘導し、その作用はタンパク質合成を必要とせず直接的だった。全トランス型レチノイン酸が9-シス型より有効だった。cAMPアナログは追加的な誘導を示さなかった。
summary_en: This study examined expression of the activin receptor type II (ActR-II) gene in pre- and post-implantation mouse embryos and in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, used as a model of embryonic development. ActR-II was expressed in mature oocytes, decreased at the two-cell stage, and was strongly activated by day 6, when ectoderm and endoderm form. Retinoic acid induced ActR-II mRNA during endodermal differentiation of F9 cells, directly and without new protein synthesis, with all-trans RA more effective than 9-cis RA. A cyclic AMP analogue did not further enhance expression. The authors conclude that activin signaling in mammalian development may be mediated by increased receptor expression.

title: Induction of germ-cell alkaline phosphatase by butyrate and cyclic AMP in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: 酪酸およびcAMPによるBeWo絨毛癌細胞における胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼの誘導
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞は2種類のアルカリホスファターゼを発現する。本研究は酪酸とcAMPによる胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼの誘導を、熱安定性の違いを利用して解析した。酪酸は96時間後に約35倍の活性誘導を示し、mRNAも増加させた。cAMP類は小さな誘導にとどまるが、併用で相乗効果が見られた。cAMPは酪酸とは異なる機序でmRNAレベルで制御すると考えられた。
summary_en: BeWo choriocarcinoma cells express two alkaline phosphatase isoenzymes. This study examined how sodium butyrate and cyclic AMP induce germ-cell alkaline phosphatase activity, using heat stability to distinguish isoenzymes. Butyrate induced activity about 35-fold after 96 hours and increased germ-cell alkaline phosphatase mRNA. Dibutyryl cAMP and other cAMP-elevating agents induced smaller increases, and combining butyrate with cAMP produced synergistic induction. The findings suggest that cAMP regulates this isoenzyme at the mRNA level through a mechanism distinct from butyrate.

title: Prognostic factors in metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の予後因子
summary_ja: 進行期の非セミノーマ性精巣がん33例を対象に、予後因子を診療録から後ろ向きに検討しました。3年全生存率は76%で、症状期間の長さ、初回治療不応、後腹膜の巨大病変、肺病変の大きさ、マーカーの持続高値が予後不良因子でした。
summary_en: This chart review of 33 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy assessed prognostic factors. The 3-year overall survival was 76%. Symptom duration over 16 weeks, poor initial response, bulky retroperitoneal disease, larger lung involvement, and persistently elevated beta-hCG or AFP after the second chemotherapy course all predicted poor outcome. Initial complete responders had a 93% survival rate. The authors conclude that these clinical and marker-based indicators identify patients with a poor prognosis.

title: Rectal adenocarcinoma with germ cell elements treated with chemotherapy.
title_ja: 胚細胞成分を伴う直腸腺癌の症例報告(化学療法施行例)
summary_ja: 胚細胞成分(卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌)を伴う直腸腺癌の症例報告で、文献上初めての報告とされています。AFPとhCGが著明に上昇し、肝転移に化学療法が行われましたが、治療開始1週間後に致死的な肝出血を来しました。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with rectal adenocarcinoma containing germ cell elements, specifically endodermal sinus tumor and choriocarcinoma, believed to be the first such case in the literature. Serum alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotropin were markedly elevated, and immunoperoxidase staining localized the markers to the neoplastic tissue. Extensive hepatic metastases developed and were treated with chemotherapy. One week after treatment began, a massive fatal hepatic hemorrhage occurred.

title: Gastric teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 胃奇形腫:症例報告
summary_ja: 生後4か月の男児に発生した胃奇形腫の症例報告です。出生時から腫瘤があり、急速な増大を機に受診しました。腫瘍は完全切除され、退院後も良好に経過していると推定されています。画像診断の進歩により、症状出現前の早期手術が可能になると述べられています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 4-month-old boy with gastric teratoma, a very rare and usually benign tumor of childhood. A mass was noted at birth, but the infant remained asymptomatic until rapid growth prompted hospital presentation. The tumor was successfully excised and the child remained well after discharge. The authors note that in industrialized countries, prenatal or early postnatal imaging facilitates diagnosis and earlier surgery before symptoms appear. The report underscores the value of early surgical management.

title: Chemotherapy of testicular cancer: 10-year experience.
title_ja: 精巣がんの化学療法：10年の経験
summary_ja: 1982～1992年に精巣胚細胞腫瘍250例へPVB療法を行った10年間の経験報告です。病期II、IV、IIIなど病期別に成績が検討されました。完全奏効率は69～93%で、再発は各群で数例にとどまりました。薬剤関連死は4%でした。
summary_en: This report summarizes a 10-year experience with PVB (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin) chemotherapy in 250 patients with germ cell testicular tumors treated from 1982 to 1992. Outcomes were stratified by clinical stage, including stage II patients receiving primary retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy and advanced stage III and IV patients receiving chemotherapy with surgical resection of residual metastases. Complete response rates ranged from 69 to 93 percent depending on stage, with relapses in a small number of patients per group. Drug-related deaths occurred in 4 percent of patients.

title: Cisplatin, vinblastine and bleocin in the treatment of disseminated testicular cancer.
title_ja: 播種性精巣がんの治療におけるシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン(PVB)療法
summary_ja: 1981～1989年に播種性精巣がんの病期IV 59例にPVB療法を行った報告です。完全寛解は58%、全奏効率は78%でした。セミノーマで最も良好な反応が得られ、5年生存率は全体で53%でした。予後不良群にはより強力な化学療法が必要と結論されています。
summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 59 patients with stage IV disseminated testicular cancer treated with at least five courses of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin (PVB) from 1981 to 1989. Histology included seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma and mixed tumors. Complete remission was achieved in 58 percent and the overall response rate was 78 percent. Seminoma patients had the best response. The 5-year survival was 53 percent overall, 88 percent for complete responders and 10 percent for partial responders. The authors conclude that poor-risk patients need more aggressive regimens.

title: New finding of Schinzel-Giedion syndrome: a case with a malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: Schinzel-Giedion症候群の新知見:悪性仙尾部奇形腫を伴う症例
summary_ja: Schinzel-Giedion症候群の男児に悪性の仙尾部奇形腫が生じた症例報告です。同症候群での悪性腫瘍は、肝芽腫に続き2例目とされます。まれな胎児性腫瘍が2種類みられたことから、悪性腫瘍のリスクが本症候群の特徴の一つである可能性が提起されています。
summary_en: This report describes a boy with Schinzel-Giedion syndrome who developed a malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma, a previously unreported association. The authors note this is only the second reported malignancy in this syndrome, after a hepatoblastoma in an earlier case. Because two uncommon embryonal tumors have now occurred in patients with this rare syndrome, the authors propose that malignancy risk may be an intrinsic component of Schinzel-Giedion syndrome. The report is brief and focuses on the clinical and genetic association.

title: [A case of stage IIIB2 infantile yolk sac tumor of testis achieved complete remission by "COMPE" chemotherapy].
title_ja: COMPE化学療法により完全寛解を得たStage IIIB2の乳児精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 23か月の乳児に発生した転移性精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例である。6か月後に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が再上昇し、単発性の肺転移が出現した。シスプラチンなどを含むCOMPE療法4コースで、AFPは正常化し肺転移も消失した。5年間無病で身体発育も正常であり、Stage III の乳児精巣がんにはシスプラチンを含む積極的な化学療法が有用と考えられると報告している。
summary_en: This report describes a 23-month-old boy with metastatic infantile yolk sac tumor of the testis. Serum AFP rose six months after orchiectomy and a solitary lung metastasis developed. After four courses of chemotherapy with cisplatin, vincristine, methotrexate, peplomycin and etoposide (COMPE), AFP normalized and the lung metastasis disappeared. He has remained disease-free for five years with normal growth, suggesting aggressive cisplatin-containing chemotherapy may be useful in stage III infantile testicular cancer.

title: Establishment and characterization of a rat yolk sac tumor cell line, NMT-1, producing alpha-fetoprotein, with potential for lymphatic metastasis.
title_ja: リンパ行性転移能を有するαフェトプロテイン産生ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株NMT-1の樹立と特性解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍から、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生する細胞株NMT-1を樹立し、その性状を解析した。細胞は単層で増殖し、倍加時間は約16時間であった。移植ではすべてのラットに腫瘍が生着し、リンパ行性転移を認めた。組織像と生物学的性状は原腫瘍を再現しており、転移研究のモデルとしての有用性が示された。
summary_en: The authors established NMT-1, a rat yolk sac tumor cell line producing alpha-fetoprotein, from a tumor in Wistar rats. The cells grew as an epithelioid monolayer with a doubling time of about 16 hours, and showed defined radiation sensitivity and cell-cycle distribution. Inoculation produced tumors in all rats with lymphatic metastases to several nodal basins and to liver, lung and kidney. The tumor reproduced the histology and behavior of the original, providing a model for studying metastasis.

title: Durable complete remission in a patient with refractory mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor after tandem high-dose chemotherapy and autologous bone marrow transplantation.
title_ja: タンデム大量化学療法と自家骨髄移植後に長期完全寛解を得た難治性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 初回化学療法および救援化学療法に抵抗性の原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例である。外科的切除と、タンデムの自家骨髄移植を行った後、初めて完全寛解に至った。初回移植から19か月後も無病状態を維持している。難治性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍で長期無病生存が得られた報告は少ないと述べている。
summary_en: This report describes a patient with primary mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor refractory to initial and salvage chemotherapy. After surgical resection and tandem autologous bone marrow transplantation, he achieved a first complete remission. Nineteen months after the first transplant he remained without evidence of disease. The authors note that long-term disease-free survival with currently available salvage regimens has not been reported in refractory mediastinal germ cell tumors, making this case notable.

title: Malignant benign neonatal sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 悪性の良性新生児仙尾部奇形腫
summary_ja: 1972年から1990年に治療された良性新生児仙尾部奇形腫36例を検討した。6例(22%)に再発を認め、うち3例は良性再発、3例は悪性再発であった。悪性再発は当初成熟良性と報告された腫瘍で、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に高値であった。全例で完全切除を含む集学的治療が行われた。組織学的に良性でも生後2年の間に再発しうるため、3年以上の厳重なフォローアップを推奨している。
summary_en: This series reviews 36 patients with benign neonatal sacrococcygeal teratoma treated between 1972 and 1990. Six patients (22%) had recurrence: three benign local recurrences and three malignant recurrences, the latter originally reported as mature benign tumors with markedly elevated serum AFP. All recurrences were treated with multimodal therapy including complete excision. The authors conclude the tumor, though histologically benign, can recur during the first two years of life and recommend at least three years of close follow-up.

title: Mediastinal teratomas: review of 15 pediatric cases.
title_ja: 小児縦隔奇形腫15例の検討
summary_ja: 1970年から1992年に1施設で経験した小児縦隔奇形腫15例を検討した。新生児6例を含み、多くは呼吸窮迫で発症し、術前の確定診断は得られなかった。組織学的には成熟2例、未熟成分を含むもの10例、悪性3例であった。新生児例はいずれも未熟奇形腫で、前縦隔腫瘍には正中胸骨切開が良好な視野を与えた。縦隔奇形腫は稀で術前診断が困難であると結論している。
summary_en: This review analyzes 15 children with mediastinal teratoma seen at one hospital between 1970 and 1992, including six newborns. Most presented with respiratory distress and none had a definite preoperative diagnosis. Histologically, two were mature, ten had immature elements and three were malignant; the malignant tumors occurred in patients over 12 years and all died within six months. All neonatal tumors were immature. Median sternotomy gave excellent exposure of anterior mediastinal tumors.

title: [A case of teratoma of the testis with retroperitoneal lymph nodes involved with malignant teratoma after chemotherapy].
title_ja: 化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節の悪性奇形腫を生じた精巣奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 18歳男性の精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌・奇形腫・卵黄嚢腫瘍)の症例である。化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節切除で成熟奇形腫を認め、その後6か月で後腹膜腫瘤が出現した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清により、腸型腺癌への悪性転化を伴う奇形腫と診断された。補助化学療法としてEAP療法を施行し、21か月無再発で生存している。
summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old man with a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis (embryonal carcinoma, teratoma and yolk sac tumor). A retroperitoneal lymph node resected after chemotherapy showed mature teratoma. Six months after further chemotherapy a retroperitoneal mass appeared, and dissection revealed teratoma with malignant transformation to enteric adenocarcinoma. Adjuvant EAP chemotherapy was given and the patient remained alive without recurrence for 21 months. Flow cytometry showed aneuploidy in all tumor components.

title: Immunohistochemical comparison between anaplastic seminoma and typical seminoma.
title_ja: 未分化型セミノーマと典型的セミノーマの免疫組織化学的比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 未分化型セミノーマ11例と典型的セミノーマ15例を比較した。核分裂像の数と割合は強く相関し、PCNA標識率とも相関した。サイトケラチン、ビメンチン、PLAP、β-hCG、AFP、c-mycの免疫染色パターンは両群で有意差がなく、未分化型は増殖活性の高いセミノーマである可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study compared 11 anaplastic seminomas with 15 typical seminomas. Mitotic count and mitotic rate correlated strongly, and both correlated with the PCNA labeling index. Immunostaining for cytokeratin, vimentin, PLAP, beta-hCG, AFP, and c-myc did not differ significantly between the two groups. No immunohistochemical or clinicopathologic parameter reliably distinguished anaplastic from typical seminoma, suggesting that anaplastic seminoma may simply be seminoma with high proliferative activity.

title: Morphological analysis of yolk sac tumor.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍の形態学的解析
summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍7例の印象標本による組織学的・細胞学的所見を解析した。組織像は4型に分類され、内胚葉洞型が最も多かった。細胞像では立方状細胞が最も多く、次いで紡錘形細胞が認められた。紡錘形細胞の由来についても考察され、凍結標本の印象細胞診は術中迅速診断に有用とされた。
summary_en: Imprint histology and cytology were analyzed in seven patients with yolk sac tumor. Histologic patterns were classified into four types, with the endodermal sinus pattern most common, followed by the polyvesicular vitelline pattern. Cytology showed four patterns, with cuboidal cells most frequent and spindle-shaped cells next. The authors proposed possible origins for these cell types. They concluded that imprint cytology of rapidly frozen specimens is sufficient for intraoperative rapid diagnosis.

title: Molecular cytogenetic analysis of i(12p)-negative human male germ cell tumors.
title_ja: i(12p)陰性男性胚細胞腫瘍の分子細胞遺伝学的解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍202例のうち、i(12p)陰性の26例の核型を解析した。12p13の再構成は陰性例の35%に認められ、陽性例では3%であった。両群とも12p由来コピー数の増加がみられ、胚細胞腫瘍の発生に重要な異常と考えられた。
summary_en: Karyotypes of 26 i(12p)-negative male germ cell tumors, selected from 202 cases, were analyzed. Nonrandom rearrangements most often involved 12p13, seen in 35% of i(12p)-negative tumors versus 3% of i(12p)-positive tumors. Chromosome 12 painting revealed extra 12p segments in marker chromosomes. Both groups showed increased 12p copy number without clinical or biological differences, suggesting that increased 12p copy number is a specific and important aberration in germ cell tumor development.

title: Maxillary extragonadal germ cell tumor: a case report.
title_ja: 上顎性腺外胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 上顎に原発した性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児症例を報告した。ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、エトポシドによる併用化学療法で完全寛解が得られ、3年後も無病で経過している。頭頸部の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍でも、標準的な化学療法が有効であることを示す症例である。
summary_en: A child with primary extragonadal yolk sac tumor of the maxilla was reported. The patient received combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, cisplatin, and etoposide and achieved complete remission. The patient has remained disease free for three years. The case shows that extragonadal germ cell tumors can arise in the head and neck region and respond to standard germ cell tumor chemotherapy.

title: Hurricane growth of malignant trophoblastic teratoma.
title_ja: 悪性トロホブラスト性奇形腫のハリケーン様増大
summary_ja: 27歳男性が喀血と肺陰影の急速な増大で受診した。原発の精巣がんは自然退縮していたが、hCG産生性の精巣がんの肺転移と判明した。治療前に呼吸不全となり、治療開始48時間後に死亡した。尿妊娠検査が早期診断に有用であることが強調されている。
summary_en: A 27-year-old man presented with haemoptysis and lung shadowing that enlarged dramatically over three weeks. He was found to have pulmonary metastases from chorionic gonadotropin-producing testicular cancer whose primary tumor had regressed spontaneously. He developed respiratory failure before treatment and died 48 hours after treatment began. The authors emphasize that the urinary pregnancy test can accelerate diagnosis and treatment in such cases.

title: Secondary leukemia associated with a conventional dose of etoposide: review of serial germ cell tumor protocols.
title_ja: 従来量エトポシドによる二次性白血病：胚細胞腫瘍の連続試験のレビュー
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の連続臨床試験538例を見直した。従来量のエトポシド併用化学療法を受けた患者のうち2例(0.37%)に二次性白血病が生じた。発生率は低く、治療の利益は危険性を上回るが、慎重なフォローアップが必要とされる。
summary_en: This review of serial germ cell tumor trials included 538 patients who received conventional-dose etoposide (cumulative 1500 to 2000 mg/m2) with cisplatin plus ifosfamide or bleomycin. Two patients (0.37%) developed secondary leukemia, and additional hematologic abnormalities were noted in patients treated outside trials. The authors conclude that the risk is low and does not change the risk-benefit ratio of etoposide-based chemotherapy, but careful follow-up is needed.

title: Changes in expression of differentiation markers between normal ovarian cells and derived tumors.
title_ja: 正常卵巣細胞と由来腫瘍における分化マーカー発現の変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 51種類のモノクローナル抗体を用い、正常卵巣18例と卵巣腫瘍138例のマーカー発現を比較した研究です。TAG-72は胚細胞腫瘍を性索腫瘍や漿液性腫瘍から区別するのに有用でした。卵巣癌関連抗原は、卵黄嚢腫瘍を除く胚細胞腫瘍ではほとんど発現していませんでした。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared 51 monoclonal antibody markers across 18 normal ovarian samples and 138 ovarian tumors, including germ cell tumors. Vimentin and simple keratins were common, while TAG-72 distinguished germ cell tumors and carcinomas from gonadal and serous tumors. Ovarian carcinoma-associated antigens were largely absent from germ cell tumors except endodermal sinus tumors. HLA-I was broadly expressed, and HLA-DR was heterogeneous in epithelial tumors. These markers help differentiate ovarian tumor types diagnostically.

title: Early detection of relapse after treatment for metastatic germ cell tumour of the testis: an exercise in medical audit.
title_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療後の再発の早期発見：医療監査の一例
summary_ja: 本監査では、転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に再発した29例（セミノーマ7例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍22例）を解析した。血清のhCGとAFPの測定が最も重要なフォローアップ手段で、患者の55%で再発の最初の指標となった。胸部X線はほとんど有用でなく、CTは24%で最初の異常所見となった。再発1例の検出費用は、集中的フォローアップで約4,500ポンド、定期的CTでは約12,880ポンドであった。
summary_en: This audit analyzed 29 patients who relapsed after treatment for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, including 7 seminomas and 22 nonseminomatous tumors. Serum hCG and AFP estimation was the most important follow-up tool, first indicating relapse in 55% of patients, while chest radiographs rarely helped. CT of the chest and abdomen was the first abnormal investigation in 24% and was especially useful in patients with residual abnormalities. Intensive follow-up cost about 4,500 pounds per relapse detected, and regular CT cost about 12,880 pounds per relapse detected.

title: Sequential trials of cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin and etoposide and cisplatin in disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis with a good prognosis at a single institution.
title_ja: 単一施設における予後良好な播種性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法とエトポシド・シスプラチン療法の逐次試験
summary_ja: 予後良好な播種性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、EP療法とPVB療法を後方視的に比較した単一施設研究です。完全奏効率はEPが91%、PVBが100%で、全生存期間は同程度でした。再発はEP群5例、PVB群1例で、PVB群の無再発生存期間が高い傾向を示しました。初回治療でのブレオマイシン省略は慎重に行うべきと結論づけています。
summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study compared etoposide plus cisplatin (EP) with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB) in patients with good-prognosis disseminated testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Complete response rates were 91% with EP and 100% with PVB, and overall survival was similar. Relapses occurred in five EP patients and one PVB patient, and recurrence-free survival tended to be higher with PVB (P = 0.054). Pulmonary and cutaneous toxicity occurred only with PVB. The authors caution against omitting bleomycin in first-line therapy.

title: Reduced dose PVB treatment of stage IIC-IV testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 進行期(IIC～IV期)精巣セミノーマに対する減量PVB療法
summary_ja: 進行期(IIC～IV期)の精巣セミノーマ36例に減量PVB療法を行った研究です。完全寛解は33例中32例(96.9%)で、観察期間中に再発例はありませんでした。事前に放射線療法を受けた患者も15例含まれていました。進行精巣セミノーマの初回治療として安全で有効と結論づけています。
summary_en: This Turkish study treated 36 patients with stage IIC-IV testicular seminoma using reduced-dose PVB chemotherapy. Most had typical seminoma, and hCG was elevated in 19 patients. Fifteen had received prior radiotherapy. Of the 33 patients who completed treatment, 32 (96.9%) achieved complete remission, and no relapse occurred during follow-up. The authors conclude that reduced-dose PVB can be a safe and successful primary treatment for advanced testicular seminoma.

title: Retinoic acid-induced differentiation of the developmentally pluripotent human germ cell tumor-derived cell line, NCCIT.
title_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍由来の発生多能性ヒト細胞株NCCITのレチノイン酸による分化誘導
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍由来の多能性細胞株NCCITを解析した研究です。セミノーマと胎児性癌の混合的な特徴を示し、hCGとAFPを産生します。レチノイン酸処理で増殖が抑制され、体細胞系譜へ分化しました。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍の関係を研究するモデルとして有用と提案しています。
summary_en: This study characterized NCCIT, a developmentally pluripotent human cell line derived from a mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, with hybrid seminoma and embryonal carcinoma features. The cells produce hCG and AFP and are hyperdiploid with structural aberrations. Retinoic acid inhibited growth and induced differentiation into keratin-, GFAP-, and neurofilament-positive somatic cells, with loss of stem cell markers. The authors propose NCCIT as a model for studying the relationship between seminoma and nonseminomatous tumors.

title: Teratoma associated with endodermal sinus tumor.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍に伴う奇形腫
summary_ja: 3歳半の女児に生じた縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍(肺・骨・肺門リンパ節転移あり)の症例報告です。7か月の化学療法後に上行大動脈由来の残存腫瘤が認められ、切除したところ心膜内の良性嚢胞性奇形腫と判明しました。心膜内奇形腫と縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の併存は極めて稀とされ、その病因が考察されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 3.5-year-old girl with a mediastinal endodermal sinus tumor with pulmonary, bone, and hilar lymph node metastases. After seven months of chemotherapy, CT showed a residual mass arising from the ascending aorta. Surgical resection revealed a benign cystic teratoma within the pericardium. The authors note that this combination of intrapericardial teratoma and mediastinal endodermal sinus tumor is probably unique, and discuss its possible etiology.

title: Modulation of fibroblast growth factor receptor expression and signalling during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of Tera-2 teratocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: レチノイン酸誘導によるTera-2奇形癌細胞の分化における線維芽細胞増殖因子受容体の発現とシグナル伝達の調節
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究はヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera-2をレチノイン酸で分化誘導した際のFGF受容体(FGFR)発現とシグナル伝達の変化を検討した。未分化細胞は4種類すべてのFGFRを発現するが、分化によりFGFR-4は消失し、FGFR-2とFGFR-3は低下した。K-FGFの結合も著明に減少し、FGF刺激による遺伝子発現応答も分化後に変化した。
summary_en: This study examines how fibroblast growth factor receptor (FGFR) expression and FGF-induced signaling change when Tera-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells are differentiated with retinoic acid. Undifferentiated cells express all four FGFRs. Differentiation abolishes FGFR-4 mRNA and reduces FGFR-2 and FGFR-3, while FGFR-1 remains unchanged. Binding of K-FGF decreases substantially. FGF-stimulated expression of c-fos, c-jun, and junB also shifts after differentiation, indicating altered growth-factor responses.

title: Fibroblast growth factor-mediated growth regulation and receptor expression in embryonal carcinoma and embryonic stem cells and human germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 胎児性癌細胞、胚性幹細胞およびヒト胚細胞腫瘍における線維芽細胞増殖因子を介した増殖調節と受容体発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウスおよびヒトの胎児性癌細胞、マウス胚性幹細胞、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、FGF受容体の発現とFGFによる増殖調節を比較した。マウス胚性幹細胞の分化ではFGFR1〜3が増加し、ヒト胎児性癌細胞ではFGFR2が低下しFGFR4が維持された。血清非含有培地で、aFGF・bFGF・kFGFは増殖を促進したが、KGFは増殖に影響しなかった。ヘパリンの作用には種差が認められた。
summary_en: This study compares fibroblast growth factor (FGF) receptor expression and FGF-driven growth in mouse and human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, mouse embryonic stem (ES) cells, and human germ cell tumours. In mouse ES cells, FGFR1-3 are upregulated during differentiation, whereas in human EC cells FGFR2 declines and FGFR4 persists. Acidic FGF, basic FGF, and K-FGF stimulate growth in serum-free medium, while KGF does not affect growth. Heparin effects differ between human and mouse cells.

title: No germline TP53 mutations detected in familial and bilateral testicular cancer.
title_ja: 家族性および両側性精巣がんにおける生殖細胞系列TP53変異は検出されず
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究では、両側性または家族性の胚細胞腫瘍患者32例と孤発例2例について、生殖細胞系列のTP53変異を調べた。腫瘍15例では体細胞変異とヘテロ接合性の消失(LOH)を解析し、12例では免疫組織化学によりTP53タンパク質を評価した。生殖細胞系列および体細胞のTP53変異は検出されなかった。解析可能な5例中1例でLOHが認められ、TP53タンパク質の増加を示す腫瘍はなかった。著者らは、TP53の変化がGCTの素因や発症に寄与する可能性は低いと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study screened 32 patients with bilateral or familial germ cell tumors and two with sporadic tumors for germline TP53 mutations. Fifteen tumors were analyzed for somatic mutations and loss of heterozygosity (LOH), and twelve were assessed for TP53 protein by immunohistochemistry. No germline or somatic TP53 mutations were detected. LOH occurred in one of five informative cases, and no tumors showed increased TP53 expression. The authors conclude that TP53 alterations are unlikely to contribute to GCT predisposition or development.

title: Cervical teratoma in later infancy: report of 13 cases.
title_ja: 乳児後期における頸部奇形腫13例
summary_ja: 19年間に治療された頸部奇形腫の乳児13例を後方視的に検討した。新生児3例は気道閉塞のため緊急手術を要し、他の10例は準緊急手術を受けた。術後に副甲状腺機能低下症と甲状腺機能低下症を合併した1例では補充療法を要した。手術死亡はなかったが、全例が経過の途中でフォローアップから脱落した。早期手術により二次的な悪性転化を回避できるとされる。
summary_en: A retrospective review of 13 infants with cervical teratomas treated over 19 years. Three neonates with airway obstruction required emergency surgery, and ten others underwent urgent operation. One patient developed postoperative hypoparathyroidism and hypothyroidism requiring replacement. No surgical deaths occurred, but all patients were lost to follow-up after a time. The authors note that early operation prevents secondary malignant transformation of these mostly benign teratomas.

title: [A case of testicular choriocarcinoma achieving pathological complete response by "COMPE" chemotherapy, consisting of cisplatin, vincristine, methotrexate, peplomycin, and etoposide].
title_ja: 「COMPE」化学療法により病理学的完全奏効を得た精巣絨毛癌の1例
summary_ja: 27歳男性の左精巣純粋型絨毛癌の症例で、精巣摘除術後に肺および傍大動脈リンパ節への転移を認めた。PVB療法4コース後に肺病変は41.9%縮小した。その後COMPE化学療法7コースで部分奏効を得た。残存病変は切除され、壊死と黄色肉芽腫性線維化が確認された。1年後も明らかな病変を認めなかった。
summary_en: A 27-year-old man with pure choriocarcinoma of the left testis, found after orchiectomy, had pulmonary and para-aortic lymph node metastases. After four PVB courses, pulmonary lesions regressed by 41.9%. Subsequent COMPE chemotherapy (cisplatin, vincristine, methotrexate, peplomycin, etoposide) produced a partial response after seven courses. Residual lung and retroperitoneal masses were resected, showing necrosis and xanthogranulomatous fibrosis, with no evidence of disease one year later.

title: Testicular cancer and Hodgkin disease in the same patient.
title_ja: 精巣がんとホジキン病が同一患者に発生した症例
summary_ja: ホジキン病の放射線療法後に精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を異時性に発症した例と、ホジキン病と同時に発症した例を報告。前者はシスプラチン併用化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に8年間寛解、後者は化学療法後14か月無病生存。若年男性では両方の悪性腫瘍を念頭に置くべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes two men with testicular cancer and Hodgkin disease. One developed metachronous nonseminomatous germ cell tumor two years after radiotherapy for Hodgkin disease. The other had synchronous disease with elevated AFP and hCG. The metachronous patient received five cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy and remained in remission for 8 years. The synchronous patient received cisplatin, etoposide, and doxorubicin and was disease-free at 14 months. The authors advise considering both malignancies in young men with atypical disease distribution.

title: Malignant germ cell tumours in two siblings.
title_ja: 2例の姉妹に発生した悪性胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 染色体が正常な姉妹2例が4か月の間に相次いで卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍を発症した。一方はディスジャーミノーマ、他方は絨毛癌成分が目立つ混合性腫瘍であった。性腺異形成を伴わない家族性発症は稀であり、家族歴の聴取の重要性を示唆している。
summary_en: This report describes two sisters with normal female karyotypes who developed malignant ovarian germ cell tumors within a four-month period. One had a dysgerminoma and the other a mixed tumor with prominent choriocarcinomatous elements. Familial germ cell tumors are typically linked to gonadal dysgenesis, so occurrence in sisters with normal chromosomes is rare. The case suggests that familial clustering of ovarian germ cell tumors can occur without karyotypic abnormality, and it underlines the value of taking a family history.

title: Differentiation antigens of human germ cell tumours: distribution of carbohydrate epitopes on glycolipids and glycoproteins analyzed using PDMP, an inhibitor of glycolipid synthesis.
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の分化抗原：PDMPを用いた糖脂質および糖タンパク質上の炭水化物エピトープ分布
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍由来の胎児性癌細胞の表面炭水化物抗原が、糖脂質と糖タンパク質のどちらに存在するかをPDMPで検討。PDMPは糖脂質抗原のみを抑制し、分化したヒト胎児性癌細胞ではSSEA1の免疫優位な形態を糖タンパク質が担うことが示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined carbohydrate antigens on human and mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, using PDMP, an inhibitor of glucosylceramide synthase, to determine whether they reside on glycolipids or glycoproteins. PDMP suppressed glycolipid antigens but not glycoprotein antigens. SSEA1 was expressed on both glycolipids and glycoproteins. PDMP resistance suggested that glycoproteins carry the immunodominant form of SSEA1 on the surface of differentiated human EC cells. The findings clarify the distribution of surface differentiation antigens in human germ cell tumor cells.

title: Cortical blindness and seizures possibly related to cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin treatment of ovarian dysgerminoma.
title_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の化学療法後に生じた皮質盲と痙攣の関連が疑われた症例
summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫にシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法を行った症例で、一過性の皮質盲と痙攣が生じた。若年女性では妊孕能温存を考慮した保存的治療が適応となり、化学療法の毒性と利益の比較が重要と指摘している。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with ovarian dysgerminoma treated with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin, who developed transient cortical blindness and seizures that may have been related to the chemotherapy. The authors note that ovarian dysgerminoma is the most common ovarian malignancy in young women and that conservative treatment is appropriate for women who wish to preserve fertility. They argue that the survival benefit of modern regimens must be weighed against serious toxicity.

title: Inhibitory effect of angiogenesis inhibitor TNP-470 on tumor growth and metastasis of human cell lines in vitro and in vivo.
title_ja: 絨毛癌由来ヒト腫瘍細胞株の増殖および転移に対する血管新生阻害剤TNP-470の抑制効果
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 血管新生阻害剤TNP-470を絨毛癌細胞株などの培養細胞とヌードマウスで評価。絨毛癌細胞株は卵巣癌や子宮内膜癌の細胞株より低濃度で増殖が抑制された。GCH-1(m)細胞では30 mg/kgで肺転移が強く抑制され、転移治療への応用が期待されると結論づけた。
summary_en: This study evaluated the angiogenesis inhibitor TNP-470 in eight human cell lines, including three choriocarcinoma lines, and in nude mice. All lines showed growth inhibition, and the choriocarcinoma lines were far more sensitive than ovarian and endometrial cancer lines. In vivo, TNP-470 suppressed growth of GCH-1(m) and NUC-1 tumors. At 30 mg/kg it markedly reduced lung metastasis of GCH-1(m) cells and decreased tumor capillary growth. The authors suggest TNP-470 may be a promising treatment for metastasis.

title: Long term results of treatment in patients with extragonadal germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者の治療長期成績
summary_ja: 1979年から1991年に性腺外胚細胞腫瘍56例にシスプラチン併用化学療法を施行した長期成績の報告である。セミノーマ例の完全寛解率は94%、非セミノーマ例は37%であった。BEP療法はVAB-6より優れ、マーカー高値は予後不良因子であった。現行の病期分類では治療成績を十分予測できないと結論している。
summary_en: This 1979–1991 series of 56 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy reports long-term outcomes. Complete remission rates were 94% for seminomatous and 37% for nonseminomatous tumors. Seminomatous histology predicted better response, and BEP induction outperformed VAB-6. Nonseminomatous patients with marker levels above 2000 ng/ml had worse prognosis. The authors conclude that current staging systems poorly predict treatment outcome.

title: Modulation of phosphatidylserine epitope expression by BeWo cells during forskolin treatment.
title_ja: フォルスコリン処理中のBeWo細胞によるホスファチジルセリン・エピトープ発現の変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌株BeWo細胞をフォルスコリンで分化・融合させた際の、ホスファチジルセリン抗原の発現変化を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。治療前後で反応するエピトープが変化し、栄養膜細胞の分化に関与する可能性が示された。絨毛癌細胞株を用いた研究である。
summary_en: The authors examined phosphatidylserine epitope expression in the human choriocarcinoma line BeWo during forskolin-induced differentiation and fusion. Untreated cells expressed one PS epitope strongly, and forskolin shifted reactivity toward a second PS-reactive antibody epitope. A cardiolipin-type antibody did not bind. The findings suggest altered PS expression may be critical for cytotrophoblast differentiation and placental development, with implications for pregnancy loss.

title: Decreased expression of epidermal growth factor and its receptor in the malignant transformation of trophoblasts.
title_ja: 栄養膜細胞の悪性転化におけるEGFおよびEGF受容体発現の低下
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の組織でEGFおよびEGF受容体の発現を免疫組織化学で比較した研究である。良性から悪性へ進むにつれて発現は低下し、侵入奇胎はその中間を示した。EGFは自己分泌・傍分泌的に作用し、その発現低下が栄養膜細胞の悪性転化に関与する可能性が示された。
summary_en: Immunoperoxidase staining compared EGF and EGF receptor expression across hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma tissues. Most moles stained intensely, most choriocarcinomas weakly, and invasive moles were intermediate. Expression decreased with progression from benign to malignant trophoblastic disease. The authors suggest EGF acts in an autocrine-paracrine manner, and that reduced EGF signaling accompanies the malignant transformation of trophoblasts.

title: [A case of advanced mediastinal choriocarcinoma showing complete remission for two years by high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation].
title_ja: 大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植により2年間完全寛解を維持した進行縦隔絨毛癌の1例
summary_ja: 縦隔原発の進行絨毛癌の26歳男性に対し、PVeBV療法で完全寛解を得た後、末梢血幹細胞移植を併用した大量化学療法を施行した症例報告である。造血回復は速やかで、24か月間再発を認めなかった。進行絨毛癌に対する本治療法の有用性が示唆される。
summary_en: A 26-year-old man with advanced mediastinal choriocarcinoma with cervical, mediastinal, and bilateral lung metastases achieved complete remission after three courses of PVeBV chemotherapy. Because recurrence risk was high, peripheral blood stem cells were collected and high-dose chemotherapy with PBSC transplantation was given. Hematopoietic recovery was rapid, and the patient remained free of recurrence for 24 months. The case shows the potential of this approach for advanced choriocarcinoma.

title: Chromosome 12-containing markers, including two dicentrics, in three i(12p)-negative testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 3例の i(12p)陰性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における、二動原体染色体を含む第12染色体由来マーカー
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: i(12p)を欠く精巣胚細胞腫瘍3例において、第12染色体由来のマーカー染色体を検討した。2例では、アクロセントリック染色体(13番または14番)の着糸点を含む部分が12p上に転座した二動原体染色体が見られた。3例目でも13qが同様の再構成に関与したと考えられた。12p上の遺伝子増幅が胚細胞腫瘍の発生における重要な段階であることを示唆する所見である。
summary_en: This study examined chromosome 12-derived markers in three testicular germ cell tumors lacking i(12p). Two markers were dicentric chromosomes in which the centromere-containing part of an acrocentric chromosome (13 or 14) had translocated onto 12p. In the third tumor, 13q was probably involved in a similar rearrangement. The findings suggest that amplification of genes on 12p is a significant step in germ cell tumor development.

title: Post-orchiectomy radiotherapy for stages I and II testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 病期I・II精巣セミノーマに対する精巣摘除術後放射線療法
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1960～1991年に病期I・IIの精巣セミノーマ350例が精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を受けた。1984年の方針変更前後で比較した。5年無再発率は病期I 97%、病期IIA 87%だった。病期IIAでは左鎖骨上窩への再発が目立ち、予防的照射の必要性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study compared outcomes of 350 patients with stage I or II testicular seminoma who received post-orchiectomy radiation at M.D. Anderson between 1960 and 1991, before and after 1984 policy changes.
