The report highlights that cardiac involvement should be considered in patients with late relapse of testicular cancer.

title: Immature teratomas of different origin carried by a pregnant mother and her fetus.
title_ja: 母体と胎児がそれぞれ保有した異なる起源の未熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 妊娠中の母親と胎児がそれぞれ未熟奇形腫を有していた症例です。胎児は妊娠38週で頭蓋内の未熟奇形腫と診断され、母親は帝王切開時に卵巣の未熟奇形腫が認められました。多型性DNAサテライト配列を用いたPCR解析により、両腫瘍は独立に発生したことが示されました。また両者ともp53遺伝子の遺伝性変異は認められず、母子で同時に独立した悪性未熟奇形腫が生じた初めての報告とされています。
summary_en: This report describes a pregnant woman and her fetus who both had immature teratomas during pregnancy. The fetus had an intracranial immature teratoma diagnosed at 38 weeks, and the mother had an ovarian immature teratoma found at cesarean delivery. PCR analysis of polymorphic DNA satellite sequences showed that the two tumors arose independently, and no inherited p53 mutation was detected. The authors describe this as the first report of simultaneous independent malignant immature teratomas in a mother and child during pregnancy.

title: Thoracic surgery of testicular cancer patients.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者の胸部外科治療
summary_ja: 1980年から1991年に治療を受けた精巣悪性腫瘍患者1,450例のうち、ステージIIIの非セミノーマ性精巣がん42例を対象とした研究です。化学療法後も残存または進行した病変に対し、延べ44回の胸部外科手術が行われ、43例で切除に成功しました。術後早期の死亡は2例でした。適切な適応を選べば胸部外科治療は妥当であり、転移巣切除術は治療の改善につながる可能性があると結論づけています。
summary_en: This single-institution review covers 1,450 patients with malignant testicular tumours treated from 1980 to 1991. It focuses on 42 patients with stage III non-seminoma germ cell testicular cancer who underwent 44 thoracic surgical interventions for residual or progressive disease after combined chemotherapy. Successful resection was achieved in 43 cases, with two early postoperative deaths. Of 40 patients followed for 4 to 130 months, 31 were alive at last follow-up. The authors conclude that thoracic surgery is justified in appropriately selected patients and that metastasectomy may improve management.

title: Bilateral germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の両側性胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 1977年から1993年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍530例を後方視的に検討した研究です。両側性の精巣腫瘍は12例(2.26%)で、2例は同時に発生し、10例は初回の精巣摘除術後5.25年(範囲3〜13.5年)で対側に腫瘍が出現しました。両精巣の組織型が異なる場合があることから、既往治療を考慮した個別化治療の必要性を強調しています。両側精巣摘除後のホルモン補充や精巣人工物挿入の可能性にも言及しています。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 530 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated between 1977 and 1993. Twelve patients (2.26%) had bilateral testicular tumors. Two had simultaneous bilateral tumors with different histologic types, and ten developed a contralateral tumor 5.25 years (range 3-13.5) after orchiectomy for the first. The authors emphasize histologic variability between the testes, the need for individualized therapy considering prior treatment, and the implications of bilateral orchiectomy, including hormone replacement and testicular prosthesis.

title: Cerebral metastasis from choriocarcinoma and oncotic aneurysms. Case report.
title_ja: 絨毛癌からの脳転移と腫瘍性動脈瘤：症例報告
summary_ja: 絨毛癌の脳転移に伴い腫瘍性動脈瘤を生じた症例報告で、脳血管造影で確認されました。絨毛癌では10〜20%に脳転移が起こるとされ、この報告は12例目にあたります。妊娠可能年齢の女性で脳出血や占拠性病変が生じた場合は本疾患を考慮すべきと強調しています。検査所見や画像所見に加え、化学療法、外科的治療、放射線療法の選択についても論じています。
summary_en: This case report describes the twelfth reported patient with cerebral metastasis from choriocarcinoma who developed oncotic aneurysms, confirmed by cerebral angiography. The authors emphasize that intracerebral hemorrhage or a mass lesion in a woman of childbearing age should prompt consideration of this diagnosis. Laboratory and radiological features are discussed, along with therapeutic options including chemotherapy, surgery and irradiation. Cerebral metastases occur in 10 to 20% of patients with choriocarcinoma.

title: Documentation of complete resolution of gestational choriocarcinoma in the oophorectomized patient.
title_ja: 卵巣摘出患者における妊娠性絨毛癌の完全消失の記録
summary_ja: 肺および子宮傍組織に転移した絨毛癌の39歳女性の症例です。子宮全摘・両側卵管卵巣摘出後の化学療法でhCG値は9 mIU/mlで横ばいとなりました。LH交差反応を補正すると定量hCGはゼロとなり、化学療法を中止しました。卵巣摘出後に低値のhCGが持続する場合は、LHの交差反応を除外すべきと結論しています。
summary_en: A 39-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma metastatic to the lungs and parametrium had hCG levels plateau at 9 mIU/ml after hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and chemotherapy. Cerebrospinal fluid hCG was negative. Serum LH measured 135 mIU/ml, causing cross-reactivity in the hCG assay. After correction for LH, quantitative hCG was zero, and chemotherapy was stopped. At 12 months, she remained in complete remission. The authors recommend ruling out LH cross-reactivity when evaluating persistent low hCG titers after oophorectomy.

title: Benign cystic teratoma of mesentery.
title_ja: 腸間膜の良性嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 10歳の女児に発生した腸間膜原発の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。良性嚢胞性奇形腫は性腺に最も多い胚細胞腫瘍ですが、性腺外での発生は稀で、腸間膜発生はさらに極めて稀とされています。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍としての発生部位の珍しさを示す報告です。
summary_en: A 10-year-old girl presented with a primary benign cystic teratoma arising in the mesentery. The authors note that benign cystic teratomas are the most common germ cell tumors of the gonads but are rare at extragonadal sites, and very rare in the mesentery. This case report documents a mesenteric teratoma in a child, highlighting its unusual location as an extragonadal germ cell tumor. Clinical details beyond the abstract are not provided here.

title: Metachronous bilateral testicular tumours of differing histologies.
title_ja: 組織型の異なる異時性両側精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 29歳の兵士に発生した、異なる組織型の異時性両側精巣腫瘍の症例報告です。奇形腫の後にセミノーマが発生するという経過は、両側精巣腫瘍の中でも極めて稀な提示形式とされています。文献レビューを行い、診断上の問題点について考察しています。精巣の胚細胞腫瘍における慎重な組織学的評価の重要性を示唆しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old soldier with metachronous bilateral testicular tumours of different histologies: a teratoma followed by a seminoma. The authors note that this sequence is among the rarest presentations of bilateral testicular tumours. The report reviews the literature and discusses the diagnostic problems these cases pose, emphasizing the importance of careful histological evaluation.

title: 12 year review of testicular tumour treatment by the army medical services.
title_ja: 陸軍医療部による精巣腫瘍治療の12年間の検討
summary_ja: 1977年から1988年に英国の陸軍病院で扱った精巣腫瘍144例の12年間の検討です。悪性は140例で、3例が性腺外に由来すると考えられました。病期分類の精度と治療プロトコルの向上により、後期には腫瘍死が減少しました。治療成績と予後改善について考察しています。
summary_en: This 12-year retrospective review covers 144 patients referred to a British military hospital between 1977 and 1988 with testicular tumours, of whom 140 were malignant. Three malignant lesions appeared extragonadal. Improvements in staging accuracy and treatment protocols are reflected in outcomes: ten tumour deaths occurred overall, but only one in the final three years despite rising caseload. The paper presents clinical presentation, treatment, and results, and discusses advances in treatment and improved prognosis.

title: Laparoscopic removal of ovarian lesions. A report of two cases.
title_ja: 卵巣病変の腹腔鏡下摘出術：2症例の報告
summary_ja: 2症例の良性と考えられる卵巣嚢腫（類皮嚢腫を含む）を、内視鏡用ポーチを用いて腹腔鏡下に摘出した報告です。腹腔内への漏出のリスクをほとんど伴わずに卵巣病変を摘出できました。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫であり、卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍の一つです。
summary_en: This report describes laparoscopic removal of apparently benign ovarian cysts, including dermoid cysts, in two patients using an endoscopic pouch. The pouch allowed extraction of ovarian lesions with little or no risk of intraperitoneal spillage. The authors suggest this technique is a reasonable alternative to traditional approaches for laparoscopic removal of ovarian tumors or cysts and should be considered when laparoscopic treatment is planned. Dermoid cysts are mature ovarian teratomas, a common ovarian germ cell tumor.

title: Massive ovarian tumor complicating pregnancy. A case report.
title_ja: 妊娠を合併した巨大卵巣腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠中に腹水様の所見で発見された、卵巣に生じた巨大な良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。超音波検査、MRI、血管造影で大きな奇形腫が確認され、合併症なく切除されました。妊娠中の付属器腫瘤の稀な提示形式と、周術期管理の重要点を論じています。
summary_en: A pregnant woman presented with what appeared to be ascites and was found to have a massive benign cystic teratoma of the ovary, far larger than typical dermoids under 10 cm. Ultrasound, MRI, and angiography demonstrated the large mass, which was resected without complications. This case report highlights an uncommon presentation of an adnexal tumour in pregnancy and discusses important perioperative care considerations for managing such a massive ovarian teratoma during pregnancy.

title: [Successful treatment with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and post-chemotherapy operation for mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with pulmonary metastasis].
title_ja: 肺転移を伴う縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法および化学療法後手術による治療成功例
summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘤と肺転移を有する19歳男性の症例です。針生検で未熟奇形腫が認められ、縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍・肺転移と診断されました。シスプラチン併用のPVB療法後、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常範囲に低下し、残存腫瘍の切除が行われました。切除検体では線維化・壊死が主体で、一部に未熟奇形腫を認めました。
summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with chest pain, a large mediastinal mass, and bilateral pulmonary nodules. Serum hCG and AFP were markedly elevated. Needle biopsy showed immature teratoma, and he was diagnosed with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with pulmonary metastasis. Cisplatin-based PVB chemotherapy normalized AFP but hCG only partly normalized. Surgical resection of the residual mediastinal tumor and pulmonary nodules followed, and pathology showed mainly fibrosis and necrosis with partial immature teratoma.

title: Hydatidiform molar pregnancy in Malaysian women: a histopathological study from the University Hospital, Kuala Lumpur.
title_ja: マレーシア人女性における胞状奇胎妊娠：クアラルンプール大学病院の病理組織学的研究
summary_ja: クアラルンプール大学病院で1989〜1990年に診断された妊娠性絨毛性疾患39例の病理組織学的検討です。完全奇胎25例、部分奇胎11例、侵入奇胎1例、絨毛癌2例でした。発生頻度は約384妊娠に1例と推定され、インド系女性で発生率が最も高いと報告されています。
summary_en: This histopathological study from University Hospital, Kuala Lumpur, reviewed gestational trophoblastic disease diagnosed over two years (1989 to 1990). Among 39 cases, there were 25 complete moles, 11 partial moles, one invasive mole and two choriocarcinomas. Mean ages and ethnic distribution of molar pregnancies were reported, with an estimated incidence of about 1 in 384 pregnancies. Partial moles constituted 30% of molar pregnancies, and the highest prevalence was observed among Indian women, consistent with a prior Singapore study.

title: Surveillance following orchidectomy for stage I seminoma of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の病期Iセミノーマに対する精巣摘除術後のサーベイランス
summary_ja: デンマークの全国規模コホート研究で、臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術後に監視のみを行った261例を評価した。19%が再発し、主に傍大動脈リンパ節であった。再発患者の多くは放射線療法を受けた。腫瘤が大きいまたは播種性の再発には化学療法が必要であり、セミノーマ関連死は3例であった。腫瘍径6cm以上は独立した予後因子であり、著者らは大きい腫瘍に対する予防的放射線療法を推奨している。
summary_en: This Danish nationwide cohort study of 261 patients evaluated surveillance alone after orchidectomy for clinical stage I testicular seminoma. Relapse occurred in 19 percent, mostly in paraaortic lymph nodes, and most relapsing patients were treated with radiotherapy. Chemotherapy was needed for bulky or disseminated relapse, and there were three seminoma-related deaths. Tumor size of 6 cm or more was an independent prognostic factor, leading the authors to recommend prophylactic radiotherapy for large tumors.

title: Ovarian cystic teratomas: value of chemical fat saturation magnetic resonance imaging.
title_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫における化学的脂肪抑制磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の有用性
summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の診断において、化学的脂肪抑制MRIの有用性を19例22病変で検討した研究です。脂肪抑制画像の追加により正診数が17病変から21病変に向上しました。少量の脂肪も検出でき、卵巣奇形腫の画像診断に有用と結論づけられています。
summary_en: This study assessed chemical fat-saturation MRI for diagnosing ovarian cystic teratoma in 19 patients with 22 lesions. Adding fat-saturation sequences to conventional T1- and T2-weighted imaging increased correct diagnoses from 17 to 21 of 22 tumors. Fat-saturation images detected small amounts of fat that were missed on conventional sequences. One tumor with minimal fat showed no signal drop and remained undiagnosed. The authors conclude that fat-saturation imaging is valuable for characterizing cystic teratomas of the ovary.

title: Teratomas in pediatric age group: experience with 75 cases.
title_ja: 小児期奇形腫75例の経験
summary_ja: 12歳未満の奇形腫小児75例を後方視的に検討しました。仙尾部が49例と最多で、成熟奇形腫は切除のみで良好な早期生存率を示しました。未熟・悪性成分を有する症例はVAC療法などの集学的治療を受け、死亡率は未熟奇形腫20%、悪性奇形腫66.7%でした。
summary_en: This retrospective review describes 75 children under 12 years with teratomas, most commonly sacrococcygeal (49 cases). Most tumors contained only mature tissue and were managed with excision alone, with 95% early survival. Patients with immature or malignant components received multiagent chemotherapy (VAC) and sometimes radiotherapy, with mortality of 20% and 66.7%, respectively. Age at presentation was the only prognostic factor besides histology, and the authors stress early recognition and complete surgical excision.

title: [Primary mediastinal tumors in children--comparison with mediastinal tumors in adults].
title_ja: 小児原発性縦隔腫瘍：成人縦隔腫瘍との比較
summary_ja: 43年間に原発性縦隔腫瘍で手術を受けた628例を、小児106例と成人522例で比較した単施設研究です。奇形腫は小児の19.8%、成人の17.1%を占めました。成人は悪性腫瘍が多く、小児は呼吸困難や緊急手術が多い傾向でした。
summary_en: This Japanese institutional series of 628 patients who underwent surgery for primary mediastinal tumors over 43 years compares children (106) with adults (522). Teratoma was a major histology in both groups, accounting for 19.8 percent of pediatric and 17.1 percent of adult cases. Neurogenic tumors predominated in children, while thymoma predominated in adults. Adults had more malignant tumors, and children more often presented with dyspnea and emergency operations.

title: [A case of cervical teratoma in adult].
title_ja: 成人の頸部奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 21歳男性の成人頸部奇形腫の症例報告。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)とMRIで縦隔への進展を認めたが周囲組織への浸潤はなく、201Tlシンチグラフィーで腫瘍への集積を示した。襟状切開と胸骨正中切開を併用して切除し、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。術後1年7か月の時点で無病生存している。
summary_en: This report describes a 21-year-old man with a cervical mature teratoma, a rare neoplasm in adults. CT and MRI showed extension into the mediastinum without invasion of surrounding tissue, and thallium-201 scintigraphy showed uptake in the tumor. The tumor was resected through a collar incision combined with median sternotomy. Histology confirmed mature teratoma. The patient remained disease-free 19 months after surgery.

title: Massive orbital teratoma in the newborn.
title_ja: 新生児の巨大眼窩奇形腫
summary_ja: 新生児女児に生じた巨大な眼窩奇形腫の報告。眼窩の著明な拡大と頬骨の偏位、眼窩天蓋の菲薄化を認めたが骨浸潤はなかった。頭蓋顔面アプローチにより腫瘍を完全切除し、病理組織では三胚葉すべての成分を認めた。文献上、確実な先天性眼窩奇形腫は51例のみと報告されている。
summary_en: This report describes a newborn girl with a massive orbital teratoma causing marked orbital enlargement, displacement of the zygoma, and thinning of the orbital roof, without bony invasion. A craniofacial approach was used to completely extirpate the tumor. Histology showed derivatives of all three germ cell layers. The authors review the literature, noting only 51 well-documented congenital orbital teratomas, and offer recommendations for definitive treatment.

title: Analysis of chromosome aneuploidy in ovarian dysgerminoma by flow cytometry and fluorescence in situ hybridization.
title_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫における染色体異数性のフローサイトメトリーおよび蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションによる解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: パラフィン包埋組織を用いてDNAフローサイトメトリーと蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションにより、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫4例の染色体異数性を解析した。腫瘍はほぼ四倍体で、多くの症例で7番と12番染色体が増加していた。このパターンは精巣セミノーマに類似しており、i(12p)マーカーを含め両腫瘍が共通の細胞遺伝学的特徴を持つことが示唆された。
summary_en: This study analyzed chromosome aneuploidy in four ovarian dysgerminomas using DNA flow cytometry and fluorescence in situ hybridization on paraffin-embedded tissue. The tumors were near-tetraploid, with frequent gains of chromosomes 7 and 12 and an X chromosome count of three in most cases. The aneuploidy pattern closely resembled that of testicular seminoma, supporting a shared cytogenetic profile, including the i(12p) marker, between these two germ cell tumors.

title: Primary extragonadal germ cell tumors of the retroperitoneum: differentiation of primary and secondary tumors.
title_ja: 後腹膜原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍：原発性腫瘍と続発性腫瘍の鑑別
summary_ja: 後腹膜に生じる原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と、精巣原発腫瘍からの転移性（続発性）腫瘍との鑑別について解説している。精巣の超音波検査が重要だが、同時性・異時性病変もありうる。β-hCGとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は診断とフォローアップに有用で、超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は局在診断に役立つ。治療は手術、放射線療法、化学療法の併用が一般的である。
summary_en: This review explains how to distinguish primary extragonadal germ cell tumors of the retroperitoneum from secondary tumors metastasized from testicular primaries. Careful testicular ultrasound is essential, though synchronous or metachronous lesions can occur. Serum beta-hCG and AFP aid diagnosis and follow-up, while ultrasound and CT help localize tumors. Treatment typically combines surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy.

title: Testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん
summary_ja: 男性悪性腫瘍の約1%を占める精巣がんについて、若年男性の社会的・心理的影響を含めて概説した看護領域の総説である。早期発見には精巣自己検査が最も有用とされる。手術と化学療法の進歩により、かつて致命的であった本疾患は現在最も治癒可能ながんの一つとなった。血清マーカー、早期診断、治療が管理の鍵である。
summary_en: This nursing-oriented review summarizes testicular cancer, noting its rarity among male malignancies yet significant impact on young men. Testicular self-examination is the best available tool for early detection. Historically fatal due to rapid metastasis, testicular cancer is now among the most curable cancers thanks to advances in surgery and chemotherapy. Serum markers, early diagnosis, and treatment are key to management.

title: Simultaneous occurrence of carcinosarcoma of the bladder and seminoma of the testis. Case report.
title_ja: 膀胱の癌肉腫と精巣セミノーマの同時性発生：症例報告
summary_ja: 51歳男性に膀胱の癌肉腫と精巣セミノーマが同時性に発症した症例報告である。癌肉腫は上皮成分と間葉成分の両方を含むまれな膀胱腫瘍である。尿路上皮系悪性腫瘍と精巣胚細胞腫瘍が同一患者に併存することはまれであり、そのような同時性の病態を認識することには臨床的意義がある。
summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old man with carcinosarcoma of the bladder and seminoma of the testis occurring synchronously. Carcinosarcoma is a rare bladder neoplasm containing both epithelial and mesenchymal components. The report highlights the uncommon coexistence of a urothelial-type malignancy and a testicular germ cell tumor in the same patient. Recognizing such synchronous presentations is clinically relevant.

title: Intense gallium-67 uptake in ovarian dysgerminoma.
title_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫におけるガリウム67の強い集積
summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の一症例で、クエン酸ガリウム67の強い集積が認められたことを報告しています。腹部でガリウム集積異常を示す疾患の一つとして、未分化胚細胞腫を追加すべきだと述べています。単一症例の核医学報告ですが、腹部病変のガリウムシンチグラフィ解釈に有用な知見です。
summary_en: A patient with ovarian dysgerminoma showed intense uptake of gallium-67 citrate on scintigraphy. The authors report this finding to add dysgerminoma to the list of abdominal lesions with abnormal gallium-67 accumulation. The brief report emphasizes that clinicians should consider germ cell tumors in the differential when interpreting gallium scans in patients with abdominal abnormalities. It is a single-case nuclear medicine report with limited generalizability but clinically useful for imaging interpretation.

title: Oropharyngeal teratoma in a child: a case report.
title_ja: 小児の口腔咽頭奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 生後20日の新生児で、口腔底に無痛性の腫瘤が生じた症例です。腫瘍は母乳哺育を妨げましたが、哺乳瓶での授乳は可能でした。摘出は容易で、組織学的に奇形腫と診断されました。口腔咽頭奇形腫は英文文献で26例のみの報告があり、先天性口腔腫瘤の鑑別診断に奇形腫を含めるべきだと述べています。
summary_en: A healthy 20-day-old neonate presented with a painless oropharyngeal mass on the floor of the mouth. The tumor interfered with breastfeeding but not bottle-feeding. After easy enucleation, histology confirmed teratoma. The authors note that the nasopharynx is the commoner site and that only 26 oropharyngeal teratomas had been reported in the English literature. They emphasize that teratoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of congenital oral growths.

title: A retrospective study of large ovarian masses in paediatric practice.
title_ja: 小児の大型卵巣腫瘤に関する後方視的研究
summary_ja: 15年間に腹部膨満を主訴に受診した小児の大型卵巣腫瘤15例を後方視的に検討した報告です。漿液性・粘液性嚢胞腺腫、ブレンナー腫瘍、若年性顆粒膜細胞腫瘍などとともに、良性・悪性奇形腫や胎児性癌も含まれます。成人と小児の卵巣腫瘤では画像所見が大きく異なることを示しています。全例で経過は良好でした。
summary_en: This retrospective review describes 15 children with large ovarian masses presenting with abdominal swelling over 15 years, all histologically confirmed. Lesions included serous and mucinous cystadenomas, Brenner tumor, juvenile granulosa cell tumors, benign and malignant teratomas, and one malignant embryonal carcinoma. The authors highlight radiological differences between pediatric and adult ovarian masses and illustrate the imaging findings. All patients were well at follow-up. The series includes several germ cell tumor cases.

title: Double malignancy in a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary (a case report).
title_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫における二重悪性腫瘍（症例報告）
summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に悪性変化を認め、二重悪性腫瘍を呈した症例報告です。平滑筋肉腫に上皮内扁平上皮癌を合併していました。卵巣摘出後1年間は良好に経過しています。成熟奇形腫内に肉腫と扁平上皮癌が併存する稀な例であり、卵巣奇形腫の慎重な病理学的検索の重要性を示しています。
summary_en: A case report describes malignant change in a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary, with double malignancy. The tumor contained leiomyosarcoma associated with in situ squamous cell carcinoma. The patient remained well for one year after ovariotomy. The report highlights the rare coexistence of sarcomatous and squamous malignant components within a mature teratoma, underscoring the need for careful pathological examination of ovarian teratomas.

title: Gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma associated with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis--a case report.
title_ja: 46,XY純粋性性腺形成不全に伴う性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）：症例報告
summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性性腺形成不全の24歳表現型女性例。原発性無月経と両側線状性腺を認めた。予防的性腺摘出を拒否後に骨盤内腫瘤が出現し、両側性腺から性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が確認された。両側性腺摘出・子宮全摘後に放射線療法とホルモン補充を行い、2年後も再発なく良好である。
summary_en: A 24-year-old phenotypic female with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis presented with primary amenorrhea and bilateral streak gonads. After refusing prophylactic gonadectomy, she developed a pelvic mass, and histology of both gonads revealed gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. She underwent bilateral gonadectomy with hysterectomy, followed by radiation therapy and hormone replacement. At two years of follow-up she remained well and recurrence-free, illustrating the risk of gonadal tumors in dysgenetic gonads.

title: Short duration radiotherapy in stage I seminoma of the testis: preliminary results of a prospective study.
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対する短期間放射線療法：前向き研究の予備的結果
summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ94例に対し、大動脈傍領域のみへ20Gy・8分割の短期間放射線療法を施行した前向き研究の予備結果。忍容性は良好で、中央値34か月の追跡で腹部再発はなかった。潜在性奇形腫由来の孤立性遠隔転移が1例あり、化学療法で無病となった。簡便で低再発率の治療として有用性が示唆された。
summary_en: Ninety-four patients with stage I testicular seminoma received short-course radiotherapy (20 Gy in 8 fractions) to the para-aortic field only, in a prospective study. The regimen was well tolerated. With a median follow-up of 34 months, no abdominal relapse occurred. One patient developed a solitary distant metastasis from a latent teratoma and was disease-free after chemotherapy. The authors suggest this simpler, shorter technique offers a low relapse rate and may reduce the need for intensive surveillance.

title: Hepatic teratoma in an adult. Case report with a review of the literature.
title_ja: 成人の肝奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 成人に発生した肝奇形腫の症例報告。成人例としては本報告が5例目と考えられ、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)との対比および44歳から61歳までの単純X線による経時的な進行記録が初めて示された。緩徐な進行を示した点が特徴である。肝奇形腫の文献レビューを付記している。
summary_en: The authors describe a hepatic teratoma in an adult patient, believed to be only the fifth such adult case reported. It is the first with CT correlation and with plain-film documentation of its development and slow progression from age 44 to 61. The report includes a review of the literature on hepatic teratomas, which are rare in adults and pose diagnostic challenges.

title: Anorectal function in adults operated for a benign sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 良性仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた成人における肛門直腸機能
summary_ja: 乳児期に良性仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた成人26例で、排便機能と生活の質をアンケートで評価した。良好な便禁制は88%だが、完全に正常な排便習慣は27%にとどまった。泌尿器症状は50%に認められた。骨盤内進展の程度と機能障害の相関はなかった。成人期にも肛門直腸機能障害と生活の質の低下が残ることが示された。
summary_en: Anorectal function and quality of life were assessed by questionnaire in 26 adults (mean age 30) who had surgery for benign sacrococcygeal teratoma in infancy, compared with 26 age- and sex-matched healthy controls. Good fecal continence was reported by 88%, but only 27% had fully normal bowel habits, and 27% reported fecal soiling and social problems. Urinary incontinence affected 50%. The degree of intrapelvic extension did not correlate with dysfunction, and quality of life was diminished.

title: Oral teratoma (epignathus) with intracranial extension: a report of two cases.
title_ja: 頭蓋内進展を伴う口腔奇形腫（エピグナサス）：2症例報告
summary_ja: 先天性口咽頭奇形腫（エピグナサス）の2症例を報告。通常は出生直後に急速な窒息を来す。本症例では腫瘍が頭蓋内へ進展しており、これは超音波検査で診断可能である。頭蓋内進展を認める場合は積極的な外科治療は不適切と結論している。出生前超音波検査が予後不良因子の同定に有用であることを示す。
summary_en: Two cases of epignathus, a congenital oropharyngeal teratoma, are described. Such masses often cause rapid asphyxia after birth. In these cases the tumor had extended intracranially, a complication that can be diagnosed by ultrasound. The authors conclude that when intracranial extension is present, aggressive surgical treatment is inappropriate. The report highlights the prenatal diagnostic value of ultrasonography in identifying this poor prognostic feature.

title: Molecular heterogeneity of human chorionic gonadotropin in serum and urine from patients with trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍患者の血清および尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の分子的不均一性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣がんや胞状奇胎などの絨毛性腫瘍患者の血清と尿に含まれるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を比較した研究。腫瘍由来のhCGは妊娠由来より酸性の変異体が多く、尿中hCGは血清由来より塩基性の分画が多かった。構造と活性の評価には血清由来のhCGを用いるべきだと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study compared the molecular heterogeneity of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in serum and urine from patients with trophoblastic tumors. Because analysis required very high serum hCG levels, it included seven men with testicular cancer, one woman with a hydatidiform mole, and one pregnancy sample. Urinary hCG contained more alkaline isoforms than serum hCG, and tumor-derived hCG had more acidic variants than pregnancy hCG. Some patients had smaller immunoreactive hCG molecules. The authors conclude that serum-derived hCG should be used to define hCG structure and biological activity.

title: The growing teratoma syndrome: a woman with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the ovary.
title_ja: growing teratoma syndrome：卵巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する女性の症例
summary_ja: 卵巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する38歳女性の症例。化学療法で腫瘍マーカーは正常化したが、外科的切除で得られた成熟奇形腫の結節は増大を続け、肝浸潤や小腸壊死、尿路閉塞を来した。精巣腫瘍で報告されてきた growing teratoma syndrome の典型像を示す症例として報告されている。
summary_en: A 38-year-old woman had incomplete surgical excision of peritoneal nodules from a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the ovary. Tumor markers normalized after combination chemotherapy, yet abdominal nodes enlarged. Resection showed only mature teratoma without malignant cells, and the nodules kept growing, invading the liver and causing bowel necrosis and urinary obstruction. The authors describe typical growing teratoma syndrome, previously reported only in testicular tumors, and note an unexpectedly high CA 19-9 level.

title: Characterization of upstream activation elements essential for the expression of germ cell alkaline phosphatase in human choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞における胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼの発現に必須の上流活性化配列の同定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞で胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼ遺伝子を発現させるプロモーター領域を解析した研究。-156〜-1の領域に3つのGC豊富な結合部位を同定し、特に部位IとIIが転写活性化に重要であった。部位同士が協調するタンパク質間相互作用が遺伝子活性化に必要と示唆された。
summary_en: This study identifies promoter elements that drive germ cell alkaline phosphatase expression in human choriocarcinoma cells, which express this gene rather than the placental form. DNase I footprinting revealed three GC-rich protein-binding sites within nucleotides -156 to -1. Sites I and II bind AP-2, and gel retardation showed similar factors binding in JEG-3 cells. Mutating sites I or II reduced activator activity, while site III alone was insufficient, indicating that protein-protein interactions are important for transcriptional activation.

title: Malignant teratoma of the lung with lymph node metastasis of the ectodermal compartment: a case report.
title_ja: リンパ節転移を伴う肺の悪性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 51歳男性の肺原発・転移性奇形癌の症例報告。当初は扁平上皮癌が疑われたが、最終的に悪性奇形腫と分類された。免疫組織化学でβ-hCGやAFPなどを検討した結果、肺芽腫に近く扁平上皮癌とは大きく異なり、稀な原発性肺悪性腫瘍と位置づけられている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old man with a metastasizing teratocarcinoma of the lung, initially suspected to be epidermoid carcinoma and finally classified as malignant teratoma. Lymph node metastasis contained ectodermal components. Immunohistochemistry tested neuron-specific enolase, CEA, beta-HCG, AFP, and p53, and the tumor's carbohydrate binding, growth-factor expression, and DNA features were compared with epidermoid carcinoma and pulmonary blastoma. Results resembled pulmonary blastoma and differed markedly from epidermoid carcinoma, supporting its status as a rare primary lung malignancy.

title: Prognosis after resection of residual masses following chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer: a multivariate analysis.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんにおける化学療法後の残存腫瘤切除後の予後：多変量解析
summary_ja: 化学療法後に残存腫瘤を切除した転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がん86例の予後解析。5年無再発率は87.4%で、化学療法前のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値、不完全切除、肺転移の広がりが不良因子であった。切除組織の組織型は再発と関連しなかった。hCG値と切除の完全性に基づき、予後良好群と不良群に分類された。
summary_en: This study analyzed 86 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer who had normal AFP and hCG after chemotherapy and then underwent resection of residual masses. Eleven relapsed, with a five-year relapse-free rate of 87.4 percent. Adverse factors were high prechemotherapy hCG (10,000 IU/L or more), incomplete resection, and extensive lung metastases. Histology at resection did not predict relapse, possibly because postoperative salvage chemotherapy was effective. Good and poor risk groups were defined by hCG level and completeness of resection.

title: Cytofluorometric analysis of spermatocytic seminoma.
title_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマのサイトフルオロメトリー解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣の精母細胞性セミノーマを細胞蛍光測定法でDNA量解析した研究。大型細胞は倍数性が段階的に倍加する異数体で、小型細胞はほぼ2CのDNA量を示した。減数分裂は関与せず、連続的な多倍数化により3種の細胞形態が生じると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study used cytofluorometry to examine DNA content in large, small, and intermediate cells of spermatocytic seminoma, a testicular tumor. Large cells were aneuploid, with ploidy doubling stepwise, whereas small cells showed 2C or near-2C DNA content with distinct cell cycles. Intermediate cells showed both diploid and aneuploid values. The authors argue that none of these cell types undergo meiosis; instead, diploid cycling of small cells and sequential polyploidization of large cells produce the three morphologic cell types.

title: Severe vascular toxicity associated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy.
title_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法に伴う重篤な血管毒性
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の19歳男性が、シスプラチン併用化学療法の晩期合併症として高血圧、心筋梗塞、脳血管障害を低マグネシウム血症とともに発症した症例報告。既報例をレビューし、早期と晩期で異なる病態機序が想定されるとしている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old man with a germ cell tumor who developed hypertension, acute myocardial infarction, and cerebrovascular accident with hypomagnesemia as late complications of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The authors review previously reported cases. They propose that early and late cisplatin-related vascular complications may arise from different physiopathologic mechanisms, highlighting a rare but serious toxicity of this standard regimen.

title: Late occurrence of malignancy following resection of a histologically mature sacrococcygeal teratoma. Report of a case and literature review.
title_ja: 組織学的に成熟した仙尾部奇形腫切除後の遅発性悪性腫瘍：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 成熟型仙尾部奇形腫を生後2か月で切除された男性が、約40年後に残存した尾骨から発生した腺癌を発症した症例報告。尾骨断端の残存が起源とされ、再発と多発転移で約2年後に死亡。小児・成人の仙尾部奇形腫に伴う悪性腫瘍を文献的に概観し、直腸後腔嚢胞などとの鑑別診断も論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a man nearly 40 years old who developed adenocarcinoma in the presacral soft tissue and residual coccyx, about 38 years after resection of a histologically mature sacrococcygeal teratoma performed in infancy. The retained coccygeal stump, not removed en bloc, was the site of origin. He died about two years later from local recurrence and widespread metastases. The authors review malignancies arising from sacrococcygeal teratomas and discuss differential diagnoses such as retrorectal cysts and tailgut cysts.

title: Benign intracardiac teratoma. A case of sudden death.
title_ja: 良性心臓内奇形腫：突然死の1例
summary_ja: 2歳半の女児が突然死し、剖検で心室中隔内に大きな良性奇形腫が見つかった症例報告。肉眼・組織学的所見は良性奇形腫に典型的であった。文献上、心臓の良性奇形腫は他に5例のみで、これらのまれな腫瘍の特徴を検討している。
summary_en: This report describes a 2.5-year-old girl who died suddenly after collapsing, with autopsy revealing a large benign teratoma within the interventricular septum of the heart. The gross and microscopic features were typical of a benign teratoma. The authors note that only five other benign cardiac teratomas had been reported in the literature, and they discuss the pertinent features of these rare tumours.

title: Skip metastases from testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの飛び越え転移
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが、初診時に後腹膜リンパ節への浸潤を伴わずに転移した症例を報告する。飛び越え転移と呼ばれる転移様式である。シスプラチン併用化学療法と照射野限定の放射線療法により治癒が得られた。本症例は、精巣セミノーマの転移が予想される後腹膜リンパ節経路を飛び越えて生じうることを示しており、病期分類および長期フォローアップにおいて考慮すべきであると強調している。
summary_en: This report describes a case of testicular seminoma that metastasised without initial involvement of the retroperitoneal lymph nodes, a pattern termed skip metastasis. Treatment with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and involved-field radiotherapy achieved cure. The case highlights that metastatic spread from testicular seminoma can bypass the expected retroperitoneal nodal pathway and should be considered during staging and follow-up.

title: Treatment of ovarian malignant germ cell tumors with preservation of fertility.
title_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の妊孕性温存治療
summary_ja: 本報告は、卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍15例に対し妊孕性と卵巣機能を温存する保存的手術と術後化学療法を行った結果を示す。卵黄嚢腫瘍1例と未熟奇形腫3例を含む4例が術後に正期産で出産した。若年女性における妊孕性温存治療の可能性を論じている。
summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 15 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumours who underwent conservative surgery and postoperative chemotherapy to preserve fertility and ovarian function. Four patients, including one with endodermal sinus tumour and three with immature teratoma, achieved full-term deliveries after surgery. The authors argue that fertility-sparing management can be considered for young women with these malignancies.

title: Does decreased skeletal uptake of 99mTc-methylene bisphosphonate in irradiated bone indicate the absence of bone metastases?
title_ja: 照射された骨における99mTc-メチレンビスホスホネート取り込み低下は骨転移の不在を示すか？
summary_ja: セミノーマに対し3〜8年前に30〜40Gyの放射線療法を受けた腫瘍のない13例で、照射された骨への99mTc-MBP集積が低下していた。放射線照射骨での集積低下のみでは骨転移がない、または腫瘍量が減ったとは判断できないと結論づけている。セミノーマ経験者の骨シンチグラフィ所見は慎重な解釈が必要である。
summary_en: Thirteen tumour-free patients who had received 30-40 Gy radiotherapy for seminoma 3-8 years earlier all showed reduced skeletal uptake of 99mTc-methylene bisphosphonate in the irradiated bone. The authors conclude that decreased tracer uptake in irradiated bone cannot by itself be taken as evidence of absence of bone metastases or reduced tumour burden. Bone scintigraphy in previously irradiated areas therefore requires careful interpretation in seminoma survivors.

title: Quantitation of human choriocarcinoma spheroid attachment to uterine epithelial cell monolayers.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛癌多細胞スフェロイドの子宮内膜上皮単層への接着の定量
journal: In Vitro Cell Dev Biol Anim
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JARの多細胞スフェロイドが子宮内膜上皮単層に接着する過程を定量するin vitro系を構築した。RL95-2への接着が最も速く、AN3-CAには接着しなかった。RL95-2上では絨毛癌細胞が上皮細胞の間へ侵入する像も確認された。着床や絨毛癌の浸潤機構を解析する基盤となる研究である。
summary_en: This in vitro study developed an assay to quantify attachment of JAR human choriocarcinoma multicellular spheroids to endometrial epithelial monolayers. JAR spheroids secreted hCG and progesterone. They attached progressively to RL95-2, HEC-1A and KLE monolayers, most rapidly to RL95-2 (about 90% at 5 h), and did not attach to AN3-CA. Light and electron microscopy showed choriocarcinoma cells intruding between RL95-2 epithelial cells. The model distinguishes adhesive properties among endometrial lines and provides a basis for studying molecular mechanisms of trophoblast-endometrium interaction.

title: Intradural extension of a sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の硬膜内進展
summary_ja: 正期産女児の仙尾部に12×13cmの腫瘤を認めたI型仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は脊柱管内へ進展し、終糸に付着していた。仙骨椎弓切除により仙骨神経根を温存して一塊として摘出され、病理学的に良性奇形腫と診断された。創離開と脳脊髄液漏の疑いで再手術を要したが、2年後まで再発はなく、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)も正常だった。
summary_en: This case report describes a full-term female newborn with a 12 x 13 cm sacral mass in whom a type I sacrococcygeal teratoma extended into the dural sac and was attached to the filum terminale. Surgery with sacral laminectomy allowed complete en bloc removal with preservation of sacral roots. Pathology showed benign teratoma. The infant needed reoperation for wound dehiscence and a suspected cerebrospinal fluid leak. At 2 years there was no recurrence, sphincter tone was normal and CT was normal. The authors emphasize the need for neurosurgical availability when this rare intradural extension occurs.

title: Testicular seminoma stage I: treatment results and long-term follow-up (1968-1988).
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマの治療成績と長期フォローアップ(1968〜1988年)
summary_ja: 1968〜1987年にイスラエル北部の腫瘍センターで治療された病期I精巣セミノーマ69例の後方視的検討である。64例が術後の横隔膜下照射を受け、5例はサーベイランスのみだった。中央値86か月のフォローアップで、20年生存率は94%だった。照射後の再発は6例で、いずれも照射野外であり、うち3例はシスプラチンを含む化学療法で救済された。
summary_en: This single-centre retrospective study reviewed 69 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated between 1968 and 1987 at the Northern Israel Oncology Center. Sixty-four received postoperative infradiaphragmatic irradiation and five underwent surveillance alone. Median follow-up was 86 months. Actuarial survival was 94% at 5, 10, 15 and 20 years. Six patients relapsed after irradiation, all outside the radiation field; three were salvaged with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Seven developed second primary cancers. The authors conclude that radiotherapy remains the optimal routine treatment until surveillance is proven effective.

title: Enteric nervous system and endocrine cells demonstrated in the gut in teratomas.
title_ja: 奇形腫の腸管内にみられる腸管神経系と内分泌細胞
journal: Virchows Arch A Pathol Anat Histopathol
summary_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫の1例で、腸管様構造に複雑な腸管壁内神経叢と多数の上皮性内分泌細胞を免疫組織化学で認めた。比較した成熟奇形腫10例では腸管壁内神経節を認めなかった。腸管内分泌細胞は腸管の分化や神経成分の有無に関係なく存在し、神経細胞とは起源が異なり内胚葉由来と考えられた。
summary_en: This paper describes a retroperitoneal teratoma with a well-developed, seemingly mature intestinal loop. Immunohistochemistry revealed complex intramural nerve plexuses and numerous epithelial endocrine cells within its gut tissue. Ten other mature teratomas containing gastrointestinal components were compared; none contained intramural ganglia or nerve networks, although endocrine cells were present in all intestinal mucosa. The enteric endocrine cells appeared regardless of intestinal layer differentiation or neural elements, suggesting they are of endodermal origin, distinct from enteric neurons. The authors propose that a teratoma with an organized enteric nervous system is related to fetus-in-fetus.

title: Epithelial choristomas and teratomas of the tongue.
title_ja: 舌の上皮性コリストーマと奇形腫
summary_ja: 口腔の非唾液腺性上皮性コリストーマと奇形腫、特に舌に生じるものを扱う。コリストーマは由来組織により胃腸型、甲状腺型、皮脂腺型に分類され、悪性対応物を持つのは舌甲状腺コリストーマのみである。舌奇形腫はさらに稀で、組織学的にはこれまで良性とされてきた。
summary_en: This paper discusses non-salivary epithelial choristomas and teratomas of the oral cavity, which predominantly affect the tongue. Choristomas are classified by generative tissue as gastroenteric, thyroidal or sebaceous, and only lingual thyroid choristoma has a malignant counterpart. Lingual teratomas are even rarer, and the authors note that they have been histologically benign in reported cases. The summary highlights the classification and the contrast in malignant potential between these lingual lesions.

title: Retinoic acid and cisdiaminodichloroplatinum in the treatment of murine teratocarcinomas in vivo in a nullipotent model.
title_ja: 無分化能モデルにおけるマウス奇形癌の生体内治療に対するレチノイン酸とシスジアミンジクロロ白金(CDDP)
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 自然発生の体細胞分化の程度が異なる3種のマウス奇形癌モデルで、レチノイン酸とシスプラチン(CDDP)の併用を検討した。併用は4回の実験で単独より腫瘍縮小効果が大きかった。併用後に残存した腫瘍は、CDDP単独後より胎児性癌成分が少なかった。分化能のないモデルでは体細胞分化は誘導されなかった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における残存成熟奇形腫の誘導リスクを検討する目的であった。
summary_en: This in vivo study tested retinoic acid (RA), cisplatin (CDDP), and their combination in three murine teratocarcinoma models with differing spontaneous somatic differentiation (E86-379, NF-1, MH-15). Combined treatment produced greater tumor reduction than either agent alone in four experiments. Residual tumor after combination therapy contained less embryonal carcinoma than after CDDP alone. Somatic differentiation was not induced in the non-differentiating MH-15 model. Toxicity, including weight loss and some deaths, paralleled tumor reduction. The authors aimed to assess whether differentiation induction might promote residual mature teratoma in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

title: [A case of anterior mediastinal mature teratoma containing air because of penetration to the lung].
title_ja: 肺へ浸潤し空気を含んでいた前縦隔成熟奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 28歳女性で、胸部X線で前縦隔に均一な腫瘤を認め、10日後に嚢胞状に変化しました。正中胸骨切開により、癒着した左肺と心膜の一部とともに腫瘍を摘出しました。嚢胞壁には皮脂腺、気管支腺、外分泌と内分泌の成分を含む膵組織が認められました。肺に浸潤し空気を含んだ前縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例です。
summary_en: A 28-year-old woman presented with a homogeneous anterior mediastinal mass on chest radiography that became cystic within ten days. Surgery through median sternotomy removed the tumor along with adherent left lung and pericardium. Histology showed cyst walls containing sebaceous glands, bronchial glands and pancreatic tissue with exocrine and endocrine elements. The case describes a mature teratoma that had penetrated the lung and contained air, an unusual presentation of an anterior mediastinal germ cell tumor.

title: [Brain metastasis of testicular yolk sac tumor with massive hemorrhage: case report].
title_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の大量出血を伴う脳転移：症例報告
summary_ja: 38歳男性が、肺転移を伴う左精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対し精巣摘除術を受けました。術後4日目に右頭頂葉の脳内血腫で昏睡と左片麻痺を生じ、緊急開頭血腫除去術で卵黄嚢腫瘍の脳転移と確認されました。PEB・PVB療法で血清AFPと肺病変は縮小しましたが、再出血と多発脳転移を防げず、術後6か月で死亡しました。
summary_en: A 38-year-old man underwent orchiectomy for a left testicular yolk sac tumor with lung metastases. Four days after surgery he developed coma and left hemiplegia from an intraparenchymal hematoma in the right parietal lobe. Emergency craniotomy revealed yolk sac tumor, confirming brain metastasis. Chemotherapy with PEB and PVB lowered serum AFP and lung lesions but did not prevent further intratumoral hemorrhage and multiple brain metastases, and he died six months after orchiectomy. The authors review prior cases.

title: Immunohistochemical expression of embryonal marker TRA-1-60 in carcinoma in situ and germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌および胚細胞腫瘍における胎児性マーカーTRA-1-60の免疫組織化学的発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎児性マーカーTRA-1-60の免疫組織化学的発現を、胎児生殖腺、精巣上皮内癌、浸潤性精巣がん、対照組織で検討しました。TRA-1-60は胎児胚細胞、上皮内癌の大部分、セミノーマ、胎児性癌で陽性でした。胎児胚細胞、上皮内癌細胞、胚細胞腫瘍が抗原的に関連することから、精巣腫瘍は胎生期に発生するという仮説を支持する結果です。
summary_en: This study examined the embryonal marker TRA-1-60 by immunohistochemistry in fetal gonads, testicular carcinoma in situ, invasive testicular cancers and controls. TRA-1-60 was expressed in fetal germ cells, in 26 of 27 testes with CIS, and in seminomas and embryonal carcinomas. The findings link fetal germ cells, CIS cells and germ cell tumors antigenically, supporting the hypothesis that testicular neoplasia arises during early fetal life from malignant fetal gonocytes.

title: Primary benign vesical teratoma. A case report.
title_ja: 膀胱原発良性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 膀胱原発の良性奇形腫は稀で、報告例の多くは膀胱へ破裂する傍膀胱奇形腫です。本症例は術前に疑われ、病理組織学的検査で確定診断された膀胱原発良性奇形腫の報告です。術前診断の可能性も示されています。抄録には年齢や治療経過などの詳細は記載されていません。
summary_en: This case report describes a primary benign teratoma of the bladder, a rare site, since most reported vesical teratomas are paravesical tumors that rupture into the bladder. The lesion was suspected before surgery and confirmed on histopathology. The brief abstract provides limited clinical detail on patient age, presentation, treatment or follow-up. It emphasizes that preoperative suspicion is possible and that histopathology establishes the diagnosis.

title: Adnexal tumor and a pigmented nevoid lesion in a benign cystic ovarian teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）に認められた付属器腫瘍と色素性母斑様病変
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）内に、稀な付属器腫瘍と青色母斑様の樹状メラノサイト集簇が認められた症例です。卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた良性皮膚付属器腫瘍の既報はないとされています。3つの良性病変は偶然共存したと考えられ、良性奇形腫の皮膚付属器組織は二次的な腫瘍化を起こしにくいと示唆されています。
summary_en: The authors describe an unusual adnexal lesion and concurrent dendritic melanocyte collections resembling blue nevus within a mature cystic ovarian teratoma. The authors note no prior reports of benign skin adnexal tumors arising in an ovarian dermoid cyst. They conclude that the three benign lesions likely coincided by chance, suggesting that cutaneous adnexal tissue in benign teratomas is not especially prone to secondary tumorigenesis.

title: Primitive neuroectodermal tumor arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma: immunohistochemical and electron microscopic studies.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍：免疫組織化学的および電子顕微鏡的研究
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍（PNET）の症例報告。免疫組織化学および電子顕微鏡による解析を行い、成熟神経成分から悪性PNETへの移行像を確認した。これは単一胚葉性神経上皮分化を示唆し、本まれな腫瘍の組織発生の理解に寄与する。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Immunohistochemical and electron microscopic analyses were performed on the lesion. Transition zones between mature neural elements and malignant PNET components were observed, supporting a monodermic neuroepithelial differentiation model for histogenesis. Only a handful of ovarian PNET cases have been reported previously, and in two of them the tumor lay adjacent to mature teratomatous tissue. The findings help explain the histogenesis of this unusual malignant neuroepithelial tumor.

title: Cytogenetic analysis of an immature teratoma of the ovary and its metastasis after chemotherapy-induced maturation.
title_ja: 化学療法による成熟化を伴った卵巣未熟奇形腫およびその転移巣の細胞遺伝学的解析
summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫（グレード3）と化学療法後に切除された転移巣の細胞遺伝学的解析を報告。転移巣は成熟奇形腫が主体であったが、両者は同一の核型（第1染色体由来の偽二動原体染色体、第4染色体モノソミー）を示した。化学療法による成熟化は悪性核型の消失を伴わないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This report presents cytogenetic and flow cytometric analyses of a grade 3 immature ovarian teratoma and its metastasis, resected one year later after cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide chemotherapy. The metastasis consisted predominantly of mature teratoma with only small immature foci, yet both lesions shared identical karyotypes, including a pseudodicentric chromosome derived from chromosome 1 and monosomy 4, with diploid DNA content. The authors conclude that chemotherapy-induced maturation of metastatic immature ovarian teratoma does not coincide with loss of the malignant karyotype or selection of a distinct tumor cell population.

title: Chest staging in testis cancer patients: imaging modality selection based upon risk assessment as determined by abdominal computerized tomography scan results.
title_ja: 腹部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見に基づくリスク評価による精巣がん患者の胸部病期分類：画像診断法の選択
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者144例を対象に、腹部CTの結果で層別化して胸部X線と胸部CTを比較した研究。腹部CT陰性例では、胸部CTは胸部X線に比べ感度を向上させなかった。腹部CT異常例では、胸部X線のみでは4例で胸腔内転移を見逃す可能性があり、胸部CTが必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: In 144 testicular cancer patients, the authors compared chest radiography with chest CT for thoracic staging, stratified by abdominal CT findings. Among patients with negative abdominal CT, chest CT did not improve sensitivity over chest X-ray, although three patients had chest metastases. In patients with abnormal abdominal CT, chest X-ray alone would have missed intrathoracic metastatic disease in four patients. The authors conclude that chest X-ray suffices initially when abdominal CT is negative, while chest CT is warranted when abdominal CT is abnormal.

title: p53 gene mutations in Chinese human testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 中国人精巣セミノーマにおけるp53遺伝子変異
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 中国人の精巣セミノーマ17例でp53遺伝子のエクソン5〜8を解析した研究。4例（23.5%）で一方の対立遺伝子にアミノ酸変化をもたらす変異が認められ、もう一方は野生型配列を保持していた。p53変異が精巣セミノーマの発生に関与する可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: Using SSCP analysis followed by direct sequencing, the authors screened exons 5 to 8 of the p53 gene in 17 primary testicular seminomas from Chinese patients. Four tumors (23.5%) harbored mutations leading to amino acid changes in one allele, while the other allele retained the wild-type sequence. Mutations were found in exons 5, 7 and 8. The authors conclude that p53 mutation may contribute to the development of testicular seminoma, as it does in several other human cancers.

title: Urological aspects of sacrococcygeal teratoma in children.
title_ja: 小児仙尾部奇形腫の泌尿器科的側面
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の小児29例の診療録を検討し、泌尿器合併症を腫瘍の悪性度と型別に解析した研究。神経因性膀胱、尿管閉塞、膀胱尿管逆流が認められた。仙骨前型（IV型）で合併症が最も多かった（81%）。全例に早期の画像評価と神経泌尿器力学的評価を推奨している。
summary_en: This review of charts from 29 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma, the most common extragonadal germ cell tumor of infancy, examined urological complications relative to tumor grade and type. Neurogenic bladder, ureteral obstruction and vesicoureteral reflux occurred in 12%, 10% and 7% of patients, respectively. Tumor grade did not correlate with complications, but presacral type IV disease carried the highest incidence at 81%. The authors recommend early radiographic and neurourodynamic evaluation for all children with sacrococcygeal teratoma.

title: Early stage of development in testicular choriocarcinomas.
title_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の初期発生段階
summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌20例を組織学的・免疫組織化学的に検討し、初期発生過程を解析した研究。精巣絨毛癌は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の中で最も悪性度が高い。初期段階では正常栄養膜細胞の分化を模倣し、一部は自然退縮した。多くは胎児性癌の段階を経て発生したと考えられるが、無関係な例もあった。
summary_en: This study examined 20 testicular choriocarcinomas histologically and immunohistochemically to clarify their early developmental stage. Early lesions mimicked the morphological and functional differentiation of normal trophoblasts, and some regressed spontaneously. Most choriocarcinomas appeared to arise through an embryonal carcinoma phase, although some showed no apparent relationship with embryonal carcinoma. Choriocarcinoma is the most malignant testicular germ cell tumor, so these findings provide insight into its histogenesis.

title: Testicular seminoma metastasizing to palatine tonsil.
title_ja: 口蓋扁桃に転移した精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ病期Iの患者が、精巣摘除術と傍大動脈・骨盤リンパ節への予防的放射線療法を受けた後、非典型部位である口蓋扁桃に再発した症例報告です。セミノーマの再発率は約2%と低く、前立腺や腸間膜などでの再発例も報告されています。遠隔再発例でも予後が良好である点が強調されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with Stage I testicular seminoma who underwent orchidectomy and prophylactic radiotherapy to the paraaortic and pelvic nodes. The tumor later relapsed in the palatine tonsil, an unusual site. Only about 2% of Stage I seminomas recur, and relapses in sites such as the prostate and mesentery have been reported before. The authors emphasize that seminoma retains a favorable prognosis even when distant recurrence occurs.

title: Prostatic acid phosphatase in strumal carcinoids of the ovary. An immunohistochemical study.
title_ja: 卵巣ストルマ性カルチノイドにおける前立腺酸性ホスファターゼの免疫組織化学的研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣のストルマ性カルチノイド5例について、免疫組織化学染色により神経内分泌マーカーや甲状腺マーカーなどを検討した研究です。全例で甲状腺グロブリン、クロモグラニン、前立腺酸性ホスファターゼ（PAP）、グルカゴンが陽性で、PSAは陰性でした。PAPの陽性所見は直腸カルチノイドと類似し、本腫瘍の起源は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の胚細胞と考えられています。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined five ovarian strumal carcinoids, tumors containing thyroid tissue admixed with carcinoid elements. All cases were positive for thyroglobulin, chromogranin, prostatic acid phosphatase (PAP), and glucagon, and negative for prostate specific antigen. The PAP positivity resembles that of rectal carcinoids. The authors note that the origin of these tumors is thought to be germ cells within mature cystic teratomas rather than the hindgut.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma with metastasis to the paraaortic nodes.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌、傍大動脈リンパ節転移を認めた症例
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した扁平上皮癌の症例報告です。卵巣外病変は傍大動脈リンパ節転移のみでした。骨盤および傍大動脈への拡大照射野放射線療法、シスプラチン、補助化学療法を行いましたが制御できませんでした。著者らは、見かけ上病期Iの再発は不十分な手術的病期分類が原因である可能性を指摘しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with squamous cell carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Surgical staging revealed paraaortic nodal metastasis as the only extraovarian disease. Extended-field radiation therapy to the pelvis and paraaortic nodes, combined with cisplatin and adjuvant chemotherapy, failed to control the disease. The authors argue that inadequate surgical staging may explain recurrences in apparent Stage I disease, underscoring the importance of thorough staging in early ovarian cancer.

title: Role of sputum cytology in the diagnosis of mediastinal germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の診断における喀痰細胞診の役割
summary_ja: 上大静脈症候群で発症した25歳男性の原発性縦隔セミノーマ（ジャーミノーマ）の症例報告です。肺浸潤と鎖骨上窩リンパ節への転移を認めました。診断は喀痰細胞診で初めて確立され、肺とリンパ節の穿刺吸引細胞診と対比されました。喀痰検査は肺浸潤を伴う胚細胞腫瘍の補助診断として有用と考えられています。
summary_en: This report describes a 25-year-old man with a primary mediastinal seminoma (germinoma) that infiltrated the lung and metastasized to a supraclavicular lymph node. He presented with superior vena cava syndrome. The diagnosis was first established cytologically from sputum specimens and correlated with fine needle aspiration of the lung and lymph node. The authors suggest that sputum examination may be a useful adjunctive diagnostic tool for germ cell tumors infiltrating the lung.

title: Tailgut remnant--or teratoma?
title_ja: 尾腸遺残か、それとも奇形腫か
summary_ja: 正期産の男児に生じた大きな仙骨部の不均一な腫瘤の症例です。腫瘤は硬膜と交通する嚢胞成分と、腸粘膜様の充実成分から構成されていました。三胚葉すべてを含むため仙尾部奇形腫の定義を満たす一方、その構造は腫瘍ではなく尾腸由来の奇形性病変を示唆すると結論しています。
summary_en: This report describes a full-term male neonate with a large heterogeneous sacral mass and severe bony abnormalities of the coccyx and lower spine, who was neurologically intact. Surgery revealed cystic components communicating with the dura and a solid component resembling intestinal mucosa. Because the mass contained all three germ layers, it meets the definition of sacrococcygeal teratoma, yet its architecture suggests a malformative tailgut origin rather than a true neoplasm.

title: Cytogenetic abnormalities detected by direct analysis in a case of choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 絨毛癌症例の直接分析で検出された染色体異常
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌の新鮮組織から悪性栄養膜細胞を直接染色体分析した研究です。54分裂中期細胞のうち41個で核型解析が行われ、3つの異常クローンが同定されました。全クローンで3番と10番の三染色体、過剰な1q等染色体、8番染色体の置換などが認められました。株化細胞ではなく生体組織での遺伝学的特徴を示した点が特徴です。
summary_en: This study performed direct cytogenetic analysis on fresh tissue from a choriocarcinoma, rather than the established cell lines used in prior work. Of 54 metaphases, 41 were fully karyotyped, revealing three abnormal clones. All showed trisomy 3 and 10, a supernumerary i(1q), an i(8q) replacing one chromosome 8, and a marker chromosome. Chromosome 12 was involved in two clones. The findings provide direct genetic characterization of malignant trophoblastic cells.

title: Effect of levamisole as an immunomodulating agent in trophoblastic lesions.
title_ja: 栄養膜性病変におけるレバミゾールの免疫調節作用
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎16例と絨毛癌6例で細胞性・液性免疫を評価し、一部の患者にレバミゾールを2か月投与しました。胞状奇胎ではリンパ球数と遅延型皮膚反応が増加しましたが、絨毛癌では変化がありませんでした。両疾患ともT細胞ロゼット数と血清免疫グロブリンは改善し、栄養膜性病変に対する免疫調節効果が示唆されています。
summary_en: This study evaluated cell-mediated and humoral immunity in 16 patients with hydatidiform mole and 6 with choriocarcinoma. Levamisole was given for two months to half of the choriocarcinoma patients and to 11 vesicular mole patients. In vesicular mole, levamisole raised absolute lymphocyte counts and delayed hypersensitivity responses, but choriocarcinoma showed no such change. T-cell rosette counts and serum immunoglobulins improved in both lesions, suggesting a beneficial immunomodulatory effect in trophoblastic disease.

title: Paraneoplastic Raynaud's phenomenon.
title_ja: 傍腫瘍性レイノー現象
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の診断に先行して、重度の指尖動脈炎を伴うレイノー現象が出現した症例報告である。動脈炎はプロスタサイクリン療法により速やかに改善した。精巣癌における血管症状は通常化学療法後に出現するが、本例では腫瘍の診断と治療に先行していた点が特徴である。
summary_en: This report describes a patient whose testicular tumour was first recognized through a paraneoplastic Raynaud's phenomenon with severe digital arteritis. The arteritis regressed rapidly under prostacyclin therapy. The authors note that vascular manifestations are frequent in testicular carcinoma but usually appear after chemotherapy, whereas here they preceded the diagnosis and specific tumour treatment. This makes it a rare presentation of testicular germ cell tumour.

title: Right ventricular metastasis from choriocarcinoma: report of a rare case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 絨毛癌からの右心室転移：稀な症例の報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 出産後の女性に生じた右心室内の絨毛癌転移の稀な症例報告である。当初は心臓肉腫が疑われたが、顕微鏡検査で悪性栄養膜細胞が確認された。高リスク群としてEMA-CO化学療法を行い、20週間で完全寛解に至った。4年後も無病で再妊娠している。文献的考察も加えている。
summary_en: A previously healthy woman who had recently given birth presented with chest pain and dyspnea, and a right ventricular mass was initially suspected to be a cardiac sarcoma. Microscopy revealed malignant trophoblast, with multiple lung nodules, while the uterus and adnexa were disease-free. Combination EMA-CO chemotherapy was given for high-risk disease, and she achieved complete remission after 20 weeks. She remained disease-free 4 years later and was pregnant again. The paper reviews the literature on this rare cardiac metastasis of choriocarcinoma.

title: Ovarian dysgerminoma: a therapeutic challenge.
title_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫：治療上の課題
summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の治療について述べた短報である。過去40年間で5年生存率は約30%から80%以上へと大きく改善した。治癒を目指しつつ卵巣機能と妊孕性を温存するためには、正確な診断と適切な病期分類が不可欠であると強調している。
summary_en: This short paper addresses ovarian dysgerminoma and notes that 5-year survival has improved markedly over 40 years, from about 30% to more than 80%. The authors emphasize that precise diagnosis and adequate staging are essential to plan treatment that cures the patient while preserving ovarian function and fertility. It frames the therapeutic challenge as balancing cure with quality of life.

title: [A case of testicular tumor with liver metastases maintaining complete remission for a long period].
title_ja: 長期間完全寛解を維持した肝転移を伴う精巣腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 20歳男性の右精巣腫瘍で、肺・肝・後腹膜リンパ節に多発転移を認めた症例報告である。病理は絨毛癌と奇形腫で、血清hCGは170,000 mIU/mlと著明に高値であった。シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節切除、救援化学療法(エトポシド)を行い、hCGは正常化し転移は消失した。37か月間再発はない。肝転移を伴う精巣腫瘍の予後と治療について文献的考察を加えている。
summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 20-year-old man with a right testicular tumor and multiple lung, liver, and retroperitoneal lymph node metastases, with serum hCG of 170,000 mIU/ml. Pathology showed choriocarcinoma and teratoma. Treatment comprised three courses of cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin, retroperitoneal lymph node resection, and three courses of salvage VP-16 (etoposide). hCG normalized and all metastases disappeared, with no recurrence for 37 months. The authors review 29 Japanese cases of testicular tumor with liver metastasis, noting a poor prognosis but potential benefit from combination therapy.

title: Ovarian cortex surrounding benign neoplasms: a histologic study.
title_ja: 良性腫瘍周囲の卵巣皮質に関する組織学的研究
summary_ja: 良性卵巣嚢胞の周囲に圧排された卵巣皮質を組織学的に検討した研究である。成熟奇形腫、良性嚢胞腺腫、子宮内膜症性嚢胞の3群で、濾胞数と血管網を半定量的に評価した。成熟奇形腫の周囲皮質は正常卵巣皮質に近く、腫瘍に関連した間質変化は認められなかった。一方、子宮内膜症性嚢胞では顕微鏡的な間質病変と濾胞数の減少がみられた。成熟奇形腫は隣接卵巣の形態を変化させないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This histologic study examined the ovarian cortex stretched over benign cysts from 48 patients, comparing 13 mature teratomas, nine benign cystadenomas, and 32 endometriomas. Follicle numbers and vascular networks were scored semiquantitatively. Cortex around mature teratomas and cystadenomas resembled normal ovarian cortex in most specimens, with regular vascular networks and no tumor-related stromal change. Endometriomas instead showed microscopic stromal endometriosis and reduced follicles. The authors conclude that mature teratomas do not alter adjacent ovarian cortex morphology, unlike endometriomas.

title: Primary ovarian tumors in the pediatric patient: CT evaluation.
title_ja: 小児の原発性卵巣腫瘍：コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による評価
summary_ja: 小児の原発性卵巣腫瘍のCT所見を検討した研究である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫9例、未熟奇形腫1例、顆粒膜細胞腫2例、未分化小細胞腫瘍1例を対象とした。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫4例は非典型的なCT像を示した。未熟奇形腫は大きく不整でびまん性の石灰化を伴う充実成分により特徴づけられた。悪性腫瘍は大きく、ほぼ充実性か、大きな充実部を伴う多房性であった。
summary_en: This CT study describes primary ovarian tumors in children, including nine mature cystic teratomas, one immature teratoma, two granulosa cell tumors, and one undifferentiated small cell tumor. Four mature cystic teratomas showed atypical CT appearances. The immature teratoma was identified by a large, irregular, diffusely calcified solid component. Malignant tumors were large and almost entirely solid, or multicystic with a large solid component. The findings aim to help radiologists distinguish benign from malignant pediatric ovarian tumors.

title: Infantile choriocarcinoma. Re-examination of a potentially curable entity.
title_ja: 乳児絨毛癌：治癒可能な疾患の再検討
summary_ja: 生後3週の乳児に発生した絨毛癌を、手術と化学療法により治癒させた症例報告である。病理診断まで絨毛癌は疑われなかったが、古典的な乳児絨毛癌症候群に合致した。文献的検討から、中枢神経症状を伴う貧血の乳児や新生児・年長児も含めて定義を拡大すべきとしている。血清β-hCGは全例で陽性であり確定診断に有用である。母体も罹患しうるため、乳児の診断は母体の迅速な評価にもつながる。
summary_en: This report describes a choriocarcinoma successfully treated in a 3-week-old infant, which the authors present as the first such reported success. The diagnosis was not suspected until pathology, although the case fit the classic infantile choriocarcinoma syndrome. Review of additional cases suggests broadening the definition to include anemic infants with central nervous system symptoms, as well as newborns and older children. Aggressive surgery and subsequent chemotherapy were curative. Serum beta-hCG was uniformly positive, aiding confirmation, and because the mother can also be affected, the infant's diagnosis may prompt maternal evaluation.

title: Results of a policy of surveillance in stage I testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対する監視療法の成績
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ148例を精巣摘除後に監視療法で前向きに追跡した研究である。5年無再発率は81%で、再発の多くは傍大動脈リンパ節に生じた。再発の予測因子は診断時年齢のみで、34歳以下で再発率が高かった。晩期再発と救援化学療法の有効性に関するデータが得られるまでは、研究の枠内でのみ監視療法を行うべきと結論している。
summary_en: This prospective study followed 148 patients with clinical Stage I testicular seminoma under surveillance after orchidectomy, without adjuvant treatment. Median follow-up was 47 months, with a 5-year relapse-free rate of 81%. Most relapses occurred in paraaortic nodes, and age at diagnosis was the only prognostic factor, with patients aged 34 or younger having a lower relapse-free rate. The authors recommend that surveillance be performed only within study settings until more data on late relapse and salvage chemotherapy become available.

title: Prognosis of human chorionic gonadotropin-producing seminoma treated by postoperative radiotherapy.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生セミノーマに対する術後放射線療法後の予後
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: hCG高値を示した純粋セミノーマ132例の後方視的解析である。全例が放射線療法を受け、5年全生存期間(全生存率)は94%、5年無再発生存率は94%であった。hCG値が高くても予後は良好で、病期Iおよび病期IIAでは術後放射線療法単独後の再発率が極めて低いと結論された。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 132 patients with pure seminoma and elevated hCG treated with radiotherapy assessed prognosis according to hCG level. Median follow-up was 5 years, and 5-year overall survival was 94%. Five-year recurrence-free survival was 94% overall, 98% in Stage I and 100% in Stage IIA, but lower in IIB and III. Elevated hCG did not appear to worsen prognosis. The authors conclude that in Stage I and IIA seminoma with elevated hCG, recurrence after postoperative radiotherapy alone is extremely low.

title: Renal tolerance to nonhomogenous irradiation: comparison of observed effects to predictions of normal tissue complication probability from different biophysical models.
title_ja: セミノーマ患者における非均一照射に対する腎臓の耐容性：異なる生物物理モデルによる正常組織合併症確率の予測との比較
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1969〜1984年にセミノーマ142例へ傍大動脈照射を行い、腎臓の3次元線量分布を後方視的に再構築した。臨床的な腎障害は7例に生じた。体積ベースの2つの生物物理モデルは実際の影響をよく予測したが、臨界要素モデルは合併症を過大評価した。治療計画への応用が示唆されている。
summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 142 seminoma patients treated with paraaortic irradiation between 1969 and 1984, reconstructing three-dimensional kidney dose distributions. Seven patients developed clinically manifest renal impairment. Two volume-oriented biophysical models closely matched the observed effects, whereas a critical element model overestimated complications. The authors suggest that these volume-based algorithms could be integrated into 3D treatment planning to compare plans on a more biologically based level, if confirmed in other organs.

title: Treatment of stage I testis seminoma by radiotherapy: long-term results--a 30-year experience.
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマの放射線療法による治療：30年間の長期成績
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1956〜1986年に病期I精巣セミノーマ184例を後方視的に検討した。精巣摘除後に平均21Gyの低用量放射線療法を施行し、5年生存率は96%、20年生存率は77%であった。再発は4例のみであった。二次悪性腫瘍は20年で21%に生じ、対側精巣腫瘍6例を含んだ。低用量予防照射は有効かつ安全と結論された。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 184 patients with Stage I testicular seminoma treated from 1956 to 1986 with orchidectomy followed by low-dose adjuvant radiotherapy (mean 21 Gy) to para-aortic and ipsilateral iliac nodes, with mediastinal, supraclavicular, or inguinoscrotal fields in some patients. Actuarial survival was 96% at 5 years and 77% at 20 years, with only four relapses. Second malignancies occurred in 21% of patients by 20 years, including six contralateral testicular tumors. The authors conclude that low-dose prophylactic irradiation is effective and safe.

title: Co-existing leiomyoma and benign cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣における平滑筋腫と嚢胞性奇形腫の併存例
summary_ja: 同一卵巣内に良性嚢胞性奇形腫と平滑筋腫が併存した症例の報告である。平滑筋腫は免疫組織化学染色により確定された。卵巣内で両者が併存することは極めて稀と述べている。治療経過や長期フォローアップの記載は乏しい。
summary_en: The authors describe a case of benign cystic teratoma and leiomyoma coexisting within the same ovary. The leiomyoma was confirmed by immunohistochemical methods. The report notes that the combination of leiomyoma and teratoma in a single ovary is very rare. This brief case report describes an ovarian germ cell tumor (benign mature teratoma) with a coexisting benign non-germ-cell lesion, and it provides little information on treatment or long-term follow-up.

title: Mixed gonadal dysgenesis: endogenous hormonal effects in the endometrium and histogenesis of germinoma.
title_ja: 混合性性腺異形成における内因性ホルモンの子宮内膜への影響とジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）の組織発生
summary_ja: 混合性性腺異形成の2例を報告し、いずれも石灰化結節を含む性腺ジャーミノーマを認めた。内因性性ホルモン値と子宮内膜の変化を関連づけ、1例ではエストロゲン上昇とともに線毛化生と扁平上皮化生が見られた。著者らは、これらのジャーミノーマが性腺芽細胞腫から発生したと結論づけている。性腺胚細胞腫瘍の組織発生を扱う。
summary_en: This 1993 Acta Pathologica Japonica report describes two patients with mixed gonadal dysgenesis, both with gonadal germinomas containing calcified nodules. The authors correlate endogenous sex hormone levels with endometrial changes, including ciliated and squamous metaplasia in one patient with elevated estrogen. They conclude that these germinomas likely arose from gonadoblastoma. The work addresses the histogenesis of gonadal germ cell tumors and their link to dysgenetic gonads, making it directly relevant to germ cell tumor curation.

title: Management of fetal sacroccocygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫の管理
summary_ja: 出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫の管理を、2例の報告を通して検討している。妊娠24週と26週で発見され、いずれも良性で正期産で娩出された。超音波検査によるフォローアップで心不全や水腫などの合併を除外した。両例とも生後3日目に外科的切除を受け、生後1年および1年8か月時点で良好な臨床経過が得られた。
summary_en: This Annals of the Academy of Medicine, Singapore report reviews antenatal management of sacrococcygeal teratoma. Two cases detected at 24 and 26 weeks' gestation were benign, and both were delivered at term, one vaginally and one by elective caesarean section. Close ultrasound follow-up excluded cardiac failure, hydrops, and other anomalies that could alter pregnancy management. Both tumors were surgically resected on the third day after birth with good outcomes at one year and nearly two years. The authors suggest accurate antenatal diagnosis may enable future intrauterine fetal intervention.

title: Thoracotomy in the management of gestational choriocarcinoma. A clinicopathologic study.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の治療における開胸術：臨床病理学的研究
summary_ja: 肺転移を伴う絨毛癌9例に対する11回の開胸術を検討した。多くは化学療法抵抗性の腫瘍巣の外科的切除が目的であった。6例（67%）が完全寛解し、期間は3か月から18年に及んだ。3例は原病で死亡した。耐性結節は細胞栄養膜と合胞体栄養膜の中間的な特徴を示す変異型栄養膜細胞からなり、化学療法感受性が低下していた。選択された症例では、肺絨毛癌の外科的切除が根治につながりうるとしている。
summary_en: This Cancer study reviews nine patients with choriocarcinoma metastatic to the lung who underwent eleven thoracotomies, mostly to resect chemotherapy-resistant tumor foci. Six patients (67%) achieved complete remission, lasting from three months to 18 years, while three died of disease. Histopathology showed resistant nodules composed of large mononucleated cells with features intermediate between cytotrophoblasts and syncytiotrophoblasts, lacking features of placental site tumor intermediate trophoblast. The authors conclude that surgical resection can be curative for selected chemotherapy-resistant pulmonary choriocarcinoma, which contains a variant trophoblast with reduced chemosensitivity.

title: Yolk sac carcinoma of the stomach with gastrin positivity.
title_ja: ガストリン陽性を示した胃の卵黄嚢癌
summary_ja: 胃前庭部の腫瘍を免疫組織化学的に解析し、卵黄嚢癌と判定した。腫瘍はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とガストリンを発現していた。卵黄嚢癌で神経内分泌分化が免疫組織化学的に示された初めての報告であり、生殖腺外の胚細胞腫瘍の組織像の多様性を示す。
summary_en: A gastric antral tumor classified as yolk sac carcinoma was studied immunohistochemically. The tumor expressed alpha-fetoprotein and gastrin. The authors describe it as the first yolk sac carcinoma shown to have neuroendocrine differentiation by immunohistochemistry. The report highlights an unusual extragonadal yolk sac tumor with mixed endocrine features. It adds to understanding of the histologic spectrum of germ cell tumors outside the gonads.

title: Spontaneous ovarian choriocarcinoma, yolk sac carcinoma, and teratoma in B6C3F1 mice: a case report.
title_ja: B6C3F1マウスに自然発生した卵巣絨毛癌・卵黄嚢癌・奇形腫の症例報告
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 2年間の発がん性試験のB6C3F1マウスで、卵巣に絨毛癌、卵黄嚢癌、奇形腫が自然発生した。卵黄嚢癌と奇形腫は同一マウスの左右の卵巣にそれぞれ生じた。これらは化学物質誘発ではなく自然発生と判断された。胚細胞腫瘍様の病変を齧歯類モデルで示した比較病理の報告である。
summary_en: Three spontaneous ovarian neoplasms, choriocarcinoma, yolk sac carcinoma, and teratoma, were identified in B6C3F1 mice during a two-year carcinogenicity study. Yolk sac carcinoma and teratoma occurred in opposite ovaries of one mouse, while the choriocarcinoma arose in a different animal. The lesions were judged spontaneous rather than induced by study compounds. The report documents germ cell-type ovarian tumors in a rodent model, relevant to comparative pathology.

title: Systemic mastocytosis following mediastinal germ cell tumor: an association confirmed.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍後に生じた全身性肥満細胞症：関連性の確認
summary_ja: 縦隔の胎児性癌(卵黄嚢成分を含む)で化学療法と切除を受けた24歳男性が、2年後に全身性肥満細胞症を発症し、8か月後に死亡した。剖検では縦隔腫瘍は残っておらず、肝と脾に肥満細胞の浸潤を認めた。胚細胞腫瘍後の悪性腫瘍との関連を示す症例である。
summary_en: A 24-year-old man with mediastinal embryonal carcinoma containing yolk sac foci received cisplatin-based chemotherapy and resection, with only necrotic tissue found. Two years later he developed systemic mastocytosis with bone marrow infiltration by atypical mast cells, and he died eight months after that diagnosis. Autopsy showed no residual mediastinal tumor but diffuse liver and spleen mast-cell infiltration. The authors describe a second such case and propose a mediastinal germ cell tumor-hematologic malignancy syndrome.

title: Surveillance in patients with stage I testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対するサーベイランス
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の14例をサーベイランスで追跡した。中央値21か月の観察で3例が再発した。再発した2例の肺転移にはPEBまたはPVBによる救援化学療法が完全奏効し、1例はフォローアップ不能であったが、他は生存している。
summary_en: Fourteen patients with clinical stage I testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor were enrolled in a surveillance study. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated in nine patients and beta-hCG in three. Over a median follow-up of 21 months, three relapsed, one with inguinal lymphadenopathy and two with lung metastases. Salvage PEB or PVB chemotherapy produced complete responses in the two patients with lung metastases. All but one patient, who was lost to follow-up, remained alive.

title: Current approaches to diagnosis and treatment of gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断と治療に関する現在のアプローチ
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断と治療を概説するレビューである。診断は血清・尿中hCG測定と組織所見に基づく。胞状奇胎の約92%は除去後に自然寛解し、残りもhCGによる慎重なフォローアップで毒性を抑えて治療可能である。非胞状奇胎性妊娠性絨毛癌は化学療法で高い治癒率を示し、耐性例では手術が救済療法となる。非妊娠性hCG産生腫瘍との鑑別にはDNA解析が有用である。
summary_en: This review summarizes the diagnosis and treatment of gestational trophoblastic disease. Serum and urinary hCG measurements, together with histology, underpin diagnosis. About 92% of hydatidiform moles resolve after evacuation, and the remainder can usually be treated with minimal toxicity through careful hCG follow-up. Non-molar gestational choriocarcinoma is highly curable with chemotherapy, and surgery can salvage drug-resistant cases. DNA analysis can distinguish gestational from nongestational hCG-producing tumors to avoid inappropriate chemotherapy.

title: Adenocarcinoma in a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary: report of a case with a long survival period.
title_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に合併した腺癌：長期生存例の報告
summary_ja: 卵巣の嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)に合併した粘液性腺癌の62歳女性の症例を報告した。組織学的所見から消化管由来が示唆された。手術後に化学療法を受け、15年以上生存している。文献的検討では、長期生存例が多いことも示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 62-year-old woman with mucinous adenocarcinoma arising in a 15 kg benign cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) of the ovary. Histology and immunohistochemistry suggested a gastrointestinal origin. After hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, she received chemotherapy and remained alive more than 15 years later. A literature review found that, although such patients are often thought not to survive, many achieve long-term survival after surgery.

title: Update on malignant ovarian germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の最新情報
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療の進歩を総説している。BEP療法が標準となり無病生存率は95%を超えた。転移性ディスジャーミノーマでは放射線療法に代わり化学療法が第一選択となった。白金製剤耐性例では自家骨髄移植を用いた大量化学療法が検討されている。
summary_en: This review traces advances in managing malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Histologic criteria were standardized, and the bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin regimen became the standard, with disease-free survival above 95%. Chemotherapy has replaced radiation therapy for metastatic dysgerminoma. For platinum-resistant tumors, high-dose therapy with autologous marrow rescue is under study. Most young patients can preserve reproductive potential. Second-look laparotomy should be limited, and secondary debulking may benefit selected patients.

title: Diagnosis and management of gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断と管理
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断と管理を総説した論文である。胞状奇胎除去後はhCGの連続測定と転移の検出で経過観察する。非胞状奇胎後の絨毛癌は転移症状でしか発見できないことが多い。NIHおよびWHOの分類では化学療法への反応性に基づき層別化する。超高リスク群でも約80%は治癒可能である。
summary_en: This article reviews the diagnosis and management of gestational trophoblastic disease, which arises from fetal chorion and produces hCG. Surveillance after molar evacuation relies on serial hCG measurement and detection of metastases. Choriocarcinoma after non-molar pregnancy is detected only by symptoms of metastasis. The NIH and WHO classifications stratify patients by chemotherapy response risk. Although very high-risk patients often have brain or liver metastases or prior chemotherapy, about 80% of them remain curable.

title: High incidence of ectopic nucleolar organizer regions in human testicular tumors.
title_ja: ヒト精巣腫瘍における異所性核小体形成体領域の高頻度出現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍などを対象に核小体形成体領域(NOR)を解析した細胞遺伝学的研究である。胎児性癌2例とセミノーマ2例で異所性NORが活性を示した。異所性NORを持つ腫瘍はすべて過二倍体で、典型的な腫瘍マーカー染色体を有していた。異所性NORは精巣腫瘍に普遍的とされた。
summary_en: This cytogenetic study examined nucleolar organizer regions (NORs) in eight primary testicular germ cell tumors, a teratocarcinoma cell line, and a Leydig cell tumor. Active ectopic NORs were found in two embryonal carcinomas and in single cells of two seminomas. All tumors with ectopic NORs were hyperdiploid and carried typical germ cell tumor marker chromosomes. Quantitative DNA analysis confirmed hyperdiploidy in three tumors. The authors conclude that active ectopic NORs are common in human testicular tumors.

title: Management of the postchemotherapy residual mass.
title_ja: 化学療法後残存腫瘤の管理
summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後の残存腫瘤に対する手術の役割を検討したレビューである。組織型により方針が異なり、非セミノーマ性腫瘍では画像で完全寛解でも残存腫瘍のリスクがある。セミノーマでは残存腫瘤の大きさが悪性例の選別に役立つ。治療毒性を抑えるため、より正確な選択基準の開発が必要である。
summary_en: This urology review examines surgery for residual masses after chemotherapy in advanced germ-cell tumors. Management depends on histology: seminoma and nonseminomatous tumors call for different approaches. Criteria for selecting nonseminomatous patients whose surgical pathology will be negative carry substantial error. A normal radiographic evaluation does not reliably predict negative pathology. For seminoma, residual size guides more accurate selection of patients who still harbor malignancy. Better selection criteria are needed to limit treatment toxicity.

title: Management of advanced and extragonadal germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 進行性および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の管理
summary_ja: 進行性および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の管理を総説している。シスプラチン併用化学療法の後に残存腫瘍や奇形腫を切除するのが基本である。治療失敗の主因は大きな腫瘍と切除不能な残存奇形腫である。65〜70%以上が無病となるため積極的な集学的治療が推奨される。イホスファミドや自家骨髄移植の臨床試験が進行中である。
summary_en: This urology review covers management of advanced and extragonadal germ-cell tumors. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy followed by resection of residual disease or teratoma is standard. Failure is mainly due to bulky disease and unresectable residual teratoma, and chemoresistant non-germ-cell elements may also contribute. More than 65% to 70% of these patients can be rendered disease-free, so aggressive multimodality therapy is warranted. Trials of ifosfamide and autologous bone marrow transplantation are ongoing.

title: Prognostic features of primary and metastatic testis germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 原発性および転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の予後因子
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理組織学的解析が予後判定に重要であることを論じた総説です。原発巣と転移巣を含め、予後に関わる各組織型の特徴を整理しています。また、組織検体の採取や病理検査で予後評価を誤らせうる落とし穴についても検討しています。病理医が予後層別化に果たす役割も強調しています。
summary_en: This review describes how careful histopathologic analysis of testicular germ cell tumors provides important prognostic information. The author outlines the histologic features of the various germ cell tumor subtypes that carry prognostic implications, covering both primary and metastatic lesions. The paper also discusses pitfalls in sampling and examining tissue specimens that can affect prognostic assessment, emphasizing the pathologist's role in risk stratification for patients with these tumors.

title: Surveillance versus nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in stage I nonseminomatous germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における経過観察と神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清の比較
summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し、経過観察と神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清を比較した論文です。4年を超える再発率の情報が乏しい点や、救援化学療法の長期的影響、潜在性病変が数年後に顕在化する可能性を指摘しています。低リスク組織像で信頼できる患者では、経過観察が侵襲や合併症を抑えつつ高い生存率を得られると論じています。
summary_en: This article compares active surveillance with nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. It notes that long-term relapse data beyond four years are limited, along with the long-term effects of salvage chemotherapy and the possibility that subclinical disease manifests years later. The authors argue that for reliable patients with low-risk histology, surveillance offers high survival with less intervention and lower morbidity, while acknowledging that treatment must be individualized.

title: Intratubular germ cell neoplasia in an infantile testis with immature teratoma.
title_ja: 未熟奇形腫を伴う乳児精巣における精細管内胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 正常位に降下した精巣を持つ生後8か月の男児で、未熟奇形腫に隣接する精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を報告した症例報告です。乳児精巣内の病変パターンは成人と異なっていましたが、形態学的・免疫組織化学的所見は類似していました。未熟奇形腫との併存は過去に報告がなく、腫瘍発生の違いを示唆する可能性がありますが、確認には症例の蓄積が必要だとしています。
summary_en: This case report describes intratubular germ cell neoplasia adjacent to an immature teratoma in an 8-month-old boy with normally descended testes. The pattern of neoplasia in the infantile testis appeared different from that in adults, although the abnormal cells resembled adult ones morphologically and immunohistochemically. The authors note that previous studies had found intratubular neoplasia with yolk sac tumour and mature teratoma but not with immature teratoma, suggesting possible differences in tumour development, while acknowledging that more cases are needed to confirm this.

title: Gonadal dysgerminoma-seminoma associated with severe hypercalcemia.
title_ja: 重度の高カルシウム血症を伴う性腺ディスジャーミノーマ・セミノーマ
summary_ja: 46,XYの核型を持つ25歳の表現型女性で、転移を伴う性腺ディスジャーミノーマ・セミノーマと重症高カルシウム血症を呈した症例報告です。高カルシウム血症は傍腫瘍症候群によるもので、外照射により改善しました。照射後の開腹術で、異形成性性腺から生じた性腺芽細胞腫が確認され、性分化疾患における胚細胞腫瘍との関連が示されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype who had metastatic gonadal dysgerminoma-seminoma complicated by severe hypercalcemia, a paraneoplastic syndrome. Her adnexal gonads were calcified, and external beam radiation therapy resolved the hypercalcemia. Exploratory laparotomy after irradiation revealed gonadoblastoma arising from dysgenetic gonads, highlighting the association between dysgenetic gonads, gonadoblastoma and germ cell tumor in patients with disorders of sex development.
