Modified resection preserved antegrade ejaculation more often and did not appear to compromise oncologic outcome.

title: Germ cell tumors of the head and neck: report from the MAKEI Study Group.
title_ja: 頭頸部胚細胞腫瘍：MAKEI研究グループの報告
summary_ja: MAKEI研究グループによる頭頸部胚細胞腫瘍32例の解析。大半は出生前後に診断され、奇形腫が中心で一部に卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を認めた。気道閉塞を呈する巨大腫瘍が多く、周産期の気道管理が重要であった。再発は不完全切除例で多く、完全切除の重要性が示された。専門施設での多職種治療により、転帰は概ね良好であった。
summary_en: This MAKEI study group report analyzes 32 prospectively followed patients with germ cell tumors of the head and neck, most diagnosed around birth. Most were teratomas, with yolk sac tumor components in some. Tumors often caused airway obstruction and required early airway management. Relapse was more frequent after incomplete resection (5 of 10) than complete resection (1 of 16). Eight patients received chemotherapy, and one patient with yolk sac tumor died after multiple relapses. The authors conclude that multidisciplinary care at specialized centers, with prenatal ultrasound detection and planned delivery, yields favorable outcomes.

title: "Exterritorial" lymphocytic hypophysitis within an ovarian teratoma during pregnancy: a possible sentinel lesion?
title_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣奇形腫内に生じた「異所性」リンパ球性下垂体炎：前兆病変の可能性
summary_ja: 妊娠19週の30歳女性の成熟卵巣奇形腫内に、異所性の下垂体組織と、リンパ球性下垂体炎に類似した炎症を認めた症例報告。炎症は下垂体組織に限局していた。著者らは、これが妊娠に伴うリンパ球性下垂体炎の前兆病変（sentinel lesion）である可能性を提唱している。
summary_en: This case report describes lymphocytic hypophysitis arising within a mature left ovarian teratoma in a 30-year-old woman at 19 weeks of gestation. The cyst wall contained a miniature anterior pituitary with normal hormone-producing cell types, pregnancy-related lactotroph hyperplasia, and prominent T- and B-cell inflammation with parenchymal destruction. No inflammation was seen elsewhere. The authors suggest this ectopic pituitary inflammation may be a preclinical sentinel lesion for classic lymphocytic hypophysitis, which occurs in pregnancy. It is the second reported organ-specific inflammatory process within an ovarian teratoma after lymphocytic thyroiditis.

title: Investigation of soluble HER2 and transforming growth factor Beta-1 serum levels in gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における血清可溶性HER2およびTGF-β1レベル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患95例と妊娠・非妊娠対照の血清中可溶性HER2およびTGF-β1をELISAで比較した研究。s-HER2に群間差はなかったが、TGF-β1はGTD患者で有意に高値であった（P<0.001）。TGF-β1は潜在的な予後マーカーとなりうるが、更なる大規模な検討が必要とされる。
summary_en: This study measured serum soluble HER2 and TGF-β1 by ELISA in 95 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease (55 complete moles, 32 persistent moles, 8 choriocarcinomas), 30 pregnant controls, and 22 non-pregnant controls. Serum s-HER2 did not differ between groups. TGF-β1 was significantly higher in GTD patients than in both control groups (P<0.001). The authors propose that serum TGF-β1 may serve as a potential prognostic marker in GTD, while noting that larger studies with more frequent sampling are needed to confirm this.

title: Malignant histiocytoses/disseminated histiocytic sarcoma with hemophagocytic syndrome in a patient with mediastinal germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に合併した悪性組織球症・播種性組織球性肉腫と血球貪食症候群
summary_ja: 縦隔の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する24歳男性が、化学療法中に血球貪食症候群を発症しました。重度の血小板減少のため脾摘が行われ、悪性組織球症に合致する所見が得られました。免疫染色ではCD68、CD163などが陽性でした。治療抵抗性で、診断から5か月後に死亡しています。
summary_en: A 24-year-old man with an anterior mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor developed hemophagocytic syndrome involving bone marrow and liver during chemotherapy. Severe thrombocytopenia and bleeding led to splenectomy, which showed erythrophagocytosis and atypical histiocytes consistent with malignant histiocytosis. Immunophenotyping showed CD68, CD163, CD4, CD45 and S-100 positivity. Cytogenetics were negative for i(12p). Despite therapy, the patient was refractory and died five months after diagnosis.

title: Is increased body mass index associated with the incidence of testicular germ cell cancer?
title_ja: 体格指数（BMI）は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症率と関連するか
summary_ja: ドイツの全国規模の症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者8,498例とBMIを比較しました。全体では差はありませんでしたが、18〜29歳の若年男性では過体重と肥満が患者に有意に多く見られました。既報19編の結果は一致していません。非セミノーマとセミノーマで発症経路が異なる可能性も示唆されています。
summary_en: This nationwide German case-control study compared body mass index in 8,498 testicular germ cell cancer patients with 2,070 age-matched population controls. Overall BMI distribution did not differ, but in men aged 18–29 years, overweight and obese categories were significantly more frequent among patients. A literature review of 19 prior studies gave mixed results. The authors suggest nutritional factors may contribute to pathogenesis and that differing BMI associations may reflect divergent pathways for nonseminoma and seminoma.

title: The quagmire of hCG and hCG testing in gynecologic oncology.
title_ja: 腫瘍マーカーとしてのヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の混乱：婦人科腫瘍学における検査
summary_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍と妊娠性絨毛性疾患における腫瘍マーカーとしてのhCGを総説した論文です。過グリコシル化hCGは侵入奇胎と侵入性絨毛癌の指標となります。遊離βサブユニットやβコアフラグメントは多くの卵巣・子宮内膜・子宮頸部悪性腫瘍で産生されます。妊娠がなく明らかな悪性腫瘍もない低値陽性の診断にも言及しています。
summary_en: This comprehensive review examines human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) as a tumor marker in gynecologic malignancies and gestational trophoblastic disease. It distinguishes regular hCG from hyperglycosylated hCG, an absolute marker of invasive mole and invasive choriocarcinoma, and from the free beta-subunit and beta-core fragment, produced by many ovarian, endometrial and cervical cancers. The authors also address diagnostic confusion from persistent low-positive hCG without pregnancy or obvious malignancy, offering guidance for diagnosis and management.

title: Cell-free circulating DNA: diagnostic value in patients with testicular germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における血清遊離DNA：診断的意義
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者74例と健常者35例の血清中遊離DNAをリアルタイムPCRで測定した研究です。遊離DNA量とDNAの完全性は、感度87%、特異度97%で癌患者と健常者を区別しました。従来の腫瘍マーカーが正常な患者でも有用でした。臨床病期III期で上昇が多く、従来のマーカーが上昇しない症例での補助的な指標として期待されます。
summary_en: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) was measured in serum from 74 patients with testicular germ cell cancer (39 seminoma, 35 nonseminoma) and 35 healthy controls, using real-time PCR for actin-beta fragments of 106, 193 and 384 bp, with DNA integrity expressed as the large-to-short ratio. cfDNA levels and integrity distinguished cancer from controls with 87% sensitivity and 97% specificity, and remained useful in patients with normal serum tumor markers. Levels were higher in stage 3 disease, suggesting value where conventional markers are not elevated.

title: Preservation of ejaculation in patients undergoing nerve-sparing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic testicular cancer.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する神経温存化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の射精機能の回復
summary_ja: 本研究は1995年から2005年に非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた341例を後方視的に検討しました。神経温存例136例のうち79%で順行性射精が保たれました。右側精巣腫瘍と5cm以上の残存腫瘤は逆行性射精と関連し、5年再発フリー生存率は98%でした。
summary_en: This institutional retrospective review examined 341 patients who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors between 1995 and 2005, including 136 nerve-sparing procedures. Antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 79% of evaluable patients. Right-sided primary testicular tumors and residual masses of 5 cm or larger were associated with retrograde ejaculation on multivariate analysis. Five-year relapse-free survival was 98%, suggesting nerve-sparing dissection offers functional and oncologic benefit in selected patients.

title: Increased expression and nuclear localization of the centrosomal kinase Nek2 in human testicular seminomas.
title_ja: ヒト精巣セミノーマにおける中心体キナーゼNek2の発現増加と核内局在
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト精巣セミノーマにおいて中心体キナーゼNek2が正常精巣や他の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に比べて高発現することを示しました。キナーゼ活性も上昇しており、腫瘍細胞ではNek2が主に核内に局在していました。Nek2の過剰発現は中心体の制御異常を介して腫瘍化に寄与する可能性があります。
summary_en: This study shows that the centrosomal kinase Nek2 is upregulated in human testicular seminomas compared with normal testes and other testicular germ cell tumor types. Kinase activity was also increased in seminoma samples. Immunohistochemistry revealed predominantly nuclear Nek2 in neoplastic cells, a feature confirmed in the Tcam-2 seminoma line. Nuclear Nek2 also marked undifferentiated mouse germ cells expressing OCT4 and PLZF. The authors propose that Nek2 overexpression may contribute to centrosome deregulation and neoplastic transformation in seminoma.

title: 3q27 aberrations in a childhood ovary teratoma with associated malignant germ cell component.
title_ja: 小児卵巣奇形腫における3q27異常（悪性胚細胞成分を伴う症例）
summary_ja: 8歳女児の卵巣奇形腫（悪性胚細胞成分の卵黄嚢腫瘍を伴う）の細胞遺伝学的所見を報告。GTGバンディングで3q27領域の異常を認め、同領域には複数のがんでLOHが報告されていることから、腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在が示唆されている。単一症例の報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes cytogenetic findings in an 8-year-old girl with an ovarian teratoma containing a malignant germ cell (yolk sac) component. GTG-banding revealed a karyotype with a t(3;20)(q27;q13.3) clone and a del(3)(q27) clone alongside normal cells. Prior studies found frequent loss of heterozygosity at 3q27-q28 across several cancers, and the authors suggest this region harbors tumor suppressor genes. Because the findings come from a single patient, they should be regarded as hypothesis-generating.

title: Risk of cancer in first- and second-degree relatives of testicular germ cell tumor cases and controls.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者と対照における第一度・第二度近親者のがんリスク
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者738例と対照904例の家族歴を用いて、血縁者の悪性腫瘍リスクを検討。症例の第一度近親者では全悪性腫瘍リスクが上昇（RR 1.17）し、特に母方親族で消化管がんや男性生殖器がんが増加していた。精巣腫瘍患者の家族には、がんの集積がある可能性が示唆される。
summary_en: Using family history data from 738 TGCT cases and 904 controls in the STEED study, this paper examines cancer risk among first- and second-degree relatives. First-degree relatives of cases had an elevated overall cancer risk compared with controls (RR 1.17). The increase was driven largely by maternal relatives, with significantly higher risks of digestive tract cancer and male genital organ cancer. Paternal relatives showed reduced lung cancer risk. The findings suggest cancer aggregates within families of men with testicular germ cell tumors, though causal mechanisms remain unclear.

title: Laparoscopic management of mature cystic teratoma of the ovary with multiple intracystic floating spherules.
title_ja: 多数の嚢胞内遊離小球を伴う卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔鏡下治療
summary_ja: 32歳未経妊女性の卵巣腫瘍に多数の嚢胞内遊離小球を認めた症例報告。血清扁平上皮癌抗原の上昇を認め、腹腔鏡補助下左卵管卵巣摘出術が施行された。病理診断は著明な落屑性角化を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、画像所見が腹腔鏡下治療の方針決定に寄与した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old nulliparous woman with a large ovarian cystic mass containing multiple intracystic floating spherules. Serum squamous cell carcinoma antigen was elevated. She underwent laparoscopic-assisted left salpingo-oophorectomy, and histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma with marked desquamative keratin formations. The authors emphasize that careful imaging evaluation identified this rare pattern, enabling successful laparoscopic management of the mature cystic teratoma.

title: TPD52, a candidate gene from genomic studies, is overexpressed in testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: ゲノム研究で同定された候補遺伝子TPD52は精巣胚細胞腫瘍で過剰発現する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の2つのゲノム解析研究を比較し、両者に共通する17遺伝子を同定。そのうちTPD52に注目し、免疫組織化学で検討した。TPD52は正常胚細胞や精細管内胚細胞腫瘍ではほぼ陰性で、セミノーマや胎児性癌の約3分の2で陽性だった。精巣腫瘍の発生への関与が示唆される。
summary_en: This study integrates two genome-wide studies of testicular germ cell tumors to identify 17 genes common to both datasets, including TPD52, JUB, NRXN3, C11orf70, and CADM1. Immunohistochemistry on a tissue microarray showed TPD52 protein absent in normal germ cells and most intratubular germ cell neoplasias. TPD52 was expressed in about two-thirds of seminomas and embryonal carcinomas, with intermediate frequencies in non-seminomas. The results suggest TPD52 overexpression is a candidate contributor to testicular germ cell tumorigenesis.

title: Stage I testicular seminoma: management and controversies.
title_ja: 臨床病期I精巣セミノーマの管理と論争点
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の臨床病期I精巣セミノーマに対する管理法（放射線療法、サーベイランス、カルボプラチン化学療法）を概説したレビュー。標準治療は放射線療法だが、晩期合併症が課題。サーベイランスの再発率は15〜20%と高い。いずれも高い治癒率を示し、毒性と患者の希望を考慮して選択すべきとされる。
summary_en: This review examines management options for clinical stage I testicular seminoma after orchiectomy, including adjuvant radiotherapy, surveillance, and single-agent carboplatin chemotherapy. Adjuvant irradiation of infradiaphragmatic nodes remains standard, with relapse rates of 3-4%, but late complications such as cardiotoxicity and second malignancies are concerns. Surveillance has higher relapse rates of 15-20%. Carboplatin offers survival comparable to radiotherapy, but long-term relapse and toxicity data are incomplete. The authors conclude that all three approaches achieve high cure rates and that toxicity and patient preference should guide decisions.

title: Early evaluation of the effects of chemotherapy with longitudinal FDG small-animal PET in human testicular cancer xenografts: early flare response does not reflect refractory disease.
title_ja: 精巣がん異種移植片に対する化学療法の早期評価におけるFDG PET：早期フレア反応は難治性疾患を反映しない
journal: Eur J Nucl Med Mol Imaging
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣がんの異種移植モデル(胎児性癌)において、シスプラチン投与後の早期治療効果をFDG PETで評価した前臨床研究である。FDG取り込みは2日目に一過性に上昇したが、これは細胞周期停止とアポトーシスによるもので、治療抵抗性を示すものではなかった。臨床では、PET上の早期の一過性の集積上昇を治療失敗と誤認しないよう留意すべきことを示唆している。
summary_en: This study used small-animal FDG PET to track early chemotherapy response in nude rats bearing human embryonal carcinoma xenografts treated with cisplatin. FDG uptake peaked on day 2 and fell by day 7, even though tumour volume remained stable. The early rise reflected transient cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis rather than refractory disease, suggesting that an early PET flare should not be read as treatment failure in testicular cancer.

title: Non-germ cell tumours arising in germ cell tumours (teratoma with malignant transformation) in men: CT and MR findings.
title_ja: 悪性転化を伴う奇形腫(TMT)の男性例におけるCTおよびMRI所見：非胚細胞性悪性成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 非胚細胞性悪性成分を伴う奇形腫(TMT)の男性14例を後方視的に検討し、CT・MRI所見の特徴を記述した研究である。肉腫が最も多く、大半の症例でリンパ節転移または遠隔転移がみられた。悪性転化を示唆する画像所見として、不均一に造影される軟部腫瘤、骨化性腫瘤、腹膜結節などが挙げられた。TMTは通常の胚細胞腫瘍に比べ予後が不良であり、早期の生検が重要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 14 men with germ cell tumours containing non-germ cell malignant components (teratoma with malignant transformation, TMT) describes CT and MRI findings. Sarcomas predominated, and most patients had nodal or distant metastases. Imaging clues included heterogeneously enhancing soft-tissue masses, ossified masses, and peritoneal nodules. Nine patients relapsed, and only four were alive at follow-up, indicating a poorer prognosis than for pure germ cell tumours.

title: Non-palpable testicular embryonal carcinoma diagnosed by ultrasound: a case report.
title_ja: 超音波検査で診断された触知不能な精巣胎児性癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 陰嚢超音波検査で発見された24歳男性の触知不能な精巣腫瘍の症例報告である。根治的精巣摘除術により、セミノーマと胎児性癌の混合腫瘍と診断された。術後1か月でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇し、CTで多発転移が確認された。全身化学療法によりAFPは正常化し転移は消失し、18か月のフォローアップで再発はなかった。
summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man whose non-palpable testicular tumour was detected by scrotal ultrasound. Radical orchiectomy revealed a mixed seminoma and embryonal carcinoma. Serum AFP rose after surgery, and CT showed multiple metastases one month later. Three courses of chemotherapy normalised AFP and cleared the metastases, with no recurrence at 18 months. The authors discuss the diagnostic implications of non-palpable testicular tumours.

title: Cryptorchidism and testicular cancer: separating fact from fiction.
title_ja: 停留精巣と精巣がん：事実と俗説の検証
summary_ja: MEDLINEの文献をもとに、停留精巣と精巣がんに関する5つの通説を検証しました。停留精巣では精巣がんのリスクが約2.75～8倍となり、12歳以降の固定術や未施行で危険性が高まります。持続性停留精巣ではセミノーマが多く、矯正例では非セミノーマが多いとしています。
summary_en: This review examines five common assumptions about cryptorchidism and testicular cancer using a MEDLINE literature search. Cryptorchidism raises testicular cancer risk by about 2.75 to 8 times, and orchiopexy after age 12 or no orchiopexy increases risk compared with prepubertal orchiopexy. Persistently cryptorchid testes are more likely to develop seminoma, while corrected cases more often become nonseminomatous. The authors suggest orchiectomy may be considered in selected patients aged 12 to 50 years.

title: Estimating the risk of cancer associated with imaging related radiation during surveillance for stage I testicular cancer using computerized tomography.
title_ja: 病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の監視中のCT検査に伴うがんリスクの推定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣がん監視で用いられるCT検査による生涯の発がんリスクを推定しました。標準化されたファントムを用いたモンテカルロ法で臓器被曝量を算出しています。5年間の監視で、18歳では約52人に1人、40歳では約63人に1人の生涯リスクとなり、胸部CTを加えるとさらに上昇します。
summary_en: This study estimated the lifetime cancer risk from radiation exposure during CT surveillance after stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis. Using Monte Carlo simulation in a standardized phantom male, organ doses were calculated and risks were estimated. Following a 5-year National Comprehensive Cancer Network protocol, lifetime risk ranged from 1 in 52 at age 18 to 1 in 63 at age 40, rising with chest CT. Surveillance carried a relative secondary malignancy risk of about 15.2 compared with a single scan after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

title: Mucinous adenocarcinoma arising in ovarian mature cystic teratoma in pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠中に卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した粘液性腺癌
summary_ja: 帝王切開時に偶然発見された、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の粘液性腺癌の症例報告。被膜浸潤を伴いIC期と診断され、補助化学療法を受けた。24か月以上無再発である。妊娠中の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化としては英文文献で3例目とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old pregnant woman in whom a mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma was found incidentally during cesarean section. Oophorectomy revealed capsule invasion. The patient was staged as IC and received adjuvant chemotherapy, and she remained disease-free for over 24 months. The authors report this as the third case of malignant transformation of a mature cystic teratoma during pregnancy in the English literature.

title: Human chorionic gonadotropin and associated molecules.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)および関連分子
summary_ja: hCGの3種の分子（通常型hCG、過剰糖鎖型hCG、遊離βサブユニット）と、その測定法の特徴を解説した総説。絨毛癌や精巣胚細胞腫瘍などで産生される変異体の多くは、市販の多くの検査で検出されない。妊娠性絨毛性疾患や胚細胞腫瘍の管理における検査の重要性も述べられている。
summary_en: This review examines human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and its molecular variants: regular hCG, hyperglycosylated hCG, and the free beta-subunit. Each variant is produced by different cell types and in different malignancies, including choriocarcinoma and testicular germ cell tumors. The authors note that most commercial assays detect only regular hCG, which may cause test errors in malignancy. They also discuss clinical uses in early pregnancy and in managing gestational trophoblastic disease and germ cell tumors.

title: Testicular microlithiasis preceding metastatic mixed germ cell tumor--first pediatric report and recommended management of testicular microlithiasis in the pediatric population.
title_ja: 転移性混合型胚細胞腫瘍に先行した精巣微小石灰化：小児における初の報告と管理の推奨
summary_ja: 以前の超音波検査で精巣微小石灰化を指摘されていた16歳男児が、転移性混合型胚細胞腫瘍を発症した症例報告。半年ごとの受診の合間に自己触診で発見され、肺病変とβ-hCG高値を認めた。小児の精巣微小石灰化では、診察、自己触診の指導、超音波検査を含む年1回の監視を推奨している。
summary_en: This report describes a 16-year-old boy who developed metastatic mixed germ cell testicular tumor after testicular microlithiasis had been detected on earlier ultrasonography. The tumor appeared between semiannual visits and was found by self-examination, with lung lesions and elevated beta-hCG at presentation. The authors present this as the first pediatric report of this association. They recommend annual surveillance for boys with testicular microlithiasis, including physical examination, repeated self-examination instruction, and ultrasonography.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratomas: prenatal surveillance, growth and pregnancy outcome.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫：出生前サーベイランス、発育および妊娠転帰
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫（SCT）を有する胎児23例の後方視的検討。出生前診断、経過観察、分娩、出生後早期の転帰を報告した。腫瘍サイズが産科的リスクと分娩様式を規定し、週150cm³を超える急速な増大は周産期死亡の上昇と関連した。周産期死亡率は約43%であった。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 23 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) reports prenatal diagnosis, surveillance, delivery and early neonatal outcomes. Cardiac output failure requires serial evaluation. Tumor size determines obstetric risk and delivery mode, and growth exceeding about 150 cm3 per week was associated with higher perinatal mortality. Maternal complications were mainly polyhydramnios and preterm labor. Perinatal mortality was approximately 43%, and maternal-fetal surgery was infrequent.

title: Germ cell tumors of the gonads: a selective review emphasizing problems in drug resistance and current therapy options.
title_ja: 性腺の胚細胞腫瘍：薬剤耐性と現行治療法に焦点を当てた選択的総説
summary_ja: 精巣・卵巣などの性腺胚細胞腫瘍について、薬剤耐性と現行治療に焦点を当てた選択的総説。診断時に約40%が転移を有するが、シスプラチンを基盤とした多剤化学療法で高い治癒率が得られ、耐性は稀である。化学療法感受性の理論的背景と今後の治療展望を整理した。
summary_en: This selective review addresses germ cell tumors of the gonads, the most common malignancy in men under 50. About 40% are metastatic at diagnosis, but cisplatin-based polychemotherapy cures most patients, and resistance is rare. The authors summarize theoretical explanations for this chemosensitivity, including molecular features of malignant germ cell tumor cells and patient immunological and nonimmunological responses. They also discuss emerging therapeutic prospects.

title: Percutaneous laser ablation of sacrococcygeal teratoma in a hydropic fetus with severe heart failure--too late for a surgical procedure?
title_ja: 重篤な心不全を伴う水腫胎児の仙尾部奇形腫に対する経皮的レーザー焼灼術：外科的処置には遅すぎたか
summary_ja: 胎児水腫と重症心不全を伴う巨大充実性仙尾部奇形腫の妊娠24週症例。超音波ドップラー検査で同定した大血管に経皮的レーザー焼灼を施行したが、重度貧血を合併し2日後に胎児死亡した。外科的胎児治療は遅すぎる可能性があり、28週未満では貧血と心不全に対する胎児治療が選択肢になりうると考察した。
summary_en: The authors report a giant solid sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) with fetal hydrops and severe heart failure at 24 weeks of gestation. 2D and 3D Doppler ultrasonography showed great vessels arising from the medial sacral artery, which were ablated percutaneously by laser. Severe fetal anemia (hemoglobin 4.3 g/dl) was found during the procedure. The fetus died two days later, and pathology showed tumor necrosis and hemorrhage. The authors suggest that fetal surgery may be too late in such cases, and that treating anemia and heart failure may be preferable before 28 weeks.

title: Anaesthetic management of a child presenting with intrapericardial teratoma compressing the airway and the heart.
title_ja: 気道と心臓を圧迫した心膜内奇形腫の乳児に対する麻酔管理
summary_ja: 生後1か月の男児が、気道と心臓を圧迫する心膜内奇形腫で緊急受診した。麻酔および外科的管理により腫瘤を切除し、術後経過は順調であった。病理組織学的に稀な心膜内奇形腫と確認され、術後1年以上のフォローアップが行われた。縦隔外の胚細胞腫瘍として、乳児では稀な症例である。
summary_en: A one-month-old boy presented emergently with an intrapericardial teratoma compressing the airway and heart, causing respiratory and cardiac compromise. Prompt anaesthetic and surgical management allowed successful resection and an uneventful recovery. Histopathology confirmed a rarely occurring intrapericardial teratoma, which poses diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. Clinical follow-up exceeded one year after surgery. Such extragonadal germ cell tumors are uncommon in infants.

title: Bilateral benign non functional struma ovarii with Pseudo-Meigs' syndrome.
title_ja: 偽Meigs症候群を伴う両側性良性非機能性卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 70歳の閉経後女性が腹水と両側胸水、CA-125上昇を呈し、卵巣悪性腫瘍が疑われた。手術で両側性の良性非機能性卵巣甲状腺腫（奇形腫の特殊型）と診断され、偽Meigs症候群を伴っていた。腫瘤切除により腹水・胸水は速やかに消失し、CA-125も低下した。両側発生の稀少性と悪性腫瘍との鑑別の難しさを示す症例である。
summary_en: A 70-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with ascites, bilateral pleural effusion and elevated CA-125, initially suspicious for ovarian malignancy. Surgery revealed bilateral benign non-functional struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma, with Pseudo-Meigs' syndrome. Excision resolved the ascites and pleural effusion and lowered CA-125. The report highlights the rarity of bilateral involvement and the diagnostic pitfall of mimicking malignancy.

title: Isolation of three stem cell lines from human sacrococcygeal teratomas.
title_ja: ヒト仙尾部奇形腫からの3株の幹細胞株の樹立
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫は新生児の良性腫瘍で、出生直後の手術適応となる。著者らは3例の仙尾部奇形腫から、nanog・Oct4・stellaを発現しαフェトプロテイン(AFP)やCEAが陰性の幹細胞株を3株樹立した。これらは神経、骨、軟骨へ分化し、ヌードマウスで奇形腫を形成した。腫瘍は原始線条の遺残に由来すると考えられ、ヒト胚性幹細胞に代わる細胞源となり得る。
summary_en: Sacrococcygeal teratomas are benign newborn tumours requiring surgery directly after birth. The authors isolated three stem cell lines from three SCTs, expressing nanog, Oct4 and stella while lacking alpha-fetoprotein and CEA. The cells differentiated into neuronal, osteogenic and chondrogenic lineages and formed teratomas in nude mice. They suggest SCTs derive from primitive streak remnants and that these cells may offer an ethical alternative to human embryonic stem cells.

title: Recurrence of pulmonary embolism in young man with retroperitoneal tumor despite insertion of temporary IVC filter.
title_ja: 一時的下大静脈フィルター留置後に再発した肺塞栓症：後腹膜転移性絨毛癌の若年男性例
summary_ja: 21歳男性が、下大静脈を閉塞する後腹膜腫瘍により肺塞栓症を発症した。血栓溶解療法とヘパリン投与で症状は一時改善したが、手術前日に留置した一時的IVCフィルター後8時間で致死的な大量肺塞栓が生じた。剖検で腫瘍は転移性絨毛癌と判明し、予防的フィルターが逆に再発を誘発した可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: A 21-year-old man developed pulmonary embolism from a retroperitoneal tumor obstructing the inferior vena cava. Thrombolysis and heparin partially improved his symptoms before urgent resection. Despite a temporary IVC filter placed the day before surgery, fatal massive PE occurred eight hours later. Autopsy identified the tumor as metastatic choriocarcinoma, suggesting that the prophylactic filter may paradoxically have precipitated the recurrent embolism.

title: Immunohistochemical studies of trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 栄養膜腫瘍の免疫組織化学的研究
summary_ja: 中間型栄養膜腫瘍（ITT）は絨毛癌と治療方針が異なるが、頸部癌と混同されやすい。15例のITT、11例の絨毛癌、10例の頸部癌を免疫組織化学的に解析した。CD10、HLA-G、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の組み合わせがITTの同定に有用で、CK5/6は頸部癌との鑑別に役立つ。一方、ITTと絨毛癌は免疫表現型が類似し、免疫組織化学のみでは区別できなかった。
summary_en: Intermediate trophoblastic tumors (ITTs) require different therapy from choriocarcinoma, yet they are easily confused with cervical carcinoma. The authors immunophenotyped 15 ITTs, 11 choriocarcinomas and 10 cervical carcinomas. CD10, HLA-G and hCG together aid ITT identification, and CK5/6 helps separate ITT from cervical carcinoma. However, ITT and choriocarcinoma share similar immunophenotypes and cannot be distinguished by immunohistochemistry alone.

title: Ruptured ovarian teratoma presenting as peritonitis.
title_ja: 破裂した卵巣奇形腫が腹膜炎として発症した症例
summary_ja: 55歳女性が急性腹膜炎で受診し、緊急開腹術で膿性腹水と左卵巣の穿孔を伴う8×6cmの厚壁嚢腫が確認された。腹腔洗浄と左卵巣摘出術が行われ、術後経過は良好だった。病理組織学的に卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。卵巣奇形腫の破裂が外科的急腹症として発症しうることを示す症例である。
summary_en: A 55-year-old woman presented with acute peritonitis caused by a perforated left ovarian cyst. Emergency laparotomy showed purulent peritoneal fluid, and an 8 by 6 cm thick-walled cyst with a minute perforation was found in the left ovary. Peritoneal lavage and left oophorectomy were performed, with smooth recovery. Histopathology confirmed a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. The report illustrates that a ruptured ovarian teratoma can present as a surgical abdominal emergency.

title: Multifocality in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における多巣性
summary_ja: 精巣摘除標本145例を後方視的に検討し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍における多巣性の頻度を評価した。多巣性は全体の33%に認められ、腫瘍径が小さい例やセミノーマ組織型で多かった。腫瘍径2cm以下の症例では63%に多巣性がみられた。臓器温存手術の適応となりうる症例にも、潜在的な浸潤病変が存在する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 145 consecutive orchiectomy specimens examined multifocality in testicular germ cell tumors, defined by distinct foci, microinvasion, extratumoral vascular invasion, or rete testis invasion. Multifocality was found in 33% of patients, most often with small tumors and seminomatous histology. It was present in 63% of men with tumors 2 cm or less. The authors note that substantial occult invasive disease may exist in candidates for organ-sparing surgery, though sampling error is a limitation of their design.

title: Successful pregnancy after treatment for ovarian malignant teratoma with growing teratoma syndrome.
title_ja: 卵巣悪性奇形腫の治療後に growing teratoma syndrome を発症した症例における妊娠成功
summary_ja: 20歳未経妊女性が卵巣悪性奇形腫（未熟奇形腫）に対し片側卵管卵巣摘出術と化学療法を受けた。数年後に growing teratoma syndrome を発症し、妊孕性温存手術と化学療法で治療された。自己胚移植を伴う体外受精の後、無病の状態で健康な児を出産した。悪性胚細胞腫瘍の稀な転移性合併症の治療後も妊娠は可能であると結論された。
summary_en: A 20-year-old nulliparous woman with ovarian malignant teratoma (immature) was treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and chemotherapy. Years later she developed growing teratoma syndrome, managed with fertility-preserving surgery and chemotherapy. After IVF with autologous embryo transfer, she was disease-free and gave birth to a healthy child. The authors conclude that successful pregnancy is achievable after effective treatment of ovarian growing teratoma syndrome, a rare metastatic complication of malignant germ cell tumor.

title: Circulating mitochondrial DNA in the serum of patients with testicular germ cell cancer as a novel noninvasive diagnostic biomarker.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における血清中循環ミトコンドリアDNA：非侵襲的診断バイオマーカーとしての可能性
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者74例（セミノーマ39例、非セミノーマ35例）と健常者35例の血清中の遊離ミトコンドリアDNAをqPCRで定量した。患者では有意に高値で、mtDNA-79の感度は59.5%、特異度は94.3%だった。従来の腫瘍マーカーが正常範囲の患者も健常者と区別でき、臨床病理学的因子との相関はなかった。腫瘍マーカーが正常な症例での診療補助となりうると示唆された。
summary_en: This study measured cell-free mitochondrial DNA in serum from 74 patients with testicular cancer (39 seminoma, 35 nonseminoma) and 35 healthy controls using quantitative PCR. Levels of mtDNA-79 and mtDNA-220 were significantly higher in patients. Using mtDNA-79, sensitivity was 59.5% and specificity 94.3% (AUC 0.787), and it still distinguished patients with normal conventional markers from controls. Levels did not correlate with clinicopathological variables. The authors suggest cell-free mtDNA may aid management, especially where tumour markers are normal.

title: Long-term outcome for men with teratoma found at postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清で奇形腫を認めた男性の長期予後
summary_ja: 1980年から2003年に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清で純粋奇形腫を認めた転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍97例を後方視的に検討した。中央値7.4年の追跡で22%が再発し、5年・10年の無再発率は81%・76%だった。化学療法後のAFP高値と初診時の縦隔病変が再発の独立予測因子であった。純粋奇形腫の所見があっても病勢進行のリスクは残ると結論された。
summary_en: Ninety-seven men with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and pure teratoma at postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (1980-2003) were retrospectively reviewed. At median follow-up of 7.4 years, 22% had recurrence, with 5- and 10-year freedom from recurrence of 81% and 76%. Postchemotherapy AFP elevation and mediastinal involvement at presentation predicted recurrence on multivariate analysis. Nine patients died of testis cancer. Teratoma at PC-RPLND does not guarantee freedom from disease progression.

title: Differential risk for neonatal surgical airway intervention in prenatally diagnosed neck masses.
title_ja: 出生前診断された頸部腫瘤における新生児期の外科的気道介入のリスクの差異
summary_ja: 本研究は、出生前に頸部腫瘤と診断された胎児23例を後方視的に検討した単施設研究である。頸部奇形腫は、リンパ管奇形と比べて新生児期の気道介入を要する割合が有意に高かった(67%対11%)。多くは子宮外胎児治療(EXIT)下に施行された。出生前カウンセリングで考慮すべき知見である。
summary_en: This retrospective single-center study of 23 fetuses with prenatally diagnosed neck masses compared neonatal airway intervention risk across diagnoses. Teratomas carried a markedly higher risk of airway intervention than lymphatic malformations (67% vs 11%, P=.02). Most procedures were performed under ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT). Survival was 93%. The authors conclude that cervical teratomas warrant careful prenatal counseling regarding neonatal airway management.

title: Cisplatin and etoposide in childhood germ cell tumor: brazilian pediatric oncology society protocol GCT-91.
title_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチンとエトポシド:ブラジル小児腫瘍学会プロトコルGCT-91
summary_ja: 本研究は、ブラジル小児腫瘍学会のGCT-91プロトコルで治療された小児・思春期の胚細胞腫瘍106例の成績を報告している。シスプラチンとエトポシドによる2剤化学療法(PE)を用いた。高リスク群では、PE単独の5年全生存率が83.3%と、イホスファミド・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシンを加えた3剤併用より良好であった。病期、切除可能性、乳酸脱水素酵素高値が予後因子であった。
summary_en: This Brazilian multicenter study reports outcomes of 106 assessable children and adolescents with germ cell tumors treated on the GCT-91 protocol, which used two-agent cisplatin and etoposide (PE) chemotherapy. Five-year overall survival was 83.3% for high-risk patients receiving PE, versus 58.8% for those receiving PE plus ifosfamide, vinblastine, and bleomycin. Stage, resectability, and elevated lactate dehydrogenase were key prognostic factors. The authors conclude that selected high-risk patients may not require three-agent regimens.

title: Deletion of eIF2beta suppresses testicular cancer incidence and causes recessive lethality in agouti-yellow mice.
title_ja: eIF2β欠損はアグーチ黄色マウスの精巣がん発生を抑制し、劣性致死性を引き起こす
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: アグーチ黄色(Ay)マウスの欠失による精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)抑制効果は、Ralyやアグーチ遺伝子ではなく、翻訳開始因子eIF2のβサブユニットをコードするEif2s2の欠失に起因することが示された。Eif2s2の部分欠損は罹患率を約半分に低下させ、完全欠損は着床期前後に胚性致死を引き起こした。翻訳制御が胚細胞の発生とTGCTの発生に関与することが示唆される。
summary_en: This study in agouti-yellow (Ay) mice shows that the Ay deletion suppresses testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) by removing Eif2s2, the beta subunit of translation initiation factor eIF2, rather than Raly or agouti. Partial Eif2s2 deficiency halved the incidence of affected males, while complete deficiency caused embryonic lethality near implantation. Reduced Eif2s2 attenuated germ cell proliferation and differentiation, processes important for TGCT formation. The findings link germ cell development and TGCT pathogenesis to translational control.

title: Diagnosis of an autoamputated ovary with dermoid cyst during a Cesarean section.
title_ja: 帝王切開時に診断された類皮嚢腫を伴う自然切断卵巣
summary_ja: 帝王切開の際に偶発的に見つかった、類皮嚢腫を伴う自然切断卵巣の症例報告である。33歳の妊婦で、右卵巣は欠如し子宮直腸窩に位置していた。有茎性の腫瘤を摘出し、病理組織学的に類皮嚢腫と残存卵巣組織が確認された。術後経過は良好であった。卵巣の自然切断はまれで、捻転後に生じることがあると考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes an autoamputated right ovary containing a dermoid cyst, found incidentally in a 33-year-old pregnant woman during Cesarean section. A pedunculated pelvic mass was extracted, and histology confirmed a dermoid cyst with residual ovarian tissue. The patient recovered uneventfully. The authors review that ovarian autoamputation is rare, may follow torsion of an ovary or dermoid cyst, and most often implants on the greater omentum.

title: Methotrexate induces apoptosis of human choriocarcinoma cell line JAR via a mitochondrial pathway.
title_ja: メトトレキサートは、ミトコンドリア経路を介してヒト絨毛癌細胞株JARのアポトーシスを誘導する
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JARに対する低濃度メトトレキサートのアポトーシス誘導機序を検討したin vitro研究である。48時間曝露後、ミトコンドリア膜電位の低下とカスパーゼ-9の活性化が認められ、カスパーゼ-8には変化がなかった。Bax発現の上昇とBcl-2発現の低下もみられた。メトトレキサートはミトコンドリア経路を介して絨毛癌細胞にアポトーシスを誘導することが示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined how low-concentration methotrexate induces apoptosis in the human choriocarcinoma cell line JAR. Flow cytometry, caspase activity assays, and immunocytochemistry were used after 48-hour exposure to 0.1 to 2.5 μg/mL methotrexate. Cells showed decreased mitochondrial membrane potential and increased caspase-9 activation, with no change in caspase-8. Bax expression rose and Bcl-2 expression fell during apoptosis. The findings indicate that methotrexate acts through a mitochondrial apoptotic pathway in choriocarcinoma cells. This is an in vitro study without patient data.

title: Mediastinal testicular tumor compressing the left atrium in a young male presenting initially with symptoms of left heart failure.
title_ja: 縦隔の精巣腫瘍が左房を圧迫し、左心不全症状を初発とした若年男性例
summary_ja: 26歳男性が左心不全症状で受診した症例報告である。経胸壁心エコー検査で、精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の縦隔転移による左房の外因性圧迫が確認された。左房充満障害から肺静脈圧亢進と肺水腫を来していた。著者らは、縦隔転移が左房を外側から圧迫して左心不全を起こした初めての報告としている。心症状で受診した際に縦隔転移を考慮する重要性を示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old man with left heart failure caused by external compression of the left atrium. Transthoracic echocardiography revealed a mediastinal metastasis of a testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumour. Compression impaired left atrial filling, leading to pulmonary venous hypertension and pulmonary oedema. The authors state this is the first reported case of a mediastinal metastatic testicular NSGCT causing left heart failure through external compression of the left atrium. The report highlights the importance of considering mediastinal metastasis in cardiac presentations.

title: Laparoscopic resection of benign ovarian tumours in children with gonadal preservation.
title_ja: 小児の良性卵巣腫瘍に対する卵巣温存下の腹腔鏡下切除
summary_ja: 3年間に卵巣温存下で腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢腫摘出術を受けた小児12例の後方視的研究である。病理所見は成熟奇形腫が10例、単純性嚢胞が2例であった。全例で腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。超音波検査によるフォローアップで、多くの症例で卵巣の大きさや血流が対側と同程度に回復した。小児の良性卵巣腫瘍に対し、卵巣温存を伴う腹腔鏡下手術は有用な選択肢であると結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective review reports 12 children who underwent laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy with ovarian preservation over three years. Most masses were mature teratomas, and two were simple cysts. Tumour markers were normal in all patients. Ultrasonographic follow-up at 2 to 5 months showed that most ovaries had recovered size, shape, and blood flow comparable to the contralateral side. Acute torsion was managed with staged detorsion and delayed cystectomy. The authors conclude that laparoscopic cystectomy with ovarian preservation is a feasible option for benign ovarian tumours in children.

title: Long-term outcomes of surgery for malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma: 20-year experience of a regional UK centre.
title_ja: 悪性仙尾部奇形腫に対する手術の長期成績：英国地域中核施設における20年の経験
summary_ja: 1987～2006年に悪性仙尾部奇形腫で治療された小児12例を後方視的に検討した英国の研究である。全例がカルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン療法を受けた。再発は2例、播種性転移による死亡は1例であった。平均10.6年の追跡で、残りの児は良好であった。手術は安全で合併症が少なく、長期成績も良好であると結論している。
summary_en: This 20-year retrospective study from a UK regional centre reviews 12 children treated for malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma between 1987 and 2006. All patients received carboplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin chemotherapy, with excision performed before or after chemotherapy. Two patients had recurrence, and one died of disseminated metastasis. Over an average follow-up of 10.6 years, the remaining children were well. The authors conclude that surgery for this tumour is safe, with low complication rates and favourable long-term outcomes.

title: Nonseminomatous germ cell tumors: assessing the need for postchemotherapy contralateral pulmonary resection in patients with ipsilateral complete necrosis.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍：同側に完全壊死を認める患者における化学療法後の対側肺切除の必要性の検討
summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する一次シスプラチン併用化学療法後に胸部残存腫瘤を有する71例を検討した多施設後方視的研究である。残存腫瘤は完全壊死31%、奇形腫55%、生存癌14%であった。両側肺切除例では、最初の肺に壊死を認めた例の95%で対側肺も壊死のみであった。最初の肺で完全壊死が確認された場合、対側肺手術は回避しうると提案している。
summary_en: This multicentre retrospective study evaluated 71 patients with thoracic residual masses after first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy for disseminated non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. Residual masses showed complete necrosis in 31%, teratoma in 55%, and viable cancer in 14%. Discordance between retroperitoneal and thoracic masses was seen in 27%. Among 39 patients with bilateral lung resection, pathology was concordant between lungs in 95% of those with necrosis in the first lung. The authors suggest that contralateral pulmonary resection might be avoidable when complete necrosis is found in the first lung.

title: Ovarian and paraovarian squamous-lined cysts (epidermoid cysts): a clinicopathologic study of 18 cases with comparison to mature cystic teratomas.
title_ja: 卵巣および卵巣傍の扁平上皮裏打ち嚢胞(類表皮嚢胞)：18例の臨床病理学的検討と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫との比較
summary_ja: 奇形腫成分を伴わない卵巣および卵巣傍の扁平上皮裏打ち嚢胞(類表皮嚢胞)18例を病理学的に検討した。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫より高齢で小型であり、比較対象の120例と有意差があった。卵巣症例16例中7例は、十分にサンプリングされていない奇形腫やBrenner腫瘍、子宮内膜症関連変化を示唆する所見を有していた。純粋な類表皮嚢胞は、卵巣表層上皮性腫瘍の1%未満と結論している。
summary_en: This clinicopathologic study examined 18 squamous-lined ovarian and paraovarian cysts (epidermoid cysts) without teratomatous elements. These cysts were one-nineteenth as common as mature cystic teratoma and occurred at an older age and smaller size than 120 mature cystic teratomas used for comparison. Seven of 16 ovarian cases showed features suggesting insufficiently sampled teratomas, Brenner tumours, or endometriosis-related change. The authors conclude that pure epidermoid cysts of the ovary probably represent less than 1% of ovarian surface epithelial tumours.

title: P63 expression in gestational trophoblastic disease: correlation with proliferation and apoptotic dynamics.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるp63の発現：増殖およびアポトーシス動態との関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の各病型におけるp63アイソフォームの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。上皮型絨毛性腫瘍で発現が最も高く、絨毛癌や胎盤部絨毛性腫瘍では低かった。p63指数はKi67、M30、p53、p21と正の相関を示し、DeltaNp63がp53依存性の増殖・アポトーシスを介して妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examines p63 isoform expression across gestational trophoblastic disease subtypes, including hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas, placental site trophoblastic tumors, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumors. Using immunohistochemistry on 98 specimens, the authors found p63 indices highest in epithelioid trophoblastic tumors and low in choriocarcinoma and placental site tumors, with higher levels in hydatidiform moles than normal placentas. p63 indices correlated positively with Ki67, M30, p53 and p21 expression, suggesting a role for DeltaNp63 in GTD pathogenesis through p53-dependent proliferation and apoptosis.

title: Long-term functional results following resection of neonatal sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 新生児仙尾部奇形腫切除後の長期機能予後
summary_ja: 1970～2006年に新生児期の仙尾部奇形腫切除を受けた患者のうち、アンケートに回答した14例で長期機能予後を評価した。排尿・排便の自制、便秘、下肢筋力低下を調査したところ、脊髄浸潤例を除き大半で問題はなかった。便秘は比較的多く認められた。機能予後は概ね良好であり、家族へのカウンセリングに有用であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study assessed long-term functional outcomes in 14 of 27 invited patients who underwent resection of neonatal sacrococcygeal teratoma between 1970 and 2006. Questionnaires covered urinary and fecal continence, constipation and lower extremity weakness. Most respondents reported no incontinence or weakness; one patient with spinal cord involvement had all three problems. Constipation was common, reported as significant by one and occasional by five. Two of the benign-treated patients had later malignant recurrences. The authors conclude that functional outcomes after neonatal SCT resection are excellent, providing useful counseling information for families.

title: Hepatic metastasectomy for testicular germ cell tumors: is it worth it?
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の肝転移に対する肝切除術：その意義は
summary_ja: 1975～2002年に精巣胚細胞腫瘍の肝転移に対して行った15例16回の肝切除を後方視的に検討した。組織学的には壊死、残存腫瘍、成熟奇形腫などが認められた。平均8.2年の観察で11例が生存し、診断からの10年全生存期間(全生存率)は62%であった。化学療法後の肝病変の切除は安全であり、外科的切除を含む集学的治療が推奨される。
summary_en: This retrospective review describes 16 hepatic operations in 15 patients with testicular germ cell tumor liver metastases treated between 1975 and 2002. Histology showed necrosis, viable tumor, mature teratoma or benign findings. Most patients were alive at a mean follow-up of 8.2 years, and the 10-year overall survival from diagnosis was 62%. The authors found no operative mortality and 40% morbidity. They conclude that resection of post-chemotherapy hepatic disease is safe and recommend a multidisciplinary approach including surgical resection of residual metastases, though predictors of benefit remain unclear.

title: Post-chemotherapy nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for advanced germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 1994～2008年に化学療法後の進行性胚細胞腫瘍で後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた92例のうち、78例で神経温存手術を施行した。射精機能の温存率は83.1%で、両側温存群が片側温存群より高かった。再発は2例のみで、いずれも化学療法と外科的切除で治癒した。神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清は局所再発を増やすことなく射精機能を保持できる。
summary_en: This study reports 92 patients with advanced germ cell tumor who underwent post-chemotherapy RPLND between 1994 and 2008, of whom 78 underwent nerve-sparing procedures (19 seminoma, 59 non-seminoma). Antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 83.1% of evaluable patients, with bilateral preservation yielding higher rates (93.3%) than unilateral (74.3%). Only two patients had recurrences, which were treated successfully. The authors conclude that nerve-sparing RPLND preserves ejaculatory function in most patients without increasing local recurrence risk.

title: Reducing treatment toxicities in the management of good prognosis testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 予後良好な精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療における治療毒性の軽減
summary_ja: 予後良好な精巣胚細胞腫瘍では治療関連毒性の軽減が重要である。晩期毒性として二次癌、心血管疾患、神経・内分泌障害が問題となる。病期Iでは、経過観察からセミノーマに対するカルボプラチンや傍大動脈放射線療法、非セミノーマに対する併用化学療法までの選択肢がある。高い治癒率を維持しつつ、長期的な罹患率を抑えることを目指すべきである。
summary_en: This review discusses strategies to reduce treatment-related toxicity in good-prognosis testicular germ cell tumors, which have near-100% disease-specific survival in localized disease. Long-term toxicities include second malignancies, cardiovascular disease, and neurological and endocrine sequelae. For stage I disease, options range from surveillance to adjuvant carboplatin or para-aortic radiotherapy for seminoma and combination chemotherapy for nonseminoma. Metastatic seminoma with low-volume para-aortic disease may be treated with radiotherapy with or without carboplatin. The authors emphasize minimizing long-term morbidity while maintaining high cure rates.

title: Retroperitoneal extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with synchronous orbital metastasis.
title_ja: 後腹膜性性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に同時性眼窩転移を伴った1例
summary_ja: 巨大な後腹膜性性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に、同時性の眼窩転移を伴った症例である。眼窩病変の生検で胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。BEP療法で眼窩腫瘤は縮小したが、後腹膜腫瘍の大きさと腫瘍マーカー値は変化しなかった。まれな病態の診断と治療について考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a large retroperitoneal extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor presenting with a synchronous orbital mass. Biopsy of the orbital lesion confirmed germ cell tumor histology. BEP chemotherapy reduced the orbital mass but did not change the retroperitoneal tumor size or serum tumor marker levels. The authors discuss the diagnosis and management of this rare entity with synchronous orbital metastases, highlighting the challenge of heterogeneous response across metastatic sites.

title: [Case of brain infarction during cisplatin-based combined chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin for testicular cancer].
title_ja: 精巣がんに対するブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン併用化学療法中に生じた脳梗塞の1例
summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(hCG高値)を有する31歳男性が、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン化学療法の第2コース中に左中大脳動脈領域の脳梗塞を発症した。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で虚血病変を確認し、心エコーでは弁膜疣贅を認めなかった。予防策を講じて化学療法を完遂し、リハビリテーションにより歩行可能となった。化学療法後3か月のフォローアップでは再発を認めなかった。
summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and markedly elevated hCG who developed a left middle cerebral artery ischemic stroke during the second cycle of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy. Brain MRI confirmed the infarct, and echocardiography showed no valvular vegetations. Chemotherapy was completed with preventive measures. He had residual right hemiparesis that improved with rehabilitation, and no tumor recurrence was observed at three months of follow-up.

title: [Metachronous testicular seminoma with an interval of 14 years from the first nonseminomatous testicular tumor: a case report].
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍から14年後に生じた異時性精巣セミノーマの1例(症例報告)
summary_ja: 左精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(病期IIB)の治療から14年後に、右精巣に異時性のセミノーマが生じた32歳男性の症例である。精索浸潤を伴う純粋セミノーマ(pT3N0M0、病期I)と診断され、精巣摘除術とVIP化学療法を施行した。異時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍として、文献的考察を加えている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man who developed a metachronous testicular seminoma in the right testis, 14 years after treatment for left-sided stage IIB nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Pathology showed pure seminoma with spermatic cord invasion, staged pT3N0M0 stage I. He underwent right high orchiectomy followed by three courses of VIP chemotherapy. The authors present this as a case of metachronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumor and review the literature on such cases.

title: [A case of posterior mediastinal mature teratoma].
title_ja: 後縦隔成熟奇形腫の1例(症例報告)
summary_ja: 発作性呼吸困難を訴えた57歳男性の後縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例である。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で石灰化を伴う腫瘍を、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で脂肪成分と嚢胞性病変を認め、外科的切除により成熟奇形腫と確定した。後縦隔奇形腫は前縦隔例より悪性度が低い可能性があり、本邦では15例目の症例報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 57-year-old man with paroxysmal dyspnea whose chest CT and MRI showed a calcified, lipid-containing and cystic posterior mediastinal tumor behind the left diaphragmatic crus. Surgical resection revealed a mature teratoma without malignant components or thymic tissue. The authors review prior reports and suggest posterior mediastinal teratomas may have less malignant behavior than anterior ones. This is the fifteenth such case reported in the Japanese literature, highlighting the need for further case accumulation.

title: Alpha-fetoprotein levels correlate with the pathologic grade and surgical outcomes of pediatric retroperitoneal teratomas.
title_ja: 小児後腹膜奇形腫におけるαフェトプロテイン値と病理学的悪性度・転帰の関連
summary_ja: 20年間に治療した小児後腹膜奇形腫13例を後方視的に検討し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値と病理学的悪性度・転帰の関連を評価した。未熟奇形腫9例中8例でAFPが上昇し、成熟奇形腫では全例が正常範囲であった。Grade IIIではAFPが有意に高く、高悪性度例では合併症や死亡が多かった。AFPは未熟性と術後合併症を予測し、完全切除により多くの乳児で長期生存が得られた。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 13 pediatric retroperitoneal teratomas treated over 20 years examined whether alpha-fetoprotein levels correlate with tumor grade and outcomes. Nine tumors were immature and four mature. All mature cases had normal AFP, while eight of nine immature cases were elevated. AFP was significantly higher in grade III tumors than in mature ones. High-grade tumors had more vascular injury, sepsis and death. The authors conclude AFP predicts tumor immaturity and operative morbidity, and complete resection achieves long-term survival in most infants.

title: Large mixed germ cell tumor in a young patient presenting as an intrapulmonary mass.
title_ja: 肺内腫瘍として発症した大型混合型胚細胞腫瘍の若年男性例
summary_ja: 26歳男性の肺内に発生した大型の混合型胚細胞腫瘍(未熟奇形腫とセミノーマ)の症例報告。初回の化学療法で一時縮小したものの、腫瘍マーカーと腫瘍径が再び増大した。右肺全摘術で成熟・未熟奇形腫成分と残存するセミノーマ細胞が確認されたが、術後4週間で急性呼吸窮迫症候群により死亡した。まれな肺内胚細胞腫瘍の病態を考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old man with a large intrapulmonary mixed germ cell tumor comprising immature teratoma and seminoma. The tumor initially responded to chemotherapy, but tumor markers and tumor size later progressed. Right pneumonectomy revealed an 18 cm mass with mature and immature teratomatous components and residual seminomatous cells. The patient died of acute respiratory distress syndrome four weeks after surgery. The authors discuss the rare spectrum of large intrapulmonary germ cell tumors.

title: Estrogen receptor-binding fragment-associated gene 9 expression and its clinical significance in human testicular cancer.
title_ja: ヒト精巣がんにおけるEBAG9発現とその臨床的意義
summary_ja: 精巣組織90例(良性28例、精巣胚細胞腫瘍62例)を用いて、EBAG9の免疫組織化学的発現を検討した。腫瘍部の52%でEBAG9が陽性で、良性組織では弱い発現にとどまった。EBAG9陽性例では血清LDH値が有意に高く、進行例では国際胚細胞腫瘍予後分類の中間または不良リスク群に多かった。EBAG9が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進展と悪性度に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined EBAG9 expression by immunohistochemistry in 90 testicular specimens, including 28 benign tissues and 62 testicular germ cell tumors. EBAG9 was positive in 52% of cancerous lesions and weak in benign tissue. EBAG9-positive patients had significantly higher serum LDH levels. Among patients with advanced disease, EBAG9 positivity was more frequent in intermediate or poor risk groups of the IGCCPCS. The authors suggest EBAG9 may contribute to progression and aggressiveness of testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Emergency management of a particular massive pulmonary embolism..
title_ja: 肺塞栓様の病態で発見された精巣胎児性癌の右心室転移
summary_ja: 55歳男性が大量肺塞栓様の病態で受診し、経胸壁心エコーで右心室から肺動脈幹へ進展する孤立性心臓転移が確認された。その精査から原発性精巣胎児性癌が判明した。緊急の心臓腫瘍切除と精巣摘除を行ったが、術後6日目に心腔内で腫瘍が再増大した。エトポシド、シスプラチン、ブレオマイシンによる併用化学療法を開始した。胚細胞腫瘍の病期分類に心エコーを組み込むべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes a 55-year-old man presenting with a massive pulmonary embolism pattern, where transthoracic echocardiography revealed an isolated right ventricular metastasis extending into the pulmonary trunk. This led to the diagnosis of a primary testicular embryonal carcinoma. Despite urgent cardiac metastasis resection and orchidectomy, the tumor regrew within the heart by postoperative day 6. Combination chemotherapy with etoposide, cisplatin, and bleomycin was started. The authors emphasize that echocardiography should be considered alongside germ cell cancer staging.

title: Disease confined within the ovary and smaller amount of ascites are good prognostic factors for survival of patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: a case series in Korea and review of the published reports.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来扁平上皮癌の予後因子：韓国の症例集積と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 韓国の報告から収集した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌55例を解析した。病変が卵巣内に限局する例と腹水500mL未満の例は、全生存期間(全生存率)が有意に長かった。卵巣内限局例の平均は116か月で、進行例の21か月より長かった。単変量解析では有意であったが、多変量解析では有意差は認められなかった。両因子が予後良好因子となりうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This Korean case series and literature review analyzed 55 patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Disease confined within the ovary and ascites under 500 mL were associated with significantly longer overall survival. Patients with disease confined to the ovary had a mean survival of 116 months, versus 21 months for advanced disease. These factors were significant by univariate but not multivariate Cox analysis. The authors suggest they may be favorable prognostic markers.

title: Low molecular mass polypeptide-2 in human trophoblast: over-expression in hydatidiform moles and possible role in trophoblast cell invasion.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎における低分子量ポリペプチド2の過剰発現と栄養膜細胞浸潤への関与
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常胎盤と胞状奇胎の絨毛組織で、プロテアソームβサブユニットLMP2の発現を免疫組織化学で検討した。部分胞状奇胎と全胞状奇胎の栄養膜柱では、正常胎盤より発現が高かった。浸潤性の絨毛外栄養膜細胞株でLMP2をノックダウンすると、IL-1β誘導性の細胞浸潤が抑制された。胞状奇胎の高侵襲性表現型にLMP2の過剰発現が寄与する可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study examined low molecular mass polypeptide-2 (LMP2), a proteasome beta subunit, in human trophoblast from normal placentas and hydatidiform moles. LMP2 expression in trophoblastic columns was higher in partial and complete moles than in normal placentas. In HTR-8/SVneo invasive trophoblast cells, LMP2 knockdown reduced IL-1beta-induced invasion. The authors conclude that LMP2 overexpression in mole trophoblasts may contribute to their highly invasive phenotype.

title: Prenatal diagnosis of retroperitoneal teratoma: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫の出生前診断：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 妊娠33週の胎児に生じた後腹膜奇形腫を、反復超音波検査により出生前に診断した症例を報告する。初回の画像では神経芽腫が疑われたが、増大と石灰化を伴う充実性成分の出現から奇形腫と診断された。出生後に腫瘍を摘出し、未熟奇形腫と確認された。石灰化を伴う嚢胞性または混合充実性の胎児腫瘤では奇形腫を考慮すべきであると結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a retroperitoneal teratoma diagnosed prenatally at 33 weeks' gestation through serial sonographic examinations. The initial image suggested neuroblastoma, but progressive growth and the development of solid areas with calcification led to the diagnosis of teratoma. After delivery at 39 weeks, the tumor was resected and histology confirmed an immature retroperitoneal teratoma. The authors conclude that teratoma should be considered when a fetal mass is cystic or mixed semisolid with calcification, and that serial ultrasound monitoring supports accurate antenatal diagnosis.

title: Polychlorinated biphenyls and risk of testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ポリ塩化ビフェニルと精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍とPCB曝露の関連を、症例736例と対照913例の診断前血清を用いて検討した。8種のPCB同族体はTGCTおよび非セミノーマのリスク低下と関連し、セミノーマでも一部の同族体で同様の関連が認められた。PCB総量も全組織型でリスク低下と関連し、PCB曝露がリスクを上昇させるという仮説は支持されなかった。
summary_en: This study examines whether serum polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB) levels are associated with testicular germ cell tumor risk, using prediagnostic samples from 736 cases and 913 controls in the Servicemen's Testicular Tumor Environmental and Endocrine Determinants study. Eight PCB congeners were associated with significantly decreased risk of overall TGCT and nonseminoma, and several were linked to decreased seminoma risk. Total PCB levels showed inverse associations with all tumor types. The authors conclude that these data do not support the hypothesis that PCB exposure increases TGCT risk.

title: Neuronal guidance protein Netrin-1 induces differentiation in human embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: 神経誘導因子Netrin-1はヒト胎児性癌細胞の分化を誘導する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA/2およびNCCITにおいて、Netrin-1が遊走を抑制し、神経外胚葉様の分化を誘導することを示した。神経系マーカーの発現が増加し、幹細胞マーカーは低下した。作用はNeogeninレセプターとSHP-2の活性化を介し、c-srcシグナルを調節することによると考えられる。
summary_en: This study shows that the guidance molecule Netrin-1 reduces migration and induces neuroectodermal-like differentiation in human embryonal carcinoma cell lines NTERA/2 and NCCIT. Netrin-1 increases neural markers such as beta-III tubulin, GFAP, and nestin while reducing Cripto-1, Nanog, and Oct4. The effects are mediated through the Neogenin receptor, SHP-2 activation, and increased phosphorylated inactive c-src. The findings suggest that Netrin-1 modulates c-src signaling to promote differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells.

title: Adenocarcinoma arising from the respiratory ciliated epithelium in a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫の呼吸上皮から発生した腺癌
summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫内の呼吸上皮の線毛上皮から、分化型腺癌が発生した症例を報告する。奇形腫の悪性転化は稀で、扁平上皮癌が最も多い。呼吸上皮由来の腺癌は極めて稀であり、本症例は報告された4例目である。
summary_en: This case report describes a well-differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from respiratory ciliated epithelium within a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is uncommon, with squamous cell carcinoma being the most frequent form. The authors note that adenocarcinoma from respiratory epithelium in such tumors is extremely rare, and this is only the fourth reported case. The report highlights the importance of recognizing this uncommon transformation in ovarian teratoma pathology.

title: A self-renewal program controls the expansion of genetically unstable cancer stem cells in pluripotent stem cell-derived tumors.
title_ja: 多能性幹細胞由来腫瘍において、遺伝的に不安定ながん幹細胞の増殖を制御する自己複製プログラム
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のモデルとして、マウス胚性胚細胞をSCIDマウスの精巣に移植した。連続移植により生じた二次腫瘍は例外なく転移性であったのに対し、原発腫瘍は転移性ではなかった。がん幹細胞には非クローン性のゲノム再配列が生じ、レチノイン酸による前処理は腫瘍形成とこれらの出現を阻止した。マイクロアレイ解析では、癌遺伝子や運動性に関わる遺伝子を含む約1,000の転写産物に発現差が見られた。著者らは、遺伝的不安定性と自己複製能の組み合わせが、多能性細胞由来のがん幹細胞の転移性行動を促すと提唱している。
summary_en: Murine embryonic germ cells were transplanted into the testes of SCID mice to model testicular germ cell tumor. Serial transplantation generated secondary tumors that were invariably metastatic, while primary tumors were not. Cancer stem cells emerged with nonclonal genomic rearrangements, and pretreatment with retinoic acid prevented tumor formation and their emergence. Microarray analysis identified about 1,000 differentially expressed transcripts involving oncogenes and motility genes. The authors propose that genetic instability combined with self-renewal drives metastatic behavior in cancer stem cells derived from pluripotent cells.

title: Alpha-fetoprotein (AFP)-producing ovarian tumor in an elderly woman.
title_ja: 高齢女性にみられたαフェトプロテイン(AFP)産生卵巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 59歳女性の左卵巣腫瘤で、血清AFPは73,687 ng/mlと著明に上昇していた。組織は肝様成分を伴い、卵黄嚢腫瘍と肝細胞癌転移・肝様癌などとの鑑別が問題となった。化学療法（ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン）3コースでAFPは大幅に低下し、二次的減量手術で残存腫瘍は認められなかった。
summary_en: An elderly Japanese woman presented with a left ovarian mass and serum AFP of 73,687 ng/ml. The tumor had a hepatoid pattern, and its pathological diagnosis was uncertain, requiring distinction between yolk sac tumor, metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma, and hepatoid carcinoma. After surgery, three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin lowered AFP from 12,600 to 16 ng/ml. Secondary cytoreductive lymphadenectomy showed no residual tumor. The report highlights chemosensitivity and the diagnostic challenge of AFP-producing ovarian tumors in older patients.

title: "Burned out" testicular seminoma presenting as a primary gastric malignancy.
title_ja: 原発性胃癌様の所見を呈した「バーンドアウト」精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 55歳男性が原発性胃癌を疑う臨床・内視鏡所見を呈した。潰瘍性病変は、臨床的に潜在していた「バーンドアウト」型精巣セミノーマからの転移によるものであった。画像所見と病理所見により胃腺癌との鑑別が可能であった。転移性であっても胚細胞腫瘍は治癒可能であるため、非典型的な転移形式を認識することの重要性が示された。
summary_en: A 55-year-old man presented with clinical and endoscopic features suggesting primary gastric carcinoma. The ulcerative mucosal lesion was instead a metastasis from an occult, regressed (burned-out) testicular seminoma. Radiologic and pathologic features distinguished it from gastric adenocarcinoma. The authors note that germ cell tumors remain curable even when metastatic, so clinicians and pathologists should recognize unusual manifestations. The case broadens the differential diagnosis of gastric ulcers in patients who may have an occult germ cell malignancy.

title: Two potent transactivation domains in the C-terminal region of human NANOG mediate transcriptional activation in human embryonic carcinoma cells.
title_ja: ヒトNANOGのC末端の2つの強力な転写活性化ドメインはヒト胚性癌細胞における転写活性化を媒介する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒトNANOGのC末端領域にある転写活性化ドメインを、NCCIT胚性癌細胞を用いて変異導入と一過性トランスフェクションで解析した。WRサブドメインとCD2は独立して、また相乗的に転写を活性化し、CD1は不活性であった。Q（グルタミン）モチーフと酸性残基が最大の活性化に必要であった。胚細胞腫瘍の発生における制御されない増殖との関連が示唆された。
summary_en: The study mapped transactivation domains in the C-terminal region of human NANOG using mutagenesis and transient transfection in NCCIT human embryonic carcinoma cells. The C-terminal domain was divided into CD1, a tryptophan-repeat (WR) subdomain and CD2. WR and CD2 independently activated transcription and acted synergistically, whereas CD1 was inactive. A glutamine motif in WR and acidic residues in CD2 were required for maximal activation. The authors link these stem cell transcription mechanisms to unregulated proliferation in germ cell tumorigenesis.

title: Mature gastric teratoma: recurrence in adulthood.
title_ja: 胃成熟奇形腫の成人期再発
summary_ja: 乳児期に完全切除された胃の成熟奇形腫が、約20年後に再発した。再発病変は外科的切除により治療され、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と確認された。性腺外に生じた成熟奇形腫の成人期における晩期再発という稀な経過を示す症例報告である。
summary_en: A patient had a mature gastric teratoma completely excised during infancy, and recurrence developed two decades later. The recurrence was managed by surgical resection, and pathology confirmed mature teratoma. The report documents late recurrence of an extragonadal mature teratoma in adulthood, a rare presentation. It suggests that long-term follow-up may be warranted even after apparently complete resection in infancy, since late recurrence can occur many years after initial treatment.

title: A novel SOX9 mutation, 972delC, causes 46,XY sex-reversed campomelic dysplasia with nephrocalcinosis, urolithiasis, and dysgerminoma.
title_ja: SOX9新規変異（972delC）による、腎石灰化・尿路結石およびディスジャーミノーマを伴う46,XY性転換型屈肢性形成異常症
summary_ja: 8歳の表現型女児で、屈肢性形成異常症(campomelic dysplasia)と46,XYの性転換を認めた。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で髄質腎石灰化と尿路結石が確認され、超音波で左性腺の腫大を認めた。腹腔鏡下性腺摘出術で左ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が切除された。予防的性腺摘出と泌尿器科的評価の重要性が示された。
summary_en: An 8-year-old phenotypic female with campomelic dysplasia and 46,XY sex reversal presented with renal colic. CT showed medullary nephrocalcinosis, urolithiasis and renal malrotation, and sonography revealed an enlarged left gonad. Genetic testing identified a novel heterozygous SOX9 deletion, 972delC. Laparoscopic gonadectomy removed a left dysgerminoma. The authors report the first dysgerminoma in a sex-reversed patient with campomelic dysplasia and urolithiasis, and stress prophylactic gonadectomy and urologic evaluation in this susceptible population.

title: Laparoscopic management of ovarian dysgerminoma presenting with acute abdomen caused by adnexal torsion in a 17-year-old girl.
title_ja: 17歳女児における捻転を伴う卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の腹腔鏡手術による管理
summary_ja: 17歳女児が急性腹症で受診し、左卵巣の付属器捻転を伴う卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と診断された症例報告である。緊急で腹腔鏡下左卵管卵巣摘出術を行い、腫瘍被膜を損傷しないよう慎重に切除した。病理診断は純粋なディスジャーミノーマであった。術後経過は良好で、早期病変の若年患者では腹腔鏡手術と再発を見据えた慎重なフォローアップが治療選択肢になり得るとしている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with acute abdomen caused by adnexal torsion from a left ovarian dysgerminoma. Ultrasonography showed a homogeneous lower abdominal tumor. Emergency laparoscopic left salpingo-oophorectomy was performed, carefully preserving the tumor capsule, and the tissue was extracted in a bag. Pathology confirmed pure dysgerminoma. The postoperative course was uneventful. The authors conclude that laparoscopic management with careful follow-up for recurrence can be an option for young patients whose disease is detected at an early stage.

title: Endometrial carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 絨毛癌様分化を伴う子宮内膜癌：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 58歳女性が絨毛癌様分化を伴う子宮内膜癌と診断され、手術と化学療法を受けた。術後9か月で膣断端に絨毛癌成分の転移性腫瘍が出現した。追加の化学療法により血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が低下し、腫瘍は縮小した。術後50か月時点で無病生存である。妊娠外に発生する絨毛癌の文献を概観し、腺癌成分と絨毛癌成分の双方に対するフォローアップが必要だと結論している。
summary_en: A 58-year-old woman with endometrial carcinoma showing choriocarcinomatous differentiation was treated initially with surgery and chemotherapy. Nine months later, a metastatic choriocarcinomatous tumor appeared at the vaginal cuff. Additional chemotherapy reduced serum hCG and the tumor regressed. Fifty months after surgery she remained alive without disease. The authors review choriocarcinomas arising outside pregnancy and emphasize that follow-up must address both the adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma components.

title: The microenvironment of germ cell tumors harbors a prominent antigen-driven humoral response.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の微小環境には顕著な抗原駆動性の液性免疫応答が認められる
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の3亜型（ジャーミノーマ、セミノーマ、ディスジャーミノーマ）の免疫細胞浸潤を解析した研究である。免疫組織化学により全腫瘍で多数のB細胞浸潤が認められ、一部では胚中心様のリンパ濾胞がみられた。腫瘍浸潤B細胞の免疫グロブリン可変領域320配列を解析すると、体細胞変異、アイソタイプスイッチ、クローン性拡大が認められ、腫瘍内で抗原依存的な成熟が起きていることが示唆された。
summary_en: This study characterized the immune infiltrate of germ cell tumors of three subtypes: germinoma, seminoma and dysgerminoma. Immunohistochemistry showed prominent B-cell infiltration in all tumors, with germinal center-like lymphoid follicles in some. Sequencing of 320 immunoglobulin variable-region sequences from tumor-infiltrating B cells revealed somatic mutation, isotype switching and clonal expansion, indicating antigen-driven maturation within the tumor. Control tissues and blood lacked these features, suggesting an adaptive humoral response in the tumor microenvironment.

title: Management of a pregnancy complicated by yolk sac tumor.
title_ja: 妊娠中に発症した卵黄嚢腫瘍の管理
summary_ja: 35歳の妊婦が妊娠25週で卵黄嚢腫瘍に対し左卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた。胎児への影響を考慮し化学療法は妊娠終了まで延期され、AFPで疾患活動性を追跡した。妊娠32週に帝王切開と子宮全摘術などの根治的手術を行い、術後はシスプラチン、エトポシド、ペプロマイシンによる化学療法を4コース実施した。最終コースから6か月後も母子は良好である。手術、選択的帝王切開、化学療法を組み合わせた個別化治療が寛解と胎児救命につながりうるとしている。
summary_en: A 35-year-old pregnant woman with a yolk sac tumor underwent left salpingo-oophorectomy at 25 weeks of gestation. Chemotherapy was deferred until after delivery to protect the fetus, and alpha-fetoprotein was used to monitor disease activity. At 32 weeks she underwent cesarean section followed by radical surgery including hysterectomy and lymphadenectomy. Four postoperative cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and peplomycin were given. Mother and child were well six months after the last cycle. The authors conclude that individualized management combining surgery, elective cesarean section and chemotherapy may achieve remission and fetal rescue.

title: Increased risk of testicular germ cell cancer among infertile men.
title_ja: 男性不妊症患者では精巣がんのリスクが増加する
summary_ja: カリフォルニア州の不妊治療施設で評価された男性22,562例をがん登録と連結し、精巣がんの発症率を一般集団と比較したコホート研究である。男性不妊因子が判明している男性では標準化発生比が2.8と顕著に高かった。多変量Cox解析でも男性不妊因子を持つ男性の精巣がんリスクは約3倍（ハザード比2.8）であった。不妊と精巣がんに共通の病因因子が存在する可能性が示唆されている。
summary_en: This cohort study linked 22,562 male partners of couples evaluated for infertility in California to the California Cancer Registry, and compared testicular cancer incidence with SEER data. Men seeking infertility treatment had a higher risk, which was markedly elevated (SIR 2.8) among those with known male factor infertility. In multivariable Cox analysis, male factor infertility was associated with nearly threefold higher risk (HR 2.8). The authors suggest that infertility and testicular cancer may share common etiologic factors.

title: Sonographic evaluation of epignathus.
title_ja: エピグナトゥス（奇形腫様腫瘍）の超音波学的評価
summary_ja: 本報告は、硬口蓋から発生し口腔を占拠する極めて稀な奇形腫様腫瘍であるエピグナトゥスの新生児例を超音波所見とともに報告している。羊水過多のため妊娠33週で帝王切開により出生した女児の症例である。出生前超音波診断は、遺伝カウンセリング、産科管理、新生児手術の計画に重要であると強調している。
summary_en: This sonographic report describes a neonatal case of epignathus, an extremely rare teratoid tumor arising from the hard palate and filling the buccal cavity. The female infant was delivered by cesarean section at 33 weeks because of hydramnios. The authors emphasize that prenatal sonographic diagnosis is important for genetic counseling, obstetric planning, and possible neonatal surgery, since these tumors often prove fatal in the neonatal period when surgical removal is impossible.

title: Huge teratoma of the face.
title_ja: 顔面の巨大奇形腫
summary_ja: 新生児女児に生じた極めて大きな顔面奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘤は眼窩、頬骨弓、顎骨を変形させていたが頭蓋内進展はなかった。生後4か月時に拡大外側顔面アプローチにより切除され、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。予後は組織学的悪性度、局在、手術の質に依存すると述べられている。
summary_en: This report describes a female neonate with a very large facial teratoma that deformed the orbit, zygomatic arch, and jaws without intracranial extension. The mass, composed of all three germ layers, was excised at 4 months of age using an extended laterofacial approach with superficial parotidectomy and facial nerve dissection. Histology showed a mature teratoma. The authors note that outcome depends on histological grade, localization, and surgical quality, and that fewer than 5% of pediatric head and neck teratomas are malignant.

title: Yolk sac tumor but not seminoma or teratoma is associated with abnormal epigenetic reprogramming pathway and shows frequent hypermethylation of various tumor suppressor genes.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍はセミノーマや奇形腫と異なり、異常なエピジェネティック再プログラミング経路と腫瘍抑制遺伝子の高頻度なメチル化を伴う
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 45例の胚細胞腫瘍について、インプリンティング領域とがん抑制遺伝子のメチル化を解析した。卵黄嚢腫瘍はセミノーマ、奇形腫、他の小児腫瘍より多くのがん抑制遺伝子がメチル化され、異常な再プログラミング経路が示された。しかし予後への影響はなく、機序が他のがんと異なる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study analyzed methylation of the H19 and SNRPN imprinted regions, 17 tumor suppressor genes, and imprinted gene expression in 45 germ cell tumors. Yolk sac tumors showed abnormal reprogramming and more methylated tumor suppressor genes than seminomas, teratomas, or other childhood tumors. However, tumor suppressor gene methylation did not affect outcome in yolk sac tumor patients, suggesting that its mechanisms may differ from those in other cancers.

title: Giant Seminoma following ipsilateral orchidectomy: a rare finding. Case report.
title_ja: 同側精巣摘除後に発生した巨大セミノーマ：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 左精巣摘除術の2年後に発生した巨大な陰嚢内再発セミノーマの症例報告である。初回の病理では精巣捻転とされ悪性所見はなかった。陰嚢切開による腫瘤摘出後、良好に回復した。精巣摘除後でも陰嚢腫脹の鑑別診断にセミノーマを含めること、また病理標本の十分な切片作製の重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old African man with a giant intrascrotal recurrent seminoma arising two years after left orchidectomy, which had been reported as torsion without malignancy. The mass was excised through an inguinoscrotal incision with good recovery, and no metastatic symptoms were present. The authors highlight the value of extirpation, the need for thorough histopathological sectioning, and the inclusion of seminoma in the differential diagnosis of scrotal swelling even after orchidectomy.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 63歳の閉経後女性で、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から扁平上皮癌が発生した症例である。超音波で混合エコーの付属器腫瘤として発見され、左卵巣摘出術を受けた。4か月後に回腸・S状結腸への転移性低分化扁平上皮癌が判明した。シスプラチンなどによる化学療法は奏効せず、初回手術から9か月後に死亡した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 63-year-old postmenopausal woman with squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, initially detected by ultrasound as a mixed-echo adnexal mass. After left oophorectomy, metastatic poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma involving the ileum and sigmoid colon appeared four months later. Combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, leucovorin, and 5-fluorouracil failed, and the patient died nine months after the initial operation.

title: Intraperitoneal rupture of mature cystic ovarian teratoma secondary to sit-ups.
title_ja: 運動後に発生した成熟囊胞性卵巣奇形腫の腹腔内破裂
summary_ja: 1600mの走行と腹筋運動の後に全腹膜炎を発症した成熟囊胞性卵巣奇形腫の破裂例の報告。開腹で大量の腹水と腫瘍頂部の10cm線状穿孔を認め、腹腔内圧上昇が原因と考えられた。英文文献に類似例はないとされる。
summary_en: This case report describes general peritonitis caused by sudden perforation of a mature cystic ovarian teratoma after a 1600-m run and repeated sit-ups. Laparotomy showed massive ascites and a 10-cm linear perforation over the tumor dome, likely from raised intra-abdominal pressure. No granulomatous reaction or adhesions were found. The authors note that no similar case appears in the English literature.

title: Human testicular (non)seminomatous germ cell tumours: the clinical implications of recent pathobiological insights.
title_ja: ヒト精巣の（非）セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍：近年の病態生物学的知見の臨床的意義
summary_ja: 本レビューは、セミノーマと非セミノーマからなるII型精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、病態発生と臨床的意義に焦点を当てて扱う。前駆病変である上皮内癌と性腺芽細胞腫、ならびにセルトリ細胞および顆粒膜細胞による微小環境の役割を説明している。OCT3/4は精液中のCIS検出に、SOX17とSOX2はセミノーマと胎児性癌の鑑別に有用である。AFPとhCGは非セミノーマ成分の指標となる。著者らは、治療抵抗性を予測するマイクロサテライト不安定性とBRAF変異について、前向き試験による検証が必要であると指摘している。
summary_en: This review covers type II testicular germ cell tumours, seminoma and non-seminoma, emphasizing pathogenesis and clinical implications. It describes the precursor lesion carcinoma in situ and gonadoblastoma, and how Sertoli and granulosa cell microenvironments support them. OCT3/4 aids detection of CIS in semen, and SOX17 and SOX2 help distinguish seminoma from embryonal carcinoma. AFP and hCG mark non-seminomatous components. The authors note that microsatellite instability and BRAF mutations need prospective validation as predictors of treatment resistance.

title: Hemipalate deformity caused by a teratoma.
title_ja: 奇形腫による半口蓋変形
summary_ja: 口腔内に発生した奇形腫が半口蓋の変形を引き起こした症例の報告。先天性口腔内腫瘍は極めてまれで、口蓋突起の挙上を妨げて口蓋裂の原因となりうる。病変の用語の混乱と治療方針についても論じ、本稿では実施した治療内容を記載している。
summary_en: The authors report a patient with an intraoral teratoma causing a hemipalate deformity and describe the treatment performed. Congenital intraoral tumors derived from germ layers, including teratomas, dermoids, epignathi, and teratoid tumors, are very rare. Such embryonal neoplasms can disturb normal palatal shelf elevation and cause cleft palate. The paper also discusses the confusing terminology used for these lesions and the principles of their management.

title: Comparative immunohistochemical characterization of canine seminomas and Sertoli cell tumors.
title_ja: イヌのセミノーマとセルトリ細胞腫瘍の免疫組織化学的比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: イヌの精巣腫瘍であるセミノーマ20例とセルトリ細胞腫瘍15例を対象に、免疫組織化学で腫瘍マーカーの発現を比較した研究です。セミノーマではc-KITの発現が顕著で、セルトリ細胞腫瘍ではインヒビンαとビメンチンが有意に発現していました。ヒトの精巣腫瘍マーカーとの類似点と相違点が示され、獣医学領域での診断や比較腫瘍学への応用が期待されます。
summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to compare tumor marker expression in 20 canine seminomas and 15 Sertoli cell tumors. The panel included human testicular tumor markers such as PLAP, OCT3/4, CD30, AFP, inhibin-alpha, vimentin, c-KIT, and desmin. c-KIT was markedly expressed in canine seminomas, while inhibin-alpha and vimentin were significantly expressed in Sertoli cell tumors. The findings show both similarities and differences between canine and human testicular tumor marker profiles, relevant to veterinary diagnosis and comparative oncology.

title: Metastasis of testicular carcinoma in the inguinal region.
title_ja: 鼠径部における精巣がんの転移
summary_ja: 精巣がんの残存腫瘍から生じた、大きな鼠径部リンパ節転移の症例報告です。肺転移も伴う進行病期でした。化学療法の前に、出血と貧血を避けるため残存腫瘍を外科的に切除しました。術後に併用化学療法を4サイクル施行し、比較的良好な反応が得られました。鼠径部転移は稀で、病期Iの精巣がんでは約2%とされます。
summary_en: This case report describes inguinal metastasis from residual testicular cancer with a large mass, with pulmonary metastases indicating advanced disease. Surgical excision of the residual tumor was performed before chemotherapy to prevent bleeding and anemia. Four cycles of combination chemotherapy followed surgery, despite delayed treatment and a residual inguinal mass. The patient showed a relatively good response to postoperative chemotherapy. The authors note that inguinal metastasis is rare, with an approximate 2% incidence in stage I disease.

title: Clinicopathologic characteristics of malignant germ cell tumors in the ovaries of Korean women: a Korean Gynecologic Oncology Group Study.
title_ja: 韓国人女性における卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の臨床病理学的特徴
summary_ja: 1995年から2000年の間に治療された卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の韓国人女性196例を、14施設から後方視的に収集した研究です。病期Iが65.3%を占め、組織型では未熟奇形腫が最多でした。134例で妊孕性温存手術が行われ、多くが化学療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)を受けました。再発は6.8%で、病期と40歳超の年齢が関連しました。5年生存率は96.7%でした。
summary_en: This retrospective multicenter study reviewed 196 Korean women with ovarian malignant germ cell tumors treated between 1995 and 2000. Most patients were in stage I (65.3%), and immature teratoma was the most common histology. Fertility-sparing surgery was performed in 134 patients, and most received bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Recurrence occurred in 6.8% and was influenced by stage and age over 40. The 5-year survival rate was 96.7%, supporting conservative surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy.

title: Successfully conservative treatment of large cervical choriocarcinoma with profuse vaginal bleeding.
title_ja: 大量の膣出血を伴った大型子宮頸部絨毛癌の保存的治療の成功例
summary_ja: 命に関わる膣出血を伴った大型の原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告です。当初は子宮頸がんと誤診されていました。選択的子宮動脈塞栓術で出血を制御し、併用化学療法により子宮摘出を回避して寛解が得られました。原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌は稀であり、保存的治療が有用であった症例として報告されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a large primary cervical choriocarcinoma with life-threatening vaginal bleeding that was initially misdiagnosed as cervical cancer. Bleeding was controlled with selective uterine artery embolization. Remission was achieved with combination chemotherapy, avoiding hysterectomy. The authors note that primary cervical choriocarcinoma is rare and often presents with abnormal bleeding that mimics more common conditions. The case highlights the value of conservative management in selected patients.

title: Long-term functional outcome of sacrococcygeal teratoma in a UK regional center (1993 to 2006).
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫切除後の長期機能転帰（英国地域センター、1993～2006年）
summary_ja: 英国の一施設で14年間に診断された仙尾部奇形腫18例を後方視的に検討した研究。術後の長期フォローアップで約3分の1に重大な泌尿器合併症が生じ、神経因性膀胱などが見られた。術後1年目の超音波検査の定期施行と、長期フォローアップの重要性が示された。
summary_en: This UK regional center study followed 18 patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) over 14 years, with a median follow-up of 30 months. Alpha-fetoprotein normalized within 6 to 12 months after resection, and there were no perioperative deaths. Three patients developed urologic complications, including neurogenic bladder dysfunction. The authors conclude that about one-third of patients develop major urologic complications, recommend routine ultrasonography in the first postoperative year, and emphasize long-term pediatric surgical follow-up.

title: PDCD1, CTLA-4 and p53 gene polymorphism and susceptibility to gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: PDCD1、CTLA-4およびp53遺伝子多型と妊娠性絨毛性疾患の感受性
summary_ja: イラン人集団を対象に、PDCD1、CTLA-4、p53の一塩基多型と妊娠性絨毛性疾患の関連を検討した症例対照研究。PDCD1のC/T遺伝子型は患者で有意に多く（40.2%対19%）、オッズ比は2.87であった。CTLA-4とp53では関連は認められず、PDCD1多型が感受性に関与すると結論された。
summary_en: This Iranian genetic association study genotyped PDCD1 (PD-1), CTLA-4, and TP53 codon 72 polymorphisms in patients with gestational trophoblastic diseases and controls. The PDCD1 C/T genotype was significantly more frequent in patients (40.2%) than controls (19%), with an odds ratio of 2.87. No association was found for CTLA-4 or p53 polymorphisms. The authors conclude that PDCD1 polymorphisms confer susceptibility to gestational trophoblastic diseases in this population.

title: Mutations of the KIT gene and loss of heterozygosity of the PTEN region in a primary malignant melanoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の原発性悪性黒色腫におけるKIT遺伝子変異とPTEN領域のヘテロ接合性消失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した原発性悪性黒色腫の遺伝子解析研究。奇形腫と黒色腫の両方で10q23.3のPTEN領域にヘテロ接合性の消失が認められた。KIT遺伝子変異は黒色腫成分のみで同定され、奇形腫由来の黒色腫の発癌に関わる追加的なイベントと考えられた。
summary_en: This study examined a primary malignant melanoma arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, an extremely rare entity. Loss of heterozygosity around the PTEN gene at 10q23.3 was found in both the melanoma and the teratoma, and was also seen in a separate mature cystic teratoma without melanoma. KIT mutations (D816H and K558E) were identified only in the melanoma component. The authors propose PTEN LOH as an early molecular alteration in ovarian mature cystic teratoma, with KIT mutation as an additional event in melanoma oncogenesis.

title: Struma ovarii and peritoneal strumosis with thyrotoxicosis.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫および腹膜甲状腺腫症を合併した甲状腺中毒症
summary_ja: 49歳女性の卵巣甲状腺腫に腹膜甲状腺腫症を合併し、甲状腺中毒症を呈した症例報告。卵巣甲状腺腫と腹膜播種組織の外科的切除後に甲状腺機能は正常化した。腹膜甲状腺腫症が甲状腺中毒症を来した初の報告とされる。両病変の甲状腺ホルモン分泌への寄与度は不明とされた。
summary_en: This case report describes a 49-year-old woman with struma ovarii complicated by peritoneal strumosis and thyrotoxicosis. After surgical resection of both the ovarian struma and the peritoneal implants, her thyroid function normalized. The authors note this is the first reported case of peritoneal strumosis causing thyrotoxicosis. They also state that the relative contribution of the ovarian and peritoneal thyroid tissue to circulating hormones is unknown.
