summary_en: This analysis of 88 patients with malignant struma ovarii and prolonged follow-up identified adhesions, large ascites and ovarian serosal rupture as predictors of clinically malignant behavior. Tumors with a strumal component of 6 cm or less recurred rarely, whereas larger strumal components carried substantial risk. Histologic features rarely predicted outcome, except a papillary pattern or poorly differentiated carcinoma. Papillary carcinomas recurred earlier than follicular neoplasms. Overall survival was 89% at 10 years and 84% at 25 years.

title: Angiosarcoma arising in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた血管肉腫：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は卵巣腫瘍で最も多い腫瘍である。その悪性転化は稀で、多くは扁平上皮癌であり、肉腫はさらに少ない。本報告は、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた血管肉腫の1例の臨床病理学的特徴を示し、既報の5例を含めて文献的考察を行っている。
summary_en: Mature cystic teratoma of the ovary is the most common ovarian tumor. Its malignant transformation is rare, usually to squamous carcinoma and less often to sarcoma. The authors report a case of angiosarcoma arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma and review the five previously reported cases of this entity. They describe the clinicopathologic features of this rare occurrence, providing a reference for recognizing sarcomatous transformation in ovarian teratomas.

title: Limbic encephalitis associated with immature teratoma.
title_ja: 未熟奇形腫に伴う辺縁系脳炎
summary_ja: 傍腫瘍性神経症候群は悪性腫瘍に伴いうるもので、辺縁系脳炎はその特徴的な型の一つである。著者らは、未熟奇形腫に伴う重度の辺縁系脳炎を発症した、それまで健康な若い女性を報告している。腫瘍の外科的切除の後、急速な神経学的改善が得られ、フォローアップ中に症状は完全に消失した。腫瘍の治癒率が高い場合でも傍腫瘍症候群は永続的障害や死亡を引き起こしうるため、早期の認識が重要であると強調している。
summary_en: Paraneoplastic neurological syndromes can accompany malignancies, and limbic encephalitis is one of their characteristic forms. The authors describe a previously healthy young woman who developed severe limbic encephalitis associated with an immature teratoma. Surgical resection of the tumor was followed by rapid neurological improvement and complete resolution of symptoms during follow-up. The report stresses that paraneoplastic syndromes can cause permanent disability or death even when the underlying tumor is highly curable, so early recognition is important.

title: Benign cystic teratoma of the parotid gland: a case report.
title_ja: 耳下腺の良性嚢胞性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 耳下腺の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は非常に稀である。本報告は、4年間徐々に増大した左耳下腺腫瘤を有する17歳女性の症例である。穿刺吸引細胞診と捺印細胞診で扁平上皮、皮脂腺様細胞、毛幹が認められた。病理組織学的に単房性で、皮膚付属器や軟骨を含み、未熟組織や悪性転化は認めなかった。耳下腺嚢胞性病変の鑑別診断に本疾患を含めるべきと述べている。
summary_en: Mature cystic teratomas of the major salivary glands are rare. The authors report a mature cystic teratoma of the left parotid gland in a 17-year-old woman with a slow-growing parotid mass. Fine needle aspiration and imprint cytology showed squamous, sebaceous, and hair-shaft-containing cells. Histology revealed a unicystic lesion lined by keratinized squamous epithelium, with skin adnexa and mature cartilage, and no immature tissue or malignant transformation. The authors suggest that this entity be included in the differential diagnosis of parotid cystic lesions.

title: Nodular lung schistosomiais lesions after chemotherapy for dysgerminoma.
title_ja: ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に対する化学療法後の結節性肺住血吸虫症病変
summary_ja: マリ渡航歴のある女性で、ディスジャーミノーマに対する化学療法終了1か月後に、結節性肺住血吸虫症が診断された。初感染から約16か月後であった。血清学的検査で著明な好酸球増多が認められた。化学療法後の患者でも、原因不明の好酸球増多があれば寄生虫感染を考慮すべきと指摘している。
summary_en: The authors describe a traveler to Mali who developed nodular pulmonary schistosomiasis about 16 months after primary infection, one month after completing chemotherapy for a malignant tumor that was dysgerminoma. Marked eosinophilia on serologic testing was an important clue. The case highlights that parasitic infection should be considered in cancer patients with unexplained eosinophilia, particularly immigrants and travelers to tropical countries, including those treated with chemotherapy.

title: Serum human chorionic gonadotropin is associated with angiogenesis in germ cell testicular tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値と血管新生の関連
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者101例を後方視的に解析し、血清hCG値と腫瘍血管密度の関連を検討した。hCG≧25mIU/mLでは血管新生が増加し、多変量解析でも独立した関連因子であった一方、VEGF発現との関連は認められなかった。hCGはVEGFとは独立して血管新生に関与し、治療標的となりうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 101 patients with germ cell testicular tumors evaluated serum hCG, AFP and LDH, microvessel density, and VEGF immunohistochemistry. High hCG (25 mIU/mL or more) was the only independent factor associated with increased vascular density on multivariate analysis, while VEGF expression showed no association. Relapse occurred in 7.5% and mortality in 11.5%. The authors suggest hCG promotes tumor angiogenesis independently of VEGF and may be a therapeutic target.

title: First use of preimplantation genotyping in prevention of recurrent diandric complete hydatidiform mole.
title_ja: 反復性両性父性完全胞状奇胎の予防への着床前遺伝子診断の初の応用
summary_ja: 反復性両性父性完全胞状奇胎の女性に対し、体外受精で得た11個の胚を全ゲノム増幅と16か所のSTR解析で評価した。全胚が両親由来の正常な遺伝形式を示し、1個の胚盤胞を移植して健康な一卵性双生児の女児が出生した。胞状奇胎の再発予防に着床前遺伝子診断を用いた初の報告である。
summary_en: The authors report a woman with recurrent diandric complete hydatidiform mole who underwent IVF with preimplantation genotyping. Eleven embryos were biopsied at the single-cell level and analyzed by whole genome amplification and 16 STR loci. All showed normal biparental inheritance, and one blastocyst was transferred, resulting in healthy monozygotic twin girls. This is the first use of preimplantation genotyping to prevent recurrent molar pregnancy, which carries a risk of persistent trophoblastic neoplasia or choriocarcinoma.

title: Upper gastrointestinal bleeding from metastatic testicular cancer.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんによる上部消化管出血
summary_ja: 精巣がんに対し精巣摘除術、リンパ節郭清、プラチナ製剤による化学療法を受けた22歳男性が、黒色便と陰嚢腫脹で受診した。十二指腸の転移病変の生検で混合型胚細胞腫瘍(未熟奇形腫成分)と診断された。イホスファミドを含むレジメンへの変更で5か月後に病変は完全消失し、プラチナ抵抗性後の二次治療としての有用性が示された。
summary_en: A 22-year-old man with prior orchiectomy, lymphadenectomy, and platinum-based chemotherapy for testicular cancer presented with melena and scrotal swelling. Endoscopy revealed duodenal polypoid masses, and biopsy showed mixed germ cell tumor with immature teratoma. After switching to an ifosfamide-based regimen, the duodenal lesions completely resolved over 5 months. The authors suggest ifosfamide is effective as second-line therapy after platinum resistance.

title: Ovarian Teratoma Masquerading as a CSF Pseudocyst in a Female with a Ventriculoperitoneal Shunt.
title_ja: 脳室腹腔シャント患者において脳脊髄液偽嚢胞と誤認された卵巣奇形腫
summary_ja: 脳室腹腔シャントを有する若年女性の腹部嚢胞性腫瘤が、当初は脳脊髄液偽嚢胞と考えられました。しかし最終的には卵巣奇形腫と判明しています。本症例は、初期の画像診断に頼らず、データ全体から診断を統合し、あらゆる鑑別診断を検討することの重要性を示しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with a ventriculoperitoneal shunt whose abdominal cystic mass was initially presumed to be a cerebrospinal fluid pseudocyst. It was ultimately identified as an ovarian neoplasm, later confirmed as an ovarian teratoma. The authors emphasize that clinicians should integrate all data sources rather than rely on initial radiographic evaluation, and should consider all differential diagnoses when evaluating cystic abdominal masses.

title: Twin fetus in fetu with immature teratoma: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 双胎内の胎児内胎児と未熟奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 生後2日の女児が腹部腫瘤、胆汁性嘔吐を呈し、手術により後腹膜に双生児胎児内胎児と別個の未熟奇形腫が見つかった症例報告です。病理学的に確認され、術後3か月のフォローアップで血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は正常化しました。文献レビューも含みます。
summary_en: This case report describes a two-day-old female newborn with an abdominal mass, in whom surgery revealed a retroperitoneal double fetus-in-fetu alongside a separate immature teratoma. Pathology confirmed both findings. Serum alpha-fetoprotein normalized by three months of follow-up, and the infant remained healthy after discharge. The report includes a review of the literature on this rare condition.

title: Male infertility: a risk factor for testicular cancer.
title_ja: 男性不妊症：精巣がんのリスク因子
summary_ja: 男性不妊症が精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク因子となりうるかをレビューした論文です。精巣形成不全症候群、12番染色体異数性、DNAミスマッチ修復、Y染色体不安定性などの関連機序を検討しています。精液の質の低下や生殖補助医療の関与にも触れ、感受性の高い男性を特定するための遺伝学的・エピジェネティックな研究の必要性を示しています。
summary_en: This review examines male infertility as a risk factor for testicular germ cell tumor. It discusses proposed links, including testicular dysgenesis syndrome, chromosome 12 aneuploidy, DNA mismatch repair defects, and Y-chromosome instability. The authors note rising tumor incidence alongside declining semen quality, and the influence of assisted reproduction. They call for genetic and epigenetic approaches to identify men susceptible to testicular germ cell tumor.

title: Vascular compromise as a cause of sudden death in a pediatric patient with widely metastatic testicular germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 広範な転移を伴う精巣腫瘍の小児における血管障害による突然死
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍と広範な転移を有する14歳男児が入院中に突然倒れ、蘇生に失敗しました。剖検では血栓塞栓症は認められず、骨盤・腹部腫瘤による下大静脈の高度圧迫と門脈系への短絡所見があり、静脈還流障害が死因と考えられました。
summary_en: This case describes a 14-year-old boy with a large testicular tumor and widespread metastatic disease who collapsed while showering and could not be resuscitated. Autopsy showed no thromboembolism, a recognized cause of sudden death in metastatic testicular tumors. Instead, marked compression of the inferior vena cava by the pelvicoabdominal tumor mass, along with findings suggesting systemic-portal shunting, indicated impaired venous return as the cause of death.

title: Intrathoracic glial implants in a child with gliomatosis peritonei.
title_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症を伴う小児の胸腔内グリア組織移植
summary_ja: 12歳女児の未熟卵巣奇形腫の症例で、腹膜の多発性神経膠組織移植(腹膜神経膠腫症)と右胸膜腫瘤を認めた。胸膜腫瘤は腹膜病変と組織学的に区別できない成熟グリア組織であり、胸膜神経膠腫症の初めての報告である。著者らは、奇形腫からの直接的な播種やリンパ行性進展ではなく、多能性ミュラー管幹細胞の化生によって生じるという化生説を支持する根拠を示している。
summary_en: A 12-year-old girl with an immature ovarian teratoma had multiple glial peritoneal implants (gliomatosis peritonei) and an unexpected right pleural mass. Histology showed the pleural mass was normal mature glial tissue, indistinguishable from the peritoneal implants. This is the first described case of pleural gliomatosis. The authors argue that these implants arise through metaplasia of pluripotent Müllerian stem cells rather than direct extrusion or lymphatic spread from the teratoma, supporting the metaplastic theory.

title: Complex partial status epilepticus revealing anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎が発見の契機となった複雑部分発作重積状態
summary_ja: 複雑部分発作重積状態で発症した症例で、当初は再発性てんかん発作と誤認された異常運動の後に、卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された。発熱を伴う前駆期に続き、記憶障害、精神症状、けいれんなどが出現した。早期の腫瘍摘除により神経学的予後が良好となりうるため、てんかんや運動障害を診療する医師は、この稀だが治療可能な疾患を認識すべきと著者らは強調している。
summary_en: A patient presented with complex partial status epilepticus that was initially misread as recurrent epileptic seizures, but was ultimately diagnosed as anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma. The illness began with a febrile prodrome resembling a viral infection, followed by memory loss, psychiatric symptoms, seizures, and abnormal movements. The authors emphasize that early tumor surgery can yield good neurological outcomes, and that clinicians treating epilepsy and movement disorders should recognize this rare but treatable condition.

title: Immature teratoma of the mediastinum arising in ectopic thyroid tissue: a case report.
title_ja: 異所性甲状腺組織由来と考えられた縦隔未熟奇形腫:症例報告
summary_ja: 生後18日の男児に発生した上縦隔未熟奇形腫の症例である。病理組織学的所見で腫瘍被膜外側に圧排された甲状腺濾胞の不連続な帯が認められ、異所性甲状腺組織を起源とする奇形腫が示唆された。乳児期の未熟奇形腫の良性の経過に合致し、患者は22か月後も無病である。異所性甲状腺組織も甲状腺と同様の病理変化、稀に奇形腫を生じうると結論づけている。
summary_en: A male newborn aged 18 days presented with an upper mediastinal immature teratoma. Histologic examination revealed a discontinuous rim of compressed thyroid follicles along the outer tumor capsule, suggesting the teratoma arose from ectopic thyroid tissue, a finding not previously described. Consistent with the typically benign behavior of immature teratoma in infancy, the patient remained disease-free at 22 months. The authors conclude that ectopic thyroid tissue can undergo the same pathologic changes as the thyroid gland, including rare teratoma formation.

title: Functional glutathione S-transferase genotypes among testicular germ cell tumor survivors: associations with primary and post-chemotherapy tumor histology.
title_ja: 機能的グルタチオンS-転移酵素遺伝子型と精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者：原発腫瘍および化学療法後の組織型との関連
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生存者675例と対照189例で、生殖細胞系列のGSTM1、GSTT1、GSTP1多型を解析した。特定の遺伝子型の組合せは純粋胎児性癌および純粋奇形腫のリスク低下と関連し、GSTP1のAアレルは予後良好群と関連した。GSTM1ヌル型は予後不良と、GSTP1-AGは化学療法後組織の壊死と関連した。白金製剤による化学療法の不応性は特定の遺伝子型の組合せと関連した。著者らは、GST遺伝子型が組織型および予後と関連すると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study analyzed germline GSTM1, GSTT1, and GSTP1 polymorphisms in 675 testicular germ cell tumor survivors and 189 controls. Certain genotype combinations were associated with reduced risk of pure embryonal carcinoma and pure teratoma, and the GSTP1 A-allele was linked to a good prognostic group. GSTM1 null genotype was associated with poor prognosis, and GSTP1-AG with necrosis in post-chemotherapy histology. Platinum-based chemotherapy failure was associated with a specific genotype combination. The authors conclude that GST genotypes relate to histology and prognosis.

title: Prognostic role of tumor-head volume ratio in fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫における予後予測因子としての腫瘍・頭部体積比
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の胎児28例、超音波画像71枚を後方視的に検討し、充実性腫瘍体積と頭部体積の比(STV/HV)を算出した。比が1を超える例では異常所見や胎児水腫の頻度が高く、死亡率は61%であった。比が1未満の例は死亡がなかった。STV/HVは高拍出性心不全や胎児水腫による予後不良例の同定に有用で、治療方針の決定を補助しうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 28 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma reviewed 71 sonograms to calculate a solid tumor volume to head volume (STV/HV) ratio. Ratios above 1 were strongly associated with abnormal sonographic signs and hydrops, and 61% of those fetuses died, versus none with ratios below 1. The authors conclude that the STV/HV ratio can identify fetuses at high risk of poor outcome from high-output cardiac failure and hydrops, and can guide management decisions.

title: Pediatric germ cell tumors and maternal vitamin supplementation: a Children's Oncology Group study.
title_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍と母体のビタミン補充:Children's Oncology Group研究
summary_ja: Children's Oncology Groupの症例対照研究で、小児胚細胞腫瘍278例と年齢・性別をマッチさせた対照423例について、妊娠前後の母体ビタミン摂取を検討した。全体では有意でないもののリスク低下が見られた。性腺外および性腺の腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)/セミノーマ、奇形腫で逆相関を認めたが、卵黄嚢腫瘍では認めなかった。母体補充が小児胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを下げる可能性があるが、小規模で観察研究の限界を考慮すべきとしている。
summary_en: This Children's Oncology Group case-control study of 278 pediatric germ cell tumor cases and 423 matched controls examined maternal vitamin use around pregnancy. Overall vitamin use was associated with a nonsignificant reduced GCT risk. Inverse associations appeared for extragonadal and gonadal tumors, dysgerminoma/seminoma, and teratoma, but not yolk sac tumors. No consistent pattern emerged for periconceptional or first-trimester exposure. The authors conclude that maternal supplementation may reduce pediatric GCT risk, but small sample size and observational limitations warrant caution.

title: Clinicopathological study of regressed testicular tumors (apparent extragonadal germ cell neoplasms).
title_ja: 退縮した精巣腫瘍(見かけ上の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍)の臨床病理学的研究
summary_ja: スペインの16年間の後方視的調査で、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍として発見された退縮性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の17例を検討した。全連続胚細胞腫瘍の4%を占めた。腹部腫瘤や腰痛が主症状で、精巣は触知されなかった。超音波検査では石灰化が多く、生存腫瘍巣が41%に残存していたため、再発予防のため超音波診断と手術が重要とされる。
summary_en: This retrospective 16-year review in Spain identified 17 patients with regressed testicular germ cell tumors that presented as extragonadal metastases. Primary testicular origin accounted for 4% of consecutive germ cell tumors. Presenting features included abdominal mass and loin pain, while the testis was not palpably abnormal. Ultrasound commonly showed calcifications and hyperechoic linear images, and histology showed fibrosis and hemosiderin. Viable tumor foci were found in 41% of cases, so the authors stress ultrasound diagnosis and surgery to prevent relapse.

title: Primary pulmonary teratoma: Report of a case and the proposition of "bronchotrichosis" as a new term.
title_ja: 原発性肺奇形腫の症例報告と新用語「bronchotrichosis」(気管支毛髪症)の提唱
summary_ja: 口臭を訴えた36歳男性で、気管支鏡検査により右上葉から発生する毛髪が確認された。右上葉切除術後、病理学的に原発性肺奇形腫と診断された。まれで多くは良性の性腺外奇形腫である。気管支内の毛髪は縦隔奇形腫が原因となることが多く、この徴候に「bronchotrichosis」という新用語を提案している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with halitosis whose bronchoscopy revealed coarse hair arising from the right upper lobe. Right upper lobectomy confirmed a primary pulmonary teratoma, a very rare extragonadal tumor that is usually benign. The authors note that hair in the airway is typically caused by mediastinal teratoma, and they propose 'bronchotrichosis' as a new term for this sign. The case highlights the diagnostic value of recognizing this finding.

title: Brain malformations associated with epignathus: a clue for the correct prenatal diagnosis.
title_ja: 口腔奇形腫(エピグナトス)に伴う頭蓋内奇形:正確な出生前診断への手がかり
summary_ja: 出生前に診断された口腔奇形腫(エピグナトス)の症例である。胎児MRIで正中頭蓋内奇形と下垂体の重複が認められ、小さな口腔腫瘤の正確な診断につながった。頭蓋内所見が出生前診断の手がかりになることを示している。ここでの頭蓋内所見は奇形であり、原発性中枢神経系胚細胞腫瘍ではない。
summary_en: This report describes a fetus with epignathus, an oral teratoma, diagnosed in utero. Fetal MRI revealed midline intracranial malformations, including duplication of the pituitary gland. These brain findings helped clinicians correctly identify a small fetal oral mass. The case shows how associated intracranial abnormalities can guide accurate prenatal diagnosis. The teratoma is extragonadal, and the intracranial findings are malformations rather than a primary CNS germ cell tumor.

title: Live birth following treatment of post molar choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎後絨毛癌の治療後の生児出産
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎除去後に持続性出血を来した絨毛癌の症例。メトトレキサートによる化学療法で寛解し、その後正常な胎盤を伴う健康な新生児を正期産で出産した。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の化学療法完遂後も、正常な月経と合併症のない分娩が期待できると結論づけている。
summary_en: A woman with post-molar choriocarcinoma, who had persistent bleeding after molar evacuation, was treated with methotrexate chemotherapy. She achieved remission and later delivered a healthy term baby with a normal placenta. The authors conclude that normal menstruation and an uncomplicated term delivery can be expected after complete chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

title: Bilateral renal and jejunal metastasis of choriocarcinoma presenting as spontaneous renal hemorrhage.
title_ja: 絨毛癌の両側腎および空腸転移により自然腎出血を呈した症例
summary_ja: 原発巣が明らかでない絨毛癌の両腎転移により、自然腎出血と反復する肉眼的血尿を呈した症例。塞栓術で出血を制御したが、化学療法中に空腸転移による消化管出血を来し外科的切除を要した。術後に院内肺炎から敗血症を併発し死亡した。
summary_en: A patient with metastatic choriocarcinoma involving both kidneys presented with spontaneous renal hemorrhage and recurrent gross hematuria, without an identifiable primary uterine tumor. Angioembolization controlled the bleeding. Jejunal metastasis later caused gastrointestinal bleeding during chemotherapy, requiring surgical resection. The patient died of postoperative sepsis after nosocomial pneumonia.

title: Identification and validation of a gene expression signature that predicts outcome in adult men with germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍の予後を予測する遺伝子発現シグネチャーの同定と検証
summary_ja: シスプラチン治療を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝子発現解析により、5年全生存期間を予測する遺伝子分類器を開発した。10遺伝子モデルは検証セットで一致指数0.83を示し、臨床リスク分類とは独立した予後因子であった。予後予測と新たな治療標的への応用が期待される。
summary_en: Expression profiling of 74 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors from cisplatin-treated patients (training set) and 34 patients (validation set) identified a gene classifier predicting 5-year overall survival. A 10-gene model achieved a concordance index of 0.83 in validation and remained an independent prognostic factor beyond clinical risk stratification, suggesting potential for improved outcome prediction and therapeutic targets.

title: Antenatal diagnosis and perinatal management of extremely giant fetal cervicopharyngeal teratoma resulting in impossible fetal intubation: a case report.
title_ja: 出生前に診断された極めて巨大な胎児頸部咽頭奇形腫の周産期管理と気道確保不能：症例報告
summary_ja: 18週に超音波とMRIで診断された、極めて巨大な胎児頸部咽頭奇形腫の症例報告。急速な増大と羊水過多のため28週で分娩とした。EXIT手技中に気道確保を繰り返し試みたが失敗し、新生児は早期に死亡した。巨大頸部奇形腫では多職種チームでも気道確保の成功は保証されないと結論づけている。
summary_en: A case report of an extremely large fetal cervicopharyngeal teratoma diagnosed at 18 weeks by ultrasound and MRI. Rapid growth and polyhydramnios led to delivery at 28 weeks. During an EXIT procedure, repeated attempts to secure the airway failed, and the neonate died early. The authors conclude that a team approach improves but does not guarantee airway success in giant neck teratomas.

title: Therapeutic options following orchiectomy for stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの精巣摘除術後の治療選択肢
summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術後に選択しうる治療を概説した総説。積極的監視では約80%が再発せず、再発例はすべて救済可能である。放射線療法は治癒率が高いが、長期毒性と約80%の過剰治療がある。化学療法のデータは未成熟である。監視を第一選択とし、次いで放射線療法を推奨している。
summary_en: A review of treatment options after orchiectomy for clinical stage I testicular seminoma, a highly curable malignancy regardless of the option chosen. Active surveillance yields about 80% relapse-free survival, and all relapses are salvageable. Radiotherapy has near-universal cure but long-term toxicity and about 80% overtreatment. Single-agent chemotherapy data remain immature. The authors favor surveillance, then radiotherapy, with chemotherapy as an alternative.

title: Choosing treatment for stage I seminoma: who should get what?
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの治療選択：誰にどの治療を行うか
summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの治療選択に関する論評。経済的に安定し、キャリアも安定した患者には積極的監視を推奨している。経済的、精神的、またはコンプライアンス上の理由でフォローアップを緩やかにする必要がある患者には予防的放射線療法を提案する。補助的カルボプラチンについては、生存、毒性、二次性精巣がん、費用に関する長期データが必要としている。
summary_en: A commentary on treatment choice for stage I seminoma. The authors favor active surveillance for patients with financial stability and stable careers. Prophylactic radiotherapy is suggested for those needing a less intensive follow-up schedule for financial, emotional, or compliance reasons. They note that longer follow-up data are needed for adjuvant carboplatin regarding survival, toxicity, second testicular cancers, and cost.

title: Metachronous mediastinal seminoma occurring after intracranial germinoma in an adolescent.
title_ja: 松果体ジャーミノーマ後に生じた異時性縦隔セミノーマ（思春期患者）
summary_ja: 15歳男児の松果体ジャーミノーマに対して放射線療法を行い寛解した後、約19か月後に縦隔セミノーマが発見された症例報告。血清β-hCGの上昇を契機に診断され、全身化学療法により完全寛解が得られた。頭蓋内胚腫後の異時性縦隔GCTのリスクと、β-hCGによるフォローアップの重要性を示す。
summary_en: A case report of a 15-year-old boy with pineal germinoma treated with radiation therapy, followed by a mediastinal seminoma diagnosed about 19 months after the germinoma resolved. The mediastinal seminoma was identified through rising serum beta-hCG, with no CNS recurrence. Systemic chemotherapy led to complete resolution. The case highlights the risk of metachronous extragonadal germ cell tumors after intracranial germinoma and the value of serum beta-hCG monitoring during follow-up.

title: Therapy for foetal pericardial tumours: survival following in utero shunting, and literature review.
title_ja: 胎児心膜奇形腫に対する子宮内治療と生存、および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 胎児心膜部奇形腫に対し、子宮内で心膜羊膜シャント術を施行し治療に成功した初例の報告と文献レビュー。胎児治療は水腫を伴う症例の生存率を向上させるとされ、反復心膜穿刺の代替としてシャント術の可能性が示唆されている。心膜部の奇形腫は稀な性腺外発生例である。
summary_en: Report of the first fetal pericardial teratoma treated successfully in utero by pericardioamniotic shunting, with a literature review. Fetal treatment is noted to improve survival in cases with hydrops. The authors suggest that pericardioamniotic shunting may be an alternative to serial pericardiocentesis. The report places this rare extragonadal fetal teratoma within the context of prenatal intervention options.

title: Immune-mediated encephalitis and virilization in association with a mature cystic ovarian teratoma in an adolescent girl.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う免疫介在性脳炎と男性化
summary_ja: 16か月前に原因不明の脳炎を発症した15歳女児が、月経異常と男性化を呈した症例。左卵巣の大きな成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が見つかり、高アンドロゲン値を示していた。血清の抗NMDA受容体抗体が検出され、腫瘍の免疫組織化学で反応が確認された。摘出後、月経と行動の異常は改善し、テストステロン値も低下した。奇形腫関連脳炎と男性化の合併は初の報告である。
summary_en: Case report of a 15-year-old girl with menstrual irregularity and virilization, who had encephalitis of unknown cause 16 months earlier. Imaging and surgery found a large left ovarian mature cystic teratoma producing high androgen levels. Serum antibodies to the NMDA receptor were detected and immunohistochemistry showed reactivity with NMDA receptor-expressing tumor areas. After excision, menses became regular, behavioral problems resolved, and testosterone fell. The authors report the first case combining virilizing mature cystic teratoma with teratoma-associated encephalitis.

title: Imaging of ovarian teratomas: appearances and complications.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の画像所見と合併症
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫は卵巣で最も多い胚細胞腫瘍である。本総説は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、卵巣甲状腺腫などの単胚葉性奇形腫の画像所見を包括的に解説する。捻転、破裂、悪性転化といった合併症に加え、未熟奇形腫治療後に生じる growing teratoma syndrome も取り上げ、診断に役立つ画像所見を示している。
summary_en: This pictorial review describes the imaging spectrum of ovarian teratomas, the most common germ cell neoplasm of the ovary. It covers mature cystic teratomas, immature teratomas, and monodermal teratomas such as struma ovarii. Complications including torsion, rupture, and malignant degeneration are discussed, along with growing teratoma syndrome after treatment of immature teratoma. The authors emphasize imaging features that help radiologists recognize these tumors and their complications, aiding accurate diagnosis.

title: Paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis cured with resection of an adnexal mass.
title_ja: 付属器腫瘤の切除により治癒した傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、混乱・興奮・攻撃性から昏睡に至った女性の傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎を報告する。付属器腫瘤を認め、切除標本では成熟奇形腫に限局した未熟成分が確認された。手術後に神経症状は改善した。辺縁系脳炎の女性では悪性腫瘍の精査を行い、付属器腫瘤があれば婦人科への相談が重要であると著者らは述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman presenting with confusion, agitation, and aggression that progressed to coma, caused by paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis. An adnexal mass was identified, and resection revealed a mature teratoma with focal immature components. Neurological symptoms resolved after surgery. The authors recommend thorough malignancy screening in women with limbic encephalitis and gynecologic consultation when an adnexal mass is found, noting good prognosis with prompt surgical resection.

title: A primary extragonadal teratoma of the proximal humerus.
title_ja: 上腕骨近位部に生じた原発性性腺外奇形腫
summary_ja: 14歳女児の左上腕骨近位部に生じた原発性性腺外悪性奇形腫の症例報告である。MRIでは悪性骨腫瘍が疑われたが、病理組織学的検査で未熟骨性奇形腫と診断された。骨シンチグラフィーとPET-CTでも上腕骨近位部以外に病変はみられなかった。四肢に発生する性腺外奇形腫は極めて稀であり、原発性骨悪性腫瘍との画像鑑別の難しさを示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl with a primary extragonadal malignant teratoma of the left proximal humerus. Although MRI suggested a malignant bone tumor, pathology revealed an immature bony teratoma. Bone scintigraphy and PET-CT showed uptake limited to the proximal humerus with no other lesions. The report highlights the rarity of extragonadal teratomas arising in an extremity and the diagnostic difficulty of distinguishing them radiologically from primary bone malignancy.

title: Identification of nuclear structural protein alterations associated with seminomas.
title_ja: セミノーマに関連する核構造タンパク質の変化の同定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、セミノーマ患者と正常精巣の核マトリックスタンパク質を二次元電気泳動と質量分析で比較した。正常精巣に特異的な蛋白7種とセミノーマに特異的な4種を同定し、StARD7 と非セミノーマ組織で見られた CDK10 にも言及している。これらの核構造タンパク質は精巣がんの検出や経過観察のバイオマーカー、治療標的となる可能性があると著者らは提案している。
summary_en: This study used two-dimensional electrophoresis and mass spectrometry to compare nuclear matrix proteins from seminoma tissue with those of normal testes. Seven proteins were specific to normal testes, while four were found only in seminomas. StARD7 was identified among normal testis proteins, and CDK10 was associated with non-seminoma tissues. The authors suggest these nuclear structural proteins may serve as biomarkers for detecting and monitoring testicular cancer and as potential therapeutic targets.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma: clinical characteristics and long-term outcome in Nigerian children.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫：ナイジェリアの小児における臨床的特徴と長期転帰
summary_ja: 1990年から2008年にナイジェリアの一施設で治療された小児仙尾部奇形腫38例の後方視的検討。大部分は良性だったが、4例は受診時に悪性で化学療法を受けた。周術期の合併症などで3例が死亡した。フォローアップされた21例のうち、2例(9.5%)が初回切除後に再発し、5例(23.8%)に機能障害が認められた。受診の遅れや長期の機能的後遺症への対策が課題であり、多施設研究の必要性が示された。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 38 Nigerian children with sacrococcygeal teratoma (1990 to 2008) found most tumors were benign, although four were malignant at presentation and received chemotherapy. Three children died, mainly from perioperative complications. Among 21 patients followed for a median of six years, two (9.5%) had recurrence after primary excision and five (23.8%) had functional impairment. The authors conclude that late presentation, recurrence, malignant transformation and long-term functional sequelae remain important problems, and that multicenter studies are needed in developing countries.

title: Coexistent gastric primary choriocarcinoma and adenocarcinoma.
title_ja: 胃原発の絨毛癌と腺癌の併存
summary_ja: 69歳男性が腹痛と排便習慣の変化で受診し、胃幽門前庭部に潰瘍性の腫瘍を認めた。切除標本では絨毛癌成分と腺癌成分が併存し、絨毛癌成分はβ-hCG陽性で血清β-hCG高値と一致した。肝転移も認められた。非妊娠性・性腺外の胃原発絨毛癌は極めてまれで予後不良であり、早期の正確な診断が重要であると述べている。
summary_en: A 69-year-old man presented with abdominal pain and irregular bowel habits and was found to have an ulcerated tumor in the gastric antrum. Histology showed combined choriocarcinoma and adenocarcinoma, and strong immunostaining for beta-hCG in the choriocarcinomatous component matched elevated serum beta-hCG levels. Liver metastasis was present. The authors note that non-gestational, extragonadal gastric choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, has a poor prognosis and metastasizes early, so accurate recognition is essential.

title: Granulosa cell tumor arising in an ovary with mature teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟奇形腫を伴う卵巣に発生した顆粒膜細胞腫
summary_ja: 閉経周辺期の女性で、同一卵巣に顆粒膜細胞腫と成熟奇形腫が同時に生じた症例を報告する。この組合せは過去に8例しか報告されていない。顆粒膜細胞腫は低悪性度の悪性腫瘍で、再発が遅れて現れることがあるため、綿密なフォローアップが必要である。本報告は、低悪性度に見える腫瘍であっても長期の監視が重要であることを強調している。
summary_en: A perimenopausal woman had granulosa cell tumor and mature teratoma occurring synchronously in the same ovary, a combination reported only eight times before. Granulosa cell tumor is a low-grade malignancy that requires close follow-up because recurrences may appear late. The report describes the case and its pathological features, emphasizing that long-term surveillance is important even when the tumor appears low grade.

title: A case of non-gestational choriocarcinoma arising in the ovary of a postmenopausal woman.
title_ja: 閉経後女性の卵巣に生じた非妊娠性絨毛癌の1例
summary_ja: 55歳の閉経後女性に発生した非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌で、肺転移を伴っていた。この腫瘍は卵巣腫瘍の0.6%以下とまれで予後不良であり、妊娠性の絨毛癌や他の癌腫と鑑別することが重要である。著者らは文献の簡単なレビューとともに症例を提示し、慎重な病理学的分類の価値を強調している。
summary_en: A 55-year-old postmenopausal woman had a non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma with lung metastasis. This tumor accounts for 0.6% or fewer of ovarian neoplasms and has a poor prognosis, making it important to distinguish it from gestational forms and other carcinomas. The authors present this case with a brief literature review and emphasize the value of careful pathological classification in this rare condition.

title: Molecular and cell biology of testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子生物学と細胞生物学
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子生物学と細胞生物学をまとめた総説。20～40歳男性で最も多い腫瘍である。セミノーマと非セミノーマはいずれも治癒率が高いが、転移性非セミノーマの最大30%は持続的寛解が得られず、転移性奇形腫はシスプラチンを基盤とする治療に抵抗性を示すことがある。分子生物学の理解を深め、治療強度を予後に応じて調整する必要性が述べられている。
summary_en: This review summarizes the molecular and cell biology of testicular germ cell tumors, the most common tumor in men aged 20 to 40. Seminomas and nonseminomas have high cure rates, but up to 30% of patients with metastatic nonseminoma do not achieve durable remission, and metastatic teratomas can resist cisplatin-based therapy. The authors argue that better understanding of molecular biology is needed to refine prognostic classification and tailor treatment intensity to disease severity.

title: Human chorionic gonadotropin tests.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン検査
summary_ja: hCGは単一の分子ではなく、通常型hCG、過グリコシル化hCG、遊離βサブユニットといった複数の変異体からなることを解説した総説。市販の多くの検査は通常型hCGしか検出しないため、他の変異体が優位な妊娠性絨毛性疾患や胚細胞腫瘍では誤差を生じうる。検査が測定する対象を理解することの重要性が述べられている。
summary_en: This review explains that hCG exists in several variants (regular hCG, hyperglycosylated hCG and free beta-subunit) produced by different cells and malignancies. Many commercial assays detect only regular hCG, which can cause errors in gestational trophoblastic disease and germ cell tumors where other variants predominate. The authors recommend that clinicians understand which hCG forms a test measures, since hCG testing is essential in managing gestational trophoblastic diseases and useful for testicular and other germ cell malignancies.

title: Suppression of teratocarcinoma growth by soluble TRAIL gene expression driven by the progression-elevated gene-3 promoter.
title_ja: rPEGプロモーター駆動の可溶性TRAIL遺伝子発現による奇形癌増殖の抑制
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: rPEGプロモーターで駆動される可溶性TRAIL遺伝子のプラスミドを構築し、胎児性癌細胞および奇形癌を担ぐマウスで評価した研究。導入された細胞はアポトーシスを起こし、デス受容体の発現が上昇した。腫瘍内注射により腫瘍増殖が抑制され生存期間が延長され、肝臓を含む組織で明らかな毒性は認められなかった。奇形癌に対する遺伝子治療への応用が期待されると結論している。
summary_en: Researchers built a plasmid expressing soluble TRAIL under the control of the rPEG promoter and tested it against embryonal carcinoma cells and teratocarcinoma-bearing mice. Transfected cells underwent apoptosis and increased death receptor expression. Intratumoral injection of the DNA-liposome complex suppressed tumor growth, prolonged survival, and caused no detectable toxicity in examined tissues including the liver. The authors conclude that this approach could enable effective gene therapy against teratocarcinoma.

title: Gestational choriocarcinoma diagnosed with spontaneous splenic rupture after pregnancy induced by in vitro fertilization: a case report.
title_ja: 体外受精による妊娠後に自然脾破裂で診断された妊娠性絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 29歳女性が体外受精後の双胎妊娠中に腹痛、低血圧、嘔吐を呈して救急受診した。自然脾破裂を契機に妊娠性絨毛癌と診断された。体外受精後に発生した転移性絨毛癌としては初の報告の可能性があり、化学療法により治癒した。生殖補助医療と本疾患の関連を示す症例である。
summary_en: A 29-year-old woman presented with abdominal pain, hypotension, and vomiting around the sixth month of a twin pregnancy after in vitro fertilization. She was diagnosed with gestational choriocarcinoma presenting as spontaneous splenic rupture. The authors believe this is probably the first reported case of metastatic choriocarcinoma developing after in vitro fertilization. She was cured with chemotherapy. The report highlights the rare association between assisted reproduction and this highly malignant trophoblastic tumor.

title: Osteolytic bone destruction resulting from relapse of a testicular tumour 23 years after inguinal orchiectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy: a case report.
title_ja: 鼠径精巣摘除術および補助化学療法の23年後に精巣腫瘍が再発し、骨融解性の骨転移をきたした症例：症例報告
summary_ja: 52歳男性が右股関節と坐骨の激痛で受診し、骨融解性の骨転移が判明した。23年前に右鼠径精巣摘除術と補助化学療法を受けた転移性精巣混合性腫瘍（絨毛癌・胎児性癌）の再発である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍として最も長い再発期間の一つであり、生涯にわたるフォローアップの必要性を強調している。
summary_en: A 52-year-old man presented with severe right hip and ischial pain due to osteolytic bone metastasis. He had undergone right inguinal orchiectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy 23 years earlier for a metastatic testicular mixed tumor of choriocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma. This relapse is among the longest intervals reported for testicular germ cell tumors. The authors stress the need for lifelong follow-up of patients with metastatic testicular cancer, even decades after apparent cure.

title: Prolonged lymphatic leak after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection: a case report.
title_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に持続性リンパ漏をきたした症例：症例報告
summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の21歳男性が、残存腫瘤に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清、腎摘除、下大静脈の部分切除を受けた。術後に持続性リンパ漏を生じ、足下垂をきたした。保存的な内科的・外科的治療で改善した。適切に管理しないと重篤な合併症となりうる。
summary_en: A 21-year-old man with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, nephrectomy, and partial inferior vena cava excision for a residual mass. He developed persistent lymphatic drainage, which caused foot drop. The complication eventually responded to conservative medical and surgical measures. The authors note that this postoperative condition usually responds well to conservative management but can cause serious morbidity if not managed appropriately.

title: Burned-out testicular tumor with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis: a case report.
title_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節転移を呈した自然退縮（burned-out）型精巣腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 31歳男性が後腹膜腫瘤で受診し、組織学的にセミノーマの所見を示した。精巣は触診上正常に見えたが、超音波検査で陰嚢内の病変が判明し精巣摘除術を施行。精巣に胚細胞腫瘍の自然退縮所見が認められた。原発性精巣腫瘍が後腹膜リンパ節転移の出現後に退縮した、世界的にもまれな症例である。
summary_en: A 31-year-old man presented with a retroperitoneal mass with histology characteristic of seminoma, while the testes appeared normal on examination. Ultrasound identified a suspicious scrotal lesion, and orchiectomy followed. The testis showed features of spontaneous regression of germ cell tumor. This burned-out seminoma case, one of very few reported, shows primary testicular tumor regressing after retroperitoneal nodal metastasis. Such burned-out tumors are hard to recognize and are incompletely characterized clinically.

title: Primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in patients with clinical stage IS testis cancer.
title_ja: 臨床病期ISの精巣がん患者に対する初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 1993〜2008年に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた280例のうち、臨床病期ISの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍24例が初回手術を受けた。後腹膜再発は中央値2.9年の観察期間中に認められなかった。多くの患者で化学療法を回避でき、初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清は病期ISの有効な治療選択肢と結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 280 retroperitoneal lymph node dissections identified 24 patients with clinical stage IS nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent primary RPLND. Embryonal carcinoma was present in all orchiectomy specimens, and teratoma in 63%. Positive nodes were found in 38%. Only 21% received postoperative chemotherapy, and no retroperitoneal recurrence was observed during median 2.9-year follow-up. The authors conclude primary RPLND can successfully treat stage IS disease, sparing most patients chemotherapy.

title: Surgical management of low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer.
title_ja: 低病期の非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の外科的管理
summary_ja: 低病期非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療方針を検討した総説。低リスクの臨床病期Iはサーベイランス、腫瘍マーカー上昇や3cm超のリンパ節腫大を伴う高リスク例は導入化学療法、その他は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を推奨している。神経温存の両側テンプレート郭清を支持し、腹腔鏡下の郭清は病期分類目的にとどまるとしている。
summary_en: This review addresses treatment of low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer (NSGCT). The authors describe surveillance for low-risk clinical stage I disease, induction chemotherapy for high-risk patients with elevated tumor markers or adenopathy over 3 cm, and RPLND for others. They note RPLND causes fewer long-term complications than chemotherapy, and that laparoscopic RPLND remains a staging procedure only. Full bilateral nerve-sparing template dissection is favored to reduce ejaculatory dysfunction, and adjuvant chemotherapy is typically reserved for pathological N2-3 disease.

title: Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy.
title_ja: 化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清(PC-RPLND)の役割をレビューしたものです。残存腫瘤があれば適応となりますが、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)だけでは生存腫瘍や奇形腫と壊死を確実に区別できません。完全切除が予後を規定し、適切な症例では神経温存術式により射精能と妊孕性を温存できます。手技は難度が高く、専門施設で行うべきとされます。
summary_en: This review discusses the role of postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) in advanced germ cell tumors. Improvements in radiographic staging, the use of tumor markers, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy have shaped its use. PC-RPLND is indicated for residual masses after chemotherapy, because CT alone cannot reliably distinguish viable tumor or teratoma from necrosis. Complete resection predicts outcome. In selected patients with normalized markers and necrosis, nerve-sparing techniques can preserve ejaculation and fertility. Because the procedure is technically demanding, it should be performed at experienced referral centers.

title: Late relapse of nonseminomatous germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発(治療後2年以上)をレビューしたものです。発生頻度は1~6%で、性腺外原発例でリスクが最も高く、再発部位は後腹膜が主です。初回治療時の後腹膜手術が不十分だと再発リスクが上がります。経験豊富な施設では5年がん特異的生存率が50%超となり、単発の成熟奇形腫では約100%に達します。症例は高症例数施設へ紹介すべきとされています。
summary_en: This review examines late relapses of nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, defined as recurrence at least two years after successful treatment, which occur in 1-6% of patients. Patients with extragonadal primary tumors are at greatest risk, and the retroperitoneum is the predominant relapse site. Suboptimal primary retroperitoneal surgery increases the risk. Radical surgery and improved salvage chemotherapy raise cure rates. At experienced centers, five-year cancer-specific survival exceeds 50%, approaching 100% for single-site mature teratoma. The authors recommend referring these patients to high-volume institutions.

title: Metachronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors: report of two cases.
title_ja: 異時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍：2症例の報告
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の異時性両側発症の2症例を報告したものです。1例は1990年に病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、腫瘍マーカー上昇による再発後にシスプラチンとエトポシドを受け、13年後に対側精巣にセミノーマを発症しました。もう1例は対側に治療後5年でセミノーマを発症しました。長期のフォローアップが重要です。
summary_en: This report describes two men who developed metachronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors. One had stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treated in 1990, relapsed on surveillance by tumor marker elevation, and received cisplatin and etoposide. He developed contralateral seminoma 13 years later. The other had orchidectomy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor in 2003, received adjuvant BEP, and developed contralateral seminoma five years later. Long-term follow-up is essential because late contralateral tumors can appear many years after treatment.

title: Spermatocytic seminoma with rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation: a case report with a review of the literature.
title_ja: 横紋筋肉腫様分化を伴う精母細胞性セミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 55歳男性の長期間持続する精巣腫大に対し、横紋筋肉腫様分化を伴う精母細胞性セミノーマと診断した症例を報告したものです。肉腫様変化はきわめて稀で、英語文献では13例のみの報告です。肉腫成分の存在は攻撃的な経過、転移、予後不良と関連します。著者らは、この稀な組み合わせについて文献を概説しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old man with long-standing testicular swelling, diagnosed with spermatocytic seminoma showing rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation. Sarcomatous transformation is extremely rare, with only 13 cases reported in the English literature. A sarcomatous component is associated with aggressive behavior, metastasis, and poor prognosis. The authors review the literature on this rare combination.

title: Lumbosacral Wilms' tumor as a component of immature teratoma associated with spinal dysraphism--a rare case and short literature review.
title_ja: 脊髄披裂を伴う未熟奇形腫の成分としての腰仙部ウィルムス腫瘍：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 生後20日の男児に生じた、二分脊椎と脊髄係留を伴う腰仙部の未熟奇形腫を報告したものです。腫瘍は成熟奇形腫の成分と、未熟成分としてのウィルムス腫瘍様成分から構成されていました。脊髄披裂を伴う未熟奇形腫内のウィルムス腫瘍としては4例目とされます。腎外性ウィルムス腫瘍の発生機序と臨床的特徴も考察しています。
summary_en: This report describes a 20-day-old boy with a lumbosacral immature teratoma associated with spina bifida and tethered cord. The tumor contained mature teratomatous components and an immature Wilms tumor-like component. The authors describe it as the fourth reported case of lumbosacral Wilms tumor within immature teratoma with spinal dysraphism. They discuss possible mechanisms and clinical features of extrarenal Wilms tumor and review the literature.

title: Massive pericardial effusion treated with in utero pericardioamniotic shunt in a fetus with intrapericardial teratoma.
title_ja: 心膜内奇形腫の胎児に対する心膜羊膜シャント術による大量心嚢水の治療
summary_ja: 妊娠21週の超音波検査で診断された心膜内奇形腫の胎児例を報告したものです。大量の心嚢水貯留と胎児水腫を伴っていました。妊娠22週6日に心膜羊膜シャントを留置し排液は得られましたが、8日後に腫瘍による心臓圧迫が疑われる胎児死亡に至りました。出生前に発見された心膜内奇形腫の文献も概説しています。
summary_en: This report describes a fetus with an intrapericardial teratoma, diagnosed on antenatal ultrasound at 21 weeks of gestation, causing massive pericardial effusion and fetal hydrops. A pericardioamniotic shunt was placed at 22 weeks and 6 days and drained the effusion. However, fetal demise occurred eight days later, likely from tumor compression of the heart. The authors also review antenatal intrapericardial teratomas in the literature.

title: Seladin-1 and testicular germ cell tumours: new insights into cisplatin responsiveness.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるセラジン-1：シスプラチン感受性に関する新知見
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究では、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織型ごとにセラジン-1の発現を検討した。奇形腫で最も高く、セミノーマで最も低い発現を示し、化学療法・放射線療法への感受性の違いと一致した。NT2細胞でセラジン-1はカスパーゼ-3の活性化を抑制し、シスプラチン感受性に関与することが示された。
summary_en: This study examined seladin-1 expression across testicular germ cell tumour histotypes and its role in cisplatin responsiveness. Seladin-1 expression was highest in teratoma and lowest in seminoma, paralleling their known chemo- and radiosensitivity differences. In NT2 cells, seladin-1 inhibited caspase-3 activation and promoted cell survival. Silencing it increased cisplatin sensitivity, while overexpression enhanced survival and anti-apoptotic effects. The authors conclude that seladin-1 plays an important role in TGCT biology and cisplatin responsiveness.

title: Cystic seminoma with elevated value of carbohydrate antigen 19-9 in tumor fluid mimicking cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 腫瘍液中のCA19-9高値を示し嚢胞性奇形腫に類似した嚢胞性セミノーマ
summary_ja: 前縦隔に発生し、嚢胞性変化が目立つ原発性腫瘍の症例報告である。最終的に嚢胞性セミノーマと診断された。嚢胞液中のCA19-9が極めて高値であった。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と類似する所見を示したため、前縦隔の嚢胞性腫瘍の鑑別には嚢胞性セミノーマと成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の両方を含めるべきと著者らは提言している。
summary_en: This case report describes a primary anterior mediastinal tumor with prominent cystic change, ultimately diagnosed as cystic seminoma. The cystic fluid showed an extremely elevated CA19-9 level. Because the cystic features closely resembled those of mature cystic teratoma, the authors caution that the differential diagnosis of cystic anterior mediastinal tumors should include both cystic seminoma and mature cystic teratoma. Recognizing this overlap is important to avoid misdiagnosis of these lesions.

title: Activating mutations in FGFR3 and HRAS reveal a shared genetic origin for congenital disorders and testicular tumors.
title_ja: FGFR3およびHRAS活性化変異が示す、先天性疾患と精巣腫瘍の共通の遺伝的起源
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 30例の精母細胞性セミノーマについて17遺伝子の発がん性変異を検索し、FGFR3 K650EおよびHRAS変異を同定した。FGFR3 K650Eは生殖細胞系列では致死性骨異形成症の原因ともなる。精子DNA解析では、FGFR3変異の頻度は父親の年齢とともに上昇し、変異スペクトルは膀胱がんに類似していた。多くの腫瘍でFGFR3および/またはHRASの免疫反応性が増強していた。著者らは、父親の年齢効果による変異が精巣内の共通の増殖経路を活性化し、先天性症候群と発がん素因を結びつけると提案している。
summary_en: The authors screened 30 spermatocytic seminomas for oncogenic mutations in 17 genes and identified recurrent FGFR3 K650E and HRAS mutations. FGFR3 K650E is also a germline cause of thanatophoric dysplasia. Sperm DNA analysis showed that FGFR3 mutation levels rise with paternal age, and the mutation spectrum resembled that seen in bladder cancer. Most tumors showed increased FGFR3 and/or HRAS immunoreactivity. The authors propose that paternal-age-effect mutations activate a shared proliferative pathway in the testis, linking congenital syndromes and cancer predisposition.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) with multiple metastases and extremely poor prognosis.
title_ja: 多発転移を伴い予後が極めて不良であった胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍
summary_ja: 36歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の症例報告である。第3子の分娩後14か月で不正性器出血を生じ、多発転移を認めた。EMA/CO療法を一次治療として行ったが、第6コースで薬剤耐性となり、初発症状から8か月で死亡した。核分裂像の多さと未分化な異型所見が予後不良因子であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) who developed multiple metastases 14 months after her third pregnancy. Her tumor had a high mitotic count, and surgery was judged difficult, so EMA/CO chemotherapy was given as first-line treatment. The disease became drug-resistant during the sixth cycle, and she died eight months after her first symptoms. The authors conclude that a high mitotic count and atypical undifferentiated features are significant adverse prognostic factors in PSTT with metastasis.

title: Gastric choriocarcinoma admixed with an alpha-fetoprotein-producing adenocarcinoma and separated adenocarcinoma.
title_ja: 胃の絨毛癌と αフェトプロテイン産生腺癌の混在、および独立した腺癌
summary_ja: 70歳男性で、AFP産生腺癌と混在する胃絨毛癌と、独立した腺癌が亜全胃切除後に確認された症例報告である。術前の血清AFPは上昇していた。術後、hCGおよびAFP値は低下し、6サイクルの補助化学療法が行われた。術後4年の経過観察で再発や遠隔転移は認められなかった。本症例は、混合組織型の性腺外絨毛癌における腫瘍マーカーモニタリングの有用性を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 70-year-old man with gastric choriocarcinoma admixed with an AFP-producing adenocarcinoma, along with a separate adenocarcinoma, identified after subtotal gastrectomy. Serum AFP was elevated preoperatively. Postoperatively, hCG and AFP levels fell, and six cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy were given. No recurrence or distant metastasis was observed at four years of follow-up. The case illustrates the value of tumor marker monitoring in extragonadal choriocarcinoma with mixed histology.

title: Congenital orbital teratoma presenting as microphthalmos with cyst.
title_ja: 小眼球症と嚢胞を呈した先天性眼窩奇形腫
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、小眼球症と眼窩嚢胞を呈した乳児の先天性眼窩奇形腫を記述する。非交通性の嚢胞は眼球から外科的に分離・切除され、病理組織学的に奇形腫と確認された。小眼球症と眼窩嚢胞を呈する乳児では、先天性嚢胞性奇形腫を鑑別診断に含めるべきであり、他の原因とは治療方針が異なると著者らは強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare congenital orbital teratoma in an infant that presented as microphthalmos with an orbital cyst. The non-communicating cyst was surgically separated from the globe and excised, and histopathology confirmed a teratoma. The authors emphasize that congenital cystic teratoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of infants with microphthalmos and orbital cysts, because its management differs from that of other causes.

title: Brain metastases from testicular germ cell tumors: a retrospective analysis.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における脳転移：後方視的解析
summary_ja: 3施設の27例を後方視的に解析し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移例を検討した。大半は非セミノーマ性で、全例に化学療法が行われ、全脳放射線療法、定位放射線治療、外科的切除が併用された。5年・10年の癌特異的生存率はいずれも35.9%であった。単発転移は多発転移より予後良好であり、著者らは脳局所治療と化学療法の併用を推奨している。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 27 patients from three institutions reviewed testicular germ cell tumors with brain metastases. Most were non-seminomatous, and all received chemotherapy, with additional brain-directed treatment including whole-brain radiotherapy, stereotactic radiosurgery, or surgical resection. Five- and 10-year cancer-specific survival were both 35.9%. Patients with a single metastasis survived better than those with multiple lesions. The authors recommend combining local brain treatment with chemotherapy.

title: Wnt pathway reprogramming during human embryonal carcinoma differentiation and potential for therapeutic targeting.
title_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞の分化過程におけるWntシグナル経路の再編成と治療標的としての可能性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞をオールトランス型レチノイン酸やPOU5F1抑制により分化誘導し、Wntシグナルの変化を解析した。未分化細胞ではカノニカルWntシグナルは低く、分化に伴い上昇した。FZD5、FZD7、WNT5Aの抑制は分化を誘導せずに増殖を抑制し、FZD7抑制は検討した全細胞株で最も強い増殖抑制を示した。FZD7は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療標的として有望と結論づけられている。
summary_en: This study examined Wnt signaling during induced differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, using retinoic acid treatment and POU5F1 repression in NT2/D1 and other lines. Canonical Wnt activity was low in undifferentiated cells and rose with differentiation. Silencing FZD5, FZD7, or WNT5A inhibited EC cell growth without inducing differentiation, and FZD7 knockdown caused the strongest growth suppression across all lines tested. The authors propose FZD7 as a therapeutic target for testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Primary intrarenal teratoma in an adult: A case report and review of literature.
title_ja: 成人の原発性腎内奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 35歳男性の左腎下極腫瘤に対し腎部分切除術が施行された症例報告である。病理組織学的検査で腎臓の奇形腫と診断された。成人の原発性腎内奇形腫は極めてまれで、文献上の報告も少ないため、著者らは文献レビューとともに本症例を提示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a left lower-pole renal mass treated with partial nephrectomy. Histopathological examination showed a teratoma of the kidney. The authors note that primary intrarenal teratomas in adults are extremely rare, with only a few cases in the literature. They present this case together with a brief literature review, highlighting the diagnostic significance of recognizing such uncommon presentations.

title: Prenatal diagnosis and management of a fetal intra-abdominal teratoma: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 胎児腹腔内奇形腫の出生前診断と管理：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 超音波検査で出生前に診断された大型の腹腔内奇形腫の症例で、嚢胞成分と充実成分が混在する不均一な腫瘤として描出された。出生後に外科的切除が行われ、良好な経過を得た。胎児期の腹腔内奇形腫はまれであり、術後予後は一般に良好と著者らは述べ、文献レビューも行っている。
summary_en: This report describes a large intra-abdominal teratoma diagnosed antenatally by ultrasound, showing a heterogeneous mass with cystic and solid components. The fetus was managed successfully, with postnatal surgical removal of the tumor. The authors also review the literature on prenatal intra-abdominal teratomas, which are rare, and note that the prognosis after surgery is generally good.

title: A case of malignant abdominal pain.
title_ja: 悪性腹痛の1例
summary_ja: 19歳男性が非定型的で強い腹痛を訴え、当初は急性虫垂炎と診断された。腹腔鏡下虫垂切除で乳糜腹水がみられたが虫垂は正常であった。精査で腸間膜リンパ節腫大が見つかり、生検で混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明し、原発は右精巣と特定された。若年男性の非定型腹痛では精巣腫瘍を鑑別に含め、精巣の診察を日常的に行うべきと著者らは強調している。
summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with severe atypical abdominal pain initially diagnosed as appendicitis. Laparoscopic appendectomy found chylous ascites and a normal appendix. Work-up revealed mesenteric lymphadenopathy, and nodal sampling showed a mixed germ cell tumor. The primary tumor was traced to the right testis. The authors stress that testicular tumors belong in the differential diagnosis of atypical abdominal pain in young men and that a thorough testicular examination should be routine.

title: The tumorigenicity of diploid and aneuploid human pluripotent stem cells.
title_ja: ヒト多能性幹細胞の腫瘍形成能（二倍体および異数体）
summary_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞(HESC)と人工多能性幹細胞(iPS細胞)の腫瘍形成能を総説している。二倍体で継代初期のHESCは遺伝子改変なしに良性奇形腫を形成する一方、培養中に遺伝的・エピジェネティックな変化を獲得した細胞は悪性の奇形癌を生じうると著者らは論じている。分子機構と予防法、培養適応細胞のマーカー同定についても考察している。
summary_en: This review examines the tumorigenicity of human embryonic stem cells (HESCs) and induced pluripotent stem cells (HiPSCs), which can form tumors in vivo. The authors argue that diploid, early-passage HESCs generate benign teratomas without genetic modification, whereas HESCs that acquired genetic or epigenetic changes during culture can produce malignant teratocarcinomas. They discuss molecular mechanisms behind this risk and suggest approaches to prevent tumor formation and to identify markers of culture-adapted cells before clinical use.

title: Trophoblastic neoplasms express fatty acid synthase, which may be a therapeutic target via its inhibitor C93.
title_ja: トロホブラスト腫瘍におけるFASN発現と、阻害薬C93による治療標的としての可能性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常胎盤・胞状奇胎・妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍におけるFASNの発現を調べ、FASN阻害薬C93の絨毛癌細胞への作用を検討した。絨毛癌の全例、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍の大半、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の60%でFASNが陽性であった。C93はJEG3およびJAR細胞でアポトーシスを誘導した。転移性・化学療法抵抗性の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する標的治療として検討の価値があると結論している。
summary_en: This study examined fatty acid synthase (FASN) expression in normal and molar placentas and in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, and tested the FASN inhibitor C93 in choriocarcinoma cells. FASN was expressed in all choriocarcinomas, most epithelioid trophoblastic tumors, and 60% of placental site trophoblastic tumors. C93 induced apoptosis in JEG3 and JAR cells without affecting cell cycle progression. The authors suggest FASN inhibitors merit investigation as targeted therapy for metastatic and chemoresistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

title: Multiple intraabdominal parasitic cystic teratomas.
title_ja: 多発性腹腔内寄生性嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の切除後に再発し、腹腔内に多発する寄生性奇形腫を認めた症例報告です。腹壁、大網、ダグラス窩に腫瘤があり、腹腔鏡下にすべて摘出されました。卵巣類皮嚢腫の自己切断と再移植が大網奇形腫の最も一般的な原因と考察されています。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)が診断に有用でした。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with multiple intra-abdominal parasitic dermoids who had previously undergone excision of an ovarian dermoid cyst and later presented with recurrent symptoms. Masses involved the abdominal wall, omentum, and pouch of Douglas. The authors note that autoamputation and reimplantation of ovarian dermoids is the most common cause of omental teratomas. Abdominal pain was the main symptom, and ultrasonography with Doppler and CT aided diagnosis. All masses were removed laparoscopically, and no prior literature described such extensive parasitic dermoids.

title: Metastatic epithelioid trophoblastic tumor in a male patient with mixed germ-cell tumor of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍を有する男性患者における転移性上皮様栄養膜腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の治療後、2年目に傍大動脈リンパ節転移を生じた39歳男性の症例です。転移巣には奇形腫成分と、妊娠性の上皮様栄養膜腫瘍に類似した絨毛型細胞の胞巣が混在していました。診断は段階的な免疫組織化学により確認されました。胚細胞腫瘍から生じる栄養膜性腫瘍の病態を理解する上で重要な症例です。
summary_en: This report describes a 39-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor who developed a para-aortic lymph node metastasis two years after orchiectomy and chemotherapy. The metastasis contained both a teratoma component and nests of trophoblastic cells resembling gestational epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Stepwise immunohistochemistry confirmed the diagnosis. The authors argue that pathologists should recognize this trophoblastic feature when evaluating post-treatment mixed germ cell neoplasms. The case offers insight into trophoblastic neoplasms arising from germ cell tumors.

title: Para-aortic lymph node metastasis in malignant dysgerminoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣悪性ディスジャーミノーマにおける傍大動脈リンパ節転移
summary_ja: 初回手術で十分な病期分類がされず、補助化学療法も受けなかった20代の2例のIA期卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ患者の報告です。両者とも傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴う再発を来し、広範な手術と多剤併用化学療法が必要となりました。初回から系統的な傍大動脈リンパ節郭清を含む包括的治療を三次施設で行うことの重要性が強調されています。
summary_en: This report describes two women aged 20 and 26 with stage IA ovarian dysgerminoma who were inadequately staged at initial surgery and received no adjuvant therapy. Both later developed recurrence with para-aortic lymph node metastasis requiring extensive surgery and multiagent chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that comprehensive initial surgery, including systematic para-aortic lymphadenectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy at tertiary centers, is needed to minimize the treatment burden for patients with apparently early-stage dysgerminoma.

title: Asbestos exposure and gestational trophoblastic disease: a hypothesis.
title_ja: 石綿曝露と妊娠性絨毛性疾患：仮説
summary_ja: ウィットヌームでクロシドライト（青石綿）に曝露した女性と少女の間で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の集積が見られたことを報告する仮説論文です。2,968人中、絨毛癌3例と胞状奇胎3例が確認されました。石綿は胎盤検体からも検出されており、生物学的な妥当性があると考えられています。患者の職業歴と居住歴の聴取、病理標本の石綿検査が有用と提案されています。
summary_en: This hypothesis paper describes a cluster of gestational trophoblastic disease among women and girls exposed to crocidolite (blue asbestos) at Wittenoom. Among 2,968 exposed individuals, the authors identified three choriocarcinomas and three hydatidiform moles. Four of six cases had lived with asbestos workers who brought dusty clothing home. Because asbestos fibers have been found in the ovary, peritoneum, and placental digests, the authors argue the association has biological plausibility. They suggest taking occupational and residential histories and examining pathologic specimens for asbestos in GTD patients.

title: Primary mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor associated with hemophagocytic syndrome.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に伴う血球貪食症候群
summary_ja: 縦隔原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫）の治療後、血球貪食症候群を発症した20歳男性の症例です。同時期に骨転移も判明しました。血小板減少はステロイドに反応せず、腫瘍進行に対する化学療法後に改善しました。胚細胞腫瘍に伴う反応性血球貪食はこれまで3例のみの報告であり、両者の密接な関連が示唆されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with a primary non-seminomatous mediastinal germ cell tumor, containing yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma, who developed hemophagocytic syndrome three months after surgical resection. Bone metastases were also found around that time. Thrombocytopenia did not respond to corticosteroids but improved after chemotherapy for tumor progression. The authors note that only three previous cases of germ cell tumor with reactive hemophagocytosis had been reported, suggesting a close relationship between the two conditions.

title: Mixed hepatoblastoma and teratoma of the liver in a 3-year-old child: a unique combination and clinical challenge.
title_ja: 3歳児の肝臓に生じた肝芽腫と奇形腫の混合腫瘍：稀な組み合わせと臨床的課題
summary_ja: 3歳児の肝臓に生じた大きな腫瘍の症例報告。肝芽腫と悪性奇形腫の両方の特徴を示し、化学療法後に拡大右半肝切除術と補助化学療法が行われた。初診から36か月後も健康で、残存腫瘍は認められていない。著者らは、この病態を混合性肝芽腫・奇形腫と位置づけている。
summary_en: A 3-year-old child presented with a large liver tumor showing features of both hepatoblastoma and malignant teratoma. Biopsy revealed an immature teratoid tumor without hepatoblastic differentiation, while resected tissue showed intermixed hepatoblastoma-like, neuroblastoma-like, and rhabdomyosarcomatous areas. The tumor enlarged after chemotherapy, and an extended right hemihepatectomy was performed, followed by adjuvant chemotherapy. At 36 months after diagnosis, the patient remained healthy without residual disease. The authors designate this entity as mixed hepatoblastoma and teratoma.

title: Metastatic seminoma and grade 1 follicular lymphoma presenting concurrently in a supraclavicular lymph node: a case report.
title_ja: 左鎖骨上窩リンパ節に同時に認められた転移性セミノーマと濾胞性リンパ腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 67歳男性の左鎖骨上窩リンパ節から、転移性セミノーマと濾胞性リンパ腫が同一リンパ節に併存して認められた症例報告。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を完遂した。胚細胞腫瘍マーカーは基線で上昇しておらず、腫瘍マーカーや陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)では再発の鑑別が困難と指摘している。
summary_en: A 67-year-old man with an enlarging left supraclavicular lymph node was found on biopsy to have both metastatic seminoma and grade 1 follicular lymphoma within the same node. Staging PET/CT showed several enlarged nodes. He completed chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Because germ cell tumor markers were not elevated at baseline, the authors note that serum tumor markers cannot reliably track response or relapse here. FDG-PET is also non-specific, since both diseases are avid. Biopsy of each enlarged node would be needed to distinguish recurrent seminoma from lymphoma.

title: Giant sacrococcygeal teratoma in an adult: case report.
title_ja: 成人の巨大仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告
summary_ja: 出生時から徐々に増大した仙骨部腫瘤を有する18歳女性の症例報告。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で周囲構造に浸潤しない充実性・嚢胞性腫瘤が認められ、肛門後方経路で完全切除された。先天性仙尾部奇形腫は乳幼児期に多い胚細胞腫瘍であり、成人例は稀である。
summary_en: An 18-year-old woman presented with a progressively enlarging sacral mass present since birth. MRI demonstrated a solid-cystic lesion with no involvement of surrounding structures. The tumor was completely excised via a post-anal approach. The authors describe this as an unusual adult presentation of congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma, which is the most common germ cell tumor of infancy and childhood and is typically diagnosed early in life. The report documents successful complete resection through the posterior route in an adult.

title: [A case of seminoma in an intra-abdominal cryptorchidism associated with ipsilateral renal agenesis].
title_ja: 右腎無形成を伴う腹腔内停留精巣から発生したセミノーマの1例
summary_ja: 右上腹部の膨満感と疼痛を主訴とした42歳男性の症例報告。直径12cmの右後腹膜腫瘤と同側腎の無形成が認められた。腫瘍切除とリンパ節郭清により、傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴うセミノーマ(pT1 pN3M0)と診断された。停留精巣と右腎無形成の合併例として、文献上3例目である。
summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with right upper abdominal distension and pain. Imaging showed a 12 cm right retroperitoneal mass, and the ipsilateral kidney was not visualized. Tumor resection and lymphadenectomy confirmed seminoma with para-aortic lymph node involvement, classified as pT1 pN3M0. The tumor was diagnosed as arising from intra-abdominal cryptorchidism associated with right renal agenesis. The authors note this is only the third such case reported in the literature.

title: [A case of metachronous testicular tumor developing seven years after complete remission of retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor].
title_ja: 後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の完全寛解から7年後に発症した異時性精巣腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 26歳男性が左頸部リンパ節の針生検でセミノーマと診断され、後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と判定された。化学療法で完全寛解を得た後、7年後に右精巣腫大を認め、根治的精巣摘除術によりセミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が確認された。術後10か月まで再発はない。
summary_en: A 26-year-old man initially diagnosed with seminoma by needle biopsy of a left cervical lymph node was found to have an aorto-caval retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor. After three courses of BEP and one of VIP, he achieved complete remission. Seven years later, right scrotal enlargement led to radical orchiectomy, which showed seminoma with yolk sac tumor components. No recurrence was seen after 10 months.

title: Phase I study of flavopiridol with oxaliplatin and fluorouracil/leucovorin in advanced solid tumors.
title_ja: 進行固形腫瘍に対するフラボピリドール・FOLFOX併用療法の第I相試験
summary_ja: 進行固形腫瘍48例を対象に、フラボピリドールとFOLFOXの併用療法の第I相試験を実施した。プラチナ抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍で評価可能な9例中3例に部分奏効が得られ、10例中7例で腫瘍マーカーの低下がみられた。奏効例はp53変異陽性で、この結果から第II相試験が進行中である。
summary_en: This phase I trial combined flavopiridol with FOLFOX (oxaliplatin, fluorouracil and leucovorin) in 48 patients with advanced solid tumors. The maximum tolerated dose was defined, with dose-limiting toxicities including nausea, vomiting and neutropenia. Clinical activity was seen in platinum-refractory germ cell tumors, with partial responses in 3 of 9 evaluable patients and tumor marker declines in 7 of 10. Responders had p53-mutant tumors. A phase II trial in platinum-refractory germ cell tumors is now enrolling.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumor.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍
summary_ja: 筆者は妊娠の可能性がないはずの時期に陽性の妊娠検査結果を得た。この経験を起点に、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を解説する看護記事である。妊娠以外の疾患、特に各種のがんでも妊娠検査が陽性になりうることを示し、臨床所見と一致しない陽性結果はさらに精査すべきと強調している。
summary_en: Written for nurses, this article describes placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) after the author received an unexpected positive pregnancy test despite knowing she could not be pregnant. It emphasizes that positive pregnancy tests can arise from conditions other than pregnancy, including various cancers such as PSTT. The authors urge that positive tests without corresponding clinical findings be evaluated further.

title: Antenatal sonographic diagnosis of pharyngeal teratoma: our experience of a rare case with review of the literature.
title_ja: 咽頭奇形腫の出生前超音波診断:稀な症例の経験と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 妊娠18週の初産婦の定期超音波検査で、胎児の口咽頭腔を満たし口外に突出する高エコー性腫瘤が見つかった。ミソプロストールで妊娠を終結し、死産児が得られた。剖検と病理検査で咽頭奇形腫と確定した。出生前超音波は稀な奇形腫の診断に有用で、早期の両親へのカウンセリングに役立つと結論している。
summary_en: A 24-year-old primipara at 18 weeks' gestation had a fetal echogenic mass filling the stomatopharyngeal cavity and protruding from the mouth, detected on routine ultrasound. Pregnancy was terminated with misoprostol, and a 250 g stillborn female fetus was delivered. Postmortem and pathologic examination confirmed a pharyngeal teratoma. The authors conclude that prenatal ultrasound can identify these rare tumors and facilitate early parental counseling, and they review the literature.

title: Observational study of prevalence of long-term Raynaud-like phenomena and neurological side effects in testicular cancer survivors.
title_ja: 精巣がん生存者における長期的なレイノー様症状および神経学的副作用の有病率に関する観察研究
summary_ja: 1980〜1994年にノルウェーで片側の精巣がんと診断された男性1409人を対象とした全国多施設調査である。中央値10.7年の追跡で、化学療法を受けた男性の39%がレイノー様症状、29%が感覚異常を報告した。高用量化学療法は難聴と耳鳴りのリスク上昇と関連し、放射線療法は足の感覚異常と関連した。
summary_en: This national multicenter survey of 1409 assessable Norwegian men treated for unilateral testicular cancer in 1980-1994 examined long-term neurological and Raynaud-like side effects. With a median follow-up of 10.7 years, Raynaud-like phenomena were reported by 39% and paresthesias by 29% of chemotherapy-treated men, and hearing impairment by 21%. Dose-intensive chemotherapy was associated with markedly higher odds of hearing impairment and tinnitus. Radiotherapy was associated with higher odds of foot paresthesias.

title: Solid mature ovarian teratoma with intrarectal protusion: case report.
title_ja: 直腸内突出を呈した充実性成熟卵巣奇形腫
summary_ja: 54歳女性が肛門からの出血で受診した。内視鏡で直腸内に毛髪様表面を持つ腫瘍を認め、画像で骨組織を含む所見があった。開腹で左卵巣が直腸前壁と癒合しており、左卵巣摘出術と腸管切開下の腫瘍摘出を行った。病理は三胚葉由来の組織から成り、直腸腫瘍の鑑別診断として卵巣奇形腫を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old woman with transanal bleeding caused by a solid mature ovarian teratoma that protruded into the rectum. Endoscopy revealed a hairy-surfaced tumor 15 cm from the anal margin, and imaging showed bony tissue within it. Laparotomy found the left ovary fused to the rectal wall. Left oophorectomy was performed, and the tumor was extracted through a peritumoral intestinal incision with primary closure. Histology showed tissues from all three germ layers. The authors recommend considering intrarectal ovarian teratoma in the differential diagnosis of rectal tumors.

title: Bilateral cystic pulmonary glial heterotopia and palatinal teratoma causing respiratory distress in an infant.
title_ja: 両側性嚢胞性肺グリア異所症と口蓋奇形腫により呼吸窮迫をきたした乳児例
summary_ja: 出生後に呼吸窮迫を呈した男児の両側性嚢胞性・充実性肺病変を報告する。肺実質温存切除を行い、組織学的に神経膠細胞で裏打ちされた嚢胞とグリア結節を認め、肺神経膠異所症と診断された。さらに口蓋奇形腫を含む神経組織が検出され切除された。既報例と照合し、病態と臨床像を考察している。
summary_en: This report describes a male infant with extensive bilateral cystic and solid lung lesions who presented with respiratory distress after birth. Parenchyma-sparing resections were performed. Histology showed neuroglial cell-lined cysts and glial nodules consistent with pulmonary neuroglial heterotopia. A neural element containing a palatinal teratoma was also detected and excised. The authors discuss the pathogenesis and clinical features of pulmonary neuroglial heterotopia based on previously published cases, highlighting the rare coexistence of an extragonadal teratoma in the infant.

title: [Testicular tumor presenting as acute scrotum with infection caused by gas-producing bacteria].
title_ja: ガス産生菌による感染を伴い急性陰嚢症として発症した精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 46歳男性が右陰嚢の腫脹と疼痛、発熱で受診した。CTとMRIで陰嚢内のガス貯留と脂肪成分を含む腫瘤を認めた。抗菌薬治療に反応せず、右高位鼠径精巣摘除術を施行した。病理でセミノーマの壊死が確認され、壊死組織からClostridiumが培養された。腫瘍壊死とガス産生菌感染による急性陰嚢症として発症した精巣腫瘍の初報告としている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old man who presented with a painful, enlarged right scrotum with redness, fever, and elevated inflammatory markers. CT and MRI showed gas within the scrotum and a partly fatty mass. Despite antibiotics, the infection progressed, prompting right high inguinal orchiectomy. Histology revealed necrotic seminoma, and cultures of necrotic tissue grew Clostridium. The authors believe this is the first report of a testicular tumor presenting as acute scrotum from tumor necrosis and gas-producing bacterial infection.

title: Management of neonatal massive anterior mediastinal teratoma--a case report.
title_ja: 新生児の巨大前縦隔奇形腫の管理：症例報告
summary_ja: 出生時から生命を脅かす呼吸窮迫を呈した新生児の症例である。右半胸郭のほぼ全体を占める巨大な前縦隔奇形腫を認めた。呼吸機能と気道の管理が重要な課題であった。多職種による連携したアプローチにより、良好な転帰が得られた。新生児における巨大縦隔奇形腫の管理の難しさと、早期の多職種連携の有用性を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a massive anterior mediastinal teratoma occupying nearly the right hemithorax. The infant presented at birth with life-threatening respiratory distress. The authors describe management that achieved a favorable outcome through a coordinated, multidisciplinary approach. The report highlights the challenges of managing respiratory compromise from a very large mediastinal germ cell tumor in a neonate, and emphasizes the value of early multidisciplinary planning.

title: Spermatocytic seminoma.
title_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ
summary_ja: 本論文は、古典的セミノーマとは臨床的・病理学的に異なる稀な胚細胞腫瘍である精母細胞性セミノーマを概説する。高齢男性に発生し、停留精巣との関連は知られていない。3種類の細胞型、細胞質グリコーゲンの欠如、リンパ球浸潤の乏しさが特徴で、第9染色体の獲得が最も一貫した遺伝子異常である。古典的セミノーマや胎児性癌との鑑別が重要で、術後に追加治療が不要な場合がある。
summary_en: This paper reviews spermatocytic seminoma, a rare germ cell tumor distinct from classical seminoma in clinical and pathological features. It affects older men, is not linked to cryptorchidism, and has no known ovarian counterpart. Histology shows three cell types, lack of cytoplasmic glycogen, and scant lymphocytes, with gain of chromosome 9 as the most consistent genetic change. Sarcomatous transformation and metastasis are rarely reported. Differentiating it from classic seminoma and embryonal carcinoma matters, since patients may not need further treatment after surgery.

title: Germ cell tumor of the colon with an adenocarcinomatous component.
title_ja: 腺癌成分を伴う結腸の胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 62歳男性の結腸に発生した、腺癌成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告する。診断時に広範な転移があり、右半結腸切除と化学療法を施行したが予後は不良であった。組織学的には卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌からなり、全ての転移巣が胚細胞の表現型を示した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀であり、本症例は理解の一助となる。
summary_en: A man aged 62 with a germ cell tumor arising in the colon, combined with an adenocarcinoma component, is described. Widespread metastases were present at diagnosis, and right hemicolectomy and chemotherapy were given, but prognosis was poor. Histology showed yolk sac tumor and choriocarcinoma, and all metastatic lesions had a germ cell phenotype. The authors note that extragonadal germ cell tumors are extremely rare, with few English-language reports, and say the report adds to understanding of this neoplasm's features.

title: [Mediastinal germ cell tumor with somatic-type malignancy successfully treated with chemotherapy followed by surgical resection combined with lobectomy: report of a case].
title_ja: 体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告：化学療法後の外科的切除と肺葉切除による治療成功例
summary_ja: 胸痛を訴えた28歳男性で、巨大な縦隔腫瘤が見つかり非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を5コース施行後、外科的切除と左上葉切除を行った。最終病理では体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う胚細胞腫瘍であった。本病態の予後は極めて不良であり、早期からの集学的治療が成功の鍵と結論づけられた。
summary_en: A 28-year-old man presented with chest pain and a large mediastinal mass, diagnosed as non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. He received five cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, followed by tumor resection with left upper lobectomy. Final pathology showed a germ cell tumor with somatic-type malignancy. The authors note this entity has an extremely poor prognosis, and that early multimodality treatment is key to successful outcomes. This is a Japanese case report published in Kyobu Geka.

title: An unusual cause of pelvic pain: struma ovarii.
title_ja: 骨盤痛の稀な原因：卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 22歳女性が3か月の骨盤部不快感と月経困難を訴えた。MRIでは嚢胞性で一部に充実成分と脂肪液面形成を伴う腫瘤を認めた。切除標本では成熟奇形腫の成分中、50%超が甲状腺組織で、2cmの範囲に乳頭状甲状腺癌様の所見があり、卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。放射線学的特徴を考察した。
summary_en: A 22-year-old woman presented with three months of pelvic discomfort and dysmenorrhoea. Pelvic MRI showed a predominantly cystic mass with solid components and a fat-fluid level. Histology after excision revealed a mature teratoma in which more than half the lesion was mature thyroid tissue, with a 2 cm focus resembling papillary thyroid carcinoma. The diagnosis was struma ovarii. The authors discuss its radiological features, which help recognize this rare ovarian neoplasm.

title: Metastatic testicular germ cell tumor presenting with abdominal pain: CT and MRI findings.
title_ja: 腹痛で発症した転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍：コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の患者が後腹膜リンパ節腫大による腹痛で受診した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で後腹膜リンパ節を評価し、MRIで腰椎骨転移を確認した。典型的な無痛性陰嚢腫瘤ではなく転移による症状で発症しうる点を画像所見とともに報告している。
summary_en: A patient with metastatic testicular tumor presented with abdominal pain caused by retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. CT and MRI were used to evaluate the retroperitoneal nodes, and MRI demonstrated a lumbar spine osseous metastasis. The authors describe these imaging findings and note that testicular tumors can present with symptoms from metastases rather than the usual painless scrotal mass. Recognizing this pattern may prompt earlier evaluation.

title: Primary seminoma of the prostate.
title_ja: 前立腺原発セミノーマ
summary_ja: 54歳男性で前立腺特異抗原値は低値だったが、腫大した不均一な腫瘤を認めた。針生検で免疫組織化学的にセミノーマと確定し、他部位に病変がないため前立腺原発と判断された。ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法3コースで完全奏効を得た。報告例は5例のみである。
summary_en: A 54-year-old man with a low PSA level and an enlarged prostatic mass was diagnosed by needle biopsy with seminoma, confirmed immunohistochemically. With no evidence of disease elsewhere, the lesion was classified as primary seminoma of the prostate. He received three courses of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy, achieving complete response on imaging and re-biopsy. The authors note that only five similar cases have been reported.

title: Blunt testicular trauma results in rupture of mixed germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 鈍的精巣外傷により混合型胚細胞腫瘍の破裂をきたした症例
summary_ja: 24歳男性が木に押しつぶされ、精巣の自然破裂を生じた。手術探索で破裂した精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。本症例は鈍的陰嚢外傷が潜在する精巣腫瘍を顕在化させうることを示し、身体診察・病歴聴取・超音波検査の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: A 24-year-old man was crushed by a tree and developed spontaneous testicular rupture. Surgical exploration revealed a ruptured mixed germ cell tumor of the testicle. The case shows that blunt scrotal trauma can unmask an underlying testicular tumor. It emphasizes the roles of physical examination, clinical history and scrotal ultrasonography in managing scrotal trauma.

title: A 2-year-old boy with a stage III yolk sac tumor occurring in an intra-abdominal retained testis.
title_ja: 腹腔内停留精巣に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍を認めた2歳男児（ステージIII）
summary_ja: 2歳男児が腹腔内停留精巣に発生し、後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴う卵黄嚢腫瘍（ステージIII）で受診した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は36,528 ng/mLであった。反対側の巨大精巣が絞扼していたため診断が遅れた。PEB化学療法後に外科的切除を行い、18か月間良好に経過した。
summary_en: A 2-year-old boy presented with a large yolk sac tumor with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis arising in an intra-abdominal undescended testis. Serum AFP was 36,528 ng/mL. Diagnosis was delayed because the contralateral giant testis had strangulated. After PEB chemotherapy, complete surgical resection was performed, and the patient remained well for 18 months. The authors suggest the tumor was a coincidental association with the undescended testis.

title: Anesthetic management of a parturient with fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma and mirror syndrome complicated by elevated hCG and subsequent hyperthyroidism.
title_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫およびミラー症候群を合併した妊婦の麻酔管理（ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値および甲状腺機能亢進症を併発）
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫、胎児水腫およびミラー症候群を有する胎児を妊娠した妊婦の麻酔管理を報告する。母体血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が著明高値となり、その後甲状腺機能亢進症を発症した。ミラー症候群では血液希釈性貧血、体液過剰、肺水腫のリスクがあり、子癇前症と区別される。
summary_en: Anesthetic management is described for a parturient carrying a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma, hydrops fetalis and mirror syndrome. Maternal serum hCG was markedly elevated, and she later developed clinical hyperthyroidism. The report highlights the hemodilutional anemia, fluid overload and pulmonary edema risk that distinguish mirror syndrome from preeclampsia, along with perioperative considerations in this complex obstetric setting.

title: Orbital teratoma: case report and management review.
title_ja: 眼窩奇形腫：症例報告と治療に関する文献的考察
summary_ja: 新生児男児に、視交叉部と海綿静脈洞に及び鼻咽頭を圧排する良性の成熟眼窩奇形腫を認めた。視機能障害の恐れから外科的切除は避け、嚢胞成分を中心とした減量術を施行した。3歳時点で腫瘍の増大はなく、良好な視力を維持している。眼窩奇形腫の治療選択肢を文献的に概説している。
summary_en: A neonatal boy had a benign mature orbital teratoma involving the chiasmal area and cavernous sinus, displacing the nasopharynx. Because complete surgical resection could compromise vision, a debulking procedure targeting the cystic components was performed instead. At 3 years of age, the tumor had not grown and vision in the affected eye remained good. The report reviews management options for orbital teratomas.

title: A case of intraocular yolk sac tumor in a child and its pathogenesis.
title_ja: 小児の眼内卵黄嚢腫瘍症例とその発症機序
summary_ja: 4歳男児の眼内卵黄嚢腫瘍を、眼球摘出後の病理組織学的検査で確定した。術後に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は速やかに正常化した。小児の悪性胚細胞腫瘍として一般的だが性腺外発生は稀である。胎生期の神経管形成時に卵黄嚢細胞が眼内へ移動するという発生機序を提唱している。
summary_en: A 4-year-old boy had an intraocular yolk sac tumor, confirmed histologically after enucleation. Serum alpha-fetoprotein normalized rapidly after surgery. Yolk sac tumor is among the most common malignant germ cell tumors in young children but rarely arises at extragonadal sites. The authors propose a pathogenesis in which yolk sac cells migrate into the eye during early embryonic neural tube formation.

title: The DM domain protein DMRT1 is a dose-sensitive regulator of fetal germ cell proliferation and pluripotency.
title_ja: DMRT1は胎児胚細胞の増殖と多能性を調節する用量感受性因子である
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 129Sv系マウスではDmrt1欠損により奇形腫が生じ、C57BL/6Jでは生じなかった。胎児胚細胞でのDmrt1が奇形腫形成の抑制に必要である。欠損胚細胞は有糸分裂停止に失敗し、多能性マーカーを異所性に発現した。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍でも、DMRT1発現と相関する遺伝子発現変化が認められた。
summary_en: Loss of Dmrt1 caused teratomas in 129Sv mice but not in C57BL/6J mice, and conditional targeting showed it is required in fetal germ cells. Mutant germ cells failed to arrest mitosis and ectopically expressed pluripotency markers. DMRT1 represses Sox2 and activates Ret, and similar expression changes were found in human germ cell tumors. The findings link testicular development, pluripotency regulation and dose-sensitive teratoma susceptibility to genetic background.

title: Spontaneous rupture of hepatic metastasis from choriocarcinoma: a review of imaging and management.
title_ja: 絨毛癌肝転移の自然破裂：画像診断と治療の文献的考察
summary_ja: 若年女性で絨毛癌の肝転移が自然破裂し、血腹症を来した。二相性のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で典型像を認め診断に有用だった。経カテーテル的肝動脈塞栓術で治療した。症例とともに、絨毛癌由来の破裂性肝転移の画像所見と治療選択肢を文献的に考察している。
summary_en: A young woman had spontaneous rupture of a hepatic metastasis from choriocarcinoma, causing hemoperitoneum. Biphasic CT showed typical features that helped establish the diagnosis. She was treated with transcatheter hepatic artery embolization. The case is presented alongside a literature review of imaging characteristics and therapeutic options for ruptured hepatic metastases from choriocarcinoma.

title: Germ cell tumor concomitant with acquired immune deficiency syndrome.
title_ja: 後天性免疫不全症候群(AIDS)を合併した胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: AIDSを合併した進行精巣セミノーマの男性の症例報告。HAART継続下で左精巣摘除と化学療法3コースを行い部分奏効を得たが、胃出血により抗ウイルス薬や予防投与ができなくなり、重症肺感染症で死亡した。化学療法とHIVによるリンパ球減少が免疫不全を相乗的に悪化させた。免疫不全の厳格な管理を伴う慎重な化学療法は予後改善に寄与しうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a man with advanced testicular seminoma and AIDS who was treated with highly active antiretroviral therapy. After left orchiectomy and three cycles of chemotherapy he achieved a partial response. Gastric bleeding then prevented antiretroviral and prophylactic medication, and he died of severe pulmonary infection.
