Six of seven patients who underwent primary RPLND had viable germ cell tumor, and most who did not receive adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed systemically. Teratoma or viable GCT was found in the retroperitoneum in 6 of 14 patients after chemotherapy (43%). Among those undergoing postchemotherapy RPLND, teratoma was present in 6 of 7. The authors conclude that patients with cIS NSGCT will benefit from adjuvant PC-RPLND. Median follow-up was 35 months.

title: Polytomous logistic regression analysis could be applied more often in diagnostic research.
title_ja: 多項ロジスティック回帰分析は診断研究においてもっと活用されるべきである
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍後に残存する後腹膜腫瘤の組織型を予測する多項ロジスティック回帰法を示した診断研究の方法論論文である。良性組織、成熟奇形腫、生存癌の確率を同時に推定でき、ROC面積は二項モデルと同等であった。臨床で使いやすいスコア表も提示されている。複数の鑑別診断を同時に扱う手法の有用性を論じている。
summary_en: This methodological diagnostic research paper demonstrates polytomous logistic regression for predicting the histology of residual retroperitoneal masses after treatment of nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Using data from that setting, the model estimates probabilities of benign tissue, mature teratoma, and viable cancer simultaneously. Its discrimination, measured by ROC areas, was similar to two sequential dichotomous models. The authors provide a simple score chart for calculating predicted probabilities and argue that modeling multiple differential diagnoses together better serves clinical practice.

title: Overexpression of prostate stem cell antigen is associated with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 前立腺幹細胞抗原の過剰発現は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と関連する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎から妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）へ進展する例では、自然退縮例に比べ前立腺幹細胞抗原（PSCA）が過剰発現していた。免疫組織化学などで検証され、絨毛癌や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍でも高発現が見られた。研究では増殖・アポトーシス指標やp53関連因子との相関も確認され、PSCAはGTNの発症マーカーとなりうることが示唆された。
summary_en: This study identified prostate stem cell antigen (PSCA) as differentially overexpressed in hydatidiform moles that progressed to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia compared with those that regressed spontaneously. PSCA RNA and protein were verified by real-time PCR and immunohistochemistry in 58 specimens, and high expression was also seen in choriocarcinomas and placental site trophoblastic tumours. PSCA expression correlated with proliferation and apoptosis indices and with p53-related markers, suggesting a role in p53-linked growth regulation. The findings suggest PSCA as a potential marker of GTN development.

title: Carcinoid tumours of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣カルチノイド腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣カルチノイドの既報62例を総説し、原発性、他部位からの転移性、精巣奇形腫内に発生したものの3群に分類した。原発例の一部は転移し、死亡例のほとんどに転移があった。全例で精巣摘除術が行われ、他の原発巣の除外が重要とされる。限局例の予後は良好である。
summary_en: This review compiled 62 previously reported cases of carcinoid tumours of the testis, classified as primary testicular carcinoid, metastasis from another site, or carcinoid arising within a testicular teratoma. Seven patients with primary tumours developed metastases, and nine patients died, nearly all with metastatic disease. All patients underwent orchidectomy. Diagnostic work-up to exclude other primary sites is recommended, with urinary 5-HIAA, somatostatin receptor scintigraphy, CT and video-capsule endoscopy as useful tools. Localized tumours have an excellent prognosis after orchidectomy.

title: European consensus conference on diagnosis and treatment of germ cell cancer: a report of the second meeting of the European Germ Cell Cancer Consensus group (EGCCCG): part I.
title_ja: 胚細胞がんに関する欧州コンセンサス会議：欧州胚細胞がんコンセンサスグループ（EGCCCG）第2回会議報告 第I部
tags: ガイドライン・コンセンサス
summary_ja: 欧州胚細胞がんコンセンサスグループ第2回会議の報告書第I部であり、胚細胞がんのエビデンスに基づくガイドラインを更新している。原発精巣腫瘍の臨床像と治療、精巣上皮内腫瘍の管理、組織学的分類、病期分類と予後因子、病期Iのセミノーマと非セミノーマの治療を扱う。2004年の勧告の大部分は有効であり、臨床試験による改良と生存者のニーズへの配慮が加えられたと述べられている。
summary_en: This is part I of the second European Germ Cell Cancer Consensus Group (EGCCCG) report, updating evidence-based guidelines for germ cell cancer. It covers clinical presentation and treatment of the primary testicular tumour, management of testicular intraepithelial neoplasia, histological classification, staging and prognostic factors, and treatment of stage I seminoma and non-seminoma. The authors note that most 2004 recommendations remain valid, with refinements from recent trials and attention to the needs of survivors.

title: Choriocarcinoma with metastasis in a rabbit (Oryctolagus cuniculi).
title_ja: ウサギ（Oryctolagus cuniculi）における転移を伴う絨毛癌
summary_ja: ウサギで自然発生した絨毛癌の初めての報告である。3歳の雌ウサギで子宮壁の腫瘤が見つかり、卵巣子宮摘出術が行われた。腫瘍は栄養膜細胞、合胞体栄養膜細胞、細胞性栄養膜細胞の3種から成り、免疫組織化学でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性を示し、絨毛癌と診断された。
summary_en: This veterinary case report describes the first documented spontaneous choriocarcinoma in a rabbit. A 3-year-old female presented with an abdominal mass in the uterine wall, and ovariohysterectomy was performed. The tumour contained trophoblastic, syncytiotrophoblastic and cytotrophoblastic cells. Immunohistochemistry was positive for cytokeratin, and syncytiotrophoblasts were positive for human chorionic gonadotropin, confirming the diagnosis. The report is relevant as a choriocarcinoma in an animal with oncologic features.

title: Bilateral malignant seminoma with metastases in the mule: a report of two cases.
title_ja: ラバにおける転移を伴う両側性悪性セミノーマ：2症例報告
summary_ja: 屠殺された2頭のラバに、両側の悪性セミノーマと腰下リンパ節への転移が見られた症例報告である。組織学的には大型で丸みを帯びた多角形の細胞が多く、分裂像も多数認められた。ラバでの両側性悪性セミノーマと転移の報告は初めてとされ、獣医病理学の症例として対象とした。
summary_en: Two cases of bilateral malignant seminoma with sublumbar lymph node metastases are described in mules slaughtered for routine reasons. Histology showed predominantly large round to polyhedral cells with frequent mitoses, and the diagnosis was malignant seminoma with metastasis. The authors state this is the first report of bilateral malignant seminoma with metastases in mules. The paper is a veterinary pathology report, relevant as a seminoma case in an animal.

title: Retroperitoneal teratomas--potential for surgical misadventure.
title_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫：外科的誤操作の危険性
summary_ja: 単一施設で8年間に治療された小児後腹膜奇形腫6例の後方視的検討です。多くは生後6か月未満で、腫瘍は大動脈や下大静脈を取り囲んでいました。完全切除には主要血管の結紮を含む広範囲切除が必要でした。全例良性で、再発は1例、2例に持続性高血圧が残りました。外科的管理の難しさが強調されています。
summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review describes six children with retroperitoneal teratoma treated by one surgeon over eight years. Most patients were infants, and tumors encased the aorta and vena cava. Complete excision required extensive resection and major vessel ligation. All tumors were benign, one recurred, and two children had persistent hypertension. The authors conclude that operative management of retroperitoneal teratomas is complex and vessel ligation may be necessary for complete excision.

title: The role of positron emission tomography in the evaluation of residual masses after chemotherapy for advanced stage seminoma.
title_ja: 進行期セミノーマの化学療法後残存腫瘤の評価における陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の役割
summary_ja: 進行期セミノーマで化学療法後の残存・再発腫瘤20例を対象とした前向き多施設研究です。FDG-PETは生存腫瘍をすべて検出し偽陰性はなかった一方、偽陽性は9例にみられました。3cmを超える腫瘤でも生存腫瘍を除外でき、不要な外科的切除の回避に役立つ可能性があります。ただし陽性所見のみで手術を決めるべきではないと結論しています。
summary_en: This prospective multicenter study evaluated FDG-PET for detecting viable tumor in residual or recurrent masses after chemotherapy in 20 patients with advanced seminoma. All patients with viable tumor were correctly identified by PET, with no false negatives, although nine patients had false-positive results. The negative predictive value was 1.0 and the positive predictive value was 0.25. The authors conclude that FDG-PET can exclude viable disease even in masses larger than 3 cm, which may help avoid unnecessary surgical resection, but that a positive PET alone should not drive surgical decisions.

title: Clinical significance of low level human chorionic gonadotropin in the management of testicular germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)低値の臨床的意義
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理で、持続する低値の血清hCGが誤解を招く問題を扱った研究です。24例を血清・尿の並行測定と別法による測定で評価し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の基準で偽陽性を同定しました。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の17例中12例は偽陽性、5例は真陽性でした。新たな分類とアルゴリズムの導入後は不要な治療や精査が行われなくなり、過剰治療の回避に役立ちました。
summary_en: This urology study addresses persistently low serum hCG levels that can mislead clinicians managing testicular germ cell tumors. Twenty-four patients with low elevated hCG were evaluated using parallel serum and urine hCG measurements and a second assay, and false-positive cases were identified using gestational trophoblastic disease criteria. Of 17 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, 12 were false-positive and 5 were true-positive. After the algorithm was applied, no unnecessary treatments or intensive examinations were performed. The authors propose this classification to avoid overtreatment.

title: Struma ovarii: CT findings.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫：コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見
summary_ja: 病理学的に確定した卵巣甲状腺腫13例のCT所見を後方視的に検討した画像研究です。腫瘍は平均11.4cmで、すべて片側性、平滑な辺縁を示しました。多嚢胞性構造が多く、造影前に高吸収の内容物を認めたものは84.6%でした。嚢胞壁の増強は無いか軽度でした。典型像を知ることで、この稀な卵巣腫瘍の診断に役立つと結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective imaging study reviewed CT scans of 13 pathologically proven struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma composed mainly of thyroid tissue. Tumors averaged 11.4 cm and were all unilateral with smooth margins. Most showed multicystic architecture, and 85% had high-attenuation contents on precontrast scans. Cyst wall enhancement was absent or moderate in most cases. The authors conclude that struma ovarii typically appears as a smooth, multicystic mass with precontrast high attenuation and little or moderate wall enhancement, features that may help radiologists recognize this uncommon tumor.

title: Teratoma of the anterior mediastinum presenting as a cystic neck mass: a case report.
title_ja: 嚢胞性頸部腫瘤として発現した前縦隔奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 無症状の嚢胞性頸部腫瘤を呈した19歳男性の症例報告です。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、頸部の嚢胞性病変が胸腔内の充実性腫瘤と連続していることが示されました。穿刺細胞診では類皮嚢腫が疑われました。頸部と経胸骨の併用アプローチで切除し、病理で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定しました。5年間のフォローアップで再発はありません。病態が不明な頸部・縦隔腫瘤には外科的治療が重要と述べています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old man with an asymptomatic cystic neck mass that proved to be an anterior mediastinal teratoma extending into the neck. CT showed a multiseptate cystic neck lesion continuous with a solid intrathoracic mass containing calcification. Aspiration cytology suggested a dermoid cyst. The tumor was excised through combined cervical and trans-sternal approaches, and histology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. After five years of follow-up, the patient remained symptom-free without recurrence. The authors emphasize surgical treatment of cervical and mediastinal masses of uncertain nature to prevent catastrophic complications.

title: A 25-year single institution experience with surgery for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する外科的治療の25年間の単施設経験
summary_ja: シスプラチン時代の25年間に、縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後手術を受けた158例を後方視的に検討した単施設研究です。手術死亡は6%で、多くが呼吸不全によるものでした。ブレオマイシンを含まないレジメンで肺合併症が減少しました。生存に関わる因子は化学療法後の病理像、残存する胚細胞がん、術後の腫瘍マーカー上昇でした。
summary_en: This single-institution review analyzed 158 patients who underwent postchemotherapy surgery for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors over 25 years in the cisplatin era. Operative mortality was 6%, mainly from respiratory failure, and regimens without bleomycin were associated with fewer pulmonary complications. Independent predictors of survival included postchemotherapy pathology (complete necrosis versus teratoma), persistent germ cell or nongerm cell cancer, and elevated postoperative tumor markers. Patients with complete necrosis had excellent long-term survival, supporting aggressive surgery for persistent cancer in operable patients.

title: Surgical treatment of malignant mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 悪性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の外科的治療
summary_ja: 1988年から2005年に原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で根治的切除を受けた21例を後方視的に検討した。化学療法後の手術で、完全一塊切除は76.2%で可能だった。5年全生存率は63.6%。診断時のβ-hCG高値と不完全切除が予後不良因子であり、完全切除が長期生存に重要であった。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 21 patients who underwent curative resection for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor between 1988 and 2005 assessed surgery after chemotherapy. Complete en bloc excision was achieved in 76.2% of patients. Five-year overall survival was 63.6% and disease-free survival 61.1%. Elevated beta-hCG at diagnosis and incomplete resection were independent predictors of poor overall survival, indicating that complete resection is essential for long-term survival.

title: An unusual successfully treated case of pulmonary yolk sac tumor.
title_ja: 肺原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の治療に成功した稀な症例
summary_ja: 右中葉に生じた巨大な悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は稀であり、肺実質原発の悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍はさらに稀である。術前化学療法の後、腫瘍を完全に外科的切除し、治療に成功した。術前化学療法と完全切除の組み合わせが有効であることを示している。本症例は、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の治療選択を考えるうえで参考になる。
summary_en: This case report describes a huge malignant yolk sac tumor arising in the right middle lobe of the lung, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. The patient received neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by complete surgical resection of the tumor and was successfully treated. The report highlights that malignant yolk sac tumors can arise primarily in the lung parenchyma, and that preoperative chemotherapy followed by complete resection can achieve a favorable outcome.

title: HSD3B1 as a novel trophoblast-associated marker that assists in the differential diagnosis of trophoblastic tumors and tumorlike lesions.
title_ja: HSD3B1：トロホブラスト腫瘍および腫瘍様病変の鑑別診断に有用な新規マーカー
summary_ja: 本研究は、ステロイド合成酵素であるHSD3B1がトロホブラスト病変の免疫組織化学マーカーとして有用かを検討した。胞状奇胎や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍など、ほぼすべてのトロホブラスト病変で陽性であった。子宮・肺・乳房の非トロホブラスト性癌では、陽性はごくわずか(1%未満)であった。鑑別診断に有用であると結論付けている。
summary_en: This study evaluated HSD3B1, a steroidogenic enzyme, as an immunohistochemical marker for trophoblastic lesions. HSD3B1 was expressed diffusely in nearly all trophoblastic lesions, including hydatidiform moles, placental site trophoblastic tumors, epithelioid trophoblastic tumors, choriocarcinomas, and placental site nodules. It was rarely detected in nontrophoblastic carcinomas of the uterus, lung, and breast (under 1%). The authors conclude that HSD3B1 is a highly sensitive and specific marker useful for distinguishing trophoblastic lesions from nontrophoblastic tumors.

title: Placental-site trophoblastic tumors: a case of resistant pulmonary metastasis.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：難治性肺転移の1例
summary_ja: 52歳女性の混合性トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例報告である。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を主体とし、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍と限局性絨毛癌を含んでいた。初診時には転移は明らかでなかった。化学療法抵抗性の肺転移が生じ、子宮・卵巣摘出、放射線照射、複数の化学療法、2回の楔状切除を組み合わせて治療された。
summary_en: This report describes a 52-year-old woman with mixed trophoblastic tumor, including placental-site trophoblastic tumor, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, and focal choriocarcinoma, 12 years after her last pregnancy. Initially no metastasis was evident, but she later developed chemoresistant pulmonary metastasis of placental-site trophoblastic tumor, which expressed EGFR, VEGF receptor, and PDGF receptor. Treatment included hysterectomy, salpingo-oophorectomy, pelvic radiation, multiple chemotherapy regimens, and two rounds of thoracotomy with wedge resection.

title: 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D-mediated hypercalcemia in ovarian dysgerminoma.
title_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に伴う1,25-ジヒドロキシビタミンD介在性高カルシウム血症
summary_ja: 10歳女児の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に伴う重度の高カルシウム血症の症例報告である。体液性因子は副甲状腺ホルモン関連ペプチドではなく、1,25-ジヒドロキシビタミンDと考えられた。この高カルシウム血症は薬物療法に抵抗性であり、腫瘍切除や減量が血清カルシウム値の管理に必要であると結論付けている。
summary_en: This case report describes severe hypercalcemia in a 10-year-old girl with ovarian dysgerminoma. The authors attribute the hypercalcemia to 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D, rather than parathyroid hormone-related peptide, as the humoral factor. Hypercalcemia of malignancy is typically resistant to medical therapy, and the authors conclude that tumor resection or volume reduction is necessary to control serum calcium levels.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma complicating pregnancy: a case report.
title_ja: 妊娠中に発症した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠中に卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌と診断された33歳女性の症例報告である。妊娠16週の腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出後、18週で卵管卵巣摘出を受け、病期Icの悪性転化と診断されたが、術後補助化学療法は行わず経過観察された。健康な児を出産し、14か月後も再発はみられなかった。著者らは、早期病期では綿密な病期分類と長期フォローアップを前提に保存的手術が安全な可能性があると述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, diagnosed during pregnancy. After laparoscopic cystectomy at 16 weeks and salpingo-oophorectomy at 18 weeks, she was diagnosed with stage Ic malignant transformation and observed without adjuvant chemotherapy. She delivered a healthy baby and had no recurrence at 14 months. The authors suggest conservative surgery may be safe in early-stage disease, with careful staging and long-term follow-up.

title: GLI1 is involved in cell cycle regulation and proliferation of NT2 embryonal carcinoma stem cells.
title_ja: GLI1はNT2胎児性癌幹細胞の細胞周期制御と増殖に関与する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、胎児性癌幹細胞株NT2を用いて、ヘッジホッグ転写因子GLI1の役割を解析した基礎研究である。レチノイン酸による神経分化の初期にGLI1発現が低下し、GLI1をRNA干渉で抑制すると、細胞周期・増殖に関わる19遺伝子の変化と増殖低下が認められた。GLI1は胎児性癌幹細胞の細胞周期制御に関与すると結論づけている。
summary_en: This basic research study examines the role of the Hedgehog transcription factor GLI1 in the NT2 embryonal carcinoma stem cell line, an established germ cell tumor model. Expression of GLI1 and its target PTCH decreases during retinoic acid-induced neuronal differentiation. Using microarray profiling after GLI1 RNA interference, the authors identified 114 differentially expressed genes, 19 of which regulate cell cycle and proliferation. GLI1 knockdown reduced NT2 proliferation and altered G1 cyclin expression, suggesting GLI1 controls cell cycle progression in embryonal carcinoma stem cells.

title: PATZ1 gene has a critical role in the spermatogenesis and testicular tumours.
title_ja: PATZ1遺伝子は精子形成および精巣腫瘍において重要な役割を果たす
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: PATZ1欠損マウスの解析により、PATZ1が精子形成に必須であることを示した。欠損雄は不妊で、精子形成細胞がアポトーシスにより減少していた。PATZ1はセルトリ細胞と精原細胞に発現する。精巣胚細胞腫瘍では発現が増加する一方、細胞質に誤局在しており、PATZ1の増加と誤局在が腫瘍発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Using PATZ1-knockout mice, this study shows that the zinc finger transcriptional repressor PATZ1 is essential for spermatogenesis, as knockout males were infertile and showed germ cell apoptosis. PATZ1 is expressed in Sertoli cells and spermatogonia. Its protein is increased in testicular germ cell tumors but mislocalized to the cytoplasm, suggesting impaired function. The authors propose that PATZ1 upregulation and mislocalization contribute to the development of testicular germ cell tumors, and that PATZ1 may act as a tumor suppressor.

title: Salvage combination chemotherapy with docetaxel, ifosfamide and cisplatin (DIP): successful treatment of a case with metastatic testicular immature teratoma.
title_ja: 転移性精巣未熟奇形腫に対する救済化学療法としてのDIP療法の奏効例
summary_ja: BEP療法と不完全な後腹膜リンパ節郭清に抵抗性を示した転移性精巣未熟奇形腫の症例報告である。二次治療のDIP療法(ドセタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチン)により、傍大動脈リンパ節、縦隔リンパ節および肺転移が著明に縮小した。その後の手術を経て、3.5年間再発は認められていない。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastatic testicular immature teratoma who was refractory to BEP chemotherapy and had an incomplete retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. At referral, lung and mediastinal nodal metastases were present and a para-aortic node had enlarged. Second-line DIP (docetaxel, ifosfamide, cisplatin) reduced para-aortic nodes by 82%, mediastinal nodes by 88% and lung metastases by 85%. The patient then underwent para-aortic node dissection, lung metastasis resection and mediastinal lymph node dissection, and remained free of recurrence 3.5 years later.

title: Diagnostic problems with trophoblastic lesions.
title_ja: 絨毛性病変の診断上の問題点
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の範囲に含まれる絨毛性病変の診断上の問題点を概説した総説である。原著ではなく病理診断の概観にあたる。抄録には個々の病変や診断基準の詳細は記載されていないため、内容は一般的な水準で要約している。
summary_en: This review addresses common diagnostic difficulties encountered when evaluating trophoblastic lesions, which form part of the gestational trophoblastic disease spectrum. It is a brief overview of pathological diagnosis rather than a primary study. The abstract does not describe specific lesions, diagnostic criteria or conclusions in detail, so the content is summarized only at a general level. Readers seeking practical diagnostic guidance would need to consult the full article.

title: Yolk sac tumor of the ovary: CT findings.
title_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見
summary_ja: 病理学的に確定した卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍10例のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を後方視的に検討した研究である。全例で輝点サイン、壊死、平滑な辺縁が認められ、いずれも片側性であった。卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍は、大きく平滑な片側性腫瘤として描出されると結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective CT study of 10 pathologically proven ovarian yolk sac tumors, read by two radiologists in consensus, describes imaging features. Mean patient age was 22 years and mean tumor size 14 cm. All tumors showed a bright dot sign, necrosis and a smooth margin on post-contrast CT, were unilateral, and nine were oval. The authors conclude that ovarian yolk sac tumors appear as large, unilateral, smooth-margined masses with a bright dot sign and necrotic areas, which may aid radiological recognition.

title: Inferior vena cava anomalies during laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清中に見つかった下大静脈の奇形
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性2名に4ポート法の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った経過を報告する。両者に左側下大静脈奇形が術中に確認され、修正した左側テンプレートを用いた。手術時間は60〜130分、出血は最小限であった。追跡期間中央値24.5か月で両者とも再発はみられなかった。著者らは、IVC奇形が存在しうる場合には術前画像検査による手術計画を勧めている。
summary_en: This report describes two men with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection using a four-port technique. Both had left-sided inferior vena cava anomalies identified intraoperatively, requiring a modified left-sided template. Operative times ranged from 60 to 130 minutes with minimal blood loss, and both remained recurrence-free at a median follow-up of 24.5 months. The authors advise preoperative imaging to plan surgery when IVC anomalies may be present.

title: Late relapse of testicular cancer 21 years after first complete remission: a case report.
title_ja: 右精巣がん初回完全寛解後21年で生じた晩期再発：症例報告
summary_ja: 右精巣がんで初回完全寛解後21年を経て、血清AFP上昇で再発した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。後腹膜リンパ節転移は化学療法に反応せず、拡大両側後腹膜リンパ節郭清と下大静脈合併切除を行った。術後48か月間、無病生存を維持している。
summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with elevated serum AFP 21 years after a first complete remission from right testicular cancer. CT showed a 5 cm retroperitoneal mass compressing the inferior vena cava. Four courses of cisplatin, etoposide, paclitaxel and ifosfamide did not control the disease, and AFP continued to rise. Extended bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with right nephrectomy, partial duodenectomy and vena cavectomy was performed. He has remained disease-free for 48 months after surgery.

title: [A case of recurrent metastatic testicular cancer, successfully treated with paclitaxel, ifomide and cisplatin].
title_ja: [再発・転移性精巣がんに対しパクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンの併用療法により奏効した1例]
summary_ja: 精巣の混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で根治的精巣摘除術を受け病期Iとされ、補助療法を行わなかった30歳男性の症例である。8か月後に脳、肺、脾臓に転移が生じ、AFPは1,297 ng/mlであった。複数の化学療法レジメンを経て、パクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンによりAFPが正常化し、脳と脾臓の転移は消失した。切除された残存肺腫瘤に生存腫瘍細胞はなく、3年間再発はみられていない。
summary_en: A 30-year-old man with a mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis underwent radical orchiectomy and was staged I, so he received no adjuvant therapy. Eight months later he developed brain, lung and spleen metastases, with AFP at 1,297 ng/ml. Several chemotherapy regimens were given, and AFP stayed elevated until paclitaxel, ifosfamide and cisplatin normalized it and cleared the brain and spleen metastases. A resected residual lung mass contained no viable tumor, and he has remained recurrence-free for 3 years.

title: Comprehensive laparoscopic surgical staging of ovarian dysgerminoma in a 13-year-old girl: a case report.
title_ja: 13歳女児の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に対する包括的腹腔鏡下外科的病期分類：症例報告
summary_ja: 偶然発見された20 cmの骨盤内腫瘤を有する13歳女児が、腹腔鏡下右卵管卵巣摘出術を受け、病理で純粋な未分化胚細胞腫と診断された。その後、腹腔洗浄やリンパ節郭清などを含む包括的腹腔鏡下病期分類が行われ、妊孕性温存のため子宮と左卵巣は温存された。21か月の経過観察で無病である。著者らは、この年齢の患者に対する同様の腹腔鏡下病期分類の報告としては初めてであると述べている。
summary_en: A 13-year-old girl with an incidentally found 20 cm pelvic mass arising from the right adnexa underwent laparoscopic right salpingo-oophorectomy, and pathology showed pure dysgerminoma. Comprehensive laparoscopic staging then included peritoneal washing, pelvic, common iliac and infrarenal paraaortic lymphadenectomy, appendectomy and infracolic omentectomy. The uterus and left ovary were spared to preserve fertility. She has been disease-free for 21 months, and the authors describe this as the first such laparoscopic staging in a patient this young.

title: Seminoma of testis masquerading as orchitis in an adult with paraplegia: proposed measures to avoid delay in diagnosing testicular tumours in spinal cord injury patients.
title_ja: 対麻痺を伴う成人男性で精巣炎と誤認されたセミノーマ：脊髄損傷患者における精巣腫瘍の診断遅延を防ぐための提案
summary_ja: 脊髄損傷で対麻痺の37歳男性が、精巣腫大を細菌性精巣炎と考えられ抗菌薬で治療されました。経時的な超音波検査で石灰化を伴う腫瘤が判明し、根治的精巣摘除術でセミノーマと診断されました。脊髄損傷患者での診断遅延を防ぐための対策を提案しています。
summary_en: A 37-year-old man with paraplegia from spinal cord injury had right testicular swelling initially treated as presumed bacterial orchitis with ciprofloxacin. Serial ultrasound revealed a mass with calcification, and radical orchidectomy showed seminoma. The authors note that orchitis is common in SCI patients, which can delay diagnosis of testicular tumors. They propose avoiding empirical antibiotics when possible, prompt scrotal ultrasound for firm swelling without urinary infection features, fine-needle aspiration for equivocal findings, and patient education.

title: A case of spermatic cord teratoma in low-stage testicular cancer managed by surveillance.
title_ja: 監視療法で管理された低病期精巣がんに生じた精索奇形腫の症例
summary_ja: 25歳男性が右精巣痛と腫大で受診し、AFPとhCGの上昇を認めました。精巣摘除術で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、臨床病期Iのため経過観察を選択しました。4か月後の血清学的再発にBEP療法を行い、16か月後の再発精索奇形腫に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行し、無病生存を維持しています。
summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with right testicular pain and swelling, with elevated AFP and hCG. Orchiectomy revealed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with yolk sac tumor, teratoma, and embryonal carcinoma, without metastasis. He chose surveillance over adjuvant therapy for clinical stage I disease. Serologic relapse at four months was treated with BEP chemotherapy. At 16 months, CT showed a nodule near the psoas, pathologically confirmed as recurrent mature teratoma in the spermatic cord, and bilateral nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was performed. He remains disease-free.

title: Periappendiceal dermoid: a rare cause of right lower quadrant pain.
title_ja: 虫垂周囲類皮嚢腫：右下腹部痛のまれな原因
summary_ja: 44歳男性が虫垂疾患を疑う急性腹症で受診しました。手術で虫垂間膜の炎症性嚢胞性病変を切除し、病理学的に重層扁平上皮に覆われた類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）と診断されました。虫垂周囲類皮嚢腫としては文献上7例目で、このような提示様式は初めてとされています。
summary_en: A 44-year-old man presented with an acute abdomen suggesting appendiceal disease. At surgery, an inflamed cystic lesion was found in the mesoappendix, resected, and pathologically diagnosed as a dermoid cyst, which is a mature teratoma lined by stratified squamous epithelium. The authors note this is only the seventh periappendiceal dermoid reported in the literature and the first presenting in this manner. Recognizing this rare entity is important for general surgeons evaluating right lower quadrant pain.

title: Oncofetal protein glypican-3 distinguishes yolk sac tumor from clear cell carcinoma of the ovary.
title_ja: オンコフェタル蛋白グリピカン-3は卵黄嚢腫瘍と卵巣明細胞癌を鑑別する
summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍と卵巣明細胞癌の鑑別におけるオンコフェタル蛋白グリピカン-3(GPC3)の有用性を検討しました。400例以上の卵巣腫瘍の組織マイクロアレイなどで評価した結果、卵黄嚢腫瘍の97%がGPC3陽性、明細胞癌の83%が陰性でした。GPC3は有望な診断マーカーとされています。
summary_en: This study evaluated glypican-3 (GPC3), an oncofetal protein, as a marker to distinguish yolk sac tumor from ovarian clear cell carcinoma, a key mimic. Tissue microarrays of over 400 ovarian neoplasms and full sections of 32 yolk sac tumors and 10 clear cell carcinomas were stained. Nearly all yolk sac tumors, including those in mixed germ cell tumors, were GPC3-positive, while teratomas and embryonal carcinomas were negative. Most clear cell carcinomas (83%) were negative, and GPC3 distinguished yolk sac tumor from clear cell carcinoma with high significance. The authors suggest GPC3 is a promising diagnostic marker, though its link to AFP expression and hepatoid clear cell carcinoma needs further study.

title: Giant mature ovarian cystic teratoma including more than 300 teeth.
title_ja: 300本を超える歯を含む巨大な卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫
journal: Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol Oral Radiol Endod
summary_ja: 25歳女性の卵巣に生じた巨大な良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は10kgに及び、300本以上の歯を含んでいた。術前の腫瘍マーカーは複数上昇していた。著者らは、腫瘍マーカーや腫瘍径だけでは成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と扁平上皮癌を鑑別しにくいと述べ、分化の良い歯の画像所見が良性を示唆しうると結論している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman with a giant, benign mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The tumor measured 320 x 270 x 185 mm, weighed 10 kg, and contained more than 300 teeth. Preoperative serum CA125, CA19-9, CEA, AFP, and SCC were elevated. The authors conclude that tumor markers and tumor size alone do not reliably distinguish mature cystic teratoma from squamous cell carcinoma arising within it, while radiologically detectable, well-differentiated teeth may suggest benignity.

title: Presumed pluripotency markers UTF-1 and REX-1 are expressed in human adult testes and germ cell neoplasms.
title_ja: ヒト成人精巣および胚細胞腫瘍における推定多能性マーカーUTF-1およびREX-1の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を含むヒト生殖腺の発生過程と腫瘍検体で、多能性関連転写因子UTF-1とREX-1の発現を検討した。両者は精巣上皮内癌と精巣胚細胞腫瘍で発現していた。UTF-1は全ての精子細胞性セミノーマで高発現し、精子幹細胞由来説を支持すると著者らは述べている。REX-1は精巣および卵巣の減数分裂細胞で発現していた。
summary_en: This study examined expression of the pluripotency-associated transcription factors UTF-1 and REX-1 across human gonadal development and in 86 testicular germ cell tumor samples. Both were expressed in testicular carcinoma in situ and in testicular germ cell tumors. UTF-1 was expressed in all spermatocytic seminomas, while REX-1 was present in meiotic cells of the testis and ovary. The authors suggest UTF-1 may support spermatogonial self-renewal and that spermatocytic seminoma arises from spermatogonia.

title: Nasopharyngeal teratoma associated with cleft palate in a newborn.
title_ja: 口蓋裂を伴う新生児の鼻咽頭奇形腫
summary_ja: 口蓋裂を伴う新生児の鼻咽頭奇形腫の症例報告である。頭頸部奇形腫は先天性のまれな病変で、鼻咽頭奇形腫はさらにまれとされる。主な初発症状は呼吸窮迫であり、治療は外科的切除が第一選択となる。予後は全体として良好で、再発はまれであり、不完全な切除に起因すると考えられている。
summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a nasopharyngeal teratoma associated with cleft palate. Head and neck teratomas are rare congenital lesions, and nasopharyngeal teratomas are rarer still. The most common presenting symptom is respiratory distress. Surgical excision is the management of choice, and the prognosis is generally excellent. Recurrences are rare and are attributed to incomplete surgical resection.

title: Teratocarcinosarcoma of the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses: report of 3 cases with assessment for chromosome 12p status.
title_ja: 鼻腔および副鼻腔の奇形癌肉腫：3症例における染色体12p状態の評価
summary_ja: 成人に生じるまれな悪性腫瘍である鼻腔・副鼻腔の奇形癌肉腫3例を対象とした。胚細胞腫瘍に典型的な染色体12p増幅の有無をFISHで検討した。いずれの症例にも悪性胚細胞成分は認めず、12p増幅もみられなかった。著者らは、本腫瘍は胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、多方向分化を示す体細胞型腫瘍であると結論している。
summary_en: This study examined three sinonasal teratocarcinosarcomas, rare malignancies of adults, for amplification of chromosome 12p, a feature typical of germ cell neoplasms. All three tumors showed admixed epithelial and mesenchymal components without a malignant germ cell component. FISH showed only two copies of chromosome 12 per case, with no 12p amplification. The authors conclude that these tumors are somatic-type neoplasms with divergent differentiation rather than germ cell tumors.

title: Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma of the ovary including three cases occurring during follow-up period.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化:追跡期間中に発症した3例を含む
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から悪性転化した14例を後方視的に解析した研究。病期Ia例は全例無病生存であったが、進行例の多くは無病生存とならなかった。画像検査や腫瘍マーカー(SCC、CEA)は早期の悪性転化の診断に十分ではなかった。フォローアップでのマーカー反復測定が偽陽性の除外に有用であった。
summary_en: Fourteen patients with malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma of the ovary were retrospectively analyzed. All stage Ia patients remained disease-free, whereas most advanced-stage patients did not. Preoperative imaging detected malignancy in advanced cases but less reliably in stage Ia. Serum SCC and CEA were elevated in most malignant cases, but were also falsely elevated in many benign cases, often normalizing on repeat testing. The authors conclude that combined diagnostic approaches and serial marker measurement are needed.

title: A 5-year followup study of asymptomatic men with testicular microlithiasis.
title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化を有する無症候性男性の5年間のフォローアップ研究
summary_ja: 超音波検査で精巣微小石灰化を認めた陸軍志願兵84名のうち63名を5年間追跡した研究。1例に混合型胚細胞腫瘍が発症し、一般集団と比較したオッズ比は317であった。大多数(98.4%)は精巣がんを発症せず、集中的なスクリーニングは費用対効果が低いと結論づけている。リスクのある男性には精巣自己検査の継続を推奨している。
summary_en: A 5-year follow-up of 63 of 84 army volunteers with testicular microlithiasis identified on screening ultrasound. One man developed a mixed germ cell tumour during follow-up, giving an odds ratio of 317 compared with the general population. Most men (98.4%) did not develop testicular cancer during this period. The authors conclude that intensive screening of men with microlithiasis is not cost-effective, but continue to recommend testicular self-examination for men at risk.

title: Low-grade mucinous epithelial neoplasm (intestinal type) arising in a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma with late recurrence as pseudomyxoma peritonei.
title_ja: 仙尾部成熟奇形腫に発生した粘液性上皮性腫瘍と遅発性腹膜偽粘液腫再発
summary_ja: 仙尾部の成熟奇形腫に併発した腸型の粘液性上皮性腫瘍の症例報告。遅発性に再発し、播種性の低悪性度粘液性腫瘍と腹膜偽粘液腫、粘液性腹水を呈した。成熟奇形腫関連の粘液性腫瘍が遅発性に腹膜偽粘液腫として再発した例は、解剖学的部位を問わず初の報告とされる。長期のフォローアップの重要性を示す。
summary_en: Case report of a mucinous epithelial neoplasm of intestinal type arising in a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma. The tumour recurred late as disseminated low-grade mucinous neoplasm with pseudomyxoma peritonei and mucinous ascites. The authors state this is the first reported case of a mature teratoma-associated mucinous neoplasm from any anatomical site with documented late recurrence as pseudomyxoma peritonei. The report highlights the need for long-term follow-up.

title: Mucinous cystadenocarcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma ovary and associated pseudomyxoma peritonei: report of a case.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する粘液性嚢胞腺癌と腹膜偽粘液腫:症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した粘液性嚢胞腺癌が腹膜偽粘液腫を伴った症例報告。卵巣原発で腹膜偽粘液腫をきたす例自体が稀であり、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の粘液性腺癌ではさらに稀である。文献検索で同様の症例は9例のみで、本報告が10例目とされる。
summary_en: A case report of mucinous cystadenocarcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, associated with pseudomyxoma peritonei. Primary ovarian tumours causing PMP are very rare, and mucinous adenocarcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma giving rise to PMP is rarer still. The authors identified only nine similar cases in a literature search and report this as the tenth. The report documents an exceptionally rare clinicopathological presentation.

title: Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy in patients with elevated tumour markers: indications, histopathology and outcome.
title_ja: 化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが高値の患者における後腹膜リンパ節郭清:適応、病理組織学、転帰
summary_ja: 化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた358例を後方視的に解析し、術前に腫瘍マーカーが高値であった48例に注目した研究。切除標本では活動性胚細胞腫瘍が58%に認められた。5年生存率は69%で、術後の腫瘍マーカー正常化のみが独立した予後因子であった。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)単独高値例で予後が良好であった。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 358 patients who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, 48 of whom had elevated tumour markers at surgery. Active germ cell tumour was found in 58% of specimens, differentiated teratoma in 25%, and necrosis in 17%. Five-year survival was 69%. Normalization of tumour markers after surgery was the only independent prognostic factor on multivariate analysis. Patients with isolated AFP elevation fared best, and surgery may offer cure without further chemotherapy in selected patients.

title: Participation of OCT3/4 and beta-catenin during dysgenetic gonadal malignant transformation.
title_ja: 性分化異常の性腺悪性転化におけるOCT3/4およびβ-カテニンの関与
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 混合性性腺異形成とGBを有する7例を対象に、OCT3/4とβ-カテニンを検討した研究である。性腺芽腫は約30％でディスジャーミノーマ／セミノーマへ進展する。著者らは、未熟な胚細胞の増殖はOCT3/4と核内に蓄積したβ-カテニンの相互作用による可能性を示唆している。一方、E-カドヘリン経路の関与は明確に示されなかった。
summary_en: Study of OCT3/4 and beta-catenin in seven patients with mixed gonadal dysgenesis and gonadoblastoma. Gonadoblastoma is an in situ tumour that progresses to dysgerminoma/seminoma in about 30% of cases. The authors suggest that proliferation of immature germ cells results from interaction between OCT3/4 and nuclear-accumulated beta-catenin. This suggests a shared oncogenic pathway in malignant transformation, although E-cadherin involvement was not conclusively shown.

title: Ovarian torsion caused by teratoma masquerading as renal colic.
title_ja: 腎疝痛と誤認された奇形腫による卵巣捻転
summary_ja: 右側腹部痛で腎疝痛と当初診断された女性が、奇形腫による卵巣捻転と判明した症例報告です。迅速な治療で良好に回復しました。卵巣捻転は認識されにくく、泌尿器疾患との鑑別が重要であることが強調されています。
summary_en: This emergency medicine report describes a woman with severe right flank pain who was initially diagnosed with renal colic. Further investigation revealed ovarian torsion caused by a teratoma. Timely surgical management led to a good recovery. The authors emphasise that ovarian torsion is poorly recognised and that teratoma-related torsion can mimic urological conditions, so emergency physicians should keep it in the differential diagnosis of flank pain in women.

title: Influence of tumor site and histology on long-term survival in 193 children with extracranial germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 小児の頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍193例における腫瘍部位と組織型が長期生存に与える影響
summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、腫瘍部位と組織型による長期生存を評価するため、頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の小児193例を検討した。仙尾部および卵巣の腫瘍が最も多く、奇形腫が主要な組織型であった。10年全生存期間は0.91、無イベント生存率は0.88であった。性腺原発の腫瘍は性腺外腫瘍より全生存期間が良好であり、頸部および縦隔の腫瘍は無イベント生存率が低かった。卵黄嚢腫瘍や絨毛癌などの悪性組織型は、成熟奇形腫より予後が不良であった。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 193 children with extracranial germ cell tumours to assess long-term survival by tumour site and histology. Sacrococcygeal and ovarian tumours were most common, and teratomas were the predominant histology. Ten-year overall survival was 0.91 and event-free survival was 0.88. Gonadal tumours had better overall survival than extragonadal tumours. Cervical and mediastinal tumours had worse event-free survival, and malignant histologies such as yolk sac tumour and choriocarcinoma had worse outcomes than mature teratoma.

title: Successful management of life-threatening choriocarcinoma syndrome with rupture of pulmonary metastatic foci causing hemorrhagic shock.
title_ja: 肺転移巣の破裂により出血性ショックを来した絨毛癌症候群の治療成功例
summary_ja: 肺と後腹膜リンパ節に転移した精巣がんの男性で、hCGが著明に上昇していた症例報告です。化学療法中に肺転移巣が破裂し、出血性ショックを来しました。下葉切除と多様式治療により完全寛解に至りました。
summary_en: This case report describes a man with testicular cancer metastatic to the lung and retroperitoneal lymph nodes, with serum hCG markedly elevated. After chemotherapy began, a pulmonary metastasis ruptured, causing hemothorax and haemorrhagic shock. Lower lobectomy was performed, and pathology showed choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumour. Multimodal treatment achieved complete remission. The authors describe this as the first reported case of choriocarcinoma syndrome with life-threatening haemorrhage from ruptured pulmonary metastases.

title: Spontaneous regression of pulmonary metastases from testicular embryonal carcinoma.
title_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の肺転移巣の自然退縮
summary_ja: 肺結節と触知可能な左精巣腫瘍を有する22歳男性の症例報告です。精巣摘除術で胎児性癌と診断されました。術後4日で肺転移巣が著明に退縮し、化学療法は行われませんでした。6か月後には肺腫瘍は認められませんでした。
summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with multiple pulmonary nodules and an 8-mm palpable left testicular tumour. Orchiectomy confirmed embryonal carcinoma with histiocytic infiltration. Lung metastases regressed remarkably within four days of surgery, so chemotherapy was withheld. Six months later, CT showed no lung tumours. The case illustrates rare spontaneous regression of metastatic testicular embryonal carcinoma after orchiectomy alone.

title: Metachronous testicular tumor developing eight years after retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の8年後に発症した異時性精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の30歳男性の症例報告です。切除と化学療法後、8年後に左精巣に異時性のセミノーマが発生しました。後腹膜EGCT後の異時性精巣腫瘍としては24例目とされています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with a retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumour and elevated LDH, hCG, AFP, DUPAN-2 and CA19-9. He received resection, neoadjuvant and adjuvant cisplatin/etoposide chemotherapy, with total necrosis on pathology. Eight years later, he developed a metachronous left testicular tumour, which was a seminoma after orchiectomy. The authors report this as the 24th case of metachronous testicular tumour after retroperitoneal EGCT.

title: Ovarian cystic teratoma with a pathognomonic appearance of multiple floating balls: a case report and investigation of common characteristics of the cases in the literature.
title_ja: 多数の浮遊球を特徴とする卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫：症例報告と文献における共通特徴の検討
summary_ja: 41歳女性の卵巣嚢胞で、超音波とMRIで多数の浮遊球を認めた症例報告です。摘出標本は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、球状構造は主に角化物でした。嚢胞内浮遊球は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に特異的な所見であり、この所見があれば他の検査の価値は限定的と結論づけられています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old woman with a 10-cm ovarian cyst containing multiple floating balls on ultrasonography, with similar findings on MRI. Right salpingo-oophorectomy showed mature cystic teratoma, with the balls composed mainly of keratin. The authors review the literature on this rare entity and conclude that intracystic floating balls are pathognomonic for mature cystic teratoma. When this appearance is seen on ultrasound, other tests such as tumour markers and CT may add limited value.

title: Retroperitoneal mature teratoma after orchidectomy for a stage IB pure embryonal testicular carcinoma.
title_ja: 病期IB精巣胎児性癌の摘除後に生じた後腹膜成熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌（病期IB）で精巣摘除後に積極的監視を受けていた19歳男性が、初診から1年以上経過して後腹膜リンパ節腫大を呈した。完全切除の結果、成熟奇形腫と判明した。悪性の原発腫瘍が良性組織像の転移を形成した稀な症例であり、監視中の後腹膜腫瘤では組織学的確認が重要であることを示す。
summary_en: A 19-year-old man on active surveillance after orchidectomy for stage IB testicular embryonal carcinoma developed a retroperitoneal lymph node enlargement more than a year after diagnosis. Complete lymph node resection revealed mature teratoma, with no malignant component. The authors describe this as an unusual case in which a highly malignant testicular primary produced a metastasis with benign histology. The case shows that late retroperitoneal masses during surveillance may be mature teratoma and highlights the importance of histological confirmation before further treatment.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome of ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣のgrowing teratoma syndrome
summary_ja: 悪性未熟奇形腫の卵巣腫瘍に化学療法と手術を行った3例を報告する。全例で化学療法後に腫瘤が増大したが、切除標本は成熟奇形腫のみであり、growing teratoma syndromeと診断された。3例とも初診から55〜103か月生存している。本症候群を早期に認識することは、根治的切除を可能にし、無効な化学療法を避けるうえで重要である。
summary_en: This report describes three patients with malignant immature teratoma of the ovary who received chemotherapy and surgery. All three developed an enlarging mass after chemotherapy, which on resection proved to be mature teratoma, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. One patient was FDG-PET positive despite purely mature histology. All three remain alive at 55 to 103 months of follow-up. The authors review the literature and stress that early recognition of this syndrome allows curative resection and avoids ineffective further chemotherapy.

title: Emergent excision of a prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 出生前診断された仙尾部奇形腫の緊急切除
summary_ja: 出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫の症例を報告し、出生直後の緊急切除に伴う麻酔上の留意点を検討する。出生前診断例は出生後診断例より死亡率が高い。治療は低侵襲治療から開腹手術まで病態に応じて選択され、多職種による連携と綿密な管理が、高リスク新生児のケアにおいて不可欠である。
summary_en: This report presents a prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma requiring emergent excision after birth. Prenatally diagnosed cases carry higher mortality than neonatally diagnosed ones. The authors discuss the variable natural history and management options, ranging from minimally invasive treatment to open surgery, with intervention timed prenatally or within minutes to days after delivery. The paper focuses on anesthetic considerations and the multidisciplinary coordination needed to care for these high-risk neonates.

title: A case of synchronous bilateral spermatocytic seminoma.
title_ja: 同時性両側精子細胞性セミノーマ
summary_ja: 両側精巣に同時性に発生した精子細胞性セミノーマの症例を報告する。両側精巣腫瘍は稀で、多くは古典的セミノーマが異時性に出現する。精子細胞性セミノーマが両側同時に発生した報告は本例が唯一とされ、診断や治療計画を考えるうえで示唆に富む。
summary_en: The authors report a case of synchronous bilateral spermatocytic seminoma, described as the only such case in the literature. Bilateral testicular tumors are rare, and most bilateral seminomas present metachronously as classic seminoma. The case highlights that spermatocytic seminoma, a distinct entity, can arise simultaneously in both testes, with implications for diagnosis and treatment planning.

title: Germ cell origin of testicular carcinoid tumors.
title_ja: 精巣カルチノイド腫瘍の胚細胞起源
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣カルチノイド4例を免疫組織化学とFISHで解析し、胚細胞起源を検討した。全例が成熟奇形腫を背景に発生しており、カルチノイド細胞では全例で12p等染色体が確認された。併存する奇形腫にも同様の変化がみられた例があった。精巣カルチノイドは精巣奇形腫の表現型であり、胚細胞由来と結論づけている。
summary_en: This study analyzed four testicular carcinoid tumors using immunohistochemistry and fluorescence in situ hybridization to test whether they originate from germ cells. All four arose within mature teratoma. Isochromosome 12p was detected in carcinoid cells in every case, and the coexisting teratoma showed the same change in several cases. The carcinoid cells were positive for synaptophysin and chromogranin. The authors conclude that testicular carcinoid represents a phenotypic expression of testicular teratoma and is of germ cell origin.

title: Intraplacental choriocarcinoma arising in a second trimester placenta with partial hydatidiform mole.
title_ja: 部分胞状奇胎を伴う妊娠中期胎盤に発生した胎盤内絨毛癌
summary_ja: 妊娠22週で部分胞状奇胎と絨毛癌が併存した症例報告。中絶後に肺結節と高値のβ-hCGが認められた。胎盤病理で部分奇胎内の微小な絨毛癌巣を確認し、フローサイトメトリーで3倍体を、p57免疫染色で腫瘍細胞と奇胎細胞を鑑別した。部分奇胎から直接絨毛癌が生じうるため、胎盤の十分な検索が必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: A case report of a 28-year-old woman at 22 weeks gestation with concurrent partial hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma. After termination she presented with lung nodules and a beta-hCG level above 100,000 IU/mL. Placental pathology showed microscopic choriocarcinoma foci within the partial mole. Flow cytometry confirmed triploidy, and p57 immunostaining distinguished atypical trophoblasts from partial molar cells. The authors suggest choriocarcinoma may arise directly from partial moles and that placentas should be thoroughly sampled.

title: Krukenberg tumor with yolk sac tumor differentiation.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍への分化を示したクルーケンベルグ腫瘍
summary_ja: 50歳女性の両側クルーケンベルグ腫瘍で、卵巣転移巣に卵黄嚢腫瘍への分化が認められた。原発の胃癌とリンパ節転移では典型的な卵黄嚢腫瘍成分はなかったが、一部の細胞はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。体細胞由来腫瘍に胚細胞型分化が巣状に生じた例であり、クルーケンベルグ腫瘍で卵黄嚢分化を示した初報告としている。
summary_en: A 50-year-old patient had bilateral Krukenberg tumors. The ovarian metastases contained foci of yolk sac tumor differentiation, while the gastric primary was a poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma. Some cells in the gastric primary and lymph node metastases were alpha-fetoprotein positive, but typical yolk sac tumor components were absent there. The authors describe this as a somatic cell-derived tumor with focal germ cell-type differentiation and the first report of yolk sac differentiation in a Krukenberg tumor.

title: Highly differentiated follicular carcinoma arising from struma ovarii: a report of 3 cases, a review of the literature, and a reassessment of so-called peritoneal strumosis.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫由来の高分化濾胞癌：3症例、文献レビュー、および腹膜ストルモーシスの再評価
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に由来する高分化濾胞癌の症例3例を報告し、既報の腹膜転移例を文献的に検討した。組織学的に無害な像を示すため、卵巣外へ進展した後に診断される例が多い。腹膜ストルモーシスは独立した疾患単位としては疑問視されている。治療は卵巣外腫瘍の局所切除に続く甲状腺摘出と放射性ヨウ素アブレーションが推奨されている。
summary_en: This article reports three cases of highly differentiated follicular carcinoma arising from struma ovarii, reviews 14 previously published peritoneal cases, and reassesses so-called peritoneal strumosis. The carcinoma looks histologically innocuous, so diagnosis often requires spread beyond the ovary. Some patients developed distant metastases many years after oophorectomy. The authors doubt that peritoneal strumosis is a distinct entity and recommend local resection followed by thyroidectomy and radioactive iodine ablation.

title: Survival of metastatic germ cell cancer patients assessed by international germ cell consensus classification in Japan.
title_ja: 国際胚細胞コンセンサス分類による日本の転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者の生存成績
summary_ja: 1990～2001年に日本の7施設で治療された転移性胚細胞腫瘍296例を、IGCC分類の予後群別に解析した多施設研究です。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の予後不良群では5年無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)52%、全生存期間(全生存率)61%で、従来より成績が改善していました。化学療法レジメンの進歩と専門施設での管理が改善の要因と考察されています。
summary_en: This Japanese multicenter cohort of 296 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors, treated between 1990 and 2001, was stratified by IGCC prognostic groups. Five-year progression-free and overall survival were higher than in earlier IGCC-era reports, especially for poor-prognosis non-seminomatous patients (PFS 52%, OS 61%). Seminoma outcomes were similar across groups. The authors attribute the gains to more effective chemotherapy regimens and care at experienced centers.

title: Cytologic differentiation of struma ovarii from other ovarian neoplasms.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫の細胞学的特徴と他の卵巣腫瘍との鑑別
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫7例の術中細胞診と細胞ブロックを検討し、サイログロブリンとTTF-1の免疫細胞化学染色の有用性を評価した研究です。膠様物質と濾胞細胞の所見により多くの症例で診断が示唆されましたが、2例は他の嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍と区別できませんでした。術前穿刺吸引および術中診断に免疫染色が有用と結論しています。
summary_en: Intraoperative cytology and cell blocks from seven struma ovarii cases were reviewed, with thyroglobulin and TTF-1 immunocytochemistry. Typical colloid and follicular cells allowed a suggestive or confirmed diagnosis in most cases, while two cases were indistinguishable from other cystic ovarian neoplasms. The authors conclude that cytology with thyroglobulin or TTF-1 staining is valuable for preoperative fine needle aspiration and intraoperative diagnosis of this benign ovarian tumor.

title: Perinatal factors and the risk of testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍と周産期因子のリスク
summary_ja: 米国STEED症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の周産期危険因子を検討しました。母親・父親の若年、母親の経産回数、骨盤位分娩が全体のリスクと関連しました。セミノーマは低出生体重、非セミノーマは骨盤位分娩と帝王切開と関連しており、精巣腫瘍が生命の非常に早期に起こるという仮説を支持しています。
summary_en: The US STEED case-control study examined perinatal risk factors for testicular germ cell tumors, using data from 527 case mothers and 561 control mothers. Young maternal and paternal age, maternal parity, and breech birth were associated with overall risk. Seminoma was linked to low birth weight, while non-seminoma was linked to breech birth and Cesarean section. The findings support the hypothesis that testicular germ cell tumors originate in very early life.

title: Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy for germ cell tumours: is a full bilateral template always necessary?
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清：完全な両側テンプレートは常に必要か
summary_ja: 後腹膜に限局した病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍102例を、限定テンプレートによる化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清で治療し、長期成績を検討しました。標本の大部分は成熟奇形腫または壊死・線維化で、活動性腫瘍は2例のみでした。順行性射精は94%で温存され、中央値102か月の追跡で後腹膜再発は1例のみでした。
summary_en: Long-term outcomes were assessed in 102 patients with stage II NSGCT whose metastases were confined to the retroperitoneum and who underwent post-chemotherapy RPLND using a restricted template. Most had unilateral or modified dissection. Mature teratoma or necrosis/fibrosis was found in nearly all specimens, with only two containing active tumor. Antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 94%. Over a median follow-up of 102 months, only one retroperitoneal recurrence occurred, supporting selective template use.

title: Pattern of germ cell testicular carcinoma in Dharmais Cancer Hospital between January 2000-December 2004.
title_ja: ダルマイス癌病院における2000年1月～2004年12月の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の傾向
summary_ja: インドネシアのダルマイス国立癌病院で2000～2004年に治療された精巣癌44例を記述的に解析しました。40例が胚細胞腫瘍で、セミノーマが最も多く、患者の多くは21～30歳でした。化学療法レジメンはBEPが最も多く用いられ、病期IIでの受診が多く見られました。
summary_en: A descriptive review of 44 testicular carcinoma cases at Dharmais National Cancer Hospital in Indonesia from 2000 to 2004 found that 40 were germ cell tumors. Seminoma was the most common histology, most patients were aged 21 to 30, and BEP was the most frequently used chemotherapy regimen. Stage II was the most common presenting stage. Non-seminoma occurred more often in patients under 30, and the number of germ cell tumor cases rose over the period.

title: Cystic struma ovarii presenting as pseudo-Meigs' syndrome with elevated CA125 levels. A case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 高CA125を伴う偽Meigs症候群として発症した嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 閉経後女性の良性卵巣甲状腺腫が、腹水・両側胸水・CA125高値を伴う偽Meigs症候群として発症した症例。開腹術で成熟甲状腺組織からなる良性腫瘍と確認され、切除後に胸水とCA125は正常化し、12か月間再発はなかった。英文献で同様の報告は5例目とされ、腹水・胸水・腫瘍マーカー上昇を伴う骨盤内腫瘤では卵巣甲状腺腫を鑑別診断に含めるべきと述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a postmenopausal woman with a benign struma ovarii, a monodermal ovarian teratoma, that presented as pseudo-Meigs' syndrome with ascites, bilateral pleural effusions, and markedly elevated CA125. Laparotomy confirmed a benign tumor composed of mature thyroid tissue. After resection, the effusions and CA125 normalized, and there was no recurrence at 12 months. The authors note this is only the fifth such case in the English literature and recommend including struma ovarii in the differential diagnosis of pelvic masses with ascites, hydrothorax, and elevated tumor markers.

title: Delayed orchiectomy at postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection due to laterality of retroperitoneal metastatic pattern consistent with testicular primary: assessment of pathologic findings.
title_ja: 後腹膜転移の側性が精巣原発と一致したことによる、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清時の遅延精巣摘除術：病理学的所見の評価
summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が疑われ、後腹膜転移の側性から精巣原発が示唆された14例を単施設で検討した。精巣超音波が正常または軽微な所見にとどまった症例でも、摘除標本の71%に精巣原発を示す所見（成熟奇形腫や壊死・線維化）がみられた。精巣所見が正常でも化学療法後精巣摘除を提案すべきとしている。
summary_en: This single-institution review examines 14 patients with presumed extragonadal germ cell tumors who underwent delayed orchiectomy at postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection because lateralized retroperitoneal metastases suggested a testicular primary. Despite normal or minimally abnormal testicular ultrasound, 71% of orchiectomy specimens showed evidence of a testicular primary, including mature teratoma in 2 patients and necrosis or fibrosis in 8. The authors recommend offering postchemotherapy orchiectomy in such patients even when testicular examination and ultrasound are normal.

title: Ovarian mature teratomas with mucinous epithelial neoplasms: morphologic heterogeneity and association with pseudomyxoma peritonei.
title_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫に伴う粘液性上皮性腫瘍：形態学的不均一性と腹膜偽粘液腫との関連
summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫に伴う粘液性上皮性腫瘍42例を、病理形態・免疫表現型・臨床経過から検討。卵巣偽粘液腫は55%、古典的腹膜偽粘液腫は24%にみられた。良性および境界悪性病変は腹腔内再発のリスクが低い一方、浸潤癌と腹膜癌腫症を伴う例は予後不良であった。
summary_en: This pathology study examined 42 patients with mucinous epithelial neoplasms arising in association with mature ovarian teratomas. Classification by 2003 WHO criteria found cystadenomas, intestinal-type low malignant potential tumors, intraepithelial carcinomas, and invasive carcinomas, with cytokeratin 7 and 20 immunophenotyping. Pseudomyxoma ovarii occurred in 55% and classic pseudomyxoma peritonei in 24%. Benign and borderline lesions with microscopic peritoneal mucinous epithelium showed no significant intra-abdominal recurrence, whereas teratomas with invasive carcinoma and peritoneal carcinomatosis had aggressive courses.

title: Differential expression of SOX17 and SOX2 in germ cells and stem cells has biological and clinical implications.
title_ja: 胚細胞と幹細胞におけるSOX17とSOX2の発現差がもたらす生物学的および臨床的意義
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胎児の胚細胞および精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるSOX転写因子を検討した。胎児の胚細胞、上皮内癌、セミノーマではSOX2が存在せず、POU5F1とともにSOX17が発現していた。免疫組織化学、ウェスタンブロット、定量的RT-PCRにより、SOX17はセミノーマと胎児性癌を区別でき、細胞株でも確認された。CISに伴うセルトリ細胞でのSOX2異常発現は、胎児性癌との誤診につながる可能性がある。本知見は診断および発生生物学に示唆を与える。
summary_en: This study examined SOX transcription factors in human fetal germ cells and testicular germ cell tumours. SOX2 was absent in fetal germ cells, carcinoma in situ, and seminoma, whereas SOX17, together with POU5F1, was expressed in these cells. Immunohistochemistry, western blotting, and quantitative RT-PCR showed that SOX17 distinguishes seminoma from embryonal carcinoma, confirmed in cell lines. Aberrant SOX2 expression in Sertoli cells associated with carcinoma in situ may lead to misdiagnosis as embryonal carcinoma. The findings have implications for diagnosis and developmental biology.

title: FOXL2 and SOX9 as parameters of female and male gonadal differentiation in patients with various forms of disorders of sex development (DSD).
title_ja: 様々な性分化疾患(DSD)患者における性腺分化の指標としてのFOXL2とSOX9
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究では、性分化疾患(DSD)における性腺分化を検討するため、FOXL2とSOX9の免疫染色を用いた。SOX9はセルトリ前駆細胞と精巣発生を、FOXL2は顆粒膜細胞と卵巣間質を示し、卵精巣性DSDでも認められた。上皮内癌を含むすべての精細管はSOX9陽性でFOXL2陰性であった。一方、発生異常を伴う性腺の性索芽腫ではFOXL2が発現し、SOX9はほとんどないか全くなかった。性腺分化が、前駆病変であるCISまたは性索芽腫の形態を規定していると考えられる。
summary_en: This study used FOXL2 and SOX9 immunostaining to investigate gonadal differentiation in disorders of sex development (DSD). SOX9 marked pre-Sertoli cells and testicular development, while FOXL2 marked granulosa cells and ovarian stroma, including in ovotesticular DSD. All seminiferous tubules containing carcinoma in situ, the precursor of type II germ cell tumours, expressed SOX9 but not FOXL2. In contrast, gonadoblastomas in dysgenetic gonads showed FOXL2 expression and little or no SOX9. Gonadal differentiation thus appears to determine the morphology of the precursor lesion, either CIS or gonadoblastoma.

title: Risk of testicular germ cell tumors and polymorphisms in the insulin-like growth factor genes.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクとインスリン様成長因子（IGF）遺伝子の多型
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍（TGCT）症例577例と対照707例で、IGF経路の4遺伝子43個の一塩基多型を解析した症例対照研究。IGF-1R多型4つは身長と関連したが、TGCTリスクおよびセミノーマ・非セミノーマいずれの組織型とも関連は認められなかった。IGF遺伝子の一般的変異はTGCTリスクに全体として関連しないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This case-control study of 577 testicular germ cell tumour cases and 707 controls genotyped 43 SNPs in four insulin-like growth factor pathway genes. Four IGF-1R polymorphisms were associated with adult height, but no polymorphism or haplotype was associated with overall TGCT risk or with seminoma or nonseminoma histology. Odds ratios ranged from 0.55 to 1.50. Adult height may modify the relationship between an IGF-1 haplotype and TGCT risk. The authors conclude that common IGF genetic variation is not associated with TGCT risk in aggregate.

title: Blindness: a rare and serious complication after extensive mediastinal resection.
title_ja: 縦隔原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の切除後に生じた失明：稀かつ重篤な合併症
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、縦隔原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の切除後に上大静脈症候群を発症し、失明に至った患者を報告する。広範な縦隔切除は静脈還流を障害し、まれだが重篤な眼神経合併症を生じうることを示している。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の外科的治療では、静脈閉塞の早期認識と周術期管理が重要である。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient who developed blindness due to superior vena cava syndrome after resection of a primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. The authors detail the clinical course and emphasize that extensive mediastinal resection can compromise venous drainage, leading to rare but severe neuro-ophthalmic complications. The report highlights the need for careful perioperative management, early recognition of venous obstruction, and awareness of this serious complication when surgically treating mediastinal germ cell tumors.

title: Racial differences among boys with testicular germ cell tumors in the United States.
title_ja: 米国における男児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の人種差
summary_ja: 本研究はSEERデータを用い、1992年から2004年に0〜14歳の男児で診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍695例を人種別に解析した。アジア・太平洋諸島系の男児は白人に比べて発生率が1.4倍高く、この傾向は年齢層や組織型（卵黄嚢腫瘍/胎児性癌、奇形腫、セミノーマ）を問わず認められた。思春期前の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生には人種が重要な役割を果たしていると結論づけている。
summary_en: This population-based SEER analysis compared testicular germ cell tumor incidence by race in boys aged 0 to 14 years diagnosed between 1992 and 2004. Among 695 cases, Asian/Pacific Islander boys had a 1.4-fold higher risk than white boys, a pattern consistent across age strata and histologies including yolk sac tumor/embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, and seminoma. The authors conclude that race plays a significant role in prepubertal testicular germ cell tumor incidence, similar to adults.

title: Postmenopausal hyperandrogenism caused by a benign cystic teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫が原因の閉経後高アンドロゲン血症：症例報告
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、多毛症と高アンドロゲン血症を呈した55歳の閉経後女性を報告する。原因は、ホルモン活性を有する卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であり、病理学的にライディッヒ細胞を含むことが確認された。手術後にテストステロン値は正常化した。過去の7例も検討され、まれながら閉経後でも男性化を生じうることが示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old postmenopausal woman with hirsutism and hyperandrogenism caused by a hormonally active mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Pathology showed mature ovarian cystic teratomas containing Leydig cells, and testosterone normalized after surgery. The authors review seven previously reported cases, concluding that although rare, ovarian androgen production can cause virilization even in postmenopausal women with mature cystic teratoma.

title: Multiple pilomatricoma in the context of previous seminoma: discussion on the possible relationship.
title_ja: 既往にセミノーマを有する患者に生じた多発性毛母腫：両者の関連についての考察
summary_ja: 本論文は、セミノーマの治療から15か月後に多発性毛母腫を発症した28歳男性を報告する。多発性毛母腫は筋強直性ジストロフィーとの関連が多いが、著者らはセミノーマの既往との新たな関連を提示する。両者の関係が偶然か、共通の分子異常によるものかを考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old man with three pilomatricomas diagnosed 15 months after treatment for seminoma. The authors note that multiple pilomatricomas are most often linked to myotonic dystrophy and propose a new association with prior seminoma. They discuss whether this temporal relationship reflects more than coincidence, possibly through shared molecular alterations. The paper examines a possible link between a germ cell tumor history and a benign skin tumor.

title: A laparoscopic approach to treating torsion of a nonpregnant uterus accompanied by a large ovarian cyst in a premenarchal girl.
title_ja: 思春期前の少女における、大きな卵巣嚢腫を伴う非妊娠子宮の捻転に対する腹腔鏡下治療
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、中等度の腹痛と大きな腹部腫瘤を呈した10歳の初経前女児を報告する。左卵巣の嚢胞性腫瘍が子宮体部とともに360度捻転し、出血性梗塞を起こしていた。腹腔鏡下に子宮部分切除および左卵管卵巣摘出術を行い、病理学的に卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。小児におけるこの稀な病態に対する腹腔鏡手術の有用性を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old premenarchal girl with abdominal pain and a large abdominal mass caused by 360-degree torsion of a left ovarian cystic tumor together with the uterine corpus, with hemorrhagic infarction. Laparoscopy revealed the cyst, and partial hysterectomy with left salpingo-oophorectomy was performed. Pathology classified the lesion as a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary with hemorrhagic necrosis extending to the tube and uterus. The report illustrates a laparoscopic approach to this uncommon presentation in a child.

title: Endothelin (ET)-1 and ET-3 promote expression of c-fos and c-jun in human choriocarcinoma via ET(B) receptor-mediated G(i)- and G(q)-pathways and MAP kinase activation.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛癌においてエンドセリン(ET)-1およびET-3はETB受容体を介するG(i)およびG(q)経路とMAPキナーゼ活性化を介してc-fosおよびc-junの発現を促進する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARおよびJeg-3において、エンドセリン(ET)-1およびET-3がETB受容体を介してp42/44 MAPKを活性化し、c-fosとc-junの転写および細胞増殖を促進することを示した。絨毛癌細胞はETを分泌しており、ETまたはETB受容体シグナルの阻害は治療標的となりうると考察している。基礎研究の段階の知見である。
summary_en: This study examined endothelin-1 and endothelin-3 signaling in the human choriocarcinoma cell lines JAR and Jeg-3. Both cell lines expressed only the ETB receptor, and ET-1 and ET-3 activated p42/44 MAPK through Gi (Src) and Gq (PKC) pathways. This increased c-fos and c-jun transcription and cell growth. Because choriocarcinoma cells secrete endothelins, the authors suggest that blocking ETs or ETB-mediated signaling may be a potential therapeutic target.

title: Targeted therapies for patients with germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する分子標的治療
summary_ja: 本総説は、胚細胞腫瘍に対する分子標的治療の可能性を検討したものである。進行例はシスプラチン併用化学療法で治癒しうるが、再発例の予後は不良である。受容体型チロシンキナーゼの発現・変異と臨床試験を文献およびデータベースから調査し、一部のセミノーマでc-KIT変異が認められた。トラスツズマブ、サリドマイド、イマチニブなどの報告があり、スニチニブやベバシズマブの試験が進行中である。
summary_en: This review assesses targeted therapies for germ cell tumors. Advanced GCTs are curable with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, but relapsed disease has poor outcomes. The authors searched the literature and trial databases for receptor tyrosine kinase expression and mutations, and for clinical trials. c-KIT mutations were found in some seminomas and bilateral tumors. Trastuzumab, thalidomide and imatinib have been tried in case reports and small trials, while sunitinib and bevacizumab trials are ongoing. Targeted therapy use is expected to grow.

title: Primary yolk sac tumor of the liver: incidental finding in a patient transplanted for hepatocellular carcinoma.
title_ja: 肝原発卵黄嚢腫瘍：肝細胞癌に対して移植された患者における偶発的所見
summary_ja: B型肝炎関連肝硬変の64歳男性で、肝細胞癌が疑われた肝結節とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値を認めた。治療後に肝移植を施行したところ、切除肝の病理検査で肝細胞癌ではなく肝原発卵黄嚢腫瘍(Schiller-Duval小体を伴う)と診断された。移植後12か月のフォローアップでは再発を認めなかった。肝硬変患者のAFP上昇では、卵黄嚢腫瘍も鑑別に含める必要があることを示す症例である。
summary_en: A 64-year-old man with HBV-related cirrhosis had a liver nodule suspected to be hepatocellular carcinoma, with AFP rising to 1600 UI/l. After laser ablation, TACE and then liver transplantation, the explanted liver showed hepatic yolk sac tumor with Schiller-Duval bodies rather than HCC. Twelve months of follow-up showed no recurrence. The case suggests that yolk sac tumor should be considered in the differential diagnosis of a liver mass with elevated AFP in cirrhotic patients.

title: Neuroectodermal ovarian tumors: a brief overview.
title_ja: 卵巣の神経外胚葉性腫瘍：概説
summary_ja: 卵巣原発の神経外胚葉性腫瘍は、ほぼ全体が神経外胚葉組織から成るまれな単相性奇形腫である。文献上約60例が報告され、組織学的には中枢神経系の神経外胚葉性腫瘍と同様の所見を示す。臨床病期I・IIの症例は主に手術で治療され、臨床病期III・IVでは放射線療法や化学療法が追加されている。診断時の臨床病期が最も重要な予後因子である。
summary_en: This brief review covers primary neuroectodermal tumors of the ovary, which are rare monophasic teratomas composed almost entirely of neuroectodermal tissue. About 60 cases have been reported, and they histologically resemble CNS neuroectodermal tumors. Most patients are in their third and fourth decades. Patients with clinical stage I or II disease were usually treated surgically, while those with stage III or IV received radiation or chemotherapy. Clinical stage at diagnosis is the most important prognostic factor.

title: Malignant transformation of testicular teratoma: a chemoresistant phenotype.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫の悪性転化：化学療法抵抗性の表現型
summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫の悪性転化(MTT)9例の単施設解析である。転化成分は主に腺癌と横紋筋肉腫であった。臨床病期Iの2例は初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清のみで無病生存した。術前化学療法を受けた7例では画像上の反応は乏しく、腫瘍マーカーは6例で正常化したものの、7例中3例が病死した。MTTは化学療法に抵抗性であり、新たな治療戦略が必要と結論している。
summary_en: This single-institution review of nine patients with malignant transformation of testicular teratoma (MTT) found that the transformed components were mainly adenocarcinoma and rhabdomyosarcoma. Two clinical stage I patients underwent primary RPLND with no viable tumor and remained disease-free. Among patients treated with preoperative chemotherapy, radiologic response was poor, although tumor markers normalized in six. Three of seven patients died of disease. The authors conclude that MTT is chemoresistant and needs alternative targeted treatments.

title: Histologic type, staging, and distribution of germ cell tumors in Korean adults.
title_ja: 韓国成人における胚細胞腫瘍の組織型、病期分類および分布
summary_ja: 1995~2004年に診断された韓国成人の胚細胞腫瘍698例を、組織型、AJCCのTNM病期分類、IGCCC分類で解析した。原発部位は精巣が67%と最多で、中枢神経系20%、縦隔11%、後腹膜2%であった。精巣原発ではセミノーマが約半数を占めた。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は西洋の報告より侵攻性が高く、セミノーマは非常に緩徐な経過をとる。性腺外原発の胚細胞腫瘍が多いことも示された。
summary_en: This study analyzed 698 Korean adults with germ cell tumors diagnosed from 1995 to 2004 by histology, AJCC TNM staging and IGCCC prognostic classification. The testis was the most common site (67%), followed by the central nervous system (20%), mediastinum (11%) and retroperitoneum (2%). Seminoma was the most common testicular histology. NSGCT presented more aggressively and seminoma more indolently than in Western reports, and extragonadal primaries were common.

title: Extramammary Paget disease in a retrorectal dermoid cyst: report of a unique case.
title_ja: 直腸後部類皮嚢腫内に生じた乳房外Paget病：稀な症例
summary_ja: 64歳男性の直腸後部(仙骨前)類皮嚢腫内に、乳房外Paget病が生じた極めてまれな症例である。類皮嚢腫は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の一型として知られる性腺外病変である。嚢腫の扁平上皮裏打ち層がPaget細胞により著明に拡大していた。臨床・画像・病理所見を報告し、この稀な合併例について考察している。
summary_en: This report describes a 64-year-old man with extramammary Paget disease arising within a retrorectal (presacral) dermoid cyst, a rare extragonadal mature cystic teratoma. The squamous lining of the cyst was markedly expanded by Paget cells. The authors describe the clinical, radiologic and pathologic findings and discuss this unusual association. Because retrorectal dermoids are also described as monodermal or mature teratomas, the case illustrates a rare complication of an extragonadal teratoma.

title: Adenocarcinoma arising in anterior mediastinal mature cystic teratoma: report of a case.
title_ja: 縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた腺癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され切除された57歳男性の症例。術後7か月で悪性胸水が再発した。切除標本を全割して再検討したところ、腫瘍内に腺癌の小病巣が見つかった。縦隔の成熟奇形腫に悪性成分が潜むことと、検出には全割による組織学的評価が必要であることを示す。
summary_en: A case report of a 57-year-old man with a large anterior mediastinal mature cystic teratoma that was initially diagnosed as benign. He later developed a recurrent malignant effusion seven months after surgical resection. Re-review of the entire resected specimen revealed small foci of adenocarcinoma within the tumor. The report highlights that malignant components can be hidden in mediastinal mature teratomas and that complete histological sampling is needed to detect them.

title: Testicular germ cell tumors in mice: new ways to study a genetically complex trait.
title_ja: マウスにおける精巣胚細胞腫瘍：遺伝的に複雑な形質を研究する新たな方法
summary_ja: 自然発生の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を生じる唯一の近交系マウス129/Svを用いた感受性研究の方法論の総説。ヒト小児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍と発生・組織学的特徴を共有する。修飾遺伝子を用いた遺伝解析の戦略を紹介する。
summary_en: A methods review on modeling testicular germ cell tumor susceptibility in the 129/Sv inbred mouse strain, the only inbred strain with a meaningful frequency of spontaneous tumors. The authors note that these tumors share developmental and histological features with human pediatric testicular germ cell tumors. Susceptibility is genetically complex, and modifier genes on the 129/Sv background are used in genetic interaction and sensitized polygenic analyses. The review outlines strategies for dissecting this complex trait.

title: Genetic variants in the 8q24 locus and risk of testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 8q24領域の遺伝子多型と精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク
summary_ja: 米国STEED研究で精巣胚細胞腫瘍568例と対照680例を比較し、8q24領域の15のSNPを検討。全体では関連は認められず、セミノーマでも同様だった。非セミノーマで3つの暫定的な関連がみられたが、いずれも頑健ではない。
summary_en: A case-control study of 568 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 680 controls from the US STEED study, examining 15 SNPs at 8q24. No overall association with risk was found, and seminoma analyses were also null. Three tentative associations emerged for nonseminoma, with odds ratios of 1.15 to 1.68, but none was robust. The authors conclude there is little evidence for 8q24 involvement and that the nonseminoma findings warrant further investigation.

title: Laparoscopic-assisted excision of sacrococcygeal teratoma in children.
title_ja: 小児の仙尾部奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡補助下切除術
journal: J Laparoendosc Adv Surg Tech A
summary_ja: 2000年から2004年の間に、腹腔鏡と会陰を併用したアプローチで小児の仙尾部奇形腫4例を治療した報告である。骨盤部分を腹腔鏡下に授動し、会陰から完全切除と回収を行った。平均手術時間は279分で、腹腔鏡操作に関連する合併症はなかった。追跡期間中央値46.5か月で再発はなく、整容的結果は優れていた。脊椎転移のあった1例を除き、機能的転帰は満足のいくものであった。
summary_en: A report of four children with sacrococcygeal teratoma treated with a combined laparoscopic and perineal approach between 2000 and 2004. The pelvic portion was mobilized laparoscopically and the tumor was completely excised and retrieved through the perineum. Mean operative time was 279 minutes with no laparoscopy-related complications. At a median follow-up of 46.5 months there was no recurrence and cosmetic results were excellent. Functional outcome was satisfactory except in one patient with spinal metastases.

title: Delayed effects of whole brain radiotherapy in germ cell tumor patients with central nervous system metastases.
title_ja: 中枢神経系転移を有する胚細胞腫瘍患者における全脳放射線療法の遅発性影響
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 中枢神経系転移を有する胚細胞腫瘍患者5例が、シスプラチン併用化学療法と併用した全脳放射線療法の後に遅発性の重篤な中枢神経毒性を発症した。発症までの中央値は72か月。3例が死亡し、全例に重い機能障害がみられた。若年患者では全脳照射が無害ではないと結論づけている。
summary_en: A report of five germ cell tumor patients who developed delayed, severe CNS toxicity after whole brain radiotherapy given with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for CNS metastases. All developed progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy-like symptoms, with a median onset of 72 months after WBRT. Three patients died, and all experienced significant debility. The authors conclude that WBRT is not innocuous in young patients with germ cell tumors and can cause late CNS toxicity.

title: Chronic cancer-related fatigue in long-term survivors of testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん長期生存者における慢性がん関連疲労
summary_ja: ノルウェーの精巣がん長期生存者1431例（治療後平均11年）を、年齢を合わせた一般男性1080例と比較した多施設調査。慢性のがん関連疲労は生存者の17.1%に認められ、一般集団の9.7%より多かった。生活の質の低下、心理社会的・身体的問題、神経症傾向と強く関連した。
summary_en: A multicenter survey of 1431 Norwegian long-term testicular cancer survivors, averaging 11 years after treatment, compared with 1080 age-matched men from the general population. Chronic cancer-related fatigue was reported by 17.1% of survivors versus 9.7% of controls with general fatigue. Poor quality of life, psychosocial and somatic problems, and neuroticism were strongly associated with fatigue. The authors recommend that fatigue be addressed during routine follow-up of survivors.

title: Germ cell tumors of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(MOGCT)の診療をまとめた総説。病期、残存腫瘍量、組織型、腫瘍マーカー高値が予後因子である。妊孕性温存を希望する場合は片側付属器切除を含む温存手術が適切とされ、標準的補助化学療法はBEP3コースである。大多数の患者は生殖機能を保持するが、晩期の治療毒性への懸念は続いている。
summary_en: This review outlines the management of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (MOGCTs), which are rare but curable at all stages. Prognostic factors include stage, residual tumor, histology, and raised tumor markers. Fertility-sparing surgery with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy is appropriate when fertility is desired. Three cycles of BEP are the standard adjuvant chemotherapy, with four cycles for bulky residual disease. Second-look surgery is generally not indicated for early-stage non-dysgerminoma or dysgerminoma. Most patients retain reproductive function, but long-term treatment toxicity remains a concern.

title: Cardiac liposarcoma and bilateral ovarian mature teratoma in a patient with congenital heart disease and f-anisosplenia.
title_ja: 心臓脂肪肉腫と両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を合併した、先天性心疾患およびf-anisosplenia患者の一例
summary_ja: 心房中隔欠損症と脾臓の不均等(f-anisosplenia)を有する10歳女児に、両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が見つかった症例報告である。2年後に心臓腫瘍が出現し、病理組織学的に脂肪肉腫と診断されて死亡した。先天性心疾患、多脾、両側卵巣成熟奇形腫、心臓脂肪肉腫の組み合わせは極めてまれな病態として報告されている。
summary_en: A 10-year-old girl with atrial septal defect and f-anisosplenia presented with bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratomas, found during endoscopic surgery. Two years later she developed a cardiac mass, which was pathologically diagnosed as liposarcoma, and she died. The authors describe this combination of congenital heart disease, multiple spleens, bilateral ovarian mature teratomas, and cardiac liposarcoma as an unusual and possibly unique presentation. As a single case report, it describes an association rather than a mechanism or treatment.

title: Genes, chromosomes and the development of testicular germ cell tumors of adolescents and adults.
title_ja: 思春期・成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍における遺伝子、染色体、および発生
summary_ja: 思春期・成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝学と分子生物学をレビューした総説。セミノーマと非セミノーマに分類され、胎児性癌は最も未分化な非セミノーマである。12p染色体の獲得がほぼ必発で、KRASなどの遺伝子が関与する。KIT、RAS/RAF/MAPK、PI3K/AKTなどのシグナル伝達経路と、環境因子および遺伝的素因の双方が発生に関わると考えられている。
summary_en: A review of the genetics and molecular biology of testicular germ cell tumors in adolescents and adults. TGCTs arise from intratubular germ cell neoplasia and are divided into seminomas and nonseminomas, with embryonal carcinoma as the most undifferentiated nonseminoma. Gain of chromosome 12p, including KRAS, is nearly universal. Signaling pathways including KIT, RAS/RAF/MAPK, STAT and PI3K/AKT are implicated, and environmental and genetic factors both contribute to development.

title: Identification of genomic changes associated with cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumor cell lines.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株におけるシスプラチン耐性に関連するゲノム変化の同定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株3組について、親株とシスプラチン耐性株のゲノム差異をSNPアレイとFISHで比較した研究。耐性株では3組すべてで6q26-27の増幅と10p14の微小欠失が共通していた。これらの領域には耐性に関わる遺伝子が含まれる可能性があり、今後の検討が必要とされている。
summary_en: Using 10K SNP microarray and FISH, the authors compared three testicular germ cell tumor cell lines with their cisplatin-resistant derivatives. All three resistant pairs shared a copy number gain at 6q26-27 (8.7 Mb) and a 0.3 Mb deletion at 10p14. These regions may harbor genes contributing to cisplatin resistance in TGCTs and possibly other cancers, and warrant further study.

title: Testicular tumors--some new and a few perennial problems.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍：新たな問題と依然として残る課題
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の病理組織学を、新しい・非典型的な特徴を中心にまとめた総説。セミノーマが篩状や微小嚢胞状の配列を示すと、セルトリ細胞腫瘍や卵黄嚢腫瘍との鑑別が問題になり、免疫組織化学が補助となる。精母細胞性セミノーマや性索間質性腫瘍なども扱われ、肉眼および顕微鏡所見の慎重な評価が診断上の問題の大部分を解決するとされる。
summary_en: A pathology review of testicular tumors highlighting new, unusual, or underemphasized features. Seminoma can show cribriform or microcystic patterns that mimic Sertoli cell tumor or yolk sac tumor, where immunohistochemistry may help. Spermatocytic seminoma, polyembryoma, burnt-out germ cell neoplasia, sex cord-stromal tumors, and secondary tumors are also discussed. Careful gross and microscopic evaluation resolves most diagnostic problems.

title: Antenatal 3-dimensional sonographic diagnosis of fetal oropharyngeal teratoma.
title_ja: 胎児口咽頭奇形腫の出生前三次元超音波診断
summary_ja: 19週の胎児に生じた大型の口咽頭奇形腫を三次元超音波で評価した症例報告です。表面および最大値投影レンダリングにより腫瘤を詳細に描出でき、妊娠管理への患者の能動的参加が可能になりました。性腺外の奇形腫の出生前診断という点で、胚細胞腫瘍の領域に関連します。
summary_en: This report describes a 19-week fetus with a large oropharyngeal teratoma evaluated by three-dimensional sonography. Surface and maximum mode rendering allowed detailed visualization of the mass, which enabled the parents to participate actively in pregnancy management. The case highlights the value of 3D ultrasound for congenital teratomas in planning and counseling. Because the lesion is an extragonadal teratoma, the report is relevant to germ cell tumors across sites, although the focus is on prenatal imaging rather than oncologic treatment.

title: Recent developments in germ cell tumors of the testes.
title_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍における最近の進展
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の最近の進展を概説したレビューです。地域によって死亡率が異なり、治療へのアクセスの限界が示唆されています。後腹膜リンパ節郭清や大量化学療法の役割、生存者の晩期毒性、予後不良例の課題が取り上げられています。
summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in testicular germ cell tumors. It highlights geographic differences in mortality that may reflect limited access to treatment, and discusses retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in early and advanced disease. High-dose chemotherapy in first-line and salvage settings is reviewed, along with large database analyses of delayed toxicities in survivors. The authors note that poor-risk tumors remain challenging and that follow-up strategies continue to be refined. Overall, the review emphasizes clinical management and survivorship in testicular germ cell tumor care.

title: Cystic struma ovarii (with macrocystic change).
title_ja: 大嚢胞性変化を伴う嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 大嚢胞性変化を伴う嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告です。粘液性または漿液性嚢胞腺腫と類似しうるため、甲状腺濾胞の有無の確認が重要とされています。診断困難な場合はサイログロブリンや甲状腺転写因子-1の免疫組織化学が有用です。卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍（奇形腫）の一亜型に関する報告です。
summary_en: This case report describes cystic struma ovarii with macrocystic change, a monodermal teratoma of the ovary. The authors note that such cysts can mimic mucinous or serous cystadenoma. Careful examination for thyroid microfollicles within fibrous septa or solid stroma is key to diagnosis. When needed, immunohistochemistry for thyroglobulin and thyroid transcription factor-1 helps confirm thyroid origin. The report is relevant to ovarian germ cell tumors because struma ovarii is a specialized teratoma. It highlights a diagnostic pitfall in ovarian cystic masses.

title: Management of advanced germ-cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の進行性胚細胞腫瘍の管理
summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療と管理をまとめたレビューです。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法後に、残存病変を外科的切除します。治療が妊孕性や腎・神経機能、二次性悪性腫瘍に与える影響にも触れ、症例数の多い施設での多職種管理が推奨されています。
summary_en: This review covers management of advanced testicular germ cell tumors. Standard treatment is chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, followed by surgical resection of residual disease. The number of cycles depends on prognostic factors such as primary site, histology, visceral metastases, and tumor markers. The authors discuss retroperitoneal dissection for nonseminoma and surgery for residual seminoma with bulky or FDG-avid disease. Treatment effects on fertility, metabolism, renal and neurological function, and secondary malignancies are addressed. They recommend multidisciplinary management at high-volume centers.

title: Contralateral intratubular germ cell neoplasia in a patient with testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者にみられた対側の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍
