title: A huge intrapericardial teratoma in an infant.
title_ja: 乳児の巨大心膜内奇形腫
summary_ja: 9か月の乳児に発生した巨大な多嚢胞性の心膜内腫瘤の症例報告である。心エコーとコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で心囊液貯留を伴う病変を評価し、外科的に切除した。病理組織学的検査により未熟奇形腫と診断された。乳児の心膜に生じた性腺外奇形腫のまれな症例であり、術前評価における画像検査の役割を示す報告である。
summary_en: A 9-month-old infant presented with a huge multicystic intrapericardial mass accompanied by pericardial effusion. Echocardiography and computed tomography delineated the lesion, which was resected surgically. Histopathological examination established the diagnosis of immature teratoma. The report highlights an unusual extragonadal teratoma arising in the pericardium of an infant and the role of imaging in its preoperative evaluation.

title: Epithelioid trophoblastic tumor of uterus presenting as an ovarian mass: a diagnostic and therapeutic dilemma.
title_ja: 卵巣腫瘤として発現した子宮の類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍：診断と治療の難しさ
summary_ja: 若年女性に発生した類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍(ETT)の症例報告である。子宮、子宮傍組織、右卵巣を侵す卵巣腫瘤として発見された。当初絨毛癌と誤診され、不適切な治療により進行した。病理組織学的検査と免疫組織化学により胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍や癌は除外された。10か月後に肺と脳に転移し、緩和的化学療法を受けている。ETTは手術が主体であり、絨毛癌との鑑別が重要である。
summary_en: A young woman with an epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) involving the uterus, parametrium and right ovary initially presented with an ovarian mass. The tumor was misdiagnosed as choriocarcinoma, leading to inappropriate treatment and progression. Histology and immunohistochemistry excluded placental site trophoblastic tumor and carcinoma. Ten months later she developed lung and brain metastases and is receiving palliative chemotherapy. The authors stress that ETT is primarily treated surgically and must be distinguished from choriocarcinoma.

title: Imprint cytology of high-grade immature ovarian teratoma: a case report, literature review, and distinction from other ovarian small round cell tumors.
title_ja: 高悪性度未熟卵巣奇形腫の捺印細胞診：症例報告、文献的考察、および他の卵巣小円形細胞腫瘍との鑑別
summary_ja: 35歳女性の骨盤内腫瘤に対し、捺印細胞診と術中迅速凍結切片で高悪性度未熟卵巣奇形腫と診断した症例報告。捺印細胞診の所見は組織像と完全に一致した。他の小円形細胞腫瘍との鑑別点を文献的に整理し、補助的検査を併用することで正確な診断が可能であることを示している。
summary_en: A case report of a 35-year-old woman with a pelvic mass, diagnosed intraoperatively as high-grade immature ovarian teratoma using imprint cytology and frozen section. The cytologic features fully matched histology. The authors review the literature and outline features that distinguish this tumor from other ovarian small round cell neoplasms, including neuroblastoma, small cell carcinoma of the hypercalcemic type, and primitive neuroectodermal tumor. They note that ancillary studies can aid accurate diagnosis.

title: Global DNA hypomethylation in intratubular germ cell neoplasia and seminoma, but not in nonseminomatous male germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣上皮内胚細胞腫瘍およびセミノーマにおける全体的DNA低メチル化。非セミノーマ性男性胚細胞腫瘍では認められない
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 免疫組織化学的に5-メチルシトシン(5mC)を検出し、著者らは未分類の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)およびそれに伴う浸潤性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の全体的メチル化を評価した。大多数のIGCNUおよびセミノーマでは、セミノーマ成分を含む混合型を含め、5mCの染色は欠如または著明に低下していたが、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では強く染色された。メチル化の消失はDNMT1の発現とは無関係であった。本知見は、大半の精巣胚細胞腫瘍が発生時の5mC消去を経たIGCNU細胞に由来し、その後のデノボメチル化は組織学的分化と関連していることを支持する。
summary_en: Using immunohistochemistry for 5-methylcytosine (5mC), the authors assessed global DNA methylation in intratubular germ cell neoplasia unclassified (IGCNU) and associated invasive testicular germ cell tumors. 5mC staining was absent or markedly reduced in most IGCNU and seminomas, including mixed tumors with seminomatous components, but robust in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Methylation loss was independent of DNMT1 expression. The findings support a model in which most testicular germ cell tumors arise from IGCNU cells that underwent developmental 5mC erasure, with subsequent de novo methylation tracking histologic differentiation.

title: Expression of glypican 3 in ovarian and extragonadal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 卵巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍におけるグリピカン3の発現
summary_ja: 卵巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を含む63例(精巣腫瘍を比較対象に含む)でグリピカン3(GPC3)の免疫反応性を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌は全例陽性で、未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫は一部のみ陽性、胎児性癌とジャーミノーマは陰性であった。GPC3は主に卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌で発現し、診断困難な胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別に有用となりうる。
summary_en: The authors examined glypican 3 (GPC3) immunoreactivity in germ cell tumors from 63 patients, including ovarian and extragonadal primary tumors and metastases, with testicular tumors for comparison. All yolk sac tumors and both choriocarcinomas were GPC3-positive, whereas only a minority of immature and mature teratomas stained, and embryonal carcinomas and germinomas were negative. GPC3 expression is thus differential across sites, predominantly marking yolk sac tumors and choriocarcinoma, which may aid diagnosis of challenging germ cell tumors.

title: The distinction of bronchogenic cyst from metastatic testicular teratoma: a light microscopic and immunohistochemical study.
title_ja: 気管支原性嚢胞と転移性精巣奇形腫の鑑別：光学顕微鏡および免疫組織化学的検討
summary_ja: 男性の後腹膜に生じた気管支原性嚢胞22例と、転移性奇形腫34例を比較した。嚢胞は気管支様構造と呼吸上皮を示し、未熟成分や異型、壊死を欠いた。奇形腫は腸型と呼吸上皮型が混在し、CDX-2とTTF-1の共発現が認められたが嚢胞では認めなかった。肉眼・組織・免疫組織化学的所見により両者は確実に鑑別できると結論づけた。
summary_en: The authors compared 22 bronchogenic cysts with 34 teratomas metastatic to the retroperitoneum in men to determine distinguishing features. Most cysts showed tracheobronchial architecture and respiratory-type epithelium, lacking immature elements, atypia, and necrosis. Teratomas showed mixed enteric and respiratory epithelium, often coexpressing CDX-2 and TTF-1, which was absent in cysts. All cysts were CK7-positive and CDX-2-negative. The study concludes that bronchogenic cysts can be reliably distinguished from metastatic teratomas using gross, histologic, and immunohistochemical features.

title: Apoptosis regulation and spontaneous apoptosis index of testicular germ cell tumors are associated with differentiation and resistance to systemic treatment.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のアポトーシス制御およびスポンタニアスアポトーシス指数は、分化度と全身治療抵抗性に関連する。
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍70例(難治20例、化学感受性50例)を対象に、p53・p21発現とアポトーシス指数を組織型別に解析した。難治群はp53発現が低くp21・アポトーシス指数が高値であった。分化度に依存したアポトーシス制御が化学感受性に関与する可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study compared p53 and p21 expression and the spontaneous apoptotic index in 20 chemorefractory and 50 chemosensitive testicular germ cell tumors. Embryonal carcinoma showed high p53 and apoptosis, whereas seminoma lacked p21, and choriocarcinoma and mature teratoma showed low apoptotic potential. Refractory tumors had lower p53, higher p21 and a higher apoptosis index. The authors conclude these markers may influence chemosensitivity, reflecting differentiation-dependent apoptotic regulation.

title: Testicular tumors in children and adolescents.
title_ja: 小児および思春期の精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のある小児および思春期の34名を対象としたレビューでは、68%が良性で、大半は奇形腫であった。32%は悪性で、卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌であった。思春期前の男児では良性腫瘍が多かった。10名に精巣温存手術が行われ、不完全切除後に良性奇形腫の再発が2名に生じた。また、6年後に対側精巣に異時性奇形腫が1名で検出された。完全切除と長期フォローアップが推奨されている。
summary_en: This review of 34 children and adolescents with testicular tumors found 68% benign, mostly teratoma, and 32% malignant, yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma. Prepubertal boys had more benign tumors. Testis-preserving surgery was done in 10 patients; two benign teratoma recurrences followed incomplete resection, and one metachronous contralateral teratoma appeared six years later. Complete excision and long-term follow-up are recommended.

title: Association of the polymorphism of the CAG repeat in the mitochondrial DNA polymerase gamma gene (POLG) with testicular germ-cell cancer.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍とPOLG遺伝子CAGリピート多型の関連。
summary_ja: POLG遺伝子のCAGリピート多型と精巣胚細胞腫瘍の関連を、患者243例と対照869例で検討した。非定型CAGリピートのホモ接合体は患者で有意に多かった(4.9%対1.3%)。ホモ接合の患者の大部分はセミノーマであり、POLG多型が特にセミノーマの発症に寄与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined whether the CAG repeat polymorphism in the POLG gene is associated with testicular germ-cell tumours (TGCT). Genotyping of 243 patients and 869 controls showed that homozygosity for non-common CAG repeat alleles was more frequent in patients (4.9% vs 1.3%). Most homozygous patients had seminoma. The authors suggest the POLG polymorphism may contribute to TGCT pathogenesis, particularly seminoma, though the mechanisms remain unclear.

title: Imaging findings of complications and unusual manifestations of ovarian teratomas.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の合併症および非典型的所見の画像所見
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の捻転、破裂、悪性転化、感染、自己免疫性溶血性貧血などの合併症と、その画像所見を解説した総説。未熟奇形腫や卵巣甲状腺腫、混合腫瘍・衝突腫瘍、脂肪成分に乏しい成熟嚢胞性奇形腫などの非典型的所見も取り上げ、誤診を防ぐための画像診断の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This imaging review describes complications of ovarian teratomas, including torsion, rupture, malignant transformation, infection, and autoimmune hemolytic anemia, and explains how each requires different management. It highlights unusual presentations that can lead to misdiagnosis, such as immature teratomas, struma ovarii, combination and collision tumors, and mature cystic teratomas lacking demonstrable fat. Recognizing these imaging features is emphasized for accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment planning.

title: Imaging of gynecological disease (4): clinical and ultrasound characteristics of struma ovarii.
title_ja: 婦人科疾患の画像診断(4)：卵巣甲状腺腫の臨床および超音波所見
summary_ja: 病理学的に卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された31例の臨床像と超音波所見を解析した研究。純粋型と類皮嚢腫内の不純型を比較し、「甲状腺パール」と呼ばれる滑らかな円形充実性領域が純粋型で最も特異的な所見であった。診断の手がかりとなる可能性があるが、前向き研究による検証が必要とされている。
summary_en: This study describes the clinical and ultrasound features of 31 women with histologically confirmed struma ovarii, a monodermal ovarian teratoma. Pure struma ovarii and impure forms within dermoid cysts were compared using IOTA terminology and pattern recognition. The struma pearl, a smooth roundish solid area, was the most specific sonographic feature of pure struma ovarii and may help suggest the diagnosis, though prospective confirmation is needed.

title: Congenital pulmonary malformations associated with esophageal duplication and teratoma: prenatal to postnatal management.
title_ja: 食道重複症と奇形腫を伴う先天性肺奇形：出生前から出生後の管理
summary_ja: 食道重複症を伴う気管支肺前腸奇形と良性奇形腫を合併した新生児の症例報告。出生前のドプラ超音波検査所見と出生後の管理を提示し、適切な画像検査と外科的介入の必要性を論じている。この希少な合併の発生機序についての仮説も示されている。
summary_en: A case report describes a neonate with a bronchopulmonary foregut malformation with esophageal duplication and an associated benign teratoma. Antenatal Doppler ultrasound findings and postnatal management are presented, along with recommendations on appropriate radiologic investigation and the need for surgical intervention. The authors also propose a hypothesis for the embryogenesis of this rare combination.

title: Comparative proteome, transcriptome, and genome analysis of a gonadal and an extragonadal germ cell tumor cell line.
title_ja: 精巣由来および性腺外由来の胚細胞腫瘍細胞株のプロテオーム、トランスクリプトーム、ゲノム解析の比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎児性癌の組織像を示す精巣由来と性腺外由来の胚細胞腫瘍細胞株を、プロテオーム、RT-PCR、array-CGHで比較した研究。両株のタンパク質プロファイルは類似し、66のタンパク質に発現差が認められた。性腺外由来株ではシスプラチン耐性に関わる可能性のあるタンパク質が見つかり、耐性が多因子性であることが示唆された。
summary_en: This study compares a testicular and an extragonadal germ cell tumor cell line, both with embryonal carcinoma histology, using proteomics, RT-PCR, and array-CGH. The two lines had similar protein profiles, with 66 proteins differentially expressed, and mRNA changes often matched protein changes, while genomic copy number correlated poorly. Proteins potentially linked to cisplatin resistance were identified in the extragonadal line, suggesting multifactorial resistance.

title: Struma Ovarii with a focus of follicular variant of papillary thyroid cancer: a case report.
title_ja: 濾胞変異型乳頭癌の病巣を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 36歳未経妊女性の卵巣甲状腺腫に濾胞変異型乳頭癌の病巣を認めた症例報告である。腹腔鏡下嚢胞摘出後、病期分類のため開腹術と両側付属器摘出などを施行した。フォローアップでは腫瘍マーカー、甲状腺検査、全身スキャンが正常であった。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の治療と監視の指針は未確立である。
summary_en: A 36-year-old nulligravid woman was found to have struma ovarii with a focus of follicular variant papillary thyroid cancer after laparoscopic cystectomy. She then underwent staging laparotomy, hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and infracolic omentectomy. Tumor markers, thyroid studies, thyroid scan, and whole-body scans were normal during follow-up. The authors note that carcinomatous change in struma ovarii is extremely rare, and that no guidelines exist for staging and treatment of malignant struma ovarii; optimal surveillance remains undefined.

title: A male phenotype (XY) hermaphrodite treated for seminoma, fathered a healthy child by IVF-ICSI technique.
title_ja: セミノーマを治療した男性表現型（XY）の真性半陰陽者が、IVF-ICSI法で健康な児の父となった（症例報告）
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマを治療し治癒した46,XY真性半陰陽の男性が、凍結精巣精子を用いたIVF-ICSIにより健康な児を得た症例報告である。セミノーマを有する同種の不妊症例での成功例として初の報告とされる。がん治療後の凍結精巣精子の生殖可能性を示す事例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old man with 46,XY true hermaphroditism who was treated and cured of seminoma. He and his 35-year-old wife then underwent IVF with ICSI using frozen testicular sperm, and a healthy infant was delivered. The authors describe it as the first reported successful delivery of a healthy child fathered by an infertile 46,XY true hermaphrodite with seminoma. Laboratory, pathology, and ultrasound data were reported. The case highlights the reproductive potential of cryopreserved testicular sperm after cancer treatment.

title: The human Y-encoded testis-specific protein interacts functionally with eukaryotic translation elongation factor eEF1A, a putative oncoprotein.
title_ja: ヒトY染色体由来の精巣特異的タンパク質TSPYは翻訳伸長因子eEF1Aと機能的に相互作用する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: Y染色体上の性腺芽腫座の候補遺伝子TSPYが、翻訳伸長因子eEF1Aと相互作用することを示した研究である。セミノーマ標本の腫瘍胚細胞で両者が共局在し高発現していた。TSPYはタンパク質合成と遺伝子転写を増強し、発癌機能を果たす可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study identifies translation elongation factor eEF1A as a binding partner of TSPY, the putative gonadoblastoma locus gene on the Y chromosome. TSPY and eEF1A co-localized and were highly expressed in tumor germ cells of seminoma specimens. In transfected COS7 cells, they co-immunoprecipitated and colocalized in the cytoplasm. TSPY enhanced protein synthesis of a reporter gene, an effect augmented by eEF1A, and promoted nuclear redistribution of eEF1A. The authors propose that TSPY may exert oncogenic function by interacting with eEF1A.

title: Prepubertal testicular germ cell tumors: 25-year experience in Taipei Veterans General Hospital.
title_ja: 思春期前の精巣胚細胞腫瘍：台北榮民總醫院における25年間の経験
summary_ja: 台北榮民總醫院で25年間に治療された12歳未満の思春期前男児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍34例の後方視的研究である。卵黄嚢腫瘍が85.3%を占め、病期I卵黄嚢腫瘍の19.2%が転移へ進行し化学療法を要した。5年生存率は卵黄嚢腫瘍96.5%、奇形腫100%であった。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 34 prepubertal boys under 12 years with primary testicular germ cell tumors treated at a single center over 25 years, with mean follow-up of 139 months. All presented with painless scrotal masses and underwent radical orchiectomy. Yolk sac tumors predominated (85.3%), while mature teratomas accounted for the rest. Among stage I yolk sac tumors, 19.2% progressed to metastasis and required chemotherapy. Five-year survival was 96.5% for yolk sac tumor and 100% for teratoma, supporting excellent long-term outcomes with appropriate treatment.

title: Outcome and reproductive function after cumulative high-dose combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin (BEP) for patients with ovarian endodermal sinus tumor.
title_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対する累積高用量BEP化学療法の転帰と生殖機能
summary_ja: 1995年から2006年に単施設で治療された卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍20例を後方視的に検討した研究である。補助化学療法として高用量BEPを施行し、全生存率は90%、骨盤内再発は2例（10%）であった。妊孕性温存手術を受けた15例は月経が回復し、2例が生児を得た。卵巣機能を損なわず良好な生存が得られた。
summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated 20 patients with ovarian endodermal sinus tumor treated with adjuvant cumulative high-dose BEP chemotherapy at a single institution between 1995 and 2006. The median age was 18 years, and median follow-up was 70 months. Overall survival was 90%, and two patients (10%) had pelvic recurrence. Fifteen patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery; all regained regular menstruation after chemotherapy, and two had live births without complications. The authors conclude that BEP achieves excellent survival without impairing ovarian function.

title: Management and outcome of bilateral testicular germ cell tumors: a 25-year single center experience.
title_ja: 双側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理と転帰：25年間の単施設経験
summary_ja: 612例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍のうち3%にあたる17例が両側病変を有したことを、25年間の単施設で後方視的に解析した研究である。異時性が11例、同時性が6例で、両側腫瘍の74%がセミノーマであった。対側発生リスクは一般集団の26倍で、残存精巣の長期監視が推奨される。
summary_en: This 25-year single-center retrospective analysis reviewed 17 of 612 testicular germ cell tumor patients (3%) with bilateral disease. Eleven cases were metachronous and six synchronous. Synchronous cases presented at higher stages (stage I: 33% vs 82%). Most bilateral tumors were seminomas, and histology often matched on both sides. Contralateral risk was 26-fold higher than in the general population. With median follow-up of 95 to 121 months, all patients were alive without evidence of disease. Long-term monitoring of the remaining testicle is recommended.

title: Survival of a profoundly hydropic fetus with a sacrococcygeal teratoma delivered at 27 weeks of gestation for maternal mirror syndrome.
title_ja: 母体ミラー症候群のため妊娠27週で娩出された、高度水腫を伴う仙尾部奇形腫胎児の生存例
summary_ja: 母体ミラー症候群のため妊娠27週で娩出された、高度水腫を伴う仙尾部奇形腫の胎児症例。出生後に切除術が施行され、児は生存した。妊娠26～30週で娩出された水腫性SCT児の転帰に関する報告は少なく、本症例は家族へのカウンセリングに有用とされる。
summary_en: This report describes a fetus with profound hydrops and a sacrococcygeal teratoma, delivered at 27 weeks because of maternal mirror syndrome. Postnatal surgical resection was performed, and the infant survived. Outcome data for hydropic SCT fetuses delivered between 26 and 30 weeks are sparse, and the authors argue that this case can inform counseling for similar families. The report adds to the limited literature on early delivery and postpartum resection.

title: An unusual variant of malignant struma ovarii.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の非典型的変異型
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫由来の濾胞型乳頭癌を呈した症例報告。卵巣甲状腺腫は成熟卵巣奇形腫の特殊型で、悪性化は全卵巣奇形腫の0.1～0.3%と稀である。CA-125の上昇と偽Meigs症候群を伴った。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の非典型的な変異型を示す報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a malignant tumor, a follicular variant of papillary carcinoma, arising from struma ovarii. Struma ovarii is a specialized form of mature ovarian teratoma in which thyroid tissue makes up at least half of the tumor. Malignant struma ovarii is rare, accounting for 0.1-0.3% of ovarian teratomas. The patient had elevated CA-125 and pseudo-Meigs syndrome. The report highlights an unusual malignant variant with thyroid-type carcinoma.

title: Is teratoma formation in stem cell research a characterization tool or a window to developmental biology?
title_ja: 幹細胞研究における奇形腫形成は特性評価ツールか、それとも発生生物学への窓か
summary_ja: 本総説は、免疫不全マウスに移植した多能性幹細胞が形成する奇形腫を分析し、3胚葉すべての組織を含むことを述べる。奇形腫は多能性の機能的評価に加え、胚発生や組織構築、ヒト発生と毒性研究のモデルとして論じられる。腫瘍学への応用可能性にも触れている。
summary_en: This review analyzes teratoma formation by pluripotent stem cells transplanted into immunodeficient mice, which generates tissues from all three germ layers. Beyond serving as a functional assay of pluripotency, teratomas are discussed as a window into embryonic tissue organization and as a model for human development and toxicity. The authors note potential relevance to oncology and bioengineering. Teratoma formation from different stem cell sources is compared to refine how teratoma characterization is interpreted.

title: Papillary carcinoma in struma ovarii: an unusual presentation.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫における乳頭癌：非典型的な提示
summary_ja: 閉経後51歳女性で、甲状腺組織を主体とする卵巣奇形腫に生じた乳頭癌の症例を報告する。当初は甲状腺機能亢進症として提示されたが血清検査で確認されず、後に閉経後性器出血と腹部腫瘤が認められた。病理学的検査で卵巣甲状腺腫の乳頭癌と診断された。
summary_en: The authors report a postmenopausal 51-year-old woman with papillary carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, a rare malignant transformation of an ovarian teratoma composed mainly of thyroid tissue. She initially presented with hyperthyroidism, but serology did not confirm it. Later she had postmenopausal vaginal bleeding, and radiography revealed an abdominal mass. Pathology established the diagnosis. The case highlights an unusual presentation relevant to internists.

title: Primary gastric choriocarcinoma in a dog.
title_ja: イヌの原発性胃絨毛癌
summary_ja: イヌの胃腫瘍について、ヒトでのみ報告されてきた原発性胃絨毛癌に一致する病理組織学的および免疫組織化学的特徴を記述した。腫瘍は幽門および前部十二指腸の粘膜下層と固有筋層に浸潤し、胃リンパ節に転移していた。β-カテニンおよびE-カドヘリンの異常発現とc-mycおよびRasの増加を認め、Wnt/β-カテニン経路とRas経路の同時活性化が示唆された。
summary_en: The authors describe a canine gastric tumour with histopathological and immunohistochemical features of primary gastric choriocarcinoma, a condition previously reported only in humans. The tumour infiltrated the pyloric and duodenal wall and metastasized to a gastric lymph node. Neoplastic cells showed aberrant beta-catenin and E-cadherin expression, with increased c-myc and Ras. The authors suggest synchronous activation of Wnt/beta-catenin and Ras signalling in carcinogenesis.

title: [Case report of malignant sertoli cell tumor].
title_ja: 悪性セルトリ細胞腫瘍の症例報告
summary_ja: 38歳男性が左精巣腫瘍（セミノーマ疑い、腫瘍マーカー陰性、臨床病期I）に対し左精巣摘除術を受けた。1年後に後腹膜リンパ節が腫大し、BEP化学療法や救援化学療法（CPT-11、ネダプラチン）でも縮小せず、生検で胎児性癌と判明した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清により悪性セルトリ細胞腫瘍と診断され、精巣摘除術後27か月で肝転移により死亡した。
summary_en: A 38-year-old man underwent left orchiectomy for a testicular tumor initially diagnosed as seminoma, with negative LDH, hCG and AFP and clinical stage I disease. A retroperitoneal lymph node mass developed a year later, and three courses of BEP chemotherapy failed to shrink it. Biopsy showed viable embryonal carcinoma, and salvage chemotherapy with CPT-11 and nedaplatin also failed. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy revealed malignant Sertoli cell tumor. He died 27 months after orchiectomy with liver metastases.

title: [A case of teratoma with malignant transformation in the anterior mediastinum].
title_ja: 前縦隔奇形腫の悪性転化の1例
summary_ja: 32歳女性が3か月続く前胸部痛で受診。前縦隔に30mmの腫瘤があり、CTで脂肪成分と石灰化を伴う嚢胞性病変を認めた。心膜・大血管浸潤のため開胸下に不完全切除。病理で腺癌成分を認め、縦隔奇形腫の悪性転化と診断された。
summary_en: A 32-year-old woman presented with three months of anterior chest pain. Chest radiography showed a 30-mm anterior mediastinal mass, and contrast CT revealed a cystic lesion with fat and calcifications invading the pericardium and great vessels. Thoracotomy found hair within the cyst and hard tissue; the mass was incompletely resected because of extensive vascular invasion. Pathology showed adenocarcinoma, leading to a diagnosis of mediastinal teratoma with malignant transformation.

title: Prospective evaluation of a novel one-stop testicular clinic.
title_ja: 新規のワンストップ精巣外来の前向き評価
summary_ja: 1017人を対象に、精巣・陰嚢疾患への一次対応ワンストップ外来を2年間前向きに評価した。大半は良性疾患であった。超音波で精巣腫瘍が疑われた11例が精巣摘除術を受け、予想外のセミノーマ1例が見つかった。陰嚢超音波検査の待機期間は22週間から2週間に短縮した。
summary_en: This prospective two-year study evaluated a one-stop joint sonographer and urology nurse clinic for men referred with testicular or scrotal conditions. Of 1017 patients, most had benign pathology. Eleven patients with suspected testicular tumour on ultrasound underwent orchidectomy, and one unsuspected seminoma was found. Waiting time for scrotal ultrasound fell from 22 to 2 weeks, and related imaging waits also decreased. The clinic enabled rapid assessment of suspected malignancy while reducing patient anxiety.

title: Cardiac teratoma of the interventricular septum with congenital aortic stenosis in a newborn.
title_ja: 先天性大動脈狭窄を合併した新生児の心室中隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 生後10日の新生児が頻呼吸、雑音、心拡大で受診した。心エコーで心室中隔を侵し左室内へ突出する多嚢胞性腫瘤を認め、左室流出路閉塞は伴わなかった。切除標本の病理で心臓奇形腫と確定した。先天性大動脈狭窄を合併した、極めてまれな心筋内奇形腫である。
summary_en: A 10-day-old infant presented with tachypnea, harsh murmur, and cardiomegaly. Echocardiography showed a multicystic mass infiltrating the interventricular septum and protruding into the left ventricle without left ventricular outflow obstruction. The mass was surgically resected, and biopsy confirmed a cardiac teratoma. The authors describe this as an unusually rare intramyocardial teratoma coexisting with congenital aortic stenosis.

title: Results of bilateral nerve sparing laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対する両側神経温存腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の成績
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の42例に対し、両側神経温存腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した成績を報告している。開腹移行例はなく、平均手術時間は323分、術中合併症は認めなかった。化学療法後病期IIBの19例中4例で奇形腫を認め、後腹膜再発は見られなかった。順行性射精は85.7%で温存された。
summary_en: The authors report the feasibility and early oncological outcomes of bilateral nerve-sparing laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 42 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, including stage I and post-chemotherapy stage IIB disease. No conversions occurred, mean operative time was 323 minutes, and no intraoperative complications arose. Teratoma was found in 21% of post-chemotherapy specimens. No retroperitoneal recurrence was observed, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 85.7%.

title: Acute abdomen due to twisted ovarian immature teratoma in a 7-year-old girl: magnetic resonance findings with histopathologic correlation.
title_ja: 7歳女児にみられた捻転性卵巣未熟奇形腫による急性腹症: MRI所見と病理所見の対比
summary_ja: 7歳女児が下腹部の急性腹痛で救急受診し、卵巣未熟奇形腫(grade 1)の茎捻転と診断された。救急での超音波検査の後に施行した術前MRIの所見が、治療方針の決定に役立った。MRI所見と病理所見を対比し、まれな疾患の診断にMRIが有用であることを示している。
summary_en: A 7-year-old girl presented with acute low abdominal pain caused by torsion of an ovarian immature grade 1 teratoma. Ultrasound in the emergency department was followed by preoperative MRI, whose findings helped guide the curative approach. The authors review the MRI characteristics of this neoplasm and correlate them with histopathologic findings. They conclude that MRI can contribute to the diagnostic approach for this rare entity, even in young children in the emergency setting.

title: Influence of year of diagnosis, patient age, and sociodemographic status on recommending adjuvant radiation treatment for stage I testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対する補助放射線療法の推奨に及ぼす診断年、患者年齢、社会人口統計学的因子の影響
summary_ja: SEERデータを用いた1990〜2004年の病期I精巣セミノーマ患者3,125例の解析である。補助放射線療法の推奨は年次が新しいほど減少し、教育水準の低い地域や最年少の患者で推奨が少なかった。治療決定における社会人口統計学的格差が示された。代替的な術後管理法が開発されている状況も踏まえ、その推奨の変化を評価した研究である。
summary_en: This SEER-based study of 3,125 men with stage I testicular seminoma diagnosed from 1990 to 2004 found that recommendations for adjuvant radiation therapy declined over time. Men diagnosed in later periods had lower odds of receiving it. Men in counties with lower education levels and the youngest men were also less likely to be recommended adjuvant radiation therapy. The findings highlight sociodemographic disparities in treatment decisions as alternative postorchiectomy strategies gained acceptance.

title: Reg I protein in healthy and seminoma human testis.
title_ja: 正常ヒト精巣およびセミノーマ精巣におけるReg Iタンパク質
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常な齧歯類およびヒト精巣、ならびにヒトセミノーマ組織におけるReg Iの発現を検討した。精細管内のセルトリ細胞と胚細胞にReg Iが認められ、セルトリ細胞株では細胞膜に局在した。ヒトセミノーマ組織およびヒト腫瘍胚細胞株で強発現しており、正常および腫瘍性の胚細胞増殖への関与が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined Reg I protein expression in normal rodent and human testes and in human seminoma testis tissue. Western blot and immunofluorescence showed Reg I in Sertoli and germ cells within the seminiferous tubules. In a Sertoli cell line, Reg I localized to the plasma membrane. Reg I was strongly expressed in human seminoma tissue and in a human tumor germ cell line, suggesting a potential role in normal and neoplastic germ cell proliferation.

title: Cutaneous metastatic adenocarcinoma arising from a malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma in an adult.
title_ja: 成人の悪性仙尾部奇形腫から生じた皮膚転移性腺癌
summary_ja: 出生時から存在する排液性の殿部腫瘤で37歳女性が受診し、先天性仙尾部奇形腫と判明した。外陰部皮膚生検では、奇形腫から生じた粘液性腺癌が確認され、皮膚転移と判断された。奇形腫が悪性転化することはまれであり、成人でこのような経過をたどる症例は珍しいと著者らは述べている。
summary_en: A 37-year-old woman presented with a draining gluteal mass present since birth, which was found to be a congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma. Vulvar skin biopsy revealed a mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from the teratoma, consistent with cutaneous metastasis. The authors note that teratomas rarely undergo malignant transformation, making this an unusual presentation in an adult patient.

title: Bilateral struma ovarii: a case mimicking an ovarian neoplasm.
title_ja: 両側性卵巣甲状腺腫：卵巣腫瘍に類似した症例
summary_ja: 両側付属器腫瘤の精査目的で入院した患者に、術後の病理検査で両側卵巣甲状腺腫が判明した症例である。臨床的な悪性所見や転移は認められなかった。卵巣腫瘍との鑑別が難しい点や、両側発生のまれさについて文献をもとに考察している。診断・治療面の知見も整理されている。
summary_en: A case of bilateral struma ovarii, detected postoperatively after hospitalization for bilateral adnexal masses, was confirmed histopathologically. No clinical malignancy or metastasis was found. The authors reviewed the literature and discussed diagnostic, histopathologic, and therapeutic aspects of the disease. Because it can mimic an ovarian neoplasm, and bilateral involvement is especially rare, the authors stress awareness of this entity.

title: Nondysgerminomatous ovarian tumors: clinical characteristics, treatment, and outcome. A case-controlled study.
title_ja: 非ジャーミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的特徴、治療および転帰：症例対照研究
summary_ja: 非ジャーミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者21例を後方視的に検討した。白金製剤を含む化学療法後の再発は31%であった。初回手術時の病期、残存腫瘍、化学療法開始までの期間が再発の予測因子となる可能性が示された。5年生存率は39%で、進行例では積極的な減量手術や二次治療の必要性が示唆されている。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 21 patients with nondysgerminomatous ovarian germ cell tumors who underwent surgical resection and adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy. Relapse occurred in 31 percent. Stage at initial surgery, residual disease, and time to chemotherapy were identified as possible prognostic factors. The 5-year survival rate was 39 percent. The authors suggest that aggressive cytoreductive surgery and second-line combination chemotherapy may be needed in advanced disease.

title: Mature orbital teratoma presenting as a recurrent orbital cellulitis with an ectopic tooth and sphenoid malformation-a case report.
title_ja: 反復性眼窩蜂窩織炎として発症した成熟眼窩奇形腫：異所性歯牙と蝶形骨奇形を伴う症例報告
summary_ja: 2歳児が反復性眼窩蜂窩織炎で受診し、眼窩外円錐内の腫瘤が確認された。画像検査で骨欠損と蝶形骨の奇形がみられ、異所性歯牙も存在した。成熟眼窩奇形腫と診断された。眼窩感染症の小児では、眼窩内腫瘤の除外のため画像検査を行うことが重要と強調されている。
summary_en: A 2-year-old child presented with recurrent orbital cellulitis and was found to have an extraconal orbital mass. Imaging showed a bony defect and sphenoid malformation, and an ectopic tooth was present. The lesion was diagnosed as a mature orbital teratoma. The authors note that sphenoid malformation has not been previously reported with intraorbital teratoma, and they emphasize imaging children with orbital infections to exclude an intraorbital mass.

title: Pattern recognition using transabdominal ultrasound to diagnose ovarian mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 超音波パターン認識を用いた卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の診断
summary_ja: 経腹超音波検査とカラー拡張血流マッピングを用いた超音波パターン認識により、付属器腫瘤306例で卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を診断できるかを検討した（36例が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）。病理結果を基準とした感度は94.4%、特異度は98.2%であり、術前の良性奇形腫の診断に有用であることが示された。
summary_en: This study evaluated transabdominal ultrasound with color extended-flow mapping, using sonographic pattern recognition, to diagnose ovarian mature cystic teratoma in 306 patients with adnexal masses undergoing elective surgery. Histopathology served as the reference standard. Thirty-six masses were confirmed as mature cystic teratomas. Pattern recognition achieved a sensitivity of 94.4% and a specificity of 98.2%, supporting its accuracy for preoperative diagnosis of benign teratoma.

title: Blood test for placental site trophoblastic tumor and nontrophoblastic malignancy for evaluating patients with low positive human chorionic gonadotropin results.
title_ja: 低値のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)症例における胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と非トロホブラスト性悪性腫瘍の血液検査
summary_ja: 持続する低値のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を示す症例で、hCG全体に占める遊離βサブユニットの割合を測定し、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)と非トロホブラスト性腫瘍の診断に有用かを検討した。128例中18例で割合が30%を超え、うち13例がPSTT、5例が非トロホブラスト性腫瘍と確定した。30%超は有用な検査と結論された。
summary_en: This study assessed the proportion of free beta-subunit of hCG as a diagnostic marker for placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) and nontrophoblastic neoplasms in patients with persistent low hCG. Among 128 tested cases, 18 had a free beta-subunit proportion above 30% of total hCG; 13 of these were histologically proven PSTT and 5 had nontrophoblastic neoplasm. The authors conclude that a proportion above 30% is a highly useful test for identifying these malignancies in women with persistent low hCG outside pregnancy.

title: Vaginal metastases in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の腟転移
summary_ja: 1962年から2006年に地域センターで治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍804例のうち、36例(4.5%)に腟転移を認めた。多くは前壁の単発病変で、絨毛癌型が多かった。36%が出血のため輸血を要し、81%が治癒した。腟転移自体が予後不良や多剤併用化学療法を必然的に必要とするわけではないと結論された。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 804 patients treated for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia at a regional center from 1962 to 2006 identified 36 (4.5%) with vaginal metastases. Most were single anterior lesions with choriocarcinoma histology, and 36% required transfusion for bleeding. Single-agent methotrexate or actinomycin-D was given to 64%, and 81% were cured. The authors conclude that vaginal metastasis does not inherently worsen prognosis or require multiagent chemotherapy, though bleeding control may be needed.

title: The changing role of thoracotomy in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia at the New England Trophoblastic Disease Center.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における開胸術の役割の変遷
summary_ja: ニューイングランド絨毛性疾患センターで開胸術を受けた19例を後方視的に検討した。治療目的の11例中10例で寛解が得られ、1980年以降は診断目的から治療目的へと適応が変化した。生存者は病期が低く、単発病変で、術前ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が低い傾向にあった。最適な症例は、病期III期、術前hCG 1,500 mIU/mL未満、化学療法抵抗性の単発肺結節と考えられた。
summary_en: This review of 19 thoracotomy patients at the New England Trophoblastic Disease Center examined changing indications for thoracotomy in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Thoracotomy was therapeutic in 11 patients, of whom 10 achieved remission, and diagnostic in 8. Indications shifted from diagnosis before 1980 to therapy after 1980. Survivors had lower stage disease, solitary lesions, and lower preoperative hCG. Optimal candidates had stage III disease, preoperative hCG below 1,500 mIU/mL, and a solitary chemotherapy-resistant nodule.

title: Role of hysterectomy in managing persistent gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患における子宮摘出術の役割
summary_ja: 1986年から2007年にシェフィールドで登録された8,860例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患のうち、62例が子宮摘出術を受けた。適応は化学療法抵抗性と大量出血が主であった。病理は絨毛癌が最も多く、侵入奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が続いた。子宮摘出術後に化学療法を要した31例の93.5%が寛解に至った。子宮摘出術は高リスク症例に対する一次治療・補助療法として有用と結論された。
summary_en: This Sheffield series reviewed 8,860 patients registered for gestational trophoblastic disease from 1986 to 2007, of whom 62 underwent hysterectomy, an incidence of about 1 in 140 among treated patients. Indications were chemotherapy resistance and major hemorrhage. Pathology included choriocarcinoma, invasive mole, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Of 31 patients needing chemotherapy after hysterectomy, 93.5% achieved remission. The authors conclude hysterectomy is valuable as both primary and adjuvant treatment for high-risk patients.

title: Liver teratoma.
title_ja: 肝奇形腫
summary_ja: 27歳の女性で、CTで偶然発見された肝の複合性腫瘤を呈した症例である。画像では肉眼的脂肪、中心部の軟部組織成分、石灰化が認められた。手術により良性肝奇形腫と確定した。真の肝奇形腫は極めてまれで、放射線学文献では25例のみ報告されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with a liver complex mass found incidentally on CT. Imaging showed macroscopic fat, a central soft tissue component, and calcification, suggesting teratoma. Surgery confirmed a benign liver teratoma. The authors note that true liver teratomas are exceptional, with only 25 cases reported in the radiology literature, and that most prior cases were intraperitoneal or retroperitoneal teratomas invading the liver.

title: Laparoscopic resection of presacral teratomas.
title_ja: 仙骨前部奇形腫の腹腔鏡下切除術
summary_ja: 慢性的な骨盤痛を訴えた15歳の女児で、CTにて径10×8.5×8cmの被包性の仙骨前部・直腸後方腫瘍が確認された。奇形腫と診断し、腹腔鏡下に完全切除された。術中合併症はなく、術後に膀胱・直腸の感覚・運動障害も認められなかった。腹腔鏡手術は仙骨前部奇形腫の切除法として有用と結論づけている。
summary_en: A 15-year-old girl with chronic progressive pelvic pain was found to have a 10 x 8.5 x 8 cm encapsulated presacral and retrorectal tumor on CT. The lesion was diagnosed as a retrorectal teratoma and completely removed by laparoscopy, with no intraoperative complications and no postoperative bladder or rectal sensory or motor dysfunction. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is a feasible approach for presacral teratomas, which were traditionally removed through open abdominal or sacral approaches.

title: The impact of histopathologic diagnosis on the proper management of testis neoplasms.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の病理組織学的診断が適切な管理に与える影響
summary_ja: 45歳男性が右精巣摘除術を受け、病期Iのセミノーマと診断された。予定されていた予防的放射線療法は実施されず、その後、後腹膜腫瘤を伴う病変に対してシスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる化学療法が行われ完全寛解に至った。3年後、精巣原発びまん性大細胞型B細胞リンパ腫の中枢神経系再発と診断された。正確な病理組織学的診断の重要性を示す症例である。
summary_en: A 45-year-old man underwent right orchiectomy for a testicular mass diagnosed as stage I seminoma. He did not receive the planned prophylactic radiotherapy, and after a bulky retroperitoneal mass appeared he was treated with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy and achieved complete remission. Three years later, during follow-up, he developed neurological deficits and was diagnosed with testicular diffuse large B-cell lymphoma relapsing in the central nervous system, treated with high-dose methotrexate with or without cytarabine. The case highlights the importance of accurate histopathologic diagnosis in testicular neoplasm management.

title: Complete response after imatinib mesylate administration in a patient with chemoresistant stage IV seminoma.
title_ja: KIT過剰発現を伴う化学療法抵抗性病期IVセミノーマに対するイマチニブ投与による完全寛解
summary_ja: KIT過剰発現を伴う病期IVの化学療法抵抗性純粋セミノーマの若年男性に、イマチニブとパクリタキセル・オキサリプラチン・ゲムシタビンによる第3選択の化学療法を併用した。β-hCGが正常化した後、後腹膜と肝の残存病変を外科的切除したところ、壊死組織のみであった。化学療法終了から36か月後も無病生存を維持している。
summary_en: A young man with stage IV chemoresistant pure seminoma overexpressing KIT achieved complete remission after imatinib was added to third-line chemotherapy of paclitaxel, oxaliplatin and gemcitabine with G-CSF support. He had previously received ifosfamide, bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin, and methotrexate, vinblastine, actinomycin D and cyclophosphamide with cisplatin, without normalization of beta-hCG. After beta-hCG normalized, residual retroperitoneal and hepatic disease, found to be necrotic, was surgically resected. The patient remained disease-free 36 months after chemotherapy completion.

title: Activated Stat3 expression in gestational trophoblastic disease: correlation with clinicopathological parameters and apoptotic indices.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるリン酸化Stat3の発現：臨床病理学的因子およびアポトーシス指数との関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性疾患を含む88検体で、リン酸化Stat3（Ser727）の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍で核内発現が高く、自然退縮した奇胎では妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍へ進展した症例より高値であった。アポトーシス指数およびBcl-2と相関を示し、胞状奇胎における妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の予測マーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: The authors examined phosphorylated Stat3 (Ser727) expression by immunohistochemistry in 88 trophoblastic tissues, including normal placentas and gestational trophoblastic disease. Nuclear p-Stat3 was higher in hydatidiform mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor than in normal placentas. Spontaneously regressed moles showed higher levels than those progressing to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, and expression correlated with apoptotic indices and Bcl-2. The authors suggest p-Stat3 regulates apoptosis and may predict gestational trophoblastic neoplasia in hydatidiform mole.

title: Lack of genetic association between exaggerated placental site reaction and placental site trophoblastic tumor.
title_ja: 滲出性胎盤部反応と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の遺伝学的関連の欠如
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: EPSと胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の生物学的関連を検討するため、EPS20例のDNAジェノタイピングを行った。全例で父由来のアレルが確認され、トロホブラスト由来と確認された。XY 55%、XX 45%で、男性・女性いずれの妊娠からも発生しうることから、EPSとPSTTの腫瘍学的関連は支持されないと結論づけられた。
summary_en: The study performed DNA genotyping on 20 exaggerated placental site (EPS) reaction cases to test whether they carry the sex chromosomal genetic profile required for placental site trophoblastic tumor. All cases showed paternal alleles confirming trophoblastic origin, with 55% XY and 45% XX genomes. Because EPS arises from both male and female gestations, the authors conclude there is no evidence of a neoplastic association between EPS and PSTT. The work addresses the biological relationship between two morphologically similar placental-site lesions.

title: Malignant Müllerian mixed tumor of the ovary associated with yolk sac tumor, neuroepithelial and trophoblastic differentiation (teratoid carcinosarcoma).
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍、神経上皮性および絨毛性分化を伴う卵巣悪性ミュラー混合腫瘍（奇形腫様癌肉腫）
summary_ja: 69歳女性のステージIVの卵巣カルチノサルコーマ症例。悪性ミュラー上皮・間葉成分に加え、神経外胚葉性、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛性の分化を伴う。三胚葉由来成分を含むため胚細胞由来奇形腫との鑑別が問題となったが、類内膜腺癌と共存しそこから生じた可能性が高いため奇形腫とは異なると結論づけられた。
summary_en: This report describes a 69-year-old woman with stage IV ovarian carcinosarcoma containing malignant Müllerian epithelial and mesenchymal components, along with neuroectodermal, yolk sac tumor, and trophoblastic differentiation. Because the tumor contained elements from all three germ layers, it had to be distinguished from a germ cell-derived teratoma. The authors concluded it differed from a teratoma because it coexisted with, and likely arose from, an endometrioid adenocarcinoma. All components were malignant, without a maturation gradient. The case highlights the diagnostic challenge of teratoid carcinosarcomas.

title: Typical thyroid-type carcinoma arising in struma ovarii: a report of 4 cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に発生した典型的甲状腺型癌：4症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に発生した甲状腺型癌の4症例（乳頭癌3例、濾胞癌1例）を報告。2例は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴い、2例に転移がみられた。文献レビューに基づき、「悪性卵巣甲状腺腫」より「典型的甲状腺型癌」という用語の使用を提唱し、診断基準と鑑別診断を論じる。
summary_en: This article reports four cases of thyroid-type carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, three papillary and one follicular, with two associated with mature cystic teratoma. Metastases occurred in two patients, and one died of disease. The authors review the literature, noting that papillary and follicular carcinomas are the most common malignancies in ovarian struma. They recommend the term typical thyroid-type carcinoma over malignant struma ovarii, because histological malignancy does not always indicate biological malignancy. They also discuss diagnostic criteria and the differential diagnosis from ovarian metastases and other ovarian neoplasms, including strumal carcinoid.

title: Power of the eternal youth: Nanog expression in the gestational choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌におけるNanog発現：永遠の若さの力
summary_ja: 多能性に関わるタンパク質Nanogについて、正常胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍での発現を論じた論評。絨毛癌細胞におけるNanogの機能的役割に焦点を当て、幹細胞関連因子が腫瘍の増殖や進展にどう関わるかを考察する。原著論文に付随する短い解説である。
summary_en: This commentary expands on the expression of Nanog, a pluripotency-associated protein, in normal placentas and in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. It focuses on the functional role of Nanog in choriocarcinoma cells. The author discusses how the presence of this stem cell-associated factor in trophoblastic tumors may relate to their proliferative and aggressive behavior. The commentary accompanies a primary study and provides context for interpreting Nanog expression in gestational choriocarcinoma. It is a short piece, so its scope is limited to the interpretation of existing findings and the functional questions they raise for future work.

title: A case of mediastinal teratoma as a cause of nonimmune hydrops fetalis, and literature review.
title_ja: 非免疫性胎児水腫の原因となった縦隔奇形腫の一例および文献的考察
summary_ja: 早産の新生児が出生時に非免疫性胎児水腫を呈し、縦隔の胚細胞奇形腫と診断された症例を報告。外科的切除と化学療法を受け50日間生存した。新生児期に縦隔腫瘍が胎児水腫の原因となった初の症例であり、新生児の胎児水腫の鑑別に縦隔奇形腫を含めるべきと論じる。
summary_en: This article reviews mediastinal tumors as a cause of nonimmune hydrops fetalis (NIHF), including outcomes of reported cases and an overview of diagnosis, workup, and management. The authors present a premature neonate with NIHF at birth who was diagnosed with a germ cell mediastinal teratoma. The infant survived 50 days after surgical resection and chemotherapy. This is described as the first neonatal case of a mediastinal tumor causing NIHF and only the third reported survivor in the neonatal period. Survival depends on tumor size, location, resectability, and malignant potential. The authors recommend including mediastinal teratoma in the evaluation of newborns with NIHF.

title: A population-based analysis of 788 cases of yolk sac tumors: A comparison of males and females.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍788例の集団ベース解析：男性と女性の比較
summary_ja: SEERデータに基づき卵黄嚢腫瘍788例を男女別に解析。原発部位は精巣が42.6%、卵巣が32.6%。性腺外発生例の5年生存率は性腺発生例より低かった。男女の全生存期間に大きな差はなく、期間中に生存率は改善した。
summary_en: This population-based study used SEER data from 1973 to 2003 to analyze 788 yolk sac tumors, comparing males and females. The most common primary sites were the testis (42.6%) and ovary (32.6%). Five-year survival was 66% for extragonadal tumors and 86% for gonadal tumors. Overall median survival was similar between sexes, at 81 months for males and 91 months for females. Survival improved over the study period. The bimodal age distribution, with peaks in early childhood and in the second to fourth decades, suggests that sex steroids may influence some yolk sac tumors. Primary sites differed by sex and affected prognosis.

title: Metastatic gestational trophoblastic tumour presenting as spontaneous subcapsular renal haematoma.
title_ja: 自然発症性腎被膜下血腫として発症した転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍
summary_ja: 急性の左側腹部痛で発症した転移性絨毛癌の症例。腎転移からの出血による被膜下血腫が原因で、転移巣を塞栓術により止血した。婦人科以外の症状が転移性絨毛癌の初発症状となりうることを示した。
summary_en: The authors describe a rare case of metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting with acute left loin pain caused by a subcapsular renal haematoma. The haematoma resulted from bleeding of a renal metastasis, which was treated by embolisation to prevent further bleeding. The authors note that presentation of gestational trophoblastic tumour with such symptoms has not been described in the recent literature. The case shows that non-gynaecological symptoms can be the first sign of metastatic choriocarcinoma in the appropriate clinical setting. It also shows that acute bleeding from a renal metastasis can be managed effectively by embolisation.

title: Heat shock induces chromosomal instability in near-tetraploid embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: 熱ショックは準四倍体胎児性癌細胞の染色体不安定性を誘導する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞株の長期培養から準四倍体のサブクローンP19RG01を単離。非致死的な熱ショックにより中心体増幅と染色体分離異常が起こり、染色体不安定性が数倍に増加することを示した。がん幹細胞の不安定性を解析する胎児性癌モデルとしての有用性を提示する。
summary_en: The authors isolated a near-tetraploid subclone, P19RG01, from long-term culture of the P19 embryonal carcinoma cell line. This subclone expresses embryonal carcinoma markers. The study shows that sub-lethal heat shock induces centrosome amplification, multipolar mitosis, and chromosome missegregation, increasing chromosomal instability several-fold. Supernumerary centrosomes are accompanied by a prolonged G2 arrest, which generates a heterogeneous cell population. The authors propose that a minor population of chromosomally unstable cancer stem cells can undergo Darwinian selection, leading to more malignant cells and tumor progression. The work uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a model for cancer stem cell instability.

title: Contemporary management of stage I testicular seminoma: a survey of Canadian radiation oncologists.
title_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマにおける現在の管理：カナダの放射線腫瘍医を対象とした調査
summary_ja: カナダの放射線腫瘍医を対象に、精巣摘除術後の病期I精巣セミノーマの管理方針を調査した。単剤の補助化学療法を検討する医師が増加したが、第一選択とはされていない。定型的な放射線療法の使用は減少し、サーベイランスが最も推奨されるようになった。近年の研究で複数の選択肢が妥当とされたことが背景にある。
summary_en: This survey of Canadian radiation oncologists examined how they manage clinical stage I testicular seminoma after orchiectomy. Compared with earlier surveys, adjuvant single-agent chemotherapy is being considered by a growing proportion of respondents, though it is not the preferred option. Routine radiotherapy use is declining, and surveillance is increasingly popular and is most often recommended. The authors attribute these shifts to recent studies showing several acceptable management options for stage I seminoma.

title: Mature solid teratoma of the fallopian tube associated with uterine leiomyomas.
title_ja: 子宮筋腫を伴う卵管の成熟充実性奇形腫
summary_ja: 40歳女性が下腹部の腹痛と過多月経で受診し、子宮筋層内の3個の筋腫と拡張した左卵管が確認された。病理検査で、子宮平滑筋腫を伴う卵管の良性成熟充実性奇形腫と診断された。卵管原発の奇形腫は極めて稀であり、婦人科腫瘍医は付属器や子宮の腫瘤の鑑別に本疾患を念頭に置くべきである。
summary_en: This report describes a 40-year-old woman with lower abdominal pain and heavy menstrual bleeding in whom a benign mature solid teratoma of the fallopian tube was found alongside three uterine leiomyomas. Imaging and surgical specimens showed nodules in the myometrium and a distended left fallopian tube. Pathology confirmed the diagnosis. Primary teratoma of the fallopian tube is extremely rare, and the authors urge gynecologic oncologists to consider it in the differential diagnosis of adnexal and uterine masses.

title: Overexpression of NANOG in gestational trophoblastic diseases: effect on apoptosis, cell invasion, and clinical outcome.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるNANOGの過剰発現：アポトーシス、細胞浸潤および臨床転帰への影響
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌におけるNANOGの発現を検討した。NANOGは正常胎盤に比べ奇胎で高発現し、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患に進展した例でさらに高値だった。JEG-3絨毛癌細胞でNANOGをノックダウンするとアポトーシスが増加し、浸潤・遊走能とMMP2、MMP9の発現が低下した。NANOGは妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病態と臨床経過に関与すると結論づけられた。
summary_en: This study examined NANOG expression in hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinomas. NANOG mRNA and protein were higher in moles than in normal placentas, particularly in those that developed persistent disease, and nuclear immunoreactivity was elevated in choriocarcinoma. NANOG levels inversely correlated with apoptosis. Knocking down NANOG in the JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell line increased apoptosis and reduced invasion and motility, with decreased MMP2 and MMP9. The authors conclude NANOG contributes to the pathogenesis and clinical progression of gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Cytologic diagnosis of metastatic seminoma to the prostate and urinary bladder: a case report.
title_ja: 前立腺および膀胱に転移したセミノーマの細胞診断：症例報告
summary_ja: 16年前にセミノーマで化学療法、両側精巣摘除術、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた42歳男性が、腹痛、便秘、血尿で受診した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で膀胱、前立腺、直腸に及ぶ膀胱後腔の腫瘤が認められた。尿細胞診で再発セミノーマと診断され、前立腺生検で壊死を伴う転移性セミノーマが確認された。免疫組織化学ではc-kit、PLAP、D2-40、OCT4が陽性であった。
summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old man with a history of testicular seminoma treated 16 years earlier with chemotherapy, bilateral orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. He presented with abdominal pain, constipation and hematuria, and CT showed a large retrovesical mass involving the bladder, prostate and rectum. Urine cytology revealed atypical cells diagnosed as recurrent seminoma, and prostate biopsy confirmed necrotic seminoma. Immunostains for c-kit, PLAP, D2-40 and OCT4 were positive.

title: Immune cell profiling in intraplacental and postmolar choriocarcinomas.
title_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌および胞状奇胎後絨毛癌における免疫細胞プロファイリング
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌5例と胞状奇胎後絨毛癌7例で、CD8、グランザイムB、FoxP3を用いて免疫細胞浸潤を検討した。胎盤内絨毛癌では浸潤は認められず、正常着床部と差はなかった。胞状奇胎後絨毛癌では隣接組織に細胞傷害性T細胞、NK細胞、制御性T細胞が強く浸潤したが、腫瘍組織内には概ね免疫細胞がみられなかった。
summary_en: This study compared immune cell infiltration in intraplacental and postmolar choriocarcinomas using CD8, granzyme B and FoxP3 staining. Five intraplacental and seven postmolar choriocarcinomas were examined. Intraplacental tumors showed no immune infiltration, comparable to normal implantation sites. Postmolar tumors showed vigorous infiltration of cytotoxic T cells, NK cells and regulatory T cells in adjacent tissue, yet immune cells were largely absent from the tumor tissue itself, with a sharp infiltration border at its edge.

title: Japanese trial for classification of gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の分類に関する日本での検討
summary_ja: 本研究は、組織学的所見なしに絨毛癌を持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患から臨床的に鑑別する日本版診断スコアの有用性を評価した。日本の809例を後方視的に解析した結果、感度は92.2%、特異度は93.5%、正確度は92.9%であった。早期の適切な管理や、各国間での発生率・生存率の比較に有用とされる。
summary_en: This study evaluated the Japanese Diagnostic Score for distinguishing choriocarcinoma from persistent gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) without histologic confirmation. Records of 809 Japanese patients treated surgically and with chemotherapy were retrospectively reviewed, including 347 choriocarcinoma and 462 invasive mole cases. The score showed 92.2% sensitivity, 93.5% specificity, and 92.9% accuracy. The authors conclude it is useful for early clinical diagnosis and for international comparison of choriocarcinoma incidence and survival.

title: Prognosis of malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: 20 years of experience.
title_ja: 悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の予後：20年間の経験
summary_ja: 1985年から2005年に当院で治療された悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍1,130例を後方視的に解析し、管理と予後因子を検討した。80.0%が完全寛解し、再発は3.4%であった。ほとんどは適切な化学療法で治癒可能であり、化学療法後少なくとも12か月の妊娠延期を推奨している。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 1,130 malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients treated at PUMC Hospital from 1985 to 2005 assessed management and prognosis. Most patients achieved complete remission (80.0%), and 3.4% of those later relapsed. Among partial responders, most had normal beta-hCG with residual lung or other metastases, and six choriocarcinoma patients progressed. Most patients were curable with timely chemotherapy, with surgery occasionally useful. The authors recommend delaying pregnancy for at least 12 months after chemotherapy.

title: Effect of Ad-TIMP3 on biologic behavior of choriocarcinoma cells in vitro.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞の生物学的挙動に対するアデノウイルス導入TIMP3の作用（in vitro）
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株jeg-3とbewoに対し、アデノウイルス導入TIMP3(Ad-TIMP3)の効果をin vitroで検討した。Ad-TIMP3は増殖を抑制し、アポトーシスを誘導し、接着と浸潤を低下させた。隣接する非感染細胞への傷害効果も認めた。絨毛癌に対する遺伝子治療の可能性が示唆されるが、基礎研究の段階である。
summary_en: This in vitro study tested whether adenovirus-delivered TIMP3 (Ad-TIMP3) could suppress choriocarcinoma cell behavior, using jeg-3 and bewo cell lines. Ad-TIMP3 induced apoptosis, inhibited growth, and reduced adhesion and invasion. It also produced a cytotoxic bystander effect on neighboring uninfected cells. The authors suggest Ad-TIMP3 may have potential as a gene therapy approach for choriocarcinoma, although this work remains preclinical.

title: Human chorionic gonadotropin free beta-subunit measurement as a marker of placental site trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍のマーカーとしての遊離ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニット(hCGβ)測定
summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)を他の妊娠性絨毛性疾患から鑑別するため、総hCGに占める遊離β-hCGサブユニットの割合を後方視的に評価した。PSTTでは中央値45.5%と有意に高値であった。ただし絨毛癌とは値が重なり、決定的な検査ではないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study evaluated the percentage of free hCG beta-subunit relative to total hCG as a marker to distinguish placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) from other gestational trophoblastic disease. Serum from 18 PSTT patients, 49 persistent trophoblastic disease patients, and 12 choriocarcinoma patients was retrospectively analyzed. PSTT showed a significantly higher median free beta-subunit proportion (45.5%). The authors conclude the test is helpful but not definitive, because choriocarcinoma values overlap with those of PSTT.

title: Prostatic remnants in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の前立腺組織遺残
summary_ja: 31歳と20歳の女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に、前立腺組織の遺残が認められた2例を報告する。前立腺腺はPSAと前立腺酸性ホスファターゼに陽性であった。1例では尿道様の移行上皮と、高度前立腺上皮内腫瘍を示唆する所見もみられた。非常に稀な所見であり、文献的考察も加えられている。
summary_en: Two women aged 31 and 20 with mature cystic teratomas of the ovary were found to contain prostatic tissue. Both lesions showed typical mature teratoma histology, and the prostatic glands stained positively for PSA and prostatic acid phosphatase. One case had urethra-like transitional epithelium and focal high-grade prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia. The authors review the literature on this rare finding within common ovarian tumors.

title: Neonatal oral tumors: congenital epulis and epignathus.
title_ja: 新生児口腔腫瘍：先天性歯肉腫とエピグナトゥス
summary_ja: 新生児の口から突出する稀な口咽頭腫瘍である先天性歯肉腫（エプリス）とエピグナトゥスを報告する。エピグナトゥスは先天性奇形腫の一種で、気道閉塞を来しうる。出生時の多職種チームによる適切な管理により、予後は極めて良好である。
summary_en: This report describes congenital epulis and epignathus, two rare oropharyngeal tumors that protrude from the mouth in neonates and can cause airway obstruction. Epignathus is a congenital teratoma. The authors share their institutional experience and review the literature. With appropriate multidisciplinary management at birth, both lesions have an excellent prognosis.

title: Testicular seminoma presenting with duodenal perforation: a case report.
title_ja: 十二指腸穿孔を初発症状とした精巣セミノーマ（症例報告）
summary_ja: 45歳男性で、転移性古典型精巣セミノーマによる十二指腸穿孔が初発症状であった症例を報告する。精巣腫瘍の上部消化管への転移は稀である。若年男性で潰瘍を伴う小腸腫瘤を認めた際は、胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: A 45-year-old man presented with duodenal perforation as the first manifestation of metastatic classic-type testicular seminoma. Upper gastrointestinal involvement by testicular tumors metastasizing to the retroperitoneum is rare. The authors conclude that germ cell tumor should be considered when an ulcerating small bowel mass is found in a young man.

title: Free beta-subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin in serum is a diagnostically sensitive marker of seminomatous testicular cancer.
title_ja: 血清中の遊離ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニット(hCGβ)は、セミノーマ性精巣がんの診断感度の高いマーカーである
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍351例を対象に、血清中の遊離hCGβサブユニットを評価した研究です。セミノーマでは測定により陽性率が17%から57%へ上昇し、再発例でも32%から59%に改善しました。hCGβは病期や組織型、予後、腫瘍サイズと相関し、一部の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍でも追加情報をもたらします。
summary_en: This study evaluated free hCG beta-subunit (hCGbeta) in serum as a marker for testicular cancer, using 94 preoperative samples, 22 relapse samples, and 3687 follow-up samples from 351 patients. Measuring hCGbeta raised marker positivity in seminomas from 17% to 57% and in relapses from 32% to 59%. About 40% of marker-positive cases would have been missed by measuring hCG and hCGbeta together. hCGbeta correlated with stage, histology, mortality and tumor size, and it adds information in some NSGCT patients.

title: Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND).
title_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)
summary_ja: 婦人科腫瘍における後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)の解剖と手術手技の要点を解説した総説です。化学療法抵抗性の卵巣未熟奇形腫では生存期間を延長しうること、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後手術の要であることを述べています。婦人科腫瘍医にとってRPLNDの技術習得が重要だと論じています。
summary_en: This review describes retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in gynecologic oncology, covering surgical anatomy and essential operative steps. It highlights that RPLND prolongs survival in chemorefractory ovarian immature teratoma and is a key part of post-chemotherapy surgery for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, the testicular counterpart. The authors argue that extensive RPLND skill is important for gynecologic oncologists. The broader therapeutic role of systematic lymphadenectomy in gynecologic malignancies remains debated.

title: Predicted cardiovascular mortality and reported cardiovascular morbidity in testicular cancer survivors.
title_ja: 精巣がん生存者における心血管死亡予測リスクおよび心血管疾患の報告
summary_ja: 1980〜1994年に治療を受けた精巣がん生存者1134例を対象に、SCOREモデルで心血管リスクを評価した研究です。化学療法群は手術のみの群より予測心血管死亡率が高く、累積シスプラチン量850mg超では中等度以上リスクのオッズが増加しました。10年の定期フォローアップを超えて、心血管リスク管理を続けることを提言しています。
summary_en: This study assessed whether testicular cancer treatment is linked to cardiovascular risk using the SCORE model in 1134 survivors treated between 1980 and 1994. Compared with surgery alone, chemotherapy-treated patients had higher predicted 10-year fatal cardiovascular risk. Those with cumulative cisplatin above 850 mg had increased odds of intermediate or high risk (OR 3.4). Only 15% were high risk, but 53% fell into the intermediate or high risk group. The authors recommend regular cardiovascular risk monitoring beyond the routine 10-year follow-up.

title: Mediastinal seminoma in a patient with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1.
title_ja: MEN1患者に発症した縦隔セミノーマ
summary_ja: 多発性内分泌腫瘍症1型(MEN1)を有する46歳男性が、呼吸器症状で発症した縦隔セミノーマを報告した症例報告です。化学療法により完全寛解が得られました。その後、副甲状腺機能亢進症と高ガストリン血症を伴う膵腫瘍が見つかり、遺伝学的にMEN1と確定しました。セミノーマとMEN1の併発は過去に報告がなく、病因的関連も示されていません。
summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old man with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (MEN1) who developed a mediastinal seminoma presenting with respiratory symptoms. Pathological diagnosis was confirmed and complete remission was achieved with chemotherapy. Hyperparathyroidism and pancreatic tumors with hypergastrinemia were later found, and MEN1 was confirmed genetically. The authors note that concurrent seminoma and MEN1 had not been reported previously, and no etiological link has been established.

title: Mediastinal teratoma with malignant degeneration.
title_ja: 悪性転化を伴う縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 前縦隔に発生し、緩徐に増大した縦隔奇形腫の症例です。外科的切除後の病理検査で、カルチノイド腫瘍への悪性転化が確認されました。このような経過は極めて稀で、文献上の報告は3例のみです。患者は切除後に腫瘍学的治療を受け、経過は良好でした。臨床病理学的特徴と治療内容が考察されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a slowly progressing anterior mediastinal teratoma that was surgically resected. Pathological examination revealed malignant transformation to carcinoid tumor, a very rare evolution for which only three prior reports exist. The authors detail the clinicopathological features and the treatment strategy. Following resection, the patient received oncological therapy and had a satisfactory clinical course.

title: Dermoid tumors of the ovary: evaluation of the gasless lift-laparoscopic approach.
title_ja: 卵巣皮様嚢腫に対するガスレスリフト腹腔鏡手術の検討
summary_ja: 卵巣皮様嚢腫108例を後方視的研究で検討し、ガスレス・リフト腹腔鏡手術の有用性を評価した報告です。臓器温存手術の79例中、被膜破綻は3例(3.8%)のみでした。洗浄後に腹腔内の細胞診で播種は認められず、病理学的に癌腫もありませんでした。他の腹腔鏡手法と比べ、破綻や内容物の漏出は最も少なかったと結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 108 patients with ovarian dermoid tumors evaluated gasless lift-laparoscopy, a technique combining laparoscopic and open-surgery precautions. Capsule rupture occurred in only 3.8% of organ-preserving cases, and no cytological contamination was detected after lavage. No carcinoma was found histologically. The authors conclude that lift-laparoscopy minimizes rupture and spillage compared with other endoscopic methods, though these events cannot be fully excluded.

title: Hepatoduodenal ligament teratoma with hepatic artery running inside.
title_ja: 肝動脈が走行する肝十二指腸間膜奇形腫
summary_ja: 肝十二指腸間膜に発生した奇形腫の7例目となる症例報告です。解剖学的に複雑な部位のため、切除は困難でした。術中超音波検査を用いて肝動脈を温存しながら腫瘍を切除した手術手技が詳述されています。小児の奇形腫自体は稀ではありませんが、この部位は極めて稀であると述べています。
summary_en: This report describes a seventh documented case of a teratoma arising in the hepatoduodenal ligament, an extremely rare location. Surgical resection was challenging due to anatomical complexity, and the hepatic artery was preserved using intraoperative ultrasonography to guide dissection. The authors emphasize the operative technique for tumor resection while sparing the hepatic artery. Teratomas in infants and children are noted to be not particularly rare overall, but this site is exceptional.

title: Long-term outcome and prognostic factors for yolk sac tumor of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の長期予後と予後因子
summary_ja: 1986年から2006年に治療された純粋型卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍36例を後方視的に検討した報告です。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は66.6%、無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は68.8%でした。病期I-IIはIII-IVより予後が良好でした。腹水量100ml未満、残存腫瘍1cm未満の症例も比較的良好な予後を示しました。血清AFP値と年齢は予後と有意な相関を認めませんでした。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 36 patients with pure ovarian yolk sac tumors treated between 1986 and 2006 reported a 5-year overall survival of 66.6% and progression-free survival of 68.8%. Patients with FIGO stage I-II disease fared better than those with stage III-IV. Ascites under 100 ml and residual tumor under 1 cm were associated with a relatively good prognosis. Serum AFP level and age showed no significant correlation with outcome.

title: [Anti-nMDA receptor encephalitis--clinical manifestations and pathophysiology].
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎：臨床像と病態生理
summary_ja: 当初は卵巣奇形腫を伴う若年女性でのみ見つかった、抗体介在性で治療反応性のある脳炎の総説です。前駆期から回復期までの5つの臨床経過と、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)、脳脊髄液(CSF)、脳波の所見が示されています。NMDA受容体機能低下や抑制性神経伝達の障害による病態仮説が論じられています。腫瘍を伴わない症例もあるため、腫瘍切除と免疫療法の併用が推奨されています。
summary_en: This review covers anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, an antibody-mediated, treatment-responsive disorder initially identified in young women with ovarian teratoma. The authors describe its five clinical phases, from prodrome through hyperkinetic phase to recovery, along with diagnostic findings such as MRI, CSF, and EEG. Pathophysiology involving NMDA receptor hypofunction and GABAergic disinhibition is discussed. Recognition of cases without teratoma supports combined tumor resection and immunotherapy as recommended treatment.

title: Intratubular transplantation as a strategy for establishing animal models of testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 精細管内移植による精巣胚細胞腫瘍の動物モデル作製
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 信頼できる精巣胚細胞腫瘍の動物モデルがないため、精細管内移植を用いたモデル作製法を検討した研究です。移植した腫瘍細胞はマウスの精巣に定着し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍を形成しました。移植前にトランスジーンを導入することで、発がん過程における遺伝子機能の評価も可能となります。病態、診断、治療の研究への応用が期待されています。
summary_en: This study explores intratubular testicular transplantation as a method to establish animal models of testicular germ cell tumours. Tumour cells delivered into seminiferous tubules of recipient mice populated the testis and developed into TGCTs. Donor cells could also be transfected with transgenes before transplantation, enabling evaluation of specific gene functions in oncogenesis. The authors suggest this approach could advance studies of TGCT pathogenesis, diagnosis, and therapy, given the lack of reliable existing animal models.

title: Pure yolk-sac tumor of the lung.
title_ja: 肺原発純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 25歳男性の右肺中葉に生じた純粋型卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告です。胸部断層撮影で中葉の腫瘤が確認されました。中葉内側区域切除を行い、術後に化学療法が施行されました。胸部の原発性胚細胞腫瘍は通常縦隔に発生し、肺や胸膜由来は稀であると述べられています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with a pure yolk sac tumor of the lung. Chest tomography revealed a mass in the middle lobe of the right lung. Treatment consisted of a middle lobe medial segmentectomy followed by postoperative chemotherapy. The authors note that primary germ cell tumors of the chest usually localize to the anterior mediastinum, whereas pulmonary and pleural origin is rare.

title: Metastases of clinically occult testicular seminoma mimicking primary extragonadal retroperitoneal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 臨床的に潜在性の精巣セミノーマ転移が原発性後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍を模倣した例
summary_ja: 停留精巣の既往がある2例と、burn-out型の原発腫瘍を伴う1例を含む、見かけ上の原発性後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍3例の報告。後腹膜腫瘍はまず精巣腫瘍の転移と考えるべきで、同側の精巣異常は精巣摘除術で治療すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: Three patients presented with apparent primary extragonadal retroperitoneal germ cell tumors. Two had a history of cryptorchidism with testicular atrophy, and orchiectomy revealed small seminomatous intratesticular tumors, while the third showed a burn-out primary testicular tumor. Diagnoses were made via endoscopic ultrasound-guided puncture, laparoscopic resection, and CT-guided biopsy. The authors conclude that retroperitoneal germ cell tumors should first be considered metastases of viable or burned-out testicular cancer and that ipsilateral testicular abnormalities warrant orchiectomy.

title: Dermoid cyst in the hepatoduodenal ligament: report of a case.
title_ja: 肝十二指腸間膜に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)の1例
summary_ja: 若年女性の肝十二指腸間膜に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)の症例報告。性腺外での発生はまれである。外科的切除が治療の中心であり、確定診断にも必要である。完全切除されれば予後は良好とされる。
summary_en: A case report of a mature cystic teratoma, or dermoid cyst, arising in the hepatoduodenal ligament of a young woman. Such extragonadal mature cystic teratomas are rare, and the authors emphasize that surgical resection is the mainstay of therapy and needed for definitive diagnosis. Complete resection generally yields an excellent prognosis. The report underscores that this extragonadal location is unusual for a benign germ cell neoplasm of this type.

title: Congenital tumors of the retrorectal space in the adult: report of two cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 後直腸間隙の先天性腫瘍: 仙尾部奇形腫と類皮嚢腫の2例および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 後直腸間隙に生じた先天性腫瘍2例(仙尾部奇形腫と類皮嚢腫)の報告と文献レビュー。会陰アプローチで尾骨切除を伴わず完全摘出され、2年間再発はなかった。診断と術前計画には磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)が重要で、完全切除が治療の第一選択とされる。
summary_en: Two cases of congenital retrorectal tumors, a sacrococcygeal teratoma and a dermoid cyst, are reported with a literature review. Both were removed completely through a perineal approach without coccygectomy and had no recurrence at two years. The authors emphasize that MRI is crucial for diagnosis and preoperative planning, and that complete surgical removal is the treatment of choice.

title: Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: experience at a single institution.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化: 単施設の経験
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 1989年から2007年の単施設データで、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの悪性転化16例を後方視的に検討し、文献レビューを加えた。扁平上皮癌が75%と最も多く、MCTの0.8%に発生していた。早期発見と完全切除が生存に重要で、高齢、大きな腫瘍径、充実性成分が悪性転化の予測因子とされる。
summary_en: A retrospective single-institution review of 16 patients with malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma, identified from 2019 MCT and 937 primary ovarian cancer cases over 1989 to 2007, with a literature review. Squamous cell carcinoma was most common, and the incidence was 0.8% of MCTs. The authors conclude that early detection and complete resection are key to survival, and that older age, large size and solid components predict malignant transformation.

title: Biphasic pulmonary blastoma with germ cell differentiation in a 36-year-old man.
title_ja: 36歳男性にみられた胚細胞分化を伴う二相性肺芽腫
summary_ja: 36歳男性の両肺転移を伴う縦隔腫瘍の症例。古典的二相性肺芽腫に未熟奇形腫、セミノーマ、胎児性癌の成分が混在していた。初診時のβ-hCGおよびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇はブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンに反応したものの腫瘍は縮小せず、後にパクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンと自家骨髄移植を要した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍との関連を含め、切除不能例の予後不良と治療選択の限界を論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a mediastinal tumor metastatic to both lungs, showing classic biphasic pulmonary blastoma with immature teratoma, seminoma, and embryonal carcinoma components. Elevated β-hCG and AFP responded to bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, but the tumor did not regress. Progression followed paclitaxel, ifosfamide, cisplatin, and tandem autologous stem cell transplantation. The authors review pulmonary blastoma and extragonadal germ cell tumors, emphasizing its poor prognosis and limited treatment options for unresectable disease.

title: Histological pattern of ovarian tumors and their age distribution.
title_ja: ネパールの教育病院における卵巣腫瘍の組織型と年齢分布
summary_ja: 2004〜2006年にネパールの大学病院で報告された卵巣腫瘍161例の組織型と年齢分布を解析した研究。83.9%が良性で、表層上皮性腫瘍(52.2%)に次いで胚細胞腫瘍が42.2%を占めた。良性腫瘍では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が最多で、悪性では漿液性腺癌が多かった。胚細胞腫瘍は20歳代までの若年層で特に多く見られた。
summary_en: This Nepali single-institution study of 161 ovarian tumors (2004 to 2006) analyzed histological types and age distribution. Most tumors were benign (83.9%), with surface epithelial tumors most common (52.2%) and germ cell tumors second (42.2%). Mature cystic teratoma was the commonest benign tumor, while serous adenocarcinoma predominated among malignancies. Benign tumors outnumbered malignant ones at all ages, with malignancies concentrated after age 40. Germ cell tumors were most frequent in the first two decades of life.

title: Prenatal diagnosis of an epignathus associated with a 49,XXXXY karyotype--a case report.
title_ja: 性染色体49,XXXXYを伴う出生前診断されたエピグナサス―症例報告―
summary_ja: 超音波で出生前に診断された、頭蓋底や口蓋から発生するまれな先天性奇形腫(エピグナサス)の症例。胎児は49,XXXXY核型であった。妊娠29週で帝王切開を行ったが、巨大腫瘍のため新生児の挿管に失敗し、出生30分後に死亡した。出生前に腫瘍の大きさと広がりを評価し、予後と周産期管理に役立てることの重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a fetus diagnosed prenatally by ultrasound with an epignathus, a rare congenital teratoma arising from the skull base or palate, and found to have a 49,XXXXY karyotype. The pregnancy was continued, and cesarean delivery was performed at 29 weeks because of abnormal Doppler and cardiotocographic findings. Because of the large tumor, neonatal intubation failed, and the newborn died 30 minutes after birth. The authors emphasize assessing tumor size and extent prenatally to guide prognosis and perinatal management, and note this is the first report of this combination.

title: Primary orbital endodermal sinus tumor (yolk sac tumor).
title_ja: 原発性眼窩卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 眼窩に原発した卵黄嚢腫瘍の少女の症例報告である。卵黄嚢腫瘍は通常、乳児の精巣や卵巣に生じる胚細胞由来の悪性腫瘍である。本症例は眼窩内容除去術と化学療法で治療され、9年間無病で経過した。著者らは、仙尾部、後腹膜、縦隔、松果体などの性腺外発生部位をレビューし、眼窩原発例が極めてまれであることを強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a girl with a primary orbital yolk sac tumor, an unusual site for this germ cell malignancy, which typically arises in infant gonads. The tumor was treated with orbital exenteration and chemotherapy. The patient remained disease-free for 9 years. The authors review extragonadal sites of yolk sac tumor, including sacrococcygeal, retroperitoneal, mediastinal, and pineal locations, and highlight that orbital primaries are exceptionally rare.

title: Hypermethylation of SOX2 gene in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎および絨毛癌におけるSOX2遺伝子の高メチル化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、正常胎盤におけるSOX2遺伝子のメチル化と発現を解析した研究。メチル化は胞状奇胎の56.4%、絨毛癌の全例で認められ、妊娠初期・正期産の正常胎盤より高頻度であった。胞状奇胎ではmRNA発現が低下し、発現はメチル化と有意に相関した。絨毛癌細胞株では脱メチル化剤とヒストン脱アセチル化酵素阻害剤の併用でSOX2発現が相乗的に回復し、エピジェネティックな抑制が妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病態に関与することが示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined SOX2 promoter methylation and mRNA expression in placentas and gestational trophoblastic disease using methylation-specific PCR. SOX2 was hypermethylated in 56.4% of hydatidiform moles and in all choriocarcinoma samples and cell lines, versus 4.4% of first-trimester and 26.7% of term placentas. Expression was significantly reduced in moles and correlated with methylation status. Treatment with demethylating and HDAC inhibitors restored SOX2 expression synergistically in choriocarcinoma cells, suggesting epigenetic silencing contributes to trophoblastic disease pathogenesis.

title: Endobronchial metastasis from testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマからの気管支内転移
summary_ja: 喀血を主訴とした27歳男性の症例報告。胸部CTで7×6cmの腫瘤が認められ、原発性肺癌が疑われた。気管支鏡で右気管支に多発結節が確認され、生検と擦過細胞診により精巣セミノーマの気管支内転移と診断された。胚細胞腫瘍の転移が原発性肺癌に酷似しうること、両者を鑑別することが予後の判断に重要であることを示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with hemoptysis whose chest CT showed a 7 x 6 cm mass and nodules, initially suggesting primary lung cancer. Bronchoscopy revealed multiple endobronchial nodules, and histopathological examination of biopsies and brushings confirmed endobronchial metastasis from a testicular seminoma. The case illustrates that germ cell tumor metastases can mimic primary lung carcinoma, and that distinguishing the two has important prognostic implications.

title: CT images of a malignant-transformed ovarian mature cystic teratoma with rupture: a case report.
title_ja: 悪性転化を伴い破裂した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)画像：症例報告
summary_ja: 39歳女性の破裂した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例。病理学的に扁平上皮癌への悪性転化と腸間膜癌腫症が確認された。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では脂肪-液面形成を伴う腹水、造影される充実成分、嚢胞壁の局所的な不連続性が認められ、破裂や悪性転化の診断に有用な所見であることを示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman with a ruptured ovarian mature cystic teratoma that had undergone malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma. Contrast-enhanced CT showed a predominantly cystic lower abdominal mass with fat-fluid-level ascites, an enhancing solid component, and regional discontinuity of the cyst wall. Pathology confirmed squamous cell carcinoma arising within the teratoma and mesenteric carcinomatosis. The authors highlight CT features that may help recognize rupture and malignant change in such tumors.

title: Mediastinal teratoma as a rare cause of hydrops fetalis and death: report of 3 cases.
title_ja: 胎児水腫と死亡をきたした稀な原因としての縦隔奇形腫：3症例の報告
summary_ja: 先天性縦隔奇形腫による胎児水腫および胎児死亡の3症例の報告。超音波検査では多発奇形や胸部腫瘤、水腫が疑われ、剖検で縦隔を占拠する奇形腫が確認された。非免疫性胎児水腫の鑑別診断として、特に超音波検査で胸部腫瘤が認められた場合に念頭に置くべきであると結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes three cases of congenital mediastinal teratoma presenting as nonimmune hydrops fetalis, each with fetal death. Ultrasonography suggested multiple anomalies, a thoracic mass, or hydrops, and autopsy identified teratomas of 4.5 to 8 cm that filled the mediastinum and compressed the heart and lungs. The authors conclude that congenital mediastinal teratoma can cause fetal death and belongs in the differential diagnosis of nonimmune hydrops, particularly when ultrasonography detects a thoracic mass.

title: Exaggerated placental site reaction following an elective abortion.
title_ja: 選択的人工妊娠中絶後に生じた過剰胎盤部位反応：症例報告
summary_ja: 選択的人工妊娠中絶後に生じた過剰胎盤部位反応(EPS)の症例報告。EPSは雑多な栄養膜病変で、臨床経過の報告は少ない。超音波検査および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見を組織学的所見とともに提示し、従来報告されていなかった画像的特徴を示している。胎盤部位病変の理解を深める報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes exaggerated placental site reaction (EPS) occurring after an elective abortion. EPS is a rare, miscellaneous trophoblastic lesion with few previously reported clinical courses. The authors present its ultrasonographic and magnetic resonance imaging features together with histopathological observations, documenting imaging characteristics not previously described. The report adds to limited knowledge of how this placental-site lesion appears on imaging and pathology.

title: Extraovarian pelvic yolk sac tumor: case report and review of published work.
title_ja: 乳癌と同時性に生じた卵巣外骨盤内卵黄嚢腫瘍：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 乳癌を同時性に合併した卵巣外骨盤内卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。骨盤内腫瘍と肝播種巣を切除し、子宮と両側付属器を温存した。BEP療法3コースの後、乳癌に対して補助化学療法と放射線療法を行った。妊孕性を保持したい女性には、妊孕性温存手術とシスプラチン併用化学療法が適切と結論し、既報9例をレビューしている。
summary_en: This case report describes extraovarian pelvic yolk sac tumor synchronous with breast carcinoma in a woman. Treatment included resection of the pelvic tumor and hepatic implant, omentectomy, and breast lumpectomy with sentinel lymph node biopsy, while preserving the uterus and adnexa. Three cycles of BEP chemotherapy were followed by adjuvant chemotherapy and radiotherapy for the breast cancer. The authors conclude that fertility-sparing surgery with cisplatin-based chemotherapy is appropriate for women who wish to retain childbearing capacity, and review nine prior cases.

title: PET imaging in the management of tumors of testis and ovary: current thinking and future directions.
title_ja: 精巣および卵巣腫瘍の管理における陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)：現状と今後の方向性
summary_ja: 精巣および卵巣腫瘍におけるFDG-PETの役割をまとめた総説。精巣腫瘍では化学療法後の残存腫瘤で活動性腫瘍と線維化・成熟奇形腫を鑑別する用途が最も確立しており、マーカー上昇時の再発検出にも感度が高い。卵巣癌では、CA125上昇時に従来画像が不明瞭な場合の再発診断に有用で、将来的に現行の監視法を置き換える可能性があると述べている。
summary_en: This review examines FDG-PET in testicular and ovarian malignancies. In testicular tumors, PET is most established for evaluating residual masses after chemotherapy, distinguishing viable disease from fibrosis or mature teratoma in seminoma and NSGCT, and it appears sensitive for recurrence when markers are raised. Its role in initial staging and prognosis is less defined. In ovarian carcinoma, PET is particularly useful for diagnosing recurrence when CA125 rises and conventional imaging is inconclusive, and may eventually replace current surveillance methods.

title: Bilateral gonadoblastomas with a left sided dysgerminoma in a true hermaphrodite (disorder of sexual differentiation) with 46, XY karyotype.
title_ja: 46,XY核型の真性半陰陽(性分化疾患)における両側性性腺芽腫と左側のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）
summary_ja: 46,XY核型で女性表現型を示す18歳の卵精巣性性分化疾患の症例。両側性の性腺芽腫と左側のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が認められた。Y染色体の存在と腹腔内の性腺位置が、異形成性性腺における胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを高めることを組織発生学的に検討している。
summary_en: This report describes an 18-year-old with a female phenotype and 46,XY karyotype, diagnosed with ovotesticular disorder of sexual differentiation. Histology showed bilateral gonadoblastomas and a dysgerminoma in the left gonad. The authors focus on histogenetic details and note that the Y chromosome and intra-abdominal gonadal location confer a high risk of neoplastic transformation in dysgenetic gonads. The case illustrates the importance of recognizing germ cell tumor risk in patients with DSD carrying Y chromosome material.

title: The molecular basis of genistein-induced mitotic arrest and exit of self-renewal in embryonal carcinoma and primary cancer cell lines.
title_ja: ゲニステインによる胎児性癌細胞および初代がん細胞の有糸分裂停止と自己複製能消失の分子基盤
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 大豆イソフラボンのゲニステインが、初代がん細胞(膠芽腫、横紋筋肉腫、肝細胞癌)と胎児性癌細胞株NCCITに与える影響を検討した。全細胞で細胞周期停止が起こり、M期関連遺伝子PBK、BUB1、CDC20の発現が低下した。NCCITではGADD45A/G上昇とOCT4・NANOGタンパク質の低下がみられ、自己複製能の喪失が示唆された。ゲニステインはM期の進行に関わる遺伝子群を標的とすると結論づけられている。
summary_en: This study examined how genistein, a soy isoflavone, affects primary cancer cells (glioblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, hepatocellular carcinoma) and the embryonal carcinoma line NCCIT. Genistein induced cell-cycle arrest at different checkpoints in all cell types, with decreased mRNA levels of PBK, BUB1, and CDC20. In NCCIT cells specifically, genistein upregulated GADD45A and GADD45G and reduced OCT4 and NANOG protein, suggesting loss of self-renewal. Genistein also increased p53 and p38 and raised cyclin A and B levels, and the authors conclude that it targets genes governing M-phase progression.

title: Anti-NMDA-receptor encephalitis: case series and analysis of the effects of antibodies.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎：症例集積と抗体の作用の解析
summary_ja: NR1-NR2抗体陽性の脳炎100例を解析した症例集積研究。腫瘍評価が可能だった98例中58例に腫瘍がみられ、最多は卵巣奇形腫であった。早期の腫瘍治療(多くは免疫療法)は予後良好、神経系再発の減少と関連した。患者抗体は培養神経細胞の表面NMDA受容体を減少させ、抗体除去で可逆的であった。抗体を介した病態機序が示唆されている。
summary_en: This case series analyzed 100 patients with encephalitis and NR1-NR2 NMDA receptor antibodies. Of 98 patients with oncological assessments, 58 had tumors, most commonly ovarian teratoma. Patients who received early tumor treatment, usually immunotherapy, had better outcomes and fewer neurological relapses. Clinical features included psychiatric symptoms, seizures, unresponsiveness, dyskinesias, and autonomic instability. Patient antibodies reduced cell-surface NMDA receptors in cultured neurons, and this effect was reversible after antibody removal, supporting an antibody-mediated mechanism.

title: Incidental placental choriocarcinoma in a term pregnancy: a case report.
title_ja: 正期産妊娠における偶発的胎盤絨毛癌：症例報告
