summary_ja: 18歳女性が妊娠39週で生児を分娩し、胎盤検査で偶発的に胎盤内絨毛癌が見つかった。産後2か月で血清β-hCGは3070 mIU/mlから2 mIU/ml未満に低下し、化学療法は行われなかった。胸部X線と全身CTで転移は否定され、母子ともに良好である。著者らは、正常分娩後に胎盤の病理検査が日常的に行われないため本症が過小診断されている可能性を指摘し、母子の注意深いフォローアップを強調している。
summary_en: An 18-year-old woman delivered a healthy infant at 39 weeks, and placental examination revealed an incidental intraplacental choriocarcinoma. Serum beta-hCG fell from 3070 to under 2 mIU/ml within two months postpartum, and chemotherapy was not given. Chest X-ray and whole-body CT excluded metastasis, and both mother and infant remained well. The authors note that placental choriocarcinoma is rare and may be underdiagnosed because placentas are not routinely examined after normal deliveries, and they stress careful follow-up of mother and infant.

title: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: an update.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍：最新情報
summary_ja: 侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の最新情報をまとめた総説。精密な評価と病期分類により治癒率は90%を超える。非転移性(病期I)および低リスク転移例は単剤化学療法で生存率がほぼ100%に達する。高リスク転移例では初回から多剤併用化学療法が必要で、放射線療法や手術を併用することもあり、生存率は80～90%である。
summary_en: This update reviews gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, which includes invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Cure rates exceed 90% with careful evaluation and staging to guide therapy. Nonmetastatic (stage I) and low-risk metastatic disease can be treated with single-agent chemotherapy, with survival approaching 100%. High-risk metastatic disease requires initial multiagent chemotherapy, with or without adjuvant radiation and surgery, achieving 80% to 90% survival.

title: miR-302b maintains "stemness" of human embryonal carcinoma cells by post-transcriptional regulation of Cyclin D2 expression.
title_ja: miR-302bはサイクリンD2の転写後調節を介してヒト胎児性癌細胞の幹細胞性を維持する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、胚細胞腫瘍のモデルであるヒト胎児性癌細胞において、マイクロRNAのmiR-302bの役割を検討した。機能獲得・機能喪失実験により、miR-302bはOct4を間接的に、サイクリンD2を直接的に調節し、自己複製を維持して神経分化を抑制することが示された。miR-302bの発現低下とサイクリンD2タンパク質の増加は、胎児性癌細胞の多能性維持の分子機構を示唆する。
summary_en: This study investigates miR-302b, a microRNA, in human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the stem-like malignant counterparts of germ cell tumors and a model for pluripotency. Using loss- and gain-of-function experiments, the authors show that miR-302b indirectly regulates Oct4 and directly regulates Cyclin D2 expression. Functional miR-302b maintains self-renewal and suppresses neuronal differentiation of EC cells. During retinoic acid-induced differentiation, miR-302b and Oct4 decline while Cyclin D2 protein rises. The findings suggest miR-302b sustains pluripotency of EC cells, and probably embryonic stem cells, through post-transcriptional control of Cyclin D2.

title: Chemotherapy as an alternative to radiotherapy in the treatment of stage IIA and IIB testicular seminoma: a Spanish Germ Cell Cancer Group Study.
title_ja: 病期IIAまたはIIBの精巣セミノーマに対し、放射線療法の代替として化学療法を用いる：スペイン胚細胞腫瘍研究グループによる研究
summary_ja: 本前向き観察研究は、病期IIAまたはIIBの精巣セミノーマ72例を対象に、初回治療としてのシスプラチン併用化学療法の有効性と毒性を検討した。83%が完全奏効を達成し、中央値71.5か月の追跡で5年無増悪生存率は90%、全生存率は95%であった。化学療法は放射線療法の晩期障害を回避しうる有効な代替治療と結論された。
summary_en: This prospective observational study from the Spanish Germ Cell Cancer Group evaluated front-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy as an alternative to radiotherapy for stage IIA or IIB testicular seminoma in 72 patients. Patients received cisplatin/etoposide or cisplatin/etoposide/bleomycin. Complete response was achieved in 83%. After a median follow-up of 71.5 months, 5-year progression-free survival was 90% and overall survival was 95%. Severe granulocytopenia occurred in eight patients. The authors conclude chemotherapy is highly effective and well tolerated and may avoid late effects of radiotherapy.

title: Clinical outcome and predictors of survival in late relapse of germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発の臨床転帰と生存の予測因子
summary_ja: 1990～2004年に晩期再発した胚細胞腫瘍75例を後方視的に解析した。再発の75%は後腹膜に生じ、完全外科的切除が得られた群では5年がん特異的生存率が79%と、得られなかった群の36%より良好であった。化学療法未施行例、無症状例、単発病変例で生存が良好であり、後腹膜の厳密な管理が再発予防に重要とされた。
summary_en: This institutional series of 75 patients managed for late relapse of germ cell tumor between 1990 and 2004 analyzed predictors of cancer-specific survival. Most late relapses (75%) occurred in the retroperitoneum, often in patients not treated with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Five-year cancer-specific survival was 60%, rising to 79% when complete surgical resection was achieved versus 36% without it. Chemotherapy-naive patients fared better. Symptomatic presentation and multifocal disease independently predicted poorer survival. The authors emphasize meticulous retroperitoneal control and complete excision.

title: Management and outcome in prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratomas.
title_ja: 出生前診断された仙尾部奇形腫の管理と転帰
summary_ja: 1985～2005年に出生前診断された仙尾部奇形腫6例を後方視的に検討した。III型の腫瘍では、水腎症、神経障害、高拍出性心不全、胎児水腫などの合併が認められた。胎児水腫を伴った1例は出生後に死亡したが、5例は手術により良好な長期転帰を得た。胎児水腫や関連奇形の評価のための詳細な超音波検査が推奨される。
summary_en: This retrospective review of six prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratomas (SCT) from 1985 to 2005 examined factors affecting postnatal outcome. Type III tumors, presenting between 22 and 33 weeks, were associated with complications including hydronephrosis, neurological deficits, high-output cardiac failure, and fetal hydrops. One neonate with hydrops died of multi-organ failure. Five infants had successful surgery with good long-term outcomes. Detailed prenatal ultrasound is recommended to assess associated anomalies and hydrops, which the authors identify as key prognostic factors.

title: A prospective 10 year audit of a single Irish centre's experience of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic testis cancer.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の10年間の前向き監査：アイルランド単一施設の経験
summary_ja: アイルランドの単一施設における10年間の前向き監査で、転移性精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた73例を報告した。多くはシスプラチン併用化学療法後の患者であった。病理では成熟奇形腫37例が認められた。合併症は多かったが予想範囲内で死亡例はなく、平均30か月の追跡で95%が完全寛解した。適切な症例選択と経験豊富な施設での実施が転帰を最適化すると結論された。
summary_en: This prospective ten-year audit from a single Irish centre reports 73 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for metastatic testicular cancer, mostly after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Most had partial responses, and 13 required salvage chemotherapy. Pathology showed mature teratoma in 37 patients. Morbidity was significant but expected, with no mortality. Ninety-five percent achieved complete remission at mean follow-up of 30 months. The authors conclude case selection in experienced centres optimises outcomes.

title: A rare case of follicular thyroid carcinoma in ovarian struma.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に生じた濾胞性甲状腺癌のまれな症例
summary_ja: 続発性無月経の40歳女性に、両側の成熟奇形腫と、右卵巣甲状腺腫内に生じた濾胞性甲状腺癌が認められた症例を報告する。病期分類のための開腹術、骨盤内郭清術、甲状腺全摘術を施行し、全身131Iシンチグラフィーで異常集積はなかった。4年後も良好で、血清サイログロブリンによるフォローアップを受けている。卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性転化の極めてまれな例である。
summary_en: A 40-year-old woman with secondary amenorrhoea had bilateral mature ovarian teratomas, with follicular thyroid carcinoma arising in a right ovarian struma. Staging laparotomy and pelvic clearance were followed by total thyroidectomy. Post-treatment whole-body radioiodine scintigraphy showed no abnormal uptake. Four years later the patient remains well, with serial serum thyroglobulin surveillance. The authors describe this as a rare case of malignant transformation of struma ovarii, a specialised mature teratoma in which malignancy occurs in only about 5% of cases.

title: [Case of metastatic germ cell tumor with testicular calcification detected by MD-CT].
title_ja: MD-CTで精巣石灰化を検出した転移性胚細胞腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 19歳男性が食欲不振、体重減少、呼吸困難で受診した。胸部X線で多発肺結節、また女性化乳房と頸部・腋窩・鼠径のリンパ節腫脹を認めた。MD-CTでは多発肺転移、肝・後腹膜腫瘤、右精巣の微小石灰化が描出され、肺生検と合わせて焼け焦げ腫瘍を伴う精巣絨毛癌と診断された。CTで焼け焦げ腫瘍を検出した初の報告であり、胚細胞腫瘍の疑い例での精巣画像検査の有用性を示した。
summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with anorexia, weight loss and dyspnoea. Chest radiography showed multiple lung nodules, and examination revealed gynecomastia and palpable lymphadenopathy, but no testicular abnormality on palpation. Multi-detector CT demonstrated pulmonary, hepatic and retroperitoneal masses and a small calcification in the right testis. Percutaneous lung biopsy and the testicular calcification led to a diagnosis of testicular choriocarcinoma with a burned-out primary. The authors note this is the first report of a burned-out tumour detected by CT, supporting CT of the testes in suspected germ cell tumour.

title: [Two cases of intrascrotal tumors complicated acute scrotum].
title_ja: 急性陰嚢症を合併した陰嚢内腫瘍の2例
summary_ja: 急性陰嚢症を呈した陰嚢内腫瘍のまれな2例を報告した。15歳例は精液瘤の捻転で、切除が行われた。25歳例は精巣捻転として徒手整復されたが腫脹が残り、術中超音波検査で所見が得られ、高位精巣摘除術を施行した。病理組織学的検査でpT1のセミノーマと判明した。陰嚢内腫瘍は急性陰嚢症の鑑別診断に含めるべきである。
summary_en: Two rare cases presenting as acute scrotum are reported. A 15-year-old had a spermatocele that torsed 180 degrees and was excised after surgical exploration. A 25-year-old had testicular torsion initially suspected, with manual detorsion failing to resolve the swelling. A stony-hard left testis and mosaic echo pattern on intraoperative ultrasonography prompted high orchiectomy, which revealed seminoma pT1. The authors emphasise that intrascrotal tumours, although rare, should be included in the differential diagnosis of acute scrotum.

title: Role of radiotherapy in organ-sparing treatment of seminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマの臓器温存治療における放射線療法の役割
summary_ja: 異時性両側セミノーマの1症例を報告する。腫瘍核出術と補助的な局所放射線療法により精巣を温存した治療経過を示し、セミノーマの臓器温存治療における放射線療法の役割を文献的に検討している。標準治療である根治的精巣摘除術は不妊やアンドロゲン欠乏などを招くため、長期生存者が増える中で生活の質を重視した治療選択の重要性を論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metachronous bilateral seminoma treated with tumor enucleation and adjuvant local radiotherapy to preserve testicular function. The authors review the literature on radiotherapy in organ-sparing treatment of seminoma. Radical orchiectomy, the standard approach, causes infertility, androgen deficiency, and psychological burden, which matters increasingly because most germ cell tumor patients become long-term survivors. The paper argues that organ-sparing strategies can improve quality of life in carefully selected patients.

title: Pilimiction.
title_ja: 毛髪尿症（pilimiction）
summary_ja: 排尿時に毛髪が混じる症状を9年間呈した患者を報告する。卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が膀胱壁に浸潤し、続発性膀胱類皮嚢腫を生じていたと診断された。経済的理由から超音波検査のみで評価し、内視鏡的切除後に開腹術で卵巣腫瘍を安全域を含めて切除した。病理学的に良性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認され、尿路への浸潤を伴う卵巣奇形腫のまれな病態を示している。
summary_en: A patient with a nine-year history of passage of hair in urine was found to have a secondary bladder dermoid arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma that had invaded the bladder wall. Ultrasound was the only imaging used because of financial constraints. Endoscopic resection suggested external invasion, so laparotomy was performed with excision of the ovarian mass and a safety margin. Histopathology confirmed a benign mature cystic teratoma. The report emphasizes this rare presentation of ovarian teratoma with urinary tract involvement.

title: Choriocarcinoma with pulmonary and cerebral metastases.
title_ja: 肺および脳転移を伴う絨毛癌
summary_ja: 33歳女性の絨毛癌症例で、肺転移に対する化学療法によりhCGは正常化し肺病変も消失した。10か月後に脳転移を伴う再発をきたし、外科手術と多剤併用化学療法で良好な転帰が得られた。絨毛癌が肺や脳に遠隔転移するまれな経過と、治療後のhCG監視の重要性を示す症例報告である。
summary_en: A 33-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma presented with pulmonary metastasis and was treated with chemotherapy, after which pulmonary lesions resolved and hCG normalized. Ten months later she developed neurological symptoms from recurrence with brain metastasis. Surgery and polychemotherapy again achieved a favourable outcome with disappearance of disease. The case illustrates the uncommon but treatable pattern of distant spread to lungs and brain in choriocarcinoma and the importance of hCG monitoring during follow-up.

title: Comprehensive staging allows for excellent outcome in patients with localized malignant germ cell tumor of the ovary.
title_ja: 病期分類を徹底することで局所性悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の良好な転帰が得られる
summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍60例を2施設で後方視的に解析した研究である。病期Iでは、再発は病期Iaでなく、病期Icで多く、術後観察や卵黄嚢腫瘍の存在で増加していた。病期Iで補助化学療法を受けた群では再発がなかった。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は96.7%で、包括的病期分類と病期Ix・Icでの補助化学療法の検討が重要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This two-center retrospective cohort of 60 patients with localized malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluates outcomes after surgery and chemotherapy. Among stage I tumors, relapse was absent in stage Ia, frequent in stage Ic, and increased after postoperative observation or when yolk sac tumor was present. Adjuvant chemotherapy eliminated relapses in stage I patients treated with it. Five-year overall survival was 96.7%. The authors conclude that comprehensive staging is essential and that stage Ix and Ic patients may benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy.

title: Teratoma of the nasal septum in a neonate: an endoscopic approach.
title_ja: 新生児の鼻中隔奇形腫に対する内視鏡的アプローチ
summary_ja: 左鼻孔を閉塞する白色腫瘤を呈した新生児の症例である。内視鏡的切除後の病理検査で鼻中隔の奇形腫と診断された。白人での鼻中隔奇形腫の初例とされ、内視鏡的治療は過去に報告がない。新生児の閉塞性鼻腫瘤に対する施設の内視鏡的治療プロトコルを示し、まれな性腺外奇形腫の治療経験をまとめている。
summary_en: A female newborn presented with a white mass obstructing the left nostril. After endoscopic resection, histopathology confirmed a teratoma of the nasal septum. The authors report this as the first such case in a white patient, with three previous cases worldwide, none managed endoscopically. The report describes their institutional protocol for endoscopic management of obstructive nasal masses in neonates, illustrating an approach to this rare extragonadal teratoma.

title: Parasitic dermoid cyst of the pouch of Douglas: a case report.
title_ja: ダグラス窩の寄生性類皮嚢腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 29歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡下右嚢胞摘出術中、ダグラス窩に寄生性の性腺外成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が偶然発見された症例です。既存の類皮嚢腫の捻転と自己切断、再移植が最も有力な成因と考察されています。文献検討では、ダグラス窩の寄生性・遊走性類皮嚢腫の報告は本例で3例目とされています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with a parasitic dermoid cyst (extragonadal mature cystic teratoma) in the pouch of Douglas, found incidentally during laparoscopic right cystectomy for an ovarian dermoid cyst. The authors propose torsion of a pre-existing dermoid with autoamputation and reimplantation as the most likely origin. A literature review identified this as only the third reported parasitic or wandering dermoid cyst of the pouch of Douglas.

title: Prognosis and treatment of squamous cell carcinoma from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来扁平上皮癌の予後と治療
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌についてMEDLINEの報告220例を統合解析しています。5年生存率は病期Iの75.7%から病期IVの0%まで低下しました。病期と最適減量手術が独立した予後因子で、進行期では術後補助化学療法が生存に寄与する可能性が示されています。
summary_en: This analysis pooled 220 reported cases of squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma from MEDLINE (1976-2005), of which 188 with surgical staging were used for survival analysis. Five-year survival fell from 75.7% in stage I to 0% in stage IV. Stage, age, tumor size, SCC antigen, CA125, and optimal debulking were prognostic, with stage and debulking independent. Postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy appeared to improve survival in advanced stages, whereas radiotherapy did not.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma over two decades: birth prevalence, prenatal diagnosis and clinical outcomes.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の20年間の出生有病率、出生前診断、臨床転帰
summary_ja: 1985〜2006年の地域集団ベースの調査で、生児754,172例中28例に仙尾部奇形腫が見つかり、出生有病率は約2万7千出生に1例でした。半数で出生前診断がなされ、新生児期に発症した例では悪性腫瘍や再発はありませんでした。根治的外科的管理を受けて生存した乳児の予後は良好でした。
summary_en: This population-based study from a regional congenital anomaly and oncology database (1985-2006) found 28 live-born infants with sacrococcygeal teratoma among 754,172 births, a birth prevalence of about 1 in 27,000. Prenatal diagnosis was made in half of cases. No neonatal-presenting cases had malignancy at diagnosis or later recurrence. Nine survivors (37.5%) had chronic morbidities. Infants surviving definitive surgery had a good prognosis.

title: A transplant recipient with a mixed germ-cell ovarian tumor.
title_ja: 卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍を有する移植患者
summary_ja: 腎移植レシピエントが、移植の7年前に治療された卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍（絨毛癌成分を含む）の既往を有していた。移植後3年間のフォローアップで腫瘍の再発は認められていない。著者らは英語文献に同様の報告はないとしている。移植までの待機期間は、腫瘍の病期、予後、各成分の割合、移植を行わない場合の全体的な予後を考慮すべきと提言している。
summary_en: This case report describes a renal transplant recipient who had been treated seven years earlier for an ovarian mixed germ cell tumor with a choriocarcinoma component. After three years of follow-up following transplantation, no tumor relapse was evident. The authors note that they found no comparable report in the English literature. They suggest that the interval before transplantation should consider tumor stage, prognosis, the proportion of tumor components, and overall prognosis.

title: [Anesthetic management of the ex-utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure for giant epignathus and of the tumor excision].
title_ja: 巨大エピグナトゥスに対するEXIT手技および腫瘍摘出の麻酔管理
summary_ja: 喉頭閉鎖を伴う巨大エピグナトゥス（先天性奇形腫）の妊娠28週胎児に対するEXIT手技の麻酔管理を報告しています。母体にセボフルランを用いて子宮弛緩を得て、胎盤循環下で気管切開を行いました。生後2日目の腫瘍摘出は正常組織との区別が困難で部分切除となりましたが、周術期合併症はありませんでした。
summary_en: This case report describes anesthetic management of an EXIT procedure for a 28-week fetus with giant epignathus, a large congenital teratoma causing laryngeal atresia. Maternal anesthesia used sevoflurane, which provided uterine relaxation, and fetal oxygenation was monitored with pulse oximetry and ultrasound. Tracheostomy was performed on placental support. Tumor excision on day 2 was partial because of difficulty distinguishing tumor from normal tissue, and no perioperative complications occurred.

title: Cytologic features of extragonadal germ cell tumors: a study of 88 cases with aspiration cytology.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の細胞学的特徴：穿刺吸引細胞診88例の検討
summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍88例の穿刺吸引細胞診を解析し、十分な検体の57例で細胞学的特徴を検討しています。セミノーマや卵黄嚢腫瘍には特徴的な所見がみられました。混合型では約4割が1成分のみで診断が難しく、未熟奇形腫と併せてサンプリング誤差が課題とされています。
summary_en: This study analyzed fine-needle aspiration cytology from 88 extragonadal germ cell tumors, with 57 adequate for analysis and histopathologic correlation in 47 cases. Seminomas, yolk sac tumors, and other types had characteristic cytologic features, while embryonal carcinoma did not. Mixed germ cell tumors were difficult to diagnose, with 37% showing only one component on cytology. Immature teratoma and mixed tumors pose sampling challenges, but FNA can reliably diagnose GCT at extragonadal sites.

title: False-positive serum human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) in a male patient with a malignant germ cell tumor of the testis: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍を伴う男性患者における偽陽性の血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍(病期IIB)の39歳男性で、化学療法後の血清hCG再上昇を再発と判断し、不要な二次・三次化学療法が行われた。保存血清の再検査で、治療後のhCG値は異種抗体による偽陽性と判明した。IgA欠損患者でみられた例であり、hCG測定の落とし穴を文献と併せて考察している。
summary_en: A 39-year-old man with stage IIB metastatic testicular malignant germ cell tumor had elevated serum hCG that normalized after first-line chemotherapy, then rose again, suggesting relapse. Resected residual retroperitoneal nodes showed no viable tumor, yet he received second- and third-line chemotherapy unnecessarily. Reanalysis of stored sera with other immunoassays showed that post-treatment hCG values were falsely positive, likely due to heterophilic antibodies in this IgA-deficient patient. The authors review the pitfalls of false-positive hCG measurement.

title: Expression of BLIMP1/PRMT5 and concurrent histone H2A/H4 arginine 3 dimethylation in fetal germ cells, CIS/IGCNU and germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胎児期の胚細胞、CIS/IGCNUおよび胚細胞腫瘍におけるBLIMP1/PRMT5の発現と、ヒストンH2A/H4のアルギニン3ジメチル化の同時検出
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児期のゴノサイト、IGCNU(上皮内癌)、胚細胞腫瘍におけるBLIMP1/PRMT5とヒストンH2A・H4のアルギニンジメチル化を検討した。両マーカーはIGCNUとほとんどのセミノーマで検出されたが、胎児性癌などの非セミノーマ性腫瘍では低下していた。この修飾の消失が非セミノーマの体細胞分化を促す可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: The study examined BLIMP1/PRMT5 expression and histone H2A and H4 arginine 3 dimethylation in human fetal gonocytes, carcinoma in situ (IGCNU), and germ cell tumors. Both markers were present in IGCNU and most seminomas but reduced in embryonal carcinoma and other nonseminomatous tumors. The findings show parallels between murine and human primordial germ cells. The authors propose that histone arginine dimethylation maintains the undifferentiated state of IGCNU and seminoma, and that its loss drives somatic differentiation in nonseminomas.

title: Treatment of stage I seminoma: is it time to change your practice?
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの治療：診療方針を変えるべき時か？
summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの術後治療として放射線療法と単回カルボプラチンを比較したMRC第III相試験の結果を検討した社説である。再発率はカルボプラチン群5.3%、放射線療法群4.0%で、急性毒性はカルボプラチン群で少なかった。フォローアップ期間が短く晩期毒性は評価できない。カルボプラチンはまだ標準治療ではなく、監視療法が依然として妥当とされている。
summary_en: This editorial reviews the MRC randomized phase III trial comparing adjuvant radiotherapy with a single cycle of carboplatin for stage I seminoma, presented at ASCO 2008. Carboplatin showed a 1.3% higher relapse rate (5.3% vs 4.0%), a 3% or greater increase could not be excluded, and acute toxicity was lower. Late toxicity and second neoplasms could not be assessed given the short follow-up. The authors conclude that carboplatin is not yet standard and that surveillance with selective radiotherapy remains prudent.

title: Genetic aspects of testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝学的側面
summary_ja: 若年白人男性に多い悪性腫瘍である精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の遺伝学的要因をまとめた総説である。唯一報告された有意な危険因子はY染色体のgr/gr欠失だが、追試による確認が必要である。ゲノムワイド解析では主要遺伝子は見つからず、体細胞変化や発現解析から複数の経路の関与が示唆される。病因、進展、治療感受性に関わる遺伝因子に焦点を当てている。
summary_en: This review summarizes genetic factors in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT), a leading malignancy in young Caucasian men with rising incidence. The only significant germline risk factor reported is the gr/gr deletion of the Y chromosome, which still needs confirmation. Genome-wide linkage studies found no major gene, suggesting multiple contributing loci. Somatic mutations, genome imbalances, and expression profiling reveal interacting pathways. The authors focus on genomic and somatic factors involved in etiology, progression, and treatment sensitivity.

title: Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase expression in gestational trophoblastic disease: implications for development of immunotherapeutic approaches.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるインドールアミン2,3-ジオキシゲナーゼの発現：免疫療法的アプローチの開発への示唆
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患52例を対象に、インドールアミン2,3-ジオキシゲナーゼ(IDO)の免疫染色を行った。全ての胞状奇胎はIDO陽性であったが、絨毛癌と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の大半は陰性か限局的陽性にとどまった。悪性形質においてIDO依存性の免疫調節は主要な要因ではない可能性が示された。IDOを標的とした免疫療法は、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍のごく一部の患者にのみ有用と考えられる。
summary_en: The authors examined indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO) immunostaining in 52 gestational trophoblastic disease cases, including hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas, and placental site trophoblastic tumors. All hydatidiform moles were IDO-positive, whereas most choriocarcinomas and PSTTs were negative or only focally positive. The authors conclude that IDO-mediated immunoregulation is unlikely to be a major driver of malignancy in gestational trophoblastic tumors. IDO-targeted immunotherapy may therefore help only a minority of GTN patients.

title: Fibrobronchoscopic evidence of endobronchial hairs in intrapulmonary teratoma with hemoptysis but without trichoptysis.
title_ja: 喀血を伴う肺内奇形腫の気管支鏡所見：毛髪喀出を伴わない症例
summary_ja: 反復する喀血と左上葉の肺腫瘤を呈した21歳男性の肺内奇形腫の症例報告である。気管支鏡で左上葉前区域気管支に褐色の毛髪束を認め、術前診断に至った。肺葉切除で確定した。肺内奇形腫は極めて稀で術前診断が困難なことが多く、慢性空洞性肺病変の鑑別における気管支鏡の有用性を強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man with five years of recurrent hemoptysis and a left upper lung mass who was diagnosed preoperatively with intrapulmonary teratoma. Fibrobronchoscopy revealed a tuft of brownish hairs in the left upper anterior segmental bronchus, enabling diagnosis without trichoptysis. Lobectomy confirmed the diagnosis. Because intrapulmonary teratoma is exceedingly rare and preoperative diagnosis is usually inaccurate, the authors emphasize the value of bronchoscopy in the differential diagnosis of chronic cavitary lung lesions.

title: Treatment experiences of testicular cancer in Hispanic patients with Down's syndrome at the National Cancer Institute of Mexico.
title_ja: ダウン症候群のヒスパニック系患者における精巣がんの治療経験：メキシコ国立癌研究所の4症例
summary_ja: メキシコ国立癌研究所で従来法により治療した、ダウン症候群を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍の4例を報告している。転帰は非ダウン症例と同様であった。ダウン症候群に精巣がんが生じる報告は主に白人集団から多いと述べ、関連の機序や発生率上昇の可能性を考察している。小規模な症例集積研究である。
summary_en: This report presents four patients with Down syndrome and testicular germ cell cancer treated with conventional methods at the National Cancer Institute of Mexico. Their outcomes were similar to those of patients without Down syndrome. The authors review reports of testicular cancer in Down syndrome, which have come mainly from Caucasian populations. They discuss theories explaining the association and the possibility of an increased incidence. The paper is a small case series highlighting the rarity and clinical relevance of testicular germ cell tumors in this population.

title: [18F]Fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors after chemotherapy: the German multicenter positron emission tomography study group.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後の残存腫瘤における[18F]FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)：ドイツ多施設前向き研究
summary_ja: シスプラチンを用いた化学療法後のIIC期またはIII期の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍121例を対象とした、ドイツの多施設前向き研究である。FDG-PETの正診率は56%で、CTや腫瘍マーカーを上回らなかった。残存腫瘤の55%に生存癌または成熟奇形腫が含まれていた。PETは標準的検査に対する明確な上乗せ効果を示さなかった。
summary_en: This prospective German multicenter study evaluated FDG-PET for predicting viable tumor in 121 patients with stage IIC or III nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. All residual masses were confirmed histologically. The correct prediction rate of PET was 56 percent, which was not better than CT (55 percent) or tumor markers (56 percent). Residual masses commonly contained viable carcinoma or mature teratoma (55 percent). The authors conclude that neither CT nor tumor markers reliably exclude disease, and FDG-PET added no clear clinical benefit to standard diagnostics.

title: Expression of glial cell line-derived neurotropic factor receptor alpha-1 in immature teratomas.
title_ja: 未熟奇形腫の同定における免疫組織化学マーカーとしてのGFRα-1の発現
summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫の同定に有用な免疫組織化学マーカーとしてGFRα-1を評価した研究である。胚細胞腫瘍38例中26例に未熟奇形腫が含まれ、そのうち24例の未熟神経上皮に強い膜染色を認めた。胎児性癌、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌などの成分では有意な染色はなかった。未熟神経上皮の同定に役立つ可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study evaluated glial cell line-derived neurotropic factor receptor alpha-1 (GFRalpha-1) as an immunohistochemical marker for identifying immature teratoma. Among 38 germ cell tumors, 26 contained immature teratoma, and 24 of these had immature neuroepithelium showing strong membrane GFRalpha-1 staining. Other components, including embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, immature mesenchyme, and intratubular germ cell neoplasia, showed no significant staining. The authors conclude that GFRalpha-1 may help identify immature neuroepithelium, which is clinically important because its amount correlates with survival in ovarian immature teratoma.

title: Cystic malignant teratoma with early recurrence after intraoperative spillage.
title_ja: 術中漏出後に早期再発した嚢胞性悪性奇形腫
summary_ja: 縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に消化管腺癌成分を伴った症例の報告。胸腔鏡下手術中に癒着のため嚢胞が破裂し、術後に急速な腫瘍播種と早期再発が認められた。嚢胞壁を保ったままの完全切除が、悪性成分による再発を防ぐうえで重要であると論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a mediastinal mature cystic teratoma containing a focal gastrointestinal adenocarcinoma, treated with video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery. The cyst ruptured intraoperatively because of dense adhesions, and rapid tumor dissemination was noted postoperatively. Early recurrence followed the spillage. The authors emphasize that complete resection with the cyst wall intact is essential, because the potentially malignant component carries a risk of relapse if the tumor is disrupted.

title: Testicular cancer in Luxembourg: incidence and outcome in relation to the different histo-pathological types (1980-2004).
title_ja: ルクセンブルクにおける精巣がんの発生率と組織型別転帰（1980〜2004年）
journal: Bull Soc Sci Med Grand Duche Luxemb
summary_ja: 1980〜2004年にルクセンブルクで診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍397例を後方視的に解析した。年齢調整発生率は10万人あたり4.5から7.7に上昇した。純粋型では胎児性癌の予後が最も悪く、10年観察生存率は87.1%だった。純粋セミノーマは長期フォローアップが必要とされる。
summary_en: This retrospective population-based study of 397 germ cell tumor patients in Luxembourg (1980-2004) analyzed incidence and outcome by histologic type. Age-standardized incidence rose from 4.5 to 7.7 per 100,000. Among pure germ cell tumors, seminoma predominated, and embryonal carcinoma had the worst prognosis, with a 10-year observed survival of 87.1%. Survival in non-seminomatous types was largely determined within 24 months, whereas pure seminoma patients require long-term follow-up, including for metachronous non-testicular malignancies.

title: Maternal Epstein-Barr virus and cytomegalovirus infections and risk of testicular cancer in the offspring: a nested case-control study.
title_ja: 母体のEBVおよびCMV感染と児の精巣がんリスク：入れ子式症例対照研究
summary_ja: フィンランド・スウェーデン・アイスランドの出生コホートを用いた入れ子式症例対照研究。妊娠初期の母体EBV IgG高値は、児の精巣がんリスク上昇と関連した。特に非セミノーマ型と8歳未満での発症で顕著だった。母体CMV陽性は8歳未満の発症リスク低下と関連した。研究者らはEBVとCMV感染が精巣がんと関連する可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: This nested case-control study within Finnish, Swedish and Icelandic maternity cohorts examined whether maternal Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection during early pregnancy affects testicular cancer risk in offspring. High maternal EBV IgG was associated with increased risk, particularly for nonseminomatous tumors and those diagnosed before age 8. Maternal CMV seropositivity was associated with reduced risk of testicular cancer diagnosed before age 8. The authors suggest that EBV and CMV infections may be linked to testicular cancer.

title: Hamartomas, teratomas and teratocarcinosarcomas of the head and neck: Report of 3 new cases with clinico-pathologic correlation, cytogenetic analysis, and review of the literature.
title_ja: 上気道に生じた過誤腫、奇形腫および奇形癌肉腫：3症例の臨床病理学的・細胞遺伝学的比較と文献的考察
summary_ja: 頭頸部（上気道）に生じた多系統性の胚細胞腫瘍として、副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫と先天性口腔鼻咽頭奇形腫の2例を報告。副鼻腔の症例ではトリソミー12と1p欠失が認められ、悪性胚細胞腫瘍との関連が示された。比較対象の唾液腺原基腫瘍とともに、生物学的多様性を論じている。
summary_en: This report describes two new cases of multilineage germ cell tumors of the upper respiratory tract: sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma and congenital oronasopharyngeal teratoma (epignathus). These were compared with a salivary gland anlage tumor. Cytogenetic analysis of the sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma revealed trisomy 12 and 1p deletion, abnormalities typical of malignant germ cell tumors and supporting a germ cell origin. The other tumors lacked such abnormalities, consistent with benign behavior. The authors highlight the biological and clinical diversity of these head and neck lesions.

title: Development of testicular alpha-fetoprotein-secreting germ cell tumor 3 years after treatment of intracranial lesion identified as non-secreting germ cell tumor on the basis of clinical data--case report.
title_ja: 頭蓋内病変の治療3年後に発症した精巣αフェトプロテイン分泌性胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 22歳男性が、非分泌性と判定されていた播種性頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍の治療3年後に、精巣のAFP産生胚細胞腫瘍を発症した症例報告。血清AFPは129 ng/mlに上昇し、腹部CTで傍大動脈リンパ節腫大を認めた。左精巣摘除術で診断された。他部位の再発監視の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: A 22-year-old man developed an AFP-secreting testicular germ cell tumor three years after treatment of a disseminated intracranial lesion that had been classified as non-secreting germ cell tumor. MRI showed a necrotic mass, serum AFP rose to 129 ng/ml, and CT revealed para-aortic lymphadenopathy. Left orchidectomy confirmed AFP-secreting germ cell tumor despite extensive necrosis. The authors note that improved therapy has increased long-term survival, and that patients may develop germ cell tumors at other sites, so follow-up should monitor for recurrence beyond the brain.

title: Intrapericardial teratoma presenting in fetal life: intrauterine diagnosis and neonatal management.
title_ja: 胎児期に発見された心膜内奇形腫：子宮内診断と新生児期の管理
summary_ja: 胎児期に超音波検査で診断された心膜内奇形腫の症例報告。出生前にレーザー減圧を行い胎児水腫を防ぎ、妊娠を満期まで継続できた。出生後まもなく外科的切除を行い、治癒が得られた。胎児水腫の管理が予後を左右することを示している。また、本腫瘍は多くの場合組織学的に良性で、切除が根治的となりうる点にも言及している。
summary_en: This case report describes an intrapericardial teratoma, a rare germ-cell tumor of neonates, diagnosed in utero by ultrasound screening. Fetal hydrops was prevented by prenatal laser decompression, allowing the pregnancy to reach term. The tumor was then surgically resected in the first days of life. The authors emphasize that prenatal management of hydrops is essential for fetal survival, and that complete surgical resection is generally curative, although prenatal diagnosis and management remain challenging.

title: Squamous-cell carcinoma in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: systematic review and analysis of published data.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における扁平上皮癌：システマティックレビューと既報データの解析
summary_ja: 64件の研究、277例を解析したシステマティックレビュー。卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じる扁平上皮癌の特徴と予後を検討した。50歳以上、腫瘍径100mm超、病期Iaで生存が良好であった。完全切除に加え補助化学療法（アルキル化薬）が生存率と関連し、放射線療法は関連しなかった。診断と治療に関する提案も示している。
summary_en: This systematic review analyzed 277 patients from 64 studies with squamous-cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The malignancy occurred mainly in women over 50 with elevated SCC antigen and CA125 and tumors larger than 100 mm. Patients with FIGO stage Ia disease survived better. Complete resection with hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and lymphadenectomy, followed by adjuvant alkylating chemotherapy, was associated with higher survival, whereas radiotherapy was not. The authors propose recommendations for investigation and treatment.

title: Mature solid teratoma of the rectum: report of a case.
title_ja: 直腸の成熟充実性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 30歳女性が肛門出血で受診し、直腸のポリープ状腫瘤を認めた。組織学的に三胚葉成分を含む成熟充実性奇形腫と診断された。英文報告で最大のポリープ型直腸奇形腫の可能性がある。文献上の既報は約50例で、ほぼ女性に限られる。脱出と肛門出血が主な症状である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with rectal bleeding caused by a pedunculated polypoidal mass of the rectum. Histology showed a mature solid teratoma containing all three germ layers. The authors suggest it may be the largest polypoidal rectal teratoma reported in the English literature. A review identified only about 50 previously reported cases, nearly all in women, with prolapse and bleeding per anum as the common presentations.

title: A rare case of advanced testicular seminoma in a 78-year-old man managed successfully with carboplatin based chemotherapy: a case report.
title_ja: 78歳男性の進行精巣セミノーマに対しカルボプラチン併用化学療法が奏効した1例：症例報告
summary_ja: 78歳男性の転移性精巣セミノーマ症例。後腹膜に大きな腫瘍があり、肝機能・腎機能障害を合併していた。左精巣摘除術で診断された。カルボプラチン併用化学療法を4サイクル施行し、症状は著明に改善し画像上完全奏効が得られた。高齢で合併症があっても治療が可能であることを示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a 78-year-old man with metastatic testicular seminoma, a large retroperitoneal tumor, and concurrent liver and renal insufficiency. The diagnosis was confirmed histologically after left orchidectomy. Despite organ dysfunction, he received four cycles of carboplatin-based chemotherapy, with marked symptomatic improvement and complete radiological response. The report suggests that germ cell tumors can be treated effectively in elderly patients with comorbidities.

title: Case-control comparison of quality of life in long-term ovarian germ cell tumor survivors: a gynecologic oncology group study.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者における生活の質：症例対照研究
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者と、年齢・教育・人種をマッチさせたがん既往のない女性を郵送・電話調査で比較した。生存者は生殖に関する懸念や性機能の低下が多い一方、人生への感謝や情緒的な社会的支援が強かった。性機能と生殖の懸念に対する介入研究の必要性を示している。臨床現場で用いるスクリーニング質問も提示された。
summary_en: This case-control study compared quality of life in long-term survivors of ovarian germ cell tumors with age-, education-, and race-matched women without a cancer history, using mail and telephone surveys. Survivors reported more reproductive concerns and worse sexual functioning, but also greater appreciation of life and more affective social support. The authors recommend future interventions targeting sexual function and reproductive concerns, and propose screening questions for clinicians while noting the need for validation.

title: [Mature teratoma in the posterior mediastinum showing the fatty density on the chest computed tomography].
title_ja: コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で脂肪濃度を示した後縦隔の成熟奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 16歳女性の左傍脊椎部の腫瘤を胸部X線で偶然発見した。CTで均一な脂肪濃度、MRIでT1・T2強調像の高信号を示し、石灰化様の所見を呈した。組織学的に成熟奇形腫と確定した。縦隔の脂肪成分を含む腫瘤では、奇形腫を鑑別に挙げるべきであることを示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old woman with a posterior mediastinal mass found incidentally on chest radiograph. CT showed homogeneous fat density, and MRI showed hyperintensity on T1- and T2-weighted images, with a calcification-like appearance on imaging. Histology confirmed a mature teratoma. The case illustrates that fat-containing mediastinal masses should prompt consideration of teratoma in the differential diagnosis.

title: Primary insular carcinoid of the ovary.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の外表面から生じた卵巣原発島状カルチノイド：症例報告
summary_ja: 44歳女性の左卵巣に、非機能性の原発性島状カルチノイドを認めた。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の外表面から発生していた。片側卵管卵巣摘出術後、3年間のCTと5-HIAA検査で再発は認めなかった。卵巣に限局し手術で治療された例は予後良好と考えられる。稀な病態であることも示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a primary, non-functioning insular carcinoid of the left ovary in a 44-year-old woman, arising from the outer surface of a mature cystic teratoma. After unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, there was no sign of recurrence at 3-year follow-up with CT and 5-HIAA testing. The authors conclude that such tumors, though rare, confined to the ovary, and treated surgically, have an excellent overall outcome.

title: Thyroid teratoma in an 11-month-old infant.
title_ja: 乳児における甲状腺奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 出生時から右甲状腺腫瘤を有していた11か月男児の先天性良性甲状腺奇形腫の症例報告。25 mmの被膜を有する腫瘍は容易に摘出された。三胚葉の成熟成分からなり、グリア細胞や上衣細胞を伴う脳様の神経組織が主体であった。
summary_en: A case report of a congenital benign teratoma of the thyroid gland in an 11-month-old boy presenting as a right thyroid mass since birth. The 25 mm encapsulated tumor was easily excised. Histology showed mature derivatives of all three germ layers, predominantly neural tissue resembling brain with glial and ependymal components, along with cysts and tubules. Immunophenotyping confirmed the benign teratoma diagnosis.

title: Management and outcomes of ovarian masses in children and adolescents.
title_ja: 小児および思春期の卵巣腫瘤の管理と転帰
summary_ja: 小児および思春期の卵巣腫瘤49例を10年間の単施設で後方視的に検討した。8例（16%）が悪性で、悪性奇形腫やディスジャーミノーマなどがみられ、化学療法に反応したが3例で再発した。良性腫瘍の大半は奇形腫で、最も多い初発症状は腹痛であった。6年以上のフォローアップ期間中に死亡例はなかった。大半は良性のため、良性病変には腹腔鏡手術を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: A 10-year single-center retrospective review of 49 children and adolescents with ovarian masses. Eight (16%) were malignant, including malignant teratoma and dysgerminoma, which responded to chemotherapy despite three recurrences. Most benign lesions were teratomas. Abdominal pain was the most common presentation. No deaths occurred over more than six years of follow-up. The authors conclude that most pediatric ovarian masses are benign and that laparoscopy should be considered for benign lesions.

title: Clinical pathologic correlation: primary amenorrhoea and bilateral adnexal tumors.
title_ja: 臨床病理相関：原発性無月経と両側付属器腫瘍
summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成と原発性無月経を呈し、両側性性腺芽腫を認めた症例について、臨床医と病理医が検討する臨床病理カンファレンス。原発性無月経と両側付属器腫瘍の鑑別診断が議論されている。
summary_en: A traditional clinicopathologic conference presenting a case of bilateral gonadoblastoma in a 46,XY patient with gonadal dysgenesis who presented with primary amenorrhoea. The clinician and pathologist jointly discuss the clinical course, histopathologic features, and the differential diagnosis of primary amenorrhoea in the setting of bilateral adnexal tumors.

title: Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma to squamous cell carcinoma involves altered expression of p53- and p16/Rb-dependent cell cycle regulator proteins.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の扁平上皮癌への悪性転化における p53 および p16/Rb 依存性細胞周期制御タンパク質の発現変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌21例を解析した研究。p53過剰発現は67%、p16蛋白発現低下は86%にみられ、p53とRbの過剰発現には有意な相関がある。p53経路とp16-Rb経路の両方の異常が奇形腫の悪性転化に関与することを示唆する。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical and genetic analysis of 21 squamous cell carcinomas arising in ovarian mature cystic teratomas. p53 overexpression occurred in 67%, p16 loss in 86%, and p16 gene alterations in 52%. p53 and Rb overexpression correlated significantly and each was associated with higher proliferation. The findings indicate that alterations in both the p53 and p16-Rb pathways contribute to malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma.

title: Colonic-type adenocarcinoma arising in a primary retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 原発性後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した大腸型腺癌
summary_ja: 腹痛を訴えた47歳女性の20 cm嚢胞性後腹膜腫瘤で、原発性後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した大腸型腺癌と診断された。奇形腫内の腺腫を前駆病変とする発生経路が示唆された。腸型腺癌の発生例としては2例目とされる。
summary_en: A 47-year-old woman with abdominal pain had a 20 cm cystic retroperitoneal mass, diagnosed as colonic-type adenocarcinoma arising in a primary retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma. The carcinoma was intracystic and did not breach the teratoma capsule. Immunohistochemistry showed CK20 and CDX2 positivity with CK7 negativity. It arose adjacent to an adenomatous lesion within the teratoma, suggesting a precursor-carcinoma sequence. This is the second reported case of intestinal-type adenocarcinoma in such a tumor.

title: Gastric yolk sac tumor complicated with beta-human chorionic gonadotropin-producing metastases.
title_ja: β-hCG産生転移を伴う胃卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 74歳男性の胃卵黄嚢腫瘍症例で、肝・肺・リンパ節にβ-hCG産生転移を認めた。血清AFPは523 ng/mLと高値であった。剖検で肝・肺転移はAFP陰性・hCG陽性を示し、脱分化が示唆された。胃卵黄嚢腫瘍は極めてまれであり、免疫組織化学による鑑別が重要である。
summary_en: A 74-year-old heavy drinker with a gastric yolk sac tumor and hCG-producing metastases to liver, lung, and lymph nodes. Serum AFP was 523 ng/mL, and he died of multiorgan failure six days after admission. Autopsy showed AFP-positive gastric yolk sac tumor, with liver and lung metastases negative for AFP but positive for hCG, suggesting retrodifferentiation. Only eight prior gastric yolk sac tumors have been reported, so immunohistochemistry is essential to avoid misdiagnosis.

title: Interleukin-18 gene promoter polymorphisms in women with gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の女性におけるインターロイキン18遺伝子プロモーター多型
summary_ja: イランの妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者92例と妊娠対照103例で、IL-18遺伝子プロモーター多型（−607、−137）を解析した。多型と妊娠性絨毛性疾患の感受性や亜型との間に有意な関連は認められなかった。血清IL-18濃度は絨毛癌患者と妊娠対照で非妊娠対照より高値であった。多型は感受性を規定しないが、IL-18は妊娠性絨毛性疾患と正常妊娠で上昇すると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study examined IL-18 promoter polymorphisms at positions -607 and -137 in 92 Iranian women with gestational trophoblastic disease and 103 pregnant controls. No association with GTD susceptibility or subtypes was found. Serum IL-18 levels were higher in choriocarcinoma patients and pregnant controls than in nonpregnant controls, and -137 GG genotype pregnant controls had higher levels than CC. The authors conclude that the polymorphisms do not confer susceptibility, while IL-18 levels rise in GTD and normal pregnancy.

title: Malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary: a review of 41 cases and risk factors for recurrence.
title_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍41例の検討と再発危険因子
summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍41例を後方視的に検討した。ディスジャーミノーマが56%を占め、大部分は病期Iであった。17%が再発し、全生存期間はディスジャーミノーマで非ディスジャーミノーマより長かった。非ディスジャーミノーマ組織型、不完全手術や根治的手術、進行病期が再発の危険因子であった。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 41 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors reports histologic types (dysgerminoma 56%, mixed germ cell tumor, yolk sac tumor, immature teratoma), with most patients at stage I. Seventy percent underwent conservative surgery. Seven patients (17%) relapsed. Overall survival was 187 months, longer for dysgerminoma than non-dysgerminoma. Non-dysgerminoma histology, suboptimal or radical surgery, and advanced stage were risk factors for recurrence.

title: Ovarian malignant immature teratoma associated with pregnancy--a case report.
title_ja: 妊娠に合併した卵巣悪性未熟奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 36歳の健康な女性が、妊娠21週に超音波検査で直径175 mmの多房性嚢胞性腫瘤を指摘された。妊娠22週に左卵巣摘出術を施行し、悪性グレード2の未熟奇形腫と診断された。化学療法3コース後に妊娠39週で帝王切開を行い、正常な新生児を得た。母体は追加の化学療法2コース後に寛解と判断された。
summary_en: A 36-year-old woman was diagnosed with a malignant grade 2 immature teratoma of the left ovary at 21 weeks of gestation after ultrasound showed a 175 mm multilocular cystic mass. Left ovariectomy was performed at 22 weeks, followed by three courses of chemotherapy. A cesarean section at 39 weeks yielded a normal newborn, and two additional chemotherapy courses were given. The mother achieved remission, illustrating management of ovarian germ cell tumor during pregnancy.

title: Life-saving hysterectomy in choriocarcinoma: presentation of two cases.
title_ja: 絨毛癌における救命的子宮全摘術：2症例の報告
summary_ja: 大量の膣出血と高値のβ-hCG（それぞれ560,000、554,700 mIU/ml）を呈した絨毛癌の女性2例の報告である。輸血にもかかわらず循環動態が不安定であったため、救命目的で緊急子宮全摘術を施行した。2例目は肺転移を伴っていた。化学療法が治療の基本であり、選択された症例では手術の併用が有用であると結論づけている。
summary_en: Two women with choriocarcinoma presented with massive vaginal bleeding and markedly elevated β-hCG levels (560,000 and 554,700 mIU/ml). Both underwent emergency hysterectomy for life-threatening hemorrhage despite transfusion. The second patient also had pulmonary metastasis and was scheduled for chemotherapy. The authors note that chemotherapy remains the cornerstone of treatment, while surgery may be added in selected cases, and hysterectomy is indicated for life-threatening bleeding.

title: Anti-Ma2 paraneoplastic encephalitis associated with testicular germ cell tumor treated by carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に合併した抗Ma2関連傍腫瘍性脳炎
summary_ja: 右精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する35歳男性に、抗Ma2関連傍腫瘍性脳炎が生じた症例である。精巣摘除術とカルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン療法3コース後、腫瘍マーカーは正常化し後腹膜転移も消失したが、神経症状は悪化した。精巣腫瘍に抗Ma2脳炎を伴う例での治療経過を報告している。
summary_en: A 35-year-old man with a right testicular germ cell tumour developed anti-Ma2-associated paraneoplastic encephalitis with multiple neurological symptoms. After orchiectomy and three cycles of carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, tumour markers normalised and retroperitoneal metastases disappeared. However, the neurological disorder deteriorated. The authors report this as the first case of orchiectomy followed by this regimen for a testicular tumour with anti-Ma2 encephalitis.

title: Late struma ovarii diagnosis many years after total thyroidectomy. A rare entity.
title_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌全摘術後10年で判明した卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌に対する全摘から10年後、血清サイログロブリン高値を契機に卵巣甲状腺腫が判明した53歳女性の症例である。開腹下に子宮全摘および両側付属器切除を施行した。稀な奇形腫の亜型であることを強調し、厳重なフォローアップの計画と良好な予後を報告している。
summary_en: A 53-year-old woman was found to have struma ovarii ten years after total thyroidectomy for papillary thyroid carcinoma. Elevated serum thyroglobulin prompted the diagnosis. She underwent laparotomy with total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. The authors highlight the rarity of this ovarian teratoma subtype, which can present as a late finding. Close follow-up was planned, and the prognosis is reported as excellent.

title: [A case of choriocarcinoma of suspected lung origin manifesting pulmonary embolism].
title_ja: 肺塞栓症を呈した肺原発が疑われた絨毛癌
summary_ja: 正常分娩後に進行性の呼吸困難を呈した28歳女性の症例である。当初は器質化肺炎としてステロイド治療を受けたが、肺塞栓症が疑われ、開胸血栓摘出術で絨毛癌と診断された。原発巣は見つからず、全身化学療法で完全寛解を2年以上維持している。肺塞栓様に発症する絨毛癌への注意を促している。
summary_en: A 28-year-old woman presented after a normal delivery with progressive dyspnoea, initially diagnosed as cryptogenic organising pneumonia and treated with steroids. Later CT suggested pulmonary thromboembolism, and surgical thrombus removal revealed choriocarcinoma. No primary gynaecological lesion was found. Systemic chemotherapy achieved complete remission, which was sustained for two years. The authors stress that choriocarcinoma embolising into pulmonary arteries can mimic thromboembolism and should be suspected in women with pulmonary embolism.

title: [Relationship between anti-NMDAR encephalitis and acute juvenile female non-herpetic encephalitis (AJFNHE)].
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎と急性若年女性非ヘルペス性脳炎(AJFNHE)との関係
summary_ja: 若年女性の非ヘルペス性脳炎(AJFNHE)と抗NMDA受容体脳炎の関係を論じた報告で、両者は同一の病態と考えられるとしている。Dalmauらの報告では12例中11例に卵巣奇形腫を認め、日本の全国調査では関連腫瘍が40%に見られ、卵巣奇形腫が最多であった。奇形腫に伴う脳炎の知見として参考になる。
summary_en: Japanese report comparing acute juvenile female non-herpetic encephalitis (AJFNHE) with anti-NMDAR encephalitis and concluding that they are likely the same condition. In Dalmau's cohort, ovarian teratoma was found in 11 of 12 patients. A Japanese nationwide survey of AJFNHE estimated an annual incidence of 0.33 per million population. Respiratory failure requiring mechanical ventilation occurred in 70% of cases, associated tumors in 40%, and ovarian teratoma was the most frequent of these tumors.

title: [Clinical features and pathogenesis of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis].
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の臨床像と病態
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の総説で、抗体は主に卵巣奇形腫を有する若年女性で検出される。統合失調症様精神病、けいれん、カタトニア、低換気、ジスキネジアなどを呈し、脳MRIは多くの場合正常である。著者らはNMDAR機能低下仮説に基づき、グルタミン酸とドーパミンの調節異常をもたらす病態モデルを提案している。
summary_en: Review of anti-NMDAR encephalitis, a treatment-responsive, antibody-mediated encephalitis. The antibodies target extracellular epitopes of NR1/NR2 heteromers and are typically found in young women with ovarian teratoma. Patients often develop schizophrenia-like psychosis after a viral-like prodrome. The clinical course includes seizures, catatonia, central hypoventilation, dyskinesias, and autonomic symptoms, with MRI often unremarkable and EEG showing diffuse delta slowing. The authors propose that antibody inhibition of presynaptic NMDARs on GABAergic interneurons leads to glutamate and dopamine dysregulation.

title: [Anti-NMDAR encephalopathy: treatment].
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳症:治療
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳症の治療に関する総説。約65%が完全またはほぼ完全に回復し、免疫療法は腫瘍の有無に関わらず有効とされる。卵巣奇形腫は死亡率や抗体価の高さと関連し、著者らは診断後に腫瘍の検索と摘出を速やかに検討すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: Review of treatment for anti-NMDAR encephalopathy, a paraneoplastic limbic encephalopathy. About 65% of patients recover fully or nearly fully. Immunotherapy, mainly corticosteroids and IVIG, with plasmapheresis, cyclophosphamide, or rituximab as alternatives, is effective with or without tumor. A tumor was found in 58% of patients. Ovarian teratoma was linked to higher mortality and antibody titers, and relapse, seen in 13%, often reflected delayed tumor diagnosis. The authors recommend prompt search for and removal of ovarian teratoma, though unstable patients may not be operable early.

title: [Acute limbic encephalitis and NMDA type-glutamate receptor].
title_ja: 急性辺縁系脳炎とNMDA型グルタミン酸受容体
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を伴う非ヘルペス性急性脳炎19例と、非傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎95例を比較した研究。先行感染はNHAE-OTで多く、入院期間はNHAE-OTで約2倍長かった。NHAE-OTではNMDAR複合体に対する抗体が90.9%で検出された。
summary_en: Comparison of 95 patients with nonparaneoplastic non-herpetic acute limbic encephalitis (NPNHALE) and 19 with non-herpetic acute encephalitis accompanying ovarian teratoma (NHAE-OT). Onset ages were similar, and preceding infections were more common in NHAE-OT (89.5% vs 63.8%). Acute symptoms were similar, but hospital stay was much longer in NHAE-OT (209 vs 88 days). CSF findings did not differ significantly between groups. GluRε2 autoantibodies were found in both groups, and NMDAR complex antibodies were detected in 90.9% of NHAE-OT patients.

title: Unusual presentation of a dermoid cyst that derived from the bladder dome presenting as subserosal leiomyoma uteri.
title_ja: 膀胱ドームに由来し子宮漿膜下筋腫として提示された類皮嚢腫の非典型的な症例
summary_ja: 慢性骨盤痛の44歳女性で、子宮漿膜下筋腫が疑われた腫瘤が、切除後に膀胱ドーム由来の類皮嚢腫と判明した症例報告。膀胱の類皮嚢腫は稀で泌尿生殖器腫瘤と混同されやすい。この提示形式の初報告とされ、胚細胞腫瘍(成熟奇形腫)の性状を示す症例として参考になる。
summary_en: Case report of a 44-year-old woman with chronic pelvic pain. A presumed subserosal uterine leiomyoma, identified on examination and ultrasonography, proved on resection to be a dermoid cyst arising from the bladder dome. Dermoid cysts are benign tumors of ectodermal and mesodermal origin, and bladder occurrence is rare and easily confused with urogenital masses. The authors describe this as the first reported case of a dermoid cyst from the bladder dome presenting as a subserosal uterine myoma.

title: Oligodendroglioma arising in an immature ovarian teratoma: case report.
title_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫に発生したオリゴデンドログリオーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 18歳女性の未熟卵巣奇形腫内に発生したオリゴデンドログリオーマの症例報告です。腫瘍は嚢胞性奇形腫に密接に接し、「目玉焼き」様の細胞形態と鶏網状の毛細血管網を示しました。免疫組織化学でS-100が陽性、GFAP・シナプトフィジン・神経特異エノラーゼは陰性でした。術後24か月のフォローアップで無病生存を確認しています。胚細胞腫瘍内での体細胞型悪性転化の一例です。
summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman in whom an oligodendroglioma arose within an immature ovarian teratoma. The tumor closely involved the cystic teratoma and showed characteristic fried-egg cells and a chicken-wire capillary network. Immunohistochemistry showed S-100 positivity with negativity for GFAP, synaptophysin and neuron-specific enolase. The patient remained disease-free at 24 months of follow-up. The case illustrates somatic-type malignant transformation within a germ cell tumor.

title: Testicular mixed germ cell tumor metastasizing to heart.
title_ja: 心臓に転移した精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 21歳男性が、2年前に精巣腫瘍で左精巣摘除術を受けた後、発熱・喀血・呼吸困難で受診した症例報告です。既往としてαフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値、β-hCG正常がありました。心エコーとコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で心内腫瘤、縦隔腫瘤、胸水を認め、病理組織学的検討で精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と確定しました。精巣悪性腫瘍が心臓へ転移する稀な進展様式で、急性の循環不全や神経症状で発症しうることを示しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man who presented with fever, hemoptysis and dyspnea two years after left orchidectomy for a testicular tumor with elevated AFP and normal beta-hCG. Echocardiography and chest CT revealed an intracardiac mass, mediastinal masses and pleural effusion. Histopathology confirmed a testicular mixed germ cell tumor. The case highlights the uncommon cardiac metastatic spread of testicular malignancy, which can present with acute hemodynamic compromise and neurological symptoms.

title: An unusual presentation of testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんの非典型的な臨床像
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的な発症形式を示した2症例の報告です。1例目は精巣腫瘍の消化管転移により、不顕性の消化管出血を来していました。2例目は血清抗Ma2抗体陽性の辺縁系脳炎で発症し、後に悪性胚細胞腫瘍と診断されました。精巣胚細胞腫瘍が消化管症状や傍腫瘍性神経症状で初発しうることを示しています。
summary_en: This report describes two patients with unusual presentations of germ cell tumor. The first had metastatic testicular germ cell tumor involving the gastrointestinal tract, causing occult gastrointestinal bleeding. The second had limbic encephalitis with serum anti-Ma2 antibodies, and was subsequently diagnosed with malignant germ cell tumor. The cases illustrate that testicular germ cell tumors may first present with gastrointestinal or paraneoplastic neurological symptoms.

title: Mature sacrococcygeal teratoma: case report.
title_ja: 成熟仙尾部奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 生後10日の男児に生じた成熟仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告です。腫瘍内には発達した下肢、未発達な外性器、歯牙が含まれていました。尾骨切除を含む完全切除を行い、術後経過は良好でした。3年間のフォローアップで臨床・生化学・画像評価により再発はありませんでした。成熟型は新生児期には良性で、完全切除が治療の基本であると結論づけています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 10-day-old boy with a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma containing well-developed lower limb, rudimentary external genitalia and teeth. He underwent complete surgical excision including coccygectomy, with primary wound closure and an uneventful recovery. Follow-up at three years, including clinical, biochemical and radiological assessment, showed no recurrence. The authors conclude that mature sacrococcygeal teratomas appear benign in the neonatal period and that complete excision remains the mainstay of treatment.

title: Extragonadal teratomas presenting at birth and originating from 3 different sites--a report of 3 cases.
title_ja: 出生時に認められた性腺外奇形腫3例：3部位からの発生
summary_ja: 出生時に認められた性腺外奇形腫の3症例の報告です。発生部位は仙尾部、後腹膜、鼻咽腔の3か所で、仙尾部のものは巨大でした。病理組織学的に3例とも成熟型の良性奇形腫で、外科的切除のみで治療が完結しました。フォローアップ中に再発は認められませんでした。新生児期に後腹膜や鼻咽腔に生じる例はまれであることが強調されています。
summary_en: This report describes three neonates with extragonadal teratomas present at birth, arising from three separate sites: a large sacrococcygeal teratoma, a retroperitoneal teratoma and a nasopharyngeal teratoma. All tumors were mature and benign on histopathology. Surgical removal alone was sufficient treatment, and no recurrence was noted during follow-up. The rarity of the retroperitoneal and nasopharyngeal locations in the neonatal period is emphasized.

title: Fungating scrotal mass: A rare clinical presentation of testicular tumor.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍による露出性陰嚢腫瘤：稀な初発症状
summary_ja: 20歳男性が露出性の陰嚢腫瘤で受診した症例報告です。精査で肺転移を伴う精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断されました。全身化学療法により、陰嚢の腫瘤と肺転移の両方が消失しました。露出性陰嚢腫瘤は精巣腫瘍の稀な初発症状であり、英語文献では本例が2例目であると述べられています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man presenting with a fungating scrotal mass. Investigations revealed a testicular yolk sac tumor with lung metastasis. Systemic chemotherapy led to complete disappearance of both the scrotal mass and the pulmonary metastatic disease. The authors note that a fungating scrotal mass is a rare presentation of testicular tumor and that this is only the second such case reported in the English literature.

title: Adenocarcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した腺癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた濾胞型甲状腺乳頭癌の症例報告です。腹腔鏡下卵管卵巣摘出術の後、病期分類のための開腹手術を行いました。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化はまれで、術前の画像や腫瘍マーカーでも鑑別が困難であると指摘しています。確定病理で悪性が判明した場合は速やかな再手術が必要になりうると述べ、文献もあわせて概説しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman in whom a follicular-variant papillary thyroid carcinoma arose within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The tumor was treated by laparoscopic salpingo-oophorectomy followed by staging laparotomy. The authors emphasize that malignant transformation of a benign cystic teratoma is rare and cannot be reliably distinguished from benign disease preoperatively, even with imaging or tumor markers, so a second staging operation may be needed when definitive pathology shows malignancy. Literature on this entity is briefly reviewed.

title: An ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma with para-aortic lymph node metastasis: a case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来で傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴う卵巣粘液性嚢胞腺癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 41歳女性で、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する粘液性腺癌が傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴って認められた症例です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は稀で、扁平上皮癌が約75%を占め、腺癌は約6.8%とされます。本例のような粘液性腺癌での傍大動脈リンパ節転移の報告は過去になく、予後は極めて不良であると述べられています。
summary_en: A 41-year-old woman had mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, with para-aortic lymph node metastasis. Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is uncommon. Squamous cell carcinoma is the most frequent type, accounting for about 75% of cases, while adenocarcinoma occurs in only about 6.8%. The authors state that no previous report has described para-aortic lymph node metastasis from mucinous adenocarcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. They also emphasize the very poor prognosis of this complication.

title: 46 XY pure gonadal dysgenesis with gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma.
title_ja: 46,XY純粋性腺異形成に合併した性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ
summary_ja: 染色体46,XYで性腺異形成のある13歳の表現型女性例で、付属器捻転に対する手術中に性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマが確認されました。性腺異形成でY染色体を有する場合は悪性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高く、予防的な両側性腺摘出術とその後のホルモン補充療法が推奨されると結論づけています。
summary_en: A 13-year-old phenotypically female patient with a 46,XY karyotype and gonadal dysgenesis, consistent with Swyer syndrome, underwent surgery for adnexal torsion. Examination of the gonads revealed gonadoblastoma with associated dysgerminoma. The authors emphasize that a Y chromosome in gonadal dysgenesis carries a high risk of malignant germ cell tumor development. They recommend prophylactic bilateral gonadectomy followed by hormone replacement therapy, and they describe the treatment and follow-up.

title: Cystic mature teratoma and epidermoid cyst associated with granulosa cell tumour: a rare ovarian scenario. Two case reports and review of the literature.
title_ja: 顆粒膜細胞腫を伴う嚢胞性成熟奇形腫および類表皮嚢胞：稀な卵巣病変の2症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 顆粒膜細胞腫と嚢胞性成熟奇形腫、一部では類表皮嚢胞が併存した2症例の報告です。固形腫瘍に隣接する嚢胞性扁平上皮病変は、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内のカルチノイド腫瘍と誤認される可能性があります。両症例の所見を示し、鑑別診断上の問題点と文献的考察を行っています。
summary_en: Two cases are reported of an ovarian granulosa cell tumour occurring together with a cystic mature teratoma and, in one case, an epidermoid cyst. In one case the cystic squamous lesion was intimately connected with the solid tumour, and in the other it was contralateral to it. These combinations are very rare and can be misinterpreted on gross and microscopic examination, where a cystic squamous lesion near a trabecular or microfollicular solid tumour may suggest a carcinoid tumour arising in a mature cystic teratoma. The authors discuss the differential diagnosis and review the literature.

title: Ovarian teratoma with torsion masquerading as intussusception in 4-year-old child.
title_ja: 腸重積と誤認された4歳児の卵巣奇形腫捻転例
summary_ja: 5日間の間欠的な腹痛と嘔吐で救急受診した4歳女児の症例です。当初は腸重積が疑われましたが、手術で卵巣奇形腫による右付属器捻転と判明し、右卵管卵巣摘出術が行われました。小児では稀ですが、卵巣腫瘤を伴う腹痛では卵巣捻転を鑑別に入れ、早期診断で卵巣温存と合併症の低減を図るべきと強調されています。
summary_en: A 4-year-old girl presented to the emergency department with five days of intermittent abdominal pain and vomiting, initially suspected to be intussusception. Surgical exploration revealed right adnexal torsion caused by an ovarian teratoma, treated with right salpingo-oophorectomy. The authors stress that ovarian torsion, although rare in children, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of abdominal pain with an ovarian mass, because early diagnosis may improve ovarian salvage and reduce morbidity.

title: A young male with shortness of breath.
title_ja: 息切れを呈した若年男性：原発性縦隔セミノーマ
summary_ja: 息切れと前胸壁上部の腫脹を主訴とした若年男性の症例です。組織学的検査と免疫組織化学的解析で原発性縦隔セミノーマと診断され、腹部・骨盤・頭部のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、精巣の超音波検査、骨シンチグラフィでは他部位に病変はありませんでした。BEP化学療法を4コース施行し、治療8か月後の受診時には良好な状態でした。
summary_en: A young man presented with shortness of breath and a swelling over the upper anterior chest wall. Histology and immunohistochemical analysis confirmed a primary mediastinal seminoma, while abdominal, pelvic and cerebral CT, testicular ultrasound and bone scintigraphy showed no other sites of disease. He received four cycles of BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin). Eight months later he was well at clinic follow-up. The report illustrates an extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting with respiratory symptoms.

title: Primary gastric choriocarcinoma: two case reports and review of the literatures.
title_ja: 原発性胃絨毛癌：2症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 進行胃癌と初診された2例で、生検により原発性胃絨毛癌と診断されました。免疫染色でβ-hCG陽性、血清β-hCGの高値が確認され、性腺に原発巣はありませんでした。両例ともBEP、VIP、EMA/CO等の化学療法を受けましたが転移が進行し、初診から10か月および12か月で死亡しています。
summary_en: Two cases of primary gastric choriocarcinoma are reported, both initially diagnosed as advanced gastric adenocarcinoma. The diagnosis was confirmed by biopsy showing choriocarcinomatous components, beta-hCG positivity on immunohistochemistry and elevated serum beta-hCG, with no gonadal primary. Both patients received multiple palliative chemotherapy regimens, including BEP, VIP and EMA/CO, but liver and lung metastases progressed. They died 10 and 12 months after the initial diagnosis. The authors review the literature on this rare and aggressive entity.

title: Clinical and genetic aspects of testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的および遺伝学的側面
summary_ja: 15〜40歳の男性で最も多い悪性疾患である精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の臨床的・遺伝学的側面を総説しています。シスプラチンを基盤とした多剤併用化学療法により生存率が大きく改善し、セミノーマに対する放射線療法や外科的治療も進歩しました。家族歴は強いリスク因子ですが、高リスクの生殖系列変異は同定されておらず、家族集積の遺伝的基盤は未解決です。
summary_en: This review covers the clinical and genetic aspects of testicular germ cell tumours (TGCTs), the most common malignancy in men aged 15 to 40. Survival has improved substantially, mainly due to cisplatin-based polychemotherapy, with advances in surgery and in radiotherapy for seminoma. Family history is among the strongest risk factors, but no high-risk germline mutations have been identified, and a Y chromosome deletion (gr/gr) confers only a modest risk. The authors conclude that the genetic basis of familial clustering remains unresolved.

title: The role of surgical management in pediatric germ cell tumors (GCTs), NCI case series.
title_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)における外科的管理の役割：NCIの症例集積
summary_ja: 本後方視的症例集積は、国立がん研究所で8年間に治療された胚細胞腫瘍の小児33例を検討し、外科的治療の役割を評価したものである。ほとんどの患者は腹部膨満で受診し、61.8%が性腺、38.2%が性腺外に腫瘍を有していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍と悪性奇形腫が最も多い組織型であり、27.2%が転移性疾患を有していた。完全切除は無病生存期間の延長と関連し、切除不能例の全生存期間は同等であった。手術と化学療法の併用は、進行例や転移例でも良好な反応をもたらした。
summary_en: This retrospective case series of 33 children with germ cell tumours treated over eight years at a national cancer institute evaluates the role of surgery. Most patients presented with abdominal swelling; 61.8% had gonadal and 38.2% extragonadal tumours. Yolk sac tumour and malignant teratoma were the most common histologies, and 27.2% had metastatic disease. Complete resection was associated with better disease-free survival, while patients with irresectable disease had comparable overall survival. Surgery combined with chemotherapy achieved good responses even in advanced and metastatic disease.

title: Immature cystic teratoma of head of pancreas.
title_ja: 膵頭部の未熟嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 生後5か月の男児に発生した膵頭部の未熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。文献上18例の報告に続く19例目とされています。術前診断は困難で、確定診断は術中に得られました。小児の膵嚢胞性腫瘍は稀であり、本症はさらに稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍であることが示されています。臨床像と術前診断の課題が検討されています。
summary_en: This report describes a 5-month-old boy with an immature cystic teratoma arising in the head of the pancreas, presented as the 19th documented case in the literature. Cystic pancreatic tumours are rare in children, and this lesion is rarer still. A review of the world literature identified 18 prior cases across all age groups. Preoperative evaluation was uninformative, and definitive diagnosis was made intraoperatively. The paper discusses the clinical presentation and preoperative diagnostic challenges of this extragonadal germ cell tumour in infancy.

title: Antenatal diagnosis of large sacro-coccygeal teratoma with foetal cardiomegaly and hydrops.
title_ja: 胎児心拡大と胎児水腫を伴う大型仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断
summary_ja: 妊娠20週の初産婦において、大きな仙尾部奇形腫が出生前超音波検査で発見された症例報告です。腫瘤は不均一で嚢胞と石灰化を伴い血流増加を示し、胎児心拡大や胎児水腫も認められました。胎児水腫を伴う本症は母子ともに予後不良であるため、妊娠は中絶されました。出生前の超音波評価の重要性が指摘されています。
summary_en: This case report describes antenatal detection of a large sacrococcygeal teratoma at 20 weeks' gestation in a primigravida. Ultrasound showed a heterogeneous, cystic and calcified mass with increased vascularity, along with fetal cardiomegaly, hydrops, thickened placenta and polyhydramnios. Given the grave prognosis associated with hydrops, the pregnancy was terminated. The fetus was expelled with a ruptured, actively bleeding mass. The authors emphasise that sacrococcygeal teratoma with hydrops carries a poor outlook for both mother and child, underscoring the value of prenatal ultrasound assessment.

title: Malignant epignathus teratoma.
title_ja: 悪性エピグナトゥス奇形腫
summary_ja: 出生前超音波で顔面腫瘤が発見された新生児のエピグナトゥス奇形腫の症例報告です。帝王切開後に全切除されましたが、病理学的には悪性所見がなかったものの、2週間後に急速に再発し頭蓋内浸潤と閉塞性水頭症をきたしました。手術不能となり、生後5週で死亡しました。画像所見と攻撃的な経過が示されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a facial mass detected on antenatal ultrasound, later diagnosed as epignathus teratoma. After caesarean delivery and total excision, histology showed teratoma without malignant features, yet the tumour recurred rapidly within two weeks with intracranial involvement and obstructive hydrocephalus. It was inoperable at re-exploration, and the infant died at five weeks of age. The case illustrates the imaging features and aggressive course of a neonatal epignathus teratoma with malignant behaviour.

title: Malignant struma ovarii: good response after thyroidectomy and I ablation therapy.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫:甲状腺全摘と131Iアブレーション療法による良好な反応
summary_ja: 分化型甲状腺癌に類似した、稀な卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍である悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の3症例の報告です。全例で卵巣病変の切除後、甲状腺全摘と131Iアブレーション療法が行われ、良好な反応が得られました。フォローアップの腫瘍マーカーとしてサイログロブリンが有用とされています。核医学画像検査で転移を描出できる点も示されています。
summary_en: This report presents three patients with malignant struma ovarii, a rare ovarian germ cell tumour resembling well-differentiated thyroid carcinoma. All received surgical removal of the ovarian lesion, followed by thyroidectomy and radioiodine (131I) ablation; two had this as first-line management and one after metastatic disease developed. Thyroglobulin is suggested as a follow-up tumour marker, and radioiodine imaging can detect metastases. The authors conclude that a multidisciplinary approach with this sequence offers good response.

title: Leptomeningeal metastases in a patient with an extragonadal germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍における軟髄膜転移
summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を有する30歳男性が後頭葉の脳転移を発症した症例報告です。切除、全脳放射線療法、化学療法により一時的な完全寛解が得られました。その後、軟髄膜再発をきたし、救援化学療法にもかかわらず原病により死亡しました。胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移の予後は不良であり、有効な標準治療の確立が必要とされています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with an extragonadal germ cell tumour who developed an occipital brain metastasis. After resection, whole brain radiotherapy and further chemotherapy produced temporary complete remission. Leptomeningeal recurrence later developed, and despite salvage chemotherapy, the patient died of disease. The authors note that prognosis for brain metastases of germ cell tumours remains unsatisfactory and call for an effective standard treatment.

title: Ovarian dysgerminoma in two sisters.
title_ja: 姉妹に発生した卵巣未分化胚細胞腫
summary_ja: 14歳と19歳の姉妹にそれぞれ卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が診断された症例を報告する。20歳未満の女性の悪性卵巣腫瘍の約3分の2を占め、すべて悪性とされるが、攻撃的に進行するのは3分の1とされる。胚細胞腫瘍の家族内発生の報告は少なく、関連する遺伝子異常の研究も行われている。両症例の画像所見を併せて示す。
summary_en: This report describes two sisters, aged 14 and 19, diagnosed with ovarian dysgerminoma. Dysgerminomas account for about two-thirds of malignant ovarian neoplasms in women under 20 and are considered malignant, although only a third behave aggressively. The authors note that familial occurrence of germ cell tumors is rarely reported, and that some reports implicate specific genetic abnormalities. The cases are presented together with their radiological findings.

title: Benign cystic teratoma of mediastinum.
title_ja: 縦隔の良性嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 縦隔の巨大な良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を報告する。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍の約6割を占め、周囲臓器を圧迫することが多い。完全切除により根治が得られた。術後6か月の時点でも肺は胸腔に比べ小さいままであり、腫瘍による圧迫の影響が長く残ることが示された。
summary_en: This report describes a giant benign cystic teratoma of the mediastinum, which accounts for a large share of mediastinal germ cell tumors and often compresses surrounding structures. The patient underwent total surgical excision, which was curative. Despite removal, the lungs remained compressed and small relative to the thoracic cavity six months after surgery, illustrating the lasting effects of the mass on adjacent organs. The paper emphasizes that complete excision is curative and life-saving.

title: Scrotal pain as the first clinical manifestation of testicular seminoma: A case report.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの初発症状としての陰嚢痛：症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが陰嚢痛を初発症状として発症した症例を報告する。若年成人男性に最も多い悪性精巣腫瘍である。超音波検査では境界明瞭な低エコーで均一な腫瘤を示し、カラードプラでは豊富な血流が確認された。これらの典型的所見が正しい診断に重要であったと結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient whose first clinical sign of testicular seminoma was scrotal pain. Seminomas are the most common malignant testicular tumors in young adult men. Ultrasonography showed a hypoechoic, well-defined, homogeneous mass, and color Doppler revealed rich vascularity. The authors emphasize that these typical ultrasound and Doppler findings were fundamental for the correct diagnosis, supporting the role of imaging in evaluating painful scrotal masses.

title: Early onset of metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease after full-term pregnancy.
title_ja: 正期産後早期に発症した転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患
summary_ja: 正期産の2週間後に転移性絨毛癌を発症した28歳女性の症例である。肺病変があり、化学療法前のhCG値は84,000 mIU/mlであった。FIGOリスクスコアは8点で高リスク群に分類された。EMA/CO療法を7コース施行し完全寛解を得た。産後出血の際には妊娠性絨毛性疾患を念頭におき、hCG測定が早期診断に有用であると述べている。
summary_en: This report describes a 28-year-old woman who developed metastatic choriocarcinoma two weeks after a term delivery, with lung lesions and a pretreatment hCG level of 84,000 mIU/ml. Classified as high risk by FIGO scoring, she received EMA/CO first-line chemotherapy and achieved complete remission after seven courses. The authors highlight that postpartum bleeding may mask gestational trophoblastic disease and that hCG measurement can aid early diagnosis.

title: Surgical anatomy of large retroperitoneal teratomas in infants: report of two cases.
title_ja: 乳児の大型後腹膜奇形腫の手術解剖：2例の報告
summary_ja: 生後11か月と12か月の乳児2例の大型充実・嚢胞性後腹膜奇形腫について報告する。両例とも完全切除され、17か月を超えるフォローアップで良好であった。奇形腫は主に上腹部に存在し、膵臓を前方へ圧排していた。腫瘍による周囲臓器の圧排、血管の変形と延長、偽被膜による大血管の線維性取り込み、大動脈分枝の被包といった手術解剖学的特徴を報告している。
summary_en: This report describes two infants aged 11 and 12 months with large solid-cystic retroperitoneal teratomas, both completely resected and doing well at follow-up beyond 17 months. The paper focuses on the surgical anatomy of this rare tumor. Teratomas were mainly in the upper abdomen and displaced the pancreas anteriorly. Observed features included displacement of organs, elongation of retroperitoneal vessels, fibrous incorporation of large vessels by the pseudocapsule, and wrapping of aortic branches by tumor lobes.

title: Testicular mixed germ-cell tumor metastatic to the choroid.
title_ja: 脈絡膜転移を生じた精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍が脈絡膜に転移した21歳男性の症例報告である。超音波検査で厚さ10.3 mmの高エコー性腫瘤を認めた。ビンブラスチン、メスナ、イホスファミド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を開始し、6週間後に脈絡膜病変は完全に消失した。8か月後も再発は認められなかった。全身化学療法への迅速な反応が期待できると結論づけている。
summary_en: This observational case report describes a 21-year-old man with a 10-cm testicular mixed germ cell tumor that metastasized to the choroid of one eye. Ophthalmic examination and ultrasonography revealed a large dome-shaped lesion. Chemotherapy with vinblastine, mesna, ifosfamide, and cisplatin led to complete resolution of the choroidal lesion within six weeks. No recurrence was seen at eight months. The authors conclude that choroidal metastases from testicular germ cell tumors can respond promptly to systemic chemotherapy.

title: Adult type granulosa cell tumor of the testis: case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 成人型精巣顆粒膜細胞腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の21歳男性の症例を報告する。根治的精巣摘除術により良好に治療された。術後10か月の時点でのコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では、再発や転移の所見はなかった。タイトルは成人型顆粒膜細胞腫を指すが、要旨は精巣胚細胞腫瘍を中心に記述している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床・病理学的特徴、治療、予後を文献的に概説している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man with a testicular germ cell tumor, treated successfully with radical orchiectomy. Follow-up computed tomography 10 months after surgery showed no evidence of recurrence or metastasis. Although the title refers to adult-type granulosa cell tumor of the testis, the abstract centers on testicular germ cell tumor. The authors review the clinical and histopathological features, treatment, and prognosis of testicular GCT.

title: Treatment of infantile choriocarcinoma of the liver.
title_ja: 乳児の肝絨毛癌の治療
summary_ja: 重篤な状態で発見された乳児の転移性原発性肝絨毛癌の症例報告である。初回生検は行わず、画像所見と腫瘍マーカーで診断された。術前化学療法の後に外科的切除を遅らせて行い、診断から24か月間寛解を維持している。小児の極めて稀な悪性腫瘍では早期診断と迅速な治療開始が重要である。
summary_en: A case report of a critically ill infant with metastatic primary hepatic choriocarcinoma, diagnosed from radiographic and tumor marker findings without an initial biopsy. Management with neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by delayed surgical resection led to a successful outcome. The patient has remained in continuous remission for 24 months from diagnosis. The report emphasizes prompt diagnosis and treatment initiation for this extremely rare childhood malignancy, which can mimic benign and malignant liver tumors.

title: A congenital teratoma with a cleft palate: report of a case.
title_ja: 口蓋裂を伴う先天性エピグナサス奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 口から突出する巨大な先天性エピグナサス奇形腫と口蓋裂を合併した新生児女児の症例報告である。出生当日に口外部分の減量切除と口腔内からの摘出を行い、病理学的に確定した。6か月後に再発が認められた。奇形腫全体の2〜9%を占める稀な病態である。
summary_en: A case report of a newborn girl with a congenital epignathus teratoma, a large mass protruding from the mouth, associated with cleft palate. Debulking of the extraoral portion was performed on the day of birth, followed by intraoral exstirpation. Histology confirmed congenital epignathus. A recurrence was found six months later. Epignathus accounts for 2 to 9 percent of teratomas and may extend intracranially, making management difficult during and after birth.

title: Cytotoxic effect of zinc-citrate compound on choriocarcinoma cell lines.
title_ja: 亜鉛クエン酸化合物による絨毛癌細胞株に対する細胞毒性効果
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究はin vitroで亜鉛クエン酸化合物CIZARの効果を検討した。正常栄養膜細胞や腫瘍性栄養膜細胞株と比べ、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoの生存率を用量・時間依存的に選択的に低下させ、アポトーシスとテロメア短縮を誘導した。p21(WAF1)とBaxの上昇、Bcl-2の低下、caspase-3の活性化を伴い、悪性栄養膜細胞に対する治療的可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This in vitro study tested the zinc-citrate compound CIZAR on normal trophoblast cells, a tumorigenic trophoblast line (HT), and the choriocarcinoma line BeWo. CIZAR selectively reduced viability of BeWo cells in a dose- and time-dependent fashion, inducing apoptosis with telomere shortening. Apoptosis involved upregulation of p21(WAF1) and Bax, downregulation of Bcl-2, and caspase-3 activation. The authors conclude CIZAR is an apoptotic inducer in malignant trophoblast cells, suggesting possible therapeutic potential against choriocarcinoma.

title: Carcinoembryonic antigen and related molecules in normal and transformed trophoblast.
title_ja: 正常および腫瘍性栄養膜におけるCEAおよびCEA関連分子
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常胎盤、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などの妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の組織と細胞株におけるCEAの発現を検討した。CEAは妊娠全期を通じて発現し、GTDの形質転換した栄養膜では正常胎盤に比べ有意に増加していた(p<0.05)。絨毛癌細胞株や培養細胞栄養膜細胞もCEAを発現しており、CEA(CD66e)が栄養膜の分化に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) and CEA-related molecules in normal placenta, gestational trophoblastic diseases (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, a placental site trophoblastic tumor), primary cytotrophoblast, and JAr and JEG-3 cell lines. Immunostaining and Western blot showed CEA expressed throughout pregnancy, and significantly increased in transformed trophoblast of GTDs compared with normal placenta (p<0.05). Choriocarcinoma cell lines and cultured cytotrophoblast expressed CEA. The authors suggest CEA (CD66e) and related proteins may participate in trophoblast differentiation.

title: Frequent epigenetic inactivation of p53 target genes in seminomatous and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるp53標的遺伝子のエピジェネティックな不活化の頻発
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍46例(セミノーマ26例、非セミノーマ20例)と正常精巣組織15例で、p53標的遺伝子のプロモーターメチル化をリアルタイムMSP法で解析した。APAF-1は全腫瘍と正常組織の60%でメチル化が見られ、DAPK-1はセミノーマで頻繁にメチル化され病期と相関した。臨床病期Iの再発リスク評価のマーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Promoter methylation of p53 target genes APAF-1, CASP-8, DAPK-1 and IGFBP-3 was analysed by real-time methylation-specific PCR in 46 primary testicular germ cell tumors (26 seminomas, 20 nonseminomas) and 15 normal testicular samples. APAF-1 was methylated in all tumors and in 60% of normal tissue. DAPK-1 methylation was frequent in seminomas and correlated with clinical stage, distinguishing seminomatous from nonseminomatous and malignant from normal tissue. The authors suggest methylation markers may help risk estimation in clinical stage I disease.

title: Spinal cord compression of primary extragonadal giant yolk sac tumor.
title_ja: 原発性性腺外巨大卵黄嚢腫瘍による脊髄圧迫
summary_ja: 腰筋内に発生した原発性性腺外巨大卵黄嚢腫瘍により急性の脊髄圧迫を来した31歳男性の症例報告である。当初はポット病が疑われたが、腫瘍は第3腰椎を破壊し硬膜嚢を圧迫していた。前後合併手術で神経症状は改善し、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を行ったが、5か月後に敗血症で死亡した。若年男性の急性対麻痺では、精巣腫瘍の既往がなくても卵黄嚢腫瘍を考慮すべきと述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with a primary extragonadal giant yolk sac tumor in the psoas muscle who presented with acute spinal cord compression, paraparesis and urinary incontinence, initially suspected as Pott's disease. Imaging showed a giant cystic mass compressing the dural sac with third lumbar vertebral destruction. Combined anterior and posterior surgery improved neurological deficits, and chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin was given, but the patient died of sepsis five months later. The authors advise considering yolk sac tumor in young men with acute paraparesis even without testicular tumor history.

title: Expression of LINE-1 p40 protein in pediatric malignant germ cell tumors and its association with clinicopathological parameters: a report from the Children's Oncology Group.
title_ja: 小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍におけるLINE-1 p40タンパク質の発現と臨床病理学的パラメータとの関連：Children's Oncology Groupからの報告
summary_ja: 米国小児腫瘍学グループの162例を用い、小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍におけるLINE-1 p40タンパク質の発現を検討した。全例で発現が認められ、強発現は低分化、性腺外発生、卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型と関連した。活性化したLINE-1が小児胚細胞腫瘍に共通し、悪性転化に関与する可能性が示唆された。p40は腫瘍の悪性度を反映するマーカーとして期待される。
summary_en: This Children's Oncology Group study examined LINE-1 p40 protein expression in 162 pediatric malignant germ cell tumors. All cases expressed p40 to varying degrees, and normal testicular tissue showed weaker expression than tumor cells. Strong p40 expression was independently associated with poor differentiation, extragonadal primary site, and yolk sac tumor histology. The authors propose that active LINE-1 retrotransposition is a common feature of pediatric germ cell tumors and may contribute to malignant transformation, suggesting p40 as a potential marker of aggressive disease.

title: Prenatal diagnosis of a large fetal cervical teratoma by three-dimensional ultrasonography: a case report.
title_ja: 三次元超音波検査により出生前診断された大型胎児頸部奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠31週で診断された大きな胎児頸部奇形腫の症例報告である。二次元超音波検査とカラードプラに加え、三次元超音波検査の表面モードによる所見の有用性を強調している。頸部奇形腫は全奇形腫の約6%を占める良性腫瘍で、予後は病変の大きさや部位、気管圧迫の程度に左右される。出生前画像診断の重要性が示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a large fetal cervical teratoma diagnosed at 31 weeks of gestation using two-dimensional ultrasonography and color Doppler. The authors highlight three-dimensional surface-mode ultrasonography, which provided findings useful for indirect assessment of neonatal prognosis. Cervical teratomas are rare benign tumors representing about 6% of all teratomas, and prognosis depends on lesion size, location, growth rate, and degree of tracheal compression.
