The authors propose hCG-H as a cytokine-like modulator of invasion shared by implantation and these malignancies, suggesting potential therapeutic relevance.

title: Novel genomic aberrations in testicular germ cell tumors by array-CGH, and associated gene expression changes.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における新規ゲノム異常と関連する遺伝子発現変化（アレイCGH）
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍17例、前駆病変、胎児性癌細胞株を用いたアレイCGHと遺伝子発現の統合解析。12p染色体の増加が最も頻繁で、NANOGなどが過剰発現していた。新規の癌遺伝子候補と癌抑制遺伝子候補を同定し、精巣発癌の全ゲノム的理解に寄与する。
summary_en: Array-CGH and expression profiling were performed on 17 testicular germ cell tumors, precursor lesions, and two embryonal carcinoma cell lines. Gain of 12p was the most common aberration, with CCND2, CD9, GDF3, NANOG, and TEAD4 overexpressed. Integrating copy number with expression identified candidate oncogenes (BRCC3, FOS, MLLT11, NES, RAC1) and putative suppressor genes (DDX26, ERCC5, FZD4, NME4, OPTN, RB1). The study provides a genome-wide integrated view of testicular tumorigenesis.

title: Metastatic struma ovarii: late presentation, unusual features and multiple radioactive iodine treatments.
title_ja: 転移を伴う悪性卵巣甲状腺腫：晩期発症、非典型的特徴、複数回の放射性ヨウ素治療
summary_ja: 当初良性と診断された卵巣甲状腺腫が10年後に遠隔転移として現れ、病理再検で浸潤性濾胞癌と判明した症例。機能性転移に対し複数回の放射性ヨウ素治療を要した。腫瘍崩壊による甲状腺中毒症や脳脊髄液鼻漏も経験された。専門的な多職種による管理の重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: A patient with struma ovarii initially diagnosed as benign presented ten years later with distant metastases, and pathological review revealed invasive well-differentiated follicular carcinoma. The course included delayed recurrence diagnosis, functioning metastases requiring multiple radioactive iodine treatments, tumour lysis-induced thyrotoxicosis, and cerebrospinal fluid rhinorrhea. The authors emphasize management by an expert multidisciplinary team and consideration of radioactive iodine for metastatic disease.

title: Presentation of nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis with symptomatic solitary bone metastasis. A case report with review of the literature.
title_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における症状を伴う単発性骨転移：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性に、診断時に同時性の単発性恥骨転移を認めた症例報告。全身化学療法と局所放射線療法で制御された。文献上の類似3例を検討し、単発骨転移は化学療法と放射線療法に感受性がある可能性を指摘。有症状例では骨シンチや PET による病期分類を推奨している。
summary_en: A man with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor presented with a symptomatic, synchronous solitary pubic bone metastasis, which is uncommon at diagnosis. Systemic chemotherapy and locoregional radiation therapy controlled the lesion. The authors review three similar prior cases and suggest that solitary bone metastases may be chemosensitive and radiosensitive. They recommend bone scintigraphy or PET during staging for symptomatic patients and a combined cytotoxic approach.

title: Superior mediastinal syndrome in an infant caused by mediastinal teratoma: case report.
title_ja: 縦隔奇形腫による乳児の上縦隔症候群：症例報告
summary_ja: 生後3か月の男児が、巨大な縦隔奇形腫による上縦隔症候群を呈した症例報告。重篤な心肺障害があり緊急治療を要した。乳児期の縦隔奇形腫は生命を脅かしうる。小児腫瘍医、外科医、麻酔科医、集中治療医、放射線科医の密接な連携が治療に不可欠であると結論づけている。
summary_en: A three-month-old male infant presented with superior mediastinal syndrome caused by a large mediastinal teratoma, resulting in severe cardiorespiratory compromise that required emergency treatment. The report emphasizes that mediastinal teratomas in infancy can be life-threatening. Management requires close coordination among pediatric oncologists, surgeons, anesthesiologists, intensivists, and radiologists. The authors describe this rare case to illustrate the urgency of these tumors and the need for coordinated care.

title: Pre-operative differentiation of pediatric ovarian tumors: morphological scoring system and tumor markers.
title_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍の術前鑑別：形態学的スコアリングシステムと腫瘍マーカー
summary_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍53例(59腫瘍)を対象に、DePriestおよびUelandの超音波形態学的指標による良悪性の鑑別能を検討した。両指標は良性腫瘍の判別に高い感度と正確度を示した。腫瘍マーカーの上昇は17例にみられ、そのうち4例は内分泌症状を伴っていた。未熟奇形腫を含む症例を含め、24例で卵巣温存が可能であった。
summary_en: This study of 53 girls with 59 pediatric ovarian tumors evaluated whether ultrasonographic morphological indexes (DePriest's and Ueland's) could distinguish benign from malignant lesions. Both indexes performed well for identifying benign tumors. Tumor markers were elevated in 17 patients, and four had endocrine manifestations. Ovaries were preserved in 24 patients, including two with immature teratoma in dermoid cysts. The authors conclude that morphological ultrasound assessment, together with tumor markers and endocrine evaluation, is useful preoperatively.

title: Laparoscopic management of mature cystic teratoma of bilateral ovaries with adnexal torsion occurring in a 9-year-old premenarchal girl.
title_ja: 両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と付属器捻転に対する腹腔鏡手術：9歳未経初潮女児の1例
summary_ja: 9歳未経初潮の女児が急性腹症で受診し、両側付属器捻転と診断された。緊急腹腔鏡手術で捻転を解除し、両側嚢腫切除により両側卵巣を温存した。病理学的に両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。若年女児での両側捻転は極めてまれであり、将来の妊孕性温存のため腹腔鏡手術が望ましいと報告している。
summary_en: A 9-year-old premenarchal girl presented with acute abdomen and was found to have bilateral adnexal torsion. Emergency laparoscopy allowed detorsion and bilateral cystectomy, preserving both ovaries. Pathology confirmed bilateral mature cystic teratoma. The report emphasizes that bilateral adnexal torsion is extremely rare in premenarchal girls, that clinicians should recognize its presentation for prompt diagnosis, and that laparoscopy is preferable in young patients to preserve fertility.

title: Poor prognosis of intraoperative rupture of mature cystic teratoma with malignant transformation.
title_ja: 悪性転化を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の術中破綻に伴う予後不良
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の2例で、開腹および腹腔鏡下手術中に腫瘍の破綻が生じた。術後病理で扁平上皮癌への悪性転化が確認された。再手術の病期分類時に両例で腫瘍播種が認められ、術後の急速な進行が問題となった症例報告である。術中破綻と予後不良の関連から、腫瘍を破綻させずに摘出すべきと強調している。
summary_en: Two patients with mature cystic teratoma had intraoperative tumor spillage, one during laparotomy and one during laparoscopic cystectomy. Postoperative pathology revealed malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma. Both developed tumor dissemination at secondary staging surgery, performed 3 months and 8 days after the initial operation. The authors stress that mature cystic teratomas should be removed intact, since intraoperative rupture may be associated with rapid postoperative progression and poor prognosis.

title: Fetus in fetu or differentiated teratomas?
title_ja: 胎児内胎児か分化した奇形腫か？
summary_ja: 先天性奇形腫の2例に対し手術が行われた。腫瘍には肢芽、腸管、脳様組織、肺組織などの高度な臓器様分化がみられ、胎児内胎児との鑑別が困難であった。文献的検討を踏まえ、胎児内胎児は高度に分化した奇形腫であり、両者は別個の疾患単位ではない可能性があると論じている。
summary_en: Two cases of congenital teratoma were surgically treated. The tumors showed a high degree of organoid differentiation, containing rudimentary limbs, intestine, brain-like and pulmonary tissue, making them difficult to distinguish from fetus-in-fetu. Based on these findings and a literature review, the authors argue that fetus-in-fetu and teratoma may not be unrelated entities, and suggest that fetuses in fetu represent highly differentiated teratomas. The report is useful for understanding the pathogenesis and classification of congenital teratoma.

title: Laparoscopic management of dermoid cysts in patients of reproductive age.
title_ja: 生殖年齢女性の類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡手術
summary_ja: 1996年から2005年に卵巣類皮嚢腫を疑われて手術を受けた95例(17～49歳)を検討した。97.9%の嚢腫が腹腔鏡下に摘出され、嚢腫核出術が最も多く行われた。全例で病理学的に成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。腹腔鏡手術は安全で利点が多いが、術前の適切な適応判断が重要と結論している。
summary_en: This study reviewed 95 women aged 17-49 who underwent surgery for suspected ovarian dermoid cyst between 1996 and 2005. Most were treated laparoscopically, with 97.9% of cysts removed by this approach. Enucleation was the most common procedure, and oophorectomy the least common; the whole gonad was removed in about a third, mainly due to loss of functional ovarian tissue. Histopathology confirmed mature ovarian cystic teratoma in all cases. The authors conclude that laparoscopic treatment is safe and advantageous, provided careful preoperative patient selection is performed.

title: Pure choriocarcinoma of testis with tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and granulomas.
title_ja: 精巣の純粋絨毛癌における腫瘍浸潤リンパ球と肉芽腫
summary_ja: 精巣に発生した純粋型絨毛癌の症例報告。超音波検査で不均一な高エコー性の精巣内腫瘤を認め、hCGも上昇していた。腫瘍内にはCD8陽性細胞傷害性T細胞の浸潤と肉芽腫性炎症がみられた。腫瘍細胞はFasLを発現するがFasは陰性で、Fasの消失により宿主免疫からの逃避が生じた可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This case report describes pure testicular choriocarcinoma, a very rare entity, in which the tumor showed extensive infiltration by lymphocytes and granulomatous inflammation. Scrotal ultrasonography revealed a heterogeneous hyperechoic intratesticular mass, and serum hCG was elevated. Immunohistochemistry showed the tumor cells expressed cytokeratin 7, EGFR, human placental lactogen and p57. Infiltrating CD8-positive cytotoxic T cells expressed granzyme-B and TIA-1. The tumor cells were FasL-positive but Fas-negative, suggesting that the tumor escaped host immune attack through loss of Fas despite an active cellular immune response.

title: Malignant teratoma of the thyroid: case report.
title_ja: 甲状腺原発悪性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 37歳女性に生じた甲状腺原発悪性奇形腫の症例報告。小児の頸部奇形腫は良性が多いが、成人例は悪性で治療抵抗性の経過をたどりやすい。手術、術後のシスプラチンを基盤とした化学療法、頸部への放射線療法の集学的治療を行い、24か月のフォローアップで良好な結果が得られた。
summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old woman with primary thyroid malignant teratoma, an extragonadal germ cell tumor that is usually benign in infants but malignant and treatment-refractory in adults. She was treated with surgery, postoperative cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and neck radiation therapy. With 24 months of follow-up, the authors attribute the successful outcome to this intensive multimodal approach. The report highlights the rarity and poor prognosis of adult thyroid teratomas.

title: Treatment options, prognostic factors and selection of treatment in stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマにおける治療選択肢、予後因子および治療選択
summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する放射線療法、サーベイランス、補助化学療法の治療選択肢を検討した総説。いずれの方法でも治癒率はほぼ100%である。現在は、再発率約15%で多くが放射線療法で救済可能なサーベイランスが最適とされる。補助放射線療法は二次性悪性腫瘍や心血管死のリスクをわずかに高めるため、長期的な有害事象を慎重に考慮すべきと述べている。
summary_en: This review examines treatment options for stage I seminoma, including radiotherapy, surveillance, and adjuvant carboplatin chemotherapy. Cure rates approach 100% with any approach. Surveillance is now considered optimal, with a relapse rate of about 15% that is largely salvageable with radiotherapy, while second relapses are cured with chemotherapy. Adjuvant radiotherapy carries a small increased risk of second malignancy and cardiovascular death, so the long-term side effects of treatment must be weighed carefully, since most patients need no treatment after orchiectomy.

title: Expression of SpanX mRNA in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるSpanX mRNAの発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)におけるSpanX mRNAの発現を検討した研究。SpanX遺伝子群はTGCTの発症と関連するXq27領域に存在する。6例のTGCTをRT-PCRで解析し、SpanX mRNAが検出され、これらの遺伝子が腫瘍内で転写活性を持つことが確認された。SpanXタンパク質の機能は不明だが、腫瘍形成への関与が示唆されている。小規模な記述的解析である。
summary_en: This study examined expression of SpanX mRNA in testicular germ cell tumors. The SpanX gene family is located at Xq27, a locus associated with testicular germ cell tumor onset. RT-PCR analysis of six TGCT cases detected SpanX mRNA, confirming transcriptional activity of these genes in these tumors. The function of SpanX proteins remains unknown, but accumulating evidence suggests they may be involved in tumorigenesis. The study is a small, descriptive transcript-level analysis.

title: Inguinal dermoid cyst of the round ligament. A case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 鼠径部に生じた子宮円索類皮嚢腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 鼠径管内で触知と圧痛を伴い、子宮円索から生じた類皮嚢腫の27歳女性の症例報告。卵巣外のきわめてまれな部位である。文献的考察として、類皮嚢腫を類表皮嚢腫や成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と鑑別し、悪性転化や再発の可能性について論じている。臨床像、病理所見、鑑別診断の重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with a tender, palpable dermoid cyst arising from the round ligament within the inguinal canal, an extremely uncommon extraovarian location. The authors review the literature and distinguish dermoid cysts from epidermoid cysts and mature cystic teratomas. They discuss clinical presentation, pathology, and the potential for malignant degeneration and recurrence, which are important considerations in management.

title: Stable hematopoietic recovery after peripheral blood stem cell transplantation in patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy for advanced germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍に対する大量化学療法後の末梢血幹細胞移植における安定した造血回復
summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍の41例に対し、大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植(PBSCT)を計86回行った後方視的解析。年齢、CD34陽性細胞量、初回治療か救済治療かなどの因子を検討した。白血球、好中球、血小板の回復中央値は8～13日であり、血小板回復のみが年齢の影響を受けていた。PBSCTにより安定した造血回復が得られ、比較的安全に施行できると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 86 peripheral blood stem cell transplantations in 41 patients with advanced germ cell tumors treated with high-dose chemotherapy. Factors examined included age, CD34-positive cell dose, first-line versus salvage indication, and prior high-dose chemotherapy. Median recovery times to white blood cell, neutrophil, and platelet thresholds ranged from 8 to 13 days. Only platelet recovery was affected by age. The authors conclude that PBSCT supports stable hematopoietic recovery and that high-dose chemotherapy can be given with comparative safety.

title: Choriocarcinoma within the third trimester placenta--a case report.
title_ja: 第3期胎盤に生じた絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠31週の死産児の第3期胎盤に偶発的に見つかった絨毛癌の症例報告。肉眼的には梗塞と区別できず、病理学的に確認された。分娩時の母体β-hCGは上昇したが速やかに正常化し、転移は認められず、フォローアップでも転移性疾患の所見はなかった。
summary_en: A case report describing an incidental focus of choriocarcinoma found within an otherwise normal third-trimester placenta from a stillborn fetus at 31 weeks. Grossly, the lesion resembled an infarct and could only be distinguished microscopically. Maternal beta-hCG was elevated at delivery but normalized quickly. No maternal metastases were present at delivery, and follow-up showed no evidence of metastatic disease.

title: Of mice and men: teratomas and teratocarcinomas.
title_ja: 奇形腫と奇形癌：マウスとヒト
summary_ja: 三胚葉由来の組織を含む奇形腫と奇形癌を、マウスモデルとヒトのデータからレビューしたもの。胎児性癌細胞、胚性幹細胞との関連、仙尾部奇形腫の発生機序に触れる。ES細胞の治療応用時には、悪性転化のリスクを抑えるため自殺遺伝子の導入を推奨している。
summary_en: A review of teratomas and teratocarcinomas, tumours containing derivatives of all three germ layers, using mouse models and human data. It covers induction by embryo transplantation, embryonal carcinoma cells, links to embryonic stem cells, and human sacrococcygeal teratomas, which arise from primitive streak remnants. The authors recommend suicide gene introduction before ES cell use to mitigate malignant transformation risk.

title: Clinical and pathologic characteristics and prognosis of placental site trophoblastic tumor.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の臨床病理学的特徴と予後
summary_ja: 2000〜2005年に単施設で治療された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍11例を後方視的に解析した。先行妊娠の多くは胞状奇胎であった。全例に化学療法と子宮摘出術が施行され、9例が完全寛解、1例が部分寛解に至った。転移例では多剤併用化学療法と子宮摘出術が有効であった。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 11 patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor treated at a single centre in 2000 to 2005, among 635 gestational trophoblastic neoplasms. Most antecedent pregnancies were molar. Symptoms were vaginal bleeding and amenorrhea. All received chemotherapy and hysterectomy, achieving nine complete and one partial remission. Pathologic diagnosis with human placental lactogen staining was considered the gold standard.

title: Expression of thyroid transcription factor 1 (TTF-1) in extra thyroidal sites: papillary thyroid carcinoma of branchial cleft cysts and thyroglossal duct cysts and struma ovarii.
title_ja: 甲状腺外部位におけるTTF-1発現：鰓裂嚢胞および甲状舌管嚢胞の乳頭状甲状腺癌と卵巣甲状腺腫
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 甲状腺外の異所性甲状腺組織におけるTTF-1の発現を免疫組織化学で評価した。対象は鰓裂嚢胞内の正常甲状腺組織、鰓裂嚢胞および甲状舌管嚢胞由来の乳頭状甲状腺癌、そして卵巣甲状腺腫である。卵巣甲状腺腫は奇形腫の一亜型である。
summary_en: An immunohistochemical study of TTF-1 expression in extrathyroidal thyroid tissue. Samples included normal ectopic thyroid in branchial cleft cysts, papillary thyroid carcinomas arising in branchial cleft and thyroglossal duct cysts, and struma ovarii, a thyroid-type teratoma of the ovary. The aim was to determine whether this thyroid marker is expressed at these extrathyroidal sites.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumor--a challenging rare entity.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：挑戦的な希少疾患
summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の総説。中間型トロホブラスト由来で、β-hCG産生は少なく化学療法への感受性も低い。予後不良因子は妊娠からの期間2年超、40歳超、高い核分裂像数。転移・再発例にはEP/EMAが有効とされ、経過観察にはβ-hCGが最良の血清マーカーである。
summary_en: This review covers placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare variant of gestational trophoblastic disease. It arises from intermediate trophoblast, produces less beta-hCG, and responds poorly to chemotherapy, so simple hysterectomy is the mainstay of treatment. Adverse prognostic factors include an interval over two years since pregnancy, age over 40, and a high mitotic count. EP/EMA appears to be the most effective first-line regimen for metastatic or relapsing disease, and beta-hCG remains the best serum marker for monitoring.

title: Ovarian neoplasm composed of an insular carcinoid tumor and a borderline mucinous cystadenoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた卵巣インスリン様カルチノイドと境界悪性粘液性嚢胞腺腫の合併：症例報告
summary_ja: 57歳女性の卵巣に、右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じたインスリン様カルチノイドと境界悪性粘液性嚢胞腺腫の合併例を報告。左卵巣にも成熟奇形腫を認めた。原発性卵巣腫瘍としてきわめて稀な組み合わせであり、共通の発生起源の可能性を考察している。
summary_en: A 57-year-old woman had an ovarian neoplasm combining an insular carcinoid and a borderline mucinous cystadenoma, both arising within a right ovarian mature cystic teratoma. A mature teratoma was also present in the left ovary. The authors describe this as an extremely rare combination of primary ovarian tumors and discuss a possible common histogenesis for these lesions.

title: Benign thyroid teratomas manifest painful cystic and solid composite nodules: three case reports and a review of the literature.
title_ja: 良性甲状腺奇形腫は疼痛性の嚢胞性・充実性複合結節を呈する：3症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 思春期以降に発症し疼痛を伴う頸部腫瘤を呈した良性甲状腺奇形腫の3例を報告。嚢胞性病変は穿刺吸引やエタノール注入に抵抗性で、切除により膵、脂肪、軟骨、筋、皮膚を含む成熟奇形腫と確定した。
summary_en: Three patients presented with painful neck masses containing cystic and solid components that enlarged rapidly after puberty. Cystic lesions were refractory to drainage and ethanol injection. Resection revealed mature teratomas containing pancreatic, adipose, cartilage, muscle and skin tissue, lined by gastric, intestinal, respiratory and squamous epithelium. The authors review prior reports and characterize benign thyroid teratomas as a rare cause of painful cystic neck tumors.

title: Extensive deep vein thrombosis as a complication of testicular cancer treated with the BEP protocol (bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin): case report.
title_ja: BEP療法（ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン）による精巣がん治療に伴う広範な深部静脈血栓症：症例報告
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍で後腹膜・肺・肝転移を有する18歳男性。根治的精巣摘除術後にBEP化学療法を開始したが、予防的抗凝固なしで第1コース4日目に広範な深部静脈血栓症を発症。ストレプトキナーゼ療法を行い、急性腎不全を合併したものの良好な経過をたどった。
summary_en: An 18-year-old man with a nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor and pulmonary, hepatic and massive retroperitoneal metastases underwent radical orchiectomy and then BEP chemotherapy without thromboprophylaxis. On day 4 of the first cycle, massive deep venous thrombosis extended from both popliteal veins to the inferior vena cava. Streptokinase thrombolysis was started, but thrombus extension to the renal veins caused acute renal failure. Streptokinase was continued for six days and the outcome was favorable.

title: Successful resection of massively enlarged residual pulmonary metastases from a nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumor.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の巨大な残存肺転移の切除に成功した1例
summary_ja: 7年前に精巣摘除術とシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた25歳男性の、非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍による巨大な残存肺転移例。救援化学療法後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が正常化し、正中切開で切除した。病理では成熟奇形腫からなる転移性胚細胞腫瘍で、術後6年生存。
summary_en: A 25-year-old man had a nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor treated with orchiectomy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy seven years earlier. Massive residual lung metastases were resected after salvage chemotherapy normalized alpha-fetoprotein. Pathology showed metastatic germ cell tumor composed of mature teratoma. The patient has survived six years after resection, and the authors argue that metastasectomy can provide pathologic assessment of response and a chance of long-term survival.

title: Classical testicular seminoma in young man.
title_ja: 古典的精巣セミノーマを発症した若年男性の1例
summary_ja: 左精巣腫大を主訴とした29歳男性。β-hCGとAFPは正常範囲、CTで転移リンパ節を認めず、高位精巣摘除術の病理で典型的な精巣セミノーマと診断。補助療法としてBEP療法を2コース施行し、退院後6か月の時点で無病生存。
summary_en: A 29-year-old man presented with six months of left testicular enlargement and no other symptoms. Ultrasonography showed the testicular tumor, and CT showed no metastatic lymph nodes. Beta-hCG and alpha-fetoprotein were within normal limits. High orchiectomy showed typical seminoma. Two adjuvant courses of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin were given, and the patient remained disease-free six months after discharge.

title: Ovarian mucinous tumour arising in mature cystic teratoma and associated with pseudomyxoma peritonei: report of two cases and comparison with ovarian involvement by low-grade appendiceal mucinous tumour.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来し腹膜偽粘液腫を伴う卵巣粘液性腫瘍：2症例報告と低悪性度虫垂粘液性腫瘍による卵巣浸潤との比較
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じ腹膜偽粘液腫を伴った卵巣粘液性腫瘍の2例を報告。免疫表現型は虫垂低悪性度粘液性腫瘍の卵巣浸潤例と同一で、下部消化管（虫垂）型を示した。原発性卵巣腫瘍に伴う腹膜偽粘液腫は稀で、主に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来と考えられる。奇形腫成分の確認には卵巣の慎重なサンプリングが必要である。
summary_en: Two cases of ovarian mucinous tumours arising within mature cystic teratomas and associated with pseudomyxoma peritonei are described. Their immunophenotype (CK20, CEA, CDX-2, MUC2, MUC5AC) was identical to that of ovarian involvement by low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasms, supporting a lower gastrointestinal, appendiceal origin. The authors conclude that pseudomyxoma peritonei associated with primary ovarian neoplasia is rare and probably restricted to tumours arising in mature cystic teratomas, and that careful ovarian sampling is needed to identify the teratomatous component.

title: Mediastinal and retroperitoneal teratoma with focal gastrointestinal adenocarcinoma.
title_ja: 縦隔および後腹膜の奇形腫に伴う限局性消化管腺癌
summary_ja: 後縦隔の巨大成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が後腹膜へ進展し、その内部に消化管型腺癌が生じた症例報告。サイトケラチン20の免疫染色で消化管腺癌と診断。補助化学療法を行わず完全切除のみで2年以上良好な経過を得た。悪性転化を伴う奇形腫の侵襲性に注意を促し、限局性の転化では完全切除が治療として考慮されうると提案している。
summary_en: A case report of gastrointestinal-type adenocarcinoma arising within a giant posterior mediastinal mature cystic teratoma that extended into the retroperitoneum. Cytokeratin 20 immunostaining supported the diagnosis. Complete surgical excision without adjuvant chemotherapy led to a good outcome over more than two years. The authors highlight the aggressive potential of teratomas with malignant transformation and suggest that complete surgical resection without adjuvant chemotherapy be considered for teratomas with focal malignant transformation.

title: Stem cell marker OCT3/4 in tumor biology and germ cell tumor diagnostics: history and future.
title_ja: がん幹細胞マーカーOCT3/4の腫瘍生物学と胚細胞腫瘍診断：歴史と展望
summary_ja: 多能性の主要な転写因子であるOCT3/4(POU5F1)について、正常発生と胚細胞腫瘍における役割をレビューした論文である。OCT3/4は胚細胞腫瘍の最も有用な診断マーカーであり、性腺芽腫、上皮内癌、胎児性癌、セミノーマで発現する。著者らは、成人組織や非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍での発現、スプライシングバリアントと偽遺伝子、上流・下流の経路因子、エピジェネティックな制御、発がんにおける役割の可能性、高リスク群のスクリーニングへの応用について論じている。
summary_en: A review of OCT3/4 (POU5F1), a key pluripotency transcription factor, in normal development and germ cell tumours. OCT3/4 is the most informative diagnostic marker for germ cell tumours and is expressed in gonadoblastoma, carcinoma in situ, embryonal carcinoma and seminoma. The authors discuss expression in adult tissues and nongerm cell malignancies, splice variants and pseudogenes, upstream and downstream pathway factors, epigenetic regulation, its possible oncogenic role, and its application to screening high-risk groups.

title: Laparoscopic resection of adrenal teratoma.
title_ja: 副腎奇形腫の腹腔鏡下切除
summary_ja: 副腎に生じた成熟奇形腫の2例（8歳と61歳）を腹腔鏡下経腹膜的副腎摘除術で切除した。腫瘍はいずれも8cmの充実性病変で、ホルモン値は正常だった。1例で後腹膜貯留に対する経皮的ドレナージを要したが、両例とも再発はない。性腺外奇形腫は稀であり、腹腔鏡下切除は実施可能で腫瘍学的に有効と考えられる。
summary_en: Two patients (aged 8 and 61) with mature teratomas of the adrenal gland were treated by laparoscopic transperitoneal adrenalectomy. Both tumours were 8 cm solid lesions with normal hormone levels. Operative times were 120 and 50 minutes, and one patient developed a retroperitoneal collection requiring percutaneous drainage. Neither patient showed recurrence. The authors note that adrenal teratoma is extremely rare and that laparoscopic excision appears feasible and oncologically effective.

title: The management of stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理
summary_ja: 精巣の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療についての総説です。微小転移の予測因子として、リンパ管侵襲、胎児性癌成分、卵黄嚢成分の欠如、MIB1増殖率を挙げています。治療は神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清、経過観察、シスプラチン併用化学療法の補助療法から選択され、いずれも長期生存率はほぼ100%です。治療毒性と患者の希望を考慮した個別化が重要だと述べています。
summary_en: This review addresses management of clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. About half of NSGCT patients present at stage I. Predictors of occult micrometastasis include lymphovascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma component, absence of yolk sac histology, and MIB1 proliferation rate. After orchiectomy, options are nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, surveillance, or adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy. All approaches yield nearly 100% long-term survival, so treatment toxicity and patient preference should guide individualized care.

title: Endocrine-disrupting chemicals and testicular cancer: a case-control study.
title_ja: 精巣がんと内分泌撹乱化学物質：症例対照研究
summary_ja: 精巣がんの危険因子を、内分泌撹乱化学物質（EDC）曝露を中心に症例対照研究で検討しました。症例103例と対照215例の解析で、塗料や溶剤などを使う趣味活動はセミノーマと非セミノーマの両方に関連しました。思春期の農村部居住は全組織型とセミノーマに関連し、職業曝露とは関連がありませんでした。既知の危険因子も再確認されました。
summary_en: This case-control study of 103 testicular cancer cases and 215 controls examined environmental and occupational exposures. Hobby activities involving endocrine-disrupting chemicals, such as paints, glues, and solvents, were associated with seminoma and nonseminoma. Rural residence during adolescence was linked to all histologic types and to seminoma. Occupational exposures showed no association. Previously identified risk factors, including cryptorchidism, high education, and low birth weight, were confirmed, supporting a possible role for EDC exposure in etiology.

title: Sacrococcycygeal teratoma in adult: report of a case.
title_ja: 成人の仙尾部奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 51歳女性の成人発症の仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告です。仙骨部の腫脹、急性腰痛、腸機能障害を呈し、CTで石灰化を伴う骨盤内腫瘤を認めました。尾骨を温存して腫瘍を完全切除し、病理で成熟奇形腫と診断されました。術後経過は良好でした。乳児に多い腫瘍の成人例として、診断と治療を考察しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old woman with a sacrococcygeal teratoma, which is usually seen in infants. She presented with a sacral swelling, acute lower back pain, and bowel disturbance. Computed tomography revealed a calcified pelvic mass. The entire tumor was surgically resected while preserving the coccyx. Pathology confirmed a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma, and recovery was good. The authors discuss diagnosis and management of this rare adult presentation.

title: Testicular germ cell tumors in children: management and outcome in a series of 20 patients.
title_ja: 小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍：20例の治療成績と転帰
summary_ja: 1963〜2003年に治療された小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍20例の後方視的検討。成熟奇形腫・未熟奇形腫・卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型がみられた。奇形腫は精巣摘除術や精巣温存腫瘍摘除術で治療され、全例が無病生存している。卵黄嚢腫瘍では後腹膜リンパ節郭清や化学療法が行われた。治療は次第に侵襲の少ない方法へ移行し、良好な治癒率が示された。
summary_en: This retrospective series of 20 boys treated between 1963 and 2003 describes childhood testicular germ cell tumors. Histology included mature teratoma (7), immature teratoma (4), and yolk sac tumor (9). Most patients were stage I. Teratomas were managed with orchiectomy or testis-sparing excision, and all 11 survived without evidence of disease. Yolk sac tumor patients received orchiectomy with retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy or chemotherapy, and seven remained disease-free for 5.5 to 23 years. The authors note a shift toward less invasive treatment and excellent cure rates with prompt diagnosis.

title: Teratoma of the penis in a child.
title_ja: 小児における陰茎奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 生後3か月の乳児に発生した陰茎原発奇形腫の症例報告である。陰茎原発奇形腫は本症例で2例目、小児では初めての報告となる。奇形腫は三胚葉由来の組織を含む胚細胞由来腫瘍で、陰茎は稀な発生部位である。純粋奇形腫の大部分の治療は外科的切除とされている。
summary_en: A case report of a 3-month-old infant with a primary teratoma of the penis, only the second reported case of penile teratoma and the first in a child. Teratomas are germ cell-derived tumors containing tissues from all three germ layers, and most arise at midline or paraxial sites. The penis is an unusual location. The authors note that surgical resection is the treatment for most pure teratomas, and this report documents a rare extragonadal presentation in infancy.

title: Benign teratoma of the liver: a rare cause of cholangitis.
title_ja: 良性肝奇形腫：胆管炎の稀な原因
summary_ja: 成人男性の肝左葉に生じた良性成熟奇形腫の症例報告で、総胆管圧迫により閉塞性黄疸を来した。肝奇形腫は極めて稀で、文献上の成人例は5例のみとされる。性腺外胚細胞の発生学的成因についても概説し、胆管炎の稀な原因として示している。
summary_en: A case report of a benign mature teratoma arising in the left lobe of the liver in an adult man, which compressed the common bile duct and caused obstructive jaundice. Liver teratomas are very rare, with only five adult cases among 25 reported in the literature. The authors review the embryologic origin of extragonadal germ cells, which fail to migrate along the urogenital ridge, and the typical teratoma sites. The case highlights hepatic teratoma as a rare cause of cholangitis.

title: Testicular Germ Cell Tumors: A Paradigm for the Successful Treatment of Solid Tumor Stem Cells.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍：固形腫瘍幹細胞の治療成功モデル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍はシスプラチン併用療法により治癒率が高く、固形腫瘍治療の模範とされる。一方、一部の患者では毒性や耐性が治療効果を制限する。胎児性癌に含まれる未分化多能性幹細胞の生物学を踏まえ、がん幹細胞を標的とする治療への応用が論じられている。
summary_en: A review framing testicular germ cell tumors as a model for curing solid tumors. Cisplatin-based therapy is highly effective, yet toxicity and resistance limit outcomes for some patients. TGCTs contain embryonal carcinoma cells, undifferentiated pluripotent stem cells resembling human embryonic stem cells. The authors discuss the role of cancer stem cells in the initiation, progression, and treatment of solid tumors, and propose that TGCT biology may inform targeted cancer stem cell therapy for other solid tumors.

title: Malignant struma ovarii mimic clear cell carcinoma.
title_ja: 明細胞癌に類似した悪性卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 超音波検査で発見された卵巣腫瘍の22歳女性の症例報告。組織学的に悪性卵巣甲状腺腫（濾胞癌への悪性転化）と診断され、明細胞成分が優位であった。明細胞癌との鑑別が重要であり、甲状腺免疫染色が有用とされる。妊孕性を考慮して保存的手術が行われ、フォローアップ中のサイログロブリン値は良好である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with an ovarian tumor detected by ultrasound. Histology showed struma ovarii with malignant transformation toward follicular carcinoma, notable for a predominance of clear cells, which closely mimicked clear cell carcinoma. The authors emphasize thyroid immunohistochemistry and thorough sampling. Because she wished to have children, conservative surgery and follow-up were chosen, and thyroglobulin levels remained satisfactory.

title: Pure nongestational choriocarcinoma of ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣の純粋非妊娠性絨毛癌
summary_ja: 22歳女性に生じた、きわめてまれな卵巣原発の純粋非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。胚細胞由来と推定される。未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、ポリエンブリオーマとの混合型をとりうることが述べられている。文献レビューと腫瘍の起源に関する考察を含む。
summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with pure nongestational choriocarcinoma of the ovary, a very rare primary ovarian tumor presumed to arise from a germ cell. The authors note that such tumors may be pure or mixed with other germ cell tumors, including immature teratoma, dysgerminoma and polyembryoma. The report reviews the literature on this entity and discusses the origin of the tumor.

title: Pregnancy outcomes and menstrual function after fertility sparing surgery for pure ovarian dysgerminomas.
title_ja: 純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に対する妊孕性温存手術後の妊娠転帰と月経機能
summary_ja: 純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫23例に対する妊孕性温存手術後の妊娠転帰と月経機能を後方視的に検討した。再発は13%に認められ、手術と放射線療法で治療され、疾患死はなかった。治療後に妊娠し健康な児を出産した例があり、月経異常は17%に見られた。妊孕性温存治療は安全と結論された。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 23 patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated with fertility-sparing surgery assessed pregnancy outcomes and menstrual function. Recurrences occurred in 13% and were managed with surgery and radiotherapy, with no disease-related deaths. Several patients who attempted pregnancy after treatment delivered healthy infants. Menstrual problems occurred in 17% of patients. The authors conclude that fertility-sparing treatment is safe in pure ovarian dysgerminoma.

title: Case report: malignant teratoma of the sinonasal tract.
title_ja: 症例報告：鼻副鼻腔管の悪性奇形腫
summary_ja: 35歳男性の鼻副鼻腔管悪性奇形腫の症例報告。上皮成分と間葉成分からなる極めてまれな成人の腫瘍で、組織像の不均一性から診断が難しい。診断は腫瘍を完全切除するまで確定しにくいとされる。手術と放射線療法を施行したが生存期間は短く、本腫瘍の攻撃性の高さが示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a malignant teratoma of the sinonasal tract, a very rare adult neoplasm composed of epithelial and mesenchymal elements. Histological heterogeneity made diagnosis difficult until complete excision. The patient was treated with surgery and radiotherapy but survived only a short time, underscoring the aggressiveness of this uncommon tumor.

title: Mutations of BRAF and RAS are rare events in germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるBRAFおよびRAS変異はまれな事象である
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍62例（セミノーマ30例、非セミノーマ32例）でBRAFおよびRAS変異を解析。活性化型BRAF変異は非セミノーマの胎児性癌成分にのみ認められ、まれであった。KRAS変異は両組織型に存在した。ほぼ全例で活性化Erkが検出され、MAPK経路活性化の関与が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined BRAF and RAS mutations in 62 male germ cell tumors (30 seminomas, 32 nonseminomas) using microdissected tissue. Activating BRAF mutations occurred only in nonseminomas (9%), specifically within embryonal carcinoma components, and KRAS mutations were found in both histologies. Microsatellite instability was seen in 7% and always accompanied BRAF mutation in embryonal carcinomas. Activated Erk was nearly universal, suggesting MAPK pathway activation contributes to GCT independently of these mutations.

title: KCNQ1/KCNE1 channels during germ-cell differentiation in the rat: expression associated with testis pathologies.
title_ja: ラットにおける胚細胞分化中のKCNQ1/KCNE1チャネル：精巣病変との関連における発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ラット精巣でKCNQ1/KCNE1チャネルは未分化胚細胞に発現し、成獣では基底部の未熟胚細胞に限局した。胚細胞無形成を伴う精巣萎縮では発現が消失した。ヒトのセミノーマでは正常組織より発現が高く、胚細胞の発達や腫瘍性胚細胞におけるK+輸送への関与が示唆された。
summary_en: In rats, KCNQ1 and KCNE1 channel subunits were expressed in undifferentiated germ cells during testicular development and confined to basal immature germ cells in adults, but absent from Leydig and Sertoli cells. Expression was lost in spontaneous testis atrophy with germ-cell aplasia. In human seminoma samples, which consist of proliferating undifferentiated germ cells, KCNQ1/KCNE1 protein levels were higher than in healthy tissue, suggesting a role in K+ transport during germ-cell development.

title: Distribution of Y-chromosome-bearing cells in gonadoblastoma and dysgenetic testis in 45,X/46,XY infants.
title_ja: 45,X/46,XY乳児の性腺芽腫および性腺形成異常精巣におけるY染色体保有細胞の分布
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 性腺形成異常を伴う乳児4例が生後2年以内に性腺芽腫を発症し、15歳の1例では両側ディスジャーミノーマがみられた。モザイク型45,X/46,XY患者でFISHを用いたところ、性腺芽腫ではXY細胞株が形成異常精巣に比べて有意に多かった。著者らは、腫瘍が非常に若年で生じうることを示し、性腺の予防的摘出を支持している。
summary_en: Four infants with gonadal dysgenesis developed gonadoblastoma within the first two years of life, and one 15-year-old had bilateral dysgerminoma. Using FISH on mosaic 45,X/46,XY patients, the authors found that the XY cell line was significantly enriched in gonadoblastoma compared with dysgenetic testis. The findings show tumors can occur at very early ages, supporting prophylactic gonadectomy.

title: Pediatric ovarian tumors: a review of 67 cases.
title_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍：67例のレビュー
summary_ja: 3施設での1980～2003年の小児卵巣腫瘍67例の後方視的検討。55%が悪性で、未熟奇形腫が最多であった。腹痛が主な初発症状で、約半数に腹部腫瘤を触知した。ほとんどは片側性で、診断時の転移は少なかった。若年女児の腹痛では卵巣腫瘍を鑑別診断に含めるべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: This review of 67 pediatric ovarian tumors from three referral centers (1980 to 2003) found 55% malignant, most commonly immature teratoma, followed by malignant mixed germ cell tumors and juvenile granulosa cell tumors. Abdominal pain was the most frequent presenting symptom, and nearly half had a palpable abdominal mass. Tumors were usually unilateral and rarely metastatic at diagnosis. The authors recommend including ovarian tumors in the differential diagnosis of young girls with abdominal pain.

title: A brief history of the pathology of the gonads.
title_ja: 性腺病理学の歴史概観
summary_ja: 精巣と卵巣の腫瘍病理学の歴史を概説した総説です。セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）などの記載と分類の確立に貢献した研究者の業績が紹介されています。1970年代初頭のWHO分類に至る経緯を理解する上で有用な内容です。
summary_en: This historical review traces the development of knowledge on gonadal pathology, covering testicular and ovarian tumors. It highlights key contributions to the description and classification of seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, dysgerminoma, gonadoblastoma, and sex cord tumors, and the WHO classification schemes of the early 1970s. Notable figures such as Chevassu, Friedman and Moore, Teilum, Meyer, and Scully are discussed. The article also touches on pseudomyxoma peritonei and borderline ovarian tumors, providing context for how current germ cell tumor classification was established.

title: Malignant transformation of an ovarian mature cystic teratoma: computed tomography findings.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化：コンピュータ断層撮影所見
summary_ja: 46歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が扁平上皮癌へ悪性転化した症例報告です。下腹部の膨満感・圧痛と高いCA-125値を認め、CTでは脂肪、石灰化、軟部組織成分を伴う左付属器腫瘤が奇形腫壁を越えて浸潤する所見が示されました。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化は稀であり、CT所見が診断の手がかりとなることを示しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old woman with a one-year history of lower abdominal fullness and tenderness, an elevated CA-125, and a left adnexal mass. Computed tomography showed fat, calcification, and soft tissue components with invasion through the teratoma wall. Histology revealed squamous cell carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The authors emphasize that CT features such as wall invasion can help identify malignant transformation, which is rare in mature cystic teratoma.

title: Repeat retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in advanced testicular cancer.
title_ja: 進行性精巣がんにおける反復後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ型精巣腫瘍の転移に対して初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に再発し、反復後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた18例の後方視的検討です。病理では壊死・線維化が44%、成熟奇形腫が33%、生存腫瘍が22%でした。疾患特異的生存率は平均22か月で89%、生存腫瘍が残存した例では50%でした。専門施設で安全かつ有効に行えるとされています。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviews 18 patients who underwent repeat retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for recurrent metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer after failed primary surgery. Most recurrences were in the retrocaval and suprahilar regions, and several required vascular or renal resection. Pathology showed necrosis or fibrosis in 44%, mature teratoma in 33%, and viable germ cell tumor in 22%. Disease-specific survival at a mean of 22 months was 89%, and was 50% for viable cancer. The authors conclude repeat RPLND is safe and effective at expert centers.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumor: outcome of five cases including fertility preserving management.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍5例の転帰：妊孕性温存治療を含む
summary_ja: 1973〜2003年に診断された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)5例の臨床経過と治療成績を報告している。全例が性器出血を初発症状とした。限局例の1例には、標準的な子宮摘出術ではなく子宮鏡下切除と化学療法による妊孕性温存治療が行われた。EMA/EP療法の反復投与により、再発例でも寛解や治癒が得られたと述べている。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of five patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), diagnosed at one institution from 1973 to 2003, reports clinical presentation, treatment, and outcomes. Vaginal bleeding was the presenting symptom in all patients. One woman with localized disease underwent fertility-preserving treatment with hysteroscopic tumor resection followed by chemotherapy, instead of standard hysterectomy. Repeated EMA/EP chemotherapy induced prolonged remission and cure even in patients who relapsed after initial EMA/EP treatment. The authors suggest hysteroscopy plus chemotherapy may be an option for highly selected patients who wish to preserve fertility.

title: Familial female and male germ cell cancer. A new syndrome?
title_ja: 女性および男性の家族性胚細胞腫瘍：新たな症候群か
summary_ja: 女性2人と男性1人の同胞3人が胚細胞腫瘍を発症した家族例の症例報告である。第1子は卵巣悪性奇形腫、第2子は両側卵巣のディスジャーミノーマ、男性は精巣の胎児性癌とセミノーマを発症した。卵巣と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍には関連がある可能性が示唆され、新たな家族性症候群の可能性が提起されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a family in which three children, two females and one male, developed germ cell malignancies. The first sibling had malignant teratoma of the ovary, the second had dysgerminoma involving both ovaries, and the male had embryonal carcinoma and seminoma of the testicle. The authors suggest that germ cell tumors of both ovaries and testis may be associated, and raise the possibility of a familial syndrome affecting both sexes. The report highlights the rarity of such familial cases and recommends considering this association when evaluating relatives.

title: Second-line high-dose chemotherapy in patients with mediastinal and retroperitoneal primary non-seminomatous germ cell tumors: the EBMT experience.
title_ja: 縦隔および後腹膜原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する二次大量化学療法：EBMTの経験
summary_ja: 縦隔または後腹膜原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍59例に対する二次治療としての大量化学療法を、EBMT登録データで後方視的に解析した。全例が一次治療でシスプラチン含有化学療法を受けていた。無病生存は後腹膜原発で43%、縦隔原発で14%であった。後腹膜例では選択肢となりうるが、縦隔例には新たな救済療法が必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective EBMT registry analysis evaluated second-line high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) in 59 patients with mediastinal (n=22) or retroperitoneal (n=37) primary NSGCT, all of whom had received cisplatin-containing first-line therapy. Toxic death occurred in 5%. With median follow-up of 58 months, 30% remained disease-free, including 43% of retroperitoneal and 14% of mediastinal patients. The authors conclude that second-line HDCT may be an option for retroperitoneal primary NSGCT, while new salvage strategies are needed for mediastinal disease.

title: CpG methylation directly regulates transcriptional activity of the human endogenous retrovirus family HERV-K(HML-2).
title_ja: HERV-K(HML-2)の転写活性はCpGメチル化により直接制御される
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)で発現が強く上昇するHERV-K(HML-2)について、CpGメチル化による転写制御を検討した。GCT由来のTera-1細胞では、LTRのメチル化の程度と転写活性が相関し、in vitroでメチル化したレポータープラスミドは転写が抑制された。GCT組織の低メチル化が発現上昇の一因と考えられている。
summary_en: This study examines how CpG methylation regulates transcription of HERV-K(HML-2) long terminal repeats, a retroviral family implicated in germ cell tumor (GCT) development and strongly upregulated in GCT tissue. In the GCT-derived cell line Tera-1, 5' LTR methylation levels correlated with transcriptional activity, and in vitro-methylated reporter plasmids were silent. However, methylation alone did not explain LTR activity in T47D cells. The authors conclude that CpG methylation directly silences HERV-K(HML-2), and that hypomethylation in GCT tissue likely underlies its upregulation.

title: Congenital teratoma: a clinicopathologic study of 22 fetal and neonatal tumors.
title_ja: 先天性奇形腫：胎児および新生児腫瘍22例の臨床病理学的研究
summary_ja: 本臨床病理学的研究は、子宮内で水腫のため切除された8例を含む先天性奇形腫22例について、組織所見を初回血清AFP値および臨床転帰と関連づけて検討したものである。子宮内介入を要した胎児腫瘍はすべてグレード3の未熟奇形腫で、44%に通常型卵黄嚢腫瘍が混在していた。新生児の血清AFP値はすべて高値であったが、組織学的特徴とは相関しなかった。完全切除のみで治療された生存者では再発や転移はみられなかった。著者らは、臨床経過は主に完全切除の可否によって決まり、腫瘍のグレードや卵黄嚢腫瘍巣の有無とは関係しないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This clinicopathologic study of 22 congenital teratomas, including eight resected in utero for hydrops, correlates histology with initial serum AFP levels and clinical outcome. All fetal tumors requiring in utero intervention were grade 3 immature teratomas, 44% with conventional yolk sac tumor. Serum AFP was elevated in all neonates without correlation to histologic features. Among 15 survivors with follow-up, no patient developed recurrence or metastasis after complete surgical excision alone. The authors conclude that behavior depends mainly on complete resectability, not on grade or yolk sac tumor foci.

title: Sonographic and Doppler imaging in the diagnosis and treatment of gestational trophoblastic disease: a 12-year experience.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断と治療における超音波およびドプラ画像：12年間の経験
summary_ja: 中国の大学病院2施設で12年間に治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患355例を後方視的に解析し、超音波およびドプラ検査の有用性を検討した。抵抗係数は侵入性胞状奇胎や絨毛癌で低値を示し、正常妊娠と識別可能であった。侵入性病変の所見は化学療法の奏効とともに消失した。超音波とドプラ検査は診断、再発の検出、化学療法効果のモニタリングに有用と結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 355 gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) cases treated over 12 years at two Chinese university hospitals evaluates sonography with Doppler for diagnosis and management. Sonography identified molar tissue, invasive disease, recurrence, and chemotherapy response. Resistive indices differed among classic mole (0.55), partial mole (0.56), invasive mole (0.28), choriocarcinoma (0.25), and normal pregnancy (0.66). Invasive disease findings resolved when chemotherapy succeeded. The authors conclude that sonography with Doppler is helpful for diagnosing GTD, detecting invasive disease and recurrence, and monitoring chemotherapy response.

title: Gene expression profiling in seminoma and nonseminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマと非セミノーマの遺伝子発現プロファイル
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のセミノーマと非セミノーマについて遺伝子発現プロファイルを比較した研究である。マクロアレイ解析とRT-PCRの検証で、両群の発現パターンはほぼ逆向きであることが示された。組織学的な鑑別と整合し、識別に用いた遺伝子の約89%が逆向きの変化を示した。発生起源や腫瘍進展への示唆が議論されている。
summary_en: Gene expression profiles of seminoma and nonseminoma testicular tumors were compared using a 1,176-gene macroarray in 11 patients, with validation by RT-qPCR in an independent cohort of 19. Expression agreement between methods was 94%. Nonseminomas showed mainly downregulated genes, whereas seminomas showed mainly upregulated genes, and most differentially expressed genes in both entities changed in opposite directions. The authors conclude the two entities have almost opposing expression signatures, consistent with histological distinction, and discuss implications for origin and progression.

title: Secondary leukemia after first-line high-dose chemotherapy for patients with advanced germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 進行胚細胞がんに対する初回大量化学療法後の二次性白血病
summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループによる本解析は、進行精巣がんに対し初回大量化学療法と自家幹細胞支持を施行された323例における二次性白血病を検討したものである。1例が転座t(11;19)を伴う二次性AMLを発症し、累積発生率は0.48%であった。原発性縦隔胚細胞がんの2例が骨髄異形成症候群を発症した。固形腫瘍はみられなかった。著者らは、高用量エトポシドを含む初回治療の二次性白血病リスクは許容可能な低さであると結論づけている。
summary_en: This German Testicular Cancer Study Group analysis of 323 patients treated with first-line high-dose chemotherapy and autologous stem cell support for advanced testicular cancer assessed secondary leukemia. One patient developed secondary AML with a t(11;19) translocation, a cumulative incidence of 0.48%. Two patients with primary mediastinal germ cell cancer developed myelodysplastic syndrome. No solid tumors occurred. The authors conclude that high-dose etoposide-containing first-line therapy carries an acceptably low risk of secondary leukemia.

title: Trichomislin, a novel ribosome-inactivating protein, induces apoptosis that involves mitochondria and caspase-3.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞に対するトリコミスリンのアポトーシス誘導作用
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 栝楼由来のリボソーム不活化蛋白トリコミスリンが、絨毛癌細胞の増殖を抑え、アポトーシスを誘導することを示した前臨床研究である。細胞内に取り込まれ、カスパーゼ-3活性を上昇させ、シトクロムcをミトコンドリアから細胞質へ放出させる。臨床試験は行われていない。新規抗腫瘍蛋白としての可能性を示す基礎的知見である。
summary_en: This study characterizes trichomislin, a recombinant ribosome-inactivating protein from Trichosanthes kirilowii, as an rRNA N-glycosidase that inhibits protein synthesis. It inhibits growth and induces apoptosis in choriocarcinoma cells, binds and enters these cells, and increases caspase-3 activity. Cytochrome c shifts from mitochondria to cytosol, implicating the mitochondrial apoptotic pathway. The work is preclinical and cell-based, so clinical application in choriocarcinoma patients was not tested.

title: Radiographic and hysteroscopic findings of a placental site nodule.
title_ja: 胎盤部結節のX線像および子宮鏡所見
summary_ja: 続発不妊の30歳女性で子宮卵管造影により胎盤部結節が発見され、子宮超音波検査(ソノヒステログラフィ)と子宮鏡下切除で確定した症例報告。胎盤部結節は良性の妊娠関連病変であり、子宮内充填欠損の鑑別に含めるべきと述べる。診断と待機的管理が基本で、長期フォローアップは不要とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with secondary infertility in whom a placental site nodule was found on hysterosalpingogram. Sonohysterography and operative hysteroscopy with excision followed, and pathology confirmed a placental site nodule. The authors report one of the first radiographic and hysteroscopic descriptions of this benign gestational trophoblastic lesion. They emphasize including it in the differential diagnosis of uterine filling defects. The lesion is benign and is typically managed by diagnosis and expectant care, with long-term follow-up unnecessary.

title: From the archives of the AFIP: a comprehensive review of fetal tumors with pathologic correlation.
title_ja: AFIPより：病理学的相関を伴う胎児腫瘍の包括的レビュー
summary_ja: 胎児腫瘍の病理学的特徴と画像所見の対応をまとめたAFIP総説。奇形腫が主要な組織型で、頭蓋外・頭蓋内腫瘍の大半を占める。頭蓋外奇形腫は仙尾部に最も多く、後腹膜がこれに次ぐ。胎児の頭蓋内腫瘍は脂肪腫と脈絡叢乳頭腫を除き予後不良である。神経芽腫が最も多い胎児悪性腫瘍とされる。
summary_en: This AFIP review covers fetal tumors with pathologic correlation, noting that their behavior can differ from the same tumors later in life. Teratomas are the dominant histologic type and make up most extracranial and intracranial fetal neoplasms, often histologically mature but potentially lethal due to location and metabolic demands. Extracranial teratomas most often arise in the sacrococcygeal region, followed by the head and neck, chest, and retroperitoneum. Fetal intracranial tumors carry a poor prognosis except lipomas and choroid plexus papillomas. Neuroblastoma is the most common fetal malignancy and has a favorable prognosis when diagnosed prenatally.

title: Cystic ovarian teratoma with intracystic floating globules.
title_ja: 嚢胞内浮遊性球状体を伴う卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 閉経後女性に生じた卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。嚢胞内に浮遊する球状体という非典型的な画像所見を呈した。卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫は通常、脂肪を含む腫瘍として生殖年齢の女性に多く、画像診断で容易に診断されることが多い。本例は高齢者における画像診断の注意点を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a postmenopausal woman with an ovarian cystic teratoma showing an unusual radiologic feature: floating globules within the cyst. Ovarian cystic teratomas are typically fatty lesions found in women of reproductive age and are usually diagnosed easily by imaging. The authors highlight that this atypical intracystic appearance in an older patient can pose diagnostic challenges and should be recognized to avoid misinterpretation.

title: In vitro chemosensitivity test for human genito-urinary tumors using collagen gel matrix.
title_ja: 泌尿生殖器腫瘍に対するコラーゲンゲルマトリックスを用いた in vitro 化学感受性試験
summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器腫瘍を対象に、コラーゲンゲルマトリックスを用いた臓器培養による化学感受性試験を検討した研究である。胚細胞腫瘍（GCT）は他の腫瘍より薬剤陽性率が高かった。試験結果に基づき20例で化学療法を行い、予測精度は55%と中等度であった。進行GCTなどで感受性の低い薬剤を除外できる可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study evaluated a collagen gel matrix organ-culture chemosensitivity assay in 75 transitional cell carcinomas, 20 germ cell tumors, and 13 renal cell carcinomas. GCT samples showed higher drug-positive rates than the other cancers, and 20 patients were treated based on assay results. Predictive accuracy was moderate, at 55%, for combination chemotherapy. The authors suggest that the test may help remove insensitive drugs from regimens for advanced GCT and invasive bladder cancer.

title: Retroperitoneal seminoma with 'burned out' phenomenon in the testis.
title_ja: 精巣に「burned-out」現象を伴う後腹膜セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣に腫瘍の痕跡がなく性腺外に胚細胞腫瘍が存在する「burned-out」現象について述べた論文である。一次性の性腺外胚細胞悪性腫瘍よりまれとされる。治療は外科的切除を基本とし、補助化学療法や放射線療法を併用することがある。他の原発性性腺外腫瘍より予後は良好とされる。後腹膜セミノーマの症例が題名に示されている。
summary_en: This report concerns the 'burned-out' phenomenon in germ cell tumors, in which an extragonadal germ cell tumor is present without residual neoplasm in the testis. The authors note that this condition is less common than primary extragonadal germ cell malignancies. Such tumors are treated surgically, with or without adjuvant chemotherapy or radiotherapy, and have a better prognosis than other primary extragonadal tumors. The title indicates a retroperitoneal seminoma case.

title: Chemoresistant placental site trophoblastic tumor with hilar lymph node metastasis: an unusual site of involvement.
title_ja: 肺門リンパ節転移を伴う化学療法抵抗性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：まれな転移部位
summary_ja: 33歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）で、右肺門リンパ節への転移を認めた症例報告である。子宮全摘・片側付属器切除後にEMA/CO化学療法を6コース施行した。hCG値は正常範囲内だったがCTでリンパ節の増大が確認され、開胸切除で原発性PSTTと診断された。まれな転移部位と化学療法抵抗性が強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) metastatic to right hilar lymph nodes. After abdominal hysterectomy and unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, she received six cycles of EMA/CO chemotherapy. Although beta-hCG remained within normal range, CT showed enlarging hilar nodes, and thoracotomy with nodal resection confirmed primary PSTT. The authors highlight this unusual metastatic site and the chemoresistance of the tumor, reviewing prior reports.

title: Germ cell tumours of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の総説である。停留精巣が唯一確立したリスク因子とされる。診断には根治的精巣摘除術が推奨され、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、LDHが腫瘍マーカーとして用いられる。セミノーマと非セミノーマに分けて治療方針が立てられ、転移性疾患ではIGCCCGの予後分類が用いられる。
summary_en: This review covers testicular germ cell tumors, a relatively rare cancer accounting for about 1% of male cancers, with cryptorchidism as the only confirmed risk factor. It describes diagnosis by radical orchidectomy and the use of AFP, hCG, and LDH as markers. Seminoma and non-seminoma are treated differently, with high cure rates reported across stages. The IGCCCG prognostic classification for metastatic disease and ESMO follow-up guidelines are also summarized.

title: The expression of Cdk inhibitors p27kip1 and p57kip2 in mouse placenta and human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells.
title_ja: マウス胎盤およびヒト絨毛癌細胞JEG-3におけるCdk阻害因子p27kip1とp57kip2の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス胎盤の発育過程とヒト絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3において、Cdk阻害因子p27kip1とp57kip2の発現を検討した。p27kip1は妊娠後期に増加し、p57kip2は中期に高発現を示した。JEG-3細胞ではデキサメタゾン処理によりp27kip1 mRNAが顕著に増加し、絨毛癌細胞の増殖抑制に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitors p27kip1 and p57kip2 during mouse placental development (12 to 18 days post-coitum) and in human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells. p27kip1 rose toward late gestation, while p57kip2 peaked earlier, suggesting distinct developmental roles. In JEG-3 cells, p27kip1 mRNAs were low but markedly increased by dexamethasone, suggesting p27kip1 may restrain choriocarcinoma cell growth.

title: Absence of constitutional Y chromosome AZF deletions in patients with testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者におけるY染色体AZF領域の先天的欠失の不在
summary_ja: オランダの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者112例を対象に、末梢血DNAを用いてY染色体AZF領域の先天的欠失をマルチプレックスPCRで検討した。欠失は1例も検出されなかった。AZF微小欠失は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症や関連する不妊の主要な要因ではないと結論された。
summary_en: This study screened 112 Dutch patients with testicular germ cell tumors for constitutional deletions in the Y chromosome azoospermia factor (AZF) region using multiplex PCR on blood-derived DNA. No AZF deletions were detected. The authors conclude that large Y chromosome microdeletions are not a major contributor to testicular germ cell tumor development or associated reduced fertility, challenging a shared genetic basis under the testicular dysgenesis hypothesis.

title: Distinctive epigenetic phenotype of cancer testis antigen genes among seminomatous and nonseminomatous testicular germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマと非セミノーマにおけるがん精巣抗原遺伝子の特異的エピジェネティック表現型
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマと非セミノーマにおけるがん精巣抗原遺伝子(MAGEA1、MAGEA3、SYCP1)のメチル化と発現を解析した。MAGEA1とMAGEA3はセミノーマでは発現の有無によらず非メチル化であった。一方、非セミノーマでは発現が消失した症例でメチル化されていた。SYCP1は両組織型とも非メチル化を保った。
summary_en: This study examined methylation and expression of cancer testis antigen genes MAGEA1, MAGEA3, and SYCP1 across seminomatous and nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. MAGEA1 and MAGEA3 were unmethylated in seminomas regardless of expression, but methylated in nonseminomas when silent. SYCP1 remained unmethylated in both subtypes. The authors suggest nonseminomas lie between seminomas and somatic tissues in their methylation-regulated gene control.

title: Loss of the tumor suppressor gene PTEN marks the transition from intratubular germ cell neoplasias (ITGCN) to invasive germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精細管内胚細胞腫瘍から胚細胞腫瘍への移行におけるPTEN癌抑制遺伝子の消失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)から浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍への移行におけるPTEN癌抑制遺伝子の役割を検討した。PTENはほとんどの腫瘍で発現が低下していたが、ITGCNでは発現が保たれていた。10q23のヘテロ接合性消失が36%以上の腫瘍に認められた。PTEN/AKT経路は胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1の増殖制御に関与した。
summary_en: This study analyzed PTEN protein and mRNA expression in 60 germ cell tumor biopsies (32 seminomas, 22 embryonal carcinomas, six teratomas), 22 adjacent intratubular germ cell neoplasias, and 10 testicular controls. PTEN was lost in most tumors but preserved in intratubular neoplasia, indicating loss occurs after the in situ stage. Loss of heterozygosity at 10q23 occurred in at least 36% of tumors, and PTEN/AKT signaling regulated proliferation of NT2/D1 embryonal carcinoma cells via p27kip1.

title: p53 in human embryonal carcinoma: identification of a transferable, transcriptional repression domain in the N-terminal region of p53.
title_ja: 胎児性癌におけるp53：N末端の転写抑制ドメインの同定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のモデルであるヒト胎児性癌細胞において、p53のN末端に転写抑制ドメイン(p53-NRD)を同定した。このドメインはp53活性の基礎的抑制に関与する。レチノイン酸とトリコスタチンAの併用で抑制が解除されたが、RARγ欠損のRA耐性細胞では解除されず、RARγ導入で感受性が回復した。
summary_en: This study identifies a transferable transcriptional repression domain within the N-terminus of p53 (residues 90 to 116, named p53-NRD) that mediates the basal repression of p53 activity characteristic of human embryonal carcinoma cells, a model of testicular germ cell tumors. Repression is strongest in EC cells and is relieved by retinoic acid combined with trichostatin-A, but not in RA-resistant cells lacking RARgamma, which regained sensitivity upon RARgamma transfection. The findings suggest differentiation and transcription therapy agents modulate p53 latency.

title: Cardiac murmur prompting diagnosis of metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell testicular neoplasia in an 18-year-old patient.
title_ja: 心雑音を契機に診断された18歳の転移性非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 心雑音を契機に診断された18歳の転移性非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告した。精巣腫瘍は後腹膜や下大静脈、心臓へ転移することがある。心室内腫瘤を外科的切除した後に化学療法を行い、経過は良好であった。新規診断の精巣がん患者では心臓の異常所見を精査すべきと強調された。
summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old patient whose cardiac murmur led to diagnosis of metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor involving the ventricle. Metastatic testicular tumors can spread to retroperitoneal sites, the inferior vena cava, and the heart. Chemotherapy was delayed until the ventricular mass was surgically resected, after which the patient recovered uneventfully. The authors emphasize pursuing abnormal cardiac findings in newly diagnosed testicular cancer patients.

title: [A case of synchronous double cancer responding to UFT--dermoid cyst with secondary malignant transformation and uterine endometrial adenocarcinoma].
title_ja: 同時性重複がんに対しUFTが奏効した1例：悪性転化を伴う類皮嚢腫と子宮内膜腺癌
summary_ja: 35歳女性の右卵巣類皮嚢腫に二次性悪性腫瘍が合併し、子宮内膜腺癌が同時性に認められた症例を報告した。卵管卵巣摘出術と部分大網切除後に化学療法を行ったが、子宮再発と骨盤リンパ節転移のため根治手術は不可能であった。化学療法と放射線療法を拒否した患者にUFTを経口投与したところ、腫瘍マーカーが著明に低下し、QOLを維持できた。
summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old female patient with a newborn-head-sized right dermoid cyst containing a secondary malignant tumor, synchronous with uterine endometrial adenocarcinoma. After salpingo-oophorectomy and partial omentectomy, cyclic chemotherapy was given, but uterine recurrence with pelvic lymph node metastases precluded radical surgery. After declining chemotherapy and radiotherapy, the patient received oral UFT, with markedly reduced tumor markers and maintained quality of life.

title: Selection of choriocarcinoma-associated genes using bioinformatics.
title_ja: 生物情報学を用いた絨毛癌関連遺伝子の選定
journal: Di Yi Jun Yi Da Xue Xue Bao
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎3例、絨毛癌3例、正常絨毛を対象に、cDNAマイクロアレイで遺伝子発現を解析した。クラスター解析により絨毛癌関連遺伝子19個を選択し、うち3個はRT-PCRで確認した。これらの遺伝子は絨毛癌の進展や転移に関わる手がかりとなる可能性がある。
summary_en: This study used a cDNA microarray to profile gene expression in three complete hydatidiform moles, three choriocarcinomas, and normal placental villi. Hierarchical cluster analysis identified 52 coexpressed candidate genes in choriocarcinoma, and 19 were selected as choriocarcinoma-related genes, including dynamin, katanin p60, calmodulin, and TLE1. Three genes were confirmed by RT-PCR. The authors suggest these genes may provide clues to choriocarcinoma progression and metastasis.

title: Risk of childhood germ cell tumors in association with parental smoking and drinking.
title_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍のリスクと両親の喫煙および飲酒との関連
summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍274例と対照421例を用いた症例対照研究で、両親の喫煙・飲酒と小児GCTリスクの関連を検討した。父母の喫煙・飲酒のいずれも有意な関連を示さず、母親の受動喫煙にも用量反応傾向は認めなかった。出生前の両親の喫煙・飲酒は小児胚細胞腫瘍との関連を示さないと結論された。
summary_en: This Children's Oncology Group case-control study of 274 children under 15 with germ cell tumors (GCT) and 421 random-digit-dialed controls examined parental smoking and alcohol use as risk factors. Exposure data were gathered by independent telephone interviews and self-administered questionnaires. Neither parental smoking nor drinking was associated with childhood GCT risk, and maternal passive smoking during pregnancy showed no dose-response trend. The authors concluded that prenatal parental smoking and drinking are not linked to childhood GCT.

title: The loss of NKX3.1 expression in testicular--and prostate--cancers is not caused by promoter hypermethylation.
title_ja: 精巣および前立腺癌におけるNKX3.1発現消失はプロモーター高メチル化によるものではない
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)と前立腺癌でのNKX3.1発現低下が、プロモーター高メチル化によるかを検討した。原発TGCT 55例などに対しメチル化特異的PCRと亜硫酸水素塩シークエンスを行った。高メチル化はTGCTの1例のみに認められ、大部分の発現低下の原因ではなかった。クロマチンやヒストン修飾などの他のエピジェネティック機序が関与すると考察している。
summary_en: This study tested whether loss of NKX3.1 expression in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) and prostate cancer results from promoter hypermethylation. Methylation-specific PCR and bisulphite sequencing were performed on 55 primary TGCTs, 7 intratubular germ cell neoplasias, 3 germ cell tumor cell lines, and prostate tumors and cell lines. Promoter hypermethylation was found in only one TGCT, so it does not explain the widespread NKX3.1 downregulation. The authors suggest other epigenetic mechanisms, such as chromatin and histone modifications, are responsible.

title: Persistent gestational trophoblastic disease is rarely, if ever, derived from non-molar first-trimester miscarriage.
title_ja: 持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患は非胞状の初期流産からの発生はまれ、あるいはまったくない
summary_ja: ロンドンの妊娠性絨毛性疾患ユニットのデータベースを用い、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患が非胞状の初期流産から生じるかを検討した。非胞状流産と確認された510例からは持続性病変は生じなかった。遺伝学的に非胞状流産由来と証明された例はなかった。非胞状流産後の発症リスクは5万分の1未満と推定され、多くは未診断の初期胞状奇胎が原因と考察している。
summary_en: This study examined whether persistent gestational trophoblastic disease (pGTD) arises from non-molar first-trimester miscarriage, using a London trophoblastic disease unit database. Among 424 cases initially diagnosed as molar but reviewed as non-molar abortion, none of 510 non-molar cases developed pGTD. Of pGTD cases needing chemotherapy, none could be genetically proven to derive from a non-molar abortion. The authors estimate the risk of pGTD after non-molar abortion is below 1 in 50,000, suggesting most cases reflect unrecognized early molar pregnancy.

title: [Bilateral testicular tumors recurring 31 years after the initial treatment: a case report and the literature review].
title_ja: 初回治療から31年後に再発した両側精巣腫瘍：症例報告と文献的検討
summary_ja: 62歳男性が、31年前に右精巣摘除術を受けた対側精巣にセミノーマを発症した症例報告。超音波検査で左精巣に複数の低エコー腫瘤を認め、CTで転移はなく臨床病期Iと診断され左精巣摘除術を施行した。現在まで再発はない。日本における異時性両側精巣腫瘍166例の文献的検討も行い、長期フォローアップと陰嚢の自己検査の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 62-year-old man who developed a seminoma in the left testis 31 years after right high inguinal orchiectomy for an earlier testicular germ cell tumor. Ultrasonography showed multiple hypoechoic masses and microlithiasis, and staging CT revealed no metastasis, consistent with clinical stage I disease. Left orchiectomy was performed, and the patient has remained recurrence-free. The authors reviewed 166 previously reported Japanese cases of metachronous bilateral testicular tumors, noting that about half recurred beyond five years. They emphasize long-term follow-up and scrotal self-examination.

title: [Inguinal lymph node metastasis of seminoma 18 years after initial treatment: a case report].
title_ja: 初回治療18年後に発見された精巣セミノーマの鼠径リンパ節転移：症例報告
summary_ja: 63歳男性が、18年前に左精巣摘除術と傍大動脈・骨盤領域への予防的放射線療法を受けた後、左鼠径リンパ節にセミノーマの転移を来した症例報告。腫瘍マーカーは正常で、CTでは左鼠径部に3つの腫瘤を認めた。鼠径リンパ節郭清術で転移と確定した。精巣腫瘍の晩期再発は稀だが起こり得るため、長期的な経過観察の必要性を指摘している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 63-year-old man with a late relapse of testicular seminoma 18 years after left orchiectomy and prophylactic radiotherapy to the para-aortic and left hemipelvic fields. He presented with a left inguinal mass in 2003. Serum AFP, hCG, hCG beta and LDH were normal, and CT showed three inguinal masses without other abnormalities. Left inguinal lymphadenectomy confirmed seminoma metastasis. The authors highlight that late relapse of testicular tumors, although rare, can occur and that long-term surveillance is needed.

title: Prenatal magnetic resonance imaging as a useful adjunctive to ultrasound-enhanced diagnosis in case of a giant foetal tumour of the neck.
title_ja: 巨大な胎児頸部奇形腫の診断における超音波検査を補完する磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の有用性
summary_ja: 妊娠29週の胎児に生じた巨大な頸部腫瘤を、超音波検査で頸部奇形腫と診断した症例。超音波では咽頭と気管の評価が不十分だったが、胎児MRIで咽頭の変形と気管の偏位を確認した。これに基づきEXIT手技を計画・実施した。胎児MRIは分娩方法や気道管理の計画に有用であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes a 41-year-old woman at 29 weeks of gestation whose fetus had a large cervical mass, diagnosed by ultrasonography as a cervical teratoma. Fetal MRI clarified the displacement of the oropharynx and trachea that ultrasound could not fully assess. Based on these findings, an EXIT procedure was planned and performed at 30 weeks. The authors conclude that fetal MRI is a valuable adjunct to ultrasound for planning delivery and airway management in giant fetal neck tumors.

title: Transcription factor AP-2gamma, a novel marker of gonocytes and seminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 転写因子AP-2γ：生殖腺の胚細胞および精上皮腫（セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍）の新規マーカー
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、転写因子AP-2γがヒト卵原細胞および胚細胞腫瘍のマーカーであることを明らかにしている。AP-2γは妊娠12～37週の胎児卵原細胞で発現し、管内胚細胞性腫瘍、精巣および性腺外のセミノーマ、転移性セミノーマ、ディスジャーミノーマで強く発現していた。胚細胞癌および絨毛癌では限局的な染色のみで、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、正常成人精巣では陰性であった。著者らは、胚細胞腫瘍の検出にAP-2γ免疫組織化学を用いることを提案している。
summary_en: This study identifies transcription factor AP-2gamma as a marker of human gonocytes and germ cell tumors. AP-2gamma was expressed in fetal gonocytes from weeks 12 to 37 of gestation and was strongly expressed in intratubular germ cell neoplasia, testicular and extragonadal seminomas, metastatic seminomas and dysgerminomas. Embryonal carcinomas and choriocarcinomas showed only focal staining, while teratomas, yolk sac tumors and normal adult testis were negative. The authors propose AP-2gamma immunohistochemistry as a diagnostic tool for germ cell tumor detection, supporting a gonocytic origin.

title: Long-term outcome of postorchiectomy surveillance for Stage I testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 臨床病期I精巣セミノーマに対する根治的鼠径部精巣摘除術後サーベイランスの長期転帰
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1985年から1996年にかけて、根治的鼠径部精巣摘除術後にサーベイランス単独で管理された臨床病期I精巣セミノーマ患者88例を前向きに追跡した単群研究である。追跡期間中央値12.1年で17例が再発したが、大部分は横隔膜より下であり、全例が放射線療法または化学療法で救済された。セミノーマによる死亡はなかった。精巣網浸潤が再発の唯一の有意な予測因子であった。著者らは、救済治療を伴うサーベイランスが補助療法に代わる安全な選択肢であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This prospective single-arm study followed 88 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma managed with surveillance alone after radical inguinal orchiectomy between 1985 and 1996. With a median follow-up of 12.1 years, 17 patients relapsed, mostly below the diaphragm, and all were salvaged with radiotherapy or chemotherapy. None died of seminoma. Rete testis invasion was the only significant predictor of relapse. The authors conclude that surveillance with salvage treatment is a safe alternative to adjuvant therapy.

title: Long-term results of para-aortic irradiation for patients with stage I seminoma of the testis.
title_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマに対する傍大動脈照射の長期成績
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1991〜2000年に、根治的鼠径精巣摘除術後に傍大動脈照射のみを受けた臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ71例の前向き研究。中央値75か月の追跡で68例が生存し無再発であった。10年無再発生存率は98.5%で、晩期毒性は認められなかった。傍大動脈照射のみは安全で、骨盤再発のリスクは非常に低いと結論された。
summary_en: This prospective study evaluated the long-term outcome of 71 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma treated with adjuvant para-aortic irradiation alone after radical inguinal orchiectomy between 1991 and 2000. Patients received 25 Gy in 15 fractions. At a median follow-up of 75 months, 68 patients were alive and relapse-free, with only one inguinal relapse. The actuarial 10-year relapse-free survival was 98.5%, and no late toxicity was observed. The authors conclude that para-aortic radiotherapy alone is a safe treatment with minimal pelvic failure.

title: Genetic alteration of poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase-1 in human germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍におけるポリ(ADP-リボース)ポリメラーゼ-1の遺伝子変異
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 脳および精巣に発生した胚細胞腫瘍16例を対象に、PARP-1遺伝子を解析した研究である。既知のSNP 2種が検出されたほか、ある腫瘍でMet129Thr置換を生じる新規のATG→ACG変化が認められた。この変化は腫瘍組織と正常組織の一方のアレルに存在し、まれなSNPまたは生殖細胞系列変異が示唆された。Met129はDNA結合に必須の第2ジンクフィンガードメインに位置する。本研究は、PARP-1の機能異常が胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関与するかを検討するものである。
summary_en: This study analyzed the PARP-1 gene in 16 surgical specimens of germ cell tumors arising in the brain and testes. Two known SNPs (Val762Ala, Lys940Arg) were detected, along with a novel ATG-to-ACG change causing a Met129Thr substitution in one tumor. This variant appeared in one allele of both tumor and normal tissue, suggesting a rare SNP or germline mutation. Met129 lies in the second zinc finger domain essential for DNA binding. The findings explore whether PARP-1 dysfunction contributes to germ cell tumorigenesis.

title: Conservative management of small testicular tumors relative to carcinoma in situ prevalence.
title_ja: 上皮内癌の有病率を踏まえた小さな精巣腫瘍の保存的治療
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の手術検体41例を対象に、上皮内癌(CIS)の有病率を検討した。39例(95%)でCISが認められ、腫瘍周囲を含む精巣実質全体に分布していた。精子形成は29%で保たれていた。小さな腫瘍では腫瘍摘出と放射線療法が適切となりうるとし、妊孕性を望む症例では放射線療法の時期を遅らせることができると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study examined carcinoma in situ (CIS) in orchiectomy specimens from 41 patients with germ cell tumors under 40 mm. CIS was found in 39 of 41 (95%), distributed throughout the testicular parenchyma around and beyond the tumor. Spermatogenesis was preserved in 29%. The authors suggest that tumorectomy plus radiotherapy may suit small bilateral or solitary-testis tumors, and that radiotherapy after orchiectomy can be postponed in men wishing to father children with preserved spermatogenesis.

title: Late relapse of testicular germ cell neoplasms: a descriptive analysis of 122 cases.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発：122例の記述的解析
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発(初回治療終了後2年以上)について122例を後方視的に解析した。非セミノーマ72例ではαフェトプロテインの上昇が多く、100 U/l以上は予後不良と考えられた。再発は主に腹部、胸部、頸部のリンパ節に認められた。外科手術の併用により治癒率が向上し、純粋奇形腫の症例には長期のフォローアップが必要とされた。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 122 patients (50 seminoma, 72 nonseminoma) examined late relapse of testicular germ cell tumor, defined as recurrence more than two years after primary treatment. Median intervals to relapse were 42 months for seminoma and 64.5 months for nonseminoma. Elevated alpha-fetoprotein was common in late-relapsing nonseminoma, and levels above 100 U/l suggested poor prognosis. Relapses were mainly in lymph nodes. Cure failed in 37 of 72 nonseminoma patients versus 6 of 48 seminoma patients. Surgery improved cure chances, and patients with pure teratoma warrant long-term follow-up.

title: Randomized trial of 30 versus 20 Gy in the adjuvant treatment of stage I Testicular Seminoma: a report on Medical Research Council Trial TE18, European Organisation for the Research and Treatment of Cancer Trial 30942 (ISRCTN18525328).
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマの術後放射線療法における30 Gyと20 Gyの無作為化比較試験
summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ患者625例を対象に、術後の放射線療法として20 Gy/10分割と30 Gy/15分割を比較した無作為化試験である。治療4週後の倦怠感や就業困難は30 Gy群で多かったが、12週後には両群で同程度になった。中央値61か月の観察で再発は両群で10例と11例であった。20 Gyは再発率を標準的な30 Gyより3%以上高くする可能性は低く、副作用の軽減により早期の復職が可能になると結論づけた。
summary_en: This randomized trial (MRC TE18/EORTC 30942) compared 20 Gy in 10 fractions with 30 Gy in 15 fractions as adjuvant therapy after orchidectomy for stage I testicular seminoma in 625 patients. Lethargy and work inability were greater with 30 Gy at four weeks but were similar by 12 weeks. With median follow-up of 61 months, there were 10 and 11 relapses, with an absolute 2-year difference of 0.7%. The authors conclude that 20 Gy is unlikely to raise relapse rates more than 3% and reduces morbidity, allowing faster return to work.

title: Outcome and prognostic factors in ovarian germ cell malignancies.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍の予後因子と転帰
summary_ja: 本研究は1984〜2003年に長庚記念病院で治療された卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍93例の後方視的解析である。ディスジャーミノーマと未熟奇形腫が多く、初回治療施設での5年生存率は97.4%と良好であった。組織型とFIGO病期が治療失敗と関連し、組織型、救援大量化学療法、救援手術後の残存腫瘍が全生存期間の予後因子であった。再発例には大量化学療法と救援手術の積極的な併用が必要とされる。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 93 patients with ovarian germ cell malignancies from Chang Gung Memorial Hospital (1984-2003) analyzed outcomes and prognostic factors. Dysgerminoma and immature teratoma predominated, followed by endodermal sinus tumor and mixed germ cell tumor, with rare choriocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma. The 5-year survival was 97.4% among patients primarily treated at the center. Histology and FIGO stage predicted treatment failure, while histology, salvage high-dose chemotherapy, and residual tumor after salvage surgery predicted overall survival. The authors conclude that standard initial treatment yields excellent prognosis, and recurrent disease benefits from aggressive high-dose chemotherapy with salvage surgery.

title: Prolonged survival following salvage surgery for chemorefractory ovarian immature teratoma: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 化学療法抵抗性卵巣未熟奇形腫に対する救援手術後の長期生存：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 28歳女性のステージIIIC・grade 3卵巣未熟奇形腫の症例報告である。初回減量手術と白金製剤による化学療法を受けたが、セカンドルック手術で残存病変が認められ、二次化学療法も無効であった。その後の積極的な二次減量手術により48か月以上の無病生存が得られた。化学療法抵抗性の未熟奇形腫では救援手術が特定の症例で役割を持つ可能性があり、有効な患者の選別にはさらなる研究が必要である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with stage IIIC grade 3 ovarian immature teratoma treated with primary cytoreductive surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy. Residual disease at second-look surgery prompted second-line chemotherapy, which failed. Aggressive secondary debulking was then performed, resulting in disease-free survival exceeding 48 months. The authors review the literature and suggest salvage surgery has a distinct role in selected chemorefractory immature teratoma, while noting that further studies are needed to identify the patients who benefit most.

title: Pure gastric yolk sac tumor that was diagnosed after curative resection: case report and review of literature.
title_ja: 根治切除後に診断された純粋型胃卵黄嚢腫瘍：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 87歳男性の胃噴門部低分化腺癌に対し胃全摘術が行われたが、術後の病理組織学的検査で腺癌成分を含まない純粋型胃卵黄嚢腫瘍と判明した。根治切除とされたが、術後5か月で腹腔内リンパ節腫大とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇が出現し、2か月後に死亡した。胃卵黄嚢腫瘍は極めて稀で、純粋型の報告は本例が2例目である。
summary_en: An 87-year-old man underwent total gastrectomy for a presumed poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma of the gastric cardia. Postoperative histology revealed a pure gastric yolk sac tumor without adenocarcinoma components, and the resection was considered curative. Five months later, intra-abdominal lymph node enlargement and elevated serum AFP appeared, and the patient died two months afterward. The authors note that only six gastric yolk sac tumors had been previously reported, five with adenocarcinoma components, making this the second report of a pure form.

title: Paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis in a teenage girl with an immature ovarian teratoma.
title_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫を伴った14歳女児の傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎
summary_ja: 14歳女児が行動異常から急速に昏睡へ進行し、髄液細胞増多を認めた。10週後に未熟卵巣奇形腫が発見された。腫瘍摘出後に症状はわずかに改善したが、リハビリテーション中に死亡した。進行性の辺縁系症状と髄液細胞増多を示す思春期女児では、卵巣奇形腫を背景とする傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎を考慮すべきと述べている。
summary_en: This report describes a 14-year-old girl whose behavioral disturbance rapidly progressed to coma, with CSF pleocytosis and no or only mild MRI abnormality. An immature ovarian teratoma was identified ten weeks later. Her symptoms improved slightly after tumor excision, but she died during rehabilitation. The authors emphasize that paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis should be considered in teenage girls with progressive limbic symptoms and CSF pleocytosis, and that an underlying ovarian teratoma should be sought.

title: Trichoptysis caused by intrapulmonary teratoma: computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging findings.
title_ja: 肺内奇形腫による喀毛症(トリコプトイシス)：コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見
summary_ja: 9歳児が肺内奇形腫に起因する喀毛症(トリコプトイシス)を呈した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で嚢胞成分と充実成分を含む不均一な腫瘤が認められ、病理組織学的検査で奇形腫と確定した。小児で肺実質から生じる奇形腫は極めて稀であり、胸部奇形腫の好発部位は縦隔前部である。画像所見と鑑別診断を論じている。
summary_en: A 9-year-old child presented with trichoptysis caused by an intrapulmonary teratoma. CT and MRI showed a heterogeneous mass with cystic and solid components, and histopathological examination confirmed teratoma. The authors note that teratomas arising in lung parenchyma are extremely rare in childhood, whereas the anterior mediastinum is the most common thoracic site. The report discusses the imaging findings and the differential diagnosis of thoracic teratomas.

title: Intrauterine torsion of a testicular teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫の子宮内捻転：症例報告
summary_ja: 早産で出生した男児が出生直後に右陰嚢の腫脹を示した。手術で、分化の高い奇形腫と出血性梗塞を伴う腟膜外捻転が判明し、精巣摘除術が施行された。奇形腫を伴う下降精巣の子宮内捻転の初報告である。12か月間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。新生児の陰嚢腫脹の鑑別診断に精巣腫瘍を含めるべきと強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a preterm male newborn with right hemiscrotal swelling immediately after birth. Surgery revealed extravaginal torsion of a descended testis containing a highly differentiated teratoma with hemorrhagic infarction, and orchiectomy was performed. The authors state this is the first report of intrauterine torsion of a descended testis with a teratomatous tumor. No recurrence was found over twelve months of follow-up. They emphasize that testicular tumors should be included in the differential diagnosis of neonatal scrotal swelling.

title: Primary embryonal carcinoma of the orbit in a 10-month-old female: a seven-year follow-up.
title_ja: 10か月女児に生じた原発性眼窩胎児性癌：7年間のフォローアップ
summary_ja: 生後10か月の女児が進行性の眼球突出と眼球運動麻痺で受診し、CTで眼窩尖端部に腫瘤を認めた。生検で胎児性癌と診断され、多剤併用化学療法により7年後も腫瘍は認められていない。眼窩原発の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は、若年児の眼球突出の鑑別診断に含めるべきと著者らは述べている。
summary_en: A 10-month-old girl presented with progressive proptosis and ophthalmoplegia. Computed tomography showed an orbital apex mass, and biopsy revealed embryonal carcinoma, a non-gonadal germ cell tumor. She was treated with multimodality chemotherapy and remained tumor-free at 7 years, with mild amblyopia and microesotropia. The authors review intracranial and intraorbital GCT cases and argue that orbital GCTs should be considered in the differential diagnosis of young children with proptosis, since accurate identification and treatment markedly improve survival.

title: Analysis of p16INK4A gene promoter in male germ-cell tumors: identification of a new point mutation.
title_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍におけるp16INK4A遺伝子プロモーターの解析：新規点突然変異の同定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: セミノーマ19例のDNAについてCDKN2プロモーターの変異を解析した。1例で位置-1973へのアデニン挿入が同定され、免疫組織化学染色でp16INK4Aタンパク発現の消失と相関した。既知の機序に加え、一部のセミノーマにおけるp16INK4A発現異常の一因となる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Seminoma DNAs from 19 patients were screened for CDKN2 promoter mutations to explain aberrant p16INK4A expression in male germ-cell tumors. PCR-SSCP and sequencing identified an adenine insertion at position -1973 in one patient. Immunohistochemistry showed that this promoter mutation correlated with loss of p16INK4A protein expression. The authors suggest that this mutation may contribute to altered p16INK4A expression in at least some seminomas, in addition to previously described mechanisms.

title: Human endogenous retrovirus rec interferes with germ cell development in mice and may cause carcinoma in situ, the predecessor lesion of germ cell tumors.
title_ja: マウスにおいてヒト内在性レトロウイルスrecは胚細胞の発生を妨げ、胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変である上皮内癌を引き起こす可能性がある
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍ではHERV-K由来のrec転写産物が高発現している。HERV-K recを誘導的に発現させたマウスでは胚細胞の発生が障害され、19か月齢までに古典的セミノーマの前駆病変である上皮内癌様の変化を示すことがあった。内在性レトロウイルス遺伝子が臓器特異的な発がんに寄与しうることを示す初の直接的証拠である。
summary_en: Patients with germ cell tumors often have serum antibodies against HERV-K proteins, and HERV-K env and rec transcripts are highly expressed in these tumors. The authors generated mice with inducible expression of HERV-K rec. These mice showed disturbed germ cell development and, by 19 months of age, some developed changes resembling carcinoma in situ, the precursor lesion of classic seminoma. This provides direct evidence that an endogenous retroviral gene can contribute to organ-specific tumorigenesis.

title: Testicular germ-cell tumours in a broader perspective.
title_ja: 広い視点でみた精巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍は臓器別に分類されてきたが、本総説では異なる解剖学的部位に生じうる5つの病型からなる一つの疾患として捉えることが提案されている。各病型の発生能は起源となる胚細胞の成熟段階とインプリンティング状態で決まる。この枠組みは、予測困難な進展や治療感受性の高さの理解に役立つとされる。
summary_en: This review proposes that germ cell tumors, traditionally classified by organ, are a single disease expressed as five entities that can arise at different anatomical sites. The developmental potential of each entity is determined by the maturation stage and imprinting status of the originating germ cell.
