Patients treated for invasive mole have had no problems with later pregnancy, but multi-agent chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma has been linked to heart malformations in some newborns, and preserving oocytes during treatment remains a concern.

title: Preoperative diagnosis of malignant transformation in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における悪性転化の術前診断
summary_ja: 本後方視的症例集積は、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫278例で悪性転化を術前に予測できるかを検討した。悪性転化は、腫瘍径10cm以上の11%、治療前SCC 2.0ng/ml以上の23%、60歳以上の13%、片側腫瘍の2%で認められた。悪性例は良性例より腫瘍径とSCCが有意に高かった。60歳以上で片側性、10cm以上かつSCC 2.0ng/ml以下の症例が高リスク群となる可能性がある。
summary_en: This retrospective case series of 278 patients with ovarian mature cystic teratoma analyzed tumor size, MRI and ultrasound findings, and preoperative tumor markers to predict malignant transformation. Malignancy was found in 11% of tumors 10 cm or larger, 23% with pretreatment SCC of 2.0 ng/ml or higher, 13% in patients over 60, and 2% of unilateral tumors. Tumor size and SCC were significantly higher in malignant cases. The authors suggest that patients over 60 with unilateral tumors of 10 cm or more and SCC of 2.0 ng/ml or less may be at high risk.

title: Teratomas of the ovary: a clinico-pathological evaluation of 87 patients from one institution during a 10-year period.
title_ja: 1施設における10年間の卵巣奇形腫87例の臨床病理学的評価
summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1施設で10年間に治療された卵巣奇形腫87例を検討した。卵巣腫瘍の5%を占め、最も多い症状は下腹部の腹痛であった。多くは嚢胞摘出術で治療され、組織学的には成熟奇形腫が大半を占めた。悪性転化は5%に認められた。治療は年齢、妊孕性、腫瘍径、嚢胞性か充実性か、両側性を考慮して決定すべきである。
summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study reviewed 87 ovarian teratomas treated over ten years, which made up 5% of ovarian tumors. Patients were aged 11 to 69 years, and lower abdominal pain was the most common symptom. Most were treated by cystectomy, and histology was mostly mature teratoma. Malignant changes occurred in 5% of cases. The authors conclude that teratomas are common at reproductive age with low complication and malignant transformation rates, and that treatment should depend on age, fertility status, size, cystic or solid nature, and bilaterality.

title: Leukemia inhibitory factor triggers activation of signal transducer and activator of transcription 3, proliferation, invasiveness, and altered protease expression in choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞におけるLIFによるSTAT3活性化、増殖、浸潤能およびプロテアーゼ発現の変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株Jeg-3を用い、白血病抑制因子(LIF)が浸潤能に及ぼす影響を検討した研究です。LIFのみがSTAT3を強く活性化し、細胞増殖と人工細胞外マトリックスへの浸潤を促進しました。プロテアーゼやその阻害因子の発現も変化しました。LIF-STAT3経路が絨毛癌と栄養膜細胞の浸潤性に関与することが示唆されています。
summary_en: This study examined how leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) influences invasiveness in Jeg-3 choriocarcinoma cells, used as a model for trophoblast behavior. Among the tested growth factors, only LIF strongly activated STAT3 signaling. LIF increased proliferation and invasion into an artificial extracellular matrix, and altered the expression of proteases and protease inhibitors, including reduced TIMP-1 and increased caspase-4 mRNA. The findings connect LIF-driven STAT3 activity with the invasive behavior of choriocarcinoma and trophoblast cells.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome as an unusual cause of gliomatosis peritonei: a case report.
title_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症の稀な原因としてのgrowing teratoma syndrome：症例報告
summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法中・後に腹膜播種が増大した34歳女性の症例報告です。組織学的には悪性成分を含まない成熟奇形腫でした。文献的検討から、growing teratoma syndromeは腹膜神経膠腫症の一部である可能性が示唆されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) presenting as enlarging peritoneal implants during or after chemotherapy for a malignant germ cell tumor. Histologically, the implants were mature teratomas without malignant components. Gliomatosis peritonei (GP), characterized by benign peritoneal glial implants, is associated with ovarian teratomas. Reviewing the literature, the authors propose that GTS may be part of GP, since both show benign peritoneal glial implants regardless of the grade of the original tumor.

title: Multicentre risk-adapted management for stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する多施設リスク適応型管理
summary_ja: スペインの多施設共同研究で、精巣摘除術後の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍589例をリスク適応型に管理しました。血管・局所浸潤例にはBE400P療法2コースを、その他の例には腫瘍マーカーや画像によるフォローアップを行いました。サーベイランス群では19%が再発し、その多くは1年以内でした。
summary_en: This multicentre Spanish study reviewed 589 patients with stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours managed after orchiectomy with a risk-adapted protocol. Patients with vascular or local invasion received two cycles of BE400P chemotherapy, while others underwent surveillance with tumour markers and imaging. Among surveillance patients, 19% relapsed, most within the first year. Embryonal carcinoma and vascular invasion were associated with relapse in patients who declined chemotherapy. The authors concluded that the protocol achieved a low recurrence rate.

title: Activation of mitogen-activated protein kinase is required for migration and invasion of placental site trophoblastic tumor.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の遊走および浸潤におけるMAPK活性化の役割
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)でMAPKが活性化していることを示し、新たにPSTT細胞株IST-2を樹立しました。IST-2は絨毛癌細胞株より高い遊走・浸潤能を示しました。MEK阻害薬によりIST-2の運動性と浸潤が有意に低下し、MAPKがPSTTの浸潤に機能的に関与することが示されました。
summary_en: This study investigated the role of mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) in placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a highly invasive gestational neoplasm. MAPK was activated in 84% of PSTT cases but not in normal extravillous trophoblasts. The authors established the first PSTT cell line, IST-2, which was more motile and invasive than choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells. MEK inhibitors CI-1040 and PD 59089 significantly reduced IST-2 motility and invasion without affecting normal trophoblasts or JEG-3 cells, indicating a functional role for MAPK in PSTT invasion.

title: Median sternotomy provides excellent exposure for excising anterior mediastinal tumors in children.
title_ja: 正中胸骨切開は小児の前縦隔腫瘍切除に優れた視野を提供する
summary_ja: 1997年から2004年に治療された5例の小児前縦隔腫瘍に対して正中胸骨切開を用いて切除した。全例で完全切除が達成され、直視下で心膜、横隔神経、肺血管との高度の癒着を安全に剥離できた。組織学的には成熟奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、胸膜肺芽腫が含まれた。1例は局所再発に対する化学療法中に播種性血管内凝固で死亡し、残り4例は平均3.4年の追跡で良好であった。著者らは、正中胸骨切開が完全切除に優れた視野を提供すると結論づけている。
summary_en: Median sternotomy was used to resect anterior mediastinal tumors in five children treated between 1997 and 2004. Complete resection was achieved in all cases, and direct visualization allowed safe dissection of dense adhesions to the pericardium, phrenic nerve, and pulmonary vessels. Histology included mature and immature teratomas and one pleuropulmonary blastoma. One child died of disseminated intravascular coagulation during chemotherapy for local recurrence, while the remaining four were well at a mean follow-up of 3.4 years. The authors conclude that median sternotomy gives excellent exposure for complete resection.

title: Image-diagnostic features of mature cystic teratomas of the pancreas: report on two cases difficult to diagnose preoperatively.
title_ja: 膵成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の画像診断的特徴：術前診断が困難であった2例の報告
summary_ja: 膵臓に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の2例を後方視的に検討した報告である。いずれも術前診断は困難であった。超音波検査では角化物や皮脂性物質によるエコー源性の充実性腫瘤様像、造影コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では水よりやや高濃度の嚢胞性病変、MRCPでは内部信号欠損がみられた。これらを組み合わせることで、粘液性嚢胞腫瘍や膵管内乳頭粘液性腫瘍との鑑別診断に役立つ可能性がある。
summary_en: Two rare cases of mature cystic teratoma of the pancreas are reported, and neither was diagnosed preoperatively. A retrospective review suggests that combining ultrasonography, enhanced CT, and MRCP may help distinguish these lesions from mucinous cystic tumors and intraductal papillary-mucinous tumors. Ultrasonography showed echogenic, solid-appearing masses because of keratinous and sebaceous contents. Enhanced CT showed a cystic nature with attenuation slightly above water, and MRCP revealed internal signal defects. These characteristic features may aid preoperative recognition of pancreatic cystic teratomas.

title: Outcome analysis for patients with elevated serum tumor markers at postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 血清腫瘍マーカーが持続的に高値の患者における化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清の転帰解析
summary_ja: 化学療法後も腫瘍マーカーが持続的に高値であった転移性胚細胞腫瘍114例を対象とした後方視的研究である。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は53.9%であった。後腹膜病理では胚細胞腫瘍が53.5%、奇形腫が34.2%、線維化が12.2%で、5年生存率はそれぞれ31.4%、77.5%、85.7%であった。β-hCGの高値、再手術、切除標本中の胚細胞腫瘍が予後不良因子であり、一部の患者は手術で治癒が期待できる。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 114 patients with metastatic germ cell cancer examined outcomes after postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PCRPLND) for persistently elevated tumor markers after first- or second-line chemotherapy. The 5-year overall survival was 53.9%. Retroperitoneal pathology showed germ cell cancer in 53.5%, teratoma in 34.2%, and fibrosis in 12.2%, with 5-year survival of 31.4%, 77.5%, and 85.7%, respectively. Higher β-hCG, redo surgery, and germ cell cancer in the specimen were poor prognostic factors. A subset of patients remains curable with surgery.

title: Pre-pubertal testicular dermoid cyst treated with conservative surgery.
title_ja: 思春期前の精巣類皮嚢腫に対する保存的手術
summary_ja: 思春期前の精巣に生じた類皮嚢腫の1例で、鼠径部経由の切除により健常な精巣実質を温存した報告である。思春期前の精巣における良性嚢胞性腫瘍の臨床的特徴と治療法について文献的検討も行っている。小児の良性嚢胞性病変では、精巣温存手術を選択しうることを示している。
summary_en: A case of a pre-pubertal testicular dermoid cyst was treated with transinguinal excision of the cyst while preserving healthy testicular parenchyma. The authors also reviewed the literature on clinical features and therapeutic approaches for benign cystic tumors of the pre-pubertal testis. The report supports testis-sparing surgery as an option for benign cystic lesions in children. The abstract provides limited detail beyond the surgical approach and literature review.

title: ACTH-secreting pituitary adenoma within an ovarian teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫内に存在したACTH分泌性下垂体腺腫
summary_ja: 26歳女性で、成熟卵巣奇形腫内に存在した下垂体微小腺腫が原因のクッシング症候群を呈した症例である。卵巣腫瘍によるクッシング症候群は稀で、多くはコルチゾールの過剰産生による。異所性ACTH症候群の鑑別診断では、奇形腫内の異所性下垂体組織のような潜在的な原因も考慮すべきであることを示している。
summary_en: A 26-year-old woman had Cushing's syndrome from ectopic ACTH production by a pituitary microadenoma located within a mature ovarian teratoma. The authors note that Cushing's syndrome from ovarian neoplasia is unusual and most often results from excess cortisol production by the ovary. Ectopic ACTH syndrome associated with an ovarian tumor has rarely been described. The case shows that occult ectopic ACTH sources, including ectopic pituitary tissue within a teratoma, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome.

title: Testicular cancer patterns in Asian-American males: an opportunity for public health education to impact outcomes.
title_ja: アジア系米国人男性における精巣がんの発症パターン：公衆衛生教育が転帰に与えうる影響
summary_ja: SEERデータを用いた後方視的解析で、アジア系米国人と白人の精巣がんを比較した。アジア系は発症率が低い一方、病期が進んだ状態で診断され、セミノーマの割合が高かった。病期と組織型で調整すると生存差は消失し、受診の遅れや医療アクセス・教育の問題が主因と考察された。
summary_en: This SEER-based retrospective analysis compares testicular cancer in Asian-American and white men diagnosed from 1973 to 2000. Asian-American men had a lower incidence but presented at higher stage and had more seminoma. Their unadjusted survival was poorer, but after adjusting for stage and histology, survival curves were similar. The authors attribute the disparity mainly to delayed presentation, cultural perceptions of malignancy, and limited healthcare access and education rather than inherent biology.

title: Rare case of carcinoid tumor arising within teratoma in kidney.
title_ja: 腎奇形腫内に発生したカルチノイド腫瘍の稀な症例
summary_ja: 無症状の女性の腎臓に発生した奇形腫内カルチノイドの症例報告。造影される腎腫瘤として発見され、腎細胞癌以外の疾患も鑑別に入れる必要性を示す。奇形腫とカルチノイドはいずれも稀で、同一腎臓内での併存は極めてまれであると述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a carcinoid tumor arising within a teratoma of the kidney in an asymptomatic woman. The lesion was found as an enhancing renal mass, which shows that non-renal-cell-carcinoma entities should be considered in differential diagnosis. The authors note that renal teratomas and carcinoids are both rare, and that their coexistence in one kidney is exceptionally unusual. Previously described radiographic features may help clinicians recognize these lesions.

title: Does the histology of nodal metastasis predict systemic relapse after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in pathological stage B1 germ cell tumors?
title_ja: 病理病期B1の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍において、リンパ節転移の組織型は再発を予測するか
summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、病理病期B1と判明した118例の後方視的検討。胎児性癌が最も多く、補助化学療法なしの5年無病生存率は68%であった。組織型による再発率の差はなく、後腹膜の組織型は予後を予測しないと結論された。
summary_en: This retrospective review included patients with clinical stage A nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent primary RPLND and were found to have pathological stage B1 disease. No patients received adjuvant chemotherapy. Embryonal carcinoma was the most common histology, and 5-year disease-free survival was 68%. Recurrence rates did not differ by histologic subtype, indicating that retroperitoneal histology does not predict outcome in this population.

title: The management and outcome of patients with germ-cell tumours treated in the Edinburgh Cancer Centre between 1988 and 2002.
title_ja: エディンバラがんセンターにおける胚細胞腫瘍患者の治療成績（1988〜2002年）
summary_ja: 1988年から2002年にエディンバラがんセンターで治療された性腺および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍の後方視的解析。病期Iのセミノーマの割合が有意に増加した。IGCCC予後不良群の非セミノーマ性腫瘍は予後が不良で、初回治療で完全奏効が得られないことも予後不良因子であった。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviews patients with gonadal and extragonadal germ cell tumours treated at the Edinburgh Cancer Centre from 1988 to 2002, comparing survival by stage and prognostic group across three five-year cohorts. The proportion of stage I seminoma increased significantly. Patients in the IGCCC poor-prognosis group with nonseminomatous tumours had poor outcomes. Failure to achieve complete response to initial therapy in metastatic nonseminoma was also a poor prognostic indicator. Trends over time were not significant.

title: A discussion of the biology of testicular cancer and current concepts in the management of stage I and bilateral disease.
title_ja: 病期Iおよび両側性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生物学と治療の現状
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生物学と、病期Iおよび両側性病変の現在の治療方針をまとめた論文。家族歴のある患者に発生した異時性両側性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例を提示し、2個目の原発巣は経過観察で管理された。家族性・両側性疾患の遺伝学についても論じている。
summary_en: This review discusses the biology of testicular germ cell tumours and current management of stage I and bilateral disease. It presents a case of metachronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumours in a patient with a family history of the disease, where the second primary was managed conservatively. The authors outline management options for early-stage disease and the genetics of familial and bilateral presentations.

title: Congenital nasopharyngeal immature teratoma: a first case report in Thailand.
title_ja: 先天性上咽頭未熟奇形腫：タイにおける初の症例報告
summary_ja: 正期産の女児新生児の上咽頭に発生した先天性未熟奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍は頭蓋内浸潤なく口腔や右扁桃窩に進展し、上気道閉塞と大腸菌による続発性肺炎を来した。頭頸部の未熟成分は予後不良因子ではなく化学療法は無効と述べ、広範切除で術後合併症はなかった。タイで初めての症例とされる。
summary_en: This report describes a congenital immature teratoma arising in the nasopharynx of a full-term female neonate. The tumor extended into the oral cavity and right tonsillar fossa without intracranial involvement, causing upper airway obstruction and secondary Escherichia coli pneumonia. The authors state that the immature component in the head and neck is not a poor prognostic indicator and that chemotherapy is not useful. The mass was widely excised without postoperative complications.

title: Retroperitoneal germ cell tumors: a clinical study of 12 patients.
title_ja: 後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍：12例の臨床的検討
summary_ja: 1974～2002年に2施設で治療された後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の新生児・乳児12例を後方視的に検討した。成熟奇形腫4例、未熟奇形腫6例、悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍2例であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の2例は化学療法後に寛解を維持し、良性腫瘍の生存者9例は平均12年のフォローアップで無病であった。一方、手術では血管や臓器の損傷など周術期合併症が多くみられた。
summary_en: A retrospective review of 12 newborns and infants treated at two institutions between 1974 and 2002 for retroperitoneal germ cell tumors. Histology included 4 mature teratomas, 6 immature teratomas, and 2 malignant yolk sac tumors. Eleven of 12 infants survived; one died from uncontrollable bleeding during emergency surgery after traumatic birth. Surgical removal caused several perioperative complications, including vascular and visceral injuries. Both yolk sac tumor patients received chemotherapy and remained in remission at 5 and 6 years. Benign-tumor survivors were disease-free at a mean follow-up of 12 years.

title: Assessing the size and stage of testicular germ cell tumours: 1984-2003.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の大きさと病期：1984～2003年
summary_ja: 1984～2002年にロンドンの2施設で治療された精巣腫瘍550例の腫瘍径と病期分類の推移を検討した。平均腫瘍径は4cmから2.5cmに縮小し、2cm未満の割合は23%に増加した。病期I期の割合も77%に上昇した。小型腫瘍では精巣温存手術の可能性が示唆され、無作為化試験の必要性が述べられている。
summary_en: This study analyzed 550 patients with testicular tumours treated at two London hospitals between 1984 and 2002, with tumour size measured on histopathology. Mean tumour size fell from 4 cm to 2.5 cm, the proportion under 2 cm rose to 23%, and stage 1 disease increased to 77%. The authors suggest that testis-sparing surgery might be considered for small tumours and call for a randomized controlled trial to address long-term psychological and fertility issues.

title: Gene signatures of testicular seminoma with emphasis on expression of ets variant gene 4.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの遺伝子シグネチャー：ETS変異遺伝子4（ETV4）の発現に着目して
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ40検体と正常精巣をマイクロアレイで解析し、腫瘍進行に伴う遺伝子発現の変化を調べた。インプリンティング異常を示唆する所見が得られた。BRD2やNASPは進行した病期で高発現であった。転写因子ETV4は腫瘍形成過程で強く増加し、セミノーマ細胞の核に局在していた。
summary_en: Microarray analysis of 40 testicular seminoma specimens at different tumour stages and normal testes identified altered gene expression. Maternally expressed transcripts were present in seminoma without correlation with DLK1, suggesting impaired imprinting. BRD2 and NASP increased with tumour progression. ETV4 was strongly upregulated during tumourigenesis, correlated with MMP2 and ADAM15, and localized to seminoma cell nuclei. The study identifies transcription factors and spermatogenesis-associated genes involved in seminoma progression.

title: The frequency and distribution of intratubular trophoblast in association with germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関連する管内トロホブラストの頻度と分布
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍75例を対象に、β-hCGの免疫組織化学染色で管内トロホブラストの頻度と分布を調べた。陽性例はセミノーマで29例中5例、非セミノーマで36例中1例、混合型で9例中1例にみられた。管内トロホブラストは真の上皮内病変と考えられ、トロホブラスト分化は腫瘍発生のより早い段階で生じる可能性がある。
summary_en: This study examined intratubular trophoblast (ITT) by beta-hCG immunohistochemistry in 75 testicular germ cell tumours. ITT was found in 5 of 29 seminomas, 1 of 36 nonseminomas, and 1 of 9 mixed tumours. In every positive case, hCG-positive trophoblastic cells were present in the invasive tumour. The authors suggest ITT is a genuine in situ lesion linked to seminomas with syncytiotrophoblastic cells. Trophoblastic differentiation may therefore occur earlier in tumour pathogenesis than previously recognized.

title: Shadow cell differentiation in testicular teratomas. A report of two cases.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫におけるシャドー細胞分化：2症例報告
summary_ja: 21歳と27歳の成人の精巣奇形腫2例に、石灰化上皮腫に類似したシャドー細胞分化がみられた症例報告である。腫瘍はいずれも精巣に限局していた。シャドー細胞は類皮嚢腫では報告があったが奇形腫では報告がなかった。シャドー細胞の有無だけでは奇形腫と類皮嚢腫を区別できず、他の形態学的所見が必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes two adult men, aged 21 and 27, with testicular teratoma showing shadow cell differentiation similar to that of pilomatrixoma. Both tumours were confined to the testis. Shadow cells had been described in benign dermoid cyst but not in teratoma. The authors conclude that the occurrence of shadow cells does not reliably separate teratoma from dermoid cyst, so distinction must rely on other morphological findings.

title: Management and outcome of bilateral testicular germ cell tumors: Twenty-five year experience in Munich.
title_ja: ミュンヘンにおける両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の25年間の治療と転帰
summary_ja: ミュンヘンの25年間の単施設データで、精巣胚細胞腫瘍1,180例中47例(4.0%)に2つ目の精巣腫瘍が発生した。同時性14例、異時性33例の内訳を示している。大半は病期Iで無病となり、2つ目の腫瘍による死亡はなかった。これらの転帰から、対側精巣の定期的生検は推奨されないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This 25-year Munich series of 1,180 testicular germ cell tumor patients identified 47 (4.0%) who developed a second TGCT. Fourteen had synchronous and 33 metachronous disease. Most patients with a second tumor presented with stage I disease and remained disease-free, with median follow-up of 37 to 41 months. No patient died from the second TGCT. Given these outcomes, the authors do not recommend routine contralateral testicular biopsy to detect testicular intraepithelial neoplasia.

title: Patients with non-seminoma germ cell tumours treated in a minor oncology department: the importance of multi-institutional protocols and research collaboration.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者：小規模腫瘍科における治療と多施設共同プロトコール・研究協力の重要性
summary_ja: 単施設で治療された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍132例を後方視的に検討した。病期Iの再発率は21%で、いずれも救援可能だった。病期II-IVの50%に後腹膜リンパ節郭清または外科的切除が行われ、23%で残存悪性腫瘍が認められた。5年の全生存期間(全生存率)は95%で、多施設共同プロトコールと研究協力の重要性が示された。
summary_en: A single minor oncology department reviewed 132 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours treated from 1985 to 2000. The stage I relapse rate was 21%, and all relapses were successfully treated. Among stage II-IV patients, 50% underwent post-treatment RPLND or surgical resection, with residual malignancy in 23%. Five-year overall and disease-specific survival were 95% and 96%. Outcomes by prognostic group were comparable to recent data, which the authors attribute to multicentre protocols and research collaboration.

title: Amplification and overexpression of the KIT gene is associated with progression in the seminoma subtype of testicular germ cell tumors of adolescents and adults.
title_ja: セミノーマ亜型の精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるKIT遺伝子の増幅と過剰発現は進行と関連する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍190例の解析で、セミノーマの21%にKIT遺伝子のコピー数増加が認められ、非セミノーマではまれだった。KITのエクソン17活性化変異はセミノーマの13%で確認された。上皮内癌からセミノーマへの進行にKITが関与し、毒性の少ない治療標的となる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Analysed 190 primary testicular germ cell tumours and found KIT copy-number gain in 21% of seminomas, versus rare gain in nonseminomas. KIT overexpression occurred independently of gain and was stronger in cases with gain. Activating exon 17 mutations were found in 13% of seminomas. The findings suggest KIT contributes to progression from carcinoma in situ to seminoma, and may offer a basis for less toxic targeted therapy.

title: Retinoic acid represses a cassette of candidate pluripotency chromosome 12p genes during induced loss of human embryonal carcinoma tumorigenicity.
title_ja: レチノイン酸は胎児性癌細胞の腫瘍形成能消失時に12p染色体上の多能性候補遺伝子群を抑制する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 全トランス型レチノイン酸は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞である胎児性癌細胞の腫瘍形成能を失わせる。その過程で12p染色体上のNanogやCD9、GDF3などの多能性関連遺伝子群が抑制される。Oct4のsiRNAによる抑制もNanogなどの発現を低下させた。多能性の強制と悪性化の関連が示唆され、分化誘導の分子機構を解明する研究である。
summary_en: Investigates how all-trans retinoic acid (RA) causes loss of tumorigenicity in human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the stem cells of testicular germ cell tumours. As tumorigenic potential is lost, RA represses a cluster of chromosome 12p genes, including Nanog, CD9, EDR1, GDF3, Stella and Glut3, along with Oct4 on chromosome 6. Oct4 knockdown reduces expression of several of these genes. The authors propose that these pluripotency genes link enforced pluripotency to transformation in testicular tumour genesis.

title: Towards individualised radiotherapy for Stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する個別化放射線療法に向けて
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する補助的放射線療法で、従来の矩形傍大動脈照射野とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)に基づく共形照射野を10例で比較した。CT計画では血管を含む標的体積への線量カバーが改善したが、照射野は広くなり、腎臓の一部へ高線量が及んだ。辺縁部の照射不足を減らせる可能性が示された。
summary_en: Compares traditional rectangular para-aortic fields with CT-based conformal fields for adjuvant radiotherapy in 10 patients with Stage I seminoma. CT-based plans gave better dose coverage of the vessel-based target volume (D95 24.7 vs 23.6 Gy, P=0.002), though fields were wider and some small kidney volumes received higher doses. The authors suggest CT planning may reduce under-dosage and marginal misses, which contribute to relapse.

title: Combination of paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin is an effective second-line therapy for patients with relapsed testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 再発精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する二次治療としてのパクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンの併用療法は有効である
summary_ja: 一次治療で完全寛解を得た精巣原発の再発転移性胚細胞腫瘍46例に、TIP療法(パクリタキセル+イホスファミド+シスプラチン)を二次治療として施行した。70%が完全寛解し、中央値69か月の追跡で63%が持続的な完全寛解を維持した。2年無増悪生存率は65%だった。従来量の救援化学療法に代わる有効な選択肢として示された。
summary_en: Evaluates paclitaxel added to ifosfamide and cisplatin (TIP) as second-line therapy in 46 patients with relapsed metastatic testicular germ cell tumours who had a testis primary and a prior complete response to first-line treatment. 70% achieved complete response, and 63% had a durable CR at a median follow-up of 69 months. The two-year progression-free survival rate was 65%. Four cycles of TIP achieved a high durable remission rate.

title: Retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor in a patient with Klinefelter's syndrome.
title_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の患者に発生した後腹膜の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、クラインフェルター症候群を有する22歳男性の後腹膜の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ)の例を記述している。14×12cmの腫瘍が上腸間膜動脈を取り囲んでいた。BEP療法による導入化学療法の後、TIP療法による救援化学療法を受け、腫瘍は著明に縮小して境界不明瞭な板状病変を残した。まれな併存例であり、救援療法への反応を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with Klinefelter's syndrome who had a large 14 x 12 cm retroperitoneal seminoma encasing the superior mesenteric artery. He received induction BEP chemotherapy followed by salvage TIP chemotherapy. The tumor shrank considerably, leaving a poorly defined plaque, and he remained free of progression during follow-up. The report highlights an unusual combination of a retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor with Klinefelter syndrome and demonstrates a response to salvage therapy.

title: Unusual location of ovarian mixed germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的な局在
summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫からなる卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍が、両側卵巣の間に橋渡し状に広がっていた21歳女性の症例報告です。卵巣、卵管、子宮を温存する最大限の妊孕性温存手術を行い、その後ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を4コース施行しました。AFPは3コース後に陰性化し、現在も経過観察中です。まれな局在の若年患者において妊孕性を温存した点が示されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with an unusual intra-abdominal mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary, composed of endodermal sinus tumor and immature teratoma components. The tumor formed a bridge between both ovaries and was managed with maximal fertility-sparing surgery preserving the ovaries, tubes and uterus. Four courses of BEP chemotherapy followed, and alpha-fetoprotein became negative after three courses. The patient remains under observation. The report emphasizes fertility preservation in a young patient with a rare tumor location.

title: Second cancers among 40,576 testicular cancer patients: focus on long-term survivors.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者40,576例における二次がん：長期生存者に焦点を当てて
summary_ja: ヨーロッパと北米の14の人口ベース腫瘍登録から、精巣がんの1年生存者40,576例を対象とした大規模コホート研究です。治療後少なくとも35年間、二次充実性がんのリスクが有意に上昇していました。特に胃、膵臓、膀胱、悪性中皮腫でリスクが高く、放射線療法、化学療法、両者併用のいずれでも上昇がみられました。1975年以降に治療された非セミノーマ患者ではリスクが低めでした。生存者の長期的なフォローアップの必要性を示す研究です。
summary_en: This large population-based cohort study followed 40,576 one-year survivors of testicular cancer from 14 registries in Europe and North America. Second solid cancers were significantly increased for at least 35 years after treatment, with the highest relative risks for stomach, pancreas, bladder and malignant mesothelioma. Risks were elevated with radiotherapy alone, chemotherapy alone, and combined treatment. Seminoma and nonseminoma patients showed similar overall patterns, and nonseminoma patients treated after 1975 had lower risks. Findings support long-term surveillance of survivors.

title: Intraplacental choriocarcinoma: experience from a tertiary referral center and relationship with infantile choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌：三次紹介施設での経験と乳児性絨毛癌との関係
summary_ja: 地域の絨毛性疾患専門施設で経験した、妊娠後期の胎盤内絨毛癌4例の報告です。肉眼的には胎盤に明らかな異常はなく、組織学的検査で初めて診断されました。文献レビューでは、母体や児に影響のない偶発的な病変から、約半数で認められる転移性の母体病変、致死的な乳児性絨毛癌まで、臨床像に幅があることが示されています。胎盤の詳細な病理検査の重要性を強調する論文です。
summary_en: This report describes four cases of intraplacental choriocarcinoma found in third-trimester pregnancies at a regional trophoblastic disease unit. Placentas looked grossly unremarkable, and the tumor was detected only on histopathology. The authors review the literature, noting that these lesions can range from incidental findings with no adverse effect to metastatic maternal disease in about half of cases, and fatal disseminated infantile choriocarcinoma. The paper highlights the importance of thorough placental pathological examination.

title: Case of mature cystic teratoma of the greater omentum misdiagnosed as ovarian cyst.
title_ja: 卵巣嚢腫と誤診された大網成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 卵巣嚢腫と誤診された、大網に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の36歳女性の症例報告です。腫瘍は5×4×4cmで、病理組織学的に未熟性や悪性所見はありませんでした。術前の腫瘍マーカーではCA125、CA19-9、CEAが中等度上昇し、左卵巣は萎縮していました。大網奇形腫は極めてまれであり、卵巣由来と考えられる腫瘤の術前診断は困難な場合があることを示しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with a 5 x 4 x 4 cm mature cystic teratoma of the greater omentum that was misdiagnosed as an ovarian cyst. Histopathology showed no immaturity or malignancy. Preoperative tumor markers showed moderate elevations of CA125, CA19-9 and CEA, and the left ovary was atrophic, suggesting possible autoamputation of ovarian tissue. The authors note that omental teratomas are very rare and that preoperative diagnosis can be difficult when the mass is thought to arise from the ovary.

title: Paraneoplastic encephalitis, psychiatric symptoms, and hypoventilation in ovarian teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎、精神症状および低換気
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴い、精神症状、けいれん、記憶障害、意識障害、中枢性低換気を呈した若年女性4例の報告です。脳脊髄液には炎症所見がありました。患者の血清やCSFは海馬ニューロン膜を染色し、標的抗原としてEFA6Aが同定されました。EFA6A由来の抗体で同様の染色が再現され、抗体が直接病態に関与する可能性が示されています。腫瘍治療や免疫抑制で多くは回復するため、早期の認識が重要です。
summary_en: This report describes four young women with ovarian teratoma who developed paraneoplastic encephalitis with acute psychiatric symptoms, seizures, memory deficits, reduced consciousness, and central hypoventilation, with CSF inflammatory changes. Three recovered after tumor treatment or immunosuppression; one died. Patient serum and CSF immunolabeled hippocampal neuronal membranes, and the target antigen was identified as EFA6A, which interacts with a two-pore-domain potassium channel. Antibodies against EFA6A reproduced the staining, supporting an antibody-mediated mechanism.

title: Epidermoid cyst and teratoma of the testis: sonographic and histologic similarities.
title_ja: 精巣の類表皮嚢胞と奇形腫：超音波所見と組織学的類似性
summary_ja: 精巣の類表皮嚢胞または奇形腫と診断された8例の超音波所見と組織所見を比較した研究です。典型的な類表皮嚢胞はタマネギ輪状のパターンを示しますが、非典型例では認められませんでした。奇形腫の3例は、扁平上皮と円柱上皮で覆われた嚢胞構造のため、典型的な類表皮嚢胞に類似した超音波像を示しました。両者の超音波所見には重複が大きく、タマネギ輪状所見のみでは確定できないと結論づけています。
summary_en: This pathologic-sonographic study compares eight testicular tumors that were epidermoid cysts or teratomas. Classic epidermoid cysts show an onion-ring pattern, but some atypical epidermoid cysts lack this appearance. Three teratomas mimicked classic epidermoid cysts on ultrasound because their cystic walls contained both squamous and columnar epithelium. The authors conclude that sonographic overlap is substantial, so an onion-ring pattern alone is not reliable: epidermoid cysts may be enucleated, but teratomas require radical orchiectomy.

title: Demographic variables of gestational trophoblastic disease in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.
title_ja: 南アフリカ共和国クワズール・ナタール州における妊娠性絨毛性疾患の人口統計学的変数
summary_ja: 南アフリカ・クワズール・ナタール州の婦人科・腫瘍科合同外来で5年間に管理された妊娠性絨毛性疾患98例を対象とした後方視的研究です。内訳は奇胎妊娠51%、絨毛癌46%、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍2%でした。多くは地区または地域病院からの紹介で、eThekwini地区の患者が52%を占め、北部地区からの紹介は少数でした。また、多くの患者は正期妊娠の既往があり、紹介が北部地域に偏るという傾向は認められませんでした。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 98 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease managed over five years at a combined gynecology-oncology clinic in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Molar pregnancy accounted for 51%, choriocarcinoma 46%, and placental site trophoblastic tumour 2%. Most patients were referred by district or regional hospitals, and about half came from the eThekwini district, while few came from northern districts. Most had a previous term pregnancy. The authors found no evidence that referrals were predominantly from the northern regions.

title: Hyperthyroidism due to secretion of human chorionic gonadotropin in a patient with metastatic choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 転移性絨毛癌患者におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン分泌に起因する甲状腺機能亢進症
summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の26歳妊婦の症例報告。高度のhCG上昇により不顕性の甲状腺機能亢進症を呈した。エトポシド、メトトレキサート、ダクチノマイシンによる併用化学療法を行い、尿路敗血症を合併したものの、甲状腺機能は正常化し、10コース後に寛解を得た。
summary_en: A case report of a 26-year-old pregnant woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma to both lungs. Markedly elevated hCG caused subclinical hyperthyroidism. Combination chemotherapy with etoposide, methotrexate, and dactinomycin was given; the course was complicated by urosepsis, but the thyroid function normalized and the patient achieved remission after ten cycles.

title: Germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理を総説した論文。20～35歳男性で最も多い悪性腫瘍であり、臨床試験を活用した集学的治療により全体生存率は90%超に達したと述べる。手術の適応、手術の組み込みに関する論争、代替治療戦略を扱う。
summary_en: A review of the management of testicular germ cell tumors. It notes that testicular cancer is the most common malignancy in men aged 20 to 35, and that multidisciplinary care based on clinical trials has achieved overall survival above 90%. The review covers indications for surgery, controversies over surgical integration, and alternative management strategies.

title: Metastatic germ cell tumor of the lung masquerading as primary rhabdomyosarcoma.
title_ja: 原発性肺横紋筋肉腫と紛らわしい肺転移性胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の既往を持つ男性が肺結節を生じた症例報告。切除標本は横紋筋肉腫様成分を伴う体細胞型悪性腫瘍を含む奇形腫であり、その後自動縫合器ラインに再発した。腫瘍マーカーは正常のままで、再発後に補助化学療法を開始した。肺の横紋筋肉腫様病変では転移性胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に挙げるべきと結論する。
summary_en: A case report of a man with prior testicular mixed germ cell tumor who developed a pulmonary nodule. Resection revealed a teratoma with somatic-type rhabdomyosarcomatous malignancy, which later recurred at the staple line. Tumor markers stayed normal. Adjuvant chemotherapy was started after recurrence, and the authors advise including metastatic germ cell tumor in the differential diagnosis of pulmonary rhabdomyosarcoma-like lesions.

title: KIT (c-kit oncogene product) pathway is constitutively activated in human testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: KIT(c-kit癌遺伝子産物)経路はヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍で構成的に活性化している
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるKITの発現、c-kit機能獲得型変異、および下流のPI3K-Akトシグナルを検討した。KITはセミノーマの88%、非セミノーマの44%で発現していた。KIT発現セミノーマの41%に変異が認められ、KITおよびPI3K-Akt経路は構成的に活性化していた。著者らは、この経路が治療標的となりうることを示唆している。
summary_en: Examines KIT expression, c-kit gain-of-function mutations, and downstream PI3K-Akt signaling in testicular germ cell tumors. KIT was expressed in 88% of seminomas and 44% of non-seminomas. Mutations were found in 41% of KIT-expressing seminomas, and KIT and PI3K-Akt were constitutively activated, suggesting the pathway as a therapeutic target.

title: Pseudomyxoma peritonei: unusual origin from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 腹膜偽粘液腫の非典型的な起源:卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来
summary_ja: 虫垂が正常で、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来した腹膜偽粘液腫の症例報告。通常は虫垂の粘液性腺腫に由来すると考えられているため、非典型的な発生源である。臨床像、病理組織学的所見、治療選択肢を述べる。
summary_en: A case report of pseudomyxoma peritonei arising from a mature ovarian cystic teratoma, with a normal appendix. This is an unusual origin, since disseminated peritoneal adenomucinosis is generally thought to arise from an appendiceal mucinous adenoma. The report describes the presentation, histopathology, and treatment options.

title: Incidence of late-relapse germ cell tumor and outcome to salvage chemotherapy.
title_ja: 晩期再発胚細胞腫瘍の発生率と救援化学療法の成績
summary_ja: 一次化学療法で完全寛解後に晩期再発した胚細胞腫瘍を検討。救援化学療法を受けた29例の生存期間中央値は23.9か月。完全寛解が得られたのはパクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンの併用例のみであった。晩期再発は551例中3%に生じ、化学療法抵抗性で予後不良とされる。
summary_en: Examines late-relapse germ cell tumor (GCT) after complete response to first-line chemotherapy. Among 29 patients treated with salvage chemotherapy, the median survival was 23.9 months. Paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin produced the only complete responses. Late relapse occurred in 3% of 551 patients, and the authors describe it as chemoresistant with poor prognosis.

title: Anterior mediastinal immature teratoma with precocious puberty in a child with Klinefelter syndrome.
title_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の小児に生じた前縦隔未熟奇形腫と思春期早発
summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群を合併し、思春期早発と前縦隔腫瘤を呈した4歳男児の症例報告。血清AFPとhCGが軽度上昇し、完全切除により未熟奇形腫と診断された。本症候群の男性はGCTの発症率が非罹患男性の約50倍であり、思春期早発と縦隔GCTを呈する男児では本症候群の除外を勧める。
summary_en: A case report of a 4-year-old boy with Klinefelter syndrome who presented with precocious puberty and an anterior mediastinal mass. Serum AFP and hCG were mildly elevated, and complete resection showed an immature teratoma. Males with Klinefelter syndrome have roughly 50 times the GCT risk of unaffected males, so the authors recommend evaluating such boys for the syndrome.

title: Evaluating changes in stage I seminoma management: a single institution review.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの管理方針の変化：単一施設での検討
summary_ja: カナダの単一施設で、放射線腫瘍医7名を対象に病期Iセミノーマの治療方針をアンケート調査した研究です。サーベイランスと補助的放射線療法はいずれも標準的選択肢として提示されていました。過去15年間でサーベイランスを選ぶ患者が有意に増え、現在はほぼ半数に達しています。
summary_en: A survey of all radiation oncologists at a single Canadian cancer centre examined their approach to stage I seminoma. All seven eligible physicians responded. Surveillance and adjuvant radiotherapy were both regarded as standard options and were routinely offered to patients. Institutional data show that over 15 years the proportion of stage I seminoma patients choosing surveillance rose significantly, and it is now almost half. The authors conclude that practice is uniform and consistent with recent literature.

title: Clinical study of six cases showing late relapse of germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発6例の臨床的検討
summary_ja: 初回治療後2年以上経過してから再発した胚細胞腫瘍の6例を検討した臨床研究です。純粋セミノーマでは中央値30か月、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では75.5か月で晩期再発していました。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、再発腫瘤の完全切除により3例が無病生存を得ています。長期フォローアップの必要性が強調されています。
summary_en: This clinical study reviews six patients with germ cell tumors who relapsed more than two years after initial successful treatment. Late relapse occurred at a median of 30 months for pure seminoma and 75.5 months for non-seminomatous tumors. Two seminoma patients with relapses outside irradiation fields achieved remission with chemotherapy. Among non-seminomatous cases, complete resection cured three patients, while two receiving salvage chemotherapy had persistently elevated tumor markers. The authors emphasize the need for long-term follow-up.

title: The pluripotency homeobox gene NANOG is expressed in human germ cell tumors.
title_ja: NANOGはヒト胚細胞腫瘍で発現している
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 多能性に関わるホメオボックス遺伝子NANOGのヒト胚細胞および胚細胞腫瘍における発現を検討しました。胎児精巣の胚細胞に加え、上皮内癌(CIS)、胎児性癌、セミノーマで高発現し、奇形腫や卵黄嚢腫瘍では認められませんでした。未分化な胚細胞腫瘍の分子マーカーとなり、分類に役立つ可能性があります。
summary_en: This study investigated expression of the pluripotency homeobox gene NANOG in human germ cells and germ cell tumors. NANOG protein was found in fetal gonocytes, and by immunohistochemistry and quantitative PCR it was highly and specifically expressed in carcinoma in situ, embryonal carcinoma, and seminoma, but not in teratoma or yolk sac tumor. The findings link germ cell tumors to the embryonic cells from which they arise, and suggest NANOG is a molecular marker of undifferentiated germ cell tumors that could aid classification.

title: Four pregnancies and two deliveries after unilateral orchidectomy and chemotherapy for testicular embryonal carcinoma.
title_ja: 精巣胎児性癌に対する片側精巣摘除術および化学療法後の4回の妊娠と2回の分娩
journal: Int Urogynecol J Pelvic Floor Dysfunct
summary_ja: 33歳男性の左側精巣胎児性癌（血管浸潤あり）の症例報告。片側精巣摘除術と化学療法の後も妊孕性が保たれ、後に健康な子どもをもうけたことを報告している。タイトルでは治療後の4回の妊娠と2回の分娩が示されており、適切な症例では妊孕性を温存できる可能性を示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with left-sided testicular embryonal carcinoma and vascular invasion. He underwent unilateral orchiectomy followed by chemotherapy. Despite treatment, he retained fertility and later fathered healthy children. The title also reports four pregnancies and two deliveries after treatment, suggesting that fertility can be preserved in selected patients after unilateral orchiectomy and chemotherapy.

title: Increased incidence of testicular cancer in men presenting with infertility and abnormal semen analysis.
title_ja: 精液検査異常を伴う不妊男性における精巣がんの発生率の増加
summary_ja: 精液検査異常を伴う不妊男性3,847例を後方視的に検討し、10例に精巣腫瘍（全例セミノーマ型胚細胞腫瘍）を認めた。SEERデータと比較した標準化発生比は22.9で、停留精巣の既往を除くと18.3であった。不妊男性では精巣がんの発生リスクが約20倍高く、患者と医師の認識が重要と結論づけている。
summary_en: A retrospective review of more than 3,800 men with infertility and abnormal semen analysis found 10 with testicular tumors, all seminomatous germ cell tumors. The standardized incidence ratio compared with SEER controls was 22.9, falling to 18.3 after excluding men with a history of cryptorchidism. The authors conclude that infertile men with abnormal semen analyses have about a 20-fold higher risk of testicular cancer, and that patients and physicians should be aware of this.

title: Postchemotherapy residual masses in advanced seminoma: current management and outcomes.
title_ja: 進行セミノーマにおける化学療法後残存腫瘤：現在の管理と転帰
summary_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマにおけるシスプラチン併用化学療法後の残存腫瘤の管理をまとめた総説。約80%の症例で残存腫瘤が認められ、管理は議論が続いている。外科的切除は3cmを超える境界明瞭な腫瘤に限るべきとされ、放射線療法の有用性は乏しい。陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)は活性腫瘍の評価によるリスク層別化に役立つ可能性がある。
summary_en: This review examines management of residual masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for advanced testicular seminoma. Up to 80% of patients have a radiographically detectable residual mass, and management remains controversial. Surgical resection is technically difficult because of desmoplasia, and retrospective data support resection only for discrete masses over 3 cm. Radiation therapy offers little benefit and may limit salvage chemotherapy. PET may improve risk stratification by identifying viable tumor.

title: High-dose chemotherapy and peripheral blood stem cell support in refractory gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 難治性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する大量化学療法および末梢血幹細胞支持療法
summary_ja: 難治性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）に対する大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞支持療法を、3施設の11例で後方視的に検討した。2例で完全なhCG奏効が4か月と12か月持続し、3例で部分的な腫瘍マーカー奏効が得られた。有効性は未確立であり、高リスク例を対象とした更なる研究が必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective series reports high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell support for refractory gestational trophoblastic neoplasia in 11 patients treated at three centers. Conditioning regimens included Carbo-EC-T, CEM, or ICE. Two patients achieved complete hCG responses lasting 4 and 12 months, and three had partial marker responses. The authors conclude that the approach remains unproven and needs further study, perhaps in high-risk patients who fail first salvage treatment.

title: Human embryonic stem cell genes OCT4, NANOG, STELLAR, and GDF3 are expressed in both seminoma and breast carcinoma.
title_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞遺伝子OCT4、NANOG、STELLAR、GDF3はセミノーマと乳癌の両方で発現している
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胚性幹細胞遺伝子(OCT4、NANOG、STELLAR、GDF3)のセミノーマにおける発現を、リアルタイムPCRと免疫組織化学を用いて正常精巣と比較した。GDF3はほとんどのセミノーマで上昇し、NANOGとOCT4は他のマーカーより高かった。減数分裂期マーカーは検出されず、DAZLとVASAは低下していた。同じ幹細胞プロファイルは乳癌とMCF7細胞でも確認された。DAZLとVASAの発現はセミノーマの胚細胞起源を示すと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study examined expression of human embryonic stem cell genes (OCT4, NANOG, STELLAR, GDF3) in seminoma versus normal testis using real-time PCR and immunohistochemistry. GDF3 was elevated in most seminomas, and NANOG and OCT4 were highest in seminoma compared with other markers. Meiotic markers BOULE and TEKT1 were undetectable, while DAZL and VASA were reduced. The same core stem cell profile was also found in breast carcinoma and MCF7 cells. The authors conclude that DAZL and VASA expression marks the germ cell origin of seminoma.

title: A rare case of penile metastasis of testicular cancer presented with priapism.
title_ja: 精巣がんの陰茎転移により持続勃起症を呈した稀な症例
summary_ja: 精巣がんの陰茎転移による持続勃起症（プリアピズム）の症例報告。持続勃起症は低流量型と高流量型に区別され、治療法が異なるため鑑別が重要であると述べられている。本症例は原因が精巣がんの陰茎転移であり、一見して原発性の持続勃起症と区別しにくかった。転移は稀だが、持続勃起症の鑑別診断として念頭に置く必要性が示された。
summary_en: A case report describing priapism caused by penile metastasis of testicular cancer. The authors distinguish priapism into low-flow and high-flow types, which require different treatments, and emphasize the importance of separating them. In this case the priapism was clinically indistinguishable from the usual forms, so the metastatic cause was not obvious initially. The report highlights that penile metastasis of testicular cancer should be considered in the differential diagnosis of priapism.

title: Association between large-scale genomic homozygosity without chromosomal loss and nonseminomatous germ cell tumor development.
title_ja: 大規模ゲノムホモ接合性（染色体欠失を伴わない）と非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の発生との関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 15例の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍をSNPマイクロアレイで解析し、全例で大規模な染色体ホモ接合性を認めた。その多くは相対的な染色体欠失を伴わず、この遺伝子型はセミノーマや他の腫瘍と区別された。特定の染色体の非ランダムな関与から、関連領域の遺伝子が非セミノーマの発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。著者らは精子融合による起源を仮説として提唱している。
summary_en: Using single nucleotide polymorphism microarray analysis of 15 tumors, the authors found large-scale chromosomal homozygosity in all nonseminomas, mostly without relative chromosome loss. This genotype distinguished nonseminomas from seminomas and other human tumors. Nonrandom involvement of certain chromosomes suggests that genes in these regions contribute to nonseminoma development. The authors hypothesize that nonseminomas may originate through sperm fusion, which could explain their embryonal morphology.

title: The management strategies for stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの治療戦略
summary_ja: 本総説は臨床病期Iセミノーマの治療選択肢を検討している。セミノーマ型精巣胚細胞腫瘍の約80%を占める病期である。選択肢は根治的精巣摘除術後の監視療法、単剤カルボプラチン、放射線療法で、多くの患者で腸骨照射は不要とされる。再発の危険因子である精巣網浸潤と原発腫瘍径4cm超は、監視療法または補助療法の対象選択に役立つ。最終的な決定は、危険因子、フォローアップの実施能力、患者の希望に依存する。
summary_en: This review discusses management options for clinical stage I seminoma, which accounts for about 80% of seminomatous testicular germ cell cancers. Options include surveillance after radical orchiectomy, single-agent carboplatin, and radiotherapy, with iliac irradiation considered unnecessary in many patients. Risk factors for relapse, namely rete testis invasion and primary tumour size over 4 cm, can help select patients for surveillance or adjuvant treatment. Final decisions depend on risk, follow-up capacity, and patient preference.

title: Benign teratoma of the buccal mucosa in a 9-year-old girl: report of case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 9歳女児の頬粘膜に生じた良性奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
journal: Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol Oral Radiol Endod
summary_ja: 9歳女児の頬粘膜に生じた良性奇形腫の症例報告と文献的考察。奇形腫は三胚葉すべての組織を含む腫瘍で、頭頸部では5%未満と稀である。口腔内奇形腫はさらに稀で、英語文献では21例のみが報告されていた。著者らは本症例の非典型的な発症様式を報告し、限られた口腔内奇形腫の報告例の中に位置づけている。
summary_en: A case report of a benign teratoma of the buccal mucosa in a 9-year-old girl, with a literature review. Teratomas are tumors containing tissues from all three germ layers and are rare in the head and neck, accounting for under 5% of cases. Oral teratomas are even rarer, with only 21 cases reported in the English literature at the time. The authors describe the unusual presentation and place it within this limited published experience.

title: Changing management of clinical low-stage testicular cancer.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍における治療方針の変化
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療がどのように変化したかをまとめた総説。根治的精巣摘除術後の選択肢として、短期化学療法が加わった。放射線療法は晩期毒性への懸念から支持が低下したが、低線量化の無作為化試験も示された。再発リスクに基づく層別化により、個々の患者に合わせた治療選択が可能になっている。
summary_en: A review of how management of clinical stage I testicular germ cell tumors has changed. Stage I seminomas and nonseminomas can now be treated with a brief course of chemotherapy in addition to surveillance, radiotherapy, or retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Concern about radiation-related late toxicity has reduced enthusiasm for radiotherapy, though recent randomized trials support lower doses and smaller fields. Risk stratification now allows treatment to be tailored to each patient's relapse risk after radical orchiectomy.

title: Embryonic stem (ES) cells and embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells: opposite sides of the same coin.
title_ja: 胚性幹(ES)細胞と胎児性癌(EC)細胞：同じコインの裏表
summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞は奇形癌の幹細胞で、胚性幹(ES)細胞の悪性対応物とされる。ヒトES細胞は長期培養で核型異常を獲得し、EC細胞と類似した性質を示す。培養中のES細胞の変化は、EC細胞の腫瘍進展に似ていると考察している。
summary_en: This review compares embryonic stem (ES) cells with embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the stem cells of teratocarcinomas. Prolonged in vitro culture causes human ES cells to acquire karyotypic changes also seen in human EC cells. When adapted ES cells were grown as tumors in SCID mice, they produced teratocarcinomas containing histologically recognizable stem cells that resembled malignant EC cells. The authors suggest that ES cells may develop in culture in ways that mimic EC tumour progression.

title: Primary germ cell tumors of the mediastinum: 10 years of experience in a tertiary teaching hospital.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍：三次医療機関における10年間の経験
summary_ja: 三次医療機関で10年間に診察された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍14例を検討した。成熟奇形腫11例、卵黄嚢腫瘍2例、セミノーマ1例であった。臨床像、病理組織学的特徴、治療、予後の違いについて考察している。
summary_en: This 10-year single-institution review at a tertiary hospital examined 14 primary mediastinal germ cell tumors. Most cases were mature teratomas (11 patients), with two yolk sac tumors and one seminoma. The authors describe differences in clinical presentation, histopathology, treatment, and prognosis. Mediastinal germ cell tumors typically arise in the anterior mediastinum, and teratomas are the most common type. Primary mediastinal malignant non-seminomatous germ cell tumors are rare.

title: Postchemotherapy resection of a primary mature malignant retroperitoneal teratoma in an adult: report of a case.
title_ja: 成人における原発性成熟悪性後腹膜奇形腫の化学療法後切除：症例報告
summary_ja: 47歳男性の原発性成熟悪性後腹膜奇形腫の症例である。術前化学療法後に残存腫瘍を切除し、組織学的に内胚葉・外胚葉・間葉成分を含む悪性奇形腫と確認された。切除後13か月時点で無病生存中である。まれな症例として、化学療法後の手術が成人の後腹膜奇形腫の治療における役割を示している。
summary_en: A 47-year-old man with a primary mature malignant retroperitoneal teratoma received neoadjuvant chemotherapy before the residual tumor was resected. Histopathological examination confirmed a malignant teratoma with endodermal, ectodermal, and mesenchymal structures. At 13 months after resection, the patient was alive and disease free. This rare case illustrates the role of postchemotherapy surgery in managing retroperitoneal teratomas in adults.

title: A very rare cause of recurrent apnea: congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma.
title_ja: 反復性無呼吸のまれな原因：先天性上咽頭奇形腫
summary_ja: 生後3か月の女児で、出生時から反復する無呼吸とチアノーゼがあった。CTで右上咽頭に25×24mmの腫瘤が見つかり、病理学的に良性奇形腫と診断された。全身麻酔下で摘出後、呼吸症状は完全に消失した。新生児の原因不明の喘鳴や反復無呼吸では、咽頭の腫瘤も考慮すべきと述べている。
summary_en: A three-month-old girl born as one of twins at 37 weeks presented with recurrent apnea and cyanosis since birth. Computed tomography showed a 25x24 mm mass in the right nasopharynx, and pathology revealed a benign teratoma. After excision under general anesthesia, respiratory distress and apnea resolved completely. The authors emphasize considering oropharyngeal and nasopharyngeal masses in neonates with unexplained stridor and recurrent apnea.

title: Time-course of radiation-induced chromosomal aberrations in tumor patients after radiotherapy.
title_ja: 腫瘍患者における放射線療法後の放射線誘発染色体異常の経時変化
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者などを含む放射線治療患者11例で、末梢血リンパ球の放射線誘発性転座を36か月追跡した。11例中9例で転座頻度が有意に低下し、月あたり約4.4%の減少であった。過去の被ばく線量推定では、この経時的減少を考慮すべきと結論している。
summary_en: Radiation-induced translocations were measured by fluorescence in situ hybridization in peripheral lymphocytes of 11 partially irradiated tumor patients over 36 months. Nine were testicular seminoma patients treated with radiotherapy alone. Most patients showed a significant monthly decline of about 4.4%, indicating that translocations are not stable over time. The authors conclude that this temporal decline must be considered in retrospective dose estimation.

title: The use of high resolution magnetic resonance imaging in the prenatal diagnosis of fetal nuchal tumors.
title_ja: 胎児後頸部腫瘤の出生前診断における高分解能磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の有用性
summary_ja: 超音波検査で偶然発見された胎児後頸部腫瘤2例に磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を施行した。1例目は頸部奇形腫と診断され、気管浸潤の評価をもとに子宮外分娩時治療(EXIT)を計画した。2例目は奇形皮様腫などが疑われたが、病理学的に過誤腫性血管リンパ管腫であった。
summary_en: Fetal MRI was used in two cases of fetal nuchal tumors detected incidentally on ultrasound. In the first, MRI aided diagnosis and prenatal multidisciplinary planning of a cervical teratoma with possible tracheal involvement, leading to an ex-utero intrapartum treatment plan. In the second, a lesion initially thought to be a cervical teratodermoid was found postmortem to be a hamartomatous hemangiolymphangioma, and the parents opted for termination. The report highlights MRI's value in prenatal counseling and management.

title: Premeiotic origin of teratomas: is meiosis required for differentiation into mature tissues?
title_ja: 奇形腫の減数分裂前起源：成熟組織への分化には減数分裂が必要か
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫の個々の組織成分を遺伝子解析し、奇形腫の起源を検討した。成熟奇形腫の大半では全組織成分で一貫したホモ接合性がみられた一方、未熟奇形腫の組織はヘテロ接合型であった。未熟奇形腫内の成熟組織はホモ接合性を示した。未熟奇形腫と一部の成熟奇形腫は減数分裂前の細胞に由来し、成熟組織への分化には減数分裂が必要である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined the genetic origin of teratomas by analyzing individual tissue components from mature and immature teratomas. Most mature teratomas showed consistent homozygous alleles across all components, while immature teratoma tissue was heterozygous. Mature components within immature teratomas were homozygous. These findings suggest that immature teratomas and some mature teratomas arise from premeiotic germ cells, and that meiosis may be required for differentiation into mature tissues.

title: Risk-adapted management for patients with clinical stage I seminoma: the Second Spanish Germ Cell Cancer Cooperative Group study.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマに対するリスク適応型治療：スペイン胚細胞腫瘍共同研究グループの研究
summary_ja: 1999〜2003年に精巣摘除術後の臨床病期Iセミノーマ314例を前向きに登録し、リスクに応じた治療戦略の有効性を評価した。リスク因子のない患者はサーベイランスとし、腫瘍径4cm超や精巣網浸潤のある患者にはカルボプラチンによる補助化学療法を2コース実施した。両群とも再発率は低く、再発例はすべてエトポシドとシスプラチンで治癒した。リスク適応戦略は安全で実施可能と結論づけられた。
summary_en: This Spanish cooperative group study evaluated a risk-adapted strategy for 314 patients with clinical stage I seminoma after orchiectomy, enrolled from 1999 to 2003. Patients without risk factors were managed with surveillance, while those with large tumors or rete testis involvement received two courses of adjuvant carboplatin. Relapse rates were low in both groups, and all relapses were salvaged with etoposide plus cisplatin. Five-year overall survival was 100%. The authors conclude that adjuvant carboplatin reduces relapse and that risk-adapted management is safe and feasible.

title: Rare case of exomphalos complicated with umbilical cord teratoma in a fetus with trisomy 13.
title_ja: 13トリソミーの胎児に生じた臍帯奇形腫とexomphalosの稀な1例
summary_ja: 妊娠17週の超音波検査で発見された臍帯ヘルニア（exomphalos）に伴う臍帯奇形腫の症例報告である。妊娠は終結され、胎児病理検査で臍帯奇形腫と確認された。胎児は13トリソミーであった。臍帯の嚢胞性病変の鑑別として、この非常にまれな病態を念頭に置くべきと著者らは強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes an umbilical cord teratoma associated with exomphalos, detected by ultrasound at 17 weeks of gestation. The pregnancy was terminated, and fetopathological examination confirmed an umbilical cord teratoma. Trisomy 13 was diagnosed. The authors highlight this very rare entity as a differential diagnosis for cystic lesions of the cord, and note that large teratomas with abdominal wall defects may carry a poor fetal prognosis.

title: Expression of a telomerase-associated gene in normal, atrophic, and tumorous testes.
title_ja: 正常、萎縮、および腫瘍性精巣におけるテロメラーゼ関連遺伝子の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、正常精巣16例、萎縮精巣8例、精巣セミノーマ6例において、免疫組織化学によりTEIFおよびhTERTの発現を検討した。TEIFはすべての検体で発現し群間差はなかった一方、hTERTは萎縮精巣で正常精巣およびセミノーマより低かった。TEIFとhTERTの共発現は正常および悪性組織で認められたが、萎縮精巣では認められなかった。著者らは、TEIFが精巣マーカーとなりうること、テロメラーゼが胚細胞の増殖維持に関与する可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: This study examined expression of telomerase transcriptional elements-interacting factor (TEIF) and hTERT by immunohistochemistry in 16 normal testes, 8 atrophic testes, and 6 testicular seminomas. TEIF was expressed in all specimens without group differences, while hTERT was lower in atrophic testes than in normal testes and seminomas. Co-expression of TEIF and hTERT was seen in normal and malignant tissue but not in atrophic testes. The authors suggest TEIF may be a testis marker and that telomerase may maintain germ cell proliferation.

title: Paternity following treatment for testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん治療後の父親となる可能性
summary_ja: 1980〜1994年にノルウェーで片側精巣がんと診断された男性を対象とした多施設の全国調査で、治療後の父親となる割合を検討した。15年時点の累積父親率は71%で、大量化学療法群の48%からサーベイランス群の92%まで差がみられた。乾性射精が最も強い負の予測因子であった。治療強度が妊孕性に反映されることから、将来の生殖能力についての説明に役立つと結論づけられた。
summary_en: This Norwegian national multicenter follow-up survey assessed post-treatment paternity in 1,433 assessable men treated for unilateral testicular cancer between 1980 and 1994. The 15-year actuarial paternity rate was 71%, ranging from 48% after high-dose chemotherapy to 92% after surveillance. Dry ejaculation was the strongest negative predictor, and assisted reproductive technologies were used by 22% of couples attempting conception. The authors conclude that paternity reflects treatment intensity, which can inform counseling about future fertility.

title: Facial numbness in a man with inguinal and retroperitoneal masses.
title_ja: 鼠径部および後腹膜腫瘤を伴う男性の顔面しびれ
summary_ja: 37歳男性が左顔面のしびれ、運動失調、複視で受診し、MRIで小脳脚に造影される腫瘤を認めた。鼠径部と後腹膜の腫瘤があり、リンパ節生検と傍腫瘍性抗体の検査が行われた。精巣摘除術、放射線療法、副腎皮質ステロイドで治療された。CNS外の胚細胞腫瘍に伴う神経症状の症例である。
summary_en: A 37-year-old man presented with left facial numbness, ataxia, vertigo, and diplopia, and MRI showed an enhancing mass in the left middle cerebellar peduncle. Lymph node biopsy and abdominal and pelvic CT evaluated inguinal and retroperitoneal masses, and paraneoplastic antibodies were tested. The working diagnosis was possible paraneoplastic demyelination. Treatment comprised orchiectomy, radiation therapy, and corticosteroids, consistent with a testicular germ cell tumor. The case illustrates a neurological presentation of a non-CNS germ cell tumor.

title: Mature ovarian teratoma with gliomatosis peritonei--a case report.
title_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症を伴う成熟卵巣奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫に腹膜神経膠腫症を合併した症例を報告した。腹膜や大網に成熟グリア組織が粟粒状に播種する稀な病態で、画像所見と病理所見の対応を示している。画像上は腹膜癌腫症と類似しうるため、卵巣奇形腫患者の腹膜病変の評価において本病態を認識することの重要性を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a mature ovarian teratoma associated with gliomatosis peritonei, a rare condition in which mature glial tissue implants on the peritoneum or omentum. The authors present imaging findings and their pathological correlation to support recognition of this entity. The case illustrates how ovarian teratomas may be linked to peritoneal glial implants, which can mimic peritoneal carcinomatosis on imaging. Recognizing this association can guide evaluation and management of patients with ovarian teratomas and peritoneal lesions.

title: Minimizing treatment without compromising cure with primary surveillance for clinical stage I embryonal predominant nonseminomatous testicular cancer: a population based analysis from British Columbia.
title_ja: 臨床病期I胎児性癌優位型非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する初期監視療法：ブリティッシュコロンビア州の集団ベース解析
summary_ja: ブリティッシュコロンビア州の集団ベース後方視的研究で、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍205例を検討した。胎児性癌優位例は107例で、監視療法群の33%が再発したが、再発例は全例化学療法で治療され、胎児性癌優位の精巣がんによる死亡はなかった。化学療法を要しない4年生存率は監視療法群65%、RPLND群50%であった。適切な患者では治癒率を損なわず治療介入を減らせると結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective population-based study from British Columbia compared primary surveillance with primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in clinical stage I embryonal carcinoma predominant nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Of 205 patients, 107 had embryonal carcinoma predominant disease, and 67% of these underwent surveillance. Relapse occurred in 33% of surveillance patients, all treated with chemotherapy. Four-year chemotherapy-free survival was 65% with surveillance versus 50% with RPLND. No ECP-related deaths occurred. The authors conclude that surveillance reduces interventions without compromising cure in selected patients.

title: A rare diagnosis: testicular dysgenesis with carcinoma in situ detected in a patient with ultrasonic microlithiasis.
title_ja: 超音波で微小石灰化を認めた患者に検出された精巣異形成と上皮内癌の稀な診断例
summary_ja: 軽度の陰嚢痛があり、超音波検査で精巣微小石灰化が検出された32歳男性で、精巣網と間質への微小浸潤を伴う上皮内癌を含む異形成の左精巣が認められた。左側停留精巣と精液の質の低下も併せ持ち、精巣異形成症候群の4つの特徴のうち3つを満たしていた。超音波所見は、顕在化した胚細胞腫瘍が出現する前の上皮内癌の発見につながりうる。TDSの特徴の一つを有する患者は、他の特徴についても検査すべきである。本報告は、臨床所見と画像所見を組み合わせた評価の価値を強調している。
summary_en: A 32-year-old man with mild scrotal pain and ultrasound-detected testicular microlithiasis was found to have a dysgenetic left testis containing microinvasive carcinoma in situ, with extension into the rete testis and interstitium. He also had left cryptorchidism and reduced semen quality, meeting three of four testicular dysgenesis syndrome features. The authors highlight that ultrasound findings can flag CIS before an overt germ cell tumor develops. Patients with one TDS feature should be screened for the others. The report underscores the value of combined clinical and imaging evaluation.

title: Regulation of Sertoli cell and germ cell differentation.
title_ja: セルトリ細胞と胚細胞の分化制御
summary_ja: ノックアウトマウスとトランスジェニックマウスを用いて、セルトリ細胞と胚細胞の分化制御を概説した論文。男性因子不妊、プロタミン置換の異常、そして異常なセルトリ細胞と胚細胞の相互作用による精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進行を取り上げている。精巣胚細胞腫瘍は西洋諸国で若年男性に最も多いがんであると述べている。
summary_en: This monograph reviews the regulation of Sertoli and germ cell differentiation using knockout and transgenic mouse models. It addresses three areas: male factor infertility linked to altered Sertoli cell maturation, infertility from incorrect histone-to-protamine exchange in haploid spermatids, and progression of testicular germ cell cancer favoured by aberrant Sertoli-germ cell communication. The introduction notes that male factor infertility affects about 7% of men and that testicular germ cell cancer is the most common cancer among young men in Western countries. It is largely a reproductive biology overview with a testicular germ cell tumor component.

title: [Yolk sac tumor of the anterior mediastinum and pulmonary metastases; report of a case].
title_ja: 前縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍と肺転移：症例報告
summary_ja: AFP高値(17,500 ng/ml)、前縦隔腫瘤、両側肺転移を伴う31歳女性の前縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍症例。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法でAFPは正常化し、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)で集積が弱かったため手術を行った。術後も化学療法を継続し、術後5か月時点で再発はない。化学療法後の手術判断にAFPが有用とされる。
summary_en: A 31-year-old woman with markedly elevated AFP (17,500 ng/ml), a 9 x 5 cm anterior mediastinal mass, and bilateral lung metastases was diagnosed with anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor. After four courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, the mass shrank and AFP normalized. FDG-PET showed only weak uptake, so surgery was performed, and the tumor was completely removed with no viable foci in part of it. Four further courses of carboplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide followed. She remained free of recurrence five months after surgery. The authors suggest serum AFP helps guide decisions about surgery after chemotherapy.

title: Paclitaxel plus ifosfamide and cisplatin in second-line treatment of germ cell tumors: a phase II study.
title_ja: 再発胚細胞腫瘍の救援化学療法としてのパクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチン併用療法(TIP)の第II相試験
summary_ja: 再発胚細胞腫瘍に対する初回救援化学療法として、パクリタキセル175 mg/m²を用いたTIP併用療法の第II相試験。一次治療に失敗した17例で、奏効率は65%、完全奏効は41%、2年無病生存率は47%であった。毒性は管理可能で、重篤な神経毒性や治療関連死はなかった。一方、有効性は期待を下回り、パクリタキセル用量の妥当性が問題提起された。
summary_en: This phase II study evaluated paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin (TIP) as first salvage therapy for relapsed germ cell tumors, using a reduced paclitaxel dose of 175 mg/m2 in 17 patients who had failed first-line treatment. The overall response rate was 65%, including 41% complete responses, and estimated 2-year disease-free survival was 47%. Grade 3-4 granulocytopenia occurred in 8% of courses and febrile neutropenia in 7%, with no severe neurotoxicity or treatment-related deaths. The authors judged toxicity acceptable but efficacy lower than expected, raising questions about paclitaxel dosing.

title: Term delivery choriocarcinoma patient with brain and lung metastases successfully treated by etoposide, methotrexate, actomycin D, cyclophosphamide and vincristine (EMA-CO) chemotherapy.
title_ja: 正期分娩後に脳・肺転移を生じた絨毛癌患者に対するEMA-CO化学療法
summary_ja: 正期分娩後に喀血を生じ、子宮・肺・脳に転移を伴う絨毛癌と診断された31歳女性の症例報告。治療前のβ-hCGは21,000 ng/mlで、WHOスコア16点の高リスク群であった。一次治療としてEMA-CO療法を行い、7コースで完全寛解に至った。その後16年以上にわたり寛解を維持しており、著者らは高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対するEMA-COの有効性を強調している。
summary_en: A 31-year-old woman developed hemoptysis three weeks after a term delivery and was found to have choriocarcinoma with uterine, pulmonary, and brain metastases, causing motor aphasia and hemiplegia. Her pretreatment beta-hCG was 21,000 ng/ml, placing her in the WHO high-risk group. After seven courses of first-line EMA-CO chemotherapy she reached complete remission, and therapy was completed after 11 courses, followed by six months of maintenance etoposide. She has remained in remission for more than 16 years. The authors recommend EMA-CO as first-line therapy for most high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

title: Postmenopausal choriocarcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 閉経後の子宮絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 閉経後に子宮出血を呈した62歳女性の子宮絨毛癌の症例報告。緊急手術で子宮腫瘍が見つかり、病理組織学的に絨毛癌と診断された。免疫組織化学では悪性細胞にβ-hCGとサイトケラチンの発現が認められ、診断が確定した。閉経後の子宮絨毛癌は非常にまれで、根治的化学療法の恩恵が期待されると述べられている。
summary_en: A 62-year-old woman presented with uterine bleeding after menopause. Emergency surgery revealed a uterine tumor, and histopathology was consistent with choriocarcinoma. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated beta-hCG and cytokeratin expression in the malignant cells, confirming the diagnosis. The authors note that postmenopausal uterine choriocarcinoma is very rare and that it benefits from curative chemotherapy.

title: The impact of 3-dimensional ultrasonography on perinatal management of a large epignathus teratoma without ex utero intrapartum treatment.
title_ja: 三次元超音波検査が大型エピグナタス奇形腫の周産期管理に与える影響：EXITを要しなかった症例
summary_ja: 妊娠22週で診断された大型のエピグナタス奇形腫の症例。35週には羊水過多と早産の兆候が出現した。羊水除去後に行った三次元超音波検査で、腫瘍の大部分は胎児の口の外側に位置し、新生児が自発呼吸できる可能性が示された。EXITを行わず、36週の帝王切開後に直ちに腫瘍を摘出した。著者らは、出生前診断でEXITの要否を選別する際に三次元超音波検査とMRIが有用であると述べている。
summary_en: A large epignathus teratoma diagnosed at 22 weeks' gestation caused polyhydramnios and preterm labor by 35 weeks. Three-dimensional ultrasound performed after amniotic fluid drainage showed most of the tumor outside the fetal mouth and in front of the mandible, suggesting the newborn could breathe through the nose. A cesarean section at 36 weeks was followed by immediate tumor extirpation and intubation, without the EXIT procedure. The authors conclude that EXIT is not always necessary and that 3D ultrasound with MRI can help select fetuses that require it.

title: [Perioperative management of a neonate with a retroperitoneal giant teratoma who underwent its extirpation under general anesthesia: a case report].
title_ja: 全身麻酔下に摘出した後腹膜巨大奇形腫の新生児の周術期管理：症例報告
summary_ja: 出生前に診断された後腹膜の巨大奇形腫を有する新生児の症例報告。腫瘍による横隔膜胸膜の圧迫で重度の呼吸性アシドーシスを生じ、術中の大量出血で循環障害、腎不全に伴う高カリウム血症も併発した。出生前診断があっても全身状態が重篤な乳児が少なくないことを示し、麻酔管理の難しさを報告している。
summary_en: A neonate with a giant retroperitoneal teratoma, diagnosed prenatally, underwent extirpation under general anesthesia. Tumor compression of the diaphragmatic pleura caused severe respiratory acidosis, massive intraoperative bleeding led to circulatory disturbance, and renal failure produced severe hyperkalemia. The case report describes the anesthetic difficulties in managing these interrelated problems and notes that infants with large teratomas may be critically compromised despite prenatal diagnosis.

title: Treatment of nonretroperitoneal residual germ cell tumor masses.
title_ja: 後腹膜以外の残存胚細胞腫瘍腫瘤の治療
summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に、後腹膜以外に残存した病変の治療方針を検討。残存病変は主に胸部に生じ、部位により組織型が一致しないことが多いため、腫瘍マーカーが正常化していれば後腹膜以外の残存病変は切除すべきとされる。可能なら同時性手術とし、導入化学療法後の中間リスク患者には追加全身治療が有益とされる。救援化学療法後の残存病変には追加化学療法の利益はない。
summary_en: This paper addresses treatment of residual germ cell tumor masses located outside the retroperitoneum after chemotherapy in advanced testicular GCT. Such residues most often occur in the thorax but may also involve the neck, liver, or brain. Because histology often differs between sites, the authors recommend resecting all nonretroperitoneal residual disease when tumor markers have normalized, ideally with synchronous surgery under one anesthetic. Further systemic therapy benefits patients with viable residual tumor after induction chemotherapy at least at intermediate risk, but not those with viable residual tumor after salvage chemotherapy.

title: Teratoma occupying the left hemithorax.
title_ja: 左半胸郭を占める縦隔奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 2か月前から肺感染症、咳嗽、呼吸困難を呈した40歳女性。左半胸郭を占める巨大な縦隔由来の腫瘤により左肺が完全無気肺となっていた。胸部MRIで大血管・気道との関係を評価し、左開胸術で完全切除した。病理組織学的に類皮嚢腫型の良性奇形腫と確定し、予後は良好であった。奇形腫の治療は完全切除が適切とされる。
summary_en: A 40-year-old woman with two months of recurrent lung infections, cough, and worsening dyspnea was found to have a huge mediastinal-origin mass that totally collapsed the left lung and filled the left hemithorax. Chest MRI clarified its relationship to great vessels and airways, and complete resection via left thoracotomy was achieved without vascular or airway invasion. Histology confirmed a benign dermoid-type teratoma with an excellent prognosis. The authors emphasize that teratomas can be asymptomatic or symptomatic and that complete removal is adequate treatment.

title: Massive congenital orbital teratoma.
title_ja: 巨大先天性眼窩奇形腫
summary_ja: 新生児に発生した巨大な先天性眼窩奇形腫の症例報告です。片側の著明な眼球突出、眼瞼の伸展、眼窩の拡大を呈しました。治療目標は眼球の温存、眼窩顔面の発育促進、整容性と視力の維持であり、眼瞼を温存する眼窩内容除去術により腫瘤を摘出できたことを報告しています。
summary_en: This report describes a massive congenital orbital teratoma in a newborn presenting with extreme unilateral proptosis, stretched eyelids, and enlargement of the orbit. The authors emphasize the management goals: saving the eye, encouraging orbitofacial development, maintaining cosmesis, and retaining some vision. The mass was successfully removed using an eyelid-sparing exenteration technique, illustrating how surgical planning can preserve function and appearance in rare extragonadal teratomas.

title: Gene expression profiling differentiates germ cell tumors from other cancers and defines subtype-specific signatures.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍を他の癌から識別し、亜型特異的シグネチャーを同定する遺伝子発現プロファイリング
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍50例の遺伝子発現を解析し、他の悪性腫瘍443例と比較しました。胚細胞腫瘍を他の癌と区別する遺伝子が多数同定され、65遺伝子によるクラス予測器は高い精度を示しました。奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、セミノーマには組織型特異的な発現パターンがあり、成熟奇形腫ではEGR1が化学療法抵抗性に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
summary_en: This study used global gene expression profiling of 50 germ cell tumors across histologic subtypes and compared them with 443 other malignancies. Hundreds of genes distinguished GCTs from other cancers, and subtype-specific signatures emerged for teratomas, yolk sac tumors, and seminomas. A 65-gene class predictor achieved high accuracy and may aid diagnosis of tumors of unknown primary origin. Known markers such as AFP, POU5F1, and KIT behaved as expected. The authors suggest EGR1 may contribute to p21-mediated cell cycle arrest and chemotherapy resistance in mature teratomas.

title: Giant spermatocytic seminoma with massive hemorrhage into accompanying hydrocele: case report.
title_ja: 大量出血を伴う巨大精母細胞性セミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 59歳男性が巨大精巣腫瘍と付随する水瘤への大量出血で急速に悪化し、緊急切除を受けた症例です。組織学的検査と免疫組織化学により精母細胞性セミノーマと診断されました。摘出標本は26×28×17cm、重量2150gに達し、血腫を含めると直径約40cmでした。大量出血を合併した巨大精母細胞性セミノーマの稀な症例として報告されています。
summary_en: A 59-year-old man presented with a giant testicular tumor and massive hemorrhage into an accompanying hydrocele, requiring emergency resection. Histology and immunohistochemistry confirmed spermatocytic seminoma. The surgical specimen was enormous, measuring 26 by 28 by 17 cm and weighing 2150 g, with the hematocele extending to about 40 cm in diameter. The report highlights a rare presentation of a large spermatocytic seminoma complicated by acute hemorrhage and clinical deterioration.

title: Non seminomatous germ cell tumour of a solitary testis in a 70-year-old man: a rare case.
title_ja: 70歳男性の単発精巣に発生した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍：稀な症例
summary_ja: 70歳男性の単発精巣に発生した未分化悪性奇形腫の症例です。高齢者における非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は稀であり、文献的検討から報告されている中で最高齢の症例となる可能性が示されています。高齢患者でのこの腫瘍の稀少性と臨床像を報告しています。
summary_en: A 70-year-old man presented with undifferentiated malignant teratoma arising from a solitary testis, a rare finding in this age group. The authors reviewed the literature and noted that this may represent the oldest reported patient with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis. The report emphasizes the rarity of such tumors in elderly patients and contributes to understanding their age distribution and clinical presentation.

title: Choriocarcinoma and gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 絨毛癌と妊娠性絨毛性疾患
summary_ja: 絨毛由来の疾患群である妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)を概説した総説です。胞状奇胎の除去後にhCGの持続高値が続く場合を妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)と定義しています。完全胞状奇胎と部分胞状奇胎の初期治療、hCGによるフォローアップ、リスク因子スコアリングと病期分類による予後分類を解説し、GTNや絨毛癌の減少と生存率の大幅な改善を報告しています。
summary_en: This review addresses gestational trophoblastic disease, a group of conditions derived from placental trophoblasts. It defines GTD as hydatidiform mole and GTN as persistent hCG elevation after molar evacuation, metastatic disease, or choriocarcinoma. Initial management of complete and partial moles involves suction curettage, baseline hCG determination, and hCG follow-up. Risk-factor scoring and a staging system classify patients into prognostic categories. The authors note that GTN and choriocarcinoma incidence is declining and survival has markedly improved.

title: Testicular tumor in Down syndrome.
title_ja: ダウン症患者にみられた精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: ダウン症を有する33歳男性の左精巣腫大に対し、根治的鼠径精巣摘除術を施行した症例報告。術前β-hCGは上昇し、術後は2年間正常を維持した。病理像は典型的なセミノーマであった。ダウン症患者では精巣がんの発生率が今後増加する可能性を論じている。
summary_en: A 33-year-old man with Down syndrome presented with left testicular enlargement and underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy. Serum beta-hCG was elevated preoperatively (0.9 ng/mL) and normalized postoperatively, remaining normal for two years. Pathology showed typical seminoma. The authors discuss the rising leukemia and testicular cancer risks in Down syndrome, suggesting that testicular cancer incidence may increase as the postpubertal population with Down syndrome grows.

title: One cycle of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin plus two cycles of etopeside and cisplatin chemotherapy in selected patients with low-volume stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の低容量病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対するBEP1サイクルとEP2サイクルの化学療法
summary_ja: 低容量の病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、初回化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化した症例を対象に、2・3サイクル目のブレオマイシン省略を検討した。BEP1回とEP2回は標準的なBEP3回と同等の効果を示し、毒性の少ない選択肢になり得ると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study evaluated omitting bleomycin from cycles 2 and 3 of BEP in selected low-volume stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients with normalized markers after cycle 1. Among 59 patients with low-volume retroperitoneal disease, 12 received 3BEP and 18 received EP for cycles 2 and 3. All achieved complete response and remained disease-free at median follow-up of 97 and 48 months. The authors conclude one cycle of BEP plus two cycles of EP is an effective, less toxic alternative.

title: Involvement of dysadherin and E-cadherin in the development of testicular tumours.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍におけるdysadherinとE-cadherinの関与
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣腫瘍120例（セミノーマ、胎児性癌、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫など）でdysadherinとE-cadherinを免疫組織化学的に検討した。ほとんどの胚細胞腫瘍で高発現し、E-cadherinの異常発現と相関した。脈管侵襲とは相関しなかった。
summary_en: The authors immunohistochemically examined E-cadherin and dysadherin in 120 testicular neoplasms, including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, mixed germ cell tumors, yolk sac tumors, teratomas and lymphomas, all clinical stage I. Dysadherin was absent in non-neoplastic germ cells and CIS but highly expressed in most germ cell tumors, correlating with aberrant E-cadherin expression. Dysadherin did not correlate with vascular invasion, suggesting a role in neoplastic transformation of germ cells.

title: Des-gamma-carboxy prothrombin (PIVKA-II)-producing mediastinal embryonal carcinoma with features of hepatoid differentiation.
title_ja: 肝様分化を伴うPIVKA-II産生縦隔胎児性癌
summary_ja: 48歳男性の後縦隔原発非セミノーマ性胎児性癌。PIVKA-IIが著明高値（4040 mAU/ml）を示した。超音波検査とCTで肝細胞癌と肝転移は否定された。術前化学療法と腫瘍完全切除後にPIVKA-IIは正常化し、腫瘍細胞の肝様分化に伴う産生が示唆された。
summary_en: A 48-year-old man had primary nonseminomatous embryonal carcinoma of the posterior mediastinum with markedly elevated PIVKA-II (4040 mAU/ml). Ultrasonography and dynamic CT excluded hepatocellular carcinoma and liver metastasis. After preoperative chemotherapy and total tumor resection, PIVKA-II normalized. Immunohistochemistry showed cytoplasmic PIVKA-II expression in carcinoma cells with hepatoid differentiation, suggesting the tumor itself produced this marker.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for stage I non-seminomatous testicular tumors.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍5例に、経腹膜的な腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。平均手術時間は190分、平均郭清リンパ節数は21個で、逆行性射精は認められなかった。平均16.3か月で病期I症例4例は無病生存であり、実施可能で安全と示唆された。
summary_en: The authors report laparoscopic modified template retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) via transperitoneal approach in five high-risk patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors. Mean operative time was 190 minutes, mean 21 nodes dissected, and no retrograde ejaculation occurred. One patient had pathological stage II disease and received chemotherapy. At mean 16.3 months, four stage I patients remained disease free, suggesting feasibility and safety.

title: Metastatic malignant melanoma arising in a mature ovarian cystic teratoma: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた転移性悪性黒色腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 19歳女性が成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の内部に生じた悪性黒色腫を発症し、初診から37日で死亡した。文献的に卵巣原発の黒色腫はおよそ30例しか報告されていない。治療は嚢腫摘出術から根治的減量術までの手術が中心で、補助化学療法は既報の4例のみに用いられていた。術中診断の難しさと、黒色腫の補助化学療法に対する低い奏効性が課題として挙げられている。
summary_en: A 19-year-old woman developed malignant melanoma arising within a mature ovarian cystic teratoma. Her disease progressed rapidly, and she died 37 days after first presentation. The authors review the literature, identifying only about 30 cases of primary ovarian melanoma. Management has mainly consisted of surgery ranging from cystectomy to radical debulking, with adjuvant chemotherapy given in only four prior cases. The paper highlights two difficulties: making the diagnosis intraoperatively and the poor response of melanoma to adjuvant chemotherapy.

title: Struma ovarii showing clinical characteristics of ovarian malignancy.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣腫瘍様の臨床像を呈した卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 閉経後女性の良性卵巣甲状腺腫が、大量の腹水、複雑な骨盤内腫瘤、著明なCA125上昇を伴い、卵巣悪性腫瘍と紛らわしい臨床像を呈した。卵巣腫瘤の外科的切除により腹水とCA125は正常化し、10か月のフォローアップ中に再発はみられなかった。複雑な腫瘤で腹水やCA125上昇を伴う場合、悪性と誤認されうることが示されている。
summary_en: A postmenopausal woman had benign struma ovarii presenting with massive ascites, a complex pelvic mass, and markedly elevated CA125, mimicking ovarian malignancy. Surgical excision of the ovarian mass resolved the ascites and normalized CA125. No recurrence was observed during 10 months of follow-up. The authors note that struma ovarii can mimic malignancy clinically, particularly when the mass is complex and accompanied by ascites and elevated CA125.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease: pictorial review.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患：絵画的総説
summary_ja: 本絵画的総説は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病態、疫学、超音波像を解説したものである。超音波検査とドプラ画像は、妊娠初期での診断、浸潤性病変の有無の判定、再発の検出、化学療法の効果判定に有用である。部分胞状奇胎と全胞状奇胎は妊娠早期に診断できる。掻爬物を病理検査に提出しないと一部が見逃される可能性があり、非典型的な超音波像を示すこともあると指摘している。
summary_en: This pictorial review describes gestational trophoblastic disease, covering its pathogenesis, epidemiology, and sonographic spectrum. Ultrasonography and Doppler imaging help diagnose the disease in early pregnancy, determine whether invasive disease is present, detect recurrence, and monitor chemotherapy response. Partial and complete hydatidiform moles can be identified in early gestation. The authors caution that some molar pregnancies may be missed if curettage material is not sent for pathological examination, and that molar pregnancies can have unusual sonographic appearances.

title: Fate of embryonal carcinoma cells injected into postimplantation mouse embryos.
title_ja: 胎児性癌細胞のマウス着床後胚への移植後の挙動
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 奇形癌の幹細胞である胎児性癌細胞を、マウス胚の各発生段階、新生仔、成体同系マウスに移植した。腫瘍形成は移植時期に依存し、胚期の移植が遅いほど出生後に腫瘍を生じる可能性が高まった。腫瘍を形成しなかった細胞は潜伏状態で残存し、成体の組織中で検出された。着床後の胚環境が腫瘍化細胞を正常化しうると著者らは考察している。
summary_en: Embryonal carcinoma cells, the stem cells of teratocarcinoma, were transplanted into mouse embryos at different stages, into newborns, and into adult syngeneic mice. Tumor formation depended on the developmental stage at injection, with later embryonic injection increasing the chance of postnatal tumors. Cells that did not form tumors persisted latently and were detected in tissues in adulthood. The authors suggest that the post-implantation embryonic environment can normalize tumorigenic cells, possibly via epigenetic signals that promote differentiation.

title: Massive immature mediastinal teratoma extending into the left pleural cavity.
title_ja: 左胸膜腔へ進展した巨大な未熟縦隔奇形腫
