summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old woman with stage IV primary peritoneal carcinoma of ovarian type who was later found to have a coexisting peritoneal choriocarcinoma component after chemotherapy. The two malignant components responded differently to treatment. Despite EMA/CO and platinum-based EP/EMA regimens producing palliation and tumor regression, the choriocarcinomatous disease progressed and the patient died, while the adenocarcinoma remained biochemically quiescent. The authors suggest aggressive weekly chorio-type chemotherapy may be warranted for palliation despite low cure likelihood.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumor arising from antecedent molar pregnancy.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎から生じた胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍
summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎から発生した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の2症例を報告している。1例は生存胎児を伴う奇胎妊娠、もう1例はメトトレキサート治療後もhCG値が持続上昇した症例である。文献解析では、PSTTの約12%が胞状奇胎に先行していた。PSTTは稀な妊娠性絨毛性疾患であるが、胞状奇胎を含む異常妊娠に先行することが多いと結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes two women with complete hydatidiform moles who developed placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT). One had a coexisting living fetus and molar pregnancy, and the other showed persistent hCG elevation despite methotrexate. A literature analysis found that about 12% of PSTTs were preceded by molar pregnancy. The authors conclude that PSTT is an uncommon form of gestational trophoblastic disease, but it is often preceded by an abnormal pregnancy, including molar pregnancy.

title: The management and survival of patients with advanced germ-cell tumours: improving outcome in intermediate and poor prognosis patients.
title_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍患者の管理と生存：中間および予後不良患者の成績向上
summary_ja: 本単施設研究は、胚細胞腫瘍で治療された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍178例とセミノーマ71例を対象に、BEPとPOMB-ACE化学療法レジメンの有効性、毒性、生存を比較している。全生存率は、良好および中間リスク群ではIGCCCG推定値と同程度であり、予後不良群では予想より良好であった(57%対48%)。POMB-ACEでは急性および遅発性の副作用がより多かった。著者らは、予後不良群の良好な成績はPOMB-ACEによる可能性があると示唆しているが、ランダム化比較が必要であると述べている。
summary_en: This single-institution study reviews 178 non-seminomatous and 71 seminoma patients treated for germ cell tumors, comparing BEP and POMB-ACE chemotherapy regimens for efficacy, toxicity, and survival. Overall survival was similar to IGCCCG estimates for good and intermediate risk groups and better than expected for poor-risk patients (57% vs 48%). POMB-ACE caused more acute and late side effects. The authors suggest POMB-ACE may explain the superior poor-risk outcomes but note that randomized comparison is required.

title: Fertility after testicular cancer treatments: results of a large multicenter study.
title_ja: 精巣がん治療後の妊孕性：大規模多施設研究の結果
summary_ja: 1979年から1999年に治療を受けた精巣がん長期生存者446例を対象に、郵送アンケートで治療前後の妊孕性を調査した多施設研究である。診断前に妊娠を試みた患者の成功率は91.2%であったが、治療後は67.1%に低下し、約30%減少した。累積妊娠率は化学療法単独の群に比べ放射線療法を受けた群で有意に低く、放射線療法が最も妊孕性への悪影響が大きいと結論づけている。
summary_en: This large French multicenter study surveyed 446 long-term testicular cancer survivors treated between 1979 and 1999 with a mailed questionnaire about reproductive events before and after treatment. Conception success fell from 91.2% before diagnosis to 67.1% after treatment, roughly a 30% decrease. Cumulative conception rates were significantly lower in patients who received radiotherapy than in those treated with chemotherapy alone. The authors conclude that radiotherapy has the most harmful effect on fertility among the treatments studied.

title: A dermoid cyst in the greater omentum as a rare epigastric tumor.
title_ja: 心窩部の稀な腫瘍としての大網の類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 36歳女性の大網に生じた9cmの左上腹部の充実性腫瘤に対し、腹腔鏡下切除を行った症例報告。組織学的に類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)と診断された腹腔内の胚細胞腫瘍の稀な例である。悪性化の可能性があるため切除が推奨され、術後は再発なく無症状で経過している。
summary_en: Case report of a 36-year-old woman with a 9 cm solid mass in the left upper abdomen, arising from the greater omentum and initially evaluated by ultrasound and CT. Laparoscopic resection was performed, and histology confirmed a dermoid cyst, a mature teratoma of extragonadal origin. The authors note the possibility of malignant degeneration and recommend resection. The patient was asymptomatic without recurrence after surgery.

title: Imaging of testicular tumours.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の画像診断
summary_ja: 主に胚細胞腫瘍である精巣腫瘍の診断、病理、画像診断をまとめた総説。診断、病期分類、フォローアップに用いられる画像検査法を解説している。精巣腫瘤を評価する臨床医や、治療後の患者を経過観察する医師にとって参考となる内容である。
summary_en: Review of testicular tumours, predominantly germ cell tumours, covering their diagnosis, pathology, and imaging. The article discusses the imaging techniques used in the diagnosis, staging, and surveillance of testicular germ cell tumours. It is a general clinical review in a hospital medicine journal, relevant to clinicians evaluating testicular masses and following patients after treatment.

title: Ovarian teratoma diagnosis and management: case presentations.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の診断と管理：症例提示
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の症例提示。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は生殖年齢女性に最も多い卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍で、超音波検査で診断されることが多い。腹腔鏡下切除で多毛が改善した例、悪性腫瘍を伴う大型例、腹膜神経膠腫症を伴う例の3例を報告している。症例を選べば腹腔鏡手術が選択肢となり、15歳未満または45歳超で大型の充実性腫瘍や腫瘍マーカー陽性の例では開腹術が推奨されると結論している。
summary_en: Case presentations on ovarian teratoma. Mature cystic teratomas, also called dermoid cysts, are the most common ovarian germ cell tumours in women of reproductive age and are often diagnosed by ultrasound. Three cases are described: laparoscopic bilateral removal with reversal of hirsutism, a large unilateral teratoma with focal malignancy, and a teratoma with gliomatosis peritonei. The authors suggest laparoscopy in selected cases and laparotomy for women under 15 or over 45 with large solid or marker-positive tumours.

title: Cytologic features of functioning stromal cells in a yolk sac tumor of the ovary. A case report.
title_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍における機能性間質細胞の細胞学的特徴：症例報告
summary_ja: 19歳女性のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)産生卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍で、機能性間質を伴い血清テストステロンが上昇していた症例報告です。インプリント細胞診で、機能性間質細胞は核/細胞質比が低く、空胞状の細胞質と陽性のインヒビン染色を示し、多形性で濃染核をもつ卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞と区別できました。細胞診での同定はホルモン作用の予測に重要です。
summary_en: A 19-year-old woman with an alpha-fetoprotein-producing ovarian yolk sac tumor and functioning stroma, with elevated serum testosterone. Imprint cytology distinguished functioning stromal cells (low nuclear/cytoplasmic ratio, vacuolated cytoplasm, inhibin-positive) from pleomorphic, hyperchromatic yolk sac tumor cells. The authors emphasize that identifying functioning stromal cells in cytologic specimens is important because they can induce hormonal effects in various ovarian tumors.

title: Fine needle aspiration cytology of metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting as a breast lump. A case report.
title_ja: 乳房腫瘤として発見された転移性絨毛癌の穿刺吸引細胞診：症例報告
summary_ja: 48歳女性が咳、喀血、鼻出血で受診し、胸部CTで多発肺結節と左乳房腫瘤を認めました。乳房の穿刺吸引細胞診では悪性腫瘍とされ、肺非小細胞癌の転移と誤診されました。鼻粘膜生検で転移性絨毛癌と確定しています。細胞性栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞に対応する特徴的な細胞所見を示し、絨毛癌は化学療法によく反応するため、細胞診での早期診断が重要だと述べています。
summary_en: A 48-year-old woman presented with cough, hemoptysis and epistaxis. Chest CT showed multiple lung nodules and a left breast mass initially suspected to be metastatic lung cancer. Fine needle aspiration cytology of the breast showed a malignant tumor misdiagnosed as non-small cell lung carcinoma. Nasal biopsy histology revealed metastatic choriocarcinoma. The authors highlight its characteristic cytology, with mononucleated cytotrophoblasts and multinucleated syncytiotrophoblasts, and stress that careful FNAC examination enables early diagnosis, since choriocarcinoma responds well to chemotherapy.

title: Gastrointestinal hemorrhage due to metastatic choriocarcinoma with gastric and colonic involvement.
title_ja: 転移性絨毛癌による胃・大腸浸潤に伴う消化管出血：症例報告
summary_ja: 黒色便で発症した転移性絨毛癌の症例報告で、内視鏡により胃と右側腸管の転移病変が診断されました。絨毛癌は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の一種で、栄養膜由来の出血傾向があり、消化管病変は5%未満とされます。病変は内視鏡、血管造影または手術で対処しうると述べています。高い治癒性がある一方、消化管出血は予後を悪化させます。
summary_en: A case report of metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting as melaena, with gastric and right bowel metastases diagnosed by endoscopy. The authors note that choriocarcinoma, a rare nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, has a hemorrhagic tendency due to its trophoblastic origin, and gastrointestinal involvement occurs in under 5% of cases. Lesions can be managed by endoscopy, angiography or surgery. Although highly curable, gastrointestinal bleeding worsens prognosis.

title: Low CYP1A2 activity associated with testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんと関連する低いCYP1A2活性
summary_ja: 378名の男性を対象とした住民ベースの症例対照研究で、尿中カフェイン代謝物比からCYP1A2とNAT2の活性を測定しました。精巣がん症例ではCYP1A2活性が低く、活性が低いほどリスクが高いことが示されました。喫煙者を除外するとリスクはさらに高くなりました。セミノーマと非セミノーマの双方で関連が認められ、NAT2の表現型は関連がありませんでした。
summary_en: A population-based case-control study of 378 men (80 seminomas, 104 non-seminomas, 194 controls) measured CYP1A2 and NAT2 activity using urinary caffeine metabolite ratios. CYP1A2 activity was lower in cases, and low activity was associated with the highest testicular cancer risk (OR 2.11 overall, higher after excluding smokers). Associations held for seminoma and non-seminoma after excluding men treated with chemotherapy or radiation. NAT2 phenotype showed no association with risk.

title: [Induction chemotherapy and radical resection for primary nonseminomatous mediastinal germ cell tumor (NSGCT); report of a case].
title_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する導入化学療法と根治的切除：症例報告
summary_ja: 15歳男性の前縦隔腫瘍例です。CTガイド下生検を2回行っても組織診断が得られず、AFPが急上昇したため、組織診断なしで導入化学療法を開始しました。2コース後にAFPは正常化し、右肺の一部を含めて外科的切除を行いました。病理では成熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍が確認され、無再発で経過しています。
summary_en: A 15-year-old boy presented with an anterior mediastinal solid tumor that could not be diagnosed histologically despite two CT-guided biopsies. Because serum AFP rose rapidly, he received cisplatin-based induction chemotherapy without a histologic diagnosis. After two courses, AFP normalized and the tumor was surgically resected together with part of the right lung. Pathology showed mature teratoma and yolk sac tumor, with viable cells in the yolk sac component, and one postoperative course was given. He remained alive without recurrence.

title: [Carcinoma in situ detected by contralateral testicular biopsy of 55 germ cell tumor patients].
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者55例の対側精巣生検で検出された上皮内癌（CIS）
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で高位精巣摘除術を受けた55例の対側精巣生検を再検討した研究です。初回判定では上皮内癌（CIS）は見つかっていませんでしたが、PLAP免疫染色を含めて再検討した結果、55例中2例（3.6%）でCISが確認されました。生検の感度には限界があるため、Skakkebaek説の指針に沿った生検が重要と結論づけています。
summary_en: This Japanese urology study reviewed contralateral testicular biopsies from 55 patients who underwent high orchiectomy for germ cell tumors. Two patients later developed contralateral testicular tumors. On re-examination with H&E and PLAP immunostaining, carcinoma in situ (CIS) was found in 2 of 55 patients (3.6%), and both had been missed on the initial review. The authors conclude that biopsy sensitivity is limited and recommend biopsy according to Skakkebaek's guidance to improve CIS detection.

title: Extragonadal yolk sac tumor in pelvic localization. A case report and literature review.
title_ja: 骨盤内性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 腹痛と腹部膨満を訴えた33歳女性で、骨盤内に性腺外の腫瘤が見つかった症例です。左骨盤内腫瘤摘出術、両側卵巣楔状切除、リンパ節郭清などを行いました。病理では卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法4コースを追加し、6か月間無病で経過しています。文献レビューも併記されています。
summary_en: A 33-year-old woman presented with abdominal pain and distension, and a pelvic mass initially thought to be a subserosal myoma. Exploration revealed an extragonadal mass, which was resected together with bilateral ovarian wedge resection, pelvic and paraaortic lymph node dissection, and omentectomy. Histology showed yolk sac tumor with positive AFP and cytokeratin staining. She received four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy and remained disease-free for 6 months. The authors also reviewed the literature.

title: Human STELLAR, NANOG, and GDF3 genes are expressed in pluripotent cells and map to chromosome 12p13, a hotspot for teratocarcinoma.
title_ja: ヒトSTELLAR、NANOG、GDF3遺伝子は多能性細胞で発現し、奇形癌好発領域12p13にマップされる
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞の多能性を担う遺伝子としてSTELLAR、NANOG、GDF3を同定した研究である。これらは精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞にも発現し、ヒト胚性幹細胞の分化に伴い発現が低下する。染色体12p13は奇形癌の好発領域であり、GDF3の転写は胚細胞腫瘍細胞に限局する。
summary_en: This study identifies STELLAR, NANOG and GDF3 as genes expressed in pluripotent human embryonic stem cells and premeiotic germ lineage cells. Their expression also appears in testicular germ cell tumour cells and is downregulated upon hES cell differentiation. The authors map these genes to chromosome 12p13, a known hotspot for teratocarcinoma. GDF3 transcription is restricted to germ cell tumour cells. The findings suggest these genes may maintain pluripotency in humans in a manner similar to their roles in mice.

title: [A difficult case of advanced testicular choriocarcinoma effectively treated by chemotherapy and resection of lung metastasis].
title_ja: 進行精巣絨毛癌を化学療法と肺転移切除で有効に治療した困難な1例
summary_ja: 進行精巣絨毛癌で肺・肝・脳に転移を有した25歳男性の症例報告である。VIP療法5コースと、末梢血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法を行い、その後肺転移を切除した。切除標本には絨毛癌の遺残を認めた。術後3年3か月再発はなく、化学療法と手術の併用が奏功した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with advanced testicular choriocarcinoma and multiple lung, liver and brain metastases. He received five courses of VIP therapy and one course of high-dose carboplatin, etoposide and cyclophosphamide with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. After one further course of cisplatin and etoposide, lung metastasis was resected. Pathology showed a remnant of choriocarcinoma. More than three years after surgery, no recurrence has been observed, illustrating the value of multimodal management.

title: Internal hemorrhage caused by a twisted malignant ovarian dysgerminoma: ultrasonographic findings of a rare case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 捻転した卵巣未分化胚細胞腫による内出血：稀な症例の超音波所見と文献的考察
summary_ja: 16歳女性が急性右下腹部痛で受診し、捻転した右卵巣腫瘤と腹腔内出血を緊急開腹で認めた。病理学的に卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と診断され、FIGO IIC期として白金系化学療法に紹介された。超音波所見を報告し、若年女性の急性腹症では本疾患を鑑別診断に含めるべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: A 16-year-old woman presented with acute right lower abdominal pain and was found to have a twisted right ovarian mass with intraperitoneal hemorrhage at emergency laparotomy. Pathology confirmed a malignant ovarian dysgerminoma extending to the mesosalpinx, with positive peritoneal cytology. She was staged FIGO IIC and referred for platinum-based chemotherapy. The authors describe the ultrasonographic findings and review the literature. They conclude that ovarian dysgerminoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of acute abdomen in young women with a solid, heterogeneous pelvic mass.

title: Gemcitabine and oxaliplatin (GEMOX) in patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors: a phase II study.
title_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍に対するゲムシタビン＋オキサリプラチン（GEMOX）療法：第II相試験
summary_ja: 再発またはシスプラチン抵抗性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍29例に対しGEMOX療法を実施した第II相試験。奏効率は32%（完全奏効4例、部分奏効5例）で、長期無病生存は14%であった。主な毒性は血液毒性で、グレード3の神経毒性が3例に認められた。前治療の多い集団において有効かつ中等度の毒性を示す治療法と結論づけている。
summary_en: A phase II study of gemcitabine plus oxaliplatin (GEMOX) in 29 patients with relapsed or cisplatin-refractory non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² was given on days 1 and 8, with oxaliplatin 130 mg/m² on day 1 every 3 weeks for up to six cycles. The response rate was 32%, including four complete and five partial responses. Some responses were durable, with a 14% long-term disease-free rate. Main toxicity was hematologic, and three patients had grade 3 neurotoxicity. The authors conclude GEMOX is active and moderately toxic in heavily pretreated patients.

title: Peritoneal carcinomatosis in refractory seminoma.
title_ja: 難治性セミノーマにおける腹膜癌腫症
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの難治例で、腹水と腹膜転移を来した33歳男性の症例報告である。腹水の細胞診でセミノーマ細胞が確認された。イリノテカンを基軸とする新規化学療法で腹水は消失したが再発し、治療開始5か月後に病勢進行で死亡した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の腹腔内転移は極めてまれであることが示された。
summary_en: A 33-year-old man with refractory testicular seminoma developed peritoneal carcinomatosis with ascites, and cytology showed seminoma cells. The ascites resolved after an irinotecan-based chemotherapy regimen. However, ascites recurred, and the patient died of progressive disease five months after starting therapy. The report highlights that intraperitoneal spread from a testicular germ cell tumor is very rare and can be refractory to newer regimens.

title: Huge seminoma developed in a patient with testicular feminization.
title_ja: 精巣女性化症に発生した巨大セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣女性化症と診断された36歳女性が、原発性無月経と巨大腹部腫瘤で受診した。腫瘍摘出術とリンパ節郭清により両側精巣セミノーマと傍大動脈リンパ節転移が確認された。思春期以降は性腺摘除が推奨され、無治療では悪性転化のリスクが高まる。まれな先天性疾患での早期診断と慎重なフォローアップの重要性が示された。
summary_en: A 36-year-old woman with testicular feminization presented with primary amenorrhea and a giant abdominal mass. Tumorectomy with pelvic and para-aortic lymphadenectomy revealed bilateral testicular seminoma with para-aortic nodal metastasis. The authors note that gonadectomy is generally recommended after puberty because the risk of malignant transformation rises substantially in dysgenetic gonads. The case shows that undiagnosed seminoma can grow into a huge abdominal mass, and that early diagnosis and careful follow-up are critical in this rare congenital disorder.

title: Long-term survivors of ovarian malignancies after cisplatin-based chemotherapy; cardiovascular risk factors and signs of vascular damage.
title_ja: 卵巣悪性腫瘍の長期生存者における心血管危険因子と血管障害の徴候：シスプラチン併用化学療法後
summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法で治癒した卵巣上皮性腫瘍または胚細胞腫瘍の女性21例を、中央値14年の経過で評価した。高コレステロール血症、肥満、高血圧などの心血管危険因子が高頻度に認められた。微量アルブミン尿は年齢をそろえた一般女性より多かった。若年の女性生存者は早期から血管障害のリスクを抱えると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study assessed 21 women with ovarian epithelial or germ cell tumors cured by cisplatin-based chemotherapy, after a median follow-up of 14 years. Hypercholesterolaemia, obesity, hypertension, insulin resistance, and microalbuminuria were common. Microalbuminuria was more frequent than in an age-matched female population. The authors conclude that young female survivors of cisplatin-based treatment are at risk of early cardiovascular risk factors and endothelial damage, extending evidence previously known mainly from male germ cell tumor patients.

title: GTT1/StarD7, a novel phosphatidylcholine transfer protein-like highly expressed in gestational trophoblastic tumour: cloning and characterization.
title_ja: GTT1/StarD7：妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍で高発現するホスファチジルコリン輸送タンパク様分子のクローニングと特性解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3で胞状奇胎や正常絨毛より高発現する遺伝子としてGTT1/StarD7をクローニングした。ホスファチジルコリン輸送タンパクに類似し、START脂質結合ドメインを持つ。JEG-3とJAR絨毛癌細胞で発現が最も高かった。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍細胞におけるリン脂質シグナル伝達への関与が示唆されている。
summary_en: This study cloned GTT1/StarD7, a gene similar to phosphatidylcholine transfer protein, identified through higher expression in the choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cell line than in complete hydatidiform mole and normal trophoblast. The gene contains a START lipid-binding domain and maps to chromosome 2p12-2p11.2. Expression was highest in JEG-3 and JAR choriocarcinoma cells, with wider expression across other tumor lines. The authors suggest GTT1 may participate in phospholipid signaling in trophoblastic tumor cells.

title: Histology in mixed germ cell tumors. Is there a favorite pairing?
title_ja: 混合型胚細胞腫瘍の組織型：好まれる組み合わせはあるか
summary_ja: 単一施設で精巣摘除標本2589例を後方視的に解析し、混合型胚細胞腫瘍1765例の組織型の組み合わせを検討した。奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の相関が最も強かった。精巣の奇形腫または卵黄嚢腫瘍は、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清で奇形腫が見つかることと関連した。精巣腫瘍の発生と臨床経過の理解に役立つ可能性がある。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 2589 orchiectomy specimens from a single institution analyzed histological combinations in 1765 mixed germ cell tumors. Odds ratios were calculated for pairings of teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and seminoma. Four pairings showed positive correlation, strongest between teratoma and yolk sac tumor. Teratoma or yolk sac tumor in the testis predicted teratoma at post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The findings may inform understanding of testicular tumor ontogeny and clinical behavior.

title: Impact of unnecessary exploratory laparotomy on the treatment of patients with metastatic germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者における不要な開腹探索術の影響
summary_ja: GCTと診断されていなかった転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対して開腹探索術を受けた40例を後方視的に検討した。手術合併症は22%に生じた。化学療法までの期間は中央値29日で、30日以上の遅延例では救援化学療法や大量化学療法など集中的治療が必要になりやすかった。胚細胞腫瘍を念頭に置く重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: Forty patients who underwent exploratory laparotomy for unsuspected metastatic germ cell tumor were retrospectively reviewed. Surgery caused complications in 22 percent and delayed chemotherapy by a median of 29 days in many patients. Those delayed 30 days or more were more likely to need intensive chemotherapy, including high-dose or salvage regimens. The authors conclude that exploratory laparotomy contributes to therapeutic delay and complicates therapy, and emphasize that clinicians should consider germ cell tumor when a retroperitoneal mass is found.

title: Outcome and staging evaluation in malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary in children and adolescents: an intergroup study.
title_ja: 小児・思春期の卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の転帰と病期分類の評価：共同研究
summary_ja: POGとCCSGの2つの共同試験に登録された卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の女児131例を解析した。6年生存率は全病期で93%以上だった。外科的病期分類の手順からの逸脱は多かったが、生存率への影響はみられなかった。保存的切除と白金製剤を用いた化学療法が有効で、新たな外科的ガイドラインが提案されている。
summary_en: This intergroup analysis of 131 girls with ovarian malignant germ cell tumors from two Pediatric Oncology Group and Children's Cancer Study Group trials reported six-year survival above 93 percent across all stages. Protocol deviations in surgical staging were common, including omitted bilateral node biopsies and omentectomies. Survival did not appear affected by these deviations. The authors propose new surgical guidelines based on correlation of gross operative findings with pathology and outcome, supporting conservative resection and platinum-based chemotherapy for pediatric ovarian GCT.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma: prenatal assessment, fetal intervention, and outcome.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫:出生前評価、胎児治療、および転帰
summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫30例を後方視的に検討し、出生前画像、自然経過、胎児治療を評価した。生存者は14例で、継続妊娠の81%に産科合併症がみられた。4例で開放型胎児外科的切除が行われ、3例が生存した。合併症には新生児死亡、塞栓症、腫瘍再発が含まれた。著者らは、心機能が急速に悪化しうるため厳重な出生前管理が必要であり、羊水減量、嚢胞穿刺、外科的減量術は救命的となりうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This review of 30 fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma cases (1995 to 2003) evaluated prenatal imaging, natural history and fetal intervention. Outcomes included 14 survivors, and obstetric complications occurred in 81% of continuing pregnancies. Fetal interventions comprised cyst aspiration, amnioreduction, and open fetal resection in four cases, of which three survived. Complications included neonatal death, embolism and tumor recurrence. The authors conclude that cardiac compromise can progress rapidly, warranting close prenatal surveillance, and that amnioreduction, cyst aspiration and surgical debulking may be life-saving.

title: Contouring buttock reconstruction after sacrococcygeal teratoma resection.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫切除後の臀部輪郭再建法
summary_ja: 巨大仙尾部奇形腫の切除後の臀部再建法を2例で報告した。従来のシェブロン切開では耳状の突出や殿溝を越える瘢痕が生じやすい。多角形の皮膚切除を連続して行い、余剰組織を中央へ寄せることで、殿溝を避けた直角状の瘢痕とした。両児とも正常な臀部輪郭を得られ、瘢痕は水着で隠れる。組織再配置の原理を応用した方法である。
summary_en: This report describes a closure technique for buttock reconstruction after resection of massive sacrococcygeal teratomas in two infants. Conventional chevron closure often leaves protruding dog-ear deformities and scars extending onto the posterior thighs. The authors used serial polygonal skin excisions, working excess tissue centrally and leaving right-angled scars that avoid the infragluteal crease. Both infants achieved a normal buttock contour without redundancy, and the scars can be concealed by bathing attire. The approach applies tissue rearrangement principles to restore contour with hidden scars.

title: 2-18fluoro-deoxy-D-glucose positron emission tomography is a reliable predictor for viable tumor in postchemotherapy seminoma: an update of the prospective multicentric SEMPET trial.
title_ja: 化学療法後セミノーマ残存腫瘤の評価における陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の有用性：SEMPET試験のアップデート
summary_ja: 転移性純粋セミノーマの化学療法後残存腫瘤に対し、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)が生存腫瘍を予測できるかを前向き多施設試験で検討した。PETの特異度と陽性的中率は100%で、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)によるサイズ評価を上回った。PETは化学療法後セミノーマの臨床判断に用いる標準的検査とすべきと結論された。
summary_en: The prospective multicentric SEMPET trial assessed FDG PET for predicting viable residual tumor in patients with metastatic pure seminoma after chemotherapy. Fifty-six PET scans from 51 patients were analyzed and correlated with histology or clinical follow-up. FDG PET showed 100% specificity and 100% positive predictive value, compared with 74% specificity and 37% positive predictive value for CT size criteria. PET sensitivity was 80%. The authors conclude that FDG PET is the best predictor of viable residual tumor in postchemotherapy seminoma and should be a standard tool for clinical decision making.

title: The role of positron emission tomography in germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の役割
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の役割を総説した。FDG PETは炎症による偽陽性や1cm未満の病変の検出困難、成熟奇形腫の鑑別困難といった限界がある。化学療法後セミノーマの残存病変評価には標準的ツールとされる。臨床病期I非セミノーマや救援化学療法の早期効果予測への有用性は検討中である。
summary_en: This review examines the role of positron emission tomography in germ cell cancer. FDG PET is currently the only tracer used for imaging GCT, but it has limitations, including false positives from inflammation, poor detection of lesions under 1 cm, and inability to distinguish mature teratoma from normal or necrotic tissue. FDG PET is established as a standard tool for evaluating postchemotherapy seminoma residuals. Its value in clinical stage I nonseminoma and in early response prediction to salvage chemotherapy remains under investigation.

title: Spectrum of germ cell tumors: from head to toe.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍のスペクトラム:頭部から足先まで
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の画像所見を、性腺・松果体・神経下垂体・縦隔・後腹膜など部位別に概説した放射線学的総説である。セミノーマは強く造影される隔壁を伴う均一な充実性の分葉状腫瘤として描出され、非セミノーマは壊死・出血・嚢胞変性を伴う不均一な腫瘤を呈する。奇形腫では脂肪と石灰化が特徴となり、未熟奇形腫では充実成分内に散在する脂肪や石灰化がみられることがある。組織学的に類似する腫瘍は部位が異なっても同様の画像所見を示す。
summary_en: This radiographic review describes the imaging spectrum of germ cell tumors across sites, including gonads, pineal gland, neurohypophysis, mediastinum and retroperitoneum. Seminomas appear as uniformly solid lobulated masses with intensely enhancing septa, while nonseminomatous tumors are heterogeneous, with necrosis, hemorrhage or cystic change. Fat and calcification are hallmarks of teratomas, and immature teratomas may show scattered fat and calcification within solid areas. Histologically similar tumors at different sites share similar imaging features, which helps radiologists make accurate diagnoses.

title: Paclitaxel-containing high-dose chemotherapy for relapsed or refractory testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 再発または難治性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するパクリタキセル含有大量化学療法
summary_ja: 再発・難治性の胚細胞腫瘍男性36例に対し、パクリタキセルを含む大量化学療法(Carbop-EC-T)と末梢血幹細胞移植を施行した。1年全生存率は全体で67%、シスプラチン感受性例で88%、シスプラチン抵抗性例で25%だった。パクリタキセルの24時間持続投与とステロイド予防により肺毒性による治療関連死が減少し、長期寛解の増加が期待されると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study evaluated Carbop-EC-T, a high-dose regimen combining paclitaxel, etoposide, carboplatin and cyclophosphamide with peripheral blood stem cell rescue, in 36 men with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumours. One-year overall survival was 67% overall, 88% for cisplatin-sensitive disease and 25% for cisplatin-refractory disease. Pulmonary toxicity led to modified paclitaxel infusion with steroid prophylaxis, after which treatment-related mortality fell markedly. The authors conclude the regimen may increase long-term remission in relapsed and refractory GCTs.

title: Survival of patients with nonseminomatous germ cell cancer: a review of the IGCC classification by Cox regression and recursive partitioning.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の生存:Cox回帰と再帰的分割によるIGCC分類の再検討
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍3048例を対象に、国際胚細胞コンセンサス(IGCC)分類の予後予測能を検討した。Cox回帰と再帰的分割法による代替分類を比較したところ、判別能はIGCC分類とほぼ同等であった。不良予後群をさらに細分化すると5群に分類でき、判別能はわずかに向上した。3群のIGCC分類は概ね支持され、Cox回帰が分類の洗練に最も有望との結論である。
summary_en: This study analysed 3048 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumours to test whether the International Germ Cell Consensus (IGCC) prognostic classification could be improved. Cox regression and recursive partitioning were compared with the IGCC model using bootstrap-corrected c-statistics. Discrimination was similar across approaches (IGCC c=0.732; Cox c=0.730; recursive partitioning c=0.709). Subgrouping the poor-prognosis group yielded five prognostic groups with slightly better discrimination (c=0.740). The authors conclude that the three-group IGCC classification is largely supported and Cox regression offers the most promising refinement.

title: Ovarian teratoma showing a predominant hemangiomatous element with stromal luteinization: report of a case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 血管腫様成分と間質黄体化を主体とした卵巣奇形腫:症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 63歳日本人女性の充実性卵巣腫瘍を報告した。主体は血管腫様成分で、呼吸上皮に覆われた小嚢胞と、インヒビン陽性の著明な間質黄体化を伴っていた。連続切片でも皮様嚢腫などの奇形腫成分は認めなかった。血管性卵巣腫瘍が単一胚葉性奇形腫か真の間質性腫瘍かを考察し、血管腫様増殖を認める場合は純粋な血管腫と診断する前に奇形腫成分を十分に探索すべきと述べている。
summary_en: A solid, well-circumscribed ovarian tumour in a 63-year-old Japanese woman was composed predominantly of a hemangiomatous component, with a small respiratory-epithelium-lined cyst and marked stromal luteinization positive for inhibin. Serial sections showed no dermoid or other teratomatous elements. The authors discuss whether ovarian hemangiomatous tumours are monodermal teratomas or true stromal neoplasms, and recommend a thorough search for teratomatous components before diagnosing a pure hemangioma.

title: Erroneous diagnosis of pancreatic cancer after radiotherapy of testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対する放射線療法後に生じた膵がんとの誤診
summary_ja: セミノーマに対して放射線療法を受けた2例(うち1例はシスプラチン併用化学療法も施行)が、膵癌に類似した胆管狭窄を発症した。1例は病理標本の再検討で、もう1例は術中所見で非悪性の線維化と確認された。両例ともバイパス術で良好な緩和が得られた。放射線照射後の後腹膜上部の線維化は膵癌との重要な鑑別診断であり、臨床・画像診断のみでは誤った情報や登録の誤りを招くと警告している。
summary_en: Two men irradiated for seminoma, one also treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, developed biliary stenosis and imaging findings mimicking pancreatic cancer. Non-malignant fibrosis was confirmed by revised histology in one case and intraoperatively in the other. Both underwent bypass surgery with excellent palliation. The authors highlight radiation-induced fibrosis of the upper retroperitoneal space as an important differential diagnosis to pancreatic cancer after radiotherapy for seminoma, and warn that clinical and radiological diagnosis alone may cause misinformation and registry errors.

title: Long-term results of laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection: a single-center 10-year experience.
title_ja: 腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の長期成績:単施設10年の経験
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍185例に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(L-RPLND)の10年成績を単施設で報告した。対象は病期Iと低腫瘍量の病期II。開腹移行率は2.6%、順行性射精の温存率は98.4%であった。化学療法後の成熟奇形腫は38.2%に認めた。大半の患者は再発なく、腫瘍進行による死亡もなかった。腫瘍制御と診断精度は開腹手術と同等で合併症は少なく、経験豊富な施設での実施が妥当とされる。
summary_en: This single-centre study reports 10-year outcomes of laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (L-RPLND) in 185 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumour, including Stage I and low-volume Stage II disease. The conversion rate was 2.6%, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 98.4%. Mature teratoma was found in 38.2% after chemotherapy, and active tumour in a minority. Most patients remained relapse-free with no tumour-progression deaths. The authors conclude that tumour control and diagnostic accuracy match open surgery with lower morbidity, supporting use at experienced centres.

title: Long-term follow-up of Anglian Germ Cell Cancer Group surveillance versus patients with Stage 1 nonseminoma treated with adjuvant chemotherapy.
title_ja: 補助化学療法を受けた病期I非セミノーマ患者とAnglian Germ Cell Cancer Groupの監視療法患者の長期フォローアップ
summary_ja: 1978~2000年に治療された病期I非セミノーマの男性382例を検討し、監視療法と高リスク患者への補助化学療法を比較した。再発は監視療法群で30%、補助化学療法群で4%であり、胚細胞腫瘍関連死亡はそれぞれ2.6%、1.4%であった。高リスク患者の24%は補助治療を辞退した。著者らは補助化学療法が後腹膜リンパ節郭清より再発を効果的に抑えるとし、監視療法とRPLNDも正当な選択肢だと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study reviewed 382 men with Stage 1 nonseminoma treated between 1978 and 2000, comparing surveillance with adjuvant chemotherapy for high-risk patients. Relapse occurred in 30% of surveillance patients versus 4% of those given adjuvant chemotherapy, with 2.6% and 1.4% germ cell cancer-related deaths respectively. Many high-risk men declined adjuvant treatment. The authors conclude adjuvant chemotherapy reduces relapse more effectively than retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, while surveillance and RPLND remain justified, and call for quality-of-life studies and greater patient involvement in treatment selection.

title: Development of human chorionic gonadotropin subunit-beta promoter-based toxic gene therapy for testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対するhCG-βプロモーター依存性毒性遺伝子治療の開発
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 組織特異的なhCG-βプロモーターでチミジンキナーゼを発現させるアデノウイルスベクター(Ad-hCG-beta-TK)を作製し、アシクロビル併用で毒性を発揮させる遺伝子治療を開発した。hCG-β産生性の精巣胎児性癌細胞株NEC 8の増殖はin vitroで選択的に抑制され、前立腺癌細胞PC-3や膀胱癌細胞WHでは抑制されなかった。ヌードマウスでもNEC 8皮下腫瘍の増殖を有意に抑制した。初回治療後に再発した精巣胚細胞腫瘍への応用が期待される。
summary_en: The authors developed a toxic gene therapy in which the tissue-specific hCG-beta promoter drives thymidine kinase expression from an adenovirus vector (Ad-hCG-beta-TK), activated by acyclovir. In vitro, the construct selectively inhibited growth of hCG-beta-producing testicular embryonal carcinoma cells (NEC 8) but not prostate PC-3 or bladder WH cells. In nude mice, it significantly suppressed NEC 8 subcutaneous tumour growth. The approach targets testicular germ cell tumours that produce hCG-beta, offering a potential therapy for patients who relapse after initial treatment.

title: Mature cystic teratoma: unusual presentation as anterior neck swelling.
title_ja: 前頸部腫脹として発症した縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 29歳マレー系女性が前頸部腫脹で受診し、縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と判明した症例を報告した。縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は通常、無症状の腫瘤として偶然発見されることが多く、頸部症状で発見された点が特徴である。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍が頸部腫脹として発症しうることを示し、前頸部腫瘤の鑑別診断に含めるべきと示唆している。
summary_en: The authors report a 29-year-old Malay woman who presented with an anterior neck swelling that proved to be a mature mediastinal cystic teratoma. Mature cystic teratomas of the mediastinum usually present as asymptomatic masses found incidentally, so this case is unusual. The report highlights that mediastinal germ cell tumours can present with cervical swelling and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of anterior neck masses.

title: The role of high-dose chemotherapy in relapsed germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 再発胚細胞腫瘍における大量化学療法の役割
summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後に再発・進行した胚細胞腫瘍に対する救援治療としての大量化学療法を検討した総説である。従来用量では長期生存者は15~30%にとどまる。マッチドペア解析では、大量化学療法が無イベント生存期間と全生存期間を改善した。末梢血前駆細胞や造血因子の利用により安全性も向上した。著者らは、初回再発で予後不良因子を有する例などに大量化学療法を推奨し、不成功例には緩和的化学療法を提案している。
summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) as salvage treatment for germ cell tumours that relapse or progress after cisplatin-based chemotherapy, where only 15-30% of patients become long-term survivors with conventional dosing. A matched-pair analysis showed HDCT improved event-free and overall survival. Improved toxicity management, peripheral blood progenitor cells and growth factors have made HDCT safer. The authors recommend HDCT for first relapse with unfavourable factors and for later salvage followed by resection, and propose palliative gemcitabine, oxaliplatin and paclitaxel for those failing HDCT.

title: Clinical epidemiology of testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床疫学
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の危険因子を、臨床疫学のエビデンスレベルで分類したレビューである。確立された因子は、停留精巣(メタ解析で統合RR 4.8)、対側精巣のGCT、家族性精巣がんであり、不妊、精巣萎縮、双胎は根拠が弱い。HIV感染も素因となりうる。著者らは、出生前のエストロゲン過剰説と小児期栄養仮説を論じ、成人身長とGCTリスクの関連が12研究中6研究で認められたと述べている。
summary_en: This review applies evidence-level grading from clinical epidemiology to risk factors for testicular germ cell tumors. Established factors include undescended testis (pooled RR 4.8 in a meta-analysis), contralateral testicular GCT, and familial testis cancer, while infertility, testicular atrophy, and twinship show weaker evidence. HIV infection may also be a predisposing factor. The authors discuss the estrogen excess theory of prenatal exposure and the childhood nutrition hypothesis, noting that adult height correlated with GCT risk in six of twelve studies.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous testicular carcinoma.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの病期I・IIに対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を検討した総説である。開腹手術と比べ出血量、術中合併症、手術時間が少なく、開腹移行率は10%未満である。順行性射精も温存可能で、長期フォローアップでも良好な腫瘍学的成績が報告されている。病期IIの残存腫瘍切除は高度な技術を要するため、経験豊富な施設に限定すべきとされる。
summary_en: This review examines laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for nonseminomatous testicular carcinoma in stage I and II disease. Compared with open surgery, laparoscopy reduces blood loss, intraoperative complications, and operative time, with conversion rates below 10% and mostly minor complications. Antegrade ejaculation can be preserved, and oncological outcomes and long-term follow-up are reported as adequate. Resection of residual tumor in stage II is feasible but technically demanding, so it should be limited to experienced centers.

title: [Mediastinal non seminomatous germ cell tumor successfully treated with chemotherapy and curative surgery; report of a case].
title_ja: 化学療法と根治的手術により良好な転帰を得た縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告
summary_ja: 20歳男性の縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例である。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇と前縦隔・右胸腔の大きな腫瘤から診断された。シスプラチンとエトポシドによる3コース後にAFPは正常化したが、出血により腫瘤は増大した。胸骨正中切開と右開胸により完全切除され、術後2年間再発はなかった。
summary_en: A 20-year-old man presented with an elevated serum AFP and a large mass in the anterior mediastinum and right thoracic cavity, leading to a diagnosis of mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. After three courses of cisplatin and etoposide, AFP normalized, but the mass enlarged due to hemorrhage. The tumor was completely removed via sternotomy and right thoracotomy. He remained free of recurrence for two years, indicating that chemotherapy followed by curative surgery can be effective even when the mass transiently grows.

title: Metastasis of choriocarcinoma to lumbar and sacral column.
title_ja: 絨毛癌の腰椎・仙椎への転移
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 進行性の下肢浮腫・疼痛・感覚異常を経て弛緩性対麻痺に至った女性の症例である。2年前に胞状奇胎に対して子宮内容除去術を受けていた。腰仙椎への絨毛癌転移と診断され、胞状奇胎後の遠隔転移による重篤な神経障害を示した症例報告である。
summary_en: A woman developed progressive lower right limb edema, pain, and paresthesia that advanced to flaccid paraplegia. Two years earlier she had undergone uterine curettage for a hydatidiform mole. Metastases of choriocarcinoma to the lumbar and sacral spinal segments were diagnosed. The case shows that gestational choriocarcinoma can metastasize to the spine years after a molar pregnancy and cause severe neurological deficit.

title: Cytogenetic investigation of testicular carcinoma in situ and early seminoma by high-resolution comparative genomic hybridization analysis of subpopulations flow sorted according to DNA content.
title_ja: DNA含量で分取した亜集団の高解像度CGH解析による精巣上皮内がんおよび早期セミノーマの細胞遺伝学的検討
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の早期病変について、DNA量で分取した細胞集団を高解像度CGHで解析した研究である。特徴的な染色体異常は3倍体から6倍体の集団でのみ認められた。上皮内がん(CIS)細胞のDNA量は3倍体から低四倍体の範囲にあり、倍数化が悪性転化の初期事象であることを示唆する。
summary_en: The authors examined early testicular germ cell neoplasia by sorting nuclei by DNA content and applying high-resolution comparative genomic hybridization. A characteristic pattern of chromosomal gains (1q, 7, 8, 12, 14, 21, X) and losses (4, 5, 9, 11, 13, 18, Y) appeared only in triploid to hexaploid subpopulations, not in hyperdiploid or pure tetraploid ones. These subpopulations contained a mix of overt tumor and carcinoma-in-situ cells, and CIS DNA content was in the triploid to hypotetraploid range. The findings support polyploidization as an early event in malignant transformation.

title: Case report: Malignant struma ovarii.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告
summary_ja: 65歳女性にみられた稀な悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は被膜浸潤を伴う濾胞型乳頭状甲状腺癌のみで構成されていた。卵巣甲状腺腫は甲状腺組織からなる特殊な奇形腫で、良性から悪性まで幅広い。奇形腫の一型として悪性成分のみからなる例が存在することを示す。
summary_en: The authors report a rare malignant struma ovarii in a 65-year-old woman. The tumor was composed exclusively of a follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma with capsular invasion, with no benign thyroid component. Struma ovarii is a specialized teratoma consisting of thyroid tissue, ranging from benign to malignant. The case shows that this ovarian teratoma can be entirely carcinomatous.

title: Spermatocytic seminoma: a review.
title_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ：総説
summary_ja: 1981年から1999年に精巣セミノーマで治療された771例のうち、精母細胞性セミノーマ12例(対象13例、1例除外)の管理を検討した総説である。全例が病期Iで、5例は傍大動脈・骨盤リンパ節への放射線療法を受け、7例はサーベイランスプログラムでフォローアップされた。中央値8.5年の観察で再発はなく、精巣網浸潤や大きな腫瘍径などのリスク因子も示された。
summary_en: This review summarizes one institution's management of spermatocytic seminoma. Of 13 identified patients (12 analyzed) among 771 treated for testicular seminoma between 1981 and 1999, all had stage I disease; five received radiotherapy to para-aortic and pelvic nodes, and seven were followed on surveillance. With median follow-up of 8.5 years, no relapses occurred. Adverse features such as rete testis invasion and large tumor size were noted. The authors conclude that surveillance after orchidectomy is preferred.

title: Gonadoblastoma in Turner syndrome patients with nonmosaic 45,X karyotype and Y chromosome sequences.
title_ja: Y染色体配列を有する非モザイク45,X核型のターナー症候群患者における性腺芽腫
summary_ja: 非モザイク型45,X核型のターナー症候群患者107例を、PCRでY染色体由来配列の検索を行った研究である。10例(9.3%)が陽性で、性腺摘除を受けた6例のうち1例に性腺芽腫、1例に性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を認めた。Y染色体配列陽性例では性腺腫瘍が33%に認められ、性腺摘除に関するカウンセリングの重要性が示された。
summary_en: This study screened 107 Mexican patients with nonmosaic 45,X Turner syndrome for Y-chromosome-derived sequences by PCR. Ten (9.3%) were positive. Of six who underwent gonadectomy, one had gonadoblastoma and another had gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma, so gonadal tumors occurred in 33% of Y-positive patients. The authors recommend counseling about gonadectomy for those carrying Y-chromosome sequences because of the high risk of gonadal tumor development.

title: New insights into the pathology and molecular biology of human germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の病理学と分子生物学における新たな知見
summary_ja: 本総説は、多様な解剖学的部位に生じるヒト胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)の病理学と分子生物学の最近の進歩をまとめたものである。精巣内の3つのGCT型について、病態生物学、細胞遺伝学、臨床的特徴の違いを解説している。OCT3/4が多能性の診断マーカーとして有用であること、若年成人の浸潤性GCTで12p獲得が一貫して見られることを強調している。さらに、治療感受性と起源細胞の性質との関連、体細胞分化が治療抵抗性に関与する可能性を論じている。
summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in the pathology and molecular biology of human germ cell tumors (GCTs), which arise at diverse anatomical sites and share similarities with early germ cell development. Within the testis, three distinct GCT entities are discussed, differing in pathobiology, cytogenetics, and clinical behavior. The authors highlight OCT3/4 as a diagnostic marker of pluripotency and the consistent 12p gain in invasive GCTs of young adults. They also discuss how treatment sensitivity relates to the cell of origin and how loss of embryonic characteristics with somatic differentiation may drive therapy resistance.

title: Adult sacrococcygeal teratomas.
title_ja: 成人の仙尾部奇形腫
summary_ja: 出生時から存在し、年齢とともに増大した成人女性の仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。単純X線、CT、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)による評価ののち、尾骨を含めて完全切除された。病理学的には三胚葉すべての分化組織が認められた。成人の仙尾部奇形腫は稀で、発生率は約8万7千人に1人、男女比は10:1と報告されている。
summary_en: This case report describes an adult woman with a sacrococcygeal teratoma that had been present since birth and enlarged progressively with age. Because her parents avoided medical consultation, the mass grew large over time. Evaluation included plain pelvic radiography, computed tomography, and magnetic resonance imaging. The tumor was completely excised together with the coccyx, and pathology showed differentiated tissue from all three germ layers. The authors note that adult sacrococcygeal teratomas are rare, with an incidence of about 1 in 87,000 and a female-to-male ratio of 10:1.

title: Outcome of patients with residual germ cell or non-germ cell malignancy after resection of primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の切除後に残存悪性腫瘍を有する患者の転帰
summary_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に残存病変を切除された47例の後方視的解析である。切除後の組織は、胚細胞腫瘍26例、奇形腫の悪性転化で非胚細胞成分を伴うもの12例などであった。16例が無病生存を継続している。残存病変を完全切除できれば、切除時の血清腫瘍マーカー上昇は予後に影響しないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 47 patients with residual cancer after resection of primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor evaluated outcomes and prognostic factors. Histology after resection included germ cell tumor in 26 patients and malignant transformation of teratoma with non-germ cell elements in 12. Sixteen patients remained continuously disease-free. Elevated serum tumor markers at resection did not alter outcome when residual disease was completely resected. The authors conclude that surgical resection of persistent cancer can achieve long-term survival in this poor-risk population.

title: Secondary surgery in germ cell tumors--when and how extensively should it be performed?
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における二次手術：いつ、どの程度行うべきか
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する二次手術、特に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を扱った総説である。抄録から判断する限り一次研究ではない。手術適応の選択と手術範囲という二つの現在の課題を論じ、いずれも治療戦略の変化とともに発展し続けていると述べている。抄録には具体的な症例数や成績は示されていない。
summary_en: This short review addresses secondary surgery in germ cell tumors, focusing on postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND). It discusses two current issues: how patients should be selected for surgery, and how extensive the operation should be. The authors note that both aspects continue to evolve as treatment strategies change. The article is a brief overview rather than a primary study, and the abstract presents no detailed case numbers or outcome data.

title: SIADH associated with ovarian immature teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫に伴うSIADH：症例報告
summary_ja: 17歳の女性が骨盤内腫瘤と低ナトリウム血症(血清Na 121 mmol/l)を呈し、抗利尿ホルモン不適切分泌症候群(SIADH)と診断された症例報告である。精査の結果、原因はグレード2の卵巣未熟奇形腫のみと判明した。根治手術と化学療法後にSIADHの再発はみられなかった。著者らは、未熟奇形腫内の神経下垂体様構造がADH分泌に関与している可能性を提唱している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with a pelvic mass and severe hyponatremia (serum sodium 121 mmol/l) caused by the syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion (SIADH). Investigation confirmed a grade 2 ovarian immature teratoma as the only identified cause. After curative surgery and chemotherapy, SIADH did not recur. The authors propose that neurohypophyseal-like structures within the immature teratoma may account for ADH release.

title: Gastric teratoma.
title_ja: 胃奇形腫
summary_ja: 女児に生じた胃奇形腫の症例報告である。小児の奇形腫の1%未満にすぎず、多くは男児にみられる胃原発例である。女性例の報告は少なく、本症例はその数少ない追加例にあたる。腫瘍は外方性と内方性の両方の発育を示した。良性・悪性を問わず完全切除により予後は良好とされている。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare gastric teratoma in a female child. Gastric teratomas account for under 1% of pediatric teratomas and usually occur in males. The tumor showed both exophytic and endophytic growth. The authors note that complete excision carries a good prognosis whether the lesion is benign or malignant, and the report adds to the few previously described gastric teratomas in females.

title: From carcinoma in situ to testicular germ cell tumour.
title_ja: 上皮内癌から精巣胚細胞腫瘍への進展
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌(CIS)が浸潤性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍へ進展する機序を、免疫組織化学を用いて検討した研究である。25例37検体を解析した。腫瘍細胞の増殖により精細管が拡張し、セルトリ細胞の変性を経て管壁が結合組織へ変化すると示唆された。従来のCIS細胞が管壁を通過するという説とは異なる知見である。
summary_en: This study examines how carcinoma in situ (CIS) of the testis progresses to invasive germ cell tumor. Immunohistochemistry was performed on 37 testicular specimens from 25 patients. The findings suggest that invasion occurs in situ: tumor cells proliferate and enlarge the seminiferous tubules, Sertoli cells degenerate, and the tubular wall converts to connective tissue while the basement membrane is preserved. This challenges the prevailing view that CIS cells migrate across the tubular wall.

title: Intracardiac yolk sac tumor and dysrhythmia as an etiology of pediatric syncope.
title_ja: 心臓内卵黄嚢腫瘍と小児失神の原因としての不整脈
summary_ja: 心臓内に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍により、三度房室ブロックと失神様発作を来した小児の症例報告である。腫瘍は右房から左房まで広がり、緊急の人工心肺下に大部分を切除した。術後も恒久的ペースメーカーが必要であった。初回のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は著明に高値で、化学療法後に正常範囲となり、4年後も再発はみられていない。
summary_en: This case report describes a child with syncope and seizure-like activity caused by a large intracardiac yolk sac tumor. The mass filled the right atrium and extended into the ventricles and left atrium, causing third-degree heart block and outflow tract obstruction. Emergency cardiopulmonary bypass removed most of the tumor, and permanent pacing was required afterward. The markedly elevated initial alpha-fetoprotein normalized after chemotherapy, and no recurrence was seen four years later.

title: Granulosa cell tumor and mucinous cystadenoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: A unique case report and review of literature.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に併存した顆粒膜細胞腫および粘液性嚢胞腺腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 40歳女性の多房性嚢胞により腫大した卵巣に、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、粘液性嚢胞腺腫、顆粒膜細胞腫が同時に認められた症例を報告する。嚢胞壁内に黄褐色結節が埋め込まれた毛髪を含む腫瘤が特徴である。3種類の併存を報告した例は著者らの知る限り過去にない。奇形腫と顆粒膜細胞腫の併存に関する文献レビューも含まれる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman whose enlarged, multiloculated ovary contained a mature cystic teratoma, a mucinous cystadenoma, and a granulosa cell tumor. The teratoma showed a hair-containing mass with a yellow-tan nodule embedded in the cyst wall. Such combinations are extremely rare, and the authors state that no prior report describes mature cystic teratoma coexisting with both granulosa cell tumor and mucinous cystadenoma. The paper includes a literature review of teratoma associated with granulosa cell tumor.

title: Late relapse of testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんの晩期再発
summary_ja: 精巣がんの晩期再発（完全寛解後2年超の再発）は2〜6%に生じ、緩徐な増殖と化学療法抵抗性を特徴とする独立した病態と考えられている。化学療法への初期反応は30%未満で、外科的切除が主な治療となり長期予後は良好である。好発部位は後腹膜で、卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型が多い。治癒率は約50%にとどまり、初回治療の適切な実施が重要である。
summary_en: Late relapse (LR) of testicular cancer, defined as recurrence more than two years after complete remission, occurs in 2 to 6% of patients and is considered a distinct entity because of slow growth and chemoresistance. Initial chemotherapy response is under 30%, so complete surgical resection is usually the main treatment with favorable long-term results. The retroperitoneum is the most common site, with yolk sac histology most frequent. The overall cure rate is only about 50%, which underscores the importance of adequate primary treatment.

title: Teratoma arising from anomalous common bile ducts: a case report.
title_ja: 総胆管から発生した奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 肝外総胆管から発生した奇形腫はきわめてまれである。文献上の2例に続く3例目として、生後4か月の女児で、遠位総肝管から発生した良性嚢胞性奇形腫を報告する。異常総胆管の合併も認められた。患者の外科的管理についても論じ、本症例は胆管由来奇形腫の診断と治療を考える上で参考になる。
summary_en: Teratoma arising from the extrahepatic common bile duct is very rare. The authors identified two prior cases in the literature and report a third: a 4-month-old girl with a benign cystic teratoma arising from the distal common hepatic bile duct, accompanied by anomalous common bile ducts. The surgical management of the patient is also discussed.

title: Detection of germ-cell-tumor-specific gene products in peripheral blood by immunomagnetic tumor cell enrichment followed by RT-PCR.
title_ja: 免疫磁気腫瘍細胞濃縮とRT-PCRによる末梢血中の胚細胞腫瘍特異的遺伝子産物の検出
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者46例の末梢血を、治療前後にRT-PCRでαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCG、胚細胞特異的アルカリホスファターゼのmRNAについて解析した。抗HEA-125マイクロビーズによる免疫磁気濃縮は検出感度を最大185.6倍に高めた。全体の陽性率は28.3%で、臨床病期との明確な関連は認められなかった。単独のRT-PCRでは病期分類の改善に不十分だが、免疫磁気濃縮には期待が持てる。
summary_en: Peripheral blood from 46 patients with testicular germ cell tumors was analyzed by RT-PCR for AFP, beta-hCG, and germ-cell-specific alkaline phosphatase mRNA before and after therapy. Immunomagnetic enrichment with anti-HEA-125 microbeads increased detection sensitivity up to 185.6-fold in titration experiments. Overall PCR positivity was 28.3% and did not clearly track clinical stage. The authors conclude that qualitative RT-PCR alone is insufficient to improve staging, but immunomagnetic enrichment is promising.

title: Diagnostic and prognostic significance of circulating tumor suppressor gene p53 autoantibodies in patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における血清p53自己抗体の診断的・予後的意義
summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍72例を対象に、血清p53自己抗体とhCGβを測定した研究である。自己抗体は正常妊娠や自然退縮する奇胎では検出されず、絨毛癌で最も高値であった。治療後に低下し、hCGβ値と正の相関を示した。鑑別診断と治療効果のモニタリングに有用と結論している。
summary_en: This study measured serum p53 autoantibodies and hCGβ in 72 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors, including hydatidiform mole, postmolar high-risk disease and choriocarcinoma, alongside first-trimester controls. Autoantibodies were absent in normal pregnancy and spontaneously regressing moles but present in postmolar high-risk and choriocarcinoma cases, with the highest levels in choriocarcinoma. They fell after treatment, most rapidly in low-risk disease, and correlated with hCGβ. The authors conclude that p53 autoantibodies aid differential diagnosis and monitoring of treatment response.

title: Testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん
summary_ja: 精巣がんに関する近年の臨床文献を概観したレビューである。発症率上昇の背景、予後マーカー（S-LD-1など）、予後不良例への集中治療、病期Iおよび病期IIのセミノーマに対する放射線療法とカルボプラチンによる補助療法、監視療法を取り上げる。化学療法後の残存腫瘤、ブレオマイシン肺毒性、妊孕性も論じている。
summary_en: This review summarizes recent clinical literature on testicular cancer. Findings cover rising incidence linked to birth-cohort effects and early exposure, and prognostic markers including proliferation, apoptosis and S-LD-1. Treatment topics include intensive therapy for poor-risk patients, radiation and adjuvant carboplatin for stage I and II seminoma, and surveillance for compliant early-stage patients. Residual masses after chemotherapy, bleomycin pulmonary toxicity and fertility are also discussed.

title: Oral teratoma: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 口腔奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 硬口蓋前部に生じた奇形腫の男児新生児例を報告し、手術により良好に治療したことを示す。奇形腫は三胚葉すべてに由来する真の腫瘍とされる。新生児の口腔奇形腫はこれまで13例しか報告がなく、極めてまれである。症例報告と文献レビューを組み合わせた論文である。
summary_en: The authors report a male neonate with a teratoma arising from the anterior hard palate, successfully treated with surgery. They describe teratomas as true neoplasms derived from all three germ layers, of unknown origin. Only 13 neonatal oral cavity cases had previously been reported, making this presentation rare. The paper combines a case report with a brief literature review.

title: Gene expression profiling of early- and late-relapse nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and primitive neuroectodermal tumor of the testis.
title_ja: 早期再発型および晩期再発型の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と精巣原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍の遺伝子発現プロファイル
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 後腹膜の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍17例（卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、奇形腫）と精巣の原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍2例の遺伝子発現を解析した。発現プロファイルは組織型と相関し、型特異的な診断マーカー候補を同定した。さらに、早期再発と晩期再発の卵黄嚢腫瘍を区別する遺伝子群を見いだし、予後や薬剤反応の差に関与する可能性を示した。
summary_en: This study profiled gene expression in 17 retroperitoneal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (yolk sac tumors, embryonal carcinomas, teratomas) and two testicular PNETs. Patients were grouped by early (within 2 years) or late relapse. Expression profiles correlated with histology and identified type-specific candidate diagnostic markers. A gene set distinguished early- from late-relapse yolk sac tumors, possibly reflecting differences in clinical outcome and drug response.

title: Unusual pathology of colon: inclusion dermoid cyst.
title_ja: 結腸の包含類皮嚢腫という異常な病理像
summary_ja: 横行結腸に生じた類皮嚢腫を報告する。類皮嚢腫は胚発生時の癒合線に沿った正中に、迷入した外胚葉組織から生じるとされ、消化管では極めてまれである。盲腸と回腸での報告はわずかで、横行結腸例は初めてと述べている。成熟奇形腫型の病変として、性腺外の病変の知見を広げる症例報告である。
summary_en: The authors describe a dermoid cyst found in the transverse colon, a site where such a lesion had not previously been reported. Dermoid cysts typically occur in the midline near embryonic fusion lines, arising from trapped ectodermal tissue, and are very rare in the gastrointestinal tract. The authors note only a few previous cases in the caecum and ileum. This case report expands knowledge of extragonadal mature teratoma-type lesions.

title: Prediction of necrosis after chemotherapy of advanced germ cell tumors: results of a prospective multicenter trial of the German Testicular Cancer Study Group.
title_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後における壊死の予測：ドイツ精巣がん研究グループの前向き多施設試験
summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループの8施設で行われた前向き試験で、進行期胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜残存腫瘍切除を受けた261例について、壊死を予測する術前因子を検討した。化学療法前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)20 ng/ml未満と腫瘍縮小率が独立した予測因子であった。純粋セミノーマ例では生存腫瘍がほとんど残らず、切除は推奨されないと結論した。
summary_en: A prospective multicenter trial from eight German Testicular Cancer Study Group centers assessed preoperative predictors of necrosis in 261 patients undergoing retroperitoneal residual tumor resection after chemotherapy for advanced germ cell tumors. Among non-seminoma patients, 35% had necrosis, 34% teratoma and 31% viable carcinoma. Serum AFP below 20 ng/ml and tumor shrinkage were independent predictors, but sensitivity was modest (52%). Pure seminoma patients rarely had residual viable tumor, so resection was not recommended for them.

title: Possible mechanism responsible for the acquisition of resistance to cis-diamminedichloroplatinum (II) by cultured human testicular seminoma cells.
title_ja: ヒト精巣セミノーマ培養細胞がシスプラチン耐性を獲得する機序
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 高転移性の精巣セミノーマ細胞株JKT-HMに低用量のシスプラチンを間欠的に長期投与し、耐性株JKT/DDPを樹立した。親株と比べて薬剤感受性が著しく低く、MDR1、MRP、GST-piの発現が高く、細胞内シスプラチン濃度が低かった。細胞質内での薬剤代謝の亢進が耐性獲得の機序と結論している。
summary_en: The authors established a cisplatin-resistant seminoma cell line, JKT/DDP, by long-term intermittent low-dose exposure of the highly metastatic JKT-HM line. Growth, drug sensitivity and intracellular platinum levels were compared with parental lines. JKT/DDP was markedly more resistant, had higher MDR1, MRP and GST-pi expression, and accumulated less intracellular cisplatin. The authors attribute resistance to increased cytoplasmic drug metabolism.

title: Thyrotoxic adenoma followed by atypical hyperthyroidism due to struma ovarii: clinical and genetic studies.
title_ja: 単一の甲状腺毒性腺腫治療後に生じた卵巣甲状腺腫による甲状腺中毒症：臨床および遺伝学的研究
summary_ja: 73歳女性で甲状腺毒性腺腫の放射性ヨウ素治療後に新たな甲状腺機能亢進症が出現した症例。骨盤部集積から卵巣甲状腺腫を摘出した。遺伝子変異は認めず、単クローン性で、LOH解析では良性奇形腫と異なる構造異常が見られた。単一胚細胞由来と考えられ、古典的な毒性腺腫とは異なる機序で甲状腺機能亢進症を起こすと結論した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 73-year-old woman with a thyroid toxic adenoma successfully treated with radioiodine who then developed new hyperthyroidism. Iodine scintigraphy revealed pelvic uptake, and a thyroid-differentiated left ovarian teratoma (struma ovarii) was removed. Genetic screening for TSH receptor and Gs-alpha mutations was negative, and clonality analysis showed a monoclonal origin. Comparative genomic hybridization showed no abnormalities, yet loss of heterozygosity revealed structural changes unlike typical benign teratomas. The authors suggest struma ovarii arises from a single germ cell and causes hyperthyroidism via mechanisms distinct from classic toxic adenoma.

title: Laparoscopic RPLND for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer: current status.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の現状
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)の現状を文献学的に評価した総説。いずれの治療法も有効であり、罹患率が治療選択の主要因となる。治療目的の腹腔鏡下RPLNDは開腹手術を低侵襲に再現でき、従来法の有効な代替手段であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This literature review evaluates laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer and compares it with other treatment options. The authors note that all treatment modalities are effective for this stage, so morbidity is the key factor guiding decisions. Laparoscopic RPLND, when used therapeutically, can replicate open RPLND through a minimally invasive approach. The review concludes that laparoscopic RPLND is an effective alternative to traditional treatment options.

title: Outcome of patients with HIV-related germ cell tumours: a case-control study.
title_ja: HIV関連胚細胞腫瘍の転帰：症例対照研究
summary_ja: HIV陽性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者と年齢・病期をマッチさせた一般人口の対照を比較した症例対照研究。無病生存には差がないが、全生存期間はHIV陽性例で低く、その死亡の70%はHIVが原因だった。病期I・転移例の再発や無病生存はHIVの影響を受けず、HAART導入後も改善はなかった。HIV関連GCTは一般例より悪性度が高いわけではないと結論。
summary_en: This matched case-control study compared outcomes of HIV-positive men and matched controls with testicular germ cell tumor. Five-year GCT-free survival did not differ, but overall survival was lower in HIV-positive patients, with HIV accounting for 70% of this mortality. Relapse-free survival in stage I patients on surveillance, and disease-free survival in metastatic disease, were unaffected by HIV status. Overall survival did not improve after highly active antiretroviral therapy. The authors conclude HIV-related GCT is not more aggressive than GCT in the general population.

title: c-mos immunoreactivity aids in the diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic lesions.
title_ja: c-mosの免疫反応性は妊娠性絨毛性疾患病変の診断に有用である
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患病変、正常胎盤、女性生殖器腫瘍、胚細胞腫瘍でc-mosの免疫染色を比較した研究。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌では陽性で、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍では陰性であった。非栄養膜由来腫瘍はすべて陰性。絨毛癌と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、および鑑別が問題となる非栄養膜性腫瘍の鑑別に有用であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study evaluated c-mos immunohistochemistry in gestational trophoblastic lesions, normal placentas, other gynecologic tumors, and germ cell tumors. c-mos was expressed in all hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinomas but in none of the placental site trophoblastic tumors, and it mirrored normal placental staining patterns. All nontrophoblastic tumors, including carcinomas, sarcomas, and germ cell tumors, were negative. The authors conclude that c-mos staining helps distinguish choriocarcinoma from placental site trophoblastic tumor and from nontrophoblastic tumors that can cause diagnostic confusion in the female genital tract.

title: Autologous cord blood transfusion in an infant with a huge sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 巨大仙尾部奇形腫の乳児に対する自己臍帯血輸血
summary_ja: 巨大仙尾部奇形腫を伴う3,992gの新生児に対し、臍帯血を採取して術中の自己輸血を行った症例。腫瘍切除時の出血約46mlに対し、臍帯血由来の赤血球を用いて同種輸血を回避した。凝固障害、溶血、細菌感染は認めず、新生児の腫瘍手術における本手技の安全性を示したと述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a neonate weighing 3,992 g with a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma who underwent autologous cord blood transfusion. Placental blood was collected from the umbilical vein and reinfused during resection of the tumor on day one, when about 46 ml of blood was lost. Using 27.8 ml of autologous packed red cells, the infant avoided homologous transfusion. No consumption coagulopathy, hemolysis, or bacterial infection was observed, suggesting the procedure is safe in neonatal tumor surgery.

title: The clinical presentation, treatment, and outcome of patients diagnosed with possible ectopic molar gestation.
title_ja: 異所性胞状奇胎の疑いと診断された患者の臨床像、治療および転帰
summary_ja: 1986〜2000年に英国の妊娠性絨毛性疾患センターに登録された異所性胞状奇胎の疑い31例の検討。病理学的に確認されたのは6例(絨毛癌3例、初期全胞状奇胎3例)であった。4例が化学療法を要したが全例寛解。異所性GTDはまれで、手術と登録が基本で予後は良好と結論。
summary_en: This study reviewed 31 suspected ectopic molar gestations among 5,581 registrations at a UK trophoblastic disease center over 14 years. Only six cases were confirmed on central histological review: three choriocarcinomas and three early complete moles. Four patients needed chemotherapy, and all achieved complete remission. Risk factors for ectopic pregnancy were present in 79% of cases. The authors conclude that ectopic GTD is uncommon, usually managed surgically with registration at a screening center, and has an excellent prognosis.

title: Computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging findings in cases of dermoid cyst coexisting with surface epithelial tumors in the same ovary.
title_ja: 同一卵巣に類皮嚢腫と表層上皮性腫瘍が併存する場合のCTおよびMRI所見
summary_ja: 141例の類皮嚢腫と97例の粘液性腫瘍のうち、同一卵巣に併存した11例のCT・MRI所見を検討。脂肪成分を含む隔壁、隣接する脂肪含有成分、隔壁付き嚢胞の3パターンを示した。粘液成分が少なくても脂肪は検出しやすい。併存は稀ではなく、脂肪を含む多房性嚢胞では類皮嚢腫を考慮すべきと結論。
summary_en: This study reviewed CT and MRI findings in 11 cases of mucinous tumors coexisting with dermoid cysts in the same ovary, drawn from 141 dermoid cysts and 97 mucinous tumors. Three radiologic patterns were identified: small fatty foci in cystic septa, an adjacent fat-containing component, and a septated cystic component. Fatty foci were easily detected even when mucinous components were small. The authors conclude that coexistence of these neoplasms is not rare and that a multiseptated cyst containing fat should prompt consideration of a dermoid cyst.

title: Resection of retroperitoneal residual tumor after chemotherapy for testicular cancer indication and surgical techniques.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対する化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘍切除:適応と手術手技
summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に残存した後腹膜腫瘍の切除に関するレビューである。純粋セミノーマでは手術は省略され監視療法が好まれるが、非セミノーマでは画像上寛解後も生存腫瘍が残ることがあるため、多くで切除が推奨される。救援化学療法を含む2種類のレジメン後もマーカーが高値の場合などに適応となる。神経温存法は一部の患者で射精機能を温存しうる。手術は技術的に難しく、専門施設での実施が望ましいとされる。
summary_en: This review discusses resection of residual retroperitoneal tumor after chemotherapy in advanced germ cell tumors. Surgery is generally omitted for pure seminoma, where surveillance is preferred, but recommended for most nonseminomatous tumors because viable teratoma or carcinoma can persist despite radiological remission. Residual resection is indicated for persistently elevated markers after two regimens including salvage chemotherapy, or for chemorefractory disease. Nerve-sparing techniques can preserve ejaculation in selected patients. Surgery is technically demanding and best performed in specialized centers.

title: Birth order, sibship size, and risk for germ-cell testicular cancer.
title_ja: 出生順位・同胞数と精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク
summary_ja: スウェーデンの症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者3051例と対照9007例を比較し、出生順位と同胞数の影響を解析した。1960年以前の出生者では、同胞数が多いほど発症リスクが低下した。1959年以降の出生者では関連は認められなかった。症例で親の不妊傾向が高い可能性が示唆されている。
summary_en: This Swedish nested case-control study compared 3051 men with germ cell testicular cancer against 9007 population controls to evaluate birth order, sibship size, and testicular cancer risk. Both birth order and sibship size showed monotonic inverse associations with risk among men born before 1960, after adjusting for parental age, paternal socioeconomic status, and twin status. The associations were absent in men born after 1959. The authors suggest that higher parental subfertility among cases may explain the findings.

title: Cystectomy for immature teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫に対する嚢腫摘出術
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍38例のうち、初回手術で嚢腫摘出のみを受けた8例を後方視的に検討した研究である。全例が未熟奇形腫と診断された。多くは補助化学療法を受け、中央値4.7年の観察期間で再発は認められなかった。早期例では厳密なフォローアップを前提に、嚢腫摘出後の補助化学療法が妥当と結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 38 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluated eight who underwent cystectomy alone at initial surgery, all of whom had immature teratoma on final pathology. Most received adjuvant chemotherapy, and none recurred over a median follow-up of 4.7 years. Three patients delivered seven babies. The authors conclude that cystectomy followed by adjuvant chemotherapy seems satisfactory for early-stage disease with close follow-up, although cystectomy alone remains unproven as safe.

title: Survival rates of patients with choriocarcinoma treated with chemotherapy without hysterectomy: effects of anticancer agents on subsequent births.
title_ja: 子宮温存化学療法を受けた絨毛癌患者の生存率：後の出産への抗がん剤の影響
summary_ja: 1965〜2001年の絨毛癌患者191例を後方視的に検討し、子宮温存群と子宮摘出群の生存率を比較した。後期には両群の生存率に差はなかった。妊孕性温存例で生まれた児3例に先天性心疾患が見られ、いずれも併用化学療法後の第2子であった。メトトレキサート総投与量が多い例で心奇形が多かった。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 191 women with choriocarcinoma treated from 1965 to 2001 compared 62 managed with fertility-preserving techniques against 129 treated with hysterectomy. Survival was comparable between groups in the later period, and uterus preservation became predominant. Among 50 fertility-preserved patients, 23 conceived and 34 children were born, three with congenital heart defects, all born after combination chemotherapy. Higher total methotrexate doses were associated with heart anomalies.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumor in a postmenopausal female--a case report.
title_ja: 閉経後女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 63歳閉経後女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例報告である。子宮摘出術中に子宮が破裂し、壊死性出血性腫瘍が認められた。腫瘍細胞はサイトケラチンとβ-hCGが陽性で、最終的に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断された。閉経後の発症はまれで、臨床的・組織学的診断が困難であると述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 63-year-old postmenopausal woman with vaginal discharge, bleeding and a large uterine mass. The uterus ruptured during hysterectomy, revealing a necrotic tumor infiltrating the myometrium. Pleomorphic tumor cells were cytokeratin and beta-hCG positive and smooth muscle antigen negative, leading to a final diagnosis of placental site trophoblastic tumor. The authors note that PSTT is rare in postmenopausal women and difficult to diagnose clinically and histologically.

title: [Refractory germ cell cancer of testis treated by salvage high-dose chemotherapy: report of three cases].
title_ja: 救援大量化学療法で治療した難治性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の3例（症例報告）
summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性3例に対し、救援大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を行った症例報告である。奏効は1例のみで、救援手術で病理学的完全奏効が確認され、68か月無病生存している。残り2例は無効で、病勢進行により死亡した。肝毒性や神経毒性が生じたが致命的ではなかった。
summary_en: This report describes three men aged 18 to 42 with advanced nonseminomatous testicular germ cell cancer treated with salvage high-dose chemotherapy and autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. Two patients refractory to BEP or VIP received CEI, and one refractory to PVB and VIP received CEI and CCT. Only one achieved an incomplete remission, confirmed as pathological complete response at salvage surgery, and remained disease-free for 68 months. Hepatotoxicity, neurotoxicity and depression occurred but were not fatal.

title: [A case of organ sparing surgery for metachronous bilateral testicular tumor with maintaining testicular function].
title_ja: 精巣機能を温存した異時性両側精巣腫瘍に対する臓器温存手術の1例
summary_ja: 右精巣摘除と予防的放射線療法を受けた病期Iのセミノーマから6年後、左精巣に異時性腫瘍が生じた28歳男性の症例です。病変が下極に限局していたため、精巣機能温存を目的に部分精巣摘除術を施行しました。病理はセミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形腫の混合型でした。BEP療法後の一時的な無精子症は18か月以内に回復し、再発はありませんでした。臓器温存手術と化学療法の併用が選択肢になり得るとしています。
summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 28-year-old man who developed a metachronous left testicular tumor six years after right orchiectomy and prophylactic irradiation for stage I seminoma. Because the lesion was confined to the lower pole, partial orchiectomy was performed to preserve testicular function. Pathology showed a mixed tumor of seminoma, embryonal carcinoma and teratoma. Three cycles of BEP chemotherapy caused azoospermia, but spermatogenesis recovered within 18 months without recurrence, and his wife later had a healthy child. The authors suggest organ-sparing surgery combined with chemotherapy may be a treatment option.

title: [The result of VIP chemotherapy as an induction therapy in 6 patients with non-seminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumor].
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍6例に対する導入療法としてのVIP化学療法
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の6例に、導入療法としてVIP化学療法を行った成績です。原発は縦隔が4例、後腹膜が2例でした。導入後に6例中4例が完全または部分奏効を示し、救援療法後は4例が完全奏効、2例が部分奏効でした。ただし2年以上フォローアップできた5例中、無病生存は2例のみでした。症例数が少ないため結論は限定的ですが、より有効なレジメンの開発が必要と結んでいます。
summary_en: This Japanese study reports outcomes of induction VIP chemotherapy (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) in six patients with non-seminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumors, most with mediastinal primaries and two with retroperitoneal primaries. Four of six achieved complete or partial response after induction. After salvage therapy, four achieved complete responses and two partial responses. However, only two of five patients followed for over two years remained disease-free. The authors conclude that VIP efficacy seemed similar to conventional regimens, though the small cohort limits conclusions, and that more effective regimens are needed.

title: Impact of therapy and androgen receptor polymorphism on sperm concentration in men treated for testicular germ cell cancer: a longitudinal study.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の精子濃度に対する治療とアンドロゲン受容体多型の影響：縦断的研究
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性112例を対象に、精子濃度の経時変化を最長60か月まで追跡した縦断研究です。補助化学療法を1〜2コース受けた群では有意な低下はみられませんでした。放射線療法や3コース以上の化学療法では一時的に低下し、2〜5年で治療前の水準に戻りました。大量化学療法群ではAR遺伝子のCAGリピート長が回復と負の相関を示しました。治療の種類が精子回復を規定する因子でした。
summary_en: This longitudinal study followed 112 men treated for testicular germ cell cancer, measuring sperm concentration after orchiectomy and at intervals up to 60 months. Patients receiving one or two cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy showed no significant decline in sperm concentration. Radiotherapy or more than two cycles of chemotherapy caused an initial drop that returned to pretreatment levels within two to five years. In patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy, androgen receptor CAG repeat length was inversely correlated with later sperm concentration. The authors conclude that treatment type, rather than baseline sperm count, predicted spermatogenic recovery.

title: Developmental expression of POU5F1 (OCT-3/4) in normal and dysgenetic human gonads.
title_ja: 正常ヒトおよび発生異常性腺におけるPOU5F1（OCT-3/4）の発現の発生段階による変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常ヒト性腺74例と発生異常・間性の性腺58例で、OCT-3/4（POU5F1）の発現を調べた研究です。OCT-3/4は原始胚細胞に発現し、精巣では徐々に低下し、卵巣では早期に消失しました。発生異常の性腺では生後14か月まで発現が持続することがありました。性腺芽腫と上皮内癌（CIS）では年齢によらず高発現を示しました。持続する多能性関連発現が悪性転化のリスクを高める可能性があると考察しています。
summary_en: This study examined OCT-3/4 (POU5F1) expression across human gonadal development, in 74 normal gonads and 58 dysgenetic or intersex gonads. OCT-3/4 was present in primordial germ cells and gradually declined in developing testes, while it was silenced early in the ovary. In dysgenetic gonads expression persisted abnormally, sometimes until 14 months of age. Gonadoblastoma and carcinoma in situ consistently showed abundant OCT-3/4 expression regardless of age. The authors propose that persistent pluripotency-associated expression in dysgenetic gonads increases malignant transformation risk, consistent with the fetal origin of germ cell tumors.

title: Nephroblastoma arising in a germ cell tumor of testicular origin.
title_ja: 精巣原発胚細胞腫瘍から生じた腎芽腫
summary_ja: 精巣原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍に腎芽腫と横紋筋肉腫の成分を伴った22歳男性の症例です。化学療法後、鎖骨上窩と後腹膜リンパ節に転移性成熟奇形腫が出現し切除されました。21か月間再発はみられませんでした。ヘテロ接合性の消失解析では、原発巣の全成分と転移巣で同一のパターンを示し、腎芽腫が胚細胞腫瘍由来であることが示唆されました。転移巣ではTP53の欠失も検出されました。
summary_en: The authors report a 22-year-old man with a testicular malignant mixed germ cell tumor containing mature and immature teratoma, nephroblastoma and rhabdomyosarcoma components. After chemotherapy, metastatic mature teratoma appeared in supraclavicular and retroperitoneal nodes and was excised, with no recurrence over 21 months of follow-up. Microdissection and loss of heterozygosity analysis showed identical allelic loss patterns across all primary components and metastases, supporting a common germ cell origin for the nephroblastoma. TP53 loss occurred only in the metastasis, and 11p13 loss may contribute to nephroblastomatous differentiation.

title: Primary retroperitoneal teratomas: a review of the literature.
title_ja: 原発性後腹膜奇形腫：文献的レビュー
summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜奇形腫の文献レビュー。後腹膜原発腫瘍の1〜11%を占め、乳児期と成人早期に発症のピークがある。病理組織学、分類、遺伝子異常、発生起源の諸説を整理し、診断と治療を論じる。悪性腫瘍の可能性は約25%で、外科的切除が治療の基本とされる。
summary_en: This review examines primary retroperitoneal teratomas, which account for roughly 1-11% of primary retroperitoneal tumors and show a bimodal age distribution with peaks in infancy and early adulthood. The authors summarize the histopathology, classification, genetic abnormalities, and proposed origin theories of teratomas. They also discuss presentation, diagnosis, and management, noting that these tumors are often large at diagnosis and carry about a 25% chance of malignancy. Surgical resection remains the mainstay of treatment and is needed for definitive diagnosis.

title: Effects of adjuvant radiotherapy for testicular cancer on CD4+ cell count in HIV-positive patients: a case report.
title_ja: HIV陽性患者における精巣がん術後補助放射線療法がCD4+細胞数に及ぼす影響：症例報告
summary_ja: HIV陽性男性の精巣セミノーマに対し、精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を施行した症例報告。治療後にCD4陽性細胞数が低下し、HIV疾患の経過が変化した。HIV陽性者は精巣がんの発症頻度が高いとされ、放射線療法中の免疫状態の監視の重要性を示している。
summary_en: A case report describing an HIV-positive patient with testicular seminoma who received orchiectomy followed by adjuvant radiotherapy. The authors note that seminoma occurs more often in HIV-positive men and that radiotherapy is typically well tolerated. After treatment, the patient's CD4+ cell count declined and the course of HIV disease changed. The report highlights the need to monitor immune status in HIV-positive patients receiving radiotherapy for testicular cancer.

title: Characterization of htAKR, a novel gene product in the aldo-keto reductase family specifically expressed in human testis.
title_ja: ヒト精巣特異的アルド・ケト還元酵素htAKRの特性解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト精巣に特異的に発現するアルド・ケト還元酵素ファミリー遺伝子htAKRの特性を解析した。複数のスプライシングアイソフォームを同定し、基質特異性は限定的であった。セミノーマ組織ではmRNA発現が正常精巣より著しく低く、精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株NEC8ではホルモンやPMAの刺激により発現が低下した。腫瘍における発現調節の可能性を示す。
summary_en: This study characterizes htAKR, an aldo-keto reductase family member expressed specifically in human testis. Multiple alternatively spliced isoforms were identified, and htAKR4 showed limited enzymatic activity toward a quinone but none toward steroids or prostaglandins. Expression was detected in testicular germ cells and interstitial cells. htAKR mRNA was markedly lower in seminoma tissue than in normal testis, and was downregulated in the testicular germ cell tumour line NEC8 by PMA and dihydrotestosterone exposure.

title: An unexpected effect of glucocorticoids on stimulation of c-fms proto-oncogene expression in choriocarcinoma cells that express little glucocorticoid receptor.
title_ja: グルココルチコイド受容体の発現が低い絨毛癌細胞におけるグルココルチコイドによるc-fms癌遺伝子発現の刺激
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞において、グルココルチコイドがc-fms癌遺伝子の発現を刺激する機序を検討した。デキサメタゾンによる誘導はRU 486やアクチノマイシンDで抑制され、受容体を介した転写制御によることが示唆された。低レベルの受容体mRNAを持つ細胞はグルココルチコイド感受性を示し、絨毛癌の浸潤性増殖を促進する可能性がある。
summary_en: This study examined how glucocorticoids stimulate c-fms proto-oncogene expression in JAR choriocarcinoma cells, which are reported to lack the glucocorticoid receptor. Dexamethasone induced c-fms in a receptor-mediated, transcription-dependent manner, even though glucocorticoid receptor protein was undetectable by binding assays and immunohistochemistry. Low receptor mRNA levels correlated with dexamethasone sensitivity across most clones. The authors propose that this sensitivity to circulating glucocorticoids may enhance the invasive behavior of choriocarcinoma cells.

title: Comparative analysis of different apoptosis detection methods in human testicular cancer.
title_ja: ヒト精巣がんにおけるアポトーシス検出法の比較解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍62例（非セミノーマ性腫瘍47例、セミノーマ15例）を対象に、アポトーシスの2種類の検出法を二重蛍光標識で比較した。DNA断片化を検出するISELは形態学的評価より多くのアポトーシス細胞を検出した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍はセミノーマより指数が高かった。両者の定量結果は同等とはいえないと結論づけられた。
summary_en: This study compared two methods for detecting apoptosis in 62 testicular tumors, 47 nonseminomatous and 15 seminomas, using double-fluorescence labeling. Internucleosomal DNA fragmentation (ISEL) yielded higher apoptotic indices than morphological chromatin condensation, which detected only about 30% of apoptotic cells versus about 80% for ISEL. Overall apoptotic indices were higher in nonseminomatous tumors than in seminomas. The authors conclude that the two methods are not equivalent for quantifying apoptosis in testicular cancer.

title: Laparoscopic removal of a large adnexal mass.
title_ja: 大型付属器腫瘤の腹腔鏡下摘出術
summary_ja: 46歳の未経妊女性に生じた20.9cmの大型付属器腫瘤を腹腔鏡下に摘出した症例報告です。腫瘤は皮様嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)と判明しました。市販のバッグがない状況でも、回収用バッグを用いて腹腔内への漏出なく取り出せたと報告しています。大型の卵巣奇形腫に対する低侵襲手術の選択肢を広げる可能性があります。
summary_en: This case report describes laparoscopic removal of a very large 20.9-cm adnexal mass in a 46-year-old nulligravida woman, which proved to be a dermoid (mature teratoma). Retrieval bags were used to isolate the mass from the peritoneal cavity, allowing extraction without intraperitoneal spillage. The authors conclude that very large adnexal masses can be removed laparoscopically despite the lack of commercially available bags sized for this purpose. The technique may expand minimally invasive options for large ovarian teratomas.

title: Immature ovarian teratoma with hyponatremia and low antidiuretic hormone level.
title_ja: 低ナトリウム血症と低抗利尿ホルモン値を伴った未熟卵巣奇形腫
summary_ja: 22歳女性が低ナトリウム血症を伴う不適切ADH分泌症候群の症状で受診し、後に未熟卵巣奇形腫と診断されました。水分制限と腫瘍摘出により低ナトリウム血症は改善しました。未熟奇形腫細胞がバソプレッシン様因子を産生する可能性が示唆されており、原因不明の本症候群では骨盤内臓器の検査が勧められています。
summary_en: This report describes a 22-year-old woman who presented with inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion syndrome, including hyponatremia and very low serum and urinary vasopressin levels. She was ultimately diagnosed with an immature ovarian teratoma. Water restriction followed by surgical removal of the tumor corrected the hyponatremia. The authors suggest that immature teratoma cells may secrete a vasopressin-like factor, and that unexplained SIADH should prompt examination of the pelvic organs for ovarian malignancy.

title: Low p21Waf1/Cip1 protein level sensitizes testicular germ cell tumor cells to Fas-mediated apoptosis.
title_ja: p21Waf1/Cip1タンパク質レベルの低下は精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞をFas介在性アポトーシスに感受性にする
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株TeraとSchaではp21の発現が低く、卵巣癌細胞A2780と比較されています。シスプラチン処理したTera細胞はp21が低いためFas依存性アポトーシスに感受性を示しました。一方、放射線照射で誘導されたp21はFas耐性を与え、siRNAによるp21抑制で感受性は回復しました。
summary_en: This study examines why testicular germ cell tumor cells are sensitive to Fas-mediated apoptosis. Compared with A2780 ovarian cancer cells, the TGCT cell lines Tera and Scha expressed low p21 protein and mRNA levels, which were reduced at the transcriptional level. Cisplatin-treated Tera cells with low p21 were Fas-sensitive, whereas irradiation-induced cytosolic p21 conferred Fas resistance; this was reversed by p21 siRNA knockdown.
