The case underscores the importance of prenatal diagnosis in guiding the timing of intervention for tumors that compromise cardiac function.

title: Undifferentiated carcinoma with osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた破骨細胞様多核巨細胞を伴う未分化癌
summary_ja: 70歳の日本人女性の巨大卵巣腫瘍と多発腹膜播種の症例。卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の、破骨細胞様多核巨細胞を伴う未分化癌が診断された。悪性転化の一例である。術後3週間で播種病変が急速に増大し、術後5週で死亡した。
summary_en: A 70-year-old Japanese woman presented with a giant ovarian tumor (30 x 23 x 9 cm) and multiple peritoneal dissemination. Histology showed undifferentiated carcinoma with osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, representing malignant transformation. The disseminated lesions grew rapidly after surgery, and the patient died five weeks postoperatively.

title: Extensive surgery in metastatic testicular cancer.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する拡大手術
summary_ja: 進行精巣がんの化学療法後の残存腫瘍切除の適応をまとめた総説。進行セミノーマでは切除は稀だが、高位病期の非セミノーマ性疾患の多くでは必要となる。再発、マーカー値の持続的上昇、晩期再発例でも切除が考慮される。後腹膜の再手術などの手技と合併症対策を解説する。
summary_en: This review summarizes indications for surgery after chemotherapy in advanced testicular cancer. Residual tumor resection is rarely needed in advanced seminoma after standard chemotherapy, but is usually required in high-stage non-seminomatous disease. Surgery may also be needed for recurrence, persistent marker elevation, or late relapse. The authors discuss demanding redo retroperitoneal and salvage operations, surgical approaches, perioperative management, and complications, emphasizing individualized planning.

title: Long-term results of first-line sequential high-dose etoposide, ifosfamide, and cisplatin chemotherapy plus autologous stem cell support for patients with advanced metastatic germ cell cancer: an extended phase I/II study of the German Testicular Cancer Study Group.
title_ja: 進行転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対する初回逐次大量化学療法(エトポシド、イホスファミド、シスプラチン)および自家末梢血幹細胞支持療法の長期成績:ドイツ精巣がん研究グループ拡大第I/II相試験
summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループによる第I/II相試験。進行または予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍221例に、逐次大量VIP化学療法と自家幹細胞支持を実施した。予後不良群の5年無増悪生存率は68%、疾患特異的生存率は73%であった。治療関連死は4%で、用量レベル6が推奨された。
summary_en: This extended phase I/II study of the German Testicular Cancer Study Group evaluated sequential high-dose VIP chemotherapy with autologous stem cell support in 221 patients with advanced or poor-prognosis germ cell tumors. Dose level 6 was recommended for randomized testing. In the poor-prognosis subgroup, progression-free survival was 68% and disease-specific survival 73% at 5 years. Treatment-related death occurred in 4%. The protocol proved feasible in multicenter settings.

title: Ovarian yolk sac tumor associated with endometrioid carcinoma and mucinous cystadenoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 類内膜癌および粘液性嚢胞腺腫を伴った卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 51歳の閉経後女性の16cm卵巣腫瘍の症例。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分に、類内膜癌と粘液性嚢胞腺腫が併存していた。免疫染色で卵黄嚢腫瘍成分はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が部分的に陽性であった。化学療法3サイクル後も進行し、診断から10か月後に死亡した。
summary_en: A 51-year-old postmenopausal woman had a 16 cm ovarian tumor with a yolk sac tumor component combined with grade I endometrioid carcinoma and mucinous cystadenoma, on a background of atypical endometriosis. Immunohistochemistry showed that the yolk sac component was focally positive for alpha-fetoprotein and negative for keratin 7. Despite three cycles of chemotherapy, the disease progressed, and the patient died 10 months after diagnosis.

title: 12p-amplicon structure analysis in testicular germ cell tumors of adolescents and adults by array CGH.
title_ja: 思春期および成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍における12p増幅単位の構造解析(アレイCGH)
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の12p増幅領域を、アレイCGHとFISHで解析した研究。セミノーマ17例と非セミノーマ1例を対象とした。増幅パターンは症例ごとに異なっていた。増幅領域の境界部に位置する少なくとも2つの遺伝子が、腫瘍進行を支える候補として提案された。
summary_en: This study used array CGH and FISH to map the architecture of 12p amplicons in testicular germ cell tumors from adolescents and adults, including 17 seminomas and one nonseminoma. Most seminomas showed amplification of the whole region or border-predominant patterns. The authors propose that at least two genes at the amplicon borders are positional candidates that may support tumor progression. The results narrow the search for pathogenetically relevant 12p genes.

title: Paraneoplastic encephalitis associated with cystic teratoma is detected by fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography with negative magnetic resonance image findings.
title_ja: 嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎:MRIが陰性でもFDG-PET陽性であった1例
summary_ja: 嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎の症例報告。脳MRIは正常であったが、FDG-PETで異常集積が検出された。従来の画像で陰性でも、機能画像が傍腫瘍性脳炎の検出に有用であることを示した。神経合併症が疑われる患者の評価におけるFDG-PETの有用性を示唆している。
summary_en: This case report describes paraneoplastic encephalitis associated with a cystic teratoma. Fluorodeoxyglucose PET showed abnormal uptake although brain MRI findings were normal. The authors highlight that functional imaging can detect paraneoplastic encephalitis when conventional MRI is negative, supporting FDG-PET as a useful tool in evaluating patients with suspected paraneoplastic neurological complications.

title: Lack of parental origin specificity of altered alleles at 11p15 in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における11p15の変化の親由来性特異性の欠如
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍71例を対象に、マイクロサテライトマーカーと第11染色体の動原体FISHを用いて11p15領域のアレル不均衡を解析した研究である。39%の症例で不均衡が認められ、父由来・母由来の両アレルで欠失と増加がみられた。インプリンティングによる不活化は示されず、非インプリンティング型の腫瘍抑制遺伝子の関与が示唆された。
summary_en: This study analysed 11p15 allelic imbalance in 71 testicular germ cell tumors using microsatellite markers and chromosome 11 copy-number FISH. Allelic imbalance was found in 39%. Losses and gains of both paternal and maternal alleles occurred, indicating no parental-origin specificity and suggesting the remaining allele is not silenced by imprinting. A smallest region of overlapping change was mapped between D11S2351 and D11S2347, supporting a non-imprinted 11p15 tumor suppressor gene in a subset of TGCTs.

title: Laboratory markers and germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 検査マーカーと胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の検査マーカーについて概説した総説である。国際胚細胞コンセンサス分類(IGCCC)の血清LD、AFP、hCGに加え、LDアイソザイム1(LD-1)の有用性を検討している。LD-1はセミノーマで高値を示しやすく、AFPとhCGは非セミノーマで多い。IGCCCとLD-1を組み合わせたモデルは、従来の病期分類より生存を良く予測するとされる。
summary_en: This review covers laboratory markers in germ cell tumors. It describes the International Germ Cell Consensus Classification's three serum tumor markers (LD, AFP, hCG), and their use in testicular, ovarian and extragonadal tumors. It notes that LD-1 is also relevant in testicular tumors, is linked to chromosome 12p gain, and is raised more often in seminoma, while AFP and hCG are mainly in nonseminomatous tumors. A model combining IGCCC and LD-1 predicts survival better than prior staging.

title: Mature cystic teratoma of the ovary associated with complete colonic wall and mucinous cystadenoma.
title_ja: 結腸壁および粘液性嚢胞腺腫を伴う卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 16歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に、完全な結腸壁と子宮頸管型粘液性嚢胞腺腫が連続して認められた症例報告である。免疫染色では嚢胞腺腫がCK7陽性、結腸壁がCK20陽性を示し、移行部はその両方を発現していた。粘液性嚢胞腺腫は奇形腫内の結腸型上皮に由来すると考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with an ovarian mature cystic teratoma containing a complete colonic wall, continuous with an endocervical-type mucinous cystadenoma. Immunohistochemistry showed CK7-positive cystadenoma and CK20-positive colonic wall, with a transitional zone expressing both markers and focal chromogranin. The authors suggest the mucinous cystadenoma arose from colonic-type epithelium within the teratoma.

title: Ifosfamide in germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるイホスファミド
summary_ja: 本総説は胚細胞腫瘍におけるイホスファミドの役割を概説する。1982年よりシスプラチンとの併用が救援化学療法として検討され、VIP療法は後に標準的二次治療となり25%の治癒率を示した。初回治療としてBEP療法と比較した第III相試験では、有意差はないもののVIP療法がわずかに優れ、BEP療法は毒性が少なかった。ブレオマイシン肺線維症のリスクがある症例ではVIP療法が選択肢となる。
summary_en: This review examines the role of ifosfamide in germ cell tumors. Ifosfamide has single-agent activity, and cisplatin plus ifosfamide was first tested as salvage chemotherapy in 1982. The VIP regimen (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) was initially used as third-line treatment and later became a standard second-line regimen with a 25% cure rate. Phase III trials compared VIP with BEP as first-line therapy. VIP was slightly better but not significantly so, and BEP was less toxic. VIP remains an option for patients at risk of bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis.

title: Liver transplantation for growing teratoma syndrome: report of a case.
title_ja: growing teratoma syndromeに対する生体肝移植：症例報告
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、悪性細胞が消失し腫瘍マーカーが正常化したにもかかわらず肝臓内の奇形腫性腫瘤が急速に増大した若年男性例を報告するもの。growing teratoma syndromeとして生体肝移植により治療された。術後管理やフォローアップについて考察し、文献を簡潔にレビューしている。
summary_en: This case report describes a young man with rapidly growing teratomatous liver masses that developed despite complete eradication of malignant cells and normal tumor markers, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. He was treated with live-donor liver transplantation. The authors discuss postoperative management and follow-up and briefly review the literature on this syndrome. The report illustrates that growing masses after treatment of germ cell tumors may be teratomatous rather than active malignancy, which has implications for management.

title: Y chromosome sequences in Turner's syndrome: association with virilization and gonadoblastoma.
title_ja: ターナー症候群におけるY染色体配列と男性化および性腺芽腫との関連
summary_ja: ターナー症候群58例を対象とした横断研究で、核型に加えPCRによりY染色体配列を検出した。PCRは核型より高感度であった。Y染色体物質を有した2例はいずれも手術で性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマが確認された。Y由来物質と男性化との関連は認められず、Y断片と若年期の性腺芽腫との関連が再確認された。
summary_en: This cross-sectional study of 58 Turner syndrome patients used PCR to detect occult Y chromosome sequences (SRY, TSPY, DYZ3) in addition to karyotyping. PCR was more sensitive than karyotype for detecting Y material. Two patients with Y sequences, one with a ring chromosome and one with 45,X/46,XY karyotype, underwent surgery and were found to have gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. Y material was not associated with virilization, but the findings confirm the link between Y fragments and gonadoblastoma at an early age.

title: Gene expression patterns in human embryonic stem cells and human pluripotent germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞および多能性胚細胞腫瘍における遺伝子発現パターン
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胚性幹細胞株、胚細胞腫瘍細胞株および腫瘍検体、体細胞株、精巣組織の遺伝子発現プロファイルをcDNAマイクロアレイで比較したもの。胚性幹細胞株は胎児性癌との類似性が高く、セミノーマとの類似性は低かった。胚性幹細胞と胎児性癌細胞で高発現する895遺伝子が同定され、多能性の維持に関与する可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study compared gene expression profiles of human embryonic stem cell lines with human germ cell tumor cell lines and tumor samples, somatic cell lines, and testicular tissue using cDNA microarrays. The ES cell lines clustered tightly together and resembled embryonal carcinoma samples more closely than seminoma samples. The authors identified 895 genes expressed at significantly higher levels in ES and embryonal carcinoma cells than in controls. These genes may be involved in maintaining a pluripotent, undifferentiated phenotype, supporting a link between pluripotent cells and germ cell tumor genesis.

title: Antisense oligodeoxynucleotide against HST-1/FGF-4 suppresses tumorigenicity of an orthotopic model for human germ cell tumor in nude mice.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍のマウス同所性モデルにおけるHST-1/FGF-4アンチセンスオリゴDNAの腫瘍形成抑制効果
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で過剰発現する線維芽細胞増殖因子HST-1/FGF-4を標的とするアンチセンスオリゴDNAの抗腫瘍効果を、ヌードマウスの精巣内移植モデルで検討しました。アテロコラーゲンと併用すると腫瘍増殖とリンパ節転移が有意に抑制されました。男性の胚細胞腫瘍に対する新たな治療法となる可能性が示唆されています。
summary_en: This study tested an antisense oligodeoxynucleotide targeting HST-1/FGF-4, a fibroblast growth factor overexpressed in human testicular germ cell tumors. In an orthotopic nude mouse model using NEC8 nonseminomatous germ cells, antisense oligonucleotides suppressed HST-1/FGF-4 production and inhibited growth in vitro. Combined treatment with Atelocollagen significantly reduced testicular tumor growth and lymph node metastasis, whereas antisense alone was less effective. The authors propose antisense targeting of HST-1/FGF-4 as a novel therapeutic approach for male germ cell tumors.

title: Epidemiology and aetiology of gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の疫学と病因
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の疫学と病因を概説した総説です。胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含むGTDの世界的分布、がん登録に基づく絨毛癌の統計、危険因子を検討しています。母体年齢と既往のGTDが胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の強い危険因子であることが確認されました。
summary_en: This review summarizes the epidemiology and etiology of gestational trophoblastic diseases (GTD), which include hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumour. The authors compile worldwide distribution data, cancer-registry statistics on choriocarcinoma, and analyses of risk factors such as maternal age, prior GTD, AB0 blood group, reproductive factors and oral contraceptive use. Higher frequencies are observed in parts of Asia, the Middle East and Africa, although methodological limits affect accuracy. Maternal age and previous GTD are established strong risk factors for hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma.

title: Primary retroperitoneal teratoma in an adult.
title_ja: 成人の原発性後腹膜奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 26歳男性に発生した原発性後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告です。腹部腫瘍に対し開腹下に切除が行われ、病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されました。術後経過は良好で、1年後のフォローアップでも状態は良好でした。成人では稀な疾患で、特徴的な画像所見を有することが報告されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old man with a primary retroperitoneal teratoma, a rare entity in adults with a distinctive imaging appearance. Abdominal imaging and serial workup identified a retroperitoneal mass, which was resected by laparotomy. Pathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. The postoperative course was uneventful, and the patient remained well at one-year follow-up. The report highlights the rarity of this tumor in adults and its characteristic imaging features.

title: Sarcomatoid intracardiac metastasis of a testicular germ cell tumor closely resembling primary cardiac sarcoma.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の肉腫様心臓内転移例：原発性心臓肉腫との鑑別
summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（混合型）の治療後10年に心房内転移が出現した40歳男性の症例です。組織像は原発性心臓肉腫に酷似していましたが、免疫組織化学染色により肉腫様胚細胞腫瘍の転移と確定されました。紡錘形細胞成分は卵黄嚢腫瘍由来で化学療法抵抗性の可能性があると考察されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old man with a history of testicular mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treated by surgery and chemotherapy. Ten years later he presented with dyspnea, a right atrial mass extending from the superior vena cava, and multiple pulmonary emboli. The sarcomatous and myxomatous morphology closely mimicked primary cardiac sarcoma, but immunohistochemistry confirmed metastatic sarcomatoid germ cell tumor. The authors note that such spindle cell metastases may arise from chemoresistant spindle cell components of yolk sac tumor.

title: Infertility rates following POMB/ACE chemotherapy for male and female germ cell tumours - a retrospective long-term follow-up study.
title_ja: 精巣および卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するPOMB/ACE化学療法後の不妊率：後方視的長期フォローアップ研究
summary_ja: POMB/ACE化学療法を受けた男女の胚細胞腫瘍生存者を対象に、後方視的に不妊率を検討した長期フォローアップ研究です。治療を受けた男性では放射線療法が不妊を有意に増加させ、化学療法による不妊は約11%と推定されました。シスプラチンの累積投与量との明らかな関連は認められませんでした。
summary_en: This retrospective long-term follow-up study assessed infertility in male and female germ cell tumor survivors treated with POMB/ACE chemotherapy. Of 64 treated men attempting to have children, 28% were unsuccessful, but radiotherapy, an atrophic testis or prior infertility explained most cases, so chemotherapy-induced infertility may have affected only 11%. Untreated stage I men also had a 26% failure rate. In women, 25% were unsuccessful, with chemotherapy-induced infertility in about 18%. Radiotherapy significantly increased male infertility, and no clear association with cumulative cisplatin dose was found.

title: Analysis of gene-expression profiles in testicular seminomas using a genome-wide cDNA microarray.
title_ja: cDNAマイクロアレイを用いた精巣セミノーマの遺伝子発現プロファイル解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ13例のがん細胞をレーザーマイクロダイセクションで採取し、正常精巣と比較した遺伝子発現解析です。セミノーマで共通して高発現する遺伝子347個と低発現する遺伝子593個が同定されました。上位9遺伝子は半定量RT-PCRで確認されています。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断マーカーや治療標的の候補となる情報を提供しています。
summary_en: This study compared gene-expression profiles of laser-capture microdissected cancer cells from 13 testicular seminomas with normal testis, using a cDNA microarray covering 23,040 genes. The authors identified 347 commonly up-regulated and 593 down-regulated genes in seminoma cells. Known overexpressed genes such as CCND2, POV1 and JUP were confirmed, and nine highly up-regulated genes were validated by semi-quantitative RT-PCR. The data are proposed as a resource for diagnostic markers and molecular treatment targets for testicular germ cell tumors.

title: A possible genetic factor in the pathogenesis of ovarian dermoid cysts.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の発症に関与する遺伝的因子の可能性
summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の女性285例と正常卵巣の対照378例を比較した症例対照研究です。第一度近親者に類皮嚢腫の既往がある割合は症例で9.8%、対照で2%でした(調整オッズ比5.60)。著者らは、卵巣類皮嚢腫には遺伝的素因がある可能性を示唆し、さらなる検討が必要と結論づけています。
summary_en: This case-control study compared first-degree family history of dermoid cysts in 285 women with ovarian dermoid cysts and 378 controls with normal ovaries. A dermoid cyst was reported in relatives of 9.8% of cases versus 2% of controls, giving an adjusted odds ratio of 5.60 (95% CI 2.24-14.2). The authors conclude the data suggest a genetic predisposition to ovarian dermoid cysts that merits further study.

title: Two cases of unusual urethral complications after resection of sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫切除後に生じた尿道の稀な合併症2例
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の切除後に生じた、尿道の稀な合併症2例を報告しています。1例は尿道閉塞、もう1例は中部尿道の壊死を来しました。著者らは、恥骨結合と腫瘍の間で尿道が機械的に圧迫されることによる圧迫性壊死が原因と考察しています。
summary_en: This report describes two rare urethral complications after resection of sacrococcygeal teratoma. One patient developed urethral obstruction, and the other developed midurethral necrosis. The authors attribute both complications to pressure necrosis caused by mechanical compression of the urethra between the pubic symphysis and the tumour. The report highlights a surgically relevant risk in patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma.

title: Genetics and molecular markers in gestational trophoblastic disease with special reference to their clinical application.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における遺伝学と分子マーカー：臨床応用との関連
journal: Best Pract Res Clin Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の遺伝学的・分子生物学的特徴をまとめた総説です。全胞状奇胎はアンドロゲネティックで、インプリンティングなどが関与する可能性を論じています。NECC1発現消失、7p12-7q11.23欠失、H19発現亢進などの絨毛癌での変化が、奇胎から絨毛癌への移行を説明しうるとしています。分子マーカーは持続性病変の予後判定に役立つ可能性があります。
summary_en: This review summarises the genetic and molecular features of gestational trophoblastic disease. Complete moles are androgenetic, and the authors discuss how monoallelic contribution, imprinting, and one-hit mechanisms could inactivate genes. Changes in choriocarcinoma, including loss of NECC1 expression, 7p12-7q11.23 deletions, and increased H19 expression, may reflect the complete mole precursor. Molecular markers may help prognosis and diagnosis of persistent disease.

title: Pathology of gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病理
journal: Best Pract Res Clin Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に加え、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍などの新しい病型を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病理を総説しています。特に妊娠初期には、水腫性流産と部分奇胎、完全奇胎と部分奇胎の鑑別が難しいと指摘しています。病理組織学的検査で予後を予測できるのは主に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に限られるため、代替の生物学的マーカーの検討が求められています。
summary_en: This review covers the pathology of gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform moles, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumour, along with newer entities such as epithelioid trophoblastic tumour. The authors note that distinguishing hydropic abortion from partial mole, and complete from partial mole, can be difficult, especially early in gestation. Histopathology alone predicts outcome mainly for placental site trophoblastic tumour, so alternative biomarkers are needed.

title: The management of recurrent and drug-resistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN).
title_ja: 再発および薬剤抵抗性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)の管理
journal: Best Pract Res Clin Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 再発および薬剤抵抗性の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)の管理をまとめた総説です。予後因子として、妊娠からの期間が長いこと、hCG高値、脳・肝転移、初回治療の失敗などが挙げられています。救援療法はアクチノマイシンD単剤から併用化学療法、選択的な手術まで幅広く、多くは長期寛解と妊孕性の温存が可能です。一方、強力な治療では二次性腫瘍や早期閉経のリスクがわずかにあります。
summary_en: This review covers management of recurrent and drug-resistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Prognostic factors include a long interval from the antecedent pregnancy, high hCG, brain and liver metastases, and treatment failure. Salvage options range from single-agent actinomycin D to combination chemotherapy and selected surgery. Most patients achieve long-term remission and can preserve fertility, although intensive treatment carries small risks of second tumours and earlier menopause.

title: Management of gestational trophoblastic disease in developing countries.
title_ja: 発展途上国における妊娠性絨毛性疾患の管理
journal: Best Pract Res Clin Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: マレーシアでの妊娠性絨毛性疾患の管理経験をまとめたものです。胞状奇胎の発生率や、子宮内容除去術の方法が報告されています。GTNの主な治療は化学療法で、低・中・高リスク群の生存率は100%、98%、61.7%でした。胎盤部腫瘍に対する予防的子宮摘出や予防的化学療法は推奨されていません。その一方で、hCGの下降が遅い症例には選択的予防化学療法が適切な場合があるとしています。
summary_en: This report from Malaysia describes the management of gestational trophoblastic disease, including molar pregnancy and GTN incidence. Uterine suction is preferred for evacuation, although 25% of cases needed repeat attempts. Chemotherapy is the main treatment for GTN, with survival of 100%, 98%, and 61.7% for low-, medium-, and high-risk groups. Prophylactic hysterectomy and chemotherapy are not recommended for placental site tumours, while selective preventive chemotherapy may suit patients with slow hCG regression.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumour.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍
journal: Best Pract Res Clin Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 中間型トロホブラストに由来する、稀な腫瘍性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の総説です。β-hCGは低値ですが、ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲンが上昇し、性器出血や無月経で発症することが多いとされています。治療の第一選択は手術で、化学療法はEMA/COまたはEMA/EPが最も有効とされています。子宮内に限局し2年以内に治療された場合は予後良好ですが、遠隔転移や治療の遅れでは予後不良です。
summary_en: This review covers placental site trophoblastic tumour, a rare neoplastic form of gestational trophoblastic disease arising from intermediate trophoblast. It shows low beta-hCG but increased human placental lactogen, and typically presents with bleeding or amenorrhoea. Surgery is the primary treatment, and EMA/CO or EMA/EP chemotherapy has been most effective. Prognosis is good when the tumour is confined to the uterus and treated within two years, but poor with distant metastasis or delayed treatment.

title: Long-term survival after high-dose salvage chemotherapy for germ cell malignancies with adverse prognostic variables.
title_ja: 予後不良因子を有する胚細胞腫瘍に対する救援化学療法としての大量化学療法後の長期生存
summary_ja: 1988年から2001年にインディアナ大学で予後不良因子を有する胚細胞腫瘍80例に大量化学療法を行った後方視的解析です。大量化学療法はカルボプラチンとエトポシドを用いました。全生存期間の中央値は14.7か月、2年無増悪生存率は32%でした。原発性縦隔非セミノーマでは成績不良でしたが、予後不良例でも根治を目指す救援療法の機会は否定されるべきではないと結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 80 patients with poor-risk germ cell tumours who received high-dose carboplatin and etoposide salvage chemotherapy at Indiana University between 1988 and 2001. Median overall survival was 14.7 months, and 2-year failure-free survival was 32%. Outcomes were poor for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous tumours, with 0% 2-year failure-free survival, but better for other high-risk groups. The authors conclude that poor-prognosis patients should still be offered curative salvage high-dose chemotherapy.

title: A solid mature teratoma of a feline ovary.
title_ja: 猫の卵巣に生じた充実性成熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 17歳の雑種雌猫の左卵巣に生じた充実性腫瘤を報告。組織学的に外胚葉・中胚葉・内胚葉の成分（皮膚付属器、骨・軟骨、腺管構造）を認め、卵巣の充実性成熟奇形腫と診断された。獣医学領域の症例報告で、動物における卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の例として位置づけられる。
summary_en: This report describes a 17-year-old crossbred female cat with a solid, firm 5.5 x 3.5 x 4.5 cm mass on the left ovary. Histology showed ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal components, including skin appendages, bone and cartilage, and glandular epithelium. The mass was diagnosed as a solid mature teratoma of the ovary. It is a veterinary case report documenting an ovarian germ cell tumor in an animal, relevant as a comparative oncology example.

title: Choriocarcinoma presenting with upper gastrointestinal bleeding and intussusception.
title_ja: 上部消化管出血と腸重積を呈した絨毛癌
summary_ja: 18歳未経妊女性が上部消化管出血と腸重積で発症した空腸絨毛癌の症例を報告する。性器外絨毛癌の多彩な臨床症状と診断上の困難について概説している。稀な腫瘍であり、高い疑いの維持と多職種による診療が不可欠であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes an 18-year-old nulliparous woman who presented with a jejunal choriocarcinoma causing upper gastrointestinal bleeding and intussusception. The authors review diagnostic difficulties and the varied extragenital manifestations of choriocarcinoma. They emphasize maintaining a high index of suspicion and using a multidisciplinary approach for management of these rare tumors that can present outside the genital tract.

title: Expression of CD34 antigen in testicular mixed germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍におけるCD34抗原の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍14例でCD34発現を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分では12例中7例で焦点性に陽性で、主に充実性・網状パターンに認められた。セミノーマ、胎児性癌、絨毛癌成分は全て陰性であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍のCD34陽性は他の胚細胞腫瘍成分との鑑別に有用と考えられる。
summary_en: This study examined CD34 immunoreactivity in 14 testicular mixed germ cell tumors and its relation to histological patterns. CD34 was focally expressed in 7 of 12 yolk sac tumor components, mainly in solid and reticular patterns, with intensity varying among cases. Seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma components were consistently CD34 negative. The authors conclude that focal CD34 positivity supports yolk sac tumor identification and helps distinguish it from other germ cell tumor components in mixed tumors.

title: Short course para-aortic radiation for stage I seminoma of the testis.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する短期間傍大動脈放射線療法
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマ431例に対し、10日間8分割・20 Gyの傍大動脈放射線療法を実施した。中央値62か月の追跡で3.5%が再発し、5年全生存率は98%であった。二次性悪性腫瘍は3%に発生した。術前hCG高値、リンパ管侵襲、白膜浸潤が再発因子であった。短期間の限局照射は安全かつ有効と結論された。
summary_en: This retrospective study followed 431 men with Stage I seminoma treated with 20 Gy para-aortic radiation in 8 fractions over 10 days. At median follow-up of 62 months, 3.5% relapsed, mostly in pelvic nodes, and 5-year survival was 98%. Second malignancies occurred in 3%. Elevated preoperative hCG, lymphovascular invasion, and tunica involvement predicted recurrence. The authors conclude that this short, limited-field regimen is safe and effective.

title: NKX3.1 expression is lost in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるNKX3.1発現の消失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 前立腺・精巣特異的ホメオボックス遺伝子NKX3.1の発現を、精巣標本510例の組織マイクロアレイで免疫組織化学的に解析した。NKX3.1は正常胚細胞と上皮内がんで高発現だが、ほとんどのセミノーマと全ての胎児性癌で低下・消失していた。発現消失は主に転写レベルの変化による。NKX3.1の消失は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の浸潤性と関連していた。
summary_en: NKX3.1, a prostate- and testis-restricted homeobox gene, was analyzed by immunohistochemistry on a tissue microarray of 510 testicular samples. NKX3.1 was high in normal germ cells and carcinoma in situ but sharply reduced or absent in most seminomas and all embryonal carcinomas, with some expression retained in differentiated nonseminomas. Changes were mainly transcriptional. Loss of NKX3.1 correlated with the invasive phenotype of testicular germ cell tumors, suggesting a role in testis biology and tumor progression.

title: Identical allelic losses in mature teratoma and other histologic components of malignant mixed germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍における成熟奇形腫と他の成分の同一の対立遺伝子欠失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣の悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍16例でLOH解析とマイクロダイセクションを行い、成熟奇形腫と他の成分の共通のクローン起源を検討した。16例中14例でアレル欠失が認められた。LOHを示した成熟奇形腫14例中10例では、他の成分と完全に一致したアレル欠失パターンを示した。これらの成分は共通のクローン起源を持つと結論された。
summary_en: This study used laser capture microdissection and loss of heterozygosity analysis on 16 malignant mixed germ cell tumors of the testis to test whether mature teratoma shares a clonal origin with other tumor components. Allelic losses were found in 14 of 16 tumors. In 10 of 14 informative cases, the mature teratoma showed a completely concordant loss pattern with other components, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and choriocarcinoma. The authors conclude that these components share a common clonal origin.

title: Stem cell factor receptor (c-KIT) codon 816 mutations predict development of bilateral testicular germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: c-KITコドン816変異は両側性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症を予測する
summary_ja: 欧州の3つの独立したシリーズの精巣胚細胞腫瘍を後方視的研究で検討し、c-KITコドン816活性化変異を解析した。片側性腫瘍では1.3%、両側性腫瘍では93%に変異を認めた。変異は体細胞性で、野生型の両側腫瘍の前浸潤性細胞にも同一の変異があった。本変異は両側発症のリスクを示すマーカーであり、精巣機能を温存する個別化治療に役立つと結論された。
summary_en: This retrospective study examined c-KIT codon 816 activating mutations in 224 unilateral and 61 bilateral testicular germ cell tumors from 46 patients across three independent European series. The mutation was found in 1.3% of unilateral tumors but 93% of bilateral tumors. Preinvasive cells in two wild-type bilateral tumors also carried the same somatic mutation. The authors conclude that the mutation predicts bilateral disease and could identify unilateral patients at risk, allowing tailored treatment that preserves testicular function.

title: Pediatric testicular tumors: contemporary incidence and efficacy of testicular preserving surgery.
title_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍：現代の発生頻度と精巣温存手術の有効性
summary_ja: 1984～2002年に単一施設で発生した小児精巣腫瘍51例を後方視的に検討した。成熟奇形腫が43%と最多で、横紋筋肉腫、類表皮嚢胞、卵黄嚢腫瘍が続いた。13例で精巣温存手術が行われ、がん制御と精巣温存に成功した。著者らは、症例に応じて精巣温存手術を選択しうる術前管理アルゴリズムを提案した。
summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review of 51 primary pediatric testicular lesions from 1984 to 2002 found mature teratoma (43%) to be the most common, followed by rhabdomyosarcoma, epidermoid cyst, yolk sac tumor, and germ cell tumors. Partial orchiectomy was performed in 13 cases with successful cancer control and testicular preservation. The authors propose a preoperative management algorithm that favors less radical, testis-sparing surgery in selected cases.

title: Minichromosome maintenance protein 7 expression in gestational trophoblastic disease: correlation with Ki67, PCNA and clinicopathological parameters.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるMCM7発現：Ki67、PCNAおよび臨床病理学的パラメータとの相関
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の増殖マーカーとしてMCM7を、PCNA・Ki67と比較して122検体で評価した。MCM7は絨毛癌で最も高値で、胎盤の成熟とともに低下した。胞状奇胎と非胞状妊娠の鑑別には有用だが、部分奇胎と全胞状奇胎の区別や持続性栄養膜細胞疾患の予測には有用ではなかった。MCM7はKi67と相関し、ばらつきが小さかった。
summary_en: This study assessed MCM7 as a proliferation marker in 122 trophoblastic tissues, including hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas, and controls, and compared it with PCNA and Ki67. MCM7 was highest in choriocarcinoma and decreased with placental maturation. It distinguished molar from non-molar gestations but did not separate partial from complete moles or predict persistent trophoblastic disease. MCM7 correlated with Ki67 and showed less variability, suggesting it may be a useful proliferation marker.

title: Teratomas of the head and neck region.
title_ja: 頭頸部領域の奇形腫
summary_ja: オーストラリアの頭蓋顎顔面ユニットで25年間に管理された頭頸部奇形腫7例の後方視的検討。多くは良性で切除により治療できたが、部位によっては成長完了まで多職種による管理が必要であった。6例は9年以上の追跡が得られた。
summary_en: This retrospective series reviews seven patients with head and neck teratomas managed by a single Australian craniofacial unit over 25 years. Most were benign and could be successfully removed, but depending on the site, some required multidisciplinary follow-up until growth was complete. Six patients had at least nine years of follow-up. The authors note that most published literature on these rare tumours consists of single case reports, and that their series helps identify common management problems.

title: Down-regulation of estrogen receptor beta and transcriptional coregulator SNURF/RNF4 in testicular germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるエストロゲン受容体βおよび共役因子SNURF/RNF4の発現低下
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍12例で腫瘍と正常組織を対比し、エストロゲン受容体β(ERβ)やSNURF/RNF4などの発現を調べた研究。セミノーマではERβ mRNAが59%低下し、ARとSNURF/RNF4もセミノーマおよび奇形癌で減少していた。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生への関与が示唆された。
summary_en: This study measures mRNA and protein levels of estrogen receptor beta, androgen receptor and the coregulators SNURF/RNF4, PIASx and PIAS1 in paired tumour and normal testicular tissue from 12 patients (8 seminomas, 4 nonseminomas). ERβ mRNA fell by 59% in seminomas, and AR and SNURF/RNF4 mRNA decreased substantially in seminomas and teratocarcinomas. Protein-level reduction of ERβ and SNURF/RNF4 was confirmed. The authors suggest that loss of these pathways may contribute to testicular tumorigenesis.

title: Chemotherapy for teratoma with malignant transformation.
title_ja: 悪性転化を伴う奇形腫に対する化学療法
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の奇形腫成分が横紋筋肉腫などの体細胞型悪性腫瘍へ悪性転化した12例を報告。転化組織型に基づく化学療法により、測定可能病変を有する10例中7例が部分奏効を示した。組織型を限定すれば化学療法は有効な場合があり、局所療法の併用が重要と結論付けられた。
summary_en: This report describes twelve patients with teratoma with malignant transformation of a germ cell tumour, in which a teratomatous component became a somatic malignancy such as rhabdomyosarcoma or primitive neuroectodermal tumour. Chemotherapy was tailored to the transformed histology. Seven of ten patients with measurable disease achieved partial response, lasting from one month to seven years. Three responders are alive. The authors conclude that chemotherapy can benefit selected patients, with local therapy as an important complement.

title: Stage I testicular seminoma: para-aortic and iliac irradiation with reduced dose after orchiectomy.
title_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマに対する精巣摘除術後の減量放射線療法：傍大動脈および腸骨リンパ節照射
summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマ53例に対し、精巣摘除術後に同側の腸骨・傍大動脈リンパ節へ減量放射線療法を行った初期成績の報告。5年全生存率100%、無病生存率98%で、急性消化管毒性は軽度であった。
summary_en: This report presents preliminary results for 53 patients with stage I testicular seminoma who received adjuvant radiotherapy to ipsilateral iliac and para-aortic lymph nodes after orchiectomy. A reduced dose of 19.6-20 Gy in standard fractions was used. With median follow-up of 42 months, five-year overall and disease-free survival were 100% and 98%, and one para-aortic recurrence occurred. Acute gastrointestinal toxicity was mild, suggesting that reduced-dose radiotherapy is effective and tolerable.

title: Synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumor with different histology. Case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 異なる組織型を呈した同時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 39歳男性に発生した、組織型の異なる同時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。各腫瘍の正確な病理組織学的診断が治療方針と予後判断に重要であることを示す。あわせて文献レビューを行い、既報例ごとの組織型を初めて図示している。稀な病態であり、詳細な組織型の確定が臨床的意義を持つことを強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors of different histological types. The authors emphasize that accurate histopathological subtyping of each lesion informs therapy and prognosis. They also present a literature review and, for the first time, illustrate the histological subtype of each previously reported tumor as diagnosed by the original authors. The paper highlights the diagnostic and prognostic value of precise histopathology in rare synchronous bilateral presentations.

title: Efficacy of cytotoxic agents used in the treatment of testicular germ cell tumours under normoxic and hypoxic conditions in vitro.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療に用いられる細胞傷害性薬剤の常酸素および低酸素条件下における効果
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎児性癌由来の3細胞株を用いたin vitro研究。低酸素条件では、シスプラチンを含む多くの抗がん剤の効果が低下した。薬剤効果の低下の程度は主に細胞株に依存した。増殖低下は要因の一つだが唯一の決定因子ではなく、腫瘍酸素化の改善が化学療法の成績向上につながる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This in vitro study tested the cytotoxicity of ten chemotherapeutic agents against three human embryonal carcinoma cell lines (NT2, 2102 EP, NCCIT) under normoxic and hypoxic conditions. Hypoxia reduced the efficacy of all drugs, including cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin, and carboplatin, with the magnitude depending mainly on the cell line. Reduced proliferation under hypoxia appeared important but was not the sole determinant. The authors suggest that improving tumor oxygenation, for example with erythropoietin, might improve chemotherapy outcomes in testicular germ cell tumor patients.

title: Synchronous cystic teratomas of the craniofacial region.
title_ja: 頭顔面領域に生じた同時性嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 出生時からの緩徐に増大する顔面腫瘤と右眼球突出を呈した症例。MRIで右眼窩と右側頭窩に2個の嚢胞を認め、眼科と耳鼻咽喉科の合同手術で摘出した。病理学的に両者とも成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。側頭窩原発の奇形腫と眼窩奇形腫の同時併存は初めての報告とされる。
summary_en: A case report describing synchronous cystic teratomas in the craniofacial region of a patient presenting since birth with a slow-growing facial mass and right eye protrusion. MRI demonstrated two separate cysts in the right orbit and right temporal fossa. Both were excised through combined ophthalmologic and otorhinolaryngologic surgery, and histopathology confirmed mature cystic teratomas in each. The authors note that coexistence of a primary temporal fossa teratoma with an orbital teratoma has not been previously reported.

title: [Testicular microlithiasis: report of 14 cases].
title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化：14症例の報告
summary_ja: 高周波超音波で評価した精巣微小石灰化14例の報告。微小石灰化の数により古典型(CTM)8例、限局型(LTM)6例に分類された。CTMの1例に、セミノーマと胎児性癌からなる混合型胚細胞腫瘍の併存を認めた。精巣微小石灰化の患者は原発性精巣腫瘍のリスクが高い可能性があり、慎重な経過観察が示唆される。
summary_en: Report of 14 patients with testicular microlithiasis (TM) examined by high-frequency ultrasound, classified as classic (CTM, n=8) or limited (LTM, n=6) based on the number of microliths. One CTM patient had coexisting mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma and embryonal carcinoma). The authors suggest that patients with TM may have an increased risk of developing primary testicular tumors until further data are available, emphasizing the need for surveillance.

title: Malignant ovarian germ cell tumors: analysis of 32 cases.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍32例の解析
summary_ja: 1983年から1999年に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍32例の後方視的検討。組織型はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が最多で、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍が続いた。ディスジャーミノーマは非ディスジャーミノーマ群より予後が良好であった。妊孕性温存を伴う治療は安全との結論が示された。
summary_en: Retrospective review of 32 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated at a Turkish institution from 1983 to 1999. Histology included dysgerminoma (40.6%), immature teratoma (28.1%), endodermal sinus tumor (25%), and mixed germ cell tumor (6.3%). Most patients underwent primary surgery and 26 received combination chemotherapy. Dysgerminoma had better prognosis than non-dysgerminomatous tumors, and fertility-preserving management was considered safe.

title: Primary carcinoid tumor of the ovary: a case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴った卵巣原発カルチノイド腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 下腹部痛を主訴とした47歳女性の右卵巣腫瘍症例。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と索状型カルチノイドの両方の組織像を示し、卵巣カルチノイドIA期と診断された。術後のCA19-9とCA125は、それぞれ18.5、10.5 U/mlであった。原発性卵巣カルチノイドと成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の併存を免疫組織化学的に記述した症例報告。
summary_en: Case report of a 47-year-old woman with lower abdominal pain and a 10-cm right ovarian mass with cystic and solid components and dermoid-type calcifications. Frozen section suggested a sex cord-stromal tumor, and subsequent staging surgery was performed. Histology showed features of both a mature cystic teratoma and a trabecular carcinoid, classified as ovarian carcinoid stage IA. Postoperative CA19-9 and CA125 were measured, and the report describes immunohistochemical features of a primary ovarian carcinoid coexisting with mature cystic teratoma.

title: Extragonadal germ cell tumors in Japan.
title_ja: 日本人性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者の治療成績
summary_ja: 1992年から2002年に治療された日本人性腺外胚細胞腫瘍30例の後方視的解析。非セミノーマの5年全生存期間(OS)は71%、無増悪生存期間(PFS)は42%であった。治療7日目の一過性の腫瘍マーカー上昇は予後不良と関連した。国際研究と同等の成績で、民族差は示唆されなかった。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 30 Japanese patients (25 nonseminomas, 4 pure seminomas) with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated from 1992 to 2002. Five-year overall survival and progression-free survival for nonseminoma were 71% and 42%. Transient elevation of AFP or beta-HCG on day 7 of treatment was significantly associated with poorer survival and progression-free survival. Outcomes appeared comparable to international series, and day-7 tumor marker changes may help identify patients needing more intensive treatment.

title: Cerebral metastases of a choriocarcinoma during pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠中に生じた絨毛癌の脳転移
summary_ja: 妊娠28週で頭痛と意識消失を呈した症例。脳と肺の病変、高値のβ-hCGから絨毛癌の転移性病変と診断された。母体予後改善のため早産帝王切開を施行し、その後化学療法に反応した。母体は対麻痺を残したが、児に明らかな後遺症はなかった。妊婦の急性神経症状では絨毛癌を鑑別に入れるべきと強調している。
summary_en: A case report of a pregnant woman at 28 weeks' gestation who presented with headache and loss of consciousness. Imaging showed cerebral and pulmonary lesions, and a high beta-hCG level supported a diagnosis of metastatic choriocarcinoma. A premature cesarean delivery was performed to improve maternal prognosis before chemotherapy. Maternal outcome was favorable despite paraplegia, and the infant had no apparent sequelae. The authors emphasize considering choriocarcinoma when acute neurological signs arise in pregnant patients.

title: Part I: testicular cancer--management of early disease.
title_ja: 精巣がんの管理（第I部）：早期病期
summary_ja: 早期精巣がんの管理を概説したレビュー（Part I）。根治的精巣摘除術が基本治療で、血管侵襲の有無によるリスク分類が補助療法やサーベイランスの選択を導く。高リスク例では補助化学療法により再発率を5%未満に抑えられる。低リスク例のサーベイランスは許容されるが、早期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の管理には統一見解がない。
summary_en: This Lancet Oncology review (Part I) outlines management of early-stage testicular cancer. Radical orchidectomy is the primary intervention. Seminoma patients usually receive adjuvant radiotherapy, while non-seminomatous patients may choose surveillance, adjuvant chemotherapy, or retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection. Risk stratification by vascular invasion guides decisions: about half of high-risk patients relapse without adjuvant therapy, reduced to under 5% with it. Low-risk patients can be safely surveilled because metastatic recurrence remains curable. Management of early non-seminomatous disease lacks consensus given near-100% survival.

title: Part II: testicular cancer--management of advanced disease.
title_ja: 精巣がんの管理（第II部）：進行病期
summary_ja: 進行精巣がん（転移性胚細胞腫瘍）を扱うLancet Oncologyレビューの第II部。従来のプラチナ併用化学療法で最大80%が治癒可能とされ、予後分類に基づく治療選択を論じる。再発例では救援化学療法や大量化学療法＋幹細胞移植が用いられ、予後不良例では初回からの用量強化療法や移植が検討される。
summary_en: Part II of the Lancet Oncology review addresses advanced testicular cancer. Up to 80% of metastatic germ-cell tumours are curable with cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide. Patients are stratified into good, intermediate and poor prognosis groups. Relapsed patients need salvage therapy, which may add ifosfamide or taxol or use high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell transplantation. Poor-prognosis patients often fail conventional chemotherapy and may be candidates for dose-intensive protocols or transplantation as first-line treatment. The authors note that outcomes exceed other solid tumours but further improvement is needed.

title: Prenatal diagnosis of sacrococcygeal teratoma with constitutional partial monosomy 7q/trisomy 2p.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫と染色体異常（7q部分欠失／2p部分トリソミー）を伴う胎児の出生前診断
summary_ja: 超音波で仙尾部奇形腫が検出された胎児の出生前診断例を報告。7q末端欠失と2p部分トリソミーが確認され、FISHでCurrarino症候群に関連するHLXB9のハプロ不全が示された。新生児は術後合併症により生後7日で死亡した。奇形腫はCurrarino症候群の部分型である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Case report of prenatal diagnosis of a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma and facial dysmorphism. Cytogenetic analysis revealed a constitutional terminal 7q deletion and 2p partial trisomy, likely from a de novo balanced translocation. The teratoma was detected by sonography, prompting prenatal karyotyping, which was confirmed at birth. The newborn died of postoperative complications at seven days. FISH showed HLXB9 haploinsufficiency, a gene linked to Currarino syndrome. The authors suggest the fetal teratoma may represent a partial, atypical Currarino syndrome presentation without other triad features.

title: Clinical outcome after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy of patients with pure testicular teratoma.
title_ja: 純粋精巣奇形腫に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の臨床経過
summary_ja: 1989〜1998年に純粋精巣奇形腫29例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清（初回または化学療法後）を施行した後方視的検討。79%に後腹膜病変があり、62%は進行病期で発症していた。化学療法後の切除標本では奇形腫9例、線維化8例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例が認められた。低病期でも後腹膜転移が多く再発リスクも高く、純粋奇形腫の転移能の高さが示された。
summary_en: Retrospective review of 29 patients with pure testicular teratoma who underwent primary (n=11) or postchemotherapy (n=18) retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy between 1989 and 1998. Retroperitoneal disease was present in 79%, and 62% presented with advanced disease. Postchemotherapy specimens showed teratoma in 9, fibrosis in 8, and yolk sac tumour in 1. Despite complete resection or favourable histology, a substantial relapse risk persisted, supporting the metastatic potential of pure testicular teratoma even at low clinical stage.

title: Two cycles of carboplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy for high-risk clinical stage I and stage IM non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis: a HECOG trial.
title_ja: 高リスク臨床病期Iおよび病期IMの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対するカルボプラチンを用いた2サイクルの補助化学療法（HECOG試験）
summary_ja: 精巣の高リスク臨床病期I・病期IMの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍52例に対し、CEB90（カルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン）2サイクルを補助療法として用いた前向き試験。96%が無病生存し、忍容性は良好だった。病期IM患者の2例は再発し、救援化学療法後も腫瘍により死亡した。シスプラチン併用レジメンと同等の有効性が期待できる治療選択肢と考察されている。
summary_en: Prospective HECOG trial of two cycles of carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (CEB90) as adjuvant therapy for 52 patients with high-risk clinical stage I or stage IM non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. High-risk features included vascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma, and absent yolk sac tumour, or marker positivity after orchidectomy. At median 112 months follow-up, 96% were alive and disease-free. Two stage IM patients relapsed with disseminated disease and died despite salvage therapy. Two cycles were well tolerated, with myelotoxicity and alopecia as main toxicities. The authors suggest it may be an equally effective option to cisplatin-based regimens.

title: Homeobox genes and cancer: new OCTaves for an old tune.
title_ja: ホメオボックス遺伝子とがん：古い調べに新たなオクターブを
summary_ja: Cancer Cell誌の論説で、Oct-4がPOUクラスのホメオボックス遺伝子として精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生に重要な役割を果たすという知見を紹介。多くの固形腫瘍で見られるホメオボックス遺伝子の発現異常が発がんに機能的に関わることを論じ、他のがん促進遺伝子との違いを解説している。
summary_en: A Cancer Cell editorial commenting on Gidekel et al., which shows that Oct-4, a POU-class homeobox transcription factor, is a critical player in the genesis of testicular germ cell tumours. The commentary places this within the broader theme that deregulated homeobox gene expression, common in many solid tumours, is functionally relevant to carcinogenesis. It highlights features that distinguish homeobox genes from other cancer-promoting genes, using the Oct-4 finding as the central example.

title: Oct-3/4 is a dose-dependent oncogenic fate determinant.
title_ja: Oct-3/4は用量依存的な発がん性の細胞運命決定因子である
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍の全検体（前がん病変を含む）でOct-3/4の発現を確認。ES細胞モデルでは、Oct-3/4の発現量に依存して腫瘍形成能が変化し、不活性化により悪性成分は退縮した。Oct-3/4はGCTの特徴的な免疫組織化学マーカーであるとともに、発生に重要な役割を果たすと結論づけられている。
summary_en: Study showing that Oct-3/4, a transcription factor sustaining embryonic stem cell self-renewal, is expressed in all human testicular germ cell tumours tested, including premalignant components. In embryonic stem cell models, Oct-3/4 dose-dependently determines oncogenic potential: high levels increase malignancy, while inactivation causes regression of malignant components. Ectopic expression transforms non-tumorigenic cells and confers tumorigenicity in nude mice. The authors propose Oct-3/4 as both a distinctive immunohistochemical marker for GCTs and a critical driver of their genesis.

title: Rectal adenocarcinoma with germ-cell differentiation: report of a case.
title_ja: 胚細胞分化を伴う直腸腺がん：症例報告
summary_ja: 胚細胞分化を伴う直腸腺がんで血清AFPが単独上昇した26歳男性の症例報告。プラチナ製剤、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法でAFPの低下と腫瘍縮小が得られたが、肝転移を生じ診断後20か月で死亡した。胚細胞分化成分が胚細胞腫瘍向けの治療に反応しうることを示す一方、予後は不良だった。
summary_en: Case report of a 26-year-old man with colorectal adenocarcinoma showing germ-cell differentiation and an isolated elevation of serum AFP. He received platinum/etoposide/bleomycin chemotherapy, with decreasing AFP and tumour shrinkage. Switching to concurrent 5-FU chemotherapy and radiation therapy maintained the marker response. He underwent palliative diversion at 10 months, developed liver metastasis at 12 months, and died at 20 months. The case suggests germ-cell-differentiated components may respond to germ cell regimens, although prognosis was poor.

title: Primary choriocarcinoma of the jejunum: report of a case.
title_ja: 空腸原発絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 45歳男性の空腸原発絨毛癌の症例報告。免疫組織化学で診断されたが、全身化学療法にもかかわらず術後5か月で肝転移により死亡した。文献レビューでは大量消化管出血と血清hCG上昇が特徴とされ、早期診断と速やかな化学療法の重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: Case report of primary choriocarcinoma of the jejunum in a 45-year-old man, diagnosed by immunohistochemistry on a resected specimen. Despite combined systemic chemotherapy, he died of progressive liver metastases five months after surgery. Serum hCG rose dramatically as the liver tumour progressed. A review of 13 small-intestinal choriocarcinoma cases in the English literature through 2001 identified massive gastrointestinal bleeding and elevated serum hCG as characteristic features. The authors emphasise early diagnosis and prompt chemotherapy as the only route to improving the poor prognosis.

title: Candidate genes for testicular cancer evaluated by in situ protein expression analyses on tissue microarrays.
title_ja: 組織マイクロアレイを用いた精巣がん候補遺伝子のin situタンパク質発現解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 279例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍から作製した組織マイクロアレイを用い、JUP、GRB7、CCND2、MGMT、FHITの発現を免疫組織化学で解析。JUP、GRB7、CCND2は腫瘍で高発現し、前がん病変はすべてJUP陽性だった。MGMTとFHITは腫瘍で発現が低下し、CCND2以外は組織型と有意に関連した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍のマーカー評価を行う高スループットツールが提示されている。
summary_en: Tissue microarray study of 510 testicular tissue cores from 279 patients with TGCT, evaluating candidate genes JUP, GRB7, CCND2, MGMT and FHIT by immunohistochemistry. JUP, GRB7 and CCND2 were rarely expressed in normal testis but frequently highly expressed in TGCT, and all premalignant intratubular neoplasias were JUP-positive. MGMT and FHIT were expressed in normal testis but less often in tumours. Except for CCND2, marker expression correlated with TGCT subtypes. The authors present this as a high-throughput tool for validating TGCT markers.

title: [Pulmonary rhabdomyosarcoma generated during treatment of testicular tumor].
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍治療中に発生した肺横紋筋肉腫
summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に肺転移が出現した23歳男性の症例である。救援化学療法（VIP療法）は腫瘍縮小効果が得られず、胸腔鏡下切除により3病変すべて横紋筋肉腫と診断された。その後CYVADIC療法と経口シクロホスファミドを行い、切除後1年時点で再発は認められていない。
summary_en: A 23-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma) and mature teratoma in a lymph node had undergone orchiectomy, PEB chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. When pulmonary metastases appeared, two courses of VIP salvage chemotherapy failed to shrink them. Video-assisted resection revealed rhabdomyosarcoma in all three nodules. Subsequent CYVADIC chemotherapy and oral cyclophosphamide were given, and no recurrence was evident one year later.

title: Trends in gestational choriocarcinoma: a 27-year perspective.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の動向：27年間の検討
summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、1973年から1999年の妊娠性絨毛癌450例の動向を解析した研究。発生率は約50%低下し、生存率は改善していた。黒人女性で発生率が高く、生存率が低かった。進行期や高齢でも生存率は低下していた。5年相対生存率は89.5%であった。
summary_en: This population-based study used SEER data to analyze trends in gestational choriocarcinoma among 450 cases recorded from 1973 to 1999. Incidence declined by nearly 50 percent over the period, and survival improved. Incidence was higher among Black women and in women aged 20 to 39, while survival was lower among Black patients, those with advanced stage, and older patients. The 5-year relative survival rate was 89.5 percent.

title: Primary abdominal gestational choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 原発性腹部妊娠性絨毛癌
summary_ja: 腹腔内出血と子宮内妊娠を認めない妊婦で、血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値は317,735mIU/mLであった。左前腹壁の出血性腫瘤を腹腔鏡下に切除し、妊娠性絨毛癌と診断された。FIGO IV期:4で、併用化学療法により臨床的寛解が得られた。原発性腹部妊娠性絨毛癌の初めての報告である。
summary_en: A pregnant woman presented with vaginal spotting, a serum hCG of 317,735 mIU/mL, and hemoperitoneum without an intrauterine pregnancy. A friable bleeding mass on the left anterior abdominal wall was laparoscopically resected and identified as gestational choriocarcinoma. The disease was staged as FIGO IV:4, and she achieved clinical remission with combination chemotherapy. The authors note that primary abdominal gestational choriocarcinoma had not been previously described, and that it can mimic a ruptured ectopic pregnancy.

title: Ovarian choriocarcinoma arising from partial mole as evidenced by deoxyribonucleic acid microsatellite analysis.
title_ja: 部分奇胎に由来する卵巣絨毛癌：DNAマイクロサテライト解析による証明
summary_ja: 最終月経から40日後に巨大な卵巣腫瘤を呈した女性の症例である。DNAマイクロサテライト解析で、腫瘍は母由来1本・父由来2本の対立遺伝子を示した。部分胞状奇胎に由来する卵巣妊娠による卵巣絨毛癌と考えられ、このような報告は初めてである。遺伝子解析は治療方針の決定に有用である。
summary_en: A woman presented with a huge ovarian mass 40 days after her last menstrual period. DNA microsatellite analysis of the tumor showed a single maternal and two paternal alleles at several independent loci. These findings are consistent with the tumor arising from an ovarian pregnancy of a partial hydatidiform mole. The authors describe this as the first reported case of ovarian choriocarcinoma derived from an ovarian pregnancy of a partial mole. Genetic analysis helps determine whether a choriocarcinoma is gestational or nongestational, guiding treatment.

title: Gestational trophoblastic syndrome and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection: a retrospective analysis.
title_ja: HIV感染を伴う妊娠性絨毛性疾患：後方視的解析
summary_ja: HIV感染女性12例と非感染女性29例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を後方視的に比較した研究。CD4値が200を超える患者には標準的化学療法が行われ、全体の93%が治癒した。CD4値が低く化学療法を受けなかった2例は死亡した。HIV感染者でも標準治療が適切と提案されている。
summary_en: This retrospective study compared 12 HIV-infected women with 29 non-HIV-infected women who had gestational trophoblastic disease. Patients with CD4 counts above 200 cells/microl received standard chemotherapy, and 93 percent of all patients were cured. Two HIV-infected women with very low CD4 counts did not receive chemotherapy and died of their disease. None of the HIV-infected patients who received chemotherapy died. The authors suggest that standard therapy is appropriate for HIV-infected women with choriocarcinoma and CD4 counts above 200.

title: Methylation status and expression of E-cadherin and cadherin-11 in gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるE-カドヘリンおよびカドヘリン-11のメチル化状態と発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、免疫組織化学法を用いて、正常胎盤、胞状奇胎および絨毛癌におけるE-カドヘリンとカドヘリン-11の発現を検討し、胞状奇胎のフォローアップと対比した。初期胎盤では、E-カドヘリンのメチル化も評価された。E-カドヘリンの免疫反応性は絨毛癌と完全胞状奇胎で低下し、完全胞状奇胎3例では高メチル化がみられた。カドヘリン-11は完全胞状奇胎で高く、絨毛癌では低かった。いずれのマーカーも遷延性栄養膜細胞疾患との関連は認められなかった。
summary_en: This study examined E-cadherin and cadherin-11 expression in normal placentas, hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas using immunohistochemistry, and correlated findings with mole follow-up. E-cadherin methylation was assessed in first-trimester placentas and molar tissue. E-cadherin immunoreactivity was reduced in choriocarcinoma and complete moles, with hypermethylation in three complete moles. Cadherin-11 was higher in complete moles but lower in choriocarcinoma. Neither marker was associated with persistent trophoblastic disease.

title: Ovarian mature cystic teratoma containing homunculus: a case report.
title_ja: 胎児様構造(ホムンクルス)を含む卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告
summary_ja: 23歳女性に生じた良性卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。三胚葉由来の組織を含む嚢胞内に、胎児様構造(ホムンクルス)が認められました。頭蓋冠の一部欠損から大脳皮質などの組織が突出しており、まれな所見として報告されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a benign ovarian mature cystic teratoma from a 23-year-old woman that contained a homunculus, a partial fetus-like structure. The cyst included tissues derived from all three germ layers. The homunculus had a distinct cranial structure with one upper limb and a partially developed osteocartilaginous skeleton. Cerebral cortex, retinal pigment, and leptomeninges were extruded through a partially disrupted calvarium. The report documents this rare anatomical finding within a common benign germ cell tumor of the ovary.

title: An approach for cure: PEI-chemotherapy and regional deep hyperthermia in children and adolescents with unresectable malignant tumors.
title_ja: 切除不能な悪性腫瘍を有する小児・思春期患者に対するPEI化学療法と局所深部温熱療法
summary_ja: 頭蓋外の非精巣性胚細胞腫瘍を含む小児・思春期患者39例を対象とした第II相試験です。イホスファミド、エトポシド、シスプラチンを併用した温熱化学療法を実施しました。完全奏効は20例でした。5年全生存期間(OS)は0.52、無イベント生存期間(EFS)は0.39でした。初回再発時に施行した場合に効果が最も高いと報告されています。
summary_en: This phase II study evaluated thermochemotherapy (TCH) combining ifosfamide, etoposide, and cisplatin with regional deep hyperthermia in 39 children and adolescents with unresectable or relapsed tumors, including 24 with extracranial non-testicular germ cell tumors. Twenty patients achieved complete response. Five-year event-free and overall survival were 0.39 and 0.52. Most relapse patients achieved sustained remission with multimodal treatment, and the effect was greatest when TCH was given at first relapse.

title: Management of recurrence and follow-up strategies for patients with seminoma and selected high-risk groups.
title_ja: セミノーマの再発管理と長期フォローアップ戦略(高リスク群を含む)
summary_ja: セミノーマの再発管理とフォローアップ戦略をまとめた総説です。病期Iで監視療法中に後腹膜に限局して再発した場合は放射線療法、大きな腫瘤や全身転移ではシスプラチン併用化学療法が必要とされます。救援化学療法にはイホスファミドとシスプラチンを含むレジメンを用い、難治例には大量化学療法と幹細胞救援を行います。
summary_en: This review outlines management of recurrence and follow-up for seminoma, including selected high-risk groups. Seminoma is highly sensitive to radiation and chemotherapy. Localized retroperitoneal recurrence after surveillance for stage I disease can be treated with radiotherapy, while bulky or systemic recurrence requires cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Salvage chemotherapy uses ifosfamide- and cisplatin-containing regimens, and refractory cases need high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue. Long-term follow-up is needed for late recurrence and second primary tumors.

title: Management of recurrence and follow-up strategies for patients with nonseminoma testis cancer.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの再発管理とフォローアップ戦略
summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)の再発時の臨床像と治療選択肢をまとめた総説です。腫瘍マーカーや画像診断の進歩、シスプラチン併用化学療法の改善、外科的切除の丁寧な実施により治癒率が大幅に向上しました。再発は過去20年で減少しており、救援率の向上には専門施設での治療が推奨されています。
summary_en: This review describes clinical features and management options for most recurrence situations in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) of the testis. Reliable serum tumor markers, improved imaging, effective cisplatin-based regimens, and meticulous surgical technique have markedly improved cure rates and reduced recurrence incidence over the past two decades. Because recurrence is now rare, the authors emphasize that patients should be managed at centers with extensive NSGCT experience to optimize salvage rates.

title: Parental and birth characteristics in relation to testicular cancer risk among males born between 1960 and 1995 in California (United States).
title_ja: 1960～1995年にカリフォルニアで出生した男性における親および出生時因子と精巣がんリスク
summary_ja: 1960～1995年にカリフォルニアで生まれた男性を対象とした症例対照研究で、精巣がんと親・出生時因子の関連を検討しました。症例1,645例に対し、対照を各症例3例ずつ設定しました。母親の年齢の上昇や初産・経産回数の少なさはリスク上昇と関連しました。セミノーマでは出生体重1500～2499gの正期産児でリスクが高い傾向がありました。
summary_en: This California birth-certificate-linked case-control study examined parental and birth characteristics in relation to testicular cancer risk among males born 1960-1995, using 1,645 cases and three matched controls per case. Higher maternal age and primiparity or low multiparity were associated with increased risk. Among seminomas, term infants with birth weights of 1500-2499 g had elevated risk. Findings suggest that maternal estrogen exposure and fetal growth factors may influence testicular cancer, especially seminoma.

title: Malignant teratoma of the orbit: a clinicopathological study of a case.
title_ja: 肉腫様変化を伴う眼窩悪性奇形腫の臨床病理学的検討
summary_ja: 10か月の乳児に生じた眼窩奇形腫の症例報告で、肉腫様変化を伴う悪性奇形腫でした。当初は肉腫と診断され化学療法と放射線療法を受けましたが、進行性の眼球突出と頭蓋内進展が疑われたため眼窩内容除去術が行われました。3年間のフォローアップで再発はありません。新生児の眼窩腫瘤の鑑別診断に奇形腫を含めるべきと結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective case report describes a 10-month-old child with an orbital teratoma showing malignant sarcomatous change. Initial fine needle aspiration suggested sarcoma, and the child received chemotherapy and radiotherapy before exenteration because of progressive proptosis and suspected intracranial extension. Histopathology confirmed a teratoma with malignant sarcomatous elements. The child remained free of recurrence at 3 years of follow-up. The authors recommend including orbital teratoma in the differential diagnosis of neonatal orbital masses and note that FNAB is unhelpful for diagnosis.

title: Intracranial metastasis of testicular seminoma in an HIV-positive. Case report and review.
title_ja: HIV陽性患者における精巣セミノーマの頭蓋内転移:症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: HIV陽性の男性に生じた精巣セミノーマの頭蓋内転移の症例報告です。CTとMRIの所見は髄膜腫や悪性リンパ腫に類似していました。AIDS患者では精巣セミノーマのリスクが高いと指摘されています。外科的切除後には放射線療法を検討し、全身病変がある場合は化学療法も組み込むべきとしています。
summary_en: This case report describes what appears to be the first intracranial metastasis from testicular seminoma in an HIV-positive man. Imaging of the lesion mimicked meningioma or lymphoma. The authors note an increased risk of testicular seminoma in AIDS patients and suggest that intracranial metastases may occur when lymph node involvement is present at diagnosis. After surgical removal of the intracranial lesion, radiotherapy should be considered, and chemotherapy should be included when systemic disease is present.

title: Extragonadal retroperitoneal embryonal carcinoma successfully treated with chemotherapy.
title_ja: 化学療法により寛解を得た性腺外後腹膜胎児性癌
summary_ja: 27歳男性の性腺外後腹膜胎児性癌で、肺転移を伴う症例報告です。胸部X線で多発陰影を認め、腹部に6cmの硬い腫瘤を触知しました。胸腔鏡下手術で切除した肺腫瘍が胎児性癌と診断されました。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法3コースで完全寛解に至り、その後の手術では悪性細胞は認められませんでした。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old Japanese man with multiple lung shadows on chest X-ray and a palpable 6 cm hard abdominal mass. Video-assisted thoracoscopic resection of a lung tumor revealed embryonal carcinoma, leading to a diagnosis of extragonadal retroperitoneal embryonal carcinoma with lung metastases. He received three courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin and achieved complete remission. Subsequent surgery found no malignant cells in the lung lesions or primary site, showing a favorable response to chemotherapy.

title: Expression of placental leucine aminopeptidase and adipocyte-derived leucine aminopeptidase in human normal and malignant invasive trophoblastic cells.
title_ja: ヒトの正常および悪性の侵入性栄養膜細胞におけるプラセンタ型およびアディポサイト由来ロイシンアミノペプチダーゼの発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常胎盤、絨毛癌（8例）、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（3例）でP-LAPとA-LAPの発現を解析した研究です。両酵素は胎盤形成期の浸潤性絨毛外栄養膜細胞で発現し、絨毛癌や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍ではさらに強く発現していました。ペプチド基質の分解を介して、栄養膜細胞の浸潤性に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
summary_en: The authors examined placental leucine aminopeptidase (P-LAP) and adipocyte-derived leucine aminopeptidase (A-LAP) in normal placenta, gestational choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Both enzymes were expressed in invasive extravillous trophoblasts during placentation and were more strongly expressed in all choriocarcinomas and placental site trophoblastic tumors, localized to invasive tumor cells. Findings suggest involvement in trophoblast invasiveness through degradation of peptide substrates.

title: Yolk sac tumor and testicular microlithiasis.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍と精巣微小石灰化
summary_ja: 2歳男児の思春期前精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例です。隣接する精巣組織の精細管外に同心円状の層状石灰化があり、残存精巣の超音波検査でも微小石灰化が確認されました。両側精巣微小石灰化と卵黄嚢腫瘍の併存は初めての報告で、先天的なセルトリ細胞機能異常や性腺の胚発生異常が示唆されています。
summary_en: A 2-year-old boy had a prepubertal testicular yolk sac tumor. Concentrically laminated microliths were located outside the seminiferous tubules in adjacent testicular tissue, and ultrasonography revealed microlithiasis in the remaining testis, indicating bilateral testicular microlithiasis. The authors note that microlithiasis has been associated with cryptorchidism, intratubular germ cell neoplasia and germ cell tumors. This combination has not been reported previously, and early-onset microlithiasis suggests congenital Sertoli cell dysfunction or abnormal gonadal embryogenesis.

title: Germ cell tumor-like neoplasms occurring outside the anatomic midline.
title_ja: 正中線外に生じる胚細胞腫瘍様腫瘍
summary_ja: 性腺や正中線上に多い胚細胞腫瘍と類似した組織像を示す、正中線外に生じる腫瘍をまとめた総説です。体細胞性腫瘍の中に胚細胞様成分として見られる場合と、純粋な形で生じる場合があります。各胚細胞腫瘍型に対応する形態学的・免疫組織化学的特徴が整理されています。
summary_en: This review examines germ cell tumor-like neoplasms arising outside the anatomic midline, which typically occur in gonads or midline extragonadal sites. Such lesions may represent germ cell-like components within somatic neoplasms or occur as pure forms. The authors review the morphologic and immunohistochemical features of these proliferations, organized by the type of germ cell tumor each recapitulates.

title: Epidermal growth factor enhances invasive activity of BeWo choriocarcinoma cells by inducing alpha2 integrin expression.
title_ja: 上皮成長因子はα2インテグリン発現誘導によりBeWo絨毛癌細胞の浸潤活性を高める
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株を用い、EGFがα2インテグリン発現を誘導して浸潤能を高めることを示した研究です。コラーゲンへの接着能は変化せず、化学運動性活性が増加しました。hCG分泌も増加し、正常栄養膜細胞に類似した分化を示しました。抗α2インテグリン抗体で効果は抑制されました。
summary_en: Using BeWo choriocarcinoma cells, the authors show that epidermal growth factor (EGF) induces alpha2 integrin expression at mRNA and protein levels. EGF increased human chorionic gonadotropin secretion, suggesting functional trophoblast-like differentiation, and dose-dependently enhanced invasiveness and chemokinetic activity, without altering collagen adhesion. An anti-alpha2 integrin antibody blocked these effects, suggesting EGF may promote trophoblast invasion into endometrium through integrin-mediated motility.

title: Prevalence of gestational trophoblastic disease. A single institution experience.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の有病率：単一施設での経験
summary_ja: 1988〜1998年にリヤドの病院で6万4千例以上の妊娠を後方視的研究として調べ、胞状奇胎59例と絨毛癌2例を確認しました。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生率は期間中に有意に低下し、現在はヨーロッパと同程度です。適切な管理には迅速な診断、リスク分類、化学療法や外科的管理が重要とされています。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed records of 64,762 pregnancies at a Riyadh hospital from 1988 to 1998, identifying 59 hydatidiform moles and 2 choriocarcinomas. Incidence of gestational trophoblastic disease declined significantly over the period and is now comparable to Europe. The authors emphasize that optimal management depends on prompt diagnosis, correct risk stratification, and appropriate chemotherapy and surgery.

title: Clinical profile of patients operated for benign adnexal tumors and the histopathological types.
title_ja: 良性付属器腫瘍で手術を受けた患者の臨床的特徴と病理組織型
summary_ja: 1999年〜2002年にオマーンの大学病院で良性付属器腫瘍の手術を受けた110例を対象とした後方視的研究です。腹痛が最も多い症状（65%）で、多くは開腹下の卵巣嚢腫摘出術を受けていました。最も多い組織型は成熟奇形腫（28%）で、再発は少数でした。良性付属器腫瘍の臨床像と組織型の傾向を示す報告です。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 110 patients who underwent surgery for benign adnexal tumors at Sultan Qaboos University Hospital between 1999 and 2002 describes clinical presentation and histopathology. Abdominal pain was the most common symptom (65%). Most patients underwent laparotomy and ovarian cystectomy. Benign mature teratoma was the most frequent histologic type (28%), and recurrences were few.

title: Mesenteric cystic teratoma in children.
title_ja: 小児の腸間膜嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 5か月女児と4か月男児に発生した成熟型の腸間膜奇形腫の2例を報告しています。出生前診断例を除けば、文献上最も若い年齢の症例です。腸間膜奇形腫は極めて稀な性腺外奇形腫で、三胚葉性または二胚葉性の組織を含みます。診断法、鑑別診断、治療についても考察されています。
summary_en: The authors describe two cases of mature mesenteric teratoma, in a 5-month-old girl and a 4-month-old boy. Excluding a recently reported prenatally diagnosed case, these are the youngest reported in the literature. Mesenteric teratoma is an extremely rare extragonadal tumor arising from totipotent primordial cells and containing tridermal or bidermal tissues. The paper also discusses diagnostic tools, differential diagnosis and management.

title: Testis-sparing surgery for benign and malignant testicular tumours.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する精巣温存手術（良性および悪性例）
summary_ja: 若年男性3例の精巣腫瘍に対し精巣温存手術を施行した報告。良性2例（ライディッヒ細胞腫、良性奇形腫）では精巣を温存できた。セミノーマの1例では、術前超音波検査で指摘されなかった浸潤性の別病変が残存精巣に認められ、根治的精巣摘除術へ移行した。
summary_en: This report describes testis-sparing surgery in three young men with testicular tumours. Two lesions were benign (a Leydig cell tumour and a benign teratoma), and testicular preservation succeeded in these patients. The third patient had a seminoma diagnosed by frozen section. A separate invasive, poorly differentiated nodule was found in the residual testis, which preoperative ultrasound had not detected, so he was converted to radical orchidectomy. The case shows the technique's feasibility while highlighting the risk of occult disease in malignant cases.

title: Gastric teratoma--a rare benign tumour of neonates.
title_ja: 新生児の胃奇形腫：稀な良性腫瘍
summary_ja: 新生児の胃奇形腫2例を報告した論文。1例は低出生体重の早産児で、巨大な未熟奇形腫を認めた。新生児に生じる稀な良性腫瘍であり、完全切除が適切な治療であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes two neonates with gastric teratoma. One was a low-birthweight premature infant with a massive immature teratoma. The report emphasises the rarity of this benign tumour in neonates and its unusual gastric location. The authors conclude that complete surgical excision is the appropriate treatment. The brief report offers a clinical description of two cases to inform recognition and management of this rare entity.

title: Lateral distribution of ovarian dermoid cyst.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の左右分布
summary_ja: 336例の卵巣類皮嚢腫について手術記録を評価した観察研究。右卵巣が有意に多く、片側性病変の56.4％が右側であった。両側例を含めても右側優位であった。年齢や嚢腫径は左右で差がなく、卵巣類皮嚢腫は右側に生じやすいと結論づけている。
summary_en: This observational study evaluated operative reports from 336 women with ovarian dermoid cysts. The mean cyst diameter was 5.6 cm. Cysts were found in the right ovary (48.8%), the left ovary (37.8%) and bilaterally (13.4%). Among unilateral cysts, right-sided lesions were significantly more frequent than the expected 50%, and this right-sided predominance persisted when bilateral cases were included. Age and cyst size did not differ by side. The authors conclude that dermoid cysts show a predisposition to a right lateral location.

title: Recurrent immature mediastinal teratoma with life-threatening respiratory distress in a neonate.
title_ja: 新生児における生命を脅かす呼吸窮迫を伴った再発性縦隔未熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 出生時に重篤な呼吸窮迫を呈し緊急手術を要した新生児の縦隔未熟奇形腫の症例報告。切除後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は正常化したが、生後4か月で再上昇し再発が判明した。カルボプラチンを基盤とした化学療法で良好な反応を得て、42か月の観察期間中も良好に経過した。
summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a mediastinal teratoma who had severe respiratory distress at birth and required emergency surgery. Histopathology showed an immature teratoma. After excision, the elevated AFP normalised, but it rose again at 4 months and a recurrence was detected. Treatment with carboplatin-based chemotherapy produced a favourable response, and the child was well at 42 months' follow-up. The authors review the literature on this clinical rarity and note that none of the similar reported patients had recurrence or malignancy.

title: Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection as adjuvant therapy in the treatment of non-seminomatous testicular cancer.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対する補助療法としての後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1987年から1997年に単施設で精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された60例を検討した。病期I患者は精巣摘除術のみで治療され、再発は認められなかった。シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた47例のうち、部分奏効の31例で後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)が施行され、一部の標本で生存腫瘍が認められた。手術死亡は0%、全生存率は98%であった。両側リンパ節郭清は片側切除に比べ長期の性機能障害と関連していた。
summary_en: This retrospective review analysed 60 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumour of the testis treated at one centre between 1987 and 1997. Patients with stage I disease were managed by orchiectomy alone and none recurred. Among 47 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, 31 with partial response underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND), and viable tumour was found in some specimens. Operative mortality was zero and overall survival was 98%. Bilateral lymphadenectomy was associated with more long-term sexual problems than unilateral resection.

title: Successful surgical management of a prenatally diagnosed intrapericardial teratoma.
title_ja: 出生前診断された心膜内奇形腫の外科的管理の成功例
summary_ja: 出生前に診断された巨大な心膜内奇形腫の新生児例を報告する。正常分娩後に外科的切除を行い、心膜液貯留や心臓圧迫を防ぐことで救命につながった。生後11か月以上のフォローアップが行われている。これらのまれな性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍は通常良性であるが、速やかな切除が重要である。
summary_en: This report describes a newborn with a large intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed prenatally. After normal delivery, the infant underwent surgical resection, which is curative and potentially lifesaving because such lesions can cause massive pericardial effusion and cardiac compression. Clinical follow-up exceeded eleven months. The authors emphasize prompt excision of these usually benign congenital tumors, which are rare extragonadal germ cell tumors.

title: Bilateral testicular microlithiasis with a unilateral testicular germ cell tumor: a case report.
title_ja: 両側精巣微小石灰化を伴う片側精巣胚細胞腫瘍:症例報告
summary_ja: 両側の精巣微小石灰化と片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を合併した男性の症例報告である。超音波検査で見つかる微小石灰化は胚細胞腫瘍と関連し、胚細胞腫瘍例では最大40%に認められるとされ、一般集団の0.05～0.6%より高い。両者の関係についての文献的考察を加え、微小石灰化を認めた際の注意点を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a man with bilateral testicular microlithiasis who also had a unilateral testicular germ cell tumor. The paper notes an important association between ultrasound-detected microlithiasis and germ cell tumors, with reported concordance up to 40%, compared with 0.05 to 0.6% in the general population. It reviews the relationship between microlithiasis and germ cell tumors, which is relevant to surveillance of patients with this finding. The clinical significance of microlithiasis is highlighted.

title: Massive ovarian edema with contralateral mature cystic teratoma--a case report of an uncommon combination.
title_ja: 巨大卵巣浮腫と対側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の併存例:まれな組み合わせの症例報告
summary_ja: 左卵巣の巨大卵巣浮腫と右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を併存した16歳未婚女性の症例報告である。巨大卵巣浮腫はまれな偽腫瘍であり、病因、形態学的特徴、鑑別診断が検討されている。正しい治療のためにこの病態の認識が重要とされ、ネパールからの初報例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old unmarried girl with massive ovarian edema of the left ovary, a rare pseudotumour, coexisting with a mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary. The paper discusses etiopathological concepts, morphological changes, and differential diagnosis. Recognizing this entity is important for correct treatment. The authors note it is the first reported case from Nepal. The mature cystic teratoma is an ovarian germ cell tumor component of this unusual combination.

title: Benign teratoma of the lesser omentum--a case report.
title_ja: 小網の良性奇形腫:症例報告
summary_ja: 16歳男性の小網奇形腫の症例報告である。未熟成分を含むにもかかわらず良性の経過をとった。小網奇形腫は極めてまれで、既報はすべて成熟組織のみであった。外科的切除後7年間無病で経過している。未熟成分があっても性腺外奇形腫が必ず悪性として振る舞うわけではないことを示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old male with a teratoma of the lesser omentum that behaved benignly despite containing immature elements. Such teratomas are extremely rare, and prior reports described only mature tissue. The patient remained disease-free for seven years after surgical resection. The report highlights that immature components do not always predict aggressive behavior in extragonadal teratomas, which are extragonadal germ cell tumors relevant to this site.

title: Congenital cervical teratoma--an unusual presentation.
title_ja: 先天性頸部奇形腫:まれな提示例
summary_ja: 女児に生じた先天性良性頸部奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は無症状であった点が特徴的で、甲状腺との関係が注目されている。先天性頸部奇形腫はまれな性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である。頸部の他の腫瘤と誤認されうるため、この提示様式を認識することが正確な診断に重要とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes a female infant with a congenital benign cervical teratoma. The tumor was unusual because it was asymptomatic, and its relationship with the thyroid gland is highlighted. Congenital teratomas of the neck are rare extragonadal germ cell tumors. Because neck teratomas can be mistaken for other cervical masses, awareness of this presentation matters for accurate diagnosis and appropriate management.

title: Primary mixed germ cell tumour of the liver--a case report.
title_ja: 肝原発混合型胚細胞腫瘍--症例報告
summary_ja: 2歳半の男児に生じた肝原発混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告です。卵黄嚢腫瘍と成熟奇形腫の成分からなり、乳児での報告は初めてです。左肝葉切除と化学療法後にAFPは低下したものの、肝内に広範な転移が出現し、術後6か月で肝機能不全により死亡しました。
summary_en: This case report describes a 2.5-year-old boy with a primary mixed malignant germ cell tumor of the left liver lobe, comprising yolk sac tumor and mature teratoma, the first such case reported in an infant. He presented with abdominal distension, upper abdominal pain, and weight loss, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated. After left lobectomy and chemotherapy, AFP levels fell rapidly, but widespread intrahepatic metastases developed, and the patient died of liver dysfunction six months after surgery.

title: Does every retroperitoneal mass associated with undescended testicle represent testicular tumor or its metastasis?
title_ja: 未下降精巣に伴う後腹膜腫瘤は精巣腫瘍またはその転移を示すか?
summary_ja: 未下降精巣を伴う36歳男性で、傍大静脈部の腫瘤に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清が行われました。精巣腫瘍や性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を疑いましたが、切除組織は非悪性でした。未下降精巣の最も高い位置は鼠径輪であるため、このような腫瘤が必ずしも腫瘍を示すわけではないと考察しています。
summary_en: A 36-year-old man with an undescended right testicle and a paracaval/pararenal mass on CT underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for suspected testicular tumor, metastasis, or extragonadal germ cell tumor. The resected tissue was non-malignant. The authors note that the highest possible location of an undescended testicle is the internal inguinal ring, so paracaval masses in such patients do not necessarily represent testicular tumor, metastasis, or EGT, and they call for further study.

title: Retrorectal benign cystic teratoma misdiagnosed with high lying pararectal abscess.
title_ja: 直腸後腔の良性嚢胞性奇形腫を高位直腸傍膿瘍と誤診した症例
summary_ja: 直腸後方に生じた良性嚢胞性奇形腫が膿瘍形成を伴い、高位直腸傍膿瘍と誤診された症例です。診断と治療上の困難点を検討し、文献的考察を加えています。直腸後腔腫瘍は奇形腫が最多の群であり、特殊な部位ゆえに誤診されやすいと述べています。
summary_en: A case of a retrorectal benign cystic teratoma complicated by abscess formation was initially misdiagnosed as a high-lying pararectal abscess. The authors describe the diagnostic and therapeutic difficulties and review the literature. Teratomas, chordomas, and dermoids form the largest group of retrorectal tumors, and the unusual location of cystic teratomas can lead to misdiagnosis.

title: Bilateral and synchronic seminomatous testicular neoplasia.
title_ja: 両側同時性セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 精子保存後に2段階で両側の根治的精巣摘除術を受けた32歳男性のセミノーマ症例です。病理学的に両側の古典型セミノーマで、両側に放射線療法が行われました。腫瘍学的には良好な経過でしたが、心理的フォローアップが必要でした。両側同時性の精巣腫瘍は極めて稀です。
summary_en: A 32-year-old man with no children underwent staged bilateral radical orchiectomy after prior sperm banking, with silicone testicular prostheses implanted. Pathology showed bilateral classical seminoma (pT2 on the right, T1 on the left). He received bilateral complementary radiotherapy at 2,500 cGy per side and had a good oncologic outcome, though psychological follow-up was needed. Bilateral synchronous testicular neoplasia is very rare, at about 0.17% of germ cell tumors.

title: MRI findings of an ovarian dermoid cyst with malignant transformation.
title_ja: 悪性転化を伴う卵巣類皮嚢腫のMRI所見
summary_ja: 69歳女性の右卵巣類皮嚢腫で、扁平上皮癌(肉腫様形質を伴う)へ悪性転化した症例です。術前に行われたMRI所見を報告しています。卵巣類皮嚢腫の悪性転化は稀であり、MRIによる術前診断の報告も少ないため、画像診断の参考になると考察しています。
summary_en: A 69-year-old woman had a right ovarian dermoid cyst that had undergone malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma with sarcomatoid features. Preoperative MRI findings are reported. The authors note that malignant transformation of ovarian dermoid cysts is uncommon and that preoperative MRI diagnosis has rarely been described, so the case may serve as an imaging reference.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma: a case report and a review of literature.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫:症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 出生時に破裂した仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告で、文献レビューを併記しています。胎児水腫、水腎症、難産、出血、死亡などの合併症が知られています。出生前診断には超音波検査が第一選択であり、早期診断は臨床判断と予後改善に寄与すると述べています。
summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma that ruptured at birth, one of its potential complications, and includes a literature review. Other complications include fetal hydrops, hydronephrosis, cervical dystocia, bleeding, and death. Prenatal ultrasonography is the diagnostic method of choice, and early diagnosis guides clinical decisions and improves outcomes.

title: Gastric teratoma in a 2-month-old boy.
title_ja: 生後2か月男児の胃奇形腫
summary_ja: 生後2か月の男児に発生した胃奇形腫の症例報告。出生時から哺乳後の嘔吐が続き、当初は肥厚性幽門狭窄症が疑われた。画像検査により診断が確定したが、劇症の敗血症性髄膜炎を合併し、診断から5日後に死亡した。小児奇形腫の2%未満という極めて稀な腫瘍であり、文献も乏しいため症例として報告された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 2-month-old boy with a gastric teratoma, an extremely rare neoplasm accounting for under 2% of pediatric teratomas. He presented with persistent postfeeding vomiting since birth, initially suspected to be hypertrophic pyloric stenosis. Imaging studies established the diagnosis. He also developed fulminant septic meningitis and died five days after the diagnosis was made. The authors report the case because of its rarity and the sparse literature on gastric teratomas in children.

title: Maurice Chevassu (1877-1957): a pioneer of the study and therapy of testicular neoplasms.
title_ja: モーリス・シュヴァッス（1877–1957）：精巣腫瘍の研究と治療の先駆者
summary_ja: フランスの泌尿器科医Chevassu（1877–1957）の業績を紹介する歴史的論文。1906年に128例の精巣腫瘍の組織学的検討に基づき、セミノーマと混合型腫瘍に分ける初の包括的分類を提示した。単純精巣摘除術に疑問を呈し、血管茎を含む精巣摘除とリンパ節郭清を提唱した。この術式は現在も精巣がんの標準治療として用いられている。
summary_en: This historical article profiles Maurice Chevassu (1877-1957), a French urologist and surgeon who pioneered the study and treatment of testicular neoplasms. In 1906, based on histological analysis of 128 testicular tumors, he proposed the first comprehensive classification, distinguishing seminomas from mixed tumors. He questioned simple orchiectomy and advocated removal of the testis with its vascular stem plus lymph node dissection. His surgical technique became the standard therapy for testicular cancer and remains in use today.

title: Matured mediastinal teratoma extending into the cervical neck of an adult.
