title_ja: 頸部へ進展した成人の成熟縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 27歳女性の頸部軟性腫瘤の症例。術前検査で甲状腺に達する上縦隔の嚢胞性病変がみられ、胸腺または前腸嚢胞と診断された。襟状切開で腫瘍を摘除したところ、病理学的に良性の成熟奇形腫と確定した。成人の頸部奇形腫は稀であり、縦隔奇形腫が頸部へ進展する例はさらに稀であるため報告された。
summary_en: A 27-year-old woman presented with a soft cervical mass. Preoperative imaging revealed a cystic upper mediastinal lesion extending to the thyroid, initially diagnosed as a thymic or foregut cyst. The mass was removed through a collar incision. Histology confirmed a benign mature teratoma. The authors report this case because cervical teratomas are rare in adults, and mediastinal teratomas extending into the neck are rarer still.

title: Immature teratoma with gliomatosis peritonei associated with pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠に関連した未熟奇形腫と腹膜神経膠腫症
summary_ja: 妊娠に合併した未熟奇形腫の症例報告である。未熟奇形腫は若年女性に多い原始的な胚細胞腫瘍である。腹膜神経膠腫症を伴っており、特徴的なMRI所見を病理所見と対比して示している。妊娠中の未熟奇形腫のまれな報告として臨床的に意義があり、画像診断の重要性を示す報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes an immature teratoma associated with pregnancy, a primitive germ cell tumor that usually affects young women. The tumor was accompanied by gliomatosis peritonei, a rare peritoneal condition with implants of glial tissue. The authors describe unique MR findings and correlate them with pathologic features. The report highlights that immature teratoma is rarely reported in association with pregnancy, and that MRI can provide useful diagnostic information in such cases.

title: Fluid-fluid levels in ovarian teratomas.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫における液液面の超音波所見
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の超音波検査での液液面所見を後方視的に検討した研究である。付属器腫瘤805例を解析し、奇形腫27例で液液面が認められた。各層のエコー輝度により3型に分類した。液液面は奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）を強く示唆するが、確定診断にはならないと結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated ultrasonographic features of ovarian teratomas containing fluid-fluid levels. Reviewing 805 masses, including 370 benign teratomas and 435 nonteratomatous adnexal masses, the authors identified fluid-fluid levels in 27 teratomas and 8 nonteratomatous masses. Teratomas were classified into three types by the echogenicity of each layer, and floating nodules at the interface were seen in 30 percent of teratomas. The authors conclude that fluid-fluid levels strongly suggest but are not pathognomonic of dermoid tumors, while certain patterns may be pathognomonic of benign ovarian teratomas.

title: Paracolic recurrence: the importance of wide excision of the spermatic cord at retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における精索転移と傍結腸部再発：後腹膜リンパ節郭清時の精索広範切除の重要性
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜リンパ節郭清で精索に転移を認めた症例を検討した。685例中34例で精索転移がみられ、他施設でRPLNDを受けた後に傍結腸部再発をきたした4例も報告された。精索と周囲リンパ組織の不完全切除が再発の原因となり得るため、郭清時には精索を広範に切除すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: This report analyzes spermatic cord involvement at retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in 34 of 685 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, and four patients who developed paracolic recurrence after RPLND elsewhere. Spermatic cord disease was found in primary and post-chemotherapy RPLND specimens, often without involvement of the primary landing zone or gonadal vessels. The authors conclude that incomplete excision of the spermatic cord and surrounding lymphatic tissue can cause recurrence, and recommend wide excision during RPLND to prevent paracolic relapse.

title: Efficient carboplatin single therapy in a mouse model of human testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: ヒト精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のマウスモデルにおけるカルボプラチン単剤療法の有効性
summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植SCIDマウスモデルで、カルボプラチン単剤療法の効果を検討した。カルボプラチン60mg/kgを2回投与すると腫瘍は消失し、6か月間無腫瘍を維持した。一方、エトポシド単剤は無効であった。シスプラチン関連の有害事象を減らすため、高リスク病期I症例での臨床試験が提案されている。
summary_en: This study tested carboplatin and etoposide monotherapy in SCID mice bearing human testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor xenografts. Two cycles of 60 mg/kg carboplatin eradicated tumors and reduced vascular density and VEGF-A mRNA, with tumor markers normalizing and animals remaining tumor-free for six months. Single-dose 120 mg/kg carboplatin also eradicated tumors but caused high mortality. Etoposide alone failed at all doses tested. The authors suggest carboplatin monotherapy may be evaluated in high-risk clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell cancer to reduce cisplatin-related morbidity.

title: Activated status of tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes and apoptosis in testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおける浸潤リンパ球の活性化とアポトーシス
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を比較し、腫瘍浸潤細胞傷害性T細胞とアポトーシスを検討した。セミノーマでは細胞傷害性マーカー陽性細胞が有意に多かった。胎児性癌ではアポトーシス指数が最も高かった。セミノーマでは活性化グランザイムB陽性細胞数とアポトーシスに強い相関がみられ、良好な予後に関与する宿主免疫機構が示唆された。
summary_en: This study compared tumor-infiltrating cytotoxic T lymphocytes and apoptosis in 20 pure testicular seminomas and 20 non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, including 16 mixed tumors. Seminomas had markedly more CD3, CD8, TIA-1 and granzyme B positive cells than non-seminomatous tumors. The apoptotic index was highest in embryonal carcinoma. In seminomas, the number of activated granzyme B positive cells strongly correlated with apoptosis. The authors propose that cytotoxic lymphocyte activity may contribute to the favorable prognosis of seminoma.

title: Fibrosarcoma associated with a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣線維肉腫を伴う良性嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 32歳女性の卵巣腫瘍は線維肉腫と良性嚢胞性奇形腫からなっていた。奇形腫は三胚葉成分を含み未熟成分はなかった。線維肉腫は奇形腫に直接連続しており、比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションで9、12、16番染色体の不均衡が認められた。1年のフォローアップで再発はなかった。卵巣線維肉腫と良性奇形腫の合併としては2例目の報告である。
summary_en: A 32-year-old woman had a 7-cm ovarian tumor composed of fibrosarcoma and benign cystic teratoma. The teratoma contained all three germ layers without immature components, and the fibrosarcoma was directly connected to it. Immunohistochemistry showed vimentin reactivity only, and comparative genomic hybridization revealed chromosomal imbalances of 9, 12 and 16. After one year of follow-up, there was no recurrence or systemic disease. The authors describe this as only the second report of this association and the first including cytogenetic analysis.

title: Intracardiac resection of a metastatic choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 心臓転移を伴う絨毛癌の心臓内切除
summary_ja: 産褥期絨毛癌が播種した41歳女性で、左房内に浮遊する腫瘍による肺高血圧が出現した。右下肺静脈を閉塞していた絨毛癌の転移性血栓を心臓手術で切除した。その後、大量化学療法を行い、1年のフォローアップで完全寛解を維持している。稀な部位の転移性絨毛癌でも、腫瘍減量手術と大量化学療法の併用が有用となり得ると述べている。
summary_en: A 41-year-old woman with disseminated postpartum choriocarcinoma developed a floating left atrial tumor causing pulmonary hypertension. The mass, a metastatic thrombus of choriocarcinoma obstructing the right inferior pulmonary vein, was resected by intracardiac surgery. She then received high-dose chemotherapy and remained in full remission at one-year follow-up. The authors suggest that tumor reductive surgery followed by high-dose chemotherapy may be a useful approach for metastatic choriocarcinoma, even at rare sites.

title: Peritoneal implantation of squamous cell carcinoma following rupture of a dermoid cyst during laparoscopic removal.
title_ja: 腹腔鏡下に摘出した類皮嚢腫に生じた扁平上皮癌の腹膜播種
summary_ja: 腹腔鏡下に摘出した類皮嚢腫から扁平上皮癌が見つかった。摘出時の内容物漏出により、開腹病期分類術で腹膜播種が確認され、FIGO病期Iaから病期IIcに上方修正された。強力な補助療法により妊孕性の喪失を含む有意な合併症が生じた。良性と考えられる卵巣腫瘤を腹腔鏡で扱う際の、予期せぬ悪性腫瘍のリスクが論じられている。
summary_en: A dermoid cyst removed laparoscopically was found to contain squamous cell carcinoma, and spillage during removal led to peritoneal implants at staging laparotomy. The disease was upgraded from FIGO stage Ia to IIc. Aggressive adjuvant therapy was given, causing significant morbidity including loss of fertility. The authors discuss the prognostic significance of upstaging and the risk of unexpected malignancy when managing presumed benign ovarian masses laparoscopically, noting that cyst spillage rates are higher with laparoscopy.

title: Gliomatosis peritonei: a report of two cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症：2症例報告と文献レビュー
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴い腹腔内に粟粒状のグリア組織が播種する稀な疾患、腹膜神経膠腫症の2症例を報告した。1例は子宮内膜症を合併していた。両症例は5年以上追跡され、生物学的態度と予後に関するデータが提供された。既報86例のレビューも行われ、腹膜癌腫症と誤診されやすい点が指摘されている。
summary_en: This report describes two patients with gliomatosis peritonei, a rare condition in which miliary glial tissue implants in the peritoneal cavity in association with ovarian teratomas. One case coexisted with endometriosis, and both were followed for more than 5.5 years, providing data on the biological behavior and prognosis of this entity. The authors also reviewed the 86 previously reported cases to summarize current knowledge, noting that the condition is easily mistaken for peritoneal carcinomatosis.

title: MR imaging of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma: diagnosis and assessment.
title_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫の磁気共鳴画像法による診断と評価
summary_ja: 産科超音波で発見された仙尾部奇形腫の胎児12例を対象に、MRIの診断・評価上の有用性を検討した。超音波とMRIの計測は完全に一致し、1例では超音波で見逃された脊柱管内進展がMRIで確認された。MRIにより出生前評価や両親へのカウンセリング、治療方針が変更された症例もあり、産科超音波検査の有用な補助手段と結論づけられた。
summary_en: This study evaluated the usefulness of MRI in the prenatal diagnosis and assessment of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma in 12 pregnant women referred after obstetric ultrasound. Sonographic and MRI measurements agreed completely, and MRI revealed a spinal canal extension in one fetus that ultrasound missed. Postnatal findings confirmed MRI in 10 patients. MRI changed prenatal evaluation in some cases and influenced parental counseling and treatment, and the authors conclude that it is a valuable adjunct to obstetric sonography.

title: Salvage chemotherapy for patients with advanced pure seminoma.
title_ja: 進行性純粋セミノーマに対する救援化学療法
summary_ja: 進行性純粋セミノーマで初回白金製剤治療後に進行した27例を対象とした研究。従来用量のシスプラチン・イホスファミドまたは自家幹細胞救援を伴う大量化学療法を実施し、56%が完全奏効を得た。残存病変が壊死・線維化のみの患者は良好で、生存セミノーマを認めた例は原病死した。再発例の約半数で持続的寛解が得られた。
summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 27 patients with progressive advanced pure seminoma who received salvage chemotherapy after first-line platinum-based treatment. Fifteen received conventional-dose cisplatin and ifosfamide, and twelve received high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell rescue. Overall, 56% achieved complete response, and 52% remained alive and disease-free at a median follow-up of 72 months. Patients whose residual masses showed only necrosis or fibrosis generally did well, whereas viable seminoma at surgery predicted death. Roughly half of relapsed pure seminoma patients achieved durable remission.

title: Ovarian teratomas with florid benign vascular proliferation: a distinctive finding associated with the neural component of teratomas that may be confused with a vascular neoplasm.
title_ja: 顕著な良性血管増生を伴う卵巣奇形腫：血管性腫瘍と誤認されうる神経成分関連の所見
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫5例（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、混合型胚細胞腫瘍を含む）で、神経組織に伴う顕著な良性血管増生を報告。免疫組織化学により内皮由来を確認した2例を含む。血管内皮増殖因子による二次的な血管新生と考えられ、血管性腫瘍や未熟奇形腫との誤診を避けるうえで重要と述べている。
summary_en: This report describes five ovarian teratomas, including mature cystic, immature, and mixed germ cell tumor types, showing prominent benign vascular proliferation associated with neural tissue. The vascular changes, thin-walled curved vessels or glomeruloid structures, were confirmed as endothelial by immunohistochemistry in two cases. The authors interpret this as a secondary angiogenic reaction, likely driven by vascular endothelial growth factor, similar to that seen in high-grade gliomas. Recognizing this benign pattern is important to avoid misdiagnosing a vascular neoplasm or immature teratoma. One patient had widespread metastatic immature teratoma.

title: Ovarian mixed germ cell tumor with predominance of polyembryoma: a case report with literature review.
title_ja: ポリエンブリオーマが優位を占める卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 34歳女性の卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。主体はポリエンブリオーマで、絨毛癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫の成分を伴っていた。同一組成の既報は見当たらないとし、文献レビューを加えている。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍における組織学的多様性を示す症例である。
summary_en: This is a case report of a 34-year-old woman with an ovarian mixed germ cell tumor. The predominant component was polyembryoma, with foci of choriocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and immature teratoma. The authors note that no previous cases with this identical composition had been found in the literature, and the report includes a literature review. The case highlights the histologic diversity possible within ovarian germ cell tumors and the importance of recognizing polyembryoma as a component.

title: Immature teratoma of the ovary with a minor rhabdomyosarcomatous component and fatal rhabdomyosarcomatous metastases: the first case in a child.
title_ja: 横紋筋肉腫様再発を伴う卵巣未熟奇形腫：小児における初例
summary_ja: 6歳女児の卵巣未熟奇形腫の症例。原発巣の横紋筋肉腫成分はわずかだったが、卵巣摘出、化学療法、放射線療法後も骨盤内再発を繰り返し、横紋筋肉腫様に変化した。3年後に全身病変で死亡した。横紋筋肉腫様の再発を伴う場合の予後は不良と結論している。
summary_en: A 6-year-old girl with an ovarian immature teratoma containing a minor rhabdomyosarcomatous component developed recurrences that became increasingly rhabdomyosarcomatous despite oophorectomy, chemotherapy, and radiation. She died of systemic disease three years after presentation. The authors describe this as the first such case in a child. Combined with prior reports, they indicate that prognosis with rhabdomyosarcomatous recurrence is poor, similar to primary ovarian rhabdomyosarcoma.

title: Nasopharyngeal teratocarcinosarcoma.
title_ja: 鼻咽腔奇形癌肉腫
summary_ja: 口蓋裂と同側耳管の先天的な置換または欠損を伴う鼻咽腔奇形癌肉腫の1例を報告した。先天性胚細胞腫瘍は仙尾部に多く、頭頸部の奇形腫はさらに稀で、鼻咽腔発生はまれであることを示した。臨床的および組織病理学的特徴を検討し、本症例の位置づけを論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a nasopharyngeal teratocarcinosarcoma associated with a cleft palate and with congenital replacement or absence of the ipsilateral Eustachian tube. The authors note that congenital germ cell tumors most often arise in the sacrococcygeal region, while teratomas of the head and neck are uncommon and nasopharyngeal lesions are rarer still. They review the clinical and histopathological features of this unusual extragonadal presentation, which is generally considered benign when it occurs as a teratoma alone.

title: From the archives of the AFIP: tumors and tumorlike lesions of the testis: radiologic-pathologic correlation.
title_ja: AFIPの資料から：精巣の腫瘍および腫瘍様病変、画像と病理の対比
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍と腫瘍様病変の画像所見と病理所見を対比して解説した。精巣腫瘍の約95%は胚細胞腫瘍で、セミノーマは均一な境界明瞭な病変として描出される。非セミノーマ性腫瘍は多様な画像所見を示し、表皮嚢腫などの良性病変は不要な精巣摘除を避ける手がかりとなる。
summary_en: This AFIP teaching review correlates imaging and pathology in testicular tumors and tumor-like lesions. Germ cell tumors account for about 95% of testicular tumors and show varied imaging appearances: seminomas are typically well-defined and homogeneous, while nonseminomatous types such as embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, teratoma, and mixed germ cell tumor appear more heterogeneous. The review describes lymphatic spread to retroperitoneal nodes and hematogenous spread of choriocarcinoma. It also covers benign mimics, such as epidermoid cysts and dilated rete testis, that can avoid unnecessary orchiectomy.

title: CD30 and CD117 (c-kit) used in combination are useful for distinguishing embryonal carcinoma from seminoma.
title_ja: 胎児性癌とセミノーマの鑑別におけるCD30およびCD117（c-kit）の併用の有用性
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍において、セミノーマと胎児性癌の鑑別にCD30とCD117の免疫染色を併用する有用性を検討した。セミノーマの多くはCD117陽性・CD30陰性、胎児性癌の多くはCD30陽性・CD117陰性であった。両者の併用は高い識別能を示した。
summary_en: This study evaluates CD30 and CD117 (c-kit) immunohistochemistry, alone and in combination, to distinguish embryonal carcinoma from seminoma in testicular germ cell tumors. The authors examined 25 pure seminomas, 7 pure embryonal carcinomas, and 7 mixed tumors. Most seminomas were CD117-positive and CD30-negative, while most embryonal carcinomas were CD30-positive and CD117-negative. The combined panel was highly discriminating, and the authors propose it as a valuable differential diagnostic tool.

title: Dermoid cyst (mature cystic teratoma) of the cecum. Histologic and cytologic features with review of the literature.
title_ja: 盲腸の類皮嚢腫（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）：組織学的・細胞学的特徴と文献的考察
summary_ja: 30歳男性の盲腸に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）を報告した。細針吸引細胞診で角化物質と無核扁平上皮細胞を認め、右結腸切除術後の組織で診断を確定した。消化管発生の奇形腫は稀であり、結腸周囲嚢胞性病変の鑑別診断を論じている。
summary_en: This report describes a mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) of the cecum in a 30-year-old man who presented with right upper quadrant abdominal pain and a palpable mass. Fine-needle aspiration showed keratinous material and anucleated squamous cells, and histology after right colectomy confirmed a cystic lesion lined by squamous epithelium with sebaceous glands. The authors note that only four prior cecal teratomas had been reported in English literature. They review the clinical, cytologic, and pathologic features and discuss the differential diagnosis of pericolic cystic masses.

title: The status of high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic stem cell transplantation in germ cell tumor patients.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者における造血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法の現状
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する大量化学療法と造血幹細胞移植の現状をレビューした。予後不良例の一次治療や、良好な予後の症例の救援療法として、高い完全寛解率と長期無病生存が報告されている。ただし無作為化試験による検証が必要であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This review summarizes the status of high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic stem cell transplantation for germ cell tumor patients. Prognostic factors identify patients who may benefit from dose-intensive therapy. High-dose chemotherapy as first-line treatment for poor-risk disease, based on IGCCCG classification, and as salvage therapy for good-risk disease, based on the Beyer prognostic index, is associated with high complete response rates and long-term disease-free survival. The authors note that randomized trials are needed to confirm these findings, and that refractory patients require new strategies.

title: Chemotherapy for trophoblastic disease: current standards.
title_ja: 絨毛性疾患に対する化学療法：現在の標準
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対する化学療法の現在の標準をレビューした。大多数は吸引掻爬術とhCG監視で治癒するが、一部は化学療法を要する。転移例でも多くは治癒し、予後因子に基づく治療層別化により長期的な治療合併症の軽減が期待される。
summary_en: This review covers chemotherapy standards for gestational trophoblastic disease, which ranges from benign complete and partial hydatidiform moles to malignant choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumors. Most patients are cured by suction curettage followed by hCG monitoring, but some require chemotherapy. The authors note that most patients are cured even with metastatic disease. Treatment should be stratified by prognostic factors to eliminate disease while minimizing long-term treatment toxicity.

title: Alterations of the fragile histidine triad gene, FHIT, and its encoded products contribute to testicular germ cell tumorigenesis.
title_ja: FHIT遺伝子およびそのコードするタンパク質の変化が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関与する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍62例で3p染色体領域の対立遺伝子不均衡と染色体3のコピー数を解析し、FHIT遺伝子およびタンパク質の発現を検討した。FHIT転写産物の異常は41%、Fhitタンパク質の発現低下は62%で認められ、奇形腫の非上皮成分で発現低下が特に強かった。FHIT異常が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study analyzed 62 primary testicular germ cell tumors for allelic imbalance at 3p loci and FHIT copy number, and examined FHIT mRNA and protein expression. FHIT transcripts lacking exon 3 were found in 41% of analyzed tumors, and reduced Fhit protein in 62%. Reduced expression was strongest in nonepithelial components of teratomas and showed a non-significant trend toward association with metastasis at diagnosis. The findings suggest FHIT alterations may contribute to testicular germ cell tumorigenesis.

title: Selective Differential Display of RNAs containing interspersed repeats: analysis of changes in the transcription of HERV-K LTRs in germ cell tumors.
title_ja: インターセッパーズリピートを含むRNAの選択的差次的ディスプレイ：胚細胞腫瘍におけるHERV-K LTR転写変化の解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: インターセッパーズリピートを含むRNAを選択的に増幅し並列表示するSDDIR法を開発した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍と正常精巣組織を比較し、HERV-K由来LTR配列を含む転写産物を解析した。多数のLTR転写産物が検出され、その多くは腫瘍と正常組織で発現量が異なっていた。胚細胞腫瘍ではHERV-K LTRの転写パターンが変化していることが示唆された。
summary_en: The authors developed Selective Differential Display of RNAs containing Interspersed Repeats (SDDIR), a method that selectively amplifies RT-PCR products from transcripts carrying a given repeat type and displays them side by side on gels. They applied it to HERV-K LTR-containing transcripts in testicular germ cell tumors versus matched normal testis. Many LTR transcripts were detected, and the levels of numerous transcripts differed between tumor and normal tissue, suggesting altered HERV-K LTR transcription in germ cell tumors.

title: Necrotic seminoma of the testis: establishing the diagnosis with Masson trichrome stain and immunostains.
title_ja: 壊死性精巣セミノーマ：Masson trichrome染色と免疫染色による診断
summary_ja: ゴースト様の腫瘍細胞を含む、壊死が広範な精巣腫瘤を報告した。Masson trichrome染色により核や細胞の詳細が明瞭となり、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼの膜陽性所見からセミノーマと確定診断された。壊死性腫瘍の診断に有用な手法として提案されている。
summary_en: This report describes a necrotic testicular mass with ghost-like neoplastic cells, initially suspicious for neoplasm. Masson trichrome staining improved nuclear and cytologic detail, supporting the diagnosis. Placental alkaline phosphatase immunostaining showed specific membrane staining, establishing the diagnosis of seminoma. The authors propose that Masson trichrome combined with selected immunostains is a useful approach for diagnosing certain necrotic neoplasms.

title: Dermoid cyst of the infratemporal fossa.
title_ja: 側頭下窩の類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 17歳女性の急速に増大する顔面腫脹の原因となった、側頭下窩の類皮嚢腫の症例を報告した。類皮嚢腫は最も単純な奇形腫であり、頭頸部の約7%に発生するとされる。Medlineによる検索では同部位の類似報告はなかった。外側アプローチにより完全摘出された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with a rapidly growing facial swelling caused by a dermoid cyst in the infratemporal fossa. The authors note dermoid cysts represent the simplest form of teratoma and occur in about 7% of head and neck cases. A Medline review found no prior reports of similar infratemporal fossa lesions. The lesion was completely excised through a lateral approach.

title: Management of the postpubertal patient with cryptorchidism: an updated analysis.
title_ja: 思春期後の停留精巣患者の管理：最新の解析
summary_ja: 思春期後の停留精巣では胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高いため、精巣摘除術の適応が議論されてきました。本研究は最新の米国データを用いて、胚細胞腫瘍による死亡リスクと周術期死亡率を比較しました。周術期死亡率の低下が大きいことから、健康な男性では50歳までの精巣摘除術を推奨しています。
summary_en: This analysis revisits the management of postpubertal cryptorchidism, in which the testis carries a markedly elevated germ cell tumor risk. Using contemporary US mortality data and a relative risk of 9.7, the authors estimated lifetime germ cell cancer death risk and compared it with perioperative orchiectomy mortality by ASA class. Because perioperative mortality has fallen more than germ cell cancer mortality, orchiectomy now carries less risk than previously estimated. The authors therefore advocate orchiectomy in healthy males with postpubertal cryptorchidism until age 50 years, rather than observation after age 32.

title: Detection of beta-human chorionic gonadotropin expressing cells by nested reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction in the peripheral blood stem cells of patients with advanced germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍患者の末梢血幹細胞におけるβ-hCG発現細胞のネステッドRT-PCRによる検出
summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の13例で、末梢血幹細胞移植に用いる採取物に腫瘍細胞が混入しているかをネステッドRT-PCRで調べました。β-hCG mRNAが7例で検出され、いずれも治療前の血清β-hCG値が高値でした。混入があった患者は予後が不良であり、移植用細胞の純度が転帰に影響する可能性が示されました。
summary_en: This study tested whether peripheral blood stem cells (PBSCs) collected from patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumors were contaminated with tumor cells. Using nested RT-PCR for beta-hCG and AFP transcripts in 13 patients undergoing PBSC transplantation, the authors detected beta-hCG mRNA in 7 patients but AFP mRNA in none. All patients with detectable beta-hCG mRNA had elevated pretreatment serum beta-hCG levels. Four of these 7 patients eventually died of cancer, whereas patients without contamination survived without disease. Tumor cell contamination was associated with poor prognosis, suggesting that graft purity may influence outcome.

title: Choriocarcinoma in the pulmonary artery treated with emergency pulmonary embolectomy.
title_ja: 肺動脈内絨毛癌に対する緊急肺動脈塞栓摘除術
summary_ja: 42歳女性の絨毛癌症例で、肺動脈塞栓に対して心肺バイパス下での緊急肺動脈塞栓摘除術が行われました。摘出された腫瘍塞栓の検体で絨毛癌と確定し、6か月の化学療法で完全寛解に至りました。まれではあるが、妊孕年齢の女性の肺塞栓では絨毛癌を鑑別診断に含めるべきと述べています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma who presented with pulmonary embolism requiring emergency pulmonary embolectomy under cardiopulmonary bypass. Examination of the tumor emboli specimens confirmed choriocarcinoma. She achieved complete remission with chemotherapy over six months. The authors highlight that choriocarcinoma, although rare, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of fertile women presenting with pulmonary embolism.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) in mother and child: first report of PSTT in infancy.
title_ja: 母子における胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）：乳児期における初の報告
summary_ja: 母親と生後4か月の息子に転移性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）が発生した症例で、乳児期のPSTTの初報告です。息子は急速に進行し、多臓器に転移した後、入院後5週間で多臓器不全により死亡しました。母親は化学療法と子宮摘出術で治療され、26か月後も病変は認められていません。
summary_en: This report describes metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) in a mother and her 4-month-old son, the first reported PSTT in infancy. The infant's disease was aggressive, with widespread metastases to liver, lungs, pleura, kidney, mesentery, and lymph nodes, and he died of multiorgan failure within five weeks of admission. The mother had a uterine tumor and lung metastases, and was treated with chemotherapy and hysterectomy, with no evidence of disease at 26 months. The authors conclude that PSTT can metastasize in both mother and child.

title: Cytopathology-histopathology of the mediastinum: epithelial, lymphoproliferative, and germ cell neoplasms.
title_ja: 縦隔の細胞診・組織診：上皮性、リンパ性、胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 縦隔の上皮性、リンパ性、胚細胞腫瘍の細胞診所見を組織所見と対比して解説している。縦隔の穿刺吸引細胞診は甲状腺や乳腺に比べ普及が遅れており、文献が乏しい。胚細胞腫瘍は主要な3群の一つとして扱われている。
summary_en: This review focuses on the cytopathologic features of mediastinal neoplasms, including epithelial, lymphoid, and germ cell tumors. Mediastinal fine-needle aspiration cytology has seen limited adoption compared with thyroid or breast sampling, so the literature is sparse. The authors correlate cytomorphology with corresponding histologic features across tumor categories, with germ cell tumors as one of three main groups. Thymoma is noted as a controversial entity. The paper is relevant as it addresses mediastinal germ cell neoplasms among other types.

title: Bone marrow involvement in a primary mediastinal extragonadal non-seminomatous germ cell tumour.
title_ja: 縦隔原発性性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における骨髄浸潤
journal: Indian J Chest Dis Allied Sci
summary_ja: 縦隔原発の性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で骨髄浸潤を認めた症例報告である。骨髄浸潤はまれな所見であり、文献レビューも併せて行われている。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の転移形式の理解に資する。抄録には治療や転帰の詳細は示されていない。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a primary mediastinal extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor showing bone marrow involvement, a rare finding. The authors review the literature on this presentation. Bone marrow spread in mediastinal germ cell tumors is uncommon, and the report adds to limited data on metastatic patterns of extragonadal disease. The abstract provides limited clinical detail, and no treatment or outcome data are summarized.

title: Comprehensive cytogenetic evaluation of a mature ovarian teratoma case.
title_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫症例の包括的細胞遺伝学的評価
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫の染色体解析を行った症例報告である。モノソミーやトリソミー、複数領域の欠失がクローン性に認められた。比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションでは正常プロファイルであった。卵巣奇形腫の染色体異常に関する文献と比較し考察している。
summary_en: This case report presents cytogenetic analysis of a mature ovarian teratoma, a benign ovarian germ cell tumor typically with normal karyotype. The tumor showed clonal chromosomal alterations including monosomies of chromosomes 6, 14, 16, and 21, trisomies of 14 and 21, and deletions of Xq, 5p, 16p, and 17p. Comparative genomic hybridization revealed a normal profile. The authors discuss these findings alongside prior reports of ovarian teratoma karyotypes. Recurrent abnormalities have not been identified in this tumor type, limiting genetic understanding.

title: VASA is a specific marker for both normal and malignant human germ cells.
title_ja: VASAは正常および悪性ヒト胚細胞の特異的マーカーである
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胚細胞特異的遺伝子VASAのmRNAとタンパクを、セミノーマやディスジャーミノーマ、前駆病変で検出した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では発現が認められなかった。古典型・精母細胞性セミノーマおよびディスジャーミノーマの特異的マーカーとなる可能性がある。
summary_en: This study shows that VASA, a germ-cell-specific gene, is detectable by RT-PCR and immunohistochemistry in seminomas, dysgerminomas, carcinoma in situ, and gonadoblastoma. Staining was weaker in invasive seminoma and dysgerminoma than in precursor lesions. Nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, including embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, and yolk sac tumor, lacked VASA expression, as did nongerm cell tumors. The authors propose VASA as a specific biomarker for classic and spermatocytic seminoma/dysgerminoma and their precursors, and suggest some tumors lose germ cell identity.

title: Germ cell tumours of the testis: clinical features, treatment outcome and prognostic factors.
title_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍：臨床的特徴、治療成績および予後因子
summary_ja: 1993〜1999年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性71例を後方視的に解析した研究。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が75%を占めた。予後良好群の完全奏効率は高く、2年全生存率は70%、無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は57%であった。35歳超、予後不良因子、縦隔原発が予後不良因子であった。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 71 men with germ cell tumours of the testis, treated between 1993 and 1999, reviewed clinical features, staging, and outcomes. Most primaries were testicular, and 75% were non-seminomatous. Patients were stratified into good, intermediate, and poor prognostic groups. Complete response was highest in good-risk patients. At median follow-up of 26 months, 2-year overall and progression-free survival were 70% and 57%. Age over 35, poor-risk features, and mediastinal primaries predicted worse survival. A bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin regimen was effective.

title: Clinical characteristics and treatment of gestational trophoblastic tumor with vaginal metastasis.
title_ja: 膣転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の臨床的特徴と治療
summary_ja: 1985〜2000年に膣転移を認めた妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の女性51例を後方視的に検討した研究。絨毛癌の8.6%、侵入奇胎の4.1%に膣転移がみられた。大きいまたは多発する転移では出血リスクが高く、5-FU併用化学療法が有効であった。出血に対しては膣パッキングや血管塞栓術が用いられた。完全寛解の44例では再発は認められなかった。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 51 women with gestational trophoblastic tumours and vaginal metastases (1985–2000) examined presentation, management, and outcome. Vaginal metastases occurred in 8.6% of choriocarcinomas and 4.1% of invasive moles. Eighteen patients bled or ruptured. All received 5-FU combination chemotherapy, with vaginal packing and angiographic embolization used for haemorrhage control. Vaginal tumours regressed after chemotherapy, and the 44 patients in complete remission had no recurrence on follow-up.

title: Tumor chemoconversion following surgery, chemotherapy, and normalization of serum tumor markers in a woman with a mixed type germ cell ovarian tumor.
title_ja: 混合型卵巣胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法による腫瘍の良性化(ケモコンバージョン)の症例
summary_ja: ディスジャーミノーマ成分と内胚葉成分を含む病期分類IIIC期の混合性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の若年女性の症例報告。保存的手術と化学療法後、腫瘍マーカーは正常化したが、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で残存腫瘤が認められた。切除された残存組織は良性であり、良性腫瘤への退縮と考えられた。腫瘍マーカーが正常でも腫瘤が残る場合は、化学療法より組織診断を考慮すべきと結論された。
summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with stage IIIC mixed germ cell ovarian tumour containing endodermal and dysgerminoma elements. After conservative surgery and chemotherapy, serum tumour markers normalised, but residual tumour persisted on CT. Resected residual tissue was benign, suggesting retroconversion to a benign mass. The authors conclude that when masses persist despite normal markers, histological diagnosis rather than further chemotherapy should be considered.

title: Thermocoagulation of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫の熱凝固術
summary_ja: 妊娠13週で発見された胎児仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。5週間で100倍以上に増大し、羊水過多や心臓・胎盤の肥大を来した。妊娠18週に腫瘍への栄養血管を熱凝固術で閉塞し、血流低下は得られたが、2日後に胎児死亡が確認された。単回の凝固範囲を制限し、必要時に後日再施行する方がより安全かもしれないと考察された。
summary_en: This report describes a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma detected at 13 weeks that grew more than 100-fold over five weeks, causing polyhydramnios and cardiac and placental enlargement. Thermocoagulation of the feeding vessels was performed at 18 weeks to reduce tumour blood supply. Blood flow was successfully reduced, but fetal death was diagnosed two days later. The authors suggest that limiting the extent of coagulation in one session and repeating it later may be safer.

title: Congenital mediastinal immature teratoma: a case report with autopsy findings.
title_ja: 先天性縦隔未熟奇形腫の剖検所見を伴う症例報告
summary_ja: 胎児期の超音波検査で縦隔腫瘤が指摘された、46,XXの新生児の先天性縦隔未熟奇形腫の症例報告です。帝王切開後に緊急手術が行われましたが、呼吸不全のため同日に死亡しました。剖検で未熟奇形腫と確定診断されました。早期診断と、肺の成熟が十分な時点での手術により長期生存が得られる可能性があると述べています。
summary_en: This case report describes a full-term newborn girl with a congenital mediastinal immature teratoma, detected by prenatal ultrasonography at 34 weeks gestation. The fetus showed a large mixed solid and multicystic mediastinal mass, pulmonary hypoplasia, and polyhydramnios. After cesarean delivery, emergency surgery was performed, but the infant died the same day from respiratory failure. Autopsy confirmed a mass containing mature and primitive mesenchymal components and immature neuroepithelium, establishing the diagnosis. The authors emphasize that early diagnosis and surgery after adequate lung maturation may allow long survival in these rare, life-threatening tumors.

title: Extragonadal retroperitoneal germ cell tumor: evidence of origin in the testis.
title_ja: 性腺外後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍：起源が精巣であることの証拠
summary_ja: 原発性とされた性腺外後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の患者26例を後方視的に検討した研究です。精巣の超音波検査と組織学的検討を行ったところ、全例に病的所見があり、生存腫瘍、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍、瘢痕などが認められました。著者らは、原発性後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀か存在しない可能性があり、証明されるまでは精巣がんの転移とみなすべきだと結論づけています。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 26 patients initially diagnosed with primary extragonadal retroperitoneal germ cell tumors examined the testes with ultrasonography and histology. Testes were atrophic or indurated in 54 percent of patients, and ultrasound showed abnormalities in all patients examined. Histology revealed viable tumor in three patients, intratubular germ cell neoplasia in four, and scar or sclerosis in most others. The authors conclude that so-called primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumors are very likely rare or nonexistent, and should be regarded as testicular metastases until proven otherwise.

title: Current understandings of the molecular genetics of gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の分子遺伝学の現状
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患の分子遺伝学をレビューした論文です。胞状奇胎は父性ゲノムが全部または過剰に寄与しており、ゲノムインプリンティングが発症に重要と考えられています。悪性転化の多段階過程や、癌遺伝子・腫瘍抑制遺伝子の異常、テロメラーゼ活性、マトリックスメタロプロテアーゼの発現異常などが紹介されています。
summary_en: This review examines the molecular genetics of gestational trophoblastic disease, a heterogeneous group that includes partial and complete hydatidiform moles, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Cytogenetic studies show that moles carry exclusive or excess paternal genomic contribution, and genomic imprinting is thought to play a central role in their pathogenesis. The authors describe the multistep process of malignant transformation in gestational trophoblastic tumors, involving oncogene activation, tumor suppressor gene inactivation, telomerase expression, altered cell adhesion molecules, and matrix metalloproteinase dysregulation. These alterations disrupt proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis, and invasion.

title: Burned-out tumor of the testis presenting as supraclavicular lymphadenopathy.
title_ja: 鎖骨上窩リンパ節腫脹として発現した精巣の焼け残り腫瘍
summary_ja: 精巣の焼け残り腫瘍（burned-out tumor）が、鎖骨上窩と後腹膜のリンパ節転移として発見された症例報告です。精巣は触診で異常を示しませんでした。退縮した腫瘍は触知されないことが多いため、性腺外転移を有する患者では陰嚢超音波検査が重要であると強調しています。画像所見の報告は少ないため、その点でも有用な報告です。
summary_en: This case report describes a burned-out testicular tumor presenting with supraclavicular and retroperitoneal lymph node metastases, despite the testis being nonpalpable. The authors note that such regressed tumors are often not detected on clinical examination and that imaging findings of burned-out tumors are poorly documented in the radiology literature. They emphasize that scrotal sonography is crucial for detecting regressed testicular tumors in patients with extragonadal metastasis from a testicular primary. The report is useful for recognizing testicular germ cell tumor in patients presenting with metastatic disease of unclear origin.

title: Early prediction of treatment response to high-dose salvage chemotherapy in patients with relapsed germ cell cancer using [(18)F]FDG PET.
title_ja: 再発胚細胞腫瘍における救援大量化学療法への反応の早期予測：[(18)F]FDG PETによる検討
summary_ja: 再発した転移性胚細胞腫瘍の23例で、導入化学療法後に[18F]FDG PETを行い、大量化学療法の効果を予測できるか検討しました。PETは画像検査や腫瘍マーカーより治療失敗の予測に優れ、感度100%、特異度78%でした。陽性PETが治療失敗を全例で捉え、陰性PETは良好な予後を予測しました。早期PETは予後モデルの改良にも役立つと結論づけています。
summary_en: This analysis of 23 patients with relapsed metastatic germ cell tumors evaluated whether [18F]FDG PET performed after two to three cycles of induction chemotherapy predicts response to high-dose salvage chemotherapy. PET was compared with CT/MRI, serum tumor markers, a prognostic score, and histopathology. A positive PET before high-dose chemotherapy identified all treatment failures, with sensitivity of 100 percent and specificity of 78 percent, outperforming CT-based monitoring and tumor markers. A negative PET predicted favorable outcomes in good and intermediate risk groups. The authors conclude that early FDG-PET may identify patients most likely to benefit from high-dose chemotherapy and may refine prognostic models.

title: The rho/rho-kinase pathway is involved in the progression of testicular germ cell tumour.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進展におけるrho/rho-kinase経路の関与
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 日本人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍57例の手術標本で、RhoAとRho-kinaseのmRNA発現をRT-PCRで定量しました。両遺伝子は腫瘍組織で非腫瘍組織より高く、病期と相関しました。セミノーマと非セミノーマの混在腫瘍は、セミノーマのみより発現が高値でした。RhoA/Rho-kinase経路が進展に関与し、新たな治療標的になりうると結論づけています。
summary_en: This study quantified RhoA and Rho-kinase mRNA expression by RT-PCR in surgical specimens from 57 Japanese patients with testicular germ cell tumors, comparing tumor tissue with matched non-tumor tissue. Both transcripts were significantly higher in tumors and correlated with tumor stage. Mixed tumors containing seminoma and nonseminoma components showed higher expression than pure seminoma tumors. Expression levels of the two genes were positively correlated within tumors. The authors suggest that the RhoA/Rho-kinase pathway contributes to progression of testicular germ cell tumors and may represent a molecular target for new therapeutic strategies.

title: Cisplatin-induced in vivo differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma.
title_ja: シスプラチンによるヒト胎児性癌の生体内分化誘導
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植したヒト精巣胎児性癌株TTSC-3を用い、シスプラチンが生体内で胎児性癌を分化させる機序を検討しました。中等量投与では腫瘍は休眠状態となり、軟骨や腺管を伴う奇形腫様の組織へと分化し、15週後には胎児性癌細胞は消失しました。アポトーシス関連遺伝子の発現増加も認められ、生体内での分化誘導に関与すると結論づけています。
summary_en: This study examined how cisplatin induces differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma in vivo, using the TTSC-3 testicular embryonal carcinoma line heterotransplanted into nude mice. A low dose had little effect, while an intermediate dose induced tumor dormancy and later differentiation into cartilage and glandular structures consistent with teratoma, with no EC cells visible after 15 weeks. A high dose caused marked tumor regression. cDNA array analysis showed increased expression of apoptosis-related genes, including tumor necrosis factor receptor 1, caspase 8, and Apaf1. The authors conclude that cisplatin contributes to in vivo differentiation of embryonal carcinoma by enhancing apoptosis-related gene expression.

title: Decreased telomerase activity is not a reliable indicator of chemosensitivity in testicular cancer cell lines.
title_ja: 精巣がん細胞株においてテロメラーゼ活性の低下は化学療法感受性の信頼できる指標ではない
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣がん細胞株2種（Susa CPと833K）に、シスプラチン、メルファラン、ドキソルビシンを4時間曝露し、テロメラーゼ活性と化学療法感受性の関係を検討しました。テロメラーゼ活性の低下は高濃度の一部薬剤でのみ認められました。一方、アポトーシスの頻度は3剤でほぼ同等でした。テロメラーゼ活性は精巣がん細胞の化学療法感受性を示す信頼できる指標ではないと結論づけています。
summary_en: This study tested whether telomerase activity reflects chemosensitivity in two testicular cancer cell lines, Susa CP and 833 K, after 4-hour exposure to cisplatin, melphalan, or doxorubicin. Telomerase activity decreased only after very high concentrations (100 times IC50) of cisplatin or melphalan, and not after doxorubicin. Apoptosis rates were similar across all three drugs despite differing effects on telomerase. Neither direct drug-enzyme interaction nor changes in hTR or hTERT mRNA explained the telomerase loss. The authors conclude that telomerase activity is not a reliable indicator of chemosensitivity in testicular cancer cells.

title: Expressions of p53, proliferating cell nuclear antigen, and Ki-67 in gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるp53、PCNA、Ki-67の発現
summary_ja: 本研究は、p53、PCNA、Ki-67の免疫組織化学的発現が、水腫性変化を伴う自然流産と妊娠性絨毛性疾患を鑑別できるかを検討した。対象は部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、侵入胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、妊娠初期の水腫性流産である。3つのマーカーはいずれも妊娠性絨毛性疾患で有意に高値だった。一方、疾患のサブグループ間を信頼性をもって区別することはできなかった。3マーカーの併用が両者の鑑別に有用である可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study tested whether immunohistochemical expression of p53, PCNA, and Ki-67 can distinguish gestational trophoblastic disease from spontaneous abortion with hydropic changes. Specimens included partial and complete hydatidiform moles, invasive moles, choriocarcinomas, and first-trimester hydropic abortions. All three markers were significantly higher in gestational trophoblastic disease than in hydropic abortion. However, none reliably discriminated among the GTD subgroups. The authors conclude that the three markers used together may help separate these entities.

title: Prenatal diagnosis of sacrococcygeal teratomas by two- and three-dimensional ultrasound.
title_ja: 二次元および三次元超音波検査による仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断
summary_ja: 本報告は、妊娠18週および22週の二次元超音波検査で仙尾部奇形腫が疑われた胎児2例を扱ったものである。診断の確定には三次元多断面表面および三次元直交平面超音波検査を用いた。三次元超音波では仙骨や骨盤内構造への浸潤範囲をより明確に評価でき、これは予後判定に重要である。従来の二次元検査に比べ、仙尾部奇形腫の出生前評価における三次元超音波の有用性が示された。
summary_en: This report describes two fetuses suspected of having sacrococcygeal teratoma on two-dimensional ultrasound at 18 and 22 weeks of gestation. Three-dimensional multiplanar surface and orthogonal planar ultrasound were then used to confirm the diagnosis. Three-dimensional imaging better defined the extent of involvement of the sacrum and other pelvic structures, which is prognostically important. The study demonstrates the added value of three-dimensional ultrasound for prenatal assessment of sacrococcygeal teratomas beyond conventional two-dimensional scanning.

title: Orbital teratoma: late presentation with normal vision.
title_ja: 眼窩奇形腫：視力正常で遅れて受診した症例
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、18か月の小児が視力正常で間欠性上斜視を伴う下眼窩部の腫瘤として受診した眼窩奇形腫を扱ったものである。CTで眼窩下裂に接する、歯を含む嚢胞性腫瘤が確認された。組織学的に三胚葉由来の組織がみられた。腫瘍は視力を温存して切除され、斜視も改善した。眼窩奇形腫は通常、先天性眼球突出で発症し視力予後が不良であるため、良好な視力を保った遅発性の受診は極めてまれである。
summary_en: This case report describes an 18-month-old child with an orbital teratoma presenting as an inferior orbital mass with normal vision and intermittent hypertropia. CT showed a cystic mass containing a tooth beside the inferior orbital fissure. Histology demonstrated tissues from all three germ cell layers. The tumor was excised with preservation of vision and resolution of the strabismus. The authors note that orbital teratomas typically present with congenital proptosis and poor visual outcomes, so late presentation with good visual preservation is exceptional.

title: Resection of residual pulmonary masses after chemotherapy in patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における化学療法後の残存肺病変の切除
summary_ja: 本研究は、1976年から1999年の間に、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の肺残存腫瘍の切除を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者を単施設で検討したものである。15例に計19回の開胸術が行われ、病理では壊死、成熟奇形腫、生存腫瘍がみられた。長期完全奏効率は80%で、追跡期間の中央値は10年であった。残存肺病変に対する開胸術は良好に忍容され、高い治癒率が得られると結論づけられている。
summary_en: This single-institution review examined patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent resection of residual pulmonary masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy between 1976 and 1999. Nineteen thoracotomies were performed in 15 patients, and pathology showed necrosis, mature teratoma, or viable tumour. Among patients with viable tumour, outcomes varied, while teratoma cases achieved better results. The long-term complete response rate was 80%, with a median follow-up of 10 years. The authors conclude that thoracotomy for residual lung masses is well tolerated and associated with high cure rates.

title: Long-term renal function after treatment for malignant germ-cell tumours.
title_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍治療後の長期腎機能
summary_ja: 本研究は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、放射線療法、またはシスプラチン併用化学療法で治療された悪性胚細胞腫瘍の患者85例について、治療後の腎機能を前向きに評価したものである。治療前と最長14年の追跡期間中に糸球体濾過率を測定した。25例で長期の腎機能障害がみられ、その多くは放射線療法または化学療法群であった。累積シスプラチン投与量や治療時の年齢が腎機能低下と関連していた。患者の20〜30%に臨床症状のない腎障害が生じ、過剰治療の回避を支持する結果であった。
summary_en: This prospective study assessed long-term renal function in 85 patients treated for malignant germ-cell tumours with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, radiotherapy, or cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Glomerular filtration was measured before treatment and up to 14 years of follow-up. Twenty-five patients had long-term impaired renal function, most from the radiotherapy or chemotherapy groups. Cumulative cisplatin dose and age at radiotherapy were associated with decline. The authors estimate that 20 to 30 percent of patients develop subclinical renal impairment, supporting efforts to avoid overtreatment.

title: Routine computerised tomographic scans of the thorax in surveillance of stage I testicular non-seminomatous germ-cell cancer--a necessary risk?
title_ja: 病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のサーベイランスにおける胸部コンピュータ断層撮影の日常的施行：必要なリスクか
summary_ja: 英国の病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のサーベイランス患者168例を後方視的に検討し、胸部X線フォローアップと日常的な胸部CTを比較した。孤立性の胸腔内再発はわずか1例(2.4%)で、再発の大半は予後良好な転移性疾患であった。胸部CTを省略しても予後は損なわれず、放射線被曝と二次悪性腫瘍のリスクを低減できることが示された。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 168 patients with stage I testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumours (NSGCT) under surveillance compared chest X-ray follow-up with routine thoracic CT. Of 42 patients who relapsed, only one (2.4%) had isolated intrathoracic relapse without another indicator of recurrence, and nearly all relapses were good-prognosis metastatic disease. Omitting chest CT did not compromise outcome, while radiation exposure and the risk of radiation-induced secondary malignancy were significantly reduced. The authors conclude that routine thoracic CT may not be necessary in this surveillance programme.

title: Rhabdomyosarcoma arising in mediastinal teratoma in an adult man: a case report.
title_ja: 成人男性の縦隔奇形腫に生じた横紋筋肉腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 44歳男性の縦隔奇形腫に横紋筋肉腫が合併した症例報告である。生検で胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分が確認され、化学療法後の切除標本では成熟奇形腫と胎児性横紋筋肉腫が認められた。局所進展、多発転移、骨髄浸潤を来し、診断8か月後に死亡した。成人での発生は稀であり、診断・治療・予後上の意義を文献とともに考察している。
summary_en: A 44-year-old man presented with chest pain, hoarseness and cough due to a mediastinal teratoma. Biopsy showed embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumour components with an associated rhabdomyosarcoma. After BEP chemotherapy, surgical resection revealed mature teratoma with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma. The disease progressed with local extension, multiple metastases and bone marrow involvement, and the patient died eight months after diagnosis despite chemotherapy and radiotherapy. The authors review the literature, note that rhabdomyosarcoma arising in primary mediastinal teratoma is unusual in adults, and discuss its diagnostic, therapeutic and prognostic implications.

title: Use of urine pregnancy test for rapid diagnosis of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in a man.
title_ja: 男性の原発性肺絨毛癌の迅速診断における尿妊娠検査の利用
summary_ja: 23歳男性が喀血と進行性の呼吸困難で受診し、胸部X線で多発肺結節を認めた。尿妊娠検査が陽性で、血清と尿のβ-hCGが著明に高値であった。気管支鏡下生検で絨毛癌と確定した。男性の原発性肺絨毛癌は稀で肺癌と誤診されやすく、簡便な尿妊娠検査が迅速診断に有用であると報告している。
summary_en: A 23-year-old man presented with hemoptysis and progressive dyspnoea. Chest radiography showed airspace consolidation with multiple nodules, and a urine pregnancy test was positive. Serum and urine beta-hCG were markedly elevated. Bronchoscopic biopsy confirmed choriocarcinoma, establishing a diagnosis of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma. Because this tumour is extremely rare in men and is often mistaken for primary or metastatic lung cancer, potentially curable chemotherapy or surgery may be withheld. The authors conclude that the simple urine pregnancy test can be a useful tool for rapid diagnosis in such cases.

title: Metastatic testicular seminoma--a case report.
title_ja: 転移性精巣セミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対し2年前に精巣摘除と放射線療法を受けた42歳男性が、左鎖骨上窩の腫脹と発熱で来院した。CTで傍喉頭部に6cmの腫瘤を認め、当初は感染性病変が疑われた。超音波ガイド下穿刺吸引細胞診で転移性セミノーマと確定し、唯一の転移部位であった。化学療法で良好な反応が得られた。頸部腫瘤の鑑別の多様性を示す症例である。
summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with a tender left supraclavicular swelling and fever, two years after orchidectomy and abdominal radiotherapy for testicular seminoma. CT showed a 6 cm para-laryngeal mass with adjacent inflammation, initially suggesting an infective process. Ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration confirmed metastatic seminoma, which was the only metastatic site. The patient began chemotherapy and responded well. The authors review the pathology of testicular seminoma and emphasise that a neck lump may have many causes.

title: Role of P53 and MDM2 in treatment response of human germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の治療反応におけるP53およびMDM2の役割
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学感受性・抵抗性におけるP53とMDM2の役割を検討した。未治療の原発腫瘍39例の解析で、P53は多くの症例で低発現または陰性であり、治療反応性との明確な関連は認められなかった。胎児性癌は全例でMDM2陽性で、MDM2増幅は稀であった。P53不活化はシスプラチン耐性の一般的な機序ではないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study examined P53 and MDM2 in testicular germ cell tumours (TGCTs) to clarify their role in chemosensitivity and resistance. Immunohistochemistry and Western blotting of 39 untreated primary tumours showed low or absent P53 in most cases, and P53 levels did not distinguish treatment-responsive from non-responsive tumours. Mutation analysis found only one silent mutation. All embryonal carcinomas were uniformly MDM2-positive, and MDM2 amplification was rare. The authors conclude that high P53 does not directly determine treatment sensitivity, and P53 inactivation is not a common mechanism of cisplatin resistance.

title: Glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor induces proliferative inhibition of NT2/D1 cells through RET-mediated up-regulation of the cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor p27(kip1).
title_ja: GDNFはRET依存性のp27(kip1)上昇を介して胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1の増殖を抑制する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: GDNFはRETシグナルを介してp27(kip1)を増加させ、胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1の増殖を抑制するとともに未分化マーカーSSEA-3を減少させることを示した。RETの機能喪失変異体や恒常活性型変異体を用いた解析で、この作用はRETシグナルに依存することが確認された。アンチセンスによるp27の発現抑制は増殖抑制とSSEA-3低下の両方を阻害し、p27が主要な媒介因子であることを示した。
summary_en: This study examines how glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF) acts on the embryonal carcinoma cell line NT2/D1. GDNF stimulation inhibited proliferation and reduced expression of the undifferentiated marker SSEA-3. Using a kinase-deficient dominant-negative RET mutant and a constitutively active RET-MEN2A construct, the authors showed these effects depend on RET signaling. RET activation increased the cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor p27(kip1), and antisense knockdown of p27 prevented both growth inhibition and SSEA-3 loss, indicating that p27 mediates these effects.

title: Molecular basis of gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の分子基盤
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の分類と病態を整理した総説である。胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などを取り上げ、真の腫瘍と腫瘍化しうる異常胎盤を区別している。胞状奇胎の細胞遺伝学的研究が詳しくまとめられ、各病型の形態と臨床像も解説されている。
summary_en: This review summarizes the molecular basis of gestational trophoblastic disease, including complete and partial hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and placental site nodule. It notes that some lesions are true neoplasms while others are abnormal placentas with neoplastic potential. Cytogenetic findings in hydatidiform moles are reviewed in detail, while the pathogenesis of other trophoblastic lesions remains poorly understood. The authors discuss molecular mechanisms of trophoblast function and summarize the morphology and clinical behavior of each entity.

title: Intratubular embryonal carcinoma.
title_ja: 精細管内胎児性癌
summary_ja: 浸潤性胎児性癌の前駆病変とされる精細管内胎児性癌の2症例を報告している。1例は浸潤成分を伴わず精巣内に限局し、対側精巣には悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の切除歴があった。免疫染色ではCD30、AE1/AE3、p53などが陽性で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は陰性であった。精細管内病変が浸潤性胎児性癌の前駆病変であるという見解を強く支持する所見である。
summary_en: This report describes two cases of intratubular embryonal carcinoma, a precursor lesion of invasive embryonal carcinoma. One case showed only an intratubular lesion in a testis, while the contralateral testis had earlier had a malignant mixed germ cell tumor excised. The second case had an intratubular lesion predominating adjacent to a malignant mixed germ cell tumor. Immunohistochemistry showed CD30, AE1/AE3, focal cytokeratin 7, and p53 positivity, with negativity for cytokeratin 20, p21, and alpha-fetoprotein. The findings support intratubular embryonal carcinoma as the precursor of invasive embryonal carcinoma.

title: Bilateral cryptorchidism with bilateral inguinal hernia and retrovesical mass in an infertile man: single-stage laparoscopic management.
title_ja: 両側停留精巣、両側鼠径ヘルニア、膀胱後部腫瘤を伴う不妊男性に対する単回腹腔鏡手術
journal: J Laparoendosc Adv Surg Tech A
summary_ja: 不妊を主訴とした30歳男性で、両側停留精巣、両側鼠径ヘルニア、膀胱後部の腫瘤を認めた。単回の腹腔鏡手術で右精巣固定術、左精巣摘除、両側ヘルニア修復、腫瘤摘出を行った。病理組織学的所見は性腺外胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマに合致した。出血はわずかで、術後24時間で退院した。
summary_en: A 30-year-old infertile man had nonpalpable bilateral testes, bilateral inguinal hernia, and a retrovesical mass seen on ultrasound and CT. Single-stage laparoscopy achieved right orchidopexy for a testis near the inguinal ring, left orchidectomy for a rudimentary testis, bilateral herniorrhaphy with mesh, and excision of the retrovesical mass. Histopathology showed an extragonadal germ cell tumor compatible with seminoma. The operation took 3.5 hours with minimal blood loss, and the patient was discharged after 24 hours.

title: Testicular sperm extraction in azoospermic patients with gonadal germ cell tumors prior to chemotherapy--a new therapy option.
title_ja: 化学療法前の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を伴う無精子症患者に対する精巣内精子採取術:新たな治療選択肢
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で無精子症の男性14例に対し、化学療法前に健側精巣から精子採取術(TESE)を行いました。14例中6例で単数体の胚細胞を回収し、治療遅延や創部の合併症はありませんでした。無精子症のがん患者に対する妊孕性温存の選択肢として提案しています。
summary_en: This study assessed testicular sperm extraction (TESE) from the contralateral healthy testis before chemotherapy in 14 azoospermic men with testicular germ cell tumors. Haploid germ cells were recovered in six of 14 patients, with maturation arrest in three and Sertoli-cell-only syndrome in the rest. No patient had wound complications or treatment delay. The authors propose TESE as a standard option for fertility preservation in azoospermic patients with cancer.

title: Coamplification of DAD-R, SOX5, and EKI1 in human testicular seminomas, with specific overexpression of DAD-R, correlates with reduced levels of apoptosis and earlier clinical manifestation.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおけるDAD-R、SOX5、EKI1の共増幅とDAD-Rの特異的過剰発現:アポトーシス低下および早期臨床発症との相関
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおける12p領域の増幅域内遺伝子(DAD-R、SOX5、EKI1)を解析しました。12p増幅を伴うセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍でDAD-Rが過剰発現し、アポトーシスの低下と早期発症に関連していました。DAD-Rは精巣胚細胞腫瘍における12p獲得の責任遺伝子候補と考えられます。
summary_en: This study examined DAD-R, SOX5, and EKI1 within the 12p amplicon in testicular seminomas. DAD-R was specifically overexpressed in seminomas with restricted 12p amplification and in nonseminomas, and these tumors showed lower apoptosis and earlier clinical presentation. DAD-R is proposed as a candidate gene contributing to the effects of 12p gain in testicular germ cell tumors, with regulatory differences between seminomas and nonseminomas.

title: Reduced expression of tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase (TIMP)-2 in gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるTIMP-2発現の低下
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の組織で、MMPとTIMPの発現を正常初期胎盤と比較しました。両病変でTIMP-2は著明に低下し、絨毛癌で特に顕著でした。MMP活性優位へのこの偏りが妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
summary_en: This study measured type IV collagenases (MMP-2, MMP-9) and their inhibitors (TIMP-1, TIMP-2) in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma tissues, compared with normal first-trimester placenta. MMP-2 and MMP-9 were increased and TIMP-1 was elevated, while TIMP-2 was markedly decreased in both lesions, most pronouncedly in choriocarcinoma. The authors suggest this shift toward matrix metalloproteinase activity may contribute to the pathogenesis of gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Dendritic cell infiltration in a patient with seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis: is there a relationship with infertility and tumor stage?
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者における樹状細胞浸潤:不妊および腫瘍病期との関連はあるか
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者30例の腫瘍組織で、樹状細胞とCD68陽性組織球の浸潤を免疫組織化学で評価しました。樹状細胞の浸潤は腫瘍径やリンパ節転移の有無と関連し、軽度の浸潤は良好な精子所見と相関しました。胚細胞腫瘍患者における不妊の機序として、精子に対する自己免疫の関与が示唆されています。
summary_en: This study examined dendritic cell (S-100) and CD68-positive histiocyte infiltration in 30 patients with seminoma who underwent orchiectomy, with sperm parameters assessed in 14. Light dendritic cell infiltration was associated with larger tumors, while strong infiltration was associated with negative lymph nodes. Slight dendritic cell infiltration correlated with better sperm counts and motility. Serum tumor markers showed no association. The authors propose sperm autoimmunity as a mechanism of infertility in germ cell tumor patients.

title: Phase II study of paclitaxel plus gemcitabine in refractory germ cell tumors (E9897): a trial of the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group.
title_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍に対するパクリタキセル+ゲムシタビン併用療法の第II相試験(E9897):東部癌研究グループ試験
summary_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍30例を対象に、パクリタキセルとゲムシタビンの併用療法の第II相試験を行いました。評価可能な28例中6例(21.4%)で奏効し、完全奏効例のうち2例はそれぞれ15か月以上、25か月以上無病で生存しています。毒性は主に血液毒性で管理可能でした。
summary_en: This phase II Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group trial evaluated paclitaxel plus gemcitabine in 30 patients with refractory germ cell tumors. Of 28 assessable patients, six responded, including three complete responses, and two complete responders remained disease-free for more than 15 and 25 months. Toxicity was mainly hematologic and manageable, with one case of neutropenic fever. The authors conclude the regimen is active with acceptable toxicity and possible long-term disease-free survival.

title: Extragonadal germ cell tumors of the mediastinum and retroperitoneum: results from an international analysis.
title_ja: 縦隔および後腹膜の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍:国際共同解析の結果
summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍635例の国際共同解析で、原発部位と組織型による予後を比較しました。セミノーマは縦隔・後腹膜のいずれでも全生存率が約88%でした。一方、縦隔原発の非セミノーマは5年時点の生存率が約45%で、後腹膜原発より不良でした。非セミノーマ組織型、肺以外の内臓転移、縦隔原発、β-hCG高値が独立した予後不良因子でした。
summary_en: This international analysis of 635 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors (EGCT) compared outcomes by primary site and histology. Seminomatous EGCT showed roughly 88% overall survival regardless of mediastinal or retroperitoneal location, whereas mediastinal nonseminomas had about 45% five-year survival, inferior to retroperitoneal nonseminomas. Nonseminomatous histology, nonpulmonary visceral metastases, mediastinal location, and elevated beta-hCG were independent adverse factors. Hematologic malignancies and metachronous testicular cancer also occurred.

title: Diagnostic value of 18F-FDG positron emission tomography for detection and treatment control of malignant germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍の検出および治療効果判定における18F-FDG陽電子放射断層撮影の診断的価値
summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍23例で、18F-FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)を比較しました。初回診断時は転移病変の検出でPETの感度が高い傾向でした。化学療法後は横隔膜下病変でPETの特異度と正確度が有意に優れる一方、横隔膜上では炎症による偽陽性が見られました。
summary_en: This study compared 18F-FDG PET with CT for detecting and monitoring malignant germ cell tumors in 23 patients, with 32 paired scans. Before chemotherapy, PET showed higher, though not statistically significant, sensitivity and negative predictive value for metastases. After chemotherapy, PET was significantly more specific and accurate for infradiaphragmatic lesions, but produced false-positive supradiaphragmatic findings from inflammation. The authors conclude PET is useful for initial staging and treatment control.

title: Metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis: results of elective and salvage surgery for patients with residual retroperitoneal masses.
title_ja: 精巣の転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍：化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤に対する待機的手術と救済手術の成績
summary_ja: 精巣の転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に後腹膜の残存腫瘤を切除した442例を後方視的に解析しています。化学療法後早期の待機的手術は救済手術より完全切除率が高く、5年全生存期間も良好でした（89%対56%）。救済群では未分化の悪性奇形腫と不完全切除が予後に影響し、著者らは待機的手術の施行を推奨しています。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 442 men with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who underwent residual retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy compares elective surgery (330 men, within 3 months of chemotherapy) with salvage surgery after relapse (112 men). Complete resection rates were 87% versus 72%, and undifferentiated malignant teratoma was far more common in the salvage group (49% vs 8.5%). Five-year overall survival was 89% for elective and 56% for salvage surgery, with complete excision and undifferentiated teratoma predicting survival in the salvage group. The authors continue to recommend elective surgery.

title: Involvement of the Fas/FasL pathway in the pathogenesis of germ cell tumours of the adult testis.
title_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症におけるFas/FasLシグナル経路の関与
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍41例を免疫組織化学で解析し、Fas/FasL経路の関与を検討しています。セミノーマと奇形腫以外の非セミノーマはFasLを発現し、浸潤リンパ球のFasを介したアポトーシスを誘導して免疫逃避に関与する可能性が示されました。精母細胞性セミノーマはFasとFasLの両方を発現し、別の発症機序を示唆しています。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study of 41 adult testicular germ cell tumors (seminomas, non-seminomas, and spermatocytic seminomas) examines the Fas/FasL apoptosis pathway. All germ cell tumors expressed the inhibitor Fap-1 and lacked HLA class I and II molecules. Seminomas and non-seminomas, except teratomas, expressed FasL but not Fas, whereas teratomas expressed Fas and lacked FasL. Spermatocytic seminoma expressed both. The authors propose that tumor FasL induces apoptosis of Fas-positive tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, suggesting immune evasion in early development and a separate pathogenesis for spermatocytic seminoma.

title: Genetic analysis of mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors in children and adolescents.
title_ja: 小児および青年の縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝学的解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 小児・青年の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍をCGHで解析し、遺伝子異常に基づく亜群を検討しています。純粋奇形腫には異常がなく、8歳未満の悪性例は仙尾部・精巣腫瘍と類似したパターンを示しました。8歳以上では12p増加が多く、青年男性の約半数でX染色体増加（クラインフェルター症候群に関連）が認められました。
summary_en: This CGH study of 15 pure mediastinal mature or immature teratomas and 20 malignant mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors in children and adolescents identifies genetic subgroups. Pure teratomas showed normal profiles. In children under 8, malignant tumors showed gains of 1q, 3, 20q and losses of 1p, 4q, 6q, resembling sacrococcygeal and testicular GCTs of that age, without sex chromosome abnormalities. In children 8 and older, gain of 12p predominated, and about half of adolescent males showed X chromosome gain consistent with Klinefelter syndrome. Infants had a better prognosis than adolescents.

title: Choriocarcinoma and epithelial trophoblastic tumor: successful treatment of relapse with hysterectomy and high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral stem cell support: a case report.
title_ja: 絨毛癌および類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍：子宮摘出術と末梢血幹細胞支持下大量化学療法による再発の治療成功――症例報告
summary_ja: 過期妊娠後に生じたIC期の絨毛癌と類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍の1例です。肺転移は多剤化学療法に反応しましたが、子宮の持続病変に対して子宮摘出術が必要でした。化学療法後4か月以内に再発し、末梢血幹細胞支持下の大量化学療法で治療され、移植後23か月無病生存しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman with stage IC post-term choriocarcinoma with epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Lung metastases responded to multiagent chemotherapy, but persistent uterine disease required hysterectomy. She relapsed within four months after chemotherapy and was treated with high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral stem cell support, remaining disease-free 23 months after transplant. The authors suggest that multimodality therapy including high-dose chemotherapy may be a potential option for choriocarcinoma relapse refractory to conventional treatment.

title: [A case of mediastinal teratoma with elevated serum tumor marker levels].
title_ja: 血清腫瘍マーカー値の上昇を伴った縦隔奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 27歳男性の巨大な多嚢胞性前縦隔腫瘍の症例報告です。嚢胞破裂による左胸水を伴い、血清と胸水のCA 125、CA 19-9、SLXが高値でした。摘出された腫瘍は成熟奇形腫でした。胸水中の腫瘍マーカーが血清値上昇の原因と考えられ、血清腫瘍マーカーは前縦隔嚢胞性腫瘍の術前鑑別に有用かもしれないと述べています。
summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 27-year-old man with cough and a giant polycystic anterior mediastinal tumor complicated by left pleural effusion from cyst perforation. Serum and pleural fluid concentrations of CA 125, CA 19-9 and SLX were elevated. Surgical resection revealed a mature teratoma. The authors suggest that tumor markers leaking into pleural fluid may explain elevated serum levels, and that serum tumor marker levels may aid preoperative differential diagnosis of anterior mediastinal cystic tumors.

title: Early nasogastric tube removal combined with metoclopramide after postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の早期経鼻胃管抜去とメトクロプラミド併用
summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清31例を後方視的に解析し、42例の歴史的対照と比較した。早期NGT抜去とメトクロプラミド併用群は合併症が少なく、食事開始と退院が早かった。腸管機能回復を独立して予測したのはメトクロプラミドではなくNGT留置日数であった。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 31 patients who underwent postchemotherapy RPLND for metastatic testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor compared an early nasogastric tube removal and metoclopramide pathway with 42 historical controls. The study group had fewer complications, earlier solid food tolerance, and earlier discharge without increased complications. Multivariate analysis identified the duration of tube placement, not metoclopramide, as the independent predictor of bowel recovery.

title: Testicular seminoma: a clinicopathologic and immunohistochemical study of 105 cases with special reference to seminomas with atypical features.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの臨床病理学的および免疫組織化学的研究：非定型的特徴を有するセミノーマに着目した105例
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ105例を対象に、形態および免疫組織化学的特徴と病理病期・臨床的意義との関連を検討した。腫瘍径や核分裂像などがpT病期と関連した。非定型的な特徴を持つセミノーマは病期が進んでおり、c-kit消失やCD30発現が認められた。より攻撃的な表現型への初期変化を示す可能性がある。
summary_en: This study examined 105 testicular seminomas to determine whether morphology and immunohistochemistry predict clinicopathologic stage and aggressive behavior. Tumor size, mitotic count, necrosis, and vascular invasion were associated with pT stage. Seminomas with atypia, a subset of usual seminomas, showed higher AJCC stage, c-kit loss, CD30 expression, and a trend toward higher Ki67 and Cam 5.2 expression. The authors suggest that atypical seminomas may represent an early step toward a more aggressive phenotype.

title: Dose-intensive chemotherapy with syngeneic peripheral blood stem cell support for poor risk germ cell tumor of extragonadal origin: a case report.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍（予後不良例）に対する同種一卵性双生児由来末梢血幹細胞支持下の大量化学療法：症例報告
summary_ja: 予後不良の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者に大量化学療法と造血幹細胞支持を行った症例報告である。先行する化学療法で末梢血幹細胞数が不足したため、一卵性双生児の兄弟から幹細胞の提供を受けた。同種の幹細胞移植により大量化学療法を完遂できた。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with poor-risk extragonadal germ cell tumor who received high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic stem cell support. Because prior chemotherapy had left an insufficient number of peripheral blood stem cells, the stem cells were donated by the patient's genomically identical twin brother. The patient successfully completed the high-dose chemotherapy with syngeneic peripheral blood stem cell transplantation.

title: Diffuse pagetoid squamous cell carcinoma of the esophagus combined with choriocarcinoma and mucoepidermoid carcinoma: an autopsy case report.
title_ja: 絨毛癌および粘表皮癌を合併したびまん性pagetoid型食道扁平上皮癌：剖検症例報告
summary_ja: 70歳男性の剖検例で、原発不明の多発肺転移による呼吸不全で死亡した。精巣などの典型的な胚細胞腫瘍の好発部位に病変はないものの、広範な絨毛癌の転移が認められた。保存血清でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)-βの上昇が確認された。食道では、びまん性pagetoid型扁平上皮癌上皮内癌を背景とする微小な原発性絨毛癌と、浸潤性扁平上皮癌、粘表皮癌が見出された。
summary_en: This autopsy report describes a 70-year-old man who died of rapidly progressive metastatic pulmonary tumors of unknown origin. Widespread metastatic choriocarcinoma was found without testicular or other typical germ cell tumor sites, and serum hCG-beta was later found to be elevated. Serial sectioning of the esophagus revealed a small primary choriocarcinoma within diffuse pagetoid squamous cell carcinoma in situ, along with invasive squamous cell carcinoma and mucoepidermoid carcinoma. The authors suggest the latter tumors arose from the overlying in situ lesion, and that pagetoid spread explains the extensive esophageal involvement.

title: The role of (18)fluoro-2-deoxyglucose positron emission tomography in initial staging and re-staging after chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初期病期分類および化学療法後再病期分類における陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の役割
summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床病期I及びIIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の初期病期分類と、化学療法後の再病期分類におけるFDG-PETの有用性を、50例で評価した。初期病期分類ではPETはCTに対する利点を示さなかった。化学療法後、PETの陰性結果はセミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の線維化した残存腫瘤を確実に予測した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では信頼性は低かったものの、原発腫瘍に奇形腫成分がない患者では線維化した腫瘤の予測に役立つ可能性があった。成熟奇形腫や炎症組織は偽陽性の集積を生じることが多く、一部の病変は見逃された。
summary_en: This study evaluated FDG-PET for initial staging of clinical stage I and II nonseminomatous germ cell tumours and for restaging after chemotherapy in 50 patients. In primary staging, PET offered no advantage over CT. After chemotherapy, a negative PET result reliably predicted fibrotic residual masses in seminomatous GCT. In nonseminomatous GCT, PET was less reliable but could help predict fibrotic masses in patients whose primary tumour had no teratoma component. Mature teratoma and inflammatory tissue often produced false-positive uptake, and some lesions were missed.

title: New insights into testicular germ cell tumorigenesis from gene expression profiling.
title_ja: 遺伝子発現プロファイリングから見た精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生機序
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 染色体17に焦点を当てたcDNAマイクロアレイを用い、精巣胚細胞腫瘍14例、上皮内癌1例、正常精巣3例の遺伝子発現を解析した。GRB7とJUPが最も高発現していた。ERBB2の発現は上昇していなかったことから、17q のDNAコピー数増加の標的はGRB7と推定された。多数の遺伝子が発現変化を示し、階層的クラスタリングで組織型を区別できた。
summary_en: This study used a chromosome 17-focused cDNA microarray to profile gene expression in 14 testicular germ cell tumours, one carcinoma in situ, and three normal testis samples. GRB7 and junction plakoglobin (JUP) were the most overexpressed genes. ERBB2 was not elevated, suggesting GRB7 is the target of the 17q copy number gain. Other genes, including POV1, MYCL1, MYBL2, MXI1, and DNMT2, were dysregulated across the genome. Hierarchical clustering distinguished histological subtypes, and some genes were associated with seminoma or nonseminoma.

title: Effect of hypoxia on human seminoma cells.
title_ja: ヒトセミノーマ細胞に対する低酸素の影響
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒトセミノーマ細胞株を低酸素下で培養し、増殖・形態・遺伝子発現・細胞周期への影響を解析した。低酸素では長期培養での増殖が抑制され、紡錘状形態へ変化した。VEGF-Cの発現とVEGF-Aの産生が増加したが、HIF-1αの発現は上昇しなかった。G1期停止が生じ、アポトーシスは増加しなかった。
summary_en: This study examined how hypoxia affects human seminoma cell lines in terms of growth, morphology, gene expression, protein expression, and cell cycle. Hypoxia inhibited long-term growth and induced a spindle-shaped morphology. VEGF-C expression was markedly increased and VEGF-A production rose, although HIF-1alpha was not upregulated. Hypoxic cultures caused G1 arrest with increased p15/ink4b and p27/Kip1 expression, without increased apoptosis. Adhesion molecule expression changed only slightly.

title: Localization of a specific germ cell marker, DAZL1, in testicular germ cell neoplasias.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるDAZL1の局在
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍におけるDAZL1の発現を免疫組織化学で検討しました。DAZL1は未分類型の管内胚細胞腫瘍で一貫して陽性でした。セミノーマでは一部の細胞が陽性で、非セミノーマ成分は陰性でした。セミノーマ細胞の抗原的不均一性を示し、管内胚細胞腫瘍が前駆病変であるとの仮説を支持します。
summary_en: This study examines DAZL1, a germ cell-specific protein, by immunohistochemistry across testicular germ cell neoplasias. DAZL1 was consistently expressed in intratubular germ cell neoplasia of unclassified type and in some intratubular seminomas. It was detected in scattered cells of pure seminomas and the seminomatous component of mixed tumors, but not in nonseminomatous components. These findings show antigenic heterogeneity of seminoma cells and support IGCN as the precursor of germ cell neoplasias.

title: Paediatric extracranial germ cell tumours: a retrospective review.
title_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍：後方視的検討
summary_ja: 1989〜1999年にシンガポールの3施設で治療された小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍38例の後方視的コホート研究です。奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍が主な組織型で、多くが病期I でした。95%で完全切除が得られ、28.9%がシスプラチン併用化学療法を受け、放射線療法は行われませんでした。10年全生存率は96%、無イベント生存率は88%でした。
summary_en: This retrospective cohort study analyzed 38 pediatric patients with extracranial germ cell tumors treated at three Singapore hospitals from 1989 to 1999. Teratomas and yolk sac tumors were the most common histologies, and most patients presented with Stage I disease. Complete resection was achieved in 95 percent, and 28.9 percent received cisplatin-based chemotherapy, with no radiotherapy. Ten-year overall survival was 96 percent and event-free survival 88 percent, reflecting the high survival associated with early-stage disease.

title: Ovarian carcinoma associated with pregnancy. A review of 9 cases.
title_ja: 妊娠に伴う卵巣癌9例の検討
summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1976年から2000年の間に2施設で妊娠中に卵巣癌と診断された女性9例の治療と転帰を検討している。7例は上皮性腫瘍、1例ずつディスジャーミノーマと顆粒膜細胞腫瘍であった。大多数はFIGO病期Iであり、5年全生存率は78%、病期Iaでは100%であった。著者らは、早期診断と適切な治療、特に術後化学療法が最良の予後をもたらすと結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective review of nine women with ovarian cancer diagnosed during pregnancy at two hospitals from 1976 to 2000 examines treatment and outcomes. Seven had epithelial tumors, and one each had dysgerminoma and granulosa cell tumor. Most patients were FIGO stage I, and the 5-year survival was 78 percent, with 100 percent for stage Ia. The authors conclude that early diagnosis and appropriate treatment, including postoperative chemotherapy, give the best prognosis.

title: Testicular cancers occurring in brothers with cryptorchism.
title_ja: 停留精巣を伴う兄弟に発症した精巣がん
summary_ja: 停留精巣を伴う兄弟2例の家族性精巣がんを報告します。2例とも純粋セミノーマで後腹膜リンパ節転移を認めました。両者ともシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けました。兄は再発を繰り返し大量化学療法で治療され、弟は後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に長期寛解を得ました。家族性症例の文献を概説し、精巣下降障害と精巣がんとの関連を考察しています。
summary_en: This report describes familial testicular cancer in two brothers with undescended testes, both with pure seminoma and retroperitoneal lymph node metastases. Both received cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The older brother had repeated recurrences and responded to high-dose chemotherapy, while the younger achieved long-term remission after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The authors review familial cases and discuss the link between maldescent of the testes and testicular cancer.

title: Microsatellite instability in gonadal tumors of XY pure gonadal dysgenesis patients.
title_ja: XY型純粋性腺異形成症患者の性腺腫瘍におけるマイクロサテライト不安定性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: XY型純粋性腺異形成症の2例の性腺腫瘍を対象に、マイクロサテライト不安定性を調べた研究である。両例とも性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマの合併であった。ディスジャーミノーマ成分にhMSH1、hMSH2、TP53の不安定性やヘテロ接合性の消失が認められ、正常組織には認められなかった。ras遺伝子変異は検出されなかった。この異常が悪性転化に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined microsatellite instability and loss of heterozygosity in gonadal tumors from two patients with XY pure gonadal dysgenesis. Both tumors were combined gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. Instability at hMSH1, hMSH2, and TP53 was found in the dysgerminoma components but not in normal tissue. No ras mutations were detected. The authors suggest microsatellite instability contributes to malignant transformation of gonadal tumors in this condition.

title: Genome profiles of familial/bilateral and sporadic testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 家族性・両側性および散発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍のゲノムプロファイル
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 家族性・両側性15例と散発性18例、計33例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で解析した研究である。両群の染色体コピー数異常は類似しており、第12染色体の増加が91%に認められた。セミノーマでは15qと22qの増加、非セミノーマでは17q近位部の増加と12p領域の高度増幅、10qの欠失が関連した。発症経路は共通する一方、組織型による違いが示された。
summary_en: This study used comparative genomic hybridization on 33 testicular germ cell tumors, including 15 familial or bilateral and 18 sporadic cases. Familial and sporadic tumors showed comparable copy-number changes, most notably gains of chromosome 12. Seminomas were associated with gains of 15q and 22q, whereas nonseminomas showed proximal 17q gain, 12p amplification, and 10q loss. The findings suggest shared genetic pathways with histology-specific differences.

title: Metastatic spinal cord compression of testicular yolk sac tumor.
title_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の転移性脊髄圧迫：症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の転移による脊髄圧迫を呈した14か月の男児の症例報告である。左根治的精巣摘除術の2か月後に進行性の対麻痺と神経因性膀胱を発症した。MRIでT9〜T11とS3の硬膜外腫瘤を認め、緊急の外科的切除で除圧と転移の病理学的確認が行われた。除圧後の補助化学療法を遅らせないことが重要と強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 14-month-old boy with metastatic spinal cord compression from a testicular yolk sac tumor. He presented with progressive paraparesis and neurogenic bladder two months after left radical orchiectomy. MRI showed a ventral epidural mass compressing the cord at T9 to T11 and S3. Emergency surgical resection provided decompression and tissue diagnosis confirming metastasis. The authors stress that surgical decompression followed by adjuvant chemotherapy should not be delayed.

title: Congenital gastric teratoma with gastric perforation mimicking meconium peritonitis.
title_ja: 胎便性腹膜炎に類似した胃穿孔を伴う先天性胃奇形腫
summary_ja: 生後1日の男児に先天性未熟胃奇形腫と自然発生的な胃穿孔を認めた症例報告である。臨床像は胎便性腹膜炎に類似していた。児は25か月齢時に蜘蛛膜嚢胞も有していたが、腫瘍とは無関係である。胎便性腹膜炎に類似した先天性未熟胃奇形腫と胃穿孔の併存は、英語文献で初めての報告とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 1-day-old boy with congenital immature gastric teratoma and spontaneous gastric perforation. The clinical picture resembled meconium peritonitis. The child also had an arachnoid cyst at 25 months of age, which is unrelated to the tumor. The authors state that this is the first description of congenital immature gastric teratoma with gastric perforation mimicking meconium peritonitis in the English-language literature.

title: Primary choriocarcinoma of jejunum.
title_ja: 空腸原発の絨毛癌
summary_ja: 60歳男性に生じた空腸原発の絨毛癌の症例報告。腹痛と嘔吐で受診し、気腹症を認めた。組織学的に合胞体栄養膜細胞と細胞性栄養膜細胞への分化を示し、術後に血清・尿中のβ-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇した。術後経過は不良で死亡した。消化管原発の絨毛癌はまれである。
summary_en: This case report describes a 60-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the jejunum, an extragonadal germ cell tumor that presented with perforation and pneumoperitoneum. Histology showed syncytiotrophoblastic and cytotrophoblastic differentiation, and postoperative serum and urine beta-hCG levels were elevated. The patient died after an unsatisfactory postoperative course. The report highlights the rarity of intestinal choriocarcinoma and the value of hCG as a marker.

title: Serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 in patients with seminoma stage I followed with surveillance.
title_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマ患者におけるサーベイランス中の血清乳酸脱水素酵素アイソザイム1
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者を対象に、精巣摘除術後のフォローアップ中の血清LD-1を検討した。術前の55%で上昇し、hCG上昇(9%)より多かった。中央値5.1年の観察で21%が再発したが、LD-1上昇は再発を予測しなかった。
summary_en: This study measured serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (S-LD-1) in patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma under surveillance after orchiectomy. Elevated S-LD-1 was found in 55% of patients before orchiectomy, more often than elevated hCG (9%), and levels fell after surgery. After a median follow-up of 5.1 years, 21% relapsed, but S-LD-1 elevation did not predict relapse. The authors conclude that S-LD-1 has limited value for predicting relapse during surveillance.

title: A cyst of benign mediastinal teratoma demonstrating a peculiar development: report of a case.
title_ja: 頸部へ進展した良性縦隔奇形腫の嚢胞の特異な進展様式：症例報告
summary_ja: 28歳女性の良性縦隔奇形腫の症例報告。首の腫脹が4か月にわたって繰り返し出現・消退した。腫瘍は頸部まで進展しており、頸部原発ではなかった。組織学的に豊富な膵組織が認められ、周囲構造による被包と膵組織による嚢胞形成が特異な進展の機序として考察されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with benign mediastinal teratoma whose cyst extended into the cervical region, causing recurrent neck swelling and remission over four months. Histology showed abundant pancreatic tissue. The authors propose that anatomical encasement by surrounding structures, together with pancreatic tissue forming a cyst, explained the unusual extension. The teratoma did not arise primarily in the neck.

title: Malignant placental site trophoblastic tumor: a cytogenetic study using comparative genomic hybridization and chromosome in situ hybridization.
title_ja: 悪性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションおよび染色体in situハイブリダイゼーションによる細胞遺伝学的研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 悪性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の2症例を対象に、比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法と染色体in situハイブリダイゼーション法で細胞遺伝学的解析を行った。両症例とも二倍体核型で、DNAコピー数の変化は認められなかった。悪性の挙動はDNAコピー数変化とは関連しない可能性があり、転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と絨毛癌の鑑別に有用と考えられた。
summary_en: This study analyzed two cases of malignant placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), both in women aged 32 with ovarian and lung metastases and elevated hCG. Cytogenetic analysis using comparative genomic hybridization and chromosome in situ hybridization showed diploid karyotypes without DNA copy number changes. The authors conclude that the malignant behavior of PSTT may not relate to DNA copy number alterations, and that cytogenetic profiling could help distinguish metastatic PSTT from choriocarcinoma.

title: Factors affecting outcomes of prenatally-diagnosed tumours.
title_ja: 出生前診断された腫瘍の転帰に影響する因子
summary_ja: 1994年から2001年に出生前診断された腫瘍を有する胎児15例を後方視的に検討した。頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍2例と仙尾部奇形腫3例を含む。死亡は頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍2例と仙尾部奇形腫1例であった。生児出生例の充実性腫瘍は術後再発がなく、比較的良性と結論された。
