summary_en: This retrospective review of 15 fetuses with antenatally diagnosed tumors from 1994 to 2001 included intracranial germ cell tumors (n=2) and sacrococcygeal teratomas (n=3). Three fetuses died, two with intracranial germ cell tumors and one with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Solid tumors in live births, including sacrococcygeal teratoma, showed no recurrence after surgery with or without adjuvant chemotherapy. Tumors without other anomalies caused morbidity through their location and vascularity, and the authors conclude that solid tumors are relatively benign.

title: Adnexal torsion presenting as an acute abdomen in a patient with bilateral cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 両側性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に伴い急性腹症を呈した付属器捻転
summary_ja: 両側卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の患者が、一方の異常に大きな腫瘍の捻転により急性腹症を呈した症例報告である。嚢胞性奇形腫は女性で最も多い良性卵巣腫瘍であり、捻転は激しい疼痛、嘔気、組織壊死を起こす主要な合併症である。診断、手術治療、術後所見を報告し、卵巣奇形腫における捻転の認識の重要性を示している。
summary_en: A patient with bilateral cystic teratomas of the ovary presented with an acute abdomen caused by torsion of one unusually large tumor. The report reviews the diagnosis, operative management, and postoperative findings of this case. Cystic teratomas are the most common benign ovarian neoplasms in women, and torsion is a major complication causing severe pain, nausea, and tissue necrosis. The case highlights the importance of recognizing torsion in patients with ovarian teratoma.

title: 18F-fluoro-2-deoxyglucose-positron emission tomography in the evaluation of nonseminomatous germ cell tumours at relapse.
title_ja: 再発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の評価における18F-フルオロ-2-デオキシグルコース陽電子放射断層撮影
summary_ja: 後腹膜に発生した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の15例で、FDG-PETとCTによるフォローアップを比較した。25回のPET検査のうち、18例で両者の結果が一致し、7例で不一致であった。FDG-PETは後腹膜の再発をCTより早期に検出し、残存腫瘤内の成熟奇形腫もより正確に同定した。日常的な使用には、さらに大規模な試験が必要と結論された。
summary_en: This study compared FDG-PET and CT in 15 patients with retroperitoneal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors during follow-up after chemotherapy and surgery. Of 25 PET examinations, results agreed with CT in 18 and conflicted in seven, a statistically significant difference. FDG-PET detected retroperitoneal relapse earlier than CT and identified mature teratoma in residual masses more accurately. The authors conclude that larger trials are needed before routine use of FDG-PET.

title: High-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation for advanced testicular cancer.
title_ja: 進行精巣がんに対する末梢血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法
summary_ja: 進行精巣がん14例に対し、カルボプラチン、エトポシド、シクロホスファミドによる大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を行った。初回または二次救援療法として施行した2例は良好な経過をたどった。シスプラチン併用化学療法を前治療された2例は無効であった。有効性は限定的で、重篤な好中球減少性大腸炎が1例にみられた。
summary_en: This study evaluated high-dose chemotherapy with carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide followed by peripheral blood stem cell transplantation in 14 patients with advanced testicular cancer. Patients were treated for refractory disease, relapse, or as consolidation or first-line therapy. Two patients previously given intensive cisplatin-based chemotherapy did not respond. Successful outcomes occurred mainly when high-dose therapy was used as first or second salvage. Efficacy was limited, and severe neutropenic colitis was the main notable toxicity.

title: Follow-up of clinical stage I testicular cancer patients: cost and risk benefit considerations.
title_ja: 臨床病期I精巣がん患者のフォローアップ：費用と危険性・有益性の検討
summary_ja: 1970年から1997年に精巣摘除術を受けた臨床病期I精巣腫瘍の患者を検討した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍39例とセミノーマ82例が対象である。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は4年間の集中的フォローアップで十分と考えられた。セミノーマでは補助放射線療法により、腹部・骨盤CTを定期フォローアップから除外できる可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study reviewed prognosis and recurrence patterns in 39 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous and 82 with stage I seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated at one institution from 1970 to 1997. Only two patients progressed. Four years of intensive follow-up appeared sufficient for stage I nonseminoma under surveillance, and routine chest X-rays may be needed only in the first year. After adjuvant radiotherapy for stage I seminoma, abdominal and pelvic CT could be removed from routine follow-up.

title: Bilateral testicular tumors: a report of nine cases with long-term follow-up.
title_ja: 両側精巣腫瘍：長期フォローアップを行った9症例の報告
summary_ja: 1980年から1999年に治療した両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍9例を後方視的に検討した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍全体の3.3%に相当した。9例中6例は異時性で、中央値8年の間隔があった。中央値78か月の観察で8例は再発を認めなかった。対側再発に備え、最長25年の長期フォローアップが推奨された。
summary_en: Nine consecutive patients with bilateral germ cell testicular tumors treated between 1980 and 1999 were reviewed, representing 3.3 percent of all testicular germ cell tumor cases. Six were metachronous, with a median interval of eight years. Most patients remained free of recurrence over a median follow-up of 78 months. Some patients with bilateral orchiectomy did not need androgen replacement, and sexual function was preserved with replacement where needed. The authors recommend long-term follow-up of up to 25 years for contralateral relapse.

title: Survey of radiation oncologists: practice patterns of the management of stage I seminoma of testis in Canada and a selected group in the United States.
title_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマの管理に関する放射線腫瘍医の診療パターン：カナダおよび米国の選択群における調査
summary_ja: 2001年にカナダの放射線腫瘍医と米国の選択群を対象に実施した調査で、精巣の病期Iセミノーマの管理法を検討した。ほぼ全員が胸部X線と腹部・骨盤CTによる病期分類を行っていた。監視療法は78%が選択肢として提示していた。放射線療法の照射範囲は施設間で大きく異なり、施設間差が明らかとなった。
summary_en: A 2001 survey of radiation oncologists in Canada and a selected group in the United States examined management of stage I testicular seminoma. Nearly all performed chest x-ray and abdominal-pelvic CT for staging. Surveillance was offered by 78 percent, with an estimated median uptake of 20 percent. Preferences varied with fertility concerns, and radiotherapy volumes differed widely. Twenty-nine percent reduced the dog-leg field after the MRC trial. The authors conclude practice patterns vary significantly.

title: Familial ovarian dysgerminomas (Swyer syndrome) in females associated with 46 XY-karyotype.
title_ja: 46,XY核型を伴う家族性卵巣未分化胚細胞腫（スウィヤー症候群）
summary_ja: 46,XY核型を示す38歳の無症状女性で、父方の叔母3名が卵巣悪性腫瘍を発症していた家族性症例を報告した。既知の原因（SRY、9p24.3、DAX1）はいずれも除外され、未知の遺伝子座の関与が示唆された。性腺悪性腫瘍の家族歴を持つ女性では遺伝学的評価が重要である。
summary_en: This report describes an asymptomatic 38-year-old woman with a 46,XY karyotype and a family history of ovarian malignancies, in whom familial Swyer syndrome with ovarian dysgerminomas was considered most likely. Three paternal aunts were affected, two of whom died young. The authors excluded known causes, including SRY, 9p24.3, and DAX1 abnormalities, suggesting an unidentified genetic locus. The case highlights the importance of genetic evaluation in women with a family history of gonadal malignancy.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma. Outcome and management. An analysis of 17 cases.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の転帰と管理：17例の解析
summary_ja: 1985年から1998年に観察された仙尾部奇形腫17例を解析し、文献と比較した。胎児3例は死亡し、残りの14例では腫瘍摘出が行われた。生存12例は無腫瘍で、括約筋機能と下肢機能は良好であった。予後不良因子として充実性腫瘍や悪性組織型などが挙げられた。
summary_en: This analysis of 17 sacrococcygeal teratomas observed between 1985 and 1998 compared the cases with the literature. Three fetuses died in utero or shortly after birth, while the remaining 14 underwent tumor removal. Twelve survivors were tumor-free with good sphincter and lower-limb function, whereas two died, one from a malignant tumor and one from recurrent embryonal carcinoma. Negative prognostic factors included solid tumors, early detection, malignant histotypes, polyhydramnios, placentomegaly, and fetal hydrops.

title: Prenatal diagnosis of sacrococcygeal teratoma: a review of cases between 1993 and 2000.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断：1993～2000年の症例の検討
summary_ja: 1993年から2000年に当施設で出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫6例を後方視的に検討した。4例は選択的人工妊娠中絶、2例は帝王切開で出産された。新生児死亡はなく、切除された腫瘍の1例で悪性の可能性が指摘された。多職種による周産期管理が推奨されている。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed six cases of sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally at one institution between 1993 and 2000. Prenatal sonographic features and pathology were evaluated. Four fetuses were electively terminated, two of them diagnosed before 16 weeks. Two cesarean deliveries occurred at 35 and 37 weeks, where diagnosis came only in late gestation. No neonatal deaths occurred, and one resected tumor showed potential malignancy. The authors recommend a multidisciplinary approach to perinatal management.

title: Intraperitoneal cancer spread after laparoscopic cystectomy for mature teratoma with malignant transformation.
title_ja: 悪性転化を伴う成熟奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術後の腹腔内播種
summary_ja: 悪性転化を伴う卵巣類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）に対し、腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術が行われた症例を報告した。術後に腹腔内への腫瘍播種を合併した。腹腔鏡手術では技術的困難、術中の腫瘍漏出、悪性転化などの限界があることを指摘している。
summary_en: This case report describes an ovarian dermoid cyst with malignant transformation that was initially treated with laparoscopic cystectomy. The procedure was complicated by intraperitoneal tumor dissemination. The authors discuss the potential limitations of laparoscopic surgery for ovarian dermoid cysts, including technical difficulty, intraoperative tumor spillage, and malignant transformation. The report highlights the risk of tumor spread when such lesions are managed laparoscopically.

title: Prospective comparison of [18F]fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography with conventional assessment by computed tomography scans and serum tumor markers for the evaluation of residual masses in patients with nonseminomatous germ cell carcinoma.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における残存腫瘤の評価：[18F]FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)とCT、血清腫瘍マーカーの前向き比較
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の残存腫瘤85病変を対象に、[18F]FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)をCTおよび腫瘍マーカーと比較した。PETの感度は59%、特異度は92%で、陽性的中率は91%であった。複数の残存腫瘤や腫瘍マーカー陰性例で有用性が高く、従来の病期分類と併用すると追加情報が得られる。
summary_en: In 85 residual lesions from 45 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated in prospective trials, FDG PET was compared with CT and serum tumor marker changes. PET showed 59% sensitivity and 92% specificity for predicting viable carcinoma, versus 55% and 86% for CT, and 42% and 100% for tumor markers. A positive PET was highly predictive of viable tumor. PET was particularly useful in patients with multiple residual masses and in those with marker-negative disease.

title: Microsatellite instability of germ cell tumors is associated with resistance to systemic treatment.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍のマイクロサテライト不安定性は全身治療抵抗性と関連する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 非選択の胚細胞腫瘍100例と化学療法抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍11例で、マイクロサテライト不安定性(MSI)とミスマッチ修復タンパク質の発現を解析した。抵抗性腫瘍ではMSIの頻度が有意に高く（45% 対 6%）、MSIと治療抵抗性の正の相関が初めて示された。
summary_en: This study examined microsatellite instability (MSI) and mismatch repair protein expression (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6) in 100 unselected germ cell tumors and 11 chemotherapy-resistant tumors. MSI was markedly more frequent in resistant tumors, with 45% versus 6% showing instability at one or more loci, and 36% versus 0% at two or more loci. Immunohistochemical findings correlated with MSI in five of the unstable tumors. The authors demonstrate, for the first time, a positive correlation between MSI and treatment resistance in germ cell tumors.

title: Right ventricular metastatic choriocarcinoma obstructing inflow and outflow tract.
title_ja: 右室流入路・流出路を閉塞した転移性絨毛癌の1例
summary_ja: 精巣由来の転移性絨毛癌により右室流入路と流出路が閉塞した34歳男性の症例を報告した。三尖弁を温存して腫瘍を切除し、BEPO化学療法を追加した。術後18か月時点で肺転移は認めず、患者は良好な経過をたどっている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with metastatic choriocarcinoma originating from the right testis, which extended from the tricuspid valve to the pulmonary valve and obstructed the right ventricular inflow and outflow tracts. The tumor was resected with preservation of the tricuspid valve, followed by BEPO chemotherapy. At 18 months postoperatively, CT showed no pulmonary metastases and MRI revealed a thickened right ventricular free wall and apex. The patient remained well.

title: Case of mediastinal seminoma with testicular microlithiasis.
title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化を伴った縦隔セミノーマの1例
summary_ja: 19歳の日本人男性で、縦隔セミノーマと両側精巣微小石灰化を認めた症例の報告。精巣の身体所見は正常で、超音波検査で微小石灰化が判明した。精巣針生検では精細管内の層状石灰化のみで生存腫瘍は認められなかった。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に精巣微小石灰化を伴う報告は6例目と稀である。
summary_en: A 19-year-old Japanese man with mediastinal seminoma had normal testicular examination findings but bilateral testicular microlithiasis on ultrasonography. Testicular needle biopsy showed multiple laminated calcifications within seminiferous tubules without viable germ cell tumor. The authors note this is only the sixth reported case of extragonadal germ cell tumor associated with testicular microlithiasis, highlighting a possible link between the two conditions and the importance of testicular assessment in patients with mediastinal germ cell tumors.

title: From teratocarcinomas to embryonic stem cells.
title_ja: 奇形癌腫から胚性幹細胞へ
journal: Philos Trans R Soc Lond B Biol Sci
summary_ja: 奇形癌腫およびその胎児性癌(EC)幹細胞の研究が、ヒト胚性幹細胞研究の基礎を築いた経緯を概説した総説。EC細胞は初期胚幹細胞の悪性の代替物として、多能性や分化の概念に寄与してきた。EC細胞やES細胞の分化を制御する分子機構は未解明な点が多い。幹細胞の可塑性に関する新知見は、既存の制御経路の概念を見直す必要性を示唆する。
summary_en: This review traces how the study of teratocarcinomas and their embryonal carcinoma stem cells laid the groundwork for modern research on human embryonic stem cells. The authors argue that EC cells, as malignant counterparts of early embryonic stem cells, have long informed ideas about pluripotency and differentiation. They note that the molecular mechanisms controlling EC and ES cell differentiation remain poorly understood, and that recent observations of stem-cell plasticity challenge current concepts of regulatory pathways, calling for new network-level analytical approaches.

title: PPARgamma expression in normal human placenta, hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 正常ヒト胎盤、胞状奇胎および絨毛癌におけるPPARγ発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常胎盤、胞状奇胎および絨毛癌におけるPPARγ発現を免疫組織化学およびウェスタンブロットで検討した。正常胎盤の栄養膜細胞核ではPPARγが陽性であったが、妊娠性絨毛性疾患では染色性が低下し、絨毛癌ではごく一部の細胞のみが弱く陽性であった。PPARγの低下は栄養膜細胞分化の異常と病態進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined PPARγ protein expression by immunohistochemistry and Western blotting in normal placentas, hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. PPARγ was nuclear in cytotrophoblasts and syncytiotrophoblasts of normal placenta, but its immunostaining was reduced in gestational trophoblastic diseases, with only weak staining in a few choriocarcinoma cells. The authors suggest PPARγ participates in trophoblast differentiation and that its downregulation may contribute to the progression of gestational trophoblastic diseases.

title: A rare association between malignant mediastinal seminoma and other malignant neoplasms.
title_ja: 悪性縦隔セミノーマと他の悪性腫瘍との稀な合併
summary_ja: 原発性悪性縦隔セミノーマに罹患し、12年後に悪性腕神経叢神経鞘腫と乳頭状甲状腺癌を発症した患者を報告した。両腫瘍は手術と局所放射線療法で治療されていたため、甲状腺癌または神経鞘腫が放射線により誘発されたのか、偶発的な合併であったのかは判別できなかった。著者らは、縦隔セミノーマとこれらの腫瘍との間に確立された関連はないことを文献から示し、この稀な腫瘍の治療方針についての議論にも言及している。
summary_en: The authors describe a patient with primary malignant mediastinal seminoma who, 12 years later, developed malignant brachial plexus schwannoma and papillary thyroid carcinoma. Both tumors had been treated with surgery and local radiotherapy, so the authors could not determine whether the thyroid carcinoma or schwannoma was radiation-induced or an incidental association. They review literature showing no established link between mediastinal seminoma and these neoplasms, and discuss the debated treatment approach for this rare tumor.

title: Comparison of surveillance and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in Stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における監視療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の比較
summary_ja: オランダの2つのコホートを後方視的に比較した研究。臨床病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍について、アムステルダムで監視療法を受けた90例と、ナイメーヘンで一次RPLNDを受けた101例を検討した。監視療法群では26%が再発し、その多くは後腹膜であった。救済後の無病生存率は98.5%であった。RPLND群では30.7%に後腹膜の生存腫瘍が認められ、補助化学療法後に再発した者はおらず、生存率は98%であった。両戦略とも優れた成績が得られ、合併症のほとんどは可逆的であった。
summary_en: Retrospective comparison of two Dutch cohorts with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis: 90 patients on surveillance in Amsterdam and 101 undergoing primary RPLND in Nijmegen. Surveillance patients had 26% relapse, mostly retroperitoneal, with 98.5% disease-free survival after salvage. RPLND patients had 30.7% viable retroperitoneal tumor, none of whom relapsed after adjuvant chemotherapy, with 98% survival. Both strategies achieved excellent results, and most complications were reversible.

title: Distinct epigenetic phenotypes in seminomatous and nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマと非セミノーマにおけるエピジェネティックな表現型の差異
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の2亜型であるセミノーマと非セミノーマのエピジェネティックな違いを解析した。セミノーマではCpGアイランドのメチル化がほぼ認められず（0.08%）、非セミノーマでは約1.11%と他の固形腫瘍に近い水準だった。セミノーマはゲノム全体もより低メチル化していた。原始胚細胞の発生過程でのメチル化パターンの切り替えを反映すると考察されている。
summary_en: This study compared the DNA methylation landscapes of seminomas and nonseminomas, the two histologic subtypes of testicular germ cell tumors, using restriction landmark genomic scanning. Seminomas showed almost no CpG island methylation (0.08%), whereas nonseminomas showed about 1.11%, similar to other solid tumors. Seminomas were also more globally hypomethylated. The authors propose these differences reflect the normal developmental shift in primordial germ cells from an undermethylated to a methylated genome, offering a developmental model for the two subtypes.

title: Overrepresentation of the short arm of chromosome 12 in seminoma and nonseminoma groups of testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ群と非セミノーマ群における12番染色体短腕の過剰表現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成人のセミノーマ7例と非セミノーマ8例を解析し、12番染色体短腕の増幅を検討した。i(12p)を中心とする12p由来の過剰な染色体物質は、セミノーマの6例と非セミノーマの全例で認められた。コピー数の不均一性や12番染色体の異数性は非セミノーマで高かった。
summary_en: This cytogenetic study analyzed seven adult seminomas and eight nonseminomas using conventional cytogenetics and fluorescent in situ hybridization. Amplified chromosome 12p material, mainly from the i(12p) marker, was found in 6 of 7 seminomas and all 8 nonseminomas. Copy number heterogeneity of the 12p-derived markers and chromosome 12 aneuploidy were greater in nonseminomas than in seminomas, suggesting that 12p overrepresentation is common to both subtypes but more heterogeneous in nonseminomas.

title: Molecular characterization of hiwi, a human member of the piwi gene family whose overexpression is correlated to seminomas.
title_ja: ヒトPIWIファミリー遺伝子hiwiの分子特性：セミノーマで発現が亢進する遺伝子
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 著者らは、精巣胚細胞腫瘍と連鎖する領域12q24.33に位置する、piwiファミリーのヒト遺伝子hiwiを特性解析した。hiwiは成人精巣で発現する861アミノ酸のタンパク質をコードし、精子形成の胚細胞に特異的に発現する。セミノーマ19例中12例で発現が亢進していたが、非セミノーマや精母細胞性セミノーマ、体細胞由来の精巣腫瘍では亢進は認められなかった。hiwiは正常および悪性の精子形成細胞において成熟段階依存的に発現し、胚細胞の増殖を制御している可能性がある。
summary_en: The authors characterize hiwi, a human member of the piwi gene family located at 12q24.33, a region linked to testicular germ cell tumors. hiwi encodes an 861-amino-acid protein expressed in adult testis, specifically in spermatogenic germ cells. Its expression was enhanced in 12 of 19 seminomas, but not in 10 nonseminomas, four spermatocytic seminomas, or somatic testicular tumors. The results suggest hiwi is expressed in normal and malignant spermatogenic cells in a maturation-stage-dependent manner and may regulate germ cell proliferation.

title: Seminoma arising in cryptorchid testis 25 years after orchiopexy: case report.
title_ja: 精巣固定術から25年後に停留精巣に生じたセミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 8歳時に停留精巣に対して右精巣固定術を受けた33歳男性が、25年後に同部位の腫脹を生じた。右高位精巣摘除術の病理像からセミノーマが示唆され、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を受けた。停留精巣の悪性転化のリスクから、早期の精巣固定術と生涯にわたるフォローアップが推奨されている。
summary_en: A 33-year-old man who had right orchiopexy at age 8 for undescended testis developed a swelling at the same site 25 years later. He underwent right high orchiectomy, and histopathology suggested seminoma. He received chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin. The authors note that early orchiopexy is advocated to preserve fertility and prevent malignant transformation, and recommend early orchiopexy and lifelong follow-up given the persistent malignant potential of cryptorchid testis.

title: Adenocarcinomas arising from primary retroperitoneal mature teratomas: CT and MR imaging.
title_ja: 原発性後腹膜成熟奇形腫から発生した腺癌：CTおよびMRI所見
summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜成熟奇形腫から発生した腺癌の2症例を、CTおよびMRIで報告している。成熟奇形腫由来の腺癌は極めて稀だが高悪性度である。純粋な良性成熟奇形腫と区別できる悪性転化を示唆する画像所見を提示し、早期の正確な診断に役立つことを示している。
summary_en: This imaging report describes two patients with adenocarcinoma arising from primary retroperitoneal mature teratoma. Adenocarcinoma arising in mature teratoma is extremely rare but highly malignant. The authors detail CT and MRI features that suggest malignant transformation and distinguish them from pure benign mature teratoma. Recognizing these imaging clues may enable earlier and more accurate diagnosis of malignant transformation.

title: An unusual phenotype of Frasier syndrome due to IVS9 +4C>T mutation in the WT1 gene: predominantly male ambiguous genitalia and absence of gonadal dysgenesis.
title_ja: WT1遺伝子IVS9+4C>T変異によるFrasier症候群の非典型的表現型：男性型曖昧生殖器と性腺異形成の欠如
summary_ja: WT1遺伝子イントロン9のスプライス変異によるFrasier症候群の46,XY男性症例である。主に男性型の曖昧生殖器、終末期腎不全、高ゴナドトロピン血症を示した。片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍と両側の性腺芽腫を認めたが性腺異形成はなかった。FrasierとDenys-Drash症候群はWT1関連疾患のスペクトラムの両端である可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 46,XY male with Frasier syndrome caused by a WT1 intron 9 splice mutation. He had predominantly male ambiguous genitalia, end-stage renal failure, and markedly high gonadotropins. He had a unilateral testicular germ cell tumor and bilateral gonadoblastoma, without gonadal dysgenesis. The authors propose that Frasier and Denys-Drash syndromes may represent a spectrum of WT1-related disorders and broaden the known phenotypes, including germ cell neoplasia.

title: The relationship between expression of c-ras, c-erbB-2, nm23, and p53 gene products and development of trophoblastic tumor and their predictive significance for the malignant transformation of complete hydatidiform mole.
title_ja: 完全胞状奇胎の悪性転化予測におけるc-ras、c-erbB-2、nm23、p53遺伝子産物の発現と妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍との関連
summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎について、妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍へ進展した症例と自然寛解した症例を後方視的に免疫組織化学染色で比較した。c-erbB-2とp53の発現増加、nm23とc-rasの発現低下が進展と関連した。4遺伝子産物を用いた予測モデルの感度は86.0%、特異度は75.0%であった。c-erbB-2の増加とnm23の低下が悪性転化の強い予測因子とされる。
summary_en: This retrospective immunohistochemical study compared c-ras, c-erbB-2, p53, and nm23 expression in complete hydatidiform moles that progressed to gestational trophoblastic tumor with those that remitted spontaneously. Increased c-erbB-2 and p53 and decreased nm23 and c-ras were associated with progression. Invasive mole and choriocarcinoma showed no significant differences in expression. A logistic model using these markers predicted malignant transformation with 86.0% sensitivity and 75.0% specificity. The authors conclude that c-erbB-2 and nm23 are strong predictors.

title: Mosaic AZF deletions and susceptibility to testicular tumors.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の感受性とモザイク型AZF欠失
summary_ja: 本遺伝学的研究は、フィンランド人の精巣腫瘍症例17例について、サブインターバルaからdにわたる17座位のAZF欠失を調べた。13例の非腫瘍組織と10例の腫瘍組織で欠失が認められた。対照群には欠失がなく、腫瘍症例の父親も欠失を保有していなかった。著者らは、AZF微小欠失は初期胚発生の段階で生じる染色体不安定性を反映し、精巣腫瘍への感受性をもたらすと提唱している。
summary_en: This genetic study screened 17 Finnish testicular tumor cases for AZF deletions at 17 loci across subintervals a to d. Deletion mosaicism was found in non-tumor tissues of 13 cases, and specific deletion haplotypes in tumor tissues of 10 cases. Controls showed no deletions, and fathers of tumor cases did not carry them. The authors propose that AZF microdeletions reflect chromosome instability that confers susceptibility to testicular tumors, arising during early embryogenesis.

title: [Treatment of metastatic germ cell tumors with etoposide and cisplatin as first line chemotherapy].
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対する一次化学療法としてのエトポシド・シスプラチン療法
summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍18例に、一次治療としてエトポシド・シスプラチン(EP)療法を実施した。完全寛解は22%、部分寛解は78%であった。残存病変を切除した7例はすべて完全寛解に至った。EBP療法と比べ毒性は少なかった。中央値29.6カ月の観察で72%が無病生存しており、予後良好な患者に対する有効で毒性の少ない一次治療と結論された。
summary_en: Eighteen patients with metastatic germ cell tumors received first-line etoposide and cisplatin (EP) chemotherapy. Complete remission was achieved in 22% and partial remission in 78%. Residual masses were resected in seven patients, and all of these achieved complete remission. Salvage chemotherapy rescued most remaining partial responders. EP showed less toxicity than EBP. At a median follow-up of 29.6 months, 72% of patients were disease-free, and the authors concluded that EP is an efficacious, less toxic first-line regimen for good-prognosis patients.

title: Treatment of gestational trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の治療
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を、NCI、WHO、FIGOの基準に基づき非転移性、低リスク転移性、高リスク転移性に分類して概説している。非転移性はメトトレキサートまたはアクチノマイシンD単剤で治癒が得られる。低リスク転移性は5日間投与スケジュールで治癒率はほぼ100%である。高リスク転移性はEMA-CO併用化学療法が必要で、治癒率は80～90%とされる。
summary_en: This review classifies gestational trophoblastic tumors (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor) into nonmetastatic, low-risk, and high-risk metastatic groups using NCI, WHO, and FIGO criteria. Nonmetastatic disease is cured with single-agent methotrexate or actinomycin D. Low-risk metastatic disease is treated with five-day schedules, with cure rates near 100%. High-risk disease requires EMA-CO combination chemotherapy, with or without radiation and surgery, achieving cure rates of 80 to 90%.

title: Mixed choriocarcinoma in a postmenopausal patient.
title_ja: 閉経後患者に生じた混合型絨毛癌
summary_ja: 60歳の閉経後女性が骨盤内腫瘤と肺転移で受診した。手術では右付属器を巻き込む8cmの多結節状子宮腫瘍が認められた。組織学的に中間型トロホブラスト形質を伴う絨毛癌と診断された。術後のβ-hCGは381,561 mIU/mlに達した。閉経後でも転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を発症しうるため、高い疑いを持つことの重要性が示された。
summary_en: A 60-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with a pelvic mass and pulmonary metastasis. Surgery revealed an 8 cm multinodular uterine tumor involving the right adnexa. Histology showed choriocarcinoma with intermediate trophoblastic features. Postoperative beta-hCG reached 381,561 mIU/ml. This is reported as the first case of mixed trophoblastic disease in a postmenopausal woman, and the authors emphasize maintaining a high index of suspicion for metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease in such patients.

title: Adeno-associated virus DNA in human gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるアデノ随伴ウイルスDNA
summary_ja: ブラジルの63例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患（胞状奇胎49例、絨毛癌14例）と15例の流産検体について、アデノ随伴ウイルス(AAV)DNAをネステッドPCRで検出した。43例（胞状奇胎28/49例、絨毛癌4/14例、流産11/15例）からAAV DNAが検出され、胚由来組織へのAAV感染と、流産および栄養膜疾患への関与が示唆された。
summary_en: This Brazilian study used nested PCR to test 63 gestational trophoblastic disease specimens (49 hydatidiform moles and 14 choriocarcinomas) plus 15 miscarriage samples for adeno-associated virus (AAV) DNA. AAV DNA was detected in 43 samples, including 28 of 49 moles, 4 of 14 choriocarcinomas and 11 of 15 miscarriage tissues. The authors confirm AAV infection of embryo-derived tissue in humans and suggest a possible role for AAV in miscarriage and trophoblastic disease.

title: Radiotherapy for early stages testicular seminoma: patterns of care study in Germany.
title_ja: 早期病期精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法：ドイツにおける診療実態調査
summary_ja: ドイツの放射線治療施設を対象とした質問票調査で、1997年のドイツ合意ガイドラインへの遵守状況を評価した。回答56施設（39%）のうち46%が病期分類の要件を完全に満たし、病期Iでは遵守率が高かった一方、病期IIA/Bでは照射標的体積や線量に大きな逸脱が22.6%・10.2%の施設で認められた。
summary_en: This German questionnaire study assessed how radiotherapy departments complied with 1997 German consensus guidelines for staging and treating testicular cancer. Of 56 responding institutions (39%), 46% fully complied with staging requirements, and CT with tumour markers was mandatory in 87.5%. Compliance was high for stage I, with under 5% major violations. In stage IIA/B, however, deviations in target volumes or doses were common (22.6% and 10.2%), indicating a need for continued quality improvement.

title: Advances in the understanding of placental site trophoblastic tumor.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の病態に関する最新知見
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患のうち最も稀な胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の知見をまとめた総説である。PSTTは正常妊娠や流産、異所性妊娠など様々な妊娠後に生じ、転移例は手術と化学療法でも制御が難しい場合がある。有糸分裂指数が重要な予後指標であり、新しい化学療法レジメンにより転移性疾患の治療反応が改善している。
summary_en: This review summarises current knowledge of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), the rarest form of gestational trophoblastic disease. PSTT represents neoplastic transformation of intermediate trophoblast and can follow any pregnancy type. Its behaviour is variable, and metastatic disease can be difficult to control despite surgery and chemotherapy. Mitotic index has emerged as an important prognostic indicator, and newer chemotherapy regimens have improved response in metastatic disease.

title: Cutaneous metastasis of gestational choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の皮膚転移
summary_ja: 40歳女性の妊娠性絨毛癌で、胸壁の皮下腫瘤、性器出血、子宮増大を呈した症例である。胸部X線と肝超音波検査で転移が確認され、生検で絨毛癌と診断された。メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミドによる治療で臨床的・画像的に完全寛解し、尿妊娠検査は陰性化した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with subcutaneous chest-wall masses, abnormal vaginal bleeding and an enlarged uterus. Chest X-ray and liver ultrasound showed metastases, and biopsy confirmed choriocarcinoma. Treatment with methotrexate, actinomycin-D and cyclophosphamide produced complete clinical and radiological resolution, and the urinary pregnancy test became negative.

title: The cancer-testis gene, NY-ESO-1, is expressed in normal fetal and adult testes and in spermatocytic seminomas and testicular carcinoma in situ.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍におけるがん精巣抗原NY-ESO-1の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣の正常組織と59例の精巣腫瘍におけるがん精巣抗原NY-ESO-1の発現を免疫組織化学で解析した。胎児精巣では妊娠18週から出生まで発現し、成人では精原細胞と一次精母細胞に認められた。古典的セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞には発現がなく、精巣上皮内癌と精母細胞性セミノーマでは発現していた。
summary_en: This immunohistochemistry study examined the cancer-testis antigen NY-ESO-1 in normal fetal and adult testes and in 59 testicular tumours. NY-ESO-1 was expressed from 18 weeks gestation in fetal testes and in adult spermatogonia and primary spermatocytes. It was absent from classical seminomas and nonseminomatous germ cells, but present in carcinoma in situ and spermatocytic seminomas. The authors suggest it may mark early testicular tumorigenesis.

title: Immunohistochemical heterogeneity of type 1 blood group antigen expressions in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における1型血液型抗原発現の免疫組織化学的不均一性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 30例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、1型血液型抗原(DU-PAN-2、CA19-9、ルイス a/b)を免疫組織化学で検討した。DU-PAN-2はすべての胎児性癌で発現し、CA19-9は53%で陽性だった。ルイス抗原は主に奇形腫に限局し、絨毛癌は全抗体で陰性であった。両者の併用解析は病理診断の確認に有用とされる。
summary_en: This study analysed type 1 blood group antigens (DU-PAN-2, CA19-9, Lewis a and b) by immunohistochemistry in 30 testicular germ cell tumours. DU-PAN-2 was expressed in all embryonal carcinomas, and CA19-9 in 53%. Lewis antigens were largely restricted to teratomas, while choriocarcinomas were negative for all antibodies. The authors conclude that combined DU-PAN-2 and CA19-9 analysis helps confirm histological diagnosis, though the value of DU-PAN-2 as a tumour marker needs clarification.

title: Oligodendroglioma arising in a sacrococcygeal immature teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部未熟奇形腫内に生じた乏突起膠腫
summary_ja: 生後2か月の女児で、仙尾部未熟奇形腫の内部に生じた乏突起膠腫の症例である。組織学的には成人の低悪性度乏突起膠腫と類似していた。未熟奇形腫がグレードIIであったため補助化学療法を行ったが、手術切除後6か月で腹腔内腫瘍の進行により死亡した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 2-month-old girl with an oligodendroglioma arising within a sacrococcygeal immature teratoma. Histologically the tumour resembled low-grade adult oligodendroglioma. Because the immature teratoma was grade II, the patient received adjuvant chemotherapy. Despite surgical excision, she died of progression of an intra-abdominal tumour six months later. The authors believe this is the first such report in the world literature.

title: Growth-associated gene expression profiles by microarray analysis of trophoblast of molar pregnancies and normal villi.
title_ja: 完全奇胎と正常絨毛の栄養膜における成長関連遺伝子発現のマイクロアレイ解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 完全奇胎の栄養膜を正常絨毛と比較し、589個の細胞増殖関連遺伝子をマイクロアレイで解析した。奇胎では57遺伝子が上昇し、Ras-MAPK、JAK-STAT5、Wnt経路の関与が示唆された。抗アポトーシスや接着に関わる遺伝子の上昇も認められた。完全奇胎の増殖調節と病態の理解に寄与すると考えられる。
summary_en: Microarray analysis of 589 growth-control genes compared trophoblast from complete hydatidiform moles with normal villi. Fifty-seven genes were up-regulated in moles, implicating Ras-MAPK, JAK-STAT5 and Wnt pathways in trophoblastic hyperplasia, along with anti-apoptotic and adhesion genes. Fewer genes were down-regulated, including IGFBPs, versican and CD44. The findings may clarify proliferation regulation and the pathological phenotype of complete moles, which carry a high propensity for choriocarcinoma.

title: Prostatic tissue in mature cystic teratomas of the ovary: a report of four cases, including one with features of prostatic adenocarcinoma, and cytogenetic studies.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の前立腺組織：前立腺腺癌様所見を伴う1例を含む4症例と細胞遺伝学的検討
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫4例（17～38歳）に前立腺組織が認められ、大半は良性であった。1例では前立腺腺癌様の浸潤性腺管がみられ、PSAとPSAPの免疫組織化学で前立腺由来と確認された。細胞遺伝学的検討では多くの核がXXを示し、一部の核でX染色体の3倍体が認められた。卵巣奇形腫内の前立腺組織の報告は少ない。
summary_en: Four mature cystic teratomas of the ovary (patients aged 17-38) contained prostatic tissue, mostly benign. One tumor showed infiltrating prostatic-type glands with Gleason grade 3 features, interpreted as adenocarcinoma and confirmed by PSA and PSAP immunostaining. Cytogenetic studies in two cases showed an XX karyotype, with 3-5% of nuclei trisomic for the X chromosome. Only a few earlier cases of prostatic tissue in ovarian teratoma have been reported, and none had carcinoma morphology.

title: Infantile and adult testicular germ cell tumors. a different pathogenesis?
title_ja: 乳児と成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍：発症機序は異なるのか
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 乳児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍3例（いずれも卵黄嚢腫瘍）の細胞遺伝学的解析では、高度な異常核型が認められた。成人例に特徴的な12p等染色体は見られず、1、3、6番染色体の構造異常が反復していた。文献と合わせ、乳児と成人では発症機序が異なると考察している。
summary_en: Cytogenetic analysis of three infantile testicular germ cell tumors, all diagnosed as yolk sac tumors, showed highly abnormal karyotypes. Unlike adult tumors, none had the characteristic isochromosome 12p, and recurrent structural abnormalities involved chromosomes 1, 3 and 6. Combined with literature data, the authors suggest that infantile and adult testicular germ cell tumors have different origins and pathogenetic pathways. Chromosome 1, 3 and 6 aberrations may be important in infantile yolk sac tumors.

title: Restoration of TGF-beta regulation of plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 in Smad3-restituted human choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: Smad3を再導入したヒト絨毛癌細胞におけるPAI-1のTGF-β制御の回復
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 悪性絨毛癌細胞（JAR、JEG-3）はSmad3を欠失しTGF-βに抵抗性を示した。JAR細胞にSmad3を再導入するとTGF-β1でPAI-1が増加しuPAが減少し、正常絨毛外栄養膜細胞に近い応答が回復した。Smad3の喪失が絨毛癌の抗浸潤シグナルへの抵抗性に関与すると結論している。
summary_en: Malignant choriocarcinoma cells (JAR and JEG-3) lacked Smad3 and were resistant to TGF-beta. Restoring Smad3 in JAR cells produced a clone that upregulated PAI-1 and downregulated uPA in response to TGF-beta1, restoring the normal extravillous trophoblast response. The original JAR cells did not respond. The authors conclude that loss of Smad3 may contribute to the resistance of choriocarcinoma cells to anti-invasive TGF-beta signalling.

title: Testicular germ cell cancer despite previous local radiotherapy to the testis.
title_ja: 局所放射線療法後の精巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 片側精巣腫瘍と対側精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）を有する2例が、残存精巣に20 Gyの局所放射線療法を受けた。その後両者に胚細胞腫瘍が発生し、一方は7年後に純粋なセミノーマ、もう一方は5年後に胎児性癌とセミノーマの混合腫瘍となった。いずれも精巣摘除術で治療され、周囲組織にはTINが残存していた。著者らは、放射線抵抗性のTIN細胞の一部が照射後も進行する可能性を提唱している。
summary_en: Two patients with unilateral testicular tumour and contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) received 20 Gy local radiotherapy to the remaining testis. Both later developed germ cell neoplasms: one pure seminoma after seven years and one combined embryonal carcinoma and seminoma after five years. Both were treated by orchiectomy, and TIN persisted in the surrounding tissue. The authors propose that a small radioresistant TIN cell fraction may progress despite irradiation.

title: Intratubular germ cell neoplasia of the testis: testicular intraepithelial neoplasia.
title_ja: 精巣の管内胚細胞腫瘍：精巣上皮内腫瘍
summary_ja: 本総説は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の多くの共通前駆病変である管内胚細胞腫瘍・未分類型（IGCNU）、別名精巣上皮内腫瘍について述べている。生検陽性の患者の約50%が5年以内に浸潤性腫瘍を発症する。片側病変では精巣摘除術、両側病変では低線量放射線が選択されるが、後者は不妊をもたらす。化学療法後の再発IGCNUの推定率は5年で21%、10年で42%とされている。
summary_en: This review describes intratubular germ cell neoplasia, unclassified type (IGCNU), also called testicular intraepithelial neoplasia, as the common precursor of most testicular germ cell tumours. About 50% of biopsy-positive patients develop invasive tumours by five years. Orchiectomy is preferred for unilateral disease and low-dose radiation for bilateral disease, though this sterilizes. Recurrent IGCNU after chemotherapy was estimated at 21% at five years and 42% at ten years.

title: Mediastinal immature teratoma with yolk sac tumor and myelomonocytic leukemia associated with Klinefelter's syndrome.
title_ja: クラインフェルター症候群に伴う縦隔未熟奇形腫・卵黄嚢腫瘍および骨髄単球性白血病
summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の14歳男児が、縦隔腫瘍により胸痛を呈した症例報告。病理学的には卵黄嚢腫瘍を伴う未熟奇形腫で、白血病性芽球が腫瘍および血管内に浸潤していた。手術中の大量出血により術後1週間で死亡した。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍と白血病の合併という稀な組み合わせを示す。
summary_en: A 14-year-old boy with Klinefelter syndrome presented with chest pain and a mediastinal mass. Histology showed immature teratoma with a yolk sac tumor component. Leukemic blasts with myelomonocytic features infiltrated the tumor and blood vessels, and the karyotype showed additional chromosomal abnormalities. Surgery was complicated by massive hemorrhage, and the patient died one week postoperatively. The report describes a rare association of mediastinal germ cell tumor with leukemia in Klinefelter syndrome.

title: Posterior leukoencephalopathy following cisplatin, bleomycin and vinblastine therapy for germ cell tumor of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法後の後部白質脳症
summary_ja: 病期Icの卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた31歳女性が、けいれん発作を繰り返した。臨床像と画像所見は後部白質脳症に一致した。抗けいれん薬で発作は制御され、フォローアップの磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で2週間後には所見が完全に消失した。治療開始前に中枢神経系への毒性を考慮すべきと論じている。
summary_en: A 31-year-old woman with stage Ic ovarian germ cell tumor developed recurrent seizures after cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin chemotherapy. Clinical and imaging features were consistent with posterior leukoencephalopathy, a rare chemotherapy complication. Seizures were controlled with phenytoin, and she recovered without permanent deficits. Follow-up MRI two weeks later showed complete resolution. The authors advise clinicians to consider this central nervous system toxicity before starting cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

title: Primary pleuro-pulmonary malignant germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 原発性胸膜肺悪性胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 呼吸器症状が急速に進行した若年男性2例で、肺および胸膜に原発した悪性胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。1例は偽中皮腫様の増殖を示す純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍、もう1例は右肺に生じた混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。両例ともαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が免疫組織化学的に確認された。性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍として極めてまれな部位である。
summary_en: Two young males presented with rapidly progressive respiratory symptoms and were found to have primary malignant germ cell tumors of the lung and pleura. One was a pure yolk sac tumor with a pseudomesotheliomatous growth pattern. The other was a yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma mixture arising in the right lung. Alpha-fetoprotein was demonstrated immunohistochemically in both cases. The report documents an extremely rare extragonadal site for germ cell tumors.

title: Alternating dose-dense chemotherapy in patients with high volume disseminated non-seminomatous germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 高容量播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する用量強化型交互化学療法
summary_ja: 高容量の播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍58例を対象とした第II相試験。用量強化型BOP-CISCA-POMB-ACEレジメンにより72.4%が完全奏効し、3年無増悪生存率は71%、3年全生存率は73%であった。グレード4の血液毒性が多く、早期死亡が4例あった。中間予後および予後不良群で高い有効性を示すと結論している。
summary_en: A phase II trial of a dose-dense alternating chemotherapy regimen (BOP-CISCA-POMB-ACE with G-CSF) in 58 patients with high-volume disseminated non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Of these patients, 72% achieved complete response, with 3-year PFS of 71% and 3-year OS of 73%. Grade 4 neutropenia and thrombocytopenia were common, and four early deaths occurred. The authors conclude the regimen is highly active in intermediate- and poor-prognosis disease.

title: In-vivo proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy in adnexal lesions.
title_ja: 付属器病変のin vivoプロトン磁気共鳴スペクトロスコピー
summary_ja: 術前に付属器病変31例で1H磁気共鳴スペクトロスコピーを施行した。悪性卵巣腫瘍と良性奇形腫では1.3 ppmの脂質ピークが認められ、良性上皮性腫瘍では認められなかった。脂質/水比は病変群で異なり、一部の奇形腫では高値を示した。付属器病変の鑑別診断に有用な可能性がある。
summary_en: Thirty-one patients with adnexal lesions underwent short-echo STEAM proton MR spectroscopy before surgery. Malignant ovarian tumors and benign teratomas showed a lipid peak at 1.3 ppm, whereas benign epithelial tumors lacked it and sometimes showed an olefinic peak at 5.2 ppm. Lipid-to-water ratios differed between groups and were characteristically high in some teratomas. The authors conclude that MR spectroscopy may help differentiate adnexal lesions.

title: Detection of hCG in trophoblastic disease. The USA hCG reference service experience.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるhCGの検出：米国hCG参照サービスの経験
summary_ja: hCGおよびその関連分子の構造と、胞状奇胎、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患、絨毛癌などにおける出現様式を整理した総説。市販の血清hCG検査がどの分子を検出するかを評価し、偽陽性の多い検査を特定した。妊娠も悪性腫瘍もないのに低値が持続する例にも言及している。不要な治療を避けるためのhCG検査選択指針を示す。
summary_en: This review examines the structure of hCG and its related molecules and their occurrence in normal pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, choriocarcinoma and other malignancies. It evaluates which commercial serum hCG assays detect these molecules, identifies assays prone to false-positive results, and discusses persistent low hCG without pregnancy or malignancy. Guidelines for selecting an hCG test are proposed to avoid unnecessary treatment of gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Advances in management of high-risk gestational trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の治療の進歩
summary_ja: 高リスク転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する集学的治療の総説です。多剤化学療法と補助放射線療法・外科的切除により治癒率は80～90%に達します。一方、患者の25～30%は初回治療に不応または再発し、絨毛癌や多発転移例に多く見られます。救援化学療法により大半は治癒し、新規薬剤や大量化学療法の役割も示唆されています。
summary_en: This review summarizes multimodality management of high-risk metastatic gestational trophoblastic tumors. Combination chemotherapy with etoposide, high-dose methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide and vincristine, plus adjuvant radiotherapy and surgery, achieves cure rates of 80-90%. However, 25-30% of high-risk patients respond incompletely or relapse, typically those with choriocarcinoma, multisite metastases and prior failed chemotherapy. Salvage regimens with cisplatin/etoposide, usually with bleomycin or ifosfamide, plus resection of resistant disease, cure most patients. Colony-stimulating factors, newer agents and high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support may play future roles.

title: Twenty-five years' clinical experience with placental site trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の25年間の臨床経験
summary_ja: チャリング・クロス病院での25年間の後方視的解析で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患1,685例中34例の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）を検討しています。性器出血が主症状で、肺転移と最終妊娠から4年以上の経過が死亡の危険因子でした。子宮限局例は手術単独で治癒することが多く、WHOスコアは予後と相関しませんでした。
summary_en: This retrospective series from Charing Cross Hospital describes 34 cases of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) among 1,685 gestational trophoblastic disease patients treated over 25 years. Most presented with vaginal bleeding, and hCG levels were typically low. Lung metastases and an interval of four years or more since the antecedent pregnancy were associated with death. Patients with disease confined to the uterus were often cured by surgery alone. The WHO scoring system did not correlate with outcome, and the authors recommend managing PSTT separately from other types of GTD.

title: Toxicity of high-dose carboplatin: ultrafiltered and not total plasma pharmacokinetics is of clinical relevance.
title_ja: 高用量カルボプラチンの毒性：全血漿ではなく限外濾過の薬物動態が臨床的に重要である
summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍に対する高用量カルボプラチン併用療法を受けた29例で、全白金と限外濾過白金の薬物動態を比較しています。全白金の半減期は限外濾過白金の約4倍と長く、長期残留が示されました。限外濾過白金の濃度とAUCは、クレアチニン上昇や高用量治療に伴う毒性と有意に相関し、臨床での測定が推奨されています。
summary_en: This pharmacokinetic study of 29 patients receiving high-dose carboplatin for poor-risk germ cell tumors compares total and ultrafiltered platinum. Total platinum had a terminal half-life over five days, about four times longer than ultrafiltered platinum, indicating long-term retention. Ultrafiltered platinum concentrations and AUC correlated with creatinine rise and high-dose toxicities, whereas total platinum did not. Low ultrafiltered levels did not impair hematologic recovery. The authors recommend measuring ultrafiltered concentrations in high-dose treatment.

title: Malignant ovarian germ cell tumors: the KK Hospital experience.
title_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍：KK病院の経験
summary_ja: KK Women's and Children's Hospitalによる本後方視的レビューは、13年間に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の49例を対象とする。未熟奇形腫が49%で最も多い組織型であり、81.6%は病期Iであった。多くの患者は手術の後に補助化学療法を受け、その割合は67.3%であった。平均約52か月のフォローアップで87.8%が生存して無病であり、再発は1例のみであった。その後に複数の患者が先天異常のない妊娠に成功した。著者らは、卵巣機能と妊孕性を保つため、温存的手術と併用化学療法を重視している。
summary_en: This retrospective review from KK Women's and Children's Hospital covers 49 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated over 13 years. Immature teratoma was the most common histology at 49%, and 81.6% had stage I disease. Most patients underwent surgery followed by adjuvant chemotherapy, given to 67.3%. With mean follow-up of about 52 months, 87.8% remained alive and disease-free, with a single recurrence. Several patients later had successful pregnancies without congenital anomalies. The authors emphasize combination chemotherapy with conservative surgery to preserve ovarian function and fertility.

title: The use of preferences to measure the benefit of adjuvant radiation therapy for stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する補助放射線療法の利益を選好により測定する試み
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 本研究は、健康な男性100名から得たユーティリティ値を用い、病期Iセミノーマに対する補助放射線療法の生活の質における価値を評価した。参加者は、再発リスク5%の補助RTや再発リスク20%の精巣摘除術のみなど5つの健康状態を、標準ゲンブル法で評価した。再発がない状態のユーティリティが最も高く、化学療法で救済された再発が最も低かった。参加者は、RTによる再発リスクの15%の絶対的低下を重視しなかった。著者らは、費用対効果分析にこれらのユーティリティを用いる予定である。
summary_en: This study uses utility measurements from 100 healthy men to assess the quality-of-life value of adjuvant radiotherapy for stage I seminoma. Participants rated five health states using the standard gamble technique, including adjuvant RT with 5% recurrence risk, orchiectomy alone with 20% risk, and recurrences salvaged with either RT or chemotherapy. Non-recurrent states had the highest utilities, and recurrence salvaged with chemotherapy had the lowest. Participants did not value the 15% absolute reduction in recurrence risk from RT. The authors plan to use these utilities for cost-effectiveness analysis.

title: Mature mediastinal teratoma: sonographic imaging patterns and pathologic correlation.
title_ja: 縦隔奇形腫の超音波画像パターンと病理学的相関
summary_ja: 外科的に確定した縦隔奇形腫28例を後方視的に解析し、超音波所見の3つの型（不均一な複雑腫瘤、均一な高エコー腫瘤、嚢胞内の浮遊球）を提示した。いずれも脂肪・毛髪・皮脂などの成熟組織成分の組み合わせを反映していた。超音波検査は縦隔奇形腫の診断向上に有用だが、感度と特異度の検証には前向き研究が必要とされる。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 28 surgically confirmed mediastinal teratomas describes three sonographic patterns: a complex heterogeneous mass with internal fat, hair, and mineralized elements; a homogeneous hyperechoic solid mass chiefly containing hair and sebaceous material; and floating spherules within a cystic mass. Pathologic correlation showed these features reflect varying combinations of mature tissue components. The authors conclude that sonography can improve diagnosis of mediastinal teratoma, while noting that prospective studies are needed to establish sensitivity and specificity.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy.
title_ja: 化学療法後の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 全身化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘤に対し、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った7例を後方視的に検討した。7例中5例で完遂され、重篤な合併症は42.8%に認めたが死亡例はなかった。実施は可能だが難易度が高く、経験豊富な施設で適応を絞るべきとされる。
summary_en: This retrospective review of seven patients describes laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection performed after systemic chemotherapy, mostly for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Laparoscopic RPLND was completed in 5 of 7 patients, with two conversions to open surgery. Complications occurred in 57.1 percent, with major complications in 42.8 percent, and no deaths. Pathology showed mature teratoma in three nodal specimens. The authors conclude the approach is feasible but challenging and should be limited to selected patients at experienced centers.

title: Cardiac tamponade caused by intrapericardial yolk sac tumor in a boy.
title_ja: 少年の心膜内卵黄嚢腫瘍による心タンポナーデ
summary_ja: 17歳男児に生じた縦隔腫瘤が上大静脈閉塞と心タンポナーデを来した症例を報告する。生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、心膜への浸潤が認められた。手術と補助化学療法後、20か月間再発は認めなかった。まれな病変であり、心膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍のMRI所見の認識に寄与する。
summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old boy with a mediastinal mass causing superior vena cava obstruction, cardiac tamponade, and pleural effusion. Imaging and biopsy identified a yolk sac tumor that had involved the pericardium, a rare site. After surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy, the patient remained free of recurrence over 20 months of follow-up. The report focuses on the magnetic resonance imaging characteristics of this pericardial yolk sac tumor, which may help recognition of this uncommon presentation.

title: Low expression of DNA polymerase beta in human testicular germ cell tumours--impact on foetal gonocytic origin theory.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるDNAポリメラーゼβの低発現：胎児性腺細胞起源説への影響
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、テロメア長とDNAポリメラーゼβの発現を解析した。ポリメラーゼβの発現は低かった。その結果、セミノーマと非セミノーマは、形質転換した胎児原始細胞から独立して生じることが示唆された。胎児性腺細胞由来説の検討に寄与する研究であり、発生機序の理解に重要である。
summary_en: This study examines telomere length and DNA polymerase beta expression in adult testicular germ cell tumours, which show low polymerase beta expression. The authors propose models of pathogenesis and suggest that seminoma and nonseminoma derive independently from transformed fetal primordial cells. These findings bear on the fetal gonocytic origin theory and address how the two main histological types may arise.

title: Gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma associated with XY gonadal dysgenesis in an adolescent with chronic renal failure: a case of Frasier syndrome.
title_ja: XY性腺異形成を伴う性腺芽腫およびディスジャーミノーマ：Frasier症候群の一例
summary_ja: Frasier症候群（XY性腺異形成と腎不全）の16歳女性に生じた性腺芽腫と限局性ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告である。免疫組織化学では性腺芽腫のみインヒビンが陽性であった。アンドロゲン受容体遺伝子に変異は認められなかった。インヒビン陽性は内分泌活性を示し、思春期早発に関与しうると考えられる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old female with Frasier syndrome, XY gonadal dysgenesis, and chronic renal failure who developed gonadoblastoma with focal dysgerminoma in a dysgenetic gonad. Bilateral gonadectomy was performed. Immunohistochemistry showed inhibin positivity in gonadoblastoma but not in dysgerminoma. No androgen receptor gene mutations were found. The authors suggest that inhibin expression in the gonadal stroma may reflect hormonal activity contributing to advanced puberty in such patients.

title: A patient with primary gastric choriocarcinoma who received a correct preoperative diagnosis and achieved prolonged survival.
title_ja: 術前に正しく診断され長期生存を得た原発性胃絨毛癌の1例
summary_ja: 68歳男性が心窩部痛とめまいで受診し、腫瘍マーカー高値、画像検査、生検の免疫組織化学染色から術前に原発性胃絨毛癌と領域リンパ節転移と診断された。胃全摘術と術後化学療法を施行され、切除標本では典型的な絨毛癌と腺癌成分を認めた。血清hCGが経過評価に有用であり、患者は術後4年6か月間再発なく生存した。
summary_en: A 68-year-old man presented with epigastric pain, abdominal fullness, and dizziness and was diagnosed preoperatively with primary gastric choriocarcinoma with regional lymph node metastases, based on elevated tumor marker levels, radiography, and immunohistochemistry of biopsy specimens. He underwent total gastrectomy with Roux-en-Y reconstruction and postoperative chemotherapy. Histology showed typical choriocarcinoma with adenocarcinomatous elements. He survived 4 years and 6 months without recurrence, and serum hCG proved a useful marker for reassessment.

title: Mature cystic teratoma involving adrenal gland.
title_ja: 副腎に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 57歳女性の副腎腫瘤が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と判明した症例報告である。病変は主に副腎傍部に存在したが、副腎皮質を部分的に破壊しており、副腎内起源は否定できなかった。極めて稀な病変で、ホルモン非産生性副腎腫瘍の鑑別診断に含めるべきとされる。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)での辺縁の輪状石灰化と脂肪濃度が診断の助けとなる。
summary_en: A 57-year-old woman presented with an adrenal mass that proved to be a mature cystic teratoma. The lesion was predominantly paraadrenal but focally interrupted the adrenal cortex, so an intraadrenal origin could not be excluded. The authors note such lesions are extremely rare and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of hormonally silent adrenal tumors. Rim-like calcification and fatty density on computed tomography may aid diagnosis.

title: Clinical use of serum TRA-1-60 as tumor marker in patients with germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者における腫瘍マーカーとしての血清TRA-1-60の臨床的有用性
summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍34例、病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍28例、病期I純粋セミノーマ40例で血清TRA-1-60を評価した。化学療法前の播種性胎児性癌陽性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の約78%で上昇し、治療後に有意に低下した。一方、病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の約3分の1は再発なく上昇を示し、偽陽性が多いため現時点では有用な腫瘍マーカーとは言えないと結論された。
summary_en: This study evaluated serum TRA-1-60 as a tumor marker in 34 patients with disseminated germ cell tumors, 28 with stage I NSGCT, and 40 with stage I pure seminoma. TRA-1-60 was elevated in about 78% of disseminated EC-positive NSGCT before chemotherapy and fell significantly afterward. However, about a third of stage I NSGCT patients had elevations without relapse, and false positives limit its clinical reliability. The authors conclude TRA-1-60 is not presently useful as a tumor marker.

title: Hypothyroidism following struma ovarii tumor resection: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫切除後に発症した甲状腺機能低下症
journal: Rev Hosp Clin Fac Med Sao Paulo
summary_ja: 62歳女性が卵巣甲状腺腫の切除6日後に甲状腺機能低下症を発症した症例報告です。TSHの上昇と甲状腺ホルモンの低値を認め、サイロキシン補充療法で症状は消失しました。切除後の甲状腺機能評価の重要性を示しています。
summary_en: A 62-year-old woman developed clinical hypothyroidism six days after resection of a right ovary containing struma ovarii. Laboratory tests showed elevated TSH and low thyroxine, and thyroxine replacement made her asymptomatic. The authors note that malignant struma ovarii has been linked to hyperthyroidism, but this is the first reported case of hypothyroidism after struma ovarii resection in a previously asymptomatic woman. The report highlights the need to monitor thyroid function after such surgery.

title: Immunohistochemical studies of caveolin-3 in germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるカベオリン3の免疫組織化学的研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の免疫組織化学的解析で、カベオリン3はセミノーマの12/16例で陽性でした。正常精巣や非セミノーマ成分では陽性所見は認められず、腫瘍浸潤免疫細胞数との相関傾向も示されました。胚細胞腫瘍へのカベオリン3の関与を示した初めての報告です。
summary_en: This study examined caveolin-1 and caveolin-3 expression by immunohistochemistry in 16 seminomas, 10 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, and normal testis. Caveolin-3 was expressed in 12 of 16 seminomas but not in normal tissue or nonseminomatous components, except muscle within teratoma. iNOS was not detected. Caveolin-3 expression tended to correlate with more tumor-infiltrating immune cells, though not significantly. The authors report the first evidence linking caveolin-3 to germ cell tumors.

title: Sexual precocity and recurrent beta-human chorionic gonadotropin upsurges preceding the diagnosis of a malignant mediastinal germ-cell tumor in a 9-year-old boy.
title_ja: 9歳男児における思春期早発症と再発性β-hCG上昇を先行した悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 9歳男児が思春期早発症と一過性のβ-hCG上昇を繰り返し、2年後にMRIで縦隔腫瘍が確認されました。繰り返す血清β-hCG上昇を伴う縦隔絨毛癌の初例とされています。自然に低下するβ-hCG変動の原因は不明です。
summary_en: A 9-year-old boy presented with sexual precocity and recurrent transient elevations of serum beta-hCG over two years. Repeated imaging of the mediastinum did not reveal a lesion until magnetic resonance imaging identified a mediastinal tumor. The authors describe this as the first case of mediastinal choriocarcinoma diagnosed with recurrent serum beta-hCG elevation. The factors responsible for the repeated spontaneous beta-hCG declines remain unknown.

title: Absence of c-KIT and members of the epidermal growth factor receptor family in refractory germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍におけるc-KITおよびEGFRファミリーの欠如
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍22例で、c-KITおよびEGFRファミリーの発現とERBB2遺伝子増幅を解析し、化学感受性の12例と比較しました。両群に差はなく、大半の難治例は分子標的薬の対象にはならないと結論しています。
summary_en: This study assessed c-KIT and EGFR family receptors by immunohistochemistry and ERBB2 gene amplification by FISH in 22 cisplatin-resistant germ cell tumors, comparing them with 12 chemosensitive advanced tumors. No differences were found between the groups. c-KIT was present in one pure seminoma and in seminomatous components, while EGFR was restricted to trophoblastic elements of nonseminomas. Only one choriocarcinoma showed ERBB2 amplification. The authors conclude that most refractory tumors would not qualify for these targeted agents.

title: Salvage high-dose chemotherapy in patients with germ cell tumors: an Italian experience with 84 patients.
title_ja: イタリアにおける胚細胞腫瘍84例の救済大量化学療法の経験
summary_ja: 1986年から2000年の間に救済療法として大量化学療法を受けた胚細胞腫瘍84例の解析です。全体の33%が無病生存し、予後良好群では69%でした。予後不良群では無病生存例はなく、治療関連死は中間リスク群と不良リスク群のみで認められました。
summary_en: This Italian series reviewed 84 patients with germ cell tumors, aged 15 to 50, who received 105 courses of high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic stem cell support as salvage therapy between 1986 and 2000. Patients were classified by a validated prognostic index. Overall, 33% remained continuously disease-free. Among good-risk patients, 69% were disease-free, compared with 13% of intermediate-risk patients and none of the poor-risk patients. Treatment-related mortality occurred only in intermediate- and poor-risk groups.

title: Treatment outcome, body image, and sexual functioning after orchiectomy and radiotherapy for Stage I-II testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 病期I–II精巣セミノーマに対する精巣摘除術と放射線療法後の治療成績、身体イメージおよび性機能
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 病期I–II精巣セミノーマ166例を対象とした後方視的研究で、精巣摘除術と横隔膜下照射後の身体イメージと性機能を質問票で評価した。再発は3例のみだった。性的関心や勃起機能は健常対照と差がなかったが、治療後は勃起困難が増加していた。治療は有効で忍容性も良好と結論された。
summary_en: A retrospective Dutch study of 166 patients with Stage I-II testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy followed by infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy. Questionnaires sent about 51 months after treatment (78% responded) assessed body image and sexual function. Relapse occurred in only 3 patients. Sexual interest and erectile function were comparable to age-matched healthy controls, although erectile difficulties increased after treatment and correlated with age. Twenty percent expressed fertility concerns, and 52% felt their body had changed. The authors conclude the regimen is effective and well tolerated.

title: HLA-G immunoreactivity is specific for intermediate trophoblast in gestational trophoblastic disease and can serve as a useful marker in differential diagnosis.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の鑑別診断におけるHLA-G免疫反応性：中間型トロホブラストに特異的なマーカー
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の各病変でHLA-G免疫染色を検討し、全トロホブラスト病変で陽性、非トロホブラスト性子宮腫瘍では陰性だった。染色パターンは中間型トロホブラストの亜型と対応し、絨毛癌は絨毛型由来が示唆された。HLA-Gは鑑別診断に有用なマーカーと結論された。
summary_en: Immunohistochemistry with the HLA-G antibody 4H84 was tested on gestational trophoblastic disease lesions, including 14 choriocarcinomas, 14 placental site trophoblastic tumors, 13 epithelioid trophoblastic tumors, 16 placental site nodules, and nine exaggerated placental sites. Thirty-four nontrophoblastic uterine neoplasms served as controls. HLA-G was positive in all trophoblastic lesions and negative in nontrophoblastic neoplasms. Staining patterns matched different intermediate trophoblast subtypes, and choriocarcinoma appeared related to villous-type intermediate trophoblast. The authors conclude that HLA-G is a useful marker for differential diagnosis.

title: New perspectives on therapy for vaginal endodermal sinus tumors.
title_ja: 膣原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の治療に関する新たな知見
summary_ja: 単一施設で治療した膣原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児3例を後方視的に検討した。無痛性の出血が共通の初発症状だった。初回化学療法で2例のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は速やかに正常化し、無病生存中である。残る1例は救済治療後に無病生存を得た。化学療法を第一選択とし、骨髄移植は救済療法として検討すべきと結論された。
summary_en: A retrospective review of three children with vaginal endodermal sinus tumor treated at a single institution. All presented with painless bleeding without an obvious source. Two received initial combination chemotherapy, with alpha-fetoprotein normalizing rapidly, and both remain disease-free. The third patient progressed after chemotherapy, then received salvage surgery, radiation, further chemotherapy, and autologous bone marrow transplant, and has been disease-free for 6.5 years. The authors recommend chemotherapy as primary treatment, endoscopic evaluation of the lower genitourinary tract, and bone marrow transplant only as a salvage option.

title: Neutral endopeptidase/CD10 expression during phorbol ester-induced differentiation of choriocarcinoma cells through the protein kinase C- and extracellular signal-regulated kinase-dependent signalling pathway.
title_ja: ホルボールエステル誘導性BeWo絨毛癌細胞分化におけるNEP/CD10発現：PKC依存性MEK/ERK経路の関与
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞をPMAで分化誘導し、形態変化とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌を確認した。PMAはNEP/CD10発現を用量・時間依存的に増加させ、PKC阻害剤およびMEK阻害剤で消失した。ERK1/2のリン酸化を伴い、PKC依存性MEK/ERK経路を介したNEP/CD10発現の亢進が示された。
summary_en: BeWo choriocarcinoma cells were induced to differentiate with phorbol ester (PMA), confirmed by morphological change and hCG secretion. PMA increased neutral endopeptidase (NEP/CD10) expression in a dose- and time-dependent manner. This effect was abolished by the PKC inhibitor Bis I and the MEK inhibitor PD98059, and PMA induced ERK1/2 phosphorylation. The authors conclude that NEP/CD10 is upregulated through a PKC-dependent MEK/ERK pathway and may play a functional role in trophoblast differentiation.

title: Long-term experience with carboplatin monotherapy for clinical stage I seminoma: a retrospective single-center study.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマに対するカルボプラチン単剤療法の長期成績：後方視的単施設研究
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ108例に、精巣摘除後の補助療法としてカルボプラチン2サイクルの単剤療法を行い、平均約60か月追跡した後方視的単施設研究。再発は2例(1.85%)のみで、いずれも救援化学療法により全例が無病生存。血液毒性は主に軽度で、放射線療法の代替として有望と結論づけている。
summary_en: This single-center retrospective study evaluated long-term outcomes of two adjuvant cycles of carboplatin monotherapy in 108 patients with clinical stage I seminoma treated after orchiectomy between 1990 and 2001. Over a mean follow-up of about 60 months, only two patients (1.85%) relapsed with retroperitoneal disease within the first year. Both received cisplatin-based salvage chemotherapy, and all patients were alive without evidence of disease. Hematologic toxicity was mostly mild, with no neutropenic fever. The authors conclude that carboplatin monotherapy is highly effective and well tolerated, offering an alternative to radiotherapy and surveillance.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection: description of the nerve-sparing technique.
title_ja: 腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清における神経温存術式の記述
summary_ja: 腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清において、交感神経幹と節後神経を温存する片側術式を4ポート経腹膜アプローチで報告した手技論文。右側では腰静脈の切離により大静脈を授動し、神経を確認する。技術的に実施可能で、合併症の軽減と治療的適応の拡大に寄与しうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This technical report describes a nerve-sparing technique for laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) performed through a four-port transperitoneal approach. Laparoscopic RPLND is currently used for diagnosis in clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and for diagnosis and therapy in low-volume stage II disease after chemotherapy. The authors detail stepwise identification of the sympathetic trunk and postganglionic fibers, including division of the lumbar veins to mobilize the vena cava on the right side. They conclude that the technique is feasible and may reduce morbidity while expanding the therapeutic role of minimally invasive RPLND.

title: Successful treatment of mother and baby with metastatic choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の母体と新生児の治療に成功した症例
summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の母体と新生児の双方を救命しえた、2例目の成功例の報告。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の既往を持つ母体は白金製剤抵抗性であったが、パクリタキセルに奏効した。早期の疑いと診断により、母体と新生児の双方に速やかな治療を行うことができ、既往歴のある患者での高い警戒の重要性を示している。
summary_en: This report describes the second documented case of successful management of both a mother and her neonate with metastatic choriocarcinoma. The mother had a history of gestational trophoblastic disease and, after showing platinum-refractory disease, responded to paclitaxel. Early suspicion and diagnosis allowed prompt treatment of both mother and neonate. The report highlights the importance of a high index of suspicion for choriocarcinoma in patients with prior gestational trophoblastic disease and presents paclitaxel as an effective option for platinum-refractory disease.

title: Struma ovarii associated with pseudo-Meigs' syndrome and elevated serum CA 125.
title_ja: 偽Meigs症候群およびCA125高値を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 腹水・胸水・卵巣腫瘤・CA125高値を呈し、卵巣悪性腫瘍が疑われた65歳女性の症例報告。摘出標本は成熟甲状腺組織からなる卵巣甲状腺腫であった。偽Meigs症候群を呈し、CA125上昇を伴う本症例は英語文献で2例目と報告されている。卵巣甲状腺腫は腹水、胸水、CA125上昇の稀な原因であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old woman who presented with ascites, hydrothorax, a right ovarian mass, and elevated CA 125, initially suspicious for ovarian malignancy. Surgical removal revealed struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma composed mainly of mature thyroid tissue. The combination of ascites and hydrothorax was classified as pseudo-Meigs' syndrome. The authors note this is only the second English-language report of pseudo-Meigs' syndrome with elevated CA 125 caused by struma ovarii, and conclude that struma ovarii is a rare cause of these findings.

title: Case report: sacrococcygeal teratoma with malignant transformation in an adult female: CT and MRI findings.
title_ja: 成人女性にみられた悪性転化を伴う仙尾部奇形腫：CTおよびMRI所見（症例報告）
summary_ja: 45歳女性の仙尾部奇形腫で、腺癌性転化を伴う稀な成人例の症例報告。CTとMRIで嚢胞性・充実性混在腫瘤と隣接構造との関係を明瞭に描出し、正確な術前計画に寄与した。予後は完全切除の可否に依存し、本部位の稀な症例における画像評価の有用性を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old woman with sacrococcygeal teratoma showing adenocarcinomatous transformation, an uncommon presentation in adults. The authors present the clinical, histological, and imaging features of the tumour. CT and MRI showed a mixed cystic and solid mass, with its extent and relationships to adjacent structures clearly defined, enabling accurate preoperative planning. The report emphasizes that prognosis depends on complete excision and that imaging is valuable for surgical planning at this rare site.

title: [Long-term side effects of chemotherapy for testicular cancer].
title_ja: 精巣がんに対する化学療法の晩期有害事象
summary_ja: 1970年代にシスプラチン併用化学療法が導入されて以降、転移性精巣がん患者の多くが治癒するようになった。若年発症のため長期生存者が多く、化学療法の晩期毒性の評価が重要となっている。本稿では文献に基づいて晩期有害事象を概観し、その軽減に向けたアプローチを検討している。
summary_en: This review summarizes the literature on long-term side effects of chemotherapy in testicular cancer patients. Since cisplatin-based chemotherapy was introduced in the 1970s, most metastatic patients are cured, but because they are young, many survive for decades and late toxicities become clinically important. The article reviews reported late effects and discusses approaches to ameliorating them.

title: Testicular microlithiasis: prospective analysis of prevalence and associated tumor.
title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化の有病率と合併する精巣腫瘍：前向き解析
summary_ja: 精巣超音波検査を受けた男性1,079例を前向きに解析し、精巣微小石灰化の有病率と合併する精巣腫瘍との関連を検討した。精巣微小石灰化は18.1%に認められ、腫瘍は古典型で8%、限局型で5.8%、石灰化がない例では0.3%にみられた。腫瘍例の多くは石灰化を伴っていたが、石灰化を有する患者の90%以上は初診時に腫瘍を認めず、腫瘍スクリーニングの指標としての価値は限定的であった。
summary_en: This prospective study of 1,079 men undergoing scrotal ultrasonography evaluated testicular microlithiasis (TM) and its association with testicular tumors using high-frequency transducers. TM was found in 18.1% of patients. Tumors were present in 8% with classic TM, 5.8% with limited TM, and 0.3% without TM, mostly seminomas. Although most patients with tumors had coexisting TM, over 90% of patients with TM had no tumor at presentation, indicating limited value for tumor screening.

title: Mature teratoma arising in intraabdominal undescended testis in an infant with previous inguinal exploration: case report and review of intraabdominal testicular tumors in children.
title_ja: 鼠径部探索術の既往を有する乳児の腹腔内停留精巣に生じた成熟奇形腫：症例報告と小児の腹腔内精巣腫瘍の文献的検討
summary_ja: 触知しない精巣に対して鼠径部探索術を受けた既往のある5歳男児で、腹腔内停留精巣に生じた成熟奇形腫を報告した。小児の腹腔内精巣腫瘍26例を文献的に検討し、1歳未満では悪性奇形腫は認められなかったが未熟奇形腫が1例あった。手術時に腹腔内精巣を確認することの重要性が示され、成人の腹腔内悪性奇形腫の一部は乳児期の成熟奇形腫に由来する可能性が指摘された。
summary_en: This report describes a 5-year-old boy with a mature teratoma arising in an intraabdominal undescended testis, who had previously undergone inguinal exploration for an impalpable testis. The authors also review 26 pediatric intraabdominal testicular tumors from English and Japanese literature. No malignant teratomas were found in children under one year, although one immature teratoma occurred. The findings emphasize locating intraabdominal testes at surgery and suggest that some adult intraabdominal malignant teratomas may arise from infantile mature teratomas.

title: Spontaneous regression of retroperitoneal metastases from a primary pure anaplastic seminoma: a case report.
title_ja: 純粋未分化セミノーマの後腹膜転移の自然退縮：症例報告
summary_ja: 27歳男性（マリファナ喫煙者）で、高位後腹膜リンパ節に転移した純粋未分化セミノーマの症例。精巣摘除術後、いかなる薬物療法も行わずに後腹膜転移が自然退縮した。純粋セミノーマ転移の自然退縮は稀であり、後腹膜の未分化型転移での報告は本例が初めてとされる。考えられる機序は提唱されているが、詳細は依然として不明である。
summary_en: The authors report a 27-year-old man with metastatic pure anaplastic seminoma involving high retroperitoneal lymph nodes. After orchiectomy alone, without any further medication, the retroperitoneal metastases spontaneously regressed. Spontaneous regression of pure seminoma metastases is rare, and this is the first reported regression of anaplastic pure seminoma metastases in the retroperitoneum. Several mechanisms are proposed, but the phenomenon remains unexplained.

title: Management of clinical stage I testicular pure seminoma. Report on 42 patients and review of the literature.
title_ja: 臨床病期I精巣純粋セミノーマの管理：42例の報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 1977年から2000年に治療された臨床病期Iの精巣純粋セミノーマ42例を報告し、文献をレビューした。41例に補助放射線療法を施行し、1例はサーベイランスとした。再発率は4.7%、全生存率は97%であった。補助放射線療法は後腹膜の微小病変に対する安全な標準治療とされ、再発リスクに応じてサーベイランスや単剤カルボプラチンによる補助化学療法が代替として検討される。
summary_en: This study reviews 42 patients with clinical stage I pure testicular seminoma treated between 1977 and 2000, most of whom received adjuvant radiotherapy and one of whom was managed with surveillance. Relapse occurred in 4.7%, and overall survival was 97%. Classic histology was seen in 98% and small vessel invasion in 19%. The authors conclude that adjuvant radiotherapy is a safe standard for microscopic retroperitoneal disease, while surveillance and single-agent carboplatin are reasonable alternatives depending on relapse risk factors.

title: Management of testicular seminoma advanced disease. Report on 14 cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマの管理：14例の報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 1977年から2000年に治療された臨床病期II精巣純粋セミノーマの14例を報告し、文献を概観した。病期IIA-IIBには放射線療法、病期IICには化学療法を行った。再発例はなく、最終フォローアップ時には全例が生存し無病であった。初回化学療法、救援化学療法、大量化学療法、残存腫瘤に対するサーベイランスの基準について検討されている。
summary_en: This report describes 14 men with clinical stage II testicular pure seminoma treated between 1977 and 2000, together with a review of the literature. Radiotherapy was used for IIA-IIB disease and chemotherapy for IIC. No relapses occurred, and all patients were alive and disease-free at last follow-up. The review covers cisplatin- and carboplatin-based first-line regimens, salvage chemotherapy with cisplatin, ifosfamide and vinblastine, high-dose chemotherapy with autologous transplantation, and surveillance criteria for residual masses.

title: Frequent Fas gene mutations in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるFas遺伝子の高頻度変異
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍24例を対象に、レーザーキャプチャーマイクロダイセクションでFas遺伝子変異を組織型ごとに解析しました。9例（37.5%）に変異があり、セミノーマと胎児性癌で多く認められました。変異は機能喪失型で、Fas遺伝子変異が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症に関与する可能性を示しています。
summary_en: The authors sequenced the Fas gene open reading frame in 24 testicular germ cell tumors and benign controls, using laser capture microdissection to assign mutations to specific histologic components. Mutations were found in 37.5% of cases, mostly missense changes in the death domain-encoding exon 9. They occurred in seminoma (27.8%) and embryonal carcinoma (62.5%) lesions but not in yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, or immature teratoma. Mutant genes conferred resistance to Fas-mediated apoptosis, indicating loss of function, and the findings suggest Fas mutations contribute to TGCT pathogenesis.

title: Neonatal teratoma of the neck causing respiratory distress: a case report.
title_ja: 呼吸窮迫を呈した新生児頸部奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 出生時から呼吸窮迫を伴う大きな頸部腫瘤を有した新生児の症例報告です。画像で石灰化と嚢胞を伴う充実性腫瘤が認められ、剖検で未熟奇形腫と確定しました。小児頸部奇形腫の臨床的、病理学的特徴について考察しています。
summary_en: The authors describe a neonate with a large cervical mass and respiratory distress at birth. Imaging showed a predominantly solid lesion with calcifications and cysts, suggesting teratoma. The patient died before surgery could be performed, and autopsy confirmed an immature teratoma. The report discusses the clinical and pathological features of pediatric cervical teratomas. It is a case report illustrating how a neonatal cervical teratoma can cause life-threatening airway compromise.

title: Malignant germ cell tumors metastatic to the brain: a model for a curable neoplasm? The Freiburg experience and a review of the literature.
title_ja: 脳転移をきたした悪性胚細胞腫瘍：治癒可能な腫瘍のモデルか？フライブルクの経験と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 1985〜2000年に悪性胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移11例を全脳照射で治療しました。全体の中央生存期間は6.6か月でした。孤立性脳再発で切除と全脳照射を受けた3例が長期生存し、最長は194か月でした。切除と放射線療法により持続的な脳内制御が得られる可能性があると結論づけています。
summary_en: This Freiburg series reviewed 11 patients with malignant germ cell tumors metastatic to the brain, treated with whole-brain radiation therapy between 1985 and 2000. Median survival was 6.6 months overall. Three long-term survivors had isolated cerebral relapse after complete remission and underwent resection plus whole-brain radiotherapy. One survived 194 months, the longest reported for this setting. The authors conclude that advanced extracerebral disease and isolated cerebral relapse do not preclude long-term survival, and that resection with radiotherapy may give durable local control.

title: A novel case of infantile sacral teratoma and a constitutional t(12;15)(q13;q25) pat.
title_ja: 乳児仙骨奇形腫の新規症例と先天性t(12;15)(q13;q25)転座
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 仙骨奇形腫の乳児に、先天性の染色体転座t(12;15)(q13;q25)が認められ、同じ転座が血縁者4名にも見られました。12q13の欠失は胚細胞腫瘍で報告されているため、同部位近傍の遺伝子異常が関与すると仮説を立てています。切断点を覆うゲノムコンティグを構築しました。
summary_en: The authors report an infant with a sacral teratoma whose peripheral lymphocytes carried a constitutional t(12;15)(q13;q25) translocation. The same translocation was present in four relatives. Tumor loss of heterozygosity analysis showed retention of both translocation-derived chromosomes. Because 12q13 allelic loss has been reported in germ cell tumors, the authors hypothesize that dysregulation of genes near the 12q13 breakpoint contributes to sacral teratoma development. They have constructed a genomic contig spanning the breakpoint as a first step toward identifying the candidate genes.

title: XY female with a dysgerminoma and no mutation in the coding sequence of the SRY gene.
title_ja: SRY遺伝子の編集配列に変異のない、ディスジャーミノーマを伴うXY女性
summary_ja: 純粋性性腺形成不全を伴う46,XYの11歳女児がディスジャーミノーマを発症しました。SRY遺伝子の欠失や変異は認められず、DMRT1とDAX1も正常でした。性転換には他の遺伝子が関与することが示唆され、SRY異常とディスジャーミノーマの関連に疑問を投げかけています。
summary_en: The authors report an 11-year-old 46,XY girl with pure gonadal dysgenesis who developed a dysgerminoma. The testis-determining gene SRY, previously linked to dysgerminoma, showed no coding-sequence deletions or mutations. DMRT1 on 9p and DAX1 on Xp21 were also normal. These results suggest that other genes contribute to sex reversal and question the proposed relationship between SRY alterations and dysgerminoma. The case highlights that dysgerminoma in dysgenetic gonads may arise without detectable SRY abnormalities.

title: Expression of thyroid transcription factor-1 in strumal carcinoid and struma ovarii: an immunohistochemical study.
title_ja: 甲状腺様カルチノイドおよび卵巣甲状腺腫におけるTTF-1の発現：免疫組織化学的研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫（strumal carcinoid）の2症例について、TTF-1の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討しました。甲状腺成分の濾胞上皮はTTF-1陽性でしたが、カルチノイド成分はほぼ陰性でした。カルチノイド成分は甲状腺への分化を示さず、組織発生の理解に寄与するとしています。
summary_en: Strumal carcinoid is an ovarian teratoma containing thyroid tissue and carcinoid components. In two cases, the authors immunohistochemically examined thyroid transcription factor-1 (TTF-1) expression. TTF-1 stained the follicular lining cells of the thyroid elements but was largely negative in the carcinoid component. These findings confirm TTF-1 expression in the thyroid element of ovarian teratomas and suggest that the carcinoid component does not show thyroid differentiation, which informs the histogenesis of strumal carcinoid.

title: Quantification of human telomerase reverse transcriptase mRNA in testicular germ cell tumors by quantitative fluorescence real-time RT-PCR.
title_ja: 定量蛍光リアルタイムRT-PCRによる精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるヒトテロメラーゼ逆転写酵素mRNAの定量
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍55例と良性生検38例でhTERTとhTRのmRNAを定量しました。未分化な腫瘍と胚細胞を含む良性組織ではhTERTが発現していましたが、成熟奇形腫では化学療法後の腫瘤を含めてほぼ消失していました。hTERT検出は成熟奇形腫の分子診断を補助し、治療判断に役立つ可能性があります。
summary_en: The authors quantified hTERT and hTR mRNA by real-time RT-PCR in 55 testicular germ cell tumors and 38 benign testicular biopsies. hTERT was expressed in all undifferentiated tumors and in benign germ-cell-containing tissue, but was nearly absent in mature teratomas, including post-chemotherapy masses. hTR was high in all samples. The inverse relationship between hTERT expression and tumor differentiation suggests that hTERT detection can molecularly confirm a histologic diagnosis of mature teratoma and may aid treatment decisions for this subtype.

title: Malignant struma ovarii: report of a case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫:症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 38歳女性の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例。子宮出血の精査中に偶然発見された卵巣腫瘤を切除したところ、奇形腫内に濾胞型乳頭状甲状腺癌を認めた。サイログロブリン測定と放射性ヨウ素全身シンチグラフィによるフォローアップのため甲状腺全摘に近い手術を行い、131I 80 mCiによるアブレーションを実施した。患者は順調に回復した。文献レビューも併記されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old woman with malignant struma ovarii, an incidentally discovered ovarian teratoma containing a follicular-variant papillary thyroid carcinoma. After resection, near-total thyroidectomy was performed to permit thyroglobulin monitoring, followed by radioiodine ablation with 80 mCi iodine-131. The patient recovered well. The authors review the scarce literature and note that the rarity of this tumor precludes consensus on treatment and follow-up.

title: Prenatal resection of a fetal pericardial teratoma.
title_ja: 胎児心膜奇形腫の子宮内切除術:症例報告
summary_ja: 胎児の心膜奇形腫に対する子宮内開胸による切除を初めて報告した症例。妊娠24週で胎児水腫を発症し、胎児正中胸骨切開で腫瘍を切除したが水腫は改善しなかった。母体には母体ミラー症候群が生じ緊急帝王切開となり、新生児は出生直後に死亡した。胎児水腫を伴う例は危機的状態であり、早期娩出、心嚢液穿刺、子宮内切除などが治療選択肢になると結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes the first in utero open resection of a fetal pericardial teratoma. The fetus of a 31-year-old woman developed hydrops at 24 weeks gestation. Open fetal resection via median sternotomy removed the tumor, but hydrops did not resolve. The mother developed maternal mirror syndrome requiring emergent cesarean section, and the neonate died shortly after birth. The authors conclude that hydrops indicates a compromised fetus and list early delivery, pericardial aspiration, and in utero resection as options.

title: Primary carcinoid tumor arising in a mature teratoma of the kidney: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 腎成熟奇形腫に原発したカルチノイド腫瘍:症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 30歳女性の左腎に発生した成熟奇形腫内に原発したカルチノイド腫瘍の症例。CTで石灰化を伴い造影効果がわずかな腎腫瘤を認めた。組織学的にカルチノイド巣と、円柱上皮、平滑筋、骨などの成熟奇形組織が混在していた。免疫染色でサイトケラチン、NSE、クロモグラニンが陽性であった。カルチノイド症候群はみられず、術後経過は良好であった。
summary_en: A case report of a primary carcinoid tumor arising within a mature teratoma of the left kidney in a 30-year-old woman. CT showed a calcified renal mass with minimal enhancement. Histology revealed carcinoid nests alongside mature teratoid elements including columnar epithelium, smooth muscle, and bone, with immunohistochemistry positive for cytokeratin, NSE, and chromogranin. The patient had no carcinoid syndrome and recovered uneventfully. The authors note that the histogenesis and prognosis of this extremely rare entity remain unknown.

title: Important factors in the diagnosis and primary staging of testicular tumours.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の診断と初期病期分類における重要因子
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病期分類法を概説し、今後の治療管理の展望を論じた総説。過去30年で5年生存率は約95%に向上し、病期分類が治療方針の基盤となっている。多くの患者が治癒するため、治療の侵襲低減が課題となり、そのためには正確な病期分類が不可欠である。早期かつ正確な診断は治療選択と予後に影響する。
summary_en: This review outlines staging methods for testicular germ cell cancer and considers future directions in management. The five-year survival has improved to about 95% over 30 years, and staging is now the cornerstone of treatment planning. Because most patients are cured, attention has shifted to reducing treatment morbidity, which requires accurate staging before regimens are changed. Early and accurate diagnosis influences treatment choice and prognosis.

title: Clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ-cell tumors: surgery or watchful waiting, still an issue?
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍：外科的治療か待機的経過観察か、なお論点となるか
summary_ja: 本総説は、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する経過観察と初回の神経温存型後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を比較したものである。いずれも治癒率はほぼ100%に達する。経過観察は不要な治療を避けられるが、20～25%の再発リスクがあり多剤併用化学療法が必要となる。RPLNDは病期分類と治療を兼ね、合併症は約17%に生じる。胎児性癌の割合と血管浸潤が潜在性リンパ節転移を予測し、選択は患者との詳細な話し合いに基づくべきとされる。
