Resection of the ovarian cysts showed histopathologically that the tumour was an adenocarcinoma arising from the left ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Such adenocarcinomas are extremely rare, so the authors report this case together with a review of the literature on this uncommon complication.

title: Monodermal highly specialized teratoma of the ovary: a sebaceous gland tumor.
title_ja: 卵巣の単一胚葉高度特殊化奇形腫：皮脂腺腫瘍
summary_ja: 奇形腫は三胚葉すべての成熟成分を含むが、単一組織のみが発育する特殊型も知られている。本稿では、完全に皮脂腺から構成される卵巣奇形腫（単一胚葉性）を報告する。組織像の多様性を示す症例として、卵巣腫瘍の鑑別にとって意義がある。
summary_en: Teratomas arise from pluripotential cells and contain mature tissues of all three germ layers, and some specialised variants show unilateral development of a single tissue type. The authors describe an ovarian teratoma composed entirely of sebaceous glands, a monodermal pattern. Such highly specialised ovarian teratomas are uncommon, and this case illustrates the morphological diversity within the teratoma spectrum for pathologists and clinicians.

title: Differential expression of RET finger protein in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるRET finger proteinの差次的発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるRET finger protein（RFP）の発現を検討した。セミノーマ13例中12例、および混合型胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ成分で陽性であり、純粋非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では陰性であった。RFPは胚細胞の増殖や組織型の決定に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: RET finger protein (RFP) expression was examined in testicular germ cell tumours, including 13 pure seminomas, five pure non-seminomatous germ cell tumours and seven mixed tumours. RFP was strongly expressed in normal spermatogonia and primary spermatocytes, and in 12 of 13 pure seminomas and in the seminomatous components of mixed tumours. Pure non-seminomatous tumours were negative. The authors suggest RFP may relate to germ cell proliferation or histological type.

title: Mucinous cystadenoma of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の粘液性嚢胞腺腫
summary_ja: 35歳男性の右精巣に発生した9cmの多房性嚢胞性腫瘍を報告する。腸管分化を示す粘液性嚢胞腺腫と診断され、奇形腫成分や精細管内胚細胞腫瘍は認められなかった。精巣内発生の良性粘液性嚢胞腺腫の初報例とされ、良性単一胚葉性奇形腫の可能性も示唆された。
summary_en: A 35-year-old man had a 9 cm multiloculated cystic tumour in the right testis, which was diagnosed as a mucinous cystadenoma with intestinal differentiation. The tumour lacked teratomatous elements and intratubular germ cell neoplasia and was confined within the testis. The authors believe it is probably the first reported benign mucinous cystadenoma arising in the testis, and suggest that it may represent a benign monodermal teratoma.

title: Nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for advanced testicular cancer after chemotherapy.
title_ja: 進行精巣がんに対する化学療法後の神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 化学療法後に神経温存RPLNDを受けた転移性・再発性精巣がんの日本人26例を報告した。全例で腰部内臓神経を温存でき、84.6%が順行性射精を回復した。後腹膜再発は1例のみで、化学療法後であっても局所再発リスクを高めることなく射精機能を温存できると結論づけている。
summary_en: Twenty-six Japanese men with metastatic or recurrent testicular cancer underwent nerve-sparing RPLND after chemotherapy, including eight seminoma and 18 non-seminoma cases. Lumbar splanchnic nerves were preserved in all patients, and 84.6% regained antegrade ejaculation. Only one patient had a retroperitoneal recurrence during a median follow-up of 25.8 months. The authors conclude that nerve-sparing RPLND is appropriate after chemotherapy, preserving ejaculatory function without increasing the risk of local recurrence.

title: Socio-economic differences in incidence rates of cancers of the male genital organs in Finland, 1971-95.
title_ja: 1971〜95年のフィンランドにおける男性生殖器がんの発症率の社会経済的差異
summary_ja: 1971〜95年のフィンランド男性110万人を対象に、前立腺・精巣・陰茎・陰嚢がんの社会階級差を検討した。精巣がんは1970年代初頭に最上位階級で低位階級の5倍であったが、1990年代には2倍未満に縮小した。セミノーマと非セミノーマで階級差の傾向は類似していた。
summary_en: Using data from 1.1 million Finnish men aged 45 to 69 (1971 to 1995), the authors studied social class differences in incidence of prostate, testicular, penile and scrotal cancers. Testicular cancer incidence in the highest social class was fivefold that of lower classes in the early 1970s, but the gradient narrowed to under twofold by the 1990s. The social class gradient was similar for seminomas and non-seminomas. The reasons for this change remain unclear.

title: Intracaval and intracardiac metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor: a rare cause of hemolytic anemia and thrombocytopenia.
title_ja: 下大静脈内および心内転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍：溶血性貧血と血小板減少をきたしたまれな原因
summary_ja: 播種性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者が、溶血性貧血、高度の血小板減少、新たな心雑音で発症した。下大静脈内および心内に広範な転移性奇形腫があり、弁膜へ浸潤していた。全身化学療法にもかかわらず急速に進行したため心内腫瘤を切除し、成熟奇形腫と判明、血液学的異常は速やかに正常化した。
summary_en: A patient with disseminated testicular germ cell tumour presented with haemolytic anaemia, severe thrombocytopenia and a new cardiac murmur. Extensive intracaval and intracardiac metastatic teratoma with valvular involvement was found. Rapid progression despite systemic chemotherapy prompted resection of the intracardiac mass, which showed mature teratoma. Haematological values normalised promptly afterwards. The report highlights intracardiac metastasis as an unusual cause of haemolysis in germ cell tumour patients.

title: Primary embryonal carcinoma of heart with SVC syndrome.
title_ja: 心臓原発胎児性癌と上大静脈症候群
summary_ja: 25歳男性で、右心房に原発した胎児性癌と多発性肺転移により上大静脈症候群を呈した症例。心腫瘍を切除し左上葉切除を施行した。精巣に病変は認めず、残存肺腫瘍にはシスプラチンを含む併用化学療法を行い、完全寛解に至った。性腺外に発生した稀な症例である。
summary_en: A case report of a 25-year-old man with primary embryonal carcinoma of the right atrium and multiple lung metastases presenting with superior vena cava syndrome. The cardiac tumour was resected together with a left upper lobectomy, and no testicular lesion was found. Residual lung tumours were treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy, which achieved complete remission. The case documents an uncommon extragonadal presentation.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 妊娠36週の23歳女性で、超音波検査により胎児の仙尾部嚢胞性腫瘤が確認された。緊急帝王切開で娩出された新生児は、成熟した神経成分を含む仙尾部奇形腫を有していた。新生児は生後10日目に死亡し、母体の経過は順調であった。本症例は出生前に診断された点が特徴的である。
summary_en: A 23-year-old second gravida at 36 weeks was found by ultrasonography to have a fetal cystic sacrococcygeal mass. Emergency caesarean section delivered a neonate with an intact sacrococcygeal teratoma that contained mature neural elements on histopathology. The infant died on day 10, while the mother's postpartum course was uneventful. The case is notable because the tumour was detected before birth.

title: Metastatic endodermal sinus tumor: CT appearances.
title_ja: 転移性卵黄嚢腫瘍：CT所見
summary_ja: 1週齢時に仙尾部嚢胞性奇形腫を切除された男児が、12か月時にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)139,000 IU/mlの骨盤内再発腫瘤を生じ、卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で鼠径リンパ節腫大と肝転移を認めた。BEP化学療法により完全寛解し、AFPも正常化した。奇形腫切除後はフォローアップとAFPモニタリングが重要である。
summary_en: A one-week-old boy who had a sacrococcygeal cystic teratoma resected developed a recurrent pelvic mass at 12 months, with alpha-fetoprotein of 139,000 IU/ml. Pathology showed endodermal sinus tumour, and CT showed inguinal nodal enlargement and liver metastases. BEP chemotherapy achieved complete remission with normalised AFP. The authors stress close follow-up and AFP monitoring after resection of sacrococcygeal teratoma.

title: The differentiation status of primary gonadal germ cell tumors correlates inversely with telomerase activity and the expression level of the gene encoding the catalytic subunit of telomerase.
title_ja: 原発性胚細胞腫瘍の分化度はテロメラーゼ活性およびその触媒サブユニット遺伝子発現と逆相関する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍42例を対象に、テロメラーゼ活性とhTERT mRNA発現を測定した。未分化な腫瘍では高値を示し、分化した奇形腫では低値を示した。テロメラーゼ活性と分化度は逆相関しており、胚細胞腫瘍の分子診断による分類に応用できる可能性が示された。
summary_en: Telomerase activity and hTERT mRNA expression were measured in 42 primary testicular germ cell tumours and benign testicular controls. Undifferentiated tumours and germ-cell-containing benign tissue showed high telomerase activity and hTERT expression, whereas differentiated teratomas and Sertoli-cell-only controls showed little or none. The authors conclude that telomerase measures correlate inversely with differentiation and may support molecular subclassification of germ cell tumours.

title: Congenital immature teratoma of the tongue: an autopsy case.
title_ja: 舌の先天性未熟奇形腫：剖検例
journal: Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol Oral Radiol Endod
summary_ja: 妊娠28週で出生した女児の舌から突出した巨大な先天性未熟奇形腫の剖検例。腫瘤は口腔を閉塞し羊水過多をきたした。母体の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は上昇しており、出生前の超音波検査で腫瘍が同定された。極めて稀な性腺外奇形腫の症例として報告されている。
summary_en: An autopsy case of a huge congenital immature teratoma protruding from the tongue of a female infant delivered at 28 weeks. The mass obstructed the mouth and caused hydramnios, and maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated. The tumour was detected by prenatal ultrasonography, and the pregnancy was ended by caesarean section. The report documents this very rare extragonadal teratoma.

title: Intrapericardial teratoma in a twin with severe failure to thrive.
title_ja: 心膜内奇形腫を有する双生児の重度発育不全
summary_ja: 咳嗽・呼吸困難・重度の発育不全を呈した双生児の一人の症例。胸部X線で著明な心拡大を認め、心膜液貯留を伴う心膜内奇形腫が原因であった。手術により腫瘍を摘出し、良好な結果が得られた。乳児に生じた性腺外奇形腫の稀な症例である。
summary_en: A twin infant presented with cough, dyspnoea and severe failure to thrive. Chest radiography showed gross cardiomegaly, which was caused by an intrapericardial teratoma with a pericardial effusion. The tumour was removed surgically with a successful outcome. The report describes a rare presentation of an extragonadal teratoma in an infant.

title: Case of PSTT treated with chemotherapy followed by open uterine tumor resection to preserve fertility.
title_ja: 化学療法後に開腹子宮腫瘍切除を行い妊孕性を温存した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 自然流産の4か月後に発症した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の若年女性症例。EMA/CO化学療法で腫瘍は縮小したが、β-hCGが低値で持続したため、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)と子宮鏡検査を基に残存腫瘍を開腹切除した。術後に月経は1週間で回復し、β-hCGは検出限界以下となった。化学療法後の保存的子宮切除により妊孕性を温存できる可能性を示した。
summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) diagnosed four months after a spontaneous abortion. After two cycles of EMA/CO chemotherapy reduced the tumor substantially but serum beta-hCG remained low, MRI and hysteroscopy guided open resection of the residual posterior myometrial tumor. Menstruation resumed within a week, MRI showed no residual tumor, and beta-hCG became undetectable. The authors conclude that chemotherapy followed by conservative uterine resection can achieve remission while preserving fertility.

title: Cytokeratin 20 as a biomarker of gestational trophoblastic disease: diagnostic and prognostic significance.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患のバイオマーカーとしてのサイトケラチン20：診断および予後における意義
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断・予後マーカーとしてサイトケラチン20(CK20)の有用性をRT-PCRで検討した。完全奇胎、絨毛癌細胞株、部分奇胎の半数でCK20が発現し、正常絨毛では陰性であった。CK20陽性の部分奇胎は侵入性へ進展する例が多かった。病理診断が不確かな場合、CK20陽性は完全奇胎、陰性は部分奇胎を示唆し得るとしている。
summary_en: This study evaluated cytokeratin 20 (CK20) as a biomarker for gestational trophoblastic disease using RT-PCR on 48 samples: molar pregnancies, choriocarcinoma cell lines, and normal trophoblast controls. CK20 was expressed in all complete moles, all choriocarcinoma lines, and half of partial moles, but absent from normal trophoblast. Among partial moles, CK20-positive cases frequently progressed to invasive disease. The authors propose CK20 can help distinguish molar from normal tissue and may aid subclassification when pathology is equivocal.

title: Gestational trophoblastic tumors in Norway, 1968-1997: patient characteristics, treatment, and prognosis.
title_ja: ノルウェーにおける妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(1968〜1997年)：患者特性、治療および予後
summary_ja: 1968〜1997年にノルウェーで化学療法を受けた妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍141例(侵入奇胎106例、絨毛癌35例)を後方視的に解析した。5年全生存率は96%で、年代が新しいほど予後は改善していた。無病生存は絨毛癌より侵入奇胎で良好であり、予後予測はWHOスコアリングシステムよりFIGO分類の方が優れていた。
summary_en: A population-based retrospective analysis of 141 Norwegian patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors (106 invasive moles, 35 choriocarcinomas) treated with chemotherapy at the Norwegian Radium Hospital from 1968 to 1997. Most patients were low-risk and had FIGO stage I or III disease. Overall five-year survival was 96%, with improved outcomes in later decades and better disease-free survival for invasive mole than choriocarcinoma. FIGO staging predicted disease-free survival better than the WHO scoring system.

title: Genetics and biology of male germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝学と生物学
summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的・分子遺伝学的研究をまとめた総説である。これらの解析は病因や化学療法感受性の理解に寄与してきた。今後、発現プロファイリングやゲノムスキャン技術により、転帰を予測する分子マーカーや、化学療法反応に関わる分子ネットワークを同定できる可能性があると論じている。
summary_en: A review of cytogenetic and molecular genetic studies of male germ cell tumors and their links to etiology and chemosensitivity. The authors note that expression profiling and genome-scanning techniques may identify molecular markers of tumor outcome and networks involved in human development and chemotherapy response. The text is a short abstract-level overview without specific cohort data.

title: Primary mediastinal malignant germ cell neoplasms: imaging features.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍の画像所見
summary_ja: 若年成人男性の原発性縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍の画像所見をまとめた総説である。成熟奇形腫は脂肪濃度を伴う多房性嚢胞性腫瘤として典型的に見える。セミノーマはリンパ腫と類似し、非セミノーマは大きく不均一で局所浸潤性を示す。性腺原発の除外、腫瘍マーカーの活用、残存病変のフォローアップ画像が重要とされる。
summary_en: A radiology review of primary mediastinal malignant germ cell neoplasms in young adult men. Mature teratomas are the most common, appearing as multilocular cystic masses with fat attenuation. Seminomas look like lymphoma, while nonseminomatous tumors are large, heterogeneous, and locally invasive. The authors emphasize excluding gonadal primary tumors and using tumor markers for initial evaluation, response assessment and recurrence, and follow-up imaging for residual disease.

title: Presentation and management of benign mediastinal teratomas.
title_ja: 良性縦隔奇形腫の臨床像と管理
summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘍の約5〜10%を占める良性縦隔奇形腫の臨床像と管理をまとめた総説である。奇形腫は発生部位に異質な組織から成る腫瘍と定義され、外胚葉・中胚葉・内胚葉の三胚葉すべてを発現しうる。「良性奇形腫」という呼称が適切であると論じている。第3または第4鰓裂由来との説にも触れている。
summary_en: A review of benign mediastinal teratomas, which account for roughly 5 to 10 percent of mediastinal tumors. The authors argue that 'benign teratoma' is the appropriate term and explain the derivation of the word teratoma. They define teratomas as tumors composed of tissue foreign to their site of origin and note that they can express all three germ layers. A proposed origin from the third or fourth brachial cleft is mentioned.

title: Diagnosis, staging, and clinical characteristics of the patient with mediastinal germ cell carcinoma.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞癌の診断、病期分類および臨床的特徴
summary_ja: 若年男性の前縦隔腫瘤では縦隔胚細胞腫瘍を第一に考えるべきだと述べる総説である。病期評価と診断は迅速に行い、根治を目指して速やかに治療を開始すべきとしている。純粋な縦隔セミノーマは80%以上が治癒するのに対し、非セミノーマ性腫瘍の全体の治癒率は35〜40%である。進行癌の中でも最も効果的に治療される群の一つに位置づけている。
summary_en: A review of mediastinal germ cell carcinoma with emphasis on diagnosis and staging. In young men with anterior mediastinal masses, germ cell tumors should be a leading consideration, and staging should be completed quickly so that curative treatment can start promptly. Pure mediastinal seminoma is curable in over 80 percent of patients, while the overall cure rate for nonseminomatous tumors is 35 to 40 percent, which the authors call among the most effectively treated advanced cancers.

title: Chemotherapeutic and surgical strategies for germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法と外科的治療戦略
summary_ja: 精巣がんは治癒可能な腫瘍の代表例であるとして、胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法と外科的戦略を総説している。短期間の集中的導入療法が維持療法より重要であり、用量増加は効果を高めずに毒性を増すとしている。難治性の胚細胞腫瘍に対する根治的救済療法の可能性や、新薬開発のモデルとしての意義も述べている。シスプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミドの承認状況もまとめている。
summary_en: A review of chemotherapy and surgical strategies for germ cell tumors, based on the authors' cisplatin combination studies. Key conclusions include that short, intensive induction with optimal doses matters more than maintenance, dose escalation adds toxicity without benefit, and curative salvage is possible for refractory tumors. The paper notes that testicular cancer has served as a model for both curable neoplasms and new drug development, and summarizes approvals of cisplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide.

title: Imaging of intrathoracic metastases of nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の胸郭内転移の画像診断
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の胸郭内転移に関する画像診断の総説である。ヘリカルコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は病期分類の中核で、肺実質結節や縦隔リンパ節腫大の検出に優れる。一方、生存腫瘍や奇形腫と線維化・壊死の鑑別は確実にはできない。術前評価には断面画像が不可欠で、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)やCTガイド下針生検は高リスク例で有用な場合がある。
summary_en: A radiology review of intrathoracic metastases from nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Helical CT is the central tool for staging and detects lung nodules and mediastinal lymphadenopathy well, while it cannot reliably distinguish viable tumor or teratoma from fibrosis and necrosis. Cross-sectional imaging remains essential before surgery for potential metastatic disease. FDG PET and CT-guided needle biopsy may help select high-risk patients.

title: Surgical techniques for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors metastatic to the lung.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の肺転移に対する外科的手技
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の肺転移に対する外科的切除法をまとめた総説です。転移があっても治癒可能な疾患であり、化学療法後に残存する病変を完全切除することが長期治癒に重要とされています。病変の広がりと術前の全身状態を慎重に評価すれば、良好な成績が得られると述べています。
summary_en: This review describes surgical strategies for pulmonary metastasectomy in patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Although these tumors are curable even when metastases are present at diagnosis, surgery serves as adjuvant therapy after chemotherapy, and complete resection of residual postchemotherapy disease is key to long-term cure. Various surgical techniques and approaches are appropriate, and good results are achievable when disease extent and preoperative medical condition are carefully assessed.

title: Surgical techniques for testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors metastatic to the mediastinum.
title_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の縦隔転移に対する外科的治療法
summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の縦隔残存病変に対する胸部外科手術をまとめています。シスプラチン併用化学療法後の残存病変を切除した結果、手術死亡率は1%と低く、10年生存率は78%と報告されています。複数回の手術が必要となることが多く、選択された患者では積極的な外科治療が正当化されると述べています。
summary_en: This article reviews thoracic surgery for residual mediastinal disease after cisplatin-based chemotherapy in patients with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The author reports over 400 procedures with low operative mortality and a 10-year survival of 78% when benign residual lesions were resected. Multiple operations are often needed, and aggressive surgery is justified in selected patients, including those with chemotherapy-refractory disease.

title: The future of therapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療の将来
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の分子機構と化学療法感受性・耐性をまとめた総説です。ハイスループット解析や新規マーカーにより予後評価を精密化し、治療選択に役立てる展望を示しています。CCND2やKITなどの細胞周期関連標的が、予後不良な病変に対する新規治療の候補として挙げられています。
summary_en: This review summarizes molecular mechanisms of germ cell transformation, tumor differentiation, and chemotherapy sensitivity and resistance in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. It discusses how high-throughput profiling and new markers could refine prognosis and guide choices among radiation, RPLND, and chemotherapy. The authors also highlight cell cycle targets such as CCND2 and KIT as candidates for therapies aimed at biologically unfavorable disease.

title: Role of hysterectomy in management of gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療における子宮摘出術の役割
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患5976例の前向き観察研究で、子宮摘出術の適応と転帰を検討しています。40例が子宮摘出を受け、出血制御不能、局所化学療法抵抗性病変、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が主な適応でした。これらの患者は治療前リスクスコアが高く、死亡率も高いと報告されています。
summary_en: This prospective study of 5976 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease evaluates hysterectomy as a treatment. Forty patients underwent hysterectomy, mainly for uncontrolled bleeding, localized chemoresistant disease, or placental site trophoblastic tumor. These patients had higher pretreatment risk scores, more atypical histology, and higher mortality. The authors conclude that hysterectomy is reserved for a high-risk subgroup.

title: Malignant Struma Ovarii: an autopsy report of a clinically unsuspected tumor.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫：臨床的に疑われなかった腫瘍の剖検報告
summary_ja: 臨床的に疑われなかった卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性例を、67歳女性の剖検で報告した症例報告です。卵巣内の甲状腺組織から濾胞型乳頭癌が発生し、肺と胸膜に転移していました。著者らは、臨床的に疑われなかった悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の剖検報告として初めての例であると述べています。
summary_en: This autopsy report describes a 67-year-old woman with an unsuspected large ovarian tumor containing ectopic thyroid tissue. Microscopy showed a follicular variant of papillary carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, with metastases to the lungs and pleura. The authors state this is the first autopsy report of a clinically unsuspected malignant struma ovarii. The tumor was an incidental finding at autopsy.

title: Clinical pattern and therapeutic results achieved in 1490 patients with germ-cell tumours of the testis: the experience of the Spanish Germ-Cell Cancer Group (GG).
title_ja: スペイン胚細胞腫瘍グループ(GG)の経験による精巣胚細胞腫瘍1490例の臨床像と治療成績
summary_ja: スペインの胚細胞腫瘍グループに登録された精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者1490例を、均一な治療プロトコルのもとで解析した。臨床病期Iで予後不良因子のない患者はサーベイランスとし、進行例はIGCCCG分類に応じて化学療法を受けた。3年時点の全生存期間(全生存率)はセミノーマで98%、非セミノーマで94%であった。化学療法後に切除された残存腫瘤で悪性細胞を含んだのは10%のみであった。臨床像は他の西洋諸国と類似していた。
summary_en: This multicenter Spanish study reports clinical features and outcomes of 1490 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated under a homogeneous protocol. Surveillance was used for stage I patients without poor prognostic factors, and chemotherapy was given according to IGCCCG risk group. Three-year overall survival was 98% for seminoma and 94% for non-seminoma. Only 10% of residual masses after chemotherapy contained malignant cells.

title: Influence of amifostine on reconstitution of lymphocyte subpopulations after conventional- and high-dose chemotherapy in patients with germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者における従来量および大量化学療法後のリンパ球サブポピュレーションの再構築に対するアミフォスチンの影響
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者40例を対象に、アミフォスチン500mgの投与群と非投与群を比較し、化学療法および末梢血幹細胞移植後のリンパ球サブセットの回復を評価した。アミフォスチンは回復に有意な影響を与えず、CD4陽性細胞の回復遅延も重篤な感染症を伴わず、臨床的意義は乏しかった。
summary_en: In 40 patients with germ cell tumor receiving paclitaxel/ifosfamide/cisplatin followed by high-dose carboplatin, etoposide and thiotepa with stem cell rescue, the authors randomized 500 mg amifostine versus no amifostine and monitored lymphocyte subsets. Amifostine did not alter lymphocyte reconstitution. Lymphocyte counts stayed low during therapy and CD4-positive cells recovered slowly after transplantation, but neither produced severe or atypical infections. The findings suggest amifostine at this dose offers no immunologic benefit, and the lymphopenia lacked clinical significance.

title: Frequent promoter hypermethylation of the O6-Methylguanine-DNA Methyltransferase (MGMT) gene in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおけるO6-メチルグアニン-DNAメチルトランスフェラーゼ（MGMT）遺伝子プロモーターの高頻度なメチル化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍70例でMGMTおよびCDKN2Aのプロモーター領域のメチル化を解析した。MGMTプロモーターのメチル化は全体の46%に認められ、非セミノーマで69%、セミノーマで24%と有意に高かった。免疫染色でもMGMTタンパクの減少が確認され、非セミノーマ性精巣がんの発生にMGMTの不活化が関与すると結論づけられた。
summary_en: This study examined MGMT promoter methylation and CDKN2A methylation in 70 testicular tumors, alongside allelic imbalances at 9p and 10q. CDKN2A was never methylated, but MGMT promoter methylation occurred in 46% of tumors overall. Methylation was markedly more frequent in nonseminomas (69%) than seminomas (24%), and immunohistochemistry confirmed reduced MGMT protein in a subset, consistent with silencing. The authors conclude MGMT inactivation contributes to the development of nonseminomatous testicular cancer.

title: Malignant germ cell tumors: clinical characteristics, treatment, and outcome. A report from the study group for Pediatric Solid Malignant Tumors in the Kyushu Area, Japan.
title_ja: 小児の悪性胚細胞腫瘍：臨床的特徴、治療および転帰 ― 九州地域小児固形悪性腫瘍研究グループの報告
summary_ja: 九州地域の小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍117例を解析した。病期が早い例、1歳未満、性腺原発が良好な予後因子で、絨毛癌や肝・肺転移は不良因子であった。限局例は完全切除のみで十分で、進行例ではPVB療法が最適とされた。
summary_en: This Kyushu multicenter review analyzed 117 childhood malignant germ cell tumors, mostly embryonal carcinomas. Five-year survival was favorable for early stage, age under one year, and gonadal primary sites, while choriocarcinoma and liver or lung metastasis predicted poorer outcomes. Complete resection alone sufficed for localized disease. For advanced disease, PVB chemotherapy showed the best results, though high-risk patients may need more intensive treatment.

title: Bleomycin-induced upper lobe fibrosis: a case report.
title_ja: ブレオマイシン誘発性上葉線維症：症例報告
summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に対しブレオマイシンを含む化学療法を終えた若年男性が、約2年後に上葉優位の肺線維症を発症した。他疾患を除外した結果、ブレオマイシンによる肺障害と診断された。治療終了後に遅発性に発症しうる点に注意が必要である。
summary_en: A young man developed late-onset upper-lobe pulmonary fibrosis about two years after completing bleomycin-containing chemotherapy for mediastinal germ cell carcinoma. The fibrosis progressed slowly, spared the lower lung fields, and was attributed to bleomycin after other diagnoses were excluded by clinical history, laboratory tests, and pathology. The report highlights that bleomycin toxicity can present long after treatment ends, so clinicians should consider it in germ cell tumor survivors with pulmonary symptoms.

title: Testicular seminoma presenting 22 years after treatment for extra-gonadal germ-cell tumour.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍（肺原発）の治療から22年後に発症した精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 肺原発の性腺外セミノーマの治療から22年後に、57歳男性が精巣セミノーマを発症した。二つの胚細胞腫瘍の間隔が極めて長い症例である。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の患者は生涯にわたるフォローアップが望ましく、退院後も精巣腫瘍のリスクと自己触診の重要性を伝えるべきだと結論づけている。
summary_en: A 57-year-old man presented with a testicular seminoma 22 years after receiving treatment for a pulmonary extragonadal seminoma. The authors describe this as an unusually long interval between the two germ cell tumors. They conclude that patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors should receive lifelong follow-up or, if discharged, be informed about the risk of future testicular tumor and taught regular testicular self-examination.

title: Management of stage I nonseminomatous germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の管理
summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し精巣摘除術後に選択しうる3つの治療法を比較した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清は米国で第一選択とされ、診断と治療を兼ねるが手術合併症がある。サーベイランスは再発リスクが最も高く、初回化学療法は同等の生存率を手術なしで得られるが副作用が問題となる。
summary_en: This review compares three options after orchiectomy for stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors: retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, surveillance, and primary chemotherapy. RPLND is the preferred choice in the United States and offers diagnostic and therapeutic value but carries surgical morbidity. Surveillance avoids surgery but has the highest relapse risk and burdens patients and physicians. Primary chemotherapy achieves similar survival without surgery, though side effects can be significant.

title: Controversies in the management of testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの治療における論点
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ治療の論争点を整理した。病期I例は、サーベイランス、術後放射線療法、カルボプラチン単剤のいずれかを選択できるが、放射線療法との比較試験が進行中である。化学療法後の残存腫瘤は、3cm未満であれば観察が一般的だが、それ以上の扱いは議論が続いている。巨大病変では初回化学療法が優先されつつある。
summary_en: This review addresses unresolved questions in managing testicular seminoma. Stage I patients may choose surveillance or postoperative radiotherapy, or single-agent carboplatin, though a randomized trial comparing carboplatin with radiotherapy is ongoing. For residual masses after chemotherapy, options include observation, radiotherapy, or retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy; masses under 3 cm can generally be observed, while the best approach for larger masses remains debated. Bulky disease now favors up-front chemotherapy.

title: Contralateral testicular biopsy procedure in patients with unilateral testis cancer: is it indicated?
title_ja: 片側精巣がん患者における対側精巣生検手技：適応はあるか
summary_ja: 片側精巣がんの約5%で対側に精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）が認められる。著者らは、定期的な対側生検は偽陰性率や合併症、不妊や内分泌障害、サーベイランスに対する予後改善がないことから支持しがたいと論じる。高リスク群（精巣容積12mL未満、停留精巣の既往、30歳未満）に限り生検を考慮しうるとしている。
summary_en: About 5% of unilateral testis cancer patients harbor contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia. This review questions routine contralateral testis biopsy, citing a 0.3% false-negative rate, a 15 to 20% biopsy complication rate, irreversible infertility and Leydig cell impairment from radiation, and no survival benefit over surveillance. Biopsy may be reasonable only for high-risk patients: testicular volume under 12 mL, prior cryptorchidism, or age under 30 years.

title: Adjuvant chemotherapy for stage II nonseminomatous germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する補助化学療法
summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清で完全切除された病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、補助化学療法2サイクルとサーベイランスの選択肢を比較した。低容積の節病変（pN1）ではサーベイランスが適し、高容積（pN2）では再発率が高いため補助化学療法が望ましいとされる。
summary_en: For patients with stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who are completely resected at RPLND, the authors compare two options: two cycles of adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy or surveillance. Both yield similarly high cure rates. Surveillance suits low-volume nodal disease (pN1, relapse 30% or less), while high-volume disease (pN2, relapse 50 to 90% on surveillance) favors adjuvant chemotherapy, with etoposide plus cisplatin shown effective in a prospective trial.

title: Chemotherapy for good-risk germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 良好リスク胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法
summary_ja: 良好リスク胚細胞腫瘍では、シスプラチン併用化学療法、外科的切除、放射線療法、観察を組み合わせて高い治癒率が得られる。本総説はリスク分類とレジメンの論点を扱う。ランダム化試験ではカルボプラチンがシスプラチンより劣り、エトポシドは1コースあたり500 mg/m²が推奨される。ブレオマイシンの位置づけは議論があるが、E(500)P 4サイクルまたはBE(500)P 3サイクルが標準的選択肢と考えられる。
summary_en: This review addresses chemotherapy for good-risk germ cell tumors, which have a high cure rate with an approach combining cisplatin-based chemotherapy, surgery, radiation and observation. It discusses risk group allocation and controversies over regimen composition, number of cycles and dosing. Randomized data show carboplatin is inferior to cisplatin, and etoposide should be given at 500 mg/m² per course. The role of bleomycin remains debated, but E(500)P for four cycles or BE(500)P for three cycles may be considered standard.

title: Poor prognosis germ-cell tumors: An unresolved challenge.
title_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍：未解決の課題
summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍に対する標準治療は、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる4サイクルの化学療法であり、腫瘍マーカーが正常化していれば残存腫瘤の外科的切除を行う。症例数の多い施設ほど成績が良い。現行治療の成績は満足できず、臨床試験への組み入れが勧められる。今後は耐性機序の分子レベルでの理解と新規治療法の開発が必要とされる。
summary_en: This review examines poor-prognosis germ cell tumors as classified by the International Germ Cell Consensus group (IGCCC). Standard therapy for poor- and intermediate-prognosis disease is four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin, followed by surgical resection of residual masses once tumor markers normalize. Outcomes are better at centers treating larger numbers of patients. The authors conclude that current results are unsatisfactory and that patients should enter clinical trials. Future progress will require understanding molecular resistance mechanisms and developing novel therapies.

title: The role of adjunctive postchemotherapy surgery for nonseminomatous germ-cell tumors: current concepts and controversies.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後の補助的外科的切除：現状の概念と論点
summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後の補助的手術を整理した総説。画像上の残存病変と正常な腫瘍マーカーを認める場合に切除が適応となる。残存組織は壊死、奇形腫、生存癌が主で、壊死の術前予測には約20%の偽陰性が残る。後腹膜リンパ節郭清が最も厳密な方法で、部位による組織像の違いから全ての残存部位を切除すべきとされる。
summary_en: This review addresses adjunctive surgery after chemotherapy for advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Resection is indicated when imaging shows residual abnormalities and markers are normal. Residual tissue is mainly necrosis, teratoma and viable carcinoma, and prediction of necrosis still carries about 20% false-negative risk. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is the most rigorous approach, and all residual sites should be resected because histology differs between sites. Completeness of resection should not be compromised to preserve ejaculation.

title: Retrospective analysis of 67 consecutive cases of pure ovarian immature teratoma.
title_ja: 純粋卵巣未熟奇形腫67例の後方視的解析
summary_ja: 1958〜1998年の純粋卵巣未熟奇形腫67例を後方視的に解析した。病期I例が多く、27例が再発、2例に遠隔転移を認めた。5年生存率は時代とともに40%から95%へ向上し、病期、組織学的グレード、適切な治療が主要な予後因子とされた。再発例や進行例では化学療法と反復手術が行われ、腫瘍マーカーも予後評価に有用とされた。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 67 patients with pure ovarian immature teratoma treated between 1958 and 1998 assessed treatment and prognosis. Most patients had early-stage disease, 27 had recurrences and 2 had distant metastases. Stage I patients underwent unilateral adnexectomy, while advanced or recurrent disease was treated with combination chemotherapy and repeated surgery. Five-year survival rose from 40% to 95% across eras. Stage, grade and adequate treatment were identified as key prognostic factors, and tumor markers were considered useful for prognosis.

title: [Adult sacrococcygeal teratoma: a case report].
title_ja: 成人仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告
summary_ja: 55歳男性の骨盤内に偶然発見された13cmの嚢胞性腫瘤の症例報告。病理診断は成熟奇形腫で、腹部と経仙骨の併用アプローチにより切除された。仙尾部奇形腫は乳児に多いが、成人では稀であり、本報告は日本国内で30例目とされる。術後1年で軽度の膀胱機能障害を認めたものの、術後20か月時点で病変は認められない。
summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old man in whom an incidental 13 cm cystic pelvic mass was found on CT and proved to be a mature teratoma. The tumor extended from the presacral area to the coccyx and was resected by a combined abdominal and transsacral approach. Sacrococcygeal teratomas are most common in infants but rare in adults; the authors state this is the 30th reported adult case in Japan. At one year the patient had mild bladder dysfunction, and at 20 months there was no evidence of disease.

title: Teratoma of the placenta.
title_ja: 胎盤の奇形腫
journal: Aust N Z J Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 正期産胎盤に生じた奇形腫の1例を報告する。栄養膜由来ではない胎盤原発腫瘍は極めて稀で、報告されているのは絨毛血管腫と奇形腫が主である。胎盤は奇形腫の稀な発生部位であり、本例はその一例である。抄録は簡潔で、組織所見や治療、転帰の詳細は示されていない。
summary_en: This report describes teratoma arising in a term placenta. The authors note that primary non-trophoblastic placental tumors are extremely rare, with chorioangioma and teratoma being the main types reported. The case highlights that teratoma can occur as a primary placental tumor, an unusual extragonadal site for this germ cell-derived neoplasm. The abstract is brief and gives little detail on histology, management or outcome.

title: Conservative therapy for malignant struma ovarii. A case report.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫に対する保存的治療：症例報告
summary_ja: 若年女性の骨盤内腫瘤に対し、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の診断で片側卵管卵巣摘除術を行った症例報告。補助療法は実施しなかった。妊孕性の温存を望む患者では、保存的な外科的アプローチを検討してよいと結論している。抄録は簡潔で、組織学的詳細や術後の経過期間は示されていない。
summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with a pelvic mass in whom malignant thyroid tissue was found within a struma ovarii. She underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy without adjuvant therapy. The authors suggest that conservative surgical approaches should be considered for patients with malignant struma ovarii who wish to preserve fertility. The abstract is brief and gives limited information on histologic subtype, duration of follow-up and outcome.

title: Management of spinal cord and cauda equina compression secondary to epidural metastatic disease in adults with malignant germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍の成人における硬膜外転移性疾患に続発する脊髄および馬尾圧迫の管理
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の硬膜外転移による脊髄・馬尾圧迫の10例を後方視的に検討した。化学療法のみで治療された4例は神経機能が良好に回復した。8例のうち5例が再発した。化学療法抵抗性や化学療法後の再発例は予後が不良で、放射線療法のみでは進行を防げなかった。化学療法未治療例では良好な神経転帰が得られた。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 10 adults with malignant germ cell tumours describes management of spinal cord or cauda equina compression from epidural metastasis. Eight had neurological deficits. Four patients received chemotherapy alone with good recovery, and four underwent decompressive laminectomy. Five of the eight relapsed. Chemotherapy-naive patients achieved good neurological outcomes, while those with chemorefractory disease or relapse after chemotherapy had poor outcomes despite radiotherapy.

title: Hepatic metastasis from choriocarcinoma: angiographic findings in two cases.
title_ja: 絨毛癌肝転移：血管造影所見の2症例
summary_ja: 出産可能年齢の女性2例で、絨毛癌の肝転移を報告。両例とも進行性の貧血または腹腔内出血で発症した。CTでは不均一に増強される肝腫瘤が認められた。血管造影では動脈相で過血管性腫瘤と末梢肝動脈の動脈瘤様拡張、静脈相で持続性の血管湖が見られ、絨毛癌肝転移の画像的特徴を示した。
summary_en: This report describes two women of childbearing age with hepatic metastases from choriocarcinoma. Both presented with progressive anemia or intra-abdominal hemorrhage, and CT showed heterogeneously enhancing liver masses. Angiography revealed hypervascular masses with aneurysmal dilatation of peripheral hepatic arteries in the arterial phase and persistent vascular lakes in the venous phase. These findings help characterize hepatic metastases from choriocarcinoma on imaging.

title: Urothelial carcinoma of the renal pelvis with choriocarcinomatous features: genetic evidence of clonal evolution.
title_ja: 絨毛癌様成分を伴う腎盂尿路上皮癌：クローン進化の遺伝学的証拠
summary_ja: 60歳男性の右腎盂に生じた、乳頭状尿路上皮癌と絨毛癌からなる二相性腫瘍の症例。診断6週後の剖検で肝・肺に絨毛癌様成分を伴う転移が広範に認められた。染色体解析で尿路上皮癌成分と絨毛癌成分は遺伝学的に近縁であった。腎盂の絨毛癌は尿路上皮癌が栄養膜分化を獲得してクローン進化したものと結論づけている。
summary_en: This paper reports a 60-year-old man with a biphasic right renal pelvic tumor composed of papillary urothelial carcinoma and choriocarcinoma. Widespread hepatic and pulmonary metastases with choriocarcinomatous features were found at autopsy six weeks after diagnosis. Chromosomal analysis showed a close genetic relationship between the urothelial and choriocarcinomatous components. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma of the renal pelvis arises through clonal evolution of urothelial carcinoma with trophoblastic differentiation.

title: Expression of functional Fas ligand in choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 絨毛癌における機能的Fasリガンドの発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌におけるFasリガンド(FasL)の発現を検討した。FasLは組織切片と3種の細胞株(JEG-3、JAR、BeWo)で検出された。絨毛癌細胞はFas感受性のJurkat細胞にアポトーシスを誘導し、抗Fas遮断抗体でその作用は大きく抑制された。絨毛癌のFasLが活性化白血球を排除し、抗腫瘍免疫の回避に関与する可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: This study examined Fas ligand (FasL) expression in choriocarcinoma. FasL was detected in choriocarcinoma tissue sections and in JEG-3, JAR, and BeWo cell lines. Choriocarcinoma cells induced apoptosis in Fas-sensitive Jurkat cells in coculture, and a Fas-blocking antibody largely abrogated this apoptosis. The authors suggest that FasL on choriocarcinoma cells may help tumor cells evade immune attack by killing activated Fas-bearing leukocytes.

title: [Dose outside the treatment field for external irradiation with high-energy X-ray reduction of the dose of the remaining testis in postoperative irradiation of seminoma].
title_ja: 「セミノーマ」術後照射における健側精巣線量低減のための高エネルギーX線照射野外線量
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: セミノーマの術後照射で、10MV X線による健側精巣の末梢線量を測定した。線量は照射野の尾側端からの距離、照射野の大きさ、鉛遮蔽の厚さに左右された。加速器ヘッドからの散乱線が主で、照射野が大きいほど照射体積からの散乱線が増えた。照射野端から5cm以上離し、鉛遮蔽を適切に配置すれば治療線量の1%未満に抑えられた。
summary_en: This study measured scattered radiation dose to the contralateral testis during postoperative 10 MV X-ray irradiation for seminoma, using a testicular phantom. Dose depended on distance from the field's caudal edge, field size, and lead shielding. Scatter from the accelerator head contributed mainly, and larger fields increased scatter from the irradiated volume. Peripheral dose could be reduced below 1% of the therapeutic dose when the phantom was over 5 cm from the field edge, with appropriate lead shielding.

title: Granulomatous chemical peritonitis on the ileocecum after laparoscopic surgery of an ovarian mature cystic teratoma: case report.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔鏡手術後に回盲部に生じた肉芽腫性化学性腹膜炎：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔鏡手術後に回盲部の肉芽腫性腹膜炎が生じた症例報告。同腫瘍で腹腔鏡検査が必要な際は、肉芽腫性腹膜炎の可能性を考慮すべきと提言している。
summary_en: This case report describes granulomatous chemical peritonitis involving the ileocecum that developed after laparoscopic surgery for an ovarian mature cystic teratoma. The authors advise that granulomatous peritonitis should be considered when laparoscopy is necessary in patients with this tumor type. The abstract is a single sentence and provides little further detail. Information on the patient's presentation, the surgical approach, the management of the peritonitis, and outcome is not available from the abstract, so the full report should be consulted for those points.

title: Mature teratoma of the pancreas: CT and MR findings.
title_ja: 膵臓の成熟奇形腫のCTおよびMR所見
summary_ja: 膵臓に生じた成熟奇形腫のCTおよびMR所見を初めて記載した報告。画像所見は奇形腫を構成する組織の割合によって変化し、まれな膵病変の診断に役立つ可能性がある。
summary_en: This report describes the CT and MR imaging findings of a mature teratoma arising in the pancreas, which the authors describe as an unusual tumor. They explain that the imaging appearance depends on the proportions of ectodermal, endodermal, and mesodermal tissues within the lesion. The authors state that this is the first description of the CT and MR appearances of this entity. The abstract does not give the number of patients, clinical course, or histological details. Recognition of these imaging features may help distinguish this rare pancreatic lesion.

title: Combined effect of hyperthermia at 42 degrees C and irradiation dose of 2 Gy on two rat yolk sac tumor cell lines with different radio-thermosensitivity in vitro.
title_ja: 2種類のラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株における42℃温熱と2 Gy照射の併用効果
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 同一起源で感受性の異なる2株の卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株を用いた基礎研究。2 Gy照射と42℃温熱の単独・併用処理で生存率を評価し、加温後のNMT-1R株で放射線感受性の増加が認められた。
summary_en: This in vitro study compares two rat yolk sac tumor cell lines, NMT-1 and NMT-1R, which share the same origin but differ in sensitivity to radiation and heat. Clonogenic survival was measured after single and sequential treatments with 2 Gy irradiation and 42℃ hyperthermia. NMT-1 was more radiosensitive, whereas NMT-1R was more heat-resistant and became more radiosensitive after heating. The timing of heat relative to irradiation changed survival, especially in NMT-1R. The authors conclude that these paired cell lines are useful for studying the interaction between irradiation and heat.

title: Malignant mediastinal germ cell tumor with pure hepatoid differentiation.
title_ja: 純粋な肝様分化を示す悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 41歳男性の前縦隔に生じた、純粋な肝様分化とAFP高値を示す悪性胚細胞腫瘍の報告。HepPar-1などの免疫組織化学で肝細胞分化を確認し、同様の腫瘍は中高年男性に多いと述べている。
summary_en: This report describes a malignant germ cell tumor of the anterior mediastinum in a 41-year-old man, showing pure hepatoid differentiation and elevated serum AFP. Hepatocellular differentiation was demonstrated by immunoreactivity for HepPar-1 and AFP, membranous canalicular CEA expression, and focal cytokeratin 19 in abortive ductular structures. The authors note that mediastinal germ cell tumors with hepatoid components typically occur in middle-aged men and are either purely hepatoid or associated with yolk sac structures. This is described as the first such neoplasm analyzed with conventional stains and immunohistochemistry.

title: Non-gestational choriocarcinoma in small intestine.
title_ja: 小腸に生じた非妊娠性絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 22歳女性の小腸に生じた非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。空腸・回腸の部分切除後に化学療法を行い、1年後も良好な状態であった。
summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old married woman with non-gestational choriocarcinoma arising in the small intestine. Treatment consisted of partial resection of the jejunum and ileum followed by chemotherapy. The authors note that choriocarcinoma most often arises from intrauterine gestational trophoblastic tissue, so non-gestational cases are rare. At one-year follow-up she was well. The abstract is brief and gives no further details on staging, tumor markers, or the chemotherapy regimen.

title: Paediatric gastric teratoma.
title_ja: 小児胃奇形腫
summary_ja: 18年間に治療された小児胃奇形腫の男児7例の検討。完全切除が可能で、平均3年のフォローアップで全例に再発はなく、予後は良好と結論されている。
summary_en: This review covers seven male children treated for gastric teratoma over an 18-year period, describing presentation, surgical resection, histology, and outcome. Presentation ranged from melaena to a progressively enlarging abdominal mass, with ages from 1 month to 7 years. Six tumors contained mature elements from all three germ layers, and one was an immature teratoma. All tumors were completely resected without metastasis, and none recurred during an average follow-up of 3 years. The authors conclude that gastric teratoma has an excellent prognosis after curative resection.

title: Dysgerminoma in a patient with a tumor of the neck. Empiric treatment of stage IV dysgerminoma.
title_ja: 頸部腫瘍を伴うディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）患者：病期IVに対する経験的治療
summary_ja: 病期IVの未分化胚細胞腫瘍を呈した患者の症例報告。頸部腫瘍が初発症状であった。進行卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の確立された治療指針に従って治療が行われ、妊孕性を温存できた。転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対してシスプラチンを含むPEP療法が有効であると結論づけられている。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with stage IV undifferentiated germ cell tumor who presented with a neck tumor. Treatment followed established guidelines for advanced malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, and fertility was preserved. The authors conclude that the PEP regimen, a cisplatin-based combination, is an effective treatment for metastatic germ cell tumor.

title: Bax, Bcl-2, fas and Fas-L antigen expression in human seminoma: correlation with the apoptotic index.
title_ja: セミノーマにおけるBax、Bcl-2、Fas、Fas-Lの発現とアポトーシス指数との相関
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 29例のクラシカル型セミノーマを対象に、Bax、Bcl-2、Fas、Fas-Lの発現を免疫組織化学およびウェスタンブロットで検討し、アポトーシス指数と比較した。Bax陽性腫瘍はBax陰性腫瘍よりアポトーシス指数が有意に高く、Baxがセミノーマのアポトーシス調節に重要な役割を果たし、良好な予後と関連する可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study examined Bax, Bcl-2, Fas, and Fas-L expression in 29 classical seminomas by immunohistochemistry and Western blotting, and compared it with the apoptotic index. Fas and Fas-L were expressed in most tumors, and none expressed Bcl-2. Bax-positive tumors showed a significantly higher apoptotic index than Bax-negative tumors, suggesting Bax plays a key role in regulating apoptosis in seminoma and may be linked to its favorable outcome.

title: Testicular cancer and electromagnetic fields (EMF) in the workplace: results of a population-based case-control study in Germany.
title_ja: 職場の電磁界（EMF）と精巣がん：ドイツの人口ベース症例対照研究の結果
summary_ja: ドイツで実施された人口ベースの症例対照研究（症例269例、対照797例）。職場における電磁界（EMF）曝露を面接で評価し、レーダー曝露は専門家が評価した。いずれの曝露区分でもリスク上昇は認められず、セミノーマと非セミノーマのサブグループ解析も同様の結果であった。職場のEMFは精巣がんの重要なリスク因子ではないと結論づけられた。
summary_en: This population-based case-control study in Germany (269 testicular cancer cases and 797 matched controls) assessed workplace electromagnetic field exposure using structured interviews and expert assessment of radar exposure. No increased risk was found for any exposure category, and subgroup analyses by seminoma and non-seminoma yielded similar results. The authors conclude that workplace EMF exposure does not appear to be a relevant risk factor for testicular cancer.

title: An unusual neurogenic cystic tumor.
title_ja: 珍しい神経原性嚢胞性腫瘍：仙骨前部嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 乳児に発生した仙骨前部の嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。嚢胞は中枢神経系組織のみから構成されており、極めて稀な所見である。文献上、この様式で発生した奇形腫の報告は見当たらなかった。病変は頭蓋内ではなく仙骨前部に生じた性腺外の奇形腫であり、本サイトの対象範囲に該当する。
summary_en: This report describes a presacral cystic teratoma in an infant that consisted solely of central nervous system tissue, a finding the authors describe as extremely rare. A literature review found no previous report of a teratoma arising in this manner. The lesion is extragonadal and presacral rather than intracranial, so it falls within the scope of this site's germ cell tumor content.

title: Huge retroperitoneal germinoma presenting with pathological fracture of the spine.
title_ja: 脊椎病的骨折を初発とした巨大後腹膜ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）
summary_ja: 16歳女性の巨大後腹膜ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）の症例報告。T12の病的骨折と脊髄圧迫により進行性の対麻痺を呈した。手術による除圧・固定後、シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる6サイクルの化学療法を実施し、腫瘍は著明に縮小した。2年後も再発はなかった。
summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with a huge retroperitoneal germinoma that caused a pathological fracture of T12 and spinal cord compression, presenting as progressive paraplegia. Surgery was performed for decompression and fixation, followed by six cycles of cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide. The tumor responded dramatically, making major retroperitoneal surgery unnecessary, and the patient remained recurrence-free at 2 years.

title: Expression of c-erbB2 in gestational trophoblastic disease and its clinical significance.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるc-erbB2の発現とその臨床的意義
journal: J Huazhong Univ Sci Technolog Med Sci
summary_ja: 正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌におけるc-erbB2の発現を免疫組織化学で検討しました。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍では発現が有意に高く、c-erbB2の過剰発現は胞状奇胎の悪性転化と関連する可能性が示されました。早期診断や治療への応用が期待されます。
summary_en: This study examined c-erbB2 expression by immunohistochemistry in normal placenta, hydatidiform moles, invasive moles, and choriocarcinomas. Expression was significantly higher in gestational trophoblastic tumors than in hydatidiform moles and normal placentas of midterm and term pregnancy. No difference was seen between early and advanced clinical stages. The authors suggest c-erbB2 overexpression may be associated with malignant transformation of hydatidiform mole and could aid early diagnosis and treatment of gestational trophoblastic tumors.

title: Dietary factors and the risk of testicular cancer.
title_ja: 食事因子と精巣がんのリスク：組織型別の症例対照研究
summary_ja: 精巣がん117例と対照334例を用いた症例対照研究で、食事の栄養素と食品群を組織型別に検討しました。ビタミンEは非セミノーマで低リスク傾向、セミノーマで高リスク傾向を示しました。全体では食事と精巣がんの関連は認められず、組織型ごとに病因が異なる可能性が示唆されました。
summary_en: This hospital-based case-control study of 117 testicular cancer patients and 334 controls examined dietary nutrients and food groups by histologic subtype. Vitamin E intake appeared protective for nonseminoma and mixed germ cell tumors but suggested increased risk for seminoma. High saturated and animal fat intake was suggestively associated with seminoma risk. Overall, diet was not associated with testicular cancer. The authors conclude seminoma, nonseminoma, and mixed germ cell tumors may have different etiologies and recommend continued histology-stratified analyses in future studies.

title: A case-control study of dietary phytoestrogens and testicular cancer risk.
title_ja: 食事性フィトエストロゲンと精巣がんリスク：症例対照研究
summary_ja: 精巣がん159例と対照136例を用いた症例対照研究で、食事性フィトエストロゲンと精巣がんリスクの関連を調べました。摂取量の四分位ごとに一定の傾向は認められず、リグナンとクマエストロールでU字型のパターンがみられましたが、効果なしとも矛盾しませんでした。
summary_en: This hospital-based case-control study of 159 testicular cancer cases and 136 matched controls evaluated dietary phytoestrogens, including lignans, flavonoids, isoflavonoids, and coumestrol. After multivariate adjustment, no consistent monotonic association with risk emerged across quartiles of intake. Lignans and coumestrol showed a U-shaped pattern, though data were also compatible with no effect. The hypothesis-generating study does not support the idea that dietary phytoestrogens alter testicular cancer risk in young men.

title: Ovarian tumours: a study of 282 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣腫瘍282例の検討
summary_ja: WHO分類に従って分類した卵巣腫瘍282例の内訳を報告した研究です。良性が75.2%、悪性が21.9%で、胚細胞腫瘍は21.2%を占めました。内訳は奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍などで、発症のピークは21〜40歳でした。
summary_en: This study reviewed 282 ovarian tumors classified by WHO criteria. Most were benign (75.2%), with 2.8% borderline and 21.9% malignant. Epithelial tumors predominated, followed by germ cell tumors (21.2%), including teratomas, dysgerminomas, and endodermal sinus tumors, and sex cord stromal tumors. Serous and mucinous tumors were most common among individual types. Ovarian tumors occurred from infancy to age 74, with peak incidence between 21 and 40 years. The paper provides a descriptive epidemiologic and histopathologic profile of ovarian tumors at one center.

title: Gliomatosis peritonei with mature teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症を伴う卵巣成熟奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟奇形腫に、腹膜および付属器への神経膠組織の播種を伴い、腹膜神経膠腫症を呈した症例報告です。腫瘍と大網の切除後、腹腔鏡検査で播種病変の縮小と線維化を確認しました。まれな病態の経過と治療を示した貴重な報告です。
summary_en: This case report describes a menstrual mature teratoma of the ovary with glial implants in the peritoneum and adnexa, a condition known as gliomatosis peritonei. After tumor and omentum resection, laparoscopic examination showed reduction and fibrosis of the glial implants with a marked cellular reaction. The report documents an uncommon presentation of mature teratoma with peritoneal spread and its management by resection and laparoscopic follow-up.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ arising in mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌（上皮内癌）
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた純粋な扁平上皮癌上皮内癌の症例報告です。奇形腫の悪性転化は通常浸潤性扁平上皮癌として見られるため、本例は稀な所見とされます。奇形腫の病理学的評価の重要性を示しています。
summary_en: This case report describes squamous cell carcinoma in situ arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Most malignant degeneration of these tumors is invasive squamous cell carcinoma, so pure in situ carcinoma in an otherwise benign cystic teratoma is rare. The report highlights an uncommon pattern of malignant transformation in ovarian germ cell tumors and the importance of careful pathological sampling of mature teratomas.

title: Primary squamous cell carcinoma of the ovary in a young patient. A case report.
title_ja: 若年患者の卵巣原発扁平上皮癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 29歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた原発性扁平上皮癌の症例報告です。若年患者でこのような悪性転化は稀であり、奇形腫由来の悪性腫瘍の臨床像として注目されます。若年成人の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍関連病変の診療にも参考になる症例です。
summary_en: This case report describes primary squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian dermoid cyst in a 29-year-old woman. Such malignant transformation is unusual in young patients, which makes the case noteworthy. The report documents an uncommon presentation of a teratoma-derived malignancy in a young adult, and is relevant to clinicians managing ovarian germ cell-derived tumors in younger patients.

title: Coexistence of malignant struma ovarii and Graves' disease.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫とグレーブス病の合併
summary_ja: 53歳女性で、再発性のグレーブス病による甲状腺機能亢進症と悪性卵巣甲状腺腫が併存した症例です。乳頭状甲状腺癌の濾胞型亜型を含む卵巣甲状腺腫を摘出し、抗甲状腺薬と放射性ヨウ素アブレーションで治療しました。併存するグレーブス病が治療と予後に影響する点が示されています。
summary_en: This report describes a 53-year-old woman with recurrent hyperthyroidism from Graves' disease who was found to have malignant struma ovarii. A 1 cm struma ovarii containing follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma was removed, and the patient was treated with antithyroid drugs and radioiodine ablation. The case shows how coexisting Graves' disease complicates treatment and prognosis. The authors also discuss the incidence of ovarian tumors with thyroid tissue.

title: High dose chemotherapy and stem cell support for poor risk and recurrent nonseminomatous germ cell cancer: initial experience with sequential therapy.
title_ja: 予後不良例および再発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する大量化学療法と幹細胞支持：逐次療法の初期経験
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者5例に対し、大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞支持療法を施行した初期経験の報告です。4例は再発例に対する救援療法、1例は予後不良因子を有する初回治療として実施されました。平均18か月のフォローアップで4例が無病生存し、1例で再発しています。
summary_en: This study reports initial experience with high-dose chemotherapy and peripheral blood stem cell support in five patients with testicular cancer. Four received it as salvage therapy for relapse, and one as primary treatment because of poor prognostic features. At about 18 months of follow-up, four remained disease-free and one had relapsed. The authors conclude that the approach may be beneficial, but randomized trials are needed.

title: Hydronephrosis secondary to a seminoma in abdominal cryptorchid testis.
title_ja: 腹腔内停留精巣に生じたセミノーマによる水腎症
summary_ja: 22歳男性で、腹腔内停留精巣に生じたセミノーマが水腎症を起こした症例です。腹痛、側腹部痛、血尿で受診し、画像で右腎の機能廃絶と充実性腫瘤が確認されました。開腹手術で腫瘤を切除し、古典的セミノーマと診断されています。腹腔内精巣は悪性腫瘍のリスクが高く、2歳以降の精巣固定術が推奨されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with hydronephrosis caused by a seminoma arising in an abdominal cryptorchid testis. He presented with abdominal pain, flank pain, and hematuria, and imaging showed a non-functioning right kidney and a solid mass. Laparotomy and resection confirmed classic seminoma. The authors note that abdominal testes carry a higher malignancy risk and recommend orchiopexy after age two.

title: Benign and malignant struma ovarii: report of three cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 良性および悪性卵巣甲状腺腫：3症例の報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫の3症例を報告し、良性2例と悪性卵巣甲状腺腫1例を含みます。悪性例では甲状腺濾胞癌とストルマカルチノイドが認められ、術後にエトポシドによる単剤化学療法を6サイクル行いました。全例で術後の甲状腺機能は正常でした。文献的考察から、外科的管理が第一選択とされています。
summary_en: This report describes three patients with struma ovarii, two with benign tumors and one with malignant struma ovarii showing follicular carcinoma and strumal carcinoid. The malignant case received six cycles of etoposide monotherapy after surgery. All patients had normal thyroid function postoperatively. The authors review the literature and conclude that surgical management is the treatment of choice and helps prevent future malignant transformation.

title: Acute presentation of choriocarcinoma: a case study and review of the literature.
title_ja: 絨毛癌の急性発症：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 27歳男性の精巣絨毛癌の症例報告。数日間の精巣痛の後、不安定なバイタル、高度貧血、動脈脈圧の拡大で急性発症した。肝転移と出血性傍大動脈リンパ節腫大を認めた。脈圧拡大は蘇生後も持続し、化学療法開始後に改善した。急性発症例の文献レビューと脈圧拡大との関連を考察する。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with testicular choriocarcinoma who presented acutely with unstable vital signs, severe anemia, and a widened arterial pulse pressure after several days of testicular pain. Imaging showed multiple hepatic metastases and large hemorrhagic para-aortic lymph nodes. The widened pulse pressure persisted despite resuscitation and narrowed only after chemotherapy was started. The authors review reported cases of acute testicular choriocarcinoma and discuss the relationship between acute presentation and widened pulse pressure.

title: An atypical presentation of metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma with maxillary sinus and subcutaneous involvement; report of a case with literature review.
title_ja: 上顎洞および皮下に浸潤した転移性妊娠性絨毛癌の非典型例：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 21歳女性の転移性妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。反復する鼻出血、膣・直腸出血、皮下結節、上顎洞腫瘤で非典型的に発症した。β-hCGの著明高値と、腎・後腹膜・両肺への転移を認めた。生検で絨毛癌と確定し、WHO基準で高リスクに分類され併用化学療法を受けた。妊娠歴の確認と鑑別診断への追加を提言する。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma that presented atypically with recurrent epistaxis, vaginal and rectal bleeding, subcutaneous nodules, and a maxillary sinus mass invading the nasal cavity. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated, and CT showed renal, retroperitoneal, and bilateral lung metastases. Biopsy confirmed choriocarcinoma, which was classified as high-risk under WHO criteria and treated with combination chemotherapy. The authors advise including choriocarcinoma in the differential diagnosis for such presentations and taking a pregnancy history.

title: Third pinna in nasopharynx-a rare case of mature teratoma.
title_ja: 鼻咽頭における第3の耳介：成熟奇形腫の稀な症例
journal: Indian J Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg
summary_ja: 鼻咽頭に発生した稀な成熟奇形腫の症例報告。耳介様の形態を示し、正常部位にも二つの耳介が存在していた。奇形腫は胚発生初期に三胚葉から生じ、出生時前後に上気道・消化管の閉塞をきたすことが多い。病因、分類、臨床像、治療について考察する。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare mature teratoma of the nasopharynx that resembled a third pinna, with two other pinnae present at their normal anatomical sites. Teratomas arise during early embryogenesis from all three germ layers and typically cause upper aerodigestive tract obstruction at or soon after birth. The authors describe the clinical presentation and discuss the etiology, classification, and management of teratoma.

title: Childhood Extracranial Germ Cell Tumors Treatment (PDQ®): Patient Version.

summary_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、患者・家族・介護者向けに解説したPDQ患者向けサマリー。医療従事者向け版から採録され、PDQ小児治療編集委員会が定期的に見直している。新たな情報が出れば改訂され、医療上の意思決定に関する正式なガイドラインや推奨は含まれていない。各サマリーの日付は最新の変更日を示す。
summary_en: This PDQ patient summary explains treatment of childhood extracranial germ cell tumors for patients, families, and caregivers. Its content is drawn from the health professional version, which is reviewed regularly by the PDQ Pediatric Treatment Editorial Board. It does not offer formal guidelines or recommendations for medical decisions. The summary is updated when new information emerges, and its date reflects the most recent change.

summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、患者・家族・介護者向けに解説したPDQ患者向けサマリー。医療従事者向け版から採録され、PDQ成人治療編集委員会が定期的に見直している。新たな情報があれば改訂され、「最終更新日」は直近の変更日を示す。医療上の意思決定に関する正式なガイドラインや推奨ではない。
summary_en: This PDQ patient summary explains treatment of extragonadal germ cell tumors for patients, families, and caregivers. tags: ガイドライン・コンセンサス
summary_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、臨床医を支援するためエビデンスに基づく査読済み情報を提供するPDQ医療従事者向けサマリー。PDQ小児治療編集委員会が定期的に見直し更新する。同委員会はNCIから編集上独立している。正式なガイドラインではなく、NCIやNIHの方針を表明するものでもない。
summary_en: This PDQ health professional summary offers evidence-based, peer-reviewed information on treating childhood extracranial germ cell tumors, intended to assist clinicians. It is reviewed and updated by the PDQ Pediatric Treatment Editorial Board, which is independent of the National Cancer Institute. It does not provide formal guidelines, and it reflects an independent literature review rather than NCI or NIH policy.

title: Extragonadal Germ Cell Tumors Treatment (PDQ®): Health Professional Version.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の治療（PDQ®）：医療従事者版
tags: ガイドライン・コンセンサス
summary_ja: 性腺外に発生する胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、査読を経てエビデンスに基づいた情報を提供する医療従事者向けのPDQサマリーである。臨床医が患者ケアを行う際の参考資料として作成されている。医療上の決定に関する正式なガイドラインや推奨ではない。PDQ成人治療編集委員会が定期的に更新しており、同委員会はNCIから編集上独立している。文献の独立したレビューに基づいている。
summary_en: This PDQ health professional summary provides comprehensive, peer-reviewed, evidence-based information on treating extragonadal germ cell tumors, which arise outside the gonads. Written as a resource for clinicians caring for patients, it reviews the treatment literature for these tumors. It does not provide formal guidelines or recommendations for health care decisions. The summary is updated regularly by the PDQ Adult Treatment Editorial Board, which is editorially independent of the National Cancer Institute, and reflects an independent literature review.

title: Ovarian Germ Cell Tumors Treatment (PDQ®): Patient Version.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療（PDQ®）：患者版
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、患者とその家族・介護者向けにわかりやすく解説したPDQの患者版サマリーである。内容は成人治療編集委員会が管理する医療従事者版に基づいている。本資料は治療に関する正式な推奨を示すものではなく、患者が病気と医療について理解するための一般的な情報を提供している。定期的に見直され、更新される。
summary_en: This PDQ patient summary explains the treatment of ovarian germ cell tumors, written for patients, families, and caregivers. It is based on the health professional version maintained by the PDQ Adult Treatment Editorial Board. The document offers general information to help patients understand their disease and care, and it does not give formal recommendations for health care decisions. title: Ovarian Germ Cell Tumors Treatment (PDQ®): Health Professional Version.

tags: ガイドライン・コンセンサス
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療について、査読を経てエビデンスに基づいた情報を提供する医療従事者向けのPDQサマリーである。臨床医が患者ケアを行う際の参考資料として作成されている。医療上の決定に関する正式なガイドラインや推奨ではない。PDQ成人治療編集委員会が定期的に更新しており、同委員会はNCIから編集上独立している。文献の独立したレビューに基づいている。
summary_en: This PDQ health professional summary provides peer-reviewed, evidence-based information on the treatment of ovarian germ cell tumors. Written as a resource for clinicians caring for patients, it summarizes the treatment literature for these tumors arising in the ovary. It does not provide formal guidelines or recommendations for health care decisions. The summary is updated regularly by the PDQ Adult Treatment Editorial Board, which is editorially independent of the National Cancer Institute, and reflects an independent review of the literature.

title: A Case of Primary Gastric Choriocarcinoma Presenting with Amenorrhea.
title_ja: 無月経を呈した原発性胃絨毛癌の1例
summary_ja: 37歳女性の原発性胃絨毛癌の症例報告である。無月経や性器出血、悪心を呈し、妊娠や妊娠性絨毛性疾患との鑑別が問題となった。血清β-hCGは著明に上昇し、内視鏡生検で絨毛癌と診断された。免疫組織化学染色でβ-hCGが陽性であった。化学療法を施行したが、診断から8か月で死亡した。極めてまれで予後不良な性腺外発生例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old woman with primary gastric choriocarcinoma who presented with amenorrhea, spotting, and nausea that mimicked pregnancy. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated, and an endoscopic biopsy of the gastric mass confirmed choriocarcinoma. Immunohistochemical staining was positive for beta-hCG. She received chemotherapy but died eight months after diagnosis. The authors highlight the rarity and very poor prognosis of this extragonadal presentation.

title: Validation of a prediction model and its predictors for the histology of residual masses in nonseminomatous testicular cancer.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんにおける残存後腹膜腫瘤の組織学的予測モデルの検証
summary_ja: インディアナ大学で1985〜1999年に化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤を切除した276例を対象に、組織型の予測モデルを検証した。判別能は良好（一致度0.79）だったが、良性組織の予測確率を過大評価していた。良性組織は28%であり、地域の良性と腫瘍性の比率に合わせた補正が必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This study validated a previously developed prediction model for the histology of residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy in 276 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer treated at Indiana University between 1985 and 1999. Predictors included teratomatous elements, pre-chemotherapy AFP and hCG, residual mass size, and mass reduction. The modified model showed good discrimination with a concordance statistic of 0.79, but it overestimated benign tissue, which occurred in 28% of cases. The authors conclude that the model must be recalibrated to local benign-to-tumor ratios for reliable prediction.

title: Extraperitoneal laparoscopic para-aortic lymph node dissection for early stage nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis with introduction of a nerve sparing technique: description and results.
title_ja: 精巣の早期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する神経温存技術を導入した腹膜外腹腔鏡下傍大動脈リンパ節郭清：手技と成績
summary_ja: 本報告は、臨床病期IまたはIIAの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者25例に対し、新しい腹膜外アプローチによる腹腔鏡下傍大動脈リンパ節郭清を行った結果を記述したものである。最後の12例では神経温存郭清を加えた。平均手術時間は3時間50分、平均入院期間は1.2日で、開腹移行を要する合併症はなかった。病理陽性の10例は白金製剤併用化学療法を受け、平均15カ月の追跡で遅発性の有害事象や再発はみられなかった。著者らは、本法が安全で有効かつ費用対効果に優れると考えている。
summary_en: This report describes a new extraperitoneal approach to laparoscopic para-aortic lymph node dissection in 25 patients with clinical stage I or IIA nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Nerve-sparing dissection was added in the final 12 cases. Mean operative time was 3 hours 50 minutes and mean hospital stay was 1.2 days, with no complications requiring laparotomy. Ten patients with positive results received platinum-based chemotherapy, and no late adverse effects or recurrence were seen at a mean follow-up of 15 months. The authors consider the approach safe, effective, and cost-effective, though longer follow-up is needed.

title: Spermatogenesis after unilateral orchiectomy for testicular cancer in patients following surveillance policy.
title_ja: 監視療法を受けた精巣がん患者における片側精巣摘除術後の精子形成
summary_ja: 監視療法を選択した非再発の精巣がん患者60例を対象に、片側精巣摘除術後の精子形成を追跡した。術後1年間で精子濃度は有意に上昇し、45例が正常精子症に回復した。ベースラインのFSH高値は回復不良と関連した。将来の父親を希望する患者や高リスク例では、この期間に精液の複数回凍結保存を行うことを提案している。
summary_en: This long-term study examined spermatogenesis in 60 men with nonrelapsing testicular cancer who underwent unilateral orchiectomy and surveillance. Sperm counts and FSH levels were measured at baseline and at one and two or more years after surgery. Sperm concentration rose significantly during the first postoperative year, and 45 patients became normospermic. Elevated baseline FSH predicted incomplete recovery. Transient improvement also occurred in two men who later developed contralateral cancer. The authors suggest multiple sperm cryopreservations during this window for high-risk men or those planning fatherhood.

title: Twelve-year experience with two courses of adjuvant single-agent carboplatin therapy for clinical stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 臨床病期I精巣セミノーマに対する2コースの補助単剤カルボプラチン療法の12年間の経験
summary_ja: 1988年から1999年に治療された臨床病期Iセミノーマの107例に、400 mg/m²のカルボプラチンによる2コースの補助単剤療法を行った後方視的研究である。大半はpT1病期であった。中央値74か月の追跡で101例が生存し無病であり、6例は腫瘍と無関係の原因で死亡した。血液毒性は軽度で、WHOグレード1または2の白血球減少のみであった。再発がなく毒性も良好であることから、著者らは本療法が放射線療法と同等である可能性があると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated two adjuvant courses of single-agent carboplatin (400 mg/m²) in 107 patients with clinical stage I seminoma treated between 1988 and 1999. Most patients had pT1 disease. After a median follow-up of 74 months, 101 patients were alive and disease-free, and six had died of unrelated causes. Hematologic toxicity was mild, with only grade 1 or 2 leukocytopenia. The authors conclude that two cycles of carboplatin may be equivalent to radiotherapy as adjuvant treatment, given the absence of recurrences and favorable toxicity.

title: Combined choriocarcinoma and adenocarcinoma of the lung occurring in a man: case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 男性に生じた肺の絨毛癌と腺癌の合併：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 61歳男性の肺絨毛癌と肺腺癌の合併例の症例報告。喀血で受診し、胸部CTで出血を伴う新生腫瘍を認めた。開胸術で腺癌と小さな絨毛癌成分が確認され、胸膜播種のため化学療法を施行した。hCG-βは徐々に上昇したが生存を維持している。男性の原発性肺絨毛癌の文献的検討も行っている。
summary_en: This report describes a 61-year-old man with combined primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma and adenocarcinoma, presenting with hemoptysis. Chest CT showed a new hemorrhagic tumor, and thoracotomy revealed adenocarcinoma with a small choriocarcinoma component. Because of pleural dissemination, the patient received chemotherapy and remained alive at last follow-up, although serum hCG-beta rose gradually. The authors also review the 12 previously reported cases of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in men, a condition with a fatal prognosis.

title: Malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors: an intergroup study.
title_ja: 縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍：施設群共同研究
summary_ja: POG 9049/CCG 8882無作為化試験に基づく二次解析で、小児の縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍36例を検討した。女児では卵黄嚢腫瘍のみが悪性成分であり、男児では多様な組織型が混在していた。化学療法単独では腫瘍の縮小が不完全なことが多く、診断時または化学療法後の外科的切除が重要とされた。4年患者生存率は71%であった。15歳以上の男児は腫瘍進行による死亡リスクが高かった。
summary_en: This intergroup analysis of the POG 9049/CCG 8882 randomized trial reviews 36 children with malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors, most arising in the anterior mediastinum. Yolk sac tumor was the only malignant element in girls, while boys showed mixed histologies. Chemotherapy alone often left incomplete regression, so resection was performed at diagnosis or after induction chemotherapy. The 4-year patient survival rate was 71%. Boys aged 15 years or older had higher mortality from tumor progression, suggesting a high-risk subgroup.

title: Role of postchemotherapy adjunctive surgery in the management of patients with nonseminoma arising from the mediastinum.
title_ja: 縦隔原発非セミノーマに対する化学療法後の補助的手術の役割
summary_ja: 前縦隔原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍32例に対する化学療法後の外科的切除の意義を検討。84%で完全切除が得られ、切除検体の66%に生存腫瘍を認めた。生存腫瘍の存在と複数部位の切除は予後不良と関連した。化学療法後に残存腫瘤を有する症例では手術が重要であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study evaluates postchemotherapy surgical resection in 32 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors arising in the anterior mediastinum. Complete resection was achieved in 84%. Viable tumor was found in 66% of resected residua, teratoma in 22%, and necrosis in 12%. Viable tumor in the specimen and resection of multiple sites were associated with shorter survival, while preoperative marker status did not significantly affect survival. The authors conclude that surgery is integral for patients with residual mass after chemotherapy.

title: Fertility-sparing surgery, with subsequent pregnancy, in persistent gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: case report.
title_ja: 持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する妊孕性温存手術とその後の妊娠：症例報告
summary_ja: 子宮に持続性の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を有した女性に対し、子宮摘出を避けて局所的な子宮切除と再建を行った症例報告。その後2回の妊娠・分娩に成功した。文献的検討も行い、子宮再建後の子宮破裂などの妊娠合併症について考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman with persistent uterine gestational trophoblastic neoplasia who was treated with localized uterine resection and reconstruction rather than hysterectomy, preserving fertility. She subsequently had two successful pregnancies and deliveries. The authors review the literature on this approach and discuss potential pregnancy complications, particularly uterine rupture, that may arise after uterine reconstruction.

title: Utility of commonly used commercial human chorionic gonadotropin immunoassays in the diagnosis and management of trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 栄養膜疾患におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)免疫測定法の有用性：診断と管理における検討
summary_ja: 栄養膜疾患患者におけるhCG免疫測定法7種を比較した研究。異常型hCGの検出能と偽陽性の有無を評価した。DPC法とRIAのみが異常型hCGを検出し、DPC法はRIAと最もよく一致し偽陽性も回避した。栄養膜疾患の診断と管理には、DPC法などの測定法が適切と結論づけている。
summary_en: This study compares seven commercial hCG immunoassays in patients with trophoblastic diseases, along with irregular hCG forms and sera from patients with prior false-positive results. Only the DPC and RIA reliably detected irregular hCG forms, and the DPC assay agreed best with RIA while avoiding false positives. The authors conclude that the DPC assay, and similarly designed assays, are appropriate for hCG testing in the diagnosis and management of gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Testicular microlithiasis: US follow-up.
title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化の超音波によるフォローアップ
summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化（TM）患者104例を対象に、古典型と限局型の経過を比較した研究。初診時の腫瘍合併は古典型18%、限局型2%だった。平均45か月のフォローアップで新たな精巣腫瘍は認めず、短期的な悪性化リスクは低いと結論づけ、定期的超音波検査の必要性に疑問を呈している。
summary_en: This study followed 104 patients with testicular microlithiasis (TM), comparing classic TM (five or more microliths) with limited TM (fewer than five). Tumor was present at presentation in 18% of classic TM patients versus 2% of limited TM patients. Among 72 patients followed for a mean of 45 months, no testicular neoplasm developed, and limited TM never progressed to classic TM. The authors conclude that short-term malignancy risk is low and question the need for routine ultrasound surveillance.

title: Prediction of relapse after lymph node dissection for germ cell tumours: can salvage chemotherapy be avoided?
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の再発予測：救援化学療法は回避できるか
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清118例の組織像を定量評価した研究。未熟・悪性成分を残した28例では、胎児性癌の割合とKi-67指数が再発を予測した。胎児性癌25%超では再発率84%、Ki-67 50%超では71%だった。高リスク例には補助療法を検討し、他は経過観察を提案している。
summary_en: This study reviewed 118 retroperitoneal lymph node dissections for metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours and quantified the morphology within them. Among 28 patients with immature or malignant residual elements managed by surveillance, the proportion of embryonal carcinoma and the Ki-67 proliferation index predicted relapse. Patients with more than 25% embryonal carcinoma had an 84% relapse rate, and those with Ki-67 above 50% had 71%. The authors suggest high-risk patients might be considered for adjuvant therapy, while others could be observed.

title: Nongestational pure ovarian choriocarcinoma with contralateral teratoma.
title_ja: 非妊娠性純粋卵巣絨毛癌と対側の奇形腫
summary_ja: 対側卵巣に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴った非妊娠性純粋卵巣絨毛癌の症例を報告し、既報30例の臨床病理学的特徴と治療成績を整理している。手術とメトトレキサートを含む術後化学療法で良好な反応が得られると結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes a case of nongestational pure ovarian choriocarcinoma accompanied by mature cystic teratoma in the contralateral ovary. The authors also compile clinicopathological data from 30 published cases, including clinical features, associations, surgicopathological findings, operative procedures, postoperative chemotherapy and outcome. They conclude that this rare malignancy responds well to surgery followed by postoperative chemotherapy, including methotrexate-based regimens.

title: Intensive and timely chemotherapy, the key of success in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんの治療における集中的かつ適時の化学療法：治癒の鍵
summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍では、シスプラチン併用化学療法の導入以降90%以上が治癒するが、予後不良例では約半数に留まる。一次治療・救援治療における大量化学療法の役割を総説し、現時点では標準治療ではないとしている。
summary_en: This review examines intensive, timely chemotherapy in testicular cancer. Since cisplatin-based chemotherapy, over 90% of advanced germ cell tumor patients are curable, but only about half with poor-risk features and under a quarter after first relapse are cured by conventional chemotherapy. The authors review dose-intensity in conventional chemotherapy and high-dose chemotherapy in first-line, first salvage and refractory settings. They note that randomized trial evidence is limited and that high-dose chemotherapy is not a standard treatment, and call for new strategies for patients with poor-prognosis germ cell tumors.

title: Disseminated choriocarcinoma in infancy is curable by chemotherapy and delayed tumour resection.
title_ja: 切除を遅らせた化学療法により治癒した乳児播種性絨毛癌
summary_ja: 肝転移を伴う進行性の乳児絨毛癌2例に、PEI化学療法と切除の遅延を組み合わせて治療し、42か月・40か月の無イベント生存を得た。FISH解析では染色体の異常も確認された。化学療法と遅延切除により乳児絨毛癌は治癒可能と結論づけている。
summary_en: Two infants aged 3 and 4 months with rapidly progressive choriocarcinoma and hepatic metastases were treated under the German MAKEI 96 germ cell tumour protocol with PEI chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, ifosfamide, with ifosfamide withheld before age 4 months), combined with delayed tumour resection. Both achieved sustained remission, with event-free survival of 42 and 40 months. FISH analysis of one tumour revealed copy gains of chromosomes X, 1 and 17 and an imbalance between the arms of chromosome 1. The authors conclude that infantile choriocarcinoma can be cured with chemotherapy and delayed resection.

title: Metachronous gonadal and extragonadal primaries, or late relapse of germ cell tumor?
title_ja: 異時性の性腺原発および性腺外原発の胚細胞腫瘍か、それとも胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発か
summary_ja: 同一患者に異時性に生じた性腺原発と性腺外原発の胚細胞腫瘍5例を報告。松果体のジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）や蝶形骨洞の病変を含む中枢神経系例と、後腹膜例を含む。残存精巣は重複原発のリスクがあり遺伝的素因が関与しうるが、真の重複癌か後腹膜原発の再発かは判別できなかったとしている。
summary_en: Five cases of apparently metachronous extragonadal and gonadal germ cell tumors occurring in the same patients are reported. Two patients had CNS and testicular tumors, including a pineal germinoma followed by a nonseminomatous testicular tumor 10 years later, and a testicular seminoma followed by a sphenoidal sinus germinoma 17 months later. Three patients had retroperitoneal and testicular tumors separated by 22 to 66 months. The authors suggest the remaining testis is at risk for a second primary and that genetic predisposition may contribute, but could not distinguish a true second primary from relapse of a retroperitoneal primary.

title: Overexpression of RhoA mRNA is associated with advanced stage in testicular germ cell tumour.
title_ja: RhoA mRNAの過剰発現は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進行期と関連する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 日本人患者45例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍でRhoA mRNAを定量し、非腫瘍組織より高値で、病期が進むほど増加することを示した。セミノーマ単独例より、セミノーマと非セミノーマが共存する領域で高かった。RhoAは進行の予後マーカーとなりうると結論づけている。
summary_en: The study measured mRNA levels of RhoA, RhoB and RhoC by RT-PCR in surgical specimens of testicular germ cell tumour from 45 Japanese patients and in matched unaffected testis. RhoA mRNA was higher in tumour than in normal tissue and increased with tumour stage, whereas RhoB and RhoC were undetectable. RhoA levels were higher in areas with both seminoma and nonseminoma than in seminoma-only tumours. The authors propose that RhoA is involved in testicular germ cell carcinogenesis and progression and may serve as a prognostic marker.

title: Altered mitochondrial gene expression in human gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるミトコンドリア遺伝子発現の変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）におけるミトコンドリア遺伝子発現の変化を検討した。差分表示法により、良性・悪性の両方で発現が低下する4種のミトコンドリア転写産物が同定された。完全奇胎、持続性GTD、絨毛癌由来JEG-3細胞で確認され、mtTFA mRNAの低下も認められた。ミトコンドリアDNA量は変化せず、転写の変化が表現型と関連すると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study examines mitochondrial gene expression in gestational trophoblastic diseases. Differential display identified four mitochondrial transcripts (COX I, ATPase 6, 12S rRNA, tRNA-Phe) that were downregulated in both benign and malignant trophoblastic diseases, including complete hydatidiform mole, persistent GTD, and the JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell line. mtDNA copy number was unchanged, but mtTFA mRNA was reduced. Western blotting confirmed decreased COX-I protein. The authors conclude that altered mitochondrial transcription is associated with the phenotype of GTDs.

title: Erythropoietin in urologic oncology.
title_ja: 泌尿器腫瘍学におけるエリスロポエチン
summary_ja: 本総説は、前立腺がん、膀胱がん、腎細胞がん、精巣がんという4つの泌尿器悪性腫瘍における貧血に対するエリスロポエチン（EPO）の使用を検討している。精巣がんでは、IGCCCG分類の中等度・不良リスク群や救援化学療法を受ける場合に輸血の必要性が高くなる。治癒率が高いため、輸血による感染リスクを避けるためEPOが一般に望ましいとされる。前立腺がんや膀胱がんでもEPOの適応が示されている。
summary_en: This review assesses erythropoietin (EPO) for anemia in four urologic malignancies: prostate, bladder, renal cell carcinoma, and testis cancer. EPO may be justified before radical prostatectomy and in hormone-refractory prostate cancer, and in bladder cancer during radical cystectomy or polychemotherapy. Renal cell carcinoma rarely needs EPO. For testis cancer, transfusion risk is substantial in intermediate or poor IGCCCG risk groups or with salvage therapy. Because cure rates are excellent, EPO is generally preferred over transfusion to avoid infection risks.

title: Fertility and sexual function following orchiectomy and 2 cycles of chemotherapy for stage I high risk nonseminomatous germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 病期I・高リスク非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する精巣摘除術と化学療法2サイクル後の妊孕性および性機能
summary_ja: 本研究は、高リスクの病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍59例を対象に、精巣摘除術後のシスプラチン併用補助化学療法2サイクルが妊孕性と性機能に与える影響を検討した。32か月以上経過後のアンケートに回答した49例中、父親となった割合は治療前の37%から治療後22%に低下した。性機能に有意な変化はなく、精液検査とホルモン値の多くは正常範囲であった。
summary_en: This study assessed fertility and sexual function in 59 patients with high-risk stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis treated with orchiectomy followed by two cycles of adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Of 49 patients who responded to a questionnaire at least 32 months later, the proportion who fathered children fell from 37% before treatment to 22% after. Sexual function did not change significantly. Semen analysis was mostly normal, and hormone levels were largely within the normal range. The authors conclude that two cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy do not adversely affect fertility or sexual activity.

title: Unusual "floating balls" appearance of an ovarian cystic teratoma: sonographic and CT findings.
title_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の特異な「浮遊ボール」像：超音波およびCT所見
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、可動性で高エコーの脂肪性の球状物が嚢胞内に浮遊する、特異な超音波像を示した卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫を報告している。この所見はCTでも対応する像として確認された。脂肪成分を含む嚢胞性奇形腫は、超音波とCTで診断しやすい脂肪性腫瘍である。この特徴的な所見を認識することが、両画像診断の正確な読影に役立つと考えられる。
summary_en: This case report describes an ovarian cystic teratoma with an unusual sonographic appearance of mobile, hyperechoic intracystic fat balls.
