CT imaging showed findings that correlated well with the sonographic appearance, confirming the fat balls as fatty components within the cyst. Ovarian cystic teratomas are cystic fatty tumors that are readily diagnosed by sonography and CT. The report emphasizes that recognizing this pattern can help clinicians interpret such lesions accurately on both imaging modalities.

title: Activation of functional oxytocin receptors stimulates cell proliferation in human trophoblast and choriocarcinoma cell lines.
title_ja: ヒト栄養膜細胞株および絨毛癌細胞株におけるオキシトシン受容体の活性化は細胞増殖を促進する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、正常ヒト栄養膜細胞株（ED27、ED77）と絨毛癌細胞株BeWoにオキシトシン受容体（OTR）が機能的に存在することを示した。オキシトシンは用量依存的に細胞内カルシウムを増加させ、拮抗薬で抑制された。また、複数のタンパク質のチロシンリン酸化を誘導し、全細胞株で増殖を促進した。正常および腫瘍性の栄養膜細胞の増殖に関与し、絨毛癌の増殖にも役割を果たす可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study shows that functional oxytocin receptors (OTR) are present in normal human trophoblast cell lines (ED27, ED77) and the choriocarcinoma line BeWo. Oxytocin raised intracellular calcium in a dose-dependent manner, blocked by an OT antagonist, and induced tyrosine phosphorylation of several proteins. Oxytocin stimulated cell proliferation in all lines, with the effect abolished by the antagonist. The authors conclude that oxytocin promotes proliferation of both normal and neoplastic trophoblast cells, suggesting a possible role in choriocarcinoma growth.

title: Survival and reproductive function after treatment of malignant germ cell ovarian tumors.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療後の生存と生殖機能
summary_ja: 1982年から1996年に悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された女性169例を対象に、生存率と妊孕性への影響を検討した。大半が妊孕性温存手術を受け、組織型によらず生存率は89%以上であった。化学療法の有無にかかわらず妊娠の多くは正常経過をたどり、奇形発生率は一般集団よりやや高い程度であった。保存的手術を標準治療とすべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study of 169 women treated for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors between 1982 and 1996 assessed survival and reproductive outcomes. Most patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery, and survival exceeded 89% across histologic subtypes. Most women regained menses, and pregnancy outcomes were largely normal, with miscarriage rates in the expected range and malformation rates only slightly above the general population. The authors conclude that conservative surgery should be the standard approach for most patients regardless of subtype or stage.

title: Advanced non-seminomatous germ cell cancer of the testis with brain metastases: feasibility of additional brain irradiation and whole body hyperthermia plus chemotherapy.
title_ja: 精巣の進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍・脳転移に対する追加脳照射と全身温熱療法併用化学療法の実現可能性
summary_ja: 肺・肝・脳に転移した精巣胎児性がんの患者に対し、精巣摘除術と放射線療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法を行ったが抵抗性であった。その後、全身温熱療法を化学療法と併用し、神経症状なく良好に忍容された。β-hCGは著明に低下し、5年以上無病生存を維持している。標準治療抵抗性の進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する有効な選択肢となりうると述べている。
summary_en: A patient with embryonal testicular cancer and lung, liver, and brain metastases was treated with orchiectomy, whole brain irradiation, and cisplatin-containing chemotherapy, but the disease was refractory. Two cycles of whole body hyperthermia combined with chemotherapy were then added and were well tolerated without neurologic sequelae. Beta-hCG fell markedly, and the patient has remained alive and disease-free for more than five years. The authors suggest this approach may be feasible and may contribute to long-term survival in advanced non-seminomatous germ cell cancer refractory to standard therapy.

title: Resection of residual masses alone: an alternative in surgical therapy of metastatic testicular germ cell tumors after chemotherapy.
title_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後手術：残存腫瘍のみの切除という選択肢
summary_ja: 化学療法後に残存腫瘍を認めた転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者75例に対し、残存腫瘍のみを切除した結果を検討した。平均37か月の追跡で82.7%が無病であり、生存者の93.6%で順行性射精が保たれた。不完全切除例や生存腫瘍細胞を含む例は予後不良であった。化学療法後手術として、残存腫瘍のみの切除は有益な選択肢となりうると結論している。
summary_en: This study of 75 patients undergoing resection of residual masses after chemotherapy for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors evaluated oncologic outcomes and ejaculatory function. Residual specimens showed necrosis/fibrosis, teratoma, or viable cancer. At a mean follow-up of 37 months, 82.7% had no evidence of disease, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 93.6% of living patients. Incomplete resection and viable cancer in specimens were associated with worse prognosis. The authors conclude that removal of residual masses alone may be a beneficial option in postchemotherapy surgery.

title: The pathology of intermediate trophoblastic tumors and tumor-like lesions.
title_ja: 中間型トロホブラスト腫瘍および腫瘍様病変の病理
summary_ja: 中間型トロホブラストに由来する病変（誇張性胎盤部、胎盤部結節、PSTT、ETT）の病理像を概説している。誇張性胎盤部と胎盤部結節は非腫瘍性であり、PSTTとETTは局所浸潤や転移の可能性を持つ腫瘍性病変である。他の腫瘍と類似しうるため形態と免疫表現型による正確な診断が重要で、治療法も病変ごとに異なると述べている。
summary_en: This review describes the pathology of intermediate trophoblastic lesions, including exaggerated placental site, placental site nodule, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Exaggerated placental site and placental site nodule are nonneoplastic, while PSTT and ETT are neoplasms with potential for local invasion and metastasis. These lesions can mimic other trophoblastic and nontrophoblastic tumors, so accurate diagnosis is important because each may require different therapy.

title: Bone scintigraphy in testicular tumors.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍における骨シンチグラフィ
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍28例を対象に、骨シンチグラフィの役割を検討した研究です。7例で患側と同側の腸骨に異常集積を認め、3例では生検で転移が確認されました。異常所見の多くはセミノーマで、リンパ流を介した早期の腸骨転移が示唆されています。従来のX線検査より感度が高い可能性があり、早期の骨転移検出に有用とされています。
summary_en: This study evaluated the role of technetium-99m MDP bone scintigraphy in 28 patients with testicular tumors. Abnormal scans, showing diffuse iliac uptake ipsilateral to the affected testis, were found in seven patients, and metastases were confirmed by biopsy in three. Most abnormal cases were seminomas, suggesting early lymphatic spread to the iliac nodes. The authors conclude that bone scintigraphy may be more sensitive than conventional radiography for detecting early skeletal metastases, which is important for guiding radiotherapy and chemotherapy.

title: Diagnostic value of alpha 1-fetoprotein and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin in infancy and childhood.
title_ja: 乳児期および小児期におけるαフェトプロテインおよびβ-hCGの診断的価値
summary_ja: 小児の分泌性腫瘍が疑われる症例の初期評価におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGの有用性を、ドイツMAKEIの経験を基にまとめた総説です。両マーカーは悪性肝腫瘍や性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍の特徴的な腫瘍マーカーであり、治療中のフォローアップにも用いられます。乳児期の生理的上昇や肝疾患、代謝異常、思春期の妊娠などの鑑別診断を除外することの重要性が強調されています。
summary_en: This review summarizes the German MAKEI experience with alpha-fetoprotein and beta-hCG in the initial evaluation of children with suspected secreting tumors. AFP and beta-hCG are characteristic markers of malignant liver tumors and nontesticular germ cell tumors, and they also guide follow-up during therapy. The authors propose diagnostic guidelines, stressing the need to exclude physiologic AFP elevation in infancy, hepatic disease, metabolic disorders, and pregnancy in adolescents. Pancreaticoblastoma should be considered in tumors of the upper abdomen.

title: 129/Sv mice--a model system for studying germ cell biology and testicular cancer.
title_ja: 129/Svマウス：胚細胞生物学と精巣がん研究のためのモデル系
summary_ja: 本総説は、129/Svマウスにおける精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生物学と遺伝学について現在の知見をまとめたものである。腫瘍感受性には、メンデル遺伝性の感受性遺伝子と多因子性の要因の双方が関与する。このマウス系統は、原始生殖細胞の発生を研究するための有用なモデルである。著者らは、これらマウスでの知見がヒト精巣がんの遺伝的素因の理解にどのように役立つかを論じている。
summary_en: This review summarizes current understanding of the biology and genetics of testicular germ cell tumors in 129/Sv mice. Both Mendelian susceptibility genes and polygenic factors contribute to tumor susceptibility, and the strain is a useful model for studying primordial germ cell development. The authors discuss how these murine findings may inform the genetic basis of inherited susceptibility to testicular cancer in humans.

title: Excision of mature teratoma using culdotomy, with and without laparoscopy: a prospective randomised trial.
title_ja: 成熟奇形腫の切除術におけるculdotomy（後腟円蓋切開）を用いた腹腔鏡併用の有無：前向きランダム化比較試験
summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫79例を対象とした前向きランダム化比較試験で、腹腔鏡非併用の経腟的嚢腫摘出術と腹腔鏡併用嚢腫摘出術を比較した。腹腔鏡併用群では出血量が少なく、開腹移行なしで手術に成功した割合が高く（97.6％対58.6％）、腫瘍内容物の漏出も少なかった（19.0％対44.8％）。著者らは成熟奇形腫の治療には腹腔鏡併用が望ましいと結論している。
summary_en: This prospective randomized trial compared culdotomy-based vaginal cystectomy without laparoscopy against laparoscopically assisted cystectomy for mature ovarian teratoma in 79 women. Laparoscopic assistance yielded lower blood loss, a higher rate of successful surgery without conversion to laparotomy (97.6% vs 58.6%), and fewer tumor spillage events (19.0% vs 44.8%). Recovery time was slightly shorter in the laparoscopic group. The authors conclude that laparoscopically assisted cystectomy is preferable for managing mature teratoma, though non-laparoscopic removal is feasible.

title: Human chorionic gonadotropin beta-core fragment is directly produced by cancer cells.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βコア断片は癌細胞により直接産生される
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌および卵巣癌を含む15の細胞株のうち5株の培養上清で、hCGβコア断片の免疫反応性が検出された。絨毛癌を移植したマウスの血清にも認められた。血清中の濃度は、無傷のhCGや遊離hCGβより低く、半減期の短さが原因と考えられた。腫瘍細胞が直接産生することが示され、尿中代謝物にとどまらないと結論している。
summary_en: This study examined whether cancer cells directly secrete the hCG beta-core fragment (hCGβcf). Immunoreactive hCGβcf was detected in culture media from five of fifteen cell lines, including choriocarcinoma and ovarian cancer lines, and in sera of mice bearing choriocarcinoma xenografts. The secreted material was about 40 kDa. Serum hCGβcf levels were lower than intact hCG or free hCGβ, likely due to its short half-life. The findings indicate hCGβcf is produced by tumor cells rather than being solely a urinary metabolite.

title: Oral mature teratoma containing epididymal tissue in a female neonate.
title_ja: 女児新生児に生じた、精巣上体組織を含む口腔成熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 女児新生児に発生した口腔成熟奇形腫の症例報告で、骨・歯・表皮に加えて精巣上体組織を含んでいた。核型は正常女性であったが、腫瘍組織からY染色体DNAが検出された。著者らは、包含された二卵性双生児由来とする仮説を支持すると述べている。性腺外奇形腫の発生機序の理解に寄与すると考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a female neonate with an oral mature teratoma containing bone, teeth, epidermis, and epididymal tissue. PCR detected Y-chromosomal DNA in the paraffin-embedded tumor despite a normal female karyotype. The authors propose this supports the hypothesis that the teratoma arose from an included dizygotic twin. The case contributes to understanding the pathogenesis of extragonadal teratomas, with theories including parthenogenesis, incomplete twinning, and totipotent somatic-cell origin being considered.

title: The effect of radiotherapy treatment changes on sites of relapse in stage I testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ病期Iにおける放射線療法の変更が再発部位に及ぼす影響
summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ406例を対象に、傍大動脈放射線療法単独と骨盤まで拡大した照射の再発パターンを比較しました。再発率は3.0%と4.4%でした。骨盤再発は傍大動脈領域のみに照射された群でのみ発生しました。再発が疑われる場合は骨盤の画像検査を含めることが重要と結論づけています。
summary_en: This study of 406 patients with stage I testicular seminoma compared relapse patterns after para-aortic radiotherapy alone with those after extended pelvic radiotherapy. Relapse rates were 3.0% and 4.4%, respectively. All pelvic relapses occurred in the para-aortic-only group. The authors conclude that pelvic imaging should be included when relapse is suspected, since pelvic relapses may increase with standard para-aortic treatment.

title: Radiofrequency ablation of human fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: ヒト胎児仙尾部奇形腫に対する高周波焼灼術
summary_ja: 超音波ガイド下の経皮的高周波焼灼術を、血流過剰で心不全を来した胎児仙尾部奇形腫4例に施行した報告。腫瘍の大部分を焼灼した2例は腫瘍内出血で予後不良となった一方、栄養血管のみを標的とした症例では心不全の改善が得られた。腫瘍全体の焼灼ではなく栄養血管の遮断が有効であることを示唆する。
summary_en: This report describes four human fetuses with highly vascular sacrococcygeal teratomas treated by percutaneous radiofrequency ablation under ultrasound guidance. Two fetuses had large portions of the tumor ablated, while two had only the major feeding vessels targeted. Two infants were delivered at 28 and 31 weeks and are doing well, whereas two fetuses died after intratumoral hemorrhage. The authors conclude that ablating feeding vessels, rather than most of the tumor, can reduce blood flow enough to reverse high-output fetal heart failure.

title: Testicular choriocarcinoma metastatic to the skin: an additional case and literature review.
title_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の皮膚転移:症例報告および文献的考察
summary_ja: 24歳男性の精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、皮膚転移巣に絨毛癌成分を認めた症例報告。精巣絨毛癌の皮膚転移は極めてまれで予後不良とされる。非妊娠性絨毛癌の臨床像と文献をレビューし、肺・肝・脳への遠隔転移傾向やhCG分泌について論じている。
summary_en: A case report of a 24-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor whose skin metastases contained choriocarcinoma. Skin metastasis from testicular choriocarcinoma is very rare and carries a grave prognosis. The authors describe the clinical presentation and review the literature on nongestational choriocarcinoma. They note its propensity for distant spread to the lungs, liver, and brain, and its secretion of human chorionic gonadotropin.

title: PBPC mobilization with paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and G-CSF with or without amifostine: results of a prospective randomized trial.
title_ja: パクリタキセル、イホスファミドおよびG-CSFによる末梢血幹細胞動員に対するアミホスチン併用の有無:前向きランダム化試験の結果
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者40例を対象に、大量化学療法前の末梢血幹細胞動員でアミホスチンを併用する効果を検討したランダム化試験。動員不全率や採取効率に差はなく、アミホスチン群で一時的に末梢血CD34陽性細胞が多かった。胚細胞腫瘍の大量化学療法前の幹細胞採取戦略に関する報告。
summary_en: A prospective randomized trial of 40 germ cell tumor patients evaluated whether a single 500 mg dose of amifostine before paclitaxel-ifosfamide mobilization chemotherapy improves peripheral blood progenitor cell collection. Mobilization failure rates and collection efficiency were similar between groups. Circulating CD34+ cell counts were higher on days 10 and 11 in the amifostine arm, but the overall yield was not improved. The study informs stem cell mobilization before high-dose chemotherapy in germ cell tumor management.

title: Multiple globules in a cystic ovarian teratoma.
title_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫における多数の小球
summary_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の20歳女性例で、皮脂性デブリと毛髪からなる多数の可動性小球を認めた。初回超音波検査では移動が確認されず、臥位後のCTで小球-液面形成が明らかになった。脂肪性小球の浮上には時間を要するため、画像診断で遅延効果を考慮すべきと結論している。
summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with a 10-cm cystic ovarian teratoma containing multiple mobile globules of sebaceous debris and hair is described. Plain radiography showed no calcification, and early ultrasonography did not show movement of the echogenic masses. A later CT after the patient lay down showed the globules layering in the upper cyst with a characteristic globules-fluid level. The authors conclude that fatty globules need time to float upward, so this delayed effect should be considered when interpreting ovarian cysts on ultrasound, CT, or MRI.

title: Equivalence of three or four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy and of a 3- or 5-day schedule in good-prognosis germ cell cancer: a randomized study of the European Organization for Research and Treatment of Cancer Genitourinary Tract Cancer Cooperative Group and the Medical Research Council.
title_ja: 良好予後胚細胞腫瘍に対するBEP療法の3サイクル対4サイクルおよび3日対5日投与の同等性：無作為化試験
summary_ja: EORTCとMRCによる無作為化試験で、良好予後の胚細胞腫瘍に対するBEP療法について、3サイクルと4サイクル、3日と5日の投与法の同等性を検証した。2年無増悪生存率はいずれの群も約89～90％で差はなく、毒性も同程度であった。3サイクルで生活の質がより良く保たれ、3サイクルで十分との結論である。
summary_en: This randomized trial by the EORTC Genitourinary Group and the Medical Research Council tested whether three cycles of BEP are equivalent to four in good-prognosis germ cell cancer, and whether 3-day or 5-day schedules are equivalent. Among 812 patients randomized to cycles and 681 to schedules, projected 2-year progression-free survival was similar across arms. Toxicity was comparable, and quality of life was better maintained with three cycles. The authors conclude that three cycles of BEP is sufficient therapy.

title: Trends in testicular carcinoma in England and Wales, 1971-99.
title_ja: イングランドおよびウェールズにおける精巣がんの動向（1971～99年）
summary_ja: 1971年から1999年のイングランドとウェールズにおける精巣がんの罹患率、死亡率、生存率の推移を解析した疫学研究である。年齢調整罹患率は1971年の10万人あたり2.9から1997年の5.4へと増加した。死亡率は1970年代半ば以降に大きく低下し、5年相対生存率は約69％から約95％へ改善した。社会的貧困度による生存率の格差は続いている。
summary_en: This population-based study analyzed incidence, mortality, and survival trends for testicular cancer in England and Wales from 1971 to 1999. Age-standardized incidence rose from 2.9 to 5.4 per 100,000 between 1971 and 1997, while mortality fell markedly after the mid-1970s and stayed below 0.5 per 100,000 since 1985. Five-year relative survival improved from 69% to about 95%. A socioeconomic survival gap persisted, and the authors attribute the gains partly to platinum-based chemotherapy.

title: The characterization of common ovarian cysts in premenopausal women.
title_ja: 閉経前女性における一般的な卵巣嚢腫の特徴づけ：経腟超音波検査による診断
summary_ja: 術前の経腟超音波検査により、閉経前女性の卵巣の子宮内膜症性嚢胞と類皮嚢腫（嚢胞性奇形腫）を診断できるかを前向きに検討した研究である。陽性的中率は類皮嚢腫で97.1％、子宮内膜症性嚢胞で96.4％であった。いずれの群にも悪性例はなかった。特徴的な超音波所見により、手術対象の選択に信頼性があるとしている。
summary_en: This prospective study evaluated transvaginal ultrasonography for diagnosing benign ovarian cysts, namely endometriomas and dermoid cysts (cystic teratomas), in 132 premenopausal women undergoing surgery. The positive predictive values were 96.4% for endometriomas and 97.1% for dermoid cysts, with false positive rates of 3.8% and 3.0%. No malignancies were found in either group. The authors conclude that characteristic ultrasound patterns reliably select women for surgery.

title: Meningeal nodules in teratoma of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫における髄膜結節
summary_ja: 52歳男性の成熟型精巣奇形腫の症例報告である。奇形腫内の末梢部に、末梢神経や神経膠組織の近くで髄膜腫様の増殖巣が認められた。これらはEMA陽性、S-100およびサイトケラチン陰性であった。頭皮や皮膚にみられる異所性髄膜結節と類似しており、同様の異所性由来が示唆されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old man with a mature adult testicular teratoma containing large areas of meningiomatous proliferation near peripheral nerve and glial tissue. These meningothelial nodules were located mainly in the peripheral parts of the teratoma and were EMA-positive while negative for S-100 and cytokeratin. The authors compare them with meningeal heterotopias of the scalp and skin, suggesting a similar heterotopic origin.

title: Comparison of two standard chemotherapy regimens for good-prognosis germ-cell tumours: a randomised trial. Australian and New Zealand Germ Cell Trial Group.
title_ja: 良好予後胚細胞腫瘍に対する2つの標準化学療法レジメンの比較：無作為化試験
summary_ja: オーストラリア・ニュージーランド胚細胞腫瘍試験グループによる無作為化試験で、良好予後の胚細胞腫瘍の男性166例に対する2つの標準化学療法レジメンを比較した。全生存期間(全生存率)はレジメンAが有意に良好であった（ハザード比0.22）。レジメンBのブレオマイシンとエトポシドの投与強度が低いことが差の原因と考察されている。試験は中間解析で中止された。
summary_en: This randomized trial from the Australian and New Zealand Germ Cell Trial Group compared two standard chemotherapy regimens in 166 men with good-prognosis germ cell tumours. Regimen A used three cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, while regimen B used four cycles with higher-dose cisplatin and etoposide. Overall survival was significantly better with regimen A (hazard ratio 0.22). The trial was stopped at the second interim analysis, and the authors attribute the difference to lower bleomycin and etoposide dose-intensity in regimen B.

title: Ovarian teratomas: tumor types and imaging characteristics.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫：腫瘍型と画像所見
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の主要な組織型（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、卵巣甲状腺腫など）と、超音波検査・コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)・磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)での画像所見を解説した総説です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は脂肪成分や皮脂様物質が特徴で、未熟奇形腫は粗大石灰化を伴う大きな充実成分が特徴とされます。鑑別のために各モダリティの所見を理解することの重要性を示しています。
summary_en: This pictorial review describes the main types of ovarian teratoma, including mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst), immature teratoma, and monodermal teratomas such as struma ovarii. It outlines ultrasonography, CT, and MRI features that aid diagnosis: echogenic sebaceous material and fat attenuation for mature cystic teratoma, and large irregular solid components with coarse calcification for immature teratoma. Struma ovarii shows a nonspecific heterogeneous solid appearance. Recognizing these features helps differentiate ovarian teratomas.

title: The role of the histopathologist in the management of testicular germ cell tumour in adults.
title_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍における病理組織学者の役割
summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診療における病理組織学の役割を論じた総説です。化学療法と病期分類の進歩により予後は改善し、病理組織学はセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別にとどまらず、再発リスクを示す予後因子として治療判断に寄与するようになったと述べています。QOLや治療削減が重視されている現状も示されています。
summary_en: This review examines the role of histopathology in managing adult testicular germ cell tumours. Although effective chemotherapy and more accurate staging have improved prognosis, histopathology has evolved beyond distinguishing seminoma from nonseminomatous germ cell tumour. It now serves as a prognostic tool, indicating relapse risk in defined clinical contexts to guide therapeutic decisions. The authors note that the current emphasis is on quality of life and reducing treatment intensity, and that protocols are established though they vary between countries.

title: Apoptotic activity in gestational trophoblastic disease correlates with clinical outcome: assessment by the caspase-related M30 CytoDeath antibody.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるアポトーシス活性は臨床転帰と相関する：caspase関連M30 CytoDeath抗体による評価
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるアポトーシス活性を、抗体M30 CytoDeathを用いた免疫組織化学染色で評価した研究です。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌では正常胎盤や流産より高値で、自然退縮した奇胎は化学療法を要する持続性疾患に進展した奇胎より高値でした。M30指数は臨床経過を予測する予後指標となりうると結論づけています。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study assessed apoptotic activity in gestational trophoblastic disease using the caspase-cleaved cytokeratin 18 antibody M30 CytoDeath across spontaneous abortions, hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas, and normal placentas. M30 indices were significantly higher in moles and choriocarcinomas than in controls. Moles that spontaneously regressed had higher indices than those developing persistent disease requiring chemotherapy. The authors conclude that apoptosis contributes to GTD pathogenesis and that the M30 index may serve as a prognostic indicator.

title: Serum levels of macrophage colony-stimulating factor in trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における血清CSF-1（マクロファージコロニー刺激因子）レベル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患45例で血清CSF-1（マクロファージコロニー刺激因子）を週単位で測定し、hCGとの関係を検討した研究です。胞状奇胎や絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などが対象でした。CSF-1とhCGはおおむね相関せず、高値を示すこともありました。CSF-1は管理や化学療法の必要性の予測には有用でないと結論づけています。
summary_en: This study measured serum CSF-1 (macrophage colony-stimulating factor) in 45 patients with trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform moles, metastatic gestational trophoblastic tumours, primary ovarian choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumour, with serial samples compared against hCG levels. CSF-1 often did not correlate with hCG, sometimes being elevated when hCG was negative and not elevated when hCG remained high. Although very high levels occurred, the authors concluded CSF-1 is not useful for managing trophoblastic disease or predicting the need for chemotherapy.

title: Surveillance programs for early stage non-seminomatous testicular cancer: a practice guideline.
title_ja: 早期非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するサーベイランスプログラム：診療ガイドライン
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性に対する適切なサーベイランスプログラムを示したカナダの診療ガイドラインです。ランダム化比較試験はなく、症例集積とRCT 1件を基に、スケジュールの違いは再発や救済率、生存率の違いと関連しないとしています。血清マーカー、胸部X線検査、CTを含む具体的なフォローアップの間隔が提示されています。
summary_en: This Canadian practice guideline identifies an appropriate surveillance program for men with clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis. Combining a systematic review with consensus, the authors found no randomized trials comparing surveillance schedules, relying instead on 12 case series and one RCT comparing radiotherapy with surveillance. Schedule variations were not associated with differences in relapse, salvage, or survival. They propose monthly early follow-up with serum markers and chest radiographs, plus CT scans at defined intervals over five years.

title: Testicular seminoma and Down's syndrome.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマとダウン症候群
summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併した精巣セミノーマの47歳男性の症例を報告し、既報の19例を文献的にレビューした研究です。診断時平均年齢は32歳で、73%が病期Iでした。停留精巣の増加、ゴナドトロピン上昇、遺伝的不安定性などの関連経路が考察され、標準治療は成功裏に施行できたとされています。
summary_en: This report describes a 47-year-old man with Down syndrome treated for testicular seminoma, who is the oldest reported such case, and reviews 19 previously reported cases. The mean age at diagnosis was 32 years, and 73% had stage I disease. The authors discuss possible links between Down syndrome and seminoma, including increased cryptorchidism, elevated gonadotropins, and genetic instability. They conclude that the stage distribution resembles the general population and that standard therapy can be delivered successfully.

title: Cardiac extension of primary mediastinal seminoma compressing the right ventricular outflow tract.
title_ja: 右室流出路を圧迫する原発性縦隔セミノーマの心臓進展
summary_ja: 33歳男性に生じた前縦隔原発セミノーマの症例報告である。腫瘍が心臓へ進展して右室流出路を圧迫しており、初発症状は心疾患を疑わせるものであった。心症状を呈する患者では、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍を含む縦隔腫瘍の存在にも注意が必要であることを示す症例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with primary seminoma of the anterior mediastinum. The tumour extended into the heart and compressed the right ventricular outflow tract. Initial clinical manifestations suggested heart disease, so cardiac symptoms may delay the diagnosis. The case highlights that mediastinal germ cell tumours should be considered in the differential diagnosis when a mediastinal mass presents with cardiac compression.

title: Membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis associated with a mixed-cell germinal ovary tumor.
title_ja: 混合型卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に伴う膜性増殖性糸球体腎炎
summary_ja: 混合型の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌とディスジャーミノーマ成分)に伴う膜性増殖性糸球体腎炎の1例を報告した。手術後もネフローゼ症候群は寛解せず腎不全が進行した。卵巣腫瘍に関連した糸球体症の既報5例を併せて検討し、両者の関連が初めて報告された点を示している。腫瘍の病理組織学的特徴と腎病変の関係を理解する上で参考になる症例である。
summary_en: A patient with membranoproliferative glomerulopathy associated with a mixed-cell ovarian germ cell tumour, containing embryonal carcinoma and dysgerminoma components, is described. Nephrotic syndrome did not remit after surgery, and renal failure progressed. The authors reviewed five previously reported cases of ovarian tumour-associated glomerulopathy. This is the first report linking membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis with a mixed-cell germ cell tumour of the ovary.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)の有用性を総説したもの。臨床病期Iでは開腹手術より効率・合併症・コストの点で優れ、診断精度は同等とされる。化学療法後や病期IIbの残存腫瘍への適応も述べている。最大の課題は学習曲線の長さであり、精巣がん専門施設の多くは腹腔鏡手術の訓練を受けていない。
summary_en: This review of laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for testicular tumours summarises its advantages over open surgery in clinical stage I disease, including efficiency, morbidity, cost and equal diagnostic accuracy. It also covers feasibility after chemotherapy, use in stage IIb disease to avoid further chemotherapy cycles, and removal of residual tumour. The main barrier is a long, steep learning curve, as specialised centres are often not trained in laparoscopy.

title: Flow cytometric and clinicopathologic study of complete hydatidiform moles with special reference to the significance of cytometric aneuploidy.
title_ja: 完全胞状奇胎のフローサイトメトリーによる臨床病理学的研究:異数性の意義
summary_ja: 239例の完全胞状奇胎をフローサイトメトリーで倍数性解析し、臨床病理学的に検討した研究。二倍体182例、四倍体30例、異数体27例に分類された。持続性疾患は異数体CMでは認められず、二倍体・四倍体CMより低リスクであった。DNA倍数性が持続性疾患の独立した予測因子となりうると結論している。侵入奇胎や絨毛癌への進展例も報告されている。
summary_en: This study analysed 239 complete hydatidiform moles by flow cytometry using formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue. Most were diploid (182), while 30 were tetraploid and 27 aneuploid. Persistent disease occurred in 17.6% of cases with follow-up data, and was absent among aneuploid moles (none of 19), compared with diploid and tetraploid moles. The authors conclude that DNA ploidy may be an independent predictor of persistent disease.

title: Altered expression of Ape1/ref-1 in germ cell tumors and overexpression in NT2 cells confers resistance to bleomycin and radiation.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるApe1/ref-1の発現変化と、NT2細胞での過剰発現によるブレオマイシンおよび放射線に対する耐性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: DNA塩基除去修復酵素Ape1/ref-1について、精巣がん患者10例の胚細胞腫瘍を免疫組織化学で検討したパイロット研究である。ほぼすべての切片で比較的高い発現が認められた。胚細胞腫瘍細胞株NT2/D1でApe1/ref-1を過剰発現させると、APエンドヌクレアーゼ活性が増加し、ブレオマイシンに対する防御効果が2～3倍となった。γ線に対する防御効果は弱かった。著者らは、Ape1/ref-1が治療抵抗性に関与し、難治性疾患のマーカーになりうると示唆している。
summary_en: This pilot study examined Ape1/ref-1, a DNA base excision repair enzyme, by immunohistochemistry in germ cell tumors from 10 patients with testicular cancer, finding relatively high expression in nearly all sections. Overexpressing Ape1/ref-1 in the NT2/D1 germ cell tumor cell line increased AP endonuclease activity and conferred two- to threefold greater protection against bleomycin, with weaker protection against gamma-irradiation. The authors suggest Ape1/ref-1 may contribute to therapy resistance and could serve as a marker for refractory disease.

title: [Testicular pure teratoma: a case report].
title_ja: 精巣純粋奇形腫の1例（症例報告）
summary_ja: 発熱と右陰嚢痛を訴えた46歳男性で、副睾丸炎の疑いのもと精巣腫瘍を除外できず高位精巣摘除術を施行した。病理学的に成熟奇形腫と副睾丸炎と診断された。組織像は良性様でも転移・再発の可能性があり、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と同様に管理すべきと結論づけている。術後6か月で再発はない。
summary_en: A 46-year-old man presented with fever and painful right scrotal swelling, initially suspected as epididymitis, with testicular tumor not excluded. High inguinal orchiectomy revealed a testicular teratoma containing hair. Histology showed mature epidermis, skin appendages, cartilage, bone and adipose tissue, with epididymal inflammation, consistent with pure mature teratoma. No recurrence was seen at 6 months. The authors stress that pure testicular teratoma can metastasize and recur and should be managed like other nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

title: [A case of intratubular germ cell tumor giving rise to seminoma in a subfertile man].
title_ja: 不妊症の精巣生検で精細管内胚細胞腫瘍が判明し、後にセミノーマを発症した男性の1例（症例報告）
summary_ja: 右陰嚢腫脹の34歳男性に右高位精巣摘除術を施行し、pT2pN0pM0のセミノーマと診断された。術後3コースの化学療法を受けた。6年前の不妊症精巣生検標本を再検討したところ精細管内胚細胞腫瘍が判明した。術後2年で再発・転移はない。
summary_en: A 34-year-old man with right scrotal swelling underwent right high orchiectomy for testicular tumor, diagnosed as seminoma pT2pN0pM0, and received three courses of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin. Six years earlier, testicular biopsy for infertility had been performed at another hospital; re-review of that specimen revealed intratubular germ cell tumor. No recurrence or metastasis was found 2 years after surgery. The case illustrates a precursor lesion preceding seminoma.

title: Multimodal treatment of malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors: a prospective analysis of 66 patients of the German cooperative protocols MAKEI 83/86 and 89.
title_ja: 悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍の多角的治療：ドイツ共同試験MAKEI 83/86および89に登録された66例の前向き解析
summary_ja: 66例の小児悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、手術とシスプラチン化学療法の多角的治療を前向きに解析した。術前化学療法は完全切除率を高め、局所進行・転移例で全生存期間の改善と関連した。5年無イベント生存率は76%、全生存期間(全生存率)は81%であった。
summary_en: This prospective German cooperative analysis reviewed 66 children with malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors treated with surgery and cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Up-front chemotherapy before delayed resection was associated with more metastatic disease but more complete resections and avoided second-look surgery. In locally advanced and metastatic tumors, neoadjuvant treatment was associated with better overall survival (83% vs 45%). At 5 years, event-free survival was 76% and overall survival 81%, supporting up-front chemotherapy followed by complete resection.

title: Treatment of recurrent malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors: analysis of 22 patients registered in the German protocols MAKEI 83/86, 89, and 96.
title_ja: 再発性悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍の治療：ドイツ共同試験MAKEI 83/86、89、96に登録された22例の解析
summary_ja: 初回白金製剤化学療法と切除後に再発した小児仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍22例の救済治療を解析した。局所再発の完全切除が治療の要であり、術前化学療法と温熱療法や、顕微鏡的不完全切除例への放射線療法が有用な場合があった。再発を重ねるごとに治癒率は低下する。
summary_en: This analysis of 22 children with recurrent malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors examined salvage therapy after first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy and resection. Complete resection of local recurrence was the cornerstone of treatment; complete remission after surgery and adjuvant platinum chemotherapy was achieved in 12 patients. Preoperative chemotherapy with regional hyperthermia helped some patients, and radiotherapy above 45 Gy was reserved for microscopically incomplete resection. Three of 14 patients with a second or later relapse were cured, and cure chances declined with each relapse.

title: Low-volume nodal metastases detected at retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for testicular cancer: pattern and prognostic factors for relapse.
title_ja: 精巣がんの後腹膜リンパ節郭清で検出された低容量リンパ節転移：再発のパターンと予後因子
summary_ja: 本研究は、RPLNDで低容量後腹膜リンパ節転移(pN1)を認めた精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者54例を解析したものである。50例は補助化学療法を行わず経過観察された。全体の22%が再発し、多くは腫瘍マーカーの上昇によるものであった。RPLND前の持続的な腫瘍マーカー上昇は、再発の強力な独立予測因子であった(マーカー上昇例80%、正常例15.6%)。著者らは、正常マーカーの臨床病期IおよびIIA患者は経過観察が可能であり、マーカー上昇例は初回化学療法を検討すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: Fifty-four patients with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and low-volume retroperitoneal nodal metastases (pN1) at RPLND were analyzed, and 50 were observed without adjuvant chemotherapy. Overall, 22% relapsed, most often through marker elevation. Persistently elevated markers before RPLND were a strong independent predictor of relapse (80% vs 15.6% with normal markers). The authors conclude that clinical stage I and IIA patients with normal markers can be observed, while those with elevated markers should be considered for primary chemotherapy.

title: Operative management for sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed in utero.
title_ja: 子宮内で診断された仙尾部奇形腫に対する外科的管理
summary_ja: 出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫の14例(1978～1999年)を後方視的に検討し、手術戦略を評価した。術中出血を抑えるため、著者らは血流遮断後に仰臥位で腹会陰式切除を行った。子宮内死亡1例と出生後早期死亡2例が生じ、晩期死亡や悪性転化は認められなかった。大量出血のなかった患者では、血流遮断または仰臥位を併用した早期切除が良好な転帰と関連していた。著者らは、出生前の超音波による密な観察を前提とした早期の腹会陰式切除を推奨している。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 14 patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally (1978 to 1999) examined operative strategy. To limit intraoperative bleeding, the authors performed abdominoperineal resection in the supine position after devascularization. One intrauterine death and two early postnatal deaths occurred, with no late deaths or malignant transformation. Among patients without massive bleeding, early resection with devascularization or supine positioning was associated with favorable outcomes. The authors recommend early abdominoperineal resection guided by close antenatal sonographic surveillance.

title: Congenital vulvar teratoma in a newborn.
title_ja: 新生児にみられた先天性外陰部奇形腫
summary_ja: 著者らは、新生児の外陰部に生じた先天性奇形腫の症例を報告する。知る限りこの年齢層の外陰部症例は初めての報告である。生後4日目に腫瘍を摘出し、18カ月の追跡で患児は正常であった。奇形腫には悪性化や再発の危険があるため、完全な外科的切除と慎重なフォローアップが治療の第一選択であると結論づけている。新生児の奇形腫は仙尾部に生じることが多いため、外陰部の病変も考慮すべきであると述べている。
summary_en: The authors describe a congenital teratoma of the vulva in a newborn, which they believe is the first reported vulvar case in this age group. The tumor was excised on day four of life, and the infant remained normal at 18-month follow-up. Because teratomas carry a risk of malignancy or recurrence, the authors conclude that complete surgical excision followed by careful surveillance is the treatment of choice. The report notes that neonatal teratomas most often arise in the sacrococcygeal region, so vulvar sites should also be considered.

title: The impact of chemotherapy on Leydig cell function in long term survivors of germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍長期生存者におけるシスプラチン併用化学療法とライディッヒ細胞機能
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者244例で、シスプラチンの累積投与量別にライディッヒ細胞機能を評価した。標準用量の化学療法では機能低下は有意ではなかったが、400 mg/m2を超える高用量では、テストステロン低値が持続し、精細管上皮の障害との関連が示された。中等度の欠乏の臨床的意義とテストステロン補充の必要性については、さらなる研究が必要とされている。
summary_en: Researchers measured testosterone, SHBG, LH, and FSH in 244 patients with germ cell tumors, grouped by cumulative cisplatin exposure. Standard-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy (400 mg/m2 or less) did not significantly impair Leydig cell function compared with patients who received no chemotherapy. High cumulative doses (over 400 mg/m2) were associated with lower testosterone levels, subnormal values in 20% of patients, and a persistent impairment. LH and FSH correlated with germinal epithelial damage. The authors call for further study of the clinical relevance of moderate testosterone deficiency and of testosterone replacement.

title: Improved long term survival of patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell carcinoma in relation to prognostic classification systems during the cisplatin era.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における長期生存の改善: シスプラチン時代の予後分類別解析
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍299例を、1977〜1986年と1987〜1996年の2期間で比較した後方視的研究である。疾患特異的10年生存率は76%から88%へ改善し、特にIGCCCG分類で予後不良の患者で顕著な向上(37%から66%)が認められた。シスプラチン時代における治療成績の改善が示され、非セミノーマ性の管理は依然として進歩していると結論づけられている。
summary_en: This single-institution study of 299 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy compares outcomes across two periods, 1977 to 1986 and 1987 to 1996. Ten-year disease-specific survival rose from 76% to 88%, with the largest gain in patients with poor-prognosis disease by IGCCCG classification (37% to 66%). Similar improvements were seen with the Royal Marsden, Indiana, MRC, and EORTC systems. The authors conclude that management of nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors continues to improve.

title: Extragonadal seminoma: an international multicenter analysis of prognostic factors and long term treatment outcome.
title_ja: 性腺外セミノーマの予後因子と長期治療成績: 国際多施設解析
summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍635例の国際多施設後方視的解析である。後腹膜または縦隔原発のセミノーマ103例が中心で、化学療法は放射線療法より無増悪生存率が高く(5年87%対33%)、再発率も低かった(14%対67%)。肝転移や2か所以上の転移は予後不良因子であった。適切なシスプラチン併用化学療法で5年生存率90%以上が得られると結論づけられている。
summary_en: This international retrospective analysis of 635 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors evaluated prognosis and treatment outcomes. Among 103 patients with pure seminoma, mostly retroperitoneal or mediastinal, 5-year progression-free survival was 87% with chemotherapy versus 33% with radiotherapy, while overall survival was similar. Recurrence occurred in 14% after chemotherapy and 67% after radiotherapy. Liver metastases and two or more metastatic sites were adverse prognostic factors. The authors conclude that adequate cisplatin-based chemotherapy yields over 90% 5-year survival and that primary radiotherapy is associated with higher recurrence.

title: Teratomas in infancy and childhood.
title_ja: 小児期の奇形腫
summary_ja: 10年間に治療された小児期奇形腫42例の単施設経験を報告する。仙尾部が最も多く、次いで卵巣および後腹膜であった。臨床像、悪性化の可能性、治療法、予後因子、フォローアップを文献とともに検討しており、小児奇形腫の全体像を把握する上で有用である。
summary_en: This report reviews 42 pediatric teratomas treated over a 10-year period at a single center. Sacrococcygeal teratoma was the most common type, followed by ovarian and retroperitoneal teratomas. The authors analyze clinical profile, malignant potential, management, prognostic factors, and follow-up, placing their findings in the context of the published literature. The study offers a broad overview of teratoma management in infancy and childhood, with relevance to pediatric surgeons and oncologists who treat germ cell tumors at gonadal and extragonadal sites.

title: Laparoscopic gastric resection for bleeding metastatic choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 出血を伴う転移性絨毛癌に対する腹腔鏡下胃楔状切除
summary_ja: 進行悪性腫瘍の69歳男性で、胃体部への転移による上部消化管出血に対し腹腔鏡下楔状切除を行った。病理組織学的に絨毛癌と診断された。術後経過は良好で、術後3日目に退院した。全身状態の良い患者では、出血を伴う消化管転移の腹腔鏡下切除は緩和的治療として有用であると結論づけている。
summary_en: A 69-year-old man with advanced malignancy developed upper gastrointestinal bleeding from a metastasis in the gastric body. The lesion was resected laparoscopically by wedge resection, with harmonic scalpel dissection and bagged specimen removal. Histology showed choriocarcinoma. The patient recovered uneventfully and was discharged on postoperative day 3. The authors conclude that in selected patients with good functional status, laparoscopic resection of bleeding gastrointestinal metastases is a useful palliative procedure that shortens hospital stay and allows early return to daily activities.

title: An umbilical cord teratoma in a 17-week-old fetus.
title_ja: 17週胎児に発生した臍帯奇形腫
summary_ja: 臍帯ヘルニアを伴う大きな臍帯奇形腫を有した17週の男児胎児に対し、治療的人工妊娠中絶が行われた症例報告です。文献上の臍帯奇形腫10例をレビューし、提示様式が多様であることを示しました。死亡例が4例あり、妊娠中の綿密なフォローアップの必要性を強調しています。
summary_en: This report describes a therapeutic abortion at 17 weeks in a male fetus with a large umbilical cord teratoma associated with exomphalos. The authors reviewed ten previously reported umbilical cord teratomas, noting their highly polymorphic presentation. Four of these fetuses and infants died from various causes. The authors emphasise the need for close follow-up of pregnancies complicated by umbilical cord teratoma.

title: Stage I non-seminomatous germ-cell tumours of the testis: identification of a subgroup of patients with a very low risk of relapse.
title_ja: 精巣の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍：再発リスクが極めて低い患者群の同定
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後にサーベイランスを受けた病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍88例を後方視的に解析し、再発に関わる組織学的因子を検討しました。脈管侵襲と成熟奇形腫が独立した予後因子でした。成熟奇形腫があり脈管侵襲がない低リスク群の再発率は0%で、病期I患者の約3分の1はサーベイランスのみで管理できる可能性があります。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 88 stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumour (NSGCT) patients under surveillance after orchiectomy evaluated histological predictors of relapse. Vessel invasion and mature teratoma were independent prognostic factors. Three risk groups were defined, and the low-risk group, with mature teratoma but no vessel invasion, had 0% relapse. This index identifies about one third of stage I patients who may be managed by surveillance alone, without RPLND or adjuvant chemotherapy.

title: Management of testicular cancer--16 years' experience from southwest Finland.
title_ja: 精巣がんの管理：南西フィンランドにおける16年間の経験
summary_ja: 1976年から1992年に治療を受けた精巣がん88例を解析した、フィンランドの単施設後方視的研究です。セミノーマの再発は5%と少なかった一方、非セミノーマでは22%が再発し、その多くは補助化学療法を受けなかった病期I患者でした。非セミノーマ患者の再発はセミノーマより有意に多く、厳重なフォローアップと専門施設での管理の重要性が示されました。
summary_en: This Finnish single-centre retrospective study reviewed 88 testicular cancer patients treated between 1976 and 1992. Seminoma relapse was rare (5%), whereas 22% of non-seminoma patients relapsed, most of them stage I patients who had not received adjuvant chemotherapy. Non-seminoma patients had significantly more relapses than seminoma patients. The authors conclude that close surveillance is essential for non-seminoma patients and that management should follow national guidelines in specialist centres.

title: Expression pattern of the adhesion molecule CEACAM1 (C-CAM, CD66a, BGP) in gestational trophoblastic lesions.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性病変におけるCEACAM1(C-CAM、CD66a、BGP)の発現パターン
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎などの妊娠性絨毛性病変20例を対象に、CEACAM1の発現を免疫組織化学で検討しました。CEACAM1は絨毛外栄養膜に局在し、胎盤部病変では発現がより強くびまん性でした。この病変の鑑別診断において、追加の診断マーカーとなる可能性が示唆されています。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined CEACAM1 expression in 20 gestational trophoblastic lesions, including complete hydatidiform moles, a placental site nodule, a placental site trophoblastic tumour and three choriocarcinomas, compared with normal placenta. CEACAM1 localised to extravillous trophoblast and was stronger and more diffuse in the placental site lesions. The authors suggest that CEACAM1 may serve as an additional diagnostic marker in the differential diagnosis of these lesions.

title: Spontaneous rupture of mediastinal cystic teratoma into the pleural cavity: report of two cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫の胸腔内への自然破裂：2症例の報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 12歳と14歳の女児2例が、縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫の右胸腔内への自然破裂を発症した症例報告です。開胸下に外科的切除が行われ、血清および胸水のCEA、CA-125、CA19-9は術後に正常化しました。極めて稀な合併症であるため、迅速な診断が重要であると強調されています。
summary_en: Two adolescent girls, aged 12 and 14, presented with spontaneous rupture of a benign mediastinal cystic teratoma into the right pleural cavity, causing acute chest pain and respiratory distress. Both tumours were completely resected by thoracotomy. Serum and pleural fluid CEA, CA-125 and CA19-9 were elevated and normalised after surgery. The authors stress that rapid diagnosis of this extremely rare complication is important to prevent life-threatening progression.

title: Hyperthermia-induced apoptosis in two rat yolk sac tumor cell lines with different radiothermosensitivity in vitro.
title_ja: 放射線温熱感受性の異なる2種のラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株における温熱誘導アポトーシス
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株2種(NMT-1とNMT-1R)における温熱誘導アポトーシスを比較したin vitro研究です。43℃の加熱は両株でアポトーシスを誘導し、TUNEL染色とDNAラダー形成で確認されました。p53とHsp70は両株で増加し、Hsp90はNMT-1でのみ増加しました。アポトーシスはp53依存性の経路とは独立していると考えられています。
summary_en: This in vitro study compared hyperthermia-induced apoptosis in two rat yolk sac tumour cell lines: NMT-1, which is radiosensitive but thermoresistant and carries wild-type p53, and its variant NMT-1R, which carries mutant p53 and is more radioresistant. Heating at 43°C induced apoptosis in both lines, confirmed by TUNEL staining and DNA laddering. p53, p21 and Hsp70 increased in both lines, whereas Hsp90 rose only in NMT-1. Apoptosis appeared to be independent of the p53 pathway.

title: Combination carboplatin and radiotherapy in the management of stage II testicular seminoma: comparison with radiotherapy treatment alone.
title_ja: 病期IIの精巣セミノーマに対するカルボプラチンと放射線療法の併用：放射線療法単独との比較
summary_ja: 病期IIA/Bの精巣セミノーマ33例を対象とした後方視的研究。カルボプラチンと放射線療法の併用と、放射線療法単独を過去の対照群と比較した。病期IIBでは5年無再発生存率が併用群100%、放射線単独群69.4%で、有意差に近づいた。併用療法の有用性は第III相無作為化比較試験による検証が必要である。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 33 patients with stage IIA/B testicular seminoma compared carboplatin followed by radiotherapy with radiotherapy alone, using historical controls. Five-year relapse-free survival was 96.9% with combined therapy versus 80.7% with radiotherapy alone. In stage IIB, the difference approached significance, with 100% versus 69.4% relapse-free survival. The authors conclude that radiotherapy alone cures most patients, but relapse remains frequent in stage IIB, and a phase III randomized trial is needed to confirm carboplatin's benefit.

title: Quality of life after radiotherapy for early-stage testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 早期精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法後の生活の質
summary_ja: 早期精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除後に放射線療法を受けた患者98例の生活の質を、標準化された質問票で評価した研究。身体・自律面の評価は概ね良好で、排尿スコアの問題は多くみられた。身体像の悪化を感じた患者は6%にとどまった。病気と治療について十分な情報を得ていた患者は、治療後の身体的・心理的適応が良好であった。
summary_en: This study assessed quality of life in 98 patients treated with radiotherapy after orchiectomy for early-stage testicular seminoma, using a validated 44-item self-completed questionnaire. The median follow-up after treatment was about 10 years. Physical and autonomy scores were generally satisfactory, and urinary symptoms were common. Only 6% perceived worsened body image, and psychological problems were reported by a minority. Patients who were better informed about their disease and treatment showed better physical and psychological adjustment, suggesting that patient education may improve long-term quality of life.

title: Chromosome analysis and comparison of the benign cystic and malignant squamous component of an ovarian teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の良性嚢胞成分と悪性扁平上皮成分の染色体解析と比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、36歳女性の単一の卵巣奇形腫から、良性嚢胞成分と悪性扁平上皮成分を別々に採取し、核型解析を行ったものである。悪性扁平上皮成分は二倍体と倍数体の2つの核型集団を示し、倍数体では20番染色体の複数コピーを含む追加の異常がみられた。良性成分と悪性成分には共通する染色体マーカーがいくつか認められた。著者らは、この共通マーカーが組織学的に良性の奇形腫のうち悪性転化するリスクのあるものを同定する手がかりになる可能性があると述べている。
summary_en: This study performed karyotypic analysis of separately sampled benign cystic and malignant squamous components from a single ovarian teratoma in a 36-year-old woman. The malignant squamous component showed two karyotypic populations, diploid and polyploid. The polyploid population had additional abnormalities, including multiple copies of chromosome 20. Several chromosomal markers were shared by the benign and malignant components. The authors suggest these shared markers might help identify histologically benign teratomas at risk of malignant transformation.

title: Metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor. Report of a case with complete response to chemotherapy.
title_ja: 化学療法で完全奏効を得た転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 肺転移を伴う転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の27歳女性の症例報告。PSTTは化学療法に抵抗性を示しやすい稀な妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍である。エトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド、ビンクリスチンによる多剤併用化学療法で完全奏効を得た。治療後40か月以上にわたり無病生存しており、多剤化学療法の有用性が示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) involving the lung. PSTT is a rare form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia that is often resistant to chemotherapy. The patient received combination chemotherapy with etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, and vincristine, and achieved complete response. More than 40 months after treatment, she remained alive without evidence of disease. The authors conclude that multiagent chemotherapy can produce long-term remission even in metastatic PSTT.

title: Choriocarcinoma of the ovary associated with mucinous cystadenoma.
title_ja: 粘液性嚢胞腺腫を合併した卵巣絨毛癌の1例
summary_ja: 54歳の閉経後女性に発生した卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告で、粘液性嚢胞腺腫に合併した初めての報告例である。超音波検査(ドプラ)、CT、MRIで多房性嚢胞内の絨毛癌部分に一致した血流増加が認められた。患者は多発性肺転移を来し、脳内出血で死亡した。粘液性卵巣嚢胞内の血流豊富な充実成分は、悪性成分の可能性を慎重に評価すべきことを示唆する。
summary_en: This report describes a 54-year-old postmenopausal woman with choriocarcinoma of the ovary arising in association with a mucinous cystadenoma, the first such case reported. Doppler ultrasonography, CT, and MRI showed hypervascularity corresponding to the choriocarcinoma area within the multilocular cyst. The patient developed multiple pulmonary metastases and died of intracerebral hemorrhage. The case suggests that hypervascular solid components within a mucinous ovarian cyst warrant careful evaluation for a malignant component.

title: Primary retroperitoneal seminoma with utrasonically abnormal testes.
title_ja: 超音波検査で精巣に異常を認めた原発性後腹膜セミノーマ
summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜セミノーマの症例報告。両側精巣に超音波異常を認めたため、片側精巣摘除術と対側精巣の超音波ガイド下生検を施行した。全標本で精巣がんは否定され、後腹膜原発と判断された。後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の診断と治療をめぐる論点も考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a primary retroperitoneal seminoma in a man whose ultrasonography showed abnormalities in both testes. Because a metastasis from an occult testicular primary can mimic a retroperitoneal primary, the team performed a unilateral orchiectomy and an ultrasound-guided biopsy of the contralateral testis. All surgical specimens were negative for testicular cancer, supporting a true retroperitoneal origin. The authors discuss controversies in diagnosing and managing primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumors, including how imaging and testicular evaluation should guide clinical decisions.

title: Dysphagia caused by a fetus-in-fetu in a 27-year-old man.
title_ja: 胎児内胎児による嚥下障害（27歳男性）
summary_ja: 27歳男性で、後腹膜嚢胞内の胎児内胎児により遠位食道が圧迫され嚥下障害を生じた症例。腫瘤は小児期から存在していた。後腹膜腫瘤の鑑別診断に本疾患を含めるべきと提言している。胎児内胎児は成熟奇形腫の一型とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with dysphagia caused by a fetus-in-fetu, a rare entity in which a malformed fetus-like structure is contained within a host. The lesion lay in a retroperitoneal cystic cavity and had been noticed since childhood, but symptoms developed only a year before presentation as the mass compressed the distal esophagus. The authors suggest that fetus-in-fetu be included in the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal masses. Fetus-in-fetu is generally regarded as a variant of mature teratoma, a form of germ cell tumor.

title: Promotion of seminomatous tumors by targeted overexpression of glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor in mouse testis.
title_ja: 精巣におけるGDNF過剰発現によるセミノーマ様腫瘍の促進
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精原細胞でGDNFを過剰発現させたトランスジェニックマウスは、胚細胞マーカーを発現する悪性精巣腫瘍を発生させた。腫瘍は浸潤性で異数性を示したが遠隔転移はなかった。組織学的・分子的特徴はヒトの古典的セミノーマに類似し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の実験モデルとして有用である。
summary_en: Using transgenic mice that overexpress glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF) in undifferentiated spermatogonia, the authors show that this deregulated signal promotes malignant testicular tumors expressing germ-cell markers. The tumors are invasive and aneuploid but did not metastasize. Their histological, molecular, and histochemical features closely resemble classic human seminomas, making them a useful experimental model of testicular germ cell tumors. The findings also suggest that overstimulation of a normal proto-oncogene by its ligand can initiate carcinogenesis.

title: Reactive oxygen species involved in trichosanthin-induced apoptosis of human choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞におけるトリコサンチン誘導性アポトーシスに関与する活性酸素種
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: トリコサンチンは絨毛癌JAR細胞において、カルシウム依存的に活性酸素種を産生しアポトーシスを誘導した。ROSの産生はカスパーゼ-3活性化に先行し、抗酸化剤や消去剤で細胞死が阻害された。ヒドロキシルラジカルはフェントン反応を介して生じると考えられ、抗腫瘍作用の機序の一端を示す細胞株での基礎研究である。
summary_en: This study shows that trichosanthin (TCS), a type-I ribosome-inactivating protein, induces reactive oxygen species (ROS) in JAR human choriocarcinoma cells in a calcium-dependent manner. ROS production began within minutes and preceded caspase-3 activation, and scavengers and antioxidants blocked TCS-induced cell death. The authors conclude that ROS, including hydroxyl radicals generated via a Fenton reaction, mediate apoptosis in these cells, which may partly explain the drug's anti-tumour and anti-HIV actions. The work is a cell-line mechanistic study without animal or clinical data.

title: Laparoscopic surgery of dermoid cysts--intraoperative spillage and complications.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の腹腔鏡手術：術中漏出と合併症
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 1992〜1998年に卵巣奇形腫で手術を受けた390例の後方視的解析。340例は腹腔鏡手術で、内容物の漏出はしばしば生じたが重篤な合併症はなかった。良性奇形腫では腹腔鏡手術は安全と結論された。悪性が疑われる場合は開腹術を考慮すべきである。
summary_en: This retrospective case series compares 390 women operated on for ovarian teratomas between 1992 and 1998, including 340 laparoscopic procedures and 43 laparotomies. Intraoperative spillage of cyst contents was common during laparoscopic dermoid cyst enucleation, since removal intact in a bag was often not possible. No serious complications occurred in any patient, including those with intraperitoneal spill. The authors conclude that laparoscopic treatment of benign teratomas is safe, while primary laparotomy and adnexectomy should be considered when malignancy is suspected, the tumor is rapidly growing or large, or infiltration is doubtful.

title: Gestational choriocarcinoma arising in a cornual pregnancy.
title_ja: 子宮角妊娠から発生した妊娠性絨毛癌
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 子宮角妊娠が絨毛癌へ移行した症例報告。子宮外妊娠の保存的治療後は、hCG値の推移を注意深く追跡する必要がある。持続性異所性妊娠の診断と、稀な栄養膜疾患の見逃し防止の両面で重要と強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a cornual pregnancy that transformed into choriocarcinoma. The case highlights that hCG titers must be monitored carefully after conservative management of an ectopic pregnancy. Careful follow-up can reveal a persistent ectopic gestation and avoid missing trophoblastic disease, which is rare but important. The authors emphasize hCG surveillance as a key element in managing conservatively treated ectopic pregnancy.

title: Mature teratoma of the middle ear.
title_ja: 中耳の成熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 中耳炎の既往がある3歳女児の側頭骨錐体部に嚢胞性病変が見つかり、亜全錐体切除術を施行した。組織学的に脳・神経・骨格筋・骨などの三胚葉由来の成熟組織からなる成熟奇形腫と診断された。術後20か月で症状は完全に回復した。中耳奇形腫は稀で、切除により治癒し補助療法は不要とされる。
summary_en: A 3-year-old girl with a one-year history of otitis media was found to have a partially cystic lesion of the petrous temporal bone. Subtotal petrosectomy was performed. Histology showed mature tissues from all three germ layers, including brain, nerve, muscle, bone, cartilage and glands, with choroid plexus within a rudimentary ventricle. At 20 months after surgery she remained well. The authors note that middle ear teratomas are rare and are generally cured by resection without adjuvant therapy.

title: Techniques available for the management of massive sacrococcygeal teratomas.
title_ja: 巨大仙尾部奇形腫の外科的管理に用いられる手技
summary_ja: 妊娠34週で帝王切開により出生した乳児の巨大仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。直腸内Nélatonカテーテルで内臓を保護し、2,380gの腫瘍を切除した。出血と凝固障害の制御、内臓保護、創感染予防が外科的管理の要点として論じられ、術前・術中管理の提案がなされている。
summary_en: A massive sacrococcygeal tumor weighing 5,355 g was delivered by elective cesarean section at 34 weeks' gestation. A rectal Nélaton catheter was used to protect the viscera during resection of the 2,380 g tumor, which was diagnosed as sacrococcygeal teratoma. The authors review that controlling hemorrhage and coagulopathy, protecting visceral structures, and avoiding wound infection are necessary for surgical management of massive sacrococcygeal tumors. They offer suggestions for pre- and intraoperative management of this rare tumor.

title: Life-threatening mediastinal teratoma in a neonate.
title_ja: 新生児にみられる生命を脅かす縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 出生時より重度の呼吸窮迫を呈した巨大縦隔奇形腫の新生児例である。腫瘍が左半胸郭を占拠し剥離の余地がなかったため、嚢胞成分を排出後に摘出に成功した。呼吸窮迫を伴う新生児の縦隔奇形腫は文献上16例のみで、手術合併症は約半数に生じたとされる。
summary_en: A newborn with a large mediastinal teratoma presented with severe respiratory distress at birth. The cystic and solid tumor filled the left hemithorax, leaving no room for dissection. After the cystic component was evacuated, the tumor was removed successfully. A literature review identifies only 16 previously reported newborns with mediastinal teratoma and respiratory distress, and operative morbidity occurred in about half. The authors discuss the potential risks of this condition.

title: ID gene expression varies with lineage during differentiation of pluripotential male germ cell tumor cell lines.
title_ja: 多能性男性胚細胞腫瘍細胞株の分化過程におけるID遺伝子発現の系統依存性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍由来の胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1と27X-1を用い、ID遺伝子ファミリーの系統決定における役割を検討した。レチノイン酸では神経系へ分化しId3が増加、BMP-2/4では非神経系へ分化しId2が増加した。両経路でId1は減少した。分化経路によりID発現が異なり、ヒト系統決定のモデルとして有用である。
summary_en: Male germ cell tumor-derived embryonal carcinoma lines NT2/D1 and 27X-1 were used to study how ID gene family members regulate lineage decisions. Retinoic acid induced neuronal differentiation with increased Id3, while BMP-2 and BMP-4 induced a non-neuronal lineage with increased Id2. Id1 declined during differentiation in both programs. The findings show that ID expression varies by differentiation pathway, supporting these pluripotential lines as a model for human lineage decisions.

title: Surgery for ovarian masses in infants, children, and adolescents: 102 consecutive patients treated in a 15-year period.
title_ja: 小児・思春期女児の卵巣腫瘤に対する手術：15年間の102例
summary_ja: 15年間に当施設で卵巣病変に対して手術を受けた小児・思春期女児102例を検討した。急性腹痛例の42%は卵巣捻転で、多くは成熟奇形腫に関連していた。一方、腹部腫瘤例では26%が悪性腫瘍であった。悪性腫瘍が疑われた9例は全員無病で経過し、可能な限り卵巣温存手術を行うべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: This 15-year single-institution series reviewed 102 girls who underwent 106 ovarian operations for pathology in childhood. Among 59 presenting with acute abdominal pain, 42% had ovarian torsion, most often associated with mature teratoma, and only one was malignant. Of 23 presenting with an abdominal mass, 26% were malignant. Nine girls underwent surgery for presumed malignant tumors, mainly germ cell tumors, and all were disease-free at follow-up of about 8 years, though four received chemotherapy. The authors conclude that ovary-preserving surgery should be performed whenever feasible.

title: Laparoscopic excision of retroperitoneal tumors: technique and review of the laparoscopic experience.
title_ja: 後腹膜腫瘍の腹腔鏡下切除術：手技と腹腔鏡手術の経験の検討
summary_ja: 良性後腹膜腫瘍の腹腔鏡下切除の手技を報告した。12cmの後腹膜奇形腫と2つの大きな嚢胞性病変を、体位や結腸・十二指腸の授動を工夫して切除した。合併症や開腹移行はなく、平均手術時間は122分、患者は術後1日で退院した。術前の慎重な評価と丁寧な手技の重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: This paper describes a technique for laparoscopic excision of benign retroperitoneal tumors, including a 12-cm retroperitoneal teratoma and two large cystic lesions. The teratoma was resected in the left lateral decubitus position, requiring medial mobilization of the ascending colon and duodenum. The cystic lesions were resected in lithotomy position and punctured for cytologic analysis. There were no complications or conversions, mean operating time was 122 minutes, and patients were discharged the day after surgery. The authors emphasize careful preoperative evaluation and meticulous technique.

title: Neurogenic cyst of ovary: an unusual massive monodermal teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣の神経原性嚢胞：まれな巨大単胚葉性奇形腫
summary_ja: 14歳女児に生じた巨大な良性嚢胞性単胚葉性奇形腫の症例を報告した。卵巣腫瘍は80×70×80cmで23リットルの液体を含んでいた。嚢胞壁は成熟した中枢神経系組織のみから成り、免疫組織化学染色で診断が裏付けられた。同様の症例は文献上1例しか報告されておらず、極めてまれな病態である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl with a massive benign cystic monodermal teratoma of the ovary, measuring 80 x 70 x 80 cm and containing 23 liters of fluid. The cyst wall consisted entirely of mature central nervous system tissue with prominent microvasculature, lying on a thin rim of ovarian cortex. Immunohistochemistry supported the diagnosis. The authors note that only one comparable case has been reported in the literature. The case illustrates an unusual ovarian teratoma in which neural tissue predominates.

title: Metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor: a case report.
title_ja: 転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 転移を伴った胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の症例報告である。PSTTは妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の変異型で、多くは子宮内に限局するが約10%で転移する。臨床経過は多様で、組織像から生物学的悪性度を予測することは難しい。報告例が少ないため、診断と予後予測の困難さが強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare variant of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia that is usually confined to the uterus but metastasizes in about 10% of patients. The authors highlight that its clinical behavior varies and that histologic recognition does not reliably predict biological behavior. The scarcity of published cases makes diagnosis and prognosis difficult. The paper primarily presents this unusual metastatic presentation and underscores the diagnostic challenges of this rare trophoblastic disease.

title: Genetic origin of malignant trophoblastic neoplasms analyzed by sequence tag site polymorphic markers.
title_ja: 悪性妊娠性トロホブラスト腫瘍の遺伝学的起源：配列タグ部位多型マーカーによる解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 悪性妊娠性トロホブラスト腫瘍12例の起源を微小衛星PCRマーカーで解析し、39例の検討を加えた。悪性妊娠性トロホブラスト腫瘍は全父性発生、正常受精、単為生殖の3様式で生じ、先行妊娠が常に原因受精とは限らないことを示した。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は父性・母性両由来の対立遺伝子を示し、発癌機構が異なる可能性がある。正常受精由来では悪性転化前に長期の休眠期間を経ることも示唆された。
summary_en: This study used microsatellite PCR markers to determine the genetic origin of 12 malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, adding to a series of 39 cases. Malignant GTNs arose through androgenesis, normal fertilization, or parthenogenesis, and the antecedent pregnancy was not always the causative conception. Placental site trophoblastic tumors showed both paternal and maternal allele contributions, suggesting distinct carcinogenic mechanisms. Long dormancy of trophoblasts before malignant transformation, particularly after normal fertilization, was also proposed.

title: Late recurrence in ovarian dysgerminoma with successful response to standard adjuvant chemotherapy: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 晩期再発した卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に対する標準的補助化学療法への良好な反応：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 25歳女性のIC期卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の症例。1983年の手術後に補助治療を受けず、12年後に再発した。半補助的にBEP化学療法を施行し良好な反応を得た。腫瘍量が小さい晩期再発には依然BEP化学療法が有効であり、治癒可能な段階で再発を捉えるための長期フォローアップが重要と結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman with stage IC ovarian dysgerminoma who received no adjuvant treatment after surgery in 1983 and developed late recurrence 12 years later. She responded well to semi-adjuvant BEP chemotherapy. The authors argue that BEP chemotherapy remains important for late recurrence when disease volume is small, and that long-term surveillance is essential to detect recurrence while it is still potentially curable. The paper also reviews literature suggesting late recurrence may carry a poorer prognosis.

title: Predicting outcome to chemotherapy in patients with germ cell tumors: the value of the rate of decline of human chorionic gonadotrophin and alpha-fetoprotein during therapy.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の化学療法転帰予測：治療中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンおよびαフェトプロテイン低下速度の有用性
summary_ja: 白金製剤ベースの化学療法を受けたAFPまたはhCG高値の189例を対象に、初期2サイクル中の腫瘍マーカー低下速度がIGCCCGリスク分類を超えて転帰を予測するかを検討した。満足すべきマーカー低下は、完全奏効割合の向上と無イベント生存・全生存の改善に関連した。この関連はリスクで調整後も有意であり、差は不良リスク患者で最も大きかった。著者らは、マーカー低下は独立した予後的価値を持ち、不良リスク患者の管理指針となりうると結論づけている。
summary_en: In 189 patients with elevated AFP or hCG treated with platinum-based chemotherapy, the authors examined whether the rate of tumor marker decline during the first two cycles predicts outcome beyond IGCCCG risk classification. Satisfactory marker decline was associated with higher complete response rates and better event-free and overall survival. The association remained significant after adjusting for risk, with the greatest difference in poor-risk patients. The authors conclude that marker decline has independent prognostic value and may guide management of poor-risk patients.

title: Noonan's syndrome and seminoma of undescended testicle.
title_ja: Noonan症候群と停留精巣のセミノーマ
summary_ja: Noonan症候群を有する26歳男性で、12歳時に両側停留精巣の固定術を受けていた。右精巣の腫大を契機に超音波検査で充実性腫瘤が見つかり、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腸間膜と後腹膜のリンパ節腫大を認めた。右精巣摘除術で精巣セミノーマと診断され、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる4サイクルの化学療法を施行された。Noonan症候群でのセミノーマ報告は本例が初めてである。
summary_en: A 26-year-old man with Noonan syndrome, who had bilateral orchiopexy for undescended testes at age 12, developed enlargement of the right testis. Ultrasonography showed a solid mass, and CT revealed enlarged mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes. Right inguinal orchiectomy confirmed seminoma. He received four cycles of cisplatin and etoposide. The authors note that nonseminoma in Noonan syndrome has been reported before, but this is the first report of seminoma in this setting.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma: 25 year experience.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫：25年間の経験
summary_ja: 1974年から1999年にシリラート病院で治療された仙尾部奇形腫の小児35例を後方視的に検討した。大部分は初回切除で完全切除されたが、6例が再発に対する追加治療を要した。初診時から悪性であった例が4例、良性切除後に悪性再発した2例が死亡した。死因は進行した悪性腫瘍が主で、手術関連死はなかった。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 35 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma treated at Siriraj Hospital between 1974 and 1999 examined delivery mode, presentation, surgical outcomes, and complications. Most cases were completely excised initially, but six patients needed further treatment for recurrence. Four presented with malignancy initially, and two died after malignant recurrences that followed complete benign excisions. Advanced malignancy was the main cause of death, and no deaths were procedure-related.

title: Testicular embryonal carcinoma metastatic to the labial mucosa of the upper lip.
title_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の上唇口唇粘膜への転移
summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌が上唇の口唇粘膜に転移した稀な症例の報告。転移性口腔病変の臨床像と治療経過が示されている。全身性悪性腫瘍の既往がある患者では、口腔の腫脹が転移巣を示す可能性があると著者らは強調している。単一症例の報告であり、系統的な検討は含まれない。
summary_en: This brief case report describes testicular embryonal carcinoma metastatic to the labial mucosa of the upper lip. It presents the clinical features of the metastatic oral lesion and how it was managed. The authors emphasize that in patients with known systemic malignancy, oral swellings may indicate a metastatic deposit. The paper is a single-patient report and does not include a broader series or outcome analysis.

title: EAT/mcl-1 expression in the human embryonal carcinoma cells undergoing differentiation or apoptosis.
title_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞の分化・アポトーシスにおけるEAT/mcl-1発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: レチノイン酸で分化誘導したヒト胎児性癌細胞株NCR-G3を用い、抗アポトーシス遺伝子EAT/mcl-1の発現を解析した基礎研究である。分化初期にEATが強く誘導され、後期の発現低下とアポトーシス増加が対応した。EATは外膜ミトコンドリアに局在し、アポトーシス細胞では検出されなかった。分化初期の細胞生存維持にEATが関与すると示唆された。
summary_en: This basic-science study examines the human embryonal carcinoma cell line NCR-G3 during retinoic acid-induced differentiation, a model of early embryogenesis. EAT/mcl-1, an antiapoptotic Bcl-2 family gene, was strongly induced early in differentiation and declined later as apoptosis increased. Bax remained constant, while Bcl-2 and Bcl-xS were undetectable. Using a monoclonal antibody, the authors showed EAT localizes to the outer mitochondrial membrane and is absent from apoptotic cells. They conclude that rapid EAT induction may protect differentiating embryonal carcinoma cells from apoptosis.

title: Three-year results of the first educational and early detection program for testicular cancer in Hungary.
title_ja: ハンガリーにおける精巣がんの教育的早期発見プログラムの3年間の成績
summary_ja: ハンガリーで実施された精巣がんの教育的早期発見プログラムの3年間の成績を報告した。媒体での啓発後、5,056名に触診と超音波検査を行い、28例の精巣がん（セミノーマ15例、非セミノーマ13例）を発見した。がんは有症状者に限られ、発見率は全国規模の検診を正当化するには不十分と結論された。リスク集団への教育と、触知可能な腫瘤への早期超音波検査が提案された。
summary_en: This report evaluates a Hungarian educational early-detection program for testicular cancer, based on media campaigns and self-examination education. Among 5,056 men examined by physical and ultrasound examination over three years, 28 testicular cancers (15 seminomas, 13 nonseminomas) were detected, mostly in men aged 15 to 40. Tumors were found only among men with symptoms, and detection rates were insufficient to justify a widespread program. The authors recommend educational programs for at-risk populations, staff training, and early ultrasound for palpable lumps.

title: Germ cell tumor associated primitive neuroectodermal tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に伴う原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍が混在した40例を後方視的に検討した。精巣摘除標本に原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍を認める場合は予後不良因子であった。臨床病期Iでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清が推奨され、転移例では化学療法後の郭清で残存腫瘍が認められた。後腹膜の腫瘍は化学療法のみではまれにしか根治しないと結論された。
summary_en: A retrospective review of 40 men treated for primitive neuroectodermal tumor admixed with germ cell tumor. Clinical stage I patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection mostly remained disease free, while surveillance patients who relapsed were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and later dissection. Most metastatic patients received cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and many required post-chemotherapy dissection. The authors conclude that primitive neuroectodermal tumor in the orchiectomy specimen is an adverse prognostic factor and recommend dissection for clinical stage I cases.

title: Aortic replacement during post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清時の大動脈置換術
summary_ja: 1970〜1998年に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた1,250例のうち、大動脈置換を要した転移性胚細胞腫瘍15例を後方視的に検討した。奇形腫は3例、生存腫瘍は12例に認めた。全体の33%が無病生存し、導入化学療法のみの後の4例は全例無病であった。人工血管関連の合併症はなく、大動脈切除は治療上の利益から正当化されると結論された。
summary_en: A retrospective review of 15 patients with metastatic germ cell cancer who underwent aortic replacement during post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, among 1,250 such operations performed from 1970 to 1998. Additional procedures included nephrectomy and vena caval resection. Teratoma was found in 3 patients and viable tumor in 12. Overall, 33% were disease free; all 4 patients treated after induction chemotherapy alone were disease free, but only 1 of 11 after salvage therapy was. There were no graft-related complications, and the authors conclude that aortic resection is justified.

title: Expression patterns of cancer testis antigens in testicular germ cell tumors and adjacent testicular tissue.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍および隣接精巣組織におけるがん精巣抗原の発現パターン
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍34例と隣接精巣組織を用い、がん精巣抗原8遺伝子の発現をRT-PCRで解析した。MAGE-B1/B2の発現はセミノーマで高く、奇形腫成分では検討した全遺伝子が陰性であった。発現パターンは組織型による分化段階を反映し、細胞傷害性Tリンパ球が認識する恒常的な腫瘍抗原ではないと結論された。
summary_en: RT-PCR analysis of eight cancer-testis antigen genes in 31 primary and 3 metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, plus adjacent testicular parenchyma. Expression depended on histology: seminomas more often expressed MAGE-B1 and MAGE-B2 than nonseminomatous tumors, and all teratomatous elements lacked expression of the genes examined. Most adjacent parenchyma showed deficient expression. The authors conclude that these transcripts reflect developmental stages of tumorigenesis rather than constitutive tumor antigens recognized by cytotoxic T lymphocytes.

title: Pelvic neoplasms in children.
title_ja: 小児の骨盤内腫瘍
summary_ja: 小児骨盤内腫瘍の総説であり、解剖学的特徴と治療の変遷を論じている。横紋筋肉腫や仙尾部奇形腫とともに、奇形腫・卵黄嚢腫瘍・絨毛癌を含む胚細胞腫瘍を主要な腫瘍として扱う。化学療法の進歩により縮小手術が可能となり、精密な組織・遺伝学的同定が重要になった。小児がん研究グループの成果として生存率は改善し、専門施設での治療が推奨される。
summary_en: A review of pelvic neoplasms in children, focusing on anatomic considerations and treatment. Common tumors include rhabdomyosarcomas of the bladder, prostate, and vagina, sacrococcygeal teratoma, and germ cell tumors including teratomas, endodermal sinus tumors, and choriocarcinomas. Improved chemotherapy has reduced the need for radical surgery, making precise histologic and genetic identification more important. Survival has improved substantially through children's cancer study groups, and the authors recommend that these patients be treated at specialized pediatric centers.

title: Carboplatin AUC8 in combination with etoposide and bleomycin in the treatment of intermediate and poor-risk metastatic germ cell tumours: a phase II study.
title_ja: 中間・不良リスク転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対するカルボプラチン（AUC8）・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン併用療法：第II相試験
summary_ja: 中間・不良リスクの転移性胚細胞腫瘍19例に、高用量カルボプラチン（AUC8）・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン併用療法（EBCa）を実施した第II相試験である。完全寛解は37%、化学療法後の手術などを含む無病生存率は58%であった。骨髄抑制の程度と治療成績に関連は認めなかった。増量したカルボプラチンは成績を改善せず、シスプラチン併用化学療法より劣るため、追加検討は推奨されないと結論された。
summary_en: A phase II trial of dose-escalated carboplatin (AUC 8) with etoposide and bleomycin, given every 3 weeks for up to four courses, in 19 patients with intermediate- or poor-risk metastatic germ cell tumors. Seven patients (37%) achieved complete remission, and overall disease-free survival reached 58% after post-chemotherapy surgery and further chemotherapy. Outcome did not correlate with myelosuppression. The authors concluded that dose-escalated carboplatin did not improve results and was inferior to cisplatin-based therapy, so further study is not recommended.

title: The management of testicular cancer in Victoria, 1988-1993. Urology Study Committee of the Victorian Co-operative Oncology Group.
title_ja: ビクトリア州における精巣がんの管理（1988〜1993年）
summary_ja: 1988〜1993年にビクトリア州で登録された精巣がん667例を後方視的に解析した。セミノーマ357例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍271例を含む。病期分類、初期治療、フォローアップは施設間で大きく異なり、病期I例の監視プログラムは多くで不十分とされた。5年相対生存率はセミノーマで99%、非セミノーマで91%であり、診療ガイドラインの策定が必要と結論された。
summary_en: A retrospective population-based analysis of 667 testicular cancer cases registered in Victoria, Australia, from 1988 to 1993, with questionnaires returned for 633 patients. There were 357 pure seminomas and 271 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Practice varied widely in staging, initial management, and follow-up. Surveillance for stage I disease was considered inadequate in most cases. Five-year relative survival was 99% for seminoma and 91% for nonseminoma. The authors call for clinical practice guidelines to improve care.

title: Mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary with sarcomatous component.
title_ja: 肉腫成分を伴う卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 23歳女性の右卵巣腫瘤が流産の精査中に見つかり、開腹時に大網への播種性転移が確認された。病理学的に未熟奇形腫とディスジャーミノーマからなる混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、肉腫成分を伴っていた。顆粒膜細胞腫様の領域も認められた。悪性成分の種類と範囲の決定には十分な組織採取が重要で、予後に直結すると強調している。文献的考察を含む報告。
summary_en: A 23-year-old woman with a right ovarian mass, found while being evaluated for miscarriage, was diagnosed with a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary comprising immature teratoma and dysgerminoma, with a sarcomatous component. Areas resembling granulosa cell tumor were also present, and disseminated omental metastases were found at laparotomy. The authors present this histologically heterogeneous tumor with a literature review, emphasizing that thorough sampling is essential to determine the type and extent of malignant components because these directly affect prognosis.

title: P53, bcl-2 and bax immunoreactivity as predictors of response and outcome after chemotherapy for metastatic germ cell testicular tumours.
title_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法反応と転帰の予測因子としてのp53、bcl-2、baxの免疫反応性
summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の24例を対象に、p53、bcl-2、baxの免疫染色を検討した。ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた患者の原発巣が対象である。化学療法への反応と関連したのはp53のみであった。3つのタンパク質はいずれも生存期間の予測因子とはならなかった。baxは非セミノーマで高値を示した。p53が反応予測に有用である可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study examined immunohistochemical expression of p53, bcl-2 and bax in primary testicular tumors from 24 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors treated with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin. Only p53 immunoreactivity was associated with chemotherapy response, while none of the three proteins predicted survival. Bax intensity was higher in nonseminomas than in seminomas. The authors conclude that p53 may help predict chemotherapy response, but these markers are not significant prognostic factors for survival after chemotherapy in testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Endogenous production of nitric oxide by vascular endothelial growth factor down-regulates proliferation of choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: 血管内皮増殖因子による内因性一酸化窒素産生が絨毛癌細胞の増殖を抑制する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株を用い、VEGFによる増殖の機構を解析した基礎研究である。VEGFはeNOS発現と一酸化窒素産生を増加させ、一酸化窒素はVEGF誘導性の増殖を抑制した。MAPKキナーゼ阻害剤はこれらの効果を打ち消し、Erk経路の活性化が中心的役割を果たすことが示された。内因性の一酸化窒素がErk経路を介して絨毛癌細胞の増殖を調節することが示唆された。
summary_en: This basic science study used the choriocarcinoma-derived BeWo trophoblast cell line to examine how vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) stimulates proliferation. VEGF increased endothelial nitric oxide synthase expression and nitric oxide production, and nitric oxide acted to down-regulate VEGF-induced proliferation. Erk MAPK activation was central, as blocking MAPK kinase reversed the effects on nitric oxide production and eNOS expression. The findings suggest that endogenous nitric oxide regulates VEGF-driven choriocarcinoma cell growth through the Erk pathway.

title: Viable malignant cells after primary chemotherapy for disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumors: prognostic factors and role of postsurgery chemotherapy--results from an international study group.
title_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における初回化学療法後の生存悪性細胞:予後因子と術後化学療法の役割
summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍238例を対象とした国際的な多施設研究である。完全切除、生存腫瘍細胞10%未満、良好なIGCCC分類が無増悪生存期間と全生存期間の独立した予後因子であった。術後化学療法は無増悪生存期間を改善したが、全生存期間は改善しなかった。中間リスク群で利益が大きく、完全切除の方が重要と考察している。
summary_en: This international multicenter study reviewed 238 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who had residual viable malignant cells after first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Complete resection, under 10% viable malignant cells, and a favorable IGCCC group independently predicted progression-free and overall survival. Postoperative chemotherapy improved progression-free survival but not overall survival, with benefit mainly in the intermediate-risk group. The authors suggest complete resection may be more critical than postoperative chemotherapy.

title: Transition from in situ to invasive testicular germ cell neoplasia is associated with the loss of p21 and gain of mdm-2 expression.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の上皮内から浸潤性への移行はp21の消失とmdm-2発現の獲得に関連する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍31例でp53、p21、mdm-2を免疫組織化学的に検討した。セミノーマと胎児性癌優位の混合型を含み、27例で隣接する精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)を伴っていた。前駆病変でp21を発現していた症例の多くは、浸潤性腫瘍でp21を消失していた。浸潤性腫瘍ではmdm-2発現が獲得されていた。p53経路の破綻が上皮内病変から浸潤性腫瘍への進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined p53, p21 and mdm-2 in 31 testicular germ cell tumors, including seminomas and mixed germ cell tumors dominated by embryonal carcinoma, with adjacent intratubular germ cell neoplasia in 27 cases. p21 was lost in most invasive tumors that had expressed it in the precursor lesion, while mdm-2 expression was gained in invasive tumors. The findings suggest disruption of the p53 pathway may drive progression from in situ neoplasia to invasive germ cell tumor.

title: Hemolytic anemia and benign pelvic tumors. A case report.
title_ja: 良性骨盤腫瘍を伴う溶血性貧血:症例報告
summary_ja: 27歳女性で、輸血やステロイドに抵抗性の血管内溶血性貧血を呈した症例報告である。CTで大きな複雑骨盤内腫瘤を認め、両側の類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)を切除すると貧血は改善した。7年後も再発はみられていない。標準治療に抵抗性の溶血性貧血では骨盤内腫瘍を検索すべきと強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with intravascular hemolytic anemia that did not respond to transfusions or steroids. Computed tomography revealed a large complex pelvic mass, and excision of bilateral dermoid cysts (mature teratomas) resolved the anemia. She remained free of recurrence seven years later. The authors emphasize that pelvic tumors should be sought in patients with hemolytic anemia refractory to standard therapy, since it resolves only after the neoplasm is removed.

title: Adrenal teratoma in four domestic ferrets (Mustela putorius furo).
title_ja: 家畜フェレットにみられた副腎奇形腫4例
summary_ja: 家畜化されたフェレット4頭の副腎に生じた奇形腫を報告した獣医病理の論文である。4例中3例で三胚葉由来の組織が認められ、2例には原始的な歯が含まれていた。1例では悪性上皮細胞が所属リンパ節に転移していた。副腎腫瘍の鑑別診断として奇形腫を考慮すべきと提案している。
summary_en: This veterinary pathology report describes adrenal teratomas in four domestic ferrets. Histologically, three of the four tumors contained tissues from ectodermal, mesodermal and endodermal germ layers, and two contained rudimentary teeth. In one case, malignant epithelial cells had metastasized to local lymph nodes. The authors suggest that teratoma, although uncommon, should be included in the differential diagnosis of adrenal neoplasms in domestic ferrets.

title: Dermoid cyst of the caecum: case report.
title_ja: 盲腸の類皮嚢腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 盲腸に生じたまれな良性類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。発症機序として、胚発生時の隔離、術後の移植、腸原性嚢胞の扁平上皮化生、奇形腫などを考察している。本患者のフォローアップ中、一側の精巣に精細管内の胚細胞性病変が見つかった。著者らは、この所見の意義について論じている。消化管外の奇形腫様病変と精巣の胚細胞前駆病変を結びつける内容であり、胚細胞腫瘍の文献として関連性がある。
summary_en: This case report describes a benign dermoid cyst of the caecum, a rare lesion, and discusses its pathogenesis, including embryological sequestration, postoperative implantation, squamous metaplasia of enterogenous cysts, and teratoma. During follow-up of the patient, intratubular germ cell neoplasia was detected in one testis. The authors discuss the significance of this finding.
