The authors note that massive para-aortic nodal metastasis from dysgerminoma had not previously been documented on MRI.

title: Early cystic relapse of embryonal carcinoma of testis in obturator fossa.
title_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の閉鎖窩における早期嚢胞性再発
summary_ja: 右精巣の進行期IIB期胎児性癌に対し化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行後、閉鎖窩に早期の嚢胞性再発を来した症例。後方視的に再検討し、非典型部位への精巣腫瘍の早期再発に関する文献を検討した。閉鎖窩再発の報告はこれまで1例のみであった。適切な治療後も予期せず短期間で再発し得るため、密なフォローアップが重要である。
summary_en: The authors report a patient with a stage IIB embryonal carcinoma of the right testis who received chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, then developed an early cystic recurrence in the obturator fossa. The case was retrospectively reanalyzed and the literature on early recurrences of testicular tumors at atypical sites reviewed. Only one prior case of obturator fossa recurrence was found. The report shows recurrence can occur unpredictably soon after appropriate therapy, emphasizing close follow-up.

title: A case of Klinefelter syndrome with retroperitoneal teratoma.
title_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫を伴うクラインフェルター症候群の1例
summary_ja: 腹部腫瘤を呈した生後5か月の男児の後腹膜腫瘍の症例。手術で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され、末梢血リンパ球の核型解析でクラインフェルター症候群と判明した。同症候群では縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍が好発するが、後腹膜発生は極めてまれである。胚細胞腫瘍の患者は部位を問わず核型異常の検査を行うべきと提案している。
summary_en: The authors describe a five-month-old boy with an abdominal mass who was found to have a retroperitoneal tumor. Surgical removal revealed a mature cystic teratoma, and peripheral lymphocyte karyotyping confirmed Klinefelter syndrome. The authors review that Klinefelter patients are at increased risk of germ cell tumors, most often in the mediastinum, and that retroperitoneal germ cell tumors in this setting are very rare. They suggest patients with germ cell tumors at any site should be screened for karyotypic abnormalities.

title: Differential binding activities of lectins and neoglycoproteins in human testicular tumors.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍におけるレクチンおよびネオ糖タンパクの結合活性の差異
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の手術検体67例（セミノーマ31例、胎児性癌32例、絨毛癌4例）を、植物・無脊椎動物由来のレクチン5種、ネオ糖タンパク16種、ガレクチン-1抗体を用いて解析した。一部の糖鎖マーカーは腫瘍型や、原発巣と転移巣の胎児性癌との間で発現に差がみられた。ネオ糖タンパクは対応するレクチンとほぼ一致する染色像を示し、レクチンの代替マーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study analyzed 67 surgical specimens of testicular germ cell tumors (31 seminomas, 32 embryonal carcinomas, 4 choriocarcinomas) using five plant and invertebrate lectins, 16 neoglycoproteins, and a galectin-1 antibody. Several glycoconjugate markers, including melibiose, lactose, and beta-N-acetylgalactosamine probes, were differentially expressed among tumor subtypes and between primary and metastatic embryonal carcinomas. Neoglycoproteins showed staining patterns that largely matched their corresponding lectins, though with weaker intensity, suggesting they could replace plant lectins as markers. The authors propose that glycoconjugate profiles may relate to tumor growth, metastasis, or prognosis.

title: Disseminated carcinomatosis after laparoscopic surgery for presumably benign ruptured ovarian teratoma.
title_ja: 良性と考えられた破裂卵巣奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡手術後に生じた播種性癌腫症
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 28歳女性が、良性と考えられた破裂成熟卵巣奇形腫に対して腹腔鏡下手術を受けた2か月後に腹膜播種が判明した。潜在性の悪性転化があったと考えられる。開腹術で扁平上皮癌による腹膜播種と確認されたが、腫瘍マーカーや画像検査では原発巣は特定されなかった。患者は開腹術後14か月で死亡した。診断が不十分な場合や切除が不完全な場合には、腹腔鏡手術に限界があると著者らは注意を促している。
summary_en: A 28-year-old woman developed intraperitoneal carcinomatosis two months after laparoscopic oophorectomy for a ruptured mature ovarian teratoma that was presumed benign but had occult malignant transformation. Peritoneal cytology and removed specimens were negative at the time of surgery. She later developed intestinal obstruction with ascites, and exploratory laparotomy confirmed carcinomatosis from squamous cell carcinoma of unknown origin. Tumor markers and imaging were negative apart from the carcinomatosis. The patient died 14 months after laparotomy. The authors caution that laparoscopic approaches may be limited when initial diagnosis is uncertain or excision is incomplete.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumour: a rare but potentially curable cancer.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：稀ではあるが根治可能な癌
summary_ja: 1984年から1996年にシェフィールドの治療センターで管理された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍7例を解析した。主な症状は不規則な性器出血であった。子宮内に限局した3例は子宮摘出術のみで治癒し、肺転移を伴う2例は併用化学療法で治癒した。遠隔転移または局所領域転移を有した残る2例は、複数の治療にもかかわらず死亡した。稀ではあるが、特に病変が限局している場合には根治可能な腫瘍であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This analysis reviews all seven cases of placental site trophoblastic tumour (PSTT) managed at the Sheffield Trophoblastic Disease Screening and Treatment Centre between 1984 and 1996, among 4,988 gestational trophoblastic disease registrations. Presentation varied, most often with irregular vaginal bleeding. Three patients with uterine-confined disease were cured by hysterectomy alone. Two with pulmonary metastases were cured with combination chemotherapy. The remaining two, with distant or loco-regional spread, died despite multiple treatments. The authors conclude that PSTT is rare but potentially curable, particularly when disease is localized.

title: Intensive chemotherapy and radical resections for primary nonseminomatous mediastinal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 縦隔原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する強力化学療法と根治的切除
summary_ja: 1993年から1998年に治療された縦隔原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性20例を、単施設で検討した。多剤併用化学療法を交互に行い、奏効例には根治的切除を実施した。手術を受けた11例中10例で完全切除が得られ、周術期死亡はなかった。初回治療群の2年生存率は72%、サルベージ群は42%であった。化学療法関連死が3例あった。マーカーが正常化した症例への集学的治療と完全切除は、生存期間を延長しうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This single-institution series reviewed 20 men with primary nonseminomatous mediastinal germ cell tumors treated from 1993 to 1998. Patients received alternating multi-drug chemotherapy, followed by radical resection in those whose tumors responded. Thirteen had metastatic disease at presentation, and all had elevated beta-hCG or alpha-fetoprotein. Eleven underwent surgery, with ten complete resections and no perioperative deaths. Two-year survival was 72% in the initial group and 42% in the salvage group. Three deaths were related to chemotherapy. The authors conclude that aggressive multidisciplinary therapy followed by complete resection can prolong survival.

title: Testicular cancer and occupational exposures with a focus on xenoestrogens in polyvinyl chloride plastics.
title_ja: 精巣がんと職業暴露：ポリ塩化ビニルプラスチック中のキセノエストロゲンに着目して
summary_ja: 精巣がん148例と健常対照314例を対象とした症例対照研究で、生涯の職歴と特定の暴露を調べた。主な所見は、ポリ塩化ビニル（PVC）に暴露された労働者でセミノーマのリスクが6倍高いことであった。他のプラスチックでは過剰リスクは認められなかった。PVCの可塑剤として用いられるフタル酸エステルなどのキセノエストロゲンとの関連が示唆された。内分泌攪乱仮説の検証と因果機序の解明には、実験的研究が必要であるとしている。
summary_en: This case-control study of 148 testicular cancer cases and 314 healthy controls examined lifetime occupational histories and specific exposures. The main finding was a six-fold increased risk of seminoma among workers exposed to polyvinyl chloride (PVC). No excess risk was seen for other plastics. The authors suggest a possible link to xenoestrogens, such as phthalates used as PVC plasticizers, which may promote growth of endocrine-sensitive tumour cells. They call for experimental studies to test this endocrine disruptor hypothesis and clarify causal mechanisms.

title: Ultrafast fetal MR images of sacrococcygeal teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の超高速胎児MR画像：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠31週に胎児MRIで診断された仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。短時間で高解像度画像を得るため、ハーフフーリエ単発スピンエコー（HASTE）超高速撮像法を用いた。この撮像法により、腫瘍の嚢胞成分と充実成分のコントラストが向上した。胎児期の仙尾部奇形腫の評価において、超高速胎児MRIが有用であることが示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed by fetal magnetic resonance imaging at 31 weeks of gestation. The authors used the half-Fourier single-shot turbo spin echo (HASTE) ultrafast sequence to acquire high-resolution images in a short time. The sequence improved contrast between the cystic and solid components of the tumor. The report highlights the usefulness of ultrafast fetal MR imaging for prenatal characterization of sacrococcygeal teratoma, particularly in distinguishing cystic from solid areas.

title: Conservative management of ovarian cystic teratoma during pregnancy and labor.
title_ja: 妊娠および分娩中の卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に対する保存的管理
summary_ja: 妊娠中に超音波検査で卵巣の嚢胞性奇形腫(6cm未満)と診断された49例を追跡した研究。68回の妊娠で健常児64例が出生し、帝王切開率は16%だった。捻転や分娩停止、破裂は認められず、経過中の嚢胞サイズは変化しなかった。小さな卵巣類皮嚢腫は妊娠中に増大や合併症を来しにくく、保存的管理が妥当と結論づけている。
summary_en: This study followed 49 women with ultrasonographically diagnosed ovarian cystic teratomas smaller than 6 cm through pregnancy and labor. Serial ultrasound examinations tracked cyst size. Of 68 pregnancies, 64 healthy infants were delivered, with a cesarean rate of 16%. No torsion, dystocia, or rupture occurred, and cyst size remained unchanged in 56 cysts followed throughout pregnancy. The authors conclude that small ovarian dermoid cysts are unlikely to grow or cause complications during pregnancy and labor, supporting conservative management.

title: Birth after treatment of a male with seminoma and azoospermia with cryopreserved-thawed testicular tissue.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマおよび無精子症の男性における凍結保存精巣組織を用いた出産
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと無精子症を有する男性で、がん治療前に精巣組織を凍結保存した症例。治療後に解凍した組織を用いた顕微授精により、健康な女児が出生した。染色体は正常で、Y染色体微小欠失は認めなかった。がん治療前の精液や精巣組織の凍結保存の重要性を論じている。
summary_en: A man with a testicular seminoma and azoospermia had testicular tissue cryopreserved by biopsy before oncologic treatment. After chemotherapy and surgery, the tissue was thawed and used for intracytoplasmic sperm injection, resulting in the birth of a healthy girl. His karyotype was normal and no Y microdeletions were found. The authors argue that cryopreservation of even poor-quality ejaculate, and of testicular tissue in azoospermia, should be offered before oncologic therapy, since fertility often deteriorates after treatment.

title: Radioimmunodetection of residual, recurrent or metastatic germ cell tumors using technetium-99 anti-(alpha-fetoprotein) Fab' fragment.
title_ja: テクネチウム99標識抗αフェトプロテイン(AFP)Fab'断片を用いた、残存・再発・転移性胚細胞腫瘍の放射免疫検出
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者において、99mTc標識抗AFP Fab'断片によるシンチグラフィの有用性を検討した。48回の検査を通常の画像検査と比較し、感度89%、特異度58%だった。活動性病変の検出に一定の有用性があり、前向き研究が妥当と結論づけている。
summary_en: Technetium-99m-labelled anti-AFP Fab' fragment scintigraphy was evaluated in patients with germ cell tumours at initial staging, during treatment, at relapse, or in long-term follow-up. Forty-eight scans were compared with conventional radiographs done within four weeks. Serum AFP was elevated in 40 measurements. Overall sensitivity was 89% and specificity 58%. The authors conclude that AFP scanning is sufficiently sensitive to justify prospective trials comparing it with conventional imaging.

title: Congenital sacrococcygeal teratomas: effect of gestational age on size, morphologic pattern, ploidy, p53, and ret expression.
title_ja: 先天性仙尾部奇形腫における胎齢と形態、倍数性、p53およびret発現の関係
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胎齢21〜41週の先天性仙尾部奇形腫7例を、形態、DNA倍数性、p53およびretの発現から解析した研究。腫瘍サイズと未熟神経組織の割合は胎齢とともに減少した。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分や未熟組織は異数性を示し、p53の蓄積も認められた。胎齢30週未満での急速な増大は未熟神経組織の増加と関連していた。
summary_en: Seven congenital sacrococcygeal teratomas (21 to 41 weeks gestation) were analysed for morphology, DNA ploidy, and immunohistochemical p53 and ret expression. Relative tumour size and immature neural content decreased with advancing gestational age. Yolk sac tumour components and immature tissues showed aneuploid populations, and p53 accumulated in these areas. Ret was seen in osteoclasts near bone formation in an immature teratoma. Rapid growth below 30 weeks correlated with more immature neural tissue, offering pathological correlates for the gestational-age-dependent survival difference.

title: Detection of Intramural Choriocarcinoma of the Uterus with 18F-FDG-PET. A Case Report.
title_ja: 18F-FDG-PETで検出された子宮筋層内絨毛癌の1例：症例報告
summary_ja: hCGが4年間上昇し続けた37歳女性の症例。複数回の掻爬と腹腔鏡でも栄養膜組織は見つからなかった。超音波で子宮筋腫様に見えた腫瘍に、FDG-PETで限局性の集積を認め、病理学的に子宮筋層内絨毛癌と確定した。通常の検査で確定できない潜在性腫瘍の局在診断にPETが有用であった。
summary_en: A 37-year-old woman had rising beta-hCG over four years despite five curettages and two laparoscopies that found no trophoblastic tissue. Vaginal ultrasound and power Doppler showed a vascular anterior uterine wall mass resembling a leiomyoma. FDG-PET showed a single focus of uptake over the uterus, which was the sole indicator of malignancy. Histology confirmed intramural choriocarcinoma. The authors highlight FDG-PET as a useful tool for localising occult trophoblastic tumours when conventional imaging and biopsy are inconclusive.

title: Yolk sac tumor of the temporal bone: report of a case.
title_ja: 側頭骨の卵黄嚢腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 18か月の女児が、鼓膜切開術の3か月後に顔面神経麻痺と外耳道の有茎性腫瘤を発症した。CTとMRIでは外耳道、中耳、乳突蜂巣の関与が示された。生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と確認されたが、血清αフェトプロテインが著明に高値であったにもかかわらず、AFP陽性の腫瘍細胞はごく少数であった。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法で神経麻痺は回復し、AFP値は低下し、画像上も腫瘍は消失した。著者らは、類似症例では手術を避けられる可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: An 18-month-old girl developed facial nerve palsy and a polypoid ear canal mass three months after myringotomy. CT and MRI showed involvement of the external ear canal, middle ear and mastoid. Biopsy confirmed a yolk sac tumour, with few AFP-positive cells despite markedly elevated serum AFP. Cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy led to nerve recovery, falling AFP and radiographic resolution, suggesting surgery may be avoided in similar cases.

title: Genetics and biology of adult human male germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 成人男性胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝学と生物学
summary_ja: 成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍について、遺伝学と生物学の最新知見を総説する。未分化型、胎児性癌、奇形腫、絨毛癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍への分化が示される。シスプラチンを基盤とした化学療法への高い感受性も扱う。サイクリンD2の過剰発現、インプリンティングを含む分化経路、p53依存性アポトーシスが論じられ、検証可能な遺伝学的モデルが提案されている。
summary_en: This review examines the genetics and biology of adult male germ cell tumors, which show histological differentiation into undifferentiated, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor phenotypes. It discusses their value as models of pluripotent cell transformation and their exceptional sensitivity to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Recent findings on early cyclin D2 overexpression, lineage differentiation pathways including imprinting, and p53-dependent apoptosis in chemosensitivity are summarized. Testable genetic models are proposed.

title: Collection of peripheral blood stem cells with granulocyte-colony-stimulating factor alone in testicular cancer patients.
title_ja: G-CSF単独による精巣がん患者からの末梢血幹細胞採取
summary_ja: 化学療法歴のある精巣がん患者3例に、G-CSF単独で末梢血幹細胞を動員し採取を試みた。単核球は十分に得られたが、CD34陽性細胞とCFU-GMは不足した。著者らはG-CSFの用量が不十分であったと結論づけている。大量化学療法と自家移植への応用を見据えた検討である。
summary_en: Three patients with testicular cancer, previously treated with several cycles of chemotherapy, underwent peripheral blood stem cell mobilization with G-CSF alone for possible high-dose chemotherapy with transplantation. Apheresis yielded adequate mononuclear cells, but CD34-positive cells and CFU-GM were insufficient. The authors conclude that the G-CSF dose used was inadequate for harvesting enough stem cells. The report is a small study of three patients, so its conclusions are limited by sample size.

title: Imprinted H19 gene expression in embryogenesis and human cancer: the oncofetal connection.
title_ja: インプリンティングを受けたH19遺伝子の発生と悪性腫瘍：オンコフェタル様の関連
summary_ja: インプリンティング遺伝子H19の胚発生と腫瘍での胎児型発現を総説する。若年成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍では、発現量と単対立遺伝子・両対立遺伝子発現が独立した特徴として乖離することが示された。アンドロジェネティックな完全胞状奇胎では、絨毛細胞栄養膜細胞でインプリンティングの弛緩が認められる。膀胱癌では早期再発のマーカーとなりうる。
summary_en: This review of the imprinted H19 gene covers its role in embryogenesis and oncofetal expression in human cancers. Among the examples, H19 was studied in testicular germ cell tumors of adolescents and young adults, where expression level dissociated from monoallelic versus biallelic expression. Relaxation of imprinting was observed in villous cytotrophoblasts of androgenetic complete hydatidiform moles. The paper also covers bladder carcinoma, where H19 marks early recurrence and may serve as a basis for gene therapy.

title: Prenatal sonographic detection of pericardial teratoma.
title_ja: 胎児超音波検査で発見された心膜奇形腫
summary_ja: 定期的な産科超音波検査で胎児期に発見された心膜奇形腫の症例報告である。約3cmの高エコー性腫瘤が右心房を圧迫し、充実性と嚢胞性の成分が混在していた。妊娠満期まで経過観察し、出生後の手術前に追加の画像検査が行われた。胎児期の診断は管理、分娩、胎児手術の計画に不可欠であると強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a pericardial teratoma detected prenatally during routine obstetric sonography. The echogenic 3 cm mass compressed the right atrium and was inhomogeneous, with solid and cystic components. The fetus was followed to term with additional radiologic studies before postnatal surgery. The authors emphasize that prenatal identification is essential for planning fetal management, delivery, and potential prenatal surgery. Pericardial teratomas usually present at birth with cardiorespiratory distress or as hydrops fetalis.

title: Evidence for a selective loss of somatostatin receptor subtype expression in male germ cell tumors of seminoma type.
title_ja: セミノーマにおけるソマトスタチン受容体サブタイプ発現の選択的消失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常精巣とセミノーマにおいてソマトスタチン受容体サブタイプのmRNA発現をRT-PCRで比較した。セミノーマでは全例がsst5のみを発現し、sst1とsst2は欠如していた。多くの症例でsst3またはsst4も欠失していた。sst3とsst4の選択的な喪失がセミノーマの発がんに関与する可能性が示唆される。
summary_en: This study compared somatostatin receptor subtype mRNA expression between normal human testes and seminoma tumors using RT-PCR. Normal testes expressed sst3, sst5 and, in most samples, sst4. All seminomas expressed only sst5, lacking sst1 and sst2 transcripts. Most seminomas also lacked sst3 or sst4. The authors conclude that normal testes are somatostatin targets and that selective loss of sst3 and sst4 may be associated with seminoma carcinogenesis.

title: An adult patient with a mixed germ cell tumor of the spermatic cord.
title_ja: 精索に発生した混合型胚細胞腫瘍を有する成人患者の1例
summary_ja: 精索に発生した混合型胚細胞腫瘍の36歳成人例を報告する症例報告である。精索原発腫瘍の約半数は悪性とされ、本例は極めて稀な発生部位である。臨床経過と治療の詳細を記述し、成人の精索混合型腫瘍の類似報告はこれまでないとしている。胚細胞腫瘍の希少な原発部位を文献に加える内容である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old adult with a mixed germ cell tumor arising from the spermatic cord, a very rare site, since roughly half of primary spermatic cord tumors are malignant. The authors detail the presentation and treatment and note that no comparable adult cases of mixed tumors of the spermatic cord had been reported previously. Because spermatic cord germ cell tumors are exceptionally uncommon, the report adds a rarely documented primary site to the literature on germ cell tumors.

title: A rare simultaneous presentation of testicular mixed germ cell tumor with a contralateral testis torsion.
title_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と対側精巣捻転を同時に呈した稀な症例
summary_ja: 27歳男性が急性陰嚢症で受診し、精巣腫瘍と対側精巣捻転が同時に認められた症例報告である。術前画像では捻転を見逃し、腫瘍の評価も不明瞭であった。術中凍結切片で悪性が疑われ右精巣摘除術が行われ、病理では全亜型を含む精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。類似例は報告されていないとしている。
summary_en: A 27-year-old man presented with an acute scrotum in which a testicular tumor coexisted with contralateral testicular torsion. Preoperative imaging missed the torsion and was equivocal for the tumor. On exploration the left testis was ischemic from threefold rotation, while the right testis was largely replaced by necrotic lesions. Frozen section suggested malignancy, prompting high right orchiectomy. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor containing all subtypes. The authors state that no similar case has been reported.

title: Chorangioma with trophoblastic proliferation.
title_ja: 栄養膜細胞増殖を伴う絨毛血管腫
summary_ja: 胎盤の絨毛血管腫23例を再検討し、15例(65%)で栄養膜細胞の増殖と核異型を認めた。これは妊娠性絨毛性疾患に類似する所見である。MIB-1増殖指数も高値であった(35.4%対15.7%)。持続性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患は認めず、臨床経過は良好であった。「栄養膜細胞増殖を伴う絨毛血管腫」への再分類を提案している。
summary_en: This study re-reviewed 23 placental chorangiomas and found trophoblastic proliferation with nuclear atypia, resembling trophoblastic neoplasia, in 15 cases (65%). The cytotrophoblast MIB-1 proliferation index was higher in these lesions than in classic chorangiomas (35.4% vs 15.7%). No persistent gestational trophoblastic disease was recorded, and the clinical course appeared benign. The authors propose reclassifying these lesions as chorangiomas with trophoblastic proliferation, noting they are more common than the rarity of reported cases suggests.

title: Sex cord-stromal tumors of the testis with entrapped germ cells: a lesion mimicking unclassified mixed germ cell sex cord-stromal tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞を取り込んだ精巣の性索間質性腫瘍：未分類型混合型胚細胞性索間質性腫瘍を模倣する病変
summary_ja: 精巣の性索間質性腫瘍10例に、胚細胞が取り込まれた所見を検討した。多くは精原細胞様の非腫瘍性細胞で、胚細胞腫瘍マーカーは陰性であった。1例はセミノーマ様細胞を含み、セルトリ細胞腫瘍との衝突腫瘍と判断された。このような取り込み例は、真の未分類型混合型腫瘍より一般的であると結論している。
summary_en: This study describes ten testicular sex cord-stromal tumors containing entrapped germ cells, which mimicked the unclassified type of mixed germ cell sex cord-stromal tumor. Patients were aged 3 to 48 years. The germ cells usually resembled spermatogonia and did not stain for neoplastic germ cell markers. In one case, seminoma-like germ cells stained positively, and the lesion was interpreted as a collision tumor with a Sertoli cell tumor. The authors conclude that such entrapped germ cells are more common than true unclassified mixed tumors.

title: Neonatal neoplasms.
title_ja: 新生児腫瘍
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 1930年から1998年に診断された生後28日以内の新生児腫瘍23例を後方視的に検討した。奇形腫/胚細胞腫瘍が8例(35%)で最多であった。悪性胚細胞腫瘍の1例は手術と化学療法後に死亡し、未熟奇形腫の生存例も報告されている。先天異常の合併が多く、新生児への放射線療法は晩期障害のリスクがあると結論している。
summary_en: This Duke University review identified 23 neonates with neoplasms diagnosed within 28 days of birth between 1930 and 1998. Teratoma or germ cell tumor was the most common histology, at 8 cases (35%), followed by neuroblastoma and retinoblastoma. Among the teratoma and germ cell tumor patients, one malignant germ cell tumor patient died despite surgery and chemotherapy, while two immature teratomas and several teratomas had long-term survivors. The authors note frequent associated congenital anomalies and that radiotherapy in neonates carries late effects.

title: Prenatal diagnosis of epignathus in the first half of pregnancy: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 妊娠中期における口腔咽頭奇形腫（エピグナトス）の出生前診断：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 19週の超音波検査で出生前に診断された、極めて稀な口腔咽頭奇形腫（エピグナトス）の症例報告である。文献レビューを併記している。予後は発症時期、手術の難易度、合併奇形、構成組織によって決まるとされる。妊娠中期の超音波検査が出生前診断に有用であることを示している。
summary_en: This case report describes the prenatal diagnosis of epignathus, an extremely rare oropharyngeal teratoma, detected by ultrasonography at 19 weeks of gestation. The authors also review the relevant literature. Congenital oral cavity teratomas typically present as masses projecting from the mouth, and prognosis depends on age at presentation, surgical difficulty, associated anomalies, and tissue composition. The report highlights the value of second-trimester ultrasound for identifying such lesions before delivery.

title: Cytokeratin expression in seminoma of the human testis.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおけるサイトケラチン発現
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ64例でサイトケラチン(CK)発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。CKは約4割で陽性だったが、年齢・病期・腫瘍径・予後との関連はなかった。胎児性癌ではCKやCD30が高率に陽性で、小さな生検検体でセミノーマと胎児性癌を鑑別するのに有用と示された。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined cytokeratin expression in 64 testicular seminomas and 17 embryonal carcinomas. CK7, CAM 5.2, AE1/AE3 and WSK were positive in roughly one-third to two-fifths of seminomas, but CK positivity did not correlate with age, stage, tumor size or outcome. Embryonal carcinomas showed much higher CK and CD30 positivity. In small needle biopsies, CK and CD30 staining may help distinguish seminoma from embryonal carcinoma.

title: RPLND or primary chemotherapy in clinical stage IIA/B nonseminomatous germ cell tumors? Results of a prospective multicenter trial including quality of life assessment.
title_ja: 臨床病期IIA/B非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清か初回化学療法か：QOL評価を含む前向き多施設試験の結果
summary_ja: 臨床病期IIA/Bの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍187例を対象に、初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清＋化学療法2サイクル群と初回化学療法3～4サイクル群を比較した前向き多施設試験。再発率は両群とも低く、射精障害は郭清群で多く、急性毒性は化学療法群で高かった。著者らは初回郭清を推奨し、QOLに有意差はないと報告した。
summary_en: This prospective multicenter German-Austrian trial compared primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection plus two cycles of chemotherapy with three to four cycles of primary chemotherapy in 187 patients with clinical stage IIA/B nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Relapse rates were low in both arms (7% and 11%). Surgical complications and loss of ejaculation were more frequent in the surgery-first arm, while chemotherapy caused more acute toxicity. The authors recommend primary RPLND, with quality of life comparable between groups.

title: Clinical evaluation of mature teratomas containing malignant elements.
title_ja: 悪性成分を含む成熟奇形腫の臨床的評価
summary_ja: 1982〜1998年の成熟卵巣奇形腫251例のうち、悪性成分を含む症例は5例(2.0%)であった。全例で腫瘍マーカーの上昇と画像診断から術前に悪性が疑われた。病期Iの扁平上皮癌2例と境界悪性1例は生存したが、進行例2例は8か月以内に死亡した。術前診断の有用性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study of 251 mature ovarian teratomas (1982 to 1998) identified five cases (2.0%) containing malignant elements. All five were suspected of malignancy before surgery, based on elevated serum tumor markers (CA19-9, CA125, SCC, CEA) together with imaging. Two early-stage squamous cell carcinomas and one borderline malignancy survived, while two advanced cases died within eight months. The findings suggest that tumor markers and imaging can support preoperative detection of malignant transformation in mature ovarian teratomas.

title: Malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary. Pregnancy considerations.
title_ja: 卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍：妊娠に関する考察
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 1976〜1992年に治療された卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍75例を後方視的に検討した。腫瘍と併存した妊娠は10例で、純粋ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）では予後と胎児転帰に悪影響はみられなかった。保存的手術後に妊娠を希望した22例のうち12例が妊娠し、多くは正常分娩であった。白金製剤による化学療法は妊孕性を損なわないと考えられた。
summary_en: This review of 75 ovarian malignant germ cell tumors treated from 1976 to 1992 examined pregnancy association and outcomes. Ten patients had a pregnancy concurrent with the tumor. Pure dysgerminoma did not appear to worsen prognosis or fetal outcome, whereas two non-dysgerminomatous tumors caused deaths during the second trimester. Among 22 women who wished to conceive after conservative surgery, 12 conceived, mostly with normal births. Platinum-based chemotherapy did not appear to impair fertility.

title: Scleromyxedema: possible association with seminoma.
title_ja: 硬化性粘液水腫：セミノーマとの関連の可能性
summary_ja: 43歳男性で、硬化性粘液水腫とセミノーマの再発を併発した症例である。硬化性粘液水腫は稀に悪性腫瘍と関連するが、セミノーマとの関連は報告がなかった。セミノーマに対する化学療法後、皮膚病変は完全に消退し、腫瘍随伴症候群の可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: The authors report a 43-year-old man with scleromyxedema and relapsed seminoma. Although scleromyxedema has occasionally been associated with neoplasms, the literature had shown no link with seminoma. Notably, the skin lesions cleared completely once the seminoma was treated with chemotherapy, suggesting a possible paraneoplastic association that warrants consideration in patients with unexplained scleromyxedema.

title: Brachyury is expressed by human teratocarcinoma cells in the absence of mesodermal differentiation.
title_ja: 中胚葉分化を伴わないヒト奇形癌細胞におけるBrachyuryの発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA2などを用いてBrachyuryの発現を検討した。レチノイン酸による神経系への分化誘導後もmRNAとタンパク質は持続し、中胚葉由来の分化は認められなかった。卵黄嚢癌および絨毛癌の細胞株でも発現がみられた。ヒト奇形癌におけるBrachyury発現は中胚葉分化の指標とは限らないと結論された。
summary_en: The authors examined Brachyury expression in human embryonal carcinoma (teratocarcinoma) cell lines, including NTERA2, along with yolk sac carcinoma and choriocarcinoma lines. Brachyury mRNA and protein persisted in NTERA2 during retinoic acid-induced neural differentiation, with no mesodermal derivatives formed. Expression was also detected in non-differentiating embryonal carcinoma lines and in the other germ cell-derived lines, indicating that Brachyury expression in human teratocarcinoma does not necessarily signal mesodermal commitment.

title: Disseminated metastasis of neuroblastomatous component in immature mediastinal teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 未熟縦隔奇形腫における神経芽腫様成分の播種性転移：症例報告
summary_ja: 血清AFPとhCGが高値の17歳男性で、原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。シスプラチン併用化学療法で腫瘍マーカーは低下したが腫瘍は増大し、切除標本は未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫の混在であった。術後6か月で神経芽腫様細胞の播種により死亡した。血清NSEは転移の検出に有用な可能性がある。
summary_en: A 17-year-old man with elevated AFP and hCG was diagnosed with a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy lowered the tumor markers, but the mass continued to grow, and resection showed a mixture of immature and mature teratoma. Six months after surgery he died of disseminated neuroblastomatous cells resembling the immature neural component. The authors describe this as a rare complication and suggest that serum NSE may help detect such metastasis.

title: [Choriocarcinoma of the renal pelvis: a case report].
title_ja: 腎盂の絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 肉眼的血尿を主訴とした68歳男性で、絨毛癌成分を伴う腎盂・膀胱の移行上皮癌と診断された。術後のβ-hCG上昇にMVC化学療法を行ったが肺転移が出現したため、PEBによる救援化学療法を施行した。β-hCGは正常化し転移は消失した。β-hCGのモニタリングが治療評価に有用であった。
summary_en: A 68-year-old man with gross hematuria was diagnosed with high-grade urothelial carcinoma of the renal pelvis and bladder containing a choriocarcinomatous component. Postoperative serum β-hCG rose, and MVC chemotherapy was given. After lung metastases appeared, salvage PEB chemotherapy normalized β-hCG and eliminated the metastases. The case shows that β-hCG can guide management of urothelial tumors with choriocarcinomatous differentiation.

title: [Primary mediastinal germ cell tumor: report of a case].
title_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 47歳男性の前縦隔の13 cm大の腫瘍で、AFPおよびβ-hCGの上昇と針生検から混合型の原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。BEP療法3コース後に外科的切除を行い、病理学的には成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。9か月間再発は認められていない。
summary_en: A 47-year-old man had a 13 cm anterior mediastinal mass with elevated AFP and β-hCG. Needle biopsy led to a diagnosis of primary mediastinal germ cell tumor with mixed seminomatous and non-seminomatous elements. After three cycles of BEP chemotherapy, surgical resection including left upper lobectomy and partial pericardiectomy was performed. Pathology of the resected mass revealed a mature cystic teratoma. No recurrence was observed during nine months of follow-up.

title: Caffeine enhanced radiosensitivity of rat tumor cells with a mutant-type p53 by inducing apoptosis in a p53-independent manner.
title_ja: カフェインによるp53変異型ラット腫瘍細胞の放射線感受性増強：p53非依存的アポトーシス誘導
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、p53の状態が異なる2種のラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株を用い、カフェインによる放射線増感効果を検討した。2 mMのカフェインは両株で放射線誘導性G2期停止を減少させた。変異型p53株では高線量域まで増感が認められ、p53非依存的経路によるアポトーシスが誘導された。
summary_en: This study examined whether caffeine radiosensitizes two rat yolk sac tumor cell lines differing in p53 status. Caffeine at 2 mM reduced radiation-induced G2 arrest in both lines. Survival reduction with the combination occurred at lower doses in the wild-type p53 line, while in the mutant-p53 line radiosensitization extended to higher doses. Irradiation combined with caffeine induced apoptosis in mutant-p53 cells through a p53-independent pathway, suggesting potential for radiotherapy enhancement regardless of p53 status.

title: Testicular cancer at Kenyatta National Hospital, Nairobi.
title_ja: ケニヤッタ国立病院（ナイロビ）における精巣がん
summary_ja: ナイロビのケニヤッタ国立病院における1983～1997年の精巣がん患者を後方視的に検討した。セミノーマが最多で、奇形腫、胎児性癌が続いた。精巣摘除と放射線療法・化学療法が行われたが、シスプラチン系レジメンは使用されず、5年生存率は38.89%にとどまった。シスプラチン系化学療法の導入が推奨されている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 39 histologically confirmed testicular cancer patients at Kenyatta National Hospital, Nairobi (1983-1997) assessed presentation, histology, treatment and outcome. Seminoma was most common, followed by teratoma and embryonal carcinoma. Many patients received orchidectomy combined with radiotherapy or chemotherapy, but no cisplatin-based regimen was used. Five-year survival was only 38.89%, and the authors recommend including cisplatin-based chemotherapy to improve outcomes.

title: Choriocarcinoma arising in a squamous cell carcinoma of the esophagus.
title_ja: 食道扁平上皮癌内に発生した絨毛癌
summary_ja: 食道扁平上皮癌の53歳男性がシスプラチンと5-FUによる治療を受けたが、女性化乳房と全身状態の悪化が出現した。ホルモン産生性の絨毛癌が食道扁平上皮癌内に発生していたと診断された。救援化学療法で腫瘍マーカーは変化したが腫瘍は縮小しなかった。扁平上皮癌内発生例は化学療法抵抗性となり得ると結論づけている。
summary_en: A 53-year-old man with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma received cisplatin plus 5-fluorouracil, then developed gynecomastia and clinical deterioration. Diagnosis revealed a hormone-secreting choriocarcinoma arising within the esophageal squamous tumor, an extragonadal germ cell tumor. Salvage chemotherapy altered tumor markers but not the tumor itself. The authors conclude that extragonadal choriocarcinoma is chemosensitive, but when arising within esophageal squamous cell carcinoma it may be chemoresistant and fatal.

title: Genetic analysis of childhood endodermal sinus tumors by comparative genomic hybridization.
title_ja: 小児卵黄嚢腫瘍の比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法による遺伝学的解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 凍結保存された小児卵黄嚢腫瘍16例（精巣10例、性腺外6例）を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で解析した。20q、1q、11q、22の増加と6q、16q、1pの欠失が多くみられた。8q24の局所的増加とc-mycの増幅を2例で認めた。成人例と異なる遺伝学的特徴が示唆された。
summary_en: Sixteen frozen childhood endodermal sinus tumors (10 testicular, 6 extragonadal) were analyzed by comparative genomic hybridization to define genetic changes. Common alterations included gains of 20q, 1q, 11q and 22, and losses of 6q (common deleted region 6q24-qter), 16q and 1p. Localized gain at 8q24 with c-myc amplification was found in two tumors. A 12p gain, typical of adolescent germ cell tumors, appeared in one testicular tumor. The results distinguish childhood from adult tumors and highlight chromosome 6 loss for future study.

title: In utero repair of rectal atresia after complete resection of a sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の完全切除と直腸閉鎖の子宮内修復
summary_ja: 胎児期に診断された仙尾部奇形腫が、高拍出性心不全・胎児水腫・直腸閉鎖・尿路閉塞を引き起こした症例を報告する。妊娠27週に子宮切開下で腫瘍を完全切除し、尿路変更と同時に引き抜き式肛門直腸形成術を施行した。出生後に心合併症で死亡したものの、同時施行を伴う胎児期完全切除の初例と結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with a prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma that caused high-output cardiac failure, hydrops, rectal atresia, and urinary obstruction. At 27 weeks' gestation, the tumor was completely resected in utero via hysterotomy, with bilateral ureterostomies for urinary diversion and concurrent pull-through anorectoplasty. The neonate died of a cardiac complication after delivery. The authors report this as the first complete prenatal resection of a sacrococcygeal teratoma with simultaneous anorectoplasty.

title: Molecular genetic analysis of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子遺伝学的解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(OGCT)の染色体ヘテロ接合性の消失(LOH)を、精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)と比較して解析した。32例の35検体について腫瘍と構成DNAの対を用い、62個のマイクロサテライトマーカーで8つの染色体領域を検討した。全組織型で3q27-q28、5q31、5q34-q35、9p22-p21、12q22に共通の欠失を認めた。両腫瘍に共通の腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined loss of heterozygosity (LOH) in malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (OGCTs) and compared the findings with testicular germ cell tumors. Paired tumor and constitutional DNA from 35 specimens in 32 patients were microdissected and analyzed with 62 microsatellite markers across eight chromosomal regions. Common deletions were found at 3q27-q28, 5q31, 5q34-q35, 9p22-p21, and 12q22 in all histologic subtypes. These regions overlap those implicated in early testicular tumor development, suggesting shared tumor suppressor genes.

title: Prognosis of primary testicular seminoma: a report on 57 new cases.
title_ja: 原発性精巣セミノーマの予後に関する57例の報告
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ57例の後方視的研究で、体積加重平均核体積(MNV)の予後予測能を検討した。全例が精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を受けた。MNVは病期II群で病期I群より大きく、多変量解析でリンパ節転移を予測する唯一の変数であった。病期I例ではMNVのみが無増悪生存期間と相関した。MNVは監視療法の対象から除外すべき患者の選別に有用と考えられる。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 57 patients with testicular seminoma evaluated whether volume-weighted mean nuclear volume (MNV) predicts prognosis. All patients underwent orchiectomy followed by radiation therapy. MNV was larger in stage 2 than stage 1 disease, and on multivariate analysis it was the only variable predicting lymph node metastasis. In stage 1 patients, MNV alone correlated with progression-free survival. The authors suggest MNV may help identify patients who can be excluded from surveillance protocols.

title: Intraosseus teratoma of the iliac bone.
title_ja: 腸骨の骨内奇形腫
summary_ja: 4歳児の腸骨に偶発的に発見された大きな骨腫瘤を報告する。病理学的には良性の成熟奇形腫であった。骨内成熟奇形腫の報告はこれまでにないとされる。本児は出生前に発見された頸部未熟奇形腫を生後6日目に切除しており、同部位の再発を2度認め、再発のたびに成熟度が高まった。腸骨病変の発見時、頸部に残存病変はなかった。
summary_en: This report describes a 4-year-old child with an incidentally discovered iliac bone mass, pathologically a benign mature teratoma. The authors believe intraosseous mature teratoma has not been previously reported. The child had earlier been treated for an immature teratoma of the neck, detected prenatally and resected on day 6 of life. That neck tumor recurred twice, each time appearing more mature. No residual neck disease was present when the iliac lesion was found. Radiologic and pathologic features, differential diagnosis, and clinical course are discussed.

title: [Treatment and prognosis of testicular seminoma].
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの治療と予後
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の約半数を占める精巣セミノーマの治療と予後を概説した総説である。大半は早期病期で発見され、治癒する。病期Iでは精巣摘除術後に監視療法か後腹膜放射線療法を選択できる。病期IIAは後腹膜放射線療法が一般的で、カルボプラチンによる化学療法も代替となる。大きな後腹膜リンパ節腫大や遠隔転移（病期IIB、III）にはシスプラチンとエトポシドによる化学療法が標準とされる。
summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes the treatment and prognosis of testicular seminoma, which accounts for about half of testicular germ cell tumors. Most patients present with early-stage disease and are cured. Stage I patients may choose surveillance or adjuvant retroperitoneal radiotherapy after orchiectomy. Stage IIA is usually treated with retroperitoneal radiation, with carboplatin as an alternative. Bulky nodal or distant disease (stage IIB, III) is treated with cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy, and about 85-90% of stage III patients are cured.

title: [Management of non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testes].
title_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の管理
summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)の治療選択肢を概説した総説である。日本では病期Iに対する監視療法が最も広く受け入れられている。ただし再発率は約30%と高く、リスクに応じた治療プロトコルの確立が必要とされる。病期II初期では、初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清と初回化学療法の治癒率は同等だが、射精障害や薬剤による不妊など毒性が異なる。予後良好例には、BEP療法3コースまたはエトポシド・シスプラチン併用療法4コースが標準とされる。
summary_en: This Japanese review covers treatment options for testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCT). Surveillance is the most accepted option for stage I disease in Japan, but the relapse rate of about 30% supports risk-adapted protocols. For early stage II, primary RPLND and primary chemotherapy achieve equivalent cure rates but differ in toxicity, including ejaculatory disorders and drug-induced infertility. For good-prognosis disease, three cycles of BEP and four cycles of etoposide plus cisplatin are standard. Since cisplatin-based chemotherapy, testicular cancer has become a model of curable cancer.

title: [Treatment for ovarian germ-cell tumors and the prognosis].
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療と予後
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療における過去20年間の主な進歩を概説した総説である。生存率は大きく改善し、多くの若年患者で妊孕性が温存されるようになった。また、本領域で未解決の主要な課題についても述べている。抄録は簡潔で、具体的なレジメンや予後データは示されていない。
summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes major advances in therapy for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors over the past two decades. Survival has improved greatly, and reproductive potential is preserved in most young patients. The authors also outline major unresolved issues in the field. The abstract is brief, and specific regimens and outcome figures are not given in it.

title: [Extratesticular germ cell tumor focusing on treatment and prognosis].
title_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍の治療と予後
summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍は全胚細胞腫瘍の約3〜5%を占める。原発性か転移性かの診断は困難で、超音波検査が補助となる。治療は進行精巣腫瘍に準じ、シスプラチン併用化学療法と手術が中心で、セミノーマには放射線療法が有効である。IGCCCG分類による予後評価も有用とされる。
summary_en: This Japanese review addresses primary extratesticular germ cell tumors, which constitute about 3-5% of germ cell tumors. It discusses the diagnostic difficulty of distinguishing primary from metastatic disease and the role of ultrasonography. Treatment generally follows approaches for advanced testicular tumors, usually cisplatin-based chemotherapy combined with surgery, while radiotherapy is effective for seminoma. The authors describe the IGCCCG prognostic classification, in which retroperitoneal primaries and poor markers define prognosis, and suggest that stem cell transplantation may improve outcomes in refractory disease.

title: [Salvage chemotherapy in refractory testicular cancer].
title_ja: 難治性精巣がんに対する救援化学療法
summary_ja: 本総説は、初回治療に失敗した難治性精巣がんに対する救援治療を検討している。標準的な初回のBEP療法と救援手術により、転移性疾患の患者の約80%が完全寛解に至る。寛解に至らない、またはフォローアップ中に再発した患者が救援化学療法の対象となるが、VIPや大量化学療法と幹細胞移植の効果は限られる。日本ではイリノテカンが用いられ、米国と欧州ではパクリタキセルとゲムシタビンが検討されている。著者らは、より有効な新規レジメンの開発が必要と述べている。
summary_en: This review examines salvage treatment for refractory testicular cancer that fails initial therapy. Standard first-line BEP chemotherapy with salvage surgery achieves complete remission in about 80% of patients with metastatic disease. Those who do not reach remission or relapse during follow-up are candidates for salvage chemotherapy, including VIP or high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation, but benefit is limited. In Japan, irinotecan is used after these failures, while paclitaxel and gemcitabine are under investigation in the United States and Europe. The authors call for more effective novel regimens.

title: Bilateral germ cell cancer of the testis: a report of 11 patients with a long-term follow-up.
title_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍:長期フォローアップを行った11例の報告
summary_ja: 552例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍のうち11例(2%)が両側発生し、7例は異時性、4例は同時性であった。停留精巣や不妊などが関連しており、同時性例の多くは進行期で発見された。性機能は保たれ、中央値11.6年の追跡で全例が無病生存した。第2の胚細胞腫瘍が必ずしも予後不良を意味しないことが示された。
summary_en: This single-institution series of 552 testicular germ cell tumor patients identified 11 (2%) with bilateral disease. Seven developed metachronous tumors at a median of 87 months, and four had synchronous disease. Cryptorchidism, infertility or atrophic testis was associated with bilateral disease in most cases. Many synchronous tumors were advanced, while metachronous ones were early-stage. Platinum-based chemotherapy was used in five patients, sexual function was preserved, and no significant morbidity was noted. With a median follow-up of 11.6 years, all patients survived without evidence of cancer, suggesting that a second germ cell cancer does not necessarily imply poor prognosis.

title: Intraplacental choriocarcinoma with fetomaternal transfusion.
title_ja: 胎児母体間輸血を伴う胎盤内絨毛癌
summary_ja: 重度貧血で出生した新生児の満期胎盤から、羊膜面の2cm結節として胎盤内絨毛癌が見つかった症例報告である。免疫染色でhCGサブユニット、hPL、Ki-67が陽性であった。母児のCT・MRIで転移はなかった。胎盤に限局する絨毛癌はまれで見逃されやすいと指摘している。
summary_en: This case report describes intraplacental choriocarcinoma found in a term placenta from a newborn with severe anemia (Hb 3.0 g/dL). A 2 cm surface nodule resembled infarction. Immunohistochemistry was positive for alpha- and beta-hCG subunits, human placental lactogen and Ki-67, with necrosis and atypical trophoblastic proliferation destroying villi. CT and MRI of the mother and infant showed no metastases. The authors note that placenta-limited choriocarcinoma is very rare and often overlooked, and that it may arise in the placenta more often than in persistent trophoblast after pregnancy.

title: Primary seminoma of the retroperitoneum.
title_ja: 後腹膜原発セミノーマ
summary_ja: 無尿で受診した男性にみられた、まれな後腹膜原発セミノーマの症例報告である。超音波検査で大きな低エコー性腫瘤が描出され、CTでは正中部の均一で分葉状の腫瘤として確認された。精巣を原発としない後腹膜のセミノーマが存在することを示す症例である。画像所見の特徴を記した。
summary_en: This report describes a rare primary seminoma of the retroperitoneum in a man who presented with anuria. Ultrasonography revealed a large hypoechoic mass, and correlative computed tomography showed a midline, homogeneous, lobulated mass. The case highlights that seminoma can present as a primary retroperitoneal mass, so such lesions should be considered in the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal tumors. The report illustrates the imaging features of this uncommon entity.

title: Abnormal testis at US in patients after orchiectomy for testicular neoplasm.
title_ja: 精巣摘除術後患者の精巣超音波検査における異常所見
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の171例に行った235回の超音波検査を検討した研究である。28例に異常があり、腫瘤15例、不均一な変化11例、石灰化2例だった。精巣内腫瘤の67%、不均一な変化の27%でがんが確認された。精巣内腫瘤は常に懸念すべきで、全例で厳重なフォローアップが推奨される。
summary_en: This study categorizes ultrasonographic intratesticular abnormalities in 171 men after orchiectomy for testicular neoplasm, with 235 examinations. Abnormalities were found in 28 patients: masses in 15, heterogeneous changes in 11 and macrocalcification in 2. Cancer was present in 67% of patients with masses and 27% with heterogeneous changes. Patients without surgical correlation were disease-free on clinical follow-up. The authors conclude that intratesticular masses are always concerning and that rigorous follow-up is recommended in all patients to rule out malignancy.

title: Retroperitoneal metastases in testicular cancer: role of CT measurements of residual masses in decision making for resection after chemotherapy.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおける後腹膜転移:化学療法後の切除判断におけるCT計測の役割
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がん641例で、化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘤のCT計測と組織所見の関連を検討した。化学療法後の腫瘤径は残存腫瘍の有無と関連し、縮小率と臨床因子を加えるとモデルの精度が向上した(AUC 0.74から0.83)。切除の判断は腫瘤径だけでなく、複合的な所見に基づくべきである。
summary_en: In 641 men with nonseminomatous testicular cancer who underwent resection after chemotherapy with normal tumor markers, the authors assessed whether CT measurements predict the histology of residual retroperitoneal masses. Residual masses were benign in 302 patients and contained tumor (mature teratoma or cancer) in 339. Post-chemotherapy mass size predicted residual tumor, while pre-chemotherapy size did not. Adding the reduction in size and clinical characteristics improved the model, with the area under the ROC curve rising from 0.74 to 0.83. The authors conclude that resection decisions should rely on these combined characteristics rather than size alone.

title: Risk of systemic metastases in clinical stage I nonseminoma germ cell testis tumor managed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清により管理された臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における全身転移のリスク
summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の292例を対象とした。精巣摘除術標本における胎児性癌の優位性と血管侵襲が、全身再発の予測因子であった。病理病期Iの患者の再発率は10.2%であった。病理病期IIでは、補助化学療法を受けた患者に再発はなく、受けなかった患者では22.6%に再発がみられた。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 292 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor treated with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) found that embryonal carcinoma predominance and vascular invasion in the orchiectomy specimen predicted systemic relapse. Among pathological stage I patients, relapse occurred in 10.2 percent. Among pathological stage II patients, none given adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed, while 22.6 percent of untreated patients did.

title: Risk adapted management with adjuvant chemotherapy in patients with high risk clinical stage i nonseminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 高リスク臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する補助化学療法によるリスク適応治療
summary_ja: 本報告は、高リスクの臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者に対し、手術や経過観察ではなく、初期の化学療法2サイクルを行うことを提案するものである。リスク適応型補助化学療法を受けた59例のうち、20例はシスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンで、39例はブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンで治療された。長期成績は良好で、罹病性は限定的であった。補助化学療法は、フォローアップが不十分な場合に特に有用である可能性が示唆されている。
summary_en: This report proposes that patients with high-risk clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors receive two initial cycles of chemotherapy instead of surgery or observation. In 59 patients treated with risk-adapted adjuvant chemotherapy, first with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin in 20 patients, and later with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin in 39 patients, long-term outcomes were excellent with limited morbidity. Adjuvant chemotherapy may be especially valuable when follow-up is compromised.

title: Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for the management of clinical stage I nonseminoma.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の根拠を、既存の代替治療と著者の経験から概説した総説である。郭清単独で病理学的病期IIの50〜75%が根治し、小腸閉塞のリスクは約1%とされる。術後再発もシスプラチン併用化学療法でほぼ治癒可能であり、標準治療として位置づけられている。
summary_en: This review examines the rationale for retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer, combining published alternatives with the authors' experience. RPLND alone cures 50 to 75 percent of patients with pathological stage II disease, with about a 1 percent risk of small bowel obstruction. Relapses after RPLND are almost always curable with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The authors conclude RPLND remains standard therapy and retains both treatment and staging roles.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular carcinoma: long-term outcome.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清：長期成績
summary_ja: 本単施設報告は、1992年から1999年に臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんの73例に対し、修正片側テンプレート郭清を用いて腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った結果を示す。開腹移行率は2.7%、軽度合併症は6.8%で、全例で射精機能が温存された。後腹膜再発は偽陰性の組織所見に起因する1例のみで、3年以上のフォローアップで手術の失敗による再発はなかった。
summary_en: This single-center report describes 73 patients who underwent laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with modified unilateral template dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer between 1992 and 1999. The conversion rate was 2.7 percent, minor complications 6.8 percent, and ejaculation was preserved in all patients. Only one retroperitoneal relapse occurred, attributed to false-negative histology, and no surgical-failure recurrences were seen over more than 3 years of follow-up.

title: Dermoid cyst in the adrenal gland.
title_ja: 副腎に生じた類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 副腎に発生した類皮嚢腫の初の単側性症例報告。胚発生と画像所見を検討している。類皮嚢腫は成熟囊胞性奇形腫であり、性腺外に生じた胚細胞腫瘍として本サイトの対象となる。抄録には治療や経過の詳細は乏しいが、稀な性腺外発生例として位置づけられる貴重な報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a dermoid cyst arising in the adrenal gland, the first unilateral adrenal case reported. The authors discuss its embryonal development and imaging features. Dermoid cysts are mature cystic teratomas, which are germ cell tumors, and this is an extragonadal site. The abstract gives limited clinical detail on treatment or follow-up, but the case is directly relevant to germ cell tumor literature as an unusual extragonadal presentation.

title: Germ-cell tumors in childhood and adolescence. GPOH MAKEI and the MAHO study groups.
title_ja: 小児および思春期の胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 小児・思春期の胚細胞腫瘍の治療を総説。成熟・未熟奇形腫は外科的切除が中心で、原発部位・未熟度・切除の完全性から再発リスクを推定できる。シスプラチン併用療法で約80%が長期寛解となり、原発腫瘍の完全切除が腫瘍マーカー値や原発部位より強力な予後因子とされる。
summary_en: This GPOH MAKEI and MAHO review summarizes management of childhood and adolescent germ cell tumors. Mature and immature teratomas are treated surgically, with recurrence risk depending on primary site, histological immaturity grade, and completeness of resection. Malignant GCTs make up 2.9% of pediatric malignancies, and over half arise at extragonadal sites. Cisplatin-based protocols achieve about 80% long-term remission. Complete primary resection is the strongest prognostic factor, outweighing tumor marker levels and primary site.

title: Thromboembolic events during chemotherapy for germ cell cancer: a cohort study and review of the literature.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法中の血栓塞栓症：コホート研究と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍患者179例を対象にしたコホート研究で、シスプラチン併用化学療法中の重大な血栓塞栓症は8.4%に認められた。肝転移と制吐療法としての高用量デキサメタゾンが危険因子であり、予防的な配慮の必要性が示唆された。
summary_en: This cohort study of 179 male germ cell tumor patients, treated mostly with cisplatin-containing chemotherapy, found major thromboembolic complications in 8.4%, most of them venous, with one fatal event. Liver metastases and high-dose dexamethasone used as antiemetic therapy were independent risk factors. The authors also review the literature on thrombosis during chemotherapy for germ cell cancer. They conclude that patients with liver metastases or high steroid exposure are at considerable risk and may need preventive attention.

title: Retroperitoneal teratoma presenting as acute abdomen in an elderly person.
title_ja: 急性腹症で発症した高齢者の後腹膜奇形腫
summary_ja: 56歳男性が急性腹症で受診し、当初は胃周囲膿瘍と診断された。開腹術で後腹膜嚢胞性奇形腫が見つかり切除された。術後経過は順調で、2年後も残存病変は認められていない。後腹膜奇形腫は炎症性の急性腹症に類似しうるため、高齢者においても鑑別診断に含める必要があることを示す症例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old man who presented with acute abdomen and was initially diagnosed with a perigastric abscess. Exploratory surgery revealed a retroperitoneal cystic teratoma, which was resected. He recovered uneventfully after surgery and had no residual disease two years later. The report highlights that retroperitoneal teratomas can mimic inflammatory abdominal emergencies and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of acute abdomen, even in older adults.

title: The secreted glycoprotein CREG enhances differentiation of NTERA-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: 分泌型糖タンパク質CREGはNTERA-2胎児性癌細胞の分化を促進する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は分泌型糖タンパク質CREGが、ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2の分化に与える影響を検討したものである。CREGはNTERA-2では発現が低いが、分化の過程で誘導された。CREGを恒常的に発現させるとレチノイン酸による神経分化が促進され、CREG含有培地は誘導剤なしでも分化を促した。奇形癌などの多能性腫瘍細胞の分化に関わるシグナル伝達への関与が示唆された。
summary_en: This basic research study examines CREG, a secreted glycoprotein, in NTERA-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells. CREG mRNA is largely absent in NTERA-2 cells but is induced during differentiation. Constitutive CREG expression enhances retinoic acid-induced neuronal differentiation, and CREG-enriched media promote differentiation even without an inducer. The authors suggest CREG participates in signaling that drives differentiation of pluripotent tumor cells such as those in teratocarcinomas.

title: MR findings of ovarian tumours with cystic components.
title_ja: 嚢胞成分を有する卵巣腫瘍の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見
summary_ja: 本稿は、嚢胞成分を有する卵巣腫瘍の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見をまとめたものである。充実成分や乳頭状結節がある場合、MRIで嚢胞内容物を推定し悪性の可能性を評価できる。脂肪抑制画像は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と他の病変の鑑別に有用である。造影後T1強調像は造影される充実部の同定に役立つ。
summary_en: This article describes MRI findings of ovarian tumors containing cystic components. MRI can predict cyst contents and assess malignant potential when solid or papillary nodules are present. Post-contrast T1-weighted imaging helps identify enhancing solid areas, while fat-suppression imaging is useful to differentiate mature cystic teratoma from other pathologies. Fat-suppressed post-contrast imaging may also reveal enhancement reflecting inflammatory or neoplastic pelvic processes, aiding diagnostic decision-making.

title: Transvaginal color Doppler ultrasonic characterization of benign and malignant ovarian cystic teratomas and comparison with serum squamous cell carcinoma antigen.
title_ja: 良性および悪性の卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の経膣カラードプラ超音波による特徴づけと血清扁平上皮癌抗原との比較
summary_ja: 本研究は、88例の卵巣腫瘍において経膣カラードプラ超音波検査(TV-CDU)が、扁平上皮癌(SCC)と良性嚢胞性奇形腫を鑑別できるかを検討した。低い抵抗・拍動指数（RI<0.4、PI<0.6）を示す腫瘍内血流は悪性病変を同定し、その診断精度は95.2%で、血清SCC抗原（76%）を上回った。著者らは、ドプラ血流評価は血清SCC測定よりも、卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化の検出に有用である可能性があると結論している。
summary_en: This study evaluated transvaginal color Doppler ultrasound in distinguishing malignant squamous cell carcinoma from benign cystic teratomas of the ovary in 88 patients. Intratumoral blood flow with low resistance and pulsatility indices (RI <0.4, PI <0.6) identified malignant lesions with 95.2% diagnostic accuracy, outperforming serum SCC antigen (76%). The authors conclude that Doppler flow assessment may be more useful than serum SCC measurement for detecting malignant transformation in ovarian cystic teratomas.

title: Father-son testicular tumors: evidence for genetic anticipation? A case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 父子の精巣腫瘍:遺伝的アンティシペーションの証拠か?症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 父と息子の両者がセミノーマを発症した症例を報告し、発症年齢に27年の差があった。1972〜1999年の47組の文献レビューでは、息子の平均発症年齢は父親より約16年若く、43%で息子の病態がより重症であった。遺伝的アンティシペーションが精巣腫瘍の発症に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This case report describes a father and son who both developed pure seminoma, with a 27-year difference in age of onset. A literature review of 47 father-son testicular tumor pairs (1972 to 1999) found that sons were diagnosed about 16 years earlier than fathers on average, and disease was more severe in sons in 43% of pairs. Pure seminoma and nonseminomatous tumors both showed earlier onset in sons, suggesting a possible inherited component in testicular carcinogenesis.

title: Management of testicular seminoma. Our experience.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの治療経験
summary_ja: ナポリの単施設でセミノーマ12例を含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍19例の治療経験を報告する。早期病期では手術と予防的放射線療法で予後が良好で、進行例では手術・放射線療法・化学療法の併用が有効であった。I・IIA期では精巣摘除術後の予防的放射線療法を推奨し、I・II期の5年生存率は約98%とされる。
summary_en: This report describes management experience with 12 seminoma cases among 19 patients with testicular germ cell tumours at a single Naples center. Early-stage patients treated with surgery and adjuvant prophylactic radiotherapy had better prognosis, while advanced-stage patients benefited from surgery combined with radiotherapy and chemotherapy. The authors favor total orchiectomy followed by prophylactic radiotherapy for stages I and IIA and do not routinely perform retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. They report five-year survival of about 98% for stages I and II.

title: Fusion of the nucleoporin gene, NUP98, and the putative RNA helicase gene, DDX10, by inversion 11 (p15q22) chromosome translocation in a patient with etoposide-related myelodysplastic syndrome.
title_ja: エトポシド関連骨髄異形成症候群においてNUP98とDDX10の融合が認められた症例
summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍に対するエトポシド含有化学療法後に治療関連骨髄異形成症候群を発症した50歳男性の症例報告である。染色体検査でinv(11)(p15q22)が、RT-PCRでNUP98-DDX10融合転写産物が確認された。この融合遺伝子がトポイソメラーゼII阻害薬による二次性血液腫瘍の発症を促す可能性が考察されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old man who developed therapy-related myelodysplastic syndrome after etoposide-containing chemotherapy for extratesticular germ cell tumor. Chromosomal analysis revealed an inv(11)(p15q22) translocation, and RT-PCR detected a NUP98-DDX10 fusion transcript. The authors propose that this fusion may promote secondary hematologic malignancy caused by topoisomerase II inhibitors through aberrant nucleocytoplasmic transport or altered ribosome assembly. The paper links germ cell tumor treatment to a secondary leukemogenic mechanism.

title: Comparative tolerability of chemotherapy regimens for germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法レジメンの忍容性の比較
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法レジメンの忍容性を比較した総説である。シスプラチンとエトポシドを用いるEP・BEP療法が標準で、予後良好群では複数のレジメンが推奨され、予後不良群の治癒率は約50%にとどまる。長期的な性腺毒性や二次性悪性腫瘍は少ないとされる。
summary_en: This review compares the tolerability of chemotherapy regimens for germ cell cancer, focusing on EP and BEP regimens. It notes that over 80% of patients are cured, that serum tumour markers and visceral metastases guide advanced-stage treatment, and that randomized trials support EP four cycles, BEP four cycles with etoposide 350 mg/m2, or BEP three cycles with etoposide 500 mg/m2 for good-risk disease. Poor-risk cure rates are about 50%. The authors conclude that long-term gonadal toxicity and secondary malignancies appear negligible.

title: Expression of epidermal growth factor receptor-related family products in gestational trophoblastic diseases and normal placenta and its relationship with development of postmolar tumor.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患および正常胎盤におけるEGFR関連癌遺伝子ファミリー産物の発現と、胞状奇胎後腫瘍の発生との関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と妊娠性絨毛癌の組織を用い、EGFR関連癌遺伝子の発現を免疫組織化学とin situハイブリダイゼーションで比較した研究です。完全胞状奇胎では絨毛外栄養膜細胞のEGFRとc-erbB-3の強い染色が、持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発生と相関していました。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical and in situ hybridization study compared EGFR, c-erbB-3, and c-erbB-4 expression across partial and complete hydatidiform moles, gestational choriocarcinoma, normal first-trimester placenta, and therapeutic abortion tissue. EGFR was strongly expressed in all choriocarcinomas and in complete mole trophoblasts, exceeding levels in normal placenta and partial mole. Strong EGFR and c-erbB-3 staining in extravillous trophoblasts of complete mole correlated with development of persistent postmolar gestational trophoblastic tumor, suggesting these oncogenes may contribute to pathogenesis and postmolar progression.

title: Clinical significance of combined use of macrophage colony-stimulating factor and squamous cell carcinoma antigen as a selective diagnostic marker for squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌の選択的診断マーカーとしてのマクロファージコロニー刺激因子と扁平上皮癌抗原併用の臨床的意義
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌を術前に鑑別するため、血清M-CSFとSCCの併用を検討した研究です。M-CSFとSCCのいずれかが陽性となる割合は悪性例で87.1%と高く、M-CSFは有用な腫瘍マーカーとされました。
summary_en: This study evaluated whether serum macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) combined with squamous cell carcinoma antigen (SCC) can preoperatively distinguish squamous cell carcinoma arising in ovarian mature cystic teratoma from benign mature cystic teratoma. Serum samples from 31 malignant and 133 benign cases were assayed. Elevated M-CSF was found in 71.0% of malignant cases versus 13.5% of benign cases, and SCC positivity in 41.9% versus 15.0%. Combined positivity for either marker reached 87.1%, and 83.3% in stage I tumors, supporting M-CSF as a useful marker.

title: Production of interleukin (IL)-6 and IL-8 by a choriocarcinoma cell line, BeWo.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoによるIL-6およびIL-8の産生
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを用い、IL-6とIL-8の産生をin vitroで解析した研究です。炎症性サイトカインやTPAで産生が増加し、これらが絨毛癌の増殖や血管新生を調節するサイトカインネットワークの一部と考察されました。
summary_en: This study examined in vitro cytokine production by the choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo to clarify biological features of choriocarcinoma. Basal IL-6 and IL-8 expression was low, but both were dose-dependently induced by IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and TPA, while TGF-beta1 affected only IL-6. IL-6 secretion was inhibited by dexamethasone and by protein kinase C pathway inhibitors. The authors suggest these cytokines form a network modulating choriocarcinoma proliferation and angiogenesis, alongside steroid hormone production.

title: Diagnostic value of hair shafts and squamous cells in peritoneal washing cytology.
title_ja: 腹腔洗浄細胞診における毛髪および扁平上皮細胞の診断的意義
summary_ja: 腹腔洗浄細胞診で、炎症細胞に囲まれた扁平上皮細胞と毛髪が卵巣奇形腫の診断手がかりになることを示した研究です。これらの所見は、腫瘍破綻が臨床的・組織学的に確認できない場合でも見られました。
summary_en: This cytology study reviewed peritoneal washing specimens from 86 ovarian tumor cases, including 22 teratomas. Squamous cells and hair shafts surrounded by inflammatory cells were found in 5 of the 22 teratomas and in none of the other tumors or nonneoplastic conditions. Hair shafts measured 10 to 28.8 microns, much thinner than normal adult hair. The authors conclude that these findings are a diagnostic clue to ovarian teratoma, even when tumor rupture is not detected clinically or microscopically.

title: Malignant teratoma of the thyroid with predominantly neuroepithelial differentiation. Fine needle aspiration cytologic, histologic and immunocytochemical features of a case.
title_ja: 神経上皮分化が主体の甲状腺悪性奇形腫：1症例の穿刺吸引細胞診、組織学的および免疫細胞化学的特徴
summary_ja: 甲状腺腫瘤と頸部リンパ節転移を有する32歳女性の悪性奇形腫の症例報告です。穿刺細胞診で神経上皮分化を伴う小円形細胞腫瘍がみられ、切除標本で扁平上皮や立方上皮の島を伴う悪性奇形腫と診断されました。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with a thyroid mass and cervical lymph node metastasis. Fine needle aspiration showed a small round cell tumor with neuroepithelial differentiation, and thyroidectomy revealed predominantly neuroepithelial tissue with islands of squamous and cuboidal epithelium, leading to a diagnosis of malignant teratoma. Thyroid teratoma in adults is extremely rare and mostly malignant, and the authors emphasize that recognizing its cytologic features allows earlier, potentially more aggressive treatment.

title: Benign teratoma in an 85-year-old woman.
title_ja: 85歳女性にみられた良性奇形腫
summary_ja: 85歳の日本人女性の骨盤内腫瘤を報告する症例報告である。経膣超音波検査、MRI、血清腫瘍マーカーにより成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され、術後の病理組織学的検査で確認された。高齢女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫はまれだが良性のまま存在しうることを示し、世界で2番目に高齢の症例とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes an 85-year-old Japanese woman with a pelvic mass diagnosed as a benign mature cystic teratoma. Transvaginal ultrasonography, MRI, and serum tumor markers supported the diagnosis, which was confirmed histologically after surgery. The authors note that mature cystic teratoma in elderly women, though uncommon, can remain benign, and they report the case as the second oldest such case in the world.

title: Old ectopic pregnancy remnants with morphological features of placental site nodule occurring in fallopian tube and broad ligament.
title_ja: 卵管および広間膜に認められた胎盤部結節様形態を示す古い異所性妊娠残存物
summary_ja: 対側卵管の腺癌の手術を受けた患者の卵管と広間膜に、以前の妊娠が退縮しなかった残存物由来の胎盤部結節を認めた症例報告である。形態学的および免疫組織化学的に中間型栄養膜細胞の増殖と確認された。広間膜に認められた胎盤部結節として初の報告であり、異所性妊娠の残存物が胎盤部病変の形態を示しうることを示した。
summary_en: This report describes placental site nodules, benign proliferations of intermediate trophoblast from a failed prior gestation, found in the fallopian tube and broad ligament of a patient undergoing surgery for an unrelated adenocarcinoma of the opposite tube. Morphology and immunohistochemistry were consistent with intermediate trophoblast. The authors describe this as the first reported PSN in the broad ligament in direct contact with the fallopian tube, showing that ectopic gestation remnants can display placental-site features.

title: An intrapulmonary teratoma associated with bronchiectasia containing various kinds of primordium: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 気管支拡張症を伴い多様な原基を含む肺内奇形腫：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 23歳男性に生じた肺内奇形腫の症例報告である。気管支と交通する多房性の気管支拡張様病変で、区域切除により摘出された。三胚葉由来の成分を含み、15種類を超える胚細胞由来成分は報告例中最多である。既報65例の文献的検討も行い、年齢・性別分布や胚細胞成分について考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes an intrapulmonary teratoma in a 23-year-old man, a multiloculated, bronchiectatic benign cystic lesion communicating with a segmental bronchus and removed by segmental resection. The tumor contained derivatives of all three germ layers, including more than 15 germ-derived components, the largest number reported. Thymic tissue was present apart from the mediastinum, which the authors relate to pathogenesis. The authors review 65 previously reported cases and discuss age, sex distribution, and germ cell derivatives.

title: Efficient retrovirus-mediated transfer of the multidrug resistance 1 gene into autologous human long-term repopulating hematopoietic stem cells.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の自家造血幹細胞へのMDR1遺伝子導入
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の自家移植に際し、造血幹細胞・前駆細胞へヒトMDR1遺伝子を導入したパイロット臨床研究である。遺伝子導入は効率的で、有害事象なく速やかな造血回復が得られた。ベクターの発現は認められたが、異常スプライシングにより制限された可能性がある。遺伝子マーキングは1年以上持続した。
summary_en: This pilot clinical study transferred the human multidrug resistance 1 gene into hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells of patients with germ cell tumors undergoing autologous transplantation. Gene transfer was efficient, and the infusion caused no harmful effects and led to prompt hematopoietic recovery. In vivo vector expression occurred but was likely limited by aberrant splicing of the transgene. Gene marking persisted for more than one year at levels higher than previously reported in humans.

title: Functioning liver metastases on an I-131 whole-body scan: a case of malignant struma ovarii.
title_ja: 機能的な肝転移を示した悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の1例
summary_ja: 46歳女性の大きな多嚢胞性骨盤内腫瘤と肝病変の症例報告である。骨盤内腫瘤の切除で濾胞型の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断され、肝生検で同様の組織像の転移性疾患が確認された。全甲状腺摘出後にI-131全身スキャンで複数の機能性肝転移への集積を認め、放射性ヨウ素治療の対象となった。
summary_en: A 46-year-old woman presented with a large multicystic pelvic mass and hepatic lesions on CT. Pelvic resection revealed malignant struma ovarii of the follicular type, and liver biopsy confirmed metastatic disease with similar histology. Thyroid laboratory values were normal, and total thyroidectomy showed only a follicular adenoma. I-131 whole-body scanning demonstrated uptake in multiple functioning liver metastases, which guided radioiodine ablation therapy. The case illustrates radioiodine-avid metastases from malignant struma ovarii.

title: Posterior mediastinal teratomas.
title_ja: 後縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 本報告は、後縦隔に発生した奇形腫の5歳男児例を報告するものである。後縦隔奇形腫は稀な部位の腫瘍である。著者らは文献上の既報18例をレビューし、小児における本疾患の臨床像を概観している。小児の胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告として、診断と臨床経過の理解に資する内容である。
summary_en: This report describes a five-year-old boy with a posterior mediastinal teratoma, a rare location for this tumor. The authors also reviewed eighteen previously published cases from the literature. The article provides a clinical overview of this uncommon presentation in a pediatric patient, placing the case in the context of prior reports. It is a case report with literature review, offering limited but useful information on diagnosis and presentation of mediastinal teratomas in children, which is relevant to the site's focus on pediatric germ cell tumors.

title: Transient increase in mitogen-induced lymphoproliferative responses in patients with testicular cancer after BEP chemotherapy.
title_ja: BEP化学療法後の精巣がん患者における有糸分裂誘発性リンパ球増殖反応の一過性増加
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者15例を対象に、BEP化学療法後の細胞性免疫を評価した研究である。治療後中央値61か月の時点でT細胞数や有糸分裂誘発反応は健常者と同等であった。一方、治療後約1年の群ではコンカナバリンAへの増殖反応が有意に一過性上昇した。BEP療法は細胞性免疫を損なわず、精巣がんの長期寛解の高さに寄与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study assessed cellular immunity in 15 patients with testicular germ cell tumors who had received BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin), evaluated a median of 61 months after treatment. T-cell subsets and lymphoproliferative responses to mitogens were comparable to healthy controls. However, patients assessed about one year after chemotherapy showed a significant transient increase in response to concanavalin A. The authors conclude BEP does not impair cellular immunity and may contribute to the high rate of long-term remission in testicular cancer. The findings suggest a temporary enhancement of T-cell function after therapy.

title: Primary testicular seminoma in a patient with a history of extragonadal non-seminomatous germ cell carcinoma.
title_ja: 性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞がんの既往を有する患者に生じた原発性精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞がんの初診7年後に精巣セミノーマを発症した29歳男性の症例報告である。このような異時性の胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀で、本例は8例目とされる。既報の他7例の平均発症間隔は8年であった。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の既往を持つ患者では、精巣を含めた長期の経過観察が必要であることを強調している。
summary_en: This report describes a 29-year-old man who developed a primary testicular seminoma seven years after presenting with extragonadal non-seminomatous germ cell carcinoma. This metachronous occurrence is exceedingly rare. The authors add this eighth reported case to the literature and note that the other seven patients had extragonadal non-seminomatous tumors followed by testicular seminoma in six and non-seminomatous germ cell carcinoma in one, with a mean interval of eight years. The case emphasizes the need for long-term surveillance, including testicular evaluation, in patients with a history of extragonadal germ cell carcinoma.

title: Nasopharyngeal teratomas and dermoids: a review of the literature and case series.
title_ja: 鼻咽頭奇形腫および類皮腫：文献レビューと症例集積
summary_ja: シアトル地域の2施設における鼻咽頭奇形腫と類皮腫の後方視的検討と、1977年以降の文献レビューを組み合わせた症例集積である。多くは出生時に診断され、呼吸窮迫が主症状であった。奇形腫は類皮腫より再発が多く、先天異常や早産を伴う傾向があった。治療は完全切除が基本で、出生前診断が予後に与える影響は小さかった。
summary_en: This retrospective review examined nasopharyngeal true teratomas and dermoids from two Seattle-area centers, combined with a literature review of cases since 1977. Most lesions were diagnosed at birth, presenting mainly with respiratory distress. Teratomas were more often associated with maternal polyhydramnios, preterm birth, emergent airway management and congenital abnormalities, and had a higher recurrence rate. Complete surgical excision was the treatment of choice. Prenatal diagnosis had little impact on diagnosis or outcome. The authors note inconsistent classification has hindered distinguishing teratomas from dermoids.

title: Significance of simultaneous determination of serum human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and hCG-beta in testicular tumor patients.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者における血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とhCG-βの同時測定の意義
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者54例(セミノーマ)と74例(非セミノーマ)で血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とβ-hCGを同時測定した。セミノーマの検出にはβ-hCGが優れ(陽性率83%)、再発の早期発見には両マーカーの測定が有用であった。hCGの偽陽性はテストステロン投与で鑑別できた。
summary_en: This study compared simultaneous serum hCG and hCG-beta measurements in 54 patients with testicular seminoma and 74 with non-seminomatous testicular tumors. hCG-beta detected seminoma more sensitively (83%) than hCG (50%), while hCG was more often positive in non-seminomatous tumors. Among 14 patients with recurrence, marker patterns varied, so both markers should be monitored. Testosterone administration was effective in identifying falsely elevated hCG.

title: DNA polymorphism analysis of a pure non-gestational choriocarcinoma of the ovary: case report.
title_ja: 卵巣原発の純粋非妊娠性絨毛癌のDNA多型解析：症例報告
summary_ja: 45歳の未経妊女性が、卵巣原発の絨毛癌により癌性腹膜炎で死亡した症例。減量手術後に化学療法抵抗性であった。DNA多型解析により妊娠に由来しない非妊娠性絨毛癌であることを証明した。臨床経過とDNA多型所見を報告する。
summary_en: A 45-year-old nulligravid woman died of carcinomatous peritonitis from a primary ovarian choriocarcinoma that was resistant to chemotherapy after debulking surgery. DNA polymorphism analysis showed that the tumor was non-gestational, meaning it did not originate from a pregnancy. The report details the clinical course and genetic findings, highlighting the value of DNA typing in determining the origin of choriocarcinoma.

title: Immunohistochemical staining properties of PCNA, Ki-67, p53, beta-hCG and HPL in trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 栄養膜疾患におけるPCNA、Ki-67、p53、β-hCGおよびHPLの免疫組織化学的染色特性
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、流産、搔爬組織などの妊娠性絨毛性疾患を対象に、PCNA、Ki-67、p53、β-hCG、HPLの免疫染色を比較した。PCNA指標のみが群間で有意差を示し、栄養膜疾患の有用なマーカーであり予後因子となりうると結論づけた。
summary_en: This study examined PCNA, Ki-67, p53, beta-hCG and HPL immunostaining in gestational trophoblastic disease, comparing 16 hydatidiform moles, 20 spontaneous abortions, and 20 curettage samples, plus two choriocarcinomas. The PCNA labeling index differed significantly among groups, while Ki-67, p53, hCG and HPL showed no significant differences. The authors conclude that PCNA is a useful marker for trophoblastic disease and may serve as a prognostic factor.

title: [A case of testicular tumor in a patient with Down's syndrome: a case report].
title_ja: ダウン症候群を合併した精巣腫瘍の1例：症例報告
summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併した40歳男性が無痛性の右陰嚢腫大で受診した症例。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で右精巣腫瘍と腸骨窩の腫瘤を認め、右高位精巣摘除術と腫瘤摘出を施行した。病理はセミノーマで、腫瘤は外腸骨リンパ節転移であった。術後に放射線療法を実施した。
summary_en: A 40-year-old man with Down's syndrome presented with a painless swollen right scrotum. CT revealed a right testicular tumor and an iliac fossa mass. He underwent right high orchiectomy and mass extirpation. Histology showed seminoma in the testis, and the mass was an external iliac lymph node metastasis of seminoma. Radiation therapy followed surgery. The report highlights the association between Down's syndrome and testicular cancer.

title: [A case of Down's syndrome associated with testicular seminoma].
title_ja: ダウン症候群に合併した精巣セミノーマの1例
summary_ja: ダウン症候群(21番染色体トリソミー)に精巣セミノーマを合併した症例を報告。国内でダウン症候群と精巣腫瘍の合併例は本例で19例目とされる。白血病リスクの上昇も知られており、精巣がんの合併に留意する必要性を示す。
summary_en: This report describes a man with Down's syndrome who was diagnosed with testicular seminoma. The authors note that coexistence of Down's syndrome with testicular tumors has been increasingly recognized, and that this case is the 19th reported in Japan. Down's syndrome, caused by trisomy 21, is also associated with an increased risk of leukemia. The case highlights the need to consider testicular cancer in these patients.

title: Ovarian gonadoblastoma with mixed germ cell tumor in a woman with 46, XX karyotype and successful pregnancies.
title_ja: 46,XX核型の女性に生じた卵巣性腺芽腫と混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例
summary_ja: 46,XX核型で妊娠出産歴のある27歳女性に、片側卵巣の性腺芽腫と混合型胚細胞腫瘍を認めた極めて稀な症例。混合腫瘍は絨毛癌、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマから成る。手術と補助化学療法後10年以上無病経過。
summary_en: A 27-year-old woman with a 46,XX karyotype and two successful pregnancies had a unilateral ovarian gonadoblastoma with a mixed germ cell tumor. The mixed tumor comprised choriocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, immature teratoma and dysgerminoma. She was treated with surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy and remained disease-free for over 10 years. The case is extremely rare.

title: DNA copy number changes in malignant ovarian germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるDNAコピー数変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍25例を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で解析した。ディスジャーミノーマで変化が最も多く、12p・12qの獲得が目立った。卵黄嚢腫瘍も12p獲得を示し、未熟奇形腫は変化が少なく12p獲得がなかった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍と同様の発生経路を持つのはディスジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍で、未熟奇形腫は異なる機序で発生すると結論づけた。
summary_en: Comparative genomic hybridization was used to analyze 25 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, including 12 dysgerminomas, four endodermal sinus tumors, and nine immature teratomas. Dysgerminomas showed the most alterations, with frequent gains on 12p and 12q. Endodermal sinus tumors shared 12p gains, while immature teratomas had fewer changes and lacked 12p gain. The authors conclude that dysgerminomas and endodermal sinus tumors follow pathways similar to testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Morphological pattern of testicular tumors.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の形態学的パターン
summary_ja: パキスタン・カラチの1施設で1991〜98年に診断された精巣腫瘍170例の形態学的研究。胚細胞腫瘍が悪性精巣腫瘍の83.5%を占め、セミノーマが最多であった。小児では卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も多く、高齢者ではリンパ腫が主体であった。頻度は国際文献の報告と一致した。
summary_en: This morphological study reviewed 170 testicular tumors diagnosed over eight years at a tertiary hospital in Karachi, Pakistan. Germ cell tumors accounted for 83.5% of malignant testicular neoplasms. Seminoma was the most common subtype (36.5%), followed by mixed germ cell tumors (28.8%). Yolk sac tumor was the commonest testicular neoplasm in children, while lymphoma predominated in the elderly. Most patients presented in the third and fourth decades with a scrotal mass. The authors concluded that the relative frequency of testicular malignancy matched international reports.

title: Identification of a new missense mutation (Gly95Glu) in a highly conserved codon within the high-mobility group box of the sex-determining region Y gene: report on a 46,XY female with gonadal dysgenesis and yolk-sac tumor.
title_ja: 新規ミスセンス変異(Gly95Glu)をSRY遺伝子のHMGボックス内の高度保存コドンに同定：卵黄嚢腫瘍を合併した46,XY女性の報告
summary_ja: 性腺異形成を伴う46,XY女性で卵黄嚢腫瘍を合併した症例報告。SRY遺伝子のHMGボックス内に新規のde novoミスセンス変異(Gly95Glu)が同定された。この変異は父親と男性兄弟には認められなかった。性分化疾患と胚細胞腫瘍の関連を示す症例であり、SRYのDNA結合活性の機能的重要性を支持する。
summary_en: This case report describes a 46,XY phenotypic female with pure gonadal dysgenesis who presented with primary amenorrhea and was found to have a yolk sac tumor. Sequencing of the SRY gene identified a novel de novo missense mutation (Gly95Glu) within the highly conserved HMG-box. The mutation was absent in her father and brothers. The authors note that this raises the number of reported SRY mutations to 36. They conclude that the findings support the functional importance of the putative DNA-binding activity of the HMG-box domain.

title: Fluorodeoxyglucose PET in the initial staging of germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の初期病期分類におけるフルオロデオキシグルコースPET
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍31例の初期病期分類におけるFDG-PETの後方視的検討。PETは転移10例を検出し、偽陽性はなく、陽性的中率は100%であった。陰性的中率は76〜91%であった。従来の画像診断で見逃される転移を検出できることが示唆された。役割の確立には大規模な前向き研究が必要とされた。
summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated fluorodeoxyglucose PET (FDG-PET) for initial staging of 31 patients with testicular germ cell tumours (13 seminomas, 18 non-seminomatous tumours). FDG-PET detected metastatic disease in 10 patients, with no false positives and five false negatives. The positive predictive value was 100%, and the negative predictive value was 76% to 91%, depending on how six equivocal cases on CT were classified. The authors conclude that FDG-PET detects metastases missed by conventional imaging, and they recommend a larger prospective study to define its role in primary staging.

title: Paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin second-line therapy for patients with relapsed testicular germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 再発精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する二次治療としてのパクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチン併用療法
summary_ja: 再発精巣胚細胞腫瘍30例に対し、パクリタキセル併用のTIP療法を二次治療として評価した第II相試験。化学療法のみで77%が完全奏効し、中央値33か月の追跡で73%の奏効が持続した。主な毒性は骨髄抑制で、グレード3の神経毒性は2例であった。予後因子に基づく患者選択が重要とされた。
summary_en: This dose-escalation and phase II study tested paclitaxel added to ifosfamide and cisplatin (TIP) as second-line salvage therapy for 30 patients with relapsed testicular germ cell tumors, all with favorable prognostic features. Seventy-seven percent achieved complete response to chemotherapy alone, and 80% achieved a favorable response overall. Mature teratoma was found in one resected residual mass. Two patients relapsed, and 73% remained in durable response at a median follow-up of 33 months. Myelosuppression was the main toxicity, with two grade 3 neurotoxic events.

title: Treatment of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors with preservation of fertility: reproductive performance after persistent remission.
title_ja: 妊孕性を温存した悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療：寛解後の生殖能力
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍31例を後方視的に検討し、寛解後の生殖能力を評価しました。21例に妊孕性温存手術が行われ、術後にはほぼ全例で化学療法が実施されました。妊孕性を温存した20例のうち8例が計9人を出産し、多くは規則的な月経を維持していました。妊孕性温存を伴う管理は安全で、多くの患者が卵巣機能を保持できると結論されています。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 31 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors assessed reproductive outcomes after remission. Most patients were diagnosed in adolescence or early adulthood, and 21 underwent fertility-sparing surgery, with postoperative chemotherapy given to nearly all. Of the 31 patients, 4 died of disease. Among 20 fertility-preserved survivors, 8 delivered 9 healthy babies, and most others had regular menses. The authors concluded that fertility-sparing management is safe and most patients retain ovarian function.

title: The relative risk of second nongerminal malignancies in patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者の二次非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍の相対リスク
summary_ja: 635例の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした多施設データベース研究で、二次悪性腫瘍のリスクを評価した。追跡期間中央値55か月で二次固形腫瘍は7例に発生し、治療関連白血病は認められなかった。全体のリスクは一般集団と比較して有意な増加は認められなかったが、化学療法後に皮膚がんが増加していた。著者らは、二次固形がんのリスクは精巣がんと同程度であり、原発性縦隔非セミノーマに関連する血液疾患の既知の関連を除けば、との結論を述べている。
