summary_en: This multicenter database study of 635 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors assessed the risk of second malignancies. Over a median follow-up of 55 months, seven second solid tumors occurred, and no treatment-related leukemia was observed. The overall risk was not significantly increased compared with the general population, although skin cancers were elevated, particularly after chemotherapy. The authors concluded that second solid cancer risk is comparable to testicular cancer, except for the known hematologic association with primary mediastinal nonseminoma.

title: Comparative genomic hybridization of microdissected samples from different stages in the development of a seminoma and a non-seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍（セミノーマと非セミノーマ）の発生段階におけるマイクロダイセクション試料の比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: セミノーマと混合型非セミノーマの各発生段階を、マイクロダイセクションした試料で比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション解析した研究です。セミノーマは全段階で類似した染色体異常パターンを示しました。非セミノーマはより不均一で、一部の異常は初期病変のみに認められました。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初期発生と進展に特定の染色体変化が関与する可能性が示唆されますが、解析は2例のみです。
summary_en: This study applied comparative genomic hybridization to microdissected samples from a seminoma and a mixed non-seminoma, covering intratubular neoplasia through invasive stages. The seminoma showed a consistent pattern of chromosomal gains and losses at all developmental stages. The non-seminoma displayed a more heterogeneous profile, with some aberrations present only in the early neoplasia or shared with invasive components. The results suggest that specific chromosomal alterations contribute to early development and progression of testicular germ cell tumors, though only two cases were analyzed.

title: Genetic analysis of the APAF1 gene in male germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍におけるAPAF1遺伝子の遺伝学的解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 染色体12q22の欠失領域に位置するAPAF1遺伝子が、男性胚細胞腫瘍の候補腫瘍抑制遺伝子かを検討した研究です。FISHでは欠失が認められましたが、コード配列の変化はありませんでした。欠失を持つ細胞株ではカスパーゼ-3活性化の障害が見られました。著者らはAPAF1が腫瘍抑制遺伝子として働くことは支持されないと結論づけています。
summary_en: This study investigated APAF1, a proapoptotic gene on chromosome 12q22, as a candidate tumor suppressor in male germ cell tumors, since this region is frequently deleted. APAF1 showed deletions by FISH in GCTs but no coding sequence changes. Expression was detectable in all examined cell lines, and some lines with deletions had defective caspase-3 activation that was restored by caspase-9 and APAF1 proteins. The authors concluded that APAF1 does not act as a tumor suppressor, though other apoptotic pathway defects linked to 12q22 loss remain possible.

title: Cystic struma ovarii: imaging findings.
title_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫：画像所見
summary_ja: 固形成分を持たない嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫の画像所見を報告した研究です。1例は薄壁の単房性腫瘤、2例は多房性嚢胞性腫瘤で、T2強調像で信号欠損がみられました。いずれも術前診断は困難でした。完全嚢胞性の卵巣腫瘤であっても、卵巣甲状腺腫を鑑別に含めるべきだと述べられています。
summary_en: This imaging report describes three cases of cystic struma ovarii without any solid component, a specialized ovarian teratoma. One was a thin-walled unilocular mass, while two were multilocular cystic masses showing T2 signal void and intermediate T1 signal. Preoperative diagnosis was difficult in all cases. The authors conclude that struma ovarii should be included in differential diagnoses even when an ovarian mass is entirely cystic, given its imaging overlap with other cystic ovarian lesions.

title: Congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma (epignathus).
title_ja: 先天性上咽頭奇形腫（epignathus）
summary_ja: 先天性上咽頭奇形腫（epignathus）の症例報告。羊水腔内の腫瘤として現れ、非対称性双胎との鑑別が問題となった。組織学的に三胚葉由来の高分化組織と骨性の中核を認めた。腫瘤は口蓋垂後方の領域に付着していた。胚細胞由来の奇形腫が性腺外に発生した例である。
summary_en: A case report describes a congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma, also called epignathus, presenting as an intra-amniotic sac mass that initially resembled asymmetric twins. Histology showed highly differentiated tissues from all three germ layers, including partially developed infant organs with a bony core. The tumor was attached in the retro-uvular region of the nasopharynx. The report illustrates the diagnostic distinction from twin pregnancy and documents the tumor's anatomical origin. It is an extragonadal teratoma in a neonatal context.

title: Detection of germ-cell tumor cells in the peripheral blood by nested reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction for alpha-fetoprotein-messenger RNA and beta human chorionic gonadotropin-messenger RNA.
title_ja: 末梢血中の胚細胞腫瘍細胞のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCG mRNAのネステッドRT-PCRによる検出
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍119例の末梢血を用い、ネステッドRT-PCRでAFPおよびβ-hCGのmRNAを検出した。全体の陽性率は26.5%で、血清AFP値とは相関しなかった。β-hCG PCRは血清hCG高値例で陽性が多く、病期IIC/IIIでは病期Iの約2倍の陽性率であった。陽性は主に胎児性癌で認められた。
summary_en: This study used nested RT-PCR to detect AFP and beta-hCG mRNA in peripheral blood of 119 patients with germ cell tumors, with 336 samples collected before and during therapy. Overall positivity was 26.5%, independent of serum marker levels for AFP. Positive beta-hCG PCR occurred more often when serum hCG was elevated. In a pretreatment subgroup of 36 patients, stage IIC/III tumors showed nearly twice the positivity of stage I tumors. Positive results were mostly seen in embryonal carcinoma, suggesting circulating tumor cells may complement conventional tumor markers.

title: A retrospective survey of clinical, pathologic, and prognostic features of adnexal masses operated on during pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠中に手術された付属器腫瘤の後方視的調査：臨床的、病理学的、予後的特徴
summary_ja: 1980〜1997年に妊娠中に付属器腫瘤の手術を受けた69例を後方視的に検討した。最多は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（33例）であった。早産は12%、周産期死亡は3例で、そのうち2例は重篤な先天異常によるものであった。典型的な良性嚢胞性奇形腫の超音波所見があれば、妊娠中の手術を回避できると結論づけた。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 69 Japanese women who underwent surgery for adnexal masses during pregnancy between 1980 and 1997. The most common pathology was mature cystic teratoma (33 cases), followed by functional cysts and mucinous cystadenomas; two were malignant. Pregnancy outcomes showed preterm birth in 12% and perinatal deaths in 3, two from major anomalies. The authors suggest adnexal masses may be associated with adverse fetal outcomes, and that surgery can be avoided when ultrasound shows features typical of benign cystic teratoma.

title: Laparoscopic cystectomy of a twisted, benign, ovarian teratoma in the first trimester of pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠初期の捻転性良性卵巣奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術
summary_ja: 妊娠11週の25歳女性が急性の左下腹部痛で受診し、捻転を伴う左卵巣奇形腫と診断された。緊急腹腔鏡手術で卵管と卵巣の捻転を解除し、奇形腫の嚢腫摘出を行った。妊娠は継続し、正期産で合併症なく出産した。超音波検査と細胞診による正確な診断、および温生理食塩水による十分な洗浄が良好な転帰に寄与したと考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman at 11 weeks of gestation who presented with acute left lower abdominal pain and was diagnosed with a twisted left ovarian teratoma. Emergency laparoscopic detorsion and cystectomy were performed, preserving the pregnancy. She delivered a healthy full-term infant without complications. The authors credit accurate ultrasound and cytologic diagnosis and copious warm saline irrigation for the favorable outcome, suggesting laparoscopy can be safely used for adnexal torsion in the first trimester.

title: Chromosomal changes in somatic cells in seminoma patients after treatment with ionizing radiation or cytostatics.
title_ja: 放射線照射または細胞傷害性抗がん薬治療後のセミノーマ患者における体細胞染色体変化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: セミノーマ患者において、放射線照射またはカルボプラチンによる治療前後の体細胞染色体損傷を細胞遺伝学的検査で比較した。放射線治療では治療後6か月でも染色体異常率が高く残存したのに対し、化学療法では回復と損傷細胞の排除がより速やかであった。細胞遺伝学的な観点から、化学療法は患者にとってより侵襲性が低いと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study compared somatic chromosomal damage in seminoma patients before and after treatment with ionizing radiation or the cytostatic drug carboplatin. Cytogenetic assays measuring chromosomal aberrations, sister chromatid exchanges, and micronuclei were performed before treatment, immediately afterwards, and six months later. Irradiation strongly suppressed lymphocyte mitotic activity and left a high aberration rate at six months, while chemotherapy showed faster recovery and quicker elimination of damaged cells. The authors conclude chemotherapy was less cytogenetically aggressive to patients.

title: An unusual case of choriocarcinoma following live term pregnancy.
title_ja: 正期産の生児出産後に発症した絨毛癌の一例
journal: Aust N Z J Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 正期産で生児を出産した後に絨毛癌を発症した、まれな症例報告である。腫瘍は子宮漿膜から発生する巨大な有茎性腫瘤として現れ、子宮内病変や遠隔転移は認めなかった。非典型的な提示様式のため診断が遅れやすいことを指摘している。予後不良とされる妊娠性絨毛性疾患の稀な臨床像を示す報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman who developed choriocarcinoma after a live term pregnancy. The tumor presented as a large pedunculated growth arising from the uterine serosa, without intrauterine involvement or distant metastasis, which delayed diagnosis. The authors note that post-term choriocarcinoma carries a poor prognosis and that its atypical presentation is often not recognized. Because clinical data on this rare entity are limited, the report adds to knowledge of an unusual manifestation of gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: A heterotopic cerebellum presenting as a suprasellar mass with associated nasopharyngeal teratoma.
title_ja: 鞍上部腫瘤として呈示した異所性小脳と鼻咽頭奇形腫
summary_ja: 新生児に鼻咽頭奇形腫と鞍上部の異所性小脳が同時に認められた症例報告である。分化の良好な異所性小脳の腫瘤は、眼窩、脊椎、前頭部脳瘤では報告があるが、鞍上部での報告は知られていないと述べている。両病変の画像所見を記述し、その起源について考察している。鼻咽頭奇形腫は性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍に分類される。
summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a nasopharyngeal teratoma found together with a heterotopic cerebellum in the suprasellar region. Well-differentiated heterotopic cerebellar masses have been reported in the orbit, spine, and frontal encephalocele, but not previously in the suprasellar region. The authors describe the imaging findings of both masses and discuss their possible embryologic origins. The nasopharyngeal teratoma is an extragonadal germ cell tumor, and the case is notable for its unusual combination of findings.

title: Expression of DNA toposiomerase I and DNA topoisomerase II-alpha in testicular seminomas.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおけるDNAトポイソメラーゼIおよびIIαの発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ20例でトポイソメラーゼIとIIαの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。トポイソメラーゼIの上昇は30%に認められ、その群は増殖指数が高かった。CD30は60%で陽性、CD15とc-erbB-2は陰性であった。トポイソメラーゼを標的とする化学療法が精巣セミノーマに有用である可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: This study examined DNA topoisomerase I and topoisomerase II-alpha expression in 20 testicular seminomas. Elevated topoisomerase I was found in 30% of cases, and these tumors had a higher proliferative index measured by topoisomerase II-alpha staining. CD30 was focally expressed in 60% of cases, while CD15 and c-erbB-2 were negative. Because camptothecin-class drugs require elevated topoisomerase I and cell proliferation for killing, the authors suggest that topoisomerase-targeting chemotherapy may be useful against testicular seminomas.

title: Measurement of CA-125 in trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるCA-125の測定
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患において、CA-125が化学療法の必要性の予測や経過観察に有用かを検討した。CA-125は化学療法を要した群と要しなかった群で有意差がなく、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とも相関しなかった。CA-125が陰性化してもヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇したままの症例が多かった。管理指標としては信頼できないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study assessed whether serum CA-125 could guide chemotherapy decisions and track disease in gestational trophoblastic disease. CA-125 was measured serially in patients with hydatidiform mole, nonmetastatic and metastatic disease, and a few cases of ovarian choriocarcinoma and placental site tumor. CA-125 did not differ significantly between patients who did and did not need chemotherapy and did not correlate with hCG. It often became negative while hCG remained elevated. The authors conclude that CA-125 does not provide reliable information for managing gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Evaluation of cyclin expression in testicular germ cell tumors: cyclin E correlates with tumor type, advanced clinical stage, and pulmonary metastasis.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるサイクリン発現：サイクリンEは腫瘍型、進行病期、肺転移と相関する
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマと胎児性癌を主体とする混合型胚細胞腫瘍40例で、Ki-67、サイクリンA・Eの発現を比較しました。サイクリンEは胎児性癌で74%、セミノーマで20%に陽性で、陽性例では病期が進んでいました。肺転移はサイクリンE陽性例のみに認められ、遠隔転移の予測因子として有用と結論されています。
summary_en: This study compared cyclin expression in 20 pure seminomas and 20 mixed germ cell tumors predominantly composed of embryonal carcinoma. Ki-67 and cyclin A were broadly expressed and offered little prognostic information. Cyclin E was positive in 74% of embryonal carcinomas but only 20% of seminomas, and its positivity correlated with higher clinical stage. Pulmonary spread occurred only in cyclin E-positive tumors. The authors conclude that cyclin E immunoreactivity correlates with tumor type and is strongly predictive of distant spread in testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Surgery for germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する手術療法
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍について、病期と組織型ごとの外科的治療をまとめた総説です。ディスジャーミノーマの病期IAでは片側卵巣摘出のみが選択され、非ディスジャーミノーマでは手術と化学療法を併用します。病期III・IVでは減量手術と化学療法が基本となります。一次・二次減量手術やリンパ節郭清の生存への寄与は議論が続いています。
summary_en: This review summarizes surgical management of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors by clinical stage and histologic type. For dysgerminoma, stage IA is treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy alone, while later stages receive chemotherapy with or without second-look surgery. Non-dysgerminomas are generally managed with surgery plus chemotherapy, with conservative procedures considered where appropriate. Advanced stages III and IV require cytoreductive surgery with chemotherapy. The authors note that the role of primary or secondary cytoreductive surgery and lymphadenectomy in improving survival remains controversial.

title: Primary mediastinal malignancies in children: report of 22 patients and comparison to 197 adults.
title_ja: 小児原発縦隔悪性腫瘍：22例の報告と成人197例との比較
summary_ja: 1973年から1995年に診断された小児原発縦隔悪性腫瘍22例を、成人197例と比較した研究です。悪性胚細胞腫瘍は18%を占め、5年生存率は25%と、リンパ腫（74%）より低値でした。胚細胞腫瘍は主に思春期に発症し、手術療法が多く用いられていました。病期分類と生存率に成人との有意差は認められませんでした。
summary_en: This study analyzed 22 children with primary mediastinal malignancies diagnosed between 1973 and 1995 and compared them with 197 adults. Lymphoma accounted for 55%, neurogenic tumors 23%, and malignant germ cell tumors 18%. Five-year survival was 25% for germ cell tumors versus 74% for lymphoma. Germ cell tumors presented mainly in adolescents, and surgery was used more frequently for germ cell tumors than lymphoma. Children had more neurogenic tumors and fewer thymomas than adults, and staging and survival did not differ significantly.

title: CT findings in post-operative subphrenic abscess with teratomatous inclusions.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫破裂に伴う横隔下膿瘍の画像所見：奇形腫様内容物を含む例
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の断裂・破裂により、腹痛を主訴とした39歳女性の症例報告です。卵巣奇形腫による脂肪成分を含む横隔下膿瘍をCTで確認しました。術後合併症としての横隔下膿瘍は既知ですが、膿瘍内に奇形腫様の内容物を認めた例は稀とされています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman who presented with abdominal pain after tubal sterilization. CT revealed a subphrenic abscess containing fatty inclusions, attributed to laceration or rupture of a mature ovarian teratoma. The authors note that subphrenic abscess is a recognized postoperative complication and that ovarian teratomas are common. A teratomatous inclusion within a subphrenic abscess, however, is unusual. The report highlights the CT appearance of this rare complication of a ruptured ovarian teratoma.

title: Angiogenesis and lymphangiogenesis in stage 1 germ cell tumours of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍における血管新生およびリンパ管新生
summary_ja: 精巣の臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍51例（セミノーマ28例、奇形腫23例）を対象に、血管新生マーカーを免疫組織化学で評価した。奇形腫はセミノーマや正常精巣より微小血管密度とVEGF発現が有意に高かったが、いずれも無再発生存とは相関せず予後因子にはならなかった。セミノーマの一部ではリンパ管新生因子が検出され、治療標的として今後の検討が必要とされる。
summary_en: This study examined whether angiogenesis could serve as an additional prognostic marker in 51 men with clinical stage 1 testicular germ cell tumours managed by orchidectomy and surveillance alone (28 seminomas, 23 teratomas). Immunohistochemistry assessed microvascular density and VEGF and thymidine phosphorylase expression, and VEGF-C and VEGFR-3 were evaluated in seminomas. Teratomas showed significantly higher microvascular density and VEGF expression than seminomas and normal testis. However, neither angiogenic marker correlated with relapse-free survival, so they were not prognostic here. Lymphangiogenic factors were detected in a subset of seminomas, suggesting possible therapeutic targets.

title: Abdominal relapse in stage 1 nonseminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis managed by surveillance or with adjuvant chemotherapy.
title_ja: 精巣の臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における監視療法または補助化学療法後の腹部再発
summary_ja: 精巣の臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍417例を18年間追跡し、監視療法と補助化学療法の腹部再発率を比較した。1986年以前は監視療法のみで腹部再発は16%だったが、以後は高リスク例に化学療法を行い、再発率は8%へ有意に低下した。治療関連死亡は低く抑えられた。著者らは、本病期でのRPLNDの必要性は依然として疑わしいと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study assessed whether adjuvant chemotherapy reduced abdominal relapse in 417 men with clinical stage 1 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours over 18 years. Up to 1986, 161 men were managed by surveillance alone, with abdominal relapse in 26 (16%). From 1986, men with adverse risk factors in the orchidectomy specimen were offered two cycles of chemotherapy; 60 accepted, with one abdominal relapse, while 196 under surveillance had 19 relapses. Abdominal relapse fell significantly from 16% to 8%. Treatment-related mortality remained low. The authors conclude that the need for RPLND in stage 1 NSGCT remains doubtful.

title: Ovarian yolk sac tumor with virilization during pregnancy: immunohistochemical demonstration of Leydig cells as functioning stroma.
title_ja: 妊娠中に男性化を来した卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍：機能性間質としてのライディッヒ細胞の免疫組織化学的証明
summary_ja: 妊娠28週の22歳女性が男性化徴候と血清テストステロン・αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値で受診した。左卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍に、ライディッヒ細胞の集簇が混在していた。免疫染色でライディッヒ細胞はビメンチン、インヒビンα、カルレチニンが陽性で、テストステロンも細胞質に証明された。腫瘍切除後にテストステロンとAFPが並行して低下し、機能性間質として作用したライディッヒ細胞が男性化の原因と考えられた。
summary_en: A 22-year-old woman at 28 weeks of gestation presented with virilization and elevated serum testosterone and alpha-fetoprotein. Resection revealed a left ovarian yolk sac tumour with Leydig cell islands distributed throughout the tumour, mostly peripherally. Immunohistochemistry showed Leydig cells positive for vimentin, inhibin alpha-subunit and calretinin, and negative for cytokeratins, while the yolk sac components were the reverse. Testosterone was identified within the Leydig cells. After resection, testosterone and AFP levels fell in parallel, indicating that Leydig cells acting as functioning stroma caused the virilization. This combination is very rare.

title: Mature teratoma of the uterine corpus with thyroid differentiation.
title_ja: 甲状腺分化を伴う子宮体部成熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 55歳の無症状女性で、多発子宮筋腫の検索中に子宮体部の偶発的な病変が見つかった。肉眼的にはコロイド状・出血性の結節で、組織学的・免疫組織化学的に甲状腺組織からなる小腫瘤と判明し、甲状腺分化を伴う子宮体部成熟奇形腫と診断された。性腺外に発生した成熟奇形腫の稀な例である。
summary_en: A 55-year-old asymptomatic woman with multiple uterine leiomyomas had an incidental colloid-hemorrhagic nodule within the uterine corpus. Histologic and immunohistochemical examination showed that this lesion was a small mass of thyroid tissue, establishing a diagnosis of mature teratoma of the uterine corpus with thyroid differentiation. The tumour was clinically silent and was discovered only incidentally during evaluation of leiomyomas. The report documents this rare extragonadal location of a mature teratoma with thyroid differentiation.

title: A male germ cell tumor-susceptibility-determining locus, pgct1, identified on murine chromosome 13.
title_ja: マウス第13染色体上の雄性胚細胞腫瘍感受性遺伝子座pgct1の同定
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 129系マウスは雄の精巣胚細胞腫瘍になりやすく、p53欠損でさらに発生率が上がる。著者らはこの性質を利用して交雑・戻し交雑マウスを作製し、遺伝子マッピングを行った。その結果、第13染色体上のD13Mit188近傍に、雄性胚細胞腫瘍の表現型と連動する遺伝子座pgct1を同定した。ヒトの5q領域との対応が示唆される。
summary_en: Inbred 129 mice are predisposed to male testicular germ cell tumours, and loss of functional p53 increases tumour incidence in this strain. The authors used p53-deficient 129 males to generate intercross and backcross panels for genetic mapping. They identified a 129-derived locus, pgct1, on mouse chromosome 13 near marker D13Mit188 that co-segregates with the male GCT phenotype. The region may be syntenic with a segment of human chromosome 5q implicated in human male germ cell tumour susceptibility. The findings identify a candidate susceptibility locus for further study.

title: Choriocarcinoma and partial hydatidiform moles.
title_ja: 絨毛癌と部分胞状奇胎
summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎3000例中、遷延する妊娠性絨毛性疾患で化学療法を要した15例のうち3例が絨毛癌と診断された。中央病理診断、フローサイトメトリー、マイクロサテライト解析により、三倍体の奇胎から絨毛癌が生じたことが示された。部分胞状奇胎の疑いがある症例は中央診断を受け、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のフォローアップを行うべきと結論づけられた。
summary_en: This study examined whether partial hydatidiform moles can transform into choriocarcinoma. Among 3000 patients with partial mole, 15 needed chemotherapy for persisting gestational trophoblastic disease, and three of these had choriocarcinoma. Central histology review, flow cytometry, and microsatellite genotyping were used to confirm triploidy and clonal origin. In all three cases, the choriocarcinomas shared identical maternal and paternal alleles with their preceding partial moles, indicating transformation. The authors conclude that patients with suspected partial mole should undergo central review and hCG follow-up.

title: Salvage surgery of chemorefractory germ cell tumors with elevated tumor markers.
title_ja: 化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが高値を示した胚細胞腫瘍に対する救済手術
summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが持続高値を示した男性30例の救済手術成績を検討した。57%が長期生存した。原病死例では胎児性癌が主な初発組織型で、内臓の残存病変が多く完全切除が難しかった。完全切除が良好な転帰を得る最重要因子であり、内臓転移例も手術の恩恵を受けた。特定のサブグループでは手術を省略すべきでないと結論している。
summary_en: This study reviewed 30 men with persistently elevated tumor markers at salvage surgery after chemotherapy for metastatic germ cell tumors. Seventeen patients (57%) were long-term survivors. Embryonal carcinoma was the predominant initial histology among those who died of disease, and their residual disease more often involved the viscera, making complete resection less likely. Complete resection was the most important factor for a favorable outcome, and patients with visceral metastasis also benefited. The authors conclude that surgery should not be omitted in certain subgroups.

title: Pre-natal and peri-natal exposures and risk of testicular germ-cell cancer.
title_ja: 出生前および周産期曝露と精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク
summary_ja: オンタリオ州の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者502例と対照を用いた症例対照研究で、母体ホルモン曝露と周産期因子を組織型別に検討した。外因性ホルモン曝露はリスク上昇と強く関連した。若年母体の初産、早産、停留精巣の治療歴もリスクを高めた。母体の多量喫煙や切迫流産はリスク低下と関連した。危険因子はセミノーマと非セミノーマでほぼ同様で、母体エストロゲン曝露の関与が示唆された。
summary_en: This case-control study of 502 Ontario men with testicular germ-cell cancer examined maternal and perinatal exposures by histologic subtype. Exogenous maternal hormone exposure was associated with markedly elevated risk. First births among young mothers, preterm birth, and treatment for undescended testicle also increased risk. Heavy maternal smoking and bleeding or threatened miscarriage were associated with lower risk. Risk factors differed little between seminoma and non-seminoma groups, supporting a role for maternal estrogen exposure.

title: The growing teratoma syndrome: results of therapy and long-term follow-up of 33 patients.
title_ja: growing teratoma syndrome：33例の治療成績と長期フォローアップ
summary_ja: 化学療法後に腫瘍が増大し、切除標本で成熟奇形腫のみが認められる growing teratoma syndrome の33例を検討した。完全な外科的切除例では、再発GTSや後の悪性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の発生が部分切除例より明らかに少なかった。GTSは独自の合併症と自然経過を持つ。完全な外科的切除が治療の第一選択であると結論している。
summary_en: This study reviewed 33 patients with growing teratoma syndrome, defined as tumor enlargement during or after chemotherapy for germ cell tumour, with only mature teratoma on histology of the resected specimen. Recurrent GTS and later malignant NSGCT were far less frequent after complete surgical resection than after partial resection. GTS has distinct complications and natural history. The authors conclude that complete surgical resection is the treatment of choice.

title: Comparative genomic and in situ hybridization of germ cell tumors of the infantile testis.
title_ja: 乳児期精巣胚細胞腫瘍の比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションおよびin situハイブリダイゼーション解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 乳児期精巣の奇形腫2例と卵黄嚢腫瘍4例を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションとin situハイブリダイゼーションで解析した。奇形腫では染色体異常はみられず、卵黄嚢腫瘍では異数性と特徴的な染色体の増減が一貫して認められた。MDM2は発現していたがp53は検出されず、乳児と成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍は異なる発生機序を持つと結論している。
summary_en: Comparative genomic hybridization and in situ hybridization were used to analyze two teratomas and four yolk sac tumors of the infantile testis. The teratomas showed no chromosomal anomalies, whereas all yolk sac tumors were aneuploid with consistent gains and losses, including recurrent losses at 1p21-31 and 4q23-33. MDM2 was detected by immunohistochemistry without p53, and no p53 exon 5-8 mutations were found. The authors conclude that infantile and adult testicular germ cell tumors have distinct pathogenesis.

title: Gastric adenocarcinoma with a yolk sac component: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う胃腺癌：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 36歳男性の低分化胃癌で、腺癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の混合成分を認めた症例報告。胃およびVirchow節の生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍成分がαフェトプロテイン(AFP)免疫組織化学染色に強陽性を示し、血清AFPは38,200 ng/mLであった。化学療法への反応は、原発性胚細胞腫瘍に比べて不良であった。胃原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍は極めてまれである。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with poorly differentiated gastric cancer showing mixed adenocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor components. Both gastric and Virchow node biopsies contained yolk sac areas strongly positive for alpha-fetoprotein by immunohistochemistry, with serum AFP of 38,200 ng/mL. The tumor metastasized to Virchow's node. The response to chemotherapy was less favorable than expected for pure primary germ cell tumors. The authors also review the rarity of gastric yolk sac tumors, which are mainly reported in elderly patients.

title: Effect of etoposide on experimental testicular teratoma in 129/SvJ mice.
title_ja: マウス実験的精巣奇形腫に対するエトポシドの効果
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 129/SvJマウスに移植した実験的精巣奇形腫モデルで、エトポシドの効果を検討した研究。移植4週後の治療では腫瘍が有意に縮小したが、6週後では認めなかった。エトポシドにより未熟神経外胚葉成分が減少し、組織像は成熟奇形腫に近づいた。化学療法後の成熟奇形腫は化学療法に反応しにくく、ヒトの残存腫瘍には完全切除と慎重な経過観察が必要とされる。
summary_en: This experimental study examines etoposide in an implanted testicular teratoma model in 129/SvJ mice. Treatment given 4 or 6 weeks after implantation was assessed for tumor growth, differentiation, apoptosis, and mdr1 P-glycoprotein localization. Etoposide significantly reduced the size of 4-week teratomas but not 6-week ones. Apoptosis and mdr1-Pgp distribution were unchanged. Immature neuroectodermal components decreased in all treated tumors, shifting histology toward mature teratoma. The authors conclude that postchemotherapy mature teratomas may not respond to chemotherapy, and that residual human tumors need complete surgical excision and surveillance.

title: Effective treatment of infantile choriocarcinoma in the liver with chemotherapy and surgical resection: a case report.
title_ja: 乳児肝原発絨毛癌に対する化学療法と外科的切除：症例報告
summary_ja: 生後10週の女児に生じた肝原発の乳児型絨毛癌の症例報告。β-hCGの著明な上昇を認めた。術前にエトポシドとシスプラチンによる化学療法を行い、肺転移を伴う腫瘍は縮小した。拡大右半肝切除により完全切除に至り、22か月間寛解を維持した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 10-week-old girl with infantile choriocarcinoma of the liver, presenting with ovarian cysts, cardiac insufficiency and hemolytic anemia. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated. Preoperative chemotherapy with etoposide and cisplatin, later intensified with ifosfamide, reduced the tumor and lung metastases. Complete resection by extended right hemihepatectomy followed, and the child remained in remission for 22 months, suggesting that preoperative chemotherapy is effective.

title: Conservative surgery to preserve ovarian function in patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. A review of 74 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対する妊孕性温存を目的とした保存手術：74例のレビュー
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍74例を対象とした後方視的研究で、子宮と対側卵巣を温存する保存手術を検討した。約75%が病期I、63.5%が補助化学療法を受けた。再発は9.5%、死亡は2例だった。化学療法後の多くの女性で月経が回復し、健常な生児14例が得られた。
summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 74 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with conservative surgery that preserved the uterus and contralateral ovary. Most had early-stage disease, and 63.5% received adjuvant chemotherapy. Recurrence occurred in 9.5% and two patients died. Most women resumed normal menstrual function after chemotherapy, and 14 healthy live births were recorded, suggesting that fertility-sparing surgery with chemotherapy is a reasonable approach for young patients with disease confined to one ovary.

title: Tricuspid valve metastasis from testicular carcinoma: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 精巣癌からの三尖弁転移：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の20歳男性で、化学療法後に再発性の腹部および横隔膜上の成熟奇形腫に対し複数回の切除を受けた。新たな心雑音から三尖弁奇形腫が判明し、弁の全切除と置換を行った。精巣癌からの三尖弁転移の初例を報告し、胚細胞腫瘍の心臓転移について文献をレビューした。
summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who was treated with chemotherapy and multiple resections of recurrent abdominal and supradiaphragmatic mature teratomas. A new heart murmur revealed a tricuspid valve teratoma, which was excised and replaced. The authors present the first discrete tricuspid valve metastasis from testicular carcinoma and review the literature on cardiac metastases from germ cell neoplasms.

title: Expression of cyclin E in placentas with hydropic change and gestational trophoblastic diseases: implications for the malignant transformation of trophoblasts.
title_ja: 水腫性変化および妊娠性絨毛性疾患の胎盤におけるサイクリンE発現：栄養膜細胞の悪性転化への示唆
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 水腫性変化の胎盤、完全胞状奇胎、部分胞状奇胎、絨毛癌におけるサイクリンEの発現を免疫組織化学で比較した研究である。サイクリンE発現は絨毛癌で最も高く、S期分画と相関した。過剰な蓄積が絨毛細胞の増殖亢進と悪性転化に寄与する可能性が示唆され、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の悪性度マーカー候補となりうると考えられる。
summary_en: This study examined cyclin E immunohistochemically in hydropic placentas, complete and partial hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. Cyclin E expression rose progressively from hydropic change to partial and complete moles, and was highest in choriocarcinomas. Expression correlated with S-phase fraction in gestational trophoblastic disease, and the authors propose that cyclin E overaccumulation contributes to uncontrolled trophoblast proliferation and neoplastic transformation. The work suggests cyclin E as a candidate marker of malignant potential in trophoblastic disease.

title: Metastatic extragonadal seminoma associated with cardiac transplantation.
title_ja: 心臓移植後に生じた転移性性腺外セミノーマ
summary_ja: 心移植後に免疫抑制療法を受けていた37歳男性に、多発骨転移を伴う転移性セミノーマが発生した症例報告である。骨髄生検で胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ陽性の未分化細胞を認め、血清のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は90 IU/lと上昇していた。精巣および後腹膜に原発巣はなく、シスプラチン併用化学療法と免疫抑制の減量により寛解に至った。
summary_en: A 37-year-old man who had undergone cardiac transplantation for dilated cardiomyopathy presented with bone pain and multiple bone metastases. Bone marrow biopsy showed undifferentiated cells that were cytokeratin and placental alkaline phosphatase positive. Serum hCG was elevated at 90 IU/l, confirming metastatic seminoma without testicular or retroperitoneal primary disease. The authors attribute this extragonadal seminoma to immunosuppression with cyclosporin and prednisolone. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy with reduced immunosuppression achieved remission.

title: Ovarian and retroperitoneal teratomas in a dog.
title_ja: 犬の卵巣および後腹膜奇形腫
summary_ja: 2歳の雌ラブラドール・レトリバーの卵巣奇形腫と後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告。開腹術で両腫瘤を摘出し、病理組織学的検査で気管支・腸嚢胞、毛包、皮脂腺などを含む奇形腫の特徴が確認された。犬における原発性後腹膜奇形腫の初報告とされる。
summary_en: A two-year-old female Labrador retriever presented with anorexia and abdominal distension and was found at laparotomy to have a 31-cm mass in the left ovary and an 11-cm mass in the left retroperitoneum. Both were surgically excised. Histopathology showed tissue elements characteristic of teratoma, including bronchial and intestinal cysts, hair follicles, sebaceous and apocrine glands, neural tissue, cartilage, bone, and fat. The authors report this as the first described case of primary retroperitoneal teratoma in a dog.

title: Improving the outcome of salvage treatment for non-seminomatous germ cell tumours (NSGCT).
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)の再発例に対する救援療法の治療成績の向上
summary_ja: 1991〜1996年に当施設で治療された再発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍41例の解析。腫瘍マーカー上昇例では、救援化学療法に続く手術の方が化学療法単独より成績が良く、導入療法後の残存病変が予後不良の最も強い因子であった。マーカー正常で再発した13例は全例生存し、再発NSGCTの治療成績は向上しつつあると結論している。
summary_en: This single-institution series from 1991 to 1996 analyzed 41 patients treated for relapsed non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. Among 28 patients with raised markers at relapse, those receiving salvage chemotherapy followed by surgery had better outcomes than chemotherapy alone, and residual disease after induction was the strongest predictor of poor survival. All 13 patients relapsing with normal markers survived after primary surgical management. The authors conclude that outcomes for relapsed NSGCT are improving.

title: DNA ploidy analysis and cell proliferation in congenital sacrococcygeal teratomas.
title_ja: 先天性仙尾部奇形腫におけるDNA倍数性と細胞増殖
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 先天性仙尾部奇形腫の成熟型と未熟型を対象に、フローサイトメトリーでDNA倍数性を、免疫組織化学でPCNAとKi-67を解析した研究。生後3か月以内に切除された腫瘍は全て二倍体で、未熟奇形腫2例はPCNAが強陽性であった。PCNAとKi-67は増殖活性を反映しうると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study measured DNA ploidy, DNA index, and proliferation markers (PCNA and Ki-67) in congenital sacrococcygeal teratomas, including mature and immature tumors. By flow cytometry, all tumors resected within three months of birth were diploid, and PCNA was strongly positive in both immature cases. Ki-67 showed weak to moderate positivity. The authors conclude that PCNA and Ki-67 may reflect proliferative activity and that the predictive value of flow cytometry needs further study.

title: Allelic losses in carcinoma in situ and testicular germ cell tumours of adolescents and adults: evidence suggestive of the linear progression model.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における上皮内癌と腫瘍のアレル欠失：直線的進展モデルの支持
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の87検体と40例由来の上皮内癌を微小切開した36検体で、ヘテロ接合性の消失を解析した。3q27-q28などで共通の欠失が見つかり、前駆細胞である上皮内癌でも同様の欠失が認められた。これらの領域の遺伝子不活化が初期事象であることを示唆する。セミノーマが上皮内癌から非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍へ進展する中間段階であるという直線的進展モデルを支持する結果である。
summary_en: This study analyzed loss of heterozygosity across 87 testicular germ cell tumor specimens and 36 microdissected carcinoma in situ samples from 40 patients. Common deletions were found at 3q27-q28, 5q31, 5q34-q35, 9p22-p21 and 12q22, and similar losses appeared in precursor CIS cells, supporting early inactivation of genes in these regions. All embryonal carcinoma samples showed 3q27-q28 loss. The results support a linear progression model in which seminoma is an intermediate stage between CIS and non-seminomatous germ cell tumor.

title: Gastric teratoma in children.
title_ja: 小児の胃奇形腫
summary_ja: 小児の胃奇形腫10例を報告した。全体の1%未満とまれな腫瘍である。未熟grade III奇形腫が2例あり、1例は肝と結腸に浸潤し、1例は所属リンパ節と大網に転移していた。全例で完全切除が行われ、死亡例はなかった。平均4.2年の観察期間中に再発例はなかった。成熟型・未熟型ともに完全切除で予後は良好であり、浸潤例でも化学療法や放射線療法は不要な可能性があるとする。
summary_en: This report describes ten children with gastric teratoma, which accounts for less than 1% of pediatric teratomas. Two cases were immature grade III tumors, one infiltrating the liver and colon and one metastasizing to regional lymph nodes and omentum. All patients underwent complete excision without deaths. After a mean follow-up of 4.2 years, none had recurrence. The authors conclude that both mature and immature gastric teratomas have an excellent prognosis after complete excision, and chemo- or radiotherapy may be unnecessary even when infiltration is present.

title: Head and neck teratomas in children.
title_ja: 小児の頭頸部奇形腫
summary_ja: 過去5年間に治療された頭頸部奇形腫の小児7例を後方視的に検討した。頸部、口腔、頭蓋骨の部位が含まれ、頭蓋骨奇形腫の1例を除く全例が切除術を受け、良好な転帰を得た。病理組織学的検査では三胚葉由来の成熟組織が確認された。最長4年の追跡で再発は認められず、頸部症例では甲状腺機能は正常化した。著者らは、これらの奇形腫は大部分が良性で切除により根治可能であり、頸部症例では気道管理を優先すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: A retrospective review of seven children with head and neck teratomas treated over five years, representing 2% of all teratomas seen. Locations included cervical, oral and skull sites. All but one underwent excision with satisfactory outcome; the skull teratoma was not operated on. Histopathology showed mature tissue from all three germ layers. Follow-up up to four years showed no recurrence, and thyroid function normalized in cervical cases. The authors conclude these teratomas are mostly benign and curable by excision, with airway management prioritized in cervical cases.

title: Thyrotoxicosis in a male patient associated with excess human chorionic gonadotropin production by germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 男性の胚細胞腫瘍によるhCG過剰産生に伴う甲状腺中毒症
summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌が産生するhCGの過剰により甲状腺機能亢進症を来した男性例を報告した。全報告例をレビューし、広範な病変を有し甲状腺症状は少ないことを示した。化学療法によりhCGが低下すると甲状腺中毒症は改善し、抗甲状腺薬はまれにしか必要ないとする。患者のhCGは妊娠時より甲状腺刺激活性の高い酸性変異体が多く、予後は一般に不良である。
summary_en: The authors report a man with thyrotoxicosis caused by excess human chorionic gonadotropin from metastatic choriocarcinoma, a germ cell tumor. Thyroid function tests later changed due to nonthyroidal illness. They reviewed all reported cases of hCG-associated thyrotoxicosis in men. Such patients usually have widespread disease and few thyrotoxic symptoms. Thyrotoxicosis typically resolves as hCG falls after chemotherapy, and antithyroid drugs are rarely needed. The circulating hCG has more acidic variants with greater thyroid-stimulating activity than in pregnancy, and prognosis is generally poor.

title: Phase II trial of pyrazoloacridine in patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors.
title_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍に対するピラゾロアクリジンの第II相試験
summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍13例に、ピラゾロアクリジン600 mg/m2を3週間ごとに静脈内投与する第II相試験を行った。白血球数の最低値中央値は2.5/mm3で血液毒性が認められた。評価可能な13例のいずれも主要奏効は得られなかった。ピラゾロアクリジンは、シスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍に対して有効でないと結論づけられた。
summary_en: This phase II trial tested pyrazoloacridine, given intravenously at 600 mg/m2 every three weeks, in 13 patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors. Hematologic toxicity was observed, with a median nadir leukocyte count of 2.5 cells/mm3, hemoglobin of 10.8 g/dl and platelets of 126,000/mm3. None of the 13 evaluable patients achieved a major response. The authors conclude that pyrazoloacridine is not efficacious in cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors.

title: Recurrence of germ cell tumor after orchiectomy.
title_ja: 精巣摘除術後の胚細胞腫瘍の再発
summary_ja: ナイメーヘンで1982～1998年に精巣がんと診断された488例を後方視的に解析し、精巣摘除術後の再発を検討した。再発は7.4%に認められ、対側精巣がんはセミノーマ成分と関連し、全身再発より著しく遅く出現した。非セミノーマでは原発巣の奇形腫および胎児性癌成分が全身再発の予測因子であった。対側がんや病期Iセミノーマの再発後の予後は良好であった。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis from Nijmegen reviewed 488 men treated for testicular cancer between 1982 and 1998. Recurrence occurred in 7.4 percent, including 12 contralateral and 24 systemic cases. Contralateral cancer was more common with seminoma components and appeared much later, at a median of 63.8 months, than systemic recurrence at 6.1 months. Teratoma and embryonal components predicted systemic recurrence in nonseminomas. Overall disease-related mortality was 3.9 percent, and prognosis was good after contralateral cancer or Stage I seminoma recurrence.

title: Germ cell-like telomeric length homeostasis in nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における胚細胞様のテロメア長の恒常性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣原発のセミノーマと非セミノーマについて、テロメア長とテロメラーゼ活性を比較した。セミノーマは大半が13kb未満と短く、非セミノーマは全例で23kb以上と精子に近い長さを示した。テロメラーゼ活性は多くの腫瘍で認められ、陰性だったのは成熟奇形腫のみの非セミノーマ1例であった。非セミノーマは生殖系列様のテロメア恒常性を保つと考えられる。
summary_en: This study compared telomere length and telomerase activity between seminomas and nonseminomas of the testis. Most seminomas had telomeres below 13 kb, whereas all nonseminomas had telomeres of at least 23 kb, similar to human sperm. Telomerase activity was present in most tumours of both types. The only telomerase-negative nonseminoma was a pure mature teratoma. The authors conclude that the telomere length difference is unrelated to telomerase activity and that nonseminomas retain germline-like telomere homeostasis.

title: Lack of p19INK4d in human testicular germ-cell tumours contrasts with high expression during normal spermatogenesis.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるp19INK4dの欠如：正常精子形成での高発現との対比
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: CDK阻害因子p19INK4dのヒト精巣における発現を、正常発生と腫瘍化の各段階で検討した。p19INK4dは成人正常精巣の精母細胞に豊富に存在したが、上皮内癌を含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではほとんど検出されなかった。胎児胚細胞にも認められず、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の胎児起源説を支持する結果であった。
summary_en: This study examined p19INK4d, a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor, in the human testis. The protein was abundant in spermatocytes of normal adult testes but nearly undetectable in testicular germ cell tumours, including carcinoma in situ. It was also absent in fetal germ cells. These findings support a fetal origin for testicular germ cell tumours and highlight the role of the RB pathway in both spermatogenesis and tumorigenesis in the human testis.

title: Fatal basilar artery thrombosis after chemotherapy for testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対する化学療法後に生じた致死的な脳底動脈血栓症
summary_ja: pT3N2M1のセミノーマ患者31歳が、シスプラチン併用化学療法の2コース目中に脳底動脈血栓症を発症した。入院後14時間で死亡した。シスプラチン併用化学療法に伴う脳血管障害は稀だが致死的になりうるため、精巣がんの治療に当たる際には留意すべきと報告している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with pT3N2M1 seminoma who developed basilar artery thrombosis during the second course of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. He died 14 hours after hospital admission. The authors note that cerebrovascular events related to cisplatin-based chemotherapy are rare but potentially fatal. They advise clinicians treating testicular cancer to keep these complications in mind.

title: [A case of synchronous cervical lymph node metastases from testicular and thyroid cancers showing mixed response to chemotherapy].
title_ja: 化学療法に混合反応を示した精巣がんと甲状腺がんの同時性頸部リンパ節転移の1例
summary_ja: 37歳男性が右陰嚢腫脹と多発リンパ節腫大で受診した。右根治的精巣摘除術で精巣セミノーマと診断され、BEP療法を3コース施行した。後腹膜と左頸部の転移は縮小したが右頸部腫瘤は不変で、切除の結果、甲状腺乳頭癌の転移と判明した。精巣がんの転移が化学療法に反応しない場合は、別の原発巣を疑う手がかりになりうると述べている。
summary_en: A 37-year-old man presented with right scrotal swelling and multiple lymph node enlargement. Right radical orchiectomy revealed testicular seminoma. After staging, he received three cycles of BEP chemotherapy, which was effective for retroperitoneal and left cervical nodes but not for a right cervical mass. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, right cervical dissection, and hemithyroidectomy revealed papillary thyroid cancer with nodal metastasis, while the retroperitoneal nodes contained no viable germ cell tumor. The authors suggest that chemotherapy unresponsiveness of metastases from testicular cancer may signal a primary tumor of another origin.

title: Intrapulmonary mature teratoma.
title_ja: 肺内成熟奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 22歳男性の左肺門部の嚢胞性病変を報告する。術前は縦隔奇形腫が疑われたが、開胸で左上葉前区域の腫瘍が確認され、区域切除で肺内成熟奇形腫(4.0×3.5cm)と診断された。英文報告で27例目にあたる。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見も記載されている。
summary_en: The authors describe a 22-year-old man with a cystic lesion in the left lung hilum, initially suspected to be an anterior mediastinal teratoma. Thoracotomy revealed the tumor in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, and segmentectomy confirmed an intrapulmonary mature teratoma measuring 4.0 x 3.5 cm. This was the 27th such case in the English literature. CT and MRI showed a heterogeneous cystic lesion, and the authors state this is the first intrapulmonary teratoma evaluated by MRI.

title: [Chemotherapy in hemodialysis patient with metastatic testicular cancer; pharmacokinetics of etoposide and cisplatin].
title_ja: 血液透析患者の転移性精巣がんに対する化学療法：エトポシドとシスプラチンの薬物動態
summary_ja: 慢性腎不全で血液透析中のステージIIIAセミノーマ患者で、シスプラチンとエトポシドの薬物動態を調べた。初回は骨髄抑制が強く、減量・透析日変更の治療に切り替えた。完全寛解が得られ、5年間再発はなかった。透析患者でも減量すれば副作用を抑えて投与できると結論している。
summary_en: The pharmacokinetics of cisplatin and etoposide were studied in a patient with stage IIIA seminoma who was receiving hemodialysis for chronic renal failure. Strong myelosuppression after the first regimen led to a reduced-dose schedule with hemodialysis on different days. Cisplatin AUC fell from 6.82 to 4.07 microg.hr/ml, and etoposide AUC was 241.9 and 216.9 microg.hr/ml. Complete remission was achieved, with no recurrence for five years. The authors conclude that these agents can be given to dialysis patients at reduced doses to limit toxicity.

title: Yolk sac tumor of the ovary: radiologic-pathologic correlation in four cases.
title_ja: 卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍：4症例における画像と病理の対応
summary_ja: 本研究は、4例の患者における卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍（内胚葉洞腫瘍）の放射線学的および病理学的特徴を報告している。CTとMRIでは、強く造影される充実性腫瘤として描出され、MRIでは顕著な信号欠損を伴っていた。顕微鏡検査で高血管性が確認され、出血は一般的な所見であった。著者らは、これらの画像所見が本腫瘍の診断に重要であると提案している。
summary_en: This study reports the radiologic and pathologic features of ovarian yolk sac tumor (endodermal sinus tumor) in four patients. On CT and MRI, the tumors appeared as well-enhancing solid masses with prominent signal voids on MRI. Microscopy confirmed a hypervascular nature, and hemorrhage was a common finding. The authors propose that these imaging features are important for diagnosing this tumor.

title: Fertility and offspring sex ratio of men who develop testicular cancer: a record linkage study.
title_ja: 精巣がんを発症した男性の妊孕性と出生児性比：記録照合研究
summary_ja: 1960～1993年に精巣がんを発症したデンマーク人男性3530例を、記録照合で解析した。一般集団と比べて妊孕性が低下し、男児の割合も低かった。妊孕性の低下は非セミノーマで顕著であった。精巣がん、男性不妊、出生児性比の偏りは生物学的機序を共有すると結論している。
summary_en: This Danish record-linkage study included 3530 men who developed testicular cancer between 1960 and 1993. Compared with the general population, they showed reduced fertility (standardized rate ratio 0.93) and a lower proportion of male offspring (48.9% versus 51.3%). The fertility reduction was greater in non-seminoma patients, while the sex ratio shift was independent of histology. The authors suggest that testicular cancer, subfertility, and a female-biased sex ratio share biological mechanisms.

title: The beneficial role of transvaginal ultrasound in the preoperative characterisation of dermoid cysts of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の術前評価における経腟超音波検査の有用性
summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)の2症例で、経腟超音波検査による術前評価の有用性を報告する。経腟超音波は両側卵巣の描出能を高め、正確な術前診断に役立つ。類皮嚢腫の典型的な超音波所見も示されている。
summary_en: The authors describe the value of transvaginal sonography for preoperative characterization of ovarian dermoid cysts in two patients. The report outlines the characteristic sonographic features of ovarian dermoid cysts. Transvaginal ultrasound improves visualization of both ovaries and supports accurate preoperative diagnosis.

title: Mature teratoma of the nasal vestibule: a case report.
title_ja: 鼻前庭に発生した成熟奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 新生児の鼻前庭に発生した成熟奇形腫の初症例を報告する。奇形腫は三胚葉由来の組織を含む先天性の希少腫瘍で、頭頸部は全体の2～9%である。上気道奇形腫の診断と治療法を考察し、文献の簡単な概説も加えている。
summary_en: The authors report the first case of a teratoma arising in the nasal vestibule, in a newborn. Teratomas are rare congenital neoplasms derived from pluripotent cells, containing tissue from all three germ layers. Head and neck teratomas account for only 2 to 9 percent of cases. The article discusses diagnosis and treatment of upper airway teratomas and includes a brief literature review.

title: Healing of superior vena cava defect in mediastinal seminoma with invasion.
title_ja: 浸潤を伴う縦隔セミノーマにおける上大静脈欠損の治癒
summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマが上大静脈内へ直接浸潤し、右心房まで進展した稀な症例を報告する。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で上大静脈の欠損を確認し、急速な腫瘍縮小による破裂の危険性を考慮して治療計画を立てた。放射線療法と化学療法を組み合わせ、腫瘍侵入部の上大静脈欠損は徐々に治癒した。
summary_en: The authors present an unusual mediastinal seminoma that invaded the superior vena cava by direct intraluminal extension and reached the right atrium. MRI showed the SVC defect, which guided treatment because rapid tumor regression could risk SVC rupture. A tailored regimen of radiotherapy and chemotherapy led to gradual healing of the SVC defect at the tumor entry site.

title: Bone morphogenetic proteins and retinoic acid induce human endogenous retrovirus HERV-K expression in NT2D1 human embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: 骨形成タンパク質およびレチノイン酸によるNT2D1胎児性癌細胞におけるヒト内因性レトロウイルスHERV-Kの発現誘導
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)で発現するHERV-Kの誘導因子を、胎児性癌細胞株NT2D1を用いて解析した。骨形成タンパク質(BMP)とレチノイン酸が早期に発現を誘導し、アクチビンやTGF-βでは誘導されなかった。誘導は一過性で、分化後には検出されなくなった。NT2D1細胞は分化時のHERV-K制御因子の研究に適した系であると述べている。
summary_en: HERV-K endogenous retrovirus expression is low in normal and tumor tissue but is detected in testicular germ cell tumors. NT2D1 embryonal carcinoma cells, which model TGCT stem cells, were used to show that HERV-K is induced early by bone morphogenetic proteins and retinoic acid, but not by activin or TGF-beta. Induction was rapid but transient, becoming undetectable upon differentiation. The authors propose NT2D1 cells as a system to study factors controlling HERV-K expression during differentiation.

title: Fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography in the evaluation of germ cell tumours at relapse.
title_ja: 再発時の胚細胞腫瘍評価におけるフルオロデオキシグルコース陽電子放射断層撮影(FDG-PET)の有用性
summary_ja: 精巣がん治療後の患者55例(FDG-PET 70回)を後方視的に解析した本研究では、残存腫瘤例で陽性的中率96%、陰性的中率90%と、腫瘍マーカーより高い陰性的中率を示した。マーカーのみ上昇した例では陰性的中率が50%にとどまった。FDG-PETは再発部位の同定に有用で、57%の症例で治療方針が変更された。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 55 patients with testicular germ cell tumours who underwent 70 FDG-PET scans for residual masses or raised tumour markers with normal CT. In residual masses, FDG-PET showed a positive predictive value of 96% and a negative predictive value of 90%, with a higher negative predictive value than markers. In patients with raised markers alone, PPV was 92% but NPV only 50%. FDG-PET localised recurrence sites and changed management in 57% of cases, supporting its role in evaluating relapse.

title: Risk-adapted chemotherapy of germ cell tumors with carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin for low-risk and cisplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide for high-risk patients. A single-center study.
title_ja: 低リスク例にカルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン、高リスク例にシスプラチン・エトポシド・イホスファミドを用いた胚細胞腫瘍のリスク適応型化学療法：単施設研究
summary_ja: 低リスク51例にはCEB(90)、高リスク9例にはVIPを用いたリスク適応型化学療法の単施設研究。CEB(90)では51例中45例が完全寛解に達し、3年生存率は全体で93%であった。高リスク例では9例中7例が完全寛解を得た。CEB(90)は外来で忍容性が高いが、シスプラチンに劣る可能性があり、臨床試験内での使用が推奨された。
summary_en: Single-centre study of 60 germ cell tumour patients treated with risk-adapted chemotherapy: 51 low-risk patients received carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (CEB90), and 9 high-risk patients received VIP. Among CEB90 patients, 45 of 51 achieved complete remission, with 3-year survival of 93% overall and 95% in the good-prognosis group. Seven of nine high-risk patients achieved CR. The authors conclude that CEB90 is a well-tolerated outpatient regimen, but recommend its use only within clinical trials given inferior results versus cisplatin.

title: Diagnostic delay and risk of relapse in patients with stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumour followed on active surveillance.
title_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の積極的監視における診断遅延と再発リスク
summary_ja: 1983〜1998年に積極的監視を行った病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍185例を後方視的に解析した研究。26例(14%)が再発し、再発までの期間中央値は4か月であった。全例が化学療法などで救済された。精巣摘除術前の症状期間は再発の有無で差がなく、診断の遅れは再発確率に影響しなかった。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 185 consecutive patients with low-risk or unknown-risk stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumour managed with active surveillance at Mount Vernon Hospital (1983-1998). Twenty-six patients (14%) relapsed, with a median time to relapse of four months. All were salvaged with chemotherapy, some with surgery. Duration of symptoms before orchidectomy did not differ significantly between relapsing and non-relapsing patients, indicating that diagnostic delay did not influence relapse probability.

title: Immunopathology of in situ seminoma.
title_ja: 上皮内セミノーマの免疫病理学
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト精巣の上皮内セミノーマおよび浸潤性セミノーマに浸潤するリンパ球を免疫組織化学的に解析した研究。T細胞とB細胞が中心で、活性化マーカーやアポトーシスは低かった。上皮内病変と浸潤性病変の間に差はなく、腫瘍特異的リンパ球の欠如やFasL以外の免疫抑制機構の関与が示唆された。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of lymphocytes infiltrating seminiferous tubules containing in situ seminoma and invasive seminomas in human testis. Lymphocytes were about 30% of cells, mainly CD4+ and CD8+ T cells and B cells, with few gamma/delta T and NK cells. Activation markers IL-2R, FasL and perforin were low, and apoptosis was limited. No differences were seen between in situ and invasive lesions. The authors suggest that specifically committed lymphocytes are absent, or that immune-suppressing mechanisms operate in addition to FasL.

title: Gestational trophoblastic diseases: new standards for therapy.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療における新たな標準
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の疫学、遺伝学、診断、治療の最近の進歩をまとめた総説。部分胞状奇胎から絨毛癌までの疾患スペクトラムを扱う。超音波検査や高感度β-hCG検査により胞状奇胎の臨床像は変化したが、持続性GTDの発生率は低下していないと述べている。
summary_en: Review of gestational trophoblastic disease, a spectrum of rare, highly curable neoplasms ranging from partial hydatidiform mole, which rarely requires chemotherapy, to choriocarcinoma, treated with multi-agent chemotherapy. The review covers advances in epidemiology, genetics, diagnosis and treatment. Improved imaging such as ultrasonography and sensitive beta-hCG assays have changed the presentation of molar pregnancy, although the incidence of persistent disease has not declined.

title: Glomus tumor arising in a mature teratoma of the ovary: report of a case simulating a metastasis from cervical squamous carcinoma.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫に発生したグロムス腫瘍：子宮頸部扁平上皮癌の転移との鑑別を要した症例
summary_ja: 子宮頸部扁平上皮癌の再発に対し両側卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた43歳女性で、卵巣成熟奇形腫の主成分をなすグロムス腫瘍を偶発的に認めた症例報告。膣の再発癌と類似したため当初は転移と判断された。免疫組織化学と超微形態学的検索で診断され、類似の報告はないとしている。
summary_en: Case report of a glomus tumour forming the major component of a mature ovarian teratoma, found incidentally in a 43-year-old woman undergoing bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy for recurrent cervical squamous carcinoma. Its superficial resemblance to the vaginal recurrence initially suggested metastasis. Immunohistochemistry and ultrastructural examination supported the glomus tumour diagnosis. The authors note that no similar tumour has previously been described in the ovary or in teratomas elsewhere.

title: Intracranial dural metastasis of mediastinal seminoma--case report.
title_ja: 縦隔セミノーマの頭蓋内硬膜転移：症例報告
summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍(純粋セミノーマ)から頭蓋内硬膜転移を生じた24歳男性の症例報告。放射線療法後のMRIで髄膜腫様の腫瘍が見つかり、部分摘出とカルボプラチン・エトポシドによる化学療法の2サイクルで残存腫瘍はほぼ消失した。寛解後も他部位の再発を含め、長期のフォローアップが推奨されている。
summary_en: Case report of a 24-year-old man with a mediastinal germ cell tumour infiltrating the superior vena cava, pericardium, aorta and lung, who later developed an intracranial dural metastasis mimicking a meningioma. Treatment comprised partial resection and radiotherapy, then partial tumour removal and two cycles of carboplatin and etoposide, which nearly eliminated the residual tumour. Both lesions were pure seminoma. The authors recommend long-term follow-up for patients in remission.

title: Adhesion of trophoblast to uterine epithelium as related to the state of trophoblast differentiation: in vitro studies using cell lines.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株を用いた、栄養膜細胞の子宮上皮への接着と分化状態の関係:in vitro研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株を用いて、子宮上皮細胞への接着と分化の関係を調べたin vitro研究。分化誘導剤はhCG分泌を増やす一方で接着を低下させた。分化と接着能は逆相関する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This in vitro study examines how trophoblast-type choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, JAr, Jeg-3) adhere to uterine epithelial cells, a process relevant to embryo implantation. Cells were treated with retinoic acid, methotrexate, dibutyryl-cAMP, or PMA to induce differentiation. All agents increased hCG secretion but reduced adhesion to endometrial monolayers in all three cell lines. The findings suggest that differentiation and adhesive capacity are inversely linked, and that epithelial adhesion is regulated differently from the matrix invasion seen in later trophoblast invasion.

title: Management of low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の低病期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の管理
summary_ja: 低病期の非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理に関する総説。現代の治療により治癒率は非常に高い。現在の焦点は、治療に伴う毒性による罹患率を減らすことにある。
summary_en: This review addresses the management of low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. It notes that testicular cancer has become one of the most curable solid neoplasms, with high cure rates from modern treatment regimens. The focus has shifted toward reducing the morbidity of potentially toxic treatment for low-stage disease. The abstract is brief and provides only a general overview of the clinical approach to balancing cure with treatment-related toxicity.

title: Diagnosis and management of teratomas and epidermoid cysts.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫と類表皮嚢胞の診断と管理
summary_ja: 小児の精巣奇形腫と類表皮嚢胞の診断と管理に関する総説。思春期前の患者では良性病変が強く疑われる。精巣温存手術の適応は凍結切片で確定する必要があり、精巣摘除術より温存手術が支持される。
summary_en: This review addresses the diagnosis and management of teratomas and epidermoid cysts in children. Preoperative sonographic, biochemical, and clinical evaluation can strongly suggest a benign lesion in prepubertal patients. Testis-sparing enucleation requires a definitive diagnosis by frozen section pathology. The authors argue that the high incidence of benign testicular lesions, the absence of carcinoma in situ in prepubertal germ cell tumors, and the benign behavior of these tumors support testis-sparing surgery over orchiectomy.

title: Characteristics of women with recurrent molar pregnancies.
title_ja: 再発性胞状奇胎妊娠の女性の特徴
summary_ja: 英国の絨毛性疾患スクリーニング登録者を後方視的に解析し、再度の胞状奇胎の頻度と特徴を調べた。再発率は1%未満で、血液型Bで高かった。再発時の化学療法は6%にとどまり、再発だけでは化学療法の適応にならないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 5,030 registrants at a UK trophoblastic screening service examines women who develop a second molar pregnancy. The recurrence risk is less than 1%, highest in the second year after the first event. Women with blood group B and, possibly, Indian/Pakistani women showed increased risk. Only 6% required chemotherapy for the second mole, and partial moles tended to recur as partial moles. The authors conclude that a second molar pregnancy is not in itself an indication for chemotherapy.

title: Alpha-fetoprotein production by pancreatic tumors exhibiting acinar cell differentiation: study of five cases, one arising in a mediastinal teratoma.
title_ja: 腺房細胞分化を示す膵腫瘍によるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)産生:5症例の検討(うち1例は縦隔奇形腫由来)
summary_ja: AFPを産生し血清AFPが上昇した膵腫瘍5例を報告し、文献もレビューした。うち1例は縦隔奇形腫の膵成分から生じた。AFP産生は腺房細胞分化と関連し、膵芽腫と腺房細胞癌が多い。両者の鑑別は難しいとされる。
summary_en: This study presents five pancreatic tumors that produced alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and showed elevated serum AFP, along with a review of documented cases. Four arose in the orthotopic pancreas, while one arose in the pancreatic component of a mediastinal teratoma. The patients were children or young adults. AFP production was closely linked to acinar differentiation, mostly in pancreatoblastoma or acinar cell carcinoma. The authors note these two tumors share many features and can be difficult to distinguish.

title: Molecular analysis of circulating tumor cells in peripheral blood from patients with germ cell tumor: a quantitative approach.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の末梢血中循環腫瘍細胞の分子解析：定量的アプローチ
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 末梢血中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)mRNAを半定量RT-PCRで測定し、胚細胞腫瘍患者7例の循環腫瘍量を健常対照者と比較した。治療前にAFP mRNAが大きく上昇した7例は全例、12か月以内に再発または転移を来した。治療前に播種した腫瘍細胞が再発の源となる可能性が示された。AFP mRNAの経時的測定は、転移リスクの高い患者の同定に有用と考えられる。
summary_en: This study quantified circulating tumour load in germ cell tumour patients by semiquantitative RT-PCR for alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) mRNA in peripheral blood. Samples from seven patients at diagnosis and during follow-up were compared with 47 healthy controls. All seven patients with markedly elevated AFP mRNA before treatment developed recurrence or metastasis within 12 months. The authors propose that AFP-expressing tumour cells disseminating before treatment may be the source of relapse. Sequential AFP mRNA monitoring may help identify patients at high risk of metastasis.

title: Surveillance for stage I testicular germ cell tumours: results and cost benefit analysis of management options.
title_ja: 臨床病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する監視療法：成績と治療選択肢の費用対効果分析
summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する303例（セミノーマ120例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍183例）の監視療法の成績を報告している。中央値5.1年の追跡期間中の死亡は3例のみであった。再発はNSGCTの28%、セミノーマの15%に生じた。5年再発フリー生存率はセミノーマで82%、NSGCTで69%であった。再発の大半は予後良好または中間リスク群で発生し、5例が対側精巣腫瘍を発症した。著者らは、動機づけの高い施設では監視療法の死亡率は低く、過剰治療を回避できると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study reports outcomes of surveillance in 303 men with stage I testicular germ cell tumours: 120 with seminoma and 183 with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours (NSGCT). Median follow-up was 5.1 years, with only three deaths. Relapse occurred in 28% of NSGCT and 15% of seminoma patients. Five-year relapse-free survival was 82% for seminoma and 69% for NSGCT. Most relapses occurred in good or intermediate prognosis groups, and five patients developed contralateral testicular tumours. The authors conclude surveillance has low mortality and avoids overtreatment in well-motivated centres.

title: Fine-needle aspiration cytology of Schiller-Duval bodies of yolk-sac tumor.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍のシラー・デュバル小体の穿刺細胞診
summary_ja: 穿刺吸引細胞診で卵黄嚢腫瘍に特徴的なシラー・デュバル小体の細胞学的所見を検討した。29歳男性の後腹膜リンパ節転移例では、細胞ブロックに多数の小体が認められた。塗抹標本では腫瘍細胞に覆われた血管様構造が観察された。これらは穿刺生検での卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断の手がかりとなりうる。
summary_en: This cytology study identifies cytological features of Schiller-Duval bodies, a histologic hallmark of yolk sac tumour, in fine-needle aspiration. The case involved a retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis of yolk sac tumour associated with testicular complex mature teratoma in a 29-year-old man. Cell block sections showed numerous Schiller-Duval bodies. Smears displayed anastomosing, thin-walled vascular channels with marked diameter variation, folded balloon-like channels, and branched vascular fragments. These findings may serve as diagnostic clues for yolk sac tumour on aspiration biopsy.

title: Acute tumor lysis syndrome with choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 絨毛癌に伴う急性腫瘍崩壊症候群
summary_ja: 進行した絨毛癌（非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍）の52歳男性で、化学療法開始後48時間以内に腫瘍崩壊症候群を発症した症例報告である。人工呼吸管理と透析により腎機能は改善したが、その後の化学療法後に肺不全で死亡した。進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の全身化学療法後に腫瘍崩壊症候群を来した初めての報告とされる。
summary_en: A 52-year-old man with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell cancer (choriocarcinoma) with retroperitoneal, lung, and liver metastases developed acute tumor lysis syndrome within 48 hours of receiving etoposide, cisplatin, and bleomycin. He had hypotension, hypoxemia, and anuria, requiring mechanical ventilation and hemodialysis. Renal function improved, but after a shortened carboplatin and etoposide course he died of pulmonary insufficiency and cardiac arrest on day 48. The authors report this as the first case of tumor lysis syndrome after systemic chemotherapy for advanced nonseminomatous germ cell cancer.

title: Prognostic parameters for the management of advanced testis tumours.
title_ja: 進行精巣腫瘍の予後因子
summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療方針を決めるための予後因子をレビューした。従来の因子には腫瘍量、肝・骨・脳転移、腫瘍マーカーの著明な上昇、縦隔原発が含まれる。β-hCGやMAGE発現などの生物学的因子は前向き試験での検証が必要とされる。また、専門施設での治療が予後に影響する点も強調されている。
summary_en: This review discusses prognostic factors guiding management of advanced testicular germ cell tumors. Traditional factors include large tumor volume, liver, bone or brain metastases, markedly elevated tumor markers, and extragonadal mediastinal primary sites. Novel factors include patient-related, socioeconomic, and tumor-biology markers such as beta-hCG and MAGE expression in seminoma and the proportion of embryonal carcinoma or vascular invasion. The authors emphasize that treatment in experienced centers influences outcomes and that biologic factors need prospective validation to tailor individualized treatment.

title: Seminoma metastatic to the prostate resulting in a rectovesical fistula.
title_ja: 前立腺に転移したセミノーマが直腸膀胱瘻を来した1例
summary_ja: 経直腸超音波ガイド下生検で診断された、前立腺転移を有するセミノーマの症例である。化学療法10週後に直腸膀胱瘻を発症したが、腫瘍が画像上の完全奏効を示したことで瘻孔は治癒した。まれな転移部位と化学療法の稀な合併症を示す単一症例の報告であり、提示、診断法、臨床経過が記載されている。
summary_en: A man with metastatic seminoma to the prostate, diagnosed by transrectal ultrasound-guided biopsy, developed a rectovesical fistula after ten weeks of chemotherapy. The fistula healed after the tumor achieved a complete radiological response to treatment. The case highlights an unusual site of metastatic seminoma and a rare complication of systemic chemotherapy. It is a single case report describing the presentation, diagnostic approach, and clinical course.

title: Microsatellite instability in germ cell tumors of the testis and ovary.
title_ja: 精巣および卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍におけるマイクロサテライト不安定性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成人の精巣および卵巣胚細胞腫瘍104組の腫瘍と正常DNAを用いて、マイクロサテライト不安定性を解析した。精巣腫瘍では24例中7例で一箇所のみに認められ、卵巣腫瘍では悪性例の多くで広範な不安定性が認められた。精巣腫瘍における遺伝的不安定性の役割は卵巣腫瘍より小さいと結論されているが、病因的意義は不明のままである。
summary_en: This study examined microsatellite instability (replication error) in 104 paired tumor and constitutional DNA samples from adult testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors, including carcinoma in situ. Replication error appeared at one locus in 7 of 24 testicular tumors, suggesting limited involvement. Ovarian germ cell tumors showed widespread instability at 38 of 64 loci, with 12 of 36 malignant tumors affected. The authors conclude that genetic instability plays a lesser role in testicular germ cell tumors than in ovarian germ cell tumors, though its pathogenic significance remains uncertain.

title: Minisatellite mutation frequency in human sperm following radiotherapy.
title_ja: 放射線療法後のヒト精子における微小衛星変異頻度
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 研究者らは、半骨盤放射線療法を受けた3例のセミノーマ患者の精子について、治療前と、前減数分裂・減数分裂・減数分裂後の各段階で照射された細胞由来の精子とを比較し、微小衛星変異頻度を測定した。B6.7およびCEB1の座位で超高感度の単一分子解析法を用いたところ、放射線誘発変異の証拠は認められなかった。この結果は、放射線誘発性の生殖細胞系変異を示唆した過去の集団研究と比較して考察されている。本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する放射線療法後の遺伝的安全性を検討したものである。
summary_en: Researchers measured minisatellite mutation frequencies in sperm from three seminoma patients who received hemipelvic radiotherapy, comparing pre-treatment sperm with sperm derived from cells irradiated at pre-meiotic, meiotic, and post-meiotic stages. Using a highly sensitive single-molecule approach at the B6.7 and CEB1 loci, they detected no evidence of radiation-induced mutation. The findings are discussed against earlier population studies that suggested radiation-induced germline mutation. The study addresses germline genetic safety after radiotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Hepatoid variant of yolk sac tumor of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍の肝様細胞型亜型
summary_ja: 本報告は、64歳男性の精巣に生じ、主に肝様細胞から構成される卵黄嚢腫瘍（内胚葉洞腫瘍）を記述している。左精巣の腫瘤は約4×3cmで、血清αフェトプロテインは5479 ng/mLと著明に上昇していた。組織学的には、好酸性または明るい細胞質を持つ肝細胞様細胞がシート状と索状に増殖していた。腫瘍細胞はAFPや複数の肝・上皮系マーカーに陽性であった。著者らは、この亜型を転移性肝細胞癌、胎児性癌、肝様癌と鑑別する必要性を強調している。
summary_en: This report describes a testicular yolk sac tumor (endodermal sinus tumor) composed predominantly of hepatoid cells in a 64-year-old man. The left testicular mass measured about 4 x 3 cm, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 5479 ng/mL. Histologically, eosinophilic or clear hepatocyte-like cells grew in sheets and trabeculae, and tumor cells were immunoreactive for AFP and several hepatic and epithelial markers. The authors emphasize the need to distinguish this variant from metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma, embryonal carcinoma and hepatoid carcinoma.

title: High-dose chemotherapy as initial salvage chemotherapy in patients with relapsed testicular cancer.
title_ja: 再発精巣がんに対する初回救援化学療法としての大量化学療法
summary_ja: インディアナ大学で治療された再発精巣がん患者65例を対象に、初回救援療法としてのカルボプラチンとエトポシドによる大量化学療法の成績を検討した。追跡期間中央値39ヶ月で57%が無病生存を持続し、さらに3例が手術後に無病となった。有意な有害事象が認められたが、治療関連死はなかった。許容しうる毒性で良好な長期生存が得られたと結論された。
summary_en: This study evaluated high-dose carboplatin and etoposide with stem-cell rescue as initial salvage chemotherapy in 65 patients with relapsed testicular cancer. With a median follow-up of 39 months, 57% remained continuously disease-free, and three more patients became disease-free after surgery. The treatment caused significant morbidity without treatment-related deaths. The authors conclude that it achieves impressive long-term survival with acceptable toxicity.

title: Inhibin-alpha CD99, HEA125, PLAP, and chromogranin immunoreactivity in testicular neoplasms and the androgen insensitivity syndrome.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍および男性ホルモン不応症候群におけるインヒビンα、CD99、HEA125、PLAP、クロモグラニンの免疫反応性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍115例、副精巣腫瘍3例、男性ホルモン不応症候群6例を対象に、インヒビンα、CD99、HEA125、PLAP、クロモグラニンの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。インヒビンαは主に性索間質性腫瘍で陽性であり、PLAPは多くの胚細胞腫瘍で陽性であった。インヒビンα、PLAP、CD99、HEA125は精巣腫瘍の鑑別診断に有用であるが、クロモグラニンの有用性は限られると結論された。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined inhibin-alpha, CD99, HEA125, PLAP and chromogranin in 115 testicular tumors, 3 epididymal tumors and 6 cases of androgen insensitivity syndrome. Inhibin-alpha was largely restricted to sex cord-stromal tumors, while PLAP was present in most germ cell tumors. CD99 and HEA125 showed variable staining, and chromogranin was of limited value. The authors conclude that inhibin-alpha, PLAP, CD99 and HEA125 aid differential diagnosis of testicular neoplasms.

title: Absence of RBM expression as a marker of intratubular (in situ) germ cell neoplasia of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣の精細管内(in situ)胚細胞腫瘍のマーカーとしてのRBM発現の消失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍21例とその周囲の精細管を対象に、正常男性胚細胞のマーカーであるRBMタンパク質の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。正常な精子形成を示す精細管ではRBMが陽性であったが、全ての胚細胞腫瘍と精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCN)の領域では陰性であった。RBM染色の消失はIGCNの同定に有用であり、精巣の浸潤前悪性病変の診断ツールになりうると結論された。
summary_en: This study examined RBM protein, a marker of normal male germ cells, in 21 testicular germ cell tumors and the adjacent seminiferous tubules. RBM was expressed in normal spermatogenic tubules but was absent in all germ cell tumors and in defined areas of intratubular germ cell neoplasia (IGCN). Loss of RBM staining allowed identification of IGCN, suggesting that RBM immunostaining may be a useful diagnostic tool for detecting preinvasive malignancy of the testis.

title: Expression of constitutively active c-MET receptor in human choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛癌における構成的活性型c-METレセプターの発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株4種(GCH-1、GCH-1m、NUC-1、SCH)において、肝細胞増殖因子(HGF)受容体c-METの発現を解析した。全ての細胞株でc-METのmRNAとタンパク質が発現し、構成的にチロシンリン酸化されていた。一方、HGFは発現していなかった。c-METが絨毛癌の増殖や性質に関与する可能性が示唆されたが、オートクリン機構は考えにくいとされた。
summary_en: This study assessed c-MET, the hepatocyte growth factor receptor, in four human choriocarcinoma cell lines. RT-PCR showed that none of the lines expressed HGF, although all expressed c-MET mRNA. Western blotting demonstrated constitutive tyrosine phosphorylation of c-MET in these cells. The findings suggest that c-MET may contribute to the growth and behavior of choriocarcinoma, although an autocrine HGF loop seems unlikely.

title: Ultrasonography and CT findings of a dermoid cyst of the cecum. A case report.
title_ja: 盲腸類皮嚢腫の超音波検査およびCT所見：症例報告
summary_ja: 盲腸に生じたきわめてまれな類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。超音波検査とCTによる画像所見を、病理所見と対比して記載し、鑑別診断を簡潔に検討している。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫に相当する病変で、本例は性腺外発生の胚細胞腫瘍の範疇に入る。
summary_en: A case report describing ultrasonography and CT findings of a dermoid cyst arising in the cecum, a very rare location for this lesion. The paper correlates imaging with pathology and briefly discusses differential diagnosis. Dermoid cysts are mature teratoma-type lesions, so this extragonadal case falls within the germ cell tumor spectrum. The report is brief and focuses on imaging characteristics.

title: Restricted 12p amplification and RAS mutation in human germ cell tumors of the adult testis.
title_ja: 成人精巣の胚細胞腫瘍における限局性12p増幅とRAS変異
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍における限局性12p増幅とK-RAS変異を検討した研究である。一次腫瘍の約8%で増幅を認め、セミノーマでは発症年齢の若年化とアポトーシスの低下に関連した。しかし増幅やRAS変異は病期、治療反応、生存を予測しなかった。12p獲得は浸潤性増殖に関与すると考察している。
summary_en: This study examines restricted 12p amplification and K-RAS mutations in adult testicular germ cell tumors. The amplification occurred in about 8% of primary tumors and was associated with younger age at diagnosis in seminomas, along with reduced apoptosis. However, neither amplification nor RAS mutation predicted stage, treatment response, or survival. The authors propose that 12p gain supports invasive growth.

title: A case of pulmonary tumour embolism mimicking miliary tuberculosis.
title_ja: 粟粒結核に類似した肺腫瘍塞栓症の1例
summary_ja: 子宮絨毛癌の23歳女性で、胸部X線が粟粒状陰影を呈した症例報告である。剖検では実質転移ではなく肺筋性動脈内の多数の腫瘍塞栓が確認された。絨毛癌の肺転移が粟粒結核様の像を示す原因は、大血管内の腫瘍塞栓である可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: A case report of a 23-year-old woman with uterine choriocarcinoma whose chest X-ray showed a miliary-like pattern. Autopsy revealed multiple macrovascular tumour emboli in pulmonary muscular arteries rather than parenchymal metastases. The authors suggest that the miliary appearance of choriocarcinoma lung metastases may result from large-vessel tumour embolism, which can mimic tuberculosis.

title: Metastatic testicular cancer presenting as spinal cord compression: report of two cases.
title_ja: 脊髄圧迫として発症した転移性精巣がん：2症例の報告
summary_ja: 原発巣が不明な若年男性で、精巣がんが脊髄圧迫として発症した2症例を報告している。両例とも下肢の急速な筋力低下があり、緊急手術と化学療法を受けた。神経機能は改善したものの、独立歩行はできなかった。著者らは、若年男性で原因不明の脊髄圧迫がある場合は、脊椎のMRIとCTによる病期分類を推奨している。
summary_en: Two case reports describing testicular cancer presenting as spinal cord compression in young men without known primary disease. Both patients had rapid lower-limb weakness, underwent emergency surgery, and received chemotherapy. Neurological function improved but independent ambulation was not regained. The authors recommend spinal MRI and CT staging in young men with unexplained cord compression.

title: Developmental regulation of neurogenesis in the pluripotent human embryonal carcinoma cell line NTERA-2.
title_ja: 多能性ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2における神経新生の発生的制御
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究はヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2を用い、レチノイン酸による神経分化過程の遺伝子発現を解析した。分化は3段階に分かれ、初期にはnestinの一過性上昇、次いで細胞周期離脱期にneuroD1とA2B5が発現し、後期にはsynaptophysinやneuron-specific enolaseが増加した。in vitroの経路は生体内の神経発生に類似していた。
summary_en: This study uses the human embryonal carcinoma cell line NTERA-2, a model of pluripotent germ-cell-tumour stem cells, to examine gene expression during retinoic acid-induced neuronal differentiation. Differentiation proceeded in three phases: transient hath1 and nestin expression early, neuroD1 and A2B5 expression as cells exited the cell cycle, and later increases in synaptophysin and neuron-specific enolase. The authors conclude that the in vitro pathway resembles neural precursor development seen in vivo.

title: Bone morphogenetic proteins (BMPs) induce epithelial differentiation of NT2D1 human embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: 骨形成因子（BMP）はNT2D1ヒト胎児性癌細胞の上皮分化を誘導する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞に相当するヒト胎児性癌細胞NT2D1を、BMPまたはレチノイン酸で処理した。レチノイン酸は神経・内胚葉・上皮マーカーを誘導したのに対し、BMPは主に上皮表現型をもたらした。レチノイン酸の作用の一部はBMP-7の誘導を介する。BMPシグナルによる多能性幹細胞の分化制御を提案している。
summary_en: Human embryonal carcinoma cells, which represent the stem cells of testicular germ cell tumours, were treated with bone morphogenetic proteins (BMPs) or retinoic acid. Retinoic acid induced neuronal, endodermal and epithelial markers, whereas BMPs drove a predominantly epithelial phenotype. Retinoic acid effects were partly mediated through induced BMP-7. The authors propose BMP signalling as a means to direct differentiation of multipotent stem cells, potentially reversing malignant features.

title: Bleomycin, actinomycin-D, and cisplatin treatment of ovarian germ-cell malignancies contributes to reducing adverse drug reactions.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍に対するブレオマイシン・アクチノマイシンD・シスプラチン療法は有害反応の軽減に寄与する
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍16例を、BEP療法群（6例）とBAP療法群（10例）に分けて比較した。BAP群では脱毛、貧血、好中球減少が有意に軽度だった。5年生存率はBAP群87.5%、BEP群83.3%で有意差はなかった。BAP療法は予後を損なわず有害反応を減らす点で有益と考えられた。
summary_en: Sixteen patients with ovarian germ cell malignancy were divided into a BEP group (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin; n=6) and a BAP group (bleomycin, actinomycin-D, cisplatin; n=10). BAP patients had significantly milder alopecia, anaemia and neutropenia. Five-year survival was 87.5% with BAP and 83.3% with BEP, a non-significant difference. The authors conclude BAP may be preferable because it reduces adverse reactions without compromising outcome.

title: Congenital cervical teratoma in neonates. Case report and review.
title_ja: 新生児先天性頸部奇形腫：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 新生児に生じた先天性頸部奇形腫9例を2施設の症例で検討した。病変は組織学的には良性のことが多いが巨大で気道閉塞を起こしやすく、出生時や胎児超音波検査で診断されることが多い。術前に1例が死亡し、手術関連死が2例発生した。残る6例は完全切除により良好な経過をたどり、3〜14年の追跡でも明らかな後遺症はみられなかった。
summary_en: This two-institution series from 1984 to 1996 describes nine neonates with congenital cervical teratoma, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. Lesions are usually histologically benign but large, often causing airway obstruction, and are often diagnosed at birth or prenatally by ultrasound. One infant died before surgery, one intraoperative and one postoperative death occurred, and the remaining six did well after complete surgical excision, with 3 to 14 years of follow-up. The authors also review malignant cervical teratomas with metastasis, which mostly occur in adults and carry a poor outcome.

title: Clues to the aetiological heterogeneity of testicular seminomas and non-seminomas: time trends and age-period-cohort effects.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマの病因的異質性：時代変化と年齢・時代・コホート効果
summary_ja: カナダ3州のがん登録データ（1970〜1995年、7296例）を用い、精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマの発症率推移を別々に解析した。両者とも増加したが、非セミノーマは91%増で若年男性（15〜19歳）に多く、セミノーマは高齢者で多かった。年齢・時代・コホートモデルではいずれも出生コホートによる変化が示され、病因の異質性が示唆された。
summary_en: Using cancer registry data from Ontario, Saskatchewan and British Columbia (1970 to 1995, 7296 testicular cancers), this study analyzed incidence trends of seminomas and non-seminomas separately. Both rose substantially, with non-seminomas increasing 91% and fourfold among 15 to 19-year-olds, while seminomas predominated in older men. Age-period-cohort modelling showed birth-cohort patterns for both, but with distinct age patterns. The authors conclude that the two histological types have different etiologies and recommend that epidemiological studies analyze them separately.

title: Primary yolk sac tumor of the rectum.
title_ja: 直腸原発卵黄嚢腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 23歳女性の直腸原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告した。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる4コースの化学療法後に外科的切除を行い、残存腫瘍は認められなかった。3.5年後も無病経過である。女性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の文献をレビューし、積極的な化学療法と手術により精巣がんに準じた治療が有効であると結論している。
summary_en: A 23-year-old woman with a yolk sac tumor arising in the rectum is described, a rare presentation since extragonadal germ cell tumors are seldom reported in women. She received four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, followed by surgical resection with no residual tumor, and remained disease free 3.5 years later. The authors review the literature on extragonadal germ cell tumors in females, noting that prior reports focus on children and predate cisplatin. They conclude that such tumors can be treated successfully with aggressive chemotherapy and surgery, similar to testis cancer.

title: A struma ovarii with increased serum basement membrane components: a case report.
title_ja: 血清基底膜成分の上昇を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 甲状腺組織からなる卵巣奇形腫である卵巣甲状腺腫の症例で、甲状腺機能亢進症と血清IV型コラーゲン・ラミニンの著明な高値を呈した。免疫染色では両成分が腫瘍の濾胞壁に局在した。血清値は摘出前に高く、術後に速やかに低下したことから、腫瘍自体が産生していると考えられた。甲状腺ホルモン過剰が基底膜の代謝回転を促す可能性も示唆している。
summary_en: This case report describes struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma composed of thyroid tissue, presenting with hyperthyroidism and markedly elevated serum type IV collagen and laminin. Immunohistochemistry localized both basement membrane components to the follicular walls of the tumor. Serum levels were high before removal and fell rapidly after surgery, suggesting that the tumor itself produces these proteins. The authors also propose that excess thyroid hormone may increase basement membrane turnover in various tissues.

title: Phase II study of bendamustine in patients with relapsed or cisplatin-refractory germ cell cancer.
title_ja: 再発またはシスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍に対するベンダムスチンの第II相試験
summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性または大量化学療法後に再発した胚細胞腫瘍19例を対象とした第II相試験である。対象の多くは大量化学療法と自家幹細胞支持を受けており、前治療として白金製剤の中央値9サイクルを投与されていた。奏効は部分奏効1例（持続6週間）のみで、毒性は軽度であった。臨床的に意味のある活性は乏しいと結論している。
summary_en: This phase II trial tested bendamustine, a bifunctional alkylating agent with partial cross-resistance to ifosfamide and cyclophosphamide, in 19 patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors or relapse after high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support. Patients had received a median of nine platinum-containing cycles before treatment. Only one partial response, lasting six weeks, was observed. Toxicity was low, with one grade 3 thrombocytopenia. The authors conclude that bendamustine has little or no clinically relevant activity in this setting.

title: Malignant ovarian tumors in children: 22 years of experience at a single institution.
title_ja: 小児の悪性卵巣腫瘍：単施設22年間の経験
summary_ja: 1975〜1997年に治療された小児の悪性卵巣腫瘍56例を単施設で検討した。最も多い組織型はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）であった。化学療法レジメンはVAC、PVB、BEPの順に変遷し、BEP療法群で全生存期間（全生存率）が最も良好（74.6%）であった。年齢と治療レジメンが予後因子で、進行例では治療強化や新たな治療法が必要と結論している。
summary_en: This single-institution review covers 56 children and adolescents with malignant ovarian tumors treated between 1975 and 1997, with dysgerminoma the most common type. Treatment evolved from VAC to PVB and then BEP chemotherapy, and the 22-year overall survival was 68%. Age and treatment protocol predicted survival, with BEP giving the best outcomes (74.6%). The authors conclude that intensified chemotherapy or new approaches are needed for advanced ovarian germ cell tumors.

title: Searching for safety signals: the experience of medical surveillance amongst men with testicular teratomas.
title_ja: 安全信号の探索：精巣奇形腫男性における医学的サーベイランスの経験
summary_ja: 病期I精巣奇形腫で監視療法を受けた25例と、進行例で化学療法を受けた22例の心理状態を比較した。不安スコアが境界域以上の割合は監視療法群で48%、化学療法群で27%と高かった。インタビュー分析から、監視中の患者は安全を示す信号を探し続ける傾向があることが示唆された。監視療法中の心理社会的支援の必要性を示している。
summary_en: This mixed-methods study compares psychological morbidity in men with stage 1 testicular teratoma managed by surveillance (n=25) with men who received chemotherapy for more advanced disease (n=22). Anxiety screening was higher in the surveillance group (48% versus 27% in the borderline or clinical range), and anxiety decreased as time since diagnosis increased.
