Transcriptomic analysis revealed more severe failure to silence pluripotency regulators in 129Sv testes. Several misregulated genes overlap with human testicular germ cell tumors. Nodal, Notch, and GDNF pathways were disrupted. Conditional Gfra1 deletion modestly increased tumor incidence, and ChIP-seq identified DMRT1 targets such as Esrrb, Nr5a2, and Sox2.

title: Placental site trophoblastic tumor, report of a case with unusual presentation.
title_ja: 非典型的な提示を呈した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の1例
summary_ja: 無月経15か月、子宮腫瘤、低値で横ばいのヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を呈した26歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の症例報告です。筋層が腫瘍に置換されていたため子宮全摘術が施行され、術後36か月まで補助療法なしで寛解を維持しました。低値で横ばいのhCGと無月経がある場合はPSTTを考慮すべきと述べています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with 15 months of amenorrhea, a large uterine mass, and a plateau of low-level serum hCG, leading to a diagnosis of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT). Because the myometrium was largely replaced by tumor, hysterectomy was performed despite her young age. She remained in remission 36 months postoperatively without adjuvant therapy. The authors suggest that low plateau hCG with amenorrhea should prompt consideration of PSTT, the rarest type of gestational trophoblastic tumor.

title: Epithelioid trophoblastic tumor: clinicopathologic and immunohistochemical analysis of three cases.
title_ja: 類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍：3症例の臨床病理学的および免疫組織化学的解析
summary_ja: 生殖年齢の女性3例の類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍を症例集積として検討した研究です。全例で不正性器出血と軽度のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)上昇がみられ、子宮全摘術が行われました。免疫組織化学では、サイトケラチン18、E-カドヘリン、EGFRなどが陽性で、α-インヒビンや胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼは概ね陰性でした。
summary_en: This case series analyzes three reproductive-age women with epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT). All presented with vaginal bleeding and mildly elevated hCG and underwent hysterectomy. The tumors comprised mononucleated epithelioid intermediate trophoblastic cells, and one case contained a focal choriocarcinoma component. Immunohistochemistry showed diffuse cytokeratin 18, E-cadherin, EGFR, and p53 positivity, with focal p63 and hCG positivity. Inhibin-alpha and placental alkaline phosphatase were largely negative. The findings help characterize this unusual trophoblastic tumor.

title: PARP expression in germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるPARP発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍124例(精巣114例、性腺外10例)でPARPを免疫組織化学的に評価し、正常精巣と比較しました。腫瘍ではPARPが有意に高発現で、セミノーマや胎児性癌で過剰発現が多く見られました。臨床変数との関連はなく、PARP阻害薬の標的候補として示唆されました。
summary_en: This translational study measured PARP expression by immunohistochemistry in 124 germ cell tumor specimens (114 testicular, 10 extragonadal) and compared them with normal testis. PARP was significantly higher in tumors than in normal tissue, with the highest expression in intratubular germ cell neoplasia and frequent overexpression in seminoma and embryonal carcinoma. Expression did not correlate with clinical variables. Based on this pilot study, the authors propose PARP as a potential target for PARP inhibitor therapy in germ cell tumors.

title: Anti-Ma-associated encephalitis due to dysgerminoma in a woman with Swyer syndrome.
title_ja: Swyer症候群の女性におけるディスジャーミノーマによる抗Ma関連脳炎
summary_ja: Swyer症候群(性腺形成不全)の女性で、性腺のディスジャーミノーマに関連した抗Ma関連の傍腫瘍性脳炎の症例報告です。抗Ma2抗体は従来、精巣がんや非小細胞肺がんと関連が知られていました。性腺が未発達でも、抗Ma脳炎では胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきと示唆されます。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman with Swyer syndrome (gonadal dysgenesis) who developed anti-Ma-associated paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis and diencephalitis caused by a gonadal dysgerminoma. Anti-Ma2 antibodies have previously been linked to testicular cancer and non-small-cell lung cancer. The report extends this paraneoplastic association to dysgerminoma arising in dysgenetic gonads, suggesting that germ cell tumors should be considered in patients with anti-Ma encephalitis even when the gonads are rudimentary.

title: Embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma arising from a mediastinal teratoma: an unusual case report.
title_ja: 縦隔奇形腫から発生した胎児性横紋筋肉腫：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 46歳男性の縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した胎児性横紋筋肉腫の症例報告です。外科的切除後にダクチノマイシン併用化学療法を施行しました。1年後のフォローアップCTで肺転移を認め、楔状切除を行いました。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍における悪性転化の例です。
summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old man with a 9.5 cm embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma arising from a mediastinal mature cystic teratoma, found after chest trauma. Complete surgical resection was followed by two cycles of dactinomycin-based chemotherapy. Lung metastasis appeared on follow-up CT a year later and was treated with wedge resection. Pathology of the metastasis matched the primary tumor. The case highlights malignant transformation within mediastinal germ cell tumors.

title: During twenty years of Cisplatin-based therapy the face of nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors is still changing: an evaluation of presentation, management, predictive factors and survival.
title_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法の20年間における非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の変化：臨床像、治療、予測因子、生存の評価
summary_ja: 1987年から2007年に精巣摘除術を受けた非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍147例を後方視的に検討しました。20年間で臨床病期Iでの診断が増え、化学療法が増加し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清は減少しました。生存は改善し、卵黄嚢成分の存在は無再発生存の改善と関連していました。
summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 147 patients undergoing orchiectomy for nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors (1987 to 2007) assessed how presentation and treatment changed over 20 years. Patients were increasingly diagnosed at clinical stage I, RPLND use declined while chemotherapy use rose, and survival improved, especially in disseminated disease. Yolk sac and teratoma elements predicted lower metastasis at diagnosis, and yolk sac elements were associated with better relapse-free survival.

title: The chemokine CXCL12 and its receptor CXCR4 are implicated in human seminoma metastasis.
title_ja: ケモカインCXCL12とその受容体CXCR4はヒトセミノーマの転移に関与する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒトセミノーマの転移におけるケモカインCXCL12とその受容体CXCR4を検討した。CXCL12はセルトリ細胞と腫瘍間質で検出され、CXCR4はセミノーマで正常精巣や非セミノーマより高値であった。腫瘍検体では、CXCR4シグナル分子との通常の相関が消失していた。CXCL12は、セミノーマ細胞株TCam-2の模擬基底膜を介した浸潤を誘導したが、非セミノーマ細胞株833keおよびNTera2/D1では誘導しなかった。著者らは、CXCL12がセミノーマの遊走と転移に選択的に影響する可能性があると結論づけている。
summary_en: This study examines the chemokine CXCL12 and its receptor CXCR4 in human seminoma metastasis. CXCL12 was detected in Sertoli cells and tumour stroma, while CXCR4 was elevated in seminoma relative to normal testis and non-seminoma. The usual correlation between CXCR4 signalling molecules was lost in tumour samples. CXCL12 induced invasion of seminoma cell line TCam-2 through simulated basement membrane but not non-seminoma lines 833ke or NTera2/D1. The findings suggest CXCL12 may selectively influence seminoma migration and metastasis.

title: Two cases of retroperitoneal metastasis from a completely regressed burned-out testicular cancer.
title_ja: 完全退縮した精巣がんから生じた後腹膜転移の2例
summary_ja: CTで後腹膜腫瘤を認めた2例では、精巣触診は正常だったが、陰嚢超音波検査で瘢痕・石灰化・結節が確認され、退縮した精巣原発セミノーマ(burned-out)と診断された。左精巣摘除術と化学療法後、現在無病である。後腹膜腫瘤を認めた場合は無症状でも精巣超音波検査を行うべきと提言している。
summary_en: Two patients presented with retroperitoneal masses on CT, with normal testicular examination. Scrotal ultrasound revealed scarring, calcification, and nodular lesions consistent with burned-out seminoma, a regressed primary testicular tumor. Both underwent left orchiectomy and chemotherapy and are currently disease-free. The authors argue that primary extragonadal germ cell tumors and testicular metastases must be distinguished, and recommend testicular ultrasonography for patients with retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy even when asymptomatic.

title: [A case of mediastinum malignant teratoma which recurred as bone metastases seven years after a resection, and survived for a long-duration].
title_ja: 縦隔悪性奇形腫が7年後に骨転移として再発し長期生存した1例
summary_ja: 縦隔悪性奇形腫(8×6cm)に対し術前PEB化学療法後、前縦隔腫瘍切除を施行した。術後も同療法を行った。7年後、腫瘍マーカーが正常にもかかわらず胸椎に骨転移が再発し、椎体切除と脊椎固定術を受けた。その後5年間再発なく生存している。腫瘍マーカーを産生しない奇形腫成分からの再発と考察している。
summary_en: A man with an 8×6 cm mediastinal malignant teratoma, classified as a malignant germ cell tumor, received preoperative PEB chemotherapy followed by anterior mediastinal resection. Tumor markers normalized, and he received the same chemotherapy postoperatively. Seven years later, bone metastases recurred despite normal tumor markers, requiring thoracic vertebra resection and spinal fusion. He has survived five years after surgery without further recurrence. The authors regard this as a rare recurrence from a teratoma component that did not produce tumor markers.

title: Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis: a cause of acute psychosis and catatonia.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎：急性精神病と緊張病の原因となる疾患
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の総説で、精神症状に始まり記憶障害、けいれん、運動異常、緊張病へと進行する多段階の経過を示す。女性に多く、約半数で卵巣奇形腫を合併する。治療はステロイドと免疫グロブリン静注が第一選択である。初診が精神科となることが多いため、精神病症状に神経症状を伴う場合は本疾患を考慮すべきと述べる。
summary_en: This review of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis describes its typical multistage course, from psychiatric onset (anxiety, mania, psychosis) to memory loss, seizures, dyskinesia and catatonia. It notes the disorder is more common in women, with about half of female patients harboring an underlying ovarian teratoma. Immunosuppression with steroids and IVIG is first-line. The authors stress that psychiatrists often see these patients first and should consider the diagnosis in new-onset psychosis with neurological features, illustrated by a 37-year-old woman case.

title: Should extragonadal germ cell tumors be included in studies of families with testicular germ cell tumors?
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の家族研究に含めるべきか
summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマを発症した24歳男性と、その二卵性双生児の兄弟で精巣セミノーマが見つかった症例を報告する。兄弟は精巣超音波検査で4.2cmの左精巣腫瘤を指摘され、精巣摘除術を受けた。性腺と性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍が血縁者で併存した報告は見当たらず、家族性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍研究に性腺外例を含めるべきか問題提起している。
summary_en: This report describes a 24-year-old man with a mediastinal seminoma diagnosed by image-guided biopsy, whose non-identical twin brother was found on elective testicular ultrasound to have a 4.2 cm left testicular seminoma, treated with orchiectomy. Because no prior study had reported gonadal and extragonadal germ cell tumors occurring together in relatives, the authors question whether extragonadal GCTs should be included in familial testicular GCT studies. They conclude that further investigation is warranted to clarify familial inheritance patterns.

title: Bilateral laparoscopic postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors--a comparison to template dissection.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後の両側と同側の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の比較
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を、同側郭清と初回両側郭清で比較した。手術時間は両側群で長い傾向だったが有意差はなく、合併症の頻度も同程度であった。再発率に有意差は認められなかった。両側郭清は後腹膜病変が広範な症例で腫瘍学的安全性が高く、罹患率は増加しないと結論している。
summary_en: This comparative study evaluates laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after platinum-based chemotherapy in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Nineteen patients underwent ipsilateral template dissection and 20 underwent primary bilateral dissection. Operative time was longer for bilateral dissection, though not significantly, and complication rates were similar. Recurrence rates did not differ significantly between groups. The authors conclude bilateral dissection offers added oncological safety, especially with extensive retroperitoneal disease, without greater morbidity.

title: Incidence, histology and management of intraluminal thrombus at post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清における管腔内血栓の発生率、組織像および管理
summary_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた240例を対象とした後方視的検討で、主要血管内の管腔内血栓を評価した。血栓は89例の98部位に生じ、下大静脈で最も多く、静脈切除、部分的静脈切除、血栓摘除または腎摘除により管理された。組織学的には、非腫瘍性血栓31例、壊死23例、奇形腫28例、活動性の胚細胞腫瘍12例であった。合併症は多く、2例の死亡を含んでいた。著者らは、外科医が血管外科の技術を備える必要性を強調している。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 240 patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection assessed intraluminal thrombus in major vessels. Thrombi occurred in 98 sites across 89 patients, most often in the inferior vena cava, and were managed with cavectomy, partial cavectomy, thrombectomy or nephrectomy. Histology showed bland thrombus in 31 cases, necrosis in 23, teratoma in 28 and active germ cell cancer in 12. Complications were substantial, including two deaths. The authors emphasize that surgeons need vascular surgical skills.

title: An intraocular yolk sac tumor in a child.
title_ja: 症例報告：小児における眼内卵黄嚢腫瘍の一例
summary_ja: 2歳女児の眼内卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。複数の施設で網膜芽細胞腫と誤診された。左眼球摘出術後に病理と免疫組織化学染色で卵黄嚢腫瘍と確定し、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を施行した。1年後のフォローアップでは良好な状態を保っている。石灰化を伴わない小児の眼内腫瘍では卵黄嚢腫瘍も鑑別に含めるべきと指摘する。
summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old girl whose intraocular tumor was initially misdiagnosed as retinoblastoma at several hospitals. After enucleation, pathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed a yolk sac tumor. She received bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy and remained in good health at one-year follow-up. The authors highlight that an intraocular tumor without calcification in a child may be a yolk sac tumor, and that enucleation followed by chemotherapy is a treatment option.

title: Microscopic dysgerminoma associated with anti-Ma2 paraneoplastic encephalitis in a patient with gonadal dysgenesis.
title_ja: 性腺異形成患者にみられた抗Ma2傍腫瘍性脳炎を伴う微小ディスジャーミノーマ
summary_ja: 性腺異形成（46,XY）の27歳女性が意識障害や幻視などで受診し、抗Ma2抗体陽性の傍腫瘍性脳炎と診断された。骨盤内腫瘤の病理では、間質線維化と異栄養性石灰化を背景とする微小なディスジャーミノーマの病巣が1か所のみ確認された。性腺異形成に抗Ma2傍腫瘍性脳炎とディスジャーミノーマを合併した初めての症例として、その病態を考察している。
summary_en: A 27-year-old woman with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis presented with encephalitis, and anti-Ma2 antibodies were positive. CT showed a pelvic mass, and histology revealed only a single microscopic focus of dysgerminoma within stromal fibrosis and dystrophic calcification; no ovarian or testicular tissue was identified. This is described as the first case of gonadal dysgenesis presenting with anti-Ma2 paraneoplastic encephalitis associated with dysgerminoma. The report discusses the paraneoplastic mechanism and the relationship between the antibody and the microscopic tumor.

title: Testicular cancer and cryptorchidism.
title_ja: 精巣がんと停留精巣
summary_ja: 停留精巣は男児に最も多い先天異常で、不妊症と精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の危険因子である。本総説では、精巣下降の制御機構を概説し、停留精巣に生じる腫瘍の多くがセミノーマであることを述べる。セミノーマや上皮内癌細胞が精原幹細胞マーカーを発現することから、成体幹細胞由来の可能性を検討している。成長因子発現の異常が幹細胞の腫瘍化を促す可能性を提案している。
summary_en: This review examines cryptorchidism, the most common congenital defect of the male genitalia, as a risk factor for infertility and testicular germ cell tumors. It describes the hormonal and genetic control of testicular descent and the predominance of seminoma among tumors arising in cryptorchid testes. The authors summarize evidence that spermatogonial stem cell markers are expressed in seminoma and carcinoma in situ cells, suggesting adult stem cell origin. Using mouse models and human data, they propose that dysregulated growth factor expression in the cryptorchid testicular niche may shift stem cells toward neoplastic transformation.

title: A rare adolescent case of female pseudohermaphroditism with adrenocortical carcinoma and synchronous teratoma.
title_ja: 副腎皮質癌および同時性奇形腫を合併した女性偽半陰陽の稀な思春期症例
summary_ja: 46,XXの女性偽半陰陽を有する12歳女児の症例です。左腹部の巨大腫瘤と肺転移、骨盤内腫瘤を認めました。腹部腫瘤は副腎皮質癌、骨盤内腫瘤は左卵巣由来の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されました。経カテーテル動脈化学塞栓術とミトタンによる治療を行いましたが、診断後8か月で死亡しています。これらの併存は過去に報告がないとされています。
summary_en: A 12-year-old Chinese girl with female pseudohermaphroditism (46,XX) presented with a large left abdominal mass with lung metastases and a concomitant pelvic mass. The abdominal mass proved to be adrenocortical carcinoma, and the pelvic mass a mature cystic teratoma of the left ovary. She received transcatheter arterial chemoembolization and mitotane but died eight months after diagnosis. The authors note that this combination of pseudohermaphroditism, ACC, and ovarian teratoma has not been reported before.

title: Incidental scintigraphic finding of ovarian teratoma containing normal thyroid tissue on post-radioactive iodine therapy for papillary thyroid cancer.
title_ja: 放射性ヨウ素治療後スキャンで偶発的に発見された、正常甲状腺組織を含む卵巣奇形腫
summary_ja: 甲状腺乳頭癌に対する放射性ヨウ素治療後のシンチグラフィで、卵巣に異常集積とサイログロブリン高値を認めました。転移性疾患が懸念されましたが、最終的に正常甲状腺組織を含む卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されています。非典型的な部位の集積が良性である場合があることを示す症例です。
summary_en: A patient treated with radioactive iodine for papillary thyroid cancer had an abnormal ovarian uptake on post-treatment scintigraphy with elevated thyroglobulin. The concern was metastatic disease, but the final diagnosis was an ovarian mature cystic teratoma containing normal thyroid tissue. The report highlights that atypical uptake sites can be benign, and that elevated thyroglobulin after surgery does not always indicate thyroid cancer spread.

title: Intraoral teratoma in a newborn presenting as severe respiratory distress.
title_ja: 重度の呼吸窮迫として発症した新生児の口腔内奇形腫
summary_ja: 出生直後の新生児女児で、口から突出した腫瘤と重度の呼吸窮迫のため気管挿管を要しました。硬口蓋由来の4×5cmの多小葉状腫瘤で、CTでは石灰化を伴い頭蓋内進展はありませんでした。出生前超音波検査は正常でした。完全切除の結果、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断されています。口腔内に生じた奇形腫の稀な症例です。
summary_en: A newborn girl presented immediately after birth with a mass protruding from the mouth and severe respiratory distress requiring intubation. The multilobulated 4 by 5 cm mass arose from the hard palate and had calcific areas on CT without intracranial extension. Prenatal ultrasonography had been normal. Complete excision was performed, and histopathology showed mature teratoma. The case is a rare presentation of teratoma in the oral cavity.

title: Embryonic carcinoma cells show specific dielectric resistance profiles during induced differentiation.
title_ja: 胚性癌細胞は分化誘導中に特異的な誘電抵抗プロファイルを示す
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胚性癌細胞株NT2の分化誘導過程を、電気細胞-基質インピーダンス測定法（ECIS）で誘電特性の変化としてリアルタイムに解析しています。レチノイン酸やヌクレオシド系薬剤により、24時間以内に濃度依存的な変化が検出されました。薬剤処理細胞のプロファイルはOCT4枯渇細胞に類似しており、OCT4低下が分化誘導の主因と示唆されています。分化療法の薬剤スクリーニングへの応用が期待されます。
summary_en: This study used electric cell-substrate impedance sensing to track real-time dielectric changes during differentiation of the embryonal carcinoma cell line NTERA-2 (NT2). Retinoic acid and nucleoside analogues such as 5-azacytidine and cytarabine induced concentration-dependent impedance changes detectable within 24 hours. Profiles from drug-treated cells closely resembled those from OCT4-depleted cells, suggesting OCT4 reduction drives drug-induced differentiation. The method enables label-free monitoring and may aid screening of differentiation therapy candidates.

title: Ovarectomy despite Negative Imaging in Anti-NMDA Receptor Encephalitis: Effective Even Late.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎における画像所見陰性の卵巣摘出術:遅れて行っても有効
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の34歳女性は、画像検査や腹腔鏡検査で卵巣奇形腫の所見が得られなかった。重篤な症状が持続したため卵巣摘出術が行われ、病理組織学的検査で潜在性の奇形腫が判明した。11か月の長期集中治療を要したが、症状は著明に改善した。著者らは、腫瘍の検索が不可欠であり、重篤な経過の後であっても奇形腫の切除は依然として有効であると結論づけている。
summary_en: A 34-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis had no imaging or laparoscopic evidence of an ovarian teratoma. Because her severe symptoms persisted, an ovariectomy was performed, and histopathology revealed an occult teratoma. Her condition improved markedly despite a prolonged 11-month intensive care course. The authors conclude that tumour search is essential, and that surgical removal can still be effective even after a long, severe course.

title: Hook wire localization for testis sparing surgery.
title_ja: 精巣温存手術のためのフックワイヤー局在化法
summary_ja: 20歳男性の両側精巣腫瘤の症例です。左精巣の小さな腫瘍をフックワイヤーで超音波ガイド下に局在化し、精巣温存手術を施行しました。右は精巣摘除術を行いました。病理は切除断端陰性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、術後に腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、フォローアップの超音波検査で左精巣は生存していました。
summary_en: A 20-year-old man with bilateral testicular masses and elevated AFP and beta-hCG underwent testis-sparing surgery for a small left testicular tumor. The team placed a hook wire through the tumor under on-table ultrasound guidance to localize it during testis delivery and cooling. Right orchiectomy was performed. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor with clear margins. Tumor markers normalized, testosterone was normal, and follow-up ultrasound showed a viable left testis. The authors conclude that wire localization facilitates controlled testis-sparing surgery in selected patients.

title: CA19-9 elevation in ovarian mature cystic teratoma: discrimination from ovarian cancer - CA19-9 level in teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫におけるCA19-9上昇：卵巣癌との鑑別
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)と卵巣癌(stage1または2)の女性322例を後方視的に検討した研究です。CA19-9上昇を伴うMCTは径が大きく脂肪成分を多く含みました。CA125とCA19-9の同時上昇は、単独のCA19-9上昇より悪性腫瘍の可能性が高いとされ、両者の併用はMCTと卵巣癌の鑑別に有用と考えられています。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 322 women with pathologically confirmed ovarian mature cystic teratoma (MCT) or ovarian cancer (stage 1 or 2) examined CA19-9 elevation. CA19-9-elevated MCTs were larger and more often contained fat. CA19-9 incidence did not differ between MCT and ovarian cancer, but mean CA19-9 levels were higher in ovarian cancer. Simultaneous elevation of CA125 and CA19-9 carried a markedly higher odds of malignancy than CA19-9 elevation alone. The authors suggest CA19-9, combined with CA125, can aid discrimination of MCT from ovarian cancer.

title: Ring chromosome 21 presenting with sacrococcygeal teratoma: prenatal diagnosis, molecular cytogenetic characterization and literature review.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫を呈したモザイク型r(21)染色体：出生前診断、分子細胞遺伝学的特徴および文献的考察
summary_ja: 本報告は、モザイク型r(21)を伴い出生前に仙尾部奇形腫が検出された胎児例を扱っています。周産期所見と分子細胞遺伝学的特徴を示し、胎児仙尾部奇形腫に関連する染色体異常について文献的に考察しています。モザイク型r(21)が胎児仙尾部奇形腫を呈した初めての報告とされています。
summary_en: This report describes a fetus prenatally diagnosed with a sacrococcygeal teratoma associated with mosaic ring chromosome 21, r(21). The authors present the perinatal findings and molecular cytogenetic characterization of the lesion. It is described as the first report of mosaic r(21) presenting with a fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma. The paper also discusses cytogenetic abnormalities associated with fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas and includes a literature review. Chromosomal analysis is thus relevant to the prenatal evaluation of such tumors.

title: Regulation network analysis of testicular seminoma at various stages of progression.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの進行に関する制御ネットワーク解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: NCBIの公開遺伝子発現データを用いて、病期の異なる精巣セミノーマ細胞の差次的発現遺伝子を解析した。40個の遺伝子を同定し、病期ごとの制御ネットワークを構築した。これらの遺伝子や経路がセミノーマの進行に関与すると結論づけている。解析は既存データを用いた計算研究である。
summary_en: This bioinformatics study analyzed publicly available NCBI gene expression data from human testicular seminoma cells at different stages. Forty differentially expressed genes were identified across stages, and regulatory networks were constructed to model disease progression. The authors conclude that these genes and pathways are involved in seminoma progression. Because testicular seminoma is the most common solid malignancy in men in their 20s, the findings may inform progression biology. The study is computational and relies on previously published expression datasets.

title: Germ-line DICER1 mutations do not make a major contribution to the etiology of familial testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 家族性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における生殖系列DICER1変異の検討
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 家族性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発端者43例を対象に、生殖系列のDICER1変異を解析した。既報の一塩基多型12個と新規変異2個が見つかったが、有害な変異やタンパク質を切断する変異はなかった。DICER1変異が病因に寄与する割合は限定的と結論づけている。
summary_en: This study screened germline DICER1 variants in 43 probands from families with familial testicular germ cell tumours using high-resolution melt analysis and Sanger sequencing. Twelve previously reported SNPs and two novel single nucleotide variants were found, but no likely deleterious or protein-truncating variants were identified. Combined with prior studies, the authors conclude that germline or somatic DICER1 mutations play a very limited role in the etiology of testicular germ cell tumours.

title: Malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors in children: a 30-year experience from a single institution.
title_ja: 小児の悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍：30年間の単施設経験
summary_ja: 1979～2009年に治療された小児の悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍58例を後方視的に解析した。全生存率は50.9%、無イベント生存率は43.8%だった。多変量解析ではαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値が最も強い予後因子であった。治療成績は文献報告より不良であった。
summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review analyzed 58 children with malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors treated between 1979 and 2009. Mean follow-up was 156 months. Overall and event-free survival were 50.9% and 43.8%. In univariate analysis, AFP status, extent of resection, coccygeal resection, chemotherapy protocol and number of courses affected event-free survival. Multivariate analysis identified AFP status as the strongest prognostic factor. Outcomes were worse than literature reports.

title: Primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) as somatic-type malignancy arising from an extragonadal germ-cell tumor: clinical, pathological and molecular features of a case.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍由来の体細胞型悪性腫瘍としての原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍：1症例の臨床・病理・分子学的特徴
summary_ja: 34歳男性で、10年前に右肩甲骨の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(奇形腫成分あり)を切除されていた。今回、腋窩の転移性小円形細胞腫瘍が体細胞型悪性腫瘍として確認された。染色体22転座を伴い原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍と判断された。エトポシド、シスプラチン、イホスファミドによる化学療法に当初反応したが、まもなく再発した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with a right axillary metastatic small round cell tumor representing a secondary somatic-type malignancy. Ten years earlier, he had been diagnosed with a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the scapula containing teratoma, which had been resected. The secondary tumor showed a distinct chromosome 22 translocation consistent with primitive neuroectodermal tumor. He initially responded well to etoposide, cisplatin, ifosfamide and mesna chemotherapy, but relapsed shortly afterward.

title: Testicular germ cell tumors: biology and clinical update.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍：生物学と臨床の最新動向
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、環境要因、感受性遺伝子、予後関連タンパク質などの最新知見をまとめたレビューである。早期セミノーマでは放射線療法の役割が縮小し、非セミノーマでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清が依然重要とする。進行例や白金製剤抵抗性例の課題も扱い、リスク層別化と治療最適化を論じている。
summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in testicular germ cell tumors, including environmental exposures such as metals and cannabinoids, genome-wide association studies identifying susceptibility variants, and prognostic protein expression. It discusses the declining role of radiotherapy for early-stage seminoma given platinum chemotherapy efficacy and radiation-related secondary malignancy risk. It also notes the continued importance of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminoma, and challenges in advanced and platinum-refractory disease, aiming to refine risk stratification and treatment.

title: Unspecific increase of tumor markers in a girl with nephrotic syndrome and ovarian teratoma.
title_ja: ネフローゼ症候群と卵巣奇形腫を合併した女児における非特異的な腫瘍マーカー上昇
summary_ja: 16歳女児で、ネフローゼ症候群、卵巣腫瘍、腫瘍マーカー高値を認めた症例報告である。当初は腫瘍随伴性を疑ったが、卵巣腫瘍切除後もネフローゼは寛解せず、腫瘍マーカーは高値のままだった。最終的に原発性メサンギウム増殖性糸球体腎炎と診断された。腫瘍マーカーの上昇は非特異的な可能性がある。
summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with nephrotic syndrome, an ovarian tumor and elevated tumor markers. Paraneoplastic nephrotic syndrome was initially suspected. After ovarian tumor resection, nephrotic syndrome did not remit, while tumor marker levels remained elevated. The final diagnosis was primary mesangial proliferative glomerulonephritis. The authors suggest that tumor marker elevation in nephrotic syndrome may be nonspecific, possibly stimulated by peritoneal mesothelium due to ascites.

title: Oncological outcomes in patients with stage I testicular seminoma and nonseminoma: pathological risk factors for relapse and feasibility of surveillance after orchiectomy.
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ患者の腫瘍学的転帰：精巣摘除術後の再発に関する病理学的危険因子とサーベイランスの実現可能性
summary_ja: 単施設の118例の病期Iセミノーマと40例の病期I非セミノーマを対象に、精巣摘除術後の再発に関する病理学的危険因子とサーベイランスの成績を検討した。両組織型でサーベイランスは実行可能と結論され、白膜浸潤やリンパ管・血管浸潤が再発リスクと関連する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This single-institution study of 118 stage I seminoma and 40 stage I nonseminoma patients evaluated pathological risk factors for relapse after orchiectomy and outcomes under surveillance. No cause-specific deaths occurred over roughly 8 to 9 years of follow-up. Relapse was uncommon in seminoma (1.7% after radiotherapy, 6.6% under surveillance; 10-year RFS 93.4% under surveillance), with tunica albuginea involvement showing a borderline trend toward poorer RFS. Nonseminoma relapsed in 22.5%, with lymphovascular invasion suggesting higher risk. The authors conclude surveillance is feasible for both histologies.

title: Germ cell tumor in an adolescent with extensive testicular microlithiasis: concerns regarding future management.
title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化を伴う思春期患者に発生した胚細胞腫瘍：今後の管理に関する懸念
summary_ja: 14歳男児の両側精巣微小石灰化と右精巣腫瘍の症例報告である。AFPとβ-hCGの上昇を認め、精巣摘除術で混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、転移は認めなかった。精巣微小石灰化患者のサーベイランスに関する小児の推奨は統一されておらず、文献的な管理法が検討されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old boy with bilateral testicular microlithiasis and a right testicular tumor. Elevated AFP and β-hCG led to orchiectomy, which revealed a mixed germ cell tumor with embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and mature teratoma, without evidence of metastatic disease. The authors highlight the strong association between testicular microlithiasis and testicular tumors and note that pediatric surveillance recommendations vary. They review the literature on managing pediatric patients with testicular microlithiasis to inform future decisions.

title: Stage I testicular seminoma: a SEER analysis of contemporary adjuvant radiotherapy trends.
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対する補助放射線療法の動向：SEER解析
summary_ja: SEERデータベースの8,151例の臨床病期I精巣セミノーマを対象に、補助放射線療法の実施動向を解析した。実施率は2000年の74.7%から2009年の37.7%へ低下し、35歳以上や社会経済的地位の高い患者で実施率が高かった。近年はサーベイランスの選択が増えていることを反映している。
summary_en: This SEER registry analysis of 8,151 men diagnosed with clinical stage I testicular seminoma from 2000 to 2009 examined trends in adjuvant radiotherapy use. Radiotherapy use fell sharply, from 74.7% in 2000 to 37.7% in 2009, with later diagnosis year strongly associated with lower odds of receipt. Men aged 35 or older and those in the highest socioeconomic quartile were more likely to receive radiotherapy. The authors attribute the decline to accumulating evidence favoring surveillance, given high cure rates even with relapse.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma - case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 26歳の患者が腹痛で受診し、画像検査で5cmの仙骨前嚢胞を認めた。腹腔鏡下に切除し、病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫と確定した。術後経過は良好であった。仙尾部奇形腫の標準的な治療指針は確立されておらず、解剖学的条件に応じた腹腔鏡手術の実施可能性が示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old patient with abdominal pain and a 5 cm presacral cyst identified on imaging, including ultrasound, CT, and MRI. Laparoscopic removal was performed, and histopathological examination confirmed a mature teratoma with an uneventful postoperative course. The authors note that presacral tumors are rare, difficult to distinguish from ovarian cystic lesions, and lack firm guidelines. They conclude that surgery can be performed laparoscopically, with the approach chosen according to anatomical conditions.

title: The WHO score predicts treatment outcome in low risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients treated with weekly intramuscular methotrexate.
title_ja: 低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍において、WHOスコアは週1回筋注メトトレキサート治療の転帰を予測する
summary_ja: 2001〜2009年に低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の女性66例に週1回筋注メトトレキサートを施行した研究。評価可能な54例中79.6%が完全寛解し、化学療法開始前のWHOスコアが低いほど良好な治療成績と関連した。治療抵抗例にはアクチノマイシンDが有効で、本レジメンの有効性と安全性が示された。
summary_en: This study of 66 women with low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) evaluated weekly intramuscular methotrexate (40 mg/m²) as first-line therapy, monitored by serum β-hCG. Complete remission occurred in 79.6% of the 54 evaluable patients, while 11 were resistant. Eighteen patients switched to actinomycin-D, and 16 of them responded. The mean pretreatment WHO score differed significantly between responders and resistant patients, and a lower score predicted better outcome. The authors recommend this regimen as effective and safe.

title: Tall cell variant of papillary carcinoma arising from strumaovarii: a rare case report.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫由来の乳頭癌の高細胞変異型：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 40歳女性に発生した卵巣甲状腺腫由来の高細胞変異型乳頭癌の症例報告。卵巣甲状腺腫は甲状腺組織が主成分となる奇形腫の一型で、その内部に生じる乳頭癌は極めてまれである。高細胞変異型の報告は従来なく、卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性転化に関する限られた文献を補うものである。
summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with a tall cell variant of papillary carcinoma arising in a struma ovarii, a teratoma subtype in which thyroid tissue is the predominant component. Papillary carcinoma within struma ovarii is exceptionally rare, and a tall cell variant had not previously been reported in this setting. The report documents this unusual combination and adds to the limited literature on malignant transformation of struma ovarii.

title: Molecular characteristics of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors and comparison with testicular counterparts: implications for pathogenesis.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子特性と精巣胚細胞腫瘍との比較：発生機序への示唆
summary_ja: 希少な悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子特性と発生経路をまとめた総説。ディスジャーミノーマは精巣胚細胞腫瘍と類似のゲノム異常を示す一方、卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫は互いに異なるプロファイルを持つ。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍は精巣腫瘍と共通する経路を含む複数の経路で発生し、原始胚細胞に類似すると考えられる。
summary_en: This review summarizes the molecular characteristics and developmental origins of rare malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (mOGCTs). It covers genomic aberrations, mRNA and miRNA expression profiles, and biomarkers for each histological subtype: dysgerminoma, yolk sac tumor, and immature teratoma. Dysgerminomas share genomic aberrations with testicular germ cell tumors, whereas yolk sac tumors and immature teratomas differ from each other and from testicular tumors. The authors propose that mOGCTs arise through multiple developmental pathways, including one shared with testicular tumors, and resemble primordial germ cells.

title: Congenital malformations and testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 先天性奇形と精巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: スウェーデンの住民ベース症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍6,593例と対照を比較した。停留精巣（OR 3.18）に加え、尿道下裂、鼠径ヘルニア、その他の生殖器奇形もリスク増加と関連し、相互調整後も持続した。非生殖器奇形は関連を示さず、泌尿生殖器発生に影響する出生前曝露がTGCTリスクに関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This Swedish population-based case-control study linked national cancer and hospital registries to examine birth defects in 6,593 testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) cases and matched controls. Beyond the known association with cryptorchidism (OR 3.18), hypospadias, inguinal hernia, and other genital malformations were associated with increased TGCT risk. These associations persisted after mutual adjustment, whereas nongenital malformations were not associated. The authors suggest that prenatal exposures affecting urogenital development contribute to TGCT risk.

title: Sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumor developing after teratoma: a clinicopathological study of pediatric sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors and a proposal of the pathogenesis of sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumors.
title_ja: 奇形腫切除後に発生した仙尾部卵黄嚢腫瘍：小児仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍の臨床病理学的検討と発生機序に関する提案
summary_ja: 日本の10施設における小児仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍289例の後方視的解析。仙尾部奇形腫切除後に卵黄嚢腫瘍が13例（5.4%）で5〜30か月後に発生し、初回手術時に顕微鏡的YSTを伴わない成熟奇形腫だった例も含まれた。AFPを4か月以内の間隔で測定することで無症候性の局所性YSTを検出でき、切除後3年以上は3か月ごとの監視を推奨する。
summary_en: This retrospective multicenter study of 289 Japanese children with sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors (SGCTs) identified 13 yolk sac tumors (YSTs) arising after sacrococcygeal teratoma resection, detected 5 to 30 months later. Many of these patients were neonates at initial surgery, and nine had mature teratoma without microscopic YST foci. Serum AFP measured at intervals of 4 months or less helped detect subclinical localized YSTs. The authors recommend AFP monitoring every 3 months for at least 3 years after resection.

title: The search for biomarkers of metastatic seminoma.
title_ja: 転移性セミノーマのバイオマーカー探索
summary_ja: 純粋型セミノーマ527例を対象に、90以上の候補因子(臨床・病理・腫瘍マーカー)を解析し、転移性セミノーマのバイオマーカーを探索した。腫瘍径や血管・リンパ管侵襲などの既知の危険因子が転移と関連し、LDH・hCG・AFPも関連を示した。単独では判別能は限定的だったが、酵素値により一部の転移例を高い陽性的中率で検出できた。
summary_en: This study of 527 men with pure seminoma screened over 90 candidate parameters, including clinical, histopathological and tumor marker data, to identify biomarkers of metastatic seminoma. Established risk factors such as tumor size, lymphovascular invasion and tunica albuginea infiltration were significantly associated with metastasis, as were absence of testicular intraepithelial neoplasia, testicular and tumor volume, and LDH, hCG and AFP. Individually, markers had limited discriminatory capacity (up to 65%), although enzyme measurements identified a small metastatic subset with high positive predictive value. Prospective validation is recommended.

title: Postoperative radiotherapy for residual tumor of primary mediastinal carcinoid teratoma.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔カルチノイド奇形腫の残存腫瘍に対する術後放射線療法
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、大動脈弓に接する前縦隔腫瘤を有し不完全切除された36歳女性を記述している。組織学的にはカルチノイドを含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。切除後の残存腫瘍に対し、25分割で50 Gyの術後放射線療法が施行された。2年間のフォローアップで病勢は安定していた。著者らは、50 Gyの補助放射線療法が縦隔カルチノイド奇形腫の残存腫瘍に有効であると結論づけている。縦隔における胚細胞腫瘍の管理に関連する報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with an anterior mediastinal mass involving the aortic arch, resected incompletely. Histology showed a mature cystic teratoma containing a carcinoid. Postoperative radiotherapy of 50 Gy in 25 fractions was delivered to the residual tumor. At two years of follow-up, the disease was stable. The authors conclude that adjuvant radiotherapy at 50 Gy is an effective approach for residual mediastinal carcinoid teratoma. The report is relevant to germ cell tumor management in the mediastinum.

title: Immature ovarian teratoma with unusual gliomatosis.
title_ja: 異常な腹膜神経膠腫症を伴う未熟卵巣奇形腫
summary_ja: 31歳女性が16歳時に未熟卵巣奇形腫を発症し、外科的に摘出された。6年後に対側卵巣に成熟グリア組織の播種が出現し、その後腹膜にも病変が生じた。播種は計3回の外科的切除後も再発を繰り返した。免疫組織化学では両者でGFAPとS100が陽性であった。播種は再発リスクが高いため、綿密なフォローアップが必要と結論づけている。
summary_en: A 31-year-old woman developed an immature ovarian teratoma at age 16, which was surgically removed. Six years later, mature glial implants appeared on the contralateral ovary, followed by peritoneal involvement, a rare presentation of gliomatosis peritonei. The implants relapsed repeatedly despite three further surgical resections. Immunohistochemistry showed GFAP and S100 expression in both the teratoma and the implants, while EMA and CK34betaE12 were expressed only in the teratoma. The authors emphasize the high relapse risk of mature glial implants and the need for close follow-up.

title: Neoadjuvant carboplatin before radiotherapy in stage IIA and IIB seminoma.
title_ja: 病期IIAおよびIIBのセミノーマに対する放射線療法前のネオアジュバント・カルボプラチン
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの病期IIAまたはIIBの51例を対象とした単群研究。放射線療法に先立ちカルボプラチンを1コース投与し、照射野を傍大動脈領域に縮小した。39例では線量も35Gyから30Gyに減量された。中央値55か月の観察期間中に再発例はなく、毒性は低かった。再発リスク低減と照射野縮小の可能性が示唆されている。
summary_en: This single-arm study treated 51 patients with stage IIA or IIB testicular seminoma using one cycle of neoadjuvant carboplatin followed by radiotherapy. The radiation field was reduced from an extended abdominopelvic field to the para-aortic region, and the dose was lowered from 35 Gy to 30 Gy in 39 patients. After a median follow-up of 55 months, no relapses were observed, with a 5-year relapse-free survival estimated at 93% to 100%. Toxicity was low, with no grade 4 events. The authors suggest the approach may reduce recurrence risk and allow smaller fields, warranting further study.

title: Congenital proptosis secondary to orbital teratoma. Clinicopathological study.
title_ja: 眼窩奇形腫に続発する先天性眼球突出：臨床病理学的研究
summary_ja: 新生児男児にみられた右眼球突出の症例報告。眼窩内の眼球後方腫瘤が原因で、角膜潰瘍・穿孔、虹彩脱出、全眼筋麻痺などを伴っていた。病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。先天性眼窩奇形腫は極めて稀であり、眼窩原発腫瘍を伴う先天性病変の鑑別に含めるべきと提言している。
summary_en: A newborn boy presented with right proptosis caused by a retro-ocular mass, along with corneal ulceration and perforation, iris herniation, total ophthalmoplegia, chemosis, and eyelid retraction. Histopathology confirmed a mature teratoma. The authors review that teratomas are tumors composed of mixtures of mature tissues from the three germ layers, and note that congenital orbital teratomas are very rare. They recommend including orbital teratoma in the differential diagnosis of congenital orbital masses with a primary tumor in the orbit.

title: Acute cord compression secondary to spinal relapse of testicular seminomas.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの脊椎再発による急性脊髄圧迫
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ病期Iで根治的精巣摘除と後腹膜照射を受けた38歳男性が、術後14か月で胸椎T8の単独再発による急性脊髄圧迫を呈した。減圧椎弓切除と固定術を行い、補助化学放射線療法を実施した。完全な神経回復が得られ、4年間無病で経過している。精巣セミノーマの脊椎再発は稀で、腰椎に多いことや疼痛で発症することが多いことを指摘している。
summary_en: A 38-year-old man with pure stage I testicular seminoma, treated by radical orchidectomy and adjuvant retroperitoneal irradiation, presented 14 months later with acute cord compression from an isolated T8 spinal relapse. Decompressive laminectomy with instrumentation was performed, followed by adjuvant chemoradiotherapy. The patient achieved full neurological recovery and has remained disease-free for four years. The authors note that testicular seminoma rarely relapses in the spine, usually in the lumbar region, and that spinal relapse often presents with pain rather than acute cord compression. They also review the literature on isolated thoracic relapse.

title: Evidence supporting the existence of benign teratomas of the postpubertal testis: a clinical, histopathologic, and molecular genetic analysis of 25 cases.
title_ja: 思春期後の精巣における良性奇形腫の存在を支持する証拠：25例の臨床・病理組織学・分子遺伝学的解析
summary_ja: 思春期後の精巣に生じた良性と思われる奇形腫25例の解析。類皮嚢腫10例と非類皮性奇形腫15例を含む。細胞異型、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍、12番染色体短腕の異常はいずれも認められなかった。追跡可能な17例は全例生存していた。悪性の可能性がある通常型とは区別して分類すべきと主張している。
summary_en: This study describes 25 apparently benign teratomas of the postpubertal testis, including 10 dermoid cysts and 15 nondermoid teratomas, in patients aged 12 to 59 years. Squamous cysts, ciliated epithelium, and smooth muscle were common, and no cytologic atypia, intratubular germ cell neoplasia, or chromosome 12p abnormality was found. All 17 patients with follow-up were alive, though 6 lacked confirmed disease-free status. The authors argue for recognizing these benign teratomas as a distinct category separate from postpubertal teratomas, which carry malignant potential.

title: Use of radiofrequency ablation for controlling liver hemorrhage in the emergency setting; report of two cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 救急時の肝出血制御における高周波アブレーションの使用：2症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 救急開腹術で大量出血を制御するために高周波アブレーションを用いた2症例の報告。1例は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の肝転移の自然破裂、もう1例はGrade IVの鈍的肝外傷であった。従来の止血法と併用して両例で出血を制御できた。術後の再出血やRF関連の合併症は認められなかった。出血性肝腫瘍では同時性腫瘍の切除にも役立つ可能性が示唆されている。
summary_en: The authors report two emergency laparotomy cases in which radiofrequency ablation was used to control massive intraoperative hemorrhage. One case involved spontaneous rupture of a liver metastasis from a testicular germ cell tumor, and the other was a grade IV blunt liver trauma. Combined with conventional hemostatic techniques, RF ablation effectively controlled bleeding in both cases. No recurrent hemorrhage or RF-related complications occurred postoperatively. The authors suggest RF ablation is an effective hemostatic strategy and may also help with synchronous tumor elimination in bleeding liver tumors.

title: Ovarian cysts and tumors in infancy and childhood.
title_ja: 乳児期および小児期の卵巣嚢腫と卵巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 3日齢から12歳までの女児49例の卵巣嚢腫・卵巣腫瘍を後方視的に検討した。良性14例、悪性33例であった。悪性腫瘍ではディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が40%と最多で、悪性奇形腫が16.6%であった。主訴は疼痛と腹部腫瘤が多かった。予後は腫瘍の大きさ、病期、組織型に依存し、温存手術と多職種管理が良好な結果につながると結論づけている。
summary_en: A retrospective study of 49 girls aged 3 days to 12 years with ovarian cysts or tumors. Fourteen had benign and 33 had malignant tumors, and one had bilateral ovarian non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Dysgerminoma was the most common malignant tumor at 40%, followed by malignant teratoma at 16.6%. Pain and an abdominal lump were the most common presenting symptoms. Prognosis depended on tumor size, stage, and histology. The authors conclude that conservative surgery should be the aim and that multidisciplinary management gives good outcomes.

title: Mutations in LRRC50 predispose zebrafish and humans to seminomas.
title_ja: LRRC50の変異はゼブラフィッシュとヒトにおけるセミノーマの素因となる
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、繊毛機能に関わるLRRC50がセミノーマの新たな素因遺伝子であることを示した。ヘテロ接合性ナンセンス変異をもつゼブラフィッシュはセミノーマを高頻度で発症し、腫瘍進行に伴い野生型アレルのLOHが認められた。家族性セミノーマ家系ではLRRC50の生殖系列変異が見つかり、Thr590Metは機能喪失型変異と確認された。LRRC50は腫瘍抑制因子として働く可能性がある。
summary_en: This study identifies LRRC50, a gene previously linked to ciliary function, as a novel predisposition gene for seminoma. Zebrafish carrying a heterozygous lrrc50 nonsense mutation developed seminomas frequently, and many tumors lost the wild-type allele as they progressed. In human families with seminoma, germline LRRC50 variants, including Arg488* and Thr590Met, reduced wild-type expression in tumors, and Thr590Met was shown to be loss-of-function in zebrafish. A pathogenic Gln307Glu variant was enriched among seminoma patients. The authors propose LRRC50 as a tumor suppressor and zebrafish as a seminoma model.

title: Post-orchidectomy retroperitoneal seminoma: A case report.
title_ja: 精巣摘除後に発症した後腹膜セミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 38歳男性が腹痛を契機に受診し、後腹膜セミノーマと診断された。10年前に停留精巣に対して右精巣摘除術を受けており、当時の病理では良性の炎症性腫瘤と報告されていた。性腺外後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍が後腹膜原発か精巣腫瘍の転移かという長年の議論を踏まえた症例報告である。
summary_en: A 38-year-old man presented with abdominal pain and was diagnosed with retroperitoneal seminoma. Ten years earlier, he had undergone right orchidectomy via the inguinal route for an undescended testis, and the histology at that time was reported as a benign inflammatory mass. The case is presented in the context of a long-debated question: whether extragonadal retroperitoneal germ cell tumors develop primarily in the retroperitoneum or represent metastases from a testicular primary. The authors use this case to discuss that controversy.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome: Brief communication and algorithm for management.
title_ja: growing teratoma syndrome：簡潔な報告と管理アルゴリズム
journal: Aust N Z J Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の女性5例を報告し、growing teratoma syndromeの臨床的特徴を検討した。全身化学療法中またはその後に、腫瘍マーカーが正常化しているにもかかわらず、成熟奇形腫に一致する腫瘤が出現した。本症候群を認識することで不要な化学療法を避けられるとして、管理の推奨事項と管理アルゴリズムを提示している。
summary_en: This brief communication reports five women with ovarian germ cell tumours who developed growing teratoma syndrome during or after systemic chemotherapy. Their tumor markers had normalized, yet they presented with a mass histologically consistent with mature teratoma. The authors stress that recognizing this syndrome is essential to avoid unnecessary chemotherapy and to guide optimal management. They illustrate the clinical dilemmas encountered and provide recommendations along with a proposed management algorithm to support clinicians facing this rare condition in practice.

title: Metachronous bilateral ovarian teratoma: a germ-line familial disorder and review of surgical management options.
title_ja: 異時性両側性卵巣奇形腫：生殖系列の家族性疾患と外科的管理の選択肢の検討
summary_ja: 女児に、初回の卵巣奇形腫から6年後に新たな卵巣奇形腫が生じた。これは極めてまれな異時性両側性の経過である。家族内の他の成員にも生殖系列の異常がみられ、胚細胞病変に対する遺伝的あるいは環境的な感受性の存在が示唆された。外科的管理の選択肢を検討し、患者と家族に対する適切なフォローアップの重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This report describes a girl who developed a second ovarian teratoma six years after the first, a very rare metachronous bilateral presentation. Germline anomalies were also observed in other family members, suggesting genetic or environmental susceptibility to germ cell lesions. The authors review surgical management options for these tumors and stress the importance of appropriate long-term follow-up for the patient and her family.

title: Ovarian mixed germ cell tumor with yolk sac and teratomatous components in a dog.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢成分と奇形腫成分を伴う犬の卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 3歳の未避妊雌のラブラドール・レトリーバーで、直径23cmの左卵巣腫瘍と腹膜の多発病変が認められた。組織学的に卵黄嚢成分と奇形腫成分を伴う混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。奇形腫成分では神経分化が主体で、腹腔内転移は卵黄嚢成分のみから成っていた。獣医領域でまれな卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の病理像と免疫組織化学的特徴を報告している。
summary_en: A 3-year-old intact female Labrador Retriever presented with a 23 cm left ovarian tumor and multiple peritoneal and diaphragmatic masses. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor with yolk sac and teratomatous components, the latter showing predominantly neural differentiation. The abdominal metastases consisted only of the yolk sac component, which was positive for cytokeratin and alpha-fetoprotein. The report documents a rare ovarian mixed germ cell tumor in a veterinary species and characterizes it immunohistochemically.

title: Clinical features, presentation, and tolerance of platinum-based chemotherapy in germ cell tumor patients 50 years of age and older.
title_ja: 50歳以上の胚細胞腫瘍患者における臨床的特徴、初診時の表現および白金製剤併用化学療法の忍容性
summary_ja: 施設コホートの4235例のうち、50歳以上は5.6%のみで、この年代ではセミノーマが非セミノーマより多かった。化学療法を受けた50例中30例で中止・遅延・変更が生じ、44%が好中球減少性発熱を来した。化学療法患者の5年生存率は84.9%で、リスクに応じた根治的治療により予後は良好であった。
summary_en: This single-center study of 4235 germ cell tumor diagnoses found that only 5.6% occurred at age 50 or older, a group in which seminoma was more common than nonseminoma. Testicular primaries predominated, with more retroperitoneal tumors than in younger men. Among 50 older men receiving platinum-based chemotherapy, 30 had complications leading to discontinuation, delay, or regimen change, and 44% developed neutropenic fever despite growth factor support. Five-year survival among treated patients was 84.9%, indicating an excellent prognosis with risk-directed curative treatment.

title: Synchronous ovarian dysgerminoma and breast carcinoma in a patient with positive immunostain of BRCA1.
title_ja: BRCA1免疫染色陽性を示した同時性卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と乳癌の1例
summary_ja: 46歳女性に生じた同時性の原発性卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と乳癌の症例報告である。両腫瘍の併存は極めてまれである。免疫組織化学では、エストロゲン受容体・プロゲステロン受容体・HER2が陰性で、p53とBRCA1が陽性であった。BRCA1変異との関連から遺伝カウンセリングの必要性が指摘されている。各手術後の経過は良好で、患者は退院した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old woman with a synchronous primary ovarian dysgerminoma and primary breast carcinoma. The two tumors were identified together, a combination that is rare because dysgerminoma accounts for under 1% of ovarian cancers. Immunohistochemistry showed negative estrogen and progesterone receptors and absent HER2/neu expression, with positive p53 and BRCA1 staining. Given the association of breast and ovarian cancer with BRCA1 mutations, the authors highlight the need for genetic counseling. Postoperative recovery was favorable after each surgery, and the patient was discharged.

title: Congenital orbital teratoma.
title_ja: 先天性眼窩奇形腫
summary_ja: 先天性眼窩奇形腫の新生児例の症例報告である。出生時に右眼球脱出と囊胞性腫瘤を認めた。眼瞼温存眼球内容除去術を施行し、病理組織学的に三胚葉由来の成熟奇形腫と確認された。鼠径部からの真皮脂肪移植により眼窩再建を行い、良好な結果を得た。
summary_en: This case report describes a full-term infant born in Fiji with a prolapsed right globe surrounded by a cystic orbital mass. Imaging was consistent with congenital orbital teratoma, and the infant was transferred to Australia for care. Lid-sparing exenteration with frozen-section control of the apical margin was performed, and a groin dermal fat graft was used for socket reconstruction. Histopathology confirmed mature teratoma with tissues from all three germ layers. The authors report successful reconstruction with dermal fat grafting after lid-sparing exenteration.

title: Salvage chemotherapy with docetaxel, ifosfamide and nedaplatin (DIN) for patients with advanced germ cell tumors: a preliminary report.
title_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍に対する救援化学療法としてのドセタキセル・イホスファミド・ネダプラチン（DIN）療法の予備報告
summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後に治療抵抗性または再発した進行胚細胞腫瘍11例に対する、DIN救援化学療法の予備報告である。奏効率は91%で、81%が外科的切除後に無病生存を維持した。グレード4の白血球減少が高頻度にみられたが、顆粒球コロニー刺激因子で管理された。有効かつ忍容性の良い治療と結論づけられている。
summary_en: This preliminary report evaluates docetaxel, ifosfamide and nedaplatin (DIN) as salvage chemotherapy in 11 patients with advanced germ cell tumors refractory or relapsed after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Ten patients (91%) responded, with one complete and nine partial responses. Nine patients (81%) remained disease-free after subsequent surgical resection, with median follow-up of 52 months. Grade 4 leukopenia occurred in 91%, managed with G-CSF. No sensory neuropathy or renal dysfunction was seen, and the authors conclude the regimen is efficacious and well tolerated.

title: Survival after a diagnosis of testicular germ cell cancers in Germany and the United States, 2002-2006: a high resolution study by histology and age.
title_ja: 2002〜2006年のドイツおよび米国における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生存率：組織型および年齢別の高解像度研究
summary_ja: 2002〜2006年のドイツと米国の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象に、組織型・年齢別の5年相対生存率を推定した大規模な登録データ研究である。両国の生存率はほぼ同等で、全体で約96〜97%であった。セミノーマは良好で、非セミノーマは低く、絨毛癌が最も低かった。非セミノーマでは高齢診断ほど予後が不良であった。
summary_en: This study estimated age- and histology-specific five-year relative survival for testicular germ cell cancer patients in Germany and the United States, using registry data from 2002–2006. Survival was similar between countries, at about 96–97% overall. Seminoma and spermatocytic seminoma had excellent outcomes, while nonseminomas fared worse. Choriocarcinoma had the lowest survival, around 80%. Older age at diagnosis was associated with poorer prognosis among nonseminoma patients, particularly those with malignant teratoma.

title: Second to fourth digit ratio, handedness and testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 第2指と第4指の指長比、利き手および精巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 米国の兵役者を対象に、指長比（2D:4D）や利き手と精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクとの関連を検討した症例対照研究である。症例246例と対照236例の解析では、有意な関連は認められなかった。胎生期のホルモン環境が発症に関与するという仮説は支持されなかったが、症例数が限られるため、より大規模な研究が必要とされている。
summary_en: This case-control study examined whether second-to-fourth digit ratio, its right-minus-left difference, and handedness are associated with testicular germ cell tumor risk among U.S. servicemen. Analyses of 246 cases and 236 controls found no significant association for digit ratios or left-hand dominance. The authors conclude that the results do not support the hypothesis that prenatal hormonal imbalance contributes to TGCT risk, while noting limited sample size and recommending larger studies.

title: Persistent CD30 expression by embryonal carcinoma in the treatment time course: prognostic significance of a worthwhile target for personalized treatment.
title_ja: 化学療法の経過を通じた胎児性癌におけるCD30の持続的発現：治療標的としての予後的意義
summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後の残存腫瘍で、胎児性癌や混合型胚細胞腫瘍のCD30発現を検討した研究である。強力な前治療後も71%の症例でCD30陽性が維持されており、治療標的として有望と考えられる。CD30陽性は無増悪生存期間と全生存期間の独立した不良予後因子であった。
summary_en: This study assessed CD30 expression in post-chemotherapy residual tumors from patients with pure embryonal carcinoma or mixed germ cell tumor treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. CD30 remained positive in 71% of cases, even after intensive treatment, supporting its use as a therapeutic target. Persistent CD30 positivity was an independent adverse prognostic factor for progression-free and overall survival, particularly in patients with multiple relapses or chemoresistant disease.

title: MicroRNA-302a sensitizes testicular embryonal carcinoma cells to cisplatin-induced cell death.
title_ja: マイクロRNA-302a（miR-302a）は精巣胎児性癌細胞のシスプラチン誘導性細胞死への感受性を高める
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌由来の細胞株NT2およびNCCITにおいて、マイクロRNA（miRNA）のmiR-302aがシスプラチン感受性を高めることを示した研究である。シスプラチン処理によりmiR-302aの発現が上昇し、G2/M期停止とアポトーシスが促進された。p21の抑制が一部関与し、p53の抑制で効果が増強された。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の新たな治療標的となる可能性がある。
summary_en: This study shows that miR-302a increases the sensitivity of testicular embryonal carcinoma cell lines NT2 and NCCIT to cisplatin. miR-302a is upregulated by cisplatin treatment and enhances G2/M arrest and apoptosis. The effect is partly mediated by downregulation of p21, and is further enhanced by p53 silencing. Targeting miR-302a may offer a new therapeutic approach for testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Interferon-α Treatment for Growing Teratoma Syndrome of the Testis.
title_ja: 精巣の growing teratoma syndrome に対するインターフェロンα治療
summary_ja: 精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍（未熟奇形腫と胎児性癌）と後腹膜・肺転移をもつ23歳男性の症例報告である。BEP療法と救援化学療法（VIP）を行ったが、growing teratoma syndromeを伴い進行した。インターフェロンα療法により腫瘍増大は緩やかになり、肺転移も安定した。16か月後も生存していた。
summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor (immature teratoma and embryonal carcinoma) and retroperitoneal and pulmonary metastases. He received BEP and then salvage VIP chemotherapy, but disease progressed with growing teratoma syndrome. Treatment with natural interferon-alpha stabilized the lung metastases and slowed tumor growth, and the patient was alive and well at 16 months.

title: An alkylphenol mix promotes seminoma derived cell proliferation through an ERalpha36-mediated mechanism.
title_ja: アルキルフェノール混合物はERα36を介してセミノーマ由来細胞の増殖を促進する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 4-tert-オクチルフェノールと4-ノニルフェノールの混合物が、精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞の増殖を促進する機序を検討した研究である。セミノーマ由来のTCam-2細胞では、ERα36を介した非ゲノム経路でCREBが活性化し、DNAメチル基転移酵素3（Dnmt3）遺伝子群の発現が変化した。胎児性癌細胞株や異種移植腫瘍でも増殖が確認され、内分泌攪乱物質への曝露と精巣がんの進展との関連を示唆する。
summary_en: This study examined how a mixture of 4-tert-octylphenol and 4-nonylphenol promotes proliferation of testicular germ cell tumor cells. In seminoma-derived TCam-2 cells, the mixture activated CREB through a rapid, ERα36-PI3K non-genomic pathway, and altered expression of DNA methyltransferase-3 genes. Proliferation was also seen in embryonal carcinoma cells and xenografted testicular tumors. The findings link endocrine-disrupting exposure to hormone-sensitive testicular cancer progression.

title: Cardiac metastasis from yolk sac tumor: case report and review.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍による心臓転移：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 26歳女性の頸部リンパ節生検でαフェトプロテイン陽性の未分化腫瘍が見つかり、胚細胞腫瘍が疑われた。その後右心室への腫瘤による心不全を発症し、多臓器不全で死亡した。剖検で右卵巣の悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍と広範な播種が判明した。文献上の心臓転移例もまとめて示されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with a poorly differentiated neoplasm on cervical lymph node biopsy that was AFP-positive, suggesting a germ cell tumor. She later developed heart failure from a mass attached to the right ventricle and died of multiple organ failure. Autopsy revealed a malignant mixed germ cell tumor of the right ovary with extensive dissemination. The authors also summarize previously published cases of germ cell tumors with cardiac metastasis over 20 years.

title: Outcomes in stage I testicular seminoma: a population-based study of 9193 patients.
title_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマの転帰：9,193例の集団ベース研究
summary_ja: SEERデータベースの病期I精巣セミノーマ9,193例を解析した。全死亡率はわずかに上昇し、二次悪性腫瘍、感染症、自殺が要因だった。心血管死は増加せず、放射線療法を受けた例の15年累積二次悪性腫瘍リスクは2.64%で、従来の報告より低かった。自殺リスク上昇は初めて報告され、確認が必要とされた。
summary_en: This population-based SEER study analyzed 9,193 men with stage I testicular seminoma, with median follow-up of 12.3 years. Overall mortality was modestly increased (SMR 1.23), driven by second malignant neoplasms, infection, and suicide, while cardiovascular mortality was not increased. Radiotherapy was given to 78 percent of patients. The cumulative 15-year SMN risk was 2.64 percent for those receiving radiotherapy, lower than historical reports. The authors highlight suicide risk as a previously unreported finding requiring confirmation.

title: [Testicular tumor arising in intra-abdominal testis which was not detected at prior orchidopexy : a case report].
title_ja: 以前の精巣固定術で発見されなかった腹腔内精巣から生じた精巣腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 25年前の左精巣固定術時に見逃された右精巣が、腹腔内で腫瘍化した35歳男性の症例。生検でセミノーマ成分を含む胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、BEP療法とVIP療法を施行した。腫瘍マーカーとPETが正常化後に腫瘍摘除と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、残存腫瘍はなく、17か月時点で再発は認められなかった。
summary_en: A 35-year-old man presented with right lower abdominal pain 25 years after left orchidopexy, during which the right testis had not been found. CT showed large pelvic tumors and para-aortic nodes, and needle biopsy revealed seminomatous germ cell tumor. He was tentatively diagnosed with NSGCT, stage IIB, and received BEP and VIP chemotherapy. After tumor markers and PET-CT normalized, tumorectomy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy were performed with no residual tumor, and no recurrence was seen at 17 months.

title: Ruptured seminoma of undescended testis presenting as acute abdomen: case report with literature review.
title_ja: 急性腹症として発症した停留精巣のセミノーマ破裂：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 28歳男性が急性腹症と血腹症で来院した。術前診断はなされず、開腹で腹腔内セミノーマの破裂が判明し、完全切除された。停留精巣の既往は情報がなく、画像所見も非特異的で術前診断は困難だった。男性の急性腹症では精巣由来疾患を鑑別に含めるべきと述べられている。
summary_en: A 28-year-old man presented with acute abdomen and hemoperitoneum. Laparotomy revealed a ruptured intra-abdominal seminoma, which had not been suspected preoperatively, and complete excision was performed. No cryptorchidism history was documented, and imaging findings were nonspecific. The authors note that ruptured intra-abdominal testicular seminoma is rare, that preoperative diagnosis is difficult, and that testicular causes should be included in the differential diagnosis of acute abdomen in men.

title: Genetic variation in AKT1, PTEN and the 8q24 locus, and the risk of testicular germ cell tumor.
title_ja: AKT1、PTEN、8q24領域の遺伝子多型と精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク
summary_ja: ノルウェー・スウェーデンの症例-親子研究で、AKT1、PTEN、8q24領域の26個のSNPを解析した。統合解析では、PTENのrs11202586が精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクと関連し、多重比較補正後もオッズ比1.16だった。組織型、親の由来、国による差はなかった。関連は弱く、再現性確認と機能解析が必要とされている。
summary_en: This Norwegian-Swedish case-parent study genotyped 26 SNPs in AKT1, PTEN and the 8q24 locus in testicular germ cell tumor cases and controls. In the combined analysis, one PTEN SNP (rs11202586) remained associated with TGCT risk after multiple-testing correction (OR 1.16). No differences were seen by histological subgroup, parent of origin or country. The authors describe the association as modest and call for replication and functional studies.

title: Prognostic impact of LDH levels in patients with relapsed/refractory seminoma.
title_ja: 再発・難治性セミノーマにおけるLDH値の予後的意義
summary_ja: IPFSGデータベースの再発・進行セミノーマ204例を対象に、再発時の年齢とLDHを解析した。ULNの1.5倍以上のLDHは独立した予後不良因子だったが、年齢は有意でなかった。LDHを加えた修正IPFSGスコアは3群に層別化でき、無増悪生存期間と全生存期間をより良く分けた。シスプラチン併用化学療法後の層別化にLDHが有用と結論された。
summary_en: Using 204 relapsed or progressing seminoma patients from the IPFSG database, all treated with at least three cisplatin-based cycles, this study evaluated age and LDH at relapse. LDH at or above 1.5 times ULN independently predicted worse outcome, while age did not. Adding LDH to the IPFSG score produced a modified three-group seminoma score that better separated progression-free and overall survival. The authors conclude LDH improves prognostic stratification after cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

title: Investigation of six testicular germ cell tumor susceptibility genes suggests a parent-of-origin effect in SPRY4.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の6つの感受性遺伝子の検討：SPRY4における親由来効果の示唆
summary_ja: 本研究はスカンジナビア人集団において、精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の既報感受性遺伝子6種を検証した。その結果、全遺伝子で有意な関連が確認され、SPRY4では母由来の遺伝的効果が示唆された。セミノーマと非セミノーマの間に有意な差は認められなかった。
summary_en: This study validated six previously reported susceptibility genes for testicular germ cell tumor (ATF7IP, BAK1, DMRT1, KITLG, SPRY4, and TERT) in a Scandinavian population. Genotyping of 118 SNPs and imputation of 734 additional SNPs were performed in 831 case-parent triads, 474 dyads, 712 singletons, and 3919 controls. Strong associations were confirmed in all six genes, with several independent signals identified. A parent-of-origin effect was observed for a SPRY4 SNP, with maternal and paternal odds ratios of 1.72 and 0.99. No significant differences were found between seminoma and non-seminoma subtypes.

title: CASE REPORT Complex Wound Closure of Partial Sacrectomy Defect With Human Acellular Dermal Matrix and Bilateral V to Y Gluteal Advancement Flaps in a Pediatric Patient.
title_ja: 症例報告：小児の部分仙骨切除欠損に対するヒト無細胞真皮マトリックスと両側V-Y殿筋前進皮弁を用いた複合創閉鎖
summary_ja: 22か月の小児に対し、卵黄嚢腫瘍の一括切除を伴う仙骨切除後の大きな欠損を再建した症例報告である。直腸の後方ヘルニアを防ぐためにヒト無細胞真皮マトリックスを用い、両側殿筋V-Y前進皮弁で死腔を閉鎖した。耐久性のある閉鎖が得られた。小児例における両側V-Y殿筋皮弁での仙骨切除再建の報告は初めてとされる。
summary_en: This case report describes reconstruction of a large defect after sacrectomy in a 22-month-old child. The patient underwent low sacral amputation and en bloc resection of a yolk sac tumor, which left extensive dead space, exposed nerve roots, and rectal projection into the wound. Reconstruction used human acellular dermal matrix to prevent posterior rectal herniation, together with bilateral gluteal V-to-Y advancement flaps to obliterate the dead space. The closure was durable. The authors state that this is the first documented case of sacral resection reconstruction with bilateral V-to-Y gluteal flaps in a pediatric patient, whereas most existing reports address adults.

title: Testicular teratoma, mimicking a simple testicular cyst, in an infant.
title_ja: 乳児の精巣奇形腫：単純な精巣嚢腫と紛らわしかった症例
summary_ja: 乳児の陰嚢内腫瘤が、超音波検査および手術時に単純な液体性嚢胞と紛らわしい所見を示した症例である。病理組織学的検査で成熟囊胞性精巣奇形腫と診断された。典型的な奇形腫は硬く無痛性の陰嚢腫瘤として現れ、超音波で石灰化を伴う不均一な高エコー像を呈する。本例のような非典型例は、嚢胞性に見える陰嚢病変でも腫瘍を鑑別診断に含める必要性を示している。
summary_en: This report describes an infant with a transilluminating scrotal mass that mimicked a simple fully liquid testicular cyst on ultrasonography and at surgery. Pathological examination revealed a mature cystic testicular teratoma. Prepubertal testicular tumors are rare, and teratoma is the second most common histologic type. Typical teratomas present as a hard, painless scrotal mass, with nonhomogeneous echoic areas and calcifications on ultrasound. This atypical presentation, with internal cystic areas causing transillumination, highlights the need to consider tumor in the differential diagnosis of an apparently cystic scrotal lesion.

title: Struma ovarii maligna.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 20歳女性の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。右卵巣摘出術で卵巣甲状腺腫由来の乳頭状甲状腺癌が判明した。その後の甲状腺全摘では異常を認めなかった。放射性ヨウ素アブレーション後の全身シンチグラフィで骨転移を認めた。著者らは分化型甲状腺癌に準じた管理を提案し、サイログロブリンの経時測定による長期フォローアップを推奨している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old woman with malignant struma ovarii, a rare ovarian neoplasm composed mainly of mature thyroid tissue. Right ovariectomy revealed papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in struma ovarii. Subsequent total thyroidectomy showed no abnormalities, and radioiodine ablation was given. Post-therapy scintigraphy showed uptake in bone metastases. The authors propose managing malignant struma ovarii like differentiated thyroid cancer, with surgical excision, thyroidectomy, radioiodine therapy, and levothyroxine suppression, plus long-term follow-up with serial thyroglobulin measurements and imaging.

title: Diagnostic accuracy of preoperative alpha-fetoprotein as an ovarian tumor marker in children and adolescents: not as good as we thought?
title_ja: 小児および思春期の卵巣腫瘍における術前血清αフェトプロテインの診断精度：期待ほど良好ではなかったのか？
summary_ja: 18歳以下の卵巣腫瘍患児110例を対象に、術前血清AFPの胚細胞腫瘍・未熟奇形腫に対する診断能を後方視的に検討した。AFPの特異度は87.8%、感度は66.7%、AUCは0.853であった。乳児を除外すると特異度とAUCは改善したが感度は改善しなかった。感度が低いため、小児卵巣腫瘍におけるAFPの有用性は限定的であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 110 girls aged 18 or younger with ovarian neoplasms assessed preoperative serum AFP as a marker for germ cell tumor or immature teratoma. Of these patients, 20 had non-benign tumors, including 12 with GCT/IT. For GCT/IT versus non-GCT/IT, AFP showed a specificity of 87.8%, a sensitivity of 66.7%, and an AUC of 0.853. Excluding infants improved specificity to 92.0% and AUC to 0.926, but sensitivity did not improve. The authors conclude that AFP has limited diagnostic value in childhood ovarian neoplasms because of poor sensitivity.

title: Prevalence of the metabolic syndrome and cardiovascular disease risk in chemotherapy-treated testicular germ cell tumour survivors.
title_ja: 化学療法を受けた精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者におけるメタボリックシンドロームおよび心血管疾患リスクの有病率
summary_ja: 化学療法を受けた精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者255名を、健常男性360名と比較した。生存者では年齢調整後のメタボリックシンドロームのリスクが約1.9倍で、併用化学療法を受けた群やテストステロン最低四分位の群で特に高かった。一方、Framingham式とSCORE式で算出した10年心血管リスクは低く、対照と同程度であった。
summary_en: This study compared 255 testicular germ cell tumour survivors with 360 healthy men. Survivors had about 1.9 times the age-adjusted risk of metabolic syndrome, highest after combination chemotherapy and in those with the lowest testosterone quartile. Ten-year cardiovascular risk, estimated with the Framingham and SCORE algorithms, was low and comparable to controls, suggesting that the elevated metabolic syndrome prevalence did not translate into higher short-term cardiovascular risk.

title: Clinical significance of amyloid precursor protein in patients with testicular germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるアミロイド前駆体タンパク質の臨床的意義
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の検体64例と凍結検体21例を用い、APPの免疫組織化学とmRNA発現を解析した。APP陽性率は非セミノーマで39.1%、セミノーマで9.8%と有意に高く、α-フェトプロテイン上昇や静脈侵襲と関連していた。APPの高発現は、特に非セミノーマにおいてより侵襲性の高い腫瘍を示唆すると考えられた。
summary_en: This study examined amyloid precursor protein (APP) immunoreactivity and mRNA expression in 64 testicular specimens and 21 snap-frozen samples of testicular germ cell tumours. APP positivity was more frequent in nonseminomatous tumours (39.1%) than in seminomatous tumours (9.8%) and was associated with elevated alpha-fetoprotein and venous invasion. The authors conclude that APP elevation may indicate a more aggressive phenotype, particularly in nonseminomas.

title: Meta-analysis identifies four new loci associated with testicular germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関連する4つの新規遺伝子座を同定したメタ解析
summary_ja: 3件のGWASに由来する931例の患者と1,975例の対照を用いた解析で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の新規感受性遺伝子座を4か所同定した。再現解析は3,211例の患者と7,591例の対照で行われた。見出された遺伝子は男性の胚細胞発生、染色体分配、DNA損傷応答に関わり、感受性の生物学的基盤を示唆する。
summary_en: This meta-analysis of 931 affected individuals and 1,975 controls from three genome-wide association studies, with replication in 3,211 cases and 7,591 controls, identified four new susceptibility loci for testicular germ cell tumour. The loci lie at 4q22.2 (HPGDS), 7p22.3 (MAD1L1), 16q22.3 (RFWD3) and 17q22 (near TEX14, RAD51C and PPM1E). The implicated genes are involved in male germ cell development, chromosome segregation and the DNA damage response, supporting a biological basis for susceptibility.

title: Identification of nine new susceptibility loci for testicular cancer, including variants near DAZL and PRDM14.
title_ja: 精巣がんに関連する9つの新規感受性遺伝子座の同定（DAZLおよびPRDM14近傍のバリアントを含む）
summary_ja: 986例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍症例と4,946例の対照によるGWASに続き、英国の追加症例と対照で再検証した。その結果、精巣がんに関連する新規遺伝子座を9か所同定した。これらは家族性リスクの4〜6%を追加で説明する。PRDM14とDAZLは胚細胞の発生に、PITX1はテロメラーゼ調節に関与する候補遺伝子である。
summary_en: A genome-wide association study of 986 testicular germ cell tumour cases and 4,946 controls, followed by genotyping of 1,064 additional UK cases and 10,082 controls, identified SNPs at nine new loci associated with testicular cancer. Together these loci explain an additional 4-6% of familial risk. Candidate genes include PRDM14 and DAZL, both involved in germ cell specification, and PITX1, which regulates TERT expression and links the disease to telomerase regulation.

title: A clinico-pathological evaluation of 194 patients with ovarian teratoma: 7-year experience in a single center.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫194例の臨床病理学的評価：単一施設での7年間の経験
summary_ja: 2005年から2012年に組織学的に診断された卵巣奇形腫194例を単一施設で後方視的に評価した。平均年齢は34.3歳で、24.5%に症状があった。手術は開腹が54.5%、腹腔鏡が45.5%で行われ、捻転は4.5%に認められた。腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術の55%で破裂が生じた。高齢者や大型の類皮嚢腫では破裂に注意が必要で、腹腔洗浄とエンドバッグの使用が推奨される。
summary_en: This retrospective single-centre study evaluated 194 women with histologically confirmed mature or immature ovarian teratoma diagnosed between 2005 and 2012. Mean age was 34.3 years, and 24.5% were symptomatic. Laparotomy was performed in 54.5% and laparoscopy in 45.5%. Torsion occurred in 4.5%, and rupture occurred in 55% of laparoscopic cystectomies. The authors advise caution with rupture in elderly patients and large dermoids, and recommend peritoneal lavage and endobag use.

title: Twisted benign ovarian teratoma presenting with pain and generalized pruritus: a case report.
title_ja: 疼痛と全身性掻痒を呈した捻転性良性卵巣奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 35歳女性が1日前からの腹痛、嘔吐、全身掻痒を主訴に受診した。CTで左卵巣由来の石灰化を伴う嚢胞性病変を認めた。腹腔鏡補助下に捻転した嚢腫を摘出したところ、疼痛と掻痒は完全に消失した。病理組織学的に良性の成熟奇形腫と確認された。掻痒は抗体を介した反応が関与した可能性があり、捻転した卵巣奇形腫が全身掻痒を呈した初の報告と考えられる。
summary_en: A 35-year-old woman presented with one day of abdominal pain, vomiting, generalised pruritus and tachycardia. Computed tomography showed a calcified cystic mass arising from the left ovary. Laparoscopy-assisted removal of the twisted cyst resolved both pain and pruritus, and histology confirmed a benign mature ovarian teratoma. The authors suggest the pruritus may have been antibody-mediated and report this as the first case of a twisted ovarian teratoma presenting with generalised pruritus.

title: Downregulation of ASPP2 in choriocarcinoma contributes to increased migratory potential through Src signaling pathway activation.
title_ja: 絨毛癌におけるASPP2のダウンレギュレーションは、Srcシグナル経路の活性化を介して遊走能を増強する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌におけるASPP2の役割を検討した基礎研究。ASPP2は絨毛癌で、正常胎盤や胞状奇胎に比べ発現が低下していた。ASPP2を導入すると細胞のアポトーシスが増え、遊走能が低下した。ASPP2はCsk依存的にSrc活性化を抑制し、絨毛癌の進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This laboratory study examined ASPP2, a tumor-suppressive p53 activator, in gestational choriocarcinoma. Quantitative PCR and immunohistochemistry showed ASPP2 was downregulated in choriocarcinoma compared with normal placentas and hydatidiform moles. Restoring ASPP2 in JEG-3 and JAR choriocarcinoma cells increased apoptosis and reduced migration. ASPP2 reduced Src activation in a Csk-dependent manner, not via ASPP1. These findings suggest ASPP2 loss promotes choriocarcinoma progression through Csk/Src signaling, a potential therapeutic target.

title: Torsion of a seminoma in an intrascrotal testis: A case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 陰嚢内精巣における捻転を伴ったセミノーマ：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 26歳男性の急性陰嚢症例で、MRIで精巣捻転と診断されたが、精巣摘除術後に精巣セミノーマと確定した。捻転が疑われる場合はカラードプラ超音波検査を追加すべきとし、急性陰嚢症では精巣腫瘍の可能性も念頭に置く必要性を示した。温存した精巣には超音波検査と腫瘍マーカーによるフォローアップが重要と述べている。
summary_en: A 26-year-old man presented with an acute scrotum. MRI initially suggested testicular torsion, but after orchiectomy the testis was diagnosed as seminoma. The authors emphasize that colour Doppler ultrasonography should be added when torsion is suspected, and that testicular tumor should be considered in acute scrotum. If the torsed testis is preserved, ultrasound and tumor marker follow-up of the remaining testis is essential. The paper also reviews the literature on this rare combination.

title: Disappearance of a major thrombus in the brachiocephalic vein without anticoagulant therapy in a patient with seminoma: A case report.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者において抗凝固療法なしに腕頭静脈の大血栓が消失した症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと傍大動脈リンパ節転移を有する42歳男性の症例報告。PEB化学療法中のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で右腕頭静脈に大きな血栓を認めたが、抗凝固療法なしに第4クールの後には消失した。精巣がんの既報では抗凝固療法が必要とされてきたため、経過の特徴として報告されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old man with testicular seminoma and para-aortic lymph node metastases. During cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (PEB) chemotherapy, CT showed a major thrombus in the right brachiocephalic vein. Without anticoagulation, the thrombus was no longer visible after the fourth PEB cycle. The authors note that prior testicular cancer cases with major thrombus required anticoagulant therapy, so this resolution without it is notable.

title: [A case of a large neonatal pharyngeal teratoma].
title_ja: 新生児咽頭奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 新生児の上咽頭から発生した大型の先天性奇形腫の症例報告。出生前超音波検査で羊水過多を伴い指摘された。気道閉塞の危険から子宮外産出療法(EXIT)が提案されたが両親が拒否し、妊娠35週に帝王切開で出生した。挿管困難のため局所麻酔下で気管切開を要し、生後9日および44日に腫瘍を摘出した。
summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a large congenital teratoma arising from the epipharynx in a neonate. Prenatal ultrasonography showed the mass causing maternal polyhydramnios. Because of the risk of airway obstruction at birth, ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) was proposed but declined by the parents. Delivery occurred by cesarean section at 35 weeks. The newborn required emergency tracheostomy under local anesthesia due to difficult intubation, and the tumor was successfully removed at 9 and 44 days of age.

title: Differential expression of E-cadherin, β-catenin, and Lewis x between invasive hydatidiform moles and post-molar choriocarcinomas.
title_ja: 侵入胞状奇胎と胞状奇胎後絨毛癌におけるE-カドヘリン、β-カテニン、Lewis xの差次的発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常胎盤、侵入胞状奇胎、絨毛癌における接着分子E-カドヘリン、β-カテニン、Lewis xの発現を免疫組織化学で比較した研究です。侵入胞状奇胎は血管構造でLewis xが強く発現し、絨毛癌ではほとんど染色されませんでした。Lewis xは両者を鑑別する信頼性の高いマーカーとなる可能性が示されました。
summary_en: This study compared three adhesion molecules, E-cadherin, β-catenin, and Lewis x, by immunohistochemistry across normal placenta, hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. E-cadherin and β-catenin were expressed in normal cytotrophoblast and declined with maturation. Invasive hydatidiform moles strongly expressed Lewis x in vascular structures, whereas choriocarcinomas were largely negative. The authors propose Lewis x as a reliable marker for distinguishing invasive moles from choriocarcinomas, and link these markers to invasive transformation and preserved villous architecture during tissue invasion.

title: Presacral tumours: a rare case of a dermoid cyst in a paediatric patient.
title_ja: 仙骨前部腫瘍:小児の類皮嚢腫の稀な症例
summary_ja: 5年間続いた腹痛を身体化障害と診断されていた15歳女児で、仙骨前部に類皮嚢腫が見つかりました。CTとMRIで腫瘤を確認し、腹腔鏡補助下に摘出され病理組織学で確定しました。小児の慢性腹痛の原因として本疾患を考慮すべきと述べています。
summary_en: A 15-year-old girl with five years of abdominal pain, initially attributed to somatisation, was found to have a presacral mass on CT and MRI. Laparoscopic-assisted excision confirmed a presacral dermoid cyst, a benign tumor arising from all three germ cell layers. The authors note that presacral dermoid tumours are extremely rare in paediatric patients and suggest they should be considered as a cause of chronic abdominal pain in children.

title: Mediastinal teratomas in children. Case reports and review of the literature.
title_ja: 小児の縦隔奇形腫:症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫の小児3例の臨床経過を報告し、文献をレビューしています。出生前診断、完全切除、AFPによるリスク層別化、必要に応じた補助化学療法の重要性を論じています。全例が無病生存中です。
summary_en: Three children with mediastinal teratomas were treated at a tertiary centre, one diagnosed prenatally and two presenting with respiratory or shoulder symptoms. Serum AFP was elevated in two cases. All underwent complete surgical excision and remain disease-free after 3 to 30 years of follow-up. The review emphasizes prenatal ultrasound, complete resection with thorough histologic sampling, marker-based risk stratification, and adjuvant chemotherapy when indicated.

title: Curcumin inhibits AP-2γ-induced apoptosis in the human malignant testicular germ cells in vitro.
title_ja: クルクミンはヒト悪性精巣胚細胞株においてAP-2γ誘導性アポトーシスを阻害する(in vitro)
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣の悪性胚細胞由来のNTera-2細胞を用い、クルクミンの抗増殖・アポトーシス作用をin vitroで検討した研究です。AP-2γの減少やErbB2、Akt、ERKシグナルの抑制を介して作用すると示されました。治療標的としての可能性を示す基礎研究です。
summary_en: Curcumin was tested in NTera-2 human malignant testicular germ cells and F9 teratocarcinoma cells in vitro. It reduced cell viability and colony formation and induced apoptosis through decreased FasL, an altered Bcl-2/Bax ratio, and caspase activation. Curcumin lowered AP-2γ protein through a proteasome-dependent route and inhibited ErbB2, Akt, and ERK signalling. The authors conclude that curcumin induces apoptosis in NTera-2 cells by inhibiting AP-2γ-mediated survival pathways.

title: A survey of Sertoli cell differentiation in men after gonadotropin suppression and in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 性腺刺激ホルモン抑制下の男性および精巣がんにおけるセルトリ細胞分化の検討
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣上皮内癌(CIS)とセミノーマにおけるセルトリ細胞の分化マーカーを、正常男性やゴナドトロピン抑制を受けた男性と比較した研究です。CISとセミノーマでは接着分子JAM-Aの局在が変化していました。胚細胞腫瘍に伴うセルトリ細胞の脱分化が示唆されています。
summary_en: This study compared Sertoli cell differentiation markers in normospermic men, men under long-term gonadotropin suppression, and testicular samples with carcinoma in situ (CIS) and seminoma. Under gonadotropin suppression, a small fraction of Sertoli cells showed PCNA and Ki67 positivity with reduced androgen receptor, suggesting an undifferentiated state. Such cells were absent in CIS tubules, and tight junction protein JAM-A was altered in CIS and seminoma, suggesting Sertoli cell dedifferentiation in germ cell neoplasia.

title: Transformation of a post-cesarean section placental site nodule into a coexisting epithelioid trophoblastic tumor and placental site trophoblastic tumor: a case report.
title_ja: 胎盤部結節から併存する上皮様トロホブラスト腫瘍および胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍へ移行した帝王切開後症例:症例報告
summary_ja: 帝王切開後1年で不正性器出血を来した41歳女性で、子宮下部に胎盤部結節と上皮様トロホブラスト腫瘍・胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の併存を認めた症例報告です。胎盤部結節から腫瘍が生じた可能性が推測されています。
summary_en: A 41-year-old woman presented with abnormal vaginal bleeding one year after a cesarean delivery. Examination of the post-cesarean lower uterine segment revealed coexisting epithelioid trophoblastic tumor and placental site trophoblastic tumor intimately associated with placental site nodules. The authors propose that the neoplasms arose from these nodules, which may relate to retained placental tissue or abnormal colonization of chorionic-type intermediate trophoblasts during cesarean section, and showed differentiation plasticity.

title: β-catenin functions pleiotropically in differentiation and tumorigenesis in mouse embryo-derived stem cells.
title_ja: β-カテニンはマウス胚由来幹細胞の分化と腫瘍形成に多面的に機能する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: β-カテニン欠損マウス胚由来幹細胞を作製し、その分化と腫瘍形成への関与を検討した研究です。欠損細胞から生じた奇形腫は未熟な胚細胞腫瘍で、多系統分化を示しませんでした。β-カテニンの再発現で腫瘍性は消失し、多能性が回復しました。
summary_en: β-catenin-deficient mouse embryo-derived stem cells were generated to test whether β-catenin is required for stem cell derivation and differentiation. Although β-catenin was dispensable for self-renewal, teratomas formed from these knockout cells were immature germ cell tumors lacking multilineage differentiation. Re-expressing functional β-catenin reversed the neoplastic phenotype and restored pluripotency. The authors conclude that β-catenin acts as a gatekeeper preventing tumorigenic character in embryonic stem cells.

title: Inguinal polypropylene plug: a cause of unusual testicular tumor pelvic metastasis.
title_ja: 鼠径部ポリプロピレンプラグが原因と考えられた、まれな精巣腫瘍の骨盤内転移
summary_ja: 3年前に鼠径ヘルニア修復でポリプロピレンプラグを留置された患者が精巣腫瘍で受診した。混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、PEB療法による補助化学療法後に骨盤内リンパ節郭清を施行した。プラグが腫大リンパ節内から見つかり、プラグが異常な転移の原因と推定された。
