SOX2 was expressed in embryonal carcinoma foci of testicular germ cell tumor tissue but absent from seminoma and yolk sac tumors. In an embryonal carcinoma model, SOX2 siRNA induced apoptosis in vitro and suppressed tumor growth in vivo. The authors conclude that SOX2 silencing has therapeutic potential, though improvements in siRNA delivery to tumors are still needed.

title: Malignant germ cell-like tumors, expressing Ki-1 antigen (CD30), are revealed during in vivo differentiation of partially reprogrammed human-induced pluripotent stem cells.
title_ja: 部分的に初期化されたヒト人工多能性幹細胞(iPS細胞)の生体内分化で出現する、CD30（Ki-1抗原）陽性の悪性胚細胞様腫瘍
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: Oct4、Sox2、Nanog、Lin28を導入して作製したヒト人工多能性幹細胞(iPS細胞)の腫瘍形成リスクを検討した。導入遺伝子が残存する部分的初期化iPS細胞では、14例中6例の奇形腫に悪性腫瘍が生じた。悪性病変は卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌で、αフェトプロテイン、AE1/AE3、CD30が陽性であった。完全に初期化された細胞では認めなかった。臨床応用前の腫瘍原性評価の徹底を勧めている。
summary_en: This study examined tumorigenic risk in human induced pluripotent stem cells generated with Oct4, Sox2, Nanog, and Lin28. Partially reprogrammed iPSCs that still expressed transgenes formed teratomas with major dysplasia and malignant tumors in 6 of 14 cases. These malignant lesions were yolk sac tumors and embryonal carcinomas, positive for alpha-fetoprotein, AE1/AE3, and CD30. Malignancy correlated with transgene expression, reduced p21 mRNA, and increased Bcl-2 mRNA. Fully reprogrammed iPSCs did not produce such tumors. The authors recommend rigorous oncogenicity evaluation before clinical use of iPSC-derived cells.

title: Molecular genetics of testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子遺伝学
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の発生・進展・化学療法耐性に関わる遺伝学的知見を総説した。多くは未分類の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)に由来し、KIT経路や胚性転写因子の関与が示唆される。12p染色体の獲得やKIT、TP53、KRAS/NRAS、BRAFの変異、DNAメチル化による遺伝子発現の違いも論じられ、新たな分子診断・治療法への応用が期待される。
summary_en: This review summarizes current genetic knowledge about testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT), the most common malignancy in young men. Most tumors arise from intratubular germ cell neoplasia, which involves KIT signaling and embryonic transcription factors such as NANOG and POU5F1. The authors discuss recurrent 12p gain, mutations in KIT, TP53, KRAS/NRAS and BRAF, and DNA methylation-driven expression differences among histologic subtypes. They also review genetic contributors to chemoresistance and suggest these insights may guide new molecular diagnostics and therapies.

title: Struma ovarii associated with Pseudo-Meig's syndrome and high serum level of CA 125; a case report.
title_ja: 偽Meigs症候群と高CA125を伴った卵巣甲状腺腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 72歳女性は骨盤内腫瘤、胸水・腹水および高値のCA125を呈し、悪性卵巣腫瘍や偽Meigs症候群と類似していた。子宮全摘術と両側付属器切除術を施行し、病理学的に卵巣甲状腺腫（甲状腺組織が主体の成熟奇形腫）と確定した。術後はCA125を含め検査値が正常化し、経過は良好であった。報告は希少である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 72-year-old woman with a pelvic mass, pleural and peritoneal effusion, and markedly elevated CA-125, which mimicked malignant ovarian tumor and Pseudo-Meigs syndrome. She underwent hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and pathology confirmed struma ovarii, a mature teratoma composed predominantly of thyroid tissue. The authors note that only about ten similar cases have been reported. Postoperative CA-125 and clinical status normalized, supporting the benign nature of this rare tumor.

title: Radiotherapy treatment planning for testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法の治療計画
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
tags: ガイドライン・コンセンサス
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法の治療計画の推奨をまとめたエビデンスに基づく総説である。病期Iの補助療法としての傍大動脈照射やカルボプラチン、病期IIA/IIBに対する照射野設定とブーストの線量・分割が示されている。化学療法の代替案も併記される。
summary_en: This evidence-based review gives radiotherapy treatment planning recommendations for testicular seminoma. Stage I patients who choose adjuvant treatment may receive para-aortic irradiation or carboplatin, while stage IIA and IIB disease can be treated with two-dimensional or conformal fields. The authors specify field borders, such as the top of the T12 vertebral body and the top of the acetabulum for dog-leg fields, along with boost doses of 10 Gy in 5 fractions for IIA and 16 Gy in 8 fractions for IIB. Alternative chemotherapy regimens are also described.

title: Germ cell pluripotency, premature differentiation and susceptibility to testicular teratomas in mice.
title_ja: 胚細胞の多能性、早期分化および精巣奇形腫への感受性（マウス）
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 129系マウスにおける精巣奇形腫の発生機序を検討した。奇形腫感受性の胚細胞では、E15.5での増殖亢進、Nanogの発現維持、Stra8やCcnd1などの早期発現が見られた。Stra8欠損マウスでは奇形腫の発生が88%減少し、有糸分裂と減数分裂の切り替えの破綻が腫瘍形成の起点になることが示された。
summary_en: This mouse study investigates why testicular teratomas arise in 129 strain mice. Teratoma-susceptible germ cells showed increased proliferation, retained Nanog expression, and premature expression of meiosis-related genes such as Stra8 and Ccnd1 at embryonic day 15.5. Stra8-deficient mice had an 88 percent reduction in teratoma incidence. The authors conclude that deregulation of the mitotic-meiotic switch in XY germ cells contributes to teratoma initiation, linking retained pluripotency and premature differentiation to tumorigenesis.

title: Benefits and limitations of errorless learning after surviving pediatric brain tumors: a case study.
title_ja: 小児脳腫瘍生存者におけるエラーレス学習の有益性と限界：症例研究
summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍とその治療後に重度のエピソード記憶障害を生じた15歳男児の症例研究。誤りを避ける学習法（エラーレス学習）と誤りを伴う学習法を比較した。実験とフォローアップの結果、エラーレス条件で学習効率が高まったが、長期記憶からの想起は手がかりへの依存が残った。脳腫瘍生存者の記憶リハビリテーションへの示唆を論じている。
summary_en: This case study describes a 15-year-old boy whose profound episodic memory impairment followed a metastatic germ cell tumor and its treatment. The authors tested whether errorless learning, which presents only correct answers, improved verbal learning compared with errorful learning. Across an experiment and follow-up study, learning was more efficient under errorless conditions, although long-term memory retrieval remained dependent on cues. The authors discuss implications for memory rehabilitation in brain tumor survivors.

title: Outcomes in patients with clinical stage III NSGCT who achieve complete clinical response to chemotherapy at extraretroperitoneal disease site.
title_ja: 臨床病期III非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者で、後腹膜外病変に化学療法による臨床的完全奏効が得られた場合の転帰
summary_ja: 本解析は、臨床病期IIIの非セミノーマ237例を対象に、導入化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた患者について、後腹膜外病変部位で臨床的完全奏効と病理学的完全奏効のどちらが得られたかによる転帰を比較した。5年無増悪率はPCRで93%、CCRで72%であった。CCRは再発リスクが高く、著者らは実施可能な場合には残存病変の完全な外科的切除を推奨している。
summary_en: This analysis of 237 men with clinical stage III nonseminoma who received induction chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection compared patients with clinical versus pathologic complete response at extraretroperitoneal disease sites. Five-year freedom from progression was 93% for pathologic complete response versus 72% for clinical complete response. Clinical complete response carried a higher relapse risk, so the authors advocate complete surgical resection of residual disease when feasible.

title: Retroperitoneal mixed germ cell tumor mimicking a renal neoplasm: a case report.
title_ja: 腎腫瘍様を呈した後腹膜混合型胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: ディスジャーミノーマと成熟単胚葉性奇形腫からなる後腹膜混合型胚細胞腫瘍を発症した11歳女児の症例報告。初めは腎腫瘍が疑われる高血圧で発症した。後腹膜のセミノーマ組織型の胚細胞腫瘍はほぼ男性のみで報告されている。女児で本腫瘍による小児高血圧を生じた例は、これまで報告されていない。
summary_en: This report describes an 11-year-old girl with a retroperitoneal mixed germ cell tumor composed of dysgerminoma and mature monodermal teratoma. She presented with hypertension, which initially suggested a renal neoplasm. The authors note that such retroperitoneal germ cell tumors are rare and of uncertain origin, and that retroperitoneal seminomatous tumors have almost exclusively been reported in men. To their knowledge, pediatric hypertension secondary to this tumor in a girl has not been reported before.

title: Malignant transformation arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: a report of six cases.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの悪性転化：6症例の報告
summary_ja: 2002〜2010年に卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの悪性転化で治療した6例の後方視的検討。悪性転化は卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の1.9%で、扁平上皮癌が多かった。6例中5例は16〜104か月で再発がなかった。腫瘍が被膜を越えず完全切除された場合に予後が良好と結論している。
summary_en: Six patients with malignant transformation arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma, treated over nine years, were reviewed retrospectively. Malignant transformation accounted for 1.9% of ovarian MCTs, and histology was mostly squamous cell carcinoma. Five of six patients showed no recurrence after 16 to 104 months, and one stage IC carcinoid patient died. The authors conclude that complete excision without capsular breach gives better prognosis and that comprehensive staging and adjuvant therapy may be reasonable for stage IC disease.

title: Diagnostic utility of CD117, CD133, SALL4, OCT4, TCL1 and glypican-3 in malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍におけるCD117、CD133、SALL4、OCT4、TCL1、グリピカン-3の診断的有用性
summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍87例で6種の免疫組織化学マーカーを検討した研究。CD117はディスジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍の全例で陽性で、未熟奇形腫では29%のみ陽性であった。SALL4は卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断に、OCT4はディスジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍の鑑別に有用と結論している。
summary_en: This study tested six immunohistochemical markers (CD117, CD133, SALL4, OCT4, TCL1, glypican-3) in 87 primary ovarian malignant germ cell tumors. CD117 was positive in all dysgerminomas and yolk sac tumors but only 29% of immature teratomas. SALL4 and glypican-3 were positive in most yolk sac tumors, while OCT4 and TCL1 were positive in dysgerminomas. The authors conclude that CD117 helps diagnose dysgerminoma and yolk sac tumor, and that SALL4 and OCT4 distinguish yolk sac tumor from dysgerminoma.

title: Malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma with a predominant pulmonary type small cell carcinoma component.
title_ja: 肺型小細胞癌成分が優位であった卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化
summary_ja: 44歳時に左卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された68歳女性が、急速に増大した腫瘍を切除された。悪性転化により、肺型小細胞癌（優位）、腸型腺癌、扁平上皮癌、移行上皮癌など多彩な癌成分が認められた。免疫組織化学染色では神経内分泌および腸型への分化が示され、CDX2はすべての癌成分で陽性であった。腺癌は奇形腫内の腸上皮に由来し、多様に分化したと考察されている。
summary_en: A 68-year-old woman with a long-standing left ovarian mature cystic teratoma developed a rapidly enlarging mass. Resection revealed malignant transformation into multiple carcinoma types, predominantly pulmonary-type small cell carcinoma, with intestinal-type adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and transitional cell carcinoma. Immunohistochemistry supported neuroendocrine and intestinal differentiation, with CDX2 retained across all components. The authors propose that the adenocarcinoma arose from intestinal epithelium within the teratoma and diversified histologically.

title: Carbon ion radiotherapy for recurrent malignant transformation from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の再発性悪性転化に対する炭素イオン放射線療法
summary_ja: 病期IIcの成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化（扁平上皮癌）に対し手術を受けた78歳女性の症例報告。残存骨盤内腫瘍に対しパクリタキセルとカルボプラチンによる化学療法を6コース行ったが再発腫瘍は増大した。その後の炭素イオン放射線療法で腫瘍は縮小し、53か月間無病の状態が続いている。再発性MT-MCTの治療として考慮しうると述べられている。
summary_en: A 78-year-old woman with stage IIc malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma (squamous cell carcinoma) had residual pelvic disease after surgery. Six courses of paclitaxel and carboplatin failed to control the recurrent tumor, which grew. Carbon ion radiotherapy was then given, after which the tumor shrank and the patient remained clinically disease-free for 53 months. The authors suggest carbon ion radiotherapy may be considered for recurrent MT-MCT.

title: Treatment of nonmetastatic and metastatic low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: factors associated with resistance to single-agent methotrexate chemotherapy.
title_ja: 低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の非転移例および転移例の治療：単剤メトトレキサート化学療法への抵抗性に関連する因子
summary_ja: 低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍358例を後方視的に検討した研究。メトトレキサートとアクチノマイシンDによる逐次単剤化学療法で、全体の完全奏効率は94%であった。メトトレキサート抵抗性はFIGOスコアの高値、絨毛癌、治療前のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値、転移と関連していた。多剤化学療法を要したのは6%のみで、生存率は100%であった。
summary_en: A retrospective review of 358 women with low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated with sequential single-agent methotrexate and actinomycin D. Initial methotrexate complete response was 81%, and overall single-agent complete response reached 94%. Resistance to methotrexate was associated with higher FIGO score, choriocarcinoma diagnosis, higher pretreatment hCG, and metastatic disease. Only 6% needed multiagent chemotherapy, with 100% survival, supporting sequential single-agent therapy.

title: Difficult differential diagnoses in testicular pathology.
title_ja: 精巣病理における鑑別診断の難題
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍で誤診されやすい病変の主要な診断的特徴と補助的ツールをまとめた病理総説。セミノーマ対非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍、胚細胞腫瘍対非胚細胞腫瘍、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍対異型胚細胞など、鑑別が困難な組み合わせを取り上げている。通常の光学顕微鏡所見からこれらの落とし穴を認識することが、的確な免疫組織化学的検査と正確な診断につながるとされる。
summary_en: A pathology review summarizing key diagnostic features and ancillary tools for frequently confused testicular tumor entities. Problem areas include seminoma versus nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, germ cell versus non-germ cell tumors, intratubular germ cell neoplasia versus maturation-arrest atypical germ cells, pseudo- versus true lymphovascular invasion, and Sertoli cell nodules versus Sertoli cell tumors. Recognizing these pitfalls on routine microscopy often guides directed immunohistochemistry and accurate diagnosis.

title: Prognosis of malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumours according to their natural history and surgical management.
title_ja: 悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍の予後：自然経過と外科的管理による検討
summary_ja: フランスのTGM 95プロトコルに登録された仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍57例の解析。うち19例は胎児仙尾部奇形腫後の二次性腫瘍であった。全例がリスク適応型化学療法後に手術を受けた。二次性腫瘍は診断時のαFPが低く治療強度も低かったが、全生存期間(全生存率)は原発性と同等であった。αFPによる系統的フォローアップが早期発見に寄与したと考えられている。
summary_en: Registry-based analysis of 57 patients aged 0-80 months with sacrococcygeal germ cell tumours from the French TGM 95 protocol, 19 of whom had secondary tumors after fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma. All received risk-adapted chemotherapy followed by delayed surgery. Secondary tumors had lower AFP at diagnosis and less intensive therapy, yet overall survival (93.8% vs 86.2%) and event-free survival were similar to primary tumors. Systematic AFP follow-up appears to detect disease earlier.

title: The evolution of methotrexate as a treatment for ectopic pregnancy and gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: a review.
title_ja: 異所性妊娠および妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対するメトトレキサート治療の変遷：総説
summary_ja: メトトレキサートは当初急性リンパ性白血病の治療薬として開発されたが、進行絨毛癌の治癒例を契機に妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍への応用が広がった。その後、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と異所性妊娠の2疾患に対する現代的なメトトレキサート治療プロトコルの発展を総説している。
summary_en: A review of how methotrexate evolved from leukemia therapy, after its serendipitous use to cure advanced choriocarcinoma, into standard medical treatment for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and ectopic pregnancy. It traces the development of modern methotrexate-based protocols for these two gynecologic conditions. The review focuses on the clinical history and treatment protocols of both gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and ectopic pregnancy.

title: AZFa protein DDX3Y is differentially expressed in human male germ cells during development and in testicular tumours: new evidence for phenotypic plasticity of germ cells.
title_ja: AZFaタンパク質DDX3Yのヒト男性胚細胞における発生段階別発現と精巣腫瘍での発現:胚細胞の表現型可塑性に関する新知見
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: Y染色体AZFa領域にコードされる胚細胞特異的RNAヘリカーゼDDX3Yを、ヒト精巣の発生と精巣腫瘍で検討した。上皮内癌(CIS)細胞で強く発現し、セミノーマでも発現が認められた。一方、奇形腫や胎児性癌を含む非セミノーマでは発現がなく、CIS細胞の表現型可塑性を示唆する。
summary_en: This study examined DDX3Y, a germ-cell-specific RNA helicase encoded in the AZFa region of the Y chromosome, during human testis development and in testicular germ cell tumors. Immunohistochemistry showed DDX3Y expression in fetal prospermatogonia and strong nuclear expression in carcinoma in situ cells. In invasive tumors, DDX3Y was expressed in classical and spermatocytic seminomas but not in somatically differentiated non-seminomas such as teratoma and embryonal carcinoma. The authors propose that CIS cells show phenotypic plasticity, and that germ cell depletion in AZFa deletion may begin prenatally.

title: The genetics of gestational trophoblastic disease: a rare complication of pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の遺伝学：妊娠の稀な合併症
summary_ja: 本総説は、完全胞状奇胎や妊娠性絨毛癌を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患の遺伝学と疫学をまとめたものである。完全奇胎が父性由来のみの起源をもつことを1977年にKajiiとOhamaが明らかにした経緯を踏まえ、宿主と異なる遺伝子型をもつ同種移植片としての性質を解説している。早期に診断・治療されれば治癒可能であることも述べられている。
summary_en: This review summarizes the genetics and epidemiology of gestational trophoblastic disease, a spectrum including complete hydatidiform mole and gestational choriocarcinoma. It highlights the androgenetic origin of complete moles, first identified by Kajii and Ohama in 1977, and explains how trophoblastic tissue acts as an allograft with a genotype differing from the host. The authors discuss morphology, epidemiology, and genetic findings that followed these milestone observations. Gestational choriocarcinoma is fatal if untreated but curable when diagnosed and treated early.

title: Microsurgical testis-sparing surgery in small testicular masses: seven years retrospective management and results.
title_ja: 微小外科的精巣温存手術：小型精巣腫瘤における7年間の後方視的管理と成績
summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、2 cm未満または非触知性の小型精巣腫瘤を有する20例に対する微小外科的精巣温存手術を評価した。術中の凍結切片検査と高周波超音波により手術を支援した。セミノーマ性腫瘍はわずか2例で、残りは良性であった。平均12か月を超える追跡で、再発や性腺機能低下症は認められなかった。著者らは、適切に選択された症例、特に両側性腫瘍や単独精巣の場合には精巣温存が実施可能であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated microsurgical testis-sparing surgery for small or nonpalpable testicular masses under 2 cm in 20 patients. Intraoperative frozen section and high-frequency ultrasound guided the procedure. Only two seminomatous tumors were found, and the remaining masses were benign. After a mean follow-up of over 12 months, no recurrence or hypogonadism occurred. The authors conclude that testis preservation is feasible in selected cases, especially bilateral tumors or a solitary testis.

title: Postorchiectomy intrascrotal hematoma mimicking local recurrence on 18F-FDG PET/CT: a diagnostic dilemma.
title_ja: 精巣摘除術後の陰嚢内血腫が局所再発に類似した18F-FDG PET/CT所見を示した例：診断上のジレンマ
summary_ja: セミノーマに対し右根治的精巣摘除術を受けた30歳男性の症例報告である。術後8週目のPET/CTで右陰嚢内の軟部病変にFDG集積を認め、局所再発が疑われた。しかし超音波検査でカラードプラを行ったところ血腫と確認された。精巣摘除後の陰嚢内血腫は、再発と紛らわしい所見を示しうることを示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man who underwent right radical orchiectomy for seminoma. PET/CT performed eight weeks later showed FDG uptake in a right scrotal soft tissue lesion suspicious for local recurrence. Color Doppler ultrasonography showed the lesion to be a hematoma. The report highlights that postoperative intrascrotal hematoma can mimic local recurrence on FDG PET/CT, so clinicians should consider it when interpreting early post-orchiectomy imaging.

title: Mature cystic teratoma of the uterosacral ligament successfully treated with laparoendoscopic single-site surgery.
title_ja: 腹腔鏡単孔式手術（LESS）で治療した子宮仙骨靭帯の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 子宮仙骨靭帯に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。34歳女性で、術前は左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されていた。子宮仙骨靭帯発生は極めて稀な性腺外発生例であり、これまでの報告は3例のみである。腹腔鏡下単孔式手術（LESS）による切除に成功し、本疾患に対するLESSによる治療の初報告となる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with a mature cystic teratoma of the uterosacral ligament, an extremely rare extragonadal site, initially suspected to be ovarian. The tumor was successfully resected by laparoendoscopic single-site surgery (LESS). The authors note that only three prior cases have been reported, and that this is the first report of LESS treatment for this entity. The report highlights the unclear etiology and the feasibility of single-port minimally invasive resection.

title: Interleukin-12 inhibits cell invasion in choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: インターロイキン12は絨毛癌細胞の浸潤を抑制する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3を用い、インターロイキン12（IL-12）の浸潤抑制効果を検討したin vitro研究である。IL-12はMMP-9とTIMP-1の発現を調節して用量・時間依存的に細胞浸潤を抑制し、細胞周期分布も変化させた。絨毛癌に対する抗腫瘍効果が示唆され、作用機序の理解につながる。
summary_en: This in vitro study examines the effect of interleukin-12 on invasion of the human choriocarcinoma cell line JEG-3. IL-12 inhibited cell invasion in a dose- and time-dependent manner by modulating MMP-9 and TIMP-1 expression. It also altered cell cycle phase distribution. The authors conclude that IL-12 has an antitumor effect in choriocarcinoma, a highly malignant gestational trophoblastic disease, suggesting mechanisms for therapeutic exploration.

title: Establishment of a versatile seminoma model indicates cellular plasticity of germ cell tumor cells.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ様細胞株TCam-2の移植により作製された多用途セミノーマモデルは胚細胞腫瘍細胞の細胞可塑性を示す
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: セミノーマ様細胞株TCam-2を用いて、マウスのセミノーマモデルを作製した。精細管内への移植では上皮内癌/セミノーマが形成され、側腹部や線条体への移植では胎児性癌様の表現型に変化した。この転換は追加の遺伝子異常ではなく微小環境に依存することが示唆され、生体内でのセミノーマ研究の基盤となる。
summary_en: This study establishes a transplantation-based mouse model of seminoma using TCam-2 cells, a seminoma-like cell line. Transplantation into the seminiferous tubules of the testis produced carcinoma in situ/seminoma, whereas grafts into the flank or striatum adopted an embryonal carcinoma-like phenotype, with altered SOX17, SOX2 and CD30 expression and reduced AKT, ERK, EphA3 and Tie2 signaling. The findings suggest that conversion from seminoma to embryonal carcinoma depends on the tumor microenvironment rather than additional genetic aberrations, and they provide an in vivo platform for studying seminoma biology.

title: A single institution, retrospective study of treatment experience in primary mediastinal germ cell tumors: elucidating the significance of systemic chemotherapy.
title_ja: 縦隔原発悪性胚細胞腫瘍の単施設後方視的研究:全身化学療法の意義の解明
summary_ja: 1991〜2007年に当施設で治療された縦隔原発悪性胚細胞腫瘍39例を後方視的に検討した。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は60.2%、無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は57.7%であった。セミノーマは非セミノーマ性腫瘍より予後が有意に良好であった。非セミノーマでは化学療法の実施により予後が改善する傾向がみられ、全身化学療法の重要性が示された。
summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 39 patients treated for primary mediastinal malignant germ cell tumors between 1991 and 2007 found a 5-year overall survival of 60.2% and progression-free survival of 57.7%. Seminoma patients had significantly better outcomes than those with nonseminomatous tumors (5-year overall survival 87.4% vs. 36.7%). Among nonseminomatous patients, chemotherapy exposure was associated with better survival, although the difference was not statistically significant. The authors conclude that systemic chemotherapy is important in treating mediastinal germ cell tumors.

title: [Clinical effectiveness of measurement of serum total human chorionic gonadotropin for diagnosis and management of testicular seminomatous germ cell tumor].
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの診断と管理における血清総ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)測定の臨床的有用性
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ25例で血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とフリーβ-hCG(fbhCG)を同時測定した。fbhCGでは20%に偽陽性がみられた。偽陽性を除く20例の感度は、血清hCGが80%、fbhCGが70%であった。セミノーマの診断と管理には血清hCGの方が信頼性が高く、精巣腫瘍ではfbhCG単独の測定は誤った結果を招くため避けるべきとされた。
summary_en: In 25 patients with testicular seminoma, the authors measured serum hCG and free beta-hCG (fbhCG) simultaneously. Five patients (20%) showed false-positive fbhCG results. Among the remaining 20 patients, sensitivity was 80% for serum hCG versus 70% for fbhCG. The authors conclude that serum hCG is more reliable than fbhCG for diagnosing and managing seminoma, and that fbhCG should not be measured alone in testicular tumors because it can give misleading results.

title: Appendiceal abscess and right ovarian teratoma: a rare association.
title_ja: 虫垂膿瘍と右卵巣奇形腫の合併:まれな症例
summary_ja: 急性腹症で受診した8歳女児が、卵巣腫瘍の疑いで手術を受けた症例報告である。術中に予期せぬ急性虫垂炎と右卵巣奇形腫が判明した。小児の急性腹症では画像所見が不明瞭または誤解釈されることがあり、術前診断が困難な合併病変が手術で初めて発見されうることを示している。
summary_en: This case report describes an 8-year-old girl with acute abdominal pain who underwent imaging and then surgery for a suspected ovarian tumor. During laparotomy, an unexpected acute appendicitis with abscess was found alongside a right ovarian teratoma. The case highlights that imaging findings in pediatric acute abdomen can be equivocal or misinterpreted, and that coexisting pathology may be discovered only at surgical exploration.

title: Evaluation of putative renal cell carcinoma markers PAX-2, PAX-8, and hKIM-1 in germ cell tumors: a tissue microarray study of 100 cases.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるPAX-2、PAX-8、hKIM-1の腎細胞癌マーカーとしての評価:100例の組織マイクロアレイ研究
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍100例の組織マイクロアレイを用い、腎細胞癌マーカー候補であるPAX-2、PAX-8、hKIM-1を評価した。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではPAX-2が50%、PAX-8が25%で陽性となり、hKIM-1は胎児性癌の48%、卵黄嚢腫瘍の50%で陽性であった。セミノーマ62例はすべて3マーカー陰性であった。転移(性)腎細胞癌と非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別には、これらマーカーを慎重に用いるべきである。
summary_en: Using tissue microarrays of 100 germ cell tumors, the authors assessed PAX-2, PAX-8 and hKIM-1 as candidate renal cell carcinoma markers. PAX-2 and PAX-8 stained 50% and 25% of yolk sac tumors, respectively, and hKIM-1 stained 48% of embryonal carcinomas and 50% of yolk sac tumors. All 62 seminomas were negative for all three markers. The authors advise cautious use of these markers when distinguishing metastatic renal cell carcinoma from nonseminomatous germ cell neoplasia.

title: Oligodendroglioma arising in the glial component of ovarian teratomas: a series of six cases and review of literature.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の神経膠成分から発生した乏突起膠腫：6例の症例シリーズと文献的考察
summary_ja: 本研究は、卵巣奇形腫の神経膠成分から発生した乏突起膠腫の6例を報告した極めて稀な症例シリーズである。患者は12～28歳で、4例は未熟奇形腫、2例は成熟奇形腫由来であった。全例がWHOグレードIIであった。未熟奇形腫由来の2例が死亡し、成熟奇形腫由来例の予後は比較的良好と考えられた。神経膠腫の有無を確認するため、卵巣奇形腫は十分に検体を採取すべきである。
summary_en: This series of six cases describes oligodendroglioma arising within the glial component of ovarian teratomas, a very rare occurrence. Patients were aged 12 to 28 years. Four tumors arose in immature teratomas and two in mature teratomas; all were WHO grade II with low Ki-67 indices and GFAP positivity. Two patients died of disease, both with tumors arising in immature teratomas, while three remain alive with follow-up of 4 to 42 months. The authors conclude that ovarian teratomas should be extensively sampled to exclude a glial tumor, and that prognosis appears better for tumors arising in mature teratomas.

title: GPR30, the non-classical membrane G protein related estrogen receptor, is overexpressed in human seminoma and promotes seminoma cell proliferation.
title_ja: GPR30はヒトセミノーマで過剰発現し、セミノーマ細胞の増殖を促進する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、膜結合型の非古典的エストロゲン受容体であるGPR30（GPER）が、正常成人精巣の胚細胞やセルトリ細胞に発現し、セミノーマで特異的に過剰発現することを示した。JKT-1セミノーマ細胞株において、GPERの活性化は増殖を促進し、この作用は選択的拮抗薬G15やsiRNAによる発現抑制で消失した。GPERは精巣胚細胞腫瘍における内分泌撹乱物質の評価対象となり、予後マーカーや治療標的となる可能性がある。
summary_en: This study shows that GPR30, a membrane-bound non-classical estrogen receptor, is expressed in normal adult human testicular germ cells and Sertoli cells, and is specifically overexpressed in seminomas. In the JKT-1 seminoma cell line, GPER activation promoted proliferation, and this effect was abolished by the selective antagonist G15 and by siRNA knockdown. The authors suggest GPER should be considered when assessing endocrine disruptors in testicular germ cell tumors, and that it may serve as a prognostic marker or therapeutic target for seminomas.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma with invasion into the adjacent small intestine: a case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生し、小腸へ浸潤した扁平上皮癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 73歳女性の24cmに及ぶ腹部嚢胞性腫瘤で、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に高分化型扁平上皮癌が発生していた症例である。腫瘍は隣接する小腸に壁深達性に浸潤したが、所属リンパ節13個に転移は認められなかった。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は1～3%とされ、小腸浸潤例の報告は本例が初めてと述べられている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 73-year-old woman with a 24-cm cystic abdominal mass that contained a well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma. The tumor transmurally invaded the adjacent small intestine, although none of 13 regional lymph nodes showed metastasis. The authors note that malignant transformation in mature cystic teratoma occurs in about 1 to 3% of cases and that invasion of the small bowel by such a tumor has not been reported previously.

title: High-grade sarcoma masquerading as growing teratoma syndrome after resection of ovarian immature teratoma: report of a case.
title_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫切除後にgrowing teratoma syndromeと誤認された高悪性度肉腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 23歳女性の病期IIIBの未熟卵巣奇形腫の症例である。手術と化学療法後に肝臓と骨盤内の腫瘤が出現し、生検で成熟奇形腫と診断され、growing teratoma syndromeと解釈された。しかし切除標本では高悪性度肉腫が確認された。最終診断は未分化肉腫であった。著者らは、再発奇形腫では複数部位から十分に検体を採取する必要性を強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old woman treated for stage IIIB immature ovarian teratoma with surgery and chemotherapy. Later liver and pelvic masses were biopsied and reported as mature teratomas, and the lesions were initially interpreted as growing teratoma syndrome. Resection revealed high-grade sarcoma with features suggesting primitive neuroectodermal tumor, although EWSR1 rearrangement was absent, so the final diagnosis was high-grade undifferentiated sarcoma. The authors emphasize extensive sampling of recurrent teratomas from multiple sites.

title: Genomic characterization of testis cancer: association of alterations with outcome of clinical stage 1 mixed germ cell nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣がんのゲノム特性解析：臨床病期I期の混合型胚細胞腫瘍（非セミノーマ性）における変化と転帰との関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床病期I期の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍においてリンパ節転移を予測する遺伝子マーカーを、比較ゲノムアレイ解析で探索したものである。後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）で転移を認めなかった8例と転移を認めた4例を比較し、両群でゲノム変化に違いが認められた。転移例ではY染色体のコピー数に統計学的に示唆的な差があり、Y染色体の欠失が進行予測のマーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study used comparative genomic array analysis to identify markers predicting lymph node metastasis in clinical stage 1 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. Twelve mixed germ cell tumors from 8 patients without nodal metastasis on retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) and from 4 patients with nodal metastasis were compared. Genomic alterations differed between the two groups, and Y chromosome copy number showed a statistically suggestive difference between metastatic and nonmetastatic cases. The authors suggest Y chromosome deletion may be a genetic marker for predicting progression of clinical stage 1 mixed germ cell NSGCT.

title: Clinical outcomes of patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumours and negative postchemotherapy positron emission tomography.
title_ja: 化学療法後の陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)が陰性であった非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の臨床転帰
summary_ja: 化学療法後のFDG-PET陰性と判定された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍93例を後方視的研究で解析し、PETが無再発生存を正しく予測できなかった因子を検討した。PETの陰性的中率は81.7%であった。診断時の腫瘍マーカー高値、リンパ節病期、残存腫瘤、奇形腫・奇形癌の組織像がPETの予測失敗と関連し、PET陰性のみでは再発を除外できない場合があることが示された。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 93 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors and a negative FDG-PET scan after chemotherapy evaluated factors linked to PET failure in predicting relapse-free survival. Results were validated by long-term follow-up and, in some cases, resection of residual masses. The negative predictive value of PET was 81.7%. Higher tumor marker levels at diagnosis, nodal stage, residual mass, and teratoma or teratocarcinoma histology were associated with PET failure, suggesting that a negative PET alone may not reliably exclude relapse.

title: Can we rely on PET in the follow-up of advanced seminoma patients?
title_ja: 進行セミノーマ患者のフォローアップにおいてPETを信頼できるか？
summary_ja: 本研究は、化学療法を受けた進行セミノーマ患者37例のフォローアップにおけるFDG-PETの有用性を検討した。一部の患者は放射線療法も受けた。PET陽性の患者は後腹膜リンパ節郭清または放射線療法を受け、PET陰性の患者はCTおよび/またはPET/CTで臨床的に経過観察された。PETは2例で偽陽性を示し、PET陰性は安定した病勢と相関した。ただし陰性例では標本を検査できなかったため、サーベイランスでPETに依拠する場合、偽陽性の結果は依然として重要な懸念である。
summary_en: This study assessed FDG-PET as a follow-up tool in 37 patients with advanced seminoma treated with chemotherapy, some of whom also received radiotherapy. PET-positive patients underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or radiotherapy, while PET-negative patients were followed clinically with CT and/or PET/CT. PET gave false-positive results in two cases, and a negative PET correlated with stable disease. However, specimens could not be examined in negative cases, so false-positive results remain an important concern when relying on PET during surveillance.

title: Large teratoma at aortic bifurcation: an unusual metastasis of testicular cancer.
title_ja: 大動脈分岐部の巨大奇形腫：精巣がんのまれな転移
summary_ja: 血清腫瘍マーカーが正常な29歳男性の右精巣腫瘤例を報告する。精巣摘除術で成熟奇形腫とセミノーマ成分が確認された。化学療法4サイクル中に仙骨前腫瘤が増大したため後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、奇形腫で後腹膜リンパ節は陰性であった。精巣がんの孤立性仙骨前転移というまれな経過から、リンパ流の変化が示唆された。
summary_en: A 29-year-old man with a right testicular mass had normal serum tumor markers but a new presacral mass on CT. Orchiectomy revealed a mature teratoma with seminomatous components. After four cycles of chemotherapy, the presacral mass grew, prompting retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, which showed teratoma with negative retroperitoneal nodes. The authors describe this as an unusual isolated presacral metastasis of testicular cancer and suggest that it raises questions about altered lymphatic drainage.

title: Utility of serum tumor markers during surveillance for stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマのサーベイランスにおける血清腫瘍マーカーの有用性
summary_ja: 1982年から2005年に病期Iの精巣セミノーマで監視療法を受けた527例を対象に、腫瘍マーカーの定期測定の有用性を検討した。再発した75例中、再発時にマーカー異常を示したのは11例のみで、再発前に異常を示したのは1例であった。定期的な腫瘍マーカー測定は中止しても安全と結論づけている。
summary_en: This study examined whether routine serum AFP, hCG, and LDH measurements aid early detection of relapse in 527 patients with stage I testicular seminoma managed by surveillance from 1982 to 2005. Of 75 patients who relapsed, 65 had markers measured, and only 11 had abnormal markers at relapse. Markers preceded relapse in only one patient, with no effect on outcome. The authors conclude that routine tumor marker measurement can be safely discontinued in seminoma surveillance schedules.

title: Glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor promotes invasive behaviour in testicular seminoma cells.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ細胞における浸潤促進因子としてのグリア細胞株由来神経栄養因子
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおけるGDNF経路の関与を検討した。GFRA1は上皮内癌および浸潤性セミノーマで過剰発現していたが、Retは発現が認められなかった。TCam-2細胞株ではGDNFは増殖を促さず、SrcおよびMEK経路を介した遊走と、細胞周囲のプロテアーゼ活性に依存する浸潤を誘導した。
summary_en: This study investigated whether glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF) signaling contributes to testicular seminoma progression. GFRA1 was overexpressed in in situ carcinoma and invasive seminoma compared with normal germ cells, whereas Ret was not. In the TCam-2 seminoma cell line, GDNF did not promote proliferation but induced migration through Src and MEK pathways and promoted invasion dependent on pericellular protease activity. These findings suggest the GDNF pathway contributes to progression of testicular germ cell cancer.

title: Germ cell tumor metastatic to the oral cavity.
title_ja: 口腔に転移した胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 25歳男性の歯肉に生じた良性のエピュリス様病変の生検で、精巣がんの転移と判明した症例報告である。精巣原発の胚細胞腫瘍が口腔内に転移し、良性病変と類似しうることを示す。口腔転移は稀であるため、歯肉や歯槽の病変の鑑別では念頭に置く必要がある。
summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with an apparently benign epulis of the gingiva. Biopsy revealed that the lesion was a metastasis of testicular cancer. The case report highlights that metastatic germ cell tumor can mimic a benign oral lesion and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of gingival or alveolar masses. Oral metastases are rare, accounting for less than 1% of oral malignancies, and usually involve soft tissue or the mandible.

title: Early diagnosis of malignant-transformed ovarian mature cystic teratoma: fat-suppressed MRI findings.
title_ja: 悪性転化した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の早期診断：脂肪抑制MRI所見
summary_ja: 79歳女性の5×6cmの卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した粘液性腺癌（病期IA）の症例報告である。脂肪抑制磁気共鳴画像法（MRI）の所見により、術前に悪性転化を疑うことができた。閉経後女性では、腫瘍径5cm未満でもCEA上昇や脂肪抑制MRI所見が悪性転化の指標となりうると提案している。
summary_en: A 79-year-old woman had a 5×6 cm mature cystic teratoma of the ovary that was found to harbor mucinous adenocarcinoma, stage IA. The authors describe fat-suppressed MRI findings that enabled preoperative suspicion of malignant transformation, a rare event. They suggest that in postmenopausal women with mature cystic teratomas, even those under 5 cm, elevated serum CEA and fat-suppressed MRI may indicate malignant transformation and warrant closer evaluation given its poor prognosis.

title: Extraperitoneal laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for early-stage testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors: initial experience.
title_ja: 早期精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する腹膜外腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清：初期経験
summary_ja: 精巣原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の早期症例15例に対し、腹膜外アプローチによる腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った初期経験の報告である。平均手術時間は164分で、順行性射精は全例で温存された。病理学的にリンパ節陽性は3例（20%）であった。2〜32か月の観察期間中に再発は認められず、安全で実施可能な手技と結論づけている。
summary_en: This initial experience reports 15 patients with early-stage testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent extraperitoneal laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after orchiectomy. Operative time averaged 164 minutes, and one vena cava injury and one ureteral obstruction occurred. Three patients (20%) had pathologically positive nodes. Antegrade ejaculation was preserved in all, and no recurrence or distant metastasis occurred over 2 to 32 months of follow-up. The authors conclude the technique is safe and feasible.

title: A translocator protein ligand PK11195 shows antigrowth activity in human choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞におけるトランスロケーター蛋白リガンドPK11195の増殖抑制作用
summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoに対するトランスロケーター蛋白リガンドPK11195の抗腫瘍効果を検討した。PK11195は濃度依存的に細胞増殖を抑制し、細胞周期を変化させ、アポトーシスを誘導した。一方、非選択的リガンドであるジアゼパムの効果はわずかであった。絨毛癌に対する治療薬としての可能性が示唆される。
summary_en: This in vitro study examined the effect of the translocator protein ligand PK11195 on the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line. PK11195 inhibited cell growth in a concentration-dependent manner, while the nonselective ligand diazepam had little effect. Treatment shifted the cell cycle, decreasing S-phase cells and increasing G0/G1 cells, and induced apoptosis, confirmed by Annexin V staining, loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, and DNA fragmentation. Altered expression of genes related to growth, malignant phenotype, and apoptosis accompanied these changes. The authors suggest PK11195 may be a candidate therapeutic agent for choriocarcinoma.

title: Hyperglycosylated human chorionic gonadotropin in serum of testicular cancer patients.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者の血清中におけるハイパーグリコシル化ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者84例の血清を用い、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖修飾体(hCG-h)、hCG、遊離hCGβサブユニットを測定した。血清中hCGの大部分は過糖鎖化されており、hCG-hはhCGと同様の診断価値と予後との関連を示した。術前の遊離hCGβ高値は無増悪生存期間の短縮と関連した。hCG測定法は過糖鎖化hCGを認識する必要があると結論づけられる。
summary_en: This study measured hyperglycosylated hCG (hCG-h), hCG, and free hCG beta subunit in serum from 84 testicular cancer patients across preoperative, relapse, and follow-up samples. Most circulating hCG was hyperglycosylated, and hCG-h correlated closely with hCG in concentration and diagnostic value. Preoperative hCG-h tracked with prognostic factors and outcome similarly to hCG. Elevated preoperative free hCG beta predicted shorter progression-free survival. The authors conclude that hCG assays used for testicular cancer management should recognize hyperglycosylated hCG.

title: Metastasizing testicular seminoma in a pet rabbit.
title_ja: ペットのウサギにみられた転移性精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 9歳のペットのライオンヘッドウサギに、片側精巣の腫大と腹部腫瘤が認められた。らせんコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腰下リンパ節付近の腹骨盤内腫瘤が確認された。精巣とリンパ節の病理組織学的検査で悪性セミノーマが広範に置換しており、自然発生的な転移が確認された。動物における精巣セミノーマ転移の症例報告である。
summary_en: A 9-year-old pet lionhead rabbit presented with unilateral testicular enlargement and an abdominal mass. Spiral computed tomography revealed an abdominal-pelvic mass near the sublumbar lymph nodes. Histopathological examination of the testis and lymph node showed diffuse replacement by malignant seminoma, indicating spontaneous metastasis. The report describes a veterinary case of metastasizing testicular seminoma, adding to comparative oncology data on germ cell tumors in non-human species.

title: Functional reconstruction of epignathus with cleft palate using part of a mature teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟奇形腫の一部を用いた口蓋裂を伴うエピグナサスの機能的再建
summary_ja: 口腔から発生する稀な先天性奇形腫であるエピグナサスと完全口蓋裂を有する乳児例の報告である。生後3か月で腫瘍を一部残して切除し、8か月時に残存腫瘍組織と左側の低形成口蓋挙筋を用いて二重対向Z形成術を施行した。10歳時点で咽頭弁機能と上顎発育は良好であった。
summary_en: An infant with epignathus, a rare congenital teratoma arising from the oral cavity, had a complete cleft palate and a large mature teratoma protruding from the right soft palate. Primary excision was performed at 3 months, leaving a portion of tumor tissue. At 8 months, a double-opposing Z-plasty was performed using this retained tumor tissue together with the left hypoplastic levator veli palatini muscle. At 10 years of age, velopharyngeal function and maxillary growth were good.

title: Stage I seminoma: treatment outcome at King Hussein Cancer Center in Jordan.
title_ja: 病期I セミノーマ：ヨルダン、King Hussein Cancer Centerにおける治療成績
summary_ja: ヨルダンの単一施設で行われた本研究は、2003年から2010年の間に治療された純粋病期Iセミノーマ74例を後方視的に検討した。全例が精巣摘除術を受け、3例を除く全例が術後補助放射線療法を受けた。平均33か月の追跡で3年無再発生存率は95.9%であった。再発は4 cmを超える腫瘍の患者にのみ認められ、再発前に腫瘍マーカーの上昇はなかった。ほぼすべての再発は化学療法で救済された。
summary_en: This single-institution study from Jordan reviewed 74 patients with pure stage I seminoma treated between 2003 and 2010. All underwent orchiectomy, and all but three received adjuvant radiotherapy. Patients with prior scrotal violation received further excision or irradiation of the scrotal scar. With a mean follow-up of 33 months, three-year relapse-free survival was 95.9%. All relapses occurred in patients with tumors larger than 4 cm, and no elevated tumor markers preceded relapse. Nearly all relapses were salvaged with chemotherapy.

title: Perinatal airway management of neonatal cervical teratomas.
title_ja: 新生児頸部奇形腫の周産期気道管理
summary_ja: 胎児期に磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で評価された、気道を圧迫する頸部奇形腫の新生児3例の後方視的症例集積である。2例は出生直後に気管挿管を行い、1例はEXIT手技を要した。全例が生後数日以内に外科的切除を受けた。腫瘍内出血のリスクから出生時の気管挿管を推奨し、早期の手術計画の重要性を示している。
summary_en: This retrospective case series describes three neonates with cervical teratomas that threatened the airway, managed over 12 months. Prenatal fetal MRI guided multidisciplinary planning. Two infants were intubated promptly after birth, and one required an EXIT procedure. All underwent surgical resection in the first days of life. The authors recommend fetal MRI, routine intubation at birth due to the risk of intratumoral hemorrhage, and early surgical planning because rapid tumor growth can compromise overlying skin.

title: Extragonadal mixed germ cell tumor of the right arm: description of the first case in the literature.
title_ja: 右上肢に発生した性腺外混合型胚細胞腫瘍：文献上初の症例
summary_ja: 37歳男性の右上腕軟部組織に発生した、原発性の悪性混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(奇形癌型)の症例。性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍で上腕発生の報告は初めてである。シスプラチン併用化学療法と手術を併用して治療された。18か月のフォローアップで局所再発や遠隔転移は認められなかった。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍には化学療法と手術の併用が最も適切であると結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes a 37-year-old man with a primary malignant mixed non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of teratocarcinoma type in the right arm, a site not previously reported for extragonadal GCTs. The tumor was treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy combined with surgery. After 18 months of close follow-up, no locoregional recurrence or distant metastasis was detected. The authors conclude that combined chemotherapy and surgery is the most appropriate strategy for extragonadal GCTs, providing both local and systemic control.

title: Successful in utero treatment of an oral teratoma via operative fetoscopy: case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 手術的胎児内視鏡による口腔奇形腫の子宮内治療成功例：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 胎児の口腔奇形腫に対し、手術的胎児内視鏡を用いた子宮内治療に成功した症例報告。鼻咽頭奇形腫の出生前診断は従来、予後が極めて不良で、胎児死亡や出生直後の緊急手術に至ることが多かった。本例では出生前に腫瘍を治療し、健康な児を満期で出産した。気道閉塞や出生後の複数回手術を回避できた点が報告されている。文献レビューも含む。
summary_en: This case report describes successful in utero treatment of a fetal oral teratoma using operative fetoscopy. Prenatal diagnosis of nasopharyngeal teratoma historically carries a very poor prognosis, with fetal demise or emergent airway surgery at birth. The authors treated the tumor before birth and delivered a healthy infant at term, avoiding the airway obstruction and multiple postnatal surgeries that often follow. The paper also reviews the literature on this rare extragonadal teratoma and its antenatal management.

title: Choriocarcinoma of the lung: report of a case.
title_ja: 肺の絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 27歳女性の孤立性肺結節に対し、胸腔鏡下手術で絨毛癌と診断された症例報告。婦人科的検査で原発巣は見つからなかった。病理では肺動脈内に腫瘍塞栓が認められ、既往妊娠に由来する妊娠性絨毛癌の肺転移と判断された。術後の再発はない。既往妊娠のある症例では、孤立性肺病変に妊娠性絨毛癌を考慮すべきと指摘している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with a solitary pulmonary nodule diagnosed as choriocarcinoma by video-assisted thoracic surgery after CT-guided biopsy was inconclusive. Gynecologic evaluation, including ultrasonography, MRI, and PET, found no primary lesion. Histology showed tumor emboli in pulmonary arteries without primary lung carcinoma, indicating metastasis of gestational choriocarcinoma from an antecedent pregnancy. No recurrence was observed after surgery. The authors emphasize that a prior gestation should prompt consideration of gestational choriocarcinoma in solitary pulmonary lesions.

title: Human embryonic stem cells fail to activate CHK1 and commit to apoptosis in response to DNA replication stress.
title_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞は、DNA複製ストレスに対してCHK1を活性化せず、アポトーシスに陥る
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒトES細胞と胚細胞腫瘍の悪性対応物である胎児性癌(EC)細胞はDNA複製阻害剤に対してS期チェックポイントを活性化できず、DNA修復ではなくアポトーシスに進むことが示された。多能性細胞はDNA修復よりも損傷細胞の除去によってゲノム完全性を保つと考えられ、そのバランスの崩れがゲノム不安定性につながる可能性がある。
summary_en: Human embryonic stem cells (hESCs) and embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the malignant counterpart of germ cell tumors, were exposed to DNA replication inhibitors. Both cell types failed to activate S-phase checkpoints, failed to form RPA, γH2AX, or RAD51 foci, and did not generate the single-stranded DNA needed for checkpoint activation and repair. Instead, they committed to apoptosis. The authors propose that pluripotent cells maintain genome integrity by eliminating damaged cells rather than repairing DNA.

title: Surgical treatment of toraco-abdominal teratoma diagnosed in utero, approached with mini-invasive technique: a case report.
title_ja: 子宮内診断された胸腹部奇形腫に対する低侵襲手術：症例報告
summary_ja: 子宮内で診断された胸腹部奇形腫の新生児に対し、胸腔鏡と腹腔鏡による低侵襲手術を行った症例報告。病理学的に成熟奇形腫と確認された。術後8日目に退院し、1年間のフォローアップで再発はみられなかった。多発性病変の評価と段階的治療計画に低侵襲手術が有用で、出生前カウンセリングを含む多職種による管理が必要とされる。
summary_en: A fetus diagnosed in utero with a thoracoabdominal teratoma was treated after birth using minimally invasive thoracoscopic and laparoscopic surgery. Histology confirmed a mature teratoma. The procedure was well tolerated, with discharge on postoperative day 8 and no recurrence at one-year follow-up. The authors argue that minimally invasive surgery allows histological assessment of the multifocal mass and staged treatment planning, and that such rare cases require multidisciplinary management with prenatal counselling.

title: Ovarian cystic tumor composed of Brenner tumor and struma ovarii.
title_ja: ブレンナー腫瘍と卵巣甲状腺腫からなる卵巣嚢胞性腫瘍
summary_ja: 66歳女性が出血性卵巣嚢胞の捻転に対し卵巣摘出術を受けた。嚢胞壁はブレンナー腫瘍と卵巣甲状腺腫のみで構成され、悪性転化は認められなかった。単一胚葉性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫である可能性や、既存の卵巣甲状腺腫の表面上皮由来である可能性が示唆され、嚢胞捻転で発症しうると報告された。
summary_en: A 66-year-old woman underwent oophorectomy for torsion of a hemorrhagic ovarian cyst. The cyst wall consisted entirely of Brenner tumor and struma ovarii, with no other elements and no malignant transformation. Immunohistochemistry characterized each component. The authors suggest this may represent a monodermal mature cystic teratoma, or that the Brenner tumor arose from surface epithelium of a pre-existing struma ovarii, and note that such tumors can present with cystic torsion.

title: Effects of N-acetylcystein on bleomycin-induced apoptosis in malignant testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞におけるブレオマイシン誘導性アポトーシスに対するN-アセチルシステインの効果
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、抗酸化物質N-アセチルシステイン(NAC)が、精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来のNCCIT細胞においてブレオマイシン誘導性アポトーシスに及ぼす影響を検討した。NACはミトコンドリア経路を阻害してアポトーシスを抑制し、がん細胞の化学療法への抵抗性を高める可能性が示された。抗がん療法中の抗酸化剤併用には注意が必要である。
summary_en: This study examined how N-acetylcysteine (NAC), an antioxidant, affects bleomycin-induced apoptosis in NCCIT cells, a human testicular germ cell tumor line with embryonal carcinoma features. Bleomycin induced apoptosis through caspase activation and changes in Bcl-2, Bax and cytochrome c. Co-treatment with 10 mM NAC abolished these effects by inhibiting the mitochondrial pathway. The authors conclude that NAC may promote resistance to apoptosis and reduce chemotherapy efficacy, which is undesirable in cancer treatment, and suggest caution with antioxidant use during bleomycin-based therapy.

title: Rediscovering pluripotency: from teratocarcinomas to embryonic stem cells. Cardiff, 10-12 October 2011.
title_ja: 多能性の再発見：奇形癌から胚性幹細胞まで(カーディフ、2011年10月10～12日)
summary_ja: 2011年にカーディフで開催された学会の報告であり、奇形癌から胚性幹細胞に至る多能性研究の歴史を振り返っている。多能性幹細胞の基盤となった胎児性癌細胞の研究の重要性が論じられた。多能性の分子機構や初期胚との関係が討議され、今後の課題も示された。
summary_en: This meeting report from the 2011 Cardiff workshop traces the history of pluripotency research from teratocarcinoma to embryonic stem cells. Embryonal carcinoma cells, first derived from teratocarcinomas, served as the foundation for the pluripotent stem cell field. Sessions covered the genetic and epigenetic makeup of pluripotent cells, the mechanisms controlling their fate, and their relationship to the early embryo. Early researchers in the field participated in revisiting earlier questions. The report highlights how much progress has been made in understanding pluripotency and how much remains to be learned about these cells and their therapeutic potential.

title: MMTV-neu mice deficient in STAT1 are susceptible to develop ovarian teratomas.
title_ja: STAT1欠損MMTV-neuマウスにおける卵巣奇形腫の発生
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: STAT1を欠損したMMTV-neuマウスの9匹で、良性類皮嚢腫に類似した分化型卵巣奇形腫が発生した。STAT1欠損は、MMTV-neuの発現と遺伝的背景に依存して奇形腫形成を促進すると考えられる。STAT1は、異常な卵胞をアポトーシスで除去することにより、奇形腫化を防ぐ役割を担う可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study found that STAT1-deficient MMTV-neu mice developed differentiated ovarian teratomas resembling benign dermoid cysts, with no chromosomal rearrangements. Tumors did not occur in STAT1-proficient mice or in STAT1-deficient mice on a different genetic background, indicating that STAT1 loss promotes teratoma formation in a manner dependent on MMTV-neu expression and genetic background. Ovarian follicle development was normal in non-tumor-bearing mice. The authors suggest STAT1 protects against teratoma formation at a later stage, possibly by inducing apoptosis of aberrant follicles that could otherwise transform into teratomas.

title: Case of peptide-YY-producing strumal carcinoid of the ovary: a case report and review.
title_ja: ペプチドYY産生性卵巣ストルマ性カルチノイドの1例：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 48歳女性の右卵巣に生じた60×50mmの充実性腫瘍を報告した。切除標本の病理検査でストルマ性カルチノイドと診断され、ペプチドYYが陽性であった。術後に重度の便秘が速やかに改善し、腫瘍による便秘と考察された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old woman with a 60 × 50 mm solid right ovarian tumor found incidentally on ultrasonography and confirmed by MRI. After right adnexectomy, the tumor was diagnosed as strumal carcinoid, a monodermal teratoma subtype, and immunohistochemistry showed peptide YY positivity. The patient had severe constipation, which resolved rapidly after surgery. The authors conclude that the constipation was caused by the peptide-YY-producing ovarian tumor, supporting a previously recognized link between such carcinoids and constipation. The case adds to the literature on functional ovarian carcinoids.

title: Early prenatal detection of a fast-growing fetal epignathus.
title_ja: 急速に増大する胎児エピグナトゥスの早期出生前診断
summary_ja: 妊娠18週の超音波検査で、胎児の口から突出する急速増大性の先天性奇形腫(エピグナトゥス)が出生前に診断された。胎児病理検査で、腫瘤が硬口蓋や椎体骨膜に付着し、気道と食道を閉塞していたことが示された。出生後の外科的切除は困難と判断され、夫婦は妊娠中絶を選択した。
summary_en: This report describes a rapidly growing fetal epignathus, a rare congenital orofacial teratoma, diagnosed prenatally at 18 weeks' gestation by ultrasonography, which showed a tumor protruding from the fetal mouth, absent stomach visualization, and extreme polyhydramnios. After counseling, the couple chose pregnancy termination. Fetopathology revealed the mass extended downward, attached to the hard palate and vertebral periosteum, and caused airway and esophageal obstruction. The authors conclude that postnatal surgical removal would likely be impossible, and that early detection of such a fast-growing epignathus may justify considering pregnancy termination.

title: Minilaparotomy a good option in specific cases: a case report of bilateral ovarian germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 特定症例におけるミニ開腹術の有用性：両側卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告
summary_ja: 39歳女性の両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例で、妊娠中に診断された。急性腹痛で受診し、左卵巣捻転に対し腹腔鏡下整復を試みたが、嚢胞破裂を避けるため中止した。2週間後にミニ開腹術で嚢胞を摘出し、卵巣温存に配慮した手術が行われた。ミニ開腹術は適切な症例で有用な選択肢と考えられた。
summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman with acute abdominal pain and a bilateral mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, first diagnosed during pregnancy. Laparoscopic detorsion was performed for a suspected left ovarian torsion but was interrupted to avoid cyst rupture. Two weeks later, minilaparotomy was used to remove the masses. A left salpingo-oophorectomy was required because the cyst involved the entire ovary, while the right dermoid cyst was fully excised, preserving ovarian tissue. The authors argue that minilaparotomy offers shorter operative time, a lower learning curve, safer extraction, and better ovarian preservation than laparoscopy in selected cases.

title: Retrospective evaluation of tumor markers in ovarian mature cystic teratoma and ovarian endometrioma.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と卵巣子宮内膜症における腫瘍マーカーの後方視的評価
summary_ja: 後方視的研究で、卵巣子宮内膜症321例と卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫435例の腫瘍マーカーを比較した。CA19-9は奇形腫の50.6%で上昇し、CA125とCA19-9は腫瘍径と相関した。STNは臨床病理学的因子の影響を受けず、悪性の検出における有用性についてはさらなる検討が必要とされた。
summary_en: This retrospective study compared serum tumor markers CA125, CA19-9, sialyl Tn antigen (STN), and squamous cell carcinoma antigen (SCC) in 321 patients with ovarian endometrioma and 435 patients with ovarian mature cystic teratoma. CA125 was elevated in 53.3% of endometriomas, while CA19-9 was elevated in 50.6% of teratomas. CA125 and CA19-9 correlated with tumor diameter, whereas STN and SCC did not. The authors conclude that STN levels were not influenced by clinicopathologic factors in either condition, and that further studies are needed to determine whether STN can detect malignancy in these benign-appearing ovarian lesions.

title: Exacerbation of chronic hepatitis B during chemotherapy due to testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマに起因する化学療法中のB型慢性肝炎の増悪
summary_ja: 慢性B型肝炎の患者が精巣セミノーマに対して化学療法を受けた際、抗ウイルス薬の中止後に肝炎が増悪した症例を報告する。免疫抑制から回復する過程で肝細胞障害が生じた。HBV感染者が免疫抑制療法を受ける場合は、病期によらず抗ウイルス療法を行うことを推奨している。
summary_en: The authors describe a patient with chronic hepatitis B who developed a hepatitis flare after antiviral therapy was stopped and chemotherapy was started for testicular seminoma. Chemotherapy-related immunosuppression enhanced viral replication, and immune recovery after withdrawal led to hepatocyte destruction and liver decompensation. The paper recommends antiviral treatment for HBV-infected patients receiving immunosuppressive therapy, regardless of disease stage, preferably using agents with the lowest risk of resistance mutations. The report highlights a practical management problem in germ cell tumor care.

title: Extragonadal seminoma presenting as a large mass in the pelvic cavity without c-kit-activating mutations.
title_ja: c-kit活性化変異を認めない、骨盤腔内の大きな腫瘤として呈した性腺外セミノーマ
summary_ja: 排尿困難と腹部膨満を呈した58歳男性の骨盤内の大きな腫瘤を報告する。開腹生検でセミノーマ様の悪性細胞が確認され、性腺外セミノーマと診断された。化学療法と放射線療法が奏功した。骨盤原発のセミノーマは極めて稀であり、骨盤内腫瘤の鑑別に考慮すべきである。
summary_en: The authors report a 58-year-old man with urinary retention and abdominal distension who was found to have a large pelvic mass. Open biopsy showed seminomatous malignant cells that were positive for vimentin, placental alkaline phosphatase and c-kit, and no c-kit activating mutation was identified. Diagnosed as extragonadal seminoma, the patient responded to chemotherapy followed by radiation therapy. The authors note that primary pelvic seminoma is extremely rare and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of pelvic masses.

title: Reproductive function after treatment of ovarian germ cell malignancy.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍治療後の生殖機能
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍の33例を後方視的に検討した。妊孕性温存手術とBEP療法による補助化学療法の後、約7割が6か月以内に月経を再開した。5例が妊娠し、5例が生児を得た。全生存期間(全生存率)は87.9%だが、30.3%が再発した。卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型が予後不良因子で、より強力・長期の補助療法が必要と示唆された。
summary_en: This retrospective Malaysian series reviewed 33 women treated for ovarian germ cell malignancy with fertility-sparing surgery and adjuvant BEP chemotherapy. About 71% resumed menses within six months, and five patients conceived with five live births. Overall survival was 87.9% at a median follow-up of 45 months, while 30% had recurrence. Yolk sac tumor histology was the most important adverse prognostic factor, suggesting these patients may need more intensive or longer adjuvant therapy.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease: an overview.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患：概説
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎から悪性の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍までを含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患を概説した総説です。分類、症状、診断法、治療法を扱い、助産師が早期に紹介できるよう危険因子と症状の理解を促しています。また妊娠喪失や生命を脅かす疾患を経験した女性の心理社会的側面と、助産師によるカウンセリングやフォローアップの役割にも触れています。
summary_en: This review summarizes gestational trophoblastic disease, from molar pregnancy to malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, including its classification, symptoms, diagnostic modalities, and treatment options. Written for midwives, it stresses recognizing risk factors and symptoms for timely referral. It also addresses the psychosocial burden on women who have experienced pregnancy loss and may face life-threatening illness, and the midwife's role in counseling and follow-up.

title: Teratomas and ovarian lesions in children.
title_ja: 小児の奇形腫と卵巣病変
summary_ja: 小児の卵巣病変は多様で頻度も高く、本総説はその病理を扱います。小児期に最も多い良性卵巣腫瘍は奇形腫であり、これら胚細胞腫瘍の起源を論じます。さらに小児卵巣病変の幅広いスペクトルを整理し、若年患者の病態理解の枠組みを示しています。小児外科医と病理医を対象とした簡潔な概説です。
summary_en: This review addresses ovarian pathology in children, which is common and diverse. It identifies teratoma as the most frequent benign ovarian tumor in childhood and discusses the origin of these germ cell tumors. The article then covers the broader spectrum of pediatric ovarian lesions, providing a framework for understanding their pathology in young patients. It is a concise overview intended for pediatric surgeons and pathologists.

title: Pediatric malignancies: neuroblastoma, Wilm's tumor, hepatoblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and sacroccygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 小児悪性腫瘍：神経芽腫、Wilms腫瘍、肝芽腫、横紋筋肉腫、仙尾部奇形腫
summary_ja: 小児の主要な悪性腫瘍5種(神経芽腫、Wilms腫瘍、肝芽腫、横紋筋肉腫、仙尾部奇形腫)を扱う総説です。各疾患について症状提示、診断、病期分類、治療、長期予後を論じ、特に外科的管理に焦点を当てています。仙尾部奇形腫は主題の一つとして取り上げられています。
summary_en: This pediatric oncology review covers five common childhood malignancies: neuroblastoma, Wilms tumor, hepatoblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and sacrococcygeal teratoma. For each, it discusses presentation, diagnosis, staging, treatment, and long-term prognosis, with particular attention to surgical management. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is one of the five subjects, so germ cell tumor content is substantive, although the paper covers multiple entities.

title: Abdominal swelling in two teenage girls: two case reports of massive ovarian tumours in puberty.
title_ja: 思春期の少女2例における巨大卵巣腫瘍：2症例報告
summary_ja: 15歳の少女2例が巨大な腹部膨隆を呈した症例報告です。症状と血清腫瘍マーカーの上昇パターンは2例で異なりました。CTとMRIで卵巣由来の腫瘤が確認され、嚢腫摘出後の病理で成熟奇形腫と粘液性嚢胞腺腫が認められました。思春期の巨大卵巣腫瘍における腫瘍マーカーと画像診断の有用性を示しています。
summary_en: Two 15-year-old girls presented with giant abdominal swelling caused by ovarian masses. Their symptoms differed, and serum tumor markers showed different elevation patterns. CT and MRI identified the masses as originating from the ovary. Histopathology after cystectomy showed a mature teratoma and a mucinous cystadenoma, illustrating the diagnostic challenge of massive ovarian tumors in puberty and the value of tumor markers and imaging.

title: Primary teratoma of the lesser sac: lesser sac teratoma.
title_ja: 網嚢の原発性奇形腫：網嚢奇形腫
summary_ja: 27歳男性に発見された無症候性の8cm奇形腫を報告する症例報告です。網嚢内に生じた奇形腫としては4例目であり、既報例との比較が可能です。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の病因論と、網嚢に生じる奇形腫との関連についても考察しています。正中構造に生じる性腺外発生の点が強調されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with an asymptomatic 8 cm teratoma located in the lesser sac of the omentum. It is the fourth reported teratoma in this location, allowing comparison with prior cases. The authors discuss etiologic theories of extragonadal germ cell tumors and how they relate to teratomas arising in the lesser sac. The midline, extragonadal origin is highlighted.

title: Presacral teratocarcinoma presenting as anal fistula and rectal adenocarcinoma: a unique case presentation and literature review.
title_ja: 仙骨前奇形癌として発症した肛門瘻と直腸腺癌: 症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 37歳男性で、仙骨前原発奇形腫由来の呼吸器型腺癌を報告している。初診時は肛門瘻と直腸腺癌と考えられていた。両腫瘍は形態と免疫表現型が一致し、正常呼吸上皮からの悪性転化像も認められた。仙骨前成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの同型腺癌としては本例が2例目とされ、文献的考察を加えている。
summary_en: Reports a 37-year-old man whose presacral primary teratoma gave rise to respiratory-type adenocarcinoma, which first presented as an anal fistula and rectal adenocarcinoma. Both tumors shared morphology and immunophenotype, and malignant transformation from normal respiratory epithelium was observed. The authors state this is only the second reported case of respiratory-type adenocarcinoma arising from a presacral mature cystic teratoma and review the literature.

title: Do high levels of CA 19-9 in women with mature cystic teratomas of the ovary warrant further evaluation?
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の女性におけるCA 19-9高値は、さらなる評価を要するか
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の女性157例で血清腫瘍マーカーを検討した。CA19-9のみが平均値でカットオフを超え、33.1%で上昇していた。上昇例は腫瘍径が大きく、癒着やCA125高値を伴っていた。術後には低下する傾向があり、無症状の若年患者では他の原因の精査を急がなくてよいと考察している。
summary_en: Evaluates serum tumor markers, particularly CA 19-9, in 157 women with ovarian mature cystic teratoma. CA 19-9 was the only marker with a mean level above the cut-off, and 33.1% of patients had elevated values. Elevation was associated with larger tumor size, adhesions, and higher CA 125. Levels generally decreased after surgery. The authors suggest that CA 19-9 elevation is expected in these tumors and that other sources should not be pursued urgently in asymptomatic young patients.

title: Struma ovarii with follicular thyroid-type carcinoma and neuroendocrine component: case report.
title_ja: 神経内分泌成分を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫由来の濾胞性甲状腺型癌: 症例報告
summary_ja: 50歳女性で、胃の間葉系腫瘍の精査中に右付属器の充実性腫瘤が偶然見つかった。組織学的に卵巣甲状腺腫由来の濾胞性甲状腺型癌と、高分化型神経内分泌成分が認められた。胃切除、子宮全摘、両側卵管卵巣摘出などを施行し、1年後のフォローアップでは良好な経過だった。
summary_en: Reports a 50-year-old woman in whom a right adnexal mass was found incidentally during workup of a gastric antral mesenchymal lesion. Histology showed follicular thyroid-type carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, with a well-differentiated neuroendocrine component, alongside a gastric cavernous angioma. Treatment consisted of gastrectomy, total hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy with lymph node dissection, and omentectomy. The patient had a favorable outcome at one-year follow-up.

title: Treatment of respiratory failure in metastatic pulmonary choriocarcinoma: an experience at Peking Union Medical College Hospital, China.
title_ja: 転移性肺絨毛癌における呼吸不全の治療: 北京協和医院の経験
summary_ja: 1995年から2010年に当院で治療した転移性肺絨毛癌による急性呼吸不全の患者16例を後方視的に検討した。肺感染症が大部分、肺出血が半数に認められた。全例が人工呼吸管理を要した。低用量または変更した化学療法で治療し、7例が完全寛解に至った。穏やかな化学療法と呼吸補助の併用が有効と結論している。
summary_en: Retrospectively reviews 16 patients treated at Peking Union Medical College Hospital from 1995 to 2010 for acute respiratory failure caused by metastatic pulmonary choriocarcinoma. Most had pulmonary infection and half had hemorrhage. All required face-mask or mechanical ventilation. Most received low-dose or modified initial chemotherapy; seven achieved complete remission, six of whom were alive at a median follow-up of 59 months. The authors conclude that gentle chemotherapy with ventilatory support is feasible and effective.

title: Fertility-preserving treatment in young patients with placental site trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 若年患者における胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の妊孕性温存治療
summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の若年患者6例を後方視的に検討した。手術と化学療法を組み合わせ、5例は子宮内動脈注入化学療法を受けた。平均47か月のフォローアップで全例が完全寛解し、再発はなく月経も回復、うち1例は出産に至った。妊孕性温存療法の適応条件も示している。
summary_en: Retrospectively reviews six young patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor treated with fertility-sparing approaches that combined surgery and chemotherapy, five of whom received intrauterine arterial infusion chemotherapy. Polypoid and nodular tumors were managed with curettage or resection plus combination chemotherapy. After 10 to 104 months of follow-up, all six achieved complete remission without recurrence and regained normal menses, and one had a normal delivery. The authors define criteria for fertility-conserving therapy.

title: Teratoma with somatic-type malignant components of the testis. A review and an update.
title_ja: 精巣の体細胞型悪性成分を伴う奇形腫：総説と最新情報
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍において体細胞型悪性成分を伴う奇形腫を、総説と最新知見としてまとめた。悪性転化は成人例の43%が原発巣で見つかり、残りは再発時または転移巣で発覚する。病期Iの予後は良好だが、切除不能な転移例は極めて不良である。根治的手術と標準的化学療法に加え、転化を意識した治療の有用性が示唆されている。
summary_en: This review examines teratomas with somatic-type malignant components, a form of malignant transformation, in testicular germ cell tumors. Such transformation is uncommon; 43% of adult cases were found within primary tumors, with the rest arising at relapse or in metastases. Stage I patients have an excellent prognosis, whereas non-resectable metastatic somatic-type malignancies have a dismal outlook. Radical surgery and standard chemotherapy remain central, and the authors argue that transformation-oriented treatment may benefit these patients. Better understanding of the biology is emphasized for clinical management.

title: Struma ovarii and the thyroid surgeon.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫と甲状腺外科医
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の一種である卵巣甲状腺腫の2症例を報告した。1例目は濾胞癌を伴う症例で甲状腺全摘と放射性ヨウ素治療が行われた。2例目は甲状腺切除後も甲状腺中毒症が持続し、全身放射性ヨウ素シンチグラフィーで卵巣への集積を認め、良性の卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。良性・悪性いずれの病型の診療にも甲状腺外科医の役割が重要であると述べている。
summary_en: This report describes two cases of struma ovarii, a rare monodermal ovarian teratoma. In the first, a 40-year-old woman had follicular carcinoma arising within struma ovarii and underwent total thyroidectomy followed by radioiodine therapy. In the second, a 60-year-old woman with thyrotoxicosis remained hyperthyroid after thyroidectomy; a whole-body radioiodine scan showed ovarian uptake, and histology confirmed benign struma ovarii. The authors highlight the role of thyroid surgeons in diagnosing and managing both benign and malignant forms.

title: Dysgerminoma in a female with turner syndrome and Y chromosome material: A case-based review of literature.
title_ja: ターナー症候群かつY染色体物質を有する女性の卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ：症例に基づく文献的考察
summary_ja: 原発性無月経を呈したターナー症候群で、Y染色体由来の細胞株(46X inv(Y))を有する17歳女性の症例報告である。結合型エストロゲン投与後に腹部腫瘤が出現し、切除で右卵巣のディスジャーミノーマと確定した。浸潤・転移はなかった。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症機序、細胞遺伝学的所見と本症例への対応を文献的に考察している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with Turner syndrome and a Y-chromosome cell line (46X inv(Y)) who presented with primary amenorrhea. After conjugated estrogen treatment and a recommendation for prophylactic oophorectomy, she developed an abdominal mass; resection confirmed a right ovarian dysgerminoma without invasion or metastasis. The authors review pathogenetic mechanisms of ovarian germ cell tumors, cytogenetic findings, and management recommendations for similar cases, emphasizing the role of Y-chromosome material in gonadal tumor risk.

title: Chorangiocarcinoma of the placenta: a case report and clinical review.
title_ja: 胎盤の絨毛血管癌：症例報告と臨床的レビュー
summary_ja: 正期産胎盤に生じた絨毛血管癌(絨毛血管腫内の悪性トロホブラスト増殖)の症例報告である。妊娠中期に超音波検査で発見され、経腟分娩で健児が出生した。組織学的に多核・異型のトロホブラストと壊死、高い核分裂像を認め、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が強陽性、Ki-67指数は高値であった。出生後3か月のフォローアップで母児とも転移はなかった。
summary_en: This case report describes chorangiocarcinoma, a malignant trophoblastic proliferation within a chorangioma, found in a term placenta. The lesion was detected by ultrasound during second-trimester screening, and a healthy child was delivered vaginally. Histology showed multinucleated, pleomorphic trophoblastic nodules with necrosis and high mitotic activity, strongly positive for hCG and with a high Ki-67 index. No extravascular stromal invasion was seen. Follow-up to three months after birth showed no metastases in mother or child. The authors note this is only the fifth reported case.

title: EP-EMA regimen (etoposide and cisplatin with etoposide, methotrexate, and dactinomycin) in a series of 18 women with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍18例に対するEP-EMAレジメンの検討
summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の女性18例に対するEP-EMAレジメンの後方視的検討である。初回治療6例、メトトレキサート単剤後の救援化学療法10例などに用いられ、89%が再発なく完全寛解した。死亡は胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と絨毛癌の各1例であった。耳毒性やグレード3/4の好中球減少が高頻度にみられた。
summary_en: This retrospective chart review of 18 women with high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia evaluates the EP-EMA regimen (etoposide and cisplatin alternating with etoposide, methotrexate, and dactinomycin). Six patients received it first-line, one had placental site trophoblastic tumor, and ten received it as salvage after single-agent methotrexate. Complete remission without recurrence occurred in 89%. Two patients died, one with placental site trophoblastic tumor and one with metastatic choriocarcinoma. Toxicity was significant, with ototoxicity requiring regimen changes and grade 3/4 neutropenia in 83%.

title: Intramedullary spinal cord metastasis of choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 絨毛癌の脊髄髄内転移
summary_ja: 21歳女性の絨毛癌が大脳皮質、椎体、脊髄髄内に転移した症例報告。頭痛と視野欠損で発症し、頭蓋内出血に対して手術を行い、絨毛癌と診断された。再手術、化学療法、放射線療法を行ったが対麻痺が進行し、診断から13か月後に死亡した。胚細胞腫瘍のまれな中枢神経転移の経過を示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma that metastasized to the cerebral cortex, vertebral body, and intramedullary spinal cord. She presented with sudden headache, vomiting, and a visual field defect caused by intracranial hemorrhage. Surgical removal of the hemorrhage and enhancing masses was performed, and histology confirmed choriocarcinoma. Despite repeated emergency surgery, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy, she developed paraplegia and died 13 months after diagnosis. The case illustrates a rare central nervous system metastasis of a germ cell tumor with a fatal course.

title: Prenatal diagnosis of a huge facial tumor: report of a rare case and literature review.
title_ja: 巨大な顔面腫瘍の出生前診断：稀な症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 妊娠26週に右側頭部に発見された胎児顔面奇形腫の出生前診断を報告する症例報告と文献レビュー。超音波検査と胎児MRIが周産期管理に有用であった。腫瘍による顔面構造の圧排があったが、完全切除後の予後は良好であった。
summary_en: This report describes the prenatal diagnosis at 26 weeks' gestation of a fetal facial teratoma on the right temporal side. Two-dimensional and four-dimensional ultrasonography, along with fetal MRI, supported perinatal management and helped families understand the malformation. The tumor grew extensively, exerting marked pressure on surrounding facial structures. After complete tumor resection, perinatal prognosis was good. The paper also reviews neonatal tumors, in which teratomas are the most frequent solid neoplasms.

title: Clipless laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection using bipolar electrocoagulation for sealing lymphatic vessels: initial series.
title_ja: バイポーラ電気凝固を用いたクリップレス腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清：初期症例シリーズ
summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍13例に対し、リンパ管の閉鎖にクリップではなくバイポーラ凝固を用いた腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の初期成績を報告する。平均約30か月の追跡で再手術やリンパ漏の遷延はなく、手術成績への影響はないとされた。
summary_en: This initial series evaluates laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (LRPLND) using bipolar electrocoagulation instead of clips to seal lymphatic vessels. Thirteen patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis underwent transperitoneal LRPLND between 2002 and 2008. Lymphocele or lymphatic leakage was monitored with abdominal CT. No reoperation was needed, and no prolonged leakage or lymphocele formation occurred over a mean follow-up of about 30 months. The authors conclude that bipolar sealing does not compromise outcomes, pending randomized trials.

title: Perforating abomasal ulcer caused by yolk sac tumor in a Holstein calf.
title_ja: ホルスタイン子牛の卵黄嚢腫瘍による穿孔性皺胃潰瘍
summary_ja: 生後2か月のホルスタイン子牛の剖検例。腹腔内に多発する結節と穿孔性皺胃潰瘍を認め、組織学的にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性の類上皮様腫瘍細胞から成っていた。牛の稀な胚細胞腫瘍である卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された、獣医病理学的な症例報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 2-month-old Holstein calf with abdominal bloating, melena, and pain, in whom necropsy revealed a perforating abomasal ulcer and widespread milky white nodular masses in the abdominal cavity. Microscopy showed hyaline matrices and atypical epithelioid tumor cells, and the tumor cells were positive for anti-human alpha-fetoprotein. The authors conclude that the masses were yolk sac tumor, a rare germ cell tumor in cattle. The report presents a veterinary example of this neoplasm.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome: a rare case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: Growing teratoma syndrome：稀な症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 若年者に多い稀なgrowing teratoma syndromeの症例報告と文献レビュー。初回の外科的切除後に化学療法を行うと腫瘍が増大し、その時点で診断に至ることがある。完全切除は通常根治的で、予後も良好となる。奇形腫の経過で認識すべき重要な病態を示す。
summary_en: This case report and literature review describes growing teratoma syndrome, a rare condition that usually occurs in younger patients. After initial surgical resection, chemotherapy may lead to enlargement of the tumor, which yields the diagnosis. The abstract notes that complete surgical resection is usually curative and gives a better prognosis. The report summarizes the clinical course of the reported case together with the existing literature on this syndrome.

title: Fetal and neonatal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胎児および新生児の胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 胎児・新生児の胚細胞腫瘍を概説したレビュー。組織型は成熟・未熟奇形腫が中心で、多くは手術のみで治癒する。新生児の悪性例は卵黄嚢腫瘍が多いが、シスプラチンを基にした化学療法で治癒が期待できる。生殖系列の発生異常に関する最近の知見も紹介されている。
summary_en: This review summarizes germ cell tumors (GCTs) in the fetus and neonate. Because of intrinsic pluripotency, GCTs show diverse histology in older patients, but fetal and neonatal cases are more restricted. Mature and immature teratomas predominate and are usually curable with surgery alone. Neonatal yolk sac tumor is the more malignant histology, yet cisplatin-based chemotherapy makes cure likely. The authors also discuss recent advances in understanding germline developmental aberrations that underlie tumor genesis.

title: Extraperitoneal laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy for nonseminomatous testicular germ-cell tumor: surgical and oncological outcomes.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の腹膜外腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清：外科的および腫瘍学的転帰
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の20例に対し、化学療法後の腹膜外腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を後方視的に検討。開腹移行や術中合併症はなく、乳糜漏は45%に生じたがいずれもグレードIであった。追跡期間中央値45か月で再発は認めなかった。
summary_en: This retrospective study assesses extraperitoneal laparoscopic RPLND performed after chemotherapy in 20 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. No conversion to open surgery occurred, and no intraoperative complications were reported. Postoperative chyle leakage occurred in 45% and lymphorrhea in 20%, all grade I. Residual masses were mostly necrotic, with teratoma in 20%. With median follow-up of 45 months, no patient had recurrence, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in all patients studied.

title: Laparoscopic and open postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in patients with advanced testicular cancer--a single center analysis.
title_ja: 進行精巣がんに対する腹腔鏡下および開腹による化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清：単施設解析
summary_ja: 進行精巣がん患者に対し、腹腔鏡下(43例)と開腹(24例)の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を単施設で比較した。腹腔鏡下群はドレーン留置と在院期間が短かった。合併症や全生存期間(全生存率)に有意差はなく、適切に選択された患者では安全な選択肢とされる。
summary_en: This single-center study compares laparoscopic and open postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (L-PCLND and O-PCLND) in patients with advanced testicular cancer. L-PCLND was performed in 43 patients and O-PCLND in 24. Laparoscopic surgery was associated with shorter drainage and hospital stays, while intraoperative complications and blood loss did not differ significantly. Recurrence was 8.6% after L-PCLND and 14.2% after O-PCLND, and overall survival did not differ significantly. The authors consider L-PCLND a safe option in selected patients.

title: Molecular genetic analysis of nongestational choriocarcinoma in a postmenopausal woman: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 閉経後女性に生じた非妊娠性絨毛癌の分子遺伝学的解析：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 閉経後58歳女性に発生した子宮原発の非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告である。病理組織学的検査で他の胚細胞腫瘍成分は認めず、核型およびSTR解析により非妊娠性由来を確認した。子宮摘出術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術後に化学療法4コースを施行し、術後3年時点で再発はない。文献的考察も含む。
summary_en: This case report describes primary nongestational choriocarcinoma of the uterus in a 58-year-old postmenopausal woman, arising 19 years after her last pregnancy. Histopathology showed pure choriocarcinoma without other germ cell components, and karyotype (XX) and 15-locus STR analysis confirmed a nongestational origin. After hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, she received four courses of combination chemotherapy and remained free of recurrence at three years. The authors also review the literature on this rare entity, which typically arises from germ cell or trophoblastic differentiation in other carcinomas.

title: The ter mutation in the rat Dnd1 gene initiates gonadal teratomas and infertility in both genders.
title_ja: ラットDnd1遺伝子のter変異は雌雄ともに性腺奇形腫と不妊を引き起こす
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: WKY/Ztmラットに自然発生したter変異は、卵巣と精巣に先天性奇形腫を生じ不妊を引き起こす。原因はDnd1遺伝子エクソン4の早期終止コドンと同定された。ホモ接合体では雌雄ともに完全浸透率で発症する。本系統は胚細胞発生と性腺腫瘍発生の研究に有用な動物モデルとして提案されている。
summary_en: This study describes a spontaneous mutation, ter, in the rat Dnd1 gene that causes congenital ovarian and testicular teratomas and infertility in WKY/Ztm rats. Histology showed derivatives of all three germ layers. Linkage analysis mapped the mutation to RNO18, and sequencing identified a premature stop codon in exon 4 of Dnd1. Homozygous ter rats of both sexes developed teratomas with complete penetrance, and affected males showed reduced testicular size with absent spermatogenesis. The authors propose this strain as a novel animal model for studying gonadal teratocarcinogenesis and germ cell development.

title: A pelvic mass on ultrasonography and high human chorionic gonadotropin level: not always an ectopic pregnancy.
title_ja: 骨盤内腫瘤と高値のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)：必ずしも子宮外妊娠ではない
summary_ja: 7週間の無月経と腟出血で受診し、β-hCGが著明高値のため子宮外妊娠が疑われた24歳女性の症例である。超音波検査で右骨盤内の充実性腫瘤を認め、切除標本は合胞体栄養膜細胞がhCGを産生するディスジャーミノーマであった。PETで転移はなく、FIGO IA期と判定され補助療法は不要であった。8か月時点で再発はない。
summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with seven weeks of amenorrhoea, vaginal bleeding, and markedly elevated serum β-hCG of 11,998 IU/l, initially suspected to be ectopic pregnancy. Ultrasonography showed a 7 × 4 cm solid right pelvic mass without an intrauterine gestational sac. Laparoscopy revealed an enlarged right ovary with a solid lesion that was resected. Histology showed dysgerminoma, with immunohistochemistry demonstrating syncytiotrophoblastic cells as the source of hCG production. PET showed no metastasis. The tumour was FIGO stage IA, and after surgical staging without adjuvant therapy, no recurrence was seen at eight months.

title: Cleft palate associated with cervico-facial teratoma: report of two cases and review of the literature.
title_ja: 口蓋裂を伴う頸部顔面奇形腫：2症例の報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 外側頸部顔面奇形腫と口蓋裂を合併した2症例を報告し、胚発生学的機序を考察した文献レビューである。1例は頸部顔面に2か所の奇形腫を認め、もう1例はピエール・ロバン配列と外側咽頭奇形腫を有していた。報告例の多くは正中部奇形腫であり、外側型の合併は稀である。
summary_en: This report describes two cases of cleft palate associated with lateral cervicofacial teratomas. One child had two cervicofacial teratoma sites with cleft palate, and the other had Pierre Robin sequence with a lateropharyngeal teratoma and an additional submaxillary lesion. Most reported cases involve midline teratomas, which have led to mechanical explanations for the cleft. The authors note that lateral tumours associated with cleft palate are rarely reported, suggesting different or more complex embryologic mechanisms. A literature review accompanies the case descriptions.

title: Laparoscopic management of a large torted ovarian cyst in an adolescent virgin: a case report.
title_ja: 大型の捻転卵巣嚢腫を呈した性交経験のない女性への腹腔鏡手術:症例報告
summary_ja: 23歳の性交経験のない女性で、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が捻転した症例です。文化的理由から患者と家族が処女膜の保護を希望したため、通常の膣内処置を省略して腹腔鏡手術による左卵管卵巣摘出術を行いました。直腸経由で子宮を操作する手技など、有用な工夫と文献的考察を報告しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old sexually inactive woman with a torted mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Because the patient and family requested preservation of the hymen for cultural reasons, the team omitted the routine intravaginal preparation normally used for laparoscopy. A left salpingo-oophorectomy was performed laparoscopically, and the specimen was extracted in a large endobag. The authors describe useful technical adaptations, including manipulating the uterus transrectally with gauze attached to ovum forceps, and review the literature on this approach.

title: Testicular tumor ultrasound characteristics and association with histopathology.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の超音波所見と病理組織学的所見との関連
summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、精巣腫瘍107例の超音波画像と診療記録を検討し、セミノーマ55例と非セミノーマ52例の超音波所見を比較した。セミノーマは低エコー性で均一、分葉状であることが多く、非セミノーマは不均一で嚢胞性であることが多かった。精巣微小石灰化はセミノーマでより多くみられた。著者らは、慎重な超音波解析により確定手術前に基礎となる病理組織像を推定でき、良性と悪性の精巣病変の鑑別研究の基盤になると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed ultrasound images and records of 107 patients with testicular tumors, comparing sonographic features of 55 seminomas with 52 non-seminomas. Seminomas were more often hypoechoic, homogeneous, and lobulated, while non-seminomas were more often heterogeneous and cystic. Testicular microlithiasis was more common in seminomas.
