summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎に関連する腫瘍について概説している。腫瘍合併率は2008年の60%から2011年には42%へ低下し、18歳未満および男性では合併が少ない傾向があった。卵巣奇形腫のほか、精巣胚細胞腫瘍などの腫瘍も関連する。子宮癌肉腫を合併した65歳女性例も報告されている。悪性腫瘍を伴う脳炎の予後は関連腫瘍の予後に左右される可能性がある。
summary_en: This review summarizes tumors associated with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. The tumor-associated proportion fell from 60% in 2008 to 42% in 2011, and was lower in patients under 18 and in males. Besides ovarian teratoma, associated tumors include testicular germ cell tumors and other malignancies. The authors also describe a 65-year-old woman with uterine carcinosarcoma with neuroendocrine differentiation who developed this encephalitis. They conclude that the prognosis of encephalitis with malignancy may depend on the prognosis of the associated tumor.

title: [Localization of NMDAR-related epitopes in ovarian teratoma: comparison between patients and controls].
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫におけるNMDAR関連エピトープの局在:患者と対照の比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の発症における卵巣奇形腫の役割を検討するため、脳炎を伴う例と伴わない例、正常卵巣を病理組織学的に評価した。ヒトおよびウシの卵母細胞の細胞質にNR2Bエピトープの強い発現が認められた。神経組織の量や炎症細胞浸潤に両群間の有意差はなかった。神経組織に富む奇形腫は、難治性脳炎のリスクを高める可能性がある。
summary_en: To clarify the role of ovarian teratomas in anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, the authors histopathologically examined ovarian teratomas with and without encephalitis and normal ovaries. Strong NR2B epitope expression was found in oocyte cytoplasm from human and bovine ovaries, and neural tissue in teratomas showed NR2B immunoreactivity, mainly in mature neurons. No significant difference in neural tissue amount or inflammatory infiltration was found between teratoma groups. The authors suggest that teratomas rich in neural tissue may increase the risk of intractable encephalitis after prodromal infection.

title: Seminoma in the testis presenting as hemospermia.
title_ja: 血精症を呈した精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 血精症は原因不明と考えられることが多いが、本症例では陰嚢診察と超音波検査で精巣腫瘍が見つかり、セミノーマであった。血精症患者では、精巣悪性腫瘍を見落とさないために陰嚢診察と必要に応じた超音波検査を行うべきである。
summary_en: A patient presented with hemospermia, which is often considered idiopathic. Scrotal examination and ultrasonography revealed a testicular tumor, which was identified as seminoma. The case highlights that patients presenting with hemospermia should undergo scrotal examination and, when indicated, ultrasound, to avoid missing a testicular malignancy. Although hemospermia is commonly regarded as benign, this report shows it can be the first sign of a testicular germ cell tumor.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma in an adolescent.
title_ja: 思春期患者の仙尾部奇形腫
summary_ja: 17歳男性が、小児期から徐々に増大する左殿部の疼痛を伴う腫瘤を主訴に受診した。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では主に脂肪と大腸を含む境界明瞭な軟部腫瘤が認められた。腫瘍と尾骨を完全切除し、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。成人での仙尾部奇形腫の報告は稀である。
summary_en: A 17-year-old male presented with a painful left buttock mass that had been gradually growing since childhood. MRI showed a well-defined soft-tissue mass containing mainly fat and large intestine. Complete excision of the tumor and coccyx was performed. Gross and histologic examination confirmed a mature teratoma. The authors note that sacrococcygeal teratoma is rarely reported in adults, and this case adds to the limited data on late-presenting sacrococcygeal teratomas.

title: Management of giant ovarian teratoma: A case series and review of the literature.
title_ja: 巨大卵巣奇形腫の管理:症例集積と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 中国の単施設で巨大卵巣奇形腫330例(腫瘍径15cm超)を検討した報告。開腹群は緊急手術例が多く、腹腔鏡群では偶発的な嚢胞破裂が多かった(31.5%対19.6%)。著者らは、一塊での摘出と腫瘤破裂の回避のために開腹切除が望ましい可能性を指摘し、術前診断には画像所見の理解が有用だとしている。
summary_en: This review of 330 patients with giant ovarian teratomas (diameter over 15 cm) at a Chinese hospital compared laparotomy with laparoscopy. Emergency cases were more common in the laparotomy group, while accidental cyst rupture occurred more often with laparoscopy (31.5% vs 19.6%). The authors suggest laparotomic en bloc resection may be preferable for giant teratomas, and that familiarity with characteristic imaging features aids preoperative diagnosis.

title: The impact of TGF-β1 on the mRNA expression of TβR I, TβR II, Smad4 and the invasiveness of the JEG-3 placental choriocarcinoma cell line.
title_ja: TGF-β1がJEG-3絨毛癌細胞株のTβR I、TβR II、Smad4のmRNA発現および浸潤能に及ぼす影響
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞株を用い、TGF-β1が細胞の浸潤能に及ぼす影響を検討した基礎研究。TGF-β1はTβR I・TβR II・Smad4の発現を低下させる一方、MMP-9とTIMP-1の発現を上昇させ、浸潤能を高めた。絨毛癌の浸潤機構の理解につながる知見である。
summary_en: Using the JEG-3 placental choriocarcinoma cell line, the authors examined how TGF-β1 affects cell invasion. TGF-β1 increased invasiveness while reducing expression of TGF-β receptors I and II and Smad4, and raising levels of MMP-9 and TIMP-1. The findings suggest TGF-β1 signaling may help drive trophoblastic invasion, with implications for understanding the invasive biology of choriocarcinoma.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌
summary_ja: 80歳女性が急性腹症で受診し、20cmの卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤に対して左卵管卵巣摘出術が行われた。組織学的に、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の高分化型扁平上皮癌と診断された。周囲の扁平上皮には異形成も認められた。奇形腫の悪性転化の形態学的・臨床病理学的特徴を考察し、本症は稀で、多くは偶発的所見であると述べている。
summary_en: An 80-year-old woman with acute abdomen underwent left salpingo-oophorectomy for a 20 cm cystic ovarian mass. Histology showed well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma, with dysplasia in the surrounding squamous epithelium. The authors review the morphologic and clinicopathologic features of malignant transformation in teratoma, noting that such squamous carcinoma is rare and often an incidental finding.

title: Mucinous adenocarcinoma of the intestinal type arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: a rare case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来した腸型粘液性腺癌:症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 49歳女性が左卵巣腫瘍に対して手術を受けた。病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と、腸型腺癌の領域が認められた。術後5年時点で無病生存中である。奇形腫の悪性転化は1〜2%とされ、消化管型腺癌は扁平上皮癌に比べ極めて稀であると述べている。文献レビューも併せて示している。
summary_en: A 49-year-old woman underwent surgery for a left ovarian tumor. Histology showed a mature cystic teratoma with hair shafts and a squamous layer, and a separate area of intestinal-type adenocarcinoma. Five years after surgery she remained alive without disease. The authors note malignant transformation occurs in 1-2% of mature cystic teratomas, and that gastrointestinal-type adenocarcinoma is extremely rare compared with squamous carcinoma.

title: Unusual coexistence of a renal anomaly and germ cell tumor: An embryonal happenstance?
title_ja: 腎奇形と胚細胞腫瘍のまれな併存:胚発生上の偶然か
summary_ja: 縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍と腎奇形、特に馬蹄腎が併存したまれな症例を総説的に検討した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と馬蹄腎はいずれも胚発生期の細胞の異常な移動に由来すると考えられ、両者の起源の関連が論じられている。この併存例は治療上の課題であり、起源の議論から治療、フォローアップまでを扱っている。
summary_en: This case review discusses the unusual coexistence of a mediastinal germ cell tumour and a renal anomaly, particularly horseshoe kidney. Extragonadal germ cell tumours and horseshoe kidney are both thought to arise from abnormal migration of germline-associated cells during embryogenesis, which links their origin. The authors note that this combination poses therapeutic challenges and cover issues ranging from origin and treatment to follow-up.

title: Chemotherapy refractory testicular germ cell tumor is associated with a variant in Armadillo Repeat gene deleted in Velco-Cardio-Facial syndrome (ARVCF).
title_ja: 化学療法抵抗性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍は、ARVCF(Velco-Cardio-Facial症候群欠失アルマジロリピート遺伝子)のバリアントと関連する
summary_ja: ペンシルベニア大学のゲノムワイド関連解析の137例の部分集団において、シスプラチン代謝経路の遺伝子GSTP1、COMT、TPMTの変異を、シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者で検討した。COMT近傍でARVCFのイントロン内にあるSNP(rs2073743)は、初回化学療法後の難治性疾患と関連し、劣性遺伝モデルではGG遺伝子型のリスクが著しく高かった。神経障害、耳毒性、無増悪生存期間、全生存期間との関連は認められなかった。著者らは、本研究結果は仮説生成的であり、検証が必要であると述べている。
summary_en: In a 137-patient subset of a University of Pennsylvania genome-wide association study, the authors examined variants in GSTP1, COMT and TPMT, genes in the cisplatin metabolism pathway, in patients with testicular germ cell tumour treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. One SNP (rs2073743) near COMT, within an intron of ARVCF, was associated with refractory disease after first-line chemotherapy, and the GG genotype carried a markedly higher risk under recessive inheritance. No associations were found with neuropathy, ototoxicity, progression-free or overall survival. The authors describe the findings as hypothesis-generating and in need of validation.

title: Ovarian tumours in children : a review of 18 cases.
title_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍18例の臨床的検討
summary_ja: モロッコの小児病院で2000年から2008年にかけて卵巣腫瘍の治療を受けた2歳から15歳の女児18例の後方視的検討である。初診時の主訴は腹痛が最も多く、腫瘍の77%は胚細胞腫瘍で、その大半は奇形腫であり、多くは良性であった。最も多い術式は片側卵管卵巣摘出術であった。悪性腫瘍の7例のうち3例は術後化学療法を受けた。治療抵抗性や死亡例はなく、転帰は概ね良好であった。著者らは、妊孕性を保つため保存的手術を推奨している。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 18 girls aged 2 to 15 years treated for ovarian tumours at a Moroccan children's hospital between 2000 and 2008 found abdominal pain to be the most common presentation. Seventy-seven percent of tumours were germ cell tumours, mostly teratomas, and most were benign. Unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy was the commonest operation. Seven patients had malignant tumours, and three of them received postoperative chemotherapy. Outcomes were good, with no treatment resistance or deaths. The authors advocate conservative surgery to preserve fertility.

title: Reduced proficiency in homologous recombination underlies the high sensitivity of embryonal carcinoma testicular germ cell tumors to Cisplatin and poly (adp-ribose) polymerase inhibition.
title_ja: 胎児性癌の高いシスプラチン感受性は相同組換え修復能の低下に起因する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞成分である胎児性癌の細胞株5種を用い、シスプラチンによる鎖間架橋を修復する能力を検討した。相同組換え修復の低下が認められ、PARP阻害薬単剤に感受性を示した。PARP阻害は、耐性の強い細胞株でシスプラチンへの反応を増強した。シスプラチン耐性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を克服する治療戦略として示唆される。
summary_en: The authors examined five embryonal carcinoma cell lines, the stem-cell component of testicular germ cell tumours, for their ability to repair cisplatin-induced interstrand crosslinks. The lines showed impaired or reduced homologous recombination, indicated by fewer RAD51 foci and a GFP-reporter assay. Consistent with this deficiency, they were sensitive to PARP inhibitor monotherapy, and sensitivity correlated with PARP1 expression and activity. PARP inhibition also enhanced cisplatin response in the most resistant lines, suggesting a way to overcome cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumours.

title: A pomegranate heart.
title_ja: ザクロの心臓:成人の臀部奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 30歳女性の左臀部の腫脹と痛みを報告する。超音波検査とMRIで、内部に多数の結節を含む嚢胞性腫瘤が認められた。切除と病理組織学的検査により臀部奇形腫と確認された。成人の臀部奇形腫は極めてまれである。厚壁の嚢胞性腫瘤に充実性結節や脂肪を伴う場合は奇形腫を示唆すると述べ、適時の完全切除により予後は良好としている。
summary_en: A 30-year-old woman presented with two weeks of left hip swelling and pain. Ultrasonography showed a subcutaneous cystic mass with echogenic spots, and MRI revealed a heart-shaped left buttock mass containing 'pomegranate seed' inclusions that were hyperintense on diffusion-weighted imaging. Complete resection and histopathology confirmed a buttock teratoma containing sebum-like material and hair. The authors note that adult buttock teratomas are extremely rare, that thick-walled cystic masses with nodules or fat suggest teratoma on imaging, and that timely resection gives a good prognosis.

title: Extragonadal germ cell tumour with the "burned out" phenomenon mimicking a retroperitioneal tumour of neurogenic origin.
title_ja: 「burned-out」現象を伴い後腹膜神経原性腫瘍と紛らわしかった性腺外胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 35歳男性の後腹膜腫瘍症例。神経原性腫瘍が疑われ切除したところ、病理はセミノーマであった。超音波検査で精巣に病変が見つかり、両側精巣摘除術を施行したが、残存瘢痕と胚細胞腫瘍の微小病変のみで、burned-out現象と判断された。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を疑うと、精巣摘除術の後に全身化学療法を行う治療方針へ変わることを示した報告。
summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a retroperitoneal mass initially suspected to be a neurogenic tumor. Pathology of the resected mass showed seminoma, and subsequent scrotal ultrasonography revealed testicular microcalcifications and hypoechoic lesions. Bilateral orchiectomy found only residual scar and focal germ cell neoplasia, consistent with the burned-out phenomenon. The authors conclude that suspecting an extragonadal germ cell tumor with burned-out phenomenon changes management: orchiectomy first, then systemic chemotherapy, with surgery reserved for residual malignant tissue.

title: TRA-1-60(+), SSEA-4(+), Oct4A(+), Nanog(+) Clones of Pluripotent Stem Cells in the Embryonal Carcinomas of the Ovaries.
title_ja: 卵巣胎児性癌における多能性幹細胞クローンの同定と分子プロファイル
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 進行卵巣胎児性癌の患者から採取した標本で、多能性幹細胞クローンを同定・解析した研究。TRA-1-60、SSEA-4、Oct4A、Nanogが発現し、胚性幹細胞や精巣胎児性癌と類似していた。胚様体を形成し三胚葉へ分化した。分子プロファイルは診断の精緻化や個別化治療に役立つ可能性がある。
summary_en: This study identifies pluripotent stem cell clones within pure ovarian embryonal carcinomas from patients with advanced disease. Cells showed strong surface TRA-1-60 and SSEA-4 and high Oct4A and Nanog expression, similar to embryonic stem cells and testicular embryonal carcinoma. The ovarian embryonal carcinoma cells formed embryoid bodies capable of differentiating into all three germ layers and into muscle, epithelial, and neuronal cells. The authors suggest these molecular profiles could refine diagnosis and support biomarker-targeted, personalized therapy.

title: Ganglioneuroblastoma arising within a retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した神経節神経芽腫の1例
summary_ja: 膵臓と左腎の間に生じた後腹膜嚢胞性腫瘤で、神経節神経芽腫を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。遠位膵切除、脾摘、左副腎摘除を伴う一塊切除を施行。充実成分の神経節神経芽腫が皮様組織と密接に関連し、悪性転化を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。奇形腫内発生の神経節神経芽腫として初の報告。
summary_en: This case report describes ganglioneuroblastoma arising within a retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma in a patient with a cystic mass between the pancreas and left kidney. En-bloc resection with distal pancreatectomy, splenectomy, and left adrenalectomy was performed. Histology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma, with the solid component showing ganglioneuroblastoma intimately associated with dermoid tissue, classified as mature cystic teratoma with malignant transformation. The authors report it as the first such case described.

title: Frasier syndrome: four new cases with unusual presentations.
title_ja: Frasier症候群の4症例：非典型的な臨床像
summary_ja: WT1遺伝子変異によりFrasier症候群と診断された4例の報告。2例で両側性の性腺腫瘍を発症し、1例は両側ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を伴った。46,XY症例では性腺腫瘍のリスクが高く、選択的な両側性性腺摘除が推奨される。ネフローゼ症候群や思春期遅延などの非典型的な表現型を示した。
summary_en: This report describes four patients with Frasier syndrome, identified by WT1 mutations, with gonadal dysgenesis and nephropathy. One patient had horseshoe kidney and bilateral dysgerminoma; two others developed bilateral gonadal tumors. Presentations included steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome, delayed puberty, and primary amenorrhea. The authors note that 46,XY patients have a higher risk of gonadoblastoma and recommend elective bilateral gonadectomy and molecular WT1 screening for diagnosis.

title: Two cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy for low-volume stage II seminoma: results of a retrospective, single-center case series.
title_ja: 低腫瘍量の病期II セミノーマに対するシスプラチン併用化学療法2サイクル：後方視的単施設症例集積の結果
summary_ja: 低腫瘍量の病期II セミノーマ15例にPEB2サイクルを施行した後方視的単施設症例集積。発熱性好中球減少症はなく、リンパ節は有意に縮小した。中央値60か月の観察で再発やセミノーマによる死亡はなく、二次悪性腫瘍は1例のみであった。治療負担軽減の可能性があるが、前向き試験での検証が必要とされる。
summary_en: This retrospective single-center case series evaluated 15 patients with low-volume stage II seminoma treated with two cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (PEB), either by patient preference or institutional practice. Chemotherapy was well tolerated, with no febrile neutropenia, and lymph node size fell significantly after treatment. With median follow-up of 60 months, no patients relapsed or died from seminoma, and one developed a second malignancy. The authors suggest this may reduce treatment burden but require prospective confirmation.

title: Acute hypersensitivity of pluripotent testicular cancer-derived embryonal carcinoma to low-dose 5-aza deoxycytidine is associated with global DNA Damage-associated p53 activation, anti-pluripotency and DNA demethylation.
title_ja: 多能性精巣がん由来の胎児性癌細胞は低用量5-アザデオキシシチジンに高感受性を示す
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞様細胞である胎児性癌細胞は、低用量の5-アザデオキシシチジンに高い感受性を示す。NT2/D1細胞では、DNA損傷とp53活性化が生じ、NANOGやSOX2などの多能性遺伝子が抑制され、RIN1やSOX15などの腫瘍抑制候補遺伝子が脱メチル化される。これらの作用は主にDNMT3Bの高発現に依存する。
summary_en: Human embryonal carcinoma cells, the stem cells of nonseminoma testicular germ cell tumors, are hypersensitive to low-dose 5-aza-deoxycytidine. Using NT2/D1 cells, the authors show that low-dose treatment causes DNA damage, activates p53, represses pluripotency genes such as NANOG and SOX2, and demethylates promoters of candidate tumor suppressors including RIN1 and SOX15. These effects largely depend on high DNMT3B levels. The findings suggest that low-dose 5-aza could be a therapeutic strategy for tumors sustained by embryonic stem-like cells.

title: An interesting case of isolated pancreatic teratoma: lessons to learn.
title_ja: 孤立性膵臓奇形腫の興味深い症例:教訓
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、新たに糖尿病と診断され、経過観察中に無症状の後腹膜腫瘤が見つかった30歳男性を記述している。CTでは、腸間膜静脈を圧排する低吸収で石灰化を伴う腫瘤が認められた。腫瘤の大きさと悪性の可能性から切除が行われた。膵臓の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫はきわめてまれであり、確定診断は術中に行われた。著者らは、膵臓への近接性を考慮すると膵頭十二指腸切除術(Whipple手術)が最も適切であり、術前に組織学的診断は確立されていなかったと結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with newly diagnosed diabetes and an asymptomatic retropancreatic mass found during follow-up. CT showed a hypodense, calcified mass displacing the mesenteric veins. Because of its size and the possibility of malignancy, the mass was resected. Mature cystic teratomas of the pancreas are extremely rare, and the definitive diagnosis was made intraoperatively. The authors conclude that a Whipple procedure is the most appropriate approach given the mass's proximity to the pancreas, although the histological diagnosis was not established preoperatively.

title: Diffuse Muscular Pain, Skin Tightening, and Nodular Regenerative Hyperplasia Revealing Paraneoplastic Amyopathic Dermatomyositis due to Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんによる傍腫瘍性無筋症性皮膚筋炎が明らかになった、びまん性筋痛・皮膚硬化・結節性再生性過形成
summary_ja: 皮膚硬化、多発筋痛、好酸球増多、結節性再生性過形成を呈した患者で、精巣セミノーマと関連する傍腫瘍性皮膚筋炎が明らかになった。精巣がんに関連する傍腫瘍性皮膚筋炎は極めてまれである。皮膚・全身症状が潜在性胚細胞腫瘍の初発症状となりうることを示す。
summary_en: This report describes a patient whose skin tightening, polymyalgia, hypereosinophilia, and nodular regenerative hyperplasia revealed a testicular seminoma with associated paraneoplastic dermatomyositis. Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis linked to testicular cancer is extremely rare. The case highlights that cutaneous and systemic findings can be the first presentation of an occult germ cell tumor. Recognizing this association may prompt earlier testicular evaluation in patients with unexplained inflammatory myopathy-like symptoms.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌
summary_ja: 52歳の閉経前女性が7cmの右付属器腫瘤と不正出血で受診した。全摘術と両側付属器摘出術を含む手術が行われた。病理組織学的に卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌と診断された。病期にかかわらず化学療法が必要とされ、カルボプラチンとパクリタキセルの追加投与が計画された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old premenopausal woman with vaginal bleeding and a 7 cm right adnexal mass. She underwent total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, pelvic lymphadenectomy, and debulking. Histopathology revealed squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is rare, and its prognosis depends on surgical stage. The authors note that chemotherapy should be given regardless of stage and planned second-cycle carboplatin and paclitaxel.

title: Ultrasound evaluation of congenital cervical teratoma and therapeutic management (ex utero intrapartum treatment).
title_ja: 超音波で診断された先天性頸部奇形腫の評価と治療管理（子宮外胎児治療：EXIT）
summary_ja: 出生前超音波で頸部奇形腫と診断された胎児の症例報告です。腫瘍が気道を圧迫したため、胎盤循環を保ったまま子宮外での生存性を確保するEXITを実施し、気道を確保しました。胎児頸部の超音波評価は気道と消化管の把握に重要であり、早期診断が計画的な分娩と外科治療につながると述べています。
summary_en: This case report describes a fetus diagnosed with a cervical teratoma by prenatal ultrasound. The tumor compressed the airway, so the team performed ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) to secure airway control while maintaining placental support and extrauterine viability. The authors emphasize that fetal neck ultrasonography is essential for assessing the airway and digestive tract, and that early recognition of such masses allows planned delivery and surgical management.

title: Torsed intraabdominal testicular tumor diagnosed during surgery performed due to suspicion of acute appendicitis.
title_ja: 急性虫垂炎の疑いで手術中に発見された腹腔内精巣腫瘍（セミノーマ）による捻転
summary_ja: 急性虫垂炎の疑いで手術された22歳男性で、腹腔内に転位した精巣捻転が判明しました。精巣と虫垂の両方が切除され、病理検査で精巣のセミノーマと正常虫垂が確認されました。まれな病態の診断と治療の原則を概説し、急性虫垂炎の鑑別診断として腫瘍性精巣捻転を考慮すべきと述べています。
summary_en: A 22-year-old man was operated on for suspected acute appendicitis, but surgery revealed intra-abdominal torsion of a testis. Both the testis and the appendix were removed. Histopathology showed seminoma of the testis with a normal appendix. The report reviews this rare condition and the principles of its diagnosis and treatment, and emphasizes that neoplastic testicular torsion should be considered in the differential diagnosis of acute appendicitis.

title: An unusual presentation of ovarian teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の非典型的な表現：症例報告
summary_ja: 左卵巣奇形腫がS状結腸へ自然破裂した症例報告です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は卵巣腫瘍の10〜20%を占め若年者に最も多い腫瘍ですが、自然破裂はまれです。腸管への進展を伴う卵巣奇形腫の非典型的な臨床像とその管理上の意義を示しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a left ovarian teratoma that spontaneously ruptured into the sigmoid colon. Mature cystic teratomas account for 10-20% of ovarian neoplasms and are the most common tumor in younger patients, but spontaneous rupture is rare. The report highlights this unusual presentation and its clinical significance for the management of ovarian teratomas with intestinal involvement.

title: Epidermoid or dermoid cysts of the ovary? Clinicopathological characteristics of 28 cases and a new pathologic classification of an old entity.
title_ja: 卵巣の表皮嚢腫か類皮嚢腫か：28例の臨床病理学的特徴と古典的疾患の新たな病理分類
summary_ja: 28例の卵巣類皮様嚢胞（表皮嚢腫）を15年間にわたり後方視的に検討し、類皮嚢腫（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）との鑑別点を示した論文です。表皮嚢腫は類皮嚢腫より小型で高齢女性に多く見られました。奇形腫の最大17%に表皮成分が含まれることがあります。多くは保存的手術で治療され、フォローアップ期間中の再発はありませんでした。
summary_en: This 15-year retrospective study of 28 histologically confirmed epidermoid ovarian cysts examines how to distinguish them from dermoid cysts, which are mature cystic teratomas. Epidermoid cysts were smaller and occurred in older women than dermoid cysts. Up to 17% of teratomas may contain epidermoid components. Most patients were managed conservatively, with no recurrence during follow-up, and the authors propose a new pathologic classification.

title: Can malignant transformation in mature cystic teratoma be preoperatively predicted?
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は術前に予測可能か
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化を術前に予測できるかを検討した論文です。悪性2例と良性76例を比較したところ、悪性例は大きく（平均130mm）、血清SCCが高値で、MRIで充実性かつ造影される成分を認めました。100mm超の腫瘍、充実性の造影病変、血清SCCとCA19-9の測定を推奨しています。
summary_en: This study examines whether malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma can be predicted before surgery. It compares two malignant cases with 76 benign cases. Malignant tumors were larger, with mean diameters of 130 mm versus 73.6 mm, and had higher serum SCC levels, solid masses, and contrast enhancement on pelvic MRI. The authors recommend checking tumors larger than 100 mm, solid enhancing masses on MRI, and serum SCC and CA19-9 levels.

title: Carney complex and teratoma maturum ovarii--a case report.
title_ja: Carney複合と卵巣成熟奇形腫の併発：症例報告
summary_ja: Carney複合を有する17歳女性の卵巣成熟奇形腫の症例報告です。経腟超音波とMRIで付属器腫瘤と腹水が確認され、悪性変化が疑われました。FIGO分類に沿って子宮付属器摘出と病期分類のための開腹術を実施しました。術後は腹水や痛みが消失し、CA-125も基準値内に戻りました。
summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old with Carney complex and a teratoma maturum ovarii. The adnexal mass with ascites, detected by transvaginal ultrasound and MRI, suggested malignant change. The patient underwent surgery with staging laparotomy under FIGO guidelines. Postoperatively the patient recovered well, ascites and pain resolved, and CA-125 levels returned to the reference range.

title: [Verification of testicular cancer guidelines].
title_ja: 精巣がんガイドラインの検証
summary_ja: 2009年版精巣がん診療ガイドラインの32のCQを検証したシンポジウム報告。病期I、進行がん、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の3領域について、補助化学療法、救援化学療法、残存腫瘍に対する低侵襲手術などの治療戦略を臨床例とともに検討している。
summary_en: This Japanese symposium report validates the 2009 Japanese Testicular Cancer Clinical Practice Guidelines through 32 clinical questions. It covers three areas. For stage I disease, single-agent carboplatin adjuvant therapy is discussed for seminoma, and vascular invasion guides risk-based choices for nonseminoma. For advanced disease, high-dose chemotherapy, salvage chemotherapy for residual tumors, and minimally invasive surgery for residual masses are reviewed. Extragonadal germ cell tumors, which can be cured with multimodal therapy, are also covered, including endoscopic ultrasound-guided biopsy.

title: [Treatment strategy for stage I testicular germ cell tumor].
title_ja: 病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療戦略
summary_ja: 病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍の補助療法を総説した。精巣摘除術のみで多くは治癒するが一部は再発する。セミノーマでは放射線療法やカルボプラチン、非セミノーマでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清や化学療法が選択肢となり、最新文献に基づいて再発抑制と有害事象の軽減を目指した管理のコンセンサスを更新している。
summary_en: This review addresses adjuvant management of stage I testicular germ cell tumors. Most are cured by orchiectomy alone, but some recur. Strategies differ for seminoma and nonseminoma. Seminoma options include radiotherapy or one to two courses of carboplatin. Nonseminoma options include retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or one to two courses of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy. The authors review recent literature on these adjuvant approaches, aiming to reduce recurrence while limiting adverse events, and they update the consensus for management.

title: [Comprehensive management of residual tumor in patients with an advanced testicular tumor].
title_ja: 進行精巣腫瘍における残存腫瘍の包括的管理
summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍の化学療法後の残存腫瘍の管理を論じた総説。純粋セミノーマでは残存腫瘍は経過観察され、非セミノーマでは多くの症例で切除が行われる。日本泌尿器科学会のガイドラインに基づき、後腹膜残存腫瘍切除の適応と手術手技を検討している。
summary_en: This Japanese review discusses management of residual tumors after chemotherapy in metastatic testicular tumors. Treatment follows International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group risk stratification and cisplatin-based chemotherapy. For pure seminoma, residual masses are usually observed without resection, whereas residual masses in nonseminomatous tumors are usually resected. The paper reviews Japanese Urological Association guidelines and discusses the indications and surgical techniques for retroperitoneal residual tumor resection after chemotherapy.

title: Bilateral synchronous spermatocytic seminoma: a rare case report from rural India and literature review.
title_ja: 両側同時性精母細胞性セミノーマ：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 50歳男性の両側同時性精母細胞性セミノーマの症例報告。精母細胞性セミノーマは精巣に限局し予後良好な稀な胚細胞腫瘍である。左右の精巣摘除術を行い、病理組織学的および免疫組織化学的に診断された。文献上の報告は5例のみで、日本を除くアジアでは初の症例とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old man with bilateral synchronous spermatocytic seminoma, a rare germ cell tumor confined to the testis with a good prognosis. Left radical orchiectomy was performed first. After intraoperative frozen section confirmed a neoplastic process, right radical orchiectomy was performed. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed the diagnosis in both testes. Only five prior cases of bilateral synchronous spermatocytic seminoma have been reported in the literature, and this is described as the first such case from Asia outside Japan.

title: Primary yolk sac tumor of the omentum: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 大網原発卵黄嚢腫瘍：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 35歳男性の大網原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。当初は免疫組織化学から原発不明がんと考えられたが、血清α-フェトプロテインの著明な上昇と生検標本の再評価により卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。免疫組織化学は診断に有用だが、臨床所見と形態学的所見を併せて解釈すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a primary yolk sac tumor of the omentum, reported as the first such adult male case. Initially considered a carcinoma of unknown primary with colorectal features based on immunohistochemistry, the tumor was reclassified after serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated to 7,144 ng/ml. Re-review of the biopsy showed microcystic or reticular patterns and Schiller-Duval bodies. The authors emphasize that immunohistochemistry is valuable for subtyping but must be interpreted alongside clinical and morphologic findings.

title: Choriocarcinoma in northwestern Nigeria: a histopathological review.
title_ja: ナイジェリア北西部における絨毛癌：病理組織学的レビュー
summary_ja: ナイジェリアの病院で43例の妊娠性絨毛癌を後方視的に病理組織学的に検討した研究。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の37.7%を占め、膣出血で発症することが多かった。出血、壊死、多形性などが主な特徴で、健康教育と早期発見の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This Nigerian histopathological review analyzed 43 cases of gestational choriocarcinoma, a malignant form of gestational trophoblastic disease, from a teaching hospital in Zaria. Gestational choriocarcinoma accounted for 4.9% of products of conception and 37.7% of gestational trophoblastic disease. Most patients were in their third and fourth decades, with vaginal bleeding as the leading presentation. Hemorrhage, necrosis, diamorphic appearance, and pleomorphism were the most common features. The authors stress health education and early detection.

title: Gliomatosis peritonei as a natural experiment in tissue differentiation.
title_ja: 組織分化の自然実験としての腹膜神経膠腫症
summary_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症（GP）は、腹膜や腹部リンパ節に成熟したアストログリア結節が広がる良性の病態で、多くは卵巣奇形腫に伴います。本総説は、奇形腫からの未熟神経細胞の播種と、腹膜幹細胞からの化生という二つの発生機序を、病理所見やヘテロ接合性解析をもとに検討しています。大部分の症例では播種説がより妥当とされています。
summary_en: This review examines gliomatosis peritonei (GP), a benign condition of widespread mature astroglial nodules in the peritoneum and abdominal lymph nodes, most often associated with ovarian teratoma. It discusses two proposed mechanisms: direct seeding of immature neural cells from the primary teratoma followed by differentiation, and metaplasia from peritoneal stem cells. Clinicopathologic features, SOX2 expression, and heterozygosity analysis are used to support each mechanism, with the implantation theory considered more probable in most cases.

title: Cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumors: comprehensive meta-analysis reveals that association between these conditions diminished over time and is modified by clinical characteristics.
title_ja: 停留精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍：関連は時代とともに弱まり、臨床特性によって修飾される包括的メタ解析
summary_ja: 停留精巣の既往と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連について、35件の疫学論文と未発表データを統合したメタ解析です。既往のある群ではリスクが約4倍（RR 4.1）でした。両側性、同側の片側性、治療の遅れ、セミノーマ組織型で関連が強く、精巣固定術後もリスクが残ることから、患者と家族への説明の重要性が示されています。
summary_en: This comprehensive meta-analysis of 35 epidemiologic articles and one unpublished dataset quantifies the association between cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumors. A history of cryptorchidism was associated with a fourfold increased risk (RR 4.1). Subgroup analyses identified stronger associations with bilateral cryptorchidism, ipsilateral unilateral cryptorchidism, delayed orchidopexy, diagnosis before 1970, and seminoma histology. The authors recommend that patients and caregivers be informed of persistent risk after orchidopexy regardless of repair age or laterality.

title: Developing retroperitoneal anaplastic carcinoma with choriocarcinoma focus after ovarian non-gestastional choriocarcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣非妊娠性絨毛癌の後に生じた、絨毛癌成分を伴う後腹膜未分化癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣非妊娠性絨毛癌に対する左付属器摘出の3か月後に、後腹膜で未分化癌と絨毛癌転移を生じた20歳の症例報告です。血清hCGは38 mIU/Lでした。メトトレキサート系化学療法と腫瘍切除を行いましたが、S状結腸破裂を伴いました。患者は化学療法を拒否し、術後1か月で死亡しています。非妊娠性転移性絨毛癌の予後不良性が示されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old patient who developed a retroperitoneal tumor with anaplastic carcinoma and choriocarcinoma metastases three months after left adnexectomy for an ovarian non-gestational choriocarcinoma. Serum hCG was 38 mIU/L. The patient received methotrexate-based chemotherapy and underwent tumor excision complicated by sigmoid colon rupture. Histology of the resected mass showed anaplastic carcinoma without choriocarcinoma. The patient declined further chemotherapy and died one month after surgery, illustrating the poor prognosis of rapidly spreading non-gestational metastatic choriocarcinoma.

title: Torsion of a neoplastic intrascrotal testis: when the torsion reveals the mass. A case report and review.
title_ja: 腫瘍が発見の契機となった陰嚢内腫瘍性精巣の捻転：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 左精巣捻転が疑われた38歳の症例で、徒手整復後約1か月して精巣固定術を希望されました。術中生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、根治的精巣摘除術と化学療法4コースを行いました。12か月のフォローアップで再発は認められていません。陰嚢内精巣の捻転を伴う癌は文献上8例目とされています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old patient with suspected left testicular torsion, which was manually derotated with immediate pain relief. About a month later the patient requested orchidopexy, and intraoperative biopsy revealed a yolk sac tumor. A radical inguinal orchiectomy with hemiscrotal excision was performed, followed by four cycles of chemotherapy. No recurrence was seen at 12 months of follow-up. The authors note that only seven prior cases of intrascrotal testicular torsion with cancer have been reported, making this the eighth.

title: Rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation in a spermatocytic seminoma with review of literature.
title_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマにおける横紋筋肉腫様分化：文献レビューの併記
summary_ja: 急速に増大した若年男性の精母細胞性セミノーマの症例です。病理組織学的検査では、精巣網と精巣上体に浸潤する横紋筋肉腫様成分が認められました。肉腫様分化を伴うと攻撃的な挙動と転移能を示すため、この成分の正確な同定が治療方針の決定に重要であると強調しています。文献レビューも併記されています。
summary_en: This case report describes a young male patient with spermatocytic seminoma whose tumor enlarged rapidly. Histopathology revealed a rhabdomyosarcomatous component infiltrating the rete testis and epididymis alongside a well-circumscribed spermatocytic seminoma. The authors emphasize that sarcomatous differentiation in spermatocytic seminoma confers aggressive behavior and metastatic potential, so identifying this component is essential because management differs. The report includes a review of the literature on this rare variant.

title: Postchemotherapy-related changes in mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor masquerading as a vascular neoplasm.
title_ja: 血管性腫瘍様を呈した縦隔混合型胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後変化
summary_ja: 14歳男性の右半胸部腫瘤。初回の病理組織学的所見は血管性腫瘍を示唆したが、腋窩転移の細胞診と免疫組織化学から混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。縦隔腫瘤の再切片作製では奇形腫成分を主体とする限局性の生存腫瘍を認めた。他院での化学療法歴があり、血管増殖は化学療法後変化、または抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍成分である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: A 14-year-old boy presented with a right hemithoracic mass that initially looked like a vascular neoplasm on histopathology. Cytology and immunohistochemistry of an axillary metastasis indicated metastatic mixed germ cell tumor. Extensive re-sectioning of the mediastinal mass revealed focal viable tumor, mainly teratomatous. History disclosed prior chemotherapy at another hospital. The florid vascular proliferation was likely a postchemotherapy change or a chemoresistant germ cell tumor component.

title: Swyer syndrome: a case report with literature review.
title_ja: 文献レビューを伴うSwyer症候群の症例報告
summary_ja: 原発性無月経と高ゴナドトロピン血症を示す46,XYの20歳女性。骨盤内の巨大腫瘤を切除し、ディスジャーミノーマと右性腺の性腺芽腫を認めた。Swyer症候群と診断し、Y染色体物質を有する異形成性性腺における性腺芽腫のリスクについて文献的に考察している。
summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with primary amenorrhea, abdominal distension, and elevated gonadotropins was found to have a 46,XY karyotype. Pelvic CT showed a large mass without visible gonads. Resection with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy revealed a dysgerminoma, and the right gonad harbored a gonadoblastoma. The authors diagnosed Swyer syndrome and reviewed the literature on gonadoblastoma risk in dysgenetic gonads, particularly when Y-chromosome material is present.

title: Coexistence of gastric adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma: complete response to trastuzumab and chemotherapy.
title_ja: 胃腺癌と絨毛癌の合併：トラスツズマブと化学療法による完全奏効
summary_ja: 57歳女性の胃腺癌と絨毛癌の合併例。β-hCG陽性およびcErbB2過剰発現を認め、肝多発転移を伴っていた。トラスツズマブと化学療法により完全奏効を得た。稀な疾患のため病理組織学的検査が診断に必須であり、cErbB2過剰発現例ではトラスツズマブが有効となり得ると報告している。
summary_en: A 57-year-old woman with weight loss and abdominal pain had gastric adenocarcinoma coexisting with choriocarcinoma, confirmed histopathologically. Immunohistochemistry was positive for beta-hCG and showed cErbB2 overexpression. Staging revealed multiple liver metastases. Treatment with trastuzumab combined with chemotherapy achieved a complete response. The authors emphasize that diagnosis requires pathological examination and that trastuzumab may be effective when cErbB2 protein is overexpressed.

title: Strumal carcinoid of the ovary: report of two cases.
title_ja: 卵巣ストルマ性カルチノイド：2症例の報告
summary_ja: 甲状腺組織とカルチノイド組織が混在する稀な卵巣奇形腫の一型、ストルマ型カルチノイドの2例を報告。卵巣奇形腫の約5%を占め、多くは成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生する。閉経前後の女性に多く、腫瘤触知または偶発的に発見される。カルチノイド型の4亜型と臨床的特徴を概説している。
summary_en: Two patients with primary ovarian strumal carcinoid, a rare carcinoid-type ovarian teratoma composed of thyroid and carcinoid tissue, are described. Such tumors account for about 5% of ovarian teratomas and often arise within mature cystic teratomas. Most patients are peri- or postmenopausal, presenting with an enlarging mass or incidentally. The article reviews the four carcinoid-type variants, insular, trabecular, strumal, and mucinous, noting carcinoid syndrome in a third of insular cases.

title: Simultaneous ipsilateral testicular seminoma with pelvic ectopy and hematovesicula seminalis.
title_ja: 同側の精巣セミノーマに骨盤内異所性精巣と精嚢血腫を合併した1例
summary_ja: 24歳男性の血精液症。同側の精巣腫瘍、骨盤内異所性精巣、精嚢血腫を同時に認めた。精巣腫瘍切除と右精嚢摘出術を施行し、精巣セミノーマと診断された。標準プロトコルに従い腹部への放射線療法を施行し、術後10年で疾患の再発は認められていない。
summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with hemospermia and was found to have a simultaneous ipsilateral testicular tumor, pelvic ectopic testis, and hematovesicula seminalis. He underwent removal of the testicular tumor and right vesiculectomy. Histopathology confirmed testicular seminoma, with a dilated seminal vesicle containing hemorrhagic fluid and chronic inflammation. Abdominal radiotherapy followed per standard protocol, and there was no disease recurrence at 10 years.

title: Congenital facial teratoma.
title_ja: 先天性顔面奇形腫
summary_ja: 本報告は、頭頸部の稀な部位に生じ奇形腫の6%未満を占める先天性顔面奇形腫の新生児例を記述している。腫瘍は外科的に管理され、術後2年のフォローアップで患者に再発は認められなかった。性腺外部位に生じた奇形腫の単一症例報告であり、胚細胞腫瘍の範囲に含まれる。
summary_en: This report describes a newborn with a congenital facial teratoma, a rare head and neck location that accounts for under 6% of teratomas. The tumour was managed surgically, and the patient showed no recurrence at two years of postoperative follow-up. It is a single case report of a teratoma arising in an extragonadal site, so it falls within the scope of germ cell tumors.

title: Exit: a salvage procedure for intraoral teratoma.
title_ja: 口腔内奇形腫に対する救済手技としてのEXIT
summary_ja: 妊娠24週で診断された大型の口腔・咽頭奇形腫に対し、マレーシアで初めて行われたEXIT手技の報告。妊娠33週で娩出後に気道を確保し、口蓋腫瘤の口外部分を切除した。生後22日目に口腔内奇形腫を完全切除した。出生前超音波検査と多職種連携の重要性を示している。
summary_en: The authors describe the first ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure performed in Malaysia for a large oropharyngeal teratoma diagnosed antenatally at 24 weeks. The fetus was delivered at 33 weeks and intubated, securing the airway before the extraoral part of the palatal mass was resected. Complete resection of the intraoral teratoma was achieved on day 22 of life. The report highlights the value of antenatal ultrasonography and multidisciplinary planning for airway-threatening teratomas.

title: Treatment of stage I seminoma: 25 years of experience.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの治療:25年の経験
summary_ja: 1979〜2004年に精巣摘除後の病期Iセミノーマ292例を対象とし、補助化学療法、放射線療法、サーベイランスを比較した。全生存期間(全生存率)は5年で100%であった。サーベイランス群の再発率が高く、補助治療の必要性が示唆された。再発例はすべて化学療法で救済された。
summary_en: This review of 292 men with stage I seminoma treated after orchidectomy between 1979 and 2004 compared adjuvant chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and surveillance. Five-year overall survival was 100%, and relapse-free survival was 95.1% overall. Five-year relapse-free survival was 97.2% with chemotherapy, 94.6% with radiotherapy, and 31.4% under surveillance. All relapses were salvaged with chemotherapy, supporting adjuvant treatment.

title: Congenital large maxillary teratoma.
title_ja: 先天性大型上顎奇形腫
summary_ja: 10歳男児の右上顎に生じた大型の先天性奇形腫の症例報告。全身麻酔下で切除された。病理組織学的に胚の三胚葉すべての成分を示し、主に線維組織から成っていた。術後2年間再発は認められなかった。
summary_en: This report describes a 10-year-old boy with a large congenital teratoma of the right maxilla, a rare site. The mass was excised under general anaesthesia. Histopathology showed all three embryonic germ layers, mainly fibrous tissue. Although malignancy has been described in adults, this tumour was benign. No recurrence was seen after two years, and the postoperative course was uneventful.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患
summary_ja: パキスタンの施設で2009年に診断された妊娠性絨毛性疾患39例を後方視的に検討した。胞状奇胎が84.6%、絨毛癌が12.8%を占めた。低経産で社会経済的に低い階層の女性に多く、受診時には進行していることが多かった。吸引掻爬術が主な治療で、化学療法を受けた患者もいた。
summary_en: This retrospective descriptive study from a Pakistani institute reviewed 39 gestational trophoblastic disease cases in 2009, about 29% of female genital tract neoplasms seen. Hydatidiform mole comprised 84.6% and choriocarcinoma 12.8%. Most patients were low-parous women of lower socioeconomic status who often presented late. Most underwent suction evacuation, and some received chemotherapy.

title: Choroidal metastasis as the presenting feature in a case of testicular choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 精巣絨毛癌を初発症状とした脈絡膜転移の1例
summary_ja: 26歳男性が非裂孔原性網膜剥離で受診し、無症候性の左精巣絨毛癌が判明した。化学療法で完全寛解を得たが視力は回復しなかった。眼転移は視力喪失のリスクが高く、早期発見と治療が重要である。若年男性の眼転移では精巣原発を考慮すべきである。
summary_en: A 26-year-old man presented with a non-rhegmatogenous retinal detachment and was found to have an occult left testicular choriocarcinoma. Chemotherapy achieved complete remission, but vision did not recover. The report underlines that intraocular metastasis carries substantial risk of visual loss and that early detection improves tumour control and visual outcome. Clinicians should consider a testicular primary in young men with ocular metastasis.

title: Case of maternal and infantile choriocarcinoma following normal pregnancy.
title_ja: 症例：正常妊娠後に発症した母体および乳児の絨毛癌
summary_ja: 33歳女性が正常分娩後に絨毛癌と診断され、その新生児も同じ疾患と診断された症例報告です。腫瘍が胎盤を介して母体から乳児へ播種(経胎盤播種)したと考えられ、母児ともに進行した病変を認めました。母体が絨毛癌の場合は新生児の評価が重要であることを示唆する、まれな経過の貴重な報告です。
summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman diagnosed with choriocarcinoma after a normal delivery, and her newborn son, who was diagnosed with the same disease. The authors describe transplacental dissemination of the tumor from mother to infant, with advanced disease present in both. The report highlights the rare possibility of congenital transmission of choriocarcinoma and the need for close evaluation of neonates born to mothers with this malignancy.

title: Metastatic vulvo-vaginal choriocarcinoma mimicking a Bartholin cyst and vulvar hematoma-two unusual presentations.
title_ja: 外陰・膣の転移性絨毛癌：バルトリン腺嚢胞および外陰血腫に類似した非典型的な2症例
summary_ja: 妊娠後に外陰・膣の腫脹のみを呈した転移性絨毛癌の2症例の報告です。いずれもバルトリン腺嚢胞や外陰血腫として誤診され、治療が遅れました。血清β-hCGに基づき診断され、併用化学療法で一時的な反応を示したものの、1例は治療の遵守が困難で死亡しました。妊娠後の外陰膣腫脹では本疾患も考慮すべきと述べています。
summary_en: This report describes two women with metastatic choriocarcinoma that presented only as vulvovaginal swelling after pregnancy. Both were initially misdiagnosed as a Bartholin cyst or vulvar hematoma, delaying treatment. Unresponsiveness to standard therapy prompted evaluation, and the diagnosis was confirmed using serum beta-hCG levels. Combination chemotherapy produced initial responses in both, but one patient died due to poor treatment compliance. The authors emphasize considering metastatic choriocarcinoma in any recent vulvovaginal swelling following pregnancy.

title: Unexpected outcome after partial epididymectomy for chronic testicular pain.
title_ja: 慢性精巣痛に対する部分副睾丸摘出術後の予期せぬ転帰
summary_ja: 慢性精巣痛に対して副睾丸部分摘出術を受けた症例の報告です。切除標本で副睾丸病変として現れた精巣がんが判明しました。若年男性では精巣悪性腫瘍が良性の副睾丸疾患に似ることがあり、良性疾患を想定した手術後に診断される場合があると示しています。持続する陰嚢症状の慎重な評価が重要です。
summary_en: This report describes a young man with chronic testicular pain who underwent partial epididymectomy. Examination of the removed tissue revealed testicular cancer presenting as an epididymal lesion, an unusual manifestation. The case highlights that testicular malignancy can mimic benign epididymal disease in young males and may be identified only after surgery performed for presumed benign causes. Careful evaluation of persistent scrotal symptoms is therefore important.

title: Primary hepatic choriocarcinoma: a rare cause of spontaneous haemoperitoneum in an adult.
title_ja: 原発性肝絨毛癌：成人における自然発症血腹症のまれな原因
summary_ja: 成人男性で自然発症の血腹症を呈し、肝腫瘍破裂に対して緊急手術を受けた原発性肝絨毛癌の症例報告です。手術標本と剖検で確定し、患者は術後10日目に死亡しました。成人の報告例はまれで、インド亜大陸からの初報告とされています。自然発症血腹症の鑑別診断に本疾患を含めるべきと述べています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old man who presented with haemoperitoneum from a ruptured hepatic tumor and underwent emergency left lateral segmentectomy. He died on postoperative day 10. Surgical and autopsy findings confirmed primary hepatic choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare entity with only seven previously reported adult cases. The authors describe this as the first such case from the Indian subcontinent and review the relevant literature. Primary hepatic choriocarcinoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of spontaneous haemoperitoneum.

title: Teratoma of the tongue.
title_ja: 舌の奇形腫
summary_ja: 56歳女性の舌の腫脹が奇形腫と診断された症例報告です。口腔内の奇形腫は極めてまれで、通常は口腔底の正中部に発生し、舌自体に生じることは少ないとされます。性腺外のまれな部位の症例として臨床像を報告しており、口腔内奇形腫に関する限られた文献に寄与します。
summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old woman with a swelling of the tongue diagnosed as teratoma. Oral cavity teratomas are extremely rare and usually arise in the midline floor of the mouth, while involvement of the tongue proper is infrequent. The authors present this unusual extragonadal location to document its clinical presentation. The report contributes to the limited literature on teratomas occurring in the oral cavity.

title: Ectopic production of HCG by a benign ovarian mature cystic teratoma simulating an extra-uterine pregnancy: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫によるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生：子宮外妊娠を模倣した症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫がhCGを産生し、子宮外妊娠と疑われた症例報告です。卵巣奇形腫の摘出後、4週間以内に血清hCGは陰性化しました。良性卵巣奇形腫がhCGを分泌することはまれですが、高hCG血症の鑑別診断に含めるべきと述べています。緊急手術に至る可能性がある点にも注意が必要です。
summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with amenorrhea and markedly elevated serum hCG three years after tubal ligation. Ultrasound did not show an intrauterine pregnancy, and laparoscopy revealed an 11-cm benign mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary, with no ectopic pregnancy seen. After surgical removal, serum hCG normalized within four weeks. The authors conclude that benign mature ovarian teratomas, though rarely, can secrete hCG and should be included in the differential diagnosis of suspected ectopic pregnancy.

title: Metastatic choriocarcinoma to the choroid with concurrent optic nerve involvement: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 脈絡膜転移と視神経病変を伴う絨毛癌：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 両肺に転移した絨毛癌の既往がある43歳男性で、片眼に出血性網膜剥離を生じた症例報告です。MRIで脈絡膜転移と視神経・視神経鞘の炎症像を認め、後頭葉と前頭葉にも出血性転移がありました。脈絡膜転移に視神経病変を合併した初の症例とされ、広範な中枢神経系病変の精査を推奨しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with choriocarcinoma metastatic to both lungs who developed a hemorrhagic retinal detachment in one eye. Magnetic resonance imaging showed a choroidal metastasis with concurrent optic nerve and sheath inflammation, and additional hemorrhagic metastases were found in the occipital and frontal lobes. The authors describe the first reported case of choroidal metastasis with concurrent optic nerve involvement and recommend investigating widespread central nervous system involvement in such cases.

title: Cancer-associated retinopathy in a patient with seminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマに伴う癌関連網膜症
summary_ja: 病期I期のセミノーマを有する43歳男性で、かすみ目から癌関連網膜症と診断された症例報告です。血清中に網膜特異的な41kDa抗体が検出されました。原発巣の早期切除、ステロイド、免疫グロブリン静注により視機能は安定しました。セミノーマによる癌関連網膜症の初報告で、早期の腫瘍切除が進行抑制に寄与する可能性を示しています。
summary_en: This report describes a 43-year-old man with stage 1 seminoma who presented with blurred vision and was diagnosed with cancer-associated retinopathy. Fundus examination and electroretinograms showed retinal abnormalities, and serum analysis revealed a 41-kDa anti-retinal antibody. Visual function remained stable after removal of the primary tumor, steroid treatment, and intravenous immunoglobulin. The authors describe this as the first reported case of cancer-associated retinopathy caused by seminoma, suggesting early tumor removal may limit progression.

title: Gastric teratoma: a rare neoplasm.
title_ja: 胃奇形腫：稀な腫瘍
summary_ja: 生後3日の男児が腹部膨満と上腹部腫瘤による呼吸困難で受診した。開腹術で大弯側の胃後下壁から生じた多嚢胞性腫瘤を切除し、胃を修復した。病理組織学的検査で成熟胃奇形腫と確定した。胃奇形腫は極めて稀な腫瘍であり、新生児では特に稀である。完全切除により治療が完結した。
summary_en: A 3-day-old male neonate presented with abdominal distension and a large upper-abdominal mass causing respiratory difficulty. Exploratory laparotomy revealed a multicystic mass arising from the posterior-inferior gastric wall along the greater curvature, which was excised with gastric repair. Histopathology confirmed a mature gastric teratoma, a rare neoplasm. The report highlights that gastric teratomas are extremely uncommon, particularly in neonates, and that complete surgical excision provides definitive management.

title: Prenatally diagnosed retroperitoneal fetus-in-fetu with ipsilateral testicular atrophy: a case report.
title_ja: 出生前診断された後腹膜胎児内胎児と同側精巣萎縮：症例報告
summary_ja: 出生前に診断された2週齢新生児の左後腹膜の胎児内胎児(FIF)の症例で、同側の精巣萎縮を伴っていた。FIFと後腹膜奇形腫の鑑別点を比較し、FIFの発生起源に関する諸説を整理した。萎縮精巣とFIFの因果関係についても考察している。後腹膜におけるFIFと奇形腫の診断上の重なりを示す症例である。
summary_en: A neonate with a prenatally diagnosed fetus-in-fetu (FIF) in the left retroperitoneum at 2 weeks of age, associated with ipsilateral testicular atrophy. The authors compare features that differentiate FIF from retroperitoneal teratoma and review theories of FIF origin. They also discuss whether the atrophic testis is causally related to the FIF. The case highlights the diagnostic overlap between FIF and retroperitoneal teratoma.

title: Metastatic follicular struma ovarii complicating pregnancy: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 妊娠に合併した転移性濾胞性卵巣甲状腺腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 妊娠10週で卵巣嚢胞摘出術を受けた35歳女性で、奇形腫に発生した濾胞癌(卵巣甲状腺腫)と診断された。甲状腺全摘と放射性ヨウ素療法後、10か月後にサイログロブリンが上昇し、肝転移と腹膜播種が判明した。減量手術と追加の放射性ヨウ素療法で治療され、値は正常化した。血清サイログロブリンの綿密なフォローアップが重要である。
summary_en: A 35-year-old pregnant woman underwent right ovarian cystectomy at 10 weeks' gestation. Histopathology showed follicular carcinoma arising in a teratoma (struma ovarii). After total thyroidectomy and radioiodine therapy, serum thyroglobulin rose markedly ten months later. Imaging revealed liver metastases and peritoneal seeding, which were treated with debulking surgery and adjuvant radioiodine therapy, and thyroglobulin normalized. The report emphasizes close follow-up of serum thyroglobulin in such patients.

title: Mediastinal dysgerminoma complicating pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠に合併した縦隔ディスジャーミノーマ
summary_ja: 妊娠23週の初産婦に縦隔ディスジャーミノーマが見つかり、BEP療法を施行した。好中球減少と胎児発育不全のため31週で分娩となった。化学療法後に腫瘍は縮小したが、産後の放射線療法後に病勢が悪化した。縦隔と卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍は異なるため、卵巣例の成績は外挿できないと指摘している。
summary_en: A 26-year-old primigravida at 23 weeks' gestation presented with a substernal mass, diagnosed by fine-needle aspiration as mediastinal dysgerminoma. She received weekly bleomycin and three-weekly cisplatin and etoposide (BEP). Neutropenia required colony-stimulating factor, and fetal growth restriction prompted delivery at 31 weeks. The tumor regressed after chemotherapy, but disease worsened after postnatal radiotherapy. The authors note that mediastinal and ovarian germ cell tumors differ, so ovarian outcome data cannot be extrapolated, and BEP safety for the fetus is unestablished.

title: Massive ovarian cystic teratomas diagnosed at a rural Nepal camp.
title_ja: ネパールの僻地キャンプで診断された巨大卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: ネパール農村部で発見された、8cmを超える症状を伴う片側性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の2症例の報告です。超音波所見(類皮プラグ、類皮メッシュ、脂肪-液体レベル、「氷山の一角」徴候)から卵巣類皮嚢腫を診断し、手術で毛髪、歯、脂肪、皮膚組織が確認されました。資源の限られた環境でも超音波検査が確定診断に有用であることを示しています。
summary_en: This case report describes two perimenopausal women in rural Nepal with symptomatic unilateral cystic ovarian teratomas larger than 8 cm. The authors review the typical sonographic features of ovarian dermoid cysts, including the dermoid plug, dermoid mesh, fat-fluid level, and 'tip of the iceberg' sign. Intratumoral hair, teeth, fat, and skin found at surgery confirmed the ultrasound-based diagnosis. The report highlights how ultrasonography can support a confident diagnosis even in resource-limited settings.

title: Mature Cardiac Teratoma in an Adult.
title_ja: 成人における成熟型心臓奇形腫
summary_ja: 成人に発生する成熟型心臓奇形腫について述べた論文です。症状は腫瘍の部位に依存し、多くは心膜内に生じます。心筋内病変はさらに稀です。診断と治療は画像検査と外科的切除後の病理診断に基づき、完全切除された症例の予後は良好であるため、合併症予防のために完全切除が推奨されています。
summary_en: This paper discusses mature cardiac teratoma in an adult, an uncommon finding in which symptoms depend on tumor location, most often intrapericardial. The authors note that intramyocardial lesions are rarer still. Diagnosis and management rely on imaging and pathological examination after surgical excision. Prognosis after complete surgical excision is generally very good, and complete excision is preferred to prevent complications.

title: A case report of mediastinal seminoma arising after renal transplantation.
title_ja: 腎移植後に発生した縦隔セミノーマの症例報告
summary_ja: 腎移植後28か月で新たに発生し、当初は移植後リンパ増殖性疾患(PTLD)と診断された縦隔セミノーマの症例報告です。臓器移植後の胚細胞腫瘍の報告は少なく、移植後の縦隔セミノーマの報告は初めてとされています。免疫抑制療法中の移植患者に生じた縦隔腫瘍では、PTLD以外の疾患も鑑別診断に含めるべきだと指摘しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a mediastinal seminoma that developed de novo 28 months after renal transplantation and was initially diagnosed as post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (PTLD). The authors note that germ cell tumors after organ transplantation are rarely reported, and that mediastinal seminoma had not been described in this setting before. They emphasize considering non-PTLD diagnoses in the differential diagnosis of mediastinal tumors arising in transplant recipients on immunosuppression.

title: Germ Cell Tumor Located in Gastrointestinal System: A Report of Two Cases.
title_ja: 消化管に発生した胚細胞腫瘍:2症例の報告
summary_ja: 消化管出血と閉塞で受診し、後腹膜を起源とする消化管の胚細胞腫瘍の2症例の報告です。いずれも若年患者で、予後は良好でした。正中部の構造物に生じやすい性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の文献を概観し、消化管胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀で、病因や臨床経過は十分に解明されていないと指摘しています。
summary_en: This report describes two young patients with germ cell tumors in the gastrointestinal tract, both presenting with gastrointestinal bleeding and obstruction and traced to a retroperitoneal origin. Both had good outcomes. The authors review the literature on extragonadal GCTs, which typically arise along midline structures such as the retroperitoneum and mediastinum, and note that gastrointestinal GCTs are very uncommon, with poorly understood etiology and clinical course.

title: An ovarian teratoma of late Roman age.
title_ja: 後期ローマ時代の卵巣奇形腫
summary_ja: カタルーニャの後期ローマ時代の考古学遺跡で発見された、30〜40歳女性の遺骨から回収された骨盤内石灰化の古病理学的報告です。考古学的文脈では骨盤石灰化の鑑別診断が困難ですが、位置、肉眼所見、歯と小骨片の存在から卵巣奇形腫と同定されました。同定は肉眼観察とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)に基づいています。
summary_en: This paleopathology paper reports an unusual pelvic calcification recovered from the skeletal remains of a 30-40-year-old woman at a late Roman archaeological site in Catalonia. Differential diagnoses for pelvic calcifications are difficult in archaeological contexts, but the precise location, gross features, and presence of teeth and a small bone led the authors to identify the finding as an ovarian teratoma. The identification was based on gross observation and computed tomography (CT).

title: Presence of teratoma in orchiectomy specimen increases the need for postchemotherapy RPLND.
title_ja: 精巣摘除術標本の奇形腫成分は化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清の必要性を増大させる
summary_ja: 病期II精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍113例を対象に、精巣摘除術標本における奇形腫成分の影響を検討した。奇形成分を有する群では初回化学療法の完全奏効率が低かった（32.1%対55%）。また、後腹膜残存腫瘤に奇形腫が残存する割合が高かった。後腹膜手術と追加治療後は両群とも高い完全奏効率に達した。精巣摘除術標本の奇形腫は、化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清の必要性を予測する因子であると結論づけた。
summary_en: This study of 113 patients with stage II testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors receiving primary chemotherapy examined whether teratomatous components in the orchiectomy specimen affected response. Patients with teratoma in the orchiectomy specimen had a lower complete response rate (32.1% vs 55%). Teratoma was also more often present in retroperitoneal residual masses in these patients. After retroperitoneal surgery and additional treatment, complete response rates were similar (92.4% vs 89.5%). The authors conclude that orchiectomy teratoma predicts residual teratoma and increased need for postchemotherapy RPLND.

title: Report of the long-term efficacy of two cycles of adjuvant bleomycin/etoposide/cisplatin in patients with stage I testicular nonseminomatous germ-cell tumors (NSGCT): a risk adapted protocol of the Hellenic Cooperative Oncology Group.
title_ja: 高リスク病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する2サイクルの補助化学療法の長期成績：ヘレニック共同腫瘍学グループのリスク適応プロトコル
summary_ja: 精巣摘除後に高リスクの病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と判断された142例に対し、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる2サイクルの補助化学療法を施行した。中央値79か月の追跡で再発は1例のみで、化学療法と手術により治癒した。本レジメンは高リスク病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対して有効かつ安全な補助療法であると結論づけた。
summary_en: This Hellenic Cooperative Oncology Group study reports outcomes of 142 patients with high-risk stage I testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who received two cycles of adjuvant bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin after orchiectomy. High-risk features included lymphovascular invasion, local tumor invasion, or embryonal carcinoma over 50%. With median follow-up of 79 months, only one relapse occurred, which was cured. The authors conclude that two cycles of this adjuvant regimen are effective and safe for high-risk stage I NSGCT.

title: Long-term outcome of salvage high-dose chemotherapy in patients with germ cell tumor with poor prognostic features.
title_ja: 予後不良因子を有する胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する救済大量化学療法の長期成績
summary_ja: 1986〜2003年に救済大量化学療法を受けた胚細胞腫瘍患者100例の単施設後方視的解析。対象は難治性または再発例で、予後不良因子を有する患者の長期成績は不良であった。絶対的シスプラチン抵抗性の患者は1年以内に全員死亡した。難治性・再発例には、タンデム大量化学療法が主要な選択肢であり、単回の大量化学療法は再考すべきと結論づけた。
summary_en: This single-center retrospective analysis evaluated long-term outcomes of salvage high-dose chemotherapy with carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide or ifosfamide in 100 germ cell tumor patients treated between 1986 and 2003. Long-term results were poor in patients with adverse prognostic features. Only a small fraction with resistant or cisplatin-refractory disease remained disease-free, and none with absolute cisplatin-refractory disease survived one year. Tandem high-dose chemotherapy appeared to be the preferred option for refractory or relapsed disease, and a single cycle was discouraged.

title: A gene signature of primary tumor identifies metastasized seminoma.
title_ja: 原発腫瘍の遺伝子発現シグネチャーによる転移性セミノーマの同定
summary_ja: 原発セミノーマの遺伝子発現から転移の有無を予測する研究。転移性10例と非転移性21例について、マイクロアレイとRTQ-PCRで差次的発現遺伝子を解析した。85遺伝子のロジスティック回帰モデルは、10分割交差検証で感度77.8%、正確度84.2%を示した。原発腫瘍から転移性セミノーマを同定できる可能性を示した。症例数は少ない。
summary_en: This study developed a gene expression signature from primary seminoma tissue to predict metastatic status. Using whole-genome microarrays and RT-qPCR on 10 metastasized and 21 non-metastasized seminomas, the authors identified many differentially expressed genes. An 85-gene logistic regression signature predicted metastasis with 77.8% sensitivity and 84.2% accuracy in 10-fold cross-validation. The authors suggest the signature can identify metastasized seminoma from the primary tumor.

title: Primary yolk sac tumor of the urachus.
title_ja: 尿膜管原発卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 44歳女性の尿膜管原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。6か月の骨盤痛と進行性の腫瘤を呈し、膀胱ドームに茎状に付着した腫瘍を切除した。病理組織学的に類上皮細胞、偽嚢胞、シラー・デュバル小体を認め、免疫組織化学でα-1-フェトプロテイン陽性であった。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍のまれな例であり、文献検索に基づき成人例としては初の報告と述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 44-year-old woman with a primary yolk sac tumor of the urachus. She presented with six months of pelvic pain and a progressively enlarging mass, which was resected with attachment to the bladder dome. Histology showed epithelioid cells, pseudocysts, a myxoid background and Schiller-Duval bodies. Immunohistochemistry was positive for AE1/AE3, alpha-1-fetoprotein and alpha-1-antitrypsin. The authors present this as the first reported adult case of urachal yolk sac tumor based on their literature search.

title: Thyroid-type solid cell nests in struma ovarii.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫における甲状腺型充実性細胞巣
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に出現した甲状腺型充実性細胞巣（SCN）の1症例報告。主細胞は上皮系マーカーおよびgalectin-3などに陽性で、神経内分泌成分はクロモグラニンA・シナプトフィジン陽性、カルシトニン陰性であった。甲状腺濾胞細胞と後腸型内分泌細胞へ分化しうる共通の前駆細胞の存在が示唆され、卵巣甲状腺腫を奇形腫とみなす立場を支持する。
summary_en: This case report describes thyroid-type solid cell nests (SCNs) in a struma ovarii, an ovarian teratoma containing thyroid tissue. The main cells expressed epithelial markers including cytokeratins, CEA, CA19.9, p63 and galectin-3. The neuroendocrine component was positive for chromogranin A and synaptophysin but negative for calcitonin. The authors suggest a common progenitor capable of differentiating toward thyroid follicular cells and hindgut-type endocrine cells. The findings support viewing struma ovarii as a teratoma and suggest a histogenetic link between SCN main cells and thyroid tissue.

title: Malignant transformation in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: three cases mimicking primary ovarian epithelial tumors.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における悪性転化：原発性卵巣上皮性腫瘍を模倣した3症例
summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）から悪性転化を来した非典型的な3症例の報告。癌肉腫、非典型脈絡叢乳頭腫、乳頭状甲状腺癌が認められ、甲状腺癌例は両側卵巣に及び腹膜播種を伴っていた。奇形腫由来であることを示し、原発性卵巣上皮性腫瘍や転移(性)腫瘍との誤診を避けるため、十分な検体採取の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This report describes three unusual cases of malignant transformation arising in mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) of the ovary: carcinosarcoma, atypical choroid plexus papilloma, and papillary thyroid carcinoma. The thyroid carcinoma case involved both ovaries and showed peritoneal dissemination. The authors emphasize adequate tissue sampling to demonstrate the teratomatous origin and avoid misdiagnosis as primary ovarian epithelial tumors or metastatic disease. Clinicopathological findings are presented together with a literature review.

title: 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis: clinical presentations and management of the tumor risk.
title_ja: 46,XY純粋性性腺異形成症：臨床像と腫瘍リスクの管理
summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性性腺異形成症の11例を報告。症状例と家族スクリーニングでの無症状例に全例両側性腺摘除術を行い、ディスジャーミノーマ、性腺芽腫、ストリーク性腺を確認した。思春期遅延を伴う性腺腫瘍では性腺異形成を疑い核型検査を行うべきであり、性腺芽腫の高いリスクから早期の両側性腺摘除術を推奨している。
summary_en: This study reports eleven patients with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis. Half presented with amenorrhea or gonadal tumor, and half were identified by family screening. All underwent bilateral gonadectomy. Pathology showed dysgerminoma with gonadoblastoma, bilateral gonadoblastoma, and streak gonads. The authors conclude that gonadal tumors in girls with pubertal delay may relate to gonadal dysgenesis, that karyotyping should follow primary amenorrhea or dysgerminoma, and that early bilateral gonadectomy is recommended given the high gonadoblastoma risk.

title: CYP1A1, CYP3A5 and CYP3A7 polymorphisms and testicular cancer susceptibility.
title_ja: CYP1A1、CYP3A5およびCYP3A7の遺伝子多型と精巣がん感受性
summary_ja: ノルウェーの精巣がん症例652例と対照199例を用い、ホルモン代謝に関わるCYP1A1・CYP3A5・CYP3A7の遺伝子多型を解析した症例対照研究。CYP1A1の*2Aおよび*2Cアレルはリスク低下と関連し、セミノーマで有意、非セミノーマでは境界域であった。CYP3A5・CYP3A7に有意差はなく、CYP1A1多型が感受性に寄与する可能性が示された。
summary_en: This case-control study of 652 Norwegian testicular cancer cases and 199 controls examined polymorphisms in CYP1A1, CYP3A5 and CYP3A7, enzymes involved in reproductive hormone metabolism. CYP1A1*2A and CYP1A1*2C alleles were associated with reduced testicular cancer risk. The protective associations were significant for seminoma and only borderline for nonseminoma. CYP3A5 and CYP3A7 polymorphisms showed no significant association. The authors conclude that CYP1A1 variants may contribute to individual susceptibility.

title: Intracaval germ cell tumor thrombus.
title_ja: 下大静脈内の胚細胞腫瘍による腫瘍栓
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後に混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され化学療法を受けた24歳男性の症例報告。フォローアップ画像検査で後腹膜の残存病変と下大静脈内の腫瘍栓が判明した。手術で大静脈切開により腫瘍栓を摘出し、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と確認された。進行した胚細胞腫瘍では、大静脈内腫瘍栓の可能性に注意し外科的切除に備える必要があると述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with mixed germ cell tumor who received chemotherapy after orchiectomy. Follow-up imaging showed residual retroperitoneal disease and a thrombus within the inferior vena cava. During surgery, a cavotomy was performed to extract the intracaval mass, which pathology confirmed as mature teratoma. The authors emphasize that surgeons should be alert to caval tumor thrombus and prepared for resection in advanced germ cell tumors.

title: Recurrence of a dysgerminoma in Frasier syndrome.
title_ja: Frasier症候群における卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の再発
summary_ja: WT1遺伝子変異によるFrasier症候群の患者が、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫により急性腹膜症候群で発症した症例報告。治療後、腎移植を受けた後に腫瘍が再発し、非典型的な経過をたどった。性分化疾患の患者では性腺の胚細胞腫瘍に対する厳重なフォローアップの重要性と、移植後の再発への注意を示している。
summary_en: This report describes a patient with Frasier syndrome, an inherited WT1-related disorder with high gonadoblastoma risk and progressive renal failure. The patient presented with acute peritoneal syndrome due to an ovarian dysgerminoma. After treatment and renal transplantation, the disease recurred, producing an unusual clinical course. The case highlights the importance of close surveillance for gonadal germ cell tumors in patients with disorders of sex development and of recognizing recurrence after transplantation.

title: Testicular cancer survival in Estonia: improving but still relatively low.
title_ja: エストニアにおける精巣がんの生存率：改善しているが依然として低い
summary_ja: 1985年から2004年にかけてのエストニアの精巣がんの生存率を、がん登録データと診療記録から解析した集団ベースの研究。5年相対生存率は47.9%から74.5%に上昇したが、30歳未満に比べ30歳以上の改善は限定的だった。精巣摘除術後に腫瘍専門医へ紹介されないことや診断の不備、放射線療法の利用の少なさなどが課題とされた。専門がんセンターでの集約的な医療提供が勧められている。
summary_en: This population-based study analyzed testicular cancer survival in Estonia between 1985 and 2004 using cancer registry data and clinical record reviews. Five-year relative survival rose from 47.9% to 74.5%, with marked gains in patients under 30 but modest improvement in older patients. Deficiencies included lack of oncology referral after orchiectomy, incomplete diagnostic workup, and low radiotherapy use. The authors recommend coordinated care through specialized cancer centers.

title: Pulmonary pure yolk-sac tumor. A rare anatomopathological entity.
title_ja: 肺原発純粋型卵黄嚢腫瘍：稀な病理学的疾患
summary_ja: 原発性肺純粋型卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例を報告した症例報告。肺原発の胚細胞腫瘍は絨毛癌や卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例がごく少数に限られる。非転移性の胚細胞腫瘍は通常前縦隔に発生するが、本症例は診断と治療の両面で非典型的な特徴を示した。稀な胚細胞腫瘍の診断上の難しさと治療の検討について述べている。
summary_en: This case report presents a primary pulmonary pure yolk sac tumor, a very rare entity because primary lung germ cell tumors are limited to a few choriocarcinoma cases and rare yolk sac tumors. Although most non-metastatic germ cell tumors arise in the anterior mediastinum, this lung tumor showed atypical features in both diagnosis and treatment. The paper highlights the diagnostic challenges and therapeutic considerations for this unusual presentation of a germ cell tumor.

title: Chemical peritonitis caused by an iatrogenic rupture of mature cystic teratoma of the ovary during labor: a report of a case didactic to all the maternity health care workers.
title_ja: 分娩時に卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が破裂して生じた化学性腹膜炎：母体医療従事者への教訓となる症例報告
summary_ja: 経膣分娩後の37歳女性が腹痛を訴えた症例。妊娠中の超音波検査では漿膜下筋腫が疑われていた。最終的に、分娩時のクリステレル圧出法により卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が破裂し、化学性腹膜炎を起こしていたと判明した。妊娠中または産後の女性の腹痛では、卵巣奇形腫の破裂も考慮すべきだと助産スタッフに注意を促している。
summary_en: A 37-year-old postpartum woman presented with abdominal pain initially attributed to uterine involution or endometritis. Ultrasound had suggested a subserosal myoma during pregnancy. The pain was ultimately traced to chemical peritonitis caused by rupture of a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, which occurred during Kristeller's maneuver in vaginal delivery. The authors urge maternity care providers to consider ovarian teratoma rupture in pregnant or postpartum women with abdominal pain.

title: Mixed testicular germ cell tumour in a patient with previous pineal germinoma.
title_ja: 松果体ジャーミノーマの既往を有する男性に生じた精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 16歳時に松果体ジャーミノーマの治療を受けた既往のある32歳男性が、後に精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍を発症した症例報告。頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍から精巣へ播種した例は確認されておらず、異時性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀とされる。二つの腫瘍が独立した原発か、関連した疾患かという点を提起し、長期的なフォローアップの必要性を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man who developed a mixed testicular germ cell tumor after previously being treated for a pineal germinoma at age 16. The authors note that metachronous testicular germ cell tumors after intracranial germinoma are extremely rare, and that dissemination of intracranial GCT to the testes has not previously been confirmed. The case raises the question of whether the two tumors were independent primaries or related disease, and underscores the need for long-term surveillance.

title: Presacral masses in children: presentation, aetiology and risk of malignancy.
title_ja: 小児の仙骨前部腫瘤：臨床像、病因、悪性化のリスク
summary_ja: 22年間に先天性仙骨前部腫瘤の外科的治療を受けた小児17例を後方視的に検討した研究。最も多い病変は成熟奇形腫で、悪性例も3例含まれた。多くが便秘を主訴とし、Currarino症候群を合併していた。1歳以上の小児では悪性化のリスクが高く、早期の外科的切除が必要だと結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective review evaluated 17 children who underwent surgery for congenital presacral masses over 22 years. Mature teratoma was the most common lesion, including three malignancies, and most patients presented with constipation and were diagnosed with Currarino syndrome. Malignancy risk was higher in children older than one year. The authors conclude that presacral tumors in children are mostly mature teratomas, either sacrococcygeal or associated with Currarino syndrome, and recommend early surgical resection.

title: Histone methylation is a critical regulator of the abnormal expression of POU5F1 and RASSF1A in testis cancer cell lines.
title_ja: 精巣がん細胞株におけるPOU5F1およびRASSF1Aの異常発現制御におけるヒストンメチル化の役割
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣がんにおけるPOU5F1とRASSF1Aの異常発現に、ヒストンH3のメチル化が関与するかを検討した基礎研究。非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍の全組織型でH3-K4およびK9のメチル化が認められた。非セミノーマ細胞株をクロマチン修飾薬の5-アザ-2'-デオキシシチジンで処理すると、RASSF1Aの発現は回復し、POU5F1の発現は低下した。遺伝子ごとに異なるヒストン修飾が精巣がんの遺伝子発現異常を引き起こすことが示唆された。
summary_en: This laboratory study examined whether histone H3 methylation regulates aberrant expression of POU5F1 and RASSF1A in testis cancer. Immunostaining showed H3-K4 and K9 methylation in all histological subtypes of non-seminoma germ cell tumors. Treating non-seminoma cell lines with 5-aza-2'-deoxycytidine restored RASSF1A expression through loss of silencing H3-K9 methylation, while reducing POU5F1 expression by removing activating H3-K4 di-methylation. The findings suggest gene-specific histone modifications drive testis cancer misregulation.

title: Salvage chemotherapy with high-dose carboplatin and etoposide with peripheral blood stem cell transplant in patients with relapsed pure seminoma.
title_ja: 再発純粋セミノーマに対する救援化学療法：大量カルボプラチン・エトポシド療法と末梢血幹細胞移植
summary_ja: 再発純粋セミノーマの48例に対し、大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を行った後方視的研究。全体の79%が完全寛解に達し、全生存率は75%だった。初回再発例の92%は完全寛解となった。三次または四次治療として行った例では完全寛解は67%、全生存率は64%で、治療関連死が3例あった。再発セミノーマにおいて高い奏効率と生存率が期待できると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated 48 patients with relapsed pure seminoma treated with high-dose carboplatin and etoposide followed by autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant. Overall, 79% achieved complete response, and overall survival was 75%. Among 24 patients with first relapse, 92% achieved complete response. Those treated as third- or fourth-line therapy had a 67% response rate and 64% survival, with three treatment-related deaths. The authors conclude that high-dose chemotherapy yields high response and survival rates in relapsed seminoma.

title: A rare case of primary seminoma of the small bowel with lymph node involvement.
title_ja: リンパ節転移を伴った小腸原発セミノーマの稀な1例
summary_ja: 30歳男性が鉄欠乏性貧血と食後腹痛で受診し、小腸原発セミノーマと確定診断された。腹腔鏡下空腸切除とシスプラチンベース化学療法で良好な治療効果を得た。精巣外発生の成因も考察されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with iron deficiency anaemia and postprandial abdominal pain. CT showed small bowel wall thickening and mesenteric lymphadenopathy. Laparoscopic jejunal resection confirmed a primary seminoma of the small bowel with lymph node involvement. The patient received three courses of cisplatin-based chemotherapy with a good response. The authors discuss possible origins, including embryonic anomaly, lymphatic drainage from the testis, and occult or regressed testicular lesions. They conclude that unexplained iron deficiency anaemia in young men warrants full gastrointestinal investigation.

title: Atypical presentation and management dilemma of mixed gonadal dysgenesis.
title_ja: 混合性性腺異形成の非典型的な症例と管理上のジレンマ
summary_ja: 45,X/46,XY混合性性腺異形成の15歳女性の症例報告である。原発性無月経と膣中隔で受診し、腹腔鏡下両側性腺摘出で左側は性腺芽腫由来のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、右側は性腺芽腫と判明した。術後CTで肺転移が疑われたが、患者は化学療法を選択せず保存的管理となった。性腺異形成に伴う悪性化リスクと、多職種による診療の必要性を強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old female with 45,X/46,XY mixed gonadal dysgenesis who presented with primary amenorrhea and a transverse vaginal septum. Laparoscopic bilateral gonadectomy revealed dysgerminoma arising from gonadoblastoma in the left gonad and gonadoblastoma in the right. Postoperative CT suggested possible lung metastases, but the patient chose conservative management without chemotherapy. The authors emphasize the inherent malignancy risk of gonadal dysgenesis and the need for multidisciplinary diagnosis and care.

title: Paraganglia mimicking metastatic seminomatous tumor.
title_ja: 転移性セミノーマを模倣した傍神経節
summary_ja: 精巣混合性胚細胞腫瘍で腹部転移を認め化学療法を受けた2例を報告する。画像検査で後腹膜病変が持続したため後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行ったところ、上皮様細胞の小集団が見つかった。当初は再発した転移性セミノーマと判断されたが、免疫組織化学染色により傍神経節細胞と確認された。両者の鑑別点を示し、悪性腫瘍の過剰診断を避けることの重要性を強調している。
summary_en: Two patients with a history of mixed testicular germ cell tumor and abdominal metastases, treated with chemotherapy, showed persistent retroperitoneal disease on follow-up imaging. After retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, multifocal clusters of epithelioid cells were initially read as recurrent metastatic seminoma. Immunohistochemistry later identified them as paraganglionic cells. The authors describe morphologic features that distinguish paraganglia from metastatic seminoma and stress avoiding overdiagnosis of malignancy in patient management.

title: Heterochromatin marks HP1γ, HP1α and H3K9me3, and DNA damage response activation in human testis development and germ cell tumours.
title_ja: ヒト精巣発生および胚細胞腫瘍におけるヘテロクロマチンマーカーHP1γ、HP1α、H3K9me3およびDNA損傷応答の活性化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は、正常なヒト胎児および成人の精巣、上皮内癌(CIS)、ならびにセミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形腫を含む胚細胞腫瘍において、ヘテロクロマチンマーカーH3K9me3、HP1α、HP1γと、DNA損傷マーカーγH2AXおよび増殖マーカーを検討した。HP1γは胎児の生殖細胞、CIS、セミノーマで高値を示し、HP1αは上皮性および神経性分化を示す奇形腫の構造で増強していた。CISでは、DDRの活性化を伴わずにヘテロクロマチン化が生じており、生殖細胞の初期腫瘍形成における独自の応答が示唆される。
summary_en: This study examined heterochromatin marks H3K9me3, HP1alpha, and HP1gamma alongside the DNA damage marker gammaH2AX and proliferation markers in normal fetal and adult human testes, carcinoma in situ, and germ cell tumors including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, and teratomas. HP1gamma was high in fetal gonocytes, carcinoma in situ, and seminomas, while HP1alpha was enhanced in teratoma structures with epithelial and neuronal differentiation. Heterochromatinization in carcinoma in situ occurred without DNA damage response activation, suggesting distinct early tumorigenic responses in germ cells.

title: Cognitive impairment in men with testicular cancer prior to adjuvant therapy.
title_ja: 補助化学療法前の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における認知機能障害
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後、補助化学療法前の新規診断の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性を対象に、神経心理学的検査で認知機能を評価した。約46%に認知機能障害が認められ、健常者の基準値より有意に多かった。運動機能、言語性学習、遂行機能の障害が多く見られた。治療前から認知機能障害が存在するため、経時的な追跡と介入の必要性が示された。
summary_en: This study assessed cognition in men with newly diagnosed nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis after orchiectomy but before adjuvant chemotherapy. Using neuropsychological tests and mood questionnaires, about 46% showed cognitive impairment, significantly more than healthy norms. Deficits were most frequent in motor function, verbal learning, and executive function. The authors conclude that cognitive dysfunction is common before treatment and recommend longitudinal tracking and interventions for survivors.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease II: classification and management of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患II：妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の分類と管理
summary_ja: 侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の分類と治療を概説した総説である。非転移性および低リスク転移性例は単剤化学療法でほぼ100%の生存率が得られる。高リスク例は多剤併用化学療法が必要で、生存率は80〜90%である。綿密な評価と病期分類が治療選択の鍵とされる。
summary_en: This review describes the classification and management of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, including invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. It explains that thorough evaluation and staging guide therapy. Nonmetastatic and low-risk metastatic disease can be treated with single-agent chemotherapy with near-100% survival. High-risk disease requires multiagent chemotherapy, sometimes with radiation or surgery, achieving 80-90% survival. The overall cure rate exceeds 90%.

title: Towards the definition of the best management and prognostic factors of teratoma with malignant transformation: a single-institution case series and new proposal.
title_ja: 奇形腫の悪性転化の最適な管理と予後因子に関する検討：単施設症例集積と新たな提案
summary_ja: 本施設の胚細胞腫瘍における悪性転化48例を再検討した症例集積である。病期Iは全例が無病生存であった一方、病期IIIでは5年全生存期間(全生存率)が44%にとどまった。転化時の病期III、不完全な外科的切除、原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍や腺癌成分が予後不良因子であった。胚細胞腫瘍に合わせた化学療法と国際登録データベースも提案されている。
summary_en: This single-institution case series of 48 patients with malignant transformation within germ cell tumours re-reviewed pathology and treatment outcomes. All stage I patients remained disease-free, while five-year overall survival was 80% for stage II and 44% for stage III. Stage III at transformation, incomplete surgical removal, and primitive neuroectodermal or adenocarcinoma histology predicted worse survival. The authors also propose GCT-tailored chemotherapy within a multimodal strategy and an international registry for malignant transformation cases.

title: Malignant mixed ovarian germ cell tumor with embryonal component.
title_ja: 胚細胞成分を伴う悪性混合型卵巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 19歳女性が腹痛と大量の腹水で受診し、胎児性癌成分を大きく含む悪性混合型卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された症例報告である。外科的切除と化学療法で治療された。若年女性に多い本疾患では妊孕性温存手術を考慮した治療計画が重要であり、多くの患者が卵巣機能を保ち出産が可能であると述べられている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with abdominal pain and massive ascites who was found to have a malignant mixed ovarian germ cell tumour with a large embryonal carcinoma component. She was treated with surgical resection followed by chemotherapy. The authors emphasise that malignant germ cell tumours often affect adolescents, so fertility-sparing surgery and careful chemotherapy planning are essential. With these approaches, most patients can preserve ovarian function and later bear children.

title: Screening for tumours in paraneoplastic syndromes: report of an EFNS task force.
title_ja: 傍腫瘍症候群における腫瘍のスクリーニング：EFNSタスクフォースの報告
tags: ガイドライン・コンセンサス
summary_ja: 欧州神経学会連合(EFNS)のタスクフォースによる、傍腫瘍症候群に伴う原発腫瘍のスクリーニングの総説である。奇形腫や精巣腫瘍を含む複数の腫瘍が対象である。胸部CTやPET、超音波検査などの推奨が示されたが、エビデンスレベルは低く、合意に基づく提案である。
summary_en: This European Federation of Neurological Societies task force reviews how to screen for underlying tumours in paraneoplastic neurological syndromes. It covers small cell lung cancer, thymoma, breast cancer, ovarian carcinoma, and teratoma with testicular tumours. Recommendations include chest CT followed by FDG-PET, mammography with MRI, and pelvic ultrasound, with testicular ultrasound for men under 50 with dermatomyositis. Most evidence was low-level, so recommendations rest on consensus good-practice points.

title: Polymorphic variation in the androgen receptor gene: association with risk of testicular germ cell cancer and metastatic disease.
title_ja: アンドロゲン受容体遺伝子多型と精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症および転移性疾患との関連
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例367例と対照214例を対象に、アンドロゲン受容体遺伝子の多型を解析した研究である。非コードSNPのrs12014709のマイナー遺伝子型が発症リスクの上昇と関連し、GGN反復配列が短いことは転移性疾患のリスク上昇と関連した。アンドロゲン作用と環境因子の相互作用の関与が示唆されたが、関連性の検証は今後の課題である。
summary_en: This study of 367 testicular germ cell tumour cases and 214 controls examined androgen receptor gene polymorphisms in relation to risk, histology, and metastatic progression. A minor genotype of the non-coding SNP rs12014709 was associated with higher risk of testicular germ cell tumour, and a short GGN repeat was linked to metastatic disease. The authors suggest that androgen action and gene-environment interactions contribute to testicular malignancy. The associations require replication in future studies.

title: Immunohistochemistry expression of P53, Ki67, CD30, and CD117 and presence of clinical metastasis at diagnosis of testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおけるp53、Ki67、CD30、CD117の免疫組織化学的発現と診断時の臨床的転移の有無
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ62例を対象とした後方視的研究で、p53、Ki67、CD30、CD117の発現を免疫組織化学で評価した。診断時の臨床的転移の有無で発現に差はなく、腫瘍径6cm超や精巣網浸潤との相関も認められなかった。これらのマーカーは臨床病期Iの症例で転移や組織学的リスク因子を予測しないと結論づけられている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 62 pure testicular seminoma patients evaluated immunohistochemical expression of p53, Ki67, CD30 and CD117. Most patients were clinical stage I, and CD117 was expressed in 90% of cases. Expression of these markers did not differ between seminomas with and without clinical metastasis at diagnosis, nor did it correlate with tumour size above 6 cm or rete testis invasion. The authors conclude that these markers do not predict metastasis or other histopathological risk factors in clinical stage I disease.
