summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma that presented with uterine perforation and hemorrhage. After six disease-free years, she had recurrence in the rectosigmoid colon, which progressed despite seven cycles of EMACO chemotherapy. Low anterior resection with lymphadenectomy was performed, and hCG normalized after surgery. She remained disease-free for 13 months. The authors suggest that surgical resection of metastases may cure a small subset of chemo-resistant patients.

title: Androgen insensitivity syndrome: risk of malignancy and timing of surgery in a paediatric and adolescent population.
title_ja: アンドロゲン不応症候群における悪性腫瘍のリスクと手術時期：小児および思春期患者集団における検討
summary_ja: XY染色体核型をもつ表現型女性11例(アンドロゲン不応症候群)を後方視的に検討した研究です。全例で腹腔鏡下両側性性腺摘出術が施行され、部分型AISの2例(18.1%)で両側性セミノーマと性腺芽腫が病理組織学的に確認されました。部分型では悪性腫瘍のリスクが高い可能性があり、腹腔鏡下性腺摘出術の日常的な実施が提唱されています。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 11 phenotypic females with XY karyotype and androgen insensitivity syndrome (AIS) assessed malignancy risk and the timing of gonadectomy. Laparoscopic bilateral gonadectomy was performed in all patients, and histopathology revealed bilateral seminoma and gonadoblastoma in two patients with partial AIS (18.1%). A benign hamartoma was found in one more patient. The authors suggest partial AIS may carry a higher malignancy risk and recommend routine laparoscopic gonadectomy.

title: Uterine leiomyoma causing menometrorrhagia with a concomitant mature teratoma in a 15-year-old child: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 15歳女児における成熟奇形腫を合併した子宮平滑筋腫による月経過多・不正性器出血：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 腹痛と月経過多・不正性器出血を訴えた15歳女児で、子宮平滑筋腫と成熟卵巣奇形腫が合併した症例報告です。両病変とも外科的切除が必要でした。小児の子宮平滑筋腫は稀であり、本論文では2つの婦人科腫瘤の画像診断と最適な治療法を文献と併せて検討しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old girl with abdominal pain and menometrorrhagia who had both a uterine leiomyoma and a concomitant mature ovarian teratoma. Both masses required surgical resection. The authors review diagnostic imaging and optimal management of these two gynecologic masses in an adolescent. Uterine leiomyoma is rare in children, with only 10 previously reported cases.

title: Fatty bronchogram: a sign of cystic teratoma rupture in the lung.
title_ja: 脂肪性気管支像：肺内への嚢胞性奇形腫破裂の徴候
summary_ja: 感染性の発熱で入院した47歳男性の症例報告です。マルチディテクタ型コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、脂肪濃度を示す空洞性肺浸潤影と脂肪性気管支像が確認されました。縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫が細菌感染を契機として肺内へ破裂し、脂肪成分が気管支を介して肺に流入したと考えられます。脂肪性気管支像は嚢胞性奇形腫破裂の画像所見として有用です。
summary_en: This report describes a 47-year-old man admitted with febrile infection whose multidetector CT showed a cavitated lung consolidation with fat density and a fatty bronchogram. The findings indicated rupture of a mediastinal cystic teratoma into the lung, likely triggered by bacterial infection. Lipoid material from the teratoma had drained through the bronchus into the lung. The paper highlights fatty bronchogram as an imaging sign of cystic teratoma rupture.

title: Anti-N-methyl-D encephalitis.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を扱った論文です。稀な自己免疫疾患で、通常は傍腫瘍症候群の一部として発症し、若年女性に多く、しばしば卵巣奇形腫を伴います。腫瘍細胞が産生する抗体が辺縁系の受容体を障害します。治療は原疾患の治療に加え、ステロイドや血漿交換療法が用いられます。神経学的後遺症は75%に残存し、再発は20%、死亡率は25%とされています。
summary_en: This article reviews anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis, a rare autoimmune disorder usually part of a paraneoplastic syndrome. It occurs mainly in young women and is frequently associated with ovarian teratoma, where tumor-produced antibodies damage limbic receptors. Presentation includes altered mental status, bizarre behavior, and seizures. Treatment targets the underlying tumor or infection and uses steroids or plasmapheresis. Neurological sequelae persist in 75 percent of cases, relapse occurs in 20 percent, and mortality is 25 percent.

title: Predictors of positive retroperitoneal lymph nodes in patients with high risk testicular cancer.
title_ja: 高リスク精巣がん患者における後腹膜リンパ節陽性の予測因子
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術標本で胎児性癌が30%を超える高リスク精巣がん患者90例を後方視的に解析した。胎児性癌の割合とリンパ管侵襲は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清での陽性リンパ節と独立して関連していた。胎児性癌100%の陽性的中率は65.5%、30%の陰性的中率は85.7%であった。治療選択肢について患者に説明する際の参考になるとされる。
summary_en: Analysis of 90 patients with testicular cancer whose orchiectomy specimens contained more than 30% embryonal carcinoma and who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Lymphovascular invasion and the percentage of embryonal carcinoma were independently associated with positive retroperitoneal lymph nodes at dissection. The positive predictive value was 65.5% for 100% embryonal carcinoma, and the negative predictive value was 85.7% for 30%. These findings may help in counseling high-risk patients about treatment options.

title: Of leaves and butterflies: how methotrexate came to be the savior of women.
title_ja: 葉と蝶について:メトトレキサートはいかにして女性の救世主となったか
summary_ja: 1949年に小児白血病治療薬として開発されたメトトレキサートが、妊娠性絨毛性疾患や転移性絨毛癌の有効な治療薬となった経緯を辿る歴史的総説である。一世紀にわたる多くの臨床家・研究者の貢献を紹介し、婦人科腫瘍学における化学療法の発展を論じている。生殖能力の温存につながった治療の歩みとして位置づけられている。
summary_en: A historical review tracing how methotrexate, developed in 1949 for childhood leukemia, became an effective treatment for gestational trophoblastic disease and metastatic choriocarcinoma. It describes the contributions of many clinicians and scientists over the past century to chemotherapy in gynecologic oncology. The development of the drug is framed as a path to preserving reproductive potential in women.

title: Chromosome X-encoded cancer/testis antigens show distinctive expression patterns in developing gonads and in testicular seminoma.
title_ja: X染色体にコードされるがん精巣抗原は、発生途上の性腺および精巣セミノーマにおいて特徴的な発現パターンを示す
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児性腺および精巣腫瘍において、X染色体にコードされる10種のがん精巣抗原を免疫組織化学的に検討した。成人の精巣では、多くの抗原が精原細胞または一次精母細胞で発現している。胎児の胚細胞では、妊娠13週頃に出現し、多能性の喪失とともに減少する。精母細胞性セミノーマはほぼすべての抗原を発現する一方、古典的セミノーマは一部のみを発現しており、両者の起源の違いを反映すると考えられる。
summary_en: An immunohistochemical study of ten chromosome X-encoded cancer/testis antigens in human fetal gonads and testicular tumors. In adult testis, most antigens are expressed in spermatogonia or primary spermatocytes. In fetal germ cells, they appear around 13 weeks and decline as pluripotency is lost. Spermatocytic seminomas express nearly all antigens, whereas classical seminomas express only a subset, reflecting their different cellular origins.

title: Persistent Mullerian duct syndrome with testicular seminoma: A report of two cases.
title_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群を伴う精巣セミノーマ:2症例の報告
summary_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群を有する男性2例の症例報告である。両例とも停留精巣があり、腹腔内に停留した精巣にセミノーマを認め、子宮および卵管などのミュラー管由来構造を伴っていた。停留精巣の患者において、この症候群を認識する上での重要な症例として位置づけられる。
summary_en: A report of two males with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome, a rare form of male pseudohermaphroditism. Both had cryptorchidism with seminoma arising in an undescended abdominal testis, and both had Müllerian duct derivatives, including a uterus and fallopian tubes, despite otherwise normal male phenotype and genotype. The report highlights that seminoma and Müllerian structures can coexist, which is relevant to recognizing this syndrome in patients with undescended testis.

title: Perinatal outcome of sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の周産期転帰
summary_ja: 2000年から2010年に出生前診断された孤立性仙尾部奇形腫の胎児22例を後方視的に解析した。胎内治療群は腫瘍が大きく血管に富み、羊水過多や心拡大を伴い、早産率も高かった。新生児生存率は治療群6/8、非治療群14/14であった。全例で出生後の切除が必要で、術後合併症として便失禁が最も多かった。胎内治療は予後不良因子を伴う症例で選択されたが、新生児転帰は同程度であった。
summary_en: This retrospective cohort study examined 22 fetuses with isolated sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally between 2000 and 2010, comparing outcomes by whether in utero intervention was performed. Intervention cases, mainly radiofrequency ablation and shunting, had larger, more vascular tumors with polyhydramnios or cardiomegaly and a higher preterm birth rate. Only one tumor regressed after ablation. Neonatal survival was 6/8 with intervention and 14/14 without. All neonates required postnatal resection, most commonly followed by fecal incontinence. Intervention was associated with worse prognostic features, but neonatal outcomes were similar.

title: Placental Site Trophoblastic Tumor with lung metastases as cause of death in a young patient: a case report.
title_ja: 若年患者の死因となった肺転移を伴う胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠25週の21歳女性が、妊娠悪阻、肝機能異常、体重減少で入院後、診断前に急死した症例である。医療過誤を疑い法医学的調査が行われた。剖検で子宮に大型の栄養膜細胞とフィブリノイド沈着、筋層および血管への浸潤が認められ、肺には多数の腫瘍塞栓があった。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の肺転移による死亡と考えられる。著者は、診断と生物学的挙動の予測の困難さと、医療過誤をめぐる問題を論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman at 25 weeks of gestation who was admitted with hyperemesis, hepatic abnormalities, and weight loss, and died suddenly before a diagnosis was made. A forensic investigation for possible malpractice followed. Autopsy showed large trophoblastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, fibrinoid deposition, myometrial invasion, and vascular invasion. Lung sections contained numerous neoplastic emboli, consistent with metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor. The authors emphasize the rarity of this tumor, the difficulty of diagnosis and of predicting its behavior, and the medicolegal issues involved.

title: N-methyl D-aspartate receptor encephalitis: A new addition to the spectrum of autoimmune encephalitis.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎：自己免疫性脳炎スペクトラムへの新たな追加
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎は、若年女性の卵巣奇形腫に関連して初めて記載された自己免疫性脳炎である。患者の約60%に腫瘍（多くは卵巣奇形腫）が認められる。精神症状、意識障害、自律神経障害、運動異常、けいれん、中枢性低換気などが典型的である。血清と脳脊髄液中の抗体で確定診断し、抗体価は治療反応の指標となる。腫瘍摘出に加え、ステロイド、免疫グロブリン、血漿交換、リツキシマブやシクロホスファミドによる免疫療法を行う。早期治療が良好な転帰に重要である。
summary_en: This review describes N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis (anti-NMDAR encephalitis), an autoimmune encephalitis first described in young women with ovarian teratoma. About 60% of patients have an underlying tumor, usually an ovarian teratoma. Typical features include psychiatric symptoms, reduced consciousness, dysautonomia, movement disorders, seizures, and central hypoventilation. Diagnosis is confirmed by serum and cerebrospinal fluid antibodies, whose titers guide treatment. Management includes tumor removal, steroids, immunoglobulins, plasma exchange, and rituximab or cyclophosphamide. Early treatment is important for a good outcome.

title: Incidence, management, and outcome of molar pregnancies at a tertiary care hospital in quetta, pakistan.
title_ja: パキスタン・クエッタの三次医療機関における胞状奇胎の発生率、管理および転帰
summary_ja: パキスタン・クエッタの三次医療機関で、入院16,625例中85例の胞状奇胎を前向きに解析した。膣出血が最多の症状（94.2%）で、39%に莢膜黄体化嚢胞を認めた。多くは吸引掻爬術で治療され、子宮摘出は14.1%に行われた。高リスク例には単剤化学療法が施行され、忍容性は良好だった。平均5.7か月のフォローアップで、持続性絨毛性疾患、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌は発生しなかった。
summary_en: This prospective study from a tertiary care hospital in Quetta, Pakistan, identified 85 molar pregnancies among 16,625 admissions. Vaginal bleeding was the most common symptom (94.2%), and theca lutein cysts were present in 39%. Suction curettage was the usual management, and hysterectomy was performed in 14.1%. Single-agent chemotherapy was given to high-risk patients and was well tolerated. During mean follow-up of 5.7 months, none developed persistent trophoblastic disease, invasive mole, or choriocarcinoma. The authors note the higher incidence reported for South Asia.

title: RNA-binding protein LIN28 is a sensitive marker of ovarian primitive germ cell tumours.
title_ja: LIN28は卵巣原始胚細胞腫瘍の鋭敏なマーカーである
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍110例と転移性11例、ならびに非胚細胞腫瘍119例を対照として、免疫組織化学的にLIN28の発現を検討した。性腺芽腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍は全例で強陽性（4+）であり、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）39例中37例も同様であった。未熟奇形腫では未熟神経上皮に限局して陽性例が多く、成熟奇形腫や卵巣甲状腺腫は陰性だった。非胚細胞腫瘍の陽性は5例のみであった。
summary_en: This immunohistochemistry study assessed LIN28 expression in 110 primary and 11 metastatic ovarian germ cell tumors, with 119 non-germ cell tumors as controls. Strong (4+) staining was seen in all gonadoblastomas, embryonal carcinomas, and yolk sac tumors, and in 37 of 39 dysgerminomas. Variable staining occurred in 12 of 14 immature teratomas, confined to immature neuroepithelium. Mature teratomas, carcinoids, struma ovarii, and strumal carcinoids were negative. Only 5 of 117 non-germ cell tumors showed weak-to-moderate staining, so LIN28 helps distinguish ovarian germ cell tumors from mimics.

title: The presence of centrioles and centrosomes in ovarian mature cystic teratoma cells suggests human parthenotes developed in vitro can differentiate into mature cells without a sperm centriole.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫細胞に中心小体と中心体が存在することは、精子由来の中心小体がなくてもヒト単為発生胚が成熟細胞へ分化しうることを示唆する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は単為発生由来と考えられており、その細胞における中心小体と中心体の有無を免疫蛍光法と透過型電子顕微鏡で検討した。その結果、中心小体と中心体の存在が確認された。精子由来の中心小体がなくても、活性化卵子から生じた単為発生胚は独自に中心小体を生成し、成熟組織へ分化しうることが示唆された。体外でのヒト単為発生研究への意義が論じられている。
summary_en: This study examined whether centrioles and centrosomes are present in ovarian mature cystic teratoma cells, which are considered parthenogenetic in origin. Using immunofluorescence and transmission electron microscopy, the authors confirmed centrioles and centrosomes in these tumor cells. They argue that human parthenotes developed in vitro can produce their own centrioles and differentiate into mature tissue even without a sperm-derived centriole. The work addresses the fate of centrioles in acentriolar parthenogenetic development and its implications for in vitro human parthenogenesis.

title: Risk-adapted treatment in clinical stage I testicular seminoma: the third Spanish Germ Cell Cancer Group study.
title_ja: 臨床病期I精巣セミノーマに対するリスク適応治療：第3次スペイン胚細胞腫瘍グループ研究
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ227例を対象とした多施設共同研究で、術後のリスク因子に応じた治療戦略の有効性を検討した。2つのリスク因子を有する症例には補助カルボプラチンを投与し、他は監視とした。中央値34か月の追跡で再発は全体の7%であり、3年無病生存率は監視群88.1%、カルボプラチン群98.0%であった。再発の多くは後腹膜リンパ節で、化学療法により全例が治癒した。
summary_en: This multicenter study of 227 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma evaluated a risk-adapted strategy after orchiectomy. Patients with two risk factors (tumor larger than 4 cm and rete testis involvement) received adjuvant carboplatin, while others were placed under surveillance. With a median follow-up of 34 months, relapse occurred in 7% overall: 9.8% of surveillance patients versus 1.4% of carboplatin-treated patients. Nearly all relapses were retroperitoneal, and all were curable with chemotherapy. Three-year disease-free survival was 88.1% under surveillance and 98.0% with carboplatin; overall survival was 100%.

title: Dysgerminoma with pregnancy and viable baby: a case report.
title_ja: ディスジャーミノーマを合併し生児を得た妊娠：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマを合併した初産婦が、生殖補助医療を用いずに自然妊娠し、母児ともに障害なく生児を得た症例を報告している。ディスジャーミノーマは卵巣原始胚細胞腫瘍の代表的な組織型であり、妊孕性の低下を伴うことが多い。このような自然妊娠と生児出産の経過は極めてまれであり、卵巣悪性腫瘍を合併した妊娠の管理に関する知見として重要である。
summary_en: This case report describes a primigravida who conceived spontaneously while harboring an ovarian dysgerminoma. Dysgerminomas, the most common primitive germ cell tumors of the ovary, usually impair fertility, and natural pregnancy with a viable birth is extremely rare. The authors describe a successful pregnancy without assisted reproduction and without fetomaternal compromise. The report highlights the uncommon coexistence of a malignant ovarian germ cell tumor and a healthy pregnancy outcome, and underscores the need for careful management of pregnancies complicated by ovarian malignancy.

title: The role of lymphadenectomy for testicular cancer: indications, controversies, and complications.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおけるリンパ節郭清の役割：適応、論点、合併症
summary_ja: 精巣がんにおける後腹膜リンパ節郭清の役割を総説した論文である。低病期および高病期の症例に対する適応と、その使用をめぐる論点を整理している。周術期および長期の合併症についても検討している。術式の改良により診断・治療上の利点が増し、合併症は減少してきたとされる。集学的治療の一部として位置づけられている。
summary_en: This review addresses the role of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in testicular cancer management. It discusses indications for the procedure in both low-stage and high-stage disease, along with ongoing controversies in its use. The article also reviews complications associated with the operation, including perioperative and long-term morbidity. The authors note that refinements in surgical technique have improved both diagnostic and therapeutic value while reducing morbidity. The review frames lymphadenectomy as an integral component of multidisciplinary care for testicular cancer, alongside systemic chemotherapy.

title: Minimally invasive retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対する低侵襲後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を取り上げた論文である。低病期では病期分類と治療を兼ねる手技とされる。開腹手術と比べ回復が早く、整容性に優れ、術後合併症も少ない。経験豊富な施設では化学療法後の症例にも適用できると述べている。手術は診断と治療において依然として重要である。
summary_en: This article examines minimally invasive, laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer. Laparoscopic RPLND serves as both a staging and therapeutic procedure in low-stage disease. Compared with open surgery, it offers faster recovery, improved cosmesis, and reduced postoperative morbidity, which drive its adoption. In experienced centers, the technique can also be applied to patients after chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that surgery remains critical in diagnosis and treatment despite improved survival attributed largely to systemic chemotherapy.

title: New prognostic markers and potential therapeutic targets in human testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍における新たな予後マーカーと潜在的治療標的
summary_ja: 本総説は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の予後マーカーと新たな治療標的をまとめたものである。セミノーマは放射線療法と化学療法に良く反応し、非セミノーマは白金系化学療法に反応するが、転移性奇形腫ではシスプラチン耐性が生じうる。OCT3/4、SOX2、SOX17、HMGA1/2などの新規マーカーは組織学的サブグループの識別に役立つ。著者らは、ヒト化抗体、キナーゼ阻害薬、血管新生阻害薬などの標的治療についても論じ、一部は臨床試験で有効性が確認されていると述べている。
summary_en: This review summarizes prognostic markers and emerging therapeutic targets in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs). Seminomas respond well to radiation and chemotherapy, whereas nonseminomas respond to platinum-based chemotherapy, and metastatic teratomas can show cisplatin resistance. Novel markers such as OCT3/4, SOX2, SOX17, and HMGA1/2 help distinguish histological subgroups. The authors also discuss targeted approaches, including humanized antibodies, kinase inhibitors, and angiogenesis inhibitors, some supported by clinical trial results. The review focuses on molecular alterations in post-pubertal TGCTs and strategies aimed at chemotherapy-resistant disease.

title: Retroperitoneal and metachronous testicular germ cell tumors with different histology and teratoma growing syndrome--a case report.
title_ja: 後腹膜および異時性精巣胚細胞腫瘍で組織型が異なり奇形腫増大症候群を呈した症例：症例報告
summary_ja: 32歳男性に3年間で3つの原発性胚細胞腫瘍が生じた経過を報告している。2002年に後腹膜非セミノーマ、2004年に後腹膜成熟奇形腫、2005年に異時性精巣セミノーマが診断された。既知の危険因子がないこと、および奇形腫増大症候群に言及している。長期のフォローアップの必要性を示す症例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man who developed three primary germ cell tumors within three years. He was diagnosed with a retroperitoneal nonseminoma in 2002, a retroperitoneal mature teratoma in 2004, and a metachronous testicular seminoma in 2005. The report also refers to teratoma growing syndrome and notes the absence of known risk factors. The unusual combination of histologies in one patient illustrates the need for long-term follow-up in patients with germ cell tumors.

title: Gestational choriocarcinoma arising in a tubal ectopic pregnancy: case report.
title_ja: 卵管異所性妊娠に発生した妊娠性絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 腹痛を主訴とした38歳女性の卵管異所性妊娠の症例報告である。hCG値は高値で、手術時に卵管破裂と血腹が確認された。病理学的に原発性卵管絨毛癌と診断され、妊娠性絨毛癌の一例とされた。β-hCGの適切な監視と病理標本の慎重な検討が誤診防止に重要と結論している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old woman who presented with abdominal pain and a serum hCG above 15,000 mIU/mL. Ultrasound suggested a ruptured tubal ectopic pregnancy, and surgery revealed hemoperitoneum. Histopathology diagnosed a primary tubal choriocarcinoma, a gestational choriocarcinoma arising from ectopic pregnancy. The patient was referred to a tertiary center for treatment and follow-up. The authors conclude that careful monitoring of beta-hCG titers and meticulous pathological review are essential to avoid misdiagnosis of ectopic gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Diagnosis and management of an immature teratoma during ovarian stimulation: a case report.
title_ja: 体外受精のための卵巣刺激中に発見された未熟奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 原発性不妊症の31歳女性が、体外受精の卵巣刺激周期中に未熟奇形腫を発症した症例報告である。卵巣刺激中の成熟奇形腫の発見は珍しくないが、未熟型の報告はこれまで見当たらない。非定型嚢胞の超音波所見を契機に慎重な対応を行い、適切な外科的治療につなげた。刺激中の超音波所見の評価の重要性を示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with primary infertility who developed an immature ovarian teratoma during an in vitro fertilization ovarian stimulation cycle. The authors note that mature teratomas, or dermoid cysts, are often found during stimulation, but immature teratomas have not been reported in this setting. Ultrasound findings of an atypical cyst prompted a cautious clinical approach and appropriate surgical oncological treatment. The case highlights the importance of recognizing atypical ultrasound features during ovarian stimulation.

title: Clinical experience of adnexal torsion: evaluation of 143 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣捻転の臨床経験：143例の評価
summary_ja: 2000年から2009年の143例の卵巣捻転を後方視的に検討し、嚢胞性奇形腫の症例と他疾患の症例を比較しました。嚢胞性奇形腫は捻転のリスクを高めることが示され、患者への説明と早期の外科的管理が推奨されています。卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍に関連する知見を含みます。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 143 adnexal torsion cases at one clinic from 2000 to 2009 compares patients with benign cystic teratoma against those with other pathologies. Benign cystic teratoma was associated with a statistically different profile, including mass size and torsion frequency, indicating it increases torsion risk. The authors recommend patient counseling about torsion symptoms and early surgical management to preserve fertility.

title: Pure non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma in a 45,XO/46,XX SRY-negative true hermaphrodite.
title_ja: SRY陰性の45,XO/46,XX真性半陰陽に生じた純粋な非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌
summary_ja: 23歳のSRY陰性の真性半陰陽患者で、右卵精巣に生じた純粋な非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告です。STR解析で非妊娠由来であることを確認しました。根治的手術とBEP療法（ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン）により良好な経過をたどりました。SRY陰性例における精巣決定機構についても考察しています。
summary_en: This case report describes pure non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma in the right ovotestis of a 23-year-old with 45,XO/46,XX SRY-negative true hermaphroditism. Short tandem repeat testing confirmed non-gestational origin. The patient responded well to radical surgery followed by BEP chemotherapy. The authors also propose an X-linked or autosomal gene mechanism for testicular determination in SRY-negative true hermaphrodites.

title: Mediastinal extragonadal seminoma presenting as severe back pain in a young male.
title_ja: 若年男性で重度の背部痛を呈した縦隔の性腺外セミノーマ
summary_ja: 3週間持続する重度の上背部痛を呈した33歳男性の症例報告です。画像検査で上大静脈と気管を圧迫する縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、病理学的にセミノーマに一致する低分化悪性腫瘍と診断されました。精巣原発巣は認められず、縦隔の性腺外セミノーマと確定しました。非典型的な背部痛が性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の初期症状となりうることを示しています。
summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with three weeks of severe upper back pain who was found to have a mediastinal mass compressing the superior vena cava and trachea. Pathology showed a poorly differentiated malignant neoplasm consistent with seminoma. No primary testicular tumor was identified, establishing a mediastinal extragonadal seminoma. The case highlights that atypical back pain can herald an extragonadal germ cell tumor.

title: [Clinical outcome of refractory seminoma].
title_ja: [難治性セミノーマの臨床転帰]
summary_ja: 1991年から2009年に治療された純粋型セミノーマ67例を後方視的に検討した。15例が転移性または再発性疾患を有し化学療法を受け、6例が化学療法抵抗性（難治性）であった。難治例は主に臨床病期III期であった。難治例には追加化学療法、サルベージ手術、サルベージ放射線療法が行われ、3例は複数回の治療にもかかわらず死亡した。著者らは、難治性は予測が困難であり、サルベージ放射線療法を含む多モダリティ治療が生存利益をもたらす可能性があると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 67 patients with pure seminoma treated between 1991 and 2009 found that 15 developed metastatic or recurrent disease and received chemotherapy. Six patients had chemotherapy-resistant (refractory) disease, most often with clinical stage III disease. Refractory patients received additional chemotherapy, salvage surgery, or salvage radiation, and three died of cancer despite multiple salvage treatments. The authors conclude that refractory seminoma is hard to predict, and that multimodality therapy including salvage radiation may improve survival.

title: [A case of solitary bone metastasis of testicular seminoma 6 years post orchiectomy].
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ精巣摘除術後6年に生じた単発性骨転移の1例
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する精巣摘除術の6年後に歩行障害で発症した40歳男性の症例報告。胸椎の単発性転移が確認され、BEP化学療法と放射線療法により完全寛解に至った。3年間再発はない。治療後数年経過してからも単発性骨転移が生じうることを示す。
summary_en: A 40-year-old man presented with gait disturbance six years after orchiectomy for stage I testicular seminoma. Imaging and biopsy after emergency decompression showed a solitary thoracic vertebral metastasis of seminoma. Treatment with three cycles of BEP chemotherapy and external beam radiotherapy led to complete remission, and he remained free of recurrence for three years. The case shows that solitary bone metastasis of seminoma can appear years after initial treatment.

title: [A case report of bilateral spermatocytic seminoma].
title_ja: 両側精母細胞性セミノーマの1例
summary_ja: 左陰嚢内容の無痛性腫脹で受診した56歳男性の症例。画像検査で両側精巣腫瘍と診断され、両側高位精巣摘除術を施行。病理診断は両側精母細胞性セミノーマ(pT1)であった。補助療法は行わず経過観察し、術後5か月時点で再発を認めていない。
summary_en: A 56-year-old man presented with painless left scrotal swelling, and imaging showed bilateral testicular tumors. Bilateral high orchidectomy was performed, and histology confirmed bilateral spermatocytic seminoma, pT1. Spermatocytic seminoma is a rare germ cell tumor first described in 1946. No adjuvant therapy was given, and the patient was followed closely. No recurrence was seen five months after surgery. The authors report this rare bilateral presentation.

title: The management of subcentimeter residual mass in NSGCT: pcRPLND vs. observation.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の1cm未満の残存腫瘤:化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清(pcRPLND)対経過観察
summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、化学療法後に残存する1cm未満の腫瘤の扱いを論じたレビュー。再発率が低いことから経過観察も選択肢だが、pcRPLNDによる外科的切除の論拠も残る。1cmを超える残存腫瘤は手術すべきという点では合意がある。
summary_en: This paper reviews management of subcentimeter residual masses after first-line chemotherapy in advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Patients with complete serologic and radiographic response may be observed, since recent reports show low relapse rates. However, surgical excision by post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection remains an option. The arguments for and against pcRPLND are presented. There is consensus that residual masses over 1 cm should undergo surgery.

title: Cytologic findings in two cases of dermoid cysts with malignant transformation.
title_ja: 悪性転化を伴う類皮嚢腫の2症例における細胞診所見
summary_ja: 悪性転化を伴った類皮嚢腫の2症例を報告。細胞診で悪性が示唆され、1例は腺癌、もう1例は腹水中の悪性黒色腫であった。いずれも進行期で発見された。類皮嚢腫の悪性転化はまれで、細胞診による診断は困難であると指摘している。
summary_en: Two cases of dermoid cysts with malignant transformation are described, in which cytologic examination first suggested malignancy. In one case, an adenocarcinoma was found on Pap smear, which the author believes is a first report of this kind. The second involved malignant melanoma, a finding rarely reported in ascitic fluid. Both patients presented at advanced stages. The paper highlights that malignant transformation of dermoid cysts is rare and difficult to diagnose cytologically.

title: Echocardiographic risk stratification of fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma and twin-reversed arterial perfusion.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫および双胎動脈反転灌流症候群の胎児における心エコーによるリスク層別化
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)または双胎動脈反転灌流症候群(TRAP)の胎児19例を後方視的に検討。水腫または周産期死亡に至った群では心血管プロファイルスコアが低く、心胸郭比が高かった。胎児心エコーは収縮機能異常を捉えられるが、拡張機能異常は捉えられないと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study assesses whether pre-intervention fetal echocardiographic parameters can predict outcome in fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma or twin-reversed arterial perfusion sequence. Among 19 fetuses reviewed, those who developed hydrops or died had worse cardiovascular profile scores and higher cardiothoracic ratios. Abnormalities such as a high cardiothoracic ratio, high combined ventricular output, or valve regurgitation were found only in poor-outcome fetuses. The authors conclude that echocardiography detects systolic but not diastolic dysfunction.

title: Choriocarcinoma of the breast; a case report and review of literatures.
title_ja: 乳腺絨毛癌の症例報告と文献的レビュー
summary_ja: 41歳女性の乳腺絨毛癌の症例を報告した論文。病歴、身体所見、検査所見、画像所見、病理所見を詳述している。乳腺絨毛癌は極めて稀で、絨毛癌様成分を伴う乳癌と乳腺への転移性絨毛癌という二つの用語で記載されてきたことを踏まえ、既報の文献をレビューしている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma of the breast. The paper details her history, physical examination, laboratory findings, imaging studies, and pathological findings. The authors note that breast choriocarcinoma is extremely rare and has been described in the literature under two terms: breast cancer with choriocarcinomatous features and metastatic choriocarcinoma to the breast. They review previously published breast choriocarcinoma cases to place this patient within existing knowledge of this rare entity.

title: Ovarian teratoma presenting as small bowel obstruction in an elderly lady-A case report.
title_ja: 小腸閉塞を呈した卵巣奇形腫の高齢女性症例
summary_ja: 高齢女性が、腸管に癒着していない巨大な卵巣類皮嚢腫により小腸閉塞を来した症例報告。卵巣奇形腫は成熟型と未熟型に分類され、成熟型は類皮嚢腫と呼ばれ、生殖年齢女性で最も多い良性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍である。捻転や破裂により急性腹症様の症状を呈しうる。
summary_en: This case report describes an elderly woman who presented with small bowel obstruction caused by a very large ovarian dermoid cyst that was not adherent to the intestine. The authors summarize that ovarian teratomas are mature or immature, and that the mature type, termed dermoid cyst, is the most common benign germ cell tumor of the ovary in women of reproductive age. Although often asymptomatic until large, cysts may cause symptoms through pressure, torsion, or rupture, which can mimic an acute abdomen. The case highlights an uncommon presentation of a mature teratoma with mechanical bowel obstruction.

title: Coincidence of mature cystic teratoma and serotonin-producing neuroendocrine tumor of the ileum.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と回腸のセロトニン産生神経内分泌腫瘍の併存
summary_ja: 51歳女性で、回腸のセロトニン産生神経内分泌腫瘍の術後に左横隔膜の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が異時性に見つかった症例報告。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の性腺外発生は極めて稀で、横隔膜発生の報告は10例のみである。両疾患の偶然の併存の可能性について考察している。
summary_en: This report describes a 51-year-old woman who developed a benign mature cystic teratoma of the left diaphragm metachronously with a serotonin-producing neuroendocrine tumor of the ileum. She had earlier undergone ileal resection for the neuroendocrine tumor and resection of a benign right ovarian cystadenoma. The authors note that mature cystic teratomas are rarely extragonadal, with only 10 prior diaphragmatic cases reported. They present this as the first report of metachronous benign mature cystic teratoma of the diaphragm with a highly differentiated neuroendocrine tumor of the ileum and discuss the possible coincidence of the two diseases.

title: Differential Akt signalling in non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるAktシグナル伝達の差異
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍）と良性精巣組織を比較し、PTEN、リン酸化Akt、p27Kip1を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。PTENは全ての病型で著明に低下していた。リン酸化Aktの過剰発現は認めず、古典的なAkt活性化以外の経路との相互作用が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined Akt pathway proteins (PTEN, phosphorylated Akt, and p27Kip1) by immunohistochemistry in non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, including 17 teratomas, 27 embryonal carcinomas, and 6 yolk sac tumors, compared with 24 benign testicular samples. PTEN was markedly reduced in all NST subgroups, and nuclear p27Kip1 was concentrated in teratomas and embryonal carcinomas. Phospho-Akt was not overexpressed, and no negative correlation with PTEN or p27Kip1 was found. Yolk sac tumors showed a late cytoplasmic shift of PTEN and p27Kip1. The authors conclude that NST signaling likely involves crosstalk with other pathways rather than classical Akt activation.

title: Unusual presentation of primary gastric choriocarcinoma in a 24-year-old female patient.
title_ja: 24歳女性にみられた原発性胃絨毛癌の非典型的な臨床像
summary_ja: 24歳女性が高いβ-hCG値、無月経、悪心、貧血など妊娠様の症状を呈し、その後上部消化管出血をきたした。内視鏡で胃腫瘍が確認され、病理組織学的検査で原発性胃絨毛癌と診断された。非妊娠性絨毛癌に準じた化学療法3コースを行ったが、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腫瘍の残存が示され、診断から約6か月で死亡した。
summary_en: A young woman presented with high serum beta-hCG, amenorrhea, nausea and anemia mimicking pregnancy, followed by upper gastrointestinal bleeding. Endoscopy revealed a gastric tumor, and histopathology confirmed primary gastric choriocarcinoma. Three cycles of nongestational choriocarcinoma chemotherapy failed, and CT showed persistent disease. The patient died about six months after diagnosis. The authors emphasize the highly aggressive course, frequent liver and lung metastases, and hormonal symptoms that mimic pregnancy.

title: Mediastinal choriocarcinoma masquerading as relapsed hodgkin lymphoma.
title_ja: 再発ホジキンリンパ腫と誤認された縦隔絨毛癌
summary_ja: 古典的ホジキンリンパ腫の治療歴を持つ25歳男性が、10年後に縦隔腫瘤と持続する咳嗽を呈した。再発ホジキンリンパ腫と考えられ複数の化学療法が行われたが、切除リンパ節生検で絨毛癌と判明した。病勢は急速に進行し、患者は2週間以内に死亡した。
summary_en: A 25-year-old man treated for classic Hodgkin lymphoma with splenectomy, radiation therapy and chemotherapy later developed a paraspinal relapse. A decade after completing treatment, he presented with a persistent cough and a mediastinal mass, which was repeatedly interpreted as relapsed lymphoma. Excisional lymph node biopsy revealed choriocarcinoma. Despite multiple regimens, the disease progressed rapidly and the patient died within two weeks, illustrating a rare extragonadal germ cell malignancy that mimicked relapsed Hodgkin lymphoma.

title: Laparoscopic treatment of ovarian dermoid cysts is a safe procedure.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡手術は安全な手技である
summary_ja: 2002～2010年に腹腔鏡下治療を受けた卵巣類皮嚢腫63例を解析した。病理組織学的検査で成熟型58例、未熟型5例が確認された。合併症は認められず、嚢腫内容物の漏出があっても化学性腹膜炎は観察されなかった。破裂例で腹腔内を十分に洗浄・ドレナージすれば、腹腔鏡手術は安全な選択肢と結論された。
summary_en: This study analyzed 63 patients with ovarian dermoid cysts treated laparoscopically between 2002 and 2010. Histopathology confirmed 58 mature and 5 immature cases. Most patients underwent cystectomy, and seven required salpingo-oophorectomy. No intra- or postoperative complications occurred, and no chemical peritonitis was observed even when cyst contents spilled. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is safe when the peritoneal cavity is thoroughly washed and drained in ruptured cases.

title: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis with serum anti-thyroid antibodies and IgM antibodies against Epstein-Barr virus viral capsid antigen: a case report and one year follow-up.
title_ja: 血清抗甲状腺抗体およびEBウイルスカプシド抗原に対するIgM抗体を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎：症例報告と1年間のフォローアップ
summary_ja: 17歳の女性が精神症状、記憶障害、痙攣、その後の反応低下や中枢性低換気を呈した。血清では抗甲状腺抗体とEBウイルスIgM抗体が高値であった。未熟卵巣奇形腫を切除したところ完全に回復し、脳脊髄液中の抗NMDA受容体抗体により抗NMDA受容体脳炎と確定した。奇形腫では異所性の未熟神経組織とEBウイルス潜伏感染が確認された。1年後も抗甲状腺ペルオキシダーゼ抗体と抗NMDA受容体抗体は陽性のままであり、神経自己免疫と甲状腺自己免疫の関連が示唆されている。
summary_en: A 17-year-old woman presented with psychiatric symptoms, memory deficits, seizures, and later unresponsiveness, dyskinesias and central hypoventilation. Serum showed high anti-thyroid antibodies and EBV capsid IgM. Resection of an immature ovarian teratoma led to full recovery, and anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis was confirmed by CSF antibodies. Teratoma pathology showed NR1-positive ectopic immature neural tissue and EBV latent infection. At one-year follow-up, anti-TPO and anti-NMDAR antibodies persisted, suggesting a link between neuronal and thyroid autoimmunity.

title: Intrapulmonary teratoma presenting with tricoptysis: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 三毛喀血を呈した肺内奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
journal: Indian J Chest Dis Allied Sci
summary_ja: 34歳男性が三毛喀血を呈し、肺内奇形腫と診断された。胸腔内奇形腫は通常縦隔に発生するが、まれに肺から発生することがある。本報告は、この稀な性腺外病変の臨床像を示し、文献的考察を加えている。
summary_en: A 34-year-old man presented with tricoptysis, hemoptysis containing hair, and was diagnosed with an intrapulmonary teratoma. Intrathoracic teratomas usually arise in the mediastinum but rarely originate from the lung, as in this case. The authors describe the clinical presentation of this rare extragonadal lesion and review the relevant literature.

title: Trends in testicular germ cell tumors among U.S. military servicemen, 1990-2003.
title_ja: 1990～2003年の米国軍人における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の動向
summary_ja: 1990～2003年のデータを用い、20～59歳男性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の罹患率を米国現役軍人と一般集団で比較した。非セミノーマの罹患率は軍人で有意に低かった（罹患率比0.90）。セミノーマでは両集団で罹患率が有意に増加し、限局性腫瘍の増加が認められたが、その理由は未解明である。
summary_en: Using ACTR and SEER data for men aged 20 to 59 from 1990 to 2003, this study compared testicular germ cell tumor incidence among US active-duty servicemen with the general population. Nonseminoma incidence was significantly lower in the military (rate ratio 0.90). Incidence rose for both histologic types in both populations, but significantly only for seminoma. Increases were confined to localized tumors. The authors note that the lower nonseminoma incidence and rising localized tumors remain unexplained.

title: A genome-wide RNAi screen in mouse embryonic stem cells identifies Mp1 as a key mediator of differentiation.
title_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞の全ゲノムRNAiスクリーニングにより分化の鍵となるMp1を同定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞を用いた全ゲノムshRNAスクリーニングにより、分化に必要なMp1を同定した。Mp1のノックダウンは自己複製を促進し、FGF4による分化を阻害したが増殖は変化させなかった。さらに、ヒトの胚細胞腫瘍では浸潤性の胎児性癌やセミノーマでMp1発現が低く、浸潤性GCT細胞でのノックダウンは分化抵抗性をもたらした。
summary_en: A genome-wide shRNA screen in mouse embryonic stem cells identified Mp1 as a regulator required for differentiation. Mp1 knockdown stimulated self-renewal, blocked FGF4-induced differentiation without affecting proliferation, and upregulated pluripotency genes. The authors also show that human germ cell tumors express low Mp1 in invasive embryonic carcinoma and seminoma, and that Mp1 knockdown in invasive GCT cells confers resistance to differentiation, suggesting a functional role in germ cell cancer.

title: Intrapericardial teratoma as a cause of fetal death--a case report.
title_ja: 胎児死亡の原因となった心膜内奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 心膜内奇形腫が出生前には診断されず、剖検で初めて確認された胎児死亡例の症例報告である。35歳女性の妊娠23週の定期超音波検査で心拍動が確認されず、人工妊娠中絶が行われた。心膜内奇形腫は稀な先天性腫瘍で、無治療では出生前後に心不全を来す。多くは出生前診断をすり抜けるため、早期診断と外科的進歩の重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with an intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed only at postmortem examination. Fetal death occurred after no cardiac activity was seen on routine ultrasound at 23 weeks, and an abortion was induced. Intrapericardial teratoma is a rare congenital tumor that can cause cardiac failure prenatally or postnatally if untreated. The authors emphasize that such tumors often go undetected during prenatal diagnostics, highlighting the value of early diagnosis and surgical advances.

title: Brain infarction as the initial presentation of primary posterior mediastinal seminoma.
title_ja: 原発性後縦隔セミノーマの初発症状としての脳梗塞
summary_ja: 40歳男性が脳梗塞と構音障害で受診し、胸部X線で偶然後縦隔腫瘍が見つかった。CT誘導下生検でセミノーマと診断され化学療法を受けた。5か月後に再発した神経症状の原因は、既存梗塞部位に生じた転移性セミノーマだった。胚細胞腫瘍が脳梗塞として初発しうること、脳転移が虚血病変に類似しうることを示す症例報告である。
summary_en: A 40-year-old man presented with cerebral infarction and slurred speech. Chest radiography revealed a posterior mediastinal tumor, diagnosed as seminoma by CT-guided biopsy. After chemotherapy, he developed recurrent neurological symptoms; brain MRI showed two lesions within prior infarct areas, histologically confirmed as metastatic seminoma. The case highlights that a germ cell tumor can initially present as cerebral infarction, and that brain metastases may mimic ischemic lesions.

title: Incidental finding of ovarian teratoma on post-therapy scan for papillary thyroid cancer and impact of SPECT/CT imaging.
title_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌の治療後スキャンで偶然発見された卵巣奇形腫と、SPECT/CTの有用性
summary_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌の41歳女性が131ヨウ素治療を受けた。治療後全身スキャンで左骨盤に集積があり、SPECT/CTで卵巣の腫瘤と特定された。病理組織学的に良性甲状腺組織を伴う嚢胞性奇形腫（卵巣甲状腺腫）で悪性所見はなかった。その後の治療でサイログロブリン値は低下し、フォローアップ画像に異常集積はなかった。偶発的な集積の評価におけるSPECT/CTの有用性を示す症例報告である。
summary_en: A 41-year-old woman with papillary thyroid carcinoma underwent radioiodine therapy. Post-therapy whole-body scanning showed a left pelvic focus, and SPECT/CT localized it to an ovarian mass. Pathology revealed a cystic teratoma with benign thyroid tissue (struma ovarii) without malignancy. Subsequent radioiodine treatment was given, and thyroglobulin levels fell with no abnormal uptake on follow-up scans. The report emphasizes the value of SPECT/CT for characterizing incidental uptake.

title: Choroidal metastases in testicular choriocarcinoma, successful treatment with chemo- and radiotherapy: a case report.
title_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の脈絡膜転移：化学療法および放射線療法により治療に成功した症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌と多臓器転移を有する26歳男性が、化学療法中に両側の脈絡膜転移を発症し、片眼の視力低下を来した。化学療法の継続と頭蓋骨および脊椎への定位放射線療法を併用した結果、完全寛解が得られ、4年以上の経過観察後も視力は保たれた。著者らは、この稀な合併症において放射線療法が根治的精巣摘除術および化学療法を補完すると結論づけている。
summary_en: A 26-year-old man with testicular choriocarcinoma and multiorgan metastases developed bilateral choroidal metastases during chemotherapy, causing vision loss in one eye. Treatment combining continued chemotherapy with stereotactic radiotherapy to the skull and spine achieved complete remission, with preserved vision after over four years of follow-up. The authors conclude radiotherapy complements orchiectomy and chemotherapy in this rare complication.

title: Synchronous metastatic seminoma and primary retroperitoneal ganglioneuroma: case report and literature review.
title_ja: 同時性転移性セミノーマと原発性後腹膜神経節腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴う同時性転移性精巣セミノーマと、良性の後腹膜神経節腫を併存した患者の症例である。併存腫瘍により診断と治療方針の決定が難しくなった。併用化学療法でセミノーマは完全奏効し、その後神経節腫を完全切除した。胚細胞腫瘍患者において併存する良性腫瘍が病期診断や治療計画を混乱させうることを示す症例報告と文献レビューである。
summary_en: A patient with synchronous metastatic testicular seminoma involving retroperitoneal lymph nodes also had a benign retroperitoneal ganglioneuroma, complicating diagnosis and management. Combination chemotherapy produced a complete response of the seminoma, and the ganglioneuroma was then completely resected. The case illustrates how a coexisting benign retroperitoneal tumor can confound staging and treatment planning in germ cell tumor patients.

title: Epididymal germinoma: Reality or myth?
title_ja: 精巣上体ジャーミノーマ：実在するのか、それとも誤りか
summary_ja: 陰嚢腫瘤の疑いで紹介された45歳男性の症例である。超音波検査で左精巣上体頭部に病変を認め、肉芽腫の可能性が示された。精巣上体腫瘍はまれで、多くは平滑筋腫や腺腫様腫瘍などの良性だが、悪性病変も報告されている。本報告は精巣上体ジャーミノーマが独立した疾患単位として存在するのかという問いを提起する。
summary_en: This report describes a 45-year-old man referred for a suspected scrotal mass. Ultrasonography showed a lesion in the left epididymal head, possibly a granuloma. The authors review the rare epididymal tumors, most benign (leiomyoma, adenomatoid tumor), with malignant entities including adenocarcinoma, liposarcoma, and lymphoma. The title questions whether epididymal germinoma truly exists as a distinct entity.

title: [A case of primary urinary bladder and ureter cancer with a choriocarcinoma].
title_ja: 絨毛癌を伴った膀胱・尿管原発癌の1例
summary_ja: 右尿管癌と50mmの膀胱腫瘍を有する85歳男性の症例である。両病変ともcT3N0M0と診断され、来院時に転移は認めなかった。右腎尿管全摘除術と膀胱摘除術が施行された。病理組織学的に尿路上皮癌に絨毛癌が混在していた。尿路上皮由来の原発腫瘍に絨毛癌成分が生じうることを示す症例報告である。
summary_en: An 85-year-old man with a right ureteral cancer and a 50 mm bladder tumor underwent right nephroureterectomy and cystectomy. Staging was cT3N0M0 for both lesions, with no metastasis at presentation. Histopathology revealed urothelial carcinoma admixed with choriocarcinoma, an unusual finding in the urinary tract. The case illustrates that a choriocarcinomatous component can arise in a urothelial primary tumor.

title: [Testicular cancer with inguinal lymph node metastasis in a patient with prior orchiopexy for undescended testis: a case report].
title_ja: 停留精巣に対する精巣固定術の既往を有する鼠径リンパ節転移を伴う精巣がんの1例:症例報告
summary_ja: 10歳時に停留精巣の精巣固定術を受けた36歳男性。左鼠径部腫瘤で受診し、鼠径リンパ節から胎児性癌の転移が判明した。超音波検査で萎縮精巣内の腫瘤を認め、左高位精巣摘除術でセミノーマと胎児性癌の混合型と診断された。BEP化学療法後18か月、再発なし。国内で11例目の報告。
summary_en: A 36-year-old man who had undergone orchiopexy for undescended testis at age 10 presented with a painful left inguinal mass. Surgery revealed enlarged inguinal lymph nodes with metastatic embryonal carcinoma. Scrotal ultrasonography then showed a mass in the atrophic left testis, and high orchiectomy revealed a mixed seminoma and embryonal carcinoma, pT1N2M0. After three cycles of BEP chemotherapy, he remained free of recurrence and metastasis at 18 months. This is reported as the 11th Japanese case of this presentation.

title: Embryonal carcinoma in androgen insensitivity syndrome.
title_ja: アンドロゲン不応症候群における胎児性癌
summary_ja: アンドロゲン不応症候群の20歳女性。下腹部の大きな腫瘤(約15cm)を認め、細胞診で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌疑い)と診断。術前BEP化学療法後に開腹で精巣摘除術などを施行し、術後さらに2コース実施。3年間無病経過。
summary_en: A 20-year-old with androgen insensitivity syndrome and primary amenorrhea presented with a large lower abdominal mass of about 15 cm. Cytology suggested non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, likely embryonal carcinoma. After three cycles of neoadjuvant BEP chemotherapy, laparotomy with orchidectomy, omentectomy and appendectomy was performed, followed by two more cycles. She has remained free of disease for three years.

title: Metastatic adenocarcinoma in a young male, 12 years after treatment of primary non seminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 原発性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療12年後に出現した転移性腺癌の若年男性例
summary_ja: 精巣未熟奇形腫の治療から12年後に、32歳男性に転移性腺癌が出現した症例。転移に対し局所放射線療法を行ったが奏効せず、腫瘍切除と緩和的化学療法を実施した。稀な経過と治療の難しさを報告する。
summary_en: A 32-year-old man developed metastatic adenocarcinoma 12 years after treatment for an immature teratoma of the testis. The metastases did not respond to local radiotherapy, so tumor excision and palliative chemotherapy were performed. The authors present the case for its rarity, unusual presentation, and difficulty of management.

title: A rare case of mature teratoma. Has FDG PET/CT a role to play?
title_ja: 稀な成熟奇形腫の1例:FDG PET/CTは役割を果たすか
summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫に悪性転化を伴った稀な症例の報告。術前のFDG PET/CTで、CT部分により三胚葉由来の成分が描出され、PET部分の高集積が悪性転化を示唆した。こうした稀な腫瘍の評価においてPET/CTは有用と結論づけている。
summary_en: A rare case of mature teratoma with malignant transformation is reported. Preoperative FDG PET/CT was performed. The CT component identified three embryonal components, while increased FDG uptake on the PET component suggested possible malignant transformation before surgery. The authors conclude that PET/CT is a valuable tool for evaluating these rare tumors.

title: Recurrent hydatidiform mole: A case report of six consecutive molar pregnancies complicated by choriocarcinoma, and review of the literature.
title_ja: 再発性胞状奇胎:連続6回の胞状奇胎妊娠に絨毛癌を合併した症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 42歳女性が連続6回の部分胞状奇胎妊娠を経験し、最後の妊娠後に絨毛癌と診断された。β-hCGの追跡を行い、絨毛癌には多剤併用化学療法を実施して治癒。その後、早発閉経を疑う症状が出現した。再発性胞状奇胎の文献レビューを含む。
summary_en: A 42-year-old woman had six consecutive partial molar pregnancies without an intervening normal pregnancy, and choriocarcinoma was diagnosed after the last one. She was followed with serial beta-hCG measurements, and multi-agent chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma led to cure. She later developed symptoms suggestive of premature menopause. The report includes a review of the literature on recurrent hydatidiform mole.

title: Sarcoid-like granulomatosis and testicular germ cell tumor: the 'Great Imitator'.
title_ja: サルコイド様肉芽腫症と精巣胚細胞腫瘍：「偉大な模倣者」
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者1,182例を後方視的に検討し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関連するサルコイド様肉芽腫症を13例で同定した。診断時の年齢中央値は25.5歳で、病期はIからIIIに及んだ。肉芽腫は9例で診断時に、4例で経過観察中に認められ、主に重篤な臓器障害を伴わない良性の肺サルコイドーシスであった。著者らは、臨床所見と組織所見の解釈に注意を要し、転移性精巣腫瘍の鑑別診断にサルコイド様肉芽腫症を含めるべきと勧めている。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 1,182 patients with testicular tumours identified 13 with sarcoid-like granulomatosis associated with testicular germ cell tumour (GCT). Median age at diagnosis was 25.5 years, with stages ranging from I to III. Granulomatosis appeared at diagnosis in 9 patients and during follow-up in 4, mainly as benign pulmonary sarcoidosis without severe organ involvement. The authors advise caution when interpreting clinical and histological findings and recommend including sarcoid-like granulomatosis in the differential diagnosis of metastatic testicular tumours.

title: Chronic eosinophilic leukemia with FIP1L1-PDGFRA transcripts after occupational and therapeutic exposure to radiation.
title_ja: 放射線療法後に発症したFIP1L1-PDGFRA転写産物陽性の慢性好酸球性白血病：職業性および治療的放射線被曝
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法の27か月後に、FIP1L1-PDGFRA陽性の慢性好酸球性白血病を発症した症例報告。患者は原子力発電所作業員として職業性放射線被曝歴があった。イマチニブにより血液学的完全寛解と分子学的完全奏効が得られた。職業性および治療的放射線被曝が原因となりうることを示唆している。
summary_en: A 40-year-old nuclear power plant worker with 20 years of occupational radiation exposure developed FIP1L1-PDGFRA-positive chronic eosinophilic leukemia 27 months after radiotherapy for testicular seminoma. He presented with eosinophilia and bone marrow and lymph node involvement. Imatinib achieved complete hematological remission at six months and complete molecular response at one year. The authors suggest that occupational and therapeutic radiation may be causative factors in this rare myeloproliferative neoplasm.

title: [Mediastinal seminoma with hemangiosarcoma].
title_ja: 縦隔セミノーマと血管肉腫
summary_ja: 30歳男性の縦隔腫瘍は当初多房性胸腺嚢胞と診断され切除された。その後、肺病変により死亡した。剖検で左肺病変は血管肉腫と診断され、嚢胞内には微小なセミノーマ成分と血管肉腫成分が確認された。セミノーマに関連して生じた血管肉腫が肺へ転移したと推測されている。
summary_en: A 30-year-old man had a large anterior mediastinal tumour that was resected and diagnosed as a multilocular thymic cyst. He later developed pulmonary nodules and died. Autopsy diagnosed the left lung lesion as hemangiosarcoma and revealed microscopic seminomatous and hemangiosarcomatous components within the original cyst. The authors speculate that the hemangiosarcoma arose in association with the seminoma and metastasized to the lung.

title: Isolated eyeball metastasis of non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumor.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞性精巣腫瘍の孤立性眼球転移
summary_ja: 左眼の疼痛と視力低下を呈した24歳男性で、非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の孤立性眼球転移が判明した。右根治的精巣摘除術とPEB化学療法（シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン）により腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、眼の病変は縮小した。その後眼球摘出術が行われ、経過観察中再発はみられなかった。著者らは、この腫瘍の血行性による眼への孤立性転移はまれであると述べている。
summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with left eye pain and vision loss, and was found to have an isolated eyeball metastasis from a non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumour. Right radical orchiectomy and PEB chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin) normalized tumour markers and regressed the eye lesion. Enucleation followed, and the patient remained free of recurrence during follow-up. The authors note that isolated haematogenous metastasis of this tumour to the eye is rare.

title: Choriocarcinoma following ovarian hydatidiform mole: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣胞状奇胎に続発した絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣異所性妊娠の既往後にhCG上昇を認めつつフォローアップが途絶えていた49歳女性の症例報告。3年後に肺・膣転移を伴う絨毛癌と診断され、化学療法で寛解した。元の組織再評価で卵巣胞状奇胎が判明し、これが絨毛癌の起源と考えられた。妊娠産物の検査では胞状奇胎の除外が重要であると強調している。
summary_en: A 49-year-old woman with a prior ectopic pregnancy, lost to follow-up despite rising hCG, presented three years later with hemoptysis, vaginal bleeding and elevated hCG. Pulmonary and vaginal metastases confirmed choriocarcinoma, which responded to six months of chemotherapy. Review of the original specimen revealed an ovarian hydatidiform mole that likely gave rise to the choriocarcinoma. The authors emphasize excluding hydatidiform mole in products of conception and monitoring hCG until it is negative.

title: Vulvar yolk sac tumor mixed with embryonal carcinoma in a peri-pubertal girl: a case report.
title_ja: 思春期前後の女児に生じた胎児性癌混在の外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 14歳女児の外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍・胎児性癌の症例報告である。外陰切除と化学療法、放射線療法後に肺転移を来し、切除後に大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を施行して無病で経過している。初回治療に抵抗性の転移性外陰部胚細胞腫瘍に対し、大量化学療法の選択肢を示唆している。
summary_en: A 14-year-old girl with vulvar yolk sac tumor mixed with embryonal carcinoma underwent vulvectomy, inguinal lymph node dissection, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy. Eight months later she developed lung metastasis, which was resected. She then received high-dose TIP and GEMOX chemotherapy with two peripheral blood stem cell transplants and remained disease-free. The authors suggest that high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue may be considered for metastatic vulvar germ cell tumors that fail first-line therapy.

title: Presacral teratoma in a Curarrino syndrome woman with an unreported insertion in MNX1 gene.
title_ja: Currarino症候群を有する女性にみられた仙骨前部奇形腫とMNX1遺伝子の新規挿入変異
summary_ja: Currarino症候群を有する26歳女性の12cm大の仙骨前部奇形腫の症例報告である。MNX1遺伝子に未報告の挿入変異が同定された。仙骨骨欠損を伴う仙骨前部腫瘍では本症候群を疑う必要があり、治療の遅れは中枢神経系感染などの重篤な合併症につながると述べられている。
summary_en: A 26-year-old woman with Currarino syndrome presented with a 12 cm presacral teratoma causing compression symptoms. She had a pelvic teratoma diagnosed eight years earlier. Imaging showed sacral dysraphism, and laparotomy confirmed presacral teratoma. Genetic analysis identified a previously unreported triple CGC insertion in exon 1 of MNX1. The authors emphasize that a presacral tumor with a sacral bony defect should prompt evaluation for Currarino syndrome, and that delayed treatment can cause serious complications.

title: Two cases of cerebral sinus venous thrombosis following chemotherapy for non-seminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に生じた脳静脈洞血栓症の2例
summary_ja: シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる化学療法を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の2症例で、脳静脈洞血栓症が発症した。頭痛と神経脱落症状が主症状であった。抗凝固療法により数週間以内に症状は可逆的に改善した。化学療法中の精巣がん患者の神経症状では本疾患を鑑別に挙げるべきと述べられている。
summary_en: Two patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor developed cerebral sinus venous thrombosis after chemotherapy with cisplatin, bleomycin, and etoposide. Headache and neurological deficits were the main symptoms. The authors note that cancer and cisplatin are known thrombotic risk factors. Anticoagulation therapy led to symptom reversal within weeks. Cerebral sinus venous thrombosis should be considered in the differential diagnosis of neurological symptoms in patients with testicular cancer receiving chemotherapy.

title: Analysis of clinical-pathologic variables, staging and prognostic groups, and therapeutic results of 106 germ-cell testicular tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍106例の臨床病理学的変数、病期分類、予後群および治療成績の解析
summary_ja: 1992〜2009年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍106例の後方視的研究である。セミノーマが54.7%を占め、腫瘍マーカー上昇は非セミノーマで多かった。危険因子を有する病期I症例には補助療法が行われ、無イベント生存率は93.3%であった。
summary_en: A retrospective review of 106 testicular germ cell tumors treated from 1992 to 2009. Most patients were diagnosed recently, and 54.7% had seminoma histology. Tumor marker elevation was more frequent in non-seminoma. Most patients were stage I-II and in the good prognostic group. Stage I seminomas with rete testis invasion or tumor size over 4 cm, and non-seminomas with vascular or lymphatic invasion, received adjuvant therapy. With median follow-up of 60 months, event-free survival was 93.3%.

title: Spermatic cord dermoid cyst as paratesticular mass. Case report and bibliographic review.
title_ja: 精索類皮嚢腫が精巣傍腫瘤として認められた症例の報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 48歳男性の左精索に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告と文献的考察である。超音波検査では診断が確定せず、外科的切除を行った。術中病理で良性と確認されたため、根治的精巣摘除術は回避された。精索腫瘤の治療判断の前に、精巣傍腫瘍の鑑別として本疾患を考慮すべきと述べられている。
summary_en: A 48-year-old man presented with a recurrent mass in the left high scrotum and inguinal area. Ultrasound and physical examination were inconclusive, so surgical exploration with complete excision was performed. Intraoperative pathology confirmed a benign dermoid cyst, and radical orchiectomy was avoided. The authors review the literature and note that spermatic cord dermoid cyst is rare but should be considered in the differential diagnosis of paratesticular masses before treatment decisions are made.

title: Immature teratoma of the ovary: a clinicopathological study of 28 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫28例の臨床病理学的研究
summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫28例の後方視的な臨床病理学的研究である。全例で未熟間葉組織が認められ、神経上皮はグレードで評価された。病期I症例の予後は良好であった。手術と化学療法の併用は再発例においても生存期間を延長しうると述べられている。
summary_en: A clinicopathological study of 28 ovarian immature teratomas. Immature mesenchyme was present in all cases, while neuroepithelium was seen in 26 and graded I to III. Grade did not correlate with immature mesenchyme. Among 23 patients with follow-up, 17 remained alive without recurrence, and six experienced death or local recurrence. Stage I tumors had a better prognosis, and combined surgery and chemotherapy may prolong survival even in recurrent disease.

title: A mediastinal germ cell tumor mimicking an ectopic pregnancy.
title_ja: 異所性妊娠に類似した原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 経口避妊薬服用中の36歳女性が、異所性妊娠に類似した所見で受診した。β-hCG高値が持続したためメトトレキサートによる治療を受けた。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で前縦隔に大きな腫瘍が発見され、原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。異所性妊娠の治療後にβ-hCGが持続高値の場合は胸部X線検査を勧めている。
summary_en: A 36-year-old woman taking oral contraceptives presented at seven weeks of amenorrhea with a beta-hCG of 850 IU and an apparent uterine mass, mimicking ectopic pregnancy. She underwent left adnexectomy and curettage, then methotrexate for persistently elevated beta-hCG. Computed tomography finally revealed a large anterior mediastinal tumor, a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor. The authors recommend chest X-ray in patients with persistently elevated beta-hCG after ectopic pregnancy treatment.

title: Swyer syndrome, 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis, a sex reversal disorder with dysgerminoma: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: Swyer症候群（46,XY性腺形成不全）に合併したディスジャーミノーマ：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 46,XY核型のSwyer症候群を有する22歳女性で、右性腺に生じたディスジャーミノーマの症例報告である。迅速病理でディスジャーミノーマと診断され、腫瘍減量術と化学療法が行われた。Y染色体の存在は性腺腫瘍のリスクを高めるため、予防的な両側卵管性腺摘出術が勧められると結論づけている。
summary_en: A 22-year-old woman with a 46,XY karyotype and Swyer syndrome presented with primary amenorrhea and a pelvic mass. Laparotomy revealed a hypoplastic uterus and an 80 x 70 x 60 mm right gonadal mass extending to the pelvic peritoneum. Frozen section showed dysgerminoma. She underwent debulking surgery with pelvic lymphadenectomy and four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. The authors conclude that Y chromosome presence increases gonadal tumor risk and prophylactic bilateral salpingo-gonadectomy should be advised.

title: Current chemotherapeutic management of patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)ではなく妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の化学療法管理の現状
summary_ja: 本総説は、侵入胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む、あらゆる病期の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の評価、化学療法による管理、フォローアップを扱う。早期病変は単剤化学療法で治癒することが多いが、進行期には多剤併用レジメンが必要とされる。著者らは、治療後の慎重な経過観察、再発の積極的な管理、既往のある女性の将来の妊娠の綿密なモニタリングを強調している。
summary_en: This review covers the workup, chemotherapeutic management, and follow-up of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia at all stages, including invasive hydatidiform mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Early-stage disease is often cured with single-agent chemotherapy, whereas advanced disease requires multiagent regimens. Adjunctive surgical procedures can help some patients. The authors emphasize careful surveillance after treatment, aggressive management of recurrence, and close monitoring of future pregnancies in women with prior GTN.

title: Struma ovarii with papillary thyroid carcinoma.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に併発した乳頭状甲状腺癌
summary_ja: 21歳女性の左卵巣に生じた卵巣甲状腺腫に、乳頭状甲状腺癌が発生した症例を報告する。卵巣甲状腺腫は奇形腫の一種で、甲状腺組織が主体または唯一の成分となる。本症例は、甲状腺組織が正常甲状腺と同様の良性・悪性の病理像を示しうることを示した。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍内に生じた稀な悪性成分の一例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with papillary thyroid carcinoma arising within a struma ovarii of the left ovary. Struma ovarii is an uncommon ovarian teratoma in which thyroid tissue predominates or is exclusive, and it can show benign or malignant thyroid pathology. The report notes that thyroid tissue in this setting can show the same spectrum of pathologic features as normal thyroid. It provides a concise illustration of a rare malignant component within an ovarian germ cell tumor.

title: Clinicopathological features and survival of testicular tumours in a Southeast Asian university hospital: a ten-year review.
title_ja: 東南アジアの大学病院における精巣腫瘍の臨床病理学的特徴と生存率：10年間の検討
summary_ja: 2001〜2011年に治療された精巣腫瘍31例を解析した東南アジアの大学病院の研究。平均診断年齢は33.7歳で、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が最多であった。胚細胞腫瘍患者の半数以上が診断時に転移を有し、転移例には補助化学療法が行われた。5年生存率は胚細胞腫瘍で88.9%、全精巣がんで83.9%であった。
summary_en: This ten-year retrospective review from a Southeast Asian university hospital analyzed 31 patients with testicular tumours. The average age at presentation was 33.7 years. Non-seminomatous germ cell tumour was the most common histology, followed by seminoma, lymphoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma. More than half of GCT patients had metastasis at diagnosis. All underwent radical orchidectomy; adjuvant chemotherapy was given to patients with metastatic disease, and four seminoma patients received para-aortic radiotherapy. The 5-year survival rate was 88.9% for GCT and 83.9% for all testicular cancers.

title: Monodermal teratomas (struma ovarii). Clinicopathological characteristics of 11 cases and literature review.
title_ja: 単一胚葉性奇形腫（卵巣甲状腺腫）11例の臨床病理学的特徴と文献的考察
summary_ja: 一施設での15年間の奇形腫256例のうち、卵巣甲状腺腫（単一胚葉性奇形腫）11例を検討した。多くは若年成人で、腹痛や骨盤内腫瘤が主症状だった。組織像は微小濾胞型、充実型、偽腺管型などがみられ、非定型例では免疫組織化学が診断に有用だった。悪性例はなく、腫瘍摘出術が適切な治療と結論している。
summary_en: This paper reviews 11 monodermal teratomas of struma ovarii identified among 256 teratomas examined at one pathology laboratory over 15 years. Patients were mostly young adults, with pain and pelvic mass as the most common presentations. Most tumors were unilateral and compact or microcystic, with microfollicular, solid, or pseudoglandular histology. Immunohistochemistry aided diagnosis in atypical cases. No malignant struma ovarii was found. Tumorectomy was the main treatment, with hysterectomy for large tumors, and the authors favor conservative surgery given the benign course.

title: Pregnancy following conservative surgical treatment of the malignant mixed germ-cell tumor of the ovary--case report.
title_ja: 卵巣の悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍に対する保存的手術後の妊娠：症例報告
summary_ja: 早期の卵巣悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の若年女性例で、片側卵管卵巣摘出術と大網切除、骨盤・傍大動脈リンパ節郭清を行い、化学療法を実施した。3年後に自然妊娠し、健康な児を出産した。早期例では保存的手術により妊孕性を温存できる可能性があると結論している。
summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with early-stage malignant mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary who underwent fertility-sparing surgery. Treatment consisted of unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, infracolic omentectomy, and pelvic and paraaortal lymph node dissection, followed by chemotherapy. Three years later she conceived spontaneously and delivered a healthy infant. The authors conclude that fertility can be successfully preserved through conservative surgery in selected patients with early-stage malignant ovarian germ cell tumors.

title: Secondary retroperitoneal teratoma.
title_ja: 続発性後腹膜奇形腫
summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫の既往から12年後に発生した後腹膜の続発性奇形腫の症例である。非特異的な腹痛の評価のために施行したCTで偶然発見された。CTとMRIでは石灰化と周辺増強を伴う嚢胞性後腹膜腫瘤が認められ、画像所見の特徴が示された。後腹膜奇形腫の文献的考察と鑑別診断もまとめている。
summary_en: This case report describes a retroperitoneal mass in a patient with a history of primary testicular teratoma diagnosed 12 years earlier, representing secondary gonadal teratoma. The mass was incidentally found on abdominal CT performed for nonspecific abdominal pain. CT and MRI showed cystic retroperitoneal masses with calcifications and peripheral enhancement. The authors review the literature on retroperitoneal teratomas and the common differential diagnoses to consider.

title: Yolk sac tumour arising in mature teratoma in the parapharyngeal space.
title_ja: 傍咽頭腔の成熟奇形腫に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 4歳男児の傍咽頭腔腫瘤が、成熟奇形腫内に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍であったと報告している。卵黄嚢腫瘍は乳幼児では主に性腺に生じ、性腺外発生は稀である。成熟奇形腫からの卵黄嚢腫瘍発生は文献上初めての報告とされる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の多様な発生様式を示す貴重な症例である。
summary_en: The authors report a four-year-old boy with a parapharyngeal mass that proved to be a yolk sac tumour arising within a mature teratoma. Yolk sac tumour is usually a gonadal germ cell tumour in infants, and extragonadal presentations are rare. Parapharyngeal mature teratomas are also uncommon. Although malignant transformation of extragonadal mature teratoma has been described, the authors state that yolk sac tumour arising in such a teratoma had not previously been reported.

title: An unusual case of altered mental status in a young woman.
title_ja: 若年女性における意識変容を呈した抗NMDA受容体抗体関連脳炎の一例
summary_ja: 28歳女性で、混乱、幻視、けいれんを呈した抗NMDA受容体抗体関連辺縁系脳炎の症例である。CTで左卵巣の類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）が見つかり、脳脊髄液中の抗体陽性で診断された。ステロイドパルス、血漿交換、左卵巣摘出術により認知機能は改善し、けいれんは消失した。卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎として腫瘍切除の重要性を述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor antibody-associated limbic encephalitis presenting with confusion, hallucinations, and seizures. CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis revealed a left ovarian dermoid cyst, and CSF antibody testing confirmed the diagnosis. Treatment included methylprednisolone, plasmapheresis, and left salpingo-oophorectomy, with marked cognitive improvement and no further seizures. The authors emphasize that ovarian teratoma is strongly associated with this paraneoplastic syndrome and that tumor resection is key.

title: Gliomatosis peritonei: recurrence, treatment and surveillance.
title_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症：再発、治療およびサーベイランス
summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫と腹膜神経膠腫症を有する33歳女性の症例で、腹部膨満と腹痛で受診した。経時的な画像のフォローアップ所見を示している。腹膜病変の鑑別は予後に重要で、数年後の悪性転化も否定できないため、術後サーベイランスの指針作成が必要と述べている。
summary_en: This report describes a 33-year-old woman with an immature ovarian teratoma and gliomatosis peritonei, presenting with abdominal distension and pain. Follow-up imaging was reviewed over time. The authors note that gliomatosis peritonei is metastatic implantation of mature glial tissue from ovarian teratoma, and that differentiating peritoneal implants is important for prognosis. Malignant transformation can occur years later, so the authors call for guidelines on postoperative surveillance of these patients.

title: Mesenteric dermoid cyst in a child.
title_ja: 小児の腸間膜類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: ガーナの2歳女児で、可動性のある無痛性の腹部腫瘤を呈した巨大な腸間膜類皮嚢腫の症例である。小児外科専門医のいない農村部の病院で外科的切除が行われた。腸間膜に発生する成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は稀であり、術前診断の困難さと資源の限られた環境における治療上の課題を指摘している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old girl in Ghana with a large mesenteric dermoid cyst, presenting as a freely movable, non-tender abdominal mass. The cyst was removed surgically in a rural hospital without a dedicated pediatric surgical service. The authors note that mesenteric cysts are rare and usually occur in children under 10, and that dermoid cysts, or mature cystic teratomas, rarely arise in the mesentery. They also highlight diagnostic challenges and limited resources in Africa.

title: A large advanced seminoma in an older woman with androgen insensitivity syndrome.
title_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症を伴う高齢女性の大型進行セミノーマ
summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症（CAIS、XY核型）を有する58歳女性で、鼠径ヘルニアを契機に大型の進行セミノーマと診断された症例である。診断が遅れたため適切な治療を受けられなかった。停留精巣の悪性転化リスクは加齢とともに高まり、思春期後の性腺摘出が推奨されることを述べ、CAISにおける早期診断の重要性を示している。
summary_en: This report describes a 58-year-old woman with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (CAIS), an XY karyotype, who presented with inguinal hernia and was diagnosed with a large advanced seminoma. Because the diagnosis was made late, she could not receive proper management. The authors explain that the risk of malignant transformation in undescended testes increases with age, so gonadectomy is recommended after puberty. The case highlights the importance of early diagnosis in CAIS.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma arising in a testicular teratoma and presenting as sister Mary joseph nodule.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌がSister Mary Joseph結節として発現した1例
summary_ja: 若年男性の精巣奇形腫内に発生した体細胞型扁平上皮癌の症例報告。臍部転移結節（Sister Mary Joseph結節）として発症した。精巣由来の扁平上皮癌からこの転移形式が報告されたのは初めてと考えられ、若年男性の臍部結節の鑑別では本起源も念頭に置くべきであると述べている。
summary_en: This report describes a rare somatic-type squamous cell carcinoma arising within a testicular teratoma in a young man. The tumor presented as a metastatic umbilical nodule (Sister Mary Joseph nodule), a finding not previously reported from testicular squamous cell carcinoma. The authors stress that this origin should be considered when evaluating umbilical nodules in young male patients.

title: Conservative surgery in patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍における温存手術
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者25例を対象とした後方視的研究で、子宮と対側卵巣を温存する手術を、化学療法の有無にかかわらず評価した。多くは若年患者で、腫瘍の多くは早期病期であった。2年間の追跡で、再発は2例、術後死亡は1例、化学療法群では健康な生児が5例得られた。研究者らは、妊孕性を温存する治療法が実行可能であることを示唆している。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 25 patients with ovarian malignant germ cell tumors evaluated conservative surgery that preserved the uterus and contralateral ovary, with or without adjuvant chemotherapy. Most patients were young, and most tumors were early stage. Over two years of follow-up there were two recurrences, one postoperative death, and five healthy live births in the chemotherapy group, suggesting fertility-sparing approaches are feasible.

title: Head and neck teratomas in children: a case series.
title_ja: 小児の頭頸部奇形腫：症例集積
journal: Indian J Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg
summary_ja: 小児の頭頸部奇形腫を扱った症例集積であり、多様で予測困難な臨床経過や劇的な症状を呈することがある希少腫瘍群について述べている。最近の用語分類の見直しにも言及し、性腺・中枢神経外の胚細胞由来奇形腫の理解を整理している。
summary_en: This case series reviews pediatric teratomas of the head and neck, a group with diverse, unpredictable clinical behavior and often dramatic presentation. The article discusses their rarity and the recent terminology used for this tumor group. It is a descriptive review centered on extragonadal germ cell-derived teratomas outside the gonads and central nervous system.

title: Management of a Type I Hypersensitivity Reaction to IV Etoposide in a Woman with a Yolk Sac Tumor: A Case Report.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍患者における静注エトポシドに対するI型過敏反応の管理：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍の女性患者において、静注エトポシドによるI型過敏反応が生じたため、エトポシドホスフェートへ置換し、BEP療法4サイクルを完遂できた症例報告。婦人科胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法における薬剤過敏症への実際的な対応を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a woman with yolk sac tumor who developed a type I hypersensitivity reaction to intravenous etoposide. Authors substituted etoposide phosphate and allowed completion of all four planned cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (BEP). The report highlights practical management of drug hypersensitivity during germ cell tumor chemotherapy in gynecologic oncology.

title: Intra-abdominal testicular seminoma in a woman with testicular feminization syndrome.
title_ja: 精巣性女性化症候群の女性にみられた腹腔内精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣性女性化症候群を有する36歳女性の腹腔内精巣腫瘍の症例報告。病理学的にセミノーマと診断された。超音波、MRI、MRスペクトロスコピーによる画像所見を記載しており、腹腔内精巣セミノーマにおけるこれらの所見の報告は初めてとしている。原発性無月経で受診した。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with testicular feminization syndrome and an intra-abdominal testicular tumor, histologically confirmed as seminoma. Imaging with ultrasound, MRI, and MR spectroscopy was documented, which the authors note is the first such description for intra-abdominal testicular seminoma. The case presented with primary amenorrhea.

title: Sacrococcygeal masses other than meningomyelocele.
title_ja: 髄膜瘤以外の仙尾部腫瘤
summary_ja: 小児の仙尾部腫瘤23例の症例集積で、髄膜瘤を除くと奇形腫が主要な群を占めた。類皮嚢腫、変性神経線維、横紋筋肉腫なども含まれる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫を中心に、まれな仙尾部病変の診断と管理の理解を深めることを目的としている。
summary_en: This series of 23 pediatric sacrococcygeal masses, excluding meningomyelocele, identifies teratoma as a major group alongside presacral dermoid, degenerated nerve fiber, fibrofatty tissue, and rhabdomyosarcoma. Presented at a pediatric surgery department over ten years, it aims to improve diagnosis and management of unfamiliar sacrococcygeal lesions. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is an extragonadal germ cell tumor.

title: A calcific pelvic mass in a woman with chronic spinal pain: a case of mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 慢性脊椎痛のある女性にみられた石灰化した骨盤内腫瘤：成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例
summary_ja: 27歳の女性が慢性の多発性脊椎痛でカイロプラクティック教育施設を受診した。脊椎のX線検査で偶発的に骨盤内の石灰化陰影が見つかった。超音波検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され、開腹手術で完全に切除された。脊椎症状はカイロプラクティック治療で改善を続け、骨盤内腫瘤は症状の原因ではなかったと考えられた。著者らは、卵巣由来が疑われる石灰化骨盤内腫瘤には追加の画像診断と適切な紹介が必要であると強調し、石灰化を伴う卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断も概説している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman who presented to a chiropractic teaching clinic with chronic multilevel spinal pain. Routine spinal radiography incidentally revealed calcific densities in the pelvis. Ultrasonography identified a mature cystic teratoma, which was completely excised through laparotomy. Her spinal symptoms continued to respond to chiropractic care, indicating the pelvic mass was not the source of her complaints. The authors emphasize that calcific pelvic masses suspected of ovarian origin require additional imaging, careful clinical correlation, and appropriate referral. They also review differential diagnoses for ovarian masses with calcifications.

title: Ovarian germ cell neoplasm in a true hermaphrodite.
title_ja: 真性半陰陽に生じた卵巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 女性表現型で染色体モザイクを有する真性半陰陽の35歳女性に、卵巣のディスジャーミノーマが認められた稀な症例。真性半陰陽の悪性腫瘍はほぼ全例が胚細胞腫瘍であり、大半は男性表現型の患者に生じると述べている。本論文は、この非典型例の治療経過と反応を報告している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with a female phenotype and cytogenetic mosaicism who had true hermaphroditism. She was diagnosed with a dysgerminoma of the ovary, a rare malignancy in this setting. The authors note that malignancies in true hermaphrodites are rare, occur almost exclusively with cytogenetic mosaicism, and are nearly always germ cell neoplasms such as seminoma, gonadoblastoma, or teratoma, usually in patients with a male phenotype. The paper reports the treatment and clinical response in this atypical case.

title: Paraneoplastic hyperthyroidism.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍に伴うhCG高値による傍腫瘍性甲状腺機能亢進症
summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍でhCGが著しく高値の31歳男性が、甲状腺機能亢進症を呈した症例。hCGはTSHと構造が類似するため、高値になるとTSH受容体を刺激して甲状腺機能亢進を来しうる。化学療法の開始後にhCG値が低下し、甲状腺機能亢進症も改善した。腫瘍マーカーの増加と臨床症状の関連を示す傍腫瘍性内分泌合併症の一例である。
summary_en: The authors report a 31-year-old man with a metastatic germ cell tumour and markedly elevated human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) who presented with hyperthyroidism. Because hCG is structurally similar to thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), very high levels can activate the TSH receptor and cause thyroid dysfunction. After chemotherapy was started, hCG levels fell and the hyperthyroidism resolved. The case illustrates a paraneoplastic endocrine complication of germ cell tumours and the link between tumour marker burden and clinical symptoms.

title: Appearance of anti-NMDAR antibodies after plasma exchange and total removal of malignant ovarian teratoma in a patient with paraneoplastic limbic encephalopathy.
title_ja: 傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳症を呈した女性における、悪性卵巣奇形腫の全摘および血漿交換後の抗NMDAR抗体の出現
summary_ja: 急性精神病で入院した29歳女性は、発熱と幻覚の悪化を呈していた。腰椎穿刺で脳脊髄液の反応性変化が認められ、経腟超音波検査で卵巣奇形腫が疑われる腫瘤が見つかった。初期の抗NMDAR抗体は陰性であったが、腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術と血漿交換を受けて徐々に改善した。その後、抗体は陽性となった。卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎と抗体検出の遅延を示す症例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman admitted with acute psychosis, fever, and worsening hallucinations. Lumbar puncture showed reactive cerebrospinal fluid, and transvaginal ultrasound revealed a left ovarian mass suggestive of teratoma. Initial anti-NMDA receptor antibody testing was negative, but she underwent laparoscopic oophorectomy and plasma exchange. Her condition gradually improved, and the anti-NMDAR antibody later became positive. The report highlights a paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma and the potential for delayed antibody detection.

title: Immature extragastric teratoma of infancy: a rare tumour with review of the literature.
title_ja: 乳児の未熟奇形腫（胃外性）：稀な腫瘍と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 進行性の腹部膨満を呈した生後4か月男児の、石灰化を伴う多嚢胞性腹部腫瘤の症例。AFPやβ-hCGなどの腫瘍マーカーは年齢相応であった。試験開腹術で胃小弯から発生した23cmの腫瘤が認められ、病理組織学的検査で未熟奇形腫と診断された。1年間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。乳児期に生じる稀な腫瘍として文献レビューも行っている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 4-month-old male infant with progressive abdominal distension and a multicystic abdominal mass with calcification. Serum AFP, beta-hCG, and other markers were within age-appropriate ranges. Laparotomy revealed a 23 cm multilobulated cystic mass arising from the lesser curvature of the stomach and fed by the left gastric artery. Histopathology showed an immature teratoma, and the infant had no recurrence after one year of follow-up. The paper also reviews the literature on this rare tumour in infancy.

title: The demographics of molar pregnancies in BPKIHS.
title_ja: BPKIHSにおける胞状妊娠の人口統計学的特徴
summary_ja: ネパールのBPKIHSで2008〜2010年に記録された胞状妊娠64例の後方視的研究。完全胞状奇胎37例、部分胞状奇胎23例に加え、侵入奇胎や絨毛癌も含まれていた。発生率は分娩1000件あたり3.94で、中央値は22歳であった。母体年齢や血液型との関連を検討し、完全奇胎は若年層に多いと報告している。
summary_en: This retrospective study analysed 64 molar pregnancies recorded at BP Koirala Institute of Health Sciences in Nepal between January 2008 and January 2010. The series comprised 37 complete moles, 23 partial moles, one persistent gestational trophoblastic tumour, one choriocarcinoma, and two invasive moles. The incidence was 3.94 per 1000 deliveries, with a median patient age of 22 years. Most women presented in early second trimester. The authors describe relationships between molar pregnancy, maternal age, and blood group, and note that complete moles were most common in younger women.

title: Mature embryoid teratoma in the wall of a mucinous cyst adenoma of ovary in multiparous female.
title_ja: 卵巣粘液性嚢胞腺腫の壁に生じた成熟胚様奇形腫
summary_ja: 経産婦の36歳女性に、卵巣の衝突腫瘍が認められた症例報告。大型の粘液性嚢胞腺腫の表面の壁に、小さな卵円形の胚様成熟奇形腫が存在していた。著者らは、嚢胞壁内の卵巣胚細胞遺残に由来すると考察している。卵子の単為発生と濾胞上皮の化生による発生という別の機序も提案している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old multiparous woman with a collision tumour of the ovary. A small ovoid embryoid mature teratoma was found in the surface wall of a large mucinous cyst adenoma, without columnar epithelium or mucin-secreting cysts in the teratoid component. The authors suggest the teratoma arose from an ovarian germ cell rest within the cyst wall. They also propose an alternative pathogenesis involving parthenogenesis of the ovum and epithelial metaplasia of the follicular lining of the adenoma.

title: Puerperal choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 産褥期の転移性絨毛癌
summary_ja: 産後に頭痛や左下肢のしびれを呈し、後に痙攣で集中治療室に入院した32歳女性の症例。脳、肺、肝、膵に病変があり、β-hCGは132,000 IU/Lを超えていた。転移性絨毛癌と診断され、併用化学療法により良好な反応を示し、完全に回復した。産後の多臓器症状では妊娠性悪性腫瘍を考慮する必要性を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman who developed headaches, blurred vision, and left leg numbness after delivery, initially attributed to migraine with sciatica. She later had seizures and was admitted to intensive care. Investigations showed abnormal cerebral perfusion, multiple lung nodules, liver lesions, and a pancreatic mass. Beta-hCG exceeded 132,000 IU/L, and metastatic choriocarcinoma was diagnosed. She responded well to combination chemotherapy and made a full recovery. The case illustrates the importance of considering gestational malignancy in postpartum patients with multisystem findings.

title: A case of thyroid-type papillary carcinoma derived from ovarian mature cystic teratoma, resected by laparoscopic surgery.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の甲状腺型乳頭癌に対する腹腔鏡手術の一例
summary_ja: 子宮筋腫と8cmの左卵巣腫瘍を有する50歳女性の症例。腹腔鏡下子宮全摘術と左卵管卵巣摘出術が施行された。病理組織学的検査で、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の甲状腺組織から生じた濾胞型甲状腺型乳頭癌と診断された。卵巣甲状腺腫の稀な悪性転化であり、腹腔鏡下治療では本疾患の可能性を念頭に置く必要があると論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old woman with a uterine fibroid, hypermenorrhea, and an 8 cm left ovarian tumour. She underwent laparoscopic hysterectomy and left salpingo-oophorectomy. Histopathological examination showed a follicular variant thyroid-type papillary carcinoma arising from thyroid tissue within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, representing a rare malignant transformation of ovarian struma. The authors note that such rare malignancy should be considered when treating teratomas laparoscopically, and that the operative strategy requires careful selection given reports of early postoperative death.

title: Genistein inhibits placental choriocarcinoma cell line JAR invasion through ERβ/MTA3/Snail/E-cadherin pathway.
title_ja: ゲニステインはERβ/MTA3/Snail/E-カドヘリン経路を介して絨毛癌細胞株JARの浸潤を抑制する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究は大豆由来のフィトエストロゲンであるゲニステインが、絨毛癌細胞株JARの浸潤に与える影響を検討したものです。ゲニステインは用量依存的に浸潤を抑制し、MTA3の減少、SnailおよびE-カドヘリンの増加をもたらしました。ERβのノックダウンによりこれらの効果は消失し、ERβを介した経路が示されました。絨毛癌の予防や治療への応用が期待されると述べています。
summary_en: This in vitro study examined whether genistein, a soy phytoestrogen, suppresses invasion of the choriocarcinoma cell line JAR. Using a Matrigel invasion assay, genistein reduced invasion in a dose-dependent manner, decreasing MTA3 and increasing Snail mRNA and E-cadherin protein. Knockdown of estrogen receptor β with siRNA abolished these effects, indicating that genistein acts through ERβ to regulate the MTA3/Snail/E-cadherin pathway. The authors suggest these findings may inform the prevention and therapy of choriocarcinoma.

title: Giant intrapulmonary teratoma: a rare case.
title_ja: 巨大肺内奇形腫：稀な症例
summary_ja: 2歳男児に発生した巨大な肺内奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビューです。肺奇形腫は稀で、多くは左肺上葉に発生します。肺原発と診断するには、性腺や他の性腺外原発巣を除外し、病変が肺内に完全に限局している必要があります。本論文は、この症例の臨床経過と診断基準を文献と照らし合わせて概説しています。
summary_en: The authors report a giant pulmonary teratoma in a 2-year-old boy and review the relevant literature. Pulmonary teratomas are rare and most often arise in the upper lobe of the left lung. Diagnosis of pulmonary origin requires exclusion of a gonadal or other extragonadal primary site and origin entirely within the lung. The paper describes the clinical course of this case and summarizes previous reports to place its diagnostic criteria in context.

title: Congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma with a cleft palate: case report and a 7 year follow up.
title_ja: 先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫と口蓋裂：症例報告および7年間のフォローアップ
summary_ja: 出生時に口から大きな腫瘤が突出していた女児の先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫(epignathus)と口蓋裂の症例報告です。出生当日に口外部分を減量し、その後口腔内から摘出して、口蓋裂の修復は段階的に行いました。病理組織学的検査で先天性奇形腫と確定しました。7年間のフォローアップを行い、本症の疫学と臨床像も概説しています。
summary_en: The authors describe a female infant with a congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma (epignathus) and cleft palate, whose large mass protruded from the mouth at birth. Management involved immediate debulking of the extraoral portion, followed by intraoral extirpation and staged cleft palate repair. Histopathological examination confirmed a congenital teratoma.
