summary_en: This case report describes an 11-month-old infant who developed cauda equina syndrome and a spinal epidural hematoma 17 days after resection of a sacrococcygeal teratoma and coccyx excision. Magnetic resonance imaging showed a large dorsal epidural lesion extending from T12 to the sacrum, connected to the prior operative site. Emergency decompression was performed. The patient was discharged with diminished neurologic function but improved substantially over 18 months and was neurologically normal at age 7. The authors emphasize sealing access to the spinal canal after sacrococcygeal surgery.

title: Deregulation of EZH2 expression in human spermatogenic disorders and testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍およびヒト精子形成障害におけるEZH2発現の異常
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における EZH2 mRNA 発現をリアルタイムRT-PCRで解析した研究。EZH2は正常精巣で最も高く、上皮内癌から浸潤性腫瘍へ進展するにつれ低下した。精子形成障害の分子マーカーとしての可能性を示している。
summary_en: This study measured EZH2 mRNA expression by real-time RT-PCR in testicular germ cell tumors, including 64 seminomas, 36 non-seminomas, and 4 carcinomas in situ. Samples with spermatogenic defects and normal testicular biopsies were included for comparison. EZH2 was expressed in 99% of tumor samples. Its levels were highest in normal testis and decreased progressively with malignant transformation to carcinoma in situ and invasive tumor. EZH2 levels were not related to histological subtype or clinical stage. They inversely correlated with spermatogenic severity, suggesting EZH2 could be a molecular marker for spermatogenic defects.

title: Teratoma with a malignant somatic component in pediatric patients: the Associazione Italiana Ematologia Oncologia Pediatrica (AIEOP) experience.
title_ja: 小児における悪性体細胞成分を伴う奇形腫：イタリア小児血液腫瘍学会(AIEOP)の経験
summary_ja: イタリア小児血液腫瘍学会(AIEOP)が悪性体細胞成分を伴う奇形腫(TMSC)の小児14例を集積した。無再発生存率は35.7%、全生存率は42.8%であった。予後は通常の胚細胞腫瘍より不良であり、化学療法は組織型に応じて体細胞成分の悪性腫瘍への治療も含めるべきだと結論づけている。
summary_en: The AIEOP Italian pediatric oncology group identified 14 children with teratoma with a malignant somatic component (TMSC) and reviewed their records and pathology. Sites included testis, sacrococcygeal region, ovary, retroperitoneum, and mediastinum, with somatic components such as carcinoma, neuroblastoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma. Relapse-free and overall survival were 35.7% and 42.8% at a median follow-up of 31 months. The authors conclude that prognosis is worse than for pure germ cell tumors and that chemotherapy should be histology-directed and include agents for the somatic malignancy, if chemosensitive.

title: Histopathological diagnosis of hydatidiform mole: contemporary features and clinical implications.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎の病理組織学的診断：現代の特徴と臨床的意義
summary_ja: 妊娠初期の胞状奇胎の病理組織学的特徴を検討し、完全胞状奇胎と部分胞状奇胎の鑑別点を示した。絨毛の異形成や異常な栄養膜細胞増殖が診断の手がかりとなる。持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍は完全奇胎の約15%、部分奇胎の0.5%に生じる。早期の組織学的同定に基づき、母体hCGの追跡により、上昇または横ばいの段階で治療できる。
summary_en: This paper examines the histopathological features of hydatidiform mole in the first trimester, distinguishing complete from partial mole. Villous dysmorphism and abnormal trophoblast hyperplasia serve as diagnostic clues. Persistent gestational trophoblastic neoplasia occurs in about 15% of complete and 0.5% of partial moles. Early histologic identification supports surveillance by serial maternal hCG measurement, allowing timely treatment when hCG levels rise or plateau. The authors emphasize that early diagnosis is essential for appropriate management.

title: Current issues in the histopathology of gestational trophoblastic tumors.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の病理組織学における現在の課題
summary_ja: 完全・部分胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(類上皮性を含む)の病理組織学的課題を検討した。胞状奇胎後のhCG監視により、組織学的確認なしに持続性病変が早期発見されることが多い。絨毛癌は血行性転移が多くhCGが高値で化学療法への反応性が高い。一方、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は低いhCG値と低い化学療法反応性を示す。
summary_en: This paper reviews current issues in the histopathology of gestational trophoblastic tumors, including complete and partial hydatidiform mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental-site trophoblastic tumor with its epithelioid variant. Postmolar hCG surveillance identifies persistent disease early, often without histologic confirmation. Choriocarcinoma shows villous trophoblast differentiation, extensive hematogenous spread, high hCG levels, and chemoresponsiveness. PSTT/ETT shows implantation-site trophoblast differentiation with lower hCG levels and poorer chemoresponse.

title: Concurrent xanthogranulomatous orchiepididymitis and seminoma in the same testis.
title_ja: 同一精巣に併発したキサントグラヌロマ性精巣上体精巣炎とセミノーマ
summary_ja: 52歳男性が左精巣腫瘤と陰嚢からの膿性分泌で受診した。超音波検査では腫瘍性病変が示唆されたが、腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。精巣摘除術で、キサントグラヌロマ性精巣上体精巣炎と、同一精巣内に併存する潜在性の典型的セミノーマが判明した。両病変の併存はこれまで報告がないとされる。広範な検体採取により潜在性セミノーマを除外すべきである。
summary_en: A 52-year-old man presented with a left testicular mass and scrotal discharge; ultrasound suggested neoplasia, but tumor markers were normal. Orchidectomy revealed xanthogranulomatous orchiepididymitis with a concurrent occult typical seminoma in the same testis. The authors state that this coincidence has not been previously documented. They stress that XGO can mimic and coexist with testicular malignancy, and recommend wide sampling of orchidectomy specimens to exclude occult seminoma.

title: Surgical management of ovarian disease in infants, children, and adolescents: a 15-year review.
title_ja: 小児における卵巣疾患の外科的管理：15年間の後方視的レビュー
journal: J Laparoendosc Adv Surg Tech A
summary_ja: 小児・思春期の卵巣疾患231例を15年間後方視的に検討した研究。良性病変が95.7%を占め、成熟奇形腫は20.8%であった。良性疾患に対する低侵襲手術の割合は年々増加し、開腹手術と比べ入院期間、出血量、手術時間が短縮された。適応があれば腹腔鏡手術を推奨すると結論づけている。
summary_en: This 15-year retrospective review of 231 pediatric and adolescent patients undergoing surgery for ovarian disease found 95.7% benign lesions, including 46 mature teratomas (20.8%), and 4.3% malignant. Over three consecutive five-year periods, minimally invasive surgery use for benign disease increased. MIS was associated with shorter hospital stay, less blood loss, and shorter operative time than open surgery. The authors recommend laparoscopy when indicated for presumed benign ovarian disease in children.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome of the ovary after fertility-sparing surgery and successful pregnancy.
title_ja: 卵巣のgrowing teratoma syndrome：妊孕性温存手術の後、妊娠に成功した症例
summary_ja: 30歳の未経妊の日本人女性が、ステージIIIaの卵巣未熟奇形腫に対して妊孕性温存手術と、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる4サイクルの化学療法を受け、その後2回出産した。初回手術から8年後、副腎腫瘍様の腫瘤を腹腔鏡下に切除したところ成熟奇形腫であり、growing teratoma syndromeと診断された。著者らは、本症候群は妊娠後であっても遅れて出現しうるため、卵巣未熟奇形腫の治療後には長期フォローアップが不可欠であると強調している。
summary_en: A 30-year-old nulliparous Japanese woman with stage IIIa ovarian immature teratoma underwent fertility-sparing surgery and four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, then had two pregnancies. Eight years after initial surgery, a mass mimicking an adrenal tumor was resected laparoscopically and proved to be mature teratoma, diagnosed as growing teratoma syndrome. The authors emphasize that this may present late, even after pregnancy, and that long-term follow-up is essential after treatment of ovarian immature teratoma.

title: Mature ovarian dermoid cyst invading the urinary bladder.
title_ja: 膀胱に浸潤した成熟卵巣類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 膿尿と排尿痛を呈した30歳女性で、超音波検査により成熟卵巣類皮嚢腫の膀胱浸潤が明確に描出された。これまでの報告例は膀胱鏡検査または開腹術で診断されていた。画像診断により術前計画を立てやすくなり、粘膜温存型の部分膀胱切除が可能となった。
summary_en: A 30-year-old woman presented with pyuria and dysuria, and ultrasound clearly showed a mature ovarian dermoid cyst invading the urinary bladder. Previously reported cases of this rare complication were diagnosed only by cystoscopy or laparotomy. The clear imaging diagnosis allowed advance surgical planning and a mucosa-sparing partial bladder resection. The report highlights ultrasound as a useful tool for diagnosing this uncommon complication of ovarian dermoid cysts.

title: Early resection and reconstruction of head and neck masses in infants with upper airway obstruction.
title_ja: 上気道閉塞を伴う乳児の頭頸部腫瘤に対する早期切除と再建
summary_ja: 香港の施設で新生児期に気道閉塞を伴う頭頸部腫瘤4例(頸部奇形腫1、口腔内奇形腫2、神経膠異所性組織1)を生後3か月以内に切除した報告。局所皮弁と頭蓋骨移植で再建し、気管切開や長期挿管は不要で、経口摂取も早期に再開できた。新生児・乳児期の早期手術は安全に実施可能と結論づけている。
summary_en: This Hong Kong series describes four neonates or infants with obstructive head and neck masses, including one neck teratoma, two intraoral teratomas and one neuroglial heterotopia, treated with resection and reconstruction in the first three months of life. Local cervical cutaneous flaps and cranial bone grafts were used for reconstruction. None required tracheostomy or prolonged intubation, and oral feeding resumed early. The authors conclude that early surgery with locoregional flap and bone graft reconstruction can be performed safely in neonates and early infants.

title: Loss of heterozygosity of selected tumor suppressor genes in human testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における腫瘍抑制遺伝子のヘテロ接合性消失
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍38例（セミノーマ17例、非セミノーマ21例）で、腫瘍抑制遺伝子4種のヘテロ接合性消失を解析した研究。p53は非セミノーマ5例で欠失が認められた。共通の構造的遺伝子変化は見られなかったが、組織型によってLOHのパターンが異なり、両群で異なる発生経路が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined loss of heterozygosity (LOH) in CDH1, APC, p53, and nm23-H1 in 38 testicular germ cell tumors, comprising 17 seminomas and 21 nonseminomas. p53 allelic loss was found in five nonseminomas, while APC and CDH1 losses occurred in both histologic groups. No common structural alterations were identified across tumors. However, LOH patterns differed between seminomas and nonseminomas, suggesting distinct genetic pathways between the two main histologic subtypes.

title: Morphologic, immunohistochemical, and fluorescence in situ hybridization study of ovarian embryonal carcinoma with comparison to solid variant of yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣胎児性癌の形態学的・免疫組織化学的・蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションによる検討：充実型卵黄嚢腫瘍および未熟奇形腫との比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 卵巣胎児性癌の診断マーカーを、OCT4、CD30、SOX2、グリピカン3の免疫染色と12p蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションで検討した研究。誤診された4例は卵黄嚢腫瘍や未熟奇形腫に再分類された。複数の免疫染色と12p FISHの併用が、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断確定に有用と結論づけている。
summary_en: This study characterized ovarian embryonal carcinoma using immunohistochemistry (OCT4, CD30, SOX2, glypican 3) and 12p fluorescence in situ hybridization. Among six mixed germ cell tumors with embryonal carcinoma, OCT4 was positive in all, and chromosome 12p alterations occurred in five. Four cases originally diagnosed as embryonal carcinoma were reclassified as solid yolk sac tumor or immature teratoma. The authors conclude that a panel of stains combined with 12p FISH improves diagnostic accuracy in ovarian germ cell tumors.

title: Pure dysgerminoma of the ovary 35 years on: a single institutional experience.
title_ja: 卵巣の純粋ディスジャーミノーマ、35年後の検証：単一施設の経験
summary_ja: 1970年から2005年に治療された純粋卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）65例を後方視的に検討した研究。病期Iが大半で、再発は9.2%に認められたが全例が救済可能だった。妊孕性温存手術後も良好な妊娠転帰が得られ、長期予後は極めて良好であった。
summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study reviewed 65 women with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated between 1970 and 2005. Most patients had stage I disease, and recurrences occurred in 9.2%, all within 19 months. All recurrences were salvaged with radiotherapy, chemotherapy, or combined surgery and chemotherapy. Long-term outcome was excellent, and 12 live births occurred among women attempting conception after treatment. Fertility-sparing surgery was shown to allow good reproductive outcomes.

title: Primary retroperitoneal teratomas in children: a single institution experience.
title_ja: 小児の原発性後腹膜奇形腫：単一施設の経験
summary_ja: 1996年から2008年に治療された小児後腹膜奇形腫8例の単施設報告。大半は良性で、腎臓を温存した完全切除で治癒した。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う1例には術後化学療法が行われた。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は再発の評価に有用であった。
summary_en: This report describes eight children with primary retroperitoneal teratoma treated at a single institution between 1996 and 2008. Most tumors were benign, and complete surgical excision preserving the kidneys was curative in these cases. One tumor contained a yolk sac component requiring postoperative chemotherapy. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was useful for surveillance of recurrence. One inferior vena cava injury occurred during surgery and was repaired successfully.

title: Comparative proteomics of human embryonic stem cells and embryonal carcinoma cells.
title_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞と胎児性癌細胞の比較プロテオミクス
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: iTRAQ定量プロテオミクスにより、ヒト胚性幹細胞(ESC)と胎児性癌細胞(ECC)を比較した研究。約1800種のタンパク質を同定し、約200種が2倍以上の差を示した。ESCでは多能性関連因子が高く、ECCではCD99やCRABP2などが高発現していた。胎児性癌細胞の悪性形質に関わる候補タンパク質も示された。
summary_en: This study used iTRAQ quantitative proteomics to compare human embryonic stem cells with embryonal carcinoma cells, the stem cells of human teratocarcinoma. About 1800 proteins were identified, with nearly 200 differing more than twofold. ESCs expressed higher levels of pluripotency-associated markers, while ECCs showed higher levels of CD99, GDF3, and CRABP2. Several malignancy-associated proteins were enriched in ECCs. The study provides insight into differences between these closely related stem cell types.

title: Renal teratoma with duplication of cecum and appendix.
title_ja: 腎奇形腫に盲腸および虫垂の重複を伴った1例
summary_ja: 1か月齢男児の右腎由来の成熟型奇形腫の症例報告です。右側腹部の腫瘤として発見され、外科的切除により良好に回復しました。腫瘍内には独立した血流をもつ盲腸と虫垂が認められ、正常の腸管とは別に存在していました。腎奇形腫は極めて稀な疾患です。
summary_en: Case report of a 1-month-old boy with a mature teratoma arising from the right kidney, presenting as a right abdominal mass. The tumor was removed completely and recovery was uneventful. The mass contained a cecum and appendix with a blood supply separate from the normal bowel. Renal teratoma is extremely rare. The report highlights an extragonadal teratoma containing intestinal structures and the need to distinguish it from a duplicated bowel segment.

title: Infected primary retroperitoneal teratoma presenting as a subhepatic abscess in a postpartum woman.
title_ja: 産後女性に肝下面膿瘍として発症した感染性原発性後腹膜奇形腫
summary_ja: 産後の女性にみられた20cmの原発性後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告です。肝下面膿瘍と敗血症性ショックとして発症しました。腫瘍は周囲の臓器や血管と強く癒着していたため、まず緊急ドレナージで感染を制御し、その後に外科的切除を行う二期的手術を選択しました。
summary_en: Case report of a 20-cm primary retroperitoneal teratoma in a postpartum woman that presented as a subhepatic abscess with septic shock. The multilocular cystic tumor was densely adherent to adjacent viscera and vessels. Because of the complexity and her critical condition, surgeons used a two-stage approach: emergency drainage to control infection, then delayed resection of the tumor. The case shows how an infected teratoma can mimic a hepatic abscess.

title: Analysis of poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase-1 (PARP1) gene alteration in human germ cell tumor cell lines.
title_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株におけるPARP1遺伝子変化の解析
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株におけるPARP1遺伝子およびタンパク質の変化を解析した研究です。NEC8株では非ヘテロ接合性のE251K変異が見つかりました。日本人健常者95例はいずれも野生型で、M129Tは稀なSNPと考えられます。PARP-1量やポリADP-リボシル化は細胞株間で異なり、腫瘍発生や化学療法・放射線療法への反応に影響する可能性があります。
summary_en: Analysis of PARP1 gene and protein alterations in human germ cell tumor cell lines. Sequencing identified a nonheterozygous E251K substitution in cell line NEC8. All 95 healthy Japanese volunteers carried wild-type alleles at both M129T and E251K, suggesting M129T is a rare SNP. Both variants showed slightly reduced auto-poly(ADP-ribosyl)ation, though not significantly. PARP-1 and poly(ADP-ribosyl)ation levels varied among cell lines, possibly influencing tumor development and response to chemotherapy and radiotherapy.

title: Individual and seminal characteristics of patients with testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の個人特性と精液所見
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍と診断され、精子凍結保存のため紹介された男性100例を前向きに検討した研究です。診断時の平均年齢は26.9歳で、セミノーマが37例、停留精巣の既往が11例でした。セミノーマ症例は非セミノーマ症例より運動精子と正常形態精子が多く、多くの患者は診断時に自身の妊孕性を認識していませんでした。
summary_en: Prospective study of 100 consecutive men referred for sperm cryopreservation after a testicular tumor diagnosis. Mean age at diagnosis was 26.9 years; 37 had seminomatous tumors and 11 had a history of cryptorchidism. Men with seminoma had more motile and morphologically normal sperm than those with nonseminoma, although individual semen variables did not differ. Most patients were young, single, childless, and unaware of their fertility potential at diagnosis, underscoring the need for fertility counseling.

title: Malignant struma ovarii: a case report.
title_ja: 原発性悪性卵巣甲状腺腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 40歳女性の原発性悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告です。骨盤痛と大きな骨盤内腫瘤で受診し、術前の腫瘍マーカーは正常でした。子宮全摘術と右卵管卵巣摘出術が行われ、病理学的に悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断されました。再病期分類のため後腹膜リンパ節郭清などが行われ、18か月間再発はみられませんでした。
summary_en: Case report of a 40-year-old woman with primary malignant struma ovarii presenting with pelvic pain and a large pelvic mass. Preoperative tumor markers and biochemistry were normal. She underwent total abdominal hysterectomy with right salpingo-oophorectomy, and histology met criteria for malignant struma ovarii. Left salpingo-oophorectomy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy were performed for restaging, with no disease found. She declined thyroidectomy and remained disease-free for 18 months with thyroglobulin monitoring.

title: Comparison of low dose with standard dose abdominal/pelvic multidetector CT in patients with stage 1 testicular cancer under surveillance.
title_ja: 病期I精巣がんのサーベイランスにおける低線量と標準線量のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の比較
summary_ja: 病期I精巣がんでサーベイランス中の100例（セミノーマ79例、非セミノーマ21例）を対象に、低線量と標準線量の腹部・骨盤部マルチディテクタ型コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の画質を比較した研究です。標準線量画像はノイズと診断画質で有意に優れましたが、低線量画像の99%は診断に十分な品質でした。低線量プロトコルにより線量は約55%減少しました。
summary_en: Compared image quality of low-dose and standard-dose abdominal/pelvic multidetector CT in 100 patients with stage I testicular cancer on surveillance (79 seminoma, 21 nonseminoma). Standard-dose images scored significantly better for noise and diagnostic quality, but 99% of low-dose scans were diagnostically acceptable. The low-dose protocol reduced dose-length product by about 55%, supporting radiation reduction during long-term surveillance.

title: Primary mixed germ cell tumor of the liver with sarcomatous components.
title_ja: 肉腫成分を伴う原発性肝混合型胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 34歳男性の肝原発混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫の成分に加え肉腫成分を認め、血清AFPは上昇していた。両成分にi(12p)と12p過剰発現が見られ、肉腫成分は奇形腫内の間葉成分の脱分化または悪性転化に由来する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with a primary hepatic mixed germ cell tumor containing yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma components, along with significant sarcomatous elements and elevated serum AFP. Immunohistochemistry confirmed AFP positivity in the yolk sac component, and interphase cytogenetics showed i(12p) and 12p overrepresentation in the GCT components, including the rhabdomyoblastic areas. The authors suggest that the sarcomatous components may arise from dedifferentiation or malignant transformation of mesenchymal elements within the teratoma. Hepatic GCTs are extremely rare.

title: Malignant transformation within ovarian dermoid cysts: an audit of treatment received and patient outcomes. an Australia New Zealand gynaecological oncology group (ANZGOG) and gynaecologic cancer intergroup (GCIG) study.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫内の悪性転化:受けた治療と患者転帰の監査(ANZGOG/GCIG共同研究)
summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の悪性転化33例を10施設から集積した後方視的調査。大部分が最適な減量手術を受け、病期Iの4例は妊孕性温存手術で良好な結果を得た。病期Iの予後は良好だが、進行例は治療内容によらず不良であった。標準的な術後補助療法は確立されていない。
summary_en: This Australia-New Zealand/GCIG collaborative audit surveyed 33 patients from 10 centers with malignant transformation in an ovarian dermoid cyst, diagnosed 1979 to 2007. Most had optimal debulking surgery, and four stage I patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery with good outcomes. Chemotherapy, mostly platinum-based, was not routinely given and did not appear effective, while stage I patients fared well. Advanced disease had poor outcomes regardless of treatment. The authors conclude there is no standard adjuvant therapy.

title: Clinical analysis of 21 cases of nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌21例の臨床解析
summary_ja: 1985〜2008年に北京協和医院で治療された非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌21例の後方視的解析。標準的多剤併用化学療法と手術により16例が完全寛解し、5年全生存率は79.4%であった。初回治療前に正診されたのは3例のみで、早期診断の改善が課題とされた。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 21 patients with nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma treated at Peking Union Medical College Hospital from 1985 to 2008. Only 3 were correctly diagnosed before initial treatment. All received standard multidrug chemotherapy plus surgery, averaging 10 courses. Sixteen achieved complete remission, four partial remission, and one died. With median follow-up of 71.4 months, 5-year overall survival was 79.4%. The authors conclude prognosis is favorable with standard multidrug chemotherapy combined with surgery.

title: Gliomatosis peritonei of the scrotal sac associated with an immature gastric teratoma.
title_ja: 胃原発未熟奇形腫に関連した陰嚢部腹膜神経膠腫症
summary_ja: 未熟胃奇形腫の切除7か月後に両側陰嚢腫瘤を呈した男児乳児の症例報告である。外科的切除後の組織学的検査で腹膜神経膠腫症と診断された。成熟したグリア組織が腹膜腔に播種する病態で、胃奇形腫の切除後に陰嚢に現れるという珍しい経過が示された。
summary_en: This report describes a male infant who presented with bilateral scrotal masses seven months after excision of an immature gastric teratoma. Surgical excision of the scrotal lesions showed gliomatosis peritonei, a rare process in which mature glial tissue spreads through the peritoneal cavity. The authors describe this unusual presentation, arising from a rare primary immature gastric teratoma, and highlight that peritoneal glial implants may present in the scrotum after teratoma resection.

title: Management of a fetal intrapericardial teratoma: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 胎児心膜内奇形腫の管理:症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 双胎の一方の胎児に心膜内奇形腫が出生前診断された症例と文献レビュー。まれだが致死的となりうる病変で、出生前超音波検査で早期診断が可能である。出生前治療か新生児期の外科的管理かの判断が課題となる。心膜液貯留と胎児水腫への進行が治療方針の指針となる。
summary_en: This report describes a twin fetus diagnosed prenatally with an intrapericardial teratoma, along with a review of the literature. Intrapericardial teratomas are rare but potentially fatal, and prenatal ultrasound allows early diagnosis and planning. The key decision is whether to treat in utero or defer definitive surgery to the neonatal period. Pericardial effusion and progression to hydrops are the most common sequelae and generally guide management.

title: Thoraco-abdominal mature teratoma in a left diaphragmatic hernia.
title_ja: 横隔膜ヘルニアに合併した胸腹部成熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 左先天性横隔膜欠損孔を介して縦隔と後腹膜に連続して広がった成熟奇形腫の症例報告である。これまで報告のない組み合わせであり、横隔膜閉鎖前の原始胚細胞の頭側移動という発生学的経過を裏付けると考察している。
summary_en: The authors describe a patient with a contiguous mediastinal and retroperitoneal mature teratoma that passed through a left congenital diaphragmatic defect, a combination not previously reported. The case is presented as an example of the embryologic migration of primordial germ cells through the developing diaphragm before its closure. The report links the spread of the tumor across the thorax and abdomen to the timing of cephalad germ cell migration. It is a germ cell tumor case report with an unusual anatomic location.

title: Testicular and paratesticular pathology in children: a 12-year histopathological review.
title_ja: 小児の精巣および精巣傍組織の病理：12年間の病理組織学的レビュー
summary_ja: 一施設で12年間に得られた小児の精巣・精巣傍組織502検体の病理像を解析した。大多数は非腫瘍性病変であった。精巣腫瘍27例のうち55.6%が悪性で、主に卵黄嚢腫瘍であった。良性腫瘍は表皮嚢腫や奇形腫が多かった。精巣捻転や消失精巣は左側に多い傾向があった。
summary_en: This 12-year single-institution review analyzed histopathology of 502 testicular and paratesticular specimens from children. Most findings were non-neoplastic, including hydatid of Morgagni and vanishing testis. Among 27 testicular neoplasms, 55.6 percent were malignant, mainly yolk sac tumor. Benign neoplasms were most often epidermoid cysts and teratomas. Paratesticular neoplasms were rare, with rhabdomyosarcoma most common. Torsion, vanishing testis and atrophic testis showed left predominance.

title: Mediastinal germ cell tumors with an angiosarcomatous component: a report of 12 cases.
title_ja: 血管肉腫成分を伴う縦隔胚細胞腫瘍：12例の検討
summary_ja: 血管肉腫様成分を伴う縦隔胚細胞腫瘍12例を解析した。全例が男性で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往はなかった。奇形腫が最も多く、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍などが続いた。追跡できた10例は全例に転移または局所再発がみられ、7例が原病で死亡した。少量の血管肉腫様成分でも予後不良と関連した。
summary_en: This study reviewed 12 mediastinal germ cell tumors that contained an angiosarcomatous component, all in men with a mean age of 34. None had a documented testicular primary. Teratoma was the most common germ cell component, followed by seminoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma. The angiosarcomatous component ranged from 5 to 95 percent of the primary tumor. Among 10 patients with follow-up, all developed metastasis or local recurrence, and seven died of disease. Even a small angiosarcomatous component was associated with poor outcome.

title: Predictive values of hCG clearance for risk of methotrexate resistance in low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasias.
title_ja: 低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍におけるメトトレキサート抵抗性の予測因子としてのヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)クリアランス
summary_ja: 低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍154例を後方視的に解析し、メトトレキサート8日間療法中のhCG低下からhCGクリアランスを算出した。絨毛癌の組織型とクリアランス0.37L/日以下が、メトトレキサート抵抗性の独立した予測因子であった。早期のhCG動態から化学療法抵抗のリスクを評価できる可能性が示された。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 154 patients with low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated with an 8-day methotrexate regimen modeled serum hCG decline and calculated individual hCG clearance. A monoexponential model fit the data, and median clearance was 0.57 L/day. Choriocarcinoma histology and clearance at or below 0.37 L/day were independent predictors of methotrexate resistance. The authors suggest that early hCG kinetics could identify patients at high risk of chemoresistance and guide treatment decisions.

title: Mediastinal teratoma complicated with acute mediastinitis.
title_ja: 急性縦隔炎を合併した縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘍と診断された24歳女性が急性縦隔炎を発症した症例報告である。経過中のCTで奇形腫の穿孔に伴う急速に進行する縦隔炎が判明し、緊急手術で腫瘍摘出と縦隔ドレナージが行われた。病理は膵組織を含む成熟奇形腫であった。患者は合併症なく軽快退院した。縦隔奇形腫の合併症として縦隔炎はまれである。
summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with an anterior mediastinal mass who developed acute mediastinitis. Follow-up computed tomography showed rapidly progressing mediastinitis, attributed to perforation of the teratoma. She underwent emergency surgical extirpation and mediastinal drainage. Histology showed a mature teratoma containing pancreatic tissue, with acute inflammation spreading through the mediastinal fat. She recovered well and was discharged without major complications. Mediastinitis is a rare complication of mediastinal teratoma.

title: Hernia uterine inguinale and seminoma in persistent Müllerian duct syndrome.
title_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群に伴うセミノーマと子宮鼠径ヘルニア
summary_ja: 46,XY核型の41歳の表現型男性が左鼠径陰嚢部の腫瘤で受診した。切除標本でセミノーマと陰嚢内子宮が確認され、精巣摘除術、陰嚢子宮摘出術、放射線療法が行われた。1年間のフォローアップで再発はみられなかった。持続性ミュラー管症候群に子宮鼠径ヘルニアと精巣異所性を合併した稀な症例の報告である。
summary_en: A 41-year-old phenotypic man with a 46,XY karyotype presented with a left inguinoscrotal mass. Imaging showed two masses and no palpable right testis. Excision revealed seminoma and scrotal uterus, and the inguinal mass was uterine tissue. The patient underwent orchiectomy, scrotal hysterectomy and radiotherapy, and remained recurrence-free at one year. The authors highlight persistent Müllerian duct syndrome with hernia uterine inguinale and transverse testicular ectopia as a rare combination.

title: Clinical presentation and outcome of pediatric ovarian germ cell tumor: a study of 40 patients.
title_ja: 小児卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床像と転帰：40例の検討
summary_ja: インドのチェンナイで1990～2002年に治療された18歳未満の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍40例を後方視的に検討した。混合型胚細胞腫瘍とディスジャーミノーマが多く、62%が進行期で受診した。70%で妊孕性温存手術が可能であり、25%で再発がみられた。5年全生存率は94.9%である。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 40 patients under 18 years with ovarian germ cell tumors treated in Chennai, India (1990–2002) describes clinical presentation and outcome. Mixed germ cell tumor and dysgerminoma were the most common histologies, and 62 percent presented in advanced stage. Fertility-sparing surgery was possible in 70 percent and relapses occurred in 25 percent. The 5-year disease-free survival was 72.8 percent and overall survival 94.9 percent. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy was the mainstay of treatment.

title: Small incidentally discovered testicular masses in infertile men--is active surveillance the new standard of care?
title_ja: 不妊男性で偶発的に発見された小さな精巣腫瘤：積極的監視は新たな標準的管理か？
summary_ja: 不妊外来を受診した4,418例のうち、1cm未満の偶発的な低エコー性精巣病変を有する46例を対象に、連続超音波による監視を行った後方視的検討。多くの病変はわずかにしか増大せず、8例が手術を受け、経時的増大を示した1例に純粋セミノーマが認められた。大きいサイズと血管血流は介入と関連していた。著者らは、1cm未満の精巣腫瘤に対する超音波監視は直ちに切除することに代わる安全な方法であると結論づけている。
summary_en: A retrospective review of 46 men among 4,418 infertility patients with subcentimeter incidental hypoechoic testicular lesions managed with serial ultrasound. Most lesions grew minimally, 8 underwent surgery, and one pure seminoma was found after interval growth. Larger size and vascular flow predicted intervention. The authors conclude that ultrasound surveillance of testicular masses under 1 cm is a safe alternative to immediate excision.

title: The worst case: giant exulcerating seminoma.
title_ja: 最悪の症例：巨大な潰瘍を形成したセミノーマ
summary_ja: 36歳の男性が、弟がセミノーマで治療を受けてから10年後に、右精巣と両側鼠径部に及ぶ巨大な潰瘍形成性腫瘤で受診した。生検で純粋セミノーマと確認され、後腹膜および骨盤リンパ節に大きな転移が認められた。シスプラチン併用化学療法を7コース施行後、PETで右鼠径部に残存腫瘍が疑われたが、切除標本では生存腫瘍は認められなかった。術後8か月のフォローアップで病勢進行は認められなかった。
summary_en: A 36-year-old man presented with a giant exulcerating mass involving the right testis and both inguinal regions, ten years after his brother had been treated for seminoma. Biopsy confirmed pure seminoma with bulky retroperitoneal and pelvic lymph node metastases. After seven courses of cisplatin-based chemotherapy, PET suggested residual tumor in the right groin. Resection showed no viable tumor, and there was no progression at eight months of follow-up.

title: Immature teratoma of the vulva with an inguinal lymph node metastasis: report of a case and review of literature.
title_ja: 鼠径リンパ節転移を伴う外陰部未熟奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 外陰部に生じ鼠径リンパ節転移を伴った未熟奇形腫の症例報告です。外陰部腫瘍は稀で多くが上皮性であるのに対し、奇形腫は多くの性腺外部位から報告されています。外陰部未熟奇形腫と鼠径リンパ節転移の併発例は本例が唯一の報告とされています。
summary_en: This report describes an immature teratoma of the vulva with inguinal lymph node metastasis. The authors note that vulvar neoplasms are rare and most are epithelial, while teratomas have been reported at many extragonadal sites. The case is presented as the only reported instance of this combination, and a literature review accompanies it.

title: Lack of a y-chromosomal complement in the majority of gestational trophoblastic neoplasms.
title_ja: 多くの妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍ではY染色体成分が欠如している
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍51例で性染色体マーカーを解析し、Y染色体の有無を調べた研究です。Y染色体を持つ腫瘍は10%にとどまりました。多くの妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍は以前の胞状奇胎に由来すると結論づけています。
summary_en: This study examined 51 gestational trophoblastic neoplasm cases using sex chromosome markers to test whether about half should carry a Y chromosome. Only 10% of tumors contained a Y-chromosomal complement, including choriocarcinomas, PSTTs, and ETTs. The authors conclude that most GTNs likely arise from previous molar gestations rather than from a male conceptus.

title: GOLPH2 expression may serve as diagnostic marker in seminomas.
title_ja: GOLPH2の発現はセミノーマの診断マーカーとなりうる
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ69例を対象に、GOLPH2の免疫組織化学染色を行った。セミノーマの89.9%で過剰発現が認められ、正常精巣組織との差は統計学的に極めて有意であった。腫瘍の状態との関連はなく、精巣間質細胞腫瘍でも高発現していた。精巣腫瘍の新たな免疫組織化学マーカーとしての可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study assessed GOLPH2, a Golgi membrane protein, by immunohistochemistry in 69 testicular seminomas. GOLPH2 was overexpressed in 89.9% of seminomas, compared with weak or negative staining in matching normal testis, a difference that was highly significant. Expression did not correlate with tumor status. GOLPH2 was also expressed in Leydig cells and Leydig cell tumors. The authors propose GOLPH2 as a novel immunohistochemical marker for testicular neoplasms and suggest that serum GOLPH2 might help detect metastases or recurrence, which warrants study in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

title: Influence of suboptimal treatment in patients with mediastinal primary nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 縦隔原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における不十分な治療の影響
summary_ja: 縦隔原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者23例を後方視的に検討した。欧州のガイドラインに沿った十分な用量強度での一次化学療法を最適治療と定義し、その有無で予後を比較した。最適治療群では無増悪生存期間が有意に良好であった(ハザード比0.19、p=0.01)。全生存期間には有意差はなかったが、最適治療群で良好な傾向があった。ガイドラインに基づく治療の重要性が示された。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 23 patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor compared outcomes by treatment adequacy. Optimal treatment was defined as first-line chemotherapy with standard-dose bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin, or etoposide, ifosfamide and cisplatin, at sufficient dose intensity, per European guidelines. Ten patients received optimal treatment and thirteen suboptimal. Progression-free survival was significantly better with optimal treatment (hazard ratio 0.19, p=0.01). Overall survival favored optimal treatment but did not reach significance. The authors conclude that adherence to evidence-based guidelines is important for outcomes.

title: [Clinical features of patients with brain metastasis from testicular germ cell tumor].
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍からの脳転移患者の臨床的特徴
summary_ja: 1980〜2007年に治療された精巣または性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍190例を後方視的に検討し、脳転移は5例(2.6%)にみられた。5例中4例は脳転移発症後1年以内に死亡し、1例は47か月無病で生存した。この長期生存例は、イリノテカンとネダプラチンによる化学療法で腫瘍マーカーが正常化し、外科的切除で完全寛解が確認された。積極的な局所治療と新規薬剤が予後改善に寄与しうる。
summary_en: This Japanese retrospective review examined 190 patients with testicular or extragonadal germ cell tumors treated from 1980 to 2007, of whom five (2.6%) developed brain metastases. Most had stage III disease. Four of the five died within a year of brain metastasis, and one remained disease-free at 47 months. Treatments included multiple chemotherapy regimens, surgical resection, gamma knife and whole brain irradiation. The long-term survivor achieved complete remission after irinotecan and nedaplatin chemotherapy, confirmed by surgery. The authors conclude that outcomes are poor, but aggressive local therapy and novel agents may benefit selected patients.

title: FNA diagnosis of teratoma lung: A case report.
title_ja: 肺奇形腫の細胞診(FNA)による診断:症例報告
summary_ja: 27歳女性に生じた肺奇形腫の症例報告である。穿刺吸引細胞診で診断され、病理組織学的にも確認された。肺原発の奇形腫は稀で、報告例は限られている。性腺外の奇形腫の診断において細胞診が有用であった点が示されている。本例は、細胞診を含む病理診断の重要性を改めて示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with a teratoma of the lung diagnosed by fine-needle aspiration cytology and confirmed by histopathology. The authors note that teratoma at this pulmonary site is rare and that few cases have been reported. The case shows that cytology can establish the diagnosis of this extragonadal tumor. It adds to the small body of reported pulmonary teratomas and highlights the role of cytology in its diagnosis.

title: TI-CE high-dose chemotherapy for patients with previously treated germ cell tumors: results and prognostic factor analysis.
title_ja: 既治療の胚細胞腫瘍に対するTI-CE大量化学療法：治療成績と予後因子解析
summary_ja: 既治療で予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍107例に対するTI-CE大量化学療法の成績を報告。5年無病生存率は47%、全生存率は52%。縦隔原発、前治療2レジメン以上、hCG高値、肺転移が無病生存の不良因子だった。BeyerおよびEinhornモデルは予後予測に有用とされた。
summary_en: This report evaluates TI-CE high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell support in 107 patients with previously treated, poor-prognosis germ cell tumors. Five-year DFS was 47% and overall survival 52%. Primary mediastinal site, two or more prior therapy lines, baseline hCG of at least 1,000 U/L, and lung metastases predicted worse disease-free survival. Poor-risk patients by Beyer and Einhorn models fared worse, supporting their use in outcome prediction. TI-CE is considered effective salvage therapy for these patients.

title: Congenital giant cervical teratoma: pre- and postnatal imaging.
title_ja: 先天性巨大頸部奇形腫：出生前および出生後の画像所見
summary_ja: 胎児・新生児に生じた先天性頸部奇形腫の出生前および出生後の画像所見を報告する。胎児磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)により腫瘍の局在と性状を正確に評価でき、生命を脅かす出生前合併症の除外にも有用であった。得られた情報は分娩方法や出生後管理の決定に役立ち、転帰の改善につながったとされる。
summary_en: This report describes prenatal and postnatal imaging of a fetus or neonate with a congenital cervical teratoma. Fetal MRI was essential for localizing and characterizing the tumor and for excluding potentially life-threatening prenatal complications. The imaging information guided decisions about delivery and postnatal care, and the authors conclude that it improved outcome. The case highlights the value of prenatal imaging in planning management of this rare neck tumor.

title: Expectant management of ultrasonically diagnosed ovarian dermoid cysts: is it possible to predict outcome?
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の待機的管理：転帰を予測できるか
summary_ja: 超音波検査で診断された卵巣類皮嚢腫の待機的管理を受けた289例の後方視的研究。平均増大速度は年1.67mmで、増大を予測できる因子は認めなかった。約4分の1が手術に至り、若年、経産回数2回以上、両側性または大きな嚢腫で手術リスクが高かった。待機的管理は外科的管理の有効な代替手段と結論づけられる。
summary_en: This retrospective study followed 289 women with 323 ultrasonically diagnosed ovarian dermoid cysts who were managed expectantly, most for more than 3 months. Cysts grew slowly, at a mean of 1.67 mm per year, and no demographic or morphologic feature predicted growth. About a quarter of women eventually required surgery, with higher risk in younger women, women with two or more deliveries, and those with bilateral or larger cysts. The authors conclude that expectant management is a viable alternative to surgery.

title: RET gene mutations are not involved in the origin of human testicular seminoma.
title_ja: RET遺伝子変異はヒト精巣セミノーマの発生に関与しない
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ66例のパラフィン包埋組織を用い、RET遺伝子の頻度の高い変異エクソンを解析した研究。体細胞変異は認められず、多型頻度も対照集団と差がなかった。若年男性に生じる古典的セミノーマは、RETの変異や意味のある多型とは関連しないと結論づけている。
summary_en: Testicular seminoma is the most common testicular germ cell tumor in young men, and RET has been implicated in mouse models and some human cancers. The authors sequenced the most frequently mutated RET exons in 66 paraffin-embedded seminoma samples from a French hospital. No somatic mutations were found, and polymorphism frequencies matched those of a control Caucasian population. They conclude that classical seminoma in young men is not linked to RET mutations or relevant polymorphisms.

title: Massive fetomaternal hemorrhage caused by an intraplacental choriocarcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌による大量胎児母体間出血：症例報告
summary_ja: 正期産近くの重度貧血児の出生後に、胎盤内絨毛癌と診断された症例報告。胎児母体間出血により児のヘモグロビンは2.1g/dLまで低下した。母体・児ともに転移の所見はなかった。直径3cmの腫瘍が母体基底板に浸潤していた。胎児母体間出血が絨毛癌の初発症状となりうるため、胎盤・母体・児の詳細な検討が必要と述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes an intraplacental choriocarcinoma diagnosed after delivery of a severely anemic near-term infant. Fetomaternal hemorrhage reduced the infant's hemoglobin to only 2.1 g/dL. Neither mother nor child showed signs of metastatic disease. The placenta was hydropic and weighed over one kilogram, and microscopy showed a 3 cm tumor infiltrating the maternal basal plate. The authors emphasize that fetomaternal bleeding can be the presenting feature of choriocarcinoma and that placentas and infants warrant detailed examination.

title: Chronic constipation due to presacral teratoma in a 36-year-old woman: a case report.
title_ja: 36歳女性にみられた仙骨前奇形腫による慢性便秘：症例報告
summary_ja: 慢性便秘を主訴とした36歳女性の症例報告。画像検査で骨盤内の良性仙骨前腫瘤が見つかり、6cmの卵円形腫瘍を外科的に切除した。病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。術後2年で再発はなく、便秘も消失した。成人の仙尾部奇形腫は稀であり、直腸診と画像評価が早期診断に有用とされる。
summary_en: A 36-year-old woman with chronic constipation was found to have a benign presacral mass on imaging. Surgical removal of a 6 cm ovoid tumor revealed a mature cystic teratoma. Two years after surgery she was well, with no recurrence and resolution of her constipation. The authors note that sacrococcygeal teratomas are rare in adults and that a high index of suspicion, rectal examination, and radiologic evaluation are important for early diagnosis.

title: Clinical relevance of HER-2/neu overexpression in patients with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍におけるHER-2/neu過剰発現の臨床的意義
summary_ja: 2001〜2007年に単一施設で治療された精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍54例を後方視的に検討し、免疫組織化学によりHER-2/neuの過剰発現を評価した。過剰発現は33.3%に認められ、混合型胚細胞腫瘍や胎児性癌よりも奇形癌腫の亜型で多かった。HER-2/neuの状態は病期、治療反応、無病生存、年齢、β-hCG、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とは相関しなかった。
summary_en: This retrospective study examined HER-2/neu overexpression by immunohistochemistry in 54 patients with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated at a single center in Iran between 2001 and 2007. Overexpression was observed in 33.3% of cases, most frequently in the teratocarcinoma subtype compared with mixed germ cell tumor or embryonal carcinoma. HER-2/neu status showed no correlation with stage, treatment response, disease-free survival, age, beta-hCG, or AFP. The authors conclude that HER-2/neu overexpression is associated with the teratocarcinoma subtype and recommend further studies to assess its clinical importance.

title: Patterns of relapse after chemotherapy in patients with high-risk non-seminomatous germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 高リスク非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後の再発パターン
summary_ja: 高リスク胚細胞腫瘍の多施設共同試験患者645例を後方視的に解析し、化学療法後に部分寛解以上を得てから進行した138例の再発様式を検討した。再発は腫瘍マーカーの上昇のみで24%、画像上の進行のみで26%、両者で42%に認められた。約半数は3か月以内、97%は2年以内に再発した。再発様式は治療前の転移部位や治療ラインとは相関しなかった。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 645 patients with high-risk germ cell tumor from three multicenter trials examined relapse after chemotherapy in 138 patients who had achieved at least partial remission. Relapse was detected by tumor marker elevation alone in 24%, radiologic progression alone in 26%, and both in 42%. Nearly half relapsed within 3 months and 97% within 2 years. Relapse patterns did not correlate with prior marker status, metastasis location, or treatment line. The authors recommend close monitoring with serum markers, imaging, and clinical examination during the first two years.

title: Persistence and malignant sequelae of gestational trophoblastic disease: Clinical presentation, diagnosis, treatment and outcome.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の持続症と悪性続発症：臨床像、診断、治療および転帰
journal: Aust N Z J Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 30年間に登録された妊娠性絨毛性疾患705例のデータベースを解析し、持続症や悪性続発症を呈した97例の臨床像と治療を検討した。血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の連続測定が治療反応の最も有用な指標であり、5因子によるリスク分類は治療選択に有用であった。高リスク25例は多剤化学療法を受け、5年生存率は89.7%であった。
summary_en: This study analyzed a database of 705 gestational trophoblastic disease patients collected over 30 years, focusing on 97 who developed persistent disease or malignant sequelae. Most (80%) followed molar pregnancy, and 59.8% had no clinical symptoms. Serial hCG monitoring was the primary tool for assessing response, and 25 patients classified as high risk by five factors received multi-drug chemotherapy. Metastases were present in 21% of persistent cases, and two deaths occurred. The authors conclude that serial hCG remains the best marker of response, that five-factor risk categorization is useful, and that five-year survival was 89.7%.

title: A case of lumbar metastasis of choriocarcinoma masquerading as an extraosseous extension of vertebral hemangioma.
title_ja: 椎体血管腫の骨外進展を装った絨毛癌の腰椎転移の一例
summary_ja: 33歳女性の絨毛癌が肺・脳・腰椎に転移した稀な症例を報告する。肺病変は動静脈奇形と考えられ塞栓術を受けたが、その後の腰椎病変は椎体血管腫の骨外進展と誤認された。生検で絨毛癌と診断された。妊娠関連の絨毛癌が中枢神経系を含む多臓器へ転移しうること、血管に富む脊椎転移の画像診断における鑑別の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: A 33-year-old woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma to the lung, brain, and lumbar spine presented after a cesarean section for intrauterine fetal death. The lung lesion was initially treated as an arteriovenous malformation and embolized, and the hypervascular lumbar lesion was mistaken for an extraosseous extension of vertebral hemangioma. Biopsy established the diagnosis of choriocarcinoma. The report highlights diagnostic pitfalls of hypervascular spinal metastases from gestational choriocarcinoma.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma and osteosarcoma arising from a dermoid cyst--a case report and review of literature.
title_ja: 類皮嚢腫から発生した扁平上皮癌および骨肉腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 55歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫から、扁平上皮癌と骨肉腫という二種類の悪性腫瘍が発生した稀な症例を報告する。両者は類皮嚢腫の奇形腫性環境を背景に生じたと考えられ、混合中胚葉性腫瘍やカルチノサルコーマとは異なる所見であった。広範な手術と化学療法を行ったが4か月以内に再発し、患者は敗血症と両側肺塞栓で死亡した。
summary_en: A 55-year-old woman developed poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma and high-grade osteosarcoma arising within an ovarian dermoid cyst. The authors propose that both malignancies developed in the teratomatous background of the benign dermoid rather than as a mixed mesodermal tumor or carcinosarcoma, since the cell types lacked well-demarcated boundaries. Despite extensive surgery with negative margins and combination chemotherapy, recurrence occurred within four months, and the patient died of septicemia and bilateral pulmonary emboli.

title: Multiple and bilateral dermoids: a case report.
title_ja: 多発性・両側性類皮嚢腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 27歳の未経産女性が6か月間の下腹部痛で受診し、両側の卵巣類皮嚢腫が認められた。腹腔鏡検査で左側に7個、右側に2個の嚢腫が確認され、いずれも被膜を損なわずに摘出し、モルセレーションで回収された。著者らは、卵巣類皮腫瘍の最大15%が両側性になりうるが、この程度の多発両側性嚢腫はまれであると述べている。1年間のフォローアップで再発や肉芽腫性腹膜炎は認められなかった。
summary_en: A 27-year-old nulliparous woman presented with six months of lower abdominal pain and was found to have bilateral ovarian dermoid cysts. Laparoscopy revealed seven cysts on the left and two on the right, all of which were enucleated and retrieved by morcellation. The authors note that ovarian dermoids can be bilateral in up to 15% of cases, but multiple bilateral cysts of this extent are rare. At one-year follow-up there was no recurrence or granulomatous peritonitis.

title: Familial testicular germ cell tumors in adults: 2010 summary of genetic risk factors and clinical phenotype.
title_ja: 成人の家族性精巣胚細胞腫瘍：遺伝的危険因子と臨床像に関する2010年のまとめ
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の家族性発症について、遺伝学的危険因子と臨床像を2010年時点でまとめた総説。家族歴は約1.4%で、息子や兄弟のリスクは数倍から十倍程度。高浸透度の感受性遺伝子は未同定で、複数の低リスク多型が関与すると考えられる。両側性が多く、精巣微小石灰化も新たな構成要素として注目されている。
summary_en: This review summarizes the genetics and clinical features of familial testicular germ cell tumors. About 1.4% of TGCT patients report a family history, and sons and siblings have several- to tenfold increased risk. Inheritance appears autosomal recessive, with multiple modest-risk loci and no high-penetrance gene identified. Familial cases are diagnosed 2-3 years earlier, are more often bilateral, and have a seminoma-to-nonseminoma ratio of 1.0. Testicular microlithiasis is a newly recognized component of the syndrome.

title: Histology-specific risks in testicular cancer in immigrants to Sweden.
title_ja: スウェーデンへの移民における組織型別の精巣がんリスク
summary_ja: スウェーデンの家族がん登録を用い、移民の息子における精巣がんの発生率を在来スウェーデン人と比較した研究。出身国により危険度は異なり、セミノーマで最も一貫した変化が見られた。胎内期以後の早期環境要因が関与し、非セミノーマより持続的にセミノーマのリスクに影響する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Using the Swedish Family-Cancer Database, the authors calculated standardized incidence ratios for testicular cancer in sons of immigrants to Sweden, compared with native Swedes. Risk varied by parental origin: some Finnish and Asian groups had decreased risk when sons were born outside Sweden, and sons of Danish immigrants had increased risk. The most consistent changes were seen for seminoma. The findings suggest early-life environmental factors act after the intrauterine period, influencing seminoma risk more persistently than non-seminoma.

title: Outcome analysis of patients with transformed teratoma to primitive neuroectodermal tumor.
title_ja: 奇形腫から原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍へ転化した症例の転帰解析
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍から原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍(PNET)へ転化した81例の解析。多くは原発巣または初発転移で見られ、後腹膜病変も多かった。化学療法後の残存病変切除やCAV/IE療法の効果を評価した。全体として予後不良であり、低腫瘍量では手術が最適な初期治療と考えられた。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 81 patients examines germ cell tumors that transformed into primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET). Most PNET arose in primary tumors or initial metastases, and retroperitoneal disease was common. Standard germ cell chemotherapy and CAV/IE were evaluated, along with postchemotherapy resection of residual PNET. Overall outcomes were poor, although surgery appears optimal for low-volume disease and CAV/IE may help unresectable cases.

title: Nephrotic syndrome associated with invasive mole: a case report.
title_ja: 侵入奇胎に伴うネフローゼ症候群：症例報告
summary_ja: 侵入奇胎に伴うネフローゼ症候群を呈した症例報告。既報の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍例では膜性糸球体腎炎が報告されていたが、本例の病理所見は微小変化型であった。侵入奇胎の摘出後、ネフローゼ症候群は完全寛解した。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に関連した傍腫瘍性の腎障害が示唆された。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with an invasive mole and nephrotic syndrome. Two previously reported GTN cases showed membranous glomerulonephritis, but histology here showed minimal change disease instead. Nephrotic syndrome completely remitted after removal of the invasive mole. The authors conclude that the renal disease was associated with the gestational trophoblastic tumor and resolved with its treatment, suggesting a paraneoplastic link in GTN.

title: The total number of retroperitoneal lymph nodes resected impacts clinical outcome after chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清で切除されたリンパ節総数は、臨床転帰に影響する
summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対し化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた628例を、前向き外科データベースから解析した。切除リンパ節数が少ないほど再発リスクが高く、10個では2年無再発率が90%、50個では97%と推定された。切除の完全性と病理評価の丁寧さの重要性を示す研究である。
summary_en: In 628 patients with fibrosis or teratoma after postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic testicular cancer, a Cox model examined the total number of nodes removed and recurrence. Median nodes resected was 25. Higher postchemotherapy nodal size and fewer nodes removed predicted recurrence. Predicted 2-year relapse-free probability was 90% with 10 nodes removed versus 97% with 50, suggesting that the completeness of resection and pathologic assessment matter.

title: Surgical management of intrapericardial teratoma in the fetus.
title_ja: 胎児心膜内奇形腫の外科的管理
summary_ja: 胎児の心膜内に発生した大きな奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘤が心臓と肺を圧迫し、心タンポナーデを起こす危険があった。出生前に心嚢穿刺を行い、その後外科的切除で治療した。胎児期に診断された場合は生命を脅かすため、迅速な対応が必要であることを示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a large fetal intrapericardial teratoma that compressed the heart and lungs and threatened cardiac tamponade. It was managed with prenatal pericardiocentesis followed by surgical resection. The report underscores that such lesions are life-threatening when diagnosed in utero and require expeditious intervention, illustrating a staged approach of prenatal drainage and postnatal surgery.

title: A dermoid cyst of the round ligament clinically misdiagnosed as incarcerated inguinal hernia.
title_ja: 鼠径ヘルニアの嵌頓と誤診された円索の類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 円索に発生した類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)の症例報告である。術前には鼠径ヘルニアの嵌頓と誤診された。MRIで診断が示唆され、病理組織学的に確定した。成熟奇形腫は主に性腺に生じるため、円索発生はまれである。鼠径管内の腫瘤は術中の予期せぬ事態を防ぐため、術前に慎重な評価が必要であると述べている。
summary_en: A dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) arising in the round ligament was initially misdiagnosed as an incarcerated inguinal hernia. MRI findings supported the diagnosis, and histopathology confirmed it. Although mature teratomas typically arise in the gonads, such extragonadal locations are rare. The authors emphasize that inguinal canal masses should be carefully evaluated before surgery to avoid intraoperative surprises.

title: Mixed germ cell tumor metastatic to the skin: case report and literature review.
title_ja: 皮膚に転移した混合型胚細胞腫瘍:症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 19歳男性が頭皮と上腹部の皮膚転移を初発症状として精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。根治的精巣摘除術とシスプラチン併用化学療法4コース後、皮膚病変は完全に消退し、肺転移は不変であった。皮膚転移は稀で予後不良と関連するが、進行期では同療法が部分奏効に有効であることを示す症例報告である。
summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with scalp and upper abdominal skin metastases and was diagnosed with testicular mixed germ cell tumor. After radical orchiectomy and four courses of cisplatin-based chemotherapy, the skin lesions regressed completely, while lung metastases remained unchanged. Skin metastasis from testicular cancer is rare and associated with poor prognosis. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based chemotherapy remains effective for achieving partial response in advanced disease.

title: Malignant germ cell tumors display common microRNA profiles resulting in global changes in expression of messenger RNA targets.
title_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍は共通のマイクロRNAプロファイルを示し、メッセンジャーRNA標的の発現に広範な変化をもたらす
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 本研究では、小児の悪性胚細胞腫瘍、対照、胚細胞腫瘍細胞株で615種のマイクロRNAを解析し、成人の性腺データも再解析した。miR-371-373およびmiR-302クラスターは、組織型、部位、年齢にかかわらず一貫して過剰発現していた。そのシード相補的なヘキサマーGCACTTは、ダウンレギュレーションされたmRNAの3'UTRに濃縮されており、これらのクラスターががん関連経路の協調的な抑制に関与することが示された。この結果は、これらのmiRNAクラスターが悪性胚細胞腫瘍に共通する生物学的特徴であることを示唆している。
summary_en: This study profiled 615 microRNAs in pediatric malignant germ cell tumors, controls, and germ cell tumor cell lines, and reanalyzed adult gonadal data. The miR-371-373 and miR-302 clusters were consistently overexpressed regardless of histology, site, or age. The seed-complementary hexamer GCACTT was enriched in the 3' UTRs of downregulated mRNAs, linking these clusters to coordinated suppression of cancer-associated pathways. The findings suggest these miRNA clusters are a common biological feature of malignant germ cell tumors.

title: Acute behavioural change in a young woman evolving towards cerebellar syndrome.
title_ja: 右卵巣奇形腫に関連した抗NMDA受容体脳炎に続発し、小脳症候群へ進展した急性行動変化
summary_ja: 若年女性が急性せん妄と準昏睡状態を交互に呈して発症し、MRIとPETは正常だったが髄液で細胞数増多を認めた。抗NMDA受容体抗体が検出され、右卵巣奇形腫を摘出した。残存症状として稀な小脳症候群を呈し、NMDA受容体を介した小脳機能障害の機序が考察されている。
summary_en: A young woman presented with acute delirium alternating with sub-comatose states. MRI and PET were normal, but lumbar puncture showed lymphocytic pleiocytosis. Antibodies against NMDA receptors were detected, and a right ovarian teratoma was found and removed. Despite treatment, she developed a cerebellar syndrome rarely described in such cases. The authors propose that these antibodies impair glutamate NMDA receptor function, which cerebellar and cortical neurons share, as the mechanism of the cerebellar dysfunction.

title: Primitive neuroectodermal tumors in patients with testicular germ cell tumors usually resemble pediatric-type central nervous system embryonal neoplasms and lack chromosome 22 rearrangements.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に合併する原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍は、多くが中枢神経系PNETに類似し、染色体22再構成を欠く
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に合併したPNET 14例を形態・免疫組織化学・FISHで解析した。多くは中枢神経系PNETに類似し、CD57が最も一貫した神経内分泌マーカーであった。染色体22転座はほぼ認められず、末梢型PNETとは異なる。今後の治療戦略に示唆を与える。
summary_en: The authors analyzed 14 primitive neuroectodermal tumors (PNETs) from patients with concurrent or prior testicular germ cell tumors, 12 from metastatic sites and 2 primary in the testis. Most resembled central nervous system PNETs, such as medulloepithelioma and medulloblastoma-like tumors. CD57 was the most consistently reactive neuroendocrine marker. FISH analysis found chromosome 22 rearrangement in only one tumor, indicating these tumors generally lack the translocation seen in peripheral PNETs. The findings may inform future treatment strategies.

title: Good prognosis for primary ovarian pure nongestational choriocarcinoma using the EMA/CO regime.
title_ja: 卵巣原発純粋非妊娠性絨毛癌に対するEMA/CO療法による良好な予後
summary_ja: 卵巣原発の純粋非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告で、EMA/CO療法を施行し良好な経過を得た。非妊娠性絨毛癌は妊娠性絨毛癌より予後が不良とされる稀な胚細胞腫瘍である。臨床経過、治療、転帰が検討されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with primary ovarian pure nongestational choriocarcinoma, a rare germ cell tumor with a worse prognosis than gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors treated the patient with the EMA/CO regimen and report a good outcome. The clinical features, management, and outcome are discussed. The report highlights the effectiveness of this chemotherapy regimen for this rare tumor.

title: MicroRNA-34a suppresses invasion through downregulation of Notch1 and Jagged1 in cervical carcinoma and choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: 子宮頸癌および絨毛癌細胞において、miR-34aはNotch1およびJagged1の発現抑制を介して浸潤を抑制する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoおよびJARを含む細胞株で、miR-34aが浸潤を抑制することを示した研究です。miR-34aはNotch1とJagged1を標的とし、Notchシグナルとウロキナーゼ型プラスミノゲン活性化因子を介して浸潤を抑えます。
summary_en: This study examined microRNA-34a (miR-34a) in cervical cancer cell lines and in trophoblast-derived choriocarcinoma lines (BeWo and JAR). Forced miR-34a expression did not change proliferation but suppressed invasion. The authors showed that miR-34a directly binds the 3' untranslated regions of Notch1 and Jagged1, reducing Notch signaling and urokinase plasminogen activator, a matrix-degrading enzyme. Notch1 knockdown and a gamma-secretase inhibitor produced similar anti-invasive effects. The findings suggest that miR-34a limits invasion via the Notch pathway in these cells.

title: Primary carcinoid tumors of the testis: a clinicopathologic study of 29 cases.
title_ja: 精巣の原発性カルチノイド腫瘍：29例の臨床病理学的研究
summary_ja: 7施設の原発性精巣カルチノイド腫瘍29例を検討した臨床病理学的研究。多くは純粋なカルチノイドであったが、嚢胞性奇形腫や表皮/類皮嚢腫を伴うものもあった。典型例の大半は良性の経過をたどり、フォローアップで再発や転移は認められなかった。異型カルチノイドの1例では後腹膜と肺に転移があり、切除標本で転移性卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌が確認され、血清AFPが高値のままであったため救援化学療法が予定された。異型組織像では転移をきたすことがあるため、長期的な慎重な経過観察が必要であると著者らは述べている。
summary_en: This clinicopathologic study reviewed 29 primary testicular carcinoid tumors from seven institutions. Most were pure carcinoids, while some coexisted with cystic teratoma or epidermoid/dermoid cysts. Most patients had typical lesions and a benign course, with no recurrence or metastasis at follow-up. One patient with an atypical carcinoid had retroperitoneal and lung metastases; resection revealed metastatic yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma, and serum AFP stayed elevated, prompting salvage chemotherapy. Atypical histology can occasionally be associated with metastatic spread, so careful long-term monitoring is warranted.

title: Subtype-specific risk of testicular tumors among immigrants and their descendants in Sweden, 1960 to 2007.
title_ja: 移民とその子孫におけるサブタイプ別の精巣腫瘍リスク（スウェーデン、1960～2007年）
summary_ja: スウェーデンの約360万人の男性コホートを用い、移民とその子孫の精巣がんリスクを解析しました。出生地のリスクが第一世代に反映され、第二世代はスウェーデン人男性のリスクに収束しました。セミノーマのリスクは移住年齢や居住期間によって修飾されました。
summary_en: This nationwide Swedish cohort of 3.6 million men aged 15 to 54 compared testicular cancer incidence among immigrants and their descendants with Swedish-born men from 1960 to 2007. First-generation immigrants from high-risk countries had higher risk (IRR 1.61), while those from low-risk countries had lower risk (IRR 0.43). Age at immigration and duration of residence modified seminoma risk among high-risk-origin immigrants. Second-generation risk converged toward the Swedish level. The authors conclude that lifestyle and environmental factors play an important role in testicular cancer etiology.

title: Tumor markers AFP, CA 125, and CA 19-9 in the long-term follow-up of sacrococcygeal teratomas in infancy and childhood.
title_ja: 乳児期および小児期の仙尾部奇形腫の長期フォローアップにおける腫瘍マーカーAFP、CA 125、CA 19-9
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の小児32例を1～15年間追跡し、AFP、CA 125、CA 19-9を連続測定しました。悪性再発の前にAFPの上昇が認められ、CA 125は成熟型および未熟型の再発で上昇しました。CA 125はAFPを補完する可能性があります。
summary_en: This study followed 32 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma for 1 to 15 years, analyzing serial serum AFP, CA 125, and CA 19-9 levels. Six neonatal cases developed eight recurrences. AFP was elevated before malignant recurrences, specifically yolk sac tumor and adenocarcinoma. CA 125 was elevated in a third of mature and a third of immature recurrences. CA 19-9 stayed within reference values in neonatal recurrences. The authors suggest CA 125 can complement AFP in long-term follow-up of sacrococcygeal teratoma.

title: The clinical advances of fluorine-2-D-deoxyglucose--positron emission tomography/computed tomography in urological cancers.
title_ja: 泌尿器がんにおけるFDG-陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)/コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の臨床的進歩
summary_ja: 泌尿器がんにおけるFDG-PET/CTの臨床的有用性を総説している。胚細胞腫瘍（セミノーマ・非セミノーマ）は糖代謝が亢進しFDG集積が高く、残存成熟奇形腫を除き生存腫瘍の評価に有用とされる。腎細胞がんや前立腺がんは集積が低い一方、代謝活性のある転移では従来のCTより高精度である。小さな肺病変は例外である。
summary_en: This review describes the clinical advances of FDG-PET/CT in urological cancers. Co-registered PET/CT has become a standard, although FDG uptake is generally low in renal cell and prostate cancers. Seminomatous and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors show high glucose metabolism, making FDG-PET/CT accurate for detecting viable tumor, except in residual mature teratoma. FDG-PET/CT outperforms conventional CT for metabolically active metastases but not for small lung lesions. Bladder cancer shows uptake, but renal excretion limits detection of primary tumors.

title: Primary ovarian neuroblastoma.
title_ja: 原発性卵巣神経芽腫
summary_ja: 17歳女性で成熟奇形腫を伴う原発性卵巣神経芽腫の症例を報告している。精査で病変の広がりはなく、N-myc増幅も認められなかった。局在性であることから外科的切除のみで治療し、3年間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。思春期の神経芽腫は多くが転移性であるため、本例の希少性と文献的考察が示されている。
summary_en: The authors report a 17-year-old woman with a primary ovarian neuroblastoma coexisting with a mature teratoma. Workup showed no disease extension, and N-myc amplification was absent. Given the localized disease, she underwent surgical resection without further systemic therapy and remained relapse-free during three years of follow-up. The paper reviews the literature on this rare entity, which tends to be metastatic when it occurs in adolescents.

title: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis associated with testicular cancer: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 精巣がんに関連した副腫瘍性皮膚筋炎：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: セミノーマを伴う精巣腫瘍に対して片側精巣摘除術を受けた37歳男性の副腫瘍性皮膚筋炎の症例である。術後に皮疹と近位筋力低下、クレアチンキナーゼ上昇が進行し、筋電図と皮膚生検で皮膚筋炎と診断された。ステロイドとアザチオプリンにより皮膚・筋症状は改善した。若年者の皮膚筋炎では悪性腫瘍のスクリーニングが重要であると強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man with paraneoplastic dermatomyositis associated with a testicular seminoma treated by unilateral orchiectomy. The skin rash worsened after surgery, followed by proximal muscle weakness and elevated creatine kinase. Electromyography and skin biopsy confirmed dermatomyositis. Moderate corticosteroids and a short course of azathioprine improved skin and muscle symptoms. The authors emphasize screening for neoplasm in young patients with dermatomyositis.

title: Endothelial nitric oxide synthase expression in gestational trophoblastic diseases.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における内皮型一酸化窒素合成酵素の発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の組織で内皮型一酸化窒素合成酵素（eNOS）の発現を、妊娠初期胎盤と比較した。GTDでは合胞体栄養膜細胞、絨毛、増殖性単核栄養膜細胞で強～極めて強い発現を示し、正常胎盤より高かった。eNOS発現は栄養膜細胞の増殖と相関すると結論している。
summary_en: This study compares endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) expression in gestational trophoblastic diseases with first-trimester placentas. Specimens included partial and complete hydatidiform moles, invasive moles, and choriocarcinomas. GTD showed strong to very strong eNOS expression in syncytiotrophoblast, villi, and proliferating mononuclear trophoblasts, exceeding the moderate expression in normal placentas. The authors conclude that eNOS expression correlates with trophoblastic proliferation in both GTD and normal pregnancy.

title: Recent strategy for the management of advanced testicular cancer.
title_ja: 進行精巣がんに対する治療戦略の最近の動向
summary_ja: シスプラチンの導入以降、精巣がんの治癒率は高まったが、初回治療で不完全奏効の症例や再発例の予後は不良である。本総説は進行精巣がんの最近の治療戦略を概説し、BEP療法を標準導入療法、TIP療法を二次治療として位置づけている。救援化学療法や大量化学療法の有用性、新規薬剤の併用も検討する。残存腫瘍切除と後腹膜リンパ節郭清は、治癒に依然として重要とされる。
summary_en: This review covers recent strategies for advanced testicular cancer, which is highly curable after cisplatin-based therapy but has a poor prognosis in patients with incomplete response or relapse. It discusses BEP as standard induction therapy, ifosfamide-containing salvage chemotherapy, and high-dose chemotherapy, which failed to show superiority in a randomized trial. It highlights paclitaxel- and irinotecan-based combinations for cisplatin-refractory disease and TIP as second-line therapy after BEP failure. Residual tumor resection with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection remains important because viable cancer or teratoma cannot be reliably predicted.

title: Visceral abdominal obesity--is there an increased prevalence in men presenting with testicular teratoma?
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫の男性では内臓脂肪の割合が高いか
summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫の男性22例と、年齢・性別・BMIをそろえた対照22例で、臍部CT画像上の内臓脂肪と皮下脂肪の比を比較した研究である。奇形腫患者の比は対照の1.56倍で、統計学的に有意であった。内臓脂肪の蓄積が精巣奇形腫と関連する可能性が示唆されたが、小規模な単施設研究であり因果関係は不明である。
summary_en: This case-control study compared abdominal adipose tissue distribution on a single CT slice at the umbilicus in 22 men with testicular teratoma and 22 age-, sex-, and BMI-matched controls. The ratio of visceral to subcutaneous fat was 1.56 times higher in teratoma patients than in controls, a statistically significant difference. The authors suggest that patients with testicular teratoma have relatively more visceral adiposity, consistent with findings in other malignancies. The study is small and single-center, and it does not establish causality.

title: Testicular germ cell tumor composed of placental site trophoblastic tumor and teratoma.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と奇形腫から構成される精巣胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 24歳男性の精巣腫瘍で、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と奇形腫が混在する症例を報告する。術前のβ-hCGは高値、AFPは正常であった。FISHで12番染色体短腕の増加が確認され、トロホブラスト成分が胚細胞由来であることが示された。術後3年時点で無治療のまま生存している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with a right testicular tumor composed of placental site trophoblastic tumor and teratoma, a combination not previously published. Serum beta-hCG was elevated while AFP was normal. Immunohistochemistry and FISH showing a gain on chromosome 12 short arm supported a germ cell origin of the trophoblastic component. Adjacent tubules contained intratubular germ cell neoplasia. The patient remained alive and well three years after orchiectomy without further treatment.

title: False elevation of human chorionic gonadotropin in a patient with testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の偽高値
summary_ja: HIV陽性の44歳男性で、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(病期1)に根治的精巣摘除術を受けた。術後のhCG高値から播種性と誤診され、化学療法を受けた。原因はhCG免疫測定におけるヘテロフィル抗体による偽高値であり、ブロッキング剤で否定された。救援療法は不要で、完全寛解を維持している。
summary_en: A 44-year-old HIV-positive man with stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after radical orchiectomy had persistently elevated hCG, which led to a misdiagnosis of disseminated disease. He received four cycles of etoposide and cisplatin. Postchemotherapy CT showed no metastatic disease, yet hCG remained elevated. The cause was heterophile antibody interference in the immunoassay, confirmed when a blocking agent eliminated detectable hCG. No salvage therapy was needed, and the patient remains in complete remission.

title: SCF and c-kit expression profiles in male individuals with normal and impaired spermatogenesis.
title_ja: 正常および異常な精子形成を示す男性におけるSCFとc-kitの発現プロファイル
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 正常精子形成、無精子症、精巣腫瘍(大部分はセミノーマ)の男性から採取した組織で、SCFとc-kitの発現をリアルタイムRT-PCRにより比較した研究である。精巣腫瘍でc-kitの発現が最も高く、セミノーマの発生との関連が示唆された。ライディッヒ細胞もc-kit転写産物の供給源となる可能性がある。
summary_en: This study measured SCF and c-kit transcript levels by real-time RT-PCR in testicular fractions from men with normal spermatogenesis, azoospermia, and testicular neoplasms, mostly seminomas. c-kit was expressed more highly than SCF across groups and was significantly highest in testicular tumours, suggesting that c-kit overexpression is associated with seminoma development. Sertoli cell only syndrome showed comparable SCF and c-kit levels, pointing to Leydig cells as a possible additional c-kit source. The authors conclude that c-kit is dynamic across testicular pathologies.

title: Neuroblastoma arising from an unresected sacrococcygeal teratoma in a child.
title_ja: 未切除の仙尾部奇形腫から発生した小児の神経芽腫
summary_ja: 未切除の仙尾部奇形腫が神経芽腫へ悪性転化した6歳女児の症例報告である。胚細胞腫瘍の悪性転化は稀であり、文献的考察が加えられている。完全切除が転化予防に必要であり、転化時は手術と組織型に応じた全身化学療法を組み合わせるべきと結論している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 6-year-old girl whose unresected sacrococcygeal teratoma underwent malignant transformation into neuroblastoma. The authors review the literature on malignant transformation of germ cell tumors, a rare entity. The case shows that complete resection of germ cell tumors is necessary to prevent transformation. When malignant transformation occurs, treatment should combine surgery with histology-adapted systemic chemotherapy.

title: [Result of treatment for advanced germ cell tumor in the last decade].
title_ja: 過去10年間の進行胚細胞腫瘍の治療成績
summary_ja: 2010年の報告で、埼玉県がんセンターにおける1997～2007年の進行男性胚細胞腫瘍51例を後方視的に解析した。IGCCC分類別の5年生存率は良好群100%、中間群74%、不良群76%。初回化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーの低下が不良だった症例は全生存期間が有意に低かった（71%対94%）。早期の二次化学療法と腫瘍マーカー動態による層別化が生存率向上に寄与した可能性が示された。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 51 men with advanced germ cell tumors treated at Saitama Cancer Center (1997-2007) assessed outcomes by IGCCC risk group. Five-year survival was 100%, 74%, and 76% for good-, intermediate-, and poor-risk patients. Patients with unsatisfactory tumor marker decline after two chemotherapy cycles, mainly due to hCG, had significantly worse five-year overall survival (71% vs 94%). Earlier second-line chemotherapy and marker kinetics appeared to improve outcomes, and unfavorable marker decline remains a key challenge.

title: [Case of far-advanced retroperitoneal extra-gonadal germ cell tumor responding to intensive treatment including multi-drug chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation and residual tumor removal].
title_ja: 末梢血幹細胞移植併用多剤化学療法と残存腫瘍切除を含む集中治療が奏効した、高度進行後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例
summary_ja: 37歳男性の後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。肺や鎖骨上窩・腋窩リンパ節への転移を伴い、AFP、hCG、LDHが著明に上昇していた。BEP 3コース後、TIPと末梢血幹細胞移植を併用し、腫瘍マーカーは正常化した。残存腫瘍を外科的切除し、組織学的に生存腫瘍細胞は認めず、24か月間無病で経過している。
summary_en: A 37-year-old man presented with lumbago and fever and was found to have a huge retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor with pulmonary, supraclavicular, and axillary lymph node involvement, with markedly elevated AFP, hCG, and LDH. The testes were normal. He received three cycles of BEP with partial response, followed by TIP with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation, achieving marker normalization. Residual masses were resected, with no viable tumor found histologically, and he remained disease-free for 24 months.

title: [Case report: simultaneous bilateral testicular tumors with different cell types].
title_ja: 異なる組織型を併存した同時性両側精巣腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 29歳男性の両側精巣腫瘍の症例報告。両側精巣摘除を行い、右側はセミノーマと未熟奇形腫、左側はセミノーマであった。肺転移と傍大静脈リンパ節転移に対しBEP療法を施行し、肺病変は消失した。PET-CTでFDG集積を認めなくなった残存リンパ節を後腹膜リンパ節郭清で切除し、生存腫瘍細胞は認めず、10か月間再発なく経過した。
summary_en: A 29-year-old man presented with bilateral testicular tumors and underwent bilateral high orchiectomy after sperm cryopreservation. Histology showed seminoma with immature teratoma on the right and seminoma on the left. After lung metastases developed, he received BEP chemotherapy; lung lesions resolved, but a residual peri-caval lymph node remained and was resected after PET-CT showed no FDG uptake. No viable tumor was found, and he remained disease-free at 10 months under androgen replacement.

title: Limitations in the diagnosis of childhood teratoid lesions on fine needle aspiration cytology.
title_ja: 小児の奇形腫様病変における穿刺吸引細胞診の診断上の限界
summary_ja: 小児の奇形腫・奇形腫様病変11例について、術前の穿刺吸引細胞診所見を検討した。扁平上皮細胞が奇形腫診断の主な所見であり、神経外胚葉成分や中胚葉成分も認められた。未熟間葉成分が2例で認められた。細胞診による診断には臨床・画像情報が不可欠であり、神経芽細胞腫やWilms腫瘍などとの鑑別が重要と結論された。
summary_en: This cytology study reviewed 11 childhood teratoma/teratoid lesions that had prior fine needle aspiration, in patients aged 3 months to 12 years. Clinicoradiologic diagnoses had included neuroblastoma, Wilms tumor, and teratoma. Squamous cells were the main finding in teratomas, with neuroectodermal and mesodermal elements also present, and immature mesenchymal fragments appeared in two cases. The authors conclude that clinical and radiologic information is essential for accurate cytologic diagnosis.

title: Gastrointestinal bleeding caused by ileal metastasis of a tubal complete mole: a case report.
title_ja: 卵管完全胞状奇胎の回腸転移による消化管出血：症例報告
summary_ja: 33歳女性の卵管完全胞状奇胎の症例報告。腹腔鏡下左卵管切除の1か月後、回腸転移による消化管出血を来した。小腸切除吻合後、メトトレキサートによる術後補助化学療法を9コース施行し、20か月再発なく経過した。異所性胞状奇胎の消化管転移は穿孔や大量出血の危険があると指摘されている。
summary_en: A 33-year-old woman with a tubal complete hydatidiform mole developed gastrointestinal bleeding from an ileal metastasis one month after laparoscopic left salpingectomy. She underwent small bowel resection with anastomosis and received nine cycles of adjuvant methotrexate. She remained free of recurrence 20 months later. The authors report the first case of a Fallopian tube molar pregnancy with ileal metastasis and highlight the risk of perforation and bleeding in ectopic molar pregnancy.

title: Paternity and testicular function among testicular cancer survivors treated with two to four cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy.
title_ja: 精巣がん生存者における、シスプラチン併用化学療法2～4コース後の父親となる可能性と精巣機能
summary_ja: 単側精巣がんに対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を2～4コース受けた316例の生存者を対象とした全国多施設調査。妊娠を試みた106例の80%が治療後に父親となり、コース数が少ないほど成功率は高かった（2コース100%、4コース76%）。FSHはコース数とともに上昇したが、精子数やテストステロンに差はなかった。
summary_en: This national multicentre survey of 316 men treated for unilateral testicular cancer with two to four cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy assessed paternity and gonadal function. Among 106 men attempting conception, 80% achieved paternity at a median 12-year follow-up. Paternity rates decreased with more chemotherapy cycles (100% with two, 76% with four), and follicle-stimulating hormone was higher with more cycles. Testosterone, luteinising hormone, and sperm counts did not differ significantly.

title: The association of CCND1 overexpression and cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumors and other cancers.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍およびその他のがんにおけるCCND1過剰発現とシスプラチン耐性の関連
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の親株と耐性株の3ペアを用いた発現マイクロアレイ解析で、CCND1が最も差のある遺伝子として同定された。臨床検体でもCCND1発現は耐性例で有意に高値だった。卵巣がんや前立腺がんでも過剰発現が認められた。CCND1のsiRNAによる抑制とシスプラチン併用は、単独よりも細胞増殖を有意に抑制した。
summary_en: This study examined cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumors by comparing three pairs of parental and resistant cell lines using expression microarrays. CCND1 was the most differentially expressed gene, and its expression was significantly higher in clinically resistant testicular tumors. CCND1 was also overexpressed in ovarian and prostate cancers. Combined CCND1 knockdown and cisplatin more effectively suppressed tumor cell growth in vitro, suggesting CCND1 as a potential stratification marker and therapeutic target.

title: TCL1 protein expression in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるTCL1タンパク発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍63例を対象に、TCL1タンパクの発現を免疫組織化学で検討した。セミノーマとIGCNUの大部分で陽性、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では陰性であった。TCL1はIGCNUやセミノーマの診断補助、およびセミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別に有用である可能性が示された。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined TCL1 protein expression across 63 testicular germ cell tumors, including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, teratomas, yolk sac tumors, and mixed germ cell tumors, plus intratubular germ cell neoplasia (IGCNU). TCL1 was detected in most seminomas and all IGCNU cases but not in nonseminomatous tumors. The findings suggest TCL1 is associated with an undifferentiated state and may help confirm IGCNU or seminoma and distinguish seminoma from nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

title: Rare case of perplexing ovarian endometriosis.
title_ja: 卵巣子宮内膜症の珍しい1例
summary_ja: 30歳未経妊女性で、同一右卵巣に子宮内膜症、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、粘液性嚢胞腺腫が共存した。片側卵巣摘出術と病期分類のための開腹術が行われた。文献上3例目とされ、単一臓器内の複合病変の診断と手術の難しさを示す。
summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old nulligravida woman with coexisting endometriosis and mature cystic teratoma in the same right ovary, along with a mucinous cystadenoma. Management involved unilateral oophorectomy and staging laparotomy. The authors note this is only the third such case reported in the literature, highlighting the diagnostic and surgical challenges of multiple pathologies within one ovary.

title: Increased expression of urokinase plasminogen activator and its cognate receptor in human seminomas.
title_ja: ヒトセミノーマにおけるウロキナーゼ型プラスミノーゲン活性化因子およびその受容体の発現増加
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: セミノーマにおけるウロキナーゼ型プラスミノーゲン活性化系の発現を正常精巣と比較した。腫瘍ではuPAとuPARが増加し、PAI-2は減少していた。PAI-1のmRNA量は腫瘍サイズと相関した。uPAとuPARの増加が精巣がんの進展に関与する可能性が示唆される。
summary_en: This study characterized the urokinase plasminogen activating system in human seminomas compared with normal testis. Quantitative RT-PCR, Western blot, zymography, and immunohistochemistry showed increased uPA and uPAR expression in tumors, while PAI-2 was reduced. Tumor size correlated with PAI-1 mRNA levels. The findings suggest that elevated uPA and uPAR may contribute to testicular cancer progression.

title: Natural history of biologically malignant struma ovarii: analysis of 27 cases with extraovarian spread.
title_ja: 生物学的悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の自然経過：腹膜外進展を伴う27例の解析
summary_ja: 腹膜外転移を伴う悪性卵巣甲状腺腫27例の自然経過を検討した。癒着、1L以上の腹水、漿膜損傷、10cm以上の腫瘍径、広範な乳頭癌成分が予後不良因子であった。経過は緩徐で、37%が原病死した。再発は術後2か月から29年の間に生じたため、長期フォローアップが推奨される。
summary_en: This study describes the natural history of 27 cases of biologically malignant struma ovarii with extraovarian spread. Adverse predictors included adhesions, ascites of at least 1 L, serosal rupture, tumor size of 10 cm or more, and extensive papillary carcinoma. Clinical course was protracted; 37% died of disease. Recurrence occurred from 2 months to 29 years after surgery, so long-term follow-up is recommended.

title: Ovarian yolk sac tumor associated with major fibrosarcoma component in a 13-year-old girl.
title_ja: 13歳女児の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に線維肉腫成分を伴った症例
summary_ja: 13歳女児の右卵巣腫瘤（10cm）で、αフェトプロテイン高値を呈した卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告した。線維肉腫成分が95%を占めていた。付属器摘出術と大網摘出術後にシスプラチンを含む化学療法を7コース施行し、7か月時点で無病生存していた。
summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with a 10-cm right ovarian mass, elevated alpha-fetoprotein, and a yolk sac tumor with a predominant (95%) fibrosarcoma component. After adnexectomy and omentectomy, she received seven cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy and remained disease free at 7-month follow-up. The authors note this is the first reported yolk sac tumor with fibrosarcoma in a teenage female.

title: Diagnostic utility of novel stem cell markers SALL4, OCT4, NANOG, SOX2, UTF1, and TCL1 in primary mediastinal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の診断における新規幹細胞マーカーSALL4、OCT4、NANOG、SOX2、UTF1、TCL1の有用性
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の診断において、SALL4、OCT4、NANOG、SOX2、UTF1、TCL1の6種の幹細胞マーカーの有用性を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではSALL4が広く陽性を示し、AFPなどの従来マーカーより感度が高かった。胸腺腫や悪性リンパ腫は陰性で、特異度も高いことが示された。既存マーカーより高感度な診断指標として有用と考えられる。
summary_en: This study evaluates six stem cell markers (SALL4, OCT4, NANOG, SOX2, UTF1, TCL1) for diagnosing primary mediastinal germ cell tumors, including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, and teratomas. SALL4 was expressed in nearly all yolk sac tumors, where it outperformed AFP, glypican-3, and PLAP. Across GCT subtypes these markers showed high sensitivity and specificity, exceeding conventional markers, and thymomas, thymic carcinomas, and lymphomas were negative. The findings support their use in diagnosing mediastinal GCTs.

title: Spindle proteins are differentially expressed in the various histological subtypes of testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織亜型における紡錘体蛋白の発現差
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織亜型における紡錘体蛋白の発現を、279例の精巣摘除標本で免疫組織化学的に検討した。上皮内癌ではBUB1BとMAD2が低下し、AURKAは上昇していた。AURKAはセミノーマと非セミノーマの双方で高値を示した。上皮内癌から浸潤性精巣がんへの移行に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study used tissue microarrays from 279 orchidectomy specimens to examine spindle proteins (AURKA, AURKB, BUB1B, MAD2) across normal testis, carcinoma in situ, and histological subtypes of testicular germ cell tumors. BUB1B and MAD2 were reduced in carcinoma in situ compared with normal testis, while AURKA was increased. AURKA was elevated in both seminomas and non-seminomas, and BUB1B decreased in non-seminomas. The authors propose these changes may mark the transition from in situ to invasive testicular cancer.

title: Screening for germline DND1 mutations in testicular cancer patients.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者における生殖細胞系列DND1変異のスクリーニング
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する272例の男性で、マウスでTGCTリスクに関連するヒトDND1遺伝子の生殖細胞系列変異を検索した。非家族例の胎児性癌で、非同義置換p.Asp219Gluが認められたが、この変異は非罹患の血縁者にも存在し、対照210染色体には認められなかった。in silico解析では非病原性と予測され、腫瘍では野生型アレルが保持されていた。著者らは、生殖細胞系列のDND1変異がヒトTGCTの感受性に大きく寄与する可能性は低いと結論づけている。
summary_en: This study screened 272 men with testicular germ cell tumors for germline mutations in the human DND1 gene, a gene linked to TGCT susceptibility in the 129/Sv mouse. One nonsynonymous variant, p.Asp219Glu, was found in a non-familial embryonal carcinoma case, but it was also present in unaffected relatives and absent from 210 control chromosomes. It was predicted to be non-pathogenic, and the wild-type allele was retained in the tumor. The authors conclude that germline DND1 mutations are unlikely to contribute significantly to human TGCT susceptibility.

title: p21-Activated kinase-1 promotes aggressive phenotype, cell proliferation, and invasion in gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における侵襲性表現型、細胞増殖および浸潤をp21活性化キナーゼ1が促進する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるp21活性化キナーゼ（PAK）の役割を検討した。PAK1のmRNAと蛋白は、胞状奇胎、特に転移や持続性病変を呈した症例、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍で高発現していた。PAK1発現は増殖マーカーKi-67およびMCM7と正の相関を示した。絨毛癌細胞株でPAK1をノックダウンすると増殖、遊走、浸潤が低下した。PAK1は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病態進展に関与すると考えられる。
summary_en: This study examined p21-activated kinases in gestational trophoblastic disease. PAK1 mRNA and protein were elevated in hydatidiform moles, particularly those that became metastatic or persistent, and in choriocarcinomas and placental site trophoblastic tumors. PAK1 expression correlated with the proliferation markers Ki-67 and MCM7. In choriocarcinoma cell lines, PAK1 knockdown reduced proliferation, migration, and invasion. PAK1 may contribute to the aggressive behavior and clinical progression of GTD.

title: [Paclitaxel + carboplatin (TC)-resistant stage Ic squamous cell carcinomas arising in mature cystic teratomas of the ovary].
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じたパクリタキセル＋カルボプラチン（TC）療法抵抗性の病期Ic扁平上皮癌
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌で、病期Icの後に再発した2症例を報告した。症例1はTC療法後に再発し、二次化学療法にもかかわらず死亡した。症例2は乳癌の化学療法中に骨盤内再発し、動脈塞栓術とシスプラチンで部分寛解を得た。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の再発扁平上皮癌に対し、経カテーテル的動脈塞栓術が二次治療として有効な可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This report describes two patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratomas, both with stage Ic disease that later recurred.
