title: Malignant teratoma of the thyroid in a pregnant woman.
title_ja: 妊娠女性の甲状腺原発悪性奇形腫
summary_ja: 妊娠中の38歳女性に生じた甲状腺原発悪性奇形腫の症例報告である。小児の甲状腺奇形腫は多くが良性であるのに対し、成人例は悪性が多く予後不良とされる。本症例は手術と術後化学療法により初期に良好な反応を示した。
summary_en: This case report describes primary malignant teratoma of the thyroid in a 38-year-old pregnant woman. The authors note that most thyroid teratomas in children are benign, whereas adult cases are usually malignant and often fatal due to treatment-refractory spread. The patient was treated with surgery and postoperative chemotherapy, with a good initial response. The report underscores the need to consider malignant teratoma in pregnant adults with thyroid masses.

title: Ovarian germ cell tumors in children. Management, survival and ovarian prognosis. A report of 75 cases.
title_ja: 小児卵巣胚細胞腫瘍：管理、生存率および卵巣予後　75例の報告
summary_ja: 1976〜2009年に卵巣胚細胞腫瘍で手術を受けた小児71例75腫瘍を後方視的に検討した研究である。良性58例では卵巣温存腫瘍摘出術により約85%の卵巣が保存された。悪性17例は高い生存率が得られ、術前鑑別の基準として75mmのサイズカットオフが提案された。
summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 75 ovarian germ cell tumors in 71 girls treated from 1976 to 2009. Fifty-eight tumors were benign and 17 malignant. Benign tumors were smaller, and ovary-sparing tumorectomy preserved about 85 percent of ovaries. Malignant tumors were managed per French pediatric oncology protocols, with high survival. A 75-mm size cutoff is proposed to differentiate benign from malignant tumors preoperatively. One patient recurred and one died.

title: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma in an adolescent female.
title_ja: 思春期女性の卵巣奇形腫に伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎
summary_ja: 15歳女性の卵巣奇形腫が誘因となった抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告である。腫瘍摘出により、傍腫瘍症候群としての神経症状と精神症状は改善した。小児例の文献的レビューと新規抗体検査の有用性も論じられ、早期の外科的切除が治療となりうると示された。
summary_en: This report describes anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis in a 15-year-old girl, attributed to NMDA receptor autoantibodies triggered by an ovarian mature teratoma. Complete removal of the teratoma led to resolution of the paraneoplastic neurological disease and associated psychiatric symptoms. The authors review pediatric cases linking ovarian teratoma to this encephalitis and note the value of a novel antibody assay. They argue that prompt surgical excision may be curative.

title: Is retroperitoneal histology predictive of liver histology at concurrent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and hepatic resection?
title_ja: 後腹膜組織所見は化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清と肝切除の同時手術における肝組織所見を予測するか
summary_ja: 肝転移を伴う非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍59例を後方視的に検討し、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清と肝切除時の後腹膜と肝の組織型の一致を評価した。全体の一致率は49%で、後腹膜の壊死は肝壊死を94%予測した。肝病変の管理は個別化すべきとされた。
summary_en: This study reviewed 59 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and liver metastases who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and liver resection, using a Indiana University testis cancer database. Overall retroperitoneal and liver histologic concordance was 49 percent. Retroperitoneal necrosis predicted hepatic necrosis in 94 percent of cases, while teratoma and cancer concordance were lower. Most liver specimens contained only necrosis. Management of liver lesions should be individualized.

title: Management options for stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する管理の選択肢
summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマは精巣がんで最も多い病態である。精巣摘除術後の治療として、補助放射線療法、サーベイランス、化学療法はいずれも高い有効性を示す。本総説は各治療の長期成績、有害事象、コスト、QOL、患者の希望を比較し、再発リスクに応じた治療戦略の意義を論じている。
summary_en: This review examines management options for stage I seminoma, the most common presentation of testicular cancer. After orchiectomy, adjuvant radiotherapy, surveillance, or chemotherapy can achieve similar efficacy and cure. The authors weigh each strategy's long-term outcomes, treatment burden, morbidity, costs, quality of life, and patient preferences. Improved predictors of relapse and growing experience with surveillance and adjuvant chemotherapy support risk-adapted strategies as alternatives to standard radiotherapy. Close surveillance for low-risk patients and adjuvant therapy for non-adherent or high-risk patients are considered acceptable, although the optimal model still requires validation.

title: Reprogramming human cancer cells in the mouse mammary gland.
title_ja: マウス乳腺におけるヒト癌細胞のリプログラミング
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞を、マウス乳腺上皮細胞とともにヌードマウスの乳腺脂肪床に移植した。ヒト由来細胞は66〜660倍に増殖し、ヒト特異的なサイトケラチンやミルクタンパク質を発現する乳腺上皮へと分化した。二次移植でも同様の所見が再現され、ヒトの癌細胞がマウス乳腺の微小環境に応答して生体内で分化方向を変えうることが示された。
summary_en: Human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells were co-inoculated with mouse mammary epithelial cells into cleared mammary fat pads of nude mice. The EC-derived cells proliferated extensively, increasing 66- to 660-fold, and differentiated into diverse mammary epithelial phenotypes expressing human-specific cytokeratins and milk proteins. Secondary transplants reproduced these features. The study shows that human cancer cells can respond to the mouse mammary microenvironment during gland regeneration and reprogram their differentiation in vivo.

title: Paradoxical development of a sarcoid-like reaction during successful chemotherapy for seminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマに対する化学療法中に生じた逆説的なサルコイド様反応
summary_ja: 再発した腹部セミノーマの36歳男性が、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法中に、腹部腫瘤は縮小したものの縦隔および両側肺門のリンパ節腫脹を生じた。縦隔リンパ節の生検で非乾酪性肉芽腫を認め、サルコイド様反応と診断された。その後、セミノーマは完全寛解に至り、胸部リンパ節腫脹は9か月後に自然消退した。
summary_en: A 36-year-old man with recurrent abdominal seminoma developed mediastinal and bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy during bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy, even as the abdominal mass shrank. Biopsy of mediastinal nodes showed noncaseating granulomas consistent with a sarcoid-like reaction. Nephrectomy with retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy confirmed complete remission of the seminoma. The thoracic lymphadenopathy resolved spontaneously nine months later. This is the first reported paradoxical sarcoid-like reaction during successful chemotherapy for seminoma.

title: In vitro interaction of high-LET heavy-ion irradiation and chemotherapeutic agents in two cell lines with different radiosensitivities and different p53 status.
title_ja: 放射線感受性とp53状態が異なる2種の細胞株における、高LET重粒子線と化学療法薬のin vitroでの相互作用
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株NMT-1（野生型p53、放射線感受性）とNMT-1R（変異型p53、放射線抵抗性）を用いた。炭素イオン線単独、およびエトポシドまたはシスプラチンとの併用の効果をコロニー形成法で評価した。変異型p53細胞でRBEが高く、エトポシドは炭素イオン線との併用で増強効果を示したが、シスプラチンは増強効果を示さなかった。
summary_en: Rat yolk sac tumor cell lines NMT-1 (wild-type p53, radiosensitive) and NMT-1R (mutant p53, radioresistant) were treated with carbon-ion irradiation alone or combined with etoposide or cisplatin. Clonogenic assays showed no difference in intrinsic heavy-ion sensitivity, but the RBE was higher in mutant p53 cells. Etoposide acted supra-additively with carbon-ion irradiation in NMT-1R cells, whereas cisplatin did not enhance radiosensitivity. The authors suggest heavy-ion radiotherapy may benefit radioresistant, p53-mutant tumors, with etoposide as a possible partner.

title: The chromosome Y-linked testis-specific protein locus TSPY1 is characteristically present in gonadoblastoma.
title_ja: 染色体Y連鎖の精巣特異的タンパク質遺伝子座TSPY1は性腺芽腫に特徴的に認められる
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 性腺芽腫は、GBY領域を有する表現型女性にほぼ限局して生じる。6症例を対象に、TSPY1とX染色体のFISH解析を行った。5例（84%）でTSPY1が検出され、残る1例では他の遺伝子座が代替している可能性が示唆された。TSPY1は性腺芽腫の発生への関与が想定される遺伝子であり、本法はY関連の性分化疾患の評価にも実用的と考えられる。
summary_en: Gonadoblastoma almost exclusively occurs in phenotypic females carrying Y-chromosome material at the GBY locus. The authors used an interphase FISH assay targeting TSPY1 and a chromosome X probe in six gonadoblastoma cases. TSPY1 was present in five of six (84%), and adjacent gonadal tissue matched the tumor genotype. The single TSPY1-negative case, in a woman with two X chromosomes, suggests other loci may compensate. The assay is also a practical tool for evaluating Y-associated intersex disorders.

title: Gonadal dysgenesis and gynecologic cancer.
title_ja: 性腺異形成と婦人科癌
summary_ja: 性腺異形成の患者3例(Swyer症候群2例、モザイク型ターナー症候群1例)にディスジャーミノーマ、セミノーマ、性腺芽腫が生じた症例集積である。前二者は月経が規則的で再発はなかった。性腺異形成と診断された場合は、悪性転化のリスクから予防的性腺摘出を推奨している。
summary_en: This case series describes three patients with gonadal dysgenesis, two with Swyer syndrome and one with mosaic Turner syndrome, who developed dysgerminoma, seminoma, or gonadoblastoma. The dysgerminoma and seminoma patients had regular menses and no recurrence. The gonadoblastoma patient was recommended hormone therapy. The authors conclude that prophylactic gonadectomy should be performed after gonadal dysgenesis is diagnosed because of the risk of malignant transformation, and that primary amenorrhea needs complete evaluation.

title: Mediastinal teratoma with pulmonary involvement presenting as massive hemoptysis in 2 patients.
title_ja: 大量喀血を呈した縦隔奇形腫と肺病変の2例
summary_ja: 気管支との交通と肺病変を伴う縦隔奇形腫により大量喀血を来した2症例の報告。縦隔奇形腫は特異的な症状に乏しく、大量喀血の鑑別診断に挙がることは稀で、術前診断が困難である。気管支病変を伴う場合は、軟性気管支鏡検査が診断に有用であると指摘している。原因不明の喀血では縦隔奇形腫を念頭に置くべきと強調している。
summary_en: Two patients presented with massive hemoptysis caused by mediastinal teratoma with bronchial communication and pulmonary involvement. The authors note that mediastinal teratoma rarely appears in the differential diagnosis of massive hemoptysis because it lacks specific symptoms, making preoperative diagnosis difficult. They highlight that flexible bronchoscopy can be diagnostic when the bronchial tree is involved. The report emphasizes considering mediastinal teratoma in patients with unexplained hemoptysis to prevent diagnostic delay.

title: Huge mediastinal cystic tumor penetrating the sternum.
title_ja: 胸骨を貫通した巨大縦隔嚢胞性腫瘍
summary_ja: 59歳女性の、胸骨を貫通した前縦隔の巨大腫瘍の症例。胸骨柄を含めて一塊に切除し、大胸筋皮弁で胸壁欠損を再建した。嚢胞性腫瘍の病理組織学的所見は良性の嚢胞性成熟奇形腫であった。縦隔奇形腫が胸骨へ直接進展した極めて稀な症例であり、隣接する骨や胸壁を侵す良性様の嚢胞性縦隔腫瘍に対する外科的治療の要点を示している。
summary_en: A 59-year-old woman had a huge anterior mediastinal tumor that penetrated the sternum. The mass was resected en bloc together with the manubrium sterni, and the chest wall defect was reconstructed with a pectoralis major muscle flap. Histology of the cystic mass revealed a benign cystic mature teratoma. The authors describe this as a very rare presentation of mediastinal teratoma with direct sternal invasion. The case highlights the surgical management required when a benign-appearing cystic mediastinal tumor breaches adjacent bone and chest wall.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の総説。良性の胞状奇胎から悪性の侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍までを概説する。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)をバイオマーカーとした管理、化学療法、治療の集約化により治癒率は98%を超え、妊孕性温存も可能になった。管理およびフォローアップ戦略、議論のある論点、今後の研究課題も論じられている。
summary_en: This review summarizes gestational trophoblastic disease, spanning premalignant complete and partial hydatidiform moles and malignant invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and the rare placental-site trophoblastic tumour. Cure rates now exceed 98% with fertility preservation, largely due to effective chemotherapy, hCG monitoring, and centralized care. The authors outline management and follow-up strategies, discuss ongoing controversies, and identify future research directions.

title: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis in a young woman with an ovarian tumour.
title_ja: 卵巣腫瘍を伴う若年女性の抗NMDA受容体脳炎
summary_ja: 香港の若年女性で、意識障害と著明なジスキネジアを呈し、卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎と確認された初の症例報告である。腫瘍摘出と免疫療法により神経症状の改善が得られた。奇形腫関連抗NMDA受容体脳炎の文献的レビューも行い、腫瘍の早期発見の重要性を述べている。
summary_en: A case report of a young Hong Kong woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis who presented with confusion and prominent dyskinesia and was later found to have an ovarian teratoma. Tumour resection and immunotherapy led to neurological recovery. The authors review the literature on teratoma-associated anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, a paraneoplastic syndrome in which the ovarian tumour is often the trigger, and stress that early tumour detection matters.

title: Malignant gastric teratoma: report of two cases from a single center.
title_ja: 悪性胃奇形腫：単施設の2症例
summary_ja: 乳児男児2例の悪性胃奇形腫(卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織像)を報告している。両例とも外科的切除が行われ、1例は補助化学療法も受けた。術後5年および6年の時点で再発はない。胃奇形腫の悪性例は文献上2例のみであり、悪性であっても予後は良好と述べている。
summary_en: Two male infants with malignant gastric teratoma, histologically an endodermal sinus tumour, are reported. Both underwent surgical excision, and one also received adjuvant chemotherapy. Both remained free of recurrence for five and six years. The authors note that gastric teratomas are rarely malignant, with only two prior cases reported, and that prognosis is excellent even when malignant.

title: Evidence-based treatment for advanced germ cell tumor of the testis with a case illustration.
title_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍のエビデンスに基づく治療と症例提示
summary_ja: 進行した精巣胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌)の症例に対しBEP療法4コースを行い、良好な経過を得た。進行胚細胞腫瘍の標準治療をエビデンスに基づいて整理し、予後分類別の長期寛解率を示している。良好群、中間群、不良群でそれぞれ約90%、75%、45%である。長期的な身体的・心理的転帰の慎重な経過観察の必要性を強調している。
summary_en: A case of far-advanced testicular embryonal carcinoma treated with four cycles of BEP chemotherapy, with a review of evidence-based management of advanced germ cell tumours. Standard BEP or EP regimens are summarised by prognostic risk group, with durable remission rates of about 90%, 75% and 45% for good, intermediate and poor risk. The authors emphasise careful monitoring of long-term physical and psychological outcomes.

title: Cytogenetic follow-up in testicular seminoma patients exposed to adjuvant radiotherapy.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者における補助放射線療法後の細胞遺伝学的フォローアップ
summary_ja: 精巣摘除後に補助放射線療法を受けた病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者10例を対象に、末梢血リンパ球のDNA・染色体損傷を健常者と比較しました。照射開始後にDNA損傷が増加し、染色体異常や小核も治療中に増加して、その後のフォローアップ期間に徐々に低下しました。細胞遺伝学的スクリーニングは高リスク患者の同定に有用かもしれません。
summary_en: This study assessed genotoxic damage in ten patients with stage I testicular seminoma receiving adjuvant radiotherapy (25 Gy in 16 fractions) after orchidectomy, compared with healthy controls. Using comet, chromosome aberration, and micronucleus assays on peripheral blood lymphocytes, the authors sampled blood before, during, and after radiotherapy, and at six and twelve months of follow-up. DNA damage rose after the first dose, and chromosomal aberrations and micronuclei increased during therapy before gradually declining. The findings suggest cytogenetic screening could identify high-risk survivors for regular monitoring.

title: Pulmonary metastasis of struma ovarii: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫の肺転移：症例報告
summary_ja: 42歳女性の多発肺結節は、分化型甲状腺癌として切除されました。15年前の卵巣嚢腫切除標本を免疫組織化学で再検討したところ卵巣甲状腺腫と判明しました。甲状腺全摘とI-131治療を3回行い、サイログロブリンは検出されなくなり、肺・骨・傍大動脈リンパ節の転移も消失しました。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の治療には卵巣切除、甲状腺全摘、放射性ヨウ素療法が組み合わされます。
summary_en: A 42-year-old woman presented with multiple pulmonary nodules that were resected and found to be differentiated thyroid carcinoma. Reexamination of an earlier ovarian cyst resection, with immunohistochemistry, revealed struma ovarii, a rare ovarian tumor. After total thyroidectomy and three rounds of I-131 therapy, thyroglobulin became undetectable and pulmonary, bone, and para-aortic lymph node metastases resolved. The authors note that malignant struma ovarii most often metastasizes to the liver and peritoneum, and that treatment combines ovarian resection, total thyroidectomy, and radioiodine therapy.

title: Choriocarcinoma arising in a serous carcinoma of ovary: an example of histopathology driving treatment.
title_ja: 卵巣漿液性癌に発生した絨毛癌:病理組織学が治療方針を決定づけた一例
summary_ja: 65歳女性の漿液性卵巣癌に絨毛癌成分が混在した症例報告。外科的切除後の病理組織学的診断により、両成分に有効なシスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法が選択された。まれな組織型の正確な分類が治療方針を変えうるため、婦人科医と病理医の認識の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old woman with a choriocarcinoma component arising within a serous carcinoma of the ovary. Histopathological examination after surgical resection established the mixed diagnosis, which directed treatment toward a cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin regimen covering both malignant components. The authors emphasize that gynecologists and pathologists should recognize such rare variants of ovarian epithelial carcinoma, since accurate histologic classification can directly change chemotherapy choice.

title: Elevated LDH predicts poor outcome of recurrent germ cell tumours treated with dose dense chemotherapy.
title_ja: 再発胚細胞腫瘍に対する用量強化化学療法において、LDH高値は予後不良を予測する
summary_ja: 初回再発の胚細胞腫瘍男性117例を対象とした後方視的研究で、用量強化救援化学療法後の転帰予測因子を検討した。LDH高値は無増悪生存期間および全生存期間の不良と強く関連し、MRCやMSKの予後モデルより優れていた。セミノーマ組織型や完全奏効に至らないことも不良因子であった。LDHは前向きに検証されるべきだと結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 117 men with a first recurrence of germ cell tumour treated with dose-dense salvage chemotherapy examined whether serum LDH predicts outcome. Raised LDH was strongly associated with poorer progression-free and overall survival, outperforming MRC and MSK prognostic models. Seminoma histology and failure to achieve complete response or marker-negative partial response were also adverse factors. The authors conclude LDH should be prospectively validated and assessed in patients receiving conventional-dose regimens.

title: Prognostic factors in patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors, a surgical multicenter retrospective study.
title_ja: 原発縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の予後因子:外科的切除を伴う多施設後方視的研究
summary_ja: フランス3施設の原発縦隔胚細胞腫瘍31例の後方視的多施設研究。5年全生存率は56.3%だった。多変量解析では外科的切除が独立した良好な予後因子であった。希少疾患のため、予後因子の精密化には症例数を増やす多施設共同研究が必要と述べている。
summary_en: This multicenter retrospective study of 31 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumours from three French centres identified prognostic factors. Five-year overall survival was 56.3%. Tumour histology, surgical resection of the tumour, and pathological evidence of persistent viable tumour in resected remnants were significant on univariate analysis, and surgical resection remained an independent favourable factor on multivariate analysis. The authors note that expanding multicentre enrollment would be needed to refine prognostic markers given the rarity of the disease.

title: Mucinous cystadenoma arising 3 years after ovarian-sparing surgery for mature teratoma in a child.
title_ja: 小児の成熟奇形腫に対する卵巣温存手術の3年後に発生した粘液性嚢胞腺腫
summary_ja: 15歳女性が、卵巣成熟奇形腫に対する卵巣温存手術の3年後に同側卵巣に粘液性嚢胞腺腫を発症した症例報告。小児の卵巣腫瘍では奇形腫が最も多く、粘液性嚢胞腺腫は小児期にきわめてまれである。若年者の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する妊孕性温存手術後には長期の経過観察が必要であることを示している。
summary_en: A 15-year-old girl developed a mucinous cystadenoma in the same ovary three years after ovarian-sparing surgery for a mature teratoma. The report highlights that ovarian teratoma is the most common ovarian neoplasm in children, whereas mucinous cystadenoma is exceedingly rare in this age group. It illustrates the need for long-term surveillance after fertility-sparing surgery for ovarian germ cell tumours in young patients.

title: Unusual ovarian malignancies in ascitic fluid: a report of 2 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣腫瘍による腹水中の稀な悪性腫瘍：2例の報告
summary_ja: 若年女性2例の卵巣腫瘍・腹水で、細胞診では腺癌が疑われたが、病理診断で卵黄嚢腫瘍と若年性顆粒膜細胞腫瘍と判明した。見直しで卵黄嚢腫瘍の硝子様小体などの所見が確認された。若年患者では臨床情報と細胞診を組み合わせた評価の重要性が強調されている。
summary_en: This report describes two young women with ovarian masses and ascites, initially cytologically interpreted as or suspected to be adenocarcinoma. Histopathology revealed yolk sac tumor in one and juvenile granulosa cell tumor in the other. Retrospective review identified hyaline globules in the yolk sac tumor and tubular structures in the granulosa cell tumor, features that would have supported the correct diagnosis. The authors emphasize combining clinical age data with cytology when evaluating serous fluid from uncommon ovarian malignancies.

title: Acute psychiatric syndrome leading young patients to ICU: consider anti-NMDA-receptor antibodies.
title_ja: 若年女性の急性精神症候群によりICUに至った症例：抗NMDA受容体抗体を考慮すべき
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体抗体脳炎の1例と既報例のレビューである。若年女性に多く、卵巣奇形腫を伴うことが多い。精神症状から始まり重症化して集中治療が必要となる。早期診断、奇形腫摘出、免疫療法が回復の鍵とされる。集中治療室に入院する若年女性では本疾患を考慮すべきと強調している。
summary_en: This paper reports a case of anti-NMDA receptor antibody encephalitis and reviews previously published cases. The disorder typically affects young women, often with an underlying ovarian teratoma, and presents with psychiatric symptoms that progress to severe neurological dysfunction requiring intensive care. Recovery depends on early diagnosis, removal of the teratoma, and immunotherapy. The authors aim to alert intensivists to consider this potentially lethal condition in young women with neuropsychiatric presentations.

title: Simultaneously detected bilateral testicular cancer of different histopathological origin--a challenging situation for the urologist.
title_ja: 同時に検出された、組織学的起源の異なる両側精巣がん：泌尿器科医にとって難しい症例
summary_ja: 停留精巣の既往がある36歳男性が両側精巣腫大で受診し、LDH・β-hCG・αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇していた。右精巣はセミノーマ、左精巣は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍、右鼠径部は転移性セミノーマと診断された。異なる組織型の両側精巣がんでは補助療法とフォローアップを慎重に選ぶべきと述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a history of right cryptorchidism who presented with bilateral testicular swelling and elevated LDH, β-hCG, and AFP. Imaging showed a right testicular lesion, a left testicular mass, and enlarged right inguinal and left retroperitoneal lymph nodes. Bilateral orchiectomy revealed seminoma of the right testis, nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the left testis, and metastatic seminoma in the right groin. The authors highlight the difficulty of managing bilateral testicular cancer with different histologies and the need for careful adjuvant treatment and follow-up.

title: Expression of benign and malignant thyroid tissue in ovarian teratomas and the importance of multimodal management as illustrated by a BRAF-positive follicular variant of papillary thyroid cancer.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に見られる良性および悪性甲状腺組織と多角的治療の重要性：BRAF陽性濾胞亜型乳頭状甲状腺癌の症例
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫内の甲状腺組織の良性・悪性を検討した総説と症例報告である。卵巣甲状腺腫と考えられた腫瘍が、濾胞亜型乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う播種性病変だった症例を示す。131I療法、減量手術、リチウム併用での再投与など多角的な治療を行い、Tgは18.1 ng/mLまで低下した。
summary_en: This review and case report examines benign and malignant thyroid tissue within ovarian teratomas. It describes a woman whose ovarian cyst, initially thought to be struma ovarii, was later found to be follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma with disseminated intra-abdominal disease, elevated thyroglobulin, and a BRAF K601E mutation. Management included thyroidectomy, radioiodine therapy, extensive debulking surgery, and repeat radioiodine with lithium pretreatment, with thyroglobulin falling to 18.1 ng/mL. The authors conclude that multimodal management is most promising for malignant struma ovarii.

title: Twist is inversely associated with claudins in germ cell tumors of the testis.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるTwistとクローディンの逆相関
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍68例を対象に、クローディン1、3〜7とTwistを免疫染色で検討した研究である。クローディンの発現は腫瘍型や成分により異なり、セミノーマではTwistが最も強く発現した。Twistはクローディン1、3、4、6の発現と逆相関し、クローディンの発現低下に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined claudins 1, 3-7, and the transcription factor Twist in 68 testicular germ cell tumors, including seminomas, teratomas, teratocarcinomas, embryonal carcinomas, and mixed tumors. Claudin expression varied by tumor type and component: epithelial and choriocarcinomatous elements expressed several claudins, while mesenchymal elements in teratomas were negative. Twist was strongest in seminoma and embryonal carcinoma and was inversely associated with claudins 1, 3, 4, and 6, suggesting Twist contributes to claudin downregulation.

title: [A case of Down's syndrome associated with recurrent testicular tumor treated by chemotherapy successfully: review of 41 cases in Japanese literature].
title_ja: ダウン症候群に合併し化学療法で良好に治療し得た再発精巣腫瘍の1例：本邦文献41例の検討
summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併した35歳男性が左精巣セミノーマに対し根治的精巣摘除術を受け、術後18か月で右後腹膜リンパ節転移が出現した。BEP療法（ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン）を3サイクル施行後に腫瘍は消失し、その後の再発徴候は認められていない。ダウン症候群における精巣腫瘍の本邦報告41例もあわせて検討した。
summary_en: A 35-year-old man with Down syndrome underwent orchiectomy for a left testicular seminoma and developed a right retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis 18 months later. He was treated with BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin), and the tumor disappeared after three cycles, with no sign of recurrence afterward. The authors also reviewed 41 previously reported Japanese cases of testicular tumor in Down syndrome.

title: Newborn's giant sacrococcigeal teratoma.
title_ja: 新生児の巨大仙尾部奇形腫
summary_ja: 妊娠25週の超音波検査で発見された、直径12cmの仙尾部奇形腫の新生児例。生後1日目に尾骨を含めて600gの腫瘍を摘出した。術後経過は良好で、生後14日目に退院した。病理組織学的検査で良性と確認された。小児の骨外性胚細胞腫瘍として、出生前診断と早期手術の経過を報告している。
summary_en: A newborn girl was found prenatally at 25 weeks to have a 12 cm sacrococcygeal mass. The mass, weighing 600 g with the coccyx, was removed on day 1 of life, and it had displaced the rectum and perineum. Postoperative recovery was uneventful, and she was discharged on day 14. Histopathology confirmed a benign teratoma. The report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma, a pediatric extragonadal germ cell tumor.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease I: epidemiology, pathology, clinical presentation and diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic disease, and management of hydatidiform mole.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患I：疫学、病理、臨床像、診断、および胞状奇胎の管理
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の総説。胞状奇胎と妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍）について、疫学、病理、臨床像、診断を概説する。特に胞状奇胎の管理として、子宮内容除去術、予防的化学療法、フォローアップを取り上げている。
summary_en: This review covers the epidemiology, pathology, clinical presentation, and diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole and gestational trophoblastic neoplasia such as invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. It places particular emphasis on hydatidiform mole management, including evacuation, twin mole with a normal fetus, prophylactic chemotherapy, and follow-up.

title: Cystic struma ovarii: a report of three cases.
title_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫の3症例
summary_ja: 16〜40歳の女性3例の嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫を報告。いずれも超音波検査で無症候性の片側卵巣腫瘤として発見された。組織学的に甲状腺濾胞は少数で、サイログロブリンの免疫染色が確定診断に有用だった。1例は嚢胞性成熟奇形腫を併存。術後の経過は良好で甲状腺機能は正常だった。非典型的な嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍では本症を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
summary_en: This report describes three cases of cystic struma ovarii in women aged 16 to 40, all presenting with asymptomatic unilateral ovarian masses detected on ultrasound. Tumors measured 7 to 10 cm and were filled with green fluid. Microscopy showed cyst walls with few thyroid follicles and non-specific epithelium; one case coexisted with a cystic mature teratoma. Thyroglobulin immunostaining was needed for diagnosis. All patients recovered with normal thyroid function. The authors suggest struma ovarii is underdiagnosed and should be considered in atypical cystic ovarian tumors.

title: Limbic encephalitis presenting with seizures, anterograde amnesia, and psychosis in a patient seven weeks status post immature ovarian teratoma removal.
title_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫摘出後7週目に痙攣、前向性健忘、精神病症状を呈した辺縁系脳炎
summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の摘出から7週後に、痙攣、記憶障害、行動変化を呈した25歳女性の症例。当初は身体表現性障害や精神病と診断されたが、経過から傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎と再評価された。脳画像検査と脳波は正常だった。免疫グロブリン静注とステロイド大量投与で症状は改善した。後の検査で抗NMDA受容体（NR1/NR2）抗体の陽性が確認された。
summary_en: A 25-year-old woman presented with seizures, memory loss, and behavioral changes seven weeks after removal of an immature ovarian teratoma. Initially considered a somatoform disorder or psychosis, the case was reclassified as paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis. Brain imaging, EEG, and neurological workup were unremarkable. Treatment with intravenous immunoglobulin and high-dose steroids improved symptoms, and she was discharged home. Later testing detected antibodies against NR1/NR2 of the NMDA receptor, confirming anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis.

title: 4-(3-Halo/amino-4,5-dimethoxyphenyl)-5-aryloxazoles and -N-methylimidazoles that are cytotoxic against combretastatin A resistant tumor cells and vascular disrupting in a cisplatin resistant germ cell tumor model.
title_ja: 4-(3-ハロ/アミノ-4,5-ジメトキシフェニル)-5-アリールオキサゾールおよびN-メチルイミダゾールの、コンブレタスタチンA耐性腫瘍細胞に対する細胞毒性とシスプラチン耐性胚細胞腫瘍モデルにおける血管破壊作用
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: オキサゾールまたはN-メチルイミダゾールで架橋したコンブレタスタチンA類似体を、耐性がん細胞株およびシスプラチン耐性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植モデルで評価した。ハロゲンまたはアミノ置換を持つイミダゾール誘導体2種はナノモル濃度で細胞毒性を示し、チュブリン重合を阻害した。高用量でも忍容性が良好で、腫瘍内出血と腫瘍退縮を誘導した。
summary_en: Novel combretastatin A analogues with oxazole or N-methylimidazole bridges were tested against several drug-resistant cancer cell lines and a cisplatin-resistant testicular germ cell tumor xenograft model. Two imidazole derivatives with halo- or amino-substituted A-rings showed nanomolar cytotoxicity, induced apoptosis, and inhibited tubulin polymerization. They were well tolerated at high doses and caused extensive intratumoral hemorrhage and regression of highly vascularized 1411HP xenografts, suggesting potential as vascular-disrupting agents for resistant germ cell tumors.

title: Salvage chemotherapy with methotrexate, etoposide and actinomycin D in men with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors with a choriocarcinoma component: a preliminary report.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（絨毛癌成分を伴う）に対するメトトレキサート、エトポシド、アクチノマイシンDによる救援化学療法：予備報告
summary_ja: 絨毛癌成分を伴う転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性9例に対し、メトトレキサート、エトポシド、アクチノマイシンDによる救援化学療法を予備的に検討した。前治療で正常化しなかったβ-hCGが、中央値3コース後に5例で正常化し、うち3例は長期無病生存した。正常化しなかった4例は全例が病勢進行で死亡した。重篤な骨髄抑制が主な有害事象だったが、治療関連死はなかった。
summary_en: This preliminary report evaluated salvage chemotherapy with methotrexate, etoposide, and actinomycin D (MEA) in nine men with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors containing a choriocarcinoma component. All had failed prior regimens of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, and high-dose ifosfamide, carboplatin, and etoposide without normalizing beta-hCG. After a median of three MEA cycles, beta-hCG normalized in five patients, three of whom remained disease-free long term. Patients who did not normalize beta-hCG all died of progression. Severe toxicities, mainly myelosuppression, occurred without treatment-related deaths.

title: Mediastinal germ cell tumor with somatic-type malignancy: report of 5 stage I/II cases.
title_ja: 病期I/IIの縦隔胚細胞腫瘍（体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う）5例の報告
summary_ja: 過去12年間に治療した原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍15例のうち、体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う5例を報告する。病期は病期I 2例、病期II 3例であった。全例が周術期化学療法と外科的切除を受けた。平均60か月の追跡で4例が再発なく生存している。まれな組織型であり、集学的治療により良好な転帰が得られることを示した。
summary_en: This report describes five patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors containing somatic-type malignancy, selected from 15 mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients treated over 12 years. Two were stage I and three stage II. All received perioperative chemotherapy and surgical resection. At a mean follow-up of 60 months, four patients remained alive without relapse. The authors highlight this rare histologic subtype and its favorable outcome with multimodal therapy.

title: Late relapse (>2 years) on surveillance in stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours; predominant seminoma only histology.
title_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のサーベイランス中に発生した2年以降の晩期再発：主としてセミノーマ組織型のみ
summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で精巣摘除後にサーベイランスを受けた453例を検討。100例が再発し、そのうち2年以降の晩期再発は9例だった。晩期再発の転移巣は56%が純粋セミノーマであった。AFPが正常な晩期再発例には生検による組織型の確認を推奨。化学療法後の残存腫瘤が純粋セミノーマ由来なら後腹膜リンパ節郭清を省略できる可能性を示した。
summary_en: This study reviewed 453 patients under surveillance after orchidectomy for stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, of whom 100 relapsed. Nine relapsed after more than two years, and most late relapses were pure seminoma at metastatic sites (56%). All late relapsers were alive and disease-free at a median 45 months after relapse. The authors recommend biopsy for late relapses with normal AFP to define histology, and suggest retroperitoneal lymph node dissection may be avoidable in pure seminoma with residual masses after chemotherapy.

title: Sertoli cell tumor with benign peritoneal implants associated with gonadoblastoma.
title_ja: 性腺芽細胞腫に関連したセルトリ細胞腫瘍と良性腹膜播種
summary_ja: Swyer症候群の23歳女性に発生した両側性性腺芽細胞腫の症例。右の索状性腺はジャーミノーマ（病期I）、左は高分化型セルトリ細胞腫瘍へ同時性に腫瘍化していた。セルトリ細胞腫瘍には多数の良性腹膜播種を伴い、腹部手術の2か月前に行った腹腔鏡下生検による医原性の播種と考えられた。浸潤がなく増殖能が低いことから良性と判断された。
summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old woman with Swyer syndrome and bilateral gonadoblastoma. The right streak gonad had transformed into stage I germinoma, and the left into a well-differentiated Sertoli cell tumor. The Sertoli tumor was accompanied by multiple benign peritoneal implants, considered iatrogenic from laparoscopic gonadal biopsies performed two months before abdominal surgery. Lack of invasion and low proliferation supported benignity. The authors discuss the pathogenesis of such benign abdominal implants.

title: Immature teratoma of the ovary with distant metastases: favorable prognosis and insights into chemotherapeutic retroconversion.
title_ja: 遠隔転移を伴う卵巣未熟奇形腫：良好な予後と化学療法による逆分化についての知見
summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の若年女性に、卵巣摘出後2年以内に脳・肺・肝転移が出現した。転移巣は化学療法の前後に段階的に切除された。後の切除検体ほど成熟成分が増え、Ki-67標識率が低下しており、化学療法が分化成熟を誘導した可能性が示唆された。10年生存が得られ、卵巣未熟奇形腫からの脳転移の初例として報告されている。
summary_en: A young woman with a primary immature ovarian teratoma developed brain, lung, and liver metastases within two years of salpingo-oophorectomy. Sequential resections of metastatic lesions were performed before and during chemotherapy. Later resections showed more mature elements and lower Ki-67 labeling indices, suggesting chemotherapy induced maturation. The patient survived 10 years. The authors report this as the first case of brain metastasis from an ovarian immature teratoma with a favorable prognosis despite CNS involvement.

title: Overexpression of the Parkinson disease protein DJ-1 and its regulator PTEN in gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるパーキンソン病タンパク質DJ-1とその制御因子PTENの過剰発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の組織95例とRT-PCR用79例、絨毛癌細胞株を用いて、DJ-1とPTENの発現を検討。全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌では初期胎盤に比べ、DJ-1およびPTENの免疫反応性とmRNA発現が有意に高かった。DJ-1はBcl-2と負の相関、PTENは野生型p53と正の相関を示した。DJ-1の過剰発現が、PTENとp53を介して栄養膜細胞のアポトーシスを制御する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This study examined DJ-1 and PTEN expression in 95 trophoblastic tissue samples for immunohistochemistry and 79 samples for RT-PCR, plus choriocarcinoma cell lines. DJ-1 and PTEN immunoreactivity and mRNA levels were significantly higher in complete moles and choriocarcinomas than in first-trimester placentas. DJ-1 negatively correlated with Bcl-2, and PTEN positively correlated with wild-type p53 and with Stat3 and Nanog. The authors suggest DJ-1 overexpression may regulate trophoblast apoptosis through PTEN and p53.

title: Incidental finding of placental choriocarcinoma after an uncomplicated term pregnancy: a case report with review of the literature.
title_ja: 正期産後に偶然発見された胎盤性絨毛癌：症例報告と文献的考察
summary_ja: 正期産で無症状の妊娠経過後、胎盤の日常検査で偶然発見された胎盤性絨毛癌の症例報告。2cmの結節は高度異型の栄養膜細胞からなり、hCG陽性であった。全身CTで転移はなく、hCG値は追跡中に陰性化した。正常分娩後の胎盤が通常検査されないため、実際の発生頻度は報告より高い可能性があると論じている。
summary_en: This case report describes placental choriocarcinoma discovered incidentally in a 29-year-old woman after an uncomplicated full-term delivery, an exceptionally rare event estimated at about 1 in 160,000 pregnancies. Routine placental examination revealed a 2 cm papillary nodule with highly atypical trophoblastic cells that were hCG positive, with extensive necrosis and hemorrhage. Whole-body CT showed no metastases, and serial hCG levels became negative during follow-up. The authors argue the true incidence may be higher than reported, since placentas after normal deliveries are often not examined.

title: Inadvertent rupture of benign cystic teratoma does not impair future fertility.
title_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫の術中破裂は将来の妊孕性を損なわない
summary_ja: 1997〜2007年に腹腔鏡下で良性嚢胞性奇形腫を切除された生殖年齢女性の妊娠転帰を、電話調査で後方視的に検討した研究。転帰が得られた45例中16例で術中漏出があった。自然妊娠率は漏出群で高く、初回妊娠までの期間は両群で類似していた。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の漏出は長期不妊の原因とならないと結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective telephone-survey study examined reproductive outcomes in women of reproductive age who underwent laparoscopic removal of benign cystic teratoma between 1997 and 2007. Of 45 women with available outcomes, intraoperative spillage occurred in 35.6%. Spontaneous pregnancy rates were higher in the spillage group, while time to first pregnancy was similar. The authors conclude that spillage of benign cystic teratomas does not cause long-term infertility.

title: Withholding Recognized Effective Adjuvant Anti-Neoplastic Chemotherapy in a Setting with Known Highly Active Treatment for Recurrent Disease: A Case Report.
title_ja: 再発時に有効な治療法がある卵巣未熟奇形腫への補助化学療法見送り：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫(ステージIA、グレード2)の若年女性で、補助化学療法を見送るかどうかの判断に直面した症例報告。再発時に高い有効性が期待できる治療が利用可能であることが見送りの根拠となった。初回の補助療法と経過観察・救済治療との間の利害得失を示す症例である。
summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with a stage IA, grade 2 ovarian immature teratoma in whom the team faced the dilemma of withholding adjuvant chemotherapy that has documented clinical benefit. The rationale rested on the availability of highly effective treatment should the cancer recur. The report illustrates the trade-off between upfront adjuvant therapy and surveillance with salvage treatment in ovarian germ cell tumors.

title: Differences in total human chorionic gonadotropin immunoassay analytical specificity and ability to measure human chorionic gonadotropin in gestational trophoblastic disease and germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)免疫測定法の分析特異性の違い：胚細胞腫瘍と妊娠性絨毛性疾患における測定能
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 6種のhCG変異体の参照試薬に対し複数の免疫測定法を比較し、精巣・卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍とGTDの患者41例の血清hCGを測定した。hCGβおよびhCGβコア断片に対する認識能が測定法により大きく異なった。胚細胞腫瘍の4検体は測定法間で値が大きくばらつき、うち1例は市販測定法3種で大幅に過小評価された。
summary_en: This laboratory comparison tested several radioimmunoassays and commercial two-site immunoassays against six hCG variant reference reagents and measured serum hCG in 41 patients with germ cell tumors or gestational trophoblastic disease. Assay performance differed markedly for hCG variants, particularly hCGβ and the hCGβ core fragment. Four germ cell tumor samples varied widely between assays, and one was grossly underestimated by three commercial assays.

title: Screening for central nervous system disease in metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における中枢神経系疾患のスクリーニング
summary_ja: シェフィールドのトロホブラスト腫瘍センターで、高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍154例を対象にCNS浸潤の検索プロトコルを後方視的に評価した。CTで7例にCNS浸潤が認められ、腰椎穿刺単独では診断は得られなかった。神経症状のない絨毛癌患者のみをスクリーニング対象とすることを提案し、MRIを推奨している。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis from the Sheffield Trophoblastic Tumour Centre evaluated a protocol for screening for central nervous system involvement in 154 high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients. CT detected CNS involvement in 7 patients, and lumbar puncture alone never established a diagnosis. The authors suggest that only patients with choriocarcinoma need screening in the absence of neurological signs, and they prefer MRI head imaging for its sensitivity and safety.

title: Geographical distribution and demographic characteristics of gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: ブラジル・バイーア州における妊娠性絨毛性疾患の地理的分布と人口統計学的特徴
summary_ja: ブラジル・バイーア州の紹介センターで、妊娠性絨毛性疾患140例を後方視的に調査し、地域的・人口統計学的分布を検討した。胞状奇胎が75.7%、侵入奇胎が22.9%を占め、発生率は分娩1000件あたり8.5であった。患者の多くは州都を含む沿岸地域の20〜34歳で、教育水準・就労率は低かった。妊孕性の高い年齢層と社会経済的に不利な女性に多いと結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective review of 140 patients at a referral center in Bahia, Brazil, characterized the geographic and demographic distribution of gestational trophoblastic disease. Hydatidiform mole comprised 75.7% of cases and invasive mole 22.9%, with an incidence of 8.5 per 1,000 deliveries. Most patients came from the coastal capital region, were aged 20 to 34, and had low education and employment levels. The authors conclude GTD predominated among women of peak fertility age and unfavorable socioeconomic status.

title: Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma after human chorionic gonadotropin normalization following hydatidiform mole: a report of two cases.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎後にヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が正常化した後に生じた原発性肺絨毛癌：2症例の報告
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後にhCGが正常化した若年女性2例の原発性肺絨毛癌を報告する。1例は肺葉切除と肝切除を行ったが、化学療法中に肝転移が生じ、診断後3年で肝不全により死亡した。もう1例は孤立性肺腫瘤で、肺葉切除と化学療法により24か月間寛解を維持している。孤立性肺腫瘤を呈する若年女性では絨毛癌を考慮し、早期の化学療法と専門施設での外科的切除が予後改善に重要だと結論している。
summary_en: This report describes two young women with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma arising after a molar pregnancy, both with previously normalized serum hCG. One patient underwent lobectomy and hepatectomy for liver metastasis detected by PET, but died of hepatic failure three years after diagnosis. The other, with an isolated pulmonary mass and persistently elevated hCG, underwent lobectomy and then chemotherapy, and remains in remission at 24 months. Pathology and microsatellite analysis confirmed gestational origin. The authors stress considering choriocarcinoma in young women with an isolated lung mass, with early chemotherapy and surgical resection at specialized centers.

title: Recurrent gestational trophoblastic disease in a case of suspected quiescent gestational trophoblastic disease: a case report.
title_ja: 疑われた休止期絨毛性疾患の症例における再発性妊娠性絨毛性疾患:症例報告
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、完全奇胎の7年後に再発性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を発症した46歳の女性を報告している。追跡中にhCGが上昇し、メトトレキサートの単回投与とその後のエトポシド投与によりhCGは検出限界未満となった。3年後にβ-hCGが3.1 ng/mLに上昇したが、MRIおよびCTでは腫瘍は認められなかった。当初は休止期GTDが疑われたが、過剰糖鎖付加hCGを含む詳細な評価により再発性GTDと結論された。著者らは、再発リスクを減らすために初回の十分な化学療法が不可欠であると強調している。
summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 46-year-old woman with recurrent gestational trophoblastic disease seven years after a complete mole. After hCG elevation during follow-up, she received single-dose methotrexate and then etoposide, and hCG became undetectable. Three years later, beta-hCG rose to 3.1 ng/mL, but MRI and CT showed no tumor. Initially suspected to be quiescent GTD, the case was concluded to be recurrent GTD after detailed evaluation including hyperglycosylated hCG. The authors emphasize that adequate initial chemotherapy is essential to reduce the risk of recurrence.

title: Intrathoracic lymphadenopathy: sarcoidosis or metastatic seminoma? The diagnostic dilemma revisited.
title_ja: 縦隔リンパ節腫脹：サルコイドーシスか転移性セミノーマか？ 診断の難題の再検討
summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対して根治的精巣摘除を受け、経過観察中だった若年男性で、診断から2年以上後に肺門部および気管分岐下のリンパ節腫脹が出現した。転移性セミノーマが疑われたが、縦隔生検では腫瘍はなく非乾酪性肉芽腫が認められた。精巣胚細胞腫瘍とサルコイドーシス様の肉芽腫性炎症の関連を指摘し、再発診断には病理組織学的確認が不可欠だと強調している。
summary_en: A young man with stage I testicular seminoma, treated with radical orchiectomy and surveillance, developed hilar and subcarinal lymphadenopathy more than two years after diagnosis. Metastatic seminoma was suspected, but mediastinal biopsy showed noncaseating granulomas without tumor, consistent with a sarcoid-like reaction. The authors highlight the rare association between testicular germ cell tumors, particularly seminoma, and granulomatous inflammation. They stress that histological confirmation is essential before diagnosing seminoma relapse in patients with lymphadenopathy during surveillance.

title: Ovarian cystic teratoma torsion in pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の捻転
summary_ja: 右下腹部痛で救急受診した28歳の妊婦で、右卵巣の極めて大きな嚢胞性奇形腫に捻転を伴っていた症例報告である。妊娠中の腫瘤スクリーニングにはベッドサイドの超音波検査が有用で、腹腔鏡手術は診断と治療の双方に安全とされる。妊婦の急性腹痛では卵巣捻転を鑑別診断に含め、早期の外科的介入を行うべきだと結論している。
summary_en: A 28-year-old pregnant woman presented with right lower abdominal pain and was found to have an extremely large cystic teratoma of the right ovary complicated by torsion. The authors highlight that bedside ultrasonography is a readily available screening tool in pregnancy and that laparoscopic surgery is safe for both diagnosis and treatment. Because acute ovarian torsion is rare and difficult to diagnose in pregnancy, it should be kept in the differential diagnosis of pregnant women with acute abdominal pain, with early surgical intervention advised.

title: Cytoplasmic p21 expression levels determine cisplatin resistance in human testicular cancer.
title_ja: ヒト精巣がんにおけるシスプラチン耐性を規定する細胞質p21発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌におけるシスプラチン耐性の主要因として、CDK阻害因子p21の細胞質内高発現が同定された。難治性精巣がん患者の大多数で、EC成分に細胞質p21の高発現が認められた。細胞質p21はCDK2の阻害を介してEC細胞をシスプラチン誘導性アポトーシスから保護し、Akt阻害により核内へ移行させると感受性が回復した。Oct4/miR-106b/p21経路を標的とすることが、化学療法抵抗性の精巣がん等に対する新たな治療戦略となり得ると結論している。
summary_en: This study identifies high cytoplasmic expression of the CDK inhibitor p21 as a key determinant of cisplatin resistance in testicular embryonal carcinoma. Most refractory testicular cancer patients showed high cytoplasmic p21 in their EC component. Cytoplasmic p21 protected EC cell lines from cisplatin-induced apoptosis via CDK2 inhibition, and Akt inhibition relocalized p21 to the nucleus, restoring sensitivity. High cytoplasmic p21 was inversely associated with Oct4 and miR-106b family expression, suggesting that targeting the Oct4/miR-106b/p21 pathway could offer new treatment strategies for chemoresistant testicular and other cancers.

title: Testicular and para-testicular tumors in south western Nigeria.
title_ja: ナイジェリア南西部における精巣腫瘍および精巣傍腫瘍
summary_ja: 1989年から2005年にナイジェリア南西部の癌登録で確認された精巣および精巣傍組織腫瘍26例の後方視的研究である。精巣がんの発生率は10万人あたり0.55で、男性のがんの1.1%を占めた。横紋筋肉腫が最も多く、セミノーマは胚細胞腫瘍の50%であった。同地域では精巣がんの発生率が依然低く、セミノーマの減少により横紋筋肉腫が主要な腫瘍となっていると結論している。
summary_en: This retrospective study from the Ife-Ijesha cancer registry in southwestern Nigeria reviewed 26 histopathologically confirmed testicular and paratesticular tumors diagnosed from 1989 to 2005. Testicular cancer incidence was 0.55 per 100,000 men, accounting for 1.1% of male cancers. Rhabdomyosarcomas were the most common paratesticular and overall testicular tumor, while seminomas comprised 50% of germ cell tumors. The authors conclude that testicular cancer incidence remains low in the region and that declining seminoma frequency has made rhabdomyosarcoma the predominant tumor.

title: Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with no adjuvant chemotherapy in clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumours: long-term outcome and analysis of risk factors of recurrence.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する補助化学療法を行わない後腹膜リンパ節郭清：長期転帰と再発危険因子の解析
summary_ja: 1985年から1995年に、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の322例に補助化学療法を行わず後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した単施設の後方視的研究である。中央値17年の追跡で10年再発率は15.2%で、再発の大半は2年以内に生じた。pN+、pT>1、血管侵襲が再発予測因子だったが識別能は中等度であった。
summary_en: This retrospective single-centre study followed 322 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection without adjuvant chemotherapy, with a median follow-up of 17 years. The 10-year recurrence rate was 15.2%, and most recurrences occurred within two years. Recurrence was predicted by pN+, pT>1 and vascular invasion, but the model had modest discriminative ability and offered limited help in identifying high-risk patients.

title: Sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumor presenting as subcutaneous fluid collection initially treated as abscess.
title_ja: 皮下膿瘍として当初治療された仙尾骨部卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 生後11か月の女児にみられた仙尾骨部の性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。当初は皮下の液体貯留として膿瘍と治療されたが、後に排液する皮下結節となった。正中部の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は良性軟部組織病変に似るため、非典型的な膿瘍様病変の乳児では本疾患を考慮すべきと述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes an 11-month-old girl with a sacrococcygeal extragonadal yolk sac tumour that first presented as a subcutaneous fluid collection and was initially treated as an abscess. The lesion later became a draining subcutaneous nodule, which led to the correct diagnosis. The authors emphasise that midline extragonadal germ cell tumours can mimic benign soft tissue conditions and should be considered in infants with atypical abscess-like lesions.

title: Testicular cancer: Management challenges in an African developing country.
title_ja: 精巣がん：アフリカ途上国における治療の課題
summary_ja: 1984年から2003年に、ナイジェリアの2施設で精巣がんと診断された24例を前向きに追跡した研究である。多くは受診が遅れ、病期の進んだ例が多かった。主な組織型はセミノーマと胎児性癌で、患者の5分の1が死亡し、半数はフォローアップから脱落した。
summary_en: This prospective study followed 24 patients treated for testicular cancer at two centres in Nigeria between 1984 and 2003. Most patients presented late, with advanced stages in many cases, and seminoma and embryonal carcinoma were the most common histological types. Treatment consisted of radical orchidectomy with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and radiotherapy in some patients. A fifth of patients died and half were lost to follow-up, reflecting resource constraints.

title: Lethal, malignant, metastatic struma ovarii.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫の致死的・悪性・転移性症例
summary_ja: 45歳女性の左卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。手術後に濾胞型乳頭状癌が判明し、甲状腺全摘と放射性ヨウ素治療を受けたが、骨盤内再発と肝転移、腹膜播種を来した。診断から37か月後に悪液質で死亡した。卵巣甲状腺腫は血行性に広がりうると述べている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old woman with left ovarian struma ovarii that became malignant, with a follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma found after surgery. Despite total thyroidectomy and radioiodine therapy, she developed pelvic recurrence, hypervascular liver metastases and peritoneal carcinomatosis. She died of cachexia 37 months after diagnosis. The authors note that struma ovarii can spread haematogenously and that imaging reflects its mixed behaviour.

title: FDG-PET probe-guided surgery for recurrent retroperitoneal testicular tumor recurrences.
title_ja: 後腹膜に再発した精巣がんに対するFDG-PETプローブ誘導手術
summary_ja: 腫瘍マーカー上昇で再発を疑われた精巣がん3例に対し、FDG-PETプローブ誘導手術を施行した研究である。術前のPET/CTと術中所見は良好に一致し、標的対背景比は約5:1であった。術前PETで描出されなかった2cmの病変もプローブで検出され、すべてのプローブ陽性病変に生存腫瘍が認められた。
summary_en: This study evaluated FDG-PET probe-guided surgery in three patients with resectable second or third recurrences of testicular cancer detected by elevated tumour markers. Pre-operative FDG-PET/CT correlated well with intra-operative detection by a gamma probe, with a target-to-background ratio of about 5:1. In one patient, a 2 cm lesion not seen on pre-operative PET was found with the probe. All probe-positive lesions contained viable tumour on histology, suggesting the technique can help guide resection in hard-to-access retroperitoneal sites.

title: Primary lung seminoma in a 76-year-old man: a case report.
title_ja: 76歳男性に生じた原発性肺セミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 76歳男性に生じた原発性肺セミノーマの症例報告である。喀血と左下葉の腫瘤で受診し、外科的に左下葉切除を受けた。化学療法や放射線療法は行われず、術後140日で死亡した。免疫組織化学では胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼとCD117が陽性であった。
summary_en: This case report describes a 76-year-old man with a primary seminoma of the lung, presenting with haemoptysis and a left lower lobe mass. He underwent lobectomy without chemotherapy or radiotherapy and died 140 days later from dyscrasia and secondary seminoma in the left ribs. Immunohistochemistry was positive for placental alkaline phosphatase and CD117. The authors conclude that primary lung seminoma is rare in older men but highly malignant and metastatic.

title: Paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis in a patient with extragonadal choriocarcinoma--significance of onconeural antibodies.
title_ja: 性腺外絨毛癌に伴う傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎：抗オンコニューラル抗体の意義
summary_ja: 原因不明の辺縁系脳炎様症状を呈した31歳男性で、後腹膜に生じた絨毛癌が見つかった症例報告。血清抗Ma2抗体陽性から傍腫瘍性脳炎と確定した。根治的化学療法で腫瘍は制御されたが、神経症状は改善しなかった。若年男性の原因不明の脳炎では、抗Ma2抗体検査により潜在的な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を見つけることが推奨される。
summary_en: A 31-year-old man presented with eye motility dysfunction, dysarthria, depression, and disorientation that were initially unexplained by neurologic and imaging workup. Ultrasound revealed a retroperitoneal mass, and biopsy showed choriocarcinoma. Serum anti-Ma2 antibodies were positive, confirming a paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis. Curative chemotherapy controlled the tumor, but neurological symptoms did not improve. The authors recommend testing for anti-Ma2 antibodies in young men with unexplained limbic or brainstem encephalitis to uncover hidden extragonadal germ cell tumors.

title: Accumulation of bone-seeking agent in a patient with mediastinal seminoma.
title_ja: 縦隔セミノーマ患者における骨親和性製剤の集積
summary_ja: 胸骨下部痛と呼吸困難を呈した39歳男性の症例報告。骨シンチグラフィで前胸部に強い集積を認め、CTで前縦隔に境界明瞭な腫瘤が見つかった。コア針生検と病理組織学的検査により縦隔セミノーマと診断された。骨外への骨親和性製剤の集積を認識することは、骨シンチグラフィの診断価値を高めるとされる。
summary_en: A 39-year-old man with substernal pain and dyspnea showed intense uptake on bone scintigraphy in the anterior chest. Computed tomography revealed a well-demarcated anterior mediastinal mass, and core needle biopsy with histopathological examination confirmed mediastinal seminoma. The case illustrates extraskeletal uptake of a bone-seeking agent by a germ cell tumor. The authors argue that recognizing such nonosseous uptake can improve the diagnostic value of bone scintigraphy and prevent misinterpretation as bone metastasis.

title: Ovarian hemangioma occurring synchronously with contralateral mature cystic teratoma in an 81-year-old patient.
title_ja: 対側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と同時性に生じた81歳女性の卵巣血管腫
summary_ja: 高血圧と低ナトリウム血症を呈した81歳女性の症例報告。超音波検査で左卵巣に骨盤内腫瘤が見つかり、病理組織学的に9.5cmの成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。対側の右卵巣には偶発的に海綿状血管腫が認められた。対側の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と同時性に生じた卵巣血管腫の初例として報告されている。
summary_en: An 81-year-old woman with hypertension and hyponatremia had a left ovarian mass on ultrasonography. Histology confirmed a 9.5 cm mature cystic teratoma in the left ovary. Incidentally, a 3.5 cm cavernous hemangioma was found in the contralateral right ovary. The authors report this as the first case of an ovarian hemangioma occurring synchronously with a contralateral mature cystic teratoma, focusing on the rarity of the coexisting lesions and their incidental discovery in an elderly patient.

title: Adenocarcinoma of small intestinal type in retroperitoneal mature teratoma.
title_ja: 後腹膜成熟奇形腫に生じた小腸型腺癌
summary_ja: 間欠的な腹痛を呈した若年男性の症例報告。開腹術で切除された後腹膜の被膜に包まれた嚢胞性病変は、三胚葉すべての成熟組織を含んでいた。隣接する小腸粘膜に、間質浸潤のない小腸型腺癌が認められた。後腹膜成熟奇形腫から生じた小腸型腺癌の初例であり、早期発見により予後は良好と考察されている。
summary_en: A young man with intermittent abdominal pain was found to have an encapsulated retroperitoneal mass, which was resected at laparotomy. The cyst contained mature tissues from all three germ layers, including a fully developed intestinal tract. Adjacent to the small intestinal mucosa, a non-invasive adenocarcinoma of small intestinal type was identified, with p53 overexpression and a high Ki-67 index. This is reported as the first small intestinal adenocarcinoma arising in a retroperitoneal mature teratoma, a malignant transformation with favorable prognosis due to early detection.

title: A SRY-HMG box frame shift mutation inherited from a mosaic father with a mild form of testicular dysgenesis syndrome in Turner syndrome patient.
title_ja: 父親がモザイク型を示すターナー症候群患者におけるSRY遺伝子フレームシフト変異
summary_ja: ターナー症候群患者（モザイク核型45,X/46,XY）の性腺芽細胞腫と、その父親（モザイク46,XY）の精巣セミノーマの家系例。両者は同一の新規SRY変異（L94fsX180）を有していた。変異型SRYタンパク質が性腺芽細胞腫の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。SRY変異のないモザイク患者も悪性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを持つと強調されている。
summary_en: A Turner syndrome patient with a mosaic 45,X/46,XY karyotype and gonadoblastoma, and her father with a mosaic 46,XY karyotype and testicular seminoma, shared the same novel SRY frameshift mutation (L94fsX180) in the HMG box. The authors propose that the mutant SRY protein may contribute to gonadoblastoma development. They also emphasize that mosaic patients without SRY mutation remain at risk for malignant germ cell tumors, linking sex chromosome mosaicism and SRY variants with gonadal tumor risk.

title: Podoplanin, a novel marker for seminoma: A comparison study evaluating immunohistochemical expression of podoplanin and OCT3/4.
title_ja: セミノーマのマーカーとしてのポドプラニン：ポドプラニンとOCT3/4の免疫組織化学的発現の比較研究
summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍68例を対象に、セミノーマの免疫組織化学マーカーとしてポドプラニンをOCT3/4と比較した。ポドプラニンは全例でセミノーマ成分を染色し、胎児性癌は染色しなかった。胎児性癌の巣に隣接するセミノーマ細胞を同定し、セミノーマから胎児性癌が分化により生じるとの仮説を支持した。性腺外部位での鑑別に有用と考えられる。
summary_en: This study evaluates podoplanin as an immunohistochemical marker for seminoma in 68 testicular mixed germ cell tumors, comparing it with OCT3/4. Podoplanin stained seminoma components diffusely in all cases and did not stain embryonal carcinoma. Focal staining occurred in one third of choriocarcinomas. Podoplanin highlighted seminoma cell clusters adjacent to embryonal carcinoma foci, supporting the hypothesis that embryonal carcinoma arises from seminoma through differentiation. The marker may aid diagnosis, especially at extragonadal sites.

title: Expression of UTF1 in primary and metastatic testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発巣および転移巣におけるUTF1の発現
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発巣と転移巣計172例を免疫組織化学的に検討した。UTF1は精細管内胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマ、胎児性癌で高頻度に陽性で、卵黄嚢腫瘍では弱陽性、奇形腫と絨毛癌は陰性であった。非胚細胞腫瘍での陽性は少数にとどまった。強い染色は胎児性癌とセミノーマの診断補助になりうる。
summary_en: This immunohistochemical study evaluated UTF1 expression in 104 primary and 68 metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, plus 339 non-germ cell tumors. UTF1 was present in all intratubular germ cell neoplasias, seminomas, and embryonal carcinomas, with strong staining in most embryonal carcinomas and seminomas. Weak staining appeared in some yolk sac tumors, while teratomas and choriocarcinomas were negative. Only a few non-germ cell tumors showed weak staining. UTF1 expression in normal spermatogonia suggests a role in spermatogenesis. Strong UTF1 staining may aid diagnosis of embryonal carcinoma and seminoma.

title: Congenital orbital teratoma.
title_ja: 先天性眼窩奇形腫
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、左眼に突出する先天性眼窩腫瘤を呈した乳児を記述しており、その臨床像は奇形腫に典型的であった。病理組織学的検査では診断は確定しなかったが、臨床経過から奇形腫が強く示唆された。多職種による治療により乳児の生命が救われ、治療成績も向上した。6か月間の良好な追跡が記録されている。著者らは、疑われる奇形腫の症例では細胞診が不可欠であると強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes an infant with a protruding congenital orbital mass in the left eye, whose clinical features were typical of teratoma. Histopathology did not confirm the diagnosis, but the clinical course strongly suggested teratoma. Multidisciplinary management preserved the infant's life and improved outcomes. Six months of compliant follow-up was documented. The authors emphasize that cytological examination is essential for any suspected teratoma case. The report highlights how rare congenital orbital teratoma is and the value of coordinated care.

title: Intra-cardiac metastasis from testicular non-seminoma germ cell tumour; to resect or not to resect.
title_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍からの心臓内転移：切除すべきか否か
summary_ja: 右精巣腫瘤、胸部X線での多数の陰影、右心室内腫瘤を呈した32歳男性の症例報告である。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の心臓内転移と考えられた。議論の末、心臓内腫瘤は切除せず化学療法単独で治療された。治癒を目指した治療方針の判断について考察し、今後の症例への推奨を示している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a right testicular mass, numerous round shadows on chest radiography, and a large right ventricular intracardiac mass, representing metastasis from a non-seminomatous germ cell tumour. After multidisciplinary debate, he was treated with chemotherapy alone rather than resection of the cardiac mass, with the aim of cure. The authors discuss the rarity of cardiac metastasis and present recommendations for future patients. The report is relevant to management decisions for metastatic testicular germ cell tumours.

title: Giant primary retroperitoneal teratoma in an adult: a case report.
title_ja: 成人における巨大な原発性後腹膜奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 腹痛の精査中にコンピュータ断層撮影で発見された、巨大な原発性後腹膜奇形腫を有する32歳男性の症例報告である。組織学的に非典型的な腫瘍であった。成人の後腹膜奇形腫はまれで、治療方針の決定が難しい。評価と治療の経過、および文献的考察が示されている。
summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a giant primary retroperitoneal teratoma, discovered on computed tomography during evaluation of abdominal pain. Retroperitoneal teratomas are rare and present challenging management options. The tumor showed unusual histology. The authors describe the evaluation and treatment of the condition and review the relevant literature. The report highlights the difficulty of managing teratomas outside the gonadal and sacrococcygeal regions, where they typically arise in adults.

title: Oligodendroglioma arising in a mature cystic ovarian teratoma in a child.
title_ja: 小児の成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫から生じた乏突起膠腫
summary_ja: 左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に低悪性度の乏突起膠腫を伴った13歳女児の症例報告である。骨盤痛を主訴に来院し、開腹術と卵巣摘出術が施行された。奇形腫内には小脳組織を含む3胚葉の成熟組織が認められた。卵巣奇形腫由来の乏突起膠腫の小児例は初めての報告とされる。
summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with a left ovarian mass and two months of pelvic pain, diagnosed as mature cystic teratoma with a low-grade oligodendroglioma component. The mature teratoma contained tissues from all three germ layers, including cerebellar tissue. The neuroepithelial component showed uniform rounded cells with a fried-egg appearance. Treatment consisted of laparotomy and oophorectomy. This is described as the first pediatric case of oligodendroglioma arising in an ovarian mature teratoma, with prior reports limited to adults.

title: Expression of glypican 3 in placental site trophoblastic tumor.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍におけるグリピカン3(GPC3)の発現
summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)15例でGPC3の免疫染色を検討した研究。PSTTの80%と胎盤部結節が陽性であった。子宮頸部扁平上皮癌の陽性例はわずかで、子宮内膜腺癌は陰性であった。非栄養膜性腫瘍との鑑別に有用な補助マーカーとなる可能性が示された。
summary_en: This study examined glypican 3 (GPC3) immunohistochemistry in 15 placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT), along with placental site nodules, several uterine tumors, and non-neoplastic tissues. GPC3 was expressed in 80% of PSTT and in both placental site nodules, but only rarely in cervical squamous cell carcinoma and not in endometrial adenocarcinoma. Because PSTT can be confused with non-trophoblastic tumors, the authors suggest GPC3 may serve as a useful adjunctive immunohistochemical marker.

title: Mediastinal mature cystic teratoma perforating into the lung.
title_ja: 縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の肺穿孔
summary_ja: 縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が肺に穿孔した症例報告。臨床経過、CTおよび超音波検査所見、病理組織学的な穿孔の確認が記載された。奇形腫と肺の瘻孔の超音波所見はこれまで報告がなかった。正確な画像診断が外科的治療方針の決定に重要であることが示された。
summary_en: This case report describes a mediastinal mature cystic teratoma that perforated into the lung. The authors present the clinical manifestation, CT and ultrasound findings, and pathological confirmation of perforation without pulmonary invasion. They note that ultrasound features of a teratoma-lung fistula had not been described before. Because perforated cystic mediastinal teratoma is rare, accurate diagnosis and characterization of its complications are important for determining the surgical approach.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with therapeutic intent in men with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性に対する治療目的の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、2006年から2009年にかけて臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、治療目的で腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた26例を検討した。9例(35%)が病理学的病期II であった。pN1の6例中4例は補助化学療法を受けず無病で経過した。病期I の2例が後腹膜外で再発した。著者らは、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清は許容可能な腫瘍学的有効性と低い罹患率を示し、pN1患者は経過観察が安全である可能性があると結論づけている。
summary_en: This retrospective series reviews 26 patients who underwent therapeutic laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors between 2006 and 2009. Nine patients (35%) had pathologic stage II disease. Four of six patients with pN1 disease did not receive adjuvant chemotherapy and remained disease-free. Two patients with stage I disease recurred outside the retroperitoneum. The authors conclude that laparoscopic RPLND offers acceptable oncologic efficacy with reduced morbidity, and that pN1 patients may be observed safely pending longer follow-up.

title: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation: report of a rare and aggressive tumor.
title_ja: 絨毛癌分化を伴う卵巣明細胞癌：まれで侵襲性の高い腫瘍の報告
summary_ja: 閉経後の48歳女性に生じた、絨毛癌分化を伴う卵巣明細胞癌の症例報告。術前化学療法で部分奏効を得たのち減量手術が行われたが、術後11か月で死亡した。予後は極めて不良であり、両成分を標的とした術前化学療法が病変縮小に寄与する可能性が示された。
summary_en: This case report describes ovarian clear cell carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation in a 48-year-old postmenopausal woman with lung and liver metastases. Biopsy showed poorly differentiated carcinoma positive for CK7 and hCG. After six cycles of neoadjuvant chemotherapy with partial response, debulking surgery revealed a clear cell carcinoma with a striking choriocarcinoma component. Despite further chemotherapy, the disease progressed and the patient died 11 months after surgery. The authors suggest that neoadjuvant therapy targeting both components may help reduce disease volume before surgery.

title: A case of ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinoma with yolk sac tumor in a 35-year-old woman.
title_ja: 35歳女性における卵巣類内膜腺癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の合併例
summary_ja: 35歳の女性に、卵巣類内膜腺癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が同時に認められた症例を報告する。免疫組織化学染色により、2つの成分で異なるAFPおよびサイトケラチン7の染色パターンが示され、別個の系統に由来することが示唆された。BEP化学療法4コースの後、タキサンとカルボプラチンを2コース追加したが、病勢は制御できず、経過観察約12か月で患者は死亡した。著者らは、これらの成分の併存は極めてまれであり、英文文献では過去に12例のみが報告されていると指摘している。
summary_en: A 35-year-old woman with simultaneous ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinoma and a yolk sac tumor component is described. Immunohistochemistry showed distinct AFP and cytokeratin 7 staining patterns in the two components, supporting separate lineages. Treatment with four cycles of BEP chemotherapy followed by taxane and carboplatin for two cycles failed to control disease, and the patient died about 12 months after follow-up. The authors note that coexistence of these components is very rare, with only 12 prior cases in English literature.

title: Neonatal teratomas.
title_ja: 新生児奇形腫
summary_ja: 本総説は新生児奇形腫を扱い、これは発生部位にとって異質な組織から構成され、性腺性または性腺外、成熟または未熟に分類される。新生児症例の大半は良性で、仙尾部が最も多く、次いで前縦隔である。出生前診断が可能な場合が多く、胎児への介入が必要となることがある。治療は完全な外科的切除が推奨される。超音波、CT、MRIが手術計画の指針となり、AFPは残存または再発病変の検出に最も有用な腫瘍マーカーである。
summary_en: This review summarizes neonatal teratomas, which are composed of tissues foreign to their site of origin and are classified as gonadal or extragonadal and as mature or immature. Most neonatal cases are benign, with the sacrococcygeal region most common, followed by the anterior mediastinum. Prenatal diagnosis is often possible and may require fetal intervention. Complete surgical excision is the preferred treatment. Ultrasound, CT, and MRI guide surgical planning, and AFP is the most useful tumor marker for detecting residual or recurrent disease.

title: Dermoid cyst of the spermatic cord in children.
title_ja: 小児の精索類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 2歳男児の精索類皮嚢腫の症例報告。これまでの報告9例はすべて成人で、本例は最年少である。小児の鼠径部腫瘤の鑑別診断として、長期間持続し圧痛がなく還納不能な場合には本疾患も考慮すべきだと述べている。鼠径部間接ヘルニアとの鑑別が重要である。
summary_en: A 2-year-old boy with a dermoid cyst of the spermatic cord is reported, the youngest case described so far, as prior reports involved only nine adults. The authors recommend including this lesion in the differential diagnosis of pediatric inguinal masses, especially those that are long-standing, nontender, and irreducible. Such masses are often misread as indirect hernias, so awareness matters. The rarity of these lesions makes recognition particularly important in children.

title: Expression of various glutamate receptors including N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) in an ovarian teratoma removed from a young woman with anti-NMDAR encephalitis.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症した若年女性から摘出された卵巣奇形腫における各種グルタミン酸受容体の発現
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症した21歳女性で、回復後に右卵巣奇形腫を摘出した症例。腫瘍の免疫染色では、神経組織および未分化神経上皮組織にNMDARのNR2Bサブユニットを含む各種グルタミン酸受容体が豊富に発現していた。正常卵巣の卵母細胞にもNR2B関連の発現がみられた。卵巣奇形腫内の神経成分が抗NMDAR抗体産生に関与するという説を支持する所見である。
summary_en: This report describes a 21-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis who underwent resection of a right ovarian teratoma about five months after recovery. Immunohistochemistry of the tumor showed abundant expression of various glutamate receptors, including the NR2B subunit of NMDAR, GluR1 and GluR2/3, in neural and undifferentiated neuroepithelial tissue. Control ovaries also showed NR2B-related immunoreactivity in oocytes. The findings support the view that neural elements within ovarian teratoma contribute to the production of anti-NMDAR antibodies.

title: A case of a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 巨大仙尾部奇形腫の1例
summary_ja: 生後16日の女児に生じたIII型の巨大仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。胎生36週の出生前超音波検査で診断された。腫瘍は周囲組織から剥離され、尾骨とともに一塊として切除された。術後経過は順調で、6か月のフォローアップで機能的・整容的に良好であった。良性病変でも最大70%の症例で尾骨を含む根治的切除が必要であると強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes a 16-day-old girl with a large type III sacrococcygeal teratoma, first diagnosed at 36 weeks of gestation by prenatal ultrasound. The tumor was dissected from surrounding structures and removed en bloc together with the coccyx. Recovery after surgery was uneventful, and functional and cosmetic results were good at six-month follow-up. The authors emphasize that radical resection including the coccyx is needed in up to 70% of cases, even when the lesion is benign.

title: Can radiotherapy be a viable salvage treatment option for the relapsed seminoma confined to the infra-diaphragm region recurring after primary chemotherapy for bulky stage II seminoma?
title_ja: 巨大病変を伴う病期IIセミノーマの初回化学療法後に横隔膜下に限局して再発したセミノーマに対し、放射線療法は救済治療の選択肢となりうるか
summary_ja: 巨大病変を伴う病期IICセミノーマの1例。初回化学療法と残存腫瘤に対する手術の後に骨盤内で再発した。再発は横隔膜下の限局した領域にとどまり、救済放射線療法で治療された。救済放射線療法後3.7年の時点で再発は認められていない。限局した横隔膜下の化学療法後再発に対して放射線療法が救済治療となりうるとし、さらなる検討を求めている。
summary_en: This case report describes a patient with bulky stage IIC seminoma who relapsed in the pelvis after primary chemotherapy and surgery for a post-chemotherapy residual mass. The recurrence was confined to the infradiaphragmatic region and was treated with salvage radiotherapy. The patient remained free of relapse 3.7 years after salvage radiotherapy. The authors conclude that radiotherapy may be a salvage option for post-chemotherapy seminoma recurrence confined to a limited infradiaphragmatic area, and call for further study.

title: Outcome of different post-orchiectomy management for stage I seminoma: Japanese multi-institutional study including 425 patients.
title_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する精巣摘除術後の治療法別の転帰：日本の多施設共同研究（425例）
summary_ja: 本研究は1985〜2006年に日本の25施設で病期Iセミノーマに対し精巣摘除術を受けた425例を後方視的に解析した。10年無再発生存率はサーベイランス群79%、化学療法群および放射線療法群ではいずれも94%であった。再発の独立した予測因子は精巣網浸潤と精巣摘除術後の管理法であった。晩期再発の検出には長期フォローアップが不可欠である。
summary_en: This Japanese multi-institutional retrospective study analyzed 425 patients with stage I seminoma treated with orchiectomy between 1985 and 2006. Ten-year relapse-free survival was 79% with surveillance, versus 94% with chemotherapy or radiotherapy. Rete testis invasion and post-orchiectomy management were independent predictors of relapse. Overall survival at 10 years exceeded 99% in all groups. Because over half of patients were lost to follow-up within five years, the authors emphasize that long-term follow-up is essential for detecting late relapse.

title: Familial cystic teratomas: four case reports and review of the literature.
title_ja: 家族性嚢胞性奇形腫：4症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、母親と3人の娘に生じた4例の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）を報告したものである。いずれも左側に発生し、20代に定期的な婦人科検診で診断された。著者らは家族性発生の頻度、遺伝的連鎖、発症機序、診断、合併症、外科的管理について文献的に概説している。世代を超えた片側性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の報告は、本例を含めてもわずか3例にとどまる。
summary_en: This report describes four cases of mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) affecting a mother and her three daughters, all with left-sided tumors diagnosed in their twenties during routine gynecologic examinations. The authors review the familial incidence, genetic linkage, pathogenesis theories, diagnosis, complications and surgical management of these tumors. Familial cases are exceedingly rare, and the literature review identifies only two previous reports of unilateral mature cystic teratomas across generations. The paper underscores the value of screening family members.

title: Prognostic factors in patients with metastatic germ cell tumors who experienced treatment failure with cisplatin-based first-line chemotherapy.
title_ja: シスプラチン系一次化学療法後に治療失敗した転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者の予後因子
summary_ja: 本研究は、シスプラチン系一次化学療法後に進行した転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者の予後モデルを構築した国際多施設研究である。38施設の1,984例を解析し、学習群と検証群に無作為に分けた。組織型、原発巣、治療効果、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の値、肝・骨・脳転移などが独立した予後因子であった。2年無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は超低リスク群の75%から超高リスク群の6%に及び、救援化学療法の選択に役立つ。
summary_en: This international multicenter study developed a prognostic model for patients with metastatic germ cell tumors who progressed after cisplatin-based first-line chemotherapy. Using 1,984 patients from 38 centers, the authors randomly split the cohort into training and validation sets, with seminomas analyzed separately. Histology, primary site, response, progression interval, AFP and hCG levels, and liver, bone or brain metastases were independent prognostic variables. Two-year progression-free survival ranged from 75% in very low-risk to 6% in very high-risk patients, which can guide salvage treatment strategies.

title: [Anesthetic management of a low birth weight infant with giant sacrococcygeal teratoma].
title_ja: 巨大仙尾部奇形腫を有する低出生体重児の麻酔管理
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、巨大仙尾部奇形腫(Altman II型)を有する1,912g(腫瘍を含む)の低出生体重児の麻酔管理を報告したものである。胎児期に診断され、腫瘍を介した動静脈シャントによる心不全のため妊娠28週で緊急帝王切開により出生した。経鼻気管挿管と中心静脈カテーテルを用い、766gの腫瘍を全摘出した。一過性のアシドーシスと高カリウム血症が生じたが、安定した状態でNICUに移送された。
summary_en: This case report describes the anesthetic management of a low birth weight infant (1,912 g including the tumor) with a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma, Altman type II. The fetus was diagnosed prenatally, and the infant was delivered by emergency cesarean at 28 weeks because of heart failure from arteriovenous shunting through the tumor. Nasotracheal intubation and a central venous line guided volume infusion during complete resection of a 766 g tumor. Transient acidosis and hyperkalemia occurred, but the infant was transferred to the neonatal intensive care unit in stable condition.

title: Crucial function of histone deacetylase 1 for differentiation of teratomas in mice and humans.
title_ja: マウスおよびヒト奇形腫の分化におけるHDAC1の重要な役割
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞由来の奇形腫モデルを用いて、HDAC1欠損が奇形腫の分化と増殖に与える影響を検討した。HDAC1欠損奇形腫では増殖が亢進し、上皮様分化が低下していた。その原因としてSNAIL1の上昇が重要であった。ヒト奇形腫でもHDAC1の低下と悪性度の上昇が関連していた。HDAC1は良性奇形腫のマーカーとなりうると述べている。
summary_en: Using wild-type and HDAC1-deficient embryonic stem cells, the authors generated experimental teratomas in mice. HDAC1-deficient teratomas were similar in size but showed increased apoptosis and enhanced proliferation, with reduced epithelial differentiation. Upregulated SNAIL1 was crucial for this proliferative, less differentiated phenotype. Analysis of human teratomas revealed a similar link between HDAC1 loss and increased tumour malignancy. The authors propose HDAC1 as a potential marker that distinguishes benign teratomas.

title: Malignant transformation arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: a retrospective study of 20 cases.
title_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた悪性転化：20例の後方視的研究
summary_ja: 1988年から2008年に卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた悪性転化の治療を受けた20例を後方視的に検討した。扁平上皮癌が15例を占めた。11例が補助治療を受け、白金系化学療法が中心であった。1年の全生存率は70%で、年齢・病期・残存腫瘍量が全生存期間と関連した。白金/タキサン併用化学療法の有用性を示唆している。
summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 20 women treated between 1988 and 2008 for malignant transformation arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Most tumours were squamous cell carcinoma, and 11 patients were stage I. Eleven patients received adjuvant treatment, mainly platinum-based chemotherapy or chemoradiation. The one-year overall survival rate was 70%. Age, stage, and residual tumour were significantly associated with overall survival. The authors suggest that combination platinum/taxane chemotherapy is a reasonable option.

title: Gestational choriocarcinoma transmission following multiorgan donation.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の多臓器提供による伝播
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌を有していた多臓器提供者から、4人の移植患者へ癌が伝播した症例を報告。hCG上昇により診断され、膵腎移植例は化学療法で2年間寛解を維持した。肝移植例は腸管転移により死亡し、心移植例はびまん性転移を来した。免疫抑制患者における高い悪性度と、化学療法や移植臓器摘出の検討の必要性が示された。
summary_en: The authors report accidental transmission of placental choriocarcinoma from a pregnant multiorgan donor to four recipients. Diagnosis was established by rising hCG levels. One pancreas-kidney recipient remained in remission for 2 years after chemotherapy without graft removal. A single-kidney recipient underwent transplantectomy and actinomycin treatment and remains in remission. The liver recipient developed intestinal metastasis and died, while the heart recipient developed diffuse metastasis despite an initial response to EMA-CO. The authors suggest that chemotherapy with or without transplantectomy should be considered in such cases.

title: A rare case of intrarenal teratoma in a 6-month-old male.
title_ja: 生後6か月男児の稀な腎内奇形腫の症例
summary_ja: 生後6か月の男児に発生した、Wilms腫瘍様に発症した稀な腎内奇形腫の症例報告。術前生検により診断を明確にし、不要な化学療法を回避できた。SIOPガイドラインでは臨床・画像所見のみでWilms腫瘍と診断されるが、英国CCLGのガイドラインに従った生検が鑑別に有用であったことが示された。小児における過剰治療の防止に生検が役立つと結論づけられている。
summary_en: The authors report a rare intrarenal teratoma in a 6-month-old boy who presented as a Wilms tumor would. Under SIOP guidelines, Wilms tumor is diagnosed on clinical and imaging findings before neoadjuvant chemotherapy. Because the patient underwent biopsy before treatment according to UK (CCLG) guidelines, the diagnosis was clarified and unnecessary chemotherapy was avoided. He was successfully managed with primary nephrectomy. The case highlights the value of pre-treatment biopsy in distinguishing intrarenal teratoma from Wilms tumor in pediatric patients.

title: Retropleural teratoma presenting as an abdominal mass in a 9-month-old boy.
title_ja: 胸膜後腔に発生した奇形腫が腹部腫瘤として発症した9か月男児例
summary_ja: 9か月男児の右側腹部腫瘤として発症した、胸膜後腔に由来する奇形腫の初めての症例報告。腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内で、画像検査では後腹膜腫瘤が疑われたが、手術で横隔膜の上方から発生していたことが判明した。病理では悪性所見のない成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。術前画像では横隔膜が不明瞭な場合があり、慎重な手術計画が必要と結論づけられている。
summary_en: The authors present a 9-month-old boy with a large right-sided abdominal mass that proved to be a retropleural teratoma, the first such report. Tumor markers were normal, and imaging suggested a retroperitoneal mass. At surgery, the tumor was found to arise above the diaphragm in the retropleural space. Histology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma without malignant features. The patient remained disease-free at 7-year follow-up. The authors caution that preoperative imaging may inaccurately depict the diaphragm and recommend careful surgical planning for tumors near the diaphragm.

title: ASCO Clinical Practice Guideline on Uses of Serum Tumor Markers in Adult Males With Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍における血清腫瘍マーカー使用に関するASCO臨床診療ガイドライン
tags: ガイドライン・コンセンサス
summary_ja: 成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍における血清腫瘍マーカーの使用に関するASCO診療ガイドライン。組織型ごとに腫瘍マーカーの特性が異なるため、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のそれぞれについて、モニタリングとサーベイランスにおける使用を検討している。摘要は簡潔で、具体的な推奨内容は記載されていない。
summary_en: This ASCO clinical practice guideline addresses the use of serum tumor markers in adult males with germ cell tumors. It examines how markers should be used for monitoring and surveillance separately for seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, reflecting the different marker profiles of these histologic subtypes. The abstract is brief and does not state specific recommendations. The guideline is relevant to clinicians managing testicular germ cell tumor patients for treatment response and relapse detection.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫
summary_ja: 本神経画像報告は、Type II仙尾部奇形腫の臨床像と放射線学的所見を示し、その病理学的特徴、画像所見、外科的管理について概説している。仙尾部奇形腫は小児に多い胚細胞腫瘍の一型であり、臨床、画像、病理の所見を対応させた本症例の提示は、診断と手術計画の理解に役立つ。
summary_en: This neuroimage report describes the clinicoradiological presentation of a Type II sacrococcygeal teratoma. It summarizes the pathological features, radiological findings, and surgical management of the tumor. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is a common germ cell tumor in children, and imaging findings are important for diagnosis and surgical planning. The report provides a concise illustrative case with clinical, imaging, and pathological correlation.

title: Metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia complicated by tumor lysis syndrome, heart failure, and thyrotoxicosis: a case report.
title_ja: 転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に合併した腫瘍崩壊症候群、心不全および甲状腺中毒症：症例報告
summary_ja: 本症例報告は、肺転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の17歳女性例を示す。EMA-CO療法後にグレード4の腫瘍崩壊症候群と腎不全を発症し、ラスブリカーゼ投与により尿酸値が正常化し透析を回避した。その後、心不全のためアクチノマイシンDに変更され、β-hCGは5コース後に陰性化した。GTNへのラスブリカーゼ使用は初の報告である。
summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old woman with metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia to the lungs, presenting with anemia, thyrotoxicosis, and elevated beta-hCG. After the first EMA-CO cycle she developed grade 4 tumor lysis syndrome with renal failure, which did not respond to hydration and allopurinol. A single dose of rasburicase normalized uric acid and reversed renal failure, avoiding dialysis. Later she developed heart failure and was switched to actinomycin-D, and beta-hCG became negative after five cycles. The authors report this as the first use of rasburicase for TLS in GTN.

title: Prepubertal testicular tumors: a 20-year experience with 40 cases.
title_ja: 思春期前精巣腫瘍：40例の20年間の経験
summary_ja: 本研究は、20年間に治療した思春期前精巣腫瘍40例を検討し、外科的アプローチのアルゴリズムを提案する。超音波検査で良性と疑われた腫瘍はすべて術後に良性と確認された。術前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫の乳児で有意差があった。精巣温存手術後、1例の奇形腫を除き再発や精巣萎縮はみられなかった。
summary_en: This study reviews 40 cases of prepubertal testicular tumors treated over 20 years to propose a surgical algorithm. All tumors suspected as benign on ultrasonography were confirmed benign after surgery. Preoperative AFP levels differed significantly between infants with yolk sac tumor and those with teratoma. Teratoma was the most common histologic subtype. Testis-sparing surgery was performed in several patients, and apart from one teratoma case, none had recurrence or testicular atrophy. The authors propose an algorithm based on ultrasonographic findings and preoperative AFP to guide surgical decisions.

title: Complications with massive sacrococcygeal tumor resection on a premature neonate.
title_ja: 早産新生児における巨大仙尾部奇形腫切除の合併症
summary_ja: 在胎34週で出生した早産新生児の、Altman3型の巨大仙尾部奇形腫切除に対する麻酔管理を報告した症例報告。高カリウム血症で手術が2日遅延し、腫瘍崩壊により全身状態が悪化した。術中は大量輸血を要する出血、腫瘍による換気困難、呼吸性アシドーシス、体温管理の問題が生じた。術後は良好に回復し退院した。
summary_en: This case report describes anesthetic management of a 34-week premature newborn undergoing resection of a massive Altman type 3 sacrococcygeal teratoma. Surgery was delayed two days due to hyperkalemia, and tumor lysis worsened the patient's condition. Intraoperative challenges included major bleeding requiring massive transfusion, difficult ventilation from the tumor pressing on the chest, respiratory acidosis, and temperature control.
