summary_ja: Swyer症候群(46,XY)患者の混合型GCT症例。二次無月経と同時にGCT発症。XY核型患者はGCT発症リスクが高い。化学療法と手術で治療。核型診断の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case of 46,XY patient with Swyer syndrome presenting with secondary amenorrhea and mixed GCT (dysgerminoma with gonadoblastoma). Highlights that XY karyotype patients have higher GCT incidence. Managed with chemotherapy followed by surgery.

title: Obstetric Results after Fertility-Sparing Management of Non-Epithelial Ovarian Cancer.
title_ja: 非上皮性卵巣癌に対する妊孕性温存治療後の産科的転帰
summary_ja: 卵巣GCT84例とSCST62例の妊孕性温存治療成績。5年・10年無再発生存率91%・83%。36・60・120ヶ月の妊娠率は13.24%・20.75%・42.37%。治療後2年間は厳密な経過観察が必要。
summary_en: Outcomes of fertility-sparing surgery in 146 patients with non-epithelial ovarian cancer (GCT n=84, SCST n=62). 5- and 10-year disease-free survival were 91% and 83%. Cumulative childbearing rates at 36, 60, and 120 months were 13.24%, 20.75%, and 42.37%.

title: Habitual physical activity modulates cardiometabolic health in long-term testicular cancer survivors.
title_ja: 習慣的身体活動は精巣がんの長期生存者の心代謝健康を調整する
summary_ja: 195人の精巣GCT長期生存者(治療後平均11.7年)を対象に身体活動と心代謝健康を調査。高い身体活動はメタボリック症候群低下と心代謝改善と関連し、特にI-II期で顕著。
summary_en: Cross-sectional study of 195 long-term testicular germ cell tumor survivors (mean 11.7 years post-therapy) examining effects of habitual physical activity on metabolic syndrome and cardiometabolic markers. Higher physical activity associated with lower metabolic syndrome prevalence and improved profiles.

title: Evaluation of calcification distribution by CT-based textural analysis for discrimination of immature teratoma.
title_ja: 未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫の鑑別のためのCT基盤のテクスチャ解析による石灰化分布の評価
summary_ja: 32人の小児患者(平均年齢14.5歳)を対象にCT画像解析で成熟・未熟奇形腫を鑑別。成熟奇形腫は均一性が高く、未熟腫瘍は相関性と不均一性が高い。石灰化分布は治療選択に有用。
summary_en: Study of CT-based textural analysis to differentiate mature and immature ovarian teratomas in 32 pediatric patients (mean age 14.5 years). Calcification distribution showed higher homogeneity in mature teratomas; immature tumors showed higher entropy. Calcification texture is potential biomarker for treatment.

title: Combined chemotherapy and pembrolizumab salvages multi-chemotherapy agent and avelumab resistant choriocarcinoma: A case report.
title_ja: 化学療法とペムブロリズマブの併用は、多剤化学療法およびアベルマブに耐性の絨毛癌を救済する：症例報告
summary_ja: 多剤・avelumab耐性絨毛癌症例をペムブロリズマブ併用化学療法で治療。完全hCG奏効と陰性PET-CTを達成。チェックポイント阻害薬がGTN治療の新しい選択肢として有用。
summary_en: Case of chemotherapy and immunotherapy-resistant gestational choriocarcinoma (GTN) successfully treated with escalated etoposide/cisplatin combined with pembrolizumab. Patient had failed prior methotrexate, actinomycin-D, and avelumab. Achieved complete hCG response and negative PET-CT.

title: Cervical Benign Teratoma: Case Report and Review of Literature.
title_ja: 頸部良性奇形腫:症例報告と文献レビュー
journal: Indian J Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg
summary_ja: 成人に発生した頸部良性奇形腫の症例で、術前に誤診されていた。成人では極めてまれだが、正中の嚢胞性頸部腫脹の鑑別診断として考慮すべきである。悪性転化の可能性があるため、完全な外科的切除が推奨される。
summary_en: Case of benign teratoma of the neck in an adult, which was preoperatively misdiagnosed. Extremely rare in adults but should be considered in differential diagnosis of midline cystic neck masses. Complete surgical resection recommended due to potential malignant transformation.

title: Differences in future life expectancy of testicular germ-cell tumor patients vs. age-matched male population-based controls.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者と年齢をマッチさせた男性の一般人口対照群との将来余命の差異
summary_ja: 20,935人の精巣GCT患者を分析し年齢層別集団対照と比較。非精上皮腫III期で最大22%のOS低下。非がん死亡率はI-II期で小さいがIII期で高い。
summary_en: SEER database analysis of 20,935 testicular GCT patients (2004-2014) comparing overall survival with age-matched male population controls. Nonseminoma stage III showed greatest OS difference (22% lower). Other-cause mortality rates were marginal in stages I-II.

title: Oropharyngeal Teratoma: Five-Month-Old Presenting With Failure to Thrive and Severe Obstructive Sleep Apnea.
title_ja: 口咽頭奇形腫:体重増加不良と重症閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸を呈した生後5か月児
summary_ja: 生後5か月の女児で、体重増加不良、哺乳困難、重症閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸を呈した口咽頭奇形腫の症例報告である。病理組織学的検査で、グリア組織と腸管組織を伴う成熟奇形腫と確定した。診断の難しさと悪性転化の可能性について論じている。
summary_en: Case of oropharyngeal teratoma in a 5-month-old female presenting with failure to thrive, feeding difficulty, and severe obstructive sleep apnea. Pathology confirmed mature teratoma with glial and intestinal tissue. Discusses diagnostic challenges and malignant transformation risk.

title: Parental occupational exposure to solvents and risk of developing testicular germ cell tumors among sons: a French nationwide case-control study (TESTIS study).
title_ja: 両親の職業性溶剤曝露と息子の精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスク:フランス全国症例対照研究(TESTIS研究)
summary_ja: 親の職業的溶剤暴露と精巣GCTリスクの関連を調査（454症例、670対照）。父親の溶剤暴露はOR 0.89で関連なし。1970年代生まれの母親の燃料暴露でリスク増加(OR 2.74)。
summary_en: French nationwide case-control study (454 cases, 670 controls) examining association between parental occupational solvent exposure and testicular germ cell tumor risk. Paternal exposure showed OR 0.89; maternal exposure in 1970s birth cohort suggested increased risk with petroleum-based solvents.

title: Treatment trends in brain metastases from testicular cancer in the United States.
title_ja: 米国における精巣がんからの脳転移の治療動向
summary_ja: 精巣がん由来脳転移の治療動向を全国データベースから分析。全脳放射線療法より立体定位放射線治療(SRS)で生存率向上。5年生存率はSRS群で最高を達成。
summary_en: Analysis of treatment trends for brain metastases from testicular cancer using the National Cancer Database (2010-2015). Most patients received whole-brain radiation therapy (WBRT) rather than stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS). SRS group showed improved 5-year overall survival.

title: A large dermoid cyst of the spermatic cord.
title_ja: 精索の大きな類皮嚢腫
summary_ja: 成人の精索に生じた10cmの類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。類皮嚢腫は嚢腫性奇形腫の良性亜型であるが、悪性転化の稀な可能性があるため、慎重な病理学的評価が必要であった。確定診断には病理組織学的検査が不可欠であった。
summary_en: Case report of a 10 cm dermoid cyst of the spermatic cord in an adult. Benign variant of cystic teratoma requiring careful pathological evaluation due to rare risk of malignant transformation. Histopathological examination essential for definitive diagnosis.

title: Neurogenic Monodermal Teratoma in the Scapula of a Child: A Case Report.
title_ja: 小児肩甲骨の神経原性単胚葉奇形腫:症例報告
summary_ja: 6歳女児の肩甲骨における神経原生単一性奇形腫(NMT)の症例。卵巣以外の骨発生が初めて報告された。31ヶ月無増殖。神経原生単一性奇形腫は骨にも発生し得ることを実証。
summary_en: Case report of neurogenic monodermal teratoma (NMT) with choroid plexus predominance in the scapula of a 6-year-old girl. First report of NMT occurring in bone rather than ovary. No progression at 31 months follow-up, demonstrating teratomas can arise in skeletal sites.

title: Risk Factors for Relapse in Nonseminomatous Testicular Cancer After Postchemotherapy Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection With Viable Residual Cancer.
title_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清における生存腫瘍を伴う非セミノーマ性精巣がんの再発リスク因子
summary_ja: 化学療法後のリンパ節転移巣に生存可能な非奇形腫型GCTを有する117人の多施設研究。監視療法と補助化学療法間で生存率に有意差なし。生存がん細胞<10%の残存病変は良好な進行無再発生存率と関連。
summary_en: Analysis of 117 men with viable nonteratomatous GCT in postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimens. No significant survival difference between surveillance and adjuvant chemotherapy. Residual disease with <10% viable cancer cells associated with better progression-free survival.

title: Tumor lysis syndrome in premature infant prompting early resection of a large sacrococcygeal teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 早産児における大型仙尾部奇形腫の早期切除を促す腫瘍崩壊症候群:症例報告
summary_ja: 未熟児の仙尾部奇形腫における自発的腫瘍崩壊症候群(TLS)の症例。ラスブリケース投与と生後40時間での早期切除で対応。SCTにおけるTLS認識・治療と早期切除の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of spontaneous tumor lysis syndrome (TLS) in a very preterm infant with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Managed with rasburicase and early surgical resection at 40 hours of life. Emphasizes recognition and management of TLS in SCT patients.

title: Causes of death after testicular cancer diagnosis: a US population-based analysis.
title_ja: 精巣がん診断後の死亡原因:米国集団ベース分析
summary_ja: SEER登録データから44,975人の精巣がん患者を分析。3,573例の死亡例のうち38.2%が診断後1-5年で発生。精巣がん自体と他のがんが主な死因で、長期生存者では心疾患が非がん死因の最多。
summary_en: Population-based analysis of 44,975 testicular cancer patients from SEER database (2000-2018). Among 3,573 deaths, 38.2% occurred 1-5 years post-diagnosis from the cancer itself or other malignancies. Heart disease was the most common non-cancer cause in long-term survivors.

title: Malignant germ cell tumor of fallopian tube with rhabdomyosarcoma: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 横紋筋肉腫を伴う卵管の悪性胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 34歳女性における横紋筋肉腫を含む卵管の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。外科的切除および化学療法(BEP/EP)で治療；24ヶ月の無腫瘍生存を達成し、腫瘍マーカーおよび画像フォローアップは正常。
summary_en: Case report of 34-year-old woman with mixed germ cell tumor of fallopian tube containing rhabdomyosarcoma. Treated with surgical resection and chemotherapy (BEP/EP regimens); achieved 24-month tumor-free survival with normal tumor markers and imaging follow-up.

title: The long non-coding RNA transcript, LOC100130460 (CAND1.11) gene, encodes a novel protein highly expressed in cancer cells and tumor human testis tissues.
title_ja: 長鎖非コードRNA転写産物LOC100130460(CAND1.11)遺伝子は、癌細胞および腫瘍ヒト精巣組織で高く発現する新規タンパク質をコード化する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣がんにおける新規lncRNA由来タンパク質CAND1.11の発現を報告。正常精巣と比較してがん組織で高発現を示し、精巣がん、特にセミノーマにおける増殖・分化制御に関与する可能性のある予後バイオマーカーとして提案された。
summary_en: Study of CAND1.11, a long non-coding RNA producing a protein highly expressed in testicular cancers including seminoma. The protein is overexpressed in cancer tissues compared to normal testis, suggesting potential as a prognostic biomarker for testicular cancer proliferation.

title: Analysis of microsatellite instability (MSI) in pediatric gonadal and extra-gonadal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 小児性腺および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍におけるマイクロサテライト不安定性(MSI)の解析
summary_ja: 小児GCT 21例（性腺9例、腹腔外12例）のMSI分析。1例がMMRタンパク質欠損（卵黄嚢腫瘍、1歳）。全例PCRとNGSでマイクロサテライト安定性を示した。
summary_en: Analysis of microsatellite instability (MSI) in 21 pediatric GCTs (9 gonadal, 12 extragonadal). One case with mismatch repair protein deficit by immunohistochemistry (yolk sac tumor, age 1). All cases were microsatellite stable by PCR and NGS, consistent with adult GCT data.

title: Treatment of Immature Teratoma Associated with Ovarian Endometrioma: A Case Report.
title_ja: 卵巣子宮内膜症に関連した未熟奇形腫の治療:症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣内膜症に合併した未熟奇形腫（GCT）患者の症例報告。大量化学療法と卵巣温存手術で治療。奇形腫の成熟化と卵巣機能温存を達成。
summary_en: Case report of a 34-year-old woman with immature ovarian teratoma (a malignant GCT type) associated with endometrioma and infertility. Treated with neoadjuvant high-dose chemotherapy and fertility-sparing surgery, achieving teratoma maturation and preserving ovarian function.

title: Choriocarcinoma complicated with intra-abdominal and intrapleural hemorrhage in pregnancy - case report.
title_ja: 妊娠中の腹腔内および胸腔内出血を伴う絨毛癌-症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠29週前に発症した転移性絨毛癌（GCT）の症例報告。腹腔内・胸腔内出血で緊急帝王切開と止血手術を実施。EMA-CO化学療法で完全奏効を達成。
summary_en: Case report of choriocarcinoma developing before 29 weeks gestation with metastatic hemorrhagic complications. Emergency cesarean section and multiple surgeries performed for hemorrhage control. Achieved complete response to EMA-CO chemotherapy with favorable maternal outcome, though neonate had prematurity-related complications.

title: Refractory primary mediastinal malignant germ cell tumor with multiple systemic metastases: A rare case report.
title_ja: 複数の全身転移を伴う難治性一次性縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍:稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 42歳男性の原発性縦隔GCT（腹腔外GCT）の症例報告。化学療法抵抗性を示し、肝臓を含む多臓器転移。放射線療法・化学療法にもかかわらず進行。診断後8ヶ月で死亡。
summary_en: Case report of a 42-year-old man with primary mediastinal malignant GCT (an extragonadal GCT type) with refractory disease and multiple systemic metastases including liver involvement. Despite radiotherapy and chemotherapy modification, disease progressed with multiple organ dysfunction. Died 8 months after diagnosis.

title: Surgical resection in patient with teratoma with somatic-type malignancy transformed into rhabdomyosarcoma resulted in long-term survival.
title_ja: 体性型悪性腫瘍を伴う奇形腫が横紋筋肉腫に形質転換した患者における外科的切除は長期生存をもたらした
summary_ja: 精巣GCT（肉腫形質転換奇形腫）の複数の肺および縦隔転移患者の症例報告。複数の外科治療と化学療法で8年以上の生存を達成。
summary_en: Case report of a 43-year-old man with testicular GCT (teratoma with somatic-type malignancy/rhabdomyosarcoma transformation) with pulmonary and mediastinal metastases. Multiple surgeries combined with sequential chemotherapy achieved >8 years survival despite challenging refractory disease.

title: A case of prostatic metastasis from non-seminomatous testicular cancer.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんからの前立腺転移の症例
summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマGCT（未熟奇形腫、胚細胞癌、絨毛癌、セミノーマ）の前立腺転移症例。稀な病態（報告例10例）。腫瘍マーカー上昇と多臓器転移を示した。
summary_en: Case of a 57-year-old man with non-seminomatous testicular GCT (immature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, seminoma) with concurrent prostatic metastasis. Rare presentation with only 10 cases reported. Showed elevated tumor markers and multiple organ involvement.

title: Extraovarian Dysgerminoma Involving the Uterine Cervix: A Rare Case Report With Literature Review.
title_ja: 子宮頸部に関連する性腺外ディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫):稀な症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 子宮頸部の原発性腹腔外ジスジェルミノーマ（GCT）の初報告症例。46歳女性。根治的子宮摘出術とBEP化学療法を実施。14ヶ月後無再発。
summary_en: First-ever case report of primary extraovarian dysgerminoma (a female GCT type) involving the uterine cervix in a 46-year-old woman. Combined surgical approach (radical hysterectomy) and adjuvant BEP chemotherapy was effective. No recurrence at 14 months follow-up.

title: Surveillance as a safe and effective option for treatment of stage I seminoma.
title_ja: 病期I セミノーマの治療における安全で有効な選択肢としての積極的監視
summary_ja: 55例の病期I セミノーマ患者を比較した後方視的研究：積極的監視、補助放射線療法、補助カルボプラチン。全アプローチで類似の3年無増悪生存率(92～100%)。全体10年全生存率は98.2%。積極的監視は安全で有効なモダリティ。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 55 stage I seminoma patients comparing surveillance, adjuvant radiotherapy, and adjuvant carboplatin. All approaches achieved similar 3-year PFS (92-100%). Overall 10-year OS was 98.2%. Surveillance safe with early detection of relapses occurring within first 24 months.

title: Subsets of preoperative sex hormones in testicular germ cell cancer: a retrospective multicenter study.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における術前性ホルモン部分集合:後方視的多施設研究
summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者518例の術前性ホルモン濃度を検討した多施設研究。3つのホルモンクラスターを同定。GCT組織が性ホルモン関連遺伝子を発現し、現地合成を示唆。
summary_en: Multicenter study examining preoperative sex hormone profiles in 518 testicular GCT patients (354 seminoma, 164 NSGCT). Identified three distinct hormonal clusters ('neutral,' 'testicle,' 'pituitary') with different hormone levels. TGCT tissue expressed sex hormone-related genes suggesting in-situ synthesis.

title: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with concurrent metastasis to the mother and child: a systematic literature review.
title_ja: 母体と児に同時転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍:システマティック文献レビュー
summary_ja: 母と児の両者への転移を伴うGTN 22例の系統的レビュー。母体診断までの中央値は産後6週。化学療法感受性が高いが、予後は診断までの時間と β-hCG値に依存。
summary_en: Systematic review of 22 reported cases of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) with concurrent metastasis to both mother and baby. Median time to maternal diagnosis was 6 weeks post-partum. High chemosensitivity but prognosis dependent on time to diagnosis and β-hCG levels.

title: Paradoxical Expression of R-10G-reactive Antigen in Human Testicular Embryonal Carcinoma.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胎児性癌におけるR-10G反応性抗原の逆説的発現
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 精巣GCT 83例125個のコンポーネントにおけるR-10G反応抗原の発現を定量分析。胚細胞癌は強い標識、セミノーマは陰性、非EC非セミノーマ腫瘍は可変的局所発現。
summary_en: Study quantitatively analyzing R-10G-reactive antigen expression in 125 GCT components from 83 testicular specimens. Embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells showed strong R-10G labeling, most seminomas were negative, and non-EC NSGCTs showed variable focal expression, suggesting R-10G as a diagnostic marker for EC.

title: A case of complete remission of intractable gestational choriocarcinoma with subsequent chemotherapy after pembrolizumab.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の難治例に対し、ペムブロリズマブ投与後の化学療法で完全寛解を得た症例
summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌の38歳女性の症例報告である。ペムブロリズマブ投与後、パクリタキセルとカルボプラチンおよびパクリタキセルとエトポシドを交互に用いる化学療法により完全寛解を得た。免疫療法が後続の化学療法の効果を高める可能性を示している。
summary_en: Case report of a 38-year-old woman with high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma achieving complete remission after pembrolizumab followed by alternating paclitaxel/carboplatin and paclitaxel/etoposide chemotherapy. Demonstrates potential role of immunotherapy in improving subsequent chemotherapy efficacy.

title: A small mature cystic ovarian teratoma associated with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and acute respiratory failure: A case report.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎および急性呼吸不全を伴った小型の成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫:症例報告
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症した小型成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫（GCT）の症例報告。精神症状、痙攣、呼吸不全で発症。腹腔鏡下卵巣切除術後に完全寛解。
summary_en: Case report of a 37-year-old woman with small (3 × 2.3 cm) mature cystic ovarian teratoma (a GCT type) presenting with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis manifesting as psychiatric symptoms, seizures, and acute respiratory failure. Complete recovery after laparoscopic oophorectomy.

title: Primary immature teratoma of the liver in an adult: Case report.
title_ja: 成人の肝原発未熟奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 成人女性における原発性肝未熟奇形腫(性腺外胚細胞腫瘍)の症例報告であり、臨床像と画像所見の特徴を記述している。本報告は、奇形腫の発生起源と性腺外奇形腫の定義を背景として、成人の原発性肝奇形腫を提示するものである。肝奇形腫は極めて稀で、全奇形腫症例の1%未満を占め、成人よりも小児に多い。
summary_en: Case report of primary immature hepatic teratoma (an extragonadal GCT) in an adult woman. Describes clinical presentation and imaging characteristics. Hepatic teratomas are extremely rare, accounting for <1% of all teratoma cases and more common in children.

title: Dose comparison of robustly optimized intensity modulated proton therapy (IMPT) vs IMRT and VMAT photon plans for testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する、ロバスト最適化強度変調陽子線療法(IMPT)とIMRT・VMAT光子線計画の線量比較
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 病期IIセミノーマ(精巣の胚細胞腫瘍)を対象とした比較治療計画研究である。陽子線療法(IMPT)は、IMRTおよびVMATの光子線計画と比べて危険臓器への放射線線量を低減した。全体的な二次がんリスクおよびほとんどの臓器別リスクも低下させる可能性が示された。
summary_en: Comparative treatment planning study for stage II seminoma (a testicular GCT). Proton therapy (IMPT) reduced radiation dose to organs at risk compared to both IMRT and VMAT photon plans, potentially reducing overall secondary cancer risk and organ-specific risks.

title: Characterizing Lymphovascular Invasion in Pediatric and Adolescent Malignant Ovarian Nongerminomatous Germ Cell Tumors: A Report from the Children's Oncology Group.
title_ja: 小児および思春期の悪性卵巣非ジャーミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍におけるリンパ管・血管侵襲の特徴:Children's Oncology Group報告
summary_ja: 小児・思春期卵巣非ゲルミノーマGCTのリンパ管侵襲を分析。50.6%にLVI認め、ステージと年齢に関連。中間リスク群でEFSおよびOSに影響なし。
summary_en: Analysis of lymphovascular invasion (LVI) in pediatric and adolescent malignant ovarian nongerminomatous GCTs. LVI present in 50.6% of 83 patients with documented LVI status; more common in stage II/III disease and age >11 years. LVI did not impact EFS or OS in intermediate-risk group.

title: A remarkable response to combination chemotherapy with nivolumab and ipilimumab in a patient with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌患者においてニボルマブとイピリムマブの併用化学療法に顕著な奏効を示した症例:症例報告
summary_ja: 術後再発した原発性肺絨毛癌患者の症例報告。カルボプラチン、パクリタキセル、ニボルマブ、イピリムマブの併用治療で12ヶ月の持続的奏効を達成。
summary_en: Case report of a 72-year-old man with post-surgery relapsed primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma (a GCT type) successfully treated with carboplatin, paclitaxel, nivolumab, and ipilimumab. Achieved sustained response for 12 months despite PD-L1 negativity, with manageable adverse events.

title: Primary Gamma Knife Radiosurgery for pineal region tumors: A systematic review and pooled analysis of available literature with histological stratification.
title_ja: 松果体部腫瘍に対する初回ガンマナイフ定位放射線治療:組織学的層別化を伴う系統的レビューおよびプール解析
summary_ja: 松果体領域腫瘍に対するガンマナイフ放射線治療の系統的レビュー。76例中GCT 4例（確認2例、推定2例）。GCTの3年生存率60%、無増悪生存率33.3%。
summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of primary Gamma Knife radiosurgery for pineal region tumors. Among 76 patients, 4 were GCTs (2 confirmed, 2 presumed germinomas). Three-year OS for GCTs was 60%; PFS was 33.3%. GCTs and high-grade gliomas predicted disease progression.

title: Mitochondrial metabolism-related signature depicts immunophenotype and predicts therapeutic response in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における免疫表現型の把握と治療反応性の予測を可能にするミトコンドリア代謝関連シグネチャー
summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおけるミトコンドリア代謝関連遺伝子の予後相関を明らかにした。2つの分子サブタイプを同定し、異なる免疫表現型と治療応答を示した。8遺伝子リスク特性モデルを構築。
summary_en: Study identifying mitochondrial metabolism-related gene signatures in testicular GCT. Found two molecular subtypes with distinct immunophenotypes, drug sensitivity, and immunotherapy response. Developed 8-gene risk model for prognostic evaluation and personalized treatment.

title: Excellent survival in relapsed stage I testicular cancer.
title_ja: 再発した病期I精巣がんにおける優れた生存
summary_ja: スイスの2施設で2010〜2020年に治療された初回臨床病期I(CSI)の胚細胞腫瘍患者を後方視的に解析した。CSI患者360例のうち22.5%が再発し、再発例の大半は予後良好因子を有していた。5年全生存期間(OS)はセミノーマで100%、非セミノーマで87%であり、積極的監視により早期発見が可能で良好な生存が得られることが示された。
summary_en: Analysis of stage I testicular GCC patients with relapse after active surveillance. 22.5% relapsed with predominantly good prognosis features. Five-year OS was 100% for seminomas and 87% for non-seminomas, demonstrating early detection enables excellent survival.

title: Ototoxicity associated with high-dose carboplatin for patients with previously treated germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 前治療を受けた胚細胞腫瘍患者における大量カルボプラチンに関連した耳毒性
summary_ja: 高用量炭プラチン化学療法を受けたGCT患者の難聴に関する研究。89%が音声周波数で中度から高度難聴を発症し、22%が補聴器が必要。基線高周波数低下が悪い転帰を予測した。
summary_en: Study of hearing loss in GCT patients receiving high-dose carboplatin chemotherapy. 89% developed moderate to profound hearing loss in speech frequencies; 22% needed hearing aids. Baseline high-frequency loss predicted worse outcomes.

title: Management strategy and outcomes of sacrococcygeal teratoma - an Egyptian multicenter experience.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の管理戦略および転帰 - エジプト多施設経験
summary_ja: エジプトの95人の仙尾部奇形腫患者の多施設後方視的研究（2013-2023）。74.7%がAltman type I/IIに分類、82%が良性成熟奇形腫。5年全生存期間(全生存率)および無病生存率は各94%、91%。手術アプローチと長期合併症（尿路/腸機能障害）について検討。
summary_en: Multicenter retrospective study of 95 sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients in Egypt (2013-2023). 74.7% classified as Altman type I/II; 82% showed benign mature teratoma. 5-year overall and event-free survival rates 94% and 91%. Discusses surgical approaches and long-term morbidity including urinary/bowel dysfunction.

title: Autoimmune hemolytic anemia due to mediastinal teratoma: A case report and review article.
title_ja: 縦隔奇形腫による自己免疫性溶血性貧血：症例報告および総説
summary_ja: 26 歳女性の前縦隔奇形腫による自己免疫溶血性貧血（AIHA）症例。初期のステロイド治療は有効だったが減量時に再発。前縦隔奇形腫の外科的切除により溶血が完全に解消。
summary_en: Case of autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA) as complication of mediastinal teratoma in a 26-year-old female. Initial steroid treatment was successful but disease relapsed upon dose reduction. Surgical resection of mediastinal teratoma resulted in complete resolution of hemolysis.

title: Neither inguinoscrotal hernia nor hydrocele misunderstood giant testicular neoplasm. Case report and literature review.
title_ja: 鼠径陰嚢ヘルニアでも水瘤でもなく誤解された巨大精巣腫瘍。症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 最初は鼠径陰嚢部ヘルニアと誤診された巨大精巣セミノーマ腫瘍（17×10×9 cm）で対側水瘤を伴う症例。精巣悪性腫瘍と良性陰嚢病変の鑑別診断の困難性と適切な術前計画のための追加画像検査の重要性について述べている。
summary_en: Case of giant seminomatous testicular neoplasm (17×10×9 cm) initially misdiagnosed as inguinoscrotal hernia with ipsilateral hydrocele. Discusses diagnostic challenges in distinguishing testicular malignancy from benign scrotal pathology and importance of additional radiologic imaging for proper preoperative planning.

title: Characterizing the mutational burden, DNA methylation landscape, and proteome of germ cell tumor-related somatic-type malignancies to identify the tissue-of-origin, mechanisms of therapy resistance, and druggable targets.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍関連体細胞型悪性腫瘍の変異負荷、DNAメチル化パターン、プロテオームの特性化による組織由来、治療抵抗性のメカニズム、および治療標的の同定
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: GCT 由来体細胞型悪性腫瘍（STM）の分子的、エピジェネティック、プロテオミクス的な包括的特性化。癌由来 STM が yolk sac tumor に類似し、肉腫由来 STM が奇形腫に類似することを示す。FGF シグナル伝達経路変異と新規バイオマーカー（EFEMP1、MIF）を治療標的として同定。
summary_en: Comprehensive molecular, epigenetic, and proteomic characterization of GCT-related somatic-type malignancies (STM). Shows carcinoma-derived STM resemble yolk sac tumors while sarcoma-derived STM resemble teratomas. Identifies FGF signaling pathway mutations and novel biomarkers (EFEMP1, MIF) as therapeutic targets.

title: Incidence, clinical characteristics, and survival outcomes of ovarian strumal diseases: a retrospective cohort study.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫疾患の発生率、臨床特性および生存転帰：後方視的コホート研究
summary_ja: 卵巣構造疾患（卵巣甲状腺腫、甲状腺腫カルチノイド、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫）の後方視的コホート研究。卵巣甲状腺腫は卵巣奇形腫の2.14%を占め、12.0%および4.7%がそれぞれ転移する可能性がある。優れた長期生存転帰。
summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of ovarian strumal diseases (struma ovarii, strumal carcinoid, malignant struma ovarii) in teratoma patients. Struma ovarii accounts for 2.14% of ovarian teratomas with 12.0% and 4.7% transforming into strumal carcinoid and malignant struma ovarii. Excellent long-term survival outcomes.

title: Alpha-fetoprotein-elevated postpubertal testicular teratoma with retroperitoneal metastasis on (18)F-FDG PET/CT: case report and literature review.
title_ja: αフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇を伴う思春期後精巣奇形腫の後腹膜転移：(18)F-FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)/コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: AFP 上昇を示す 17 歳の思春期後精巣奇形腫で巨大な後腹膜転移を伴う症例。成熟組織学的像にもかかわらず、画像と腫瘍マーカーが潜在的な悪性成分を示唆。PET/CT による転移検出と予後予測の価値を示す。
summary_en: Case of 17-year-old with postpubertal testicular teratoma showing elevated AFP and massive retroperitoneal metastasis with high FDG uptake. Despite mature histology, imaging and tumor markers suggested occult malignant components. Demonstrates value of PET/CT in detecting metastasis and predicting prognosis.

title: Mediastinal Presentation of Testicular Embryonal Carcinoma.
title_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の縦隔転移
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞癌（非精上皮腫瘍）の希少な臨床発表の症例：触知可能な精巣腫瘤がない状態での鎖骨上リンパ節腫大と前縦隔転移。標準的な BEP 化学療法と化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清による診断と治療を述べる。
summary_en: Case report of testicular embryonal carcinoma (nonseminomatous GCT) with unusual presentation: supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and mediastinal metastasis without palpable testicular mass. Discusses diagnosis and treatment with standard BEP chemotherapy and post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

title: Adverse health outcomes and global quality of life in long-term testicular cancer survivors: a longitudinal 30-year perspective.
title_ja: 精巣がん長期生存者における有害健康転帰とグローバル生活の質：30年縦断的観点
summary_ja: 精巣がん生存者427人の30年縦断調査（1980-1994年診断）。末梢神経障害、レイノー現象、耳鳴り、難聴などの有害健康転帰を追跡。高用量シスプラチン群は有意に増加した長期合併症を示したが、全体的HrQoLは一般人口と同等。
summary_en: 30-year longitudinal follow-up of 427 testicular cancer survivors diagnosed 1980-1994. Tracks adverse health outcomes (neuropathy, Raynaud's phenomenon, tinnitus, hearing loss) and quality of life. High-dose cisplatin group shows significantly increased long-term complications but overall HrQoL comparable to general population.

title: Ovarian squamous cell carcinoma associated with teratoma: a report of six cases with genomic analysis.
title_ja: 奇形腫に由来する卵巣扁平上皮癌：ゲノム解析を伴う6症例報告
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の卵巣扁平上皮癌（肉腫様亜型含む）6症例の臨床病理学的およびゲノム解析。全症例がPD-L1発現および高い腫瘍変異負荷を示した。PIK3CA、TP53、TERT、相同組換え修復遺伝子に頻出変異。免疫チェックポイント阻害薬およびPARP阻害薬の効果が示唆される。
summary_en: Clinicopathologic and genomic analysis of 6 ovarian squamous cell carcinomas (including sarcomatoid variant) arising from mature cystic teratomas. All showed PD-L1 expression and high tumor mutation burden. Identified mutations in PIK3CA, TP53, TERT, and homologous recombination genes, suggesting immunotherapy and PARP inhibitor benefits.

title: Histopathologic Patterns of Ovarian Tumors in Hawassa University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Southern Ethiopia.
title_ja: 南エチオピアのハワッサ大学総合専門病院における卵巣腫瘍の組織病理学的パターン
summary_ja: エチオピアにおける 187 例の卵巣腫瘍の組織病理学的研究。胚細胞腫瘍が 29.4% を占め、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が最も一般的な良性腫瘍（良性例の 37.8%）。表面上皮腫瘍が全体で優位で、次に性索間質腫瘍が続く。
summary_en: Histopathologic study of 187 ovarian tumors in Ethiopia. Germ cell tumors account for 29.4% of cases with mature cystic teratomas as the most common benign tumor (37.8% of benign cases). Surface epithelial tumors predominate overall, followed by sex cord-stromal tumors.

title: Prenatal MRI diagnosis and outcomes of abdominal or sacrococcygeal teratomas and parasitic fetuses.
title_ja: 腹部または仙尾部奇形腫および寄生双胎児の出生前磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)診断と転帰
summary_ja: 胎児腹部および仙尾部奇形腫と寄生胎児 60 症例の MRI 診断研究（仙尾部奇形腫 52 症例、寄生胎児 8 症例）。画像パターンと出生後転帰を分析。MRI の高い診断精度と良好な予後を示すが、IV型腫瘍は合併症が多い。
summary_en: MRI imaging study of fetal abdominal and sacrococcygeal teratomas (60 cases including 52 sacrococcygeal and 8 parasitic fetuses). Analyzes imaging patterns and postnatal outcomes. Demonstrates high diagnostic accuracy of MRI with generally favorable prognosis, though type IV tumors prone to complications.

title: Parasitic mature cystic ovarian teratoma: A rare case of autoimplantation of a twisted dermoid cyst.
title_ja: 寄生性成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫：捻転類皮嚢腫の自己移植の稀な症例
summary_ja: ねじれに伴う自動移植を起こした成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫（皮様嚢胞）の寄生性病変の稀な症例。精巣外寄生性奇形腫の診断の困難性を述べ、通常は腹腔内腫瘤の外科的探索中に術中に診断されることを示す。
summary_en: Rare case of parasitic mature cystic ovarian teratoma (dermoid cyst) with autoimplantation following torsion. Discusses diagnostic challenges in identifying extragonadal parasitic teratomas, typically discovered intraoperatively during surgical exploration.

title: Analysis of a mouse germ cell tumor model establishes pluripotency-associated miRNAs as conserved serum biomarkers for germ cell cancer detection.
title_ja: マウス胚細胞腫瘍モデルの解析は、多能性関連マイクロRNA(miRNA)を胚細胞腫瘍検出の保存された血清バイオマーカーとして確立する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 悪性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の血清バイオマーカーとしての miR-290-295 クラスター（ヒト miR-371-373 ホモログ）を確立したマウスモデル研究。腫瘍保有マウスの血清で検出されるが対照群では検出されない。モデルの妥当性を検証し、早期 TGCT 検出の向上の可能性を示唆。
summary_en: Mouse model study establishing miR-290-295 cluster as conserved serum biomarker for malignant testicular germ cell tumors, homologous to human miR-371-373. Detected in serum of tumor-bearing mice but not controls or mice with benign teratomas. Validates mouse model and highlights potential for improved early TGCT detection.

title: Clinical characteristics and prognostic models of gonadal and extra-gonadal yolk sac tumors: a population-based analysis in children and adolescents.
title_ja: 性腺および性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の臨床的特性および予後モデル：小児および思春期患者における集団ベース解析
summary_ja: SEER データベースから 520 人の小児 yolk sac tumor 患者の人口ベース研究（2000-2018年診断）。年齢、性別、原発部位（精巣内対精巣外）、治療方法が独立した生存予測因子であることを明らかにした。小児・青年の YST リスク層別化のための予後ノモグラムを開発。
summary_en: Population-based cohort study of 520 pediatric yolk sac tumor patients from SEER database (2000-2018). Identifies age, gender, primary site (gonadal vs. extragonadal), and treatment regimen as independent survival predictors. Develops prognostic nomogram for YST risk stratification in children and adolescents.

title: Cytopathologic diagnosis of extragonadal germ cell tumors: A 10-year institutional review.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の細胞病理診断：10年間の機関内レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍の細胞病理学的診断の35症例（32人の男性患者）の10年機関レビュー。体腔液細胞診、穿刺吸引細胞診、コア生検の高い診断精度を実証。先制化学療法の使用を考慮した初期診断の正確性の重要性を強調。
summary_en: 10-year institutional review of cytopathologic diagnosis of extragonadal germ cell tumors in 35 cases from 32 male patients. Demonstrates high diagnostic accuracy of fluid cytology, FNA, and core biopsy techniques. Emphasizes importance of initial accurate diagnosis given widespread use of neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

title: Colorectal Adenocarcinoma Derived From Mature Cystic Teratomas: A Case Report With Review of the Literature.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する大腸腺癌：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 中年女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた大腸腺癌の症例。奇形腫由来の体細胞悪性腫瘍と転移性癌の鑑別の課題を論じている。正確な同定と病期分類のための免疫組織化学と十分なサンプリングの重要性を強調している。
summary_en: Case of colorectal adenocarcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma in a middle-aged woman. Discusses diagnostic challenges in distinguishing teratoma-derived somatic malignancies from metastatic cancers. Highlights importance of immunohistochemistry and thorough sampling for correct identification and staging.

title: Struma Ovarii with Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma and Metastasis to the Appendix: A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫と虫垂転移：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の2%未満を占めるまれな腫瘍である卵巣甲状腺腫は良性生物学的特性を持つが、稀（3%）に悪性転化する。最も一般的な悪性転化は乳頭状甲状腺癌である。41歳女性は腹部腫瘤で来院し、濾胞性亜型の乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う悪性卵巣甲状腺腫および虫垂転移を有することが判明し、包括的な外科的管理が必要であった。
summary_en: Struma ovarii is a rare teratoma (<2% of ovarian teratomas) with benign biology but rare (3%) malignant transformation. Most common malignant transformation is papillary thyroid carcinoma. This 41-year-old woman presented with abdominal mass, found to have malignant struma ovarii with follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma and appendiceal metastasis requiring comprehensive surgical management.

title: Pediatric presacral tumors with intraspinal extension: a rare entity with diagnostic challenges.
title_ja: 脊髄内伸展を伴う小児仙骨前腔腫瘍：診断的課題を伴う稀な疾患
summary_ja: 仙骨前腔は原始胚細胞を含み、腫瘍の起源となる。脊髄内伸展を伴う小児仙骨前腔腫瘍の6症例を報告。未熟および悪性仙尾部奇形腫、神経芽細胞腫などを含み、腫瘍の中心位置と骨関与のパターンなどの特性により鑑別が可能。
summary_en: The presacral space contains primitive germ cell types serving as tumor origin. This case series of six pediatric presacral tumors with intraspinal extension includes immature sacrococcygeal teratoma, malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma, and other sarcomas. Imaging features including tumor epicenter, bone involvement, and internal characteristics aid differentiation of these diverse tumors.

title: Gestational choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌
summary_ja: 妊娒関連絨毛がんは妊娒栄養膜疾患の5%を占める。FIGO分類で低リスクと高リスクに分類され、化学療法で治癒率が高い。局所病変は外科手術なしに化学療法で治癒でき、生殖能温存が可能である。
summary_en: Gestational choriocarcinoma accounts for 5% of gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, occurring after molar pregnancies (50%), term pregnancies (25%), or other gestational events (25%). FIGO scoring stratifies patients into low and high-risk disease. Most patients are cured with chemotherapy; <5% die from multi-drug resistance, prompting exploration of immunotherapy and novel combinations.

title: RET/PTC rearrangement in papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in malignant struma ovarii with abdominal wall metastasis and cervical thyroid gland: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫から生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌におけるRET/PTC再構成で、腹壁転移と頸部甲状腺を伴う：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は50%以上の甲状腺組織を含む稀な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、悪性転化はさらに稀。47歳女性が両側付属器腫瘤と腹壁腫瘤を示し、卵巣甲状腺腫内の乳頭状甲状腺癌と腹壁転移と頸部甲状腺癌と診断され、すべてRET/PTC1再構成を有していた。
summary_en: Struma ovarii is a rare mature cystic teratoma with >50% thyroid tissue; malignant transformation is even rarer. This case presents a 47-year-old woman with bilateral adnexal masses and abdominal wall mass revealing papillary thyroid carcinoma within struma ovarii with abdominal wall metastasis and concurrent cervical thyroid cancer—all harboring RET/PTC1 rearrangement.

title: Systematic Review of the Survival Outcomes of Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Women with Malignant Ovarian Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍女性における新補助化学療法の生存転帰に関するシステマティックレビュー
summary_ja: 新補助化学療法(NACT)は進行上皮卵巣癌の高異形度漿液性癌を中心に研究。本システマティックレビューは15研究を検討し、ほとんどの患者がブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンを投与。NACTと一次減量手術の奏効率と生存転帰は同等。
summary_en: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) for advanced epithelial ovarian cancer predominantly targets high-grade serous carcinomas. This systematic review of 15 studies examined NACT efficacy for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (MOGCT). Most patients received bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin. NACT and primary debulking surgery showed similar complete response rates and comparable survival outcomes.

title: Molecular Characterization of Patients with Cryptorchidism: Preliminary Search for an Expression Profile Related to That of Testicular Germ-Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 停留精巣患者の分子学的特性化：精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関連する発現プロファイルの予備的検索
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 停留精巣は精巣胚細胞腫瘍発症の危険因子である。本研究では停留精巣患者、TGCT患者および対照群の精巣組織を分析し、GCT関連マーカー（POU5F1、PLAP、KIT）およびマイクロRNA（miR-371-373、miR-367）を検査した。停留精巣患者の16.7%が原位置胚細胞新生物と同様のGCT様発現パターンを示した。
summary_en: Cryptorchidism is a risk factor for testicular germ-cell tumor development. This study analyzed testicular tissues from cryptorchidism patients, TGCT patients, and controls for GCT-related markers (POU5F1, PLAP, KIT) and microRNAs (miR-371-373, miR-367). 16.7% of cryptorchidism patients showed GCT-like expression patterns similar to germ cell neoplasia in situ.

title: A Case of Testicular Tumor Presenting as Acute Scrotum.
title_ja: 急性陰嚢症として発症した精巣腫瘍の症例
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)は最も一般的な精巣悪性腫瘍で、通常は無痛性結節として発症。本症例は25歳男性の急性陰嚢症で、精巣捻転の疑いが高かったが、外科的探査により混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、非定型的発症を示している。
summary_en: Germ cell tumors (GCT) are the most common testicular malignancies, typically presenting as painless nodule or swelling. This case presents a 25-year-old male with acute scrotum highly suspicious for testicular torsion, but surgical exploration revealed mixed germ cell tumors, demonstrating an atypical presentation requiring high clinical suspicion for accurate diagnosis.

title: Testicular Seminoma Presenting as Gastrointestinal Bleeding: A Rare Cause of Metastatic Disease in the Stomach.
title_ja: 胃腸出血として呈する精巣セミノーマ：胃の転移性疾患の稀な原因
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの胃転移は稀である。本症例は上部消化管出血として発症し、精巣セミノーマと診断された。詳細な身体診察と病歴聴取が診断に重要である。GCT転移の稀な臨床像を示す。
summary_en: Gastric metastases are infrequent; those from testicular germ cell tumors typically arise from nonseminomas. This case presents a 45-year-old man with upper gastrointestinal bleeding from gastric ulcers, elevated lactate dehydrogenase, and retroperitoneal masses, subsequently diagnosed with testicular seminoma with gastric and retroperitoneal metastases, demonstrating an unusual manifestation of GCT.

title: Primary Immature Renal Teratoma in a Neonate.
title_ja: 新生児における原発性未熟腎奇形腫
summary_ja: 奇形腫は一般的に性腺から生じるが、腎臓からの発症は稀。未熟腎内奇形腫は非常にまれで、これまで4症例が報告。本症例は新生児における初の報告例で、小児患者における性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の知見を広げる。
summary_en: Teratomas commonly originate from gonads but rarely from kidney. Immature intrarenal teratomas are exceptionally rare, with only four cases previously reported. This case presents the fifth immature intrarenal teratoma documented and the first in a neonate, expanding knowledge of extragonadal germ cell tumor presentations in pediatric patients.

title: Outcomes of relapsed clinical stage I versus de novo metastatic testicular cancer patients: an analysis of the IGCCCG Update database.
title_ja: 再発臨床病期I対新規転移性精巣がん患者の転帰：IGCCCG Update データベースの分析
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の積極的監視は臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍の推奨管理で15～30%の再発率を伴う。本IGCCCG更新データベース分析では、臨床病期Iから再発した症例と新規転移性疾患患者を比較し、同一の予後分層内では同等の生存転帰を示し、より強力な治療による不要な毒性を回避できる可能性を示唆した。
summary_en: Active surveillance after orchiectomy is preferred for clinical stage I testicular germ-cell tumors with 15-30% relapse rate. This IGCCCG database analysis compared outcomes of gonadal GCTs relapsing from stage I to de novo metastatic disease. Relapsed stage I patients showed similar survival to de novo patients of the same IGCCCG prognostic group, potentially avoiding unnecessary toxicity.

title: Congenital Immature Grade ΙΙΙ Teratoma of the Neck: A Case Report.
title_ja: 先天性未熟奇形腫(グレードIII)の頸部：症例報告
summary_ja: 奇形腫は三つの胚葉由来の構造を含む稀な胚細胞腫瘍で、ほとんどは良性だが悪性化することがある。仙尾部領域が最も一般的な部位で、頸部奇形腫は非常に稀である。本症例は12カ月齢児における巨大な頸部腫瘤で、外科切除で成功し、グレードIII未熟奇形腫と診断されて術後再発なし。
summary_en: Teratoma is a rare germ cell tumor containing structures derived from all three embryonic germ layers. While most are benign, some become malignant. Sacrococcygeal region is the most common location, with neck teratomas being very rare. This case presents a 12-month-old child with a huge neck mass found to be immature grade III teratoma, treated successfully with surgical excision.

title: Fertility-Preserving Surgery in a Young Nulligravid Woman with Bilateral Coexistence of a Granulosa Cell Tumor with a Teratoma.
title_ja: 両側卵巣顆粒膜細胞腫と奇形腫共存を有する若年未産女性における生殖機能温存手術
summary_ja: 顆粒膜細胞腫と奇形腫の共存は極めて稀であり、術前診断が困難である。本症例の24歳女性は両側卵巣に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と顆粒膜細胞腫を有していた。卵巣温存手術により生殖能が保存された。
summary_en: Coexistence of granulosa cell tumor with teratoma is extremely rare and cannot be diagnosed preoperatively. This 24-year-old nulligravid woman presented with bilateral adnexal masses initially imaging as teratomas. Bilateral oophorectomy for fertility preservation revealed bilateral mature cystic teratomas coexisting with granulosa cell tumors, demonstrating the importance of histopathological confirmation.

title: Choriocarcinoma in tubal pregnancy: A case report.
title_ja: 卵管妊娠における絨毛癌:症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娒関連絨毛がんは卵管妊娠として発症した場合、診断が困難である。本症例は組織診により同定され、EMA-CO化学療法により完全奏効を得た。異所性妊娠患者の組織学的確認が診断に重要である。
summary_en: Gestational choriocarcinoma is a malignant epithelial tumor of chorionic villi following pregnancy. This case presents a 34-year-old woman initially diagnosed with ruptured tubal pregnancy, but histology revealed primary tubal choriocarcinoma. Six cycles of EMA-CO chemotherapy achieved complete remission with normalized beta-hCG after three cycles, with no metastasis on follow-up.

title: CSNK1G2-AS1 promotes metastasis, colony formation and serves as a biomarker in testicular germ cell tumor cells.
title_ja: CSNK1G2-AS1は精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞の転移、コロニー形成を促進しバイオマーカーとして機能する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 長いnon-codingRNAのCSNK1G2-AS1は、正常精巣と比較して精巣胚細胞腫瘍で有意に低下した発現を示す。本研究では、CSNK1G2-AS1過剰発現がクローン形成、浸潤および遊走を促進し、アポトーシスを阻害することをEMTおよびAKT媒介シグナル伝達経路を通じて見出し、潜在的治療標的として確立した。
summary_en: Long non-coding RNA CSNK1G2-AS1 shows significantly decreased expression in testicular germ cell tumors compared to normal testis. This study found that CSNK1G2-AS1 overexpression promoted clone formation, invasion, and migration while inhibiting apoptosis through EMT and AKT-mediated signaling pathways, establishing it as a potential therapeutic target.

title: Primary mediastinal seminoma presenting with paraneoplastic anti-Hu encephalitis: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 傍腫瘍症候群性抗Hu脳炎で発症した原発性縦隔セミノーマ:症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマは極めて稀な腫瘍である。本症例は両側難聴、神経障害、失調を呈した19歳男性で、高力価のanti-Hu抗体を有する縦隔セミノーマが診断された。文献上このような症例は非常に稀である。
summary_en: Primary mediastinal seminomas are exceedingly rare tumors localized to the anterior mediastinum. This case describes a 19-year-old male presenting with bilateral hearing loss, progressive neuropathy, and ataxia, subsequently found to have mediastinal seminoma with high-titer anti-Hu antibodies. Only one other case of mediastinal seminoma with anti-Hu antibodies has been reported.

title: Targeting oncogenic microRNAs from the miR-371~373 and miR-302/367 clusters in malignant germ cell tumours causes growth inhibition through cell cycle disruption.
title_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍におけるmiR-371~373およびmiR-302/367クラスターの発がん性マイクロRNAのターゲティングは細胞周期破壊を通じた増殖阻害を引き起こす
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: miR-371~373およびmiR-302/367クラスターはすべての悪性胚細胞腫瘍で過剰発現される。本研究はCRISPR、ギャップマーおよび核酸阻害剤を用いてこれらのマイクロRNA(miRNA)を機能的にターゲティングした。LNA-DNA阻害は特にセミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞で細胞周期破壊を通じた増殖阻害を実証し、潜在的治療アプローチを示している。
summary_en: MiR-371~373 and miR-302/367 clusters are overexpressed in all malignant germ cell tumors. This study functionally targeted these microRNAs using CRISPR, gapmer, and nucleic acid inhibitors. LNA-DNA inhibition demonstrated growth inhibition through cell cycle disruption, particularly in seminoma and yolk sac tumor cells, representing a potential therapeutic approach.

title: An Extremely Rare Case of Poorly Differentiated Thyroid Carcinoma Arising in Malignant Struma Ovarii and Concurrent Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma: A Case Study.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫に由来する未分化甲状腺癌および併発乳頭状甲状腺癌の極めて稀な症例：症例研究
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は50%以上の甲状腺組織を有する稀な卵巣奇形腫(すべての卵巣腫瘍の0.01%)である。悪性転化は極めて稀である。本症例は卵巣甲状腺腫内の未分化甲状腺癌と併発原発性甲状腺癌を呈する唯一の症例で、報告されているPDTC卵巣甲状腺腫症例10例中では詳密な病理学的検査の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: Struma ovarii is a rare ovarian teratoma with >50% thyroid tissue (0.01% of ovarian tumors). Malignant transformation is extremely rare. This case uniquely presents poorly differentiated thyroid carcinoma (PDTC) within struma ovarii with concurrent primary thyroid cancer—the only such case among 10 reported PDTC-struma ovarii cases, emphasizing the importance of meticulous pathological examination.

title: Paraneoplastic Hypercholesterolemia Identified in an Adult Male Diagnosed With Metastatic Yolk Sac Tumor.
title_ja: 転移性卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された成人男性で同定された傍腫瘍症候群性高コレステロール血症
summary_ja: 肝転移と肺転移を呈した52歳男性の転移性卵黄嚢腫瘍症例。著明な高コレステロール血症（>800 mg/dL）とAFP>24,000 ng/mLを伴う。卵黄嚢腫瘍に関連する傍腫瘍高コレステロール血症の初報告。
summary_en: Case of 52-year-old male with metastatic yolk sac tumor (major histologic subtype of germ cell tumor) presenting with hepatomegaly, pulmonary nodules, and severe hypercholesterolemia (>800 mg/dL). AFP >24,000 ng/mL. First reported case of paraneoplastic hypercholesterolemia associated with yolk sac tumor.

title: [A Case of Testicular Cancer with Solitary Iliac Bone Metastasis].
title_ja: 孤立性腸骨転移を伴う精巣がんの症例
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌70%、未熟奇形腫、セミノーマ30%)を呈する23歳患者が孤立性腸骨転移で提示された症例。BEP化学療法とデノスマブで治療。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)正常化と骨化回復を達成し、厳密なフォローアップで最後の化学療法から45カ月の無病生存を継続中。
summary_en: Case of 23-year-old with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (embryonic carcinoma 70%, immature teratoma, seminoma 30%) presenting with solitary iliac bone metastasis. Treated with BEP chemotherapy and denosumab. Achieved AFP normalization and ossification recovery; disease-free at 45 months with close follow-up.

title: Pediatric retroperitoneal non-organ-originated malignancies: An analysis based on SEER database.
title_ja: 小児後腹膜非臓器由来悪性腫瘍：SEERデータベースに基づく分析
summary_ja: SEER データベース分析(2000～2019年)では、小児後腹膜非臓器由来悪性腫瘍443例中、神経芽細胞腫に次いで胚細胞腫瘍が2番目に多い病理学的分類である。10年全生存率70.7%; 診断時の転移性疾患は42.9%。完全切除と早期診断が主要な予後因子である。
summary_en: SEER database analysis of 443 pediatric retroperitoneal non-organ-originated malignancies (2000-2019). Germ cell tumors were second most common histology after neuroblastoma. Overall 10-year survival 70.7%; metastatic disease present at diagnosis in 42.9%. Complete resection and early diagnosis are key prognostic factors.

title: Renal vein thrombosis due to metastatic germ cell tumor, report of a case with a very rare clinical scenario.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍による腎静脈血栓症、非常に稀な臨床シナリオを呈する症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後14カ月に肺、腎、傍大動脈リンパ節転移を発症した35歳非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の症例。画像検査は腎静脈内に奇形腫成分を含む転移性病変を明らかにした。血管内侵襲の特定が外科計画において極めて重要であることを強調する。
summary_en: Case of 35-year-old with stage IS non-seminomatous germ cell tumor developing lung, kidney, and para-aortic lymph node metastases 14 months post-orchiectomy. Imaging revealed metastatic lesion with teratomatous component in renal vein. Emphasizes importance of identifying endovascular involvement for surgical planning.

title: Timely Laparoscopic Intervention for Ovarian Tumor-related Autoimmune Encephalitis: A Challenging Pathology at Tu Du Hospital in Vietnam and Literature Review.
title_ja: 卵巣腫瘍関連自己免疫性脳炎に対する適時な腹腔鏡下介入：ベトナムトゥドゥ病院における困難な病理および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎に関連した卵巣奇形腫(胚細胞腫瘍)を有する39歳女性の症例。腹腔鏡下奇形腫摘除後、2カ月の昏睡状態を経て完全回復。卵巣奇形腫と自己免疫性脳炎との重要な関連性および迅速な腫瘍摘除の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: Case of 39-year-old woman with anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma (germ cell tumor). Laparoscopic removal of teratoma led to complete recovery after 2 months. Highlights important association between ovarian teratomas and autoimmune encephalitis and importance of prompt tumor removal.

title: Cervicomedullary junction mature teratoma with pulmonary differentiation and diastematomyelia in an adult - A rare case.
title_ja: 成人における肺分化を伴う頸髄移行部成熟奇形腫と脊髄髄核解離-稀な症例
summary_ja: 52歳女性の脊髄頸髄移行部成熟奇形腫症例。I型脊髄二分症を合併。手術的切除により症状消失。肺分化を伴う成熟囊胞奇形腫で成人での椎管内外腫瘍としては稀。
summary_en: Case of symptomatic mature teratoma at cervicomedullary junction in 52-year-old female with concurrent type I diastematomyelia. Tumor surgically resected with symptom resolution. Histopathology showed mature cystic teratoma with pulmonary differentiation, a rare intradural extramedullary presentation in adults.

title: Bilateral Ovarian Torsion Due to a Giant Mucinous Cystadenoma, Contralateral Mature Teratoma, and Paratubal Cyst in a Young Adult.
title_ja: 巨大粘液性嚢胞腺腫、対側成熟奇形腫、および傍卵管嚢胞による若年成人の両側卵巣捻転
summary_ja: 24歳女性が両側卵巣捻転を呈し、30 cm粘液性嚢胞腺腫、10 cm成熟奇形腫(胚細胞腫瘍)、および8 cm傍卵管嚢胞による三者構成。液体穿刺後の一塊切除で管理。両側捻転の極めて稀な発生および生殖能力保存の考慮を強調する。
summary_en: Case of 24-year-old female with bilateral ovarian torsion caused by triad of masses: 30 cm mucinous cystadenoma, 10 cm mature teratoma (germ cell tumor), and 8 cm paratubal cyst. Emergency surgery with controlled aspiration and en bloc resection. Highlights rarity of bilateral torsion and fertility preservation considerations.

title: Primary hepatic metastatic epitheloid trophoblastic tumor of the uterus treated with multimodal therapy including pembrolizumab and thermoablation. Case report of an extremely rare disease and review of the literature.
title_ja: 子宮の上皮様栄養膜腫瘍の肝転移に対するペムブロリズマブと熱焼灼術を含む多次元療法:稀な疾患の症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 類上皮絨毛腫瘍の肝転移を伴う46歳女性症例。化学療法、手術、熱焼灼、ペムブロリズマブ免疫療法で治療し4年無病生存。他の妊娠絨毛性疾患と比べて稀で、hCG産生低く、診断困難で化学療法抵抗性。
summary_en: Case of 46-year-old female with epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) and hepatic metastasis treated with multimodal therapy including chemotherapy, surgery, thermoablation, and pembrolizumab. Patient disease-free at 4 years. Notes ETT's rarity, low hCG production, diagnostic challenges, and relative chemoresistance.

title: Unusual Location of Residual Mass in an Uncorrected Undescended Testis with Germ Cell Tumor.
title_ja: 未治療停留精巣における胚細胞腫瘍の異常位置の残存腫瘤
summary_ja: 33歳男性の未治療停留精巣に伴う胚細胞腫瘍による転移性疾患。化学療法後の膀胱後腔における残存腫瘤が転移と確認された。転移範囲と血管浸襲の正確な評価の重要性が強調される。
summary_en: Case of 33-year-old man with undescended testis complicated by germ cell tumor with metastatic spread. After chemotherapy, residual mass found in retrovesical space. Histology confirmed testicular germ cell tumor metastasis. Emphasizes importance of accurate assessment of metastatic extent and vascular involvement.

title: SYNCHRONOUS DIAGNOSIS OF TESTICULAR AND THYROID CANCER IN A YOUNG MALE.
title_ja: 若年男性における精巣がんと甲状腺癌の同時性診断
summary_ja: 若年男性における非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍と乳頭状甲状腺癌の同時性症例。両悪性腫瘍にRAS遺伝子とBRAF遺伝子の共通の遺伝的変異があり、BRAF-V600Eが両者で陽性であることから遺伝的素因の可能性が示唆される。
summary_en: Case of synchronous non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor and papillary thyroid carcinoma in young male. Discusses shared genetic alterations in RAS and BRAF genes suggesting common pathogenetic background. BRAF-V600E positive in both malignancies, indicating genetic predisposition rather than treatment-related oncogenesis.

title: Retracted: CBR3-AS1 Accelerates the Malignant Proliferation of Gestational Choriocarcinoma Cells by Stabilizing SETD4.
title_ja: 撤回:CBR3-AS1はSETD4の安定化によって妊娠性絨毛癌細胞の悪性増殖を加速させる
summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛がんに関する撤回論文。妊娠絨毛性疾患の稀な悪性腫瘍で集学的治療を要する。細胞増殖の分子機構を検討。注：論文は撤回されている（DOI: 10.1155/2022/7155525）。
summary_en: Retracted study on gestational choriocarcinoma, a rare malignant gestational trophoblastic disease requiring multidisciplinary treatment. Examined molecular mechanisms of cell proliferation in gestational choriocarcinoma. Note: This article has been retracted (DOI: 10.1155/2022/7155525).

title: A rare case of squamous cell carcinoma associated with a huge ovarian dermoid cyst in a postmenopausal woman.
title_ja: 閉経後女性における巨大卵巣類皮嚢腫に伴う扁平上皮癌の稀な症例
summary_ja: 65歳の閉経後女性における成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化による高分化扁平上皮癌の症例。高齢、巨大な腫瘍サイズ、多量の固形成分が悪性転化の危険因子。標準的治療ガイドラインが不足していることが課題。
summary_en: Case of 65-year-old postmenopausal woman with malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma to well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma. Emphasizes need for high suspicion of malignancy in elderly patients with large tumors and significant solid components. Notes rarity of SCC from MCT and lack of standard treatment guidelines.

title: Testicular Cancer: The Unmet Needs of a Younger Generation of Cancer Survivors.
title_ja: 精巣がん:若い世代のがん生存者の未充たされたニーズ
summary_ja: 精巣がん若年患者の未充たされた包括的ニーズのレビュー。90%以上の治癒率で30-50年の生存期間が期待され、生存期間全体を通じた専門的支援が必要。独特のニーズに対応する戦略が重要。
summary_en: Clinical review of unmet holistic needs of younger men with testicular cancer survivors. High cure rates (>90% with early detection) result in 30-50 year life expectancy, requiring specialized support across survivorship. Emphasizes need for provider strategies addressing unique psychosocial and physical needs.

title: Co-Existence of Endometriosis with Ovarian Dermoid Cysts: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
title_ja: 子宮内膜症と卵巣類皮嚢腫の併存：後方視的コホート研究
summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫を有する女性の26.5%が子宮内膜症を併存。卵巣予備能や妊娠能に影響を与える可能性があり、術前カウンセリングで両疾患の認識と生殖能保存オプション説明が重要。
summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of 985 women with endometriosis and 83 with ovarian dermoid cysts (mature teratomas/germ cell tumors). Found 22 women with both conditions; 26.5% of women with dermoid cysts also had endometriosis. Emphasizes need for awareness and fertility preservation counseling.

title: Radiation Therapy for Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia: Forward-Looking Lessons Learnt.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する放射線療法：前向きな教訓
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の放射線療法の役割を検討したナラティブレビュー。侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に対する化学療法、手術、放射線療法の多学科的プロトコール。既存研究は小規模で後方視的であり、最新技術評価が必要。
summary_en: Narrative review of radiotherapy role in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (invasive moles, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumors). Discusses multidisciplinary protocols combining chemotherapy, surgery, and radiotherapy. Notes most studies are small and retrospective; modern techniques need further evaluation.

title: Causes of death among patients with testicular cancer during the survivorship.
title_ja: 生存期間中の精巣がん患者の死亡原因
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者27,143例の死因分析。肺・大腸がん、第二悪性腫瘍、心疾患、事故、自殺が主要死因。局所進行例は一般人口より非がん死亡リスク低い。転移例はがん関連死亡高率。
summary_en: Analysis of causes of death in 27,143 testicular cancer patients. Leading causes included lung/colon cancers, second malignancies, cardiac disease, accidents, and suicide. Localized TC patients had lower non-cancer mortality than general population; metastatic cases had higher TC-related deaths.

title: Secondary somatic glioblastoma arising from a mature ovarian cystic teratoma in a patient with underlying Li-Fraumeni syndrome.
title_ja: Li-Fraumeni症候群を基礎疾患とする患者における成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた二次的体細胞神経膠芽腫
summary_ja: Li-Fraumeni症候群患者の成熟卵巣囊胞奇形腫からの二次性神経膠芽腫発生の初報告。MCTから神経膠芽腫が発生した場合の遺伝的素因調査の重要性。IDH1野生型で攻撃的経過。
summary_en: First reported case of secondary somatic glioblastoma arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma in patient with Li-Fraumeni syndrome. Highlights importance of investigating genetic predisposition when glioblastoma develops from mature teratoma. Demonstrates aggressive behavior with wild-type IDH1 status.

title: A massive immature mediastinal teratoma treated with chemotherapy and surgical resection: a case report.
title_ja: 化学療法および外科的切除で治療された巨大未熟縦隔奇形腫:症例報告
summary_ja: 24歳患者の巨大未熟縦隔奇形腫（190×150×140 mm）症例。化学療法と胸部切開で治療。未熟縦隔奇形腫の稀少性と診断における放射線学的・病理学的評価の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case of 24-year-old with massive (190×150×140 mm) immature mediastinal teratoma treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by thoracotomy. Highlights rarity of immature mediastinal teratomas and importance of radiological and pathological assessment for diagnosis.

title: Adult Onset Sacrococcygeal Teratoma.
title_ja: 成人発症仙尾部奇形腫
summary_ja: 新生児では一般的だが成人での発症は極めて稀な仙尾部奇形腫（胚細胞腫瘍）の56歳女性症例。大多数が良性嚢胞性であり悪性転化は1～2%のみ。診断は放射線検査で偶発的、治療は完全な手術切除が標準。
summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal teratoma (germ cell tumor) in 56-year-old female. SCT most common in newborns but rarely in adults. Majority are benign cystic lesions with only 1-2% malignant transformation. Complete surgical excision is standard treatment.

title: [(18)F]fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography characteristics of primary mediastinal germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の[(18)F]フルオロデオキシグルコース陽電子放射断層撮影/コンピュータ断層撮影の特性
summary_ja: 35例の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍（成熟奇形腫24例、セミノーマ4例、卵黄嚢腫瘍5例、混合型2例）をPET/CT分析。SUVmaxは良性と悪性の区別と非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍識別に有用、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)レベルと相関。
summary_en: Study of 35 mediastinal germ cell tumor patients using PET/CT imaging. Analyzed 24 mature teratomas, 4 seminomas, 5 yolk sac tumors, and 2 mixed GCTs. SUVmax showed highest discriminative ability between benign and malignant mediastinal GCTs and correlated with AFP levels.

title: Unexpected finding: Papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in a mature ovarian teratoma - A case report and literature review.
title_ja: 予期しない所見：成熟卵巣奇形腫内に生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌―症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 帝王切開時に偶然発見された右卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した乳頭状甲状腺癌の症例。組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の乳頭状甲状腺癌と診断。TTFおよびサイログロブリン陽性で甲状腺分化を確認。追加治療なく術後7年で再発なし。
summary_en: Case of a 37-year-old woman incidentally found to have right ovarian mature cystic teratoma (20×20×10mm) during cesarean section. Histological examination revealed papillary thyroid carcinoma arising within the teratoma. Immunohistochemistry confirmed thyroid differentiation (TTF1, Thyroglobulin positive). No additional treatment given; patient remains disease-free 7 years post-surgery.

title: A rare case of pulmonary artery embolism with choriocarcinoma: A case report and literature review.
title_ja: 絨毛癌を伴う肺動脈塞栓症の稀な症例―症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 胸痛と発熱で発症した21歳女性の肺動脈原発絨毛癌の症例。当初肺炎と誤診され診断が遅延。PET/CTで高代謝病変を検出；hCG-β値が著しく高値で絨毛癌と確定診断。化学療法に良好に奏効。過去15例の報告のみであり稀少性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of a 21-year-old fertile woman with primary pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma presenting with chest pain and fever. Initial misdiagnosis as pneumonia delayed diagnosis. PET/CT revealed hypermetabolic lesion; markedly elevated hCG-β subunit confirmed choriocarcinoma. Patient underwent chemotherapy with good response. Literature review identified only 15 previously reported cases.

title: Neoplasms in Struma Ovarii: A Review.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫における腫瘍：レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫内の異所性甲状腺組織（ストルマオバリ）内に発生する悪性腫瘍のレビュー。乳頭状甲状腺癌、ストルマルカルチノイド、濾胞甲状腺癌など一般的な悪性腫瘍について論じている。TTF1免疫染色による悪性病変と周囲産婦人科上皮の鑑別と診断援助を強調。
summary_en: Review of malignant neoplasms arising within struma ovarii (ectopic thyroid tissue within mature ovarian teratomas). Discusses common malignancies including papillary thyroid carcinoma, strumal carcinoid, follicular thyroid carcinoma, and other thyroid carcinomas. Emphasizes TTF1 immunostaining utility in differentiating malignant lesions from surrounding gynecologic epithelium to assist diagnosis.

title: Endodermal Sinus Tumor of the Neck: A Rare Presentation.
title_ja: 頸部の卵黄嚢腫瘍:稀な臨床提示
summary_ja: 頸部卵黄嚢腫瘍(性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の稀な提示)を呈した25歳患者の症例報告。1年間の左側頸部腫脹で発症。細針吸引細胞診で胚細胞腫瘍を示唆。診断後、化学療法と広範囲局所切除を施行し、病理組織学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍を確認。
summary_en: Case report of a 25-year-old patient with endodermal sinus tumor (yolk sac tumor) of the neck, a rare presentation of extragonadal germ cell tumor (EGCT). Patient presented with painful left-sided neck swelling for one year. Fine needle aspiration cytology suggested GCT. Following diagnosis, patient received chemotherapy and underwent wide local excision with histologic confirmation of endodermal sinus tumor.

title: Follicular thyroid carcinoma within a struma ovarii: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫内の濾胞性甲状腺癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫内の甲状腺組織（ストルマオバリ）が濾胞甲状腺癌に悪性転化した28歳女性の症例。右下腹部激痛で発症。両側卵管卵巣摘除術、網嚢摘除術、子宮全摘術施行。稀少性と不十分なガイドラインのため管理に課題がある。
summary_en: Case of a 28-year-old woman with struma ovarii (thyroid tissue in mature ovarian teratoma) that underwent malignant transformation to follicular thyroid carcinoma. Patient presented with severe right iliac fossa pain. Treatment included bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, and hysterectomy. Diagnosis confirmed by biopsy; management remains challenging due to rarity.

title: Mature Triphyllic Cystic Teratoma of the Posterior Mediastinum in a Fetus: A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 胎児の後縦隔における成熟三胚葉嚢胞性奇形腫：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 妊娠21週の胎児に診断された右後縦隔の成熟三胚葉嚢胞性奇形腫（グレード0）の症例。3cm大嚢胞性腫瘤は周囲組織の対側シフトを引き起こした。組織学的に透明軟骨、平滑筋、神経組織、呼吸上皮など三胚葉誘導体が認められた。
summary_en: Case report of a 21-week gestation fetus with mature cystic teratoma (grade 0) in right posterior mediastinum. The 3cm cystic mass caused contralateral displacement of surrounding structures. Histological examination revealed derivatives of three germ layers: hyaline cartilage, smooth muscle, nervous tissue, and respiratory epithelium. Discusses prenatal diagnosis and differential diagnosis of fetal mediastinal masses.

title: Underreporting of SMARCB1 alteration by clinical sequencing: Integrative patho-genomic analysis captured SMARCB1/INI-1 deficiency in a vulvar yolk sac tumor.
title_ja: 臨床的シーケンシングによるSMARCB1変異の過少報告：統合的病理ゲノム分析により外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍におけるSMARCB1/INI-1欠損が検出された
summary_ja: 外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍のSMARCB1/INI-1欠損症例報告。SMARCB1変異が体細胞コピー数異常によってNGSで過小報告される可能性を指摘。診断戦略として病理検討、INI1免疫組織化学検査、NGS過小報告の認識が提案されている。
summary_en: Case report of vulvar yolk sac tumor with SMARCB1/INI-1 deficiency, highlighting underreporting of SMARCB1 alterations by next-generation sequencing due to somatic copy number variations. Proposes diagnostic strategy: careful pathology review for rhabdoid cells, INI1 immunohistochemistry confirmation in NGS-negative cases, and awareness of potential NGS underreporting.

title: METTL3 promotes choriocarcinoma progression by activating the miR-935/GJA1 pathway in an m6A-dependent manner.
title_ja: METTL3はm6A依存的にmiR-935/GJA1経路を活性化することで絨毛癌の進行を促進する
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: METTL3がmiR-935/GJA1経路を介して絨毛癌進行を促進するメカニズム研究。miR-935は絨毛癌組織で上昇し、細胞増殖、遊走、侵襲、血管新生を促進。METTL3はm6Aメチル化を介してmiR-935成熟を促進。絨毛癌治療における新規治療標的の可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: Molecular study investigating METTL3's role in choriocarcinoma progression through the miR-935/GJA1 axis. MiR-935 was upregulated in choriocarcinoma tissues and promoted cell proliferation, migration, invasion, and angiogenesis. METTL3 promoted miR-935 maturation through m6A methylation, identifying a novel therapeutic target for choriocarcinoma management.

title: Histopathological and biomarker complete response after neoadjuvant chemotherapy of advanced stage yolk sac tumor of the ovary: A case report and literature review.
title_ja: 卵巣進行期卵黄嚢腫瘍に対する新規補助化学療法後の病理組織学的および腫瘍マーカー完全奏効：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 進行期卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対する術前化学療法(NACT)の治療例。24歳女性患者がNACTと手術により腫瘍サイズ、組織学的検査、腫瘍マーカーにおいて完全寛解を達成。文献レビューで111篇から2症例のみが詳細評価対象となり、進行期卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対するNACTの有用性が示唆された。
summary_en: Case report of a 24-year-old woman with advanced ovarian yolk sac tumor treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by surgery. Patient achieved complete response in tumor size, histopathology, and tumor markers. Literature review of 111 manuscripts identified only 2 additional cases with similar presentation, highlighting rarity and potential benefit of NACT for advanced ovarian yolk sac tumors.

title: Radiomics Analyses to Predict Histopathology in Patients with Metastatic Testicular Germ Cell Tumors before Post-Chemotherapy Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection.
title_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清前の転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における病理組織学予測のためのラジオミクス分析
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者122例の後方視的研究。CTベースラジオミクス機械学習モデルで化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清前の病理組織学(線維化/壊死、奇形腫、生存腫瘍)を予測。最適AUC 0.945。若年患者の過度/過少治療リスク低減の有望なツール。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 122 metastatic non-seminomatous testicular GCT patients. CT-based radiomics machine learning models integrated clinical predictors to predict histopathology (fibrosis/necrosis, teratoma, viable tumor) before post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Support Vector Machine model achieved optimal AUC of 0.945, potentially reducing over/under-treatment in young patients.

title: Physical exercise in patients with testicular cancer treated with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy: pulmonary and vascular endothelial function-an exploratory analysis.
title_ja: ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン化学療法を受けた精巣がん患者における身体運動:肺および血管内皮機能-探索的分析
summary_ja: 転移性精巣がん患者を対象とした無作為化試験の後方視的分析。BEP化学療法中の運動は化学療法後の運動と比較して肺機能(FVC、FEV1、DLCO)をより良く保持し、血管内皮機能障害マーカー(vWF、因子VIII)を低減。1年フォローアップでも有益。
summary_en: Post hoc analysis of a randomized trial examining physical exercise effects during or after BEP chemotherapy in metastatic testicular cancer patients. Exercise initiated during chemotherapy better preserved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, DLCO) and reduced vascular endothelial dysfunction markers (vWF, factor VIII) compared to post-chemotherapy exercise, with benefits sustained at one-year follow-up.

title: Patient with concurrent anti-NMDAR autoimmune encephalitis and immature teratoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 抗NMDAR自己免疫性脳炎と未熟卵巣奇形腫を伴う患者の症例
summary_ja: 卵巣未成熟奇形腫（グレード3）とanti-NMDAR自己免疫脳炎を合併した思春期女性の症例。腫瘍切除後、免疫療法と化学療法の同時投与を受けた。術後フォローアップで再発なし。卵巣奇形腫患者において同時性自己免疫脳炎の認識と適切な管理の重要性が強調された。
summary_en: Case of an adolescent female with grade 3 immature ovarian teratoma concurrent with anti-NMDAR autoimmune encephalitis. Following tumor resection, the patient received combined immunotherapy and chemotherapy. Post-operative follow-up showed no recurrence or sequelae, emphasizing the importance of recognizing concurrent autoimmune encephalitis in patients with ovarian teratoma, particularly immature variants.

title: A Rare Intersection: A Case of Gastric Adenocarcinoma With Yolk Sac Differentiation.
title_ja: 稀な合併:卵黄嚢分化を伴う胃腺癌の症例
summary_ja: 胃における卵黄嚢腫瘍と腺癌成分の共存症例報告(73歳男性)。消化管における稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で、根治的切除と化学療法後に良好な長期生存を達成。
summary_en: Case report of yolk sac tumor coexisting with adenocarcinoma components in stomach of 73-year-old male. Rare extragonadal germ cell tumor in gastrointestinal tract with favorable outcome after curative resection and chemotherapy.

title: Metastatic Testicular Mixed Germ Cell Tumor Presenting as Posterior Scrotal Pain in the Emergency Department: A Case Report.
title_ja: 救急部門に後部陰嚢痛として発症した転移性精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍:症例報告
summary_ja: 救急部門に陰嚢痛の急性発症で呈した転移性精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍症例報告。非典型的な臨床提示にもかかわらず高い臨床的疑いが診断に重要であることを示す症例。
summary_en: Case report of metastatic testicular mixed germ cell tumor presenting with acute posterior scrotal pain to emergency department. Demonstrates importance of clinical suspicion despite atypical presentation.

title: Generalized Lymphatic Anomaly as a Differential Diagnosis of Lytic Lesions.
title_ja: 溶骨性病変の鑑別診断としての全身型リンパ管異常
summary_ja: 性腺外縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者における全身型リンパ管異常の症例報告。化学療法中に溶骨性病変が放射線学的に認められ、複数の生検により異常なリンパ管増殖が病理学的に確認された。骨溶解性病変は多くの異なる病因を持ち、腫瘍性病変に似たものもあるため、特に若年成人患者においてGLAの臨床的疑診が診断アプローチの第一段階であることが強調されている。
summary_en: Case report of generalized lymphatic anomaly (GLA) diagnosed in patient with extragonadal mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who developed lytic lesions during chemotherapy. Highlights GLA in differential diagnosis.

title: Large Retroperitoneal Teratoma Presenting with Unilateral Hydronephrosis in an Infant: A Case Report and Review of the Literature.
title_ja: 乳幼児における一側性水腎症を伴う大型後腹膜奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 左尿管圧迫による水尿管症で発症した乳幼児の後腹膜未熟奇形腫症例。小児腹腔内腫瘍の鑑別診断を検討。
summary_en: Case report of large retroperitoneal immature teratoma (grade 3) in infant presenting with unilateral hydronephrosis from mass effect on ureter. Discusses differential diagnosis of abdominal masses in children.

title: Giant Mature Ovarian Cystic Teratoma in a Pediatric Patient: Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 小児患者における巨大成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 小児の巨大成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。2003年から2023年の16例の文献レビューを含めて、大型腫瘍の外科的治療を検討。
summary_en: Case report of giant mature cystic ovarian teratoma (dermoid cyst) in 10-year-old girl with diameter >15 cm. Reviews 16 additional cases from 2003-2023 and discusses surgical management of large pediatric germ cell tumors.

title: Use of Sotrovimab for COVID-19 in a Patient with International Germ Cell Consensus Classification Poor Prognosis Testicular Germ Cell Tumor.
title_ja: 国際胚細胞腫瘍合意分類による不良予後精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者におけるCOVID-19治療でのソトロビマブの使用
summary_ja: 病期IIIC非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者（不良予後）がCOVID-19を合併した症例報告である。BEP化学療法を継続しながらソトロビマブで同時治療管理した結果、重篤な合併症なく化学療法を完了し、腫瘍マーカー正常化と部分奏効を達成した。免疫抑制下でも治療可能性が高い疾患の同時治療が可能であることを強調している。
summary_en: Case report of stage IIIC non-seminoma testicular germ cell tumor (poor prognosis) patient treated with BEP chemotherapy while managing concurrent COVID-19 with sotrovimab. Demonstrates successful completion of curative therapy despite immunosuppression.

title: Testicular mixed germ cell tumor: A case report.
title_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍（TMGCT）の症例報告であり、典型的な精巣腫大と疼痛ではなく、反復性発熱と左鎖骨上リンパ節腫大で呈現した稀な症例である。病理組織学的特徴と免疫組織化学的検査結果を報告することで、胚細胞腫瘍の認識における診断上の課題と早期診断の重要性を強調した。
summary_en: Case report of testicular mixed germ cell tumor (TMGCT) with atypical presentation of recurrent fever and left supraclavicular lymphadenopathy rather than typical testicular pain. Highlights diagnostic challenges in GCT recognition.

title: A case of sacrococcygeal teratoma associated with antenatally acquired urethrovaginal fistula and hydrocolpos.
title_ja: 出生前に獲得した尿道膣瘻およびハイドロコルポスを伴う仙尾部奇形腫の症例
summary_ja: 先天的尿道膣瘻と水性腟液貯留を合併した新生児の仙尾部奇形腫症例。腫瘍による圧迫に基づく尿路合併症を詳述している。
summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal teratoma with associated urethrovaginal fistula and hydrocolpos in 1-day-old neonate. Discusses tumor pathogenesis and urological complications resulting from mass effects.

title: Prognostic factors for pure ovarian immature teratoma and the role of adjuvant chemotherapy in stage I diseases.
title_ja: 純粋卵巣未熟奇形腫の予後因子と病期Iにおける補助化学療法の役割
summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫155例の予後因子と補助化学療法の役割を検討した研究。腫瘍マーカーと臨床進行期が予後を規定することを示している。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 155 pure ovarian immature teratoma patients examining prognostic factors and role of adjuvant chemotherapy. Demonstrates positive postoperative tumor markers and FIGO stage II-IV as prognostic factors.

title: A mature ovarian teratoma from New Kingdom Amarna, Egypt.
title_ja: 新王国時代アマルナ（エジプト）出土の成熟卵巣奇形腫
summary_ja: 古代エジプト新王国時代の埋葬地から発見された成熟卵巣奇形腫の古病理学的報告。アフリカ大陸における最古の成熟卵巣奇形腫症例である。
summary_en: Paleopathological case report of mature ovarian teratoma recovered from 18-21-year-old female buried at New Kingdom Amarna, Egypt (~1345 BCE). Oldest known example of mature ovarian teratoma from Pharaonic Egypt and Africa.

title: A decade in focus: mixed germ cell tumors with choriocarcinoma components.
title_ja: 10年間の焦点：絨毛癌成分を有する混合型胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: サウジアラビア癌レジストリの10年間分析における絨毛癌成分を有する混合型胚細胞腫瘍33症例の検討。大多数が若年グループ（18～45歳）で発生し、45.5%が診断時に高悪性度病変と遠隔転移を呈現した。全体死亡率は15%で、不良予後と攻撃的な臨床経過を示した。
summary_en: 10-year Saudi Cancer Registry analysis of 33 cases of mixed germ cell tumors with choriocarcinoma components. Demonstrates aggressive behavior with 45.5% high-grade/metastatic presentation and 15% mortality rate.

title: Giant sacrococcygeal teratoma in an infant: a case report with a literature review.
title_ja: 乳幼児における巨大仙尾部奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 乳幼児における巨大仙尾部奇形腫（性腺外未熟奇形腫）の症例報告。出生体重5 kgのうち2.5 kgを占める巨大腫瘤を呈現した新生児。完全切除を行い、病理組織学的検査で性腺外未熟奇形腫を確認。仙尾部奇形腫の組織学的分類と外科的管理について述べ、早期診断の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of large sacrococcygeal teratoma (immature extragonadal germ cell tumor) in neonate weighing 5 kg with 2.5 kg tumor mass. Discusses classification, histopathology, and surgical management of rare embryonal tumor.

title: Germ Cell Tumor Complicated by Mediastinal Mass Syndrome: A Report of Cardiac Arrest to Full Recovery.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に伴う縦隔腫瘍症候群：心停止から完全回復への報告
summary_ja: 性腺外縦隔胚細胞腫瘍が縦隔腫瘍症候群による心停止を合併した症例報告。陽圧換気開始直後に致命的な心停止が発生したが、適切な蘇生処置により成功裏に回復した。学際的アプローチと適時な化学療法開始の重要性を強調し、生命危機的なGCT合併症の管理戦略を示した。
summary_en: Case report of extragonadal mediastinal germ cell tumor complicated by mediastinal mass syndrome with resulting cardiac arrest. Highlights importance of multidisciplinary approach for managing life-threatening GCT complications.

title: Gestational Trophoblastic Disease with Coexisting Progressing Pregnancy: Personalised Treatment Modalities.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患と共存する進行妊娠：個別化された治療モダリティ
summary_ja: 進行中の妊娠と共存する妊娠関連栄養膜疾患の症例分析。胞状奇胎や絨毛癌を含む管理戦略と産前後の監視方法を詳述している。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of five cases of gestational trophoblastic disease coexisting with progressing pregnancy, including hydatidiform moles and invasive moles with choriocarcinoma. Discusses prenatal and postnatal monitoring and management strategies.

title: Retroperitoneal Hematoma as an Atypical Presentation of Choriocarcinoma: A Case Report.
title_ja: 絨毛癌の非典型的提示としての後腹膜血腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 腎動脈仮性動脈瘤破裂による後腹膜血腫で発症した妊娠関連栄養膜疾患の症例。GTNの非典型的な発症形式と血管合併症を強調している。
summary_en: Case report of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (choriocarcinoma) with unusual complication of acute retroperitoneal hematoma from renal artery pseudoaneurysm rupture. Emphasizes atypical presentations and vascular complications of GTN.

title: Fertility outcomes following surgery and multiagent chemotherapy in malignant ovarian germ cell tumor survivors: a survey study.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者における妊孕性温存手術と化学療法後の妊孕性転帰：調査研究
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における妊孕性温存手術後の妊孕性転帰についての調査研究（77例）。85%の妊娠率と80.4%の生児出産率を報告した。手術単独群と化学療法併用群で妊孕性転帰に統計的有意差を認めず、化学療法投与量と妊孕性転帰の間に相関関係もなかった。
summary_en: Survey study of 77 women treated for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors with fertility-sparing surgery. Reports 85% conception rate and 80.4% live birth rate with no significant difference between surgery-only and chemotherapy groups.

title: Regressed Non-metastatic Germ Cell Tumour: A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 転移を伴わない退縮非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の自然退縮を呈現した稀な症例報告である。非セミノーマ性の純粋胎児性癌が全体的に壊死した状態で精巣摘出術で発見された。転移性疾患を伴わない原発腫瘍の自然退縮は稀であり、このような呈現を示す症例は特に注目される。
summary_en: Case report of regressed testicular germ cell tumor, specifically non-seminomatous pure embryonal carcinoma showing spontaneous regression and necrosis. Rare presentation of primary tumor regression without metastatic disease.

title: Benign and Malignant Ovarian Teratomas: Multimodality Imaging Findings With Histopathologic Correlation.
title_ja: 良性および悪性卵巣奇形腫：多モダリティ画像所見と病理組織学的相関
summary_ja: 良性成熟卵巣奇形腫および悪性卵巣奇形腫（未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫の悪性変性を含む）の画像所見と組織病理学的相関を包括的に検討する論文。放射線科医による診断が多学科治療の指針となる。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of imaging findings and histopathologic correlation of benign mature teratomas and malignant ovarian teratomas, including immature teratomas and malignant degeneration. Emphasizes radiologist's role in guiding interdisciplinary care and improving outcomes.

title: A huge mediastinal teratoma in a 14-year-old girl.
title_ja: 14歳の女児における巨大な縦隔奇形腫
summary_ja: 14歳女性の19cm右前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。呼吸困難症状で発見、重要構造圧迫。血管鉗子法による完全摘出で予後良好。巨大縦隔奇形腫に対する外科的マネジメント。
summary_en: A 14-year-old girl presented with dyspnea from a 19 cm right anterior mediastinal mass compressing vital structures. Imaging confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Using hemiclamshell approach with contents aspiration for improved mobilization, complete en bloc resection was achieved. Postoperative course was uneventful with complete symptom resolution, demonstrating surgical management of giant mediastinal teratoma.

title: Seminoma and dysgerminoma: evidence for alignment of clinical trials and de-escalation of systemic chemotherapy.
title_ja: セミノーマとディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）：臨床試験の一致と全身化学療法の治療縮小のための証拠
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと卵巣ジスジェルミノーマの生物学的同等性を実証。同一形態、遺伝子異常（KIT/RAS、12p増幅）、多能性マーカー共通。白金化学療法で生存率>90%だが長期毒性課題。臨床試験統合と化学療法減量戦略を提案。
summary_en: This comprehensive review demonstrates that testicular seminoma and ovarian dysgerminoma are biologically analogous diseases sharing identical morphology, genetic features (KIT/RAS mutations, chromosome 12p amplification), and pluripotency markers. Both achieve >90% survival with BEP chemotherapy but face significant lifelong toxicity. The authors propose unified clinical trials and chemotherapy de-escalation strategies.

title: Establishment and characterization of a non-gestational choriocarcinoma patient-derived xenograft model.
title_ja: 非妊娠性絨毛癌患者由来異種移植モデルの確立と特性化
tags: 基礎・トランスレーショナル
summary_ja: 非妊娠関連絨毛がんのPDXモデル初樹立。原発腫瘍と同様のhCG発現と遺伝子発現プロファイルを維持。シスプラチン、MTX感受性を示し、臨床効果予測とGCT新規治療開発に有用。
summary_en: Researchers established the first patient-derived xenograft (PDX) model of non-gestational choriocarcinoma (NGC). The PDX retained morphological features, elevated hCG expression, and gene expression profiles similar to the primary tumor. RNA sequencing identified 568 dysregulated genes. The model demonstrated sensitivity to cisplatin and methotrexate, predicting clinical drug response.

title: Fertility-Sparing Treatment in Gestational Choriocarcinoma: Evaluating Oncological and Obstetrical Outcomes in Young Patients.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌における妊孕性温存治療：若年患者における腫瘍学的および産科転帰の評価
summary_ja: 若年絨毛がん患者の妊孕性温存治療成績。第一選択化学療法の奏効率72.22%、二次治療後全体的88.88%。出産率22.22%で、6児とも正期産で先天異常なし。
summary_en: This study evaluated fertility-sparing treatment in 18 young patients (≤40 years) with gestational choriocarcinoma (GC). Complete response to first-line chemotherapy was 72.22%; salvage treatment achieved response in progressive cases. Overall complete response was 88.88% with 2 deaths. Birth rate was 22.22% with 6 children born at term and no congenital abnormalities detected.

title: Excellent Outcomes in Children, Adolescents, and Young Adults with Ovarian Germ Cell Tumors Treated by Either Reduced- or Standard-Dose Bleomycin.
title_ja: 減量または標準用量ブレオマイシンで治療した小児、思春期、および若年成人の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の優れた転帰
summary_ja: 小児・若年成人の卵巣悪性GCT 61例を検討。5年全生存率98.3%、無増悪生存率84.9%。減量ブレオマイシンで生存率変わらず、3ヶ月以内の腫瘍マーカー正常化が良好予後と関連。
summary_en: This study analyzed 61 pediatric and young adult patients (≤39 years) with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Five-year overall survival was 98.3% and event-free survival was 84.9%. Reduced bleomycin dose did not compromise survival. Rapid tumor marker normalization within 3 months predicted better outcomes. Long-term toxicity was minimal with manageable peripheral neuropathy.

title: Prognostic accuracy of factors associated with poor outcome in prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
title_ja: 出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫における不良転帰に関連する因子の予後的精度：システマティックレビューとメタ解析
summary_ja: 出生前診断仙尾部奇形腫の予後因子を検討。全体死亡率34.9%。心肥大、高血管性、充実性腫瘍、胎児水腫、胎盤腫大、TFR>0.12が不良予後と関連。
summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated prognostic factors in prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) from 11 studies involving 447 patients. Overall mortality was 34.9%. Poor prognostic factors included cardiomegaly, hypervascular tumor, solid morphology, fetal hydrops, placentomegaly, and tumor-to-fetal-weight ratio >0.12 before 24 weeks.

title: A systematic review of pN0 testicular seminoma: a new clinical entity and future directions.
title_ja: pN0精巣セミノーマのシステマティックレビュー：新しい臨床実体と今後の方向性
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマのpN0病変（後腹膜リンパ節郭清で陰性）の発生率0-22%を検証。小さいリンパ節やmiRNA-371陰性が関連。治療効率化と診断精度向上の課題。
summary_en: This systematic review examined pN0 (pathologically node-negative) disease in testicular seminoma patients undergoing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection despite enlarged nodes. pN0 rates ranged 0-22% across studies. Associations with smaller lymph nodes and negative serum miRNA-371 were identified, highlighting potential historical overtreatment and opportunities to improve staging accuracy.

title: Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia-A Retrospective Analysis of Patients Treated at a Tertiary Care Oncology Center in North India.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍：インド北部の三次医療腫瘍センターで治療を受けた患者の後方視的分析
summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患39例の治療成績。WHO危険度層別化に基づく化学療法（MTX/actinomycin D またはEMACO）で、低危険度85.7%、高危険度87.5%の奏効率。二次治療の成功例も報告。
summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 39 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) patients used WHO risk stratification. Low-risk patients (n=14) received single-agent methotrexate/actinomycin D with 85.7% response rate; high-risk patients (n=25) received EMACO with 87.5% response rate. Salvage therapy achieved response in nonresponders, with outcomes dependent on WHO score and metastasis location.

title: Testicular cancer: new developments, molecular pathology, and current research keynote.
title_ja: 精巣がん：新展開、分子病理学、および現在の研究トピック
summary_ja: 精巣GCTの治療成績>95%、病理用語統一、IGCCCG危険度層別化、腫瘍マーカー（AFP、hCG）、マイクロRNAバイオマーカーを総説。診断・治療モニタリングの進展。
summary_en: This review comprehensively discusses testicular germ cell tumors (GCTs), which now achieve >95% overall cure rates. It covers standardized pathological terminology, the IGCCCG risk stratification model, prognostic determinants including serum markers (AFP, hCG), and emerging microRNA biomarkers for noninvasive diagnosis and treatment monitoring of seminomas and non-seminomatous GCTs.

title: A non-pregnant woman with elevated beta-HCG: A rare case of ovarian seminoma.
title_ja: β-hCG上昇を伴う非妊娠女性：卵巣セミノーマの稀な症例
summary_ja: 15歳女性の卵巣ジスジェルミノーマ（FIGO IC）症例。腫瘍マーカー上昇と腹膜転移を伴い、妊孕性温存化学療法で良好な転帰。若年卵巣GCT患者の管理戦略。
summary_en: A 15-year-old female presented with ovarian dysgerminoma (FIGO IC), elevated CA-125 levels, and peritoneal involvement. After right adnexectomy and fertility-sparing polychemotherapy, the patient achieved satisfactory disease progression. The case demonstrates clinical management strategies and favorable outcomes in young patients with ovarian germ cell tumors.

title: Advances in radiation therapy for testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法の進歩
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの放射線療法の役割と最新治療戦略を検証。従来の術後照射から化学放射線療法や手術併用への転換、二次発がんリスク軽減戦略を紹介。治癒率95%以上。
summary_en: This review evaluates radiation therapy advances for testicular seminoma, a highly radiosensitive and curable GCT. Recent developments include combined chemoradiation and surgical approaches for clinical stage II disease, with strategies to reduce secondary malignancy risk while maintaining cure rates exceeding 90%. Discussion of shifting from adjuvant RT to surveillance in stage I disease.

title: Comparison of the diagnostic efficiency between the O-RADS US risk stratification system and doctors' subjective judgment.
